records.title_en: Financing Competitors: Shadow Banks’ Funding and Mortgage Market Competition
records.title_cn: 为竞争对手融资：影子银行的资金来源与抵押贷款市场竞争
records.abstract_en: Using novel shadow bank funding data, I find that shadow banks are funded by the very banks they compete with when originating mortgages. Evidence suggests that banks have market power in the upstream market for shadow banks’ funding, which in turn softens mortgage market competition through their strategic behaviors in both markets. I build and calibrate a quantitative model of vertical integration and competition to show that those consumers who would most benefit from shadow bank services are the ones to bear the costs. Secondary market innovation could increase downstream competition by reducing shadow banks’ reliance on their competitors. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 利用新颖的影子银行融资数据，我发现影子银行在发放抵押贷款时，其资金来源正是它们所竞争的银行。证据表明，银行在影子银行融资的上游市场中拥有市场势力，这反过来通过它们在两个市场中的战略行为削弱了抵押贷款市场的竞争。我构建并校准了一个关于纵向一体化和竞争的定量模型，以表明那些最能从影子银行服务中受益的消费者恰恰是承担成本的人。二级市场创新可以通过减少影子银行对其竞争对手的依赖来增强下游竞争。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Shocked by Bank Funding Shocks: Evidence from Consumer Credit Cards
records.title_cn: 银行融资冲击的冲击：来自消费者信用卡的证据
records.abstract_en: Using the near universe of U.S. consumer credit cards, we show that banks transmit their wholesale funding shocks to consumers by reducing their credit card limits. Credit-constrained consumers who are unable to hedge against the transmitted shock by accessing other credit cards experience a stronger and more persistent reduction in aggregate credit card limits at the consumer level. Consequently, these credit-constrained consumers reduce their aggregate credit card borrowing. Our results document a credit card lending channel for the transmission of adverse bank shocks and show who bears the costs of fragile bank funding structures. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 利用近乎全量的美国消费者信用卡数据，我们表明银行通过降低信用卡额度将批发融资冲击传导给消费者。受信贷约束的消费者若无法通过使用其他信用卡来对冲传导的冲击，其在消费者层面的总信用卡额度将经历更强烈且更持久的减少。因此，这些受信贷约束的消费者减少了总信用卡借款。我们的结果记录了信用卡贷款渠道在不利银行冲击传导中的作用，并揭示了谁承担了脆弱银行融资结构的成本。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Liquidity Constraints, Consumption, and Debt Repayment: Evidence from Macroprudential Policy in Turkey
records.title_cn: 流动性约束、消费与债务偿还：来自土耳其宏观审慎政策的证据
records.abstract_en: Using account-level credit card data from a large Turkish bank, we study the impact of a unique credit card policy that increases minimum payment on consumption and debt repayment. We show that the policy reduces credit card spending and debt, boosts existing debt repayment, and reduces credit card delinquency. The credit card debt of affected consumers falls on average by 50$\%$ two years into the policy’s implementation. An increase in minimum payment has a stronger effect than does a decrease of a similar magnitude. We build a benchmark life cycle model with soft liquidity constraint to explain the reduction in credit card spending. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一家大型土耳其银行的账户级信用卡数据，我们研究了一项独特的信用卡政策的影响，该政策提高了最低还款额，对消费和债务偿还产生影响。我们表明，该政策减少了信用卡支出和债务，促进了现有债务的偿还，并降低了信用卡违约率。受影响的消费者的信用卡债务在政策实施两年后平均下降了50。最低还款额的增加比同等幅度的减少具有更强的影响。我们构建了一个具有软流动性约束的基准生命周期模型来解释信用卡支出的减少。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Adjusting to Macroprudential Policies: Loan-to-Value Limits and Housing Choice
records.title_cn: 适应宏观审慎政策：贷款价值比限制与住房选择
records.abstract_en: This study provides novel evidence regarding the effects of loan-to-value (LTV) limits on housing choices. Using a detailed loan-level dataset, I exploit the introduction of LTV limits in Israel. I find that the LTV limits led borrowers to choose housing units that were more affordable, farther from the central business district, and in lower socioeconomic neighborhoods. Additionally, these LTV limits increase interest rates and decrease loan amounts. The findings of this study indicate that macroprudential policies, which focus on the stability of the financial system, have micro implications on location choices, commuting costs, and movement to less-advantaged areas.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了关于贷款价值比（LTV）限制对住房选择影响的新证据。利用详细的贷款级数据集，我利用了以色列引入LTV限制的机会。我发现LTV限制导致借款人选择更负担得起的住房单元，这些单元距离中央商务区更远，且位于社会经济地位较低的社区。此外，这些LTV限制提高了利率并减少了贷款金额。本研究的发现表明，关注金融体系稳定性的宏观审慎政策，对地点选择、通勤成本以及向弱势地区的迁移具有微观影响。

records.title_en: Financial Crises and the Transmission of Monetary Policy to Consumer Credit Markets
records.title_cn: 金融危机与货币政策向消费信贷市场的传导
records.abstract_en: How does creditor health affect the pass-through of monetary policy to households? Using data on the universe of U.S. credit unions, I document that creditor asset losses increase the sensitivity of consumer credit to monetary policy. Identification exploits plausibly exogenous variation in asset losses and high-frequency identification of monetary policy shocks. Weaker lenders can respond more if they face financial frictions that easing alleviates. The estimates imply constraints on monetary policy become more costly in financial crises featuring creditor asset losses and that an additional benefit of monetary easing is that it weakens the causal, contractionary effect of asset losses. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 债权人健康状况如何影响货币政策向家庭的传导？利用美国信用合作社的总体数据，我记录了债权人资产损失增加了消费信贷对货币政策的敏感性。识别利用了资产损失的外生变异和货币政策冲击的高频识别。较弱的贷款人如果面临宽松政策缓解的金融摩擦，可能反应更大。估计表明，在债权人资产损失的金融危机中，货币政策的约束成本更高，而货币宽松的一个额外好处是削弱了资产损失的因果性紧缩效应。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Stock Market Stimulus
records.title_cn: 股市刺激
records.abstract_en: We study the stock market effects of the arrival of the three rounds of “stimulus checks” to U.S. taxpayers and the single round of direct payments to Hong Kong citizens. The first two rounds of U.S. checks appear to have increased retail buying and share prices of retail-dominated portfolios. The Hong Kong payments increased overall turnover and share prices on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. We cannot rule out that these price effects were permanent. The findings raise novel questions about the role of fiscal stimulus in the stock market. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国纳税人三轮“刺激支票”和香港市民单轮直接付款对股市的影响。美国前两轮支票似乎增加了散户购买和散户主导投资组合的股价。香港的付款增加了香港交易所的整体成交量和股价。我们不能排除这些价格影响是永久性的。这些发现引发了关于财政刺激在股市中作用的新问题。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Does the Federal Reserve Obtain Competitive and Appropriate Prices in Monetary Policy Implementation?
records.title_cn: 美联储在货币政策实施中是否获得了竞争性和适当的价格？
records.abstract_en: Many of the Federal Reserve’s (the Fed’s) monetary policy operations involve trading with primary dealers. We find that, for agency MBS, dealers charge 2.5 cents (per $100 face value) higher selling to the Fed than to non-Fed customers. Controlling for the same dealer, same security, and same trading time, this discriminatory pricing likely arises from dealers’ market power rather than inventory costs. Further, matching trade size reduces the price differential by more than half, implying that dealers’ market power greatly relates to the Fed’s purchases in large amounts, whereas the Fed’s limited breadth of counterparty choice also plays some role.
records.abstract_cn: 美联储的许多货币政策操作涉及与一级交易商的交易。我们发现，对于机构抵押贷款支持证券，交易商向美联储出售的价格比向非美联储客户出售的价格高出2.5美分（每100美元面值）。在控制同一交易商、同一证券和同一交易时间的情况下，这种歧视性定价可能源于交易商的市场力量而非库存成本。此外，匹配交易规模使价格差异减少一半以上，这表明交易商的市场力量与美联储的大额购买密切相关，而美联储对手方选择范围有限也起了一定作用。

records.title_en: When Do Low-Frequency Measures Really Measure Effective Spreads? Evidence from Equity and Foreign Exchange Markets
records.title_cn: 低频度量何时真正衡量有效价差？来自股票和外汇市场的证据
records.abstract_en: We present evidence that several popular low-frequency measures of effective spread suffer from a volatility-induced bias and that volatility is the primary driver of the variation of these liquidity proxies. Using data for U.S. equities and major foreign exchange rates, we show that the bias arises when the effective spread is small relative to volatility. We document that the bias has become more acute over time and show that volatility-biased measures fail to replicate some well-known results in empirical finance. We conclude by providing guidance on the choice of low-frequency measures in empirical applications. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供的证据表明，几种流行的有效价差低频度量存在波动性引起的偏差，且波动性是这些流动性代理变量变化的主要驱动因素。利用美国股票和主要外汇汇率的数据，我们表明当有效价差相对于波动性较小时，偏差就会出现。我们记录了偏差随时间变得更加严重，并表明波动性偏差的度量无法复制实证金融中一些众所周知的结果。最后，我们为实证应用中选择低频度量提供了指导。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: International Portfolio Choice with Frictions: Evidence from Mutual Funds
records.title_cn: 摩擦下的国际投资组合选择：来自共同基金的证据
records.abstract_en: Using data on international equity portfolio allocations by U.S. mutual funds, we estimate a portfolio expression derived from a standard mean-variance portfolio model extended with portfolio frictions. The optimal portfolio depends on the previous month and the buy-and-hold portfolio shares, and a present discounted value of expected excess returns. We estimate expected return differentials and use them in the portfolio regressions. The estimates imply significant portfolio frictions and a modest rate of risk aversion. While mutual fund portfolios significantly respond to expected returns, portfolio frictions lead to a weaker and a more gradual portfolio response to changes in expected returns. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 利用美国共同基金的国际股票投资组合配置数据，我们估计了一个由标准均值-方差投资组合模型扩展而来的投资组合表达式，该模型包含了投资组合摩擦。最优投资组合取决于上个月和买入并持有的投资组合份额，以及预期超额收益的现值折现。我们估计预期收益差异，并将其用于投资组合回归中。估计结果显示出显著的投资组合摩擦和适度的风险厌恶率。虽然共同基金投资组合对预期收益有显著反应，但投资组合摩擦导致投资组合对预期收益变化的反应更弱且更渐进。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: The value of relationships in healthcare
records.title_cn: 医疗保健中关系的价值
records.abstract_en: Many interactions between buyers and sellers occur in the context of relationships. In healthcare markets, the patient-primary care physician (PCP) relationship is one common example. I provide evidence that patient-PCP relationships are valued by patients and are good for patients’ health. In response to an exogenous loss of a longstanding PCP, adverse events increase: patient mortality increases by 4%, emergency department visits increase by 4%, and hospital admissions increase by 3%. Adverse events increase with the length of the exiting PCP-patient relationship, suggesting that relationships contain non-transferable information that positively impacts patients’ health.
records.abstract_cn: 买卖双方之间的许多互动发生在关系的背景下。在医疗保健市场中，患者与初级保健医生（PCP）的关系是一个常见的例子。我提供的证据表明，患者-PCP关系受到患者的重视，并且对患者的健康有益。当长期PCP被外生性失去时，不良事件增加：患者死亡率增加4%，急诊就诊次数增加4%，住院次数增加3%。不良事件随着离职PCP与患者关系长度的增加而增加，这表明关系中包含不可转移的信息，这些信息对患者的健康产生积极影响。

records.title_en: Spatial inequality of opportunity in West Africa
records.title_cn: 西非机会的空间不平等
records.abstract_en: In this paper, I study spatial inequality of opportunity measured in terms of the causal effect place has on primary completion, in Benin, Cameroon, and Mali. Using a movers design I find that on average moving to a one standard deviation better location at birth increases a child’s probability of completing primary school by 15 percentage points. Estimating locality-year and gender-locality-year place effects I show that place matters more for girls than boys and place effects are correlated with local characteristics such as urbanization, access to electricity, and employment in agriculture. Religion is weakly correlated with average causal place effects but strongly correlated with the gender gap in the effect place has on educational attainment.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我研究了以地点对小学完成率的因果效应衡量的机会的空间不平等，研究对象为贝宁、喀麦隆和马里。使用迁移者设计，我发现平均而言，出生时迁移到一个标准差更好的地点会使儿童完成小学的概率提高15个百分点。通过估计地点-年份和性别-地点-年份的地点效应，我表明地点对女孩的影响大于男孩，并且地点效应与城市化、电力获取和农业就业等地方特征相关。宗教与平均因果地点效应弱相关，但与地点对教育成就影响的性别差距强相关。

records.title_en: The spillover effects of labor regulations on the structure of earnings and employment: Evidence from occupational licensing
records.title_cn: 劳动法规对收入与就业结构的溢出效应：来自职业许可的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper measures how labor regulations affect the structure of earnings and employment in other occupations in the context of occupational licensing. Using a state boundary discontinuity design, I estimate the market spillovers of licensing on other occupations with similar skills, which I classify using hierarchical clustering techniques on skills data from O*NET. I find evidence of negative earnings and employment spillovers, with the largest earnings effects concentrated among women, black, and foreign-born Hispanic workers. These effects lead to greater earnings inequality. The results are most consistent with licensing changing skill- and industry-specific labor demand and with a monopsony model where licensing increases search costs and reduces workers’ outside options.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在职业许可的背景下，衡量了劳动法规如何影响其他职业的收入与就业结构。利用州边界断点设计，我估计了许可对具有相似技能的其他职业的市场溢出效应，这些技能分类基于O*NET技能数据的层次聚类技术。我发现了负面的收入与就业溢出证据，其中最大的收入效应集中在女性、黑人和外国出生的西班牙裔工人中。这些效应导致了更大的收入不平等。结果最符合许可改变技能和行业特定劳动力需求，以及垄断模型，其中许可增加了搜索成本并减少了工人的外部选择。

records.title_en: Minimum wage, social insurance mandate, and working hours
records.title_cn: 最低工资、社会保险强制规定与工作时间
records.abstract_en: Raising the minimum wage may have unintended negative consequences for workers. In South Korea, employers are required to contribute towards their employees’ social insurance, with the amount proportional to earnings. However, workers employed for less than 60 h per month are exempt from this contribution requirement. Using administrative payroll records from 2011 to 2019, we find that raising the minimum wage results in a higher share of the exempt workers. Our results remain robust when focusing on unanticipated hikes in the minimum wage in 2018 and 2019.
records.abstract_cn: 提高最低工资可能对工人产生意想不到的负面后果。在韩国，雇主必须为员工缴纳社会保险，金额与收入成比例。然而，每月工作时间少于60小时的工人可免除此缴费要求。利用2011年至2019年的行政工资记录，我们发现提高最低工资导致豁免工人比例上升。当聚焦于2018年和2019年未预期的最低工资上调时，我们的结果依然稳健。

records.title_en: Pareto-improving minimum corporate taxation
records.title_cn: 帕累托改进的最低企业税
records.abstract_en: The international agreement on a minimum effective corporate tax rate, implementation of which is imminent, marks a profound change in global tax arrangements. The appropriate level of that minimum, however, has been, and remains, extremely contentious. This paper explores the strategic responses to a minimum tax, which – the policy objective being to change the rules of the tax competition game – are critical for assessing the design and welfare impact of this fundamental policy innovation. Analysis and calibration plausibly suggest sizable scope for minima that are Pareto-improving, benefiting low tax countries as well as high, relative to the uncoordinated equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 关于最低有效企业税率的国际协议即将实施，标志着全球税收安排发生深刻变化。然而，该最低税率的适当水平一直且仍然是极具争议的。本文探讨了对最低税的战略反应——鉴于政策目标是改变税收竞争游戏的规则——这对于评估这一根本性政策创新的设计和福利影响至关重要。分析和校准合理地表明，相对于无协调均衡，存在相当大的帕累托改进的最低税率空间，使低税收国家和高税收国家均受益。

records.title_en: A mechanism for the efficient provision of Potential Pareto public goods
records.title_cn: 潜在帕累托公共物品有效供给机制
records.abstract_en: Providing a public good that causes a local harm to its host poses two problems previously unexplored together: where to locate it and how large it should be. We propose a mechanism combining some market-like properties with a modified second-price auction. The mechanism selects a host, a facility size, a compensation for hosting the project, and determines how the compensation is split among the non-hosts. If each community bids truthfully for becoming the host–a strategy from which no community has incentives to deviate–the selected allocation is globally optimal, even if communities’ preferences are private information. In contrast with the literature, the host pays the second-highest bid while receiving the market benefits to prevent distortions in the optimal size.
records.abstract_cn: 提供一种对其所在地造成局部损害的公共物品，会带来两个此前未共同探讨的问题：选址何处以及规模多大。我们提出一种机制，将某些市场特性与修正的二价拍卖相结合。该机制选择主办方、设施规模、主办补偿，并确定补偿如何在非主办方之间分配。如果每个社区如实投标成为主办方——这一策略没有任何社区有激励偏离——所选配置即为全局最优，即使社区偏好是私人信息。与文献不同，主办方支付第二高投标价，同时获得市场收益，以防止最优规模出现扭曲。

records.title_en: Where does opportunity knock? On doors that voted for the executive
records.title_cn: 机会在哪里敲门？在投票给行政长官的门上
records.abstract_en: The Trump Tax Bill of 2017 gave U.S. state governors a one-time opportunity to select an exogenously fixed number of census tracts for preferential tax treatment. We model a governors’ choice of tracts to maximize competing goals of mobilizing voters, rewarding co-partisan legislators, and alleviating poverty. We estimate the likelihood that an eligible tract is selected as a function of both the economic characteristics of the tract and the political characteristics of the governor and the relevant state and federal legislators. Our results show that the executive accountability engendered by eligibility for reelection is weakened by the dual constituency hypothesis.
records.abstract_cn: 2017年的特朗普税收法案为美国各州州长提供了一次性机会，选择外生固定数量的普查区以获得优惠税收待遇。我们模拟了州长在选择普查区时，如何在动员选民、奖励同党议员和减轻贫困等竞争目标之间进行权衡。我们估计了一个符合条件的普查区被选中的可能性，该可能性既取决于普查区的经济特征，也取决于州长及相关州和联邦议员的政治特征。我们的结果表明，由连任资格产生的行政问责制被双重选区假说所削弱。

records.title_en: On the optimal reform of income support for single parents
records.title_cn: 关于单亲父母收入支持的最优改革
records.abstract_en: We characterize the optimal reform of U.S. income support for low-income single parents using a life-cycle heterogeneous agent model with idiosyncratic risk and incomplete asset markets. We use the U.S. tax-transfer system as the benchmark policy and a sample of single mothers drawn from the CPS to assess reforms that maximize average expected utility among single mothers-to-be. When policy cannot be tagged by the age of the children, the optimal reform calls for an increase in out-of-work income support by about 15 percent, and a decrease in earnings subsidies to low-wage workers by roughly 50 percent. This reform delivers substantial welfare gains. Tagging policy by the age of the children makes the government’s trade-off between providing insurance to single mothers with children of pre-school age, on the one hand, and providing work incentives to those with school-age children, on the other hand, more favorable, thus increasing their scope for smoothing marginal utility throughout the life cycle. With tagging, mothers of pre-school age children get a substantial increase in out-of-work income support and no earnings subsidies. Tagging brings additional welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个具有异质性风险和资产市场不完全的生命周期异质性主体模型，刻画了美国低收入单亲父母收入支持的最优改革。我们以美国税收-转移支付体系作为基准政策，并使用来自当前人口调查（CPS）的单亲母亲样本，评估旨在最大化准单亲母亲平均预期效用的改革。当政策无法按子女年龄进行标签化时，最优改革要求将失业收入支持提高约15%，并将对低工资劳动者的收入补贴减少约50%。这一改革带来了显著的福利收益。按子女年龄对政策进行标签化，使得政府在为有学龄前子女的单亲母亲提供保险与为有学龄子女的单亲母亲提供工作激励之间的权衡更加有利，从而增加了她们在整个生命周期中平滑边际效用的空间。通过标签化，有学龄前子女的母亲获得大幅增加的失业收入支持，且没有收入补贴。标签化带来了额外的福利收益。

records.title_en: Reservations and the politics of fear
records.title_cn: 预留席位与恐惧政治
records.abstract_en: Reserving political office for members of a specific, usually disadvantaged, group is a common form of political quota in many parts of the world. This has been shown to improve distributional access in favor of reserved groups, but often conjectured (and shown in some cases) to come at the cost of governance quality. We develop a theoretical model to demonstrate that a political quota can, in contrast, improve governance if it weakens a village leader’s hold on power, making them more accountable to their supporters. The model establishes a tight set of predictions regarding when improvements should be expected to occur, and when not. We show, in a Maharashtrian (India) sample of rural villages, that governance outcomes dramatically improve under reservations for some, but not all, villages, and demonstrate a pattern of improvement that lines up with the predictions of the theory.
records.abstract_cn: 为特定（通常是弱势）群体成员预留政治职位是世界许多地区常见的政治配额形式。已有研究表明，这能改善有利于预留群体的分配性获取，但通常被推测（并在某些情况下被证明）会以治理质量为代价。我们构建了一个理论模型，证明政治配额如果削弱了村庄领导人的权力掌控，使其对支持者更加负责，反而可以改善治理。该模型建立了一套关于何时应预期改善、何时不应预期改善的严格预测。我们在印度马哈拉施特拉邦的农村村庄样本中显示，在预留席位下，一些（但并非所有）村庄的治理结果显著改善，并展示了与理论预测相符的改善模式。

records.title_en: The electoral consequences of environmental accidents: Evidence from Chernobyl
records.title_cn: 环境事故的选举后果：来自切尔诺贝利的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the relationship between environmental accidents and voting. Following the 1986 Chernobyl disaster, environmentalist parties entered parliaments in several nations. This paper uses Chernobyl as a natural experiment creating variation in radioactive fallout exposure over Sweden. I match municipality-level data on cesium ground contamination with election results for the environmentalist Green Party, which was elected to parliament in 1988. After adjusting for pre-Chernobyl views on nuclear power, the results show that voters in high-fallout areas were more likely to vote for the Greens. Detailed individual-level survey data suggests that resistance to nuclear energy increased in fallout-effected areas after the accident, and that this change was driven by voters who followed local media closely.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了环境事故与投票之间的关系。在1986年切尔诺贝利灾难之后，环保主义政党进入了多个国家的议会。本文将切尔诺贝利作为自然实验，在瑞典产生了放射性沉降物暴露的差异。我将市政层面的铯地面污染数据与环保主义绿党的选举结果相匹配，该党于1988年当选进入议会。在调整了切尔诺贝利之前对核电的看法后，结果显示，高沉降物地区的选民更有可能投票给绿党。详细的个体层面调查数据表明，在事故后，受沉降物影响地区的核能抵制情绪有所增加，且这一变化是由密切关注当地媒体的选民所驱动的。

records.title_en: Tax competition with two tax instruments — and tax base erosion
records.title_cn: 两种税收工具的税收竞争——以及税基侵蚀
records.abstract_en: We consider a world in which countries apply optimal taxes on mobile capital and savings (like in Bucovetsky and Wilson, 1991). Firms and savers may underreport income to avoid or evade taxation. We show that, even in the presence of underreporting, the equilibrium under tax competition may still be constrained-efficient (in the sense that there is no scope for welfare-enhancing tax coordination). This is the case if the marginal social costs of underreporting savings and investment income are equal. The model demonstrates that, if source-based taxes on capital are inefficiently low, as is often assumed, taxes on savings must be inefficiently high. Constrained-efficient tax policy minimizes the social cost of underreporting. The results are robust to introducing taxes on profit or labor income, if these types of income can be underreported as well. We conclude that commonly held assumptions on the need for coordination under tax competition need to be revised or qualified.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个各国对流动资本和储蓄征收最优税收的世界（如Bucovetsky和Wilson，1991）。企业和储蓄者可能低报收入以避税或逃税。我们表明，即使存在低报，税收竞争下的均衡仍可能是约束有效的（即没有福利改善的税收协调空间）。当低报储蓄和投资收入的边际社会成本相等时，情况即如此。模型表明，如果基于来源的资本税低效地低，正如通常假设的那样，那么储蓄税必然低效地高。约束有效的税收政策最小化低报的社会成本。如果利润或劳动收入也能被低报，则结果对引入这些税收具有稳健性。我们得出结论，关于税收竞争下协调必要性的常见假设需要修正或限定。

records.title_en: The effect of market-based sourcing on labor outcomes
records.title_cn: 市场基础来源对劳动成果的影响
records.abstract_en: This study examines how income tax sourcing rules affect business activity in U.S. states. As technology has enabled companies to provide services to consumers globally, a growing number of governments seek to tax service companies based on the customer location (“market-based sourcing”) rather than the location of the company’s labor and capital. Consistent with market-based sourcing reducing the tax cost of locating marginal labor in the state, I find that state adoption of market-based sourcing increases the total number of employees and total labor earnings in affected service industries by roughly 2 to 5 percent, after controlling for concurrent tax policy changes. I find indirect evidence that the effects are mostly attributable to business expansion rather than employee reallocation across states. Market-based sourcing does not seem to adversely affect state corporate tax revenues. This study provides timely insights for policymakers given increased adoption of market-based sourcing by U.S. states and related international proposals.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了所得税来源规则如何影响美国各州的商业活动。随着技术使公司能够向全球消费者提供服务，越来越多的政府试图根据客户所在地（“市场基础来源”）而非公司劳动力和资本所在地来对服务公司征税。与市场基础来源降低在该州安置边际劳动力的税收成本相一致，我发现，在控制同时期的税收政策变化后，州采纳市场基础来源会使受影响服务行业的总员工人数和总劳动收入增加约2至5%。我发现了间接证据表明，这些影响主要归因于业务扩张，而非跨州的员工重新分配。市场基础来源似乎不会对州企业所得税收入产生不利影响。鉴于美国各州越来越多地采纳市场基础来源以及相关的国际提案，本研究为政策制定者提供了及时的见解。

records.title_en: The costs of bureaucracy and corruption at customs: Evidence from the computerization of imports in Colombia
records.title_cn: 海关官僚主义与腐败的成本：来自哥伦比亚进口计算机化的证据
records.abstract_en: We assess the effects of the computerization of import transactions in Colombia on import volume, port efficiency and the performance of manufacturing firms. Staggered implementation allows us to identify the causal effects of the reform. We find that computerization triggered a significant increase in reported imports in reformed ports compared to nonreformed ones, along with a sizeable increase in tax collection. Our results indicate that a combination of factors underpin the increase in declared imports: an actual increase in firms’ imports, a reduction in import underreporting and a redirection of imports from nonreformed to reformed ports that reveals importers' preference for the latter. Other signs of reduced corruption include increased predictability of clearance times and a reduction in the number of customs-related corruption cases prosecuted by the authorities. Importantly, increased imports lead to better firm performance: in municipalities associated with treated customs, sales of manufacturing firms increased by 5.2% for importers and shrunk by 3.9% for nonimporters. These effects increase over time and are concentrated in small- to medium-sized firms, which appear to have been the most affected by the nontariff barriers before computerization.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了哥伦比亚进口交易计算机化对进口量、港口效率以及制造业企业绩效的影响。分阶段实施使我们能够识别改革的因果效应。我们发现，与非改革港口相比，计算机化显著增加了改革港口的报告进口量，同时税收收入也大幅增加。我们的结果表明，多种因素共同推动了申报进口的增加：企业进口的实际增长、进口低报的减少以及进口从非改革港口转向改革港口，这揭示了进口商对后者的偏好。其他腐败减少的迹象包括清关时间可预测性的提高以及当局起诉的海关相关腐败案件数量的减少。重要的是，进口增加带来了更好的企业绩效：在与处理海关相关的城市，制造业企业的销售额对进口商而言增加了5.2%，对非进口商而言则减少了3.9%。这些效应随时间增强，并集中在中小型企业，这些企业在计算机化之前似乎受非关税壁垒影响最大。

records.title_en: How much violence does football hooliganism cause?
records.title_cn: 足球流氓行为造成了多少暴力？
records.abstract_en: This paper quantifies how much of violent crime in society can be attributed to football-related violence. Exploiting rich crime register data, we study the universe of professional football matches played out in Germany’s top three football leagues over the period 2011–2015. Our main result shows that violent crime increases by 17 percent on a match day, with associated social costs of roughly 58 million euros annually. Exploring possible mechanisms, we find that the match day effect can be attributed to violence among males in the 18–39 age group, rises to 63 percent on days with high-rivalry derby matches, and that a non-negligible share of it stems from violent crimes committed by group offenders and assaults on police officers. Most of the facts we document can be accommodated by social identity explanations of football hooliganism, while frustration-aggression theories of sports-related violence can explain only some of the findings in isolation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文量化了社会中暴力犯罪中有多少可归因于与足球相关的暴力。利用丰富的犯罪登记数据，我们研究了2011-2015年期间德国顶级三个足球联赛中所有职业足球比赛。我们的主要结果表明，在比赛日，暴力犯罪增加了17%，相关的社会成本每年约为58万欧元。探索可能的机制，我们发现比赛日效应可归因于18-39岁年龄组男性中的暴力，在高对抗性的德比比赛日上升至63%，并且其中不可忽视的一部分源于群体犯罪者实施的暴力犯罪和对警察的袭击。我们记录的大多数事实可以用足球流氓行为的社会认同解释来容纳，而体育相关暴力的挫折-攻击理论只能孤立地解释部分发现。

records.title_en: Pass-through of subsidies to prices under limited competition: Evidence from Canada’s Nutrition North program
records.title_cn: 有限竞争下补贴向价格的传导：来自加拿大北方营养计划的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the pass-through of Canada’s Nutrition North food subsidy in remote, mainly Indigenous communities with limited competition. Reforms to the program in 2016 and 2019 provide exogenous changes in retailer marginal costs and we show that on average, retail prices were lowered by 67 cents for every additional dollar of subsidy, well below the full pass-through expected under perfect competition. We can precisely characterize the competitive environment for each community, which is typically a retail monopoly or duopoly, and find that the low average pass-through is mostly driven by monopoly communities. Our findings show that resources intended for marginalized communities can be partly captured by local firms with market power.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了加拿大在偏远、主要原住民社区且竞争有限的“北方营养”食品补贴的传导效应。2016年和2019年的项目改革提供了零售商边际成本的外生变化，我们发现平均而言，每增加一美元补贴，零售价格降低了67美分，远低于完全竞争下预期的完全传导。我们可以精确刻画每个社区的竞争环境，通常是零售垄断或双头垄断，并发现低平均传导率主要由垄断社区驱动。我们的研究结果表明，旨在惠及边缘化社区的资源可能部分被拥有市场势力的当地企业所攫取。

records.title_en: How did federal aid to states and localities affect testing and vaccine delivery?
records.title_cn: 联邦对州和地方政府的援助如何影响检测和疫苗交付？
records.abstract_en: We estimate whether large allocations of federal aid for state and local governments played a role in advancing population testing for COVID-19 and the administration of vaccines. To overcome biases that can result from the endogeneity of federal aid allocations, we use an instrumental-variables estimator reliant on the substantial variation in federal aid predicted by variation in states’ congressional representation. We find that federal fiscal assistance dollars had a modest if any impact on the pace of vaccine rollouts, may have improved the equitability of vaccine administration, and had a substantial impact on the volume of tests administered. We observe that the difference in our findings for testing relative to vaccination suggests that surplus funds were more effective at increasing demand for services that exhibit relatively elastic demand, which is socially desirable when those services are associated with substantial public health externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估算了联邦对州和地方政府的巨额援助拨款是否在推进COVID-19人群检测和疫苗管理方面发挥了作用。为了克服联邦援助拨款内生性可能导致的偏差，我们使用了一个工具变量估计器，该估计器依赖于由各州国会代表权变化所预测的联邦援助的显著变化。我们发现，联邦财政援助资金对疫苗推广速度的影响即使有也是适度的，可能改善了疫苗管理的公平性，并对检测数量产生了显著影响。我们观察到，我们的研究结果中检测与疫苗接种之间的差异表明，剩余资金在增加需求弹性相对较大的服务需求方面更为有效，当这些服务与显著公共卫生外部性相关时，这在社会上是有益的。

records.title_en: Occupations, retirement, and the value of disability insurance
records.title_cn: 职业、退休与伤残保险的价值
records.abstract_en: Occupations vary greatly in physical intensity, and there are, correspondingly, many differences in later-life work disability risk, retirement patterns, and applications for Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI)—a national program that insures shocks to work productivity due to disability, with about nine million current beneficiaries in the U.S. In light of its widespread coverage and large differences in utilization across occupations, this paper aims to measure the value of the SSDI program across a broad population and the extent to which it influences the major choice of occupation. Using data from the Health and Retirement Study and O*NET, I estimate a life-cycle equilibrium model of occupational choice, work, savings, and disability at older ages, and find that incorporating occupations and preference heterogeneity is an integral part of understanding work and SSDI application behavior. While SSDI coverage is nearly universal and the premiums from workers are uniform, estimates suggest that the value of the program varies greatly, from being worth 2.1 to 14.5 percent of earned income—depending on preferences and choice of occupation—though for all groups it is welfare improving. I also find that SSDI plays an important role in the choice of occupation for older workers, providing an insurance value that results in over ten percent more people choosing physically intense, blue-collar occupations at older ages. This overall effect, however, masks the underlying selection of less risk-averse individuals into blue-collar jobs, which, if not accounted for, would lead to overstating the effects of the SSDI program on behavior. A counterfactual experiment aimed at eliminating the distortion created by uniform SSDI tax rates shows that—even without any additional employer accommodation of disabled workers—occupation-specific tax rates lead to fewer aggregate work-disabled years.
records.abstract_cn: 职业在体力强度上差异很大，相应地，晚年工作残疾风险、退休模式以及社会保障伤残保险（SSDI）的申请也存在许多差异——SSDI是一项国家计划，为因残疾导致的工作生产力冲击提供保险，目前美国约有九百万受益人。鉴于其广泛的覆盖范围和不同职业间利用率的巨大差异，本文旨在衡量SSDI计划在广泛人群中的价值及其对职业选择这一重要决策的影响程度。利用健康与退休研究以及O*NET的数据，我估计了一个包含职业选择、工作、储蓄和老年残疾的生命周期均衡模型，并发现纳入职业和偏好异质性是理解工作和SSDI申请行为不可或缺的部分。尽管SSDI的覆盖几乎是普遍的，且工人的保费是统一的，但估计表明该计划的价值差异很大，从相当于劳动收入的2.1到14.5%%不等——取决于偏好和职业选择——尽管对所有群体而言，它都改善了福利。我还发现，SSDI在老年工人的职业选择中扮演着重要角色，其提供的保险价值导致超过百分之十的人选择体力强度大的蓝领职业。然而，这一总体效应掩盖了风险规避程度较低的个体选择蓝领工作的潜在选择性，如果不加以考虑，将会高估SSDI计划对行为的影响。一项旨在消除统一SSDI税率所造成的扭曲的反事实实验表明——即使没有雇主对残疾工人的额外便利——职业特定税率也会导致更少的总工作残疾年数。

records.title_en: Wealthy Americans and redistribution: The role of fairness preferences
records.title_cn: 富裕美国人与再分配：公平偏好的作用
records.abstract_en: We examine the attitudes of the wealthy towards government redistribution using a large and diverse sample of individuals from the top 5% of the income and wealth distribution in the U.S., as well as the remaining 95%. Three results stand out: (1) wealthy Americans have distinct fairness preferences, with a greater willingness to accept inequalities relative to the general public, (2) individuals who self-report having experienced upward social mobility and became first-generation wealthy are particularly accepting of inequality, while those born into wealth have fairness preferences similar to the general population; (3) the disparity in fairness preferences between the rich and the general public is predictive of greater opposition to redistribution among the wealthy, resulting in more conservative voting behavior. These findings provide new insights into the reasons behind the wealthy’s opposition to government redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自美国收入和财富分布前5%以及其余95%的大量多样化个体样本，考察了富人对政府再分配的态度。三个结果突出： (1) 富裕美国人具有独特的公平偏好，相比普通公众更愿意接受不平等， (2) 自我报告经历过向上社会流动并成为第一代富人的人尤其接受不平等，而出生富裕的人其公平偏好与普通人群相似； (3) 富人与普通公众之间公平偏好的差异预示着富人对再分配的更大反对，导致更保守的投票行为。这些发现为富人反对政府再分配的原因提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Congestion on the information superhighway: Inefficiencies in economics working papers
records.title_cn: 信息高速公路上的拥堵：经济学工作论文中的低效率
records.abstract_en: Using data on the NBER working paper series, we show that the dissemination of economics research suffers from a congestion problem: An increase in the number of weekly released working papers on average reduces downloads, abstract views, and media attention for each paper. Subsequent publishing and citation outcomes are harmed as well. Papers written by prominent authors are not immune to this congestion effect. Finally, suggestive evidence on viewership and downloads implies that working papers substitute for the dissemination function of publication. Our results highlight how readers face time and cognitive constraints, with increased congestion in working papers leading to real impacts on how research is consumed.
records.abstract_cn: 利用NBER工作论文系列的数据，我们表明经济学研究的传播存在拥堵问题：每周发布的工作论文数量增加，平均会减少每篇论文的下载量、摘要浏览量和媒体关注度。后续的发表和引用结果也受到损害。知名作者撰写的论文也不能幸免于这种拥堵效应。最后，关于浏览量和下载量的提示性证据表明，工作论文替代了出版的传播功能。我们的结果凸显了读者面临时间和认知约束，工作论文拥堵加剧对研究消费方式产生了实际影响。

records.title_en: Dangerous prescribing and healthcare fragmentation: Evidence from opioids
records.title_cn: 危险处方与医疗碎片化：来自阿片类药物的证据
records.abstract_en: Fragmented healthcare received from many different physicians results in higher costs and lower quality, but does it contribute to dangerous opioid prescribing? The effect is theoretically ambiguous because fragmentation can trigger costly coordination failures but also permits greater specialization. We examine dangerous opioid prescribing, defined as receiving high dosages, long prescription durations, or harmfully interacting medications. Cross-sectionally, regions with higher fragmentation have lower levels of dangerous opioid prescribing. This relationship is associational and may result from unobserved patient-level confounders. Identifying the impact of healthcare fragmentation by examining patients who move across regions, we find a relatively precise null effect of regional fragmentation on dangerous opioid prescribing. These results cast doubt on the role of fragmentation in this phenomenon and highlight the potential role of other forces in driving it.
records.abstract_cn: 由多位不同医生提供的碎片化医疗导致更高的成本和更低的质量，但它是否会导致危险的阿片类药物处方？理论上，这种效应是模糊的，因为碎片化可能引发代价高昂的协调失败，但也允许更大的专业化。我们考察了危险阿片类药物处方，定义为接受高剂量、长处方持续时间或有害相互作用的药物。横截面来看，碎片化程度较高的地区，危险阿片类药物处方的水平较低。这种关系是关联性的，可能源于未观察到的患者层面混杂因素。通过考察跨地区迁移的患者来识别医疗碎片化的影响，我们发现区域碎片化对危险阿片类药物处方的影响是一个相对精确的零效应。这些结果对碎片化在这一现象中的作用提出了质疑，并强调了其他力量在推动这一现象中的潜在作用。

records.title_en: Are students time constrained? Course load, GPA, and failing
records.title_cn: 学生是否受时间约束？课程负荷、GPA 与不及格
records.abstract_en: Given the simultaneous rise in time-to-graduation and college GPA, it may be that students reduce their course load to improve their performance. Yet, evidence to date only shows increased course loads increase GPA. We provide a model showing many unobservable factors – beyond student ability – can generate a positive relationship between course load and GPA unless researchers control student schedules. West Point regularly implements the ideal experiment by randomly modifying student schedules with additional training courses. Using 19 years of administrative data, we provide the first causal evidence that taking more courses reduces GPA and increases course failure rates, sometimes substantially.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于毕业时间和大学 GPA 的同时上升，学生可能通过减少课程负荷来提高成绩。然而，迄今为止的证据仅显示增加课程负荷会提高 GPA。我们提供了一个模型，表明许多不可观测的因素——超出学生能力之外——可以在研究人员控制学生日程的情况下，产生课程负荷与 GPA 之间的正相关关系。西点军校定期通过随机修改学生日程并增加训练课程来实施理想实验。利用 19 年的行政数据，我们提供了首个因果证据，表明修读更多课程会降低 GPA 并增加课程不及格率，有时影响相当大。

records.title_en: The “Matthew effect” in rebates: How does VAT rebates allocation affect firm export performance
records.title_cn: 退税中的“马太效应”：增值税退税分配如何影响企业出口绩效
records.abstract_en: Changes in Value-Added Tax (VAT) rebate rates affect exports. This paper shows, when financially strapped, the timely and efficient allocation of rebates becomes essential. Using a unique panel of Chinese firms with export and rebates information, we show that delay in rebates has negative but unequal effects on firm exports. Delays in rebates also cause more exit and reduce the product scope. Furthermore, we find a “Matthew effect” in allocating rebates: exporters with tighter financial constraints respond more elastically to a delay in rebates, yet they are also more likely to have a higher delay ratio. Thus, reducing rebates delay to the most constrained firms is more effective than a similar reduction to the least constrained firms. In partial equilibrium, correcting the misallocation in rebates would increase Chinese exports by 35%, while eliminating rebates delay would increase exports by 52%.
records.abstract_cn: 增值税退税税率的变化影响出口。本文表明，当企业面临财务困境时，退税的及时和有效分配变得至关重要。利用包含中国企业的出口和退税信息的独特面板数据，我们发现退税延迟对企业出口具有负面但不平等的影响。退税延迟还导致更多企业退出并缩小产品范围。此外，我们发现在退税分配中存在“马太效应”：财务约束更紧的出口商对退税延迟的反应更敏感，但他们也更可能面临更高的延迟比率。因此，减少对最受约束企业的退税延迟比减少对最不受约束企业的类似延迟更有效。在局部均衡中，纠正退税分配不当将使中国出口增加35%，而消除退税延迟将使出口增加52%。

records.title_en: Earnings business cycles: The Covid recession, recovery, and policy response
records.title_cn: 收入商业周期：新冠疫情衰退、复苏与政策应对
records.abstract_en: Using a panel of tax data, we follow individuals’ earnings over business cycles. Compared to prior recessions, the Covid policy response and recovery were more progressive. Among workers starting in the bottom quintile, median real earnings including fiscal relief increased 66 percent in 2020—after the prior two recessions this measure decreased. This resulted from substantial Covid-era stimulus payments and unemployment insurance. With fiscal relief ending, bottom-quintile earnings in 2022 returned near pre-Covid levels. Among those starting in the top quintile, median real market earnings rose in 2020. Top-quintile earnings subsequently fell, although by less than around previous recessions.
records.abstract_cn: 利用税收数据面板，我们追踪了个人收入在商业周期中的变化。与之前的衰退相比，新冠疫情期间的政策应对和复苏更具进步性。在起始于最低五分位的工人中，包括财政救济在内的实际收入中位数在2020年增长了66%——而在前两次衰退后，这一指标有所下降。这源于新冠时期大量的刺激支付和失业保险。随着财政救济结束，2022年最低五分位的收入回到了接近疫情前的水平。在起始于最高五分位的工人中，实际市场收入中位数在2020年有所上升。随后最高五分位的收入下降，尽管降幅小于之前几次衰退。

records.title_en: Fiscal Stimulus under Sovereign Risk
records.title_cn: 主权风险下的财政刺激
records.abstract_en: What is the optimal fiscal policy response to a recession when the government is subject to sovereign risk? We study this question in a model of endogenous sovereign default with nominal rigidities. Increasing spending in a recession reduces unemployment, but it exposes the government to a debt crisis. We quantitatively analyze this trade-off between stimulus and austerity and find that expanding government spending may be undesirable, even in the presence of sizable Keynesian stabilization gains and inequality concerns. Consistent with these findings, we show that sovereign risk is a key driver of the fiscal procyclicality observed worldwide.
records.abstract_cn: 当政府面临主权风险时，对衰退的最优财政政策反应是什么？我们在一个具有名义刚性的内生主权违约模型中研究这一问题。在衰退中增加支出会降低失业率，但这使政府面临债务危机。我们定量分析了这种刺激与紧缩之间的权衡，并发现扩大政府支出可能是不可取的，即使存在显著的凯恩斯主义稳定收益和公平关切。与这些发现一致，我们表明主权风险是全球观察到的财政顺周期性的关键驱动因素。

records.title_en: No Kin in the Game: Moral Hazard and War in the US Congress
records.title_cn: 国会中的无亲属涉险：道德风险与美国国会中的战争
records.abstract_en: We study agency frictions in the US Congress. We examine the long-standing hypothesis that political elites engage in conflict because they fail to internalize the associated costs. We compare the voting behavior of legislators with draft age sons versus draft age daughters during the conscription-era wars of the twentieth century. We estimate that having a draft age son reduces proconscription voting by 7–11 percentage points. Support for conscription recovers when a legislator’s son ages out of eligibility. We establish that agency problems contribute to political conflict and that politicians are influenced by private incentives orthogonal to political concerns or ideological preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国国会中的代理摩擦。我们检验了一个长期存在的假设，即政治精英之所以参与冲突，是因为他们未能内化相关成本。我们比较了二十世纪征兵制战争期间，有适龄征兵年龄儿子的立法者与有适龄征兵年龄女儿的立法者的投票行为。我们估计，有一个适龄征兵年龄的儿子会使支持征兵投票的比例降低7-11个百分点。当立法者的儿子超出征兵年龄后，对征兵的支持会恢复。我们证实，代理问题导致了政治冲突，且政治家受到与政治关切或意识形态偏好无关的私人激励的影响。

records.title_en: Collective Progress: Dynamics of Exit Waves
records.title_cn: 集体进展：退出浪潮的动态
records.abstract_en: We introduce a framework for studying collective search by teams. Discoveries are correlated over time and governed by a Brownian path, where search speed is jointly controlled. Agents individually choose when to cease search and implement their best discovery. We characterize equilibrium and optimal policies. Search speeds are constant within active alliances and depend on complementarities between members. A drawdown stopping boundary governs each agent’s search termination. The consequent exit waves, whereby possibly heterogeneous agents cease search simultaneously, exhibit deterministic sequencing but stochastic timing. We highlight environments with lower than optimal equilibrium speeds and search durations, and different exit waves.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个研究团队集体搜索的框架。发现随时间相关，并由布朗路径支配，其中搜索速度是联合控制的。代理人各自选择何时停止搜索并实施其最佳发现。我们刻画了均衡和最优政策。搜索速度在活跃联盟内是恒定的，并取决于成员之间的互补性。一个回撤停止边界支配每个代理人的搜索终止。由此产生的退出浪潮，即可能异质的代理人同时停止搜索，表现出确定性的顺序但随机的时机。我们强调了均衡速度和时间低于最优水平的环境，以及不同的退出浪潮。

records.title_en: Local Evidence and Diversity in Minipublics
records.title_cn: 小型公众中的地方证据与多样性
records.abstract_en: A policymaker selects a minipublic—a group of citizens from a demographically diverse citizenry with access to local evidence about the impact of a policy. Citizens face uncertainty about the policymaker’s eventual policy bias, which is shown to discourage the most marginally informative minipublic citizens from discovering their evidence. We fully characterize the optimal minipublic composition. Relative to the most demographically representative minipublic, the optimal minipublic overrepresents demographics at the margins of the citizenry while underrepresenting those around the median citizen. The representativeness of the optimal minipublic varies nonmonotonically with uncertainty. Our findings bear practical implications for minipublic design.
records.abstract_cn: 政策制定者选择一个小型公众——一个来自人口多样化公民群体、能够获取关于政策影响的地方证据的公民小组。公民面临关于政策制定者最终政策偏好的不确定性，这种不确定性被证明会阻碍最具边际信息价值的小型公众公民发现他们的证据。我们充分刻画了最优小型公众的构成。相对于最具人口代表性的小型公众，最优小型公众过度代表了公民群体边缘的人口统计特征，而低估了中位数公民周围的人口统计特征。最优小型公众的代表性随不确定性非单调变化。我们的发现对小型公众设计具有实际意义。

records.title_en: Dust Bowl Migrants: Environmental Refugees and Economic Adaptation
records.title_cn: 沙尘暴移民：环境难民与经济适应
records.abstract_en: The 1930s American Dust Bowl created archetypal “Dust Bowl migrants,” refugees from environmental collapse. I examine this archetype, comparing migration from more-eroded and less-eroded counties to distinguish Dust Bowl migrants from other migrants. Dust Bowl migrants were “negatively selected,” in years of education, compared to other migrants who were “positively selected.” Dust Bowl migrants had lower incomes than natives in their destinations, which is reflected in popular impressions. I estimate strikingly modest impacts of the Dust Bowl on average wage incomes in 1939, however, which contrasts with the Dust Bowl’s large and enduring impacts on agricultural land.
records.abstract_cn: 1930年美国沙尘暴造就了典型的“沙尘暴移民”，即环境崩溃的难民。我考察了这一典型形象，通过比较侵蚀较重和侵蚀较轻县的移民来区分沙尘暴移民与其他移民。沙尘暴移民在受教育年限方面是“负向选择”的，而其他移民则是“正向选择”的。沙尘暴移民在目的地的收入低于本地人，这反映在普遍印象中。然而，我估计沙尘暴对1939年平均工资收入的影晌出奇地温和，这与沙尘暴对农业用地的巨大而持久的影响形成对比。

records.title_en: The Glorious Revolution and Access to Parliament
records.title_cn: 光荣革命与进入议会的途径
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that the Glorious Revolution of 1688 broadened access to Parliament for families needing rights to sell land in so-called estate bills. Bills were on average 14–27 percentage points more likely to be for gentry families and not aristocratic families in legislative sessions after the Revolution compared to sessions before. Regression and archival evidence suggest that parliamentary certainty was primarily responsible for improved access by altering families’ entry calculus and brokers’ recruitment of new business. More broadly, the paper provides insight into the ways in which political institutions affect access to and the provision of property rights.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，1688年的光荣革命拓宽了那些需要通过所谓的财产法案出售土地权利的家庭进入议会的途径。与革命前的立法会议相比，革命后的立法会议中，法案平均有14-27个百分点更可能针对士绅家庭而非贵族家庭。回归分析和档案证据表明，议会的确定性主要通过改变家庭的进入计算和经纪人对新业务的招募，从而改善了进入途径。更广泛地说，本文深入探讨了政治制度如何影响财产权的获取和提供。

records.title_en: State Capacity, Property Rights, and External Revenues: Haiti, 1932–1949
records.title_cn: 国家能力、产权与外部收入：海地，1932-1949
records.abstract_en: External revenues blunt investments in fiscal capacity. But how do external revenues affect investments in legal capacity? In a simple model of state capacity investment, external revenues should be positively correlated with investments in legal capacity. But this implication could flip if fiscal capacity lowers the cost of legal capacity investments. I test the model by looking at Haiti in 1942 when U.S. mobilization caused a negative shock to external revenues. Contrary to the basic model, the shock led to an increase in legal capacity. This puzzle is explained by institutions that tied fiscal and legal capacity investments.
records.abstract_cn: 外部收入削弱了财政能力的投资。但外部收入如何影响法律能力的投资？在一个简单的国家能力投资模型中，外部收入应与法律能力投资正相关。但如果财政能力降低了法律能力投资的成本，这一含义可能会反转。我通过考察1942年的海地来检验该模型，当时美国的动员导致外部收入受到负面冲击。与基本模型相反，这一冲击导致了法律能力的增强。这一谜团可以通过将财政和法律能力投资联系在一起的制度来解释。

records.title_en: Internal Borders and Population Geography in the Unification of Italy
records.title_cn: 意大利统一中的内部边界与人口地理
records.abstract_en: We offer new evidence on the spatial economic impact of Italian unification. Adopting municipal population as a proxy for local economic activity, we construct a new geocoded dataset spanning the pre- and post-unification periods and discover robust evidence of an acceleration in growth near the former borders. A disproportionate improvement in market access boosted growth in these locations when barriers to trade were dismantled. Indirectly, unification’s decisive contribution to intraregional market integration, local specialization and exchange, and economic development is revealed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于意大利统一的空间经济影响的新证据。以市政人口作为地方经济活动的代理指标，我们构建了一个涵盖统一前后时期的新地理编码数据集，并发现了在前边界附近增长加速的稳健证据。当贸易壁垒被拆除时，市场准入的显著改善促进了这些地区的增长。间接地，统一对区域内市场整合、地方专业化与交换以及经济发展的决定性贡献得以揭示。

records.title_en: Churches as Social Insurance: Oil Risk and Religion in the U.S. South
records.title_cn: 教堂作为社会保险：美国南部的石油风险与宗教
records.abstract_en: Religious communities are important providers of social insurance. We show that risk associated with oil dependence facilitated the proliferation of religious communities throughout the U.S. South during the twentieth century. Known oil abundance predicts higher rates of church membership, which are not driven by selective migration or local economic development. Consistent with a social insurance channel, greater oil price volatility increases effects, while greater access to credit, state-level social insurance, and private insurance crowd out effects. Religious communities limit spillovers of oil price shocks across sectors, reducing increases in unemployment following a negative shock by about 30 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 宗教社区是社会保险的重要提供者。我们表明，与石油依赖相关的风险在二十世纪促进了美国南部宗教社区的扩散。已知的石油丰富度预测了更高的教会成员率，这并非由选择性迁移或地方经济发展所驱动。与社会保险渠道一致，更高的石油价格波动性增强了效应，而更多的信贷获取、州级社会保险和私人保险则挤出效应。宗教社区限制了石油价格冲击跨部门的溢出效应，在负面冲击后将失业率的增加减少了约30%。

records.title_en: British-French Technology Transfer from the Revolution to Louis Philippe (1791–1844): Evidence from Patent Data
records.title_cn: 从法国大革命到路易·菲利普时期的英法技术转移（1791-1844年）：来自专利数据的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the patterns of technology transfer from Britain to France during the early phases of industrializing using a dataset comprising all patents granted in France in the period 1791–1844. Exploiting the peculiarities of French legislation, we construct an array of patent quality indicators and investigate their determinants. We find that patents filed by British inventors or French inventors with personal connections to British inventors were of relatively higher quality. Overall, our results show that the French innovation system was capable of attracting and effectively absorbing key technologies from Britain.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用1791-1844年间法国授予的所有专利数据集，考察了工业化早期阶段从英国到法国的技术转移模式。利用法国立法的特殊性，我们构建了一系列专利质量指标并研究其决定因素。我们发现，由英国发明人或与英国发明人有个人联系的法国发明人提交的专利质量相对较高。总体而言，我们的结果表明，法国的创新体系能够吸引并有效吸收来自英国的关键技术。

records.title_en: Plantation Mortgage-Backed Securities: Evidence from Surinam in the Eighteenth Century
records.title_cn: 种植园抵押贷款支持证券：来自十八世纪苏里南的证据
records.abstract_en: In the second half of the eighteenth century, Dutch bankers channeled investors’ funds to sugar and coffee plantations in the Caribbean, Surinam in particular. Agency problems between plantation owners, bankers, and investors led to an arrangement called negotiaties . Bankers oversaw plantations’ cash flows and placed mortgage debt with investors. We demonstrate how this securitization arrangement worked using market-wide data and detailed records from banker F. W. Hudig. During the boom, debt contracts and their securitization were an effective solution for planters, bankers, and investors. However, the market crashed after an oversupply of credit. This led to inefficient restructuring due to debt overhang.
records.abstract_cn: 在十八世纪下半叶，荷兰银行家将投资者的资金引导至加勒比地区，特别是苏里南的糖和咖啡种植园。种植园主、银行家和投资者之间的代理问题导致了一种名为“negotiaties”的安排。银行家监督种植园的现金流，并将抵押债务置于投资者手中。我们利用市场-wide数据和银行家F. W. Hudig的详细记录，展示了这种证券化安排是如何运作的。在繁荣时期，债务合同及其证券化对种植园主、银行家和投资者来说是一种有效的解决方案。然而，在信贷过度供应之后，市场崩溃了。这导致了由于债务积压而进行的低效重组。

records.title_en: We Do Not Know the Population of Every Country in the World for the Past Two Thousand Years
records.title_cn: 我们并不知道过去两千年世界各国的 population
records.abstract_en: Economists have reported results based on populations for every country in the world for the past two thousand years. The source, McEvedy and Jones’ Atlas of World Population History , includes many estimates that are little more than guesses and that do not reflect research since 1978. McEvedy and Jones often infer population sizes from their view of a particular economy, making their estimates poor proxies for economic growth. Their rounding means their measurement error is not “classical.” Some economists augment that error by disaggregating regions in unfounded ways. Econometric results that rest on McEvedy and Jones are unreliable. “… we haven’t just pulled the figures out of the sky. Well, not often.” —McEvedy and Jones (1978, p. 11)
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家们报告了基于过去两千年世界各国人口的研究结果。其来源，McEvedy和Jones的《世界人口历史地图集》，包含了许多几乎只是猜测的估计，并且没有反映自1978年以来的研究。McEvedy和Jones常常从他们对特定经济的看法推断人口规模，使得他们的估计成为经济增长的糟糕代理变量。他们的四舍五入意味着他们的测量误差不是“经典的”。一些经济学家通过毫无根据的方式对区域进行分解，加剧了这种误差。依赖McEvedy和Jones的计量经济学结果不可靠。“……我们并非凭空捏造数字。嗯，不经常。”——McEvedy和Jones（1978年，第11页）

records.title_en: Stable Randomisation
records.title_cn: 稳定随机化
records.abstract_en: We design a laboratory experiment to identify whether a preference for randomisation defines a stable type across different choice environments. In games and individual decisions, subjects face 20 simultaneous repetitions of the same choice. Subjects can randomise by making different choices across the repetitions. We find that randomisation does define a type that is predictable across domains. A sizeable fraction of individuals randomise in all domains, even in questions that offer a stochastically dominant option. For some mixers, dominated randomisation is responsive to intervention. We explore theoretical foundations for mixing, and find that most preference-based models are unable to accommodate our results.
records.abstract_cn: 我们设计了一个实验室实验，以识别在不同选择环境中，对随机化的偏好是否定义了一种稳定的类型。在博弈和个体决策中，受试者面临20次相同选择的重复。受试者可以通过在不同重复中做出不同选择来进行随机化。我们发现，随机化确实定义了一种在领域间可预测的类型。相当大比例的个体在所有领域都进行随机化，即使在提供随机占优选项的问题中也是如此。对于某些混合者，占优随机化对干预有反应。我们探索了混合的理论基础，并发现大多数基于偏好的模型无法容纳我们的结果。

records.title_en: Partitioned Pricing and Collusion on Surcharges
records.title_cn: 分项定价与附加费合谋
records.abstract_en: Partitioned pricing is a pricing practice that divides the price of a product into a base price and one or more mandatory surcharges. This paper develops a theory of partitioned pricing using a duopoly model where the owner of each firm determines the surcharge, but delegates the setting of the base price to a manager. In equilibrium, both firms choose partitioned pricing over the conventional all-inclusive pricing. Moreover, partitioned pricing leads to higher full prices and larger profits than all-inclusive pricing. Most surprisingly, collusion on surcharges without any coordination on base prices is as profitable as collusion on all-inclusive prices.
records.abstract_cn: 分项定价是一种将产品价格划分为基础价格和一项或多项强制性附加费的定价做法。本文利用一个双寡头模型发展了分项定价理论，在该模型中，每家企业的所有者决定附加费，但将基础价格的设定委托给经理。在均衡状态下，两家企业都选择分项定价而非传统的全包定价。此外，分项定价导致比全包定价更高的全价和更大的利润。最令人惊讶的是，在没有任何基础价格协调的情况下，对附加费的合谋与对全包价格的合谋一样有利可图。

records.title_en: Does Homeownership Reduce Crime? A Radical Housing Reform from the UK
records.title_cn: 自有住房能否减少犯罪？来自英国的一项激进住房改革
records.abstract_en: ‘Right to Buy’, a large-scale natural experiment whereby incumbent tenants in public housing could buy properties at heavily subsidised prices, increased the United Kingdom homeownership rate by over 10 percentage points between its 1980 introduction and the 1990s. This paper studies the impact of this reform on crime by leveraging exogenous variation in eligibility for the policy. Results show that Right to Buy generated significant property crime reductions. Behavioural changes of incumbent tenants and renovation of public properties were the main drivers of this crime reduction. This is evidence of a novel means by which subsidised homeownership and housing policy can reduce criminality.
records.abstract_cn: “购买权”是一项大规模自然实验，公共住房的现有租户可以以高额补贴价格购买房产，在1980年引入至1990年间，英国自有住房率提高了超过10个百分点。本文通过利用政策资格的外生变化，研究了这项改革对犯罪的影响。结果表明，“购买权”显著减少了财产犯罪。现有租户的行为变化和公共房产的翻新是犯罪减少的主要驱动因素。这为补贴性自有住房和住房政策可以减少犯罪提供了一种新途径的证据。

records.title_en: Gender Differences in Reference Letters: Evidence from the Economics Job Market
records.title_cn: 推荐信中的性别差异：来自经济学就业市场的证据
records.abstract_en: Academia, and economics in particular, faces increased scrutiny because of gender imbalance. This paper studies the job market for entry-level faculty positions. We employ machine learning methods to analyse gendered patterns in the text of 12,000 reference letters written in support of over 3,700 candidates. Using both supervised and unsupervised techniques, we document widespread differences in the attributes emphasised. Women are systematically more likely to be described using ‘grindstone’ terms and at times less likely to be praised for their ability. Using information on initial placement, we highlight the implications of these gendered descriptors for the quality of academic placement.
records.abstract_cn: 学术界，尤其是经济学领域，因性别失衡而面临越来越多的审视。本文研究了初级教职岗位的就业市场。我们采用机器学习方法分析了超过3,700名候选人的12,000封推荐信文本中的性别模式。通过监督和无监督技术，我们记录了所强调特质上的广泛差异。女性更系统性地被描述为使用‘磨盘’类术语，有时较少因能力而受到赞扬。利用初始就业信息，我们强调了这些性别描述词对学术就业质量的影响。

records.title_en: Trade-Offs of Attending Better Schools: Achievement, Self-Perceptions and Educational Trajectories
records.title_cn: 就读更好学校的权衡：学业成就、自我认知与教育轨迹
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impacts of attending better middle schools on the test scores, on-time graduation, self-reported socio-emotional skills, aspirations and high school track choices of marginally admitted students. A regression discontinuity design comparing students just above and below the admission threshold to higher-achieving middle schools in Mexico shows some modest gains on externally graded tests, but adverse effects on grade point average and on-time graduation. By the end of middle school, marginally admitted students feel academically inferior to their peers, obtain worse scores on measures of conscientiousness, and are more likely to shift their aspirations and subsequent schooling choices from academic to vocational programmes. The results are consistent with the hypothesis that unfavourable peer comparisons, stemming from direct observation or subjective teacher assessments, can be sufficiently important to affect students’ educational trajectories.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了就读更好的中学对边缘录取学生的考试成绩、按时毕业、自我报告的社会情感技能、抱负和高中轨道选择的影响。一项回归不连续设计比较了墨西哥更高成就中学录取分数线上下附近的学生，结果显示在外部评分测试中有些适度收益，但对平均绩点和按时毕业有不利影响。到中学结束时，边缘录取学生感到在学业上不如同龄人，在尽责性测量上得分更差，并且更可能将他们的抱负和后续教育选择从学术转向职业项目。结果与以下假设一致：不利的同龄人比较，源于直接观察或主观教师评估，可能足以影响学生的教育轨迹。

records.title_en: Effects and Mechanisms of CEO Quality in Public Education
records.title_cn: 公立教育中CEO质量的影响与机制
records.abstract_en: ‘CEOs’ of public schools in many countries have authority and responsibilities that can greatly affect the quality of schooling. This paper estimates the impact of CEOs on student outcomes in Israeli elementary schools. We estimate CEO quality in two ways—once using schools that do not switch CEOs and once using schools that do. We show that switches are exogenous and are not correlated with potential outcomes. CEO quality positively affects students’ test scores and behavioural outcomes, with pronounced effects for disadvantaged schools. Potential mechanisms show that high-quality CEOs lead to improvements in school priorities, working procedures and violence reduction.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多国家，公立学校的‘CEO’拥有极大的权力和责任，这些权力和责任可能对教育质量产生重大影响。本文估算了以色列小学中CEO对学生成绩的影响。我们通过两种方式估算CEO质量——一种使用未更换CEO的学校，另一种使用更换CEO的学校。我们表明，更换CEO是外生的，且与潜在结果不相关。CEO质量对学生考试成绩和行为结果产生积极影响，对弱势学校的影响尤为显著。潜在机制表明，高质量的CEO能够改善学校优先事项、工作流程并减少暴力。

records.title_en: Do Conditional Cash Transfers Improve Economic Outcomes in the Next Generation? Evidence from Mexico
records.title_cn: 有条件现金转移支付能否改善下一代的经济成果？来自墨西哥的证据
records.abstract_en: Conditional cash transfer programmes have spread to over 60 countries in the past two decades, but little is known about their long-term effects. We estimate the lasting impact of childhood exposure to the Mexico’s flagship programme Progresa by leveraging the age structure of benefits and geographic variation in early programme penetration nationwide. Childhood exposure improves women’s outcomes in early adulthood with increases in educational attainment, geographic mobility, labour market performance and household living standards. For men, effects are smaller and more difficult to distinguish from spatial convergence.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去二十年中，有条件现金转移支付项目已扩展到超过60个国家，但对其长期影响知之甚少。我们利用福利的年龄结构和全国范围内早期项目渗透的地理差异，估计了儿童时期接触墨西哥旗舰项目Progresa的持久影响。儿童时期的接触改善了女性成年早期的成果，包括教育程度、地理流动性、劳动力市场表现和家庭生活水平的提高。对于男性而言，影响较小且更难与空间趋同区分开来。

records.title_en: A Behavioural Theory of Discrimination in Policing
records.title_cn: 警务歧视的行为理论
records.abstract_en: A large economic literature studies whether racial disparities in policing are explained by animus or by beliefs about group crime rates. But what if these beliefs are incorrect? We analyse a model where officers form beliefs using crime statistics, but do not properly account for the fact that they will detect more crime in more heavily policed communities. This creates a feedback loop where officers over-police groups that they (incorrectly) believe exhibit high crime rates. This inferential mistake can exacerbate discrimination even among officers with no animus and who sincerely believe that disparities are driven by real differences in crime rates.
records.abstract_cn: 大量经济学文献研究警务中的种族差异是由敌意还是对群体犯罪率的信念所解释。但如果这些信念是错误的呢？我们分析了一个模型，其中警官利用犯罪统计形成信念，但没有适当考虑他们将在警务更密集的社区发现更多犯罪这一事实。这创造了一个反馈循环，警官过度监管他们（错误地）认为犯罪率高的群体。这种推断错误即使在那些没有敌意且真诚相信差异是由犯罪率真实差异驱动的警官中，也可能加剧歧视。

records.title_en: Preheating Prosocial Behaviour
records.title_cn: 预热亲社会行为
records.abstract_en: We provide new evidence on motivations for voluntary contributions to public goods in a natural setting. Using natural language processing on users’ Twitter posts, we measure revealed sentiment changes before and after making a donation to Wikipedia. We find strong evidence that sentiment improves in the hour and minutes directly before contributing, which we call ‘preheating’. Results are robust to alternative fixed effects and approaches to inference and supported by a complementary online experiment with randomised mood inducement among Twitter users. Preheating suggests that affective states influence giving in addition to reward-seeking, utility-maximising behaviour that has been documented in other contexts.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了在自然环境中自愿贡献公共物品动机的新证据。通过对用户在Twitter上的帖子进行自然语言处理，我们测量了在向维基百科捐款前后揭示的情绪变化。我们发现强有力的证据表明，在直接贡献前的一小时和几分钟内，情绪有所改善，我们称之为“预热”。结果对于替代固定效应和推断方法具有稳健性，并得到了一项在Twitter用户中进行随机情绪诱导的补充在线实验的支持。预热表明，情感状态影响给予行为，此外还有在其他情境中记录到的寻求奖励、效用最大化的行为。

records.title_en: Regret‐Minimizing Project Choice
records.title_cn: 最小化遗憾的项目选择
records.abstract_en: An agent observes the set of available projects and proposes some, but not necessarily all, of them. A principal chooses one or none from the proposed set. We solve for a mechanism that minimizes the principal's worst‐case regret. We compare the single‐project environment in which the agent can propose only one project with the multiproject environment in which he can propose many. In both environments, if the agent proposes one project, it is chosen for sure if the principal's payoff is sufficiently high; otherwise, the probability that it is chosen decreases in the agent's payoff. In the multiproject environment, the agent's payoff from proposing multiple projects equals his maximal payoff from proposing each project alone. The multiproject environment outperforms the single‐project one by providing better fallback options than rejection and by delivering this payoff to the agent more efficiently.
records.abstract_cn: 一个代理人观察可用的项目集合，并提出其中一些，但不一定是全部。委托人从提议的集合中选择一个或一个都不选。我们求解了一个最小化委托人最坏情况遗憾的机制。我们比较了代理人只能提议一个项目的单项目环境和他可以提议多个项目的多项目环境。在两种环境中，如果代理人提议一个项目，当委托人的收益足够高时，该项目肯定会被选中；否则，该项目被选中的概率随代理人的收益增加而降低。在多项目环境中，代理人提议多个项目的收益等于他单独提议每个项目所获得的最大收益。多项目环境通过提供比拒绝更好的后备选项，并更有效地向代理人传递这一收益，从而优于单项目环境。

records.title_en: Selection Into Credit Markets: Evidence From Agriculture in Mali
records.title_cn: 信贷市场的选择：来自马里农业的证据
records.abstract_en: We use a two‐stage experiment on agricultural lending in Mali to test whether selection into lending is predictive of heterogeneous returns to capital. Understanding this heterogeneity, and the selection process which reveals it, is critical for guiding modeling of credit markets in developing countries, as well as for policy. We find such heterogeneity: returns to capital are higher for farmers who borrow than for those who do not. In our first stage, we offer loans in some villages and not others. In the second stage, we provide cash grants to a random subset of all farmers in villages where no loans were offered, and to a random subset of the farmers who do not borrow in villages where loans were offered. We estimate seasonal returns to the grant of 130% for would‐be borrowers, whereas we find returns near zero for the sample representative of non‐borrowers. We also provide evidence that there are some farmers—particularly those that are poor at baseline—that have high returns but do not receive a loan.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用马里农业贷款的两阶段实验来检验贷款选择是否能预测资本回报的异质性。理解这种异质性以及揭示它的选择过程，对于指导发展中国家信贷市场的建模以及政策制定至关重要。我们发现存在这种异质性：借款农民的资本回报高于不借款的农民。在第一阶段，我们在一些村庄提供贷款，而在其他村庄不提供。在第二阶段，我们向未提供贷款村庄的所有农民中的随机子集提供现金赠款，并向提供贷款村庄中不借款的农民中的随机子集提供现金赠款。我们估计潜在借款人的赠款季节性回报为130%，而对于非借款人代表性样本，我们发现回报接近于零。我们还提供证据表明，有些农民——特别是那些基线时贫困的农民——具有高回报但未获得贷款。

records.title_en: Infinite Debt Rollover in Stochastic Economies
records.title_cn: 随机经济中的无限债务滚动
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that there is more scope for a borrower to engage in a sustainable infinite debt rollover (a “Ponzi scheme”) when interest/growth rates are stochastic. In this context, I prove that the relevant “r vs. g” comparison uses the yield r long to an infinite‐maturity zero‐coupon bond. I show that r long is lower than the risk‐neutral expectation of the short‐term yield when it is variable, and that r long is close to the minimal realization of the short‐term yield when it is highly persistent. The paper applies these results to illustrative heterogeneous agent dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models to obtain similarly weakened sufficient conditions for the existence of public debt bubbles.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，当利率/增长率是随机的时，借款人进行可持续的无限债务滚动（“庞氏骗局”）的空间更大。在此背景下，我证明了相关的“r与g”比较使用的是长期零息债券的收益率r long。我表明，当短期收益率可变时，r long低于其风险中性预期，并且当短期收益率高度持久时，r long接近其最小实现值。本文将这些结果应用于说明性的异质主体动态随机一般均衡模型，以获得类似的放宽的公共债务泡沫存在的充分条件。

records.title_en: The Investment Effects of Market Integration: Evidence From Renewable Energy Expansion in Chile
records.title_cn: 市场一体化的投资效应：来自智利可再生能源扩张的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the investment effects of market integration on renewable energy expansion. Our theory highlights that market integration not only improves allocative efficiency by gains from trade but also incentivizes new investment in renewable power plants. To test our theoretical predictions, we examine how recent grid expansions in the Chilean electricity market changed electricity production, wholesale prices, generation costs, and renewable investments. We then build a structural model of power plant entry to quantify the impact of market integration with and without the investment effects. We find that the market integration in Chile increased solar generation by around 180%, saved generation costs by 8%, and reduced carbon emissions by 5%. A substantial amount of renewable entry would not have occurred in the absence of market integration. Our findings suggest that ignoring these investment effects would substantially understate the benefits of market integration and its important role in expanding renewable energy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了市场一体化对可再生能源扩张的投资效应。我们的理论强调，市场一体化不仅通过贸易收益提高配置效率，还激励对可再生能源发电厂的新投资。为检验我们的理论预测，我们考察了智利电力市场近期的电网扩张如何改变电力生产、批发价格、发电成本和可再生能源投资。然后，我们构建了一个发电厂进入的结构模型，以量化在有和没有投资效应的情况下市场一体化的影响。我们发现，智利的市场一体化使太阳能发电量增加了约180%，节省了8%的发电成本，并减少了5%的碳排放。如果没有市场一体化，大量可再生能源的进入将不会发生。我们的研究结果表明，忽视这些投资效应将大大低估市场一体化的收益及其在扩大可再生能源方面的重要作用。

records.title_en: What Can Time‐Series Regressions Tell Us About Policy Counterfactuals?
records.title_cn: 时间序列回归能告诉我们关于政策反事实的什么？
records.abstract_en: We show that, in a general family of linearized structural macroeconomic models, knowledge of the empirically estimable causal effects of contemporaneous and news shocks to the prevailing policy rule is sufficient to construct counterfactuals under alternative policy rules. If the researcher is willing to postulate a loss function, our results furthermore allow her to recover an optimal policy rule for that loss. Under our assumptions, the derived counterfactuals and optimal policies are robust to the Lucas critique. We then discuss strategies for applying these insights when only a limited amount of empirical causal evidence on policy shock transmission is available.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，在一族一般的线性化结构宏观经济模型中，对现行政策规则下的同期冲击和新闻冲击的可经验估计的因果效应的了解，足以构建替代政策规则下的反事实。如果研究者愿意设定一个损失函数，我们的结果还允许她恢复该损失的最优政策规则。在我们的假设下，推导出的反事实和最优政策对卢卡斯批判是稳健的。然后，我们讨论了当仅有有限的经验因果证据关于政策冲击传导时应用这些见解的策略。

records.title_en: Monitoring versus Discounting in Repeated Games
records.title_cn: 重复博弈中的监督与贴现
records.abstract_en: We study how discounting and monitoring jointly determine whether cooperation is possible in repeated games with imperfect (public or private) monitoring. Our main result provides a simple bound on the strength of players' incentives as a function of discounting, monitoring precision, and on‐path payoff variance. We show that the bound is tight in the low‐discounting/low‐monitoring double limit, by establishing a public‐monitoring folk theorem where the discount factor and the monitoring structure can vary simultaneously.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有不完美（公开或私人）监督的重复博弈中，贴现和监督如何共同决定合作是否可能。我们的主要结果提供了一个关于玩家激励强度的简单界限，该界限是贴现、监督精度和路径上收益方差的函数。我们通过建立一个公开监督的民间定理，其中贴现因子和监督结构可以同时变化，证明了该界限在低贴现/低监督的双重极限下是紧的。

records.title_en: Mitigating Disaster Risks in the Age of Climate Change
records.title_cn: 气候变化时代减轻灾害风险
records.abstract_en: Emissions abatement alone cannot address the consequences of global warming for weather disasters. We model how society adapts to manage disaster risks to capital stock. Optimal adaptation—a mix of firm‐level efforts and public spending—varies as society learns about the adverse consequences of global warming for disaster arrivals. Taxes on capital are needed alongside those on carbon to achieve the first best. We apply our model to country‐level control of flooding from tropical cyclones. Learning rationalizes empirical findings, including the responses of Tobin's q , equity risk premium, and risk‐free rate to disaster arrivals. Adaptation is more valuable under learning than a counterfactual no‐learning environment. Learning alters social‐cost‐of‐carbon projections due to the interaction of uncertainty resolution and endogenous adaptive response.
records.abstract_cn: 仅靠减排无法解决全球变暖对天气灾害的影响。我们模拟了社会如何适应管理资本存量的灾害风险。最优适应——企业层面努力与公共支出的组合——随着社会了解全球变暖对灾害发生的负面影响而变化。除了碳税，还需要对资本征税以实现最优。我们将模型应用于国家层面热带气旋洪水的控制。学习使实证发现合理化，包括托宾q、股权风险溢价和无风险利率对灾害发生的反应。在学习环境下，适应比反事实的无学习环境更有价值。由于不确定性解决与内生适应性反应的相互作用，学习改变了社会碳成本预测。

records.title_en: Platform Design When Sellers Use Pricing Algorithms
records.title_cn: 当卖家使用定价算法时的平台设计
records.abstract_en: We investigate the ability of a platform to design its marketplace to promote competition, improve consumer surplus, and increase its own payoff. We consider demand‐steering rules that reward firms that cut prices with additional exposure to consumers. We examine the impact of these rules both in theory and by using simulations with artificial intelligence pricing algorithms (specifically Q‐learning algorithms, which are commonly used in computer science). Our theoretical results indicate that these policies (which require little information to implement) can have strongly beneficial effects, even when sellers are infinitely patient and seek to collude. Similarly, our simulations suggest that platform design can benefit consumers and the platform, but that achieving these gains may require policies that condition on past behavior and treat sellers in a nonneutral fashion. These more sophisticated policies disrupt the ability of algorithms to rotate demand and split industry profits, leading to low prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了平台设计其市场以促进竞争、改善消费者剩余并增加自身收益的能力。我们考虑了需求引导规则，这些规则奖励降价企业以额外的消费者曝光。我们在理论上和使用人工智能定价算法（特别是计算机科学中常用的Q学习算法）的模拟中检验了这些规则的影响。我们的理论结果表明，这些政策（实施所需信息很少）可以产生强烈的有益效果，即使卖家无限耐心并试图合谋。同样，我们的模拟表明，平台设计可以使消费者和平台受益，但实现这些收益可能需要基于过去行为并以非中立方式对待卖家的政策。这些更复杂的政策破坏了算法轮换需求和分配行业利润的能力，导致低价格。

records.title_en: The Macro Impact of Short‐Termism
records.title_cn: 短期主义的宏观影响
records.abstract_en: R&D investment reduces current profits, so short‐term pressure to hit profit targets may distort R&D. In the data, firms just meeting Wall Street forecasts have lower R&D growth and subsequent innovation, while managers just missing receive lower pay. But short‐termist distortions might not quantitatively matter if aggregation or equilibrium dampen their impact. So I build and estimate a quantitative endogenous growth model in which short‐termism arises naturally as discipline on conflicted managers and boosts firm value by about 1%. But short‐termism reduces R&D, and the social return to R&D is higher than the private return due to standard channels including knowledge spillovers and imperfect competition. So at the macro level, short‐termist distortions slow growth by 5 basis points yearly and lower social welfare by about 1%.
records.abstract_cn: 研发投资会减少当前利润，因此实现利润目标的短期压力可能会扭曲研发。在数据中，刚好达到华尔街预测的公司研发增长和后续创新较低，而刚好未达标的经理人薪酬较低。但短期主义扭曲可能不会在数量上产生重要影响，如果加总或均衡削弱了它们的影响。因此，我构建并估计了一个定量内生增长模型，其中短期主义自然产生于对冲突经理人的约束，并使企业价值提高约1%。但短期主义减少了研发，而研发的社会回报高于私人回报，原因包括知识溢出和不完全竞争等标准渠道。因此，在宏观层面，短期主义扭曲使年增长率降低5个基点，并使社会福利降低约1%。

records.title_en: The Power of Certainty: Experimental Evidence on the Effective Design of Free Tuition Programs
records.title_cn: 确定性的力量：免费学费项目有效设计的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Proposed “free college” policies vary widely in design. The simplest set tuition to zero for everyone. More targeted approaches limit free tuition to those who demonstrate need through an application process. We experimentally test the effects of these two models on the schooling decisions of low-income students. An unconditional free tuition offer from a large public university substantially increases application and enrollment rates. A free tuition offer contingent on proof of need has a much smaller effect on application and none on enrollment. These results are consistent with students placing a high value on financial certainty when making schooling decisions. (JEL H52, H75, I22, I23, I28, I32)
records.abstract_cn: 拟议中的“免费大学”政策在设计上差异很大。最简单的做法是将所有人的学费设为零。更有针对性的方法是通过申请程序，将免费学费限制在那些证明有需要的学生。我们通过实验检验了这两种模式对低收入学生求学决策的影响。一所大型公立大学提供的无条件免费学费大幅提高了申请率和入学率。而附带经济需求证明条件的免费学费对申请的影响要小得多，对入学则没有影响。这些结果与学生在做出求学决策时高度重视财务确定性是一致的。（JEL H52, H75, I22, I23, I28, I32）

records.title_en: A Characterization for Optimal Bundling of Products with Nonadditive Values
records.title_cn: 非加性价值产品最优捆绑销售的特征化描述
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the optimal bundling of products with nonadditive values. Under monotonic preferences and single-peaked profits, I show that a monopolist finds pure bundling optimal if and only if the optimal sales volume for the grand bundle is larger than the optimal sales volume for any smaller bundle. I then detail how my analysis relates to ratio monotonicity results on bundling and describe the implications for nonlinear pricing. (JEL D21, D42, L12, L25)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有非加性价值的产品的最优捆绑销售问题。在单调偏好和单峰利润条件下，我证明了垄断者认为纯捆绑销售是最优的，当且仅当大捆绑的最优销售量大于任何较小捆绑的最优销售量。随后，我详细阐述了我的分析与捆绑销售中的比率单调性结果之间的关系，并描述了其对非线性定价的启示。（JEL D21, D42, L12, L25）

records.title_en: Reducing Frictions in Health Care Access: The ActionHealthNYC Experiment for Undocumented Immigrants
records.title_cn: 减少医疗保健获取中的摩擦：针对无证移民的ActionHealthNYC实验
records.abstract_en: In 2016, New York City designed and implemented an intervention to reduce frictions in accessing safety net care: randomly making initial primary care appointments for 2,428 undocumented immigrants. We leverage a novel survey-administrative data linkage to show that the program increased self-reported access to primary care, leading to 23 percent fewer emergency department (ED) visits. High-risk individuals’ ED visits fell by 32 percent on average, driving the aggregate effect. Preventive care also increased among individuals visiting sponsored clinics. (JEL H75, I11, I12, I13, I14, I18, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 在2016年，纽约市设计并实施了一项干预措施，以减少获取安全网护理的摩擦：随机为2,428名无证移民安排初次初级保健预约。我们利用一项新颖的调查-行政数据关联表明，该计划增加了自我报告的初级保健获取，导致急诊科就诊次数减少了23%。高风险个体的急诊就诊平均减少了32%，推动了总体效应。在赞助诊所就诊的个体中，预防性护理也有所增加。（JEL H75, I11, I12, I13, I14, I18, J15）

records.title_en: A Minimalist Model for the Ruble during the Russian Invasion of Ukraine
records.title_cn: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间卢布的极简模型
records.abstract_en: This note isolates an overlooked economic force for the ruble to appreciate in response to international sanctions limiting exports to Russia. The intuition is that when Russians are unable to buy the mix of foreign goods they wish, foreign goods become less attractive, increasing demand for domestic goods. To reestablish an equilibrium, a real appreciation is needed to raise the relative price of domestic goods and incentivize imports from nonsanctioning countries. We also review well-known forces for depreciation. Our analysis emphasizes that the exchange rate is an inadequate signal of the welfare impact and of the effectiveness of sanctions. (JEL D74, E31, F14, F31, F51, P24, P33)
records.abstract_cn: 本文揭示了一个被忽视的经济力量，即国际制裁限制对俄出口时，卢布会升值。其直觉是，当俄罗斯人无法购买他们想要的外国商品组合时，外国商品的吸引力下降，从而增加了对国内商品的需求。为了重新建立均衡，需要实际升值以提高国内商品的相对价格，并激励从非制裁国家的进口。我们还回顾了众所周知的贬值力量。我们的分析强调，汇率并不能充分反映制裁的福利影响和有效性。（JEL D74, E31, F14, F31, F51, P24, P33）

records.title_en: Decision Theory and Stochastic Growth
records.title_cn: 决策理论与随机增长
records.abstract_en: This paper examines connections between stochastic growth and decision problems. We use tools from the theory of large deviations to show that wishful thinking decision problems are equivalent to utility maximization problems, both of which are equivalent to growth maximization under idiosyncratic risk. Rational inattention problems are equivalent to growth-optimal portfolio problems, both of which are equivalent to growth maximization under aggregate risk. Stochastic growth generates extreme inequality, with nearly all wealth eventually held by those who happen to have faced empirical distributions that match the solution to the wishful thinking or rational inattention problem. (JEL D31, D81, D82, D83, G51, O41)
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了随机增长与决策问题之间的联系。我们利用大偏差理论的工具来证明，一厢情愿的决策问题等价于效用最大化问题，而这两者又等价于在特质风险下的增长最大化问题。理性疏忽问题等价于增长最优投资组合问题，而这两者又等价于在总体风险下的增长最大化问题。随机增长会产生极端的不平等，最终几乎所有财富都由那些恰好面临的经验分布与一厢情愿或理性疏忽问题的解相匹配的人持有。(JEL D31, D81, D82, D83, G51, O41)

records.title_en: The Educational Consequences of Remote and Hybrid Instruction during the Pandemic
records.title_cn: 疫情期间远程与混合教学的教育后果
