records.abstract_cn: 不诚实行为是否具有传染性？我们通过研究腐败丑闻是否影响超市顾客在使用自助结账系统时偷窃的倾向来回答这个问题。关键在于，该系统允许购物者通过低报其购物车价值来从事不诚实行为。利用对购物者随机审计的数据，我们表明，在当地腐败丑闻爆发后，偷窃的概率增加了16%。这一效应并非由物质激励的任何变化所驱动。提示性证据表明，它是由偷窃自我施加成本的降低所驱动的。(JEL D12, D73, D91, K42, L81, Z13)

records.title_en: Collateralized Marriage
records.title_cn: 抵押婚姻
records.abstract_en: Marriage rates have become increasingly stratified by homeownership. We investigate this in a household model where investments in public goods reduce future earnings and, thus, divorce risk creates inefficiencies. Access to a joint savings technology, like a house, collateralizes marriage, providing insurance to the lower-earning partner and increasing specialization, public goods, and value from marriage. We use idiosyncratic variation in housing prices to show that homeownership access indeed leads to greater specialization. The model also predicts that policies that erode the marriage contract in other ways will make wealth a more important determinant of marriage, which we confirm empirically. (JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31)
records.abstract_cn: 结婚率日益按房屋所有权分层。我们在一个家庭模型中研究这一问题，其中公共品投资会降低未来收入，因此离婚风险造成低效率。获得联合储蓄技术（如房屋）的机会将婚姻抵押化，为低收入伴侣提供保险，并增加专业化、公共品和婚姻价值。我们利用房价的异质性变化表明，获得房屋所有权确实导致更大的专业化。该模型还预测，以其他方式侵蚀婚姻契约的政策将使财富成为婚姻更重要的决定因素，我们在实证中证实了这一点。（JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31）

records.title_en: How Cable News Reshaped Local Government
records.title_cn: 有线新闻如何重塑地方政府
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that partisan cable news broadcasts have a causal effect on the size and composition of budgets in US localities. Using exogenous channel positioning as an instrument for viewership, we show that exposure to the conservative Fox News channel reduces revenues and expenditures. Multiple mechanisms drive these results: Fox News improves election chances for local Republicans, alters politician campaign agendas, and shifts voter policy preferences on fiscal issues. Consistent with the priorities of small-government conservatism, we find evidence that private provision compensates for the reduced public services. The “Fox News effect” extends beyond vote shares to rightward policy shifts. (JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，党派有线新闻广播对美国地方政府的预算规模和构成具有因果效应。利用外生的频道定位作为收视率的工具变量，我们表明接触保守派福克斯新闻频道会减少收入和支出。多种机制驱动这些结果：福克斯新闻提高了地方共和党人的选举机会，改变了政治家的竞选议程，并转变了选民在财政问题上的政策偏好。与小政府保守主义的优先事项一致，我们发现证据表明私人供给补偿了减少的公共服务。“福克斯新闻效应”超越了选票份额，延伸至右翼政策转变。（JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82）

records.title_en: Hidden Income and the Perceived Returns to Migration
records.title_cn: 隐藏收入与迁移的感知回报
records.abstract_en: In many developing economies, urban workers earn substantially more than rural workers with the same level of education. Why don't more rural workers migrate to cities? I use two field experiments in Kenya to show that low migration is partly due to underestimation of urban incomes, which is sustained by income hiding by migrants. Parents at the origin underestimate their migrant children's incomes by nearly half, and underestimation is greater when a migrant's remittance obligations are high. Providing information about urban earnings increases migration to the capital city by about 40 percent over two years. (JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中经济体，城市工人比同等教育水平的农村工人收入高得多。为什么没有更多农村工人迁移到城市？我在肯尼亚进行了两项实地实验，表明低迁移率部分是由于对城市收入的低估，而这种低估是由迁移者隐藏收入所维持的。原籍地的父母低估其迁移子女的收入近一半，当迁移者的汇款义务较高时，低估程度更大。提供关于城市收入的信息使前往首都城市的迁移在两年内增加了约40%。(JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)

records.title_en: Returns to International Migration: Evidence from a Bangladesh-Malaysia Visa Lottery
records.title_cn: 国际移民的回报：来自孟加拉国-马来西亚签证抽签的证据
records.abstract_en: South Asians traveling to richer Asian nations is the world's largest migration corridor. We track down applicants to a government lottery that randomly allocated visas to Bangladeshis for temporary labor contracts in Malaysia, five years later. Most lottery winners migrate, and migrants' earnings triple. Their remittance raises their family's standard of living in Bangladesh. The migrant's absence pauses marriage and childbirth and shifts decision-making power toward females. Migration removes enterprising individuals, lowering household entrepreneurship, but does not crowd out other family members' labor supply. A deferred migration offer never materialized for a subgroup. Their premigration investments in skills generate no returns in the domestic market. (JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 南亚人前往较富裕的亚洲国家是世界上最大的移民走廊。我们追踪了一项政府抽签的申请人，该抽签随机分配签证给孟加拉国人，以便他们在马来西亚获得临时劳动合同，五年后进行调查。大多数中签者移民，移民的收入增加了两倍。他们的汇款提高了家人在孟加拉国的生活水平。移民的缺席推迟了婚姻和生育，并将决策权转向女性。移民带走了有创业精神的个体，降低了家庭创业，但并未挤出其他家庭成员的家庭劳动力供给。一个推迟的移民提议对某个亚组从未实现。他们在移民前对技能的投资在国内市场没有产生回报。(JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)

records.title_en: Civil Liberties in Times of Crisis
records.title_cn: 危机时期的公民自由
records.abstract_en: We study people's willingness to trade off civil liberties for increased health security in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic by deploying representative surveys involving around 550,000 responses across 15 countries. We document significant heterogeneity across groups in willingness to sacrifice rights: citizens disadvantaged by income, education, or race are less willing to sacrifice rights than their more advantaged peers in every country. Leveraging naturally occurring variation and experimental approaches, we estimate a one standard deviation increase in health insecurity increases willingness to sacrifice civil liberties by 68–83 percent of the difference between the average Chinese and US citizen. (JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过部署涉及约19万份回复、覆盖550000个国家的代表性调查，研究在COVID-15大流行背景下人们愿意以公民自由换取更高健康安全的程度。我们记录了不同群体在牺牲权利意愿上的显著异质性：在每个国家，收入、教育或种族方面处于不利地位的公民比其更有利的同伴更不愿意牺牲权利。利用自然发生的变异和实验方法，我们估计健康不安全感增加一个标准差会使牺牲公民自由的意愿增加平均中国公民与美国公民差异的68-83%。（JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36）

records.title_en: Discrimination in Times of Crises and the Role of the Media
records.title_cn: 危机时期的歧视与媒体的作用
records.abstract_en: Can the extent of ethnic discrimination change quickly, and what circumstances and mechanisms make such changes possible? I address these questions by using scraped data to study the daily evolution of customer discrimination against Arab doctors in Israel from January 2020 to June 2021. Results show that: (1) the outbreak of the coronavirus crisis in March 2020 led to a dramatic decline in discrimination; (2) the eruption of a wave of ethnic riots in May 2021 had the opposite effect; (3) media coverage of the contribution of Arab doctors to the fight against the pandemic helped bring about the first change. (JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 种族歧视的程度能否迅速变化，哪些环境和机制使这种变化成为可能？我通过使用抓取的数据研究以色列阿拉伯医生在2020年一月至2021年六月期间顾客歧视的日常演变来回答这些问题。结果表明：（1）2020年三月冠状病毒危机的爆发导致歧视急剧下降；（2）2021年五月种族骚乱的爆发产生了相反的效果；（3）媒体对阿拉伯医生抗击疫情的贡献的报道有助于促成第一个变化。（JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82）

records.title_en: Physical Disability and Labor Market Discrimination: Evidence from a Video Résumé Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 身体残疾与劳动力市场歧视：来自视频简历实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We sent fictitious applications to firms advertising job openings. We find that revealing a disability decreases callback rates by 25 percentage points. This result is not explained by accessibility constraints or lower productivity due to disability. We find that including a video résumé of a well-spoken applicant significantly increases callbacks by 10 percentage points for persons with and without disabilities, suggesting that discrimination is unaffected by quality signals in our context. Analysis of viewing activity suggests that employers seek less information when the applicant is disabled. Disclosing the disability later in the video increases employers' viewing time but leaves callback rates unchanged. (JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们向发布招聘广告的公司发送了虚构的求职申请。我们发现，披露残疾会使回电率降低25个百分点。这一结果并非由无障碍限制或残疾导致的生产率下降所解释。我们发现，包含一位口齿清晰的申请人的视频简历会显著提高有残疾和无残疾申请人的回电率10个百分点，这表明在我们的情境中，歧视不受质量信号的影响。对观看活动的分析表明，当申请人为残疾人时，雇主会寻求更少的信息。在视频中较晚披露残疾会增加雇主的观看时间，但回电率保持不变。(JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)

records.title_en: The Effect of Hospital Postpartum Care Regulations on Breastfeeding and Maternal Time Allocation
records.title_cn: 医院产后护理法规对母乳喂养和母亲时间分配的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of state hospital regulations intended to increase breastfeeding by requiring certain standards of care during the immediate postpartum hospital stay. We find that these regulations significantly increased breastfeeding initiation by 3.8 percentage points (5.1 percent) and the probability of breastfeeding at 3 and 6 months postpartum by approximately 7 percent. We also provide evidence that these breastfeeding-promoting policies significantly increased maternal time spent on child care, crowding out time spent on formal work. Observed reductions in employment are concentrated among mothers with infants between zero and three months of age. (JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了旨在通过要求产后住院期间特定护理标准来增加母乳喂养的州医院法规的影响。我们发现这些法规显著提高了母乳喂养的启动率，增加了3.8个百分点（5.1%），并使得产后3个月和6个月时母乳喂养的概率大约提高了7%。我们还提供了证据表明，这些促进母乳喂养的政策显著增加了母亲用于儿童护理的时间，挤占了用于正式工作的时间。观察到的就业减少主要集中在婴儿年龄在零到三个月之间的母亲中。（JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22）

records.title_en: Narrative Asset Pricing: Interpretable Systematic Risk Factors from News Text
records.title_cn: 叙事资产定价：来自新闻文本的可解释系统性风险因子
records.abstract_en: We estimate a narrative factor pricing model from news text of The Wall Street Journal. Our empirical method integrates topic modeling (LDA), latent factor analysis (IPCA), and variable selection (group lasso). Narrative factors achieve higher out-of-sample Sharpe ratios and smaller pricing errors than standard characteristic-based factor models and predict future investment opportunities in a manner consistent with the ICAPM. We derive an interpretation of the estimated risk factors from narratives in the underlying article text. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用《华尔街日报》的新闻文本估计了一个叙事因子定价模型。我们的实证方法整合了主题建模（LDA）、潜在因子分析（IPCA）和变量选择（组套索）。叙事因子在样本外实现了更高的夏普比率和更小的定价误差，优于基于特征的标准因子模型，并且以与ICAPM一致的方式预测未来的投资机会。我们从底层文章文本的叙事中推导出估计风险因子的解释。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Mandatory Financial Disclosure and M&A Activity
records.title_cn: 强制性财务披露与并购活动
records.abstract_en: Taking advantage of the implementation of the 2003 European Commission (EC) directive on financial reporting, we explore the impact of mandatory financial disclosure on mergers and acquisitions (M&A). We find robust evidence that the number (and volume) of private firms becoming an M&A target increases with mandatory disclosure. Analyses of cross-industry differences, deal-level data, and post-deal performance indicate that financial disclosure increases M&A activity by reducing information frictions in the market for corporate control. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 利用2003年欧洲委员会（EC）财务报告指令的实施，我们探讨了强制性财务披露对并购（M&A）的影响。我们发现了强有力的证据表明，成为并购目标的私营企业数量（和交易量）随着强制性披露而增加。对跨行业差异、交易层面数据和交易后绩效的分析表明，财务披露通过减少公司控制权市场中的信息摩擦来增加并购活动。作者已提供互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: ES Risks and Shareholder Voice
records.title_cn: ES风险与股东投票
records.abstract_en: We examine whether shareholder votes in environmental and social (ES) proposals are informative about firms’ ES risks. ES proposals are unique in that they nearly always fail. We examine whether mutual funds’ support for these failed proposals contains information about the ES risks that firms face. Higher support in failed ES proposals predicts subsequent ES incidents and the effects of these incidents on shareholder value. Examining the detailed records of fund votes, we find that agency frictions between a group of shareholders contribute to proposal failure. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究股东在环境和社会（ES）提案上的投票是否能够反映企业面临的ES风险。ES提案的独特之处在于它们几乎总是未能通过。我们考察共同基金对这些未通过提案的支持是否包含有关企业所面临ES风险的信息。未通过ES提案中较高的支持率预示着后续ES事件的发生以及这些事件对股东价值的影响。通过检查基金投票的详细记录，我们发现一组股东之间的代理摩擦导致了提案的失败。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Firm-Level Exposure to Epidemic Diseases: COVID-19, SARS, and H1N1
records.title_cn: 企业层面的传染病暴露：COVID-19、SARS和H1N1
records.abstract_en: We construct text-based measures of the primary concerns listed firms associated with the spread of COVID-19 and other epidemic diseases. We identify which firms perceive to lose or gain from a given epidemic and textually decompose the epidemic’s effect on the firm’s demand and supply. We find that the effects of COVID-19 manifest as a simultaneous shock to demand and supply, with both shocks affecting firms’ market valuations in equal measure on average. By contrast, demand-related impacts appear more important in accounting for the observed collapse in firm-level investment during the COVID-19 crisis. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了基于文本的衡量上市公司与COVID-19及其他传染病传播相关的主要担忧的指标。我们识别哪些企业认为在特定传染病中受损或受益，并从文本上分解传染病对企业需求和供给的影响。我们发现，COVID-19的影响表现为需求和供给的同时冲击，平均而言，这两种冲击对企业市场估值的影响程度相当。相比之下，在与需求相关的冲击在解释COVID-19危机期间观察到的企业层面投资崩溃方面显得更为重要。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Measuring the Expected Effects of the Global Tax Reform
records.title_cn: 衡量全球税制改革的预期效应
records.abstract_en: Over 140 countries agreed on a fundamental corporate tax reform in 2021 to be implemented in 2023 and beyond. To measure its potential effects, we study asset price changes within minutes of the reform announcements. We construct proxies for the reform’s costs regarding U.S. companies’ tax burdens and countries’ public finances. Likely exposed companies exhibit significant negative stock returns. Our lower-bound estimates indicate total shareholder value losses of $112.6 billion one day after the reform announcements. Further, likely exposed countries experience increases in sovereign debt credit risk. Our findings inform the cost-benefit analysis of a historical international tax reform. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 超过140个国家同意在2021年实施一项根本性的企业税制改革，并于2023年及以后实施。为了衡量其潜在影响，我们研究了改革公告发布后几分钟内的资产价格变化。我们构建了改革对美国公司税负和各国公共财政成本的代理变量。可能受影响的公司表现出显著的负股票回报。我们的下限估计表明，在改革公告发布一天后，股东总价值损失达112.6亿美元。此外，可能受影响的国家主权债务信用风险增加。我们的研究结果为这一历史性国际税制改革的成本效益分析提供了信息。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Inflation and Individual Investors’ Behavior: Evidence from the German Hyperinflation
records.title_cn: 通货膨胀与个人投资者行为：来自德国恶性通货膨胀的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyze how individual investors respond to inflation. We introduce a unique data set containing information on local inflation and security portfolios of more than 2,000 clients of a German bank between 1920 and 1924, covering the German hyperinflation. We find that individual investors buy fewer (sell more) stocks when facing higher local inflation. This effect is more pronounced for less sophisticated investors. Moreover, we document a positive relation between local inflation and forgone returns following stock sales. Our findings are consistent with individual investors suffering from money illusion. Alternative explanations, such as consumption needs, are unlikely to drive our results. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了个人投资者如何应对通货膨胀。我们引入了一个独特的数据集，其中包含1920年至1924年间德国一家银行超过2,000名客户的当地通货膨胀和证券投资组合信息，涵盖了德国恶性通货膨胀时期。我们发现，当面临较高的当地通货膨胀时，个人投资者会购买更少的股票（卖出更多股票）。这种效应在不太成熟的投资者中更为明显。此外，我们记录了当地通货膨胀与股票卖出后放弃的回报之间的正相关关系。我们的发现与个人投资者遭受货币幻觉的影响一致。其他解释，如消费需求，不太可能驱动我们的结果。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Cognitive Uncertainty
records.title_cn: 认知不确定性
records.abstract_en: This article documents the economic relevance of measuring cognitive uncertainty: people’s subjective uncertainty over their ex ante utility-maximizing decision. In a series of experiments on choice under risk, the formation of beliefs, and forecasts of economic variables, we show that cognitive uncertainty predicts various systematic biases in economic decisions. When people are cognitively uncertain—either endogenously or because the problem is designed to be complex—their decisions are heavily attenuated functions of objective probabilities, which gives rise to average behavior that is regressive to an intermediate option. This insight ties together a wide range of empirical regularities in behavioral economics that are typically viewed as distinct phenomena or even as reflecting preferences, including the probability weighting function in choice under risk; base rate insensitivity, conservatism, and sample size effects in belief updating; and predictable overoptimism and -pessimism in forecasts of economic variables. Our results offer a blueprint for how a simple measurement of cognitive uncertainty generates novel insights about what people find complex and how they respond to it.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了衡量认知不确定性的经济相关性：即人们对其事前效用最大化决策的主观不确定性。在一系列关于风险选择、信念形成和经济变量预测的实验中，我们表明认知不确定性可以预测经济决策中的各种系统性偏差。当人们在认知上不确定时——无论是内生性的还是因为问题被设计得复杂——他们的决策是客观概率的严重衰减函数，这导致平均行为向中间选项回归。这一见解将行为经济学中广泛的经验规律联系在一起，这些规律通常被视为不同的现象，甚至被视为反映偏好，包括风险选择中的概率加权函数；信念更新中的基础率不敏感、保守主义和样本量效应；以及经济变量预测中可预测的过度乐观和过度悲观。我们的结果为如何简单衡量认知不确定性提供了一幅蓝图，从而产生关于人们认为什么复杂以及他们如何应对复杂性的新见解。

records.title_en: Gender Differences in Job Search and the Earnings Gap: Evidence from the Field and Lab
records.title_cn: 求职中的性别差异与收入差距：来自实地和实验室的证据
records.abstract_en: This article investigates gender differences in the job search process in the field and lab. Our analysis is based on rich information on initial job offers and acceptances from undergraduates of Boston University’s Questrom School of Business. We find (i) a clear gender difference in the timing of job offer acceptance, with women accepting jobs substantially earlier than men, and (ii) a sizable gender earnings gap in accepted offers, which narrows in favor of women over the course of the job search period. To understand these patterns, we develop a job search model that incorporates gender differences in risk aversion and overoptimism about prospective offers. We validate the model’s assumptions and predictions using the survey data and present empirical evidence that the job search patterns in the field can be partly explained by the greater risk aversion displayed by women and the higher levels of overoptimism displayed by men. We replicate these findings in a laboratory experiment that features sequential job search and provide direct evidence on the purported mechanisms. Our findings highlight the importance of risk preferences and beliefs for gender differences in job-finding behavior and, consequently, early-career wage gaps among the highly educated.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了实地和实验室中求职过程中的性别差异。我们的分析基于波士顿大学奎斯特罗姆商学院本科生的初始工作机会和接受情况的丰富信息。我们发现（i）在工作机会接受的时间上存在明显的性别差异，女性比男性更早接受工作，以及（ii）在接受的工作机会中存在相当大的性别收入差距，随着求职期的推进，这一差距缩小并有利于女性。为了理解这些模式，我们开发了一个求职模型，该模型纳入了性别在风险厌恶和对未来工作机会过度乐观方面的差异。我们使用调查数据验证了模型的假设和预测，并提供了实证证据表明，实地中的求职模式可以部分由女性表现出的更高风险厌恶和男性表现出的更高过度乐观来解释。我们在一个具有顺序求职特征的实验室实验中复制了这些发现，并提供了关于所声称机制的直接证据。我们的发现强调了风险偏好和信念对于性别差异在求职行为中的重要性，以及由此导致的高学历人群早期职业收入差距。

records.title_en: A Fiscal Theory of Persistent Inflation
records.title_cn: 持续通胀的财政理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a new class of general-equilibrium models with partially unfunded debt to propose a fiscal theory of persistent inflation. In response to business cycle shocks, the monetary authority controls inflation and the fiscal authority stabilizes debt. However, the central bank accommodates unfunded fiscal shocks, causing persistent movements in inflation, output, and real interest rates. In an estimated quantitative model, fiscal inflation accounts for the bulk of inflation dynamics. In the aftermath of the pandemic, unfunded fiscal shocks sustain the recovery but also cause a persistent increase in inflation. The model is able to predict the inflationary effects of the American Rescue Plan Act fiscal stimulus out of sample and with real-time data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一类新的具有部分无资金支持债务的一般均衡模型，以提出一种持续通胀的财政理论。针对商业周期冲击，货币当局控制通胀，财政当局稳定债务。然而，中央银行适应无资金支持的财政冲击，导致通胀、产出和实际利率的持续变动。在一个估计的定量模型中，财政通胀解释了通胀动态的大部分。在疫情之后，无资金支持的财政冲击维持了复苏，但也导致了通胀的持续上升。该模型能够利用实时数据在样本外预测《美国救援计划法案》财政刺激的通胀效应。

records.title_en: Children’s Indirect Exposure to the U.S. Justice System: Evidence From Longitudinal Links between Survey and Administrative Data
records.title_cn: 儿童对美国司法系统的间接暴露：基于调查与行政数据纵向链接的证据
records.abstract_en: Children’s indirect exposure to the justice system through biological parents or coresident adults is both a marker of their own vulnerability and a measure of the justice system’s expansive reach in society. Estimating the size of this population for the United States has historically been hampered by inadequate data resources, including the inability to observe nonincarceration events, follow children throughout their childhood, and measure adult nonbiological parent cohabitants. To overcome these challenges, we leverage billions of restricted administrative and survey records linked with Criminal Justice Administrative Records System data and find substantially larger exposure rates than previously reported: prison, 9% of children born between 1999–2005; felony conviction, 18%; and any criminal charge, 39%. Charge exposure rates exceed 60% for Black, American Indian, and low-income children. While broader definitions reach a more expansive population, strong and consistently negative correlations with childhood well-being suggest that these remain valuable predictors of vulnerability. Finally, we document substantial geographic variation in exposure, which we leverage in a movers design to estimate the effect of living in a high-exposure county during childhood. We find that children moving into high-exposure counties are more likely to experience postmove exposure events and exhibit significantly worse outcomes by age 26 on multiple dimensions (earnings, criminal activity, teen parenthood, mortality); effects are strongest for those who moved at earlier ages.
records.abstract_cn: 儿童通过亲生父母或同住成人间接暴露于司法系统，既是其自身脆弱性的标志，也是司法系统在社会中广泛覆盖程度的衡量。历史上，估算美国这一人群的规模一直受到数据资源不足的阻碍，包括无法观察非监禁事件、无法在整个童年期追踪儿童，以及无法衡量非亲生父母同住成人。为克服这些挑战，我们利用了数十亿条受限行政和调查记录，并与刑事司法行政记录系统数据相链接，发现暴露率远高于先前报告的水平：监狱，1999-2005年间出生的儿童中占9%；重罪定罪，占18%；任何刑事指控，占39%。黑人、美洲印第安人和低收入儿童的指控暴露率超过60%。虽然更宽泛的定义覆盖了更广泛的人群，但与儿童福祉的强烈且一致的负相关表明，这些仍然是脆弱性的有效预测指标。最后，我们记录了暴露率的显著地理差异，并利用移动者设计来估计童年时期居住在高暴露县的影响。我们发现，搬入高暴露县的儿童更可能经历搬迁后的暴露事件，并在26岁时在多个维度（收入、犯罪活动、青少年生育、死亡率）表现出显著更差的结果；对较早年龄搬迁者的影响最强。

records.title_en: What We Teach About Race and Gender: Representation in Images and Text of Children’s Books
records.title_cn: 我们如何教授种族与性别：儿童书籍图像与文本中的代表性
records.abstract_en: Books shape how children learn about society and norms, in part through representation of different characters. We use computational tools to characterize representation in children’s books widely read in homes, classrooms, and libraries over the past century and describe economic forces that may contribute to these patterns. We introduce new artificial intelligence methods for systematically converting images into data. We apply these tools, alongside text analysis methods, to measure skin color, race, gender, and age in the content of these books, documenting what has changed and what has endured over time. We find underrepresentation of Black and Latinx people in the most influential books, relative to their population shares, though representation of Black individuals increases over time. Females are also increasingly present but appear less often in text than in images, suggesting greater symbolic inclusion in pictures than substantive inclusion in stories. Characters in these influential books have lighter average skin color than in other books, even after conditioning on race, and children are depicted with lighter skin color than adults on average. We present empirical analysis of related economic behavior to better understand the representation we find in these books. On the demand side, we show that people consume books that center their own identities and that the types of children’s books purchased correlate with local political beliefs. On the supply side, we document higher prices for books that center nondominant social identities and fewer copies of these books in libraries that serve predominantly White communities.
records.abstract_cn: 书籍通过呈现不同角色，部分地塑造了儿童对社会和规范的学习。我们使用计算工具来表征过去一个世纪中，家庭、教室和图书馆广泛阅读的儿童书籍中的代表性，并描述可能促成这些模式的经济力量。我们引入了新的人工智能方法，系统地将图像转换为数据。我们将这些工具与文本分析方法一起应用，以测量这些书籍内容中的肤色、种族、性别和年龄，记录随时间变化的内容和持续不变的内容。我们发现，在最具影响力的书籍中，黑人和拉丁裔人群的代表性不足，相对于他们的人口比例，尽管黑人个体的代表性随时间增加。女性也越来越多地出现，但在文本中的出现频率低于图像，这表明在图片中的象征性包容多于在故事中的实质性包容。这些有影响力的书籍中的角色平均肤色比其他书籍中的角色更浅，即使在控制种族后也是如此，而且儿童的平均肤色比成人更浅。我们提供了相关经济行为的实证分析，以更好地理解我们在这些书籍中发现的代表性。在需求方面，我们表明人们消费以自己身份为中心的书籍，并且购买的儿童书籍类型与当地政治信仰相关。在供给方面，我们记录了以非主导社会身份为中心的书籍价格更高，而在主要为白人社区服务的图书馆中，这些书籍的副本较少。

records.title_en: Labor Market Dynamics and Development
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场动态与发展
records.abstract_en: We provide new evidence on how labor market dynamics vary with development. We build a new data set consisting of harmonized microdata from rotating panel labor force surveys covering 80 million people from 49 countries. Labor market flows, such as the job-finding or employment exit rate, are higher in developing economies. These higher flows largely reflect a slippery job ladder: workers transition frequently to and from marginal employment without climbing to or persisting in better-paying jobs. Subsistence self-employment and different patterns of selection for wage workers each play a role in our findings and are useful avenues for future theories of labor market frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于劳动力市场动态如何随发展变化的新证据。我们构建了一个新的数据集，包含来自80个国家、覆盖49万人的轮转面板劳动力调查的统一微观数据。发展中经济体的劳动力市场流动率，如找工作率或就业退出率，更高。这些较高的流动率在很大程度上反映了不稳定的职业阶梯：工人频繁地在边缘就业之间转换，而未能攀升至或保持在薪酬更高的岗位上。生存型自雇就业和工资劳动者不同的选择模式在我们的发现中都发挥了作用，并为未来劳动力市场摩擦理论提供了有用的途径。

records.title_en: A Quantity-Driven Theory of Term Premia and Exchange Rates
records.title_cn: 数量驱动的期限溢价与汇率理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a model in which specialized bond investors must absorb shocks to the supply and demand for long-term bonds in two currencies. Since long-term bonds and foreign exchange are both exposed to unexpected movements in short-term interest rates, a shift in the supply of long-term bonds in one currency influences the foreign exchange rate between the two currencies, as well as bond term premia in both currencies. Our model matches several important empirical patterns, including the comovement between exchange rates and term premia, and the finding that central banks’ quantitative easing policies affect exchange rates. An extension of our model links spot exchange rates to the persistent deviations from covered interest rate parity that have emerged since 2008.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，专业债券投资者必须吸收两种货币长期债券供需冲击。由于长期债券和外汇都面临短期利率意外变动的风险，一种货币长期债券供给的变动会影响两种货币之间的汇率以及两种货币的债券期限溢价。我们的模型匹配了几个重要的实证模式，包括汇率与期限溢价之间的联动，以及中央银行量化宽松政策影响汇率的发现。我们模型的扩展将即期汇率与自2008年以来出现的持续偏离有担保利率平价的现象联系起来。

records.title_en: Buyers’ Sourcing Strategies and Suppliers’ Markups in Bangladeshi Garments
records.title_cn: 孟加拉国服装买家的采购策略和供应商的加价
records.abstract_en: We study differences in markups earned by Bangladeshi garment exporters across buyers with different sourcing strategies and make three contributions. First, we distinguish buyers with a relational versus a spot sourcing strategy and show that a buyer’s sourcing strategy is correlated across products and origins. Buyer fixed effects explain most of the variation in sourcing strategies, suggesting that these depend on organizational capabilities. Second, we use novel data that match quantities and prices of the two main variable inputs in the production of garments (fabric and labor on sewing lines) to specific export orders. We derive conditions under which these data allow measurement of within exporter-product-time differences in markups across orders produced for different buyers. Third, we show that exporters earn higher markups on otherwise identical orders produced for relational, as opposed to spot, buyers. A sourcing model with imperfect contract enforcement, idiosyncratic shocks to exporters, and buyers that adopt different sourcing strategies trading off higher prices and reliable supply rationalizes this and other observed facts in the industry. We discuss alternative explanations and policy implications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了孟加拉国服装出口商在采用不同采购策略的买家中获得的加价差异，并做出了三点贡献。首先，我们区分买家的关系采购策略和现货采购策略，并表明买家的采购策略与产品和原产地相关。买方固定效应解释了采购策略的大部分变化，表明这些变化取决于组织能力。其次，我们使用新颖的数据将服装生产中两个主要可变投入（缝纫线上的面料和劳动力）的数量和价格与特定的出口订单相匹配。我们得出了一些条件，在这些条件下，这些数据可以测量出口商产品时间内为不同买家生产的订单的加价差异。第三，我们发现出口商在为关系买家（而不是现货买家）生产的其他相同订单上获得更高的加价。合同执行不完善的采购模式、对出口商的特殊冲击以及采用不同采购策略的买家在更高的价格和可靠的供应之间进行权衡，使这一点和行业中其他观察到的事实合理化。我们讨论替代解释和政策影响。

records.title_en: Search Frictions and Efficiency in Decentralized Transport Markets
records.title_cn: 分散化运输市场中的搜索摩擦与效率
records.abstract_en: We explore efficiency and optimal policy in decentralized transport markets, such as taxis, trucks, and bulk shipping. We show that in these markets, search frictions distort the transportation network and the dynamic allocation of carriers over space. We derive explicit and intuitive conditions for efficiency and show how they translate into efficient pricing rules, or optimal taxes and subsidies for the planner who cannot set prices directly. The results imply that destination-based pricing is essential to attain efficiency. Then, using data from dry bulk shipping, we demonstrate that search frictions lead to a sizable social loss and substantial misallocation of ships over space. Optimal policy can eliminate about half of the welfare loss. Can a centralizing platform, often arising as a market-based solution to search frictions, do better? Interestingly, the answer is no; although the platform eradicates frictions, it exerts market power, thus eroding the welfare gains. Finally, we use two recent interventions in the industry (China’s Belt and Road Initiative and the environmental initiative IMO 2020) to demonstrate that taking into account the efficiency properties of transport markets is germane to any proposed policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了分散化运输市场（如出租车、卡车和散货航运）中的效率与最优政策。我们表明，在这些市场中，搜索摩擦扭曲了运输网络和承运人在空间上的动态配置。我们推导出明确且直观的效率条件，并展示这些条件如何转化为有效的定价规则，或对于无法直接设定价格的政策制定者而言的最优税收和补贴。结果表明，基于目的地的定价对于实现效率至关重要。然后，利用干散货航运的数据，我们证明搜索摩擦导致可观的社会损失和船舶在空间上的显著错配。最优政策可以消除约一半的福利损失。一个集中化平台——通常作为搜索摩擦的市场化解决方案出现——能否做得更好？有趣的是，答案是否定的；尽管该平台消除了摩擦，但它行使市场力量，从而侵蚀了福利收益。最后，我们利用该行业的两次近期干预（中国的“一带一路”倡议和环境倡议IMO 2020）来证明，考虑运输市场的效率属性与任何拟议政策都密切相关。

records.title_en: The Damages and Distortions from Discrimination in the Rental Housing Market
records.title_cn: 租赁住房市场歧视的损害与扭曲
records.abstract_en: By constraining an individual’s choice during a search, housing discrimination distorts sorting decisions away from true preferences and results in a ceteris paribus reduction in welfare. This study combines a large-scale field experiment with a residential sorting model to derive utility-theoretic measures of renter welfare loss associated with the constraints imposed by discrimination in the rental housing market. Results from experiments conducted in five cities show that key neighborhood amenities are associated with higher levels of discrimination. Counterfactual simulations based on the sorting model suggest that discrimination imposes damages equivalent to 4.4% and 3.5% of the annual incomes for African American and Hispanic/Latinx renters, respectively. Damages are increasing in income for African American renters, such that effects become stronger for economically mobile households. Renters of color must make substantial investments in additional search to mitigate the costs of these constraints. We find that a naive model ignoring discrimination constraints yields biased estimates of willingness to pay for key neighborhood amenities.
records.abstract_cn: 通过限制个体在搜索过程中的选择，住房歧视扭曲了偏离真实偏好的分类决策，并在其他条件相同的情况下导致福利减少。本研究将大规模实地实验与居住分类模型相结合，推导出与租赁住房市场歧视所施加限制相关的租房者福利损失的效用理论度量。在五个城市进行的实验结果表明，关键社区便利设施与更高水平的歧视相关。基于分类模型的反事实模拟表明，歧视对非裔美国人和西班牙裔/拉丁裔租房者造成的损害分别相当于其年收入的4.4%和3.5%。对于非裔美国人租房者，损害随收入增加而增加，因此对经济流动性较强的家庭影响更强。有色人种租房者必须进行大量额外的搜索投资以减轻这些限制的成本。我们发现，忽略歧视约束的朴素模型会对关键社区便利设施的支付意愿产生有偏估计。

records.title_en: Economic Consequences of Kinship: Evidence From U.S. Bans on Cousin Marriage
records.title_cn: 亲属关系的经济后果：来自美国禁止表亲婚姻的证据
records.abstract_en: Close-kin marriage, by sustaining tightly knit family structures, may impede development. We find support for this hypothesis using U.S. state bans on cousin marriage. Our measure of cousin marriage comes from the excess frequency of same-surname marriages, a method borrowed from population genetics that we apply to millions of marriage records from the eighteenth to the twentieth century. Using census data, we first show that married cousins are more rural and have lower-paying occupations. We then turn to an event study analysis to understand how cousin marriage bans affected outcomes for treated birth cohorts. We find that these bans led individuals from families with high rates of cousin marriage to migrate off farms and into urban areas. They also gradually shift to higher-paying occupations. We observe increased dispersion, with individuals from these families living in a wider range of locations and adopting more diverse occupations. Our findings suggest that these changes were driven by the social and cultural effects of dispersed family ties rather than genetics. Notably, the bans also caused more people to live in institutional settings for the elderly, infirm, or destitute, suggesting weaker support from kin.
records.abstract_cn: 近亲婚姻通过维持紧密的家庭结构，可能阻碍发展。我们利用美国各州对表亲婚姻的禁令找到了支持这一假设的证据。我们对表亲婚姻的衡量来自同姓婚姻的过剩频率，这是一种从群体遗传学中借鉴的方法，我们将其应用于十八至二十世纪的数百万条婚姻记录。利用人口普查数据，我们首先表明已婚表亲更倾向于农村地区，且从事较低收入的职业。然后，我们转向事件研究分析，以了解表亲婚姻禁令如何影响受处理出生队列的结果。我们发现，这些禁令导致来自表亲婚姻率高的家庭的个人从农场迁移到城市地区。他们也逐渐转向收入更高的职业。我们观察到分散程度增加，这些家庭的个人居住在更广泛的地点，并从事更多样化的职业。我们的发现表明，这些变化是由分散的家庭联系的社会和文化效应驱动的，而非遗传。值得注意的是，这些禁令还导致更多人居住在养老院、医院或济贫院等机构环境中，这表明亲属支持减弱。

records.title_en: Seeing What is Representative
records.title_cn: 看见代表性
records.abstract_en: We provide evidence for a bias that we call “representative signal distortion” (RSD), which is particularly relevant to settings of statistical discrimination. Experimental subjects distort their evaluation of new evidence on individual group members and interpret such information to be more representative of the group to which the individual belongs (relative to a reference group) than it really is. This produces a discriminatory gap in the evaluation of members of the two groups. Because it is driven by representativeness, the bias (and the discriminatory gap) disappears when subjects are prevented from contrasting different groups; because it is a bias in the interpretation of information, it disappears when subjects receive information before learning of the individual’s group. We show that this bias can be easily estimated from appropriately constructed data sets and can be distinguished from previously documented inferential biases in the literature. Importantly, we document how removing the bias produces a kind of free lunch in reducing discrimination, making it possible to significantly reduce discrimination without lowering accuracy of inferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一种我们称之为“代表性信号扭曲”（RSD）的偏见的证据，这种偏见与统计歧视的情境尤为相关。实验主体会扭曲他们对个体群体成员新证据的评估，并将此类信息解释为比实际更能代表该个体所属群体（相对于参照群体）。这导致了对两个群体成员评估中的歧视性差距。由于这种偏见是由代表性驱动的，当主体被阻止对比不同群体时，这种偏见（以及歧视性差距）就会消失；由于这是信息解释中的偏见，当主体在了解个体所属群体之前收到信息时，这种偏见就会消失。我们表明，这种偏见可以很容易地从适当构建的数据集中估计出来，并且可以与文献中先前记录的推断性偏见区分开来。重要的是，我们记录了消除这种偏见如何在减少歧视方面产生一种“免费午餐”，使得在不降低推断准确性的情况下显著减少歧视成为可能。

records.title_en: The importance of supply and demand for oil prices: Evidence from non‐Gaussianity
records.title_cn: 石油价格供需的重要性：来自非高斯性的证据
records.abstract_en: When quantifying the importance of supply and demand for oil price fluctuations, a wide range of estimates have been reported. Models identified via a sharp upper bound on the short‐run price elasticity of supply find supply shocks to be minor drivers. In turn, when replacing the upper bound with a weakly informative prior, supply shocks turn out to be substantially more important. In this paper, I revisit the evidence in a model that combines weakly informative priors with identification by non‐Gaussianity. For this purpose, a SVAR is developed where the unknown distributions of the structural shocks are modeled nonparametrically. The empirical findings suggest that once identification by non‐Gaussianity is incorporated into the model, posterior mass of the short‐run oil supply elasticity shifts toward zero and oil supply shocks become minor drivers of oil prices. In terms of contributions to the forecast error variance of oil prices, the model arrives at median estimates of just 6% over a 16‐month horizon.
records.abstract_cn: 在量化供需对石油价格波动的重要性时，已有研究报道了广泛的估计结果。通过短期石油供给价格弹性的严格上界识别的模型发现供给冲击是次要驱动因素。相反，当用弱信息先验替代上界时，供给冲击变得重要得多。在本文中，我在一个结合弱信息先验与非高斯性识别的模型中重新审视证据。为此，开发了一个SVAR，其中结构冲击的未知分布以非参数方式建模。实证结果表明，一旦将非高斯性识别纳入模型，短期石油供给弹性的后验质量向零移动，石油供给冲击成为石油价格的次要驱动因素。就石油价格预测误差方差的贡献而言，模型在16个月的时间范围内得出的中位数估计仅为6%。

records.title_en: Local projections, autocorrelation, and efficiency
records.title_cn: 局部投影、自相关与效率
records.abstract_en: It is well known that Local Projections (LP) residuals are autocorrelated. Conventional wisdom says that LP have to be estimated by OLS and that GLS is not possible because the autocorrelation process is unknown and/or because the GLS estimator would be inconsistent. I show that the autocorrelation process of LP can be written as a Vector Moving Average (VMA) process of the Wold errors and impulse responses and that autocorrelation can be corrected for using a consistent GLS estimator. Monte Carlo simulations show that estimating LP with GLS can lead to more efficient estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 众所周知，局部投影（LP）的残差存在自相关。传统观点认为，LP必须通过OLS估计，而GLS不可行，因为自相关过程未知和/或GLS估计量将不一致。我证明了LP的自相关过程可以写成Wold误差和脉冲响应的向量移动平均（VMA）过程，并且可以使用一致的GLS估计量来修正自相关。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，使用GLS估计LP可以带来更有效的估计。

records.title_en: A new posterior sampler for Bayesian structural vector autoregressive models
records.title_cn: 贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型的一种新后验抽样器
records.abstract_en: We develop an importance sampler for sign restricted Bayesian structural vector autoregressive models. The algorithm nests as a special case the sampler associated with the popular Normal inverse Wishart Uniform prior, while allowing to move beyond such prior in medium sized models. We then propose a prior on contemporaneous impulse responses that provides flexibility on the magnitude and shape of the impact responses. We illustrate the quantitative relevance of the choice of the prior in an application to US monetary policy shocks. We find that the real effects of monetary policy shocks are stronger under our proposed prior than in the Normal inverse Wishart Uniform setup.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为带符号约束的贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型开发了一种重要性抽样器。该算法将流行的正态逆 Wishart 均匀先验相关的抽样器作为特例嵌套其中，同时允许在中型模型中超越此类先验。然后，我们提出了一种关于同期脉冲响应的先验，该先验在冲击响应的幅度和形状上提供了灵活性。我们在一个美国货币政策冲击的应用中说明了先验选择的定量相关性。我们发现，在我们提出的先验下，货币政策冲击的实际效应比正态逆 Wishart 均匀设置下更强。

records.title_en: Demand estimation with infrequent purchases and small market sizes
records.title_cn: 低频购买与小市场规模下的需求估计
records.abstract_en: We propose a demand estimation method that allows for a large number of zero‐ sale observations, rich unobserved heterogeneity, and endogenous prices. We do so by modeling small market sizes through Poisson arrivals. Each of these arriving consumers solves a standard discrete choice problem. We present a Bayesian IV estimation approach that addresses sampling error in product shares and scales well to rich data environments. The data requirements are traditional market‐level data as well as a measure of market sizes or consumer arrivals. After presenting simulation studies, we demonstrate the method in an empirical application of air travel demand.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种需求估计方法，该方法允许大量零销售观测值、丰富的未观测异质性和内生价格。我们通过泊松到达来建模小市场规模。每个到达的消费者解决一个标准的离散选择问题。我们提出了一种贝叶斯工具变量估计方法，该方法解决了产品份额中的抽样误差，并能很好地扩展到丰富的数据环境。数据要求是传统的市场层面数据以及市场规模或消费者到达的度量。在展示模拟研究之后，我们在航空旅行需求的实证应用中演示了该方法。

records.title_en: Spatial interactions
records.title_cn: 空间互动
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how the strength of social ties is affected by the geographical location of other individuals and their social capital. We characterize the equilibrium in terms of both social interactions and social capital. We show that lower travel costs increase not only the interaction frequency but also the social capital for all agents. We also show that the equilibrium frequency of interactions is lower than the efficient one. Using a unique geocoded data set of friendship networks among adolescents in the United States, we structurally estimate the model and show that indeed agents socially interact less than that at the first best optimum. Our policy analysis suggests that, at the same cost, subsidizing social interactions yield a higher total welfare than subsidizing transportation costs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究社会联系的强度如何受到其他个体的地理位置及其社会资本的影响。我们从社会互动和社会资本两方面刻画均衡。我们表明，较低的旅行成本不仅增加了互动频率，也增加了所有参与者的社会资本。我们还表明，互动的均衡频率低于有效频率。利用美国青少年友谊网络的独特地理编码数据集，我们对模型进行了结构估计，并表明确实参与者的社会互动低于最优水平。我们的政策分析表明，在相同成本下，补贴社会互动比补贴交通成本能带来更高的总福利。

records.title_en: Capital reallocation and the cyclicality of aggregate productivity
records.title_cn: 资本再配置与总体生产率的周期性
records.abstract_en: Capital reallocation between firms is procyclical and leads to variations in measured aggregate productivity. In this paper, we ask how much of the cyclical variation in measured productivity is the consequence of capital reallocation. We build a heterogeneous‐firm model to study the effects of exogenous shocks to total factor productivity (TFP) and to the costs of reallocation. These shocks cause an endogenous cyclicality of measured aggregate productivity. Only a model driven by exogenous TFP shocks is able to generate both data‐consistent cyclical movements in reallocation and sizeable variations in measured aggregate productivity. We find that capital reallocation does not play a major role in amplifying aggregate productivity variations over the business cycle.
records.abstract_cn: 企业间的资本再配置是顺周期的，并导致所测度的总体生产率发生变化。在本文中，我们探讨所测度生产率的周期性变化中有多少是资本再配置的结果。我们构建了一个异质性企业模型，以研究全要素生产率（TFP）的外生冲击和再配置成本的冲击的影响。这些冲击引起了所测度总体生产率的内生周期性。只有由外生TFP冲击驱动的模型才能同时产生与数据一致的再配置周期性变动和所测度总体生产率的显著变化。我们发现，资本再配置在放大商业周期中的总体生产率变动方面并未发挥主要作用。

records.title_en: Tax‐and‐transfer progressivity and business cycles
records.title_cn: 税收与转移支付的累进性与经济周期
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how tax‐and‐transfer progressivity influences aggregate fluctuations when interacting with household heterogeneity. Using a simple static model of the extensive margin labor supply, we analytically characterize how a degree of progressivity influences differential labor supply responses to aggregate conditions across heterogeneous households. We then build a quantitative dynamic general equilibrium model with both idiosyncratic and aggregate productivity shocks and show that it delivers moderately procyclical average labor productivity and a large cyclical volatility of aggregate hours relative to output. Our quantitative exercises suggest that progressivity at the bottom of the income distribution shaped by the phasing out of transfers is key for these findings. Finally, we provide suggestive empirical evidence on the heterogeneity of employment responses across the wage distribution.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究税收与转移支付的累进性在与家庭异质性相互作用时如何影响总体波动。利用一个简单的扩展边际劳动力供给静态模型，我们从分析上刻画了累进程度如何影响异质性家庭对总体状况的差异化劳动力供给反应。然后，我们构建了一个包含异质性和总体生产率冲击的定量动态一般均衡模型，并表明该模型能产生适度顺周期的平均劳动生产率以及相对于产出的大幅周期性波动。我们的定量实验表明，由转移支付逐步退出所塑造的收入分配底部的累进性对这些发现至关重要。最后，我们提供了关于工资分布中就业反应异质性的提示性经验证据。

records.title_en: Behavioral learning equilibria in New Keynesian models
records.title_cn: 新凯恩斯主义模型中的行为学习均衡
records.abstract_en: We introduce Behavioral Learning Equilibria (BLE) into a multivariate linear framework and apply it to New Keynesian DSGE models. In a BLE, boundedly rational agents use simple, but optimal AR(1) forecasting rules whose parameters are consistent with the observed sample mean and autocorrelation of past data. We study the BLE concept in a standard 3‐equation New Keynesian model and develop an estimation methodology for the canonical Smets and Wouters (2007) model. A horse race between Rational Expectations (REE), BLE, and constant gain learning models shows that the BLE model outperforms the REE benchmark and is competitive with constant gain learning models in terms of in‐sample and out‐of‐sample fitness. Sample‐autocorrelation learning of optimal AR(1) beliefs provides the best fit when short‐term survey data on inflation expectations are taken into account in the estimation. As a policy application, we show that optimal Taylor rules under AR(1) expectations inherit history dependence and require a lower degrees of interest rate smoothing than REE.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将行为学习均衡 (BLE) 引入多元线性框架，并将其应用于新凯恩斯 DSGE 模型。在 BLE 中，有限理性代理使用简单但最优的 AR(1) 预测规则，其参数与观察到的样本均值和过去数据的自相关一致。我们在标准 3 方程新凯恩斯模型中研究 BLE 概念，并开发了规范 Smets 和 Wouters (2007) 模型的估计方法。理性期望 (REE)、BLE 和恒定增益学习模型之间的赛马表明，BLE 模型优于 REE 基准，并且在样本内和样本外适应度方面与恒定增益学习模型具有竞争力。当在估计中考虑通货膨胀预期的短期调查数据时，最优 AR(1) 信念的样本自相关学习提供了最佳拟合。作为政策应用，我们表明 AR(1) 期望下的最优泰勒规则继承了历史依赖性，并且需要比 REE 更低程度的利率平滑。

records.title_en: Costly information acquisition in centralized matching markets
records.title_cn: 集中匹配市场中的昂贵信息获取
records.abstract_en: When applying to a university, students and their parents devote considerable time acquiring information about university programs in order to form preferences. We explore ways to reduce wasteful information acquisition, that is, to help students avoid acquiring information about out‐of‐reach schools or universities, using a market design approach. Focusing on markets where students are ranked by universities based on exam scores, we find that, both theoretically and experimentally, a sequential serial dictatorship mechanism leads to higher student welfare than a direct serial dictatorship mechanism. This is because the sequential mechanism informs students about which universities are willing to admit them, thereby directing their search. Our experiments also show that the sequential mechanism has behavioral advantages because subjects deviate from the optimal search strategy less frequently than under the direct mechanism. Furthermore, providing historical cutoff scores under the direct mechanism can increase student welfare, especially when the information costs are high, although the observed effect is weaker than that of a sequential mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 在申请大学时，学生及其父母会投入大量时间获取关于大学项目的信息以形成偏好。我们探索减少浪费性信息获取的方法，即通过市场设计方法帮助学生避免获取关于遥不可及的学校或大学的信息。聚焦于学生根据考试成绩被大学排名的市场，我们在理论和实验上均发现，序贯独裁机制比直接独裁机制带来更高的学生福利。这是因为序贯机制告知学生哪些大学愿意录取他们，从而引导他们的搜索。我们的实验还表明，序贯机制具有行为优势，因为受试者偏离最优搜索策略的频率低于直接机制。此外，在直接机制下提供历史分数线可以增加学生福利，尤其是在信息成本高时，尽管观察到的效果弱于序贯机制。

records.title_en: Combining Aggregate Demand and Discrete Choice Data with Application to Deer License Demand in Indiana
records.title_cn: 结合加总需求与离散选择数据及其在印第安纳州鹿许可证需求中的应用
records.abstract_en: Estimating demand for licenses for recreational activities is complicated because of a lack of meaningful variation across time, space, buyer types, and license attributes, including price. Prior work uses discrete choice experiments (DCEs) to overcome this challenge, but the resulting demand models are unlikely to replicate observed demands in the absence of ad hoc calibration procedures. We use a generalized method of moments–based approach that combines DCE data with observed market share data to estimate a choice model that yields demand functions that much more closely replicate observed data.
records.abstract_cn: 由于时间、空间、购买者类型和许可证属性（包括价格）缺乏有意义的变动，估计休闲活动许可证的需求变得复杂。先前的研究使用离散选择实验（DCEs）来克服这一挑战，但由此产生的需求模型在缺乏临时校准程序的情况下不太可能复制观察到的需求。我们采用基于广义矩估计的方法，将DCE数据与观察到的市场份额数据相结合，以估计一个选择模型，该模型产生的需求函数能更紧密地复制观察到的数据。

records.title_en: Estimating the Ex Ante Recreational Loss of an Oil Spill Using Revealed and Stated Preference Data
records.title_cn: 利用揭示偏好和陈述偏好数据估算石油泄漏的事前休闲损失
records.abstract_en:
ABSTRACT

This paper combines data to estimate the ex-ante recreational impact of oil spills. Using a unique contingent behavior question, our application highlights the gains in combining stated and revealed preferences. We consider both a reduction of the available choice set and of perceived site quality. We show that omitting perceived site quality leads to low welfare losses while omitting alternative specific constants leads to high welfare losses. Overall, we find recreational losses due to potential oil spills in Norway ranging from 347 and 524 NOK (32 to 49 US dollars) per person across the four oil spill scenarios.
records.abstract_cn: 本文结合数据来估算石油泄漏的事前休闲影响。通过一个独特的条件行为问题，我们的应用突出了结合陈述偏好和揭示偏好的优势。我们同时考虑了可用选择集的减少和感知场地质量的下降。我们表明，忽略感知场地质量会导致较低的福利损失，而忽略替代特定常数则会导致较高的福利损失。总体而言，我们发现挪威潜在石油泄漏导致的休闲损失在四种石油泄漏情景下，每人介于347至524挪威克朗（32至49美元）之间。

records.title_en: Early Exposure to Nature and Willingness to Pay for It: The Value of Tallgrass Prairie Grassland Restoration
records.title_cn: 早期接触自然及其支付意愿：高草草原恢复的价值
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Widespread global grassland destruction motivates restoration efforts. However, little research on public preferences exists to inform restoration decisions, and reduced exposure to nature, such as grasslands, could diminish public willingness-to-pay (WTP) for it. We conduct a choice experiment to estimate preferences over Tallgrass Prairie grassland restorations and quantify how those preferences are correlated with childhood experiences. We find that WTP for grassland restoration can be large, especially with recreational opportunities. Furthermore, people who participated in outdoor activities or grew up near grasslands during their childhood would place a higher value on grassland restoration than people who did not.
records.abstract_cn: 全球范围内草原的广泛破坏促使了恢复工作的开展。然而，目前关于公众偏好的研究很少，难以指导恢复决策，而且减少接触自然（如草原）可能会降低公众对其的支付意愿（WTP）。我们进行了一项选择实验，以估计对高草草原恢复的偏好，并量化这些偏好与童年经历的关联。我们发现，对草原恢复的支付意愿可能很大，尤其是当包含娱乐机会时。此外，童年时期参与户外活动或在草原附近长大的人，对草原恢复的估值会高于没有这些经历的人。

records.title_en: The Value of Naturalness of Urban Green Spaces: Evidence from a Discrete Choice Experiment
records.title_cn: 城市绿地自然性的价值：来自离散选择实验的证据
records.abstract_en:
ABSTRACT

The range of benefits for humans and biodiversity conservation provided by urban green spaces (UGS) receives substantial attention in relation to urban planning and management. However, little is known about the value of nature in UGS. We developed a graphical measurement scale for the naturalness of UGS, with 5 steps between largely sealed and largely wilderness, which was embedded in an online survey and a discrete choice experiment. Using mixed logit models, we find that German citizens have a mean willingness to pay of €20.25 per month for an increase in the naturalness of the closest UGS by one step.
records.abstract_cn: 城市绿地（UGS）为人类和生物多样性保护提供的各种益处，在城市规划和管理中受到广泛关注。然而，关于UGS中自然的价值知之甚少。我们开发了一个用于UGS自然性的图形测量量表，在大部分密封和大部分荒野之间有5个等级，该量表嵌入在线调查和离散选择实验中。使用混合logit模型，我们发现德国公民平均愿意每月支付20.25欧元，以使最近的UGS自然性提高一个等级。

records.title_en: State Mandates on Renewable Heating Technologies and the Housing Market
records.title_cn: 州级可再生能源供暖技术强制规定与住房市场
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of a state-level mandate on renewable heating technologies on the housing market. The mandate requires a minimum share of 10% renewable energy sources when changing the heating system in the existing building stock. The mandate could lower the relative price of homes in the existing building stock. We implement a two-stage difference-in-differences nearest neighbor matching approach to identify the effect on prices taking advantage of differences in regulation by location and vintage of the building stock. We find no evidence of a negative effect of the mandate on housing prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了州级可再生能源供暖技术强制规定对住房市场的影响。该强制规定要求，在现有建筑存量中更换供暖系统时，可再生能源的最低占比为10%。该强制规定可能降低现有建筑存量中房屋的相对价格。我们采用两阶段双重差分最近邻匹配方法，利用不同地点和建筑年代在监管上的差异来识别对价格的影响。我们没有发现该强制规定对房价产生负面影响的证据。

records.title_en: The Impact of Water Body Restoration on the Sales and Rental Markets in Beijing
records.title_cn: 水体修复对北京销售和租赁市场的影响
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Black and odorous water bodies (BOWBs) are increasingly common in cities worldwide. This paper evaluates the impact of an urban water bodies restoration program in Beijing, China, based on detailed housing sale and rental transaction data. We implement a hedonic price model with a difference-in-difference and a triple difference approach and find that listing and restoration of a BOWB significantly increase house prices by 2.2-3.9 percent and 2.3-4.9 percent, respectively, while at the same time increase rents by 11.3-13.7 percent and 13.4-16.9 percent, respectively.
records.abstract_cn: 黑臭水体（BOWBs）在全球城市中日益普遍。本文基于详细的住房销售和租赁交易数据，评估了中国北京城市水体修复项目的影响。我们采用特征价格模型，结合双重差分和三重差分方法，发现黑臭水体的列入名单和修复分别显著提高了房价2.2-3.9%和2.3-4.9%，同时分别提高了租金11.3-13.7%和13.4-16.9%。

records.title_en: Taxation, Fiscal Redistribution, and Local Land Use Regulation
records.title_cn: 税收、财政再分配与地方土地使用规制
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

This paper explores the role of fiscal institutions for local land use. It argues that tax-base mobility results in an incentive to expand commercial and residential land use, which is mitigated by fiscal redistribution. These predictions are investigated empirically using a dataset of German municipalities. To identify differences in the exposure to fiscal redistribution, I exploit institutional characteristics of fiscal-equalization grants using a regression-discontinuity analysis. The results support the role of fiscal incentives for local land-use regulation, as commercial and residential land use is expanded much faster, and agricultural land use declines more rapidly in municipalities exempted from fiscal redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了财政制度对地方土地使用的作用。文章认为，税基流动性会产生扩大商业和住宅用地使用的激励，而这种激励会被财政再分配所缓解。利用德国市政当局的数据集对这些预测进行了实证研究。为了识别财政再分配暴露程度的差异，我利用财政均等化拨款的制度特征，采用断点回归分析。结果支持财政激励对地方土地使用规制的作用，因为免于财政再分配的市政当局中，商业和住宅用地使用扩张更快，农业用地使用下降更迅速。

records.title_en: A Half-Century of Yield Growth along the Forty-First Parallel of the Great Plains
records.title_cn: 大平原北纬四十一度沿线半个世纪的产量增长
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

We examine a half-century of crop yield growth along an 800-mile transect in the U.S. Great Plains. The main contributors to growth were non-specific technical change +53%, irrigation +26%, fertilizer +13% and chemicals +10%. Environmental changes were small and had a minor impact. The wide range of agroclimatic conditions produced significant sub-regional deviations. Irrigation was important in the more arid and warmer areas of the west, while fertilizer and chemicals were more important in the humid east. Sensitivity to weather has increased in the rainfed regions of the east while it has decreased in irrigated regions of the west.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了美国大平原一条800英里横断面沿线半个世纪的作物产量增长。增长的主要贡献因素是非特定技术变革（+53%）、灌溉（+26%）、化肥（+13%）和化学品（+10%）。环境变化很小，影响也较小。广泛的农业气候条件导致了显著的次区域差异。灌溉在西部更干旱和温暖的地区很重要，而化肥和化学品在湿润的东部更为重要。东部雨养地区对天气的敏感性有所增加，而西部灌溉地区的敏感性则有所下降。

records.title_en: Technology, Management, and Input Choices to Increase Abatement and Output
records.title_cn: 技术、管理与投入选择：提升减排与产出
records.abstract_en: A firm’s environmental performance and productivity result from decisions regarding input use and technological and management abatement strategy. Using a sample of chemical using/manufacturing/emitting facilities, this article examines how these choices are made and their effects on output and abatement. Not only are technological and management strategy adoption driven by different motives, adopting a management system discourages technological strategy adoption in the succeeding period. Further, dirty input use falls with technological strategy adoption but increases with management strategy adoption. These relationships require a more judicious approach to balancing the promotion of technological and management strategies vis-à-vis dirty input choices.
records.abstract_cn: 企业的环境绩效和生产率源于其关于投入使用以及技术和管理减排策略的决策。本文以使用、制造和排放化学品的设施为样本，考察这些选择如何做出及其对产出和减排的影响。不仅技术和策略的采用受不同动机驱动，管理系统的采用还会抑制后续时期技术策略的采用。此外，脏投入的使用随技术策略的采用而减少，但随管理策略的采用而增加。这些关系要求采取更审慎的方法来平衡技术和管理策略的推广与脏投入的选择。

records.title_en: Does Being Intergenerationally Accountable Resolve the Intergenerational Sustainability Dilemma?
records.title_cn: 代际问责能否解决代际可持续性困境？
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

We address whether being intergenerationally accountable (IA) is effective at maintaining intergenerational sustainability (IS) through conducting lab-in-the-field experiments of IS dilemma games. In baseline, a sequence of six generations, each composed of three members, is organized, and each generation chooses whether to maintain IS (sustainable option) or to maximize their payoff by imposing costs on future generations (unsustainable option) via deliberation. In IA, each generation is additionally asked to provide reasons and advice to subsequent generations along with the decision. Results indicate that IA induces generations to choose the sustainable option with positive reasons and advice, enhancing IS.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过开展代际可持续性困境博弈的实验室实地实验，探讨代际问责（IA）在维持代际可持续性（IS）方面是否有效。在基线中，组织了由六代人组成的序列，每代由三名成员组成，每代通过商议选择是维持IS（可持续选项）还是通过将成本强加给未来世代来最大化自身收益（不可持续选项）。在IA中，每代还被要求随决策向后续世代提供理由和建议。结果表明，IA促使各代选择带有积极理由和建议的可持续选项，从而增强了IS。

records.title_en: Estimating Consumer Willingness to Supply and Willingness to Pay for Curbside Recycling
records.title_cn: 估计消费者的供应意愿和支付路边回收的意愿
records.abstract_en: In the article “Estimating Consumer Willingness to Supply and Willingness to Pay for Curbside Recycling” published in the November 2012 issue of Land Economics (vol. 88 [4]: 745–63), Margaret Hughes-Morgan and Fred Morgan were inadvertently omitted as coauthors. The correction has been made in
records.abstract_cn: 在《土地经济学》十一月2012期（第88[4]：745-63）发表的文章《估算消费者供应意愿和路边回收支付意愿》中，玛格丽特·休斯-摩根和弗雷德·摩根作为共同作者被无意中遗漏。更正已于

records.title_en: Increasing the take-up of public health services: An at-scale experiment on digital government
records.title_cn: 提高公共卫生服务的利用率：一项关于数字政府的规模化实验
records.abstract_en: Increasing public service take-up is a critical challenge. We invested in a government-run digital appointment system for an important health screening service and conducted a large-scale experiment encouraging its use, specifically assessing the influence of transactions costs and information. Using administrative records on the near-universe of eligible women (47,600) in Uruguay’s capital city, we randomized invitations to book with our digital-system or as-usual with local clinics. Digital encouragements doubled medical visits versus as-usual invitations, and tripled compared to a pure control group (5.5 % versus 1.9 %) over 16 weeks. These large impacts are highly cost-effective, mediated by salience and reduced transactions costs.
records.abstract_cn: 提高公共服务利用率是一个关键挑战。我们投资了一个由政府运营的数字预约系统，用于一项重要的健康筛查服务，并开展了一项大规模实验鼓励其使用，特别评估了交易成本和信息的影响。利用乌拉圭首都近全部符合条件的女性（47,600人）的行政记录，我们随机分配邀请使用我们的数字系统预约或照常与当地诊所预约。数字鼓励措施使医疗就诊次数相比照常邀请翻倍，相比纯对照组增加了两倍（16周内为5.5%对1.9%）。这些巨大影响具有很高的成本效益，通过显著性和降低交易成本来实现。

records.title_en: Do housing regulations affect child development? Evidence and mechanisms
records.title_cn: 住房政策是否影响儿童发展？证据与机制
records.abstract_en: This study analyzes the effects of housing policies on child development. By exploiting the policy-induced discontinuity in house size in China, we find that favorable housing policies significantly reduce children’s cognitive skills, lessen their beliefs in an internal locus of control, and decrease their self-esteem but have little impact on their physical health or depression symptoms. The heterogeneous analyses show that children at a critical stage of skill formation, girls and children with longer exposure respond more strongly to housing policies. Furthermore, our mechanism decomposition shows that parenting skills play a large role in the effect of housing wealth on child development.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了住房政策对儿童发展的影响。通过利用中国住房面积的政策性断点，我们发现有利的住房政策显著降低了儿童的认知能力，削弱了他们对内在控制点的信念，并降低了他们的自尊，但对他们的身体健康或抑郁症状影响不大。异质性分析表明，处于技能形成关键阶段的儿童、女孩以及暴露时间更长的儿童对住房政策的反应更为强烈。此外，我们的机制分解表明，养育技能在住房财富对儿童发展的影响中发挥了重要作用。

records.title_en: Uncovering illegal and underground economies: The case of mafia extortion racketeering
records.title_cn: 揭露非法和地下经济：黑手党敲诈勒索的案例
records.abstract_en: I propose a new approach to quantify the economic cost of hidden economies and apply it to the case of mafia extortion in Northern Italy. To quantify the extortion rate, unobserved in the data, I first show that extortion racketeering is linked to resource misallocation. Then, I implement a structural estimation based on matching the observed misallocation in markets defined as mafia-infiltrated, with that predicted from a model whose parameters are estimated using data on non-mafia markets or calibrated from the literature. The results suggest that the share of output that the mafia extorts from firms ranges between 0.5 and 5 percent of firm-level output for those firms that are subject to extortion, with an implied loss between 0.6 and 8 percent of aggregate value added.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种新方法来量化隐藏经济的经济成本，并将其应用于意大利北部的黑手党敲诈案例。为了量化数据中未观察到的敲诈率，我首先表明敲诈勒索与资源错配有关。然后，我实施了一种结构估计，基于将定义为黑手党渗透的市场中观察到的错配，与使用非黑手党市场数据估计或从文献中校准的模型预测的错配进行匹配。结果表明，对于遭受敲诈的企业，黑手党从企业敲诈的产出份额介于0.5和5%的企业产出之间，隐含损失介于0.6和8%的总增加值之间。

records.title_en: With a little help from my friends. Political competition in the shadow of organized crime
records.title_cn: 在朋友的帮助下：有组织犯罪阴影下的政治竞争
records.abstract_en: Higher electoral competition may reinforce the position of politically active criminal organizations, which can endorse politicians in exchange for favors. This paper formalizes this intuition and test it on Italian electoral data, using the 1991 electoral reform as an exogenous source of variation in electoral competition in one of the two branches of the Parliament. Our triple-difference estimates suggest that after the reform mafia-prone areas reported higher vote shares awarded to the party traditionally supported by criminal organizations only for the branch affected by the reform, and a larger dispersion of votes across candidates of the same party.
records.abstract_cn: 更高的选举竞争可能会强化政治活跃的犯罪组织的地位，这些组织可以支持政治家以换取好处。本文形式化了这一直觉，并在意大利选举数据上进行了检验，利用1991年的选举改革作为议会两院之一选举竞争的外生变异来源。我们的三重差分估计表明，改革后，黑手党易发地区在受改革影响的议院中，传统上由犯罪组织支持的政党获得了更高的选票份额，并且同一政党候选人之间的选票分散程度更大。

records.title_en: Tax wedges, financial frictions and misallocation
records.title_cn: 税收楔子、金融摩擦与资源错配
records.abstract_en: We revisit the classical result that in a closed economy the incidence of corporate taxes on labor is approximately zero. We consider a rich general equilibrium framework, where agents differ in the level of their wealth as well as in their managerial and working ability. Potential entrepreneurs go through all the key decisions affected by corporate tax changes: the choice of (i) occupation, (ii) organizational form, (iii) investment, and (iv) financing structure. We allow both for the presence of financial frictions and the traditional tax advantage of debt over corporate equity, which jointly generate misallocation of capital and talent. In this environment we characterize the effects of increasing corporate taxes both analytically and for a calibrated version of the model. We show that this tax increase reallocates production from C corporations to pass-through businesses. Since, due to distorted prices, the latter have higher capital-labor ratios, this reallocation generates a reduction in labor productivity and wages. Furthermore, the corporate tax increase induces some C corporations to reorganize as pass-throughs, which implies more restricted access to external funds and thus a socially inefficient downsizing of production in these firms. Finally, the tax increase causes further misallocation of talent by inducing agents with low wealth relative to their managerial talent to switch from entrepreneurship to being workers, while the reverse happens for agents with higher wealth and lower managerial skills. Overall, we find that both labor and capital bear a large share of the corporate tax incidence, while entrepreneurs are net beneficiaries of the tax change.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了经典结论，即在封闭经济中，公司税对劳动力的归宿近似为零。我们考虑了一个丰富的一般均衡框架，其中个体在财富水平以及管理能力和工作能力上存在差异。潜在企业家会经历受公司税变化影响的所有关键决策：选择（i）职业，（ii）组织形式，（iii）投资，以及（iv）融资结构。我们同时考虑了金融摩擦的存在以及债务相对于公司股权的传统税收优势，这两者共同导致了资本和人才的错配。在这种环境下，我们从分析上和针对校准版本的模型两方面刻画了提高公司税的影响。我们表明，这种税收增加将生产从C类公司重新分配给穿透型企业。由于价格扭曲，后者的资本劳动比更高，这种重新分配导致劳动生产率下降和工资降低。此外，公司税增加促使一些C类公司重组为穿透型企业，这意味着外部融资渠道受限，从而导致这些企业生产规模的社会性低效缩减。最后，税收增加还通过诱导相对于其管理才能而言财富较低的个体从企业家转为工人，而财富较高且管理技能较低的个体则相反，从而进一步加剧了人才错配。总体而言，我们发现劳动力和资本都承担了公司税归宿的很大份额，而企业家则是税收变化的净受益者。

records.title_en: Kosher Pork
records.title_cn: 犹太洁食猪肉
records.abstract_en: There are two common views of pork barrel spending. One is that pork barrel spending benefits special interests at the expense of social welfare, hence antithetical to responsible policy making, especially in times of crisis. An alternative is that pork “greases the legislative wheels” making possible the enactment of socially beneficial legislation that would otherwise not pass. In this paper we reexamine both arguments and show that they depend on the nature of heterogeneity of interests and information across legislators. Under full information, but with heterogeneous ideology, policy compromise may be sufficient to pass beneficial legislation. Pork typically reduces welfare as in the conventional wisdom, but we also characterize cases where pork can indeed “grease the wheels” and improve social welfare. When agents are heterogeneous not only in their ideology, but also their information, allocation of pork may be crucial to passage of legislation appropriate to the situation. It does so not simply by inducing legislators to accept legislation they view as harmful, but also by conveying information about the necessity of policy change, where it may be impossible to convey such information in the absence of pork. Moreover, pork will be observed when the public good is most valuable precisely because it is valuable and the informed agenda setter wants to convey this information. Moreover, information may be conveyed for the reason pork is widely criticized, that is, because it benefits special interests.
records.abstract_cn: 关于猪肉桶支出有两种常见观点。一种观点认为，猪肉桶支出以社会福利为代价使特殊利益集团受益，因此与负责任的决策相悖，尤其是在危机时期。另一种观点则认为，猪肉“为立法车轮润滑”，使得原本无法通过的有益于社会的立法得以颁布。在本文中，我们重新审视了这两种论点，并表明它们取决于立法者之间利益和信息异质性的性质。在完全信息但意识形态异质的情况下，政策妥协可能足以通过有益立法。猪肉通常如传统观点所认为的那样降低福利，但我们也刻画了猪肉确实可以“润滑车轮”并改善社会福利的情形。当主体不仅在意识形态上而且在信息上存在异质性时，猪肉的分配可能对通过适合情况的立法至关重要。它这样做不仅是通过诱导立法者接受他们认为有害的立法，而且是通过传递关于政策变化必要性的信息，而在没有猪肉的情况下可能无法传递此类信息。此外，当公共物品最有价值时，恰恰因为其有价值且知情的议程设定者想要传递这一信息，猪肉将被观察到。而且，信息的传递可能正是出于猪肉被广泛批评的原因，即因为它使特殊利益集团受益。

records.title_en: Measuring take-up of the California EITC with state administrative data
records.title_cn: 利用州行政数据衡量加州劳动所得税抵免的领取情况
records.abstract_en: The Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) is the largest cash-based means-tested transfer program in the United States. In 2021, 31 million households received $64 billion from the federal EITC. Twenty-eight states also offer eligible taxpayers a supplement to the federal program. An estimated one-fifth of eligible households fail to claim the federal credit, but little is known about take-up of these state programs. We use administrative data from California on the population of Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) recipients linked to state tax records to estimate the number of households who are eligible for California’s supplement to the federal EITC (CalEITC) but do not claim it. We find that over 400,000 households who received SNAP benefits and who were eligible for the state EITC in 2017 did not receive the credit. This includes approximately 40,000 eligible households who claimed the federal EITC but not the state credit; nearly 98,000 eligible households who filed a state tax return but did not claim the state or federal credit; and roughly 270,000 eligible households who did not file a state tax return. The corresponding take-up rate for the CalEITC among eligible SNAP-enrolled households was 54%. Altogether, these households left a total of $71 million in state EITC funds on the table. If received, these credits would have increased incomes among these households by 2.7% and increased total state EITC outlays by 20%.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动所得税抵免（EITC）是美国最大的基于现金的资产调查转移支付项目。2021年，31万户家庭从联邦EITC获得了64亿美元。二十八个州还为符合条件的纳税人提供联邦项目的补充。据估计，五分之一的合格家庭未能申领联邦抵免，但关于这些州项目的领取情况知之甚少。我们使用加利福尼亚州补充营养援助计划（SNAP）受助者人口与州税务记录相关联的行政数据，来估计符合加州联邦EITC补充（CalEITC）条件但未申领的家庭数量。我们发现，400000年，超过2017户领取SNAP福利且符合州EITC条件的家庭未获得该抵免。这包括约40000户申领了联邦EITC但未申领州抵免的合格家庭；近98000户提交了州纳税申报表但未申领州或联邦抵免的合格家庭；以及约270000户未提交州纳税申报表的合格家庭。在符合条件的SNAP登记家庭中，CalEITC的相应领取率为54%。总体而言，这些家庭总共放弃了71万美元的州EITC资金。如果获得这些抵免，将使这些家庭的收入增加2.7%，并使州EITC总支出增加20%。

records.title_en: Bitcoin and carbon dioxide emissions: Evidence from daily production decisions
records.title_cn: 比特币与二氧化碳排放：来自每日生产决策的证据
records.abstract_en: Environmental externalities from cryptomining may be large, but have not been linked causally to mining incentives. We exploit daily variation in Bitcoin price as a natural experiment for an 86 megawatt waste coal-fired power plant with on-site cryptomining. We find that carbon emissions respond swiftly to mining incentives, with price elasticities of 0.69–0.71 in the short-run and 0.33–0.40 in the longer run. A $1 increase in Bitcoin price leads to $3.11–$6.79 in external damages from carbon emissions alone, well exceeding cryptomining’s value added (using a $190 social cost of carbon, but ignoring increased local air pollution). As cryptomining requires ever more computing power to mine a given number of blocks, our study highlights both the revitalization of US fossil assets and the need for financial industry accounting to incorporate cryptomining externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 加密货币挖矿的环境外部性可能很大，但尚未与挖矿激励建立因果关系。我们利用比特币价格的日度变化作为一项自然实验，研究对象是一家装机容量为86兆瓦、现场进行加密货币挖矿的废煤发电厂。我们发现碳排放对挖矿激励反应迅速，短期价格弹性为0.69-0.71，长期为0.33-0.40。比特币价格每上涨1美元，仅碳排放造成的外部损害就达3.11-6.79美元，远超加密货币挖矿的附加值（使用190美元的社会碳成本，但忽略当地空气污染的加剧）。由于挖矿需要越来越多的计算能力来挖掘给定数量的区块，我们的研究既凸显了美国化石资产的复兴，也凸显了金融行业会计需要纳入加密货币挖矿外部性的必要性。

records.title_en: News credibility and the quest for clicks
records.title_cn: 新闻可信度与点击追求
records.abstract_en: We examine a model of dynamic communication by a media outlet. In each period, the uninformed public can consult the outlet’s report at a cost. The outlet, which is primarily driven by profit maximization, has an incentive to induce uncertainty in order to encourage future consultation and thereby generate revenue. In an intermediate cost range, the public and the outlet may be worse off with a cheaper cost of access since it leads the outlet to distort information more, by making the public’s future consultation decision more responsive to the current report.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个媒体机构进行动态传播的模型。在每个时期，不知情的公众可以花费成本查阅该机构的报道。该机构主要受利润最大化驱动，有动机制造不确定性以鼓励未来咨询，从而产生收入。在中等成本区间内，公众和机构可能因访问成本更低而境况更差，因为这导致机构更多扭曲信息，使公众未来的咨询决策对当前报道更加敏感。

records.title_en: The employment effects of collective wage bargaining
records.title_cn: 集体工资谈判的就业效应
records.abstract_en: This study examines the wage and employment effects of Italian collective wage bargaining. It analyzes monthly data on the population of private-sector employees, matched with the information on contractual pay levels set by industry-wide agreements, which were bargained by the representatives of trade unions and employers at the national level. The research design exploited the generalized wage growth induced by changes in the contractual pay levels, whose timing and size differ across collective agreements. The specification adopted compared the outcomes of interest within sectors and geographical locations, and among workers subject to different collective contracts. The study results show that contractual wage growth raised the actual pay levels and had significant negative effects on employment. These employment effects were broadly consistent with the Hicks–Marshall laws and with several hypotheses of traditional centralized wage bargaining models.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了意大利集体工资谈判的工资和就业效应。它分析了私营部门雇员总体的月度数据，并与行业协议设定的合同工资水平信息相匹配，这些协议由工会和雇主代表在国家层面进行谈判。研究设计利用了合同工资水平变化所引发的普遍工资增长，其时间和规模因集体协议而异。所采用的规范比较了不同部门和地理位置内，以及受不同集体合同约束的工人之间的利益结果。研究结果表明，合同工资增长提高了实际工资水平，并对就业产生了显著的负面影响。这些就业效应与希克斯-马歇尔定律以及传统集中工资谈判模型的若干假设大体一致。

records.title_en: The air quality and well-being effects of low emission zones
records.title_cn: 低排放区的空气质量与幸福感效应
records.abstract_en: This study provides the first evidence of the subjective well-being impacts of low emission zones (LEZs) while also undertaking a comprehensive analysis of their air quality effects. We identify causal impacts by exploiting the zones’ introduction date with difference-in-differences designs robust to staggered implementations and time-varying treatment effects. Results show air quality improvements through reductions in traffic-related pollutants despite ground-level ozone increases and harmful spatial pollution spillovers. We further find that the zones cause transitory yet long-lasting reductions in individuals’ life satisfaction despite health benefits, suggesting that the subjective well-being effects of restricting mobility potentially outweigh those of improved health.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究首次提供了低排放区（LEZs）对主观幸福感影响的证据，同时对其空气质量效应进行了全面分析。我们利用低排放区的引入日期，采用对交错实施和时间变化处理效应稳健的双重差分设计来识别因果影响。结果表明，尽管地面臭氧增加并产生有害的空间污染溢出效应，但交通相关污染物的减少带来了空气质量改善。我们进一步发现，尽管存在健康益处，低排放区仍导致个体生活满意度出现短暂但持久的下降，这表明限制出行的主观幸福感效应可能超过健康改善带来的效应。

records.title_en: Optimal Dynamic Mediation
records.title_cn: 最优动态调解
records.abstract_en: How should mediators communicate with bargainers? When can they improve outcomes? Can arbitrators that impose outcomes do better? I provide answers in wars of attrition with flexible and commitment types, consistent with reputational bargaining. I characterize the unique mediated equilibrium, which maximizes flexible types’ payoffs. The mediator immediately elicits private information but waits to suggest agreements. She front-loads agreements between flexible types, while initially delaying any involving commitment types. This improves on unmediated outcomes only if commitment probabilities are less than agents’ payoff share in their preferred agreement. Arbitrators do strictly better but sometimes impose disagreement, which may be hard to enforce.
records.abstract_cn: 调解人应如何与谈判者沟通？他们何时能改善结果？强加结果的仲裁者能否做得更好？我在具有灵活型和承诺型的消耗战中提供答案，这与声誉性讨价还价一致。我刻画了唯一的调解均衡，该均衡最大化灵活型的收益。调解人立即引出私人信息，但等待建议协议。她将灵活型之间的协议前置，而最初延迟涉及承诺型的协议。只有当承诺概率小于代理人在其偏好协议中的收益份额时，这才优于无调解结果。仲裁者严格做得更好，但有时强加分歧，这可能难以执行。

records.title_en: Shocks and Technology Adoption: Evidence from Electronic Payment Systems
records.title_cn: 冲击与技术采纳：来自电子支付系统的证据
records.abstract_en: We provide evidence on the importance of coordination frictions in technology adoption, using data from a large provider of electronic wallets during the Indian demonetization. Exploiting geographical variation in exposure to the demonetization, we show that adoption of the wallet increased persistently in response to the large but temporary cash contraction, consistent with the predictions of a technology adoption model with complementarities. Model estimates indicate that adoption would have been 45% lower without complementarities. Our results illustrate how large but temporary interventions can help overcome coordination frictions, though we caution that such interventions may also exacerbate initial differences in adoption.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用印度废钞期间一家大型电子钱包提供商的数据，提供了关于协调摩擦在技术采纳中重要性的证据。利用废钞暴露程度的地理差异，我们表明，钱包的采纳在应对大规模但暂时的现金紧缩时持续增加，这与具有互补性的技术采纳模型的预测一致。模型估计表明，如果没有互补性，采纳率将降低45%。我们的结果说明，大规模但暂时的干预措施如何帮助克服协调摩擦，尽管我们警告此类干预也可能加剧初始采纳差异。

records.title_en: Information Frictions, Reputation, and Sovereign Spreads
records.title_cn: 信息摩擦、声誉与主权利差
records.abstract_en: We formulate a reputational model in which the type of government is time varying and private information. Agents adjust their beliefs about the government’s type (i.e., reputation) using noisy signals about its policies. We consider a debt repayment setting in which reputation influences the market’s perceived probability of default, which affects sovereign spreads. We focus on the 2007–12 Argentine episode of inflation misreport to quantify how markets price reputation. We find that the misreports significantly increased Argentina’s sovereign spreads. We use those estimates to discipline our model and show that reputation can have long-lasting effects on a government’s borrowing costs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个声誉模型，其中政府类型随时间变化且为私人信息。代理人通过关于政府政策的噪声信号来调整其对政府类型（即声誉）的信念。我们考虑一个债务偿还环境，其中声誉影响市场感知的违约概率，进而影响主权利差。我们聚焦于2007年12月阿根廷的通胀误报事件，以量化市场如何为声誉定价。我们发现，误报显著提高了阿根廷的主权利差。我们利用这些估计来约束我们的模型，并表明声誉可能对政府的借贷成本产生长期影响。

records.title_en: Disability Insurance Income Saves Lives
records.title_cn: 残疾保险收入挽救生命
records.abstract_en: We show that higher payments from US Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) reduce mortality. Using administrative data on new DI beneficiaries, we exploit discontinuities in the benefit formula through a regression kink design. We estimate that $1,000 more in annual DI payments decreases the annual mortality rate of lower-income beneficiaries by approximately 0.18–0.35 percentage points, implying an elasticity of mortality with respect to DI income of around −0.6 to −1.0. We find no robust evidence of an effect of DI income on the mortality of higher-income beneficiaries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美国社会保障残疾保险（DI）的更高支付降低了死亡率。利用新DI受益人的行政数据，我们通过回归扭结设计利用福利公式中的不连续性。我们估计，年度DI支付每增加1000美元，低收入受益人的年死亡率降低约0.18至0.35个百分点，这意味着死亡率对DI收入的弹性约为-0.6至-1.0。我们没有发现DI收入对高收入受益人死亡率影响的稳健证据。

records.title_en: Informed Information Design
records.title_cn: 知情信息设计
records.abstract_en: We study informed persuasion, whereby a privately informed designer without ex ante commitment power chooses disclosure mechanisms to influence agents’ actions. We characterize the subset of Bayes-correlated equilibria yielding every designer type a payoff higher than what they could get from any disclosure mechanism with credible beliefs. This set of interim-optimal mechanisms is nonempty and tractable, and all its elements are perfect Bayesian equilibrium mechanisms of the informed-designer game. Interim-optimal mechanisms are characterized via belief-based approaches in pure persuasion settings. We identify single- and multiagent interactive environments in which ex ante–optimal mechanisms are interim optimal.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究知情说服，即一个拥有私人信息且没有事前承诺能力的设计者选择披露机制以影响代理人的行动。我们刻画了贝叶斯相关均衡的子集，该子集使得每种设计者类型获得的收益高于他们从任何具有可信信念的披露机制中能获得的收益。这一组中期最优机制是非空且易于处理的，并且其所有元素都是知情设计者博弈中的完美贝叶斯均衡机制。在纯说服环境中，中期最优机制通过基于信念的方法来刻画。我们识别了单一和多个代理的互动环境，在这些环境中，事前最优机制是中期最优的。

records.title_en: Public Debt as Private Liquidity: Optimal Policy
records.title_cn: 公共债务作为私人流动性：最优政策
records.abstract_en: We study optimal policy in an economy where interest rates are low because public debt serves as collateral or buffer stock. Issuing more public debt raises welfare by easing the underlying friction but also reduces the private valuation of this service, raising interest rates. This trade-off shapes the optimal quantity of public debt in the long run, justifies a departure from tax smoothing in the short run, and calls for larger deficits during financial crises. Our analysis illustrates the possible robustness of these insights to different microfoundations and helps clarify when exactly low interest rates represent an opportunity for cheap government borrowing.
