records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个经济中的最优政策，在该经济中，由于公共债务充当抵押品或缓冲库存，利率较低。发行更多公共债务通过缓解潜在摩擦来提高福利，但也降低了这种服务的私人估值，从而提高了利率。这种权衡塑造了长期公共债务的最优数量，证明了短期内偏离税收平滑的合理性，并呼吁在金融危机期间增加赤字。我们的分析说明了这些见解对不同微观基础的可能稳健性，并有助于澄清低利率究竟在何时代表廉价政府借款的机会。

records.title_en: Why Did the Best Prepared Country in the World Fare So Poorly during COVID?
records.title_cn: 为什么世界上准备最充分的国家在新冠疫情期间表现如此糟糕？
records.abstract_en: Though all countries struggled to respond to COVID-19, the United States’ poor performance during the pandemic was unexpected. Despite having more pandemic preparedness capacities than other countries, the United States experienced more than one million COVID-19 deaths, which has contributed to historic declines in national life expectancy. Though some have raised questions as to whether preparedness capacities matter, data that appropriately address cross-country differences in age structure and surveillance approaches show that higher levels of national preparedness was associated with reduced mortality during the pandemic. The United States, however, stands out as a clear outlier in COVID-19 mortality comparisons with other highly prepared countries. We subsequently discuss and summarize the specific gaps in US pandemic preparedness that may have hampered COVID-19 responses in the country. Additional data and research are urgently needed to more accurately understand why the US did not make better use of its prepandemic advantages.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管各国都在努力应对新冠肺炎19，但美国在疫情期间的糟糕表现却出人意料。尽管美国比其他国家拥有更强的大流行防范能力，但仍有超过一百万人死于新冠肺炎19，这导致国民预期寿命历史性下降。尽管一些人提出了备灾能力是否重要的​​问题，但适当解决了年龄结构和监测方法方面的跨国差异的数据表明，国家备灾水平的提高与大流行期间死亡率的降低有关。然而，与其他准备充分的国家相比，美国在新冠肺炎19死亡率方面明显表现突出。我们随后讨论并总结了美国大流行病防备方面的具体差距，这些差距可能阻碍了该国的 COVID-19 应对工作。迫切需要更多的数据和研究来更准确地理解为什么美国没有更好地利用其疫情前的优势。

records.title_en: The Evolution of Work from Home
records.title_cn: 居家办公的演变
records.abstract_en: Full days worked at home account for 28 percent of paid workdays among Americans 20–64 years old, as of mid-2023. That’s about four times the 2019 rate and ten times the rate in the mid-1990s. We first explain why the big shift to work from home has endured rather than reverting to prepandemic levels. We then consider how work-from-home rates vary by worker age, sex, education, parental status, industry and local population density, and why it is higher in the United States than other countries. We also discuss some implications for pay, productivity, and the pace of innovation. Over the next five years, US business executives anticipate modest increases in work-from-home rates at their own companies. Other factors that portend an enduring shift to work from home include the ongoing adaptation of managerial practices and further advances in technologies, products, and tools that support remote work.
records.abstract_cn: 截至2023年年中，20-64岁的美国人中，全职居家办公天数占带薪工作天数的28%。这大约是2019年水平的四倍，也是1990年代中期水平的十倍。我们首先解释了为什么向居家办公的大规模转变得以持续，而不是恢复到疫情前的水平。然后，我们考察了居家办公率如何因工人年龄、性别、教育程度、育儿状况、行业和当地人口密度而异，以及为什么美国的居家办公率高于其他国家。我们还讨论了对薪酬、生产率和创新步伐的一些影响。在未来五年内，美国企业高管预计其公司的居家办公率将适度增加。预示着向居家办公持续转变的其他因素包括管理实践的持续调整以及支持远程工作的技术、产品和工具的进一步进步。

records.title_en: COVID-19, School Closures, and Outcomes
records.title_cn: COVID-19、学校关闭及其影响
records.abstract_en: This article discusses the question of data and our perspective on the importance of public, accessible, and contemporaneous data in the face of public crisis. Then, we present data on the extent of school closures during the COVID-19 pandemic, both globally and within the United States. We describe the available data on the degree of these closures, which will provide a set of resources for studying longer-term consequences as they emerge. We also highlight what we know about the demographic patterns of school closures. We then discuss the emerging estimates of the short-term impacts of school closures. A central finding throughout our discussion is that school closures during the pandemic tended to increase inequality, both within and across countries, but that fully understanding the long-run impact of COVID-related school closures on students will take time and will surely be influenced by events and policies in the next few years.
records.abstract_cn: 本文讨论了数据问题以及我们对在公共危机面前公开、可获取和及时数据重要性的看法。然后，我们提供了关于COVID-19大流行期间学校关闭程度的数据，包括全球和美国的情况。我们描述了关于这些关闭程度的现有数据，这将为研究长期后果提供一系列资源。我们还强调了关于学校关闭的人口统计模式我们所了解的情况。接着，我们讨论了学校关闭短期影响的新兴估计。我们讨论中的一个核心发现是，疫情期间的学校关闭往往加剧了不平等，无论是在国家内部还是国家之间，但充分理解与COVID相关的学校关闭对学生的长期影响将需要时间，并且肯定会受到未来几年事件和政策的影响。

records.title_en: Changes in the Distribution of Black and White Wealth since the US Civil War
records.title_cn: 美国内战以来黑人与白人财富分布的变化
records.abstract_en: The difference in the average wealth of Black and white Americans narrowed in the first century after the Civil War, but remained large and even widened again after 1980. Given high levels of wealth concentration both historically and today, dynamics at the average may not capture important heterogeneity in racial wealth gaps across the distribution. This paper looks into the historical evolution of the Black and white wealth distributions since Emancipation. The picture that emerges is an even starker one than racial wealth inequality at the mean. Tracing, for the first time, the evolution of wealth of the median Black household and the gap between the typical Black and white household over time, we estimate that the majority of Black households only began to dispose of measurable wealth around World War II. While the civil rights era brought substantial wealth gains for the median Black household, the gap between Black and white wealth at the median has not changed much since the 1970s. The top and the bottom of the wealth distribution show even greater persistence, with Black households consistently over-represented in the bottom half of the wealth distribution and under-represented in the top-10 percent over the past seven decades.
records.abstract_cn: 在内战后的第一个世纪里，美国黑人与白人平均财富的差距有所缩小，但差距仍然很大，甚至在1980年之后再次扩大。鉴于历史上和当今财富集中程度都很高，平均值的动态可能无法捕捉到财富分配中种族财富差距的重要异质性。本文考察了自解放以来黑人与白人财富分布的历史演变。呈现出的图景比平均值的种族财富不平等更为严峻。我们首次追踪了黑人家庭财富中位数以及典型黑人家庭与白人家庭之间差距随时间的变化，估计大多数黑人家庭直到第二次世界大战前后才开始拥有可衡量的财富。虽然民权时代为黑人家庭财富中位数带来了可观的收益，但自1970年以来，黑人家庭与白人家庭在财富中位数上的差距并没有太大变化。财富分布的顶端和底端表现出更大的持续性，在过去七十年中，黑人家庭在财富分布的下半部分持续过度代表，而在前10%中则代表性不足。

records.title_en: Why Do Retired Households Draw Down Their Wealth So Slowly?
records.title_cn: 为什么退休家庭财富消耗如此缓慢？
records.abstract_en: Retired households, especially those with high lifetime income, decumulate their wealth very slowly, and many die leaving large estates. The three leading explanations for the “retirement savings puzzle” are the desire to insure against uncertain lifespans and medical expenses, the desire to leave bequests to one’s heirs, and the desire to remain in one’s own home. We discuss the empirical strategies used to differentiate these motivations, most of which go beyond wealth to exploit additional features of the data. The literature suggests that all the motivations are present, but has yet to reach a consensus about their relative importance.
records.abstract_cn: 退休家庭，尤其是那些终身收入较高的家庭，财富消耗非常缓慢，许多人去世时留下大量遗产。对“退休储蓄之谜”的三种主要解释是：希望防范不确定的寿命和医疗费用、希望给继承人留下遗产，以及希望留在自己的家中。我们讨论了用于区分这些动机的实证策略，其中大多数超越了财富本身，利用了数据的额外特征。文献表明所有动机都存在，但尚未就其相对重要性达成共识。

records.title_en: Where Does Wealth Come From? Measuring Lifetime Resources in Norway
records.title_cn: 财富从何而来？衡量挪威的终身资源
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we use comprehensive administrative data on the population of Norway to create a measure of lifetime resources, which generates several stylized facts. First, lifetime resources are highly correlated with net wealth, but net wealth is more unequally distributed. Second, labor income is the most important component of lifetime resources, except among the top 1 percent where capital income and capital gains on financial assets become important. Lastly, lifetime resources are a better predictor of child human capital outcomes than net wealth, suggesting that, in some cases, inequality in lifetime resources may be more relevant than inequality in wealth.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们利用挪威人口的全面行政数据构建了一个终身资源的衡量指标，并由此得出几个典型事实。首先，终身资源与净财富高度相关，但净财富的分配更加不平等。其次，劳动收入是终身资源最重要的组成部分，但在前1%的人群中，资本收入和金融资产资本利得变得重要。最后，终身资源对儿童人力资本结果的预测能力优于净财富，这表明在某些情况下，终身资源的不平等可能比财富不平等更为重要。

records.title_en: The Importance of Financial Literacy: Opening a New Field
records.title_cn: 金融素养的重要性：开辟新领域
records.abstract_en: We undertake an assessment of our two decades of research on financial literacy, building on our empirical research and theoretical work casting financial knowledge as a form of investment in human capital. We also draw on recent data to determine who is the most—and least—financially savvy in the United States, and we highlight the similarity of our results in other countries. A number of convincing studies is now available, from which we draw conclusions about the effects and consequences of financial illiteracy, and what can be done to fill these gaps. We conclude by offering our thoughts on implications for teaching, policy, and future research.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于实证研究和将金融知识视为人力资本投资形式的理论工作，对我们在金融素养方面的二十年研究进行了评估。我们还利用最新数据来确定美国谁最懂金融——以及谁最不懂金融，并强调了我们在其他国家的结果的相似性。现在已有大量令人信服的研究，我们从中得出关于金融素养不足的影响和后果的结论，以及可以采取哪些措施来填补这些空白。最后，我们就教学、政策和未来研究的启示提出了我们的想法。

records.title_en: Transmission Impossible? Prospects for Decarbonizing the US Grid
records.title_cn: 传输不可能？美国电网脱碳的前景
records.abstract_en: Encouraged by the declining cost of grid-scale renewables, recent analyses conclude that the United States could reach net zero carbon dioxide emissions by 2050 at relatively low cost using currently available technologies. While the cost of renewable generation has declined dramatically, integrating these renewables would require a large expansion in transmission to deliver that power. Already there is growing evidence that the United States has insufficient transmission capacity, and current levels of annual investment are well below what would be required for a renewables-dominated system. We describe a variety of challenges that make it difficult to build new transmission and potential policy responses to mitigate them, as well as possible substitutes for some new transmission capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 受电网规模可再生能源成本下降的鼓舞，近期分析得出结论，美国到2050年可以以相对较低的成本，利用现有技术实现净零二氧化碳排放。虽然可再生能源发电成本已大幅下降，但整合这些可再生能源将需要大幅扩展输电能力以输送电力。已有越来越多的证据表明，美国的输电容量不足，而目前的年度投资水平远低于可再生能源主导系统所需。我们描述了使新建输电变得困难的多种挑战，以及缓解这些挑战的潜在政策应对措施，以及某些新输电容量的可能替代方案。

records.title_en: The Economics of Electricity Reliability
records.title_cn: 电力可靠性的经济学
records.abstract_en: The physics of an electrical grid requires that the supply injected into the grid is always in balance with the quantity consumed. If that balance is not maintained, cascading outages are likely to disrupt supply to all consumers on the grid. In the past, vertically integrated monopoly utilities have ensured that supply is adequate to meet demand and maintain grid stability, but with deregulation of generation, assuring adequate supply has become much more complex. The unique characteristics of electricity distribution means that there are immense potential externalities among market participants from supply shortfalls. In this paper, we discuss the institutions that US electricity markets have developed to avoid such destabilizing supply shortfalls when there are multiple generators and retailers in the market. Though many of the markets rely on standardized requirements for supplier reserves, we conclude that recent technological progress may steer future evolution towards a system that relies to a greater extent on economic incentives.
records.abstract_cn: 电网的物理特性要求注入电网的供应量与消耗量始终保持平衡。如果这种平衡未能维持，级联停电可能会中断电网所有消费者的供应。过去，垂直一体化的垄断公用事业确保供应充足以满足需求并维持电网稳定，但随着发电的放松管制，确保充足供应变得更加复杂。电力分配的特殊性意味着供应短缺在市场参与者之间可能产生巨大的外部性。在本文中，我们讨论了美国电力市场在存在多个发电商和零售商时，为避免这种不稳定的供应短缺而发展的制度。尽管许多市场依赖于供应商储备的标准化要求，但我们得出结论，近期的技术进步可能引导未来演变朝着更依赖经济激励的体系发展。

records.title_en: The Economics Profession’s Socioeconomic Diversity Problem
records.title_cn: 经济学专业的社会经济多样性问题
records.abstract_en: It is well-documented that women and racial and ethnic minorities are underrepresented in the economics profession, relative to both the general population and other academic disciplines. Less is known about the socioeconomic diversity of the economics profession. In this paper, we use data on parental education from the Survey of Earned Doctorates to examine the socioeconomic background of US economics PhD recipients, as compared to other disciplines. We find that economics PhD recipients are substantially more likely to have highly educated parents, and less likely to have parents without a college degree, than PhD recipients in other non-economics disciplines. This is true for both US-born PhD recipients and non-US-born PhD recipients, but is particularly stark for the US-born. The gap in socioeconomic diversity between economics and other PhD disciplines has increased over the last five decades, and particularly over the last two decades.
records.abstract_cn: 有充分证据表明，相对于普通人群和其他学科，女性以及种族和民族少数群体在经济学专业中的代表性不足。关于经济学专业的社会经济多样性，我们知之甚少。在本文中，我们利用博士学位获得者调查中关于父母教育程度的数据，考察了美国经济学博士获得者的社会经济背景，并与其他学科进行了比较。我们发现，与其他非经济学学科的博士获得者相比，经济学博士获得者的父母拥有高学历的可能性要大得多，而父母没有大学学位的可能性则要小得多。这对于美国出生的博士获得者和非美国出生的博士获得者都是如此，但对于美国出生的博士获得者尤为明显。经济学与其他博士学科之间的社会经济多样性差距在过去五十年中有所扩大，特别是在过去二十年中。

records.title_en: Early Career Paths of Economists Inside and Outside of Academia
records.title_cn: 经济学家学术界内外早期职业路径
records.abstract_en: Economics job candidates face considerable professional and financial uncertainties when deciding between academic and nonacademic career paths. Using novel panel data, we provide a broad picture of PhD economists’ early career mobility and earnings growth–both in and outside of academia. We find that academic jobs have fallen to just over half of US placements, with growing shares in tech, consulting, and government. We document considerable early career job mobility and higher earnings growth among job changers, private-sector economists, and men. We also find an earnings premium for graduates of top-ranked PhD programs that grows over early career years in academia while shrinking in the private sector. These different earnings dynamics mean the opportunity cost (in terms of potential earnings) of remaining in academia is generally less for graduates of top-ranked programs, although there is significant dispersion in mid-career earnings among these academics.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学求职者在决定学术与非学术职业路径时面临相当大的职业和财务不确定性。利用新颖的面板数据，我们提供了经济学博士毕业生在学术界内外早期职业流动性和收入增长的广泛图景。我们发现学术职位在美国就业安置中的比例已降至略高于一半，而科技、咨询和政府部门的份额不断增长。我们记录了求职者、私营部门经济学家和男性中显著的早期职业流动性和更高的收入增长。我们还发现，顶尖博士项目毕业生的收入溢价在学术界早期职业生涯中增长，而在私营部门则缩小。这些不同的收入动态意味着，对于顶尖项目毕业生而言，留在学术界的（潜在收入方面的）机会成本通常较低，尽管这些学者中职业生涯中期的收入存在显著离散度。

records.title_en: Retrospectives: Margaret Reid, Chicago, and Permanent Income
records.title_cn: 回顾：玛格丽特·里德、芝加哥与永久收入
records.abstract_en: Margaret Gilpin Reid (1896-1990) began her career as a home economist and, with Dorothy Brady, Milton and Rose Friedman, played a central role in the development of the permanent income hypothesis at Chicago. Reid was the first woman to be elected Fellow of the American Economic Association, and was a key figure in the empirical tradition at the University of Chicago. This article examines the opportunities and constraints that shaped her career.
records.abstract_cn: 玛格丽特·吉尔平·里德（1896-1990）以家政经济学家的身份开始其职业生涯，并与多萝西·布雷迪、米尔顿和罗斯·弗里德曼一起，在芝加哥的永久收入假说发展中发挥了核心作用。里德是第一位当选美国经济学会会士的女性，也是芝加哥大学实证传统中的关键人物。本文考察了塑造她职业生涯的机遇与制约因素。

records.title_en: On The Distributional Effects Of International Tariffs
records.title_cn: 论国际关税的分配效应
records.abstract_en: We provide a quantitative analysis of the distributional effects of the 2018 increase in tariffs by the United States and its major trading partners. We build a trade model with incomplete asset markets and households that are heterogeneous in their age, income, wealth, and labor skill. When tariff revenues are used to reduce distortionary taxes on consumption, labor, and capital income, the average welfare loss from the trade war is equivalent to a permanent 0.1% reduction in consumption. Much larger welfare losses are concentrated among retirees and low‐wealth households, whereas only wealthy households experience a welfare gain.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对2018年美国及其主要贸易伙伴提高关税的分配效应进行了定量分析。我们构建了一个具有不完整资产市场以及年龄、收入、财富和劳动技能异质性的家庭的贸易模型。当关税收入用于减少对消费、劳动和资本收入的扭曲性税收时，贸易战的平均福利损失相当于消费永久性减少0.1%。更大的福利损失集中在退休人员和低财富家庭，而只有富裕家庭才能获得福利收益。

records.title_en: A Panel Clustering Approach To Analyzing Bubble Behavior
records.title_cn: 面板聚类方法分析泡沫行为
records.abstract_en: This study provides new mechanisms for identifying and estimating explosive bubbles in mixed‐root panel autoregressions with a latent group structure. A postclustering approach is employed that combines k‐means clustering with right‐tailed panel‐data testing. Uniform consistency of the k‐means algorithm is established. Pivotal null limit distributions of the tests are introduced. A new method is proposed to consistently estimate the number of groups. Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed methods perform well in finite samples; and empirical applications of the proposed methods identify bubbles in the U.S. and Chinese housing markets and the U.S. stock market.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究为具有潜在群组结构的混合根面板自回归中爆炸性泡沫的识别和估计提供了新机制。采用了一种后聚类方法，将k均值聚类与右尾面板数据检验相结合。建立了k均值算法的一致一致性。引入了检验的枢轴零极限分布。提出了一种新方法来一致估计群组数量。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的方法在有限样本中表现良好；所提出方法的实证应用识别了美国和中国的住房市场以及美国股市中的泡沫。

records.title_en: Costly Information And Sovereign Risk
records.title_cn: 昂贵信息与主权风险
records.abstract_en: The consequences of costly information acquisition for sovereign risk are explored in a quantitative sovereign default model. We identify information costs empirically using Bloomberg news‐heat data. The calibrated model microfounds heteroskedasticity in the country risk spread as measured by a novel metric we call the Crisis Volatility Ratio (CVR). Crises are endogenously more volatile because more information is acquired and priced. Recalibrated extant models do not generate CVRs in the empirical range, but ours does. Because effective risk tolerance depends on the information set, the model also suggests that risk premia fall with information costs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个量化的主权违约模型中探讨了昂贵信息获取对主权风险的影响。我们利用彭博新闻热度数据实证识别了信息成本。校准后的模型为一种我们称之为危机波动率比（CVR）的新指标所衡量的国家风险溢价的异方差性提供了微观基础。危机内生地更具波动性，因为更多信息被获取并定价。重新校准的现有模型无法生成处于经验范围内的CVR，而我们的模型可以。由于有效风险承受能力取决于信息集，该模型还表明风险溢价随信息成本下降而降低。

records.title_en: Entrepreneur–Investor Information Design
records.title_cn: 企业家-投资者信息设计
records.abstract_en: I consider an environment in which an entrepreneur generates information about the quality of his project prior to contracting with an investor. The investor faces a moral‐hazard problem since the entrepreneur may divert the funding for private consumption. I find that the efficient amount of information is generated if and only if the bargaining power of the entrepreneur is high enough. I interpret this result in terms of investors' tightness, competitiveness, and generosity measures. I also show that the investor prefers not to have all the bargaining power when the project costs are high enough.
records.abstract_cn: 我考虑一个环境，其中企业家在与投资者签订合同之前生成关于其项目质量的信息。投资者面临道德风险问题，因为企业家可能将资金挪用于私人消费。我发现，当且仅当企业家的议价能力足够高时，才会生成有效数量的信息。我根据投资者的紧张程度、竞争性和慷慨程度指标来解释这一结果。我还表明，当项目成本足够高时，投资者宁愿不拥有全部议价能力。

records.title_en: Catchment Areas, Stratification, And Access To Better Schools
records.title_cn: 学区划分、分层与优质学校入学机会
records.abstract_en: School Choice provides students with the opportunity to attend better schools than those in their neighborhood. This is crucial for students from disadvantaged areas where schools may be of lower quality. Our theoretical model and numerical simulations show that the widely used Deferred Acceptance (DA) algorithm has limitations in providing access to better schools (ABS). When schools have varying levels of quality and when there are priorities linked to neighborhood schools, the DA algorithm experiences significant limitations in providing ABS. Top Trading Cycles, when compared to DA, offers greater ABS, particularly for disadvantaged students.
records.abstract_cn: 学校选择为学生提供了就读比其所在社区更好的学校的机会。这对于来自学校质量可能较低的弱势地区的学生至关重要。我们的理论模型和数值模拟表明，广泛使用的延迟接受（DA）算法在提供优质学校入学机会（ABS）方面存在局限性。当学校质量参差不齐且存在与 neighborhood 学校相关的优先权时，DA 算法在提供 ABS 方面表现出显著局限性。与 DA 相比，顶级交易循环（TTC）提供了更大的 ABS，尤其是对弱势学生而言。

records.title_en: Modeling Interregional Patient Mobility: Theory And Evidence From Spatially Explicit Data
records.title_cn: 建模跨区域患者流动：来自空间显式数据的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: This article provides theory and evidence on the spatial determinants of regional patient flows. We develop a theoretical model that explains a patient's choice to consult a general practitioner by a measure of spatial accessibility. We empirically test this gravity‐type model using regional patient flows and detailed data on the spatial distribution of residents and physicians in Austria. Our measure of spatial accessibility is a crucial determinant of patient flows that substantially increases the explanatory power of regular gravity models. Counterfactual simulations show heterogeneous effects of exiting physicians on health‐care accessibility and patient mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于区域患者流动空间决定因素的理论和证据。我们开发了一个理论模型，通过空间可达性指标解释患者选择咨询全科医生的决策。我们使用奥地利区域患者流动以及居民和医生空间分布的详细数据，对该引力型模型进行了实证检验。我们的空间可达性指标是患者流动的关键决定因素，显著提高了常规引力模型的解释力。反事实模拟显示，医生退出对医疗保健可达性和患者流动具有异质性影响。

records.title_en: Structural Interventions In Networks
records.title_cn: 网络中的结构性干预
records.abstract_en: Two types of interventions are commonly implemented in networks: characteristics interventions, which influence individuals' intrinsic incentives, and structural interventions, which target the social links among individuals. In this article, we provide a general framework to evaluate the distinct equilibrium effects of both types of interventions. We show that any structural intervention is outcome‐equivalent to an endogenously determined characteristics intervention. We present a wide range of applications of our theory, including evaluating a potential new link in a community, identifying the most wanted criminal(s) in delinquent networks, and determining whether a structural intervention improves certain welfare measures.
records.abstract_cn: 网络中通常实施两种类型的干预：特征干预，影响个体的内在激励；以及结构性干预，针对个体之间的社会联系。在本文中，我们提供了一个通用框架来评估这两种干预措施的独特均衡效应。我们表明，任何结构性干预在结果上等同于一种内生决定的特征干预。我们展示了我们理论的广泛应用，包括评估社区中潜在的新联系、识别 delinquent 网络中最想要的罪犯，以及确定结构性干预是否改善某些福利指标。

records.title_en: A Three‐State Rational Greater‐Fool Bubble Model With Intertemporal Consumption Smoothing
records.title_cn: 一个具有跨期消费平滑的三状态理性更大傻瓜泡沫模型
records.abstract_en: We construct a simple rational greater‐fool bubble model, where the motive for trade is intertemporal consumption smoothing. This yields an easy‐to‐understand bubble model with three states of the world, instead of the five required previously. Bubbles are more likely when asset sellers have profitable investment opportunities, but little wealth, so they sell shares in those opportunities to wealthier investors. “Bad sellers” then pretend to sell similar investment opportunities, creating potential bubble assets. Bubbles are possible even if alternative means of consumption smoothing are available. Also, antibubble policy can reduce the welfare of even the greater fools it is supposed to protect.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个简单的理性更大傻瓜泡沫模型，其中交易动机是跨期消费平滑。这产生了一个易于理解的泡沫模型，具有三种世界状态，而不是之前所需的五种。当资产卖方拥有有利可图的投资机会但财富很少时，泡沫更可能发生，因此他们将那些机会的股份出售给更富有的投资者。然后，“坏卖方”假装出售类似的投资机会，创造潜在的泡沫资产。即使有其他消费平滑手段可用，泡沫也可能存在。此外，反泡沫政策甚至可能降低它本应保护的更大傻瓜的福利。

records.title_en: Uk Inflation Dynamics Since The Thirteenth Century
records.title_cn: 自十三世纪以来英国的通胀动态
records.abstract_en: Historians have suggested that there were waves of inflation or price revolutions in the United Kingdom (and earlier England) in the 13th, 16th, and 18th centuries, prior to the ongoing inflation since 1935. We study retail price inflation since 1251 and model its dynamics. The model is an AR(n) but allows for gradually evolving or drifting parameters and stochastic volatility. The long‐horizon forecasts suggest only one inflation wave, that of the 20th century. We also use the model to measure inflation predictability and price‐level instability from the beginning of the sample and to provide measures of real interest rates since 1695.
records.abstract_cn: 历史学家提出，在联合王国（以及更早的英格兰），于13、16和18世纪存在通胀浪潮或价格革命，早于自1935年以来持续的通胀。我们研究自1251年以来的零售价格通胀并对其动态进行建模。该模型为AR(n)模型，但允许参数逐渐演变或漂移以及随机波动率。长期预测表明仅存在一次通胀浪潮，即20世纪的那次。我们还使用该模型从样本开始时期衡量通胀可预测性和价格水平不稳定性，并提供自1695年以来的实际利率度量。

records.title_en: Highways And Globalization
records.title_cn: 高速公路与全球化
records.abstract_en: This article quantifies the value of U.S. highways. We develop a multisector general equilibrium model with many locations in the United States (i.e., counties) and many countries. In the model, producers choose shipping routes subject to domestic and international trade costs, endogenous congestion, and port efficiency at international transshipment points. Applying the model, we find that removing the Interstate Highway System reduces real GDP by $421–$578 billion. The results highlight the gains from intersectoral and international trade as well as the role of domestic transportation infrastructure in shaping regional comparative advantage.
records.abstract_cn: 本文量化了美国高速公路的价值。我们构建了一个多部门一般均衡模型，包含美国国内的许多地点（即县）和许多国家。在模型中，生产者在面临国内和国际贸易成本、内生拥堵以及国际转运点港口效率的情况下选择运输路线。应用该模型，我们发现移除州际公路系统将使实际GDP减少421亿至578亿美元。结果凸显了部门间和国际贸易的收益，以及国内交通基础设施在塑造区域比较优势中的作用。

records.title_en: Optimal Payment Contracts In Trade Relationships
records.title_cn: 贸易关系中的最优支付契约
records.abstract_en: In buyer–seller relationships, offering trade credit to buyers fosters long‐term collaboration but seller provision varies systematically as relationships evolve. We study the optimal provision dynamics of trade credit when the seller's information about the buyer is incomplete. We show how the interaction of self‐enforcing relational contracts and formal contracts determines optimal payment contract choice. We find that payment contracts can be interpreted as screening technologies and imply distinct learning opportunities about the buyer's type. In line with empirical evidence, the model predicts that all transitions between payment terms lead to seller trade credit provision in the long run.
records.abstract_cn: 在买方-卖方关系中，向买方提供贸易信贷有助于促进长期合作，但卖方的提供会随着关系的发展而系统性变化。我们研究了当卖方对买方的信息不完全时，贸易信贷的最优提供动态。我们展示了自我执行的关系契约与正式契约的相互作用如何决定最优支付契约选择。我们发现，支付契约可以被解释为筛选技术，并意味着关于买方类型的独特学习机会。与经验证据一致，该模型预测，支付条款之间的所有转换最终都会导致卖方在长期内提供贸易信贷。

records.title_en: Learning And Evidence In Insurance Markets
records.title_cn: 保险市场中的学习与证据
records.abstract_en: I analyze a model of monopoly insurance contracting where the consumer has access to endogenous, costly evidence of his risk type. I characterize when the consumer is worse off if the insurer is allowed to condition contracts on evidence and when the ability to contract on evidence leads to a Pareto improvement. I compare the results to an analogous setting with perfect competition: Under perfect competition, when evidence acquisition costs are low, the ability to contract on evidence is always Pareto improving. For intermediate costs, I uncover a new source of unraveling.
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了一个垄断保险合约模型，其中消费者可以获得关于其风险类型的内生的、有成本的证据。我刻画了在何种情况下，如果允许保险公司根据证据来制定合约，消费者的境况会变得更差，以及何时基于证据的合约能力会导致帕累托改进。我将结果与一个完全竞争的类似环境进行比较：在完全竞争下，当证据获取成本较低时，基于证据的合约能力总是帕累托改进的。对于中等成本，我发现了新的拆解来源。

records.title_en: Credit Constraints, Endogenous Innovations, And Price Setting In International Trade
records.title_cn: 国际贸易中的信贷约束、内生创新与价格设定
records.abstract_en: This article analyzes the role of credit frictions in a trade model where producers differ in their capabilities to conduct process and quality innovations and require external finance for investments. Accounting for cost‐based and quality‐based sorting of firms in a unified framework allows us to demonstrate that the reactions of prices and commonly used productivity measures do not necessarily reflect welfare implications. Credit frictions lead to distortions through aggravated access to finance and endogenous price adjustments so that the responses of quantity‐based and revenue‐based productivity differ substantially. In counterfactual scenarios, we show that these differential effects are quantitatively important.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个贸易模型中分析了信贷摩擦的作用，其中生产者在其进行工艺创新和质量创新的能力上存在差异，并且需要外部融资来进行投资。在一个统一的框架中考虑基于成本和基于质量的企业分类，使我们能够证明价格和常用生产率指标的反应不一定反映福利含义。信贷摩擦通过加剧融资困难和内生价格调整导致扭曲，使得基于数量和基于收入的生产率的反应存在显著差异。在反事实情景中，我们表明这些差异效应在数量上是重要的。

records.title_en: Presidential Address: Demand‐Side Constraints in Development. The Role of Market Size, Trade, and (In)Equality
records.title_cn: 主席演讲：发展中的需求侧约束——市场规模、贸易与（不）平等的作用
records.abstract_en: What is the pathway to development in a world marked by rising economic nationalism and less international integration? This paper answers this question within a framework that emphasizes the role of demand‐side constraints on national development, which is identified with sustained poverty reduction. In this framework, development is linked to the adoption of an increasing returns to scale technology by imperfectly competitive firms that need to pay the fixed setup cost of switching to that technology. Sustained poverty reduction is measured as a continuous decline in the share of the population living below $1.90/day purchasing power parity in 2011 U.S. dollars over a five‐year period. This outcome is affected in a statistically significant and economically meaningful way by domestic market size, which is measured as a function of the income distribution, and international market size, which is measured as a function of legally‐binding provisions to international trade agreements, including the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, the World Trade Organization, and 279 preferential trade agreements. Counterfactual estimates suggest that, in the absence of international integration, the average resident of a low‐ or lower‐middle‐income country does not live in a market large enough to experience sustained poverty reduction. Domestic redistribution targeted towards generating a larger middle class can partially compensate for the lack of an international market.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个经济民族主义抬头、国际一体化程度降低的世界中，发展的路径是什么？本文在一个强调需求侧约束对国家发展作用的框架内回答这一问题，该发展被定义为持续减贫。在此框架下，发展与非完全竞争企业采用规模报酬递增技术相关联，这些企业需要支付转向该技术的固定设立成本。持续减贫以五年期内生活在按购买力平价计算的每日1.90美元（2011年美元）贫困线以下人口比例的持续下降来衡量。这一结果受到国内市场规模和国际市场规模的统计显著且经济意义重大的影响，其中国内市场规模以收入分配的函数衡量，国际市场规模以国际贸易协定（包括关税与贸易总协定、世界贸易组织以及279项特惠贸易协定）中具有法律约束力条款的函数衡量。反事实估计表明，在没有国际一体化的情况下，低收入或中低收入国家的普通居民所生活的市场不足以实现持续减贫。针对扩大中产阶级的国内再分配政策可以部分弥补国际市场的缺失。

records.title_en: A Comment on: “Presidential Address: Demand‐Side Constraints in Development. The Role of Market Size, Trade, and (In)Equality” by Pinelopi Koujianou Goldberg and Tristan Reed
records.title_cn: 对皮内洛皮·库吉亚努·戈德堡和特里斯坦·里德《主席致辞：发展中的需求侧约束——市场规模、贸易与（不）平等的作用》的评论

records.title_cn: 对皮内洛皮·库吉亚努·戈德堡和特里斯坦·里德《主席致辞：发展中的需求侧约束：市场规模、贸易与（不）平等的作用》的评论

records.title_en: Algorithmic Mechanism Design With Investment
records.title_cn: 带投资的算法机制设计
records.abstract_en: We study the investment incentives created by truthful mechanisms that allocate resources using approximation algorithms. Some approximation algorithms guarantee nearly 100% of the optimal welfare in the allocation problem but guarantee nothing when accounting for investment incentives. An algorithm's allocative and investment guarantees coincide if and only if its confirming negative externalities are sufficiently small. We introduce fast approximation algorithms for the knapsack problem that have no confirming negative externalities and guarantees close to 100% for both allocation and investment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了使用近似算法分配资源的诚实机制所产生的投资激励。一些近似算法在分配问题中保证了接近100%的最优福利，但在考虑投资激励时却无法保证任何东西。一个算法的分配和投资保证相一致，当且仅当其确认的负外部性足够小。我们引入了针对背包问题的快速近似算法，这些算法没有确认的负外部性，并且在分配和投资方面都提供了接近100%的保证。

records.title_en: Price Setting With Strategic Complementarities as a Mean Field Game
records.title_cn: 战略互补性下的价格设定作为平均场博弈
records.abstract_en: We study the propagation of monetary shocks in a sticky‐price general equilibrium economy where the firms' pricing strategy features a complementarity with the decisions of other firms. In a dynamic equilibrium, the firm's price‐setting decisions depend on aggregates, which in turn depend on the firms' decisions. We cast this fixed‐point problem as a Mean Field Game and prove several analytic results. We establish existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium and characterize the impulse response function (IRF) of output following an aggregate shock. We prove that strategic complementarities make the IRF larger at each horizon. We establish that complementarities may give rise to an IRF with a hump‐shaped profile. As the complementarity becomes large enough, the IRF diverges, and at a critical point there is no equilibrium. Finally, we show that the amplification effect of the strategic interactions is similar across models: the Calvo model and the Golosov–Lucas model display a comparable amplification, in spite of the fact that the non‐neutrality in Calvo is much larger.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在粘性价格一般均衡经济中货币冲击的传播，其中企业的定价策略与其他企业的决策具有互补性。在动态均衡中，企业的定价决策依赖于总量，而总量又依赖于企业的决策。我们将这一不动点问题表述为平均场博弈，并证明了若干解析结果。我们确立了均衡的存在性和唯一性，并刻画了总冲击后产出的脉冲响应函数（IRF）。我们证明战略互补性使IRF在每个时间水平上更大。我们确立互补性可能产生具有驼峰形状的IRF。当互补性变得足够大时，IRF发散，并且在临界点不存在均衡。最后，我们表明战略互动的放大效应在不同模型中相似：Calvo模型和Golosov–Lucas模型显示出相当的放大效应，尽管Calvo中的非中性要大得多。

records.title_en: An Adversarial Approach to Structural Estimation
records.title_cn: 结构估计的对抗性方法
records.abstract_en: We propose a new simulation‐based estimation method, adversarial estimation, for structural models. The estimator is formulated as the solution to a minimax problem between a generator (which generates simulated observations using the structural model) and a discriminator (which classifies whether an observation is simulated). The discriminator maximizes the accuracy of its classification while the generator minimizes it. We show that, with a sufficiently rich discriminator, the adversarial estimator attains parametric efficiency under correct specification and the parametric rate under misspecification. We advocate the use of a neural network as a discriminator that can exploit adaptivity properties and attain fast rates of convergence.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的基于模拟的估计方法，即对抗性估计，用于结构模型。该估计量被表述为生成器（使用结构模型生成模拟观测）与判别器（分类观测是否为模拟）之间的极小极大问题的解。判别器最大化其分类的准确性，而生成器则最小化它。我们证明，在判别器足够丰富的情况下，对抗性估计量在正确设定下达到参数有效性，在错误设定下达到参数速率。我们提倡使用神经网络作为判别器，它可以利用自适应性质并达到快速收敛速率。

records.title_en: The Cross‐Sectional Implications of the Social Discount Rate
records.title_cn: 社会贴现率的横截面含义
records.abstract_en: In this paper, I consider two normative questions: (1) how should policymakers approach tradeoffs that involve different age groups, and (2) at what rate should policymakers discount the consumption of future generations? I demonstrate that, under standard assumptions, these two questions are equivalent: caring more about the future means caring less about the elderly. Even small differences between the social discount rate and the market interest rate can have significant quantitative implications for the relative value placed on the consumption of different age groups.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我考虑了两个规范性问题：（1）政策制定者应如何处理涉及不同年龄群体的权衡，（2）政策制定者应以何种比率贴现未来世代的消费。我证明，在标准假设下，这两个问题是等价的：更关心未来意味着更少关心老年人。即使社会贴现率与市场利率之间的微小差异，也可能对不同年龄群体消费的相对价值产生显著的定量影响。

records.title_en: Tail Risk in Production Networks
records.title_cn: 生产网络中的尾部风险
records.abstract_en: This paper describes the response of the economy to large shocks in a nonlinear production network. A sector's tail centrality measures how a large negative shock transmits to GDP, that is, the systemic risk of the sector. Tail centrality is theoretically and empirically very different from local centrality measures such as sales share—in a benchmark case, it is measured as a sector's average downstream closeness to final production. It also measures how large differences in sector productivity can generate cross‐country income differences. The paper also uses the results to analyze the determinants of total tail risk in the economy. Increases in interconnectedness can simultaneously reduce the sensitivity of the economy to small shocks while increasing the sensitivity to large shocks. Tail risk is related to conditional granularity, where some sectors become highly influential following negative shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 本文描述了经济在非线性生产网络中对大冲击的响应。一个部门的尾部中心性衡量了大的负面冲击如何传导至GDP，即该部门的系统性风险。尾部中心性在理论和实证上都与诸如销售份额之类的局部中心性度量非常不同——在一个基准情形中，它被衡量为部门对最终生产的平均下游接近度。它也衡量了部门生产率的巨大差异如何能够产生跨国收入差异。本文还利用这些结果分析了经济中总尾部风险的决定因素。互联性的增加可以同时降低经济对小冲击的敏感性，同时增加对大冲击的敏感性。尾部风险与条件粒度相关，其中一些部门在负面冲击后变得高度有影响力。

records.title_en: Same Root Different Leaves: Time Series and Cross‐Sectional Methods in Panel Data
records.title_cn: 同根异叶：面板数据中的时间序列与横截面方法
records.abstract_en: One dominant approach to evaluate the causal effect of a treatment is through panel data analysis, whereby the behaviors of multiple units are observed over time. The information across time and units motivates two general approaches: (i) horizontal regression (i.e., unconfoundedness), which exploits time series patterns, and (ii) vertical regression (e.g., synthetic controls), which exploits cross‐sectional patterns. Conventional wisdom often considers the two approaches to be different. We establish this position to be partly false for estimation but generally true for inference. In the absence of any assumptions, we show that both approaches yield algebraically equivalent point estimates for several standard estimators. However, the source of randomness assumed by each approach leads to a distinct estimand and quantification of uncertainty even for the same point estimate. This emphasizes that researchers should carefully consider where the randomness stems from in their data, as it has direct implications for the accuracy of inference.
records.abstract_cn: 评估处理因果效应的一种主导方法是通过面板数据分析，即观察多个单位随时间的行为。跨时间和单位的信息激发了两种一般方法：（i）水平回归（即无混杂性），利用时间序列模式，和（ii）垂直回归（例如，合成控制），利用横截面模式。传统观点通常认为这两种方法是不同的。我们确定这一立场在估计方面部分错误，但在推断方面通常正确。在没有任何假设的情况下，我们表明这两种方法对几种标准估计量产生代数上等价的点估计。然而，每种方法假设的随机性来源导致即使对于相同的点估计，也有不同的估计目标和不确定性量化。这强调研究者应仔细考虑其数据中随机性的来源，因为它对推断的准确性有直接影响。

records.title_en: Nonrandom Exposure to Exogenous Shocks
records.title_cn: 外生冲击的非随机暴露
records.abstract_en: We develop a new approach to estimating the causal effects of treatments or instruments that combine multiple sources of variation according to a known formula. Examples include treatments capturing spillovers in social or transportation networks and simulated instruments for policy eligibility. We show how exogenous shocks to some—but not all—determinants of such variables can be leveraged while avoiding omitted variables bias. Our solution involves specifying counterfactual shocks that may as well have been realized and adjusting for a summary measure of nonrandomness in shock exposure: the average treatment (or instrument) across shock counterfactuals. We use this approach to address bias when estimating employment effects of market access growth from Chinese high‐speed rail construction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种新方法，用于估计处理或工具变量的因果效应，这些处理或工具根据已知公式结合了多种变异来源。例子包括捕捉社交或交通网络中溢出效应的处理，以及政策资格的模拟工具。我们展示了如何利用这些变量某些（但非全部）决定因素的外生冲击，同时避免遗漏变量偏误。我们的解决方案涉及指定可能已经实现的反事实冲击，并调整冲击暴露非随机性的汇总度量：跨冲击反事实的平均处理（或工具）。我们使用这种方法来解决估计中国高铁建设带来的市场准入增长对就业影响时的偏误。

records.title_en: Estimation Based on Nearest Neighbor Matching: From Density Ratio to Average Treatment Effect
records.title_cn: 基于最近邻匹配的估计：从密度比到平均处理效应
records.abstract_en: Nearest neighbor (NN) matching is widely used in observational studies for causal effects. Abadie and Imbens (2006) provided the first large‐sample analysis of NN matching. Their theory focuses on the case with the number of NNs, M fixed. We reveal something new out of their study and show that once allowing M to diverge with the sample size an intrinsic statistic in their analysis constitutes a consistent estimator of the density ratio with regard to covariates across the treated and control groups. Consequently, with a diverging M, the NN matching with Abadie and Imbens' (2011) bias correction yields a doubly robust estimator of the average treatment effect and is semiparametrically efficient if the density functions are sufficiently smooth and the outcome model is consistently estimated. It can thus be viewed as a precursor of the double machine learning estimators.
records.abstract_cn: 最近邻（NN）匹配在观察性研究中广泛用于因果效应。Abadie和Imbens（2006）首次对NN匹配进行了大样本分析。他们的理论侧重于NN数量M固定的情况。我们从他们的研究中揭示了新的内容，并表明一旦允许M随样本量发散，他们分析中的一个内在统计量构成了关于协变量在处理组和对照组之间的密度比的一致估计量。因此，当M发散时，采用Abadie和Imbens（2011）偏差校正的NN匹配产生了平均处理效应的双稳健估计量，并且如果密度函数足够平滑且结果模型被一致估计，则它是半参数有效的。因此，它可以被视为双重机器学习估计量的先驱。

records.title_en: A Sufficient Statistics Approach for Macro Policy
records.title_cn: 宏观政策的充分统计量方法
records.abstract_en: The evaluation of macroeconomic policy decisions has traditionally relied on the formulation of a specific economic model. In this work, we show that two statistics are sufficient to detect, often even correct, nonoptimal policies, i.e., policies that do not minimize the loss function. The two sufficient statistics are (i) forecasts for the policy objectives conditional on the policy choice and (ii) the impulse responses of the policy objectives to policy shocks. Both statistics can be estimated without relying on a specific structural economic model. We illustrate the method by studying US monetary policy decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 宏观经济政策决策的评估传统上依赖于特定经济模型的构建。在这项工作中，我们表明两个统计量足以检测甚至常常纠正非最优政策，即未使损失函数最小化的政策。这两个充分统计量是（i）基于政策选择的条件下的政策目标预测，以及（ii）政策目标对政策冲击的脉冲响应。这两个统计量都可以在不依赖特定结构经济模型的情况下进行估计。我们通过研究美国货币政策决策来阐述该方法。

records.title_en: Beyond Teachers: Estimating Individual School Counselors' Effects on Educational Attainment
records.title_cn: 超越教师：估算学校辅导员个体对学生教育成就的影响
records.abstract_en: Counselors are a common school resource for students navigating complicated and consequential education choices. I estimate counselors' causal effects using quasi-random assignment policies in Massachusetts. Counselors vary substantially in their effectiveness at increasing high school graduation and college attendance, selectivity, and persistence. Counselor effects on educational attainment are similar in magnitude to teacher effects, but they flow through improved information and assistance more than cognitive or noncognitive skill development. Counselor effectiveness is most important for low-income and low-achieving students, so improving access to effective counseling may be a promising way to increase educational attainment and close socioeconomic gaps in education.
records.abstract_cn: 辅导员是学生在应对复杂且影响深远的教育选择时常见的学校资源。我利用马萨诸塞州的准随机分配政策来估算辅导员的因果效应。辅导员在提高高中毕业率、大学入学率、大学选择性和持续性方面的有效性存在显著差异。辅导员对教育成就的影响在幅度上与教师效应相似，但其作用机制更多是通过改善信息和援助，而非认知或非认知技能的发展。辅导员的有效性对低收入和低学业成就的学生最为重要，因此，改善获得有效辅导的机会可能是提高教育成就和缩小社会经济教育差距的一个有前景的途径。

records.title_en: The Impact of Regulation on Innovation
records.title_cn: 监管对创新的影响
records.abstract_en: We present a framework that can be used to assess the equilibrium impact of regulation on endogenous innovation with heterogeneous firms. We implement this model using French firm-level panel data, where there is a sharp increase in the burden of labor regulations on companies with 50 or more employees. Consistent with the model's qualitative predictions, we find a fall in the fraction of innovating firms just to the left of the regulatory threshold. Furthermore, we find a reduction in the innovation response of firms to demand shocks just below the threshold. Regulation reduces aggregate innovation by 5.7 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个框架，可用于评估监管对具有异质性企业的内生创新的均衡影响。我们使用法国企业层面的面板数据实施该模型，其中员工人数达到或超过50人的公司所承担的劳动监管负担急剧增加。与该模型的定性预测一致，我们发现监管门槛左侧的创新企业比例有所下降。此外，我们发现门槛以下企业对需求冲击的创新反应有所减少。监管使总体创新降低了5.7%。

records.title_en: Selection on Welfare Gains: Experimental Evidence from Electricity Plan Choice
records.title_cn: 福利收益上的选择：来自电力计划选择的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We study a problem in which policymakers need to screen self-selected individuals by unobserved heterogeneity in social welfare gains from a policy intervention. In our framework, the marginal treatment effects and marginal treatment responses arise as key statistics to characterize social welfare. We apply this framework to a randomized field experiment on electricity plan choice. Consumers were offered welfare-improving dynamic pricing with randomly assigned take-up incentives. We find that price-elastic consumers—who generate larger welfare gains—are more likely to self-select. Our counterfactual simulations quantify the optimal take-up incentives that exploit observed and unobserved heterogeneity in selection and welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个问题，其中政策制定者需要通过政策干预中社会福利收益的未观测异质性来筛选自我选择的个体。在我们的框架中，边际处理效应和边际处理响应作为刻画社会福利的关键统计量出现。我们将此框架应用于一个关于电力计划选择的随机实地实验。消费者被提供了改善福利的动态定价，并随机分配了参与激励。我们发现，价格弹性较大的消费者——他们产生更大的福利收益——更有可能自我选择。我们的反事实模拟量化了最优参与激励，这些激励利用了选择和福利收益中的观测和未观测异质性。

records.title_en: Unpacking P-hacking and Publication Bias
records.title_cn: 解析P值操纵与发表偏倚
records.abstract_en: We use unique data from journal submissions to identify and unpack publication bias and p-hacking. We find initial submissions display significant bunching, suggesting the distribution among published statistics cannot be fully attributed to a publication bias in peer review. Desk-rejected manuscripts display greater heaping than those sent for review; i.e., marginally significant results are more likely to be desk rejected. Reviewer recommendations, in contrast, are positively associated with statistical significance. Overall, the peer review process has little effect on the distribution of test statistics. Lastly, we track rejected papers and present evidence that the prevalence of publication biases is perhaps not as prominent as feared.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自期刊投稿的独特数据来识别并解析发表偏倚和P值操纵。我们发现初次投稿显示出显著的聚集现象，表明已发表统计量中的分布不能完全归因于同行评审中的发表偏倚。被编辑直接拒稿的稿件比送审的稿件表现出更大的堆积现象；即，边缘显著的结果更可能被直接拒稿。相比之下，审稿人的推荐与统计显著性正相关。总体而言，同行评审过程对检验统计量的分布影响甚微。最后，我们追踪被拒稿件，并提供证据表明发表偏倚的普遍性或许并不像人们担心的那样突出。

records.title_en: Is There a VA Advantage? Evidence from Dually Eligible Veterans
records.title_cn: 是否存在VA优势？来自双重合格退伍军人的证据
records.abstract_en: We study public versus private provision of health care for veterans aged 65 and older who may receive care provided by the US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and in private hospitals financed by Medicare. Utilizing the ambulance design of Doyle et al. (2015), we find that the VA reduces 28-day mortality by 46 percent (4.5 percentage points) and that these survival gains are persistent. The VA also reduces 28-day spending by 21 percent and delivers strikingly different reported services relative to private hospitals. We find suggestive evidence of complementarities between continuity of care, health IT, and integrated care.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了65岁及以上退伍军人的公共与私人医疗提供情况，这些退伍军人可能接受美国退伍军人事务部（VA）提供的护理，以及在由Medicare资助的私立医院接受护理。利用Doyle等人（2015）的救护车设计，我们发现VA将28天死亡率降低了46%（4.5个百分点），且这些生存获益是持续的。VA还将28天支出降低了21%，并提供与私立医院显著不同的报告服务。我们发现了护理连续性、健康信息技术和整合护理之间互补性的提示性证据。

records.title_en: Measuring Upward Mobility
records.title_cn: 衡量向上流动性
records.abstract_en: We conceptualize and measure upward mobility over income or wealth. At the core of our exercise is the Growth Progressivity Axiom: transfers of instantaneous growth rates from relatively rich to poor individuals increases upward mobility. This axiom, along with mild auxiliary restrictions, identifies an "upward mobility kernel" with a single free parameter, in which mobility is linear in individual growth rates, with geometrically declining weights on baseline incomes. We extend this kernel to trajectories over intervals. The analysis delivers an upward mobility index that does not rely on panel data. That significantly expands our analytical scope to data-poor settings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们概念化并衡量收入或财富的向上流动性。我们工作的核心是增长进步性公理：将瞬时增长率从相对富裕者转移给相对贫穷者会增加向上流动性。这一公理，连同温和的辅助限制，确定了一个具有单一自由参数的“向上流动性核”，其中流动性在个体增长率上是线性的，对基线收入的权重呈几何递减。我们将此核扩展到区间内的轨迹。该分析提供了一个不依赖面板数据的向上流动性指数。这显著扩展了我们在数据匮乏环境中的分析范围。

records.title_en: Who Controls the Agenda Controls the Legislature
records.title_cn: 谁控制议程，谁就控制立法机构
records.abstract_en: We model legislative decision-making with an agenda setter who can propose policies sequentially, tailoring each proposal to the status quo that prevails after prior votes. Voters are sophisticated, and the agenda setter cannot commit to future proposals. Nevertheless, the agenda setter obtains her favorite outcome in every equilibrium regardless of the initial default policy. Central to our results is a new condition on preferences, manipulability, that holds in rich policy spaces, including spatial settings and distribution problems. Our findings therefore establish that, despite the sophistication of voters and the absence of commitment power, the agenda setter is effectively a dictator.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个立法决策模型，其中议程设定者可以依次提出政策，并根据先前投票后形成的现状来调整每一项提案。投票者是老练的，且议程设定者无法承诺未来的提案。尽管如此，无论初始默认政策如何，议程设定者在每个均衡中都能获得她最偏好的结果。我们结果的核心是一个关于偏好的新条件——可操纵性，该条件在丰富的政策空间中成立，包括空间设置和分配问题。因此，我们的发现表明，尽管投票者老练且缺乏承诺力，议程设定者实际上是一个独裁者。

records.title_en: Do Credit Supply Shocks Affect Employment in Middle-Income Countries?
records.title_cn: 信贷供给冲击是否影响中等收入国家的就业？
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of bank credit supply shocks on formal employment in Mexico using a proprietary dataset containing information on all loans extended to firms by commercial banks during 2010–2015. We find large impacts on the formal employment of small and medium firms: a positive credit shock of 1 standard deviation increases yearly employment by 1.4 percentage points. The shares of uncollateralized credit and credit received by family firms, younger firms, and firms with no previous bank relationships also increase, suggesting that credit shocks may play a more prominent role for employment creation in credit-constrained settings. (JEL D22, G21, G32, J23, L25, M51, O16)
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个专有数据集，该数据集包含2010-2015年间商业银行向企业发放的所有贷款信息，研究了银行信贷供给冲击对墨西哥正规就业的影响。我们发现信贷冲击对中小企业的正规就业有显著影响：正向信贷冲击增加1个标准差，会使年就业增加1.4个百分点。无抵押信贷和由家族企业、年轻企业以及无先前银行关系的企业获得的信贷份额也有所增加，这表明在信贷受限的环境中，信贷冲击可能对就业创造发挥更突出的作用。（JEL D22, G21, G32, J23, L25, M51, O16）

records.title_en: Public and Private Options in Practice: The Military Health System
records.title_cn: 实践中的公共与私人选择：军事卫生系统
records.abstract_en: Recent debates over health care reform, including in the context of the Military Health System (MHS) and Veterans Administration, highlight the dispute between public and private provision of health care services. Using novel data on childbirth claims from the MHS and drawing on the combination of plausibly exogenous patient moves and heterogeneity across bases in the availability of base hospitals, we identify the impact of receiving obstetrical care on versus off military bases. We find evidence that off-base care is associated with slightly greater resource intensity, but also notably better outcomes, suggesting marginal efficiency gains from care privatization. (JEL H51, H56, I11, I18, J13, L33)
records.abstract_cn: 近期关于医疗改革的辩论，包括在军事卫生系统（MHS）和退伍军人管理局的背景下，凸显了公共与私人提供医疗服务之间的争议。利用来自MHS的新颖分娩索赔数据，并结合看似外生的患者流动和不同基地在基地医院可用性上的异质性，我们识别了在军事基地内与基地外接受产科护理的影响。我们发现证据表明，基地外护理与略高的资源密集度相关，但同时也与显著更好的结果相关，这表明护理私有化带来了边际效率收益。（JEL H51, H56, I11, I18, J13, L33）

records.title_en: Age Discrimination across the Business Cycle
records.title_cn: 年龄歧视与经济周期
records.abstract_en: We test whether age discrimination rises during recessions using two complementary analyses. Confidential EEOC microdata reveal that age-related firing and hiring charges rise by 3.3 percent and 1.6 percent, respectively, for each percentage point increase in a state-industry’s monthly unemployment. Though the opportunity cost of filing falls, the fraction of meritorious claims increases—a sufficient condition for rising discrimination under plausible assumptions. Second, we repurpose data from hiring correspondence studies conducted across different cities and time periods during the recovery from the Great Recession. Each percentage point increase in local unemployment reduces the callback rate for older versus younger women by 15 percent. (JEL E32, J14, J16, J23, J71, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过两项互补分析检验年龄歧视是否在经济衰退期间加剧。机密的EEOC微观数据显示，州-行业月度失业率每上升一个百分点，与年龄相关的解雇和招聘指控分别上升3.3%和1.6%。尽管提起诉讼的机会成本下降，但有理有据的索赔比例增加——在合理假设下，这是歧视加剧的充分条件。其次，我们重新利用大衰退复苏期间在不同城市和时间段进行的招聘对应研究数据。当地失业率每上升一个百分点，老年女性相对于年轻女性的回电率下降15%。(JEL E32, J14, J16, J23, J71, M51)

records.title_en: My Professor Cares: Experimental Evidence on the Role of Faculty Engagement
records.title_cn: 我的教授关心：教师参与作用的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence on the impact of specific faculty behaviors aimed at increasing student success for college students from historically underrepresented groups. The intervention was developed after conducting in-person focus groups and a pilot experiment. We find significant positive treatment effects across a multitude of short- and longer-run outcomes. Specifically, underrep-resented students in the treatment report more positive perceptions of the professor and earned higher course grades. These positive effects persisted over the next several years, with students in the treatment more likely to persist in college, resulting in increased credit accumulation and degree completion. (JEL I22, I23, I28, J15, J44)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于特定教师行为对历史上代表性不足群体大学生学业成功影响的实验证据。该干预措施是在进行面对面焦点小组和试点实验后制定的。我们在众多短期和长期结果中发现了显著的正向处理效应。具体而言，处理组中代表性不足的学生对教授的看法更为积极，并获得了更高的课程成绩。这些积极效应在接下来的几年中持续存在，处理组的学生更有可能坚持完成大学学业，从而增加了学分积累和学位完成率。（JEL I22, I23, I28, J15, J44）

records.title_en: Public Pension Reforms and Retirement Decisions: Narrative Evidence and Aggregate Implications
records.title_cn: 公共养老金改革与退休决策：叙事证据与总体影响
records.abstract_en: We construct a database of public pension policy changes with motivation and implementation information for ten OECD countries. Structural pension reforms, motivated by long-run sustainability concerns, often come with prolonged phase-in periods. In response to pension retrenchments implemented immediately, people close to retirement stay in the workforce longer. News about future pension retrenchments with implementation lags, however, is likely to lead this group to exit the labor market. This decline in the labor force participation rate is particularly strong for reforms with long lags, ones that introduce fundamental policy changes, and ones where citizens have lower trust in the government. (JEL E62, H55, J14, J22, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含十个OECD国家公共养老金政策变化及其动机和实施信息的数据库。出于长期可持续性考虑的结构性养老金改革，往往伴随着较长的分阶段实施期。对于立即实施的养老金削减措施，接近退休年龄的人群会延长工作年限。然而，关于未来养老金削减且实施滞后的消息，则可能导致这一群体退出劳动力市场。这种劳动力参与率的下降，在实施滞后较长、引入根本性政策变化以及公民对政府信任度较低的情况下尤为显著。(JEL E62, H55, J14, J22, J26)

records.title_en: Moved to Poverty? A Legacy of the Apartheid Experiment in South Africa
records.title_cn: 被迫迁往贫困？南非种族隔离实验的遗产
records.abstract_en: During the South African apartheid, Black people were forced to move to homelands during the 1960s and 1970s, resulting in one of history’s largest segregation policy experiments. We examine how and why relocation to the homelands affected human capital attainment. Exploiting the staggered timing of homeland establishment in a cross-cohort identification strategy, we find that moving to the home-lands during childhood significantly reduces educational attainment, labor earnings, and employment rates in adulthood. The data suggest an important role for place effects. Moving to the homelands in childhood implies greater exposure to poorer neighborhoods, and it disproportionally reduces human capital attainment. (JEL I26, J15, J24, J31, N37, O15, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 在南非种族隔离期间，黑人在1960年代和1970年代被迫迁往“黑人家园”，这成为历史上最大规模的种族隔离政策实验之一。我们研究了迁往家园如何以及为何影响人力资本积累。利用家园建立时间在不同队列中的交错性作为识别策略，我们发现童年时期迁往家园显著降低了成年后的教育成就、劳动收入和就业率。数据表明，地点效应发挥了重要作用。童年时期迁往家园意味着更多地暴露于更贫困的社区，并且不成比例地减少了人力资本积累。(JEL I26, J15, J24, J31, N37, O15, R23)

records.title_en: Dynamic Impacts of School-Based Internet Access on Student Learning: Evidence from Peruvian Public Primary Schools
records.title_cn: 学校互联网接入对学生学习的动态影响：来自秘鲁公立小学的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate the impacts of school-based internet access on second graders’ test scores, using over 2 million student observations from a panel of Peruvian public primary schools. We identify effects up to 6+ years after installation on different cohorts of second-grade students, exploiting variation in the timing of internet access induced by the rollout of a national program. We find positive but modest short-run impacts, but importantly, these effects grow for subsequent cohorts. Indeed, short-run estimates alone would have led to different conclusions. These dynamics underscore the value of extended evaluation windows to allow benefits of educational technology to materialize. (JEL I21, I26, I28, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用秘鲁公立小学的面板数据，包含超过2万个学生观测值，研究了学校互联网接入对二年级学生考试成绩的影响。我们利用国家项目推广过程中互联网接入时间的差异，识别了安装后长达6年以上的不同二年级学生群体的效应。我们发现短期影响虽为正但较为温和，但重要的是，这些效应在后续队列中有所增长。实际上，仅基于短期估计会得出不同的结论。这些动态变化强调了延长评估窗口的重要性，以便教育技术的好处得以显现。（JEL I21, I26, I28, O15）

records.title_en: Effects of Maturing Private School Choice Programs on Public School Students
records.title_cn: 成熟的私立学校选择项目对公立学校学生的影响
records.abstract_en: Using a rich dataset that merges student-level school records with birth records, and leveraging a student fixed effects design, we explore how a Florida private school choice program affected public school students’ outcomes as the program matured and scaled up. We observe growing benefits (higher standardized test scores and lower absenteeism and suspension rates) to students attending public schools with more preprogram private school options as the program matured. Effects are particularly pronounced for lower-income students, but results are positive for more affluent students as well. Local and district-wide private school competition are both independently related to student outcomes. (JEL H75, I21, I22, I28)
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个将学生层面的学校记录与出生记录合并的丰富数据集，并采用学生固定效应设计，我们探讨了佛罗里达州的一个私立学校选择项目在成熟和扩大规模过程中如何影响公立学校学生的结果。随着项目的成熟，我们观察到就读于项目前私立学校选择更多的公立学校的学生获得了越来越多的益处（标准化测试成绩更高，缺勤率和停学率更低）。对于低收入学生而言，这些效应尤为显著，但对较富裕学生而言结果也是积极的。地方和学区范围内的私立学校竞争均与学生结果独立相关。（JEL H75, I21, I22, I28）

records.title_en: Electoral Cycles in Macroprudential Regulation
records.title_cn: 宏观审慎监管中的选举周期
records.abstract_en: Do politics matter for macroprudential policies? I show that changes in macroprudential regulation exhibit a predictable electoral cycle in the run-up to 221 elections across 58 countries from 2000 through 2014. Policies restricting mortgages and consumer credit are systematically looser before elections, particularly during economic expansions. Consistent with theories of opportunistic political cycles, this pattern is stronger when election outcomes are uncertain, regulators are closely tied to politicians, and institutions are poor. These results suggest that political pressures may limit the ability of regulators to “lean against the wind.” (JEL D72, E32, G01, G21, G28)
records.abstract_cn: 政治因素对宏观审慎政策有影响吗？我展示了在2000年至2014年间，58个国家的宏观审慎监管变化在221次选举前呈现出可预测的选举周期。限制抵押贷款和消费信贷的政策在选举前系统性放松，尤其是在经济扩张期间。与机会主义政治周期理论一致，这种模式在选举结果不确定、监管者与政治家关系密切以及制度薄弱时更为明显。这些结果表明，政治压力可能限制监管者“逆风而行”的能力。（JEL D72, E32, G01, G21, G28）

records.title_en: Market Power and Price Exposure: Learning from Changes in Renewable Energy Regulation
records.title_cn: 市场势力与价格暴露：从可再生能源监管变化中学习
records.abstract_en: Given the critical role of renewable energies in current and future electricity markets, it is important to understand how they affect firms’ pricing incentives. We study whether the price-depressing effect of renewables depends on their degree of market price exposure. Paying renewables with fixed prices, rather than market-based prices, is more effective at curbing market power when the dominant firms own large shares of renewables, and vice versa. Our empirical short-lived changes to renewables regulation in the Spanish market and shows that switching from full-price exposure to fixed prices caused a 2–4 percent reduction in the average price-cost markup. (JEL L13, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于可再生能源在当前和未来电力市场中的关键作用，理解它们如何影响企业的定价激励十分重要。我们研究了可再生能源的价格抑制效应是否取决于其市场价格暴露程度。当主导企业拥有大量可再生能源份额时，以固定价格而非市场价格支付可再生能源，在抑制市场势力方面更为有效，反之亦然。我们对西班牙市场可再生能源监管的短期变化进行的实证研究表明，从完全价格暴露转向固定价格导致平均价格-成本加成率下降了2-4%。（JEL L13, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

records.title_en: The Effects of Import Competition on Unionization
records.title_cn: 进口竞争对工会化的影响
records.abstract_en: We study direct and indirect effects of Chinese import competition on union membership in the United States, 1990–2014. Import competition in manufacturing induced a modest decline in unionization within manufacturing industries. The magnitude is small because unionized manufacturers competed in higher-quality product segments. Manufacturers in right-to-work states experienced more direct competition with low-quality Chinese imports. Outside of manufacturing, however, import competition causes an important increase in union membership, as less educated women shift away from retail and toward jobs in health care and education where unions are stronger. We calculate that Chinese imports prevented 26 percent of the union density decline that would have otherwise occurred. (JEL F14, F16, J16, J51, L60, P33)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了1990-2014年间中国进口竞争对美国工会会员人数的直接和间接影响。制造业中的进口竞争导致制造业行业内工会化程度出现适度下降。这一幅度较小，因为工会化的制造商在更高质量的产品细分市场竞争。在拥有工作权法的州，制造商面临来自低质量中国进口商品的更直接竞争。然而，在制造业之外，进口竞争导致工会会员人数显著增加，因为受教育程度较低的女性从零售业转向医疗保健和教育行业，这些行业的工会更为强大。我们计算得出，中国进口阻止了本可能发生的工会密度下降的26%。（JEL F14, F16, J16, J51, L60, P33）

records.title_en: Information and Spillovers from Targeting Policy in Peru’s Anchoveta Fishery
records.title_cn: 秘鲁鳀鱼渔业中目标政策的信息与溢出效应
records.abstract_en: This paper establishes that a targeted policy backfires because it reveals information about nontargeted units. In the world’s largest fishery, the regulator attempts to reduce the harvesting of juvenile fish by temporarily closing areas where the share of juvenile catch is high. By combining administrative microdata with biologically richer data from fishing firms, I isolate variation in closures that is due to the regulator’s lower-resolution data. I estimate substantial temporal and spatial spillovers from closures. Closures increase total juvenile catch by 48 percent because closure announcements implicitly signal that fishing before, just outside, and after closures is high productivity. (JEL D83, O13, Q21, Q22, Q28)
records.abstract_cn: 本文证实了一项目标政策因揭示了非目标单位的信息而适得其反。在全球最大的渔业中，监管机构试图通过暂时关闭幼鱼捕捞比例较高的区域来减少幼鱼的捕捞。通过将行政微观数据与渔业公司提供的生物学更丰富的数据相结合，我分离了因监管机构较低分辨率数据而导致的关闭变化。我估计了关闭带来的显著时间和空间溢出效应。关闭使幼鱼总捕捞量增加了48%，因为关闭公告隐含地表明，在关闭之前、紧邻关闭区域之外以及关闭之后进行捕捞具有高生产率。(JEL D83, O13, Q21, Q22, Q28)

records.title_en: Digitization and the Market for Physical Works: Evidence from the Google Books Project
records.title_cn: 数字化与实体作品市场：来自谷歌图书项目的证据
records.abstract_en: The free digital distribution of creative works could cannibalize demand for physical versions, but it could also boost physical sales by enabling consumers to discover the original work. We study the impact of the Google Books digitization project on the market for physical books. We find that digitization significantly boosts the demand for physical versions and provide evidence for the discovery channel. Moreover, digitization allows independent publishers to introduce new editions for existing books, further increasing sales. Our results highlight the potential of free digital distribution to strengthen the demand for and supply of physical products. (JEL D12, L82, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 创意作品的免费数字分发可能会蚕食实体版本的需求，但也可能通过使消费者发现原作来促进实体销售。我们研究了谷歌图书数字化项目对实体书市场的影响。我们发现数字化显著提升了实体版本的需求，并为发现渠道提供了证据。此外，数字化使独立出版商能够为现有书籍推出新版本，进一步增加销售。我们的结果凸显了免费数字分发在增强实体产品需求和供给方面的潜力。（JEL D12, L82, L86）

records.title_en: Brexit Uncertainty and Its (Dis)Service Effects
records.title_cn: 英国脱欧不确定性及其（非）服务效应
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of increased policy uncertainty from Brexit on UK trade in services. We apply an uncertainty-augmented gravity equation to UK services trade with the European Union at the industry level from 2016:I to 2018:IV. By exploiting the variation in the probability of Brexit from prediction markets interacted with a new trade policy risk measure across service industries, we identify a significant negative impact of the threat of Brexit on trade values and participation. The increased probability of Brexit in this period lowered services exports by at least 20 log points. (JEL F13, F14, F15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估算了英国脱欧带来的政策不确定性增加对英国服务贸易的影响。我们将不确定性增强的引力方程应用于2016年第一季度至2018年第四季度英国与欧盟在行业层面的服务贸易。通过利用预测市场中脱欧概率的变化与跨服务行业的新贸易政策风险度量之间的交互作用，我们识别出脱欧威胁对贸易额和参与度的显著负面影响。该时期脱欧概率的增加使服务出口至少下降了20个对数点。（JEL F13, F14, F15）

records.title_en: Do Tax Incentives Increase Firm Innovation? An RD Design for R&D, Patents, and Spillovers
records.title_cn: 税收激励是否增加企业创新？研发、专利和溢出效应的断点回归设计
records.abstract_en: We present causal evidence of R&D tax incentives’ positive impacts on a firm’s own innovation and that of its technological neighbors. Exploiting a change in size-based eligibility thresholds for R&D tax relief, we implement a Regression Discontinuity Design using administrative data. We find significant effects of tax relief on (quality-adjusted) patenting (and R&D) that persist up to seven years, and evidence of R&D spillovers on the innovation of technologically close firms. We can rule out elasticities of patenting with respect to R&D user cost of under 2 at the 5 percent level and show that our large effects are driven by financially constrained treated firms. (JEL D22, H25, H32, O31, O34)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了研发税收激励对企业自身创新及其技术邻近企业创新的因果证据。利用基于规模资格的研发税收减免门槛变化，我们使用行政数据实施断点回归设计。我们发现税收减免对（质量调整后的）专利申请（和研发）有显著影响，且影响持续长达七年，并提供了研发溢出效应对技术相近企业创新的证据。我们可以在5%水平上排除专利申请相对于研发用户成本的弹性低于2的情况，并表明我们的显著效应是由财务受限的处理企业驱动的。（JEL D22, H25, H32, O31, O34）

records.title_en: Juvenile Crime and Anticipated Punishment
records.title_cn: 青少年犯罪与预期惩罚
records.abstract_en: Can sanctions deter juvenile crime? Research indicates that they may not, as offending barely decreases when individuals cross the age of criminal majority and begin to face harsher sanctions. Several models of criminal behavior predict, however, that these small reactions close to the threshold may mask larger behavioral responses among individuals below the age threshold. Policy variation between 2007–2015 in the United States is used to show evidence consistent with these predictions—juvenile crime increases when the age of majority is increased. This increase is driven by younger age groups and is considerably larger than discontinuity estimates at the threshold. (JEL D91, J13, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 制裁能否威慑青少年犯罪？研究表明，它们可能不能，因为当个人跨过刑事责任年龄并开始面临更严厉的制裁时，犯罪行为几乎没有减少。然而，几种犯罪行为模型预测，接近门槛的这些微小反应可能掩盖了低于年龄门槛的个体中更大的行为反应。利用美国2007-2015年间的政策变化，提供了与这些预测一致的证据——当成年年龄提高时，青少年犯罪增加。这种增加由较年轻的年龄组驱动，并且比门槛处的断点估计要大得多。（JEL D91, J13, K42）

records.title_en: Monitor Reputation and Transparency
records.title_cn: 监督者声誉与透明度
records.abstract_en: We study the disclosure policy of a regulator overseeing a monitor with reputation concerns. The monitor faces a manager, who chooses how much to manipulate based on the monitor’s reputation. Reputational incentives are strongest for intermediate reputations. Instead of providing transparency, the regulator’s disclosure policy aims to keep the monitor’s reputation intermediate, even at the cost of diminished incentives. Beneficial schemes feature random delay or noisy information. Schemes that feature verifiable disclosure destroy reputational incentives. The regulator discloses more aggressively when she has better enforcement tools. (JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, G38, M42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个监管者对具有声誉顾虑的监督者的披露政策。监督者面对一个经理，经理根据监督者的声誉选择操纵程度。声誉激励在中等声誉时最强。监管者的披露政策并非提供透明度，而是旨在保持监督者的声誉处于中等水平，即使以激励减弱为代价。有益的方案具有随机延迟或噪声信息的特点。具有可验证披露的方案会破坏声誉激励。当监管者拥有更好的执法工具时，她会更积极地进行披露。（JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, G38, M42）

records.title_en: Multihoming and Oligopolistic Platform Competition
records.title_cn: 多归属与寡头平台竞争
records.abstract_en: We provide a general framework to analyze competition between any number of symmetric two-sided transaction platforms, in which buyers and sellers can multihome. We show how key primitives such as the number of platforms, the fraction of buyers that find multihoming costly, the value of transactions, and the degree of user heterogeneity jointly determine the level and structure of platform fees. Even though platform entry always reduces the total fee level, whether it shifts the fee structure in favor of buyers or sellers depends on whether most of the buyers are singlehoming or multihoming. (JEL D43, L11, L13, L40)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个一般性框架来分析任意数量的对称双边交易平台之间的竞争，其中买家和卖家可以多归属。我们展示了关键初始条件，如平台数量、发现多归属成本高昂的买家比例、交易价值以及用户异质性程度，如何共同决定平台费用的水平和结构。尽管平台进入总是降低总费用水平，但费用结构是偏向买家还是卖家，取决于大多数买家是单归属还是多归属。(JEL D43, L11, L13, L40)

records.title_en: Using Team Discussions to Understand Behavior in Indefinitely Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma Games
records.title_cn: 利用团队讨论理解无限重复囚徒困境博弈中的行为
records.abstract_en: We compare behavior of two person teams with individuals in indefinitely repeated prisoner dilemma games with perfect monitoring. Team discussions are used to understand the rationale underlying these choices and how these choices come about. There are three main findings: (i) Teams learned to cooperate faster than individuals, and cooperation was more stable for teams. (ii) Strategies identified from team dialogues differ from those identified by the Strategy Frequency Estimation Method. This reflects the improvisational nature of teams’ decision making. (iii) Increasing cooperation was primarily driven by teams unilaterally cooperating in the hope of inducing their opponent to cooperate. (JEL C72, C73, C92)
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了两人团队与个体在具有完美监督的无限重复囚徒困境博弈中的行为。团队讨论被用来理解这些选择背后的理由以及这些选择是如何产生的。有三个主要发现：（i）团队比个体更快学会合作，且团队的合作更为稳定。（ii）从团队对话中识别的策略不同于通过策略频率估计方法识别的策略。这反映了团队决策的即兴性质。（iii）增加的合作主要是由团队单方面合作以期诱导对手合作所驱动的。（JEL C72, C73, C92）

records.title_en: Supervised Machine Learning for Eliciting Individual Demand
records.title_cn: 监督机器学习用于引出个体需求
records.abstract_en: The canonical direct-elicitation approach for measuring individuals’ valuations for goods is the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak procedure, which generates willingness-to-pay (WTP) values that are imprecise and systematically biased. We show that enhancing elicited WTP values with supervised machine learning (SML) can improve estimates of peoples’ out-of-sample purchase behavior. Furthermore, swapping WTP data with choice data generated from a simple task leads to comparable performance. We quantify the benefit of using various SML methods in conjunction with using different types of data. Our results suggest that prices set by SML would increase revenue by 29 percent over using the stated WTP, with the same data. (JEL C45, C91, D12)
records.abstract_cn: 衡量个体对商品价值的经典直接引出方法是Becker-DeGroot-Marschak程序，该方法产生的支付意愿（WTP）值不精确且存在系统性偏差。我们表明，用监督机器学习（SML）增强引出的WTP值可以改进对人们样本外购买行为的估计。此外，用简单任务产生的选择数据替换WTP数据可达到相当的性能。我们量化了使用各种SML方法结合不同类型数据的收益。我们的结果表明，使用相同数据，由SML设定的价格相比使用陈述的WTP将增加收入29%。（JEL C45, C91, D12）

records.title_en: Smaller Slices of a Growing Pie: The Effects of Entry in Platform Markets
records.title_cn: 增长蛋糕中的更小块：平台市场进入的影响
records.abstract_en: Entry of new firms onto a platform has an ambivalent effect on the incumbent firms operating on the platform: the main tension lies between the negative effects of increased competitive pressure and positive indirect network effects. This paper empirically studies the net effect of these countervailing forces and its dependence on firm quality, using a quasi-exogenous shock on a large online platform. On average, market expansion favors incumbents, though the average effect masks substantial heterogeneity: high-quality incumbents experience significant increases in sales and revenue, whereas low-quality firms perform unambiguously worse. Lastly, the paper explores the main mechanisms and firms’ responses. (JEL D22, D85, L14, L15, L84)
records.abstract_cn: 新企业进入平台对平台上现有企业具有矛盾的影响：主要张力在于竞争压力增加的负面效应与正向间接网络效应之间的权衡。本文利用大型在线平台上的准外生冲击，实证研究了这些相反力量的净效应及其对企业质量的依赖性。平均而言，市场扩张有利于现有企业，但平均效应掩盖了显著的异质性：高质量现有企业的销售额和收入显著增加，而低质量企业则表现明显更差。最后，本文探讨了主要机制和企业的应对策略。（JEL D22, D85, L14, L15, L84）

records.title_en: Monopolistic Competition and Efficiency under Firm Heterogeneity and Nonadditive Preferences
records.title_cn: 企业异质性与非可加偏好下的垄断竞争与效率
records.abstract_en: We consider the single-sector version of the Melitz-Ottaviano model of monopolistic competition with heterogeneous firms. We characterize the first-best and market allocations. We find that the market provides the first-best level of entry but too little selection; hence, the market provides too many varieties and too little aggregate quantity, and allocates too little (much) production to low (high) cost realizations. Allowing for a broad family of quantity allocation functions, we establish sufficient conditions for the global optimality of the first-best solution. Several important extensions are also examined. (JEL D21, D43, D50, D60)
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了具有异质性企业的梅利茨-奥塔维亚诺垄断竞争模型的单部门版本。我们刻画了最优和市场竞争配置。我们发现市场提供了最优水平的进入，但选择不足；因此，市场提供了过多的品种和过少的总量，并将过少（过多）的生产分配给低成本（高成本）实现。通过允许广泛的产量分配函数族，我们建立了最优解全局最优性的充分条件。还考察了几个重要的扩展。（JEL D21、D43、D50、D60）

records.title_en: Evaluating the Impact of Online Market Integration—Evidence from the EU Portable PC Market
records.title_cn: 评估在线市场整合的影响——来自欧盟便携式电脑市场的证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a framework to evaluate the impact of market integration, accounting for spillovers between multiple distribution channels. We adapt the standard random coefficients logit demand model to allow for substitution between channels and consumer arbitrage across countries. We apply our framework to the European portable PC market, where geoblocking practices that restrict online cross-border trade have recently been banned. Consumers in high income countries gain most from price convergence, while consumers in other countries may be worse off. The total consumer and welfare gains from online market integration are more modest and mainly due to increased product choice rather than reduced price discrimination. (JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个评估市场整合影响的框架，考虑了多个分销渠道之间的溢出效应。我们调整了标准随机系数logit需求模型，以允许渠道之间的替代和消费者跨国套利。我们将该框架应用于欧洲便携式电脑市场，该市场最近禁止了限制在线跨境贸易的地理封锁做法。高收入国家的消费者从价格趋同中获益最多，而其他国家的消费者可能受损。在线市场整合带来的总消费者和福利收益较为温和，主要归因于产品选择的增加而非价格歧视的减少。(JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)

records.title_en: Slope Takers in Anonymous Markets
records.title_cn: 匿名市场中的斜率接受者
records.abstract_en: We present a learning-based selection argument for Linear Bayesian Nash equilibrium in a Walrasian auction. Endowments vary stochastically; traders model residual supply as linear, estimate its slope from past trade data, and periodically update these estimates. In the standard setting with quadratic preferences, we show that this learning process converges to the unique LBN. Anonymity and statistical learning therefore support this commonly used equilibrium selection rule. (JEL D43, D44, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个基于学习的筛选论证，用于瓦尔拉斯拍卖中的线性贝叶斯纳什均衡。禀赋随机变化；交易者将剩余供给建模为线性的，从过去的交易数据中估计其斜率，并定期更新这些估计。在具有二次偏好的标准设定中，我们证明了这一学习过程收敛于唯一的LBN。因此，匿名性和统计学习支持了这一常用的均衡筛选规则。（JEL D43, D44, D83）

records.title_en: A Model of Sequential Crisis Management
records.title_cn: 序贯危机管理模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of how multiple societies respond to a common crisis. A government faces a “damned-either-way” policymaking dilemma: aggressive intervention contains the crisis, but the resulting good outcome makes people skeptical about the costly response; light intervention worsens the crisis and causes the government to be faulted for not doing enough. When multiple societies encounter the crisis sequentially, due to this policymaking dilemma, late societies may underperform despite having more information, while early societies can benefit from a dynamic counterfactual effect. (JEL D72, D82, D83, H12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个关于多个社会如何应对共同危机的模型。政府面临一个“两头不讨好”的政策制定困境：激进的干预能够控制危机，但由此产生的良好结果会让人们对高昂的应对措施持怀疑态度；轻度的干预则会加剧危机，并使政府因做得不够而受到指责。当多个社会依次遭遇危机时，由于这种政策制定困境，后来的社会尽管拥有更多信息，表现却可能不佳，而早期的社会则能从动态反事实效应中受益。（JEL D72, D82, D83, H12）

records.title_en: Trade-ins and Transaction Costs in the Market for Used Business Jets
records.title_cn: 二手公务机市场中的以旧换新与交易成本
records.abstract_en: Manufacturers of durable goods can encourage consumers facing transaction costs to upgrade by accepting used units as trade-ins. These “buyback schemes” increase demand for new units, but increase the supply of used units if trade-ins are resold. I investigate the equilibrium effects of buyback schemes in the market for business jets. I find that buyback increases manufacturer revenue by 7.2 percent at fixed prices. However, in equilibrium this revenue gain is diminished by 43 percent due to substitution away from new jets among first time buyers. I show how the size of this cannibalization effect depends on preference heterogeneity. (JEL D23, G34, L13, L62)
records.abstract_cn: 耐用品制造商可以通过接受旧产品作为以旧换新，来鼓励面临交易成本的消费者升级。这些“回购计划”增加了对新产品的需求，但如果以旧换新的产品被转售，则会增加二手产品的供应。我研究了公务机市场中回购计划的均衡效应。我发现，在固定价格下，以旧换新使制造商收入增加了7.2%。然而，在均衡状态下，由于首次购买者对新飞机的替代效应，这一收入增长被削弱了43%。我展示了这种蚕食效应的大小如何取决于偏好的异质性。（JEL D23, G34, L13, L62）

records.title_en: Regulatory Limits to Risk Management
records.title_cn: 风险管理的监管限制
records.abstract_en: Variable annuities, the largest liability of U.S. life insurers, are investment products containing long-dated minimum return guarantees. I show that guarantees with similar economic risks are treated differently by regulation and these differences impact insurers’ hedging behavior. When the regulatory regime recognizes certain risks, insurers start to hedge these risks in a substantial way. For some guarantees, this involves hedging both interest rate and equity market risks. However, for others, it involves hedging only equity market risk. As the regulatory regime still does not recognize the interest rate risk of all guarantees, insurers remain exposed to substantial interest rate risk. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 可变年金是美国寿险公司最大的负债，是包含长期最低回报保证的投资产品。我表明，具有类似经济风险的保证在监管上受到不同对待，这些差异影响保险公司的对冲行为。当监管制度承认某些风险时，保险公司开始以实质性方式对这些风险进行对冲。对于某些保证，这涉及同时对冲利率风险和股票市场风险。然而，对于其他保证，仅涉及对冲股票市场风险。由于监管制度仍未承认所有保证的利率风险，保险公司仍然面临大量的利率风险。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边找到。

records.title_en: Watch What They Do, Not What They Say: Estimating Regulatory Costs from Revealed Preferences
records.title_cn: 看他们做什么，而非说什么：从显示性偏好估计监管成本
records.abstract_en: We show that distortion in the size distribution of banks around regulatory thresholds can be used to identify costs of bank regulation. We build a structural model in which banks can strategically bunch their assets below regulatory thresholds to avoid regulations. The resultant distortion in the size distribution of banks reveals the magnitude of regulatory costs. Using U.S. bank data, we estimate the regulatory costs imposed by the Dodd-Frank Act. Although the estimated regulatory costs are substantial, they are significantly lower than banks’ self-reported estimates. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，银行规模分布在监管阈值附近的扭曲可用于识别银行监管的成本。我们构建了一个结构模型，其中银行可以策略性地将其资产聚集在监管阈值以下以避免监管。由此产生的银行规模分布扭曲揭示了监管成本的大小。利用美国银行数据，我们估计了《多德-弗兰克法案》所施加的监管成本。尽管估计的监管成本相当可观，但显著低于银行自我报告的成本。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Man versus Machine Learning: The Term Structure of Earnings Expectations and Conditional Biases
records.title_cn: 人类与机器学习：盈利预期的期限结构与条件性偏差
records.abstract_en: We introduce a real-time measure of conditional biases to firms’ earnings forecasts. The measure is defined as the difference between analysts’ expectations and a statistically optimal unbiased machine-learning benchmark.
