The asymmetric behavior is valid for private firms, but not for state-owned firms that have softer budget constraints. Such tax avoidance is done through the manipulation of the costs of goods sold and other expenses, rather than managing net receivables.
records.abstract_cn: 利用中国2008年企业所得税改革作为准自然实验，我们构建了一个双重差分设定来研究企业税收遵从的不对称性。与税收不受改革影响的企业相比，税率上升的企业报告的利润率显著更低，以避免缴纳更多税款。然而，面临减税的企业与未受影响的企业行为并无差异。这种不对称行为对民营企业成立，但对预算约束较软的国有企业不成立。这种避税行为是通过操纵销售成本和其他费用实现的，而非通过管理净应收账款。

records.title_en: The Agglomeration of Urban Amenities: Evidence from Milan Restaurants
records.title_cn: 城市便利设施的集聚：来自米兰餐厅的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate agglomeration externalities in Milan’s restaurant sector using the abolition of a unique regulation that restricted where restaurants could locate. In 2005, Milan abolished a minimum distance requirement that had kept the number of establishments artificially constant across neighborhoods. We find that after 2005, the geographical concentration of restaurants increased sharply and at an accelerating rate. Consistent with the existence of strong and self-sustaining agglomeration externalities, restaurants agglomerated in some neighborhoods and deserted others, leading to a growing divergence in local amenities across neighborhoods. Restaurants located in neighborhoods that experienced large increases in agglomeration reacted by increasing product differentiation. (JEL D62, L83, L88, R32, R52)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项限制餐厅选址的独特法规的废除，估计了米兰餐饮业的集聚外部性。2005年，米兰废除了最低距离要求，该要求曾使各街区的餐厅数量人为地保持恒定。我们发现，2005年之后，餐厅的地理集中度急剧上升，并以加速的速度上升。与强大且自我维持的集聚外部性的存在相一致，餐厅在某些街区集聚，而在其他街区则被遗弃，导致各街区本地便利设施的差异不断扩大。位于集聚程度大幅增加街区的餐厅，其反应是增加产品差异化。(JEL D62, L83, L88, R32, R52)

records.title_en: Reputation and Partial Default
records.title_cn: 声誉与部分违约
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a continuous-time reputation model of sovereign debt allowing for both varying levels of partial default and full default. In it, a government can be a nonstrategic commitment type or a strategic opportunistic type, and a government’s reputation is its equilibrium Bayesian posterior of being the commitment type. Our equilibrium has that for bond levels reachable by both types without defaulting, bigger partial defaults (or bigger haircuts for bond holders) imply higher interest rates for subsequent bond issuances, as in the data. (JEL D83, E32, E43, G12, H63)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个主权债务的连续时间声誉模型，允许不同程度的部分违约和完全违约。在该模型中，政府可以是非战略性的承诺类型或战略性的机会主义类型，而政府的声誉是其作为承诺类型的均衡贝叶斯后验概率。我们的均衡表明，对于两种类型在不违约情况下均可达到的债券水平，较大的部分违约（或对债券持有人的较大减记）意味着后续债券发行的利率更高，这与数据相符。（JEL D83, E32, E43, G12, H63）

records.title_en: Pandemic Schooling Mode and Student Test Scores: Evidence from US School Districts
records.title_cn: 疫情教学模式与学生考试成绩：来自美国学区的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of district-level schooling mode (in-person versus hybrid or virtual learning) in the 2020–2021 school year on students’ pass rates on standardized tests in grades 3–8 across 11 states. Pass rates declined from 2019 to 2021: an average of 12.8 percentage points in math and 6.8 in English language arts (ELA). Focusing on within-state, within–commuting zone variation in schooling mode, we estimate that districts with full in-person learning had significantly smaller declines (13.4 pp in math, 8.3 in ELA). The value to in-person learning was larger for districts with larger populations of Black students. (JEL H75, I12, I18, I21, I28, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了2020-2021学年学区层面的教学模式（线下教学与混合或线上学习）对11个州3-8年级学生标准化考试通过率的影响。从2019年到2021年，通过率有所下降：数学平均下降12.8个百分点，英语语言艺术（ELA）平均下降6.8个百分点。聚焦于州内和通勤区内的教学模式差异，我们估计，完全线下教学的学区的下降幅度显著更小（数学下降13.4个百分点，ELA下降8.3个百分点）。对于黑人学生比例较大的学区，线下教学的价值更大。（JEL H75, I12, I18, I21, I28, J15）

records.title_en: Status Quo Property Protection in Politico-Legal Systems
records.title_cn: 政治法律体系中的现状财产保护
records.abstract_en: This paper models status quo (SQ) protection of property rights. A politico-legal system determines eligibility of citizen groups for protection. A ruling authority can reallocate property if and only if reallocation is preferable to the status quo for one such group. Along the solution path, SQ protections distort allocations across different assets and different property owners. Asset distortions vanish in the limit as the path converges to a stationary assignment. Ownership distortions vanish in the limit if no individuals belong to every eligible group. If the authority is self-interested, systemic protection of vulnerable groups may be welfare improving. (JEL D72, H13, K11, P14)
records.abstract_cn: 本文对财产权的现状（SQ）保护进行建模。政治法律体系决定公民群体获得保护的资格。当且仅当重新分配对某一此类群体而言优于现状时，统治当局才能重新分配财产。沿着解路径，SQ保护会扭曲不同资产和不同财产所有者之间的配置。当路径收敛至平稳分配时，资产扭曲在极限中消失。如果没有任何个体属于所有合格群体，则所有权扭曲在极限中消失。如果当局是自利的，对弱势群体的系统性保护可能改善福利。（JEL D72, H13, K11, P14）

records.title_en: Technical Change and Superstar Effects: Evidence from the Rollout of Television
records.title_cn: 技术变革与超级明星效应：来自电视推广的证据
records.abstract_en: Technical change that extends market scale can generate winner-take-all dynamics, with large income growth among top earners. I test this “superstar model” in the entertainer labor market, where the historic rollout of television creates a natural experiment in scale-related technological change. The resulting inequality changes are consistent with superstar theory: the launch of a local TV station skews the entertainer wage distribution sharply to the right, with the biggest impact at the very top of the distribution, while negatively impacting workers below the star level. The findings provide evidence of superstar effects and distinguish such effects from popular alternative models. (JEL D31, J31, J44, L82, L88, O33)
records.abstract_cn: 扩大市场规模的技术变革可以产生赢家通吃的动态，顶尖收入者的收入大幅增长。我在演艺人员劳动力市场中检验了这一“超级明星模型”，其中电视的历史推广创造了与规模相关的技术变革的自然实验。由此产生的收入不平等变化与超级明星理论一致：地方电视台的开播使演艺人员的工资分布急剧右偏，对分布最顶端的影响最大，同时对明星水平以下的工人产生负面影响。这些发现提供了超级明星效应的证据，并将此类效应与流行的替代模型区分开来。(JEL D31, J31, J44, L82, L88, O33)

records.title_en: National and Global Impacts of Genetically Modified Crops
records.title_cn: 转基因作物的国家与全球影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of genetically modified (GM) crops on countrywide yields, harvested area, and trade using a triple-differences rollout design that exploits variation in the availability of GM seeds across crops, countries, and time. We find positive impacts on yields, especially in poor countries. Our estimates imply that without GM crops, the world would have needed 3.4 percent additional cropland to keep global agricultural output at its 2019 level. We also find that bans on GM cultivation have limited the global gain from GM adoption to one-third of its potential. Poor countries would benefit most from lifting such bans. (JEL O13, Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用三重差分推广设计，通过作物、国家和时间上转基因种子可用性的变化，估计了转基因作物对国家产量、收获面积和贸易的影响。我们发现转基因作物对产量有积极影响，尤其是在贫穷国家。我们的估计表明，如果没有转基因作物，世界将需要额外3.4%的耕地来维持2019年的全球农业产出水平。我们还发现，转基因种植禁令将全球从转基因采用中获得的收益限制在了其潜力的三分之一。贫穷国家将从解除此类禁令中获益最多。（JEL O13, Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18）

records.title_en: A Note on Temporary Supply Shocks with Aggregate Demand Inertia
records.title_cn: 关于具有总需求惯性的暂时性供给冲击的注记
records.abstract_en: We study optimal monetary policy during temporary supply contractions when aggregate demand has inertia and the central bank is concerned about future constraints on expansionary policy. In this environment, it is optimal to run the economy hot until supply recovers. However, the policy does not remain loose throughout the low-supply phase. Overall, when the initial aggregate demand is low, the goal is to frontload the rate cuts to raise demand in anticipation of the recovery of supply. If inflation also has inertia, the central bank still overheats the economy during the low-supply phase but gradually cools it down over time. (JEL E12, E21, E23, E31, E43, E52)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在总需求具有惯性且中央银行担忧未来扩张性政策受限的情况下，暂时性供给收缩期间的最优货币政策。在这种环境下，最优政策是让经济过热运行直至供给恢复。然而，政策在整个低供给阶段并非始终保持宽松。总体而言，当初始总需求较低时，目标是提前降息以提高需求，为供给恢复做准备。如果通胀也具有惯性，中央银行在低供给阶段仍会使经济过热，但会随时间逐渐降温。（JEL E12, E21, E23, E31, E43, E52）

records.title_en: Should We Tax Capital Income or Wealth?
records.title_cn: 我们应该对资本收入还是财富征税？
records.abstract_en: We study optimal capital income and wealth taxation in an economy that reproduces the importance of private businesses for output and inequality. If entrepreneurs are subject to collateral constraints, they face heterogeneous rates of return, which generate a meaningful distinction between capital income and wealth taxation. We find that taxing capital income is preferable to taxing wealth because the efficiency gains from wealth taxation are swamped by the redistributional benefits of taxing the profits of richer entrepreneurs. Consequently, the gains from taxing wealth are modest. This conclusion is robust to the planner’s preference for redistribution and allowing for nonlinear taxes. (JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, K34, L26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个再现私人企业对产出和不平等重要性的经济中的最优资本收入和财富税。如果企业家面临抵押品约束，他们面临不同的回报率，这产生了资本收入税和财富税之间的有意义区别。我们发现，对资本收入征税优于对财富征税，因为财富税的效率收益被对更富有的企业家的利润征税的再分配收益所淹没。因此，财富税的收益是适度的。这一结论对规划者的再分配偏好和允许非线性税收是稳健的。（JEL D31, H21, H23, H24, H25, K34, L26）

records.title_en: Influence Motives in Social Signaling: Evidence from COVID-19 Vaccinations in Germany
records.title_cn: 社会信号中的影响动机：来自德国COVID-19疫苗接种的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether a desire to influence others’ choices affects our own behavior. To separate such influence motives from social pressure, we study participants’ willingness to register for a COVID-19 vaccination in a field experiment in Germany. We vary whether participants’ registration decisions are shared with a peer, to activate social pressure, and whether peers are informed before their own decision, to isolate influence motives. We find that influence motives double participants’ registration likelihood, an effect driven by individuals with ex ante trust in the vaccine. Despite anticipating to influence their peers, participants cannot alter peer behavior in the experiment. (JEL C93, D12, D82, D91, I12, I18)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究影响他人选择的愿望是否会影响我们自己的行为。为了将这种影响动机与社会压力区分开来，我们在德国的一项实地实验中研究了参与者注册COVID-19疫苗接种的意愿。我们变化参与者的注册决定是否与同伴分享，以激活社会压力，以及同伴是否在参与者自己决定之前被告知，以隔离影响动机。我们发现影响动机使参与者的注册可能性翻倍，这一效应由事前信任疫苗的个体驱动。尽管参与者预期会影响同伴，但在实验中他们无法改变同伴的行为。(JEL C93, D12, D82, D91, I12, I18)

records.title_en: Presidential Address: Does Monetary Policy Matter? The Narrative Approach after 35 Years
records.title_cn: 主席演讲：货币政策重要吗？35年后的叙事方法
records.abstract_en: The narrative approach to macroeconomic identification uses qualitative sources, such as newspapers or government records, to provide information that can help establish causal relationships. This paper discusses the requirements for rigorous narrative analysis using fresh research on the impact of monetary policy as the focal application. We read the historical Minutes and Transcripts of Federal Reserve policymaking meetings to identify significant contractionary and expansionary changes in monetary policy not taken in response to current or prospective developments in real activity for the period 1946 to 2016. We find that such monetary shocks have large and significant effects on unemployment, output, and inflation in the expected directions. Analysis of available policy records suggests that a contractionary monetary shock likely occurred in 2022. Based on the empirical estimates of the effect of previous shocks, one would expect substantial negative impacts on real GDP and inflation in 2023 and 2024.
records.abstract_cn: 宏观经济识别的叙事方法利用定性来源，如报纸或政府记录，提供有助于建立因果关系的信息。本文以货币政策影响的新研究为焦点应用，讨论了严谨叙事分析的要求。我们阅读了美联储政策制定会议的历史会议纪要和记录，以识别1946年至2016年期间并非针对当前或预期实际活动变化而采取的重大紧缩性和扩张性货币政策变化。我们发现，此类货币冲击对失业、产出和通胀产生了符合预期方向的大幅且显著的影响。对现有政策记录的分析表明，2022年可能发生了紧缩性货币冲击。基于先前冲击影响的实证估计，预计2023年和2024年实际GDP和通胀将受到显著的负面影响。

records.title_en: The Birth of a Nation : Media and Racial Hate
records.title_cn: 一个国家的诞生：媒体与种族仇恨
records.abstract_en: This paper documents the impact of popular media on racial hate by examining the first American blockbuster: 1915's The Birth of a Nation , a fictional portrayal of the KKK's founding rife with racist stereotypes. Exploiting the film's five-year "road show," I find a sharp spike in lynchings and race riots coinciding with its arrival in a county. Instrumenting for road show destinations using the location of theaters prior to the movie's release, I show that the film significantly increased local Klan support in the 1920s. Road show counties continue to experience higher rates of hate crimes and hate groups a century later.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过考察美国第一部大片——1915年的《一个国家的诞生》，记录了大众媒体对种族仇恨的影响。这部电影虚构了三K党成立的故事，充满了种族主义刻板印象。利用该片为期五年的“巡回放映”，我发现私刑和种族骚乱在其到达一个县时急剧增加。使用电影上映前剧院的位置作为巡回放映目的地的工具变量，我表明该片在1920年代显著增加了当地三K党的支持。一个世纪后，巡回放映的县仍然经历着更高的仇恨犯罪和仇恨团体发生率。

records.title_en: Reconciliation Narratives: The Birth of a Nation after the US Civil War
records.title_cn: 和解叙事：美国内战后《一个国家的诞生》
records.abstract_en: We study how the spread of the Lost Cause narrative—a revisionist and racist retelling of the US Civil War—shifted opinions and behaviors toward national reunification and racial discrimination against African Americans. Looking at screenings of The Birth of a Nation , a blockbuster movie that greatly popularized the Lost Cause after 1915, we find that the film shifted the public discourse toward a more patriotic and less divisive language, increased military enlistment, and fostered cultural convergence between former enemies. We document how the racist content of the narrative connects to reconciliation through a "common-enemy" type of argument.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了“失落的事业”叙事——一种对美国内战的修正主义和种族主义重述——的传播如何改变了对国家统一和针对非裔美国人的种族歧视的意见和行为。通过考察《一个国家的诞生》的放映情况，这部在1915年后极大推广了“失落的事业”的卖座电影，我们发现这部电影将公共话语转向了更加爱国和较少分裂的语言，增加了军事入伍，并促进了前敌人之间的文化融合。我们记录了叙事中的种族主义内容如何通过一种“共同敌人”类型的论证与和解联系起来。

records.title_en: Optimal Procurement with Quality Concerns
records.title_cn: 考虑质量关切的最优采购
records.abstract_en: Adverse selection in procurement arises when low-cost bidders are also low-quality suppliers. We propose a mechanism called LoLA (lowball lottery auction) which, under some conditions, maximizes any combination of buyer's and social surplus, subject to incentive compatibility, in the presence of adverse selection. The LoLA features a floor price, and a reserve price. The LoLA has a dominant strategy equilibrium that, under mild conditions, is unique. In a counterfactual analysis of Italian government auctions, we compute the gain that the government could have made, had it used the optimal procurement mechanism (a LoLA), relative to a first-price auction (the adopted format).
records.abstract_cn: 当低成本投标者同时也是低质量供应商时，采购中便会出现逆向选择。我们提出了一种名为LoLA（低价彩票拍卖）的机制，在存在逆向选择的情况下，该机制在满足激励相容约束的条件下，最大化买方剩余与社会剩余的任何组合。LoLA具有一个底价和一个保留价。LoLA存在一个占优策略均衡，在温和条件下该均衡是唯一的。在对意大利政府采购的反事实分析中，我们计算了相对于第一价格拍卖（所采用的格式），政府若采用最优采购机制（即LoLA）本可获得的收益。

records.title_en: Optimal Contracting with Altruistic Agents: Medicare Payments for Dialysis Drugs
records.title_cn: 利他主义代理人的最优契约：透析药物的医疗保险支付
records.abstract_en: We study health-care provider agency and optimal payments, considering an expensive medication for dialysis patients. Using Medicare claims data we estimate a structural model of treatment decisions, in which providers differ in their altruism and marginal costs, and this heterogeneity is unobservable to the government. In a novel application of nonlinear pricing methods, we empirically characterize the optimal contracts in this environment. The optimal contracts eliminate medically excessive dosages and reduce expenditures, resulting in approximately $300 million in annual gains from better contracting. This approach could be applied to a broad class of problems in healthcare payment policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究医疗服务提供者的代理问题和最优支付，考虑一种用于透析患者的昂贵药物。利用医疗保险索赔数据，我们估计了一个治疗决策的结构模型，其中提供者在利他主义和边际成本方面存在差异，且这种异质性对政府是不可观测的。在非线性定价方法的新应用中，我们实证刻画了该环境下的最优契约。最优契约消除了医学上过量的剂量并减少了支出，通过更好的契约每年可带来约300亿美元的收益。该方法可应用于医疗支付政策中的一大类问题。

records.title_en: The Common-Probability Auction Puzzle
records.title_cn: 共同概率拍卖之谜
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a puzzle in the behavior of experimental subjects in what we call common-probability auctions. In common-value auctions, uncertainty is defined over values, while in common-probability auctions, uncertainty is defined over probabilities. We find that in contrast to the substantial overbidding found in common-value auctions, bidding in strategically equivalent common-probability auctions is consistent with Nash equilibrium. To explain our results, we run treatments to identify whether this difference stems from the way subjects estimate the good's value in a competitive environment rather than the way they bid conditional on these valuations. We conclude it is the former.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个关于实验对象在我们所称的共同概率拍卖中行为的谜题。在共同价值拍卖中，不确定性定义在价值上，而在共同概率拍卖中，不确定性定义在概率上。我们发现，与共同价值拍卖中发现的显著过度出价相反，在策略等价的共同概率拍卖中，出价与纳什均衡一致。为了解释我们的结果，我们进行了处理实验，以确定这种差异是否源于受试者在竞争环境中估计商品价值的方式，而非他们根据这些估值出价的方式。我们得出结论是前者。

records.title_en: When Losses Turn into Loans: The Cost of Weak Banks
records.title_cn: 当损失变成贷款：弱银行的成本
records.abstract_en: We provide evidence that banks distort the composition of credit supply in order to comply with ratio-based capital requirements in times of economic distress. An unexpected intervention by the European Banking Authority provides a natural experiment to study how banks respond to falling below minimum required capital ratios during an economic downturn. We show that affected banks respond by cutting lending but also by reallocating credit to distressed firms with underreported loan losses. We develop a method to detect underreported losses using loan-level data. The credit reallocation leads to a reallocation of inputs across firms. We calculate that the resulting increase in input misallocation accounts for about 22 percent of the decline in productivity in Portugal in 2012.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供的证据表明，银行在经济困境时期为了满足基于比率的资本要求而扭曲信贷供给的构成。欧洲银行管理局的一次意外干预提供了一个自然实验，用以研究银行在经济衰退期间资本比率低于最低要求时的反应。我们表明，受影响的银行通过削减贷款来应对，但也将信贷重新分配给那些贷款损失被低估的困境企业。我们开发了一种利用贷款级数据检测低估损失的方法。信贷的重新分配导致了企业间投入的重新分配。我们计算出，由此导致的投入错配增加约占葡萄牙2012年生产率下降的22%。

records.title_en: Occupational Exposure to Capital-Embodied Technical Change
records.title_cn: 职业对资本体现型技术变革的暴露
records.abstract_en: We study differences in exposure to factor-biased technical change among occupations by providing the first measures of capital-embodied technical change (CETC) and of the elasticity of substitution between capital and labor at the occupational level. We document sizable occupational heterogeneity in both measures, but quantitatively, it is the heterogeneity in factor substitutability that fuels workers' exposure to CETC. In a general equilibrium model of worker sorting across occupations, CETC accounts for almost all of the observed labor reallocation in the US between 1984 and 2015. Absent occupational heterogeneity in factor substitutability, CETC accounts for only 17 percent of it.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过提供首个职业层面的资本体现型技术变革（CETC）以及资本与劳动替代弹性的度量，研究了不同职业对要素偏向型技术变革暴露的差异。我们记录了这两种度量在职业间存在显著的异质性，但从数量上看，正是要素替代性的异质性加剧了工人对CETC的暴露。在一个工人跨职业选择的一般均衡模型中，CETC解释了美国在1984年至2015年间观察到的几乎所有劳动力重新配置。若不存在职业间要素替代性的异质性，CETC仅能解释其中的17%。

records.title_en: Dollar and Exports
records.title_cn: 美元与出口
records.abstract_en: The strength of the U.S. dollar has attributes of a barometer of dollar credit conditions, with a stronger dollar associated with tighter dollar credit conditions. We find that following dollar appreciation, exporters that are more reliant on dollar-funded bank credit suffer a greater decline in credit and slowdown in exports, including those exporting to the United States. Our findings shed light on the role of the U.S. dollar in the interaction between financial globalization and international trade and show a novel channel of exchange rate transmission that goes in the opposite direction to the competitiveness channel. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 美元走强具有美元信贷条件晴雨表的属性，美元走强与美元信贷条件收紧相关。我们发现，在美元升值后，更依赖美元融资银行信贷的出口商信贷下降幅度更大，出口放缓，包括对美国的出口。我们的研究揭示了美元在金融全球化与国际贸易相互作用中的作用，并展示了一个与竞争力渠道方向相反的汇率传导新渠道。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Factor Momentum
records.title_cn: 因子动量
records.abstract_en: Factors display strong cross-sectional momentum that subsumes momentum in industries and other portfolio characteristics. The profits of all these momentum strategies—based on factors, industries, and other characteristics—significantly correlate with each other and therefore likely emanate from the same source. If factors display momentum, so will any set of portfolios with cross-sectional variation in factor loadings. Consistent with factors being at the root of momentum, we find that momentum in industry-neutral factors explains industry momentum, but industry momentum explains none of the factor momentum. Cross-sectional factor momentum concentrates in the first few highest-eigenvalue factors and is distinct from time-series factor momentum. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 因子表现出强烈的横截面动量，这种动量涵盖了行业和其他投资组合特征的动量。所有这些动量策略——基于因子、行业和其他特征——的利润彼此显著相关，因此可能源于同一来源。如果因子表现出动量，那么任何在因子载荷上具有横截面变化的投资组合集合也会表现出动量。与因子处于动量根源相一致的是，我们发现行业中性因子的动量解释了行业动量，但行业动量并不能解释因子动量。横截面因子动量集中在少数几个最高特征值的因子上，并且与时间序列因子动量不同。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Do Corporate Disclosures Constrain Strategic Analyst Behavior?
records.title_cn: 公司披露是否约束了分析师的策略性行为？
records.abstract_en: We show that analyst behavior changes in response to a randomly assigned shock that exogenously varies the timeliness and cost of accessing mandatory disclosures in the cross-section of investors: analysts reduce coverage and issue less optimistic, more accurate, less bold, and less informative forecasts. Our evidence indicates that analysts reduce a strategic component of their behavior: the changes are stronger among analysts with more strategic incentives like affiliated or retail-focused analysts. We conclude that mandatory disclosure can substitute for analyst information production, which is constrained by investors’ ability to verify forecasts using corporate filings. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，分析师行为会随着一个随机分配的冲击而变化，该冲击外生地改变了投资者群体中获取强制性披露的及时性和成本：分析师减少了覆盖范围，并发布了更不乐观、更准确、更不大胆且信息量更少的预测。我们的证据表明，分析师减少了其行为中的策略性成分：在具有更多策略性激励的分析师（如关联分析师或专注于散户的分析师）中，变化更为显著。我们得出结论，强制性披露可以替代分析师的信息生产，而分析师的信息生产受到投资者利用公司文件验证预测能力的约束。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Neglected Peers in Merger Valuations
records.title_cn: 并购估值中被忽视的同业公司
records.abstract_en: Using novel merger valuation data, we show that firms selected by investment banks as “comparable peers” are more than twice as likely to later become takeover targets themselves compared to matched control firms. Peer firms not subsequently acquired attract more institutional ownership and analyst coverage, deliver strong operating performance, reduce investments, and increase payouts. Investors are inattentive, though, to peer identification at the time of merger filings’ public disclosure. A portfolio that longs peers and shorts controls earns up to 15.6$\%$ alpha annually, which mainly comes from the long leg and is difficult to explain by short-sale constraints. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 利用新颖的并购估值数据，我们表明，被投资银行选为“可比同业”的公司，与匹配的对照组公司相比，后来自身成为收购目标的可能性是其两倍以上。未被随后收购的同业公司吸引了更多的机构持股和分析师覆盖，表现出强劲的经营业绩，减少了投资，并增加了派息。然而，投资者在并购文件公开披露时对同业识别并不关注。一个做多同业、做空对照组的投资组合每年可获得高达15.6的阿尔法收益，这主要来自多头部分，且难以用卖空限制来解释。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Regulatory Intensity and Firm-Specific Exposure
records.title_cn: 监管强度与企业特定暴露
records.abstract_en: Building on administrative data and machine-learning models, I develop a firm-specific measure of regulatory intensity: cost of compliance with all federal paperwork regulations. Regulatory intensity increases the cost of goods sold and overhead spending (SGA). It also incentivizes companies to reduce capital investment, hire fewer employees, and lobby more. The effects are particularly strong among financially constrained firms and those with irreversible investment opportunities, suggesting that regulation affects companies through budgetary pressures and heightened uncertainty. The findings highlight the real effects of regulation and the underlying mechanisms. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 基于行政数据和机器学习模型，我构建了一个企业特定的监管强度衡量指标：遵守所有联邦文书工作法规的成本。监管强度增加了销售成本和管理费用（SGA）。它还激励公司减少资本投资、雇佣更少的员工，并进行更多游说。这些效应在财务受限的公司和那些具有不可逆投资机会的公司中尤为显著，表明监管通过预算压力和不确定性增加影响企业。研究结果凸显了监管的实际效应及其潜在机制。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁获取。

records.title_en: How Has COVID-19 Impacted Research Production in Economics and Finance?
records.title_cn: COVID-19如何影响经济学和金融学的研究产出？
records.abstract_en: Following the onset of COVID-19, research production in economics and finance (measured by the posting of working papers) increased by 29$\%$. Production increases were widespread across geographies, job titles, departments, and ages with larger increases in top departments and for people under the age of 35. Men and women both experienced production increases with the exception of women between the age of 35 and 49, who experienced no production gains despite large increases for men in the same age group. COVID-19 increased reliance on past coauthorship networks, with larger production gains for authors that are more central to the network. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19爆发后，经济学和金融学的研究产出（以工作论文的发布量衡量）增加了29。产出的增加在地理区域、职位、部门和年龄上广泛分布，其中顶级部门和35岁以下人群的增幅更大。男性和女性都经历了产出增加，但35岁至49岁之间的女性除外，她们没有产出增长，而同年齡段的男性则有大幅增长。COVID-19增加了对过去合作者网络的依赖，网络中心性更高的作者获得了更大的产出增长。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁获取。

records.title_en: How Large Are Bequest Motives? Estimates Based on Health Shocks
records.title_cn: 遗赠动机有多大？基于健康冲击的估计
records.abstract_en: I analyze the inter vivo transfers and bequest decisions of 700,000 individuals during a period when the decision maker receives negative news regarding their life expectancy. The event that initiates the news is a health outcome. Expected mortality increases both the likelihood of transferring wealth to the next generation and the amount transferred. The size of the inter vivo transfer and bequest are positively related to the wealth of the parent and the severity of the diagnosis, regardless of diagnosis-specific demand for informal care. Using a structural life cycle model, I estimate the bequest parameters that are consistent with the causal effect estimates. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了在决策者收到关于其预期寿命的负面消息期间，700,000个个体的生前转移和遗赠决策。引发该消息的事件是健康结果。预期死亡率的增加既提高了向下一代转移财富的可能性，也增加了转移的金额。生前转移和遗赠的规模与父母的财富和诊断的严重程度正相关，而与诊断特定的非正式护理需求无关。使用结构生命周期模型，我估计了与因果效应估计一致的遗赠参数。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Patient-Physician Race Concordance, Physician Decisions, and Patient Outcomes
records.title_cn: 患者与医生种族一致性、医生决策与患者结局
records.abstract_en: Using administrative data from a large and diverse emergency department (ED), we examine the impact of race concordance between patients and physicians on physician decision-making and patient health outcomes. We find that patient-physician race concordance increases consultation time and decreases the probability of inpatient admission and diagnostic testing. Subsequently, race-concordant patients have lower revisit rates after ED discharge. The effect of race concordance is largely driven by patients who had less serious illnesses and whose diseases had nonspecific symptoms or less clear causes. The results are best explained by the informational and communication mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 利用来自一个大型多样化急诊科（ED）的行政数据，我们考察了患者与医生之间的种族一致性对医生决策和患者健康结局的影响。我们发现，患者与医生种族一致性增加了会诊时间，并降低了住院收治和诊断性检查的概率。随后，种族一致的患者在急诊出院后的复诊率较低。种族一致性的效应主要由病情较轻、症状非特异性或病因不明确的患者驱动。结果最好由信息和沟通机制来解释。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Saving for Multiple Financial Needs: Evidence from Lockboxes and Mobile Money in Malawi
records.title_cn: 为多种财务需求储蓄：来自马拉维锁箱和移动货币的证据
records.abstract_en: We test whether the provision of multiple labeled savings accounts affects savings and downstream outcomes in an experiment with 761 microentrepreneurs in urban Malawi. Treatment respondents received one or multiple savings accounts, in the form of lockboxes or mobile money. We find that while providing additional boxes increased savings by 40%, technical issues marred the efficacy of a second mobile money account. Data from novel high-frequency surveys suggest that both types of accounts had impacts on downstream outcomes, including farming decisions and credit extended to customers. We do not detect differential downstream effects by the number or modality of accounts.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在马拉维城市地区对761名微型企业家进行了一项实验，检验提供多个标签储蓄账户是否会影响储蓄和下游结果。治疗组受访者获得一个或多个储蓄账户，形式为锁箱或移动货币。我们发现，虽然提供额外的锁箱使储蓄增加了40%，但技术问题影响了第二个移动货币账户的有效性。来自新颖的高频调查数据表明，两种类型的账户都对下游结果产生了影响，包括农业决策和向客户提供的信贷。我们没有检测到账户数量或方式对下游结果的差异化影响。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Advancing the Agency of Adolescent Girls
records.title_cn: 提升青春期女孩的自主权
records.abstract_en: More than 98 million adolescent girls are not in school. Can girls influence their schooling without changes in their family's economic environment? In Rajasthan, India, we examine the impact of a school-based life skills program that seeks to address low aspirations, narrow societal roles for girls and women, restricted networks of social support, and limited decision-making power. We find the intervention causes a 25% decline in school dropout that persists from seventh grade through the transition to high school. Improvements in socioemotional support among girls exposed to the intervention seem especially important in their decision to stay in school.
records.abstract_cn: 超过98万名青春期女孩失学。在家庭经济环境不变的情况下，女孩能否影响自身的 schooling？在印度拉贾斯坦邦，我们考察了一项基于学校的 life skills 项目的影响，该项目旨在解决低志向、对女孩和妇女狭窄的社会角色、有限的社会支持网络以及有限的决策权问题。我们发现该干预措施使辍学率下降25%，这一效果从七年级持续到向高中过渡。在干预中，女孩们获得的社会情感支持的改善似乎对其继续上学的决定尤为重要。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: The Effects of Career and Technical Education: Evidence from the Connecticut Technical High School System
records.title_cn: 职业与技术教育的影响：来自康涅狄格州技术高中系统的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the effect of attending stand-alone technical high schools in Connecticut using regression discontinuity. Male students are 10 percentage points more likely to graduate from high school and have half a semester less time enrolled in college. Male students have 32% higher average quarterly earnings. Earnings effects may in part reflect general skills: male students have higher attendance rates and test scores, industry fixed effects explain less than one-third of earnings gains, and large earnings gains persist past traditional college going years. Attending a technical high school does not affect the outcomes of female students.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用断点回归考察了就读康涅狄格州独立技术高中的影响。男学生高中毕业的可能性高出10个百分点，并且在大学就读的时间少半个学期。男学生的平均季度收入高出32%。收入效应可能部分反映了通用技能：男学生的出勤率和考试成绩更高，行业固定效应解释了不到三分之一的收入增长，且较大的收入增长在传统大学就读年龄之后持续存在。就读技术高中对女学生的结果没有影响。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Relaxed Optimization: How Close Is a Consumer to Satisfying First-Order Conditions?
records.title_cn: 松弛优化：消费者满足一阶条件的程度有多接近？
records.abstract_en: We propose relaxing the first-order conditions in optimization to approximate rational consumer choice. We assess the magnitude of departures with a new, axiomatically founded measure that admits multiple interpretations. Standard inequality tests of rationality for any given reference class of preferences can be conveniently repurposed to measure goodness-of-fit with that class. Another advantage of our approach is that it is applicable in any context where the first-order approach is meaningful (e.g., convex budget sets arising from progressive taxation). We apply these ideas to shed new light on existing portfolio-choice data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出在优化中松弛一阶条件，以近似理性消费者选择。我们通过一个新的、基于公理化的度量来评估偏离的程度，该度量允许多种解释。对于任何给定的偏好参考类别，标准的理性不等式检验可以方便地重新用于衡量与该类别的拟合优度。我们方法的另一个优势是，它适用于任何一阶方法有意义的背景（例如，由累进税制产生的凸预算集）。我们将这些想法应用于现有投资组合选择数据，以提供新的见解。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Measuring Commuting and Economic Activity inside Cities with Cell Phone Records
records.title_cn: 利用手机记录测量城市内部的通勤与经济活动
records.abstract_en: We show how to use commuting flows to infer the spatial distribution of income within a city. A simple workplace choice model predicts a gravity equation for commuting flows whose destination fixed effects correspond to wages. We implement this method with cell phone transaction data from Dhaka and Colombo. Model-predicted income predicts separate income data, at the workplace and residential level, and by skill group. Unlike machine learning approaches, our method does not require training data, yet it achieves comparable predictive power. We show that hartals (transportation strikes) in Dhaka reduce commuting more for high model-predicted wage and high skill commuters.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了如何利用通勤流来推断城市内部收入的空间分布。一个简单的工作地点选择模型预测了通勤流的引力方程，其目的地固定效应对应于工资。我们使用达卡和科伦坡的手机交易数据实施这一方法。模型预测的收入能够预测独立的收入数据，无论是在工作地点层面还是居住层面，以及按技能分组。与机器学习方法不同，我们的方法不需要训练数据，但达到了可比的预测能力。我们表明，达卡的交通罢工（hartals）对模型预测工资高和技能高的通勤者的通勤减少影响更大。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: The Four-Equation New Keynesian Model
records.title_cn: 四方程新凯恩斯模型
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a New Keynesian model featuring financial intermediation, short- and long-term bonds, credit shocks, and scope for unconventional monetary policy. The log-linearized model reduces to four equations: Phillips and IS curves, as well as policy rules for the short-term interest rate and the central bank's long-bond portfolio (QE). Credit shocks and QE appear in both the IS and Phillips curves. In equilibrium, optimal monetary policy entails adjusting the short-term interest rate to offset natural rate shocks but using QE to offset credit market disruptions. Use of QE significantly mitigates the costs of a binding zero lower bound.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个包含金融中介、短期和长期债券、信贷冲击以及非常规货币政策空间的新凯恩斯模型。对数线性化后的模型简化为四个方程：菲利普斯曲线和IS曲线，以及短期利率和央行长期债券组合（量化宽松）的政策规则。信贷冲击和量化宽松同时出现在IS曲线和菲利普斯曲线中。在均衡状态下，最优货币政策需要调整短期利率以抵消自然利率冲击，但使用量化宽松来抵消信贷市场紊乱。使用量化宽松显著减轻了零利率下限约束的成本。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Household Inflation Expectations and Consumer Spending: Evidence from Panel Data
records.title_cn: 家庭通胀预期与消费支出：来自面板数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Recent research offers mixed results concerning the relationship between inflation expectations and consumption, using qualitative measures of readiness to spend. We revisit this question using survey panel data of actual spending from the United States between 2009 and 2012 that also allows us to control for household heterogeneity. We find that durables spending increases with expected inflation only for selected types of households while nondurables spending does not respond to expected inflation. Moreover, spending decreases with expected unemployment. These results imply a limited stimulating effect of inflation expectations on aggregate consumption, which could be reversed if inflation and unemployment expectations move together.
records.abstract_cn: 近期研究使用定性衡量支出意愿的方法，对通胀预期与消费之间的关系得出了混合结果。我们利用美国2009年至2012年间实际支出的调查面板数据重新审视这一问题，该数据还使我们能够控制家庭异质性。我们发现，仅对特定类型的家庭而言，耐用品支出随预期通胀上升而增加，而非耐用品支出对预期通胀没有反应。此外，支出随预期失业率上升而减少。这些结果表明，通胀预期对总消费的刺激作用有限，如果通胀和失业预期同时变动，这种作用可能会逆转。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Structural Change and Internal Labor Migration: Evidence from the Great Depression
records.title_cn: 结构变迁与国内劳动力迁移：来自大萧条的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyze sectoral labor reallocation and the reversal of urbanization in the United States during the Great Depression. The widespread movement to farms, which serves as a form of migratory insurance during the crisis, is largely toward farms with low levels of mechanization. In contrast, the mechanized agricultural sector sheds workers, many of whom reallocate into low-productivity or subsistence farming. The crisis perverts the normal process of structural change in which workers displaced by farm equipment are released into more productive occupations, suggesting that macroeconomic fluctuations are an important factor determining the labor market consequences of technological change.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国大萧条期间部门间劳动力重新配置和城市化的逆转。危机期间，广泛向农场迁移的现象作为一种迁徙保险形式，主要流向机械化程度较低的农场。相比之下，机械化农业部门减少了工人，其中许多人重新配置到低生产率或自给自足的农业。危机扭曲了结构变迁的正常过程，在这一过程中，被农业设备取代的工人被释放到更具生产力的职业中，这表明宏观经济波动是决定技术变革劳动力市场后果的重要因素。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Omitted Variable Bias of Lasso-Based Inference Methods: A Finite Sample Analysis
records.title_cn: 基于Lasso的推断方法的遗漏变量偏误：有限样本分析
records.abstract_en: We study the finite sample behavior of Lasso-based inference methods such as post–double Lasso and debiased Lasso. We show that these methods can exhibit substantial omitted variable biases (OVBs) due to Lasso's not selecting relevant controls. This phenomenon can occur even when the coefficients are sparse and the sample size is large and larger than the number of controls. Therefore, relying on the existing asymptotic inference theory can be problematic in empirical applications. We compare the Lasso-based inference methods to modern high-dimensional OLS-based methods and provide practical guidance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了基于Lasso的推断方法（如双重Lasso和去偏Lasso）的有限样本行为。我们表明，由于Lasso未能选择相关的控制变量，这些方法可能表现出显著的遗漏变量偏误（OVBs）。即使系数稀疏且样本量大于控制变量数量，这种现象也可能发生。因此，在实证应用中依赖现有的渐近推断理论可能存在问题。我们将基于Lasso的推断方法与现代高维OLS方法进行比较，并提供实用指导。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Discrimination, Narratives, and Family History: An Experiment with Jordanian Host and Syrian Refugee Children
records.title_cn: 歧视、叙事与家族历史：约旦宿主儿童与叙利亚难民儿童的实验研究
records.abstract_en: We measure the prevalence of discrimination between Jordanian host and Syrian refugee children attending school in Jordan. Using a simple sharing experiment, we find only a small degree of out-group discrimination. However, Jordanian children with Palestinian roots do not discriminate at all, suggesting that a family history of refugee status can generate solidarity with new refugees. We also find that parents’ narratives about the refugee crisis are correlated with their children's degree of out-group discrimination, particularly among Syrian refugee children, suggesting that discriminatory preferences are being transmitted through parental attitudes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们衡量了在约旦上学的约旦宿主儿童与叙利亚难民儿童之间歧视的普遍程度。通过一个简单的分享实验，我们发现只有小程度的群体外歧视。然而，有巴勒斯坦血统的约旦儿童完全不歧视，这表明难民身份的家族历史可以产生对新难民的团结。我们还发现，父母关于难民危机的叙事与子女的群体外歧视程度相关，尤其是在叙利亚难民儿童中，这表明歧视性偏好正通过父母的态度传递。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Do Stay-at-Home Orders Cause People to Stay at Home? Effects of Stay-at-Home Orders on Consumer Behavior
records.title_cn: 居家令是否真的让人们待在家里？居家令对消费者行为的影响
records.abstract_en: We link the county-level rollout of stay-at-home orders during the COVID-19 pandemic to anonymized cell phone records and consumer spending data. We document three patterns. First, stay-at-home orders caused people to stay home: county-level measures of mobility declined 6% to 7% within two days of when the stay-at-home order went into effect. Second, stay-at-home orders caused large reductions in spending in sectors associated with mobility: small businesses and large retail chains. Third, we estimate fairly uniform responses to stay-at-home orders across the country; effects do not vary by county-level income, political leanings, or urban/rural status.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将COVID-19大流行期间县级居家令的推出与匿名手机记录和消费者支出数据联系起来。我们记录了三种模式。首先，居家令导致人们待在家里：在居家令生效后的两天内，县级流动性指标下降了6%至7%。其次，居家令导致与流动性相关的行业支出大幅减少：小企业和大型零售连锁店。第三，我们估计全国范围内对居家令的反应相当一致；效应不因县级收入、政治倾向或城乡状况而异。

records.journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics
records.title_en: Crisis and the Trajectory of Science: Evidence from the 2014 Ebola Outbreak
records.title_cn: 危机与科学轨迹：来自2014年埃博拉疫情的证据
records.abstract_en: When crises such as disease outbreaks occur in low-income countries, the global response can influence the output of researchers in the most affected locations. This paper investigates the impact of the 2014 West African Ebola epidemic on publication outcomes of endemic country scientists. Driven by collaborations with high-income country scientists in Ebola publications, endemic country scientists with relevant experience increase their publication output. However, the productivity of scientists without relevant experience falls, driving a reduction in non-Ebola publications. Any benefits arising from increased visibility during the epidemic does not appear to spill over to non-Ebola or Africa-led research in the long run.
records.abstract_cn: 当低收入国家发生疾病爆发等危机时，全球应对措施可能影响受影响最严重地区研究者的产出。本文研究了2014年西非埃博拉疫情对地方病国家科学家发表成果的影响。通过与高收入国家科学家在埃博拉相关出版物上的合作，具有相关经验的地方病国家科学家增加了其发表产出。然而，没有相关经验的科学家的生产力下降，导致非埃博拉出版物的减少。疫情期间知名度提升带来的任何好处似乎并未长期溢出到非埃博拉或非洲主导的研究中。

records.title_en: The strategic determination of the supply of liquid assets
records.title_cn: 流动资产供给的战略性决定
records.abstract_en: We study asset liquidity in a model where financial assets can be liquidated for money in over-the-counter (OTC) secondary markets, in response to random liquidity needs. Traders choose to enter the market where they expect to find the best terms, understanding that their chances to trade depend on the entry decision of other investors. We find that small differences in OTC microstructure can induce very large differences in the relative liquidity of two assets. We use our model to rationalize, qualitatively and quantitatively, the superior liquidity of U.S. Treasuries over equally safe corporate debt.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个模型中的资产流动性，在该模型中，金融资产可以在场外交易（OTC）二级市场上变现为货币，以应对随机的流动性需求。交易者选择进入他们预期能找到最佳条件的市场，并理解他们的交易机会取决于其他投资者的进入决策。我们发现，OTC微观结构的微小差异可能导致两种资产相对流动性的巨大差异。我们使用我们的模型，定性和定量地解释了美国国债相对于同等安全公司债务的优越流动性。

records.title_en: Indeterminacy and imperfect information
records.title_cn: 不确定性与不完全信息
records.abstract_en: We study equilibrium determination in an environment where two types of agents have different information sets: Fully informed agents observe histories of all exogenous and endogenous variables. Less informed agents observe only a strict subset of the full information set and need to solve a dynamic signal extraction problem to gather information about the variables they do not directly observe. Both types of agents know the structure of the model and form expectations rationally. In this environment, we identify a new channel that generates equilibrium indeterminacy: Optimal information processing of the less informed agent introduces stable dynamics into the equation system that lead to self-fulling expectations. For parameter values that imply a unique equilibrium under full information, the limited information rational expectations equilibrium is indeterminate. We illustrate our framework with monetary policy models where an imperfectly informed central bank follows an interest rate rule.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个环境中均衡的决定，其中两类代理人拥有不同的信息集：完全知情的代理人观察所有外生和内生变量的历史。信息较少的代理人只观察完整信息集的一个严格子集，并且需要解决一个动态信号提取问题来收集关于他们未直接观察到的变量的信息。两类代理人都知道模型的结构并理性地形成预期。在这种环境中，我们确定了一个产生均衡不确定性的新渠道：信息较少的代理人的最优信息处理将稳定动态引入方程系统，导致自我实现的预期。对于在完全信息下意味着唯一均衡的参数值，有限信息理性预期均衡是不确定的。我们用货币政策模型来说明我们的框架，其中不完全知情的中央银行遵循利率规则。

records.title_en: Employer reallocation during the COVID-19 pandemic: Validation and application of a do-it-yourself CPS
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫情期间的雇主重新配置：DIY CPS的验证与应用
records.abstract_en: Economists have recently begun using independent online surveys to collect national labor market data. Questions remain over the quality of such data. This paper provides an approach to address these concerns. Our case study is the Real-Time Population Survey (RPS), a novel online survey of the US built around the Current Population Survey (CPS). The RPS replicates core components of the CPS, ensuring comparable measures that allow us to weight and rigorously validate our results using a high-quality benchmark. At the same time, special questions in the RPS yield novel information regarding employer reallocation during the COVID-19 pandemic. We estimate that 26% of pre-pandemic workers were working for a new employer one year into the COVID-19 outbreak in the US, at least double the rate of any previous episode in the past quarter century. Our discussion contains practical suggestions for the design of novel labor market surveys and highlights other promising applications of our methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家最近开始使用独立的在线调查来收集国家劳动力市场数据。关于此类数据质量的问题仍然存在。本文提供了一种解决这些担忧的方法。我们的案例研究是实时人口调查（RPS），这是一个围绕当前人口调查（CPS）构建的新型美国在线调查。RPS复制了CPS的核心组成部分，确保可比较的衡量指标，使我们能够使用高质量基准进行加权和严格验证。同时，RPS中的特殊问题提供了关于COVID-19疫情期间雇主重新配置的新信息。我们估计，在COVID-19疫情爆发一年后，疫情前工人中有26%正在为新雇主工作，至少是过去四分之一世纪中任何先前时期比率的两倍。我们的讨论包含了对新型劳动力市场调查设计的实用建议，并强调了我们的方法在其他有前景的应用。

records.title_en: The promises (and perils) of control-contingent forward guidance
records.title_cn: 控制条件前瞻指引的承诺（与风险）
records.abstract_en: We develop a model with control-contingent forward guidance: the central bank explicitly anchors future policy announcements to short run inflation. Even though the model features past promises, we compute a closed form solution using a simple Markov chain representation. This allows us to show analytically that control-contingent forward guidance can rid the model of sunspot liquidity traps. The same holds for a policy of price level targeting, which emerges as a special case. Finally, we leverage this new framework to formally show that announced interest rates are only a means to an end: what truly matters is expected inflation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含控制条件前瞻指引的模型：中央银行明确将未来的政策公告锚定于短期通胀。尽管模型包含过去的承诺，我们通过简单的马尔可夫链表示计算了闭式解。这使我们能够分析性地证明，控制条件前瞻指引可以消除模型中的太阳黑子流动性陷阱。价格水平目标政策同样如此，该政策作为特例出现。最后，我们利用这一新框架正式表明，公布的利率只是达到目的的手段：真正重要的是预期通胀。

records.title_en: Commitment versus flexibility and sticky prices: Evidence from life insurance
records.title_cn: 承诺与灵活性及价格粘性：来自人寿保险的证据
records.abstract_en: Life insurance premiums display significant rigidity in the data, on average adjusting once every 3 years by more than 10%. This contrasts with the underlying marginal cost which exhibits considerable volatility due to the movements in interest and mortality rates. We build a dynamic model where policyholders are held-up by long-term insurance contracts, resulting in a time inconsistency problem for the insurer. The optimal contract balances commitment and flexibility and takes the form of a simple cutoff rule: premiums are rigid for cost realizations smaller than the threshold, while adjustments must be large and are only possible when cost realizations exceed it. We use a calibrated version of the model to show that it matches the data and captures several aspects of premium rigidity in the cross-section and over time.
records.abstract_cn: 人寿保险保费在数据中表现出显著的粘性，平均每3年调整一次，调整幅度超过10%。这与潜在边际成本形成鲜明对比，后者因利率和死亡率的变动而表现出相当大的波动性。我们构建了一个动态模型，其中保单持有人被长期保险合同锁定，导致保险公司面临时间不一致问题。最优合同在承诺与灵活性之间取得平衡，并采取简单的阈值规则形式：当成本实现值低于阈值时，保费保持刚性；而当成本实现值超过阈值时，调整必须是大幅度的且仅在此情况下才可能发生。我们使用校准版本的模型来表明其与数据匹配，并捕捉了保费刚性在横截面和时间维度上的多个方面。

records.title_en: The welfare effects of tax progressivity in a frictional labor market
records.title_cn: 摩擦性劳动力市场中税收累进性的福利效应
records.abstract_en: A progressive tax schedule is usually justified in terms of redistribution and insurance. When the labor market is frictional and there is no intensive margin of labor supply, progressive taxation has been shown to reduce unemployment by lowering wages. However, a more progressive tax schedule discourages the individual's supply of labor and (precautionary) savings, thus potentially reducing capital accumulation and total production.I examine the different effects of a progressive tax and transfer schedule on unemployment, labor income, an individual's labor supply, and savings. My modeling strategy follows Setty and Yedid-Levi (2020), who build on the workhorse model of Krusell et al. (2010), to which I add individual labor supply. I allow for ex ante heterogeneity in productivity, as well as in preferences, while the only idiosyncratic risk is the endogenous risk of unemployment. I compare my baseline model with a frictional labor market to one with a Walrasian labor market where the unemployment risk is exogenous.Steady state comparisons, based on a utilitarian welfare criterion, show that a tax and transfer schedule with a positive degree of progressivity is optimal in both frameworks, and that the presence of labor market friction implies that the optimal level of progressivity is (slightly) higher.
records.abstract_cn: 累进税制通常以再分配和保险为由进行辩护。当劳动力市场存在摩擦且没有劳动供给的集约边际时，已有研究表明累进税通过降低工资来减少失业。然而，更累进的税制会抑制个人劳动供给和（预防性）储蓄，从而可能减少资本积累和总产出。我考察了累进税收和转移支付制度对失业、劳动收入、个人劳动供给和储蓄的不同影响。我的建模策略遵循Setty和Yedid-Levi（2020）的方法，他们基于Krusell等人（2010）的基准模型，我在此基础上加入了个人劳动供给。我允许生产率以及偏好存在事前异质性，而唯一的异质性风险是内生的失业风险。我将带有摩擦性劳动力市场的基准模型与失业风险外生的瓦尔拉斯劳动力市场模型进行比较。基于功利主义福利标准的稳态比较表明，在两种框架中，具有一定累进程度的税收和转移支付制度都是最优的，并且劳动力市场摩擦的存在意味着最优累进程度（略微）更高。

records.title_en: On the coexistence of cryptocurrency and fiat money
records.title_cn: 加密货币与法定货币的共存
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a search-theoretic model to study conditions under which cryptocurrency is valued and under which it coexists with fiat money. In my model, a cryptocurrency economy is one in which private agents' decisions determine the stock of money and in which the marginal cost of producing money is increasing in the existing nominal stock. I show that the inflation rate of cryptocurrency must be zero in a stationary monetary equilibrium. This result is in sharp contrast to models with fiat money in which the stock of money is exogenously given. In fiat money economies, the inflation rate is determined by the rate of growth of the money stock. My result is also in sharp contrast with other types of private money economies, in which the inflation rate must necessarily be different from zero. In such private money economies, the cost of producing additional money does not depend on the existing nominal stock. Moreover, I show that cryptocurrency and fiat money can circulate at the same time and that the rates of return on these two assets may not be the same. Competition with cryptocurrency restricts the government's ability to over-issue fiat money and thereby might improve on pure fiat money equilibria without government commitment.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用搜索理论模型研究加密货币被赋予价值以及其与法定货币共存的条件。在我的模型中，加密货币经济是指私人主体的决策决定货币存量，且生产货币的边际成本随现有名义存量增加而增加的经济。我证明，在稳态货币均衡中，加密货币的通货膨胀率必须为零。这一结果与外生给定货币存量的法定货币模型形成鲜明对比。在法定货币经济中，通货膨胀率由货币存量的增长率决定。我的结果也与其他类型的私人货币经济形成鲜明对比，在这些经济中，通货膨胀率必然不为零。在这种私人货币经济中，生产额外货币的成本不依赖于现有的名义存量。此外，我证明加密货币和法定货币可以同时流通，且这两种资产的回报率可能不同。与加密货币的竞争限制了政府过度发行法定货币的能力，从而可能在没有政府承诺的情况下改善纯法定货币均衡。

records.title_en: Should monetary policy target financial stability?
records.title_cn: 货币政策是否应以金融稳定为目标？
records.abstract_en: Monetary policy can promote financial stability and improve household welfare. We consider a macro model with a financial sector in which banks do not actively issue equity, output and growth depend on the aggregate level of bank equity, and equilibrium is inefficient. Monetary policy rules responding to the financial sector are ex-ante stabilizing because their effects on risk premia decrease the likelihood of crises and boost leverage during downturns. Stability gains from monetary policy increase welfare whenever macroprudential policy is poorly targeted. If macroprudential policy is sufficiently well-targeted to promote financial stability, then monetary policy should not target financial stability.
records.abstract_cn: 货币政策可以促进金融稳定并改善家庭福利。我们考虑一个包含金融部门的宏观模型，在该模型中，银行不积极发行股票，产出和增长取决于银行股权的总量，且均衡是无效率的。对金融部门做出反应的货币政策规则具有事前稳定性，因为它们对风险溢价的影响降低了危机发生的可能性，并在经济低迷时期提升了杠杆率。当宏观审慎政策目标定位不佳时，货币政策带来的稳定性收益会增加福利。如果宏观审慎政策能够充分精准地以促进金融稳定为目标，那么货币政策就不应以金融稳定为目标。

records.title_en: Long-term care needs and savings in retirement
records.title_cn: 长期护理需求与退休储蓄
records.abstract_en: In this paper, I investigate to what extent heterogeneity in both long-term care (LTC) needs and informal care support affects the savings decisions of the old. For this purpose, I develop and estimate a model of retired single individuals where agents are exposed to physical and/or cognitive health deterioration that triggers demand for LTC. To cope with LTC, agents differ in the amount of informal care provided by relatives and can purchase formal care at a market price to supplement this. I find that (i) LTC is relatively more important than bequest motives in explaining the lack of dissaving of individuals with limited access to informal care, (ii) concurrent cognitive and physical limitations account for most of the precautionary savings related to LTC, and (iii) Abstracting from informal care provision from relatives overestimates the welfare gains from expansions in government-provided means-tested care programs.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我研究了长期护理需求和非正式护理支持的异质性在多大程度上影响老年人的储蓄决策。为此，我开发并估计了一个退休单身个体模型，其中个体面临身体和/或认知健康恶化，从而引发对长期护理的需求。为了应对长期护理，个体在亲属提供的非正式护理数量上存在差异，并且可以按市场价格购买正式护理作为补充。我发现：（i）在解释无法获得非正式护理的个体缺乏消费减少方面，长期护理比遗赠动机相对更重要；（ii）认知和身体限制同时出现是长期护理相关预防性储蓄的主要原因；（iii）忽略亲属提供的非正式护理会高估政府提供的经济状况调查护理项目扩张的福利收益。

records.title_en: Individual earnings and family income: Dynamics and distribution
records.title_cn: 个人收入与家庭收入：动态与分布
records.abstract_en: We review research on the dynamics and distribution of individual earnings and family income. We start with univariate earnings models, which dominate the literature and are often used as the exogenous component of family income in structural models of saving. We present a version of the linear model that nests most of the specifications that have been used in the literature, and then discuss recent papers that stress nonnormal shocks, nonlinear and age-dependent processes, and heterogeneous model parameters. The recent work provides a much richer description of the nature of earnings volatility than the basic model. We then turn to models of individual earnings that are based on wages, employment, job mobility, and hours. These multivariate models permit measuring the sources of permanent differences in earnings and distinguishing among shocks that influence earnings through employment, job mobility, general productivity, or hours. Finally, we consider models of lifetime family income that integrate individual earnings, marriage (accounting for marital sorting), and earnings of a spouse, if present. We conclude by discussing directions for future work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们回顾了关于个人收入和家庭收入动态与分布的研究。我们从单变量收入模型开始，这些模型在文献中占主导地位，并常被用作储蓄结构模型中家庭收入的外生组成部分。我们提出了一个线性模型的版本，该模型涵盖了文献中使用的大多数规格，然后讨论了近期强调非正态冲击、非线性和年龄依赖过程以及异质性模型参数的论文。近期工作提供了比基本模型更丰富的收入波动性描述。然后我们转向基于工资、就业、工作流动性和工时的个人收入模型。这些多变量模型能够衡量收入永久性差异的来源，并区分通过就业、工作流动性、一般生产率或工时影响收入的冲击。最后，我们考虑整合个人收入、婚姻（考虑婚姻匹配）以及配偶收入（如有）的终身家庭收入模型。我们最后讨论了未来工作的方向。

records.title_en: The fall of the labor income share: The role of technological change and hiring frictions
records.title_cn: 劳动收入份额的下降：技术进步与招聘摩擦的作用
records.abstract_en: Documenting an average drop of the labor share of eight percentage points for eight European countries and the US between 1980 and 2007, we analyze the role of technological progress and labor market frictions. According to our results, while capital-labor substitution in general was not crucial, Information Communication Technology (ICT) explains more than half of the decline in the labor share, given an estimated elasticity of substitution with the labor input of 1.18. Considering hiring costs slightly dampens the estimated substitution effect at aggregate level. Additionally, by modeling the substitution between ICT and labor with a set of key labor market variables, we find it to be linked to both the share of routine occupations (positively) and the share of high-skill workers (negatively) with a similar strength.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了八个欧洲国家和美国在1980年至2007年间劳动份额平均下降八个百分点的情况，并分析了技术进步和劳动力市场摩擦的作用。根据我们的结果，虽然资本与劳动之间的替代总体上并不关键，但信息通信技术（ICT）解释了劳动份额下降的一半以上，其与劳动投入的替代弹性估计为1.18。考虑招聘成本在总体上略微削弱了估计的替代效应。此外，通过用一组关键的劳动力市场变量对ICT与劳动之间的替代进行建模，我们发现它与常规职业占比（正相关）和高技能工人占比（负相关）的联系强度相似。

records.title_en: Diffusion of ideas in networks with endogenous search
records.title_cn: 内生搜索网络中的思想扩散
records.abstract_en: I study the diffusion of technology when the decision to search for productivity-enhancing technologies depends on the network of interactions between agents. Agents have the option to engage in costly learning from their first-degree connections. The more productive an agent's connections, the higher the gains from learning. Hence, the network affects the reservation productivity at which agents choose to learn and, therefore, affects aggregate productivity. I find that the denser the network, the higher total factor productivity and the lower inequality on average. This effect is due to less dispersed gains from learning across nodes when network density increases. Despite the increase in productivity, the share of agents that learn in equilibrium is not affected by network density.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了当搜索提高生产率技术的决策取决于代理人之间的互动网络时技术的扩散。代理人可以选择从其一级连接中进行成本高昂的学习。代理人的连接生产率越高，学习的收益就越大。因此，网络影响代理人选择学习的保留生产率，从而影响总生产率。我发现，网络越密集，全要素生产率越高，平均不平等程度越低。这种效应是由于网络密度增加时，各节点学习收益的分散程度降低。尽管生产率提高，但均衡中学习的代理人比例不受网络密度的影响。

records.title_en: Regional divergence and house prices
records.title_cn: 区域分化与房价
records.abstract_en: We document a new fact: regional divergence, the rate at which rich states grow faster than poor states, explains most U.S. house price movements since 1939, including the post-2000 boom-bust-boom cycle. An industry-share instrument provides evidence the relationship is causal, implying the location of economic growth affects national house prices. We propose a model to learn why regional divergence and house prices are related. In the model, high interstate inequality raises rents on average because relative demand for living in a high-income state increases and housing supply in low-income states is elastic. Regional divergence leads to higher expected future interstate inequality, which implies higher expected future rents, and therefore, higher current house prices. The model accurately predicts rents since 1929, which are quite different than prices, as well as cross-sectional moments of prices, rents, construction, and migration.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了一个新事实：区域分化，即富裕州比贫穷州增长更快的速率，解释了自1939年以来美国房价的大部分变动，包括2000年后的繁荣-萧条-繁荣周期。一个行业份额工具提供了因果关系证据，表明经济增长的地理位置影响全国房价。我们提出了一个模型来理解区域分化与房价为何相关。在该模型中，高州际不平等平均提高了租金，因为对高收入州居住的相对需求增加，而低收入州的住房供给具有弹性。区域分化导致未来预期州际不平等加剧，这意味着未来预期租金上升，因此当前房价更高。该模型准确预测了自1929年以来的租金，这些租金与价格截然不同，同时也预测了价格、租金、建设和迁移的横截面矩。

records.title_en: Disability insurance and the effects of return-to-work policies
records.title_cn: 残疾保险与重返工作岗位政策的效果
records.abstract_en: I provide a quantitative assessment of the labor market and welfare effects of return-to-work policies targeted at disability insurance (DI) recipients. I do so by estimating a life-cycle model in which individuals with different health evolving over time choose consumption, labor supply, and DI application. I find that a wage subsidy incentivizing return to work is welfare improving, and the willingness to pay for such reform is increasing in sickness and decreasing in wealth. This policy increases labor force participation of DI beneficiaries by 4.6 percentage points, and decreases the DI rate by 5.7 percentage points. A policy mandating a 10% yearly eligibility reassessment would decrease the welfare of individuals in bad health and poor economic condition, and force about 30% of the beneficiaries to exit the program, 54% of whom would return to work.
records.abstract_cn: 我对针对残疾保险（DI）受益人的重返工作岗位政策的劳动力市场和福利效应进行了定量评估。为此，我估计了一个生命周期模型，其中健康状况随时间变化的不同个体选择消费、劳动供给和DI申请。我发现，激励重返工作的工资补贴能改善福利，对此类改革的支付意愿随疾病程度增加而增加，随财富减少而减少。该政策使DI受益人的劳动力参与率提高了4.6个百分点，并使DI率降低了5.7个百分点。一项要求每年进行10%资格重新评估的政策将降低健康状况不佳且经济条件较差的个体的福利，并迫使约30%的受益人退出该计划，其中54%的人将重返工作岗位。

records.title_en: Fiscal multipliers: A heterogeneous‐agent perspective
records.title_cn: 财政乘数：异质性主体视角
records.abstract_en: We use an analytically tractable heterogeneous‐agent (HANK) version of the standard New Keynesian model to show how the size of fiscal multipliers depends on (i) the distribution of factor incomes, and (ii) the source of nominal rigidities. With sticky prices but flexible wages, the standard representative‐agent (RANK) model predicts large multipliers because profits fall after a fiscal stimulus and the resulting negative income effect makes the representative worker work harder. Our HANK model, where workers do not own stock, and thus do not receive profit income, predicts smaller fiscal multipliers. In fact, they are smaller with sticky prices than with flexible prices. When wages are the source of nominal rigidity, in contrast, fiscal multipliers are close to one, independently of income heterogeneity and price stickiness.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用标准新凯恩斯模型的一个可解析处理的异质性主体（HANK）版本，来展示财政乘数的大小如何取决于（i）要素收入的分配，以及（ii）名义刚性的来源。在价格粘性但工资灵活的情况下，标准代表性主体（RANK）模型预测较大的乘数，因为财政刺激后利润下降，由此产生的负收入效应使代表性工人更加努力工作。我们的HANK模型，其中工人不持有股票，因此不获得利润收入，预测较小的财政乘数。事实上，在价格粘性情况下，它们比在价格灵活情况下更小。相反，当工资是名义刚性的来源时，财政乘数接近一，与收入异质性和价格粘性无关。

records.title_en: Redistribution and the monetary‐fiscal policy mix
records.title_cn: 再分配与货币-财政政策组合
records.abstract_en: We show that the effectiveness of redistribution policy is tied to how much inflation it generates, and thereby to monetary‐fiscal adjustments that ultimately finance the transfers. In the monetary regime, taxes increase to finance transfers while in the fiscal regime, inflation rises, imposing inflation taxes on public debt holders. We show analytically that the fiscal regime generates larger and more persistent inflation than the monetary regime. In a two‐sector model, we quantify the effects of the CARES Act in a COVID recession. We find that transfer multipliers are larger, and that moreover, redistribution is Pareto improving, under the fiscal regime.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，再分配政策的有效性与其产生的通货膨胀程度相关，从而与最终为转移支付融资的货币-财政调整相关。在货币体制下，税收增加以为转移支付融资，而在财政体制下，通货膨胀上升，对公共债务持有者征收通货膨胀税。我们在分析上表明，财政体制比货币体制产生更大且更持久的通货膨胀。在一个两部门模型中，我们量化了COVID衰退中《CARES法案》的影响。我们发现，转移乘数更大，而且，在财政体制下，再分配是帕累托改进的。

records.title_en: The origins and effects of macroeconomic uncertainty
records.title_cn: 宏观经济不确定性的起源与影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate a production‐based general equilibrium model featuring demand‐ and supply‐side uncertainty and an endogenous term premium. Using term structure and macroeconomic data, we find sizable effects of uncertainty on risk premia and business cycle fluctuations. Both demand‐ and supply‐side uncertainty imply large contractions in real activity and an increase in term premia, but supply‐side uncertainty has larger effects on inflation and investment. We introduce a novel analytical decomposition to illustrate how multiple distinct endogenous risk wedges account for these differences. Supply and demand uncertainty are strongly correlated in the beginning of our sample, but decouple after the Great Recession.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个基于生产的一般均衡模型，该模型包含需求侧和供给侧不确定性以及内生期限溢价。利用期限结构和宏观经济数据，我们发现不确定性对风险溢价和商业周期波动具有显著影响。需求侧和供给侧不确定性都意味着实际活动的严重收缩和期限溢价的上升，但供给侧不确定性对通胀和投资的影响更大。我们引入了一种新颖的分析分解方法，以说明多个不同的内生风险楔子如何解释这些差异。在我们样本初期，供给和需求不确定性高度相关，但在大衰退之后它们脱钩了。

records.title_en: Anticipated productivity and the labor market
records.title_cn: 预期生产率与劳动力市场
records.abstract_en: We identify the main shock driving fluctuations in long‐horizon productivity expectations, consistent with theories of TFP news. The identified shock induces strong comovement patterns in output, consumption, investment, employment, and stock prices even though TFP does not change significantly for more than 2 years. A labor search model in which wages are determined by a cash‐flow sharing rule, rather than the present value of match surplus, matches the observed responses to the news shock. The model also matches the empirical patterns of vacancies, labor force participation, hours, and job‐finding rates. The proposed wage rule is consistent with empirical responses of wages to both anticipated and unanticipated productivity changes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们识别了驱动长期生产率预期波动的主要冲击，这与全要素生产率（TFP）新闻理论一致。该识别出的冲击在产出、消费、投资、就业和股票价格中引发了强烈的联动模式，尽管全要素生产率在超过2年内没有显著变化。一个劳动力搜索模型，其中工资由现金流分享规则而非匹配盈余的现值决定，与观察到的对新闻冲击的反应相匹配。该模型还匹配了职位空缺、劳动力参与率、工作时间和工作找到率的经验模式。所提出的工资规则与工资对预期和非预期生产率变化的经验反应一致。

records.title_en: Sufficient statistics for frictional wage dispersion and growth
records.title_cn: 摩擦性工资离散与增长的充分统计量
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a sufficient statistics approach for estimating the role of search frictions in wage dispersion and life‐cycle wage growth. We show how the wage dynamics of displaced workers are directly informative of both for a large class of search models. Specifically, the correlation between pre‐ and post‐displacement wages is informative of frictional wage dispersion. Furthermore, the fraction of displaced workers who suffer a wage loss is informative of frictional wage growth and job‐to‐job mobility, independent of the job‐offer distribution and other labor‐market parameters. Applying our methodology to US data, we find that search frictions account for less than 20% of wage dispersion. In addition, we estimate that between 40 to 80% of workers experience no frictional wage growth during an employment spell. Our approach allows us to estimate how frictions change over time. We find that frictional wage dispersion has declined substantially since 1980 and that frictional wage growth, while low, is more important toward the end of expansionary periods. We finish by estimating two versions of a random search model to show how at least two different mechanisms—involuntary job transitions or compensating differentials—can reconcile our results with the job‐to‐job mobility seen in the data. Regardless of the mechanism, the estimated models show that frictional wage growth accounts for about 15% of life‐cycle wage growth.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种充分统计量方法，用于估计搜索摩擦在工资离散和生命周期工资增长中的作用。我们展示了对于一大类搜索模型， displaced workers 的工资动态直接提供了这两方面的信息。具体来说，置换前后工资之间的相关性提供了摩擦性工资离散的信息。此外，遭受工资损失的 displaced workers 的比例提供了摩擦性工资增长和职位间流动性的信息，且独立于工作机会分布和其他劳动力市场参数。将我们的方法应用于美国数据，我们发现搜索摩擦占工资离散的比例不到20%。此外，我们估计在就业期间，有40至80%的工人没有经历摩擦性工资增长。我们的方法使我们能够估计摩擦随时间的变化。我们发现，自1980年以来，摩擦性工资离散已大幅下降，而摩擦性工资增长虽然较低，但在扩张期结束时更为重要。最后，我们估计了随机搜索模型的两种版本，以展示至少两种不同的机制——非自愿工作转换或补偿性差异——如何将我们的结果与数据中观察到的职位间流动性相协调。无论机制如何，估计模型都显示摩擦性工资增长约占生命周期工资增长的15%。

records.title_en: Expertise, gender, and equilibrium play
records.title_cn: 专业知识、性别与均衡行为
records.abstract_en: Mixed‐strategy Nash equilibrium is the cornerstone of our understanding of strategic situations that require decision makers to be unpredictable. Using data from nearly half a million serves over 3000 tennis matches, and data on player rankings from the ATP and WTA, we examine whether the behavior of professional tennis players is consistent with equilibrium. We find that win rates conform remarkably closely to the theory for men, but conform somewhat less neatly for women. We show that the behavior in the field of more highly ranked (i.e., better) players conforms more closely to theory. We show that the statistical tests used in the prior related literature are not valid for large samples like ours; we develop a novel statistical test that is valid and show, via Monte Carlo simulations, that it is more powerful against the alternative that receivers follows a nonequilibrium mixture.
records.abstract_cn: 混合策略纳什均衡是我们理解需要决策者不可预测的战略情境的基石。利用来自超过3000场网球比赛中近五十万次发球的数据，以及ATP和WTA的球员排名数据，我们检验了职业网球运动员的行为是否与均衡一致。我们发现，男性的胜率与理论高度吻合，而女性的吻合程度则稍差。我们表明，排名更高（即更优秀）的球员在赛场上的行为更符合理论。我们还表明，先前相关文献中使用的统计检验对于像我们这样的大样本并不有效；我们开发了一种有效的新统计检验，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟显示，在接发球者遵循非均衡混合策略的备择假设下，该检验具有更高的功效。

records.title_en: Estimating large‐dimensional connectedness tables: The great moderation through the lens of sectoral spillovers
records.title_cn: 估计高维关联表：以部门溢出视角看大缓和
records.abstract_en: We estimate sectoral spillovers around the Great Moderation with the help of forecast error variance decomposition tables. Obtaining such tables in high dimensions is challenging because they are functions of the estimated vector autoregressive coefficients and the residual covariance matrix. In a simulation study, we compare various regularization methods on both and conduct a comprehensive analysis of their performance. We show that standard estimators of large connectedness tables lead to biased results and high estimation uncertainty, both of which are mitigated by regularization. To explore possible causes for the Great Moderation, we apply a cross‐validated estimator on sectoral spillovers of industrial production in the US from 1972 to 2019. We find that the spillover network has considerably weakened, which hints at structural change, for example, through improved inventory management, as a critical explanation for the Great Moderation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们借助预测误差方差分解表来估计大缓和时期的部门溢出效应。在高维情况下获取此类表具有挑战性，因为它们依赖于估计的向量自回归系数和残差协方差矩阵。在模拟研究中，我们比较了多种正则化方法，并对其性能进行了全面分析。我们表明，标准的高维关联表估计器会导致有偏结果和高估计不确定性，而正则化可以缓解这两个问题。为了探究大缓和的可能原因，我们将交叉验证估计器应用于美国1972年至2019年工业生产的部门溢出效应。我们发现溢出网络已显著减弱，这暗示结构性变化（例如通过改进库存管理）可能是大缓和的关键解释。

records.title_en: Bootstrapping Laplace transforms of volatility
records.title_cn: 波动率拉普拉斯变换的自助法
records.abstract_en: This paper studies inference for the realized Laplace transform (RLT) of volatility in a fixed‐span setting using bootstrap methods. Specifically, since standard wild bootstrap procedures deliver inconsistent inference, we propose a local Gaussian (LG) bootstrap, establish its first‐order asymptotic validity, and use Edgeworth expansions to show that the LG bootstrap inference achieves second‐order asymptotic refinements. Moreover, we provide new Laplace transform‐based estimators of the spot variance as well as the covariance, correlation, and beta between two semimartingales, and adapt our bootstrap procedure to the requisite scenario. We establish central limit theory for our estimators and first‐order asymptotic validity of their associated bootstrap methods. Simulations demonstrate that the LG bootstrap outperforms existing feasible inference theory and wild bootstrap procedures in finite samples. Finally, we illustrate the use of the new methods by examining the coherence between stocks and bonds during the global financial crisis of 2008 as well as the COVID‐19 pandemic stock sell‐off during 2020, and by a forecasting exercise.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究在固定跨度设定下，使用自助法对波动率的已实现拉普拉斯变换（RLT）进行推断。具体而言，由于标准的野自助法程序会产生不一致的推断，我们提出了一种局部高斯（LG）自助法，建立了其一阶渐近有效性，并利用Edgeworth展开证明LG自助法推断实现了二阶渐近修正。此外，我们提供了基于拉普拉斯变换的新的现货方差以及两个半鞅之间的协方差、相关性和贝塔的估计量，并将我们的自助法程序调整到所需场景。我们为我们的估计量建立了中心极限理论，并证明了其相关自助法的一阶渐近有效性。模拟表明，在有限样本中，LG自助法优于现有的可行推断理论和野自助法程序。最后，我们通过考察2008年全球金融危机以及2020年COVID-19大流行股市抛售期间股票与债券之间的联动性，以及通过一次预测练习，来说明新方法的使用。

records.title_en: Fixed‐effects binary choice models with three or more periods
records.title_cn: 三期或更多期的固定效应二元选择模型
records.abstract_en: We consider fixed‐effects binary choice models with a fixed number of periods T and regressors without a large support. If the time‐varying unobserved terms are i.i.d. with known distribution F, Chamberlain (2010) shows that the common slope parameter is point identified if and only if F is logistic. However, he only considers in his proof T = 2. We show that the result does not generalize to T ≥ 3: the common slope parameter can be identified when F belongs to a family including the logit distribution. Identification is based on a conditional moment restriction. Under restrictions on the covariates, these moment conditions lead to point identification of relative effects. If T = 3 and mild conditions hold, GMM estimators based on these conditional moment restrictions reach the semiparametric efficiency bound. Finally, we illustrate our method by revisiting Brender and Drazen (2008).
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有固定期数T和没有大支撑回归量的固定效应二元选择模型。如果时变不可观测项是独立同分布的，且分布函数F已知，Chamberlain（2010）表明，当且仅当F是逻辑分布时，共同斜率参数是点识别的。然而，他在证明中只考虑了T = 2。我们表明，该结果不能推广到T ≥ 3：当F属于包括logit分布在内的一个族时，共同斜率参数可以被识别。识别基于条件矩约束。在协变量的限制下，这些矩条件导致相对效应的点识别。如果T = 3且温和条件成立，基于这些条件矩约束的GMM估计量达到半参数效率界。最后，我们通过重新审视Brender和Drazen（2008）来说明我们的方法。

records.title_en: Ellsberg meets Keynes at an urn
records.title_cn: 埃尔斯伯格在瓮中遇见凯恩斯
records.abstract_en: Keynes (1921) and Ellsberg (1961) have articulated an aversion toward betting on an urn containing balls of two colors of unknown proportion to one with a 50–50 composition. Keynes views this as reflecting different preferences for bets arising from different sources of uncertainty. Ellsberg describes this as weighting the priors arising from the unknown urn pessimistically. In two experiments, we observe substantial links between attitude toward almost‐objective uncertainty and attitudes toward multiple‐prior uncertainties in terms of ambiguity and its corresponding compound risk. Our findings point to a shared component across domains of uncertainty and motivate the need for further theoretical development.
records.abstract_cn: 凯恩斯（1921）和埃尔斯伯格（1961）阐述了对一个包含两种颜色球且比例未知的瓮下注的厌恶，相较于一个50-50组成的瓮。凯恩斯认为这反映了来自不同不确定性来源的赌注的不同偏好。埃尔斯伯格将其描述为对来自未知瓮的先验进行悲观加权。在两个实验中，我们观察到对几乎客观不确定性的态度与对多重先验不确定性的态度（在模糊性及其相应的复合风险方面）之间存在显著联系。我们的发现指向不确定性各领域间的共同组成部分，并激励进一步理论发展的需求。

records.title_en: A quantitative evaluation of universal basic income
records.title_cn: 全民基本收入的定量评估
records.abstract_en: We provide a quantitative evaluation of the impact of Universal Basic Income (UBI) as an alternative to the existing system of means-tested transfers. We explore varying levels of UBI generosity, paired with different strategies to finance it. All the reforms we consider result in welfare losses for a huge majority of initial households. Moreover, these losses are increasing in UBI generosity. A reform financed with consumption taxes implies lower efficiency losses than reforms financed with income taxes, but fewer individuals benefit from it.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对全民基本收入（UBI）作为现有经济状况调查转移支付体系的替代方案的影响进行了定量评估。我们探讨了不同慷慨程度的UBI，以及与之配套的不同融资策略。我们考虑的所有改革方案都会导致绝大多数初始家庭福利损失。此外，这些损失随着UBI慷慨程度的提高而增加。以消费税融资的改革相比以所得税融资的改革效率损失更低，但受益人数更少。

records.title_en: Choice and consequence: Assessing mismatch at Chicago exam schools
records.title_cn: 选择与后果：评估芝加哥考试学校的不匹配
records.abstract_en: The educational mismatch hypothesis asserts that students are hurt by affirmative action policies placing them in selective schools for which they wouldn’t otherwise qualify. We evaluate mismatch in Chicago’s selective public exam schools, which admit students using neighborhood-based diversity criteria as well as test scores. Regression discontinuity estimates for applicants favored by affirmative action indeed show no gains in reading and negative effects of exam school attendance on math scores and four-year college enrollment. But these results are similar for more- and less-selective schools and for applicants more and less likely to benefit from affirmative action, a pattern inconsistent with mismatch. We show that Chicago exam school effects are determined largely by the schools attended when not offered an exam school seat. In particular, apparent mismatch is explained by the fact that exam school admission diverts many applicants from high-performing Noble Network charter schools, where they would have done well. Consistent with these findings, exam schools reduce math scores for applicants applying from high-quality charter schools in another large urban district. Exam school applicants’ previous achievement, race, and other demographic characteristics that are sometimes said to mediate student-school matching play no role in this story.
records.abstract_cn: 教育不匹配假说认为，平权行动政策将学生安排到他们原本不符合资格的精英学校，反而会伤害这些学生。我们评估了芝加哥选择性公立考试学校中的不匹配现象，这些学校在录取时既使用基于邻里的多样性标准，也使用考试成绩。对受平权行动青睐的申请者的断点回归估计确实显示，阅读成绩没有提高，而考试学校出勤对数学成绩和四年制大学入学率有负面影响。但这些结果在选择性较高和较低的学校之间，以及在更可能和更不可能受益于平权行动的申请者之间是相似的，这种模式与不匹配假说不一致。我们表明，芝加哥考试学校的效果在很大程度上取决于未获得考试学校席位时所就读的学校。特别是，表面上的不匹配可以通过以下事实解释：考试学校录取使许多申请者离开了表现优异的Noble Network特许学校，而他们在那里本可以表现出色。与这些发现一致的是，在另一个大型城市学区，考试学校降低了来自高质量特许学校申请者的数学成绩。考试学校申请者之前的学业成绩、种族和其他有时被认为会调节学生与学校匹配的人口特征，在这个故事中不起任何作用。

records.title_en: The effects of changes in social security’s delayed retirement credit: Evidence from administrative data
records.title_cn: 社会保障延迟退休积分变化的影响：来自行政数据的证据
records.abstract_en: The delayed retirement credit (DRC) increases monthly OASI (Old Age and Survivors Insurance) retired worker benefits for primary beneficiaries who claim after their full retirement age (FRA). For many years, the DRC was set at 3.0 percent per year (0.25 percent monthly). The 1983 amendments to Social Security more than doubled this actuarial adjustment to 8.0 percent per year, with the changes phased in gradually over time. In this paper, we use administrative data from the Social Security Administration (SSA) to estimate the effect of this policy change on individual claiming behavior and labor supply. We focus on the first half of the DRC increase (from 3.0 to 5.5 percent) given changes in other SSA policies that coincided with the later increases. Our findings demonstrate that the increase in the DRC led to an increase in delayed claiming of Social Security benefits among men and strongly suggest that the effects were larger for those with higher lifetime incomes, who would have a greater financial incentive to delay given their longer life expectancies. Furthermore, liquidity constraints play an important role in responsiveness to DRC increases. We do not find evidence of changes to the claiming behavior of women or to labor supply for either men or women.
records.abstract_cn: 延迟退休积分（DRC）提高了在完全退休年龄（FRA）之后申请领取的主要受益人的月度OASI（老年和遗属保险）退休工人福利。多年来，DRC设定为每年3.0%（每月0.25%）。1983年社会保障修正案将这一精算调整提高了一倍多，达到每年8.0%，且变化随时间逐步实施。在本文中，我们使用社会保障管理局（SSA）的行政数据来估计这一政策变化对个人申请行为和劳动力供给的影响。我们关注DRC增加的前半部分（从3.0到5.5%），因为其他SSA政策的变化与后来的增加同时发生。我们的研究结果表明，DRC的增加导致男性延迟申请社会保障福利的行为增加，并强烈表明对于终身收入较高的人群，影响更大，因为他们预期寿命更长，延迟申请会有更大的经济激励。此外，流动性约束在响应DRC增加中起着重要作用。我们没有发现女性申请行为或男性和女性劳动力供给变化的证据。

records.title_en: Access to banking, savings and consumption smoothing in rural India
records.title_cn: 印度农村获得银行服务、储蓄与消费平滑
records.abstract_en: To what extent does access to banking help poor households to save and smooth consumption? To answer this fundamental question, we combine a field experiment that randomly provides access to a bank account with weekly interviews on household finances. Access to banking does not change average consumption, but it improves consumption smoothing by alleviating savings constraints. Indeed, the control’s expenditures follow income more closely than the expenditures of the treated. The latter handle variations in income by engaging in pro-cyclical saving in their account. These results provide an important new insight into the role of banking in low- and middle-income countries.
records.abstract_cn: 获得银行服务在多大程度上帮助贫困家庭储蓄和平滑消费？为了回答这一基本问题，我们将一项随机提供银行账户访问权的实地实验与每周家庭财务访谈相结合。获得银行服务并未改变平均消费，但通过缓解储蓄约束改善了消费平滑。确实，对照组的支出比处理组的支出更紧密地跟随收入。后者通过在其账户中进行顺周期储蓄来应对收入变动。这些结果为银行在中低收入国家中的作用提供了重要的新见解。

records.title_en: School quality and the return to schooling in Britain: New evidence from a large-scale compulsory schooling reform
records.title_cn: 学校质量与英国教育回报：来自大规模义务教育改革的新证据
