Our findings introduce six propositions that shed light on key factors for the development and longevity of financing schemes: i) the AVCF Ecosystem, ii) how AVCF schemes emerge, iii) social capital and value chain interactions, iv) culture and value chain characteristics, v) market risk, vi) transaction costs reduction. We find that AVCF can use social and trade capital to reduce transaction costs and mitigate risks related to quality, prices, and markets. In AVCF ecosystems, there are financial products for interlinked agricultural value chains with a balanced focus on all chain actors, no lock-in relationships between the lenders and the borrowers, and multiple benefits for participants. As the evolution towards an Ecosystem Approach offers a promising outlook for agricultural credit, future research should explore how policymakers and development agencies can support these schemes and how they can be used to increase financial access and equity in rural communities.
records.abstract_cn: 在发展中国家，小农户往往缺乏长期的信贷来源。虽然传统银行、小额信贷和合作社已经解决了一些融资缺口，但农业价值链融资（AVCF）因其允许价值链参与者利用社会资本并满足其资金需求而受到关注。为了识别AVCF发展的驱动因素，我们通过深入的专家访谈分析了包括银行、发展组织、农业企业和学术界在内的非农民参与者的作用。遵循扎根理论方法，我们提出生态系统方法作为在发展中国家建立长期AVCF计划的框架，基于三个关键解决方案：为价值链交易记录建立金融平台，为价值链实施捆绑服务，以及从价值链演变为价值网络方法。我们的研究结果提出了六个命题，揭示了融资计划发展和长期性的关键因素：i) AVCF生态系统，ii) AVCF计划如何出现，iii) 社会资本与价值链互动，iv) 文化与价值链特征，v) 市场风险，vi) 交易成本降低。我们发现AVCF可以利用社会和贸易资本来降低交易成本，并减轻与质量、价格和市场相关的风险。在AVCF生态系统中，有面向相互关联的农业价值链的金融产品，平衡关注所有链上参与者，贷款方和借款方之间没有锁定关系，参与者获得多重利益。随着向生态系统方法的演进为农业信贷提供了有前景的前景，未来的研究应探索政策制定者和发展机构如何支持这些计划，以及如何利用它们来增加农村社区的金融可及性和公平性。

records.title_en: Market concentration, trade exposure, and firm productivity in developing countries: Evidence from Mexico
records.title_cn: 发展中国家市场集中度、贸易开放度与企业生产率：来自墨西哥的证据
records.abstract_en: To show how local market concentration affects firm productivity, we exploit a rare database for developing-country standards consisting of five rounds of the Mexican Manufacturing Census and geographically disaggregated data on sectoral exports. Our estimates show that a decline by 10 points in the Herfindahl-Hirschman index, a measure of market concentration, explains an increase by 1 percent in the total factor productivity (TFP) of revenue. We also find that greater exposure to trade offsets and, in most cases, reverses the negative effects of local concentration on productivity. Our heterogeneity analysis also shows that informal firms exhibit a higher probability of exiting the market if competitive pressure and exposure to international markets increase and that firms in the southern region of the country would benefit the most from higher competition and exposure to international markets.
records.abstract_cn: 为展示本地市场集中度如何影响企业生产率，我们利用了一个罕见的发展中国家标准数据库，该数据库包含五轮墨西哥制造业普查以及地理细分层面的部门出口数据。我们的估计显示，赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（衡量市场集中度的指标）下降10个百分点，可解释收入全要素生产率（TFP）提高1%。我们还发现，更大的贸易开放度抵消并在多数情况下逆转了本地集中度对生产率的负面影响。我们的异质性分析还表明，如果竞争压力和国际市场开放度增加，非正规企业退出市场的概率更高，且该国南部地区的企业将从更高的竞争和国际市场开放度中获益最多。

records.title_en: Joint decision-making, technology adoption and food security: Evidence from rice varieties in eastern India
records.title_cn: 联合决策、技术采用与粮食安全：来自印度东部水稻品种的证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the effect of married couples’ joint decision-making on rice variety selection on rice productivity—a measure of food security. The study uses the 2016 Rice Monitoring Survey and the endogenous switching regression (ESR) method. Results show that rice farms with joint decision-makers (husband and wife) would have higher yields, particularly in households that adopted MRVGen1 (before 1986) rice varieties. Thus, families with joint-decision making have higher food security. Intervention programs for food insecurity should acknowledge and incorporate information regarding the persons responsible for making rice varietal decisions and the characteristics of modern rice varieties to ensure food security.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了已婚夫妇在稻米品种选择上的联合决策对水稻生产力（粮食安全的一个衡量指标）的影响。研究使用了2016年水稻监测调查和内生转换回归（ESR）方法。结果表明，采用联合决策（夫妻共同决策）的稻米农场产量更高，尤其是在采用了MRVGen1（1986年前）水稻品种的家庭中。因此，联合决策的家庭具有更高的粮食安全水平。针对粮食不安全的干预项目应承认并纳入有关负责稻米品种决策的人员信息以及现代水稻品种的特征，以确保粮食安全。

records.title_en: How to cope with a refugee population? Evidence from Uganda
records.title_cn: 如何应对难民人口？来自乌干达的证据
records.abstract_en: Sub-Saharan Africa hosts a large proportion of the world’s refugees, raising concerns about the consequences on host countries. Uganda is the largest refugee-hosting country in Africa and is praised for its progressive refugee policy. We analyze the effects of hosting refugees on material welfare in Uganda, relying on longitudinal data and an instrumental variable approach. Our results indicate that Ugandan households benefit from living close to refugee settlements. In contrast to the existing literature, those initially involved in subsistence agriculture benefit the most. The effect seems to be driven by the few households able to move from subsistence agriculture to commercial farming and to some extent, to wage employment.
records.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲收容了世界上很大比例的难民，这引发了对东道国后果的担忧。乌干达是非洲最大的难民收容国，并因其进步的难民政策而受到赞扬。我们利用纵向数据和工具变量方法，分析了收容难民对乌干达物质福利的影响。我们的结果表明，乌干达家庭因居住在难民定居点附近而受益。与现有文献相反，那些最初从事自给农业的家庭受益最多。这种效应似乎是由少数能够从自给农业转向商业农业，并在一定程度上转向工资就业的家庭所驱动的。

records.title_en: Making meat and milk from plants: A review of plant-based food for human and planetary health
records.title_cn: 用植物制作肉和奶：植物性食品对人类和地球健康的综述
records.abstract_en: Interest in alternative protein sources to substitute for animal source protein-rich foods has emerged alongside calls for sustainable food systems to meet protein demands as the global population grows towards a projected 9.8 billion people by 2050. Food companies are capitalizing on sustainable diet recommendations that encourage consumption of plant-based foods and have heavily invested in new plant-based foods that mimic animal source foods, effectively expanding the “plant-based foods” category. At the same time, globally there are two opposing protein transitions taking place as lower-income populations shift from plant to animal protein sources and higher-income populations that overconsume animal protein sources are recommended to shift towards plant-based foods. Using a global food systems lens, this review article builds on existing literature to assess the extent to which plant-based meat and milk analogs can become part of sustainable diets across two competing protein transitions and to identify unresolved knowledge gaps. This articles first examines global meat and dairy consumption trends as well as the emergence of plant-based analogs and consumer perceptions. We then draw on the literature to compare the environmental footprints and nutrition compositions of plant-based meats and milks against their respective conventional equivalents. We find that, while there are promising environmental benefits to substituting meats and milk with certain plant-based analogs, the uptake of these products is likely stifled based on the small number of products they mimic (i.e., ground meat, meat emulsions, meat crumbles, and fluid milk). Further, plant-based analogs do not completely mimic the nutrient composition of animal source foods. Plant-based analogs may have improved compositions, such as improved fat profiles. However, analogs may lack comparable protein and micronutrients that are highly bioavailable in animal source foods. Care should be considered for plant-based analogs that inherently fall under the “plant- based food” category as they are vastly different from whole and minimally processed plant foods and the intended benefits of plant-based food consumption may not be generalizable. Future assessments of meat and milk analogs should consider under which contexts direct substitution of animal source foods are viable from a consumer standpoint and examine both environment and nutrition impacts that are important to the given population.
records.abstract_cn: 随着全球人口预计到9.8年增长至2050亿，人们对替代动物源蛋白质丰富食品的替代蛋白质来源的兴趣，与对可持续食品系统满足蛋白质需求的呼吁一同出现。食品公司正利用鼓励消费植物性食品的可持续饮食建议，并大力投资于模仿动物源食品的新型植物性食品，有效扩大了“植物性食品”类别。与此同时，全球正发生两种相反的蛋白质转型：低收入人群从植物蛋白转向动物蛋白，而高收入人群因过度消费动物蛋白被建议转向植物性食品。本文采用全球食品系统视角，在现有文献基础上评估植物性肉类和奶类类似物在两种竞争性蛋白质转型中成为可持续饮食一部分的程度，并识别未解决的知识空白。本文首先考察全球肉类和乳制品消费趋势以及植物性类似物的出现和消费者认知。然后，我们利用文献比较植物性肉类和奶类与其各自传统对应物的环境足迹和营养成分。我们发现，虽然用某些植物性类似物替代肉类和奶类具有可观的环境效益，但这些产品的采用可能因它们模仿的产品种类有限（即碎肉、肉糜、肉碎和液态奶）而受到抑制。此外，植物性类似物并未完全模仿动物源食品的营养成分。植物性类似物可能具有改善的成分，如改善的脂肪谱。然而，类似物可能缺乏动物源食品中高度生物可利用的相当蛋白质和微量营养素。应谨慎考虑那些本质上属于“植物性食品”类别的植物性类似物，因为它们与完整和最低加工植物食品截然不同，植物性食品消费的预期益处可能不具普遍性。未来对肉类和奶类类似物的评估应考虑在哪些背景下，从消费者角度看直接替代动物源食品是可行的，并考察对特定人群重要的环境和营养影响。

records.title_en: Does environmental regulation spur innovation? Quasi-natural experiment in China
records.title_cn: 环境规制是否激发创新？中国的准自然实验
records.abstract_en: The relationship between stringent environmental regulation and the innovation capability of enterprises has been controversial. Treating the target-based sulfur dioxide emissions control policy implemented for the Two Control Zones after 2000 as a quasi-natural experiment, we exploit the difference-in-difference approach to investigate the causal relationship between stringent environmental regulation and technological innovation using the disaggregated Chinese manufacturing firm-level data between 1998 and 2007. Our estimation results indicate that the target-based environmental policy effectively limits the sulfur dioxide emissions of regulated enterprises and facilitates their technological innovation capability. The conclusion that strengthening environmental regulation has contributed to the technological innovation capability of enterprises is still robust after ruling out the effect of China’s integration into the World Trade Organization. However, enterprises with different characteristics might respond heterogeneously to strict environmental regulation. The estimation results of the difference-in-difference-in-difference confirm that heavily polluting enterprises and those exposed to greater environmental protection pressure have experienced more technological progress. Further analyses demonstrate that enterprises’ technological innovation triggered by strict environmental regulation dramatically reduces their non-clean energy consumption and improves their environmental performance. Our research sheds light on the causal relationship between environmental regulation and technological innovation and provides crucial references for governments within developing economies to design scientific environmental policies aimed at searching for win–win solutions for economic growth and eco-environmental protection.
records.abstract_cn: 严格的环境规制与企业创新能力之间的关系一直存在争议。将2000年后实施的两控区基于目标的二氧化硫排放控制政策视为准自然实验，我们利用双重差分方法，基于1998年至2007年间中国制造业企业层面的细分数据，研究严格环境规制与技术创新的因果关系。估计结果表明，基于目标的环境政策有效限制了受规制企业的二氧化硫排放，并促进了其技术创新能力。在排除了中国加入世界贸易组织的影响后，加强环境规制有助于提升企业技术创新能力的结论依然稳健。然而，不同特征的企业对严格环境规制的反应可能存在异质性。三重差分估计结果证实，重污染企业和面临更大环境保护压力的企业经历了更多的技术进步。进一步分析表明，严格环境规制引发的企业技术创新显著降低了其非清洁能源消耗，并改善了其环境绩效。我们的研究揭示了环境规制与技术创新之间的因果关系，并为发展中经济体的政府设计旨在寻求经济增长与生态环境保护双赢的科学环境政策提供了重要参考。

records.title_en: Macroeconomic exposure of developing economies to low-carbon transition
records.title_cn: 发展中经济体对低碳转型的宏观经济敞口
records.abstract_en: The low-carbon transition is a specific type of rapid structural change where low-emission industries grow and high-emission industries decline due to deliberate policies, changing preferences and technological change. Developing countries’ macroeconomic exposure to this transition depends upon their reliance on carbon-intensive industries as a source of foreign currency, fiscal revenue, employment and wage income. Identifying these different dimensions of countries’ exposure is important because different green policies need to be applied in different contexts, and the results of these policies will be more or less effective according to countries’ idiosyncrasies.
records.abstract_cn: 低碳转型是一种特定类型的快速结构性变化，其中低排放行业增长，高排放行业因刻意政策、偏好变化和技术变革而衰退。发展中国家对这一转型的宏观经济敞口取决于其对碳密集型行业作为外汇、财政收入、就业和工资收入来源的依赖。识别这些国家敞口的不同维度很重要，因为不同的绿色政策需要在不同情境下应用，而这些政策的效果将根据各国的特殊性而或多或少地有效。

records.title_en: Pathways towards power shifts: State-society synergy
records.title_cn: 权力转移的路径：国家与社会协同
records.abstract_en: Policy reformers often make bold promises to improve government responsiveness to citizen demands. Yet such proclaimed openings from above often fall short, get diverted, or are blocked. This study uses the state-society synergy approach to analyze exceptional cases when reformers within the state managed to deliver openings for citizen action that tangibly empowered otherwise excluded or marginalized groups. What happens when these reform strategies are attempted? We used process tracing, combined with qualitative comparative analysis, to identify patterns across 19 cases in the global South where state actors created a more enabling environment for citizens’ collective action. The study compares the triggers and scope of enabling state actions, the breadth and intensity of collective action, roadblocks within the state, and whether or not these interactive processes led to substantive power shifts in favor of the excluded. We find that half of these openings led to shifts towards greater power for either citizens or reformist actors within public institutions, in spite of both structural obstacles and governmental roadblocks. Notably, power shifts occurred where reformers’ initiatives to enable collective action were themselves most intensive (often but not always backed by political change). Windows of opportunity were often open only briefly, until reformers lost power, and the pathways that led to power shifts combined collaborative and adversarial relationships. The power shifts identified were all incremental and uneven, and many were limited to subnational arenas. Though some later stalled or were partly rolled back, from the point of view of socially and politically excluded groups they represented tangible improvements in the balance of power. While tangible openings from above are rare and conventional theory would expect little institutional change, the state-society synergy framework shows how state actions to reduce the risks or costs of collective action can enable pathways to power shifts.
records.abstract_cn: 政策改革者常常做出大胆承诺，以改善政府对公民需求的回应性。然而，这种来自上层的宣称开放往往落空、被转移或受阻。本研究采用国家与社会协同方法，分析国家内部改革者成功为公民行动提供开放机会的特殊案例，这些机会切实增强了原本被排斥或边缘化群体的权能。当这些改革策略被尝试时会发生什么？我们使用过程追踪，结合定性比较分析，以识别全球南方19个案例中的模式，在这些案例中，国家行为者为公民的集体行动创造了更具支持性的环境。本研究比较了国家支持性行动的触发因素和范围、集体行动的广度和强度、国家内部的障碍，以及这些互动过程是否导致了有利于被排斥群体的实质性权力转移。我们发现，尽管存在结构性障碍和政府阻挠，这些开放中有一半导致了公民或公共机构内部改革派行为者权力增强的转移。值得注意的是，权力转移发生在改革者自身推动集体行动的举措最为密集的地方（通常但不总是有政治变革的支持）。机会之窗往往只短暂开放，直到改革者失去权力，而通向权力转移的路径结合了合作与对抗的关系。所识别的权力转移都是渐进且不均衡的，许多仅限于次国家层面。尽管有些后来停滞或部分倒退，但从社会和政治上被排斥群体的角度来看，它们代表了权力平衡的切实改善。虽然来自上层的切实开放很少见，且传统理论预期制度变革甚微，但国家与社会协同框架表明，国家为降低集体行动风险或成本所采取的行动可以开辟通向权力转移的路径。

records.title_en: Does professionalizing maintenance unlock demand for more reliable water supply? Experimental evidence from rural Uganda
records.title_cn: 专业化维护能否释放对更可靠供水的需求？来自乌干达农村的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Professionalization is gaining prominence as a strategy to address the deficiencies in rural water supply reliability and financial sustainability in low- and middle-income countries that have persisted under community management policies. Yet there is little evidence regarding how much water users can and will pay for the higher reliability that professionalized services promise. What evidence exists largely relies on stated preference studies that do not confront water users with paying over time. We conducted a price experiment to measure effective demand (willingness and ability to pay) for a professional handpump maintenance and repair service among 113 water committees and 1,031 households representative of two districts in northern Uganda. We offered a one-year subscription using Becker-DeGroot-Marschak auctions with real money payments. The service largely delivered on its guarantee of fast repairs and satisfied most customers. Nonetheless, we found that just 4% of water committees paid any price for the full service period. None paid for more than one month at prices higher than our estimate of operating cost even though it represented less than 1% of annual household expenditure. Our findings contrast assertions from recent stated preference studies that increasing handpump reliability is a lynchpin to attracting higher payments from rural water users. Misaligned incentives that discourage water users, nonprofits and their donors, local governments, and political candidates from shifting to higher tariffs for maintenance seem to best explain why effective demand was low. Despite the low demand, we estimate that professionally maintaining the existing handpumps in the study districts would cost less in the long run than the de facto practice of letting these assets fail repeatedly and rehabilitating them. As Uganda and other countries embark on maintenance-oriented, post-community management rural water policies, funders, practitioners, and researchers will need to grapple with how to align institutional incentives for sustainable financing.
records.abstract_cn: 专业化正日益成为解决低收入和中等收入国家农村供水可靠性和财务可持续性缺陷的战略，这些缺陷在社区管理政策下持续存在。然而，关于用水户能为专业化服务承诺的更高可靠性支付多少费用，以及是否愿意支付，证据甚少。现有证据主要依赖于陈述性偏好研究，这些研究并未让用水户面对随时间推移的支付问题。我们进行了一项价格实验，以衡量乌干达北部两个地区具有代表性的113个水委员会和1,031户家庭对专业手泵维护和维修服务的有效需求（支付意愿和能力）。我们使用贝克-德格鲁特-马尔沙克拍卖方式，以真实货币支付提供了一年期的订阅服务。该服务在很大程度上兑现了快速维修的承诺，并使大多数客户满意。尽管如此，我们发现仅有4%的水委员会为整个服务期支付了任何价格。在高于我们估计的运营成本的价格下，没有人支付超过一个月的费用，尽管这占家庭年支出的不到1%。我们的发现与近期陈述性偏好研究的断言形成对比，后者认为提高手泵可靠性是吸引农村用水户更高支付的关键。激励错位使得用水户、非营利组织及其捐助者、地方政府和政治候选人都不愿转向更高的维护关税，这似乎最能解释有效需求为何低迷。尽管需求低迷，我们估计，从长远来看，对研究地区现有手泵进行专业维护的成本将低于让这些资产反复失效并修复的实际做法。随着乌干达和其他国家开始以维护为导向的后社区管理农村供水政策，资助者、从业者和研究者将需要应对如何协调机构激励以实现可持续融资的问题。

records.title_en: Crowd in or crowd out? The subnational fiscal response to aid
records.title_cn: 挤出还是挤入？地方财政对援助的响应
records.abstract_en: The fiscal response of aid recipients is crucially important to understanding the effects of aid. The dynamics of governments’ fiscal response to receiving aid can help reconcile the micro–macro aid puzzle, as well as having important implications for studying the micro effects of aid. I explore, in the context of Uganda from 2010 to 2017, whether IDA aid crowds out or crowds in government spending at the district level. To do so, I use an instrumental variables approach combining subnational variation with temporal variation and rich and detailed data on project aid and government budgets in Uganda. I find evidence that IDA funding leads to increases in government spending, and further evidence that these dynamics are more complex than simple follow-on in the same sector as IDA projects. These results suggest critical and underexplored dynamics in subnational fiscal responses to foreign aid, which may have important implications for the study of aid effectiveness.
records.abstract_cn: 受援国的财政响应对于理解援助效应至关重要。政府财政对接受援助的响应动态有助于调和微观-宏观援助之谜，并对研究援助的微观效应具有重要意义。我在乌干达2010年至2017年的背景下，探讨了IDA援助在地区层面是挤出还是挤入政府支出。为此，我采用工具变量方法，结合次国家级变异与时间变异，以及乌干达项目援助和政府预算的丰富详细数据。我发现证据表明IDA资金导致政府支出增加，并进一步证明这些动态比IDA项目在同一部门的简单后续效应更为复杂。这些结果表明，次国家级财政对外国援助的响应存在关键且未被充分探索的动态，这可能对援助有效性的研究具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Multidimensional forests: Complexity of forest-based values and livelihoods across Amazonian socio-cultural and geopolitical contexts
records.title_cn: 多维森林：亚马逊社会文化与地缘政治背景下森林价值与生计的复杂性
records.abstract_en: Research on the contribution of forests to local livelihoods has so far had a strong focus on quantifying the monetary value of forest-derived products and services. In this paper, we move beyond monetary valuation and integrate the less tangible and sometimes culturally complex dimensions through which forests support local livelihoods. We look at four local contexts in the Brazilian, Bolivian and Ecuadorian Amazon, which differ markedly in terms of their biophysical, sociocultural and geopolitical settings. Combining economic and anthropological data, we used quantitative and qualitative methods, and measures of the ecological impacts of local forest uses. Quantitative analyses drew on datasets from 48 communities, and 510 households, while the qualitative analyses relied on semi-structured interviews with 78 families in 22 communities. Forest-based livelihoods exhibited complex portfolios, diversified production systems, seasonal variation of activities, and different specialization strategies. Beyond a source of subsistence and cash incomes, forests were locally valued by people across all sites in terms of identities, worldviews, territorial attachment, governance, and conservation. Populations with a longer history of interactions with the environment displayed more complex forest-related cultural systems, but even among people who had migrated into the forest in a more recent historical period, forest-based self-cultural identification was evident. At all sites, forests were unanimously recognized as critical to people’s health and wellbeing, despite substantial differences in local histories, policy and market environments. The findings underscore the persistent importance of non-economic values of forests as both Indigenous and non-Indigenous groups constantly adapt their forest and land use practices based on transcultural exchange and changing conditions. A focus on economic value as the rationale for forest conservation disregards the striking resilience of cultural values in promoting forest conservation and use by diverse local and Indigenous communities, especially when supported by favorable policies and markets.
records.abstract_cn: 关于森林对当地生计贡献的研究迄今主要集中于量化森林产品与服务的货币价值。在本文中，我们超越货币估值，整合森林支持当地生计的较少有形且有时文化复杂的维度。我们考察了巴西、玻利维亚和厄瓜多尔亚马逊的四个地方背景，这些背景在生物物理、社会文化和地缘政治环境方面存在显著差异。结合经济与人类学数据，我们使用了定量和定性方法，以及当地森林利用的生态影响度量。定量分析基于48个社区和510个家庭的数据集，而定性分析依赖于对22个社区中78个家庭的半结构化访谈。以森林为基础的生计表现出复杂的组合、多样化的生产系统、活动的季节性变化以及不同的专业化策略。除了作为生计和现金收入的来源外，森林在所有地点都被当地人在身份认同、世界观、领土归属、治理和养护方面赋予价值。与环境互动历史较长的群体表现出更复杂的森林相关文化体系，但即使在较近期迁入森林的人群中，基于森林的自我文化认同也很明显。在所有地点，尽管当地历史、政策和市场环境存在显著差异，森林被一致认为是人们健康和福祉的关键。研究结果强调了森林非经济价值的持久重要性，因为原住民和非原住民群体不断根据跨文化交流和变化条件调整其森林和土地利用实践。将经济价值作为森林养护理由的关注忽视了文化价值在促进多样地方和原住民社区森林养护与利用方面的显著韧性，尤其是在有利政策和市场支持下。

records.title_en: Varieties of participatory institutions and interest intermediation
records.title_cn: 参与式制度的类型与利益中介
records.abstract_en: Although participatory institutions have become ubiquitous in contemporary politics, they often serve such different objectives that viewing the institutions as part of the same phenomenon can produce more confusion than clarity. We argue that participatory institutions can serve distinct and even opposite functions in interest intermediation, and develop a conceptual framework that distinguishes participatory institutions based on 1) what political project they were established to advance, 2) whose participation is channeled into these venues, and 3) how participatory institutions engage participants in the policymaking. We illustrate this framework with cases from Brazil, Peru, Venezuela, and Ecuador. We show that participatory institutions can serve a wide array of political projects that connect citizens to the state in radically different ways, including restructuring state-society relations to empower marginalized groups, increasing civil society influence over policymaking and government oversight, expanding parties’ electoral coalitions, and constraining the influence of disruptive social movements.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管参与式制度在当代政治中已无处不在，但它们往往服务于如此不同的目标，以至于将这些制度视为同一现象的一部分可能带来的困惑多于清晰。我们认为，参与式制度在利益中介中可以发挥不同甚至相反的功能，并提出了一个概念框架，根据1这些制度旨在推进的政治项目、2谁参与被引导进入这些场所，以及3参与式制度如何让参与者参与政策制定来区分参与式制度。我们用巴西、秘鲁、委内瑞拉和厄瓜多尔的案例来说明这一框架。我们表明，参与式制度可以服务于广泛的政治项目，以截然不同的方式将公民与国家联系起来，包括重构国家-社会关系以赋权边缘群体、增加公民社会对政策制定和政府监督的影响、扩大政党的选举联盟，以及限制破坏性社会运动的影响。

records.title_en: What makes a program good? Evidence from short-cycle higher education programs in five developing countries
records.title_cn: 什么使项目优质？来自五个发展中国家短期高等教育项目的证据
records.abstract_en: Short-cycle higher education programs (SCPs) can play a central role in skill development and higher education expansion, yet their quality varies greatly within and among countries. In this paper, we explore the relationship between programs’ practices and inputs (quality determinants) and student academic and labor market outcomes. We design and conduct a novel survey to collect program-level information on quality determinants and average outcomes for Brazil, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, and Peru. Categories of quality determinants include training and curriculum, infrastructure, faculty, link with productive sector, costs and funding, and practices on student admission and institutional governance. We also gather administrative student-level data on higher education and formal employment for SCP students in Brazil and Ecuador and match it to survey data. Using machine learning methods, we select the quality determinants that predict outcomes at the program and student levels. We show that specific quality determinants may favor academic and labor market outcomes. Two practices predict improvements in all labor market outcomes in Brazil and Ecuador—teaching numerical competencies and providing job market information—and one practice—teaching numerical competencies—additionally predicts improvements in labor market outcomes for all survey countries. Since quality determinants account for 20–40 percent of the explained variation in student-level outcomes, quality determinants might have a role shrinking program quality gaps. These findings have implications for the design and replication of high-quality SCPs, their regulation, and the development of information systems.
records.abstract_cn: 短期高等教育项目（SCPs）在技能发展和高等教育扩张中可以发挥核心作用，但其质量在国家内部和国家之间差异很大。在本文中，我们探讨了项目的实践和投入（质量决定因素）与学生学业和劳动力市场结果之间的关系。我们设计并实施了一项新颖的调查，以收集巴西、哥伦比亚、多米尼加共和国、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁的项目层面质量决定因素和平均结果信息。质量决定因素的类别包括培训和课程、基础设施、师资、与生产部门的联系、成本和资金，以及学生录取和机构治理的实践。我们还收集了巴西和厄瓜多尔SCP学生的高等教育和正规就业的行政学生层面数据，并将其与调查数据匹配。使用机器学习方法，我们选择了在项目和学生层面预测结果的质量决定因素。我们表明，特定的质量决定因素可能有利于学业和劳动力市场结果。在巴西和厄瓜多尔，有两种实践预测了所有劳动力市场结果的改善——教授数值能力和提供就业市场信息——而一种实践——教授数值能力——还额外预测了所有调查国家劳动力市场结果的改善。由于质量决定因素占学生层面结果解释变异的20-40%，质量决定因素可能在缩小项目质量差距方面发挥作用。这些发现对高质量SCP的设计和复制、其监管以及信息系统的开发具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Integrated policymaking: Institutional designs for implementing the sustainable development goals (SDGs)
records.title_cn: 综合政策制定：实施可持续发展目标（SDGs）的制度设计
records.abstract_en: Increased policy coherence and integrated implementation are necessary to address pressing development problems that cut across different sectors. Meeting these demands, as called for by the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, requires institutional innovation. Based on the comparative analysis of 137 countries, this paper investigates how governments have responded to this call and which contextual factors shape their institutional responses. We propose a four-dimensional typology to analyse the institutional set-ups for implementing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG), focusing on political leadership, horizontal integration across policy sectors, vertical integration across levels of government, and integration of societal stakeholders. We apply this framework to the descriptions of national SDG-implementation bodies provided by governments in their Voluntary National Review (VNRs) and use qualitative directed content analysis and regression modelling to investigate different driving factors of institutional design choices, including socio-economic development and political regime. Besides a strong commitment from the Centre of Government in most cases, our results show that ministries of the exterior and the environment have a dominant role, indicating that sustainability is not yet perceived holistically. Further, we find that the integration of subnational governments and societal actors is often under-institutionalised: while countries with higher levels of socio-economic development appear more likely to set up mechanisms suited to achieving cross-sectoral integration, political regime type seems to have little impact on institutional design choices for SDG implementation. Conceptually, this study offers a theory-led investigation of the institutional mechanisms for integrated SDG-implementation and the factors that drive institutional innovation or inertia. Empirically, by compiling the information in an original dataset, our study paves the way for future cross-national analysis on effective integrated SDG implementation and identifies entry points for inter- and transnational support of integrated SDG implementation in the context of development cooperation.
records.abstract_cn: 加强政策一致性和综合实施对于解决跨部门的紧迫发展问题至关重要。满足《2030年可持续发展议程》所提出的这些要求，需要制度创新。基于对137个国家的比较分析，本文探讨了各国政府如何回应这一呼吁，以及哪些背景因素塑造了其制度回应。我们提出了一个四维类型学来分析实施可持续发展目标（SDG）的制度安排，重点关注政治领导力、跨政策部门的横向整合、跨政府层级的纵向整合以及社会利益相关者的整合。我们将此框架应用于各国政府在其自愿国家审查（VNRs）中提供的国家SDG实施机构的描述，并使用定性定向内容分析和回归模型来研究制度设计选择的不同驱动因素，包括社会经济发展和政治体制。除了大多数情况下政府核心的坚定承诺外，我们的结果显示外交部与环境部占据主导地位，表明可持续性尚未被全面认知。此外，我们发现地方政府和社会行动者的整合往往制度化不足：虽然社会经济发展水平较高的国家似乎更可能建立适合实现跨部门整合的机制，但政治体制类型对SDG实施的制度设计选择似乎影响不大。在概念上，本研究提供了对综合SDG实施制度机制及其驱动制度创新或惯性的因素的理论导向调查。在实证上，通过将信息汇编成原始数据集，我们的研究为未来关于有效综合SDG实施的跨国分析铺平了道路，并确定了在发展合作背景下为综合SDG实施提供跨国家和跨国支持的切入点。

records.title_en: The scientific revolution and its implications for long-run economic development
records.title_cn: 科学革命及其对长期经济发展的影响
records.abstract_en: We analyze the role of the Scientific Revolution in the takeoff to sustained long-run economic development. Basic scientific knowledge is a necessary input in the production of applied knowledge, which, in turn, fuels productivity growth and leads to rising incomes. Subsequently, rising incomes instigate a fertility transition and foster education investments. Together, the increasing stocks of basic scientific knowledge and human capital, and the concomitant reduction in fertility enable economic development. In regions where scientific inquiry is severely constrained—for example, due to religious reasons or due to oppressive rulers—the takeoff is delayed or may not occur at all. This shows the importance of investing in basic scientific inquiry when trying to achieve long-run economic prosperity. Our framework could contribute to the understanding of why sustained economic development emerged first in Europe and not in technologically more advanced China.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了科学革命在向持续长期经济发展起飞中的作用。基础科学知识是应用知识生产中的必要投入，而应用知识又推动生产率增长并导致收入上升。随后，收入上升引发人口转变并促进教育投资。基础科学知识和人力资本存量的增加，以及随之而来的生育率下降，共同促进了经济发展。在科学探究受到严重限制的地区——例如，由于宗教原因或由于压迫性统治者——起飞被延迟或可能根本不会发生。这表明在追求长期经济繁荣时投资于基础科学探究的重要性。我们的框架可能有助于理解为什么持续经济发展首先出现在欧洲，而不是在技术上更先进的中国。

records.title_en: Narrowing women’s time and income gaps: An assessment of the synergies between working time reduction and universal income schemes
records.title_cn: 缩小女性的时间和收入差距：评估工作时间缩减与普遍收入计划之间的协同作用
records.abstract_en: This paper departs from the hypothesis that policies targeting time poverty have the potential to reduce the gender income gap through the redistribution of time use between women and men. To this purpose, we compare two policy mixes and assess the synergies between working time reduction and two universal income schemes: a basic income and care income programme. While the former provides every individual with an equal monetary benefit, the latter ties monetary benefits to the amount of unpaid and care work performed by individuals. We assess the impact of these policy mixes by applying Eurogreen, a macrosimulation model tailored to Italy. Results suggest that while working time reduction directly drives a reduction of the aggregate amount of time spent by women in unpaid work, this does not imply a reduction in time poverty. The universal income schemes – and in particular the care income – promote a reduction of gender inequality in terms of income by sustaining women’s total income, but leave the wage gap between women and men unchanged.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于这样一个假设：针对时间贫困的政策有可能通过重新分配女性和男性之间的时间使用来缩小性别收入差距。为此，我们比较了两种政策组合，并评估了工作时间缩减与两种普遍收入计划（基本收入和照护收入计划）之间的协同作用。前者为每个人提供平等的货币福利，而后者则将货币福利与个人从事的无偿和照护工作量挂钩。我们通过应用Eurogreen（一个针对意大利量身定制的宏观模拟模型）来评估这些政策组合的影响。结果表明，虽然工作时间缩减直接减少了女性在无偿工作上花费的总时间，但这并不意味着时间贫困的减少。普遍收入计划——尤其是照护收入——通过维持女性的总收入来促进性别收入不平等的减少，但男女之间的工资差距保持不变。

records.title_en: Child labor among farm households in Mozambique and the role of reciprocal adult labor
records.title_cn: 莫桑比克农户家庭中的童工现象与成人互助劳动的作用
records.abstract_en: We test the impact of a reciprocal adult labor program, Ajuda Mútua (AM), on child labor and schooling. AM was introduced into the province of Nampula in Mozambique, an area where farm production relies on child labor, potentially due to labor and financial market failures. Using difference in differences, we estimate that AM reduces child labor by eight percentage points. We argue that AM reduces child labor by providing low-cost adult labor and potentially increasing farm productivity. We benchmark the AM results against the impact of Village Saving and Loan Associations (VSLA) and AM and VSLA in combination (VAM). Neither VSLA nor VAM reduce child labor. If credit is used in a way that increases labor demand beyond what can be accommodated by AM labor, child labor may increase. We conclude that addressing labor market failures may be more successful at reducing child labor than addressing financial market failures. Results on schooling are mixed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们检验了成人互助劳动项目“互助援助”（AM）对童工和就学的影响。AM在莫桑比克楠普拉省引入，该地区的农业生产依赖童工，这可能是由于劳动力和金融市场失灵所致。使用双重差分法，我们估计AM使童工减少了八个百分点。我们认为AM通过提供低成本的成人劳动并可能提高农业生产力来减少童工。我们将AM的结果与村庄储蓄贷款协会（VSLA）以及AM和VSLA组合（VAM）的影响进行了基准比较。VSLA和VAM均未减少童工。如果信贷的使用方式导致劳动需求增加超出AM劳动所能满足的范围，童工可能会增加。我们得出结论，解决劳动力市场失灵可能比解决金融市场失灵更能有效地减少童工。就学方面的结果好坏参半。

records.title_en: Seeing like a smartphone: The co-production of landscape-scale and rights-based conservation
records.title_cn: 像智能手机一样看：景观尺度与基于权利的保护的共同生产
records.abstract_en: Landscape approaches are heralded as ways to advance more effective and equitable social-ecological governance by working across economic sectors and stakeholder groups. There remains a need, however, to understand how they are enacted in particular contexts, how rights-based efforts are pursued within them, and what this means for the protection of community rights. Developed in partnership by The Nature Conservancy and the Berau district government, the Berau Forest Carbon Program (BFCP) uses a landscape approach to advance REDD+ policy in East Kalimantan, Indonesia. Drawing on 26 months of ethnographic research across international, national, subnational, and village governance levels, I find the BFCP aligns with Indonesia’s national vision of green growth. Focusing on the BFCP’s rights-based instrument known as SIGAP, I find that it enacts and facilitates that green growth vision both through forest governance policy and as a malleable Foucauldian “technology of power.” Tracing how SIGAP has expanded over time from a community engagement protocol to become a multi-stakeholder platform and social media app, this work empirically documents how landscape-scale and rights-based conservation agendas recursively influence each other and that this dynamic co-production illuminates important tensions between rights-based agendas and projects of environmental governance. One example of such a tension is how the development and use of the SIGAP app is shown to preclude the recognition and discussion of stakeholder conflict and in so doing undermine community rights. Ultimately, this article presents a valuable case study for thinking through the diverse kinds of work rights-based instruments can do and centers the need for conservationists to recognize rights-based approaches not as technical toolkits but rather governance mechanisms to be considered and navigated appropriately.
records.abstract_cn: 景观方法被誉为通过跨经济部门和利益相关者群体合作来推进更有效和公平的社会-生态治理的途径。然而，仍然需要理解它们如何在特定背景下实施，如何在其中推进基于权利的努力，以及这对社区权利保护意味着什么。由大自然保护协会和贝劳区政府合作开发的贝劳森林碳计划（BFCP）采用景观方法推进印度尼西亚东加里曼丹的REDD+政策。基于跨越国际、国家、次国家和村庄治理层面的26个月民族志研究，我发现BFCP与印度尼西亚的绿色增长国家愿景相一致。聚焦于BFCP的基于权利的工具SIGAP，我发现它通过森林治理政策以及作为一种可塑的福柯式“权力技术”来实施和促进这一绿色增长愿景。通过追踪SIGAP如何随时间从社区参与协议扩展为多利益相关者平台和社交媒体应用程序，本研究实证记录了景观尺度和基于权利的保护议程如何递归地相互影响，并且这种动态的共同生产揭示了基于权利的议程与环境治理项目之间的重要张力。这种张力的一个例子是，SIGAP应用程序的开发和使用被证明排除了利益相关者冲突的识别和讨论，从而削弱了社区权利。最终，本文提供了一个有价值的案例研究，用于思考基于权利的工具可以做的各种工作，并强调保护主义者需要认识到基于权利的方法不是技术工具包，而是需要适当考虑和驾驭的治理机制。

records.title_en: Stakeholder perspectives on cocoa’s living income differential and sustainability trade-offs in Ghana
records.title_cn: 利益相关者对加纳可可生活收入差价与可持续性权衡的看法
records.abstract_en: Policy responses to balance the trade-offs between nature conservation and socioeconomic development have recently come to the fore in Ghana – the world’s second largest producer of cocoa. In 2019, the Government of Ghana introduced the Living Income Differential (LID), which requires buyers to pay an additional US$400 per ton of cocoa on top of the floor price. With low farmer incomes identified as a critical driver of multiple sustainability issues in Ghana’s cocoa sector, this differential is meant to be directly transferred to cocoa farmers in response to the persistent challenge of poverty in cocoa farming communities. Using the Q methodology, we engaged over 50 stakeholders from various levels (international policy experts, cocoa sector stakeholders in Ghana, and cocoa farmers) to understand how the LID is perceived, including its potential to transform the rural poverty complex embedded in Ghana’s cocoa supply chain. While the LID is lauded for increasing producer price across the board, our findings indicate that the lack of regard for farmer diversity (i.e., tenure rights, sharecroppers, and caretakers), farm size, and land management strategies (agroforestry versus clearing forest to establish farms) risks undermining the ability of this pricing mechanism to reduce farmer poverty. Further, the LID is siloed from on-going sustainability governance efforts in the sector, such as zero deforestation cocoa. If the LID is delivered to farmers across the board without any quid pro quo for how cocoa is produced, the policy’s unintended consequences may include increasing deforestation in the short term, while lowering the world market price of cocoa in the long term as cocoa supply increases. We conclude with policy implications on why different perspectives matter in managing sustainability trade-offs in deforestation frontiers.
records.abstract_cn: 平衡自然保护与社会经济发展之间权衡的政策响应最近在加纳——世界第二大可可生产国——成为焦点。2019年，加纳政府引入了生活收入差价（LID），要求买家在最低价格之上每吨可可额外支付400美元。鉴于农民收入低被确定为加纳可可部门多个可持续性问题的关键驱动因素，这一差价旨在直接转移给可可农民，以应对可可种植社区持续存在的贫困挑战。采用Q方法，我们与来自不同层级（国际政策专家、加纳可可部门利益相关者以及可可农民）的50多名利益相关者进行了接触，以了解LID如何被感知，包括其改变加纳可可供应链中根深蒂固的农村贫困复合体的潜力。尽管LID因全面提高了生产者价格而受到赞誉，但我们的研究结果表明，对农民多样性（即土地保有权、分成佃农和看护人）、农场规模和土地管理策略（农林复合经营与清理森林建立农场）缺乏考虑，可能会削弱这一定价机制减少农民贫困的能力。此外，LID与部门内正在进行的可持续性治理努力（如零毁林可可）相互孤立。如果LID不加区别地提供给所有农民，而不对可可生产方式提出任何交换条件，该政策的意外后果可能包括短期内增加毁林，而长期内随着可可供应增加而降低世界市场价格。我们最后总结了政策启示，说明在毁林前沿地带管理可持续性权衡时，不同视角为何重要。

records.title_en: Turning poo into profit? The troubled politics of a biogas-based sanitation business model in Mozambique
records.title_cn: 把粪便变成利润？莫桑比克基于沼气的卫生商业模式的多舛政治
records.abstract_en: Business models based on resource recovery and reuse (RRR) are presented by various actors as innovative and promising solutions to sanitation problems in development contexts. This article suggests that these models must be seen instead as a contemporary neoliberal approach to sanitation development, shaped by the RRR ‘waste regime’. Under this regime, (human) waste is not only revalued as a renewable resource rather than disposable dirt, but simultaneously treated as a potential commodity. The idea of poo as a potential resource and profitable commodity has given rise to the main promise of sanitation business models in development: long-term sustainability of sanitation facilities, based on cost-recovery or commercial viability through market-led innovation and entrepreneurship by the poor. I critically examine this promise for a sanitation business model piloted in two towns in Mozambique. This model sought to ‘turn poo into profit’ through the production and commercial use of biogas, extracted out of human and other types of waste using anaerobic digestion. The study, based on interviews and documentary analysis, finds that an exclusionary and contested ‘politics of poo’ underpinned the process of developing this model. The persistent, but increasingly fruitless pursuit of rendering the model commercially viable heavily divided the actors who were closely involved in the process, rendering the pilot contested. Actors who should have been closely involved, i.e. targeted people and the Mozambican public agency responsible for sanitation in the towns, were largely excluded in the process as they were not familiar with, or interested in, the ideas and market discourses specific to sanitation business models. The article concludes that those propagating sanitation business models based on biogas need to come to grips with the likelihood that poo may perhaps not have a golden future in development.
records.abstract_cn: 基于资源回收与再利用（RRR）的商业模式被各方行为体视为发展中背景下卫生问题的创新且有前景的解决方案。本文认为，这些模式应被视为当代新自由主义卫生发展路径，受RRR“废弃物体制”塑造。在该体制下，（人类）废弃物不仅被重新估价为可再生资源而非可弃置的污物，同时被当作潜在商品对待。粪便作为潜在资源和可盈利商品的想法催生了发展中卫生商业模式的主要承诺：基于成本回收或通过市场主导的创新和穷人创业实现商业可行性的卫生设施长期可持续性。我批判性地审视了这一承诺，针对在莫桑比克两个城镇试点的卫生商业模式。该模式试图通过厌氧消化从人类及其他类型废弃物中提取沼气，并加以生产和商业利用，从而实现“把粪便变成利润”。本研究基于访谈和文献分析，发现一种排他性的、充满争议的“粪便政治”支撑了该模式的发展过程。持续但日益徒劳的追求使该模式商业可行性的努力，严重分裂了密切参与该过程的行为体，使试点备受争议。本应密切参与的行为体，即目标人群和负责城镇卫生的莫桑比克公共机构，在很大程度上被排除在过程之外，因为他们不熟悉或不感兴趣于卫生商业模式特有的理念和市场话语。文章总结道，那些推广基于沼气的卫生商业模式的人需要正视这样一种可能性：粪便在发展领域或许并没有金色的未来。

records.title_en: Impact of a pension program on healthcare utilization among older farmers: Empirical evidence from health claims data
records.title_cn: 养老金计划对老年农民医疗利用的影响：来自健康索赔数据的实证证据
records.abstract_en: In many countries, family-owned farms are predominant, with self-employed farmers. When such farmers reach retirement age, they likely do not have access to pensions. Using the farmer pension program in Taiwan as an example, this study examines the effect of access to public pension on healthcare utilization among older farmers. We investigate whether this program affects healthcare utilization, number of visits, and the costs associated with outpatient or inpatient services and prescription drugs. We also explore whether these effects vary by medical specialty and the amount of pension received. By using health claims data from the universal health insurance program and a regression discontinuity design, we find that pension payments significantly increase the number of outpatient visits by 4% and outpatient expenditure by 5%. We also find that pension recipients spend more on family medicine, internal medicine, and Chinese medicine. As the pension program is designed to secure older farmers’ welfare, our results demonstrate an improvement in the health component of individual well-being.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多国家，家庭经营的农场占主导地位，农民多为自雇人士。当这些农民达到退休年龄时，他们可能无法获得养老金。以台湾的农民养老金计划为例，本研究考察了获得公共养老金对老年农民医疗利用的影响。我们调查该计划是否影响医疗利用、就诊次数以及与门诊或住院服务和处方药相关的费用。我们还探讨了这些影响是否因医学专业和养老金金额而异。通过使用全民健康保险计划的健康索赔数据和断点回归设计，我们发现养老金支付显著增加了门诊就诊次数4%和门诊支出5%。我们还发现，养老金领取者在家庭医学、内科和中医上的支出更多。由于养老金计划旨在保障老年农民的福利，我们的结果表明个人福祉中的健康组成部分得到了改善。

records.title_en: Health consequences of small-scale industrial pollution: Evidence from the brick sector in Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 小规模工业污染对健康的影响：来自孟加拉国砖厂的证据
records.abstract_en: Coal-fired brick kilns have spread rapidly in Bangladesh, where they are one of the largest sources of air pollution. The adverse health impacts of air pollution have been widely documented, yet there is little empirical evidence on the externalities of this important industry. We conducted a field study in Bangladesh to quantify the contribution of brick kilns to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and estimate the association with child asthma symptoms, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and general respiratory symptoms. We exploit variation in the timing of brick production, seasonal wind direction, and household proximity to kilns to isolate the effects of brick manufacturing from other sources of air pollution. We find that PM2.5 is 72.3 μg/m3 (95% CI: 10.2, 134.3) higher in areas 2 km downwind from a brick kiln during the brick production season. We also find 2.2 (95% CI: 1.2, 4.3) greater odds of COPD symptoms among adults over 40 and 4.2 (95% CI: 2.7, 6.8) greater odds of respiratory symptoms among adults over 18. Among children under 5, we found greater odds of respiratory symptoms (2.1, 95% CI: 0.7, 6.0) and asthma symptoms (2.5, 95% CI: 0.1, 96.1), but the results were underpowered for the smaller sample of children. Our findings suggest that existing regulations, which require that kilns be at least 1–2 km from residential areas, schools, and health facilities, are inadequate to protect nearby communities from the substantial health burden brick manufacturing imposes.
records.abstract_cn: 燃煤砖窑在孟加拉国迅速蔓延，是当地最大的空气污染源之一。空气污染对健康的不利影响已被广泛记录，但关于这一重要行业的外部性的实证证据却很少。我们在孟加拉国进行了一项实地研究，以量化砖窑对细颗粒物 (PM2.5) 的贡献，并估计与儿童哮喘症状、慢性阻塞性肺病 (COPD) 和一般呼吸道症状的关联。我们利用砖块生产时间、季节性风向以及家庭距离窑炉的距离的变化来隔离砖块制造与其他空气污染源的影响。我们发现，在砖生产季节，砖窑顺风 2 公里的区域 PM2.5 为 72.3 µg/m3 (95% CI: 10.2, 134.3) 较高。我们还发现，2.2 (95% CI: 1.2, 4.3) 成年人出现 COPD 症状的几率高于 40，4.2 (95% CI: 2.7, 6.8) 成年人出现呼吸道症状的几率高于 18。在 5 岁以下的儿童中，我们发现呼吸道症状（2.1、95% CI：0.7、6.0）和哮喘症状（2.5、95% CI：0.1、96.1）的可能性更大，但对于较小样本的儿童来说，结果不够有力。我们的研究结果表明，现有法规要求窑炉距离住宅区、学校和卫生设施至少 1-2 公里，不足以保护附近社区免受制砖带来的巨大健康负担。

records.title_en: Life expectancy across countries: Convergence, divergence and fluctuations
records.title_cn: 各国预期寿命：趋同、分化与波动
records.abstract_en: We document the evolution of life expectancies around the world during 1960-2015 using graphical analysis, statistical decomposition of survival gains by age-groups and by measuring the contribution of each age-group to changes in the global and regional distributions of life expectancy at birth. We emphasize three findings. First, enormous gains in early-life survival have led to unconditional convergence in life expectancy at birth across countries while late-life longevity has diverged. Gains have been higher for females than males. Secondly, global and regional survival gains among the elderly, though smaller than among the young, have strongly influenced changes in country rankings of life expectancy at birth with the exception of sub-Saharan Africa. Country rankings for late-life survival have changed relatively more than for younger ages. Third, the divergence in survival gains among the elderly is related to disparities in healthcare access, driven in part by within- and between-country income inequality. While providing fresh insight into the uneven pace of health changes during the past half century, these results also highlight how policy can address the socio-economic and demographic consequences of aging.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用图形分析、按年龄组对生存收益进行统计分解，并衡量各年龄组对全球和区域出生时预期寿命分布变化的贡献，记录了1960-2015年间世界各地的预期寿命演变。我们强调三个发现。首先，早期生存的巨大收益导致各国出生时预期寿命无条件趋同，而晚年寿命则出现分化。女性的收益高于男性。其次，全球和区域老年人生存收益虽小于年轻人，但对出生时预期寿命国家排名的变化产生了强烈影响，撒哈拉以南非洲除外。晚年生存的国家排名变化相对大于较年轻年龄组。第三，老年人生存收益的分化与医疗保健获取的不平等有关，部分由国内和国家间的收入不平等驱动。这些结果不仅为过去半个世纪健康变化的不均衡步伐提供了新见解，也强调了政策如何应对老龄化的社会经济和人口后果。

records.title_en: Village networks and entrepreneurial farming in Uganda
records.title_cn: 乌干达的村庄网络与创业型农业
records.abstract_en: The transition from semi-subsistence farming to more entrepreneurial farming by the adoption of new crops or improved seeds is important for poverty reduction in developing countries. In rural societies, farmers’ propensity to experiment with new technologies is influenced by their access to information and support, provided by networks of friends and relatives. Considering that the same connection can share both information and support, we study the separate effects as well as the interaction of both network functions. Using two waves of data from a sample of Ugandan farmers, we find that the propensity to adopt new crops or improved seeds increases with the number of friends or relatives who adopted new crops or improved seeds before. The effect on the adoption of new crops is stronger if the same friends or relatives also provide support in the form of gifts or loans. At the same time, we find a positive effect of support that is conditional on friends or relatives having adopted new crops before.
records.abstract_cn: 从半自给农业向更具创业精神的农业转变，通过采用新作物或改良种子，对于发展中国家的减贫至关重要。在农村社会中，农民尝试新技术的倾向受到其获取信息和支持的影响，这些信息和支持由朋友和亲属的网络提供。考虑到同一联系可以同时分享信息和支持，我们研究了这两种网络功能的单独效应及其相互作用。利用乌干达农民样本的两轮数据，我们发现采用新作物或改良种子的倾向随着之前采用新作物或改良种子的朋友或亲属数量的增加而增加。如果同样的朋友或亲属也以礼物或贷款的形式提供支持，那么对新作物采用的影响更强。同时，我们发现支持的正向效应是以朋友或亲属之前采用过新作物为条件的。

records.title_en: The hidden cost of global economic integration: How foreign investment drives military expenditures
records.title_cn: 全球经济一体化的隐性成本：外国投资如何推动军事支出
records.abstract_en: The global economy is increasingly integrated, with more than 60,000 international firms now directing almost one million foreign affiliates worldwide. We examine one significant, and largely unexplored, aspect of this integration – the cost of protecting these global investments. More specifically, we assess the extent to which foreign direct investment (FDI) drives military expenditures. Drawing from recent studies, we adopt a social network framework. Using data from the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development’s Bilateral FDI Statistics and the International Monetary Fund’s Coordinated Direct Investment Survey, we construct the global FDI network between 2001 and 2017 and derive out-degree centrality scores based on each country’s structural location in this network. Next, using data from the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, we estimate two-way fixed effects models for a global sample of 1,880 observations across 129 countries over this time period to assess the relationship between FDI centrality and military expenditures. We find that degree centrality in the global FDI network has a positive impact on military expenditures, net of other relevant predictors.Military expenditures do not, however, appear to drive FDI. We estimate the aggregate impact of FDI centrality on military expenditures, and suggest that these increased costs amount to a hidden subsidy of global corporate activity.
records.abstract_cn: 全球经济日益一体化，目前有超过60,000家国际企业在全球范围内指导着近一百万家外国子公司。我们考察了这一体化中一个重要且很大程度上未被探索的方面——保护这些全球投资的成本。更具体地说，我们评估了外国直接投资（FDI）推动军事支出的程度。借鉴近期研究，我们采用社会网络框架。利用联合国贸易和发展会议的双边FDI统计以及国际货币基金组织的协调直接投资调查数据，我们构建了2001年至2017年间的全球FDI网络，并根据各国在该网络中的结构位置得出出度中心性得分。接下来，利用斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所的数据，我们对该时间段内覆盖129个国家的1,880个观测值的全球样本估计了双向固定效应模型，以评估FDI中心性与军事支出之间的关系。我们发现，在控制其他相关预测因素后，全球FDI网络中的度中心性对军事支出有正向影响。然而，军事支出似乎并不推动FDI。我们估计了FDI中心性对军事支出的总体影响，并认为这些增加的成本相当于对全球企业活动的隐性补贴。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous impact of internet availability on female labor market outcomes in an emerging economy: Evidence from Indonesia
records.title_cn: 互联网可用性对新兴经济体中女性劳动力市场结果的异质性影响：来自印度尼西亚的证据
records.abstract_en: Greater female labor market participation benefits not only women's empowerment and the well-being of their families, but also the economy as a whole. Yet the labor force participation of women in developing countries is relatively stagnant, even with higher levels of economic development and better educational attainment. Women are also more likely to work in the informal sector and unskilled jobs. The arrival of the internet and the subsequent creation of internet-based jobs may positively affect women's labor market outcomes. In this paper, we examine the effect of internet availability on five dimensions of women's labor market outcomes in Indonesia, focusing on the heterogeneity in the impact of internet availability on female labor market outcomes. We construct a balanced pseudo panel covering all districts in the country for 2008 – 2018. We find that internet availability has a small positive effect on the labor force participation and full-time employment of younger or low-educated women. We find a small negative effect on the likelihood of holding skilled jobs for these groups of women. We also find a small negative effect on job formality. These effects are concentrated among low-educated women. The findings are mainly explained by the kind of internet-based jobs that were created in the country. On balance, we do not find evidence that the internet significantly improves women's labor market outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 女性劳动力市场参与度的提高不仅有利于女性赋权及其家庭的福祉，也有利于整体经济。然而，在发展中国家，即使经济发展水平和教育程度有所提高，女性的劳动力参与率仍相对停滞。女性也更可能从事非正规部门和非技术性工作。互联网的出现以及随后基于互联网的工作岗位的创造，可能对女性的劳动力市场结果产生积极影响。在本文中，我们考察了互联网可用性对印度尼西亚女性劳动力市场结果五个维度的影响，重点关注互联网可用性对女性劳动力市场结果影响的异质性。我们构建了一个覆盖全国所有地区的平衡伪面板，时间跨度为2008-2018年。我们发现，互联网可用性对年轻或低教育水平女性的劳动力参与和全职就业有较小的正向影响。我们发现，对这些女性群体而言，互联网可用性对从事技术性工作的可能性有较小的负向影响。我们还发现，互联网可用性对工作正规性有较小的负向影响。这些影响主要集中在低教育水平女性中。这些发现主要归因于该国创造的基于互联网的工作岗位类型。总体而言，我们没有发现证据表明互联网显著改善了女性的劳动力市场结果。

records.title_en: Fighting against hunger: A country-wide intervention and its impact on birth outcomes
records.title_cn: 抗击饥饿：一项全国性干预及其对出生结局的影响
records.abstract_en: In 2013 the Mexican government launched Sin Hambre (SH), a large-scale food assistance policy, with which to fight hunger, and which the government expressly intended to improve nutrition and access to food. This study applies a difference-in-differences approach using timing and regional variations in exposure to evaluate the impact of SH, particularly on average birthweight. Because municipalities were not selected randomly, the approach employs a method proposed by Imai et al. (2021) that improves the confidence to satisfy the parallel trend assumption under staggered adoption. Findings reveal that exposure to SH leads to, at most, moderate impacts on birthweight across various specifications.
records.abstract_cn: 2013年，墨西哥政府启动了“无饥饿”（Sin Hambre, SH）这一大规模食品援助政策，旨在抗击饥饿，并明确意图改善营养和食物获取。本研究采用双重差分方法，利用暴露时间的先后和地区差异来评估SH政策的影响，特别是对平均出生体重的影响。由于市政当局并非随机选择，该方法采用了Imai等人（2021年）提出的方法，在交错采用的情况下提高满足平行趋势假设的信心。研究结果显示，在各种设定下，暴露于SH政策对出生体重的影响至多为中等程度。

records.title_en: How political insiders lose out when international aid underperforms: Evidence from a participatory development experiment in Ghana
records.title_cn: 当国际援助表现不佳时，政治内部人士如何受损：来自加纳参与式发展实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Although participatory development often aims specifically to mitigate problems from political biases and party-based clientelism, the path is complicated and depends critically on the efficacy of underlying programs as well as how they interact with pre-existing institutions. We provide a framework to understand when participatory development is likely to generate politically biased benefits, showing that even if participatory aid is neutrally allocated, neutral benefit realizations occur only under specific circumstances. We apply this framework to a five-year randomized controlled study of a major participatory development program in Ghana, analyzing the program’s effects on participation in, leadership of, and investment by pre-existing political institutions, and on households’ overall socioeconomic well-being. We find the government and its political supporters acted with high expectations for the participatory approach: treatment led to increased participation in local governance and reallocation of resources. But the results did not meet expectations, resulting in a worsening of socioeconomic wellbeing in treatment versus control villages for government supporters. This demonstrates aid’s complex distributional consequences.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管参与式发展通常旨在专门缓解政治偏见和党派庇护主义带来的问题，但其路径复杂，且关键取决于基础项目的有效性以及它们与既有制度的互动方式。我们提供了一个框架来理解参与式发展何时可能产生政治偏见的利益，表明即使参与式援助被中立分配，中立的利益实现也仅在特定情况下发生。我们将此框架应用于加纳一个大型参与式发展项目的五年随机对照研究，分析该项目对既有政治制度中的参与、领导力和投资，以及家庭整体社会经济福祉的影响。我们发现政府及其政治支持者对参与式方法抱有高度期望：处理导致了地方治理参与度的提高和资源的重新分配。但结果未达到预期，导致处理村中政府支持者的社会经济福祉相对于对照村有所恶化。这展示了援助复杂的分配后果。

records.title_en: Gender wage discrimination with employer prejudice and trade openness
records.title_cn: 雇主偏见与贸易开放下的性别工资歧视
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of trade liberalisation on gender wage inequality. A simple trade model with employer taste-based discrimination and imperfect competition provides an explanation for the heterogeneous effects of international trade on the gender wage gap within sectors. While import competition reduces rents and with them the gender wage gap, the effect of exports depends on the level of concentration of a sector. On the one hand, easier access to foreign markets has a competition effect through the selection of the low-cost firms in non-concentrated sectors. On the other hand, better export opportunities with easier access to foreign markets can increase profits of domestic firms’ in concentrated sectors and thus enable discriminatory firms to maintain wage gaps. Evidence from Uruguay supports the empirical relevance of the taste-based discrimination mechanism at the sector level.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了贸易自由化对性别工资不平等的影响。一个包含雇主基于偏好的歧视和不完全竞争的简单贸易模型，为国际贸易对部门内性别工资差距的异质性影响提供了解释。进口竞争减少了租金，从而缩小了性别工资差距，而出口的影响则取决于部门的集中程度。一方面，更容易进入外国市场通过非集中部门中低成本企业的选择产生竞争效应。另一方面，更容易进入外国市场带来的更好出口机会可以增加集中部门中国内企业的利润，从而使歧视性企业能够维持工资差距。来自乌拉圭的证据支持了部门层面基于偏好的歧视机制的经验相关性。

records.title_en: The flag and the stick: Aid suspensions, human rights, and the problem of the complicit public
records.title_cn: 旗帜与棍棒：援助暂停、人权与共谋公众的问题
records.abstract_en: Foreign aid donors often use, or are expected to use, the threat of aid suspensions in response to human rights violations. The use of such conditionality seeks to pressure the ‘recipient’ government into ending or preventing rights abuses. This article argues that this approach tacitly relies on the assumption that most citizens in the recipient country oppose their government’s rights violations. However, in recent years, and particularly linked to the rise of populism, there has been growing recognition of instances around the world in which significant parts of the public support government actions giving rise to human rights violations. Drawing in particular on the example of donor responses to recent efforts to introduce repressive anti-homosexuality legislation in Uganda, the article argues that such cases present donors with a dilemma that arises because the threat of aid suspensions serves two distinct but related purposes: an instrumental function (‘the stick’), whereby the threat of withdrawing aid is used to pressure the ‘recipient’ government into ending the rights violation; and an expressive function (‘the flag’) that is often overlooked, whereby conditionality signals the donor government’s commitment to international human rights norms. While typically these two functions of aid conditionality reinforce one another, we show that when faced with a ‘complicit public’, the stick and flag come apart, generating the dilemma for donors. The threat of aid sanctions is likely to trigger a public backlash but refraining from effective criticism will undermine support for international human rights norms. Based on this analysis, the article provides a framework for recognizing and evaluating potential responses to this dilemma that considers the salient political and ethical features of such contexts. In doing so, it demonstrates the importance of understanding the political ethics of aid suspensions and other donor responses to human rights violations.
records.abstract_cn: 外国援助捐赠者经常使用或预期使用暂停援助的威胁来回应人权侵犯。这种条件性的使用旨在向‘受援国’政府施压，以终止或防止权利滥用。本文认为，这种方法默认依赖于一个假设，即受援国的大多数公民反对其政府的权利侵犯行为。然而，近年来，特别是与民粹主义的兴起相关，世界各地越来越多地认识到，相当一部分公众支持导致人权侵犯的政府行动的情况。本文特别借鉴了捐赠者对乌干达近期引入压制性反同性恋立法努力的回应案例，认为此类情况给捐赠者带来了一个困境，因为暂停援助的威胁服务于两个不同但相关的目的：工具性功能（‘棍棒’），即利用撤资威胁向‘受援国’政府施压以终止权利侵犯；以及表达性功能（‘旗帜’），这常常被忽视，即条件性传达捐赠国政府对国际人权规范的承诺。虽然援助条件性的这两种功能通常相互加强，但我们表明，当面对‘共谋公众’时，棍棒和旗帜会分离，从而给捐赠者带来困境。援助制裁的威胁可能引发公众反弹，但避免有效批评将削弱对国际人权规范的支持。基于这一分析，本文提供了一个框架，用于识别和评估对这一困境的可能回应，该框架考虑了此类背景下的显著政治和伦理特征。通过这样做，它展示了理解援助暂停及其他捐赠者对侵犯人权回应的政治伦理的重要性。

records.title_en: Agricultural value chains in a fragile state: The case of rice in Myanmar
records.title_cn: 脆弱国家中的农业价值链：缅甸大米案例
records.abstract_en: The large majority of extreme poor in the world lives in fragile states. Yet, despite the enormous importance of these areas for global poverty and food insecurity, there is relatively little research examining how agricultural value chains, crucial for assuring food security, respond and adapt to such contexts. This paper analyzes Myanmar’s rice value chain – its most important staple and biggest value chain – during the economic collapse and political instability caused by a military coup in early 2021. It relies on unique data collected with a large sample of rice retailers and millers before and after the coup. Despite many challenges in the rice value chain after the coup – most importantly linked to banking and transport – rice processing and trade continued, assuring availability of rice in most retail markets and illustrating the resilience of the value chain to such major shock. While processing margins were mostly stable, an increased distribution margin (between rice millers and retailers) led to 11 percent higher average retail prices after the coup, implying welfare losses of almost USD 0.5 billion for the country. Using a market-pair regression method, we further find that localized violence near sellers and buyers, distances traveled, and distance of vendors from borders are associated with significantly increased rice price dispersion between rice retailers and mills. Despite the amalgam of problems to address in such settings, prioritizing the easing of transport restrictions and facilitating cheap and safe spatial arbitrage of food products would likely help prevent further food price inflation, assure higher farm prices, and therefore improve welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 世界上绝大多数极端贫困人口生活在脆弱国家。然而，尽管这些地区对全球贫困和粮食不安全具有极其重要的意义，但关于农业价值链（对确保粮食安全至关重要）如何应对和适应此类环境的研究相对较少。本文分析了缅甸大米价值链——其最重要的主食和最大的价值链——在2021年初军事政变导致的经济崩溃和政治不稳定期间的情况。研究依赖于政变前后对大量大米零售商和碾米厂收集的独特数据。尽管政变后大米价值链面临诸多挑战——最重要的是与银行和运输相关的挑战——大米加工和贸易仍在继续，确保了大多数零售市场的大米供应，并展示了价值链对此类重大冲击的韧性。虽然加工利润率基本稳定，但分销利润率（碾米厂与零售商之间）的上升导致政变后平均零售价格上涨了11%%，意味着该国福利损失近0.5亿美元。使用市场配对回归方法，我们进一步发现，卖方和买方附近的局部暴力、运输距离以及供应商与边境的距离与大米零售商和碾米厂之间大米价格离散度的显著增加相关。尽管此类环境中需要解决的问题众多，但优先放宽运输限制并促进食品低成本、安全的跨区域套利，可能有助于防止进一步的食物价格通胀，确保更高的农场价格，从而改善福利。

records.title_en: Bank deregulation and corporate environmental performance
records.title_cn: 银行放松管制与企业环境绩效
records.abstract_en: In this study, we provide one of the first pieces of evidence about how bank deregulation affects corporate environmental performance. We use a unique dataset that contains rich information on firms’ toxic emissions and exploit the bank branching deregulation policy in China. We find that bank deregulation significantly improves firms’ environmental performance, as measured by lower emission intensity of chemical oxygen demand (COD). We further demonstrate that these firms’ production efficiency increases and the ratio of tangible assets to total assets decreases, which suggests that upgrading technology and asset mix are the main channels. To improve the efficiency of the banking system, many developing countries are undergoing or moving toward bank deregulation. By focusing on corporate environmental performance, we document an important but unanticipated result of bank deregulation, and the results also provide policy implications for the burgeoning reform in green finance.
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们提供了关于银行放松管制如何影响企业环境绩效的首批证据之一。我们使用了一个包含企业有毒排放丰富信息的独特数据集，并利用了中国银行分支机构放松管制政策。我们发现银行放松管制显著改善了企业的环境绩效，以化学需氧量（COD）排放强度降低为衡量标准。我们进一步证明，这些企业的生产效率提高，有形资产占总资产的比例下降，这表明技术升级和资产组合调整是主要渠道。为提高银行体系的效率，许多发展中国家正在经历或走向银行放松管制。通过关注企业环境绩效，我们记录了银行放松管制的一个重要但未预料到的结果，这些结果也为绿色金融的新兴改革提供了政策启示。

records.title_en: The Agency, Resources, and Institutional Structures for Sanitation-related Empowerment (ARISE) Scales: Development and validation of measures of women’s empowerment in urban sanitation for low- and middle-income countries
records.title_cn: 卫生相关赋权的机构、资源与制度结构（ARISE）量表：针对中低收入国家城市卫生领域女性赋权测量工具的开发和验证
records.abstract_en: Sustainable Development Goal 6 aims to ensure access to water and sanitation for all, and target 6.2 emphasizes “paying special attention to the needs of women and girls”. Research documenting how water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) conditions impact women’s and girls’ lives is growing. However, no rigorously validated survey instruments exist for measuring empowerment within the WASH sector. The objective of our study was to develop and validate survey instruments to measure sub-domains of women’s empowerment in relation to sanitation in urban areas of low- and middle-income countries. We followed a multi-phased, theory-informed approach that included factor analysis and item response theory methods, as well as reliability and validity testing, to analyze cross-sectional data collected from women in two cities: Tiruchirappalli, India (N = 996) and Kampala, Uganda (N = 1,024). Through rigorous evaluation of conceptually grounded question (item) sets, we identify a set of valid, comprehensive scales. The Agency, Resources, and Institutional Structures for Sanitation-related Empowerment (ARISE) scales represent 16 sub-domains of sanitation-related empowerment, each of which can be used alone or in combination with others, as needed. The ARISE scales are the only set of psychometrically validated metrics for the measurement of women’s empowerment in WASH. In addition to the scales, we provide six indices to assess women’s direct experiences with sub-domains of sanitation-related empowerment, as well as validated item sets related to menstruation, which are available as optional add-on measures for those who menstruate. The ARISE scales and associated survey modules respond to an established need for an increased focus on empowerment in WASH. We provide researchers and implementers with tools to measure sub-constructs of empowerment in a valid and reliable way, to generate data for better targeting, design, implementation, and evaluation of strategies to improve women’s empowerment in the context of urban sanitation at the program and policy level.
records.abstract_cn: 可持续发展目标6旨在确保人人享有水和卫生设施，具体目标6.2强调“特别关注妇女和女童的需求”。记录水、环境卫生和个人卫生（WASH）条件如何影响妇女和女童生活的研究日益增多。然而，目前尚无经过严格验证的调查工具用于衡量WASH领域的赋权。我们研究的目的是开发和验证调查工具，以衡量中低收入国家城市地区与卫生相关的女性赋权的子领域。我们采用了多阶段、理论指导的方法，包括因子分析和项目反应理论方法，以及信度和效度检验，分析了来自两个城市女性的横断面数据：印度蒂鲁奇拉帕利（N = 996）和乌干达坎帕拉（N = 1,024）。通过对概念上有依据的问题（项目）集进行严格评估，我们确定了一套有效、全面的量表。卫生相关赋权的机构、资源与制度结构（ARISE）量表代表了卫生相关赋权的16个子领域，每个子领域可根据需要单独使用或与其他子领域结合使用。ARISE量表是唯一一套经过心理测量学验证的用于衡量WASH领域女性赋权的指标。除量表外，我们还提供了六个指数来评估女性在卫生相关赋权子领域的直接经历，以及与月经相关的经过验证的项目集，这些项目集可作为针对月经人群的可选附加测量模块。ARISE量表及相关调查模块回应了在WASH领域增加赋权关注的既定需求。我们为研究人员和实施者提供了以有效可靠的方式衡量赋权子构念的工具，以生成数据，用于更好地在项目和政策层面针对城市卫生背景下的女性赋权进行目标定位、设计、实施和评估策略。

records.title_en: Productivity gaps at formal and informal microfirms
records.title_cn: 正规与非正规微型企业的生产率差距
records.abstract_en: Although evidence of a productivity gap between formal and informal firms has been observed, this “formality premium” has been less explored for microfirms. The informality of microfirms is a central concern in low- and middle-income countries, leading to a crucial demand for designing economic policies addressing this issue. We fill this void by estimating a productivity premium for the case of Colombia, considering two margins of formality for microfirms: extensive, referring to business registration, and intensive, which includes labor regulations. We use a unique longitudinal dataset from the Microenterprise Survey by the Colombian Statistics Department, which follows approximately 39,000 micro-establishments with up to nine employees during 2012–2016. We utilize the transition into and out of formality to estimate the productivity premium (yearly sales per worker) between informal and formal firms, thereby exploring differences concerning initial productivity. We use a fixed-effects quantile regression to explore differential effects along the productivity distribution. We find evidence of a premium for both the extensive (18%) and intensive margins (7%), a gap that decreases with a firm’s productivity when considering a strict definition of formality. The evidence of these premiums is related to two growth strategies of firms: an increase in capital investments for the extensive margin and an increase in human capital quality for the intensive margin. Further, we find the premium is notably wider for young firms (less than three years in the business) relative to the older; and for the least productive ‘necessity’ driven businesses in comparison with the business-driven businesses. We do not find systematic differences according to the gender of the owners. These results are new evidence to support the existence of a premium and the transition into and out of formality for microfirms in middle-income countries. Moreover, they suggest that microfirms’ formalization and growth policies should be oriented toward promoting and enhancing formality’s benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管已有证据表明正规与非正规企业之间存在生产率差距，但这种“正规性溢价”在微型企业中研究较少。微型企业的非正规性是低收入和中等收入国家的一个核心关切，因此迫切需要设计解决这一问题的经济政策。我们通过估算哥伦比亚案例中的生产率溢价来填补这一空白，考虑了微型企业正规性的两个维度：广泛边际（指企业注册）和密集边际（包括劳动法规）。我们使用了哥伦比亚统计部门微观企业调查中的独特纵向数据集，该调查在2012-2016年间跟踪了约39,000家雇员不超过九人的微型企业。我们利用企业进入和退出正规性的转变来估算非正规与正规企业之间的生产率溢价（每位员工的年销售额），从而探讨与初始生产率相关的差异。我们使用固定效应分位数回归来探索生产率分布上的异质性效应。我们发现，广泛边际（18%）和密集边际（7%）均存在溢价，且在采用严格的正规性定义时，这一差距随企业生产率的提高而缩小。这些溢价的证据与企业的两种增长策略相关：广泛边际对应资本投资的增加，密集边际对应人力资本质量的提升。此外，我们发现年轻企业（经营年限不足三年）的溢价明显高于老企业；而生产率最低的“生存型”企业相比“机会型”企业溢价更高。我们没有发现所有者性别方面的系统性差异。这些结果为新证据，支持中等收入国家微型企业存在正规性溢价以及进入和退出正规性的转变。此外，它们表明，微型企业的正规化和增长政策应旨在促进和增强正规性的益处。

records.title_en: Drivers of growth accelerations: What role for capital accumulation?
records.title_cn: 增长加速的驱动因素：资本积累扮演什么角色？
records.abstract_en: Economic growth is often episodic but the ultimate drivers of such growth accelerations are not understood very well. We therefore take a different perspective and investigate what happens to production factors and productivity before, during, and after 156 growth accelerations that we identify for 148 countries between 1950 and 2019. We are particularly interested in the role that physical capital accumulation can play in this context, given recent interest in investment surges and several investment-led growth models.
records.abstract_cn: 经济增长往往是间歇性的，但此类增长加速的最终驱动因素尚未被充分理解。因此，我们采取不同的视角，考察在1950年至2019年间为148个国家识别的156次增长加速之前、期间和之后，生产要素和生产率发生了什么变化。鉴于近期对投资激增和若干投资主导型增长模型的关注，我们特别关注实物资本积累在此背景下可能发挥的作用。

records.title_en: Following your lead: Migration networks and immigrants' education decisions
records.title_cn: 跟随你的引领：移民网络与移民的教育决策
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the effect of immigrant networks on the education of school-age Salvadoran immigrants in the United States. I construct an instrument for the network size in the U.S. using previous settlement patterns and municipality-level push factors in El Salvador such as crime, agricultural land use, and economic development. I find that Salvadoran immigrants lose half a year of education when their network size exogenously increases by 1 standard deviation (4.7% decrease). Causal links between the education decisions of immigrants and their network may partly explain the low level of education attained by new young immigrants. Immigrants with more education may assimilate better into their host countries and contribute to their economies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了移民网络对美国学龄萨尔瓦多移民教育的影响。我利用先前定居模式以及萨尔瓦多市级层面的推动因素（如犯罪、农业土地利用和经济发展）构建了美国网络规模的工具变量。我发现，当网络规模外生增加1个标准差（下降4.7%）时，萨尔瓦多移民平均损失半年的教育。移民教育决策与其网络之间的因果联系可能部分解释了新年轻移民教育水平低下的现象。受教育程度更高的移民可能更好地融入东道国并为其经济做出贡献。

records.title_en: Child health and the housing environment
records.title_cn: 儿童健康与住房环境
records.abstract_en: We propose and test an internationally-comparable country-level index of the adequacy of the housing environment for protecting children from ill-health. The housing environment for protection (HEP) index combines seven easily-monitored indicators of housing conditions related to communications, density of occupants, toilet and handwashing facilities, the use of finished construction materials, and cooking facilities. In calibrating and validating the HEP index, the paper uses infant mortality, the incidence of child illnesses and child stunting. We calculate the HEP index for the 41 developing countries with complete recent data from the Demographic and Health Surveys. We find that only 8% of households fully comply with all our identified housing conditions, though there is considerable variation across countries, with full compliance varying from virtually zero to almost 60% of households. A poor HEP is found to be associated with significantly worse health outcomes among children. This finding is robust to adding controls for likely confounders such as income and poverty. Our results suggest that reducing the incidence of ill-health among children is in part achieved by reducing income poverty, but also depends crucially on how much income gains tend to directly improve housing conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出并测试了一个国际可比较的国家级住房环境充分性指数，该指数用于评估住房环境在保护儿童免受疾病侵害方面的充分性。住房保护环境（HEP）指数结合了七项易于监测的住房条件指标，涉及通讯、居住密度、厕所和洗手设施、成品建筑材料的使用以及烹饪设施。在校准和验证HEP指数时，本文使用了婴儿死亡率、儿童疾病发病率和儿童发育迟缓数据。我们计算了来自人口与健康调查的41个拥有完整近期数据的发展中国家的HEP指数。我们发现，尽管各国之间存在显著差异，完全符合我们所有确定住房条件的家庭比例从几乎为零到接近60%不等，但仅有8%的家庭完全符合所有条件。研究发现，较差的HEP与儿童健康状况显著恶化相关。这一发现在加入可能混淆因素（如收入和贫困）的控制变量后依然稳健。我们的结果表明，降低儿童疾病发病率部分通过减少收入贫困实现，但也关键取决于收入增长是否倾向于直接改善住房条件。

records.title_en: Methodological lessons for negotiating power, political capabilities, and resilience in research on climate change responses
records.title_cn: 关于气候变化应对研究中权力、政治能力与韧性谈判的方法论启示
records.abstract_en: Critical scholarship on the intersection of development pathways and climate change responses highlights the roles of power, agency, social difference, intersecting inequalities, and social justice in shaping people’s resilience in a rapidly transforming world. Yet, how to precisely increase the spaces in which people experiencing marginalisation can address power asymmetries and strengthen their resilience, particularly from a methodological perspective, remains poorly understood. Here, we build on recent insights into political capabilities and their relevance for equitable resilience practice to assess the role research methods play in not only locating political capabilities but also enhancing them in the context of climate resilience. We present the findings from an in-depth analysis of 57 articles, out of a larger set of 200+ papers, that have employed co-learning/cooperative inquiries, participatory action research, participatory methods, workshops, and/or interviews combined with other approaches as most engaging and potentially empowering methods. Methodological insights through this analysis allow us to examine if and how resilience-in-the-making materialises across uneven power relations and often flawed decision-making processes. We show the pervasiveness of power differentials, even in research settings designed to be inclusive, and how disempowering processes in adaptation, mitigation, disaster management, and social transformation further marginalise already disadvantaged actors. At the same time, we illustrate the transformative role of alliances, resistance, shared learning, and sustaining inclusive approaches. Such nuanced insights into best processes as well as detrimental pitfalls are essential for development scholars and practitioners to help anchor deliberative resilience practice in the everyday lives of disadvantaged populations and foster political capabilities for more just climate action and policy.
records.abstract_cn: 关于发展路径与气候变化应对交叉领域的批判性学术研究强调了权力、能动性、社会差异、交叉不平等和社会正义在塑造人们于快速变化世界中的韧性方面的作用。然而，如何精确地扩大边缘化人群能够解决权力不对称并增强其韧性的空间，特别是从方法论角度来看，仍然知之甚少。在此，我们基于近期关于政治能力及其与公平韧性实践相关性的见解，评估研究方法在定位政治能力以及在气候韧性背景下增强这些能力方面的作用。我们展示了对57篇文章的深入分析结果，这些文章来自更大的200余篇论文集合，这些文章采用了共同学习/合作探究、参与式行动研究、参与式方法、研讨会和/或访谈与其他方法相结合的方式，被认为是最具参与性和潜在赋权性的方法。通过这一分析获得的方法论见解使我们能够检验韧性形成过程是否以及如何在不平等的权力关系和往往有缺陷的决策过程中实现。我们展示了权力差异的普遍性，即使在旨在包容的研究环境中也是如此，以及适应、减缓、灾害管理和社会转型中的去权过程如何进一步边缘化本已处于不利地位的参与者。同时，我们说明了联盟、抵抗、共享学习和维持包容性方法的变革性作用。这些关于最佳过程以及有害陷阱的细致见解对于发展学者和实践者至关重要，有助于将协商性韧性实践锚定在弱势群体的日常生活中，并培养政治能力以促进更公正的气候行动和政策。

records.title_en: Women’s work in India: Evidence from changes in time use between 1998 and 2019
records.title_cn: 印度女性的工作：来自1998年至2019年时间使用变化的证据
records.abstract_en: I provide evidence on long-run changes in women’s work for six Indian states common to the 1998–99 and 2019 time-use surveys. Rural women experienced large decreases in work time (especially paid work) but urban women did not. Men experienced larger declines in paid work but partly compensated with greater self-employment. Changes in self-reported “principal usual activity status” that are typically used to measure labour force participation do not provide an accurate measure of these changes in work time. Declining work for rural women is observed regardless of self-reported usual activity status, education level, caste/religious group, or state. Leisure time for women increased, reducing the gender-gap in leisure by 50%.
records.abstract_cn: 我提供了关于印度六个邦女性工作长期变化的证据，这些邦在1998-99年和2019年的时间使用调查中均有覆盖。农村女性的工作时间大幅减少（尤其是有偿工作），但城市女性并非如此。男性的有偿工作下降幅度更大，但部分通过增加自雇来补偿。通常用于衡量劳动力参与率的自我报告“主要通常活动状态”的变化并不能准确反映这些工作时间的变化。无论自我报告的通常活动状态、教育水平、种姓/宗教群体或邦如何，农村女性工作时间的下降均被观察到。女性的闲暇时间增加，使闲暇时间中的性别差距缩小了50%。

records.title_en: Mapping community development aid: Spatial analysis in Myanmar
records.title_cn: 绘制社区发展援助地图：缅甸的空间分析
records.abstract_en: Development aid has greater potential to alleviate poverty when targeted towards areas of concentrated need. However, the body of research examining subnational aid targeting is often constrained to state- or district-level analysis due to the lack of aid or wealth data in small regions. This study fills this gap by examining the poverty orientation of aid at the granular spatial units where the pro-poor interventions are implemented. Specifically, it explores the extent to which community-centered development (CCD) in Myanmar takes place in poor villages. This paper estimates aid presence and density, given regional poverty, by linking detailed aid location with nightlight luminosity and wealth-related data. Overall, densely aided areas tend to shine brighter and have a lower share of vulnerable populations. However, for villages with similar luminosity, aid goes to areas with fewer resources. This study also finds heterogeneity in the targeting practice among donors who adopt different ideologies. The market-oriented World Bank project supports poorer villages whereas the Korean International Cooperation Agency’s project, drawing from the developmental state, includes villages close to conflict zones. Some evidence of needs-based allocation in this study runs counter to previous findings that aid favors richer states and districts. The result of this study suggests that analyzing aid at a fine-grained level with high resolution spatial data can provide a more nuanced view of aid targeting.
records.abstract_cn: 发展援助在针对需求集中地区时，更有可能减轻贫困。然而，由于缺乏小区域的援助或财富数据，研究次国家级援助瞄准的文献往往局限于州或区级分析。本研究通过考察在实施有利于穷人的干预措施的精细空间单元上援助的贫困导向，填补了这一空白。具体而言，它探讨了缅甸以社区为中心的发展（CCD）在多大程度上发生在贫困村庄。本文通过将详细的援助位置与夜间灯光亮度和财富相关数据联系起来，估计了在给定区域贫困情况下的援助存在和密度。总体而言，援助密集的地区往往更亮，脆弱人口比例更低。然而，对于亮度相似的村庄，援助流向资源较少的地区。本研究还发现，采取不同意识形态的捐助者之间的瞄准实践存在异质性。以市场为导向的世界银行项目支持较贫困的村庄，而韩国国际协力团的项目则借鉴发展型国家理念，包括靠近冲突地区的村庄。本研究中一些基于需求的分配证据与先前关于援助偏向较富裕州和区的发现相悖。本研究的结果表明，利用高分辨率空间数据在细粒度层面分析援助可以提供对援助瞄准更细致的视角。

records.title_en: Are smart cities green? The role of environmental and digital policies for Eco-innovation in China
records.title_cn: 智慧城市是否绿色？环境与数字政策对中国生态创新的作用
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we employ negative binomial and quasi-natural experimental methods (i.e., Difference-in-Differences and Propensity Score Matching), whereby we examine the joint impact of environmental and digital policies (for designing smart cities) upon the generation of eco-innovations in China. Using longitudinal data for the period 2006–2018, we examine the changes in green patents granted: (i) due to the implementation of various levels of stringency of environmental policies across all cities; and (ii) after the introduction of smart city policies in 2012 in China.
