In the Brazilian Amazon, thousands of kilometres of vegetation are annually burned, releasing pollutants that impact the health of 24 million inhabitants. The paper seeks to fill two crucial informational gaps for policy planning, namely, the size of the impact on the most pollution-susceptible groups, i.e., children and the elderly, and the priority locations for health-oriented intervention on fires. A municipal-monthly panel covering ten years of the Amazonian territory was analysed by relying on exogenous and high-resolution wind direction variation to identify the effect of fires on pollution and hospitalizations. This is an unparalleled effort for applying to a large geographical area spanning five million km2 a highly refined identification strategy relying on hourly gridded wind and fire data. As the result, one extra standard deviation of “upwind” fires was estimated to increase asthma-related hospitalization of the elderly in 0.03 days/month, that is, 4 % of the bed-days commonly demanded by such kind of hospitalization, an effect whose size decayed with the distance between fires and hospitals. A policy assessment uncovered the trade-off between respiratory health of the elderly and nutritional health of fire-dependent subsistence farmers, presenting a priority map for tackling the issue with municipal-level interventions. The targeting of non-subsistence fires is advised, what could avoid 28 days of hospitalization per year. It is thus demonstrated that the trade-offs inherent to agricultural fires could be better balanced by evidence-based targeting of fire prevention policy.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家依赖农业火灾，以呼吸健康换取更廉价的土地准备和自给农民更高的粮食安全。在巴西亚马孙地区，每年有数千平方公里的植被被焚烧，释放的污染物影响24万居民的健康。本文旨在填补政策规划的两个关键信息空白，即对最易受污染群体（即儿童和老年人）的影响程度，以及针对火灾的健康导向干预的优先地点。通过利用外生且高分辨率的风向变化来识别火灾对污染和住院的影响，分析了覆盖亚马孙地区十年的市级月度面板数据。这是将精细识别策略应用于覆盖五百万平方公里的大地理区域的空前努力，该策略依赖于每小时网格化的风和火灾数据。结果显示，上风向火灾每增加一个标准差，估计会使老年人哮喘相关住院增加0.03天/月，即占此类住院通常所需床位日的4%，且该效应的大小随火灾与医院之间的距离增加而衰减。政策评估揭示了老年人呼吸健康与依赖火灾的自给农民营养健康之间的权衡，并提出了通过市级干预解决该问题的优先地图。建议针对非自给性火灾进行干预，每年可避免28天的住院。因此，研究表明，通过基于证据的火灾预防政策目标定位，可以更好地平衡农业火灾固有的权衡。

records.title_en: Do green foreign direct investments increase the innovative capability of MNE subsidiaries?
records.title_cn: 绿色外国直接投资是否提升了跨国企业子公司的创新能力？
records.abstract_en: Technologies to mitigate climate change may diffuse from lead markets to the rest of the world through several mechanisms and make important contributions to the global green transformation. In this paper, we explore the role played by multinational enterprises (MNEs) in transferring knowledge and innovative capabilities in green technologies to their global subsidiaries. We posit that the degree of green knowledge transfer and innovative capability development in subsidiaries depend on: (i) the host country characteristics, (ii) the specific technology in question, and (iii) the mode of entry. The empirical analysis combines data on foreign direct investments with patent analysis. The results suggest that being a subsidiary of a green MNE has a positive impact on the number and quality of green patents produced locally. This green innovative advantage vis-à-vis domestic companies is larger in less developed countries and in those that are less reliant on oil rents, in particular if they already possess higher levels of relevant domestic innovative capacity. Furthermore, firm and sectoral characteristics also matter. The analysis suggests that green FDIs are more effective when technologies are characterized by low tradability and tacit knowledge. Finally, cross-border acquisitions are more efficient at strengthening green innovative capabilities than subsidiaries established with greenfield investments.
records.abstract_cn: 缓解气候变化的技术可能通过多种机制从领先市场扩散到世界其他地区，并为全球绿色转型做出重要贡献。在本文中，我们探讨了跨国企业在向其全球子公司转移绿色技术知识和创新能力方面所扮演的角色。我们假设，子公司中绿色知识转移和创新能力发展的程度取决于：（i）东道国特征，（ii）所涉及的具体技术，以及（iii）进入模式。实证分析将外国直接投资数据与专利分析相结合。结果表明，作为绿色跨国企业的子公司对当地产生的绿色专利数量和质量具有积极影响。相对于国内企业，这种绿色创新优势在欠发达国家以及对石油租金依赖程度较低的国家中更大，特别是如果这些国家已经拥有较高的相关国内创新能力。此外，企业和部门特征也很重要。分析表明，当技术具有低可交易性和隐性知识特征时，绿色外国直接投资更为有效。最后，跨境收购在增强绿色创新能力方面比绿地投资建立的子公司更为有效。

records.title_en: Is China forest landscape restoration (FLR) worth it? A cost-benefit analysis and non-equilibrium ecological view
records.title_cn: 中国森林景观恢复（FLR）是否值得？成本效益分析与非平衡生态学视角
records.abstract_en: Forest Landscape Restoration (FLR) is an important way to address the problems of climate change and land desertification. However, there has been significant controversy about the high cost of restoration and whether it is economically feasible. Most cost-benefit analyses of ecological restoration plans have focused on a single ecosystem, without considering the complexity and relevance of the ecosystem. These studies have also not considered the large number of potential important benefits and real opportunity costs, creating the possibility of bias in the cost-benefit analysis. This study applies theoretical analysis tools from non-equilibrium ecology, combining a land system change model and economic analysis to conduct a comprehensive cost-benefit analysis of China's FLR program. The research results show that: (1) The benefits of China's implementation of the FLR policy exceed the costs, with positive net benefits. (2) After fully considering the cost of FLR, including the true opportunity cost, the net benefit of forest landscape restoration in China is between 60 trillion yuan and 110 trillion yuan. (3) Different types of commitment goals impact the success of the recovery plan. Specifically, quantifiable targets better support successful FLR implementation. The article concludes that it is worthwhile to implement forest landscape restoration in China, although the profit margin of the ecological plan is smaller than generally thought. The results provide a scientific basis for the government to formulate FLR policies and other ecological restoration plans.
records.abstract_cn: 森林景观恢复（FLR）是应对气候变化和土地荒漠化问题的重要途径。然而，关于恢复的高成本及其经济可行性一直存在重大争议。大多数生态恢复计划的成本效益分析都集中在单一生态系统上，没有考虑生态系统的复杂性和相关性。这些研究也没有考虑大量潜在的重要效益和真实的机会成本，从而可能导致成本效益分析存在偏差。本研究运用非平衡生态学的理论分析工具，结合土地系统变化模型和经济分析，对中国FLR计划进行了全面的成本效益分析。研究结果表明：（1）中国实施FLR政策的效益超过成本，具有正净效益。（2）在充分考虑FLR成本（包括真实机会成本）后，中国森林景观恢复的净效益在60万亿元至110万亿元之间。（3）不同类型的承诺目标影响恢复计划的成功。具体而言，可量化的目标更能支持FLR的成功实施。文章得出结论，在中国实施森林景观恢复是值得的，尽管生态计划的利润率比普遍认为的要小。研究结果为政府制定FLR政策和其他生态恢复计划提供了科学依据。

records.title_en: Fighting Covid-19 amidst civil conflict: Micro-level evidence from Burkina Faso
records.title_cn: 在内战中抗击新冠病毒19：来自布基纳法索的微观证据
records.abstract_en: How does violent conflict affect the spread of Covid-19? In this paper we analyze how violent conflict influences the adoption of preventative measures and infection rate in a very poor, conflict-affected country, Burkina Faso. We use a unique panel of 1,919 households surveyed during the first six months of the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020 and merge these data with indicators of violence at the municipality and regional level. Infection data are leveraged from test centers located across 65 municipalities in the country. We find a lower adoption rate of preventive measures, and a higher infection rate in areas affected by violence. We also find that poverty appears to play a role for understanding individuals’ adoption rate of preventive measures. Closure of health centers in violence-prone areas is a potential mechanism that seems to drive our results. We argue that political interventions towards peace and stability also help to tackle the Covid-19 pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: 暴力冲突如何影响 Covid-19 的传播？在本文中，我们分析了暴力冲突如何影响布基纳法索这个非常贫穷、受冲突影响的国家采取预防措施和感染率。我们使用了在2020新冠肺炎19大流行的前六个月对1,919家庭进行调查的独特小组，并将这些数据与市和地区层面的暴力指标合并。感染数据来自该国65多个城市的测试中心。我们发现，在受暴力影响的地区，预防措施的采用率较低，感染率较高。我们还发现，贫困似乎在了解个人预防措施的采用率方面发挥着重要作用。关闭暴力多发地区的卫生中心是一种潜在机制，似乎可以推动我们取得成果。我们认为，实现和平与稳定的政治干预也有助于应对新冠病毒19大流行。

records.title_en: Did a successful fight against COVID-19 come at a cost? Impacts of the pandemic on employment outcomes in Vietnam
records.title_cn: 成功抗击COVID-19是否付出了代价？疫情对越南就业结果的影响
records.abstract_en: Despite its low middle-income status, Vietnam has been widely praised for its success in the fight against early waves of the COVID-19 pandemic, with a low mortality rate of approximately 100 deaths out of a population of less than 100 million by the end of 2020. We add to the emerging literature on COVID-19 effects on the labor market for poorer countries by analyzing rich individual-level data from Vietnam’s Labor Force Surveys spanning 2015 to 2020. We find post-pandemic increases in unemployment and temporary layoff rates alongside decreases in employment quality. Monthly wages declined even as the proportion of workers receiving below-minimum wages substantially increased, contributing to sharply rising wage inequality. Our findings suggest that more resources should be allocated to protect vulnerable workers, especially as the pandemic continues to cause increasingly severe damage to the global economy.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管越南属于中低收入国家，但其在抗击COVID-19疫情早期浪潮中的成功广受赞誉，截至100年底，在不到100亿的人口中，死亡率约为2020例。我们通过分析越南劳动力调查中19年至2015年的丰富个体层面数据，为关于COVID-2020对较贫困国家劳动力市场影响的新兴文献做出贡献。我们发现疫情后失业率和临时裁员率上升，同时就业质量下降。月工资下降，而领取低于最低工资的工人比例大幅增加，导致工资不平等急剧上升。我们的研究结果表明，应分配更多资源来保护弱势工人，尤其是在疫情继续对全球经济造成日益严重损害的情况下。

records.title_en: The impact of robots in Latin America: Evidence from local labor markets
records.title_cn: 拉丁美洲机器人的影响：来自地方劳动力市场的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of robots on labor markets in Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico, the major robot users in Latin America, during the period 2004–2016. We exploit spatial and time variations in exposure to robots arising from initial differences in industry specialization across geographic locations and the evolution of robot adoption across industries, to estimate a causal effect of robots on local labor market outcomes. We find that district’s exposure to robots causes a relative deterioration in labor market indicators such us unemployment and labor informality. We document that robots mainly replace formal salaried jobs, affecting young and semi-skilled workers to a greater extent, and that informal employment acts as a buffer that prevents a larger increase in unemployment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2004-2016年期间机器人对阿根廷、巴西和墨西哥（拉丁美洲主要的机器人使用者）劳动力市场的影响。我们利用各地区初始行业专业化差异和机器人采用跨行业演变所带来的机器人暴露度的空间和时间变化，来估计机器人对地方劳动力市场结果的因果效应。我们发现，地区对机器人的暴露度导致失业和劳动力非正规性等劳动力市场指标的相对恶化。我们记录到，机器人主要替代正规受薪工作，对年轻和半熟练工人的影响更大，而非正规就业起到了缓冲作用，防止了失业率的更大上升。

records.title_en: Healthcare reform and gender specific infant mortality in rural Nepal
records.title_cn: 医疗改革与尼泊尔农村地区性别特异性婴儿死亡率
records.abstract_en: We estimate to what extent a large scale health care reform disproportionately affects the mortality rate of boys in the context of a developing country with cultural preferences favoring boys. We use arguably exogenous variations due to a health care reform—the National Health Policy—which was implemented in Nepal in 1991 along with data from the Nepal Living Standard Survey 1996 and estimate that improved quality of primary health care facilities (by one standard deviation) reduces the mortality rate of infant boys by 3.43 percentage points but does not affect the mortality rate of infant girls. Our analysis points to societal gender preferences for sons and the consequent neglect of daughters’ health as potential drivers of some of the observed differences in mortality between genders and highlights the important role of cultural norms in shaping the outcomes of large scale health care reforms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计在具有偏爱男孩文化偏好的发展中国家背景下，大规模医疗改革在多大程度上不成比例地影响男孩的死亡率。我们利用因医疗改革——国家卫生政策——而产生的看似外生的变异，该政策于1991年在尼泊尔实施，并结合尼泊尔生活水平调查1996年的数据，估计初级卫生保健设施质量的提高（按一个标准差计）使男婴死亡率降低3.43个百分点，但不影响女婴死亡率。我们的分析指出，社会对儿子的性别偏好及由此导致的女儿健康忽视，是观察到的性别间死亡率差异的部分潜在驱动因素，并强调了文化规范在塑造大规模医疗改革结果中的重要作用。

records.title_en: Community and industrial forest concessions: Are they effective at reducing forest loss and does FSC certification play a role?
records.title_cn: 社区和工业森林特许经营权：它们在减少森林损失方面是否有效，FSC认证是否发挥作用？
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the role of community forest management coupled with mandatory forest certification in Guatemala’s Maya Biosphere Reserve (MBR). Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) certification aims to promote sustainable forest practices and increase economic returns for harvesting certified timber through price premiums gained through eco-labeling and specialized access to international markets. Guatemala established community and industrial forest concessions in the reserve as a way to stem rampant deforestation in the region in the 1990s. Concessions are required to obtain FSC certification to maintain their harvesting rights to the forest. The communities that manage the concessions vary across a number of cultural and socio-demographic characteristics, such as income, educational attainment, and previous forest experience. Some community concession members have lived in the region for multiple generations and have historically depended on the forest for their livelihoods, while other groups are comprised of more recent migrants that come primarily from agricultural backgrounds. The differences among the community forest groups, along with the private industrial concessions, allow for a robust examination of the impact of forest certification across different institutional approaches to forest management. Using Hansen’s forest loss data from 2000 to 2017 for Guatemala, we employ a random effects model to compare the effectiveness of the community and industrial concessions in reducing deforestation compared to a matched control group. Additionally, we test whether the benefit of increased market access that comes with FSC certification further decreases deforestation. Our findings suggest that sustainable forest management practices have continued to reduce forest loss in the MBR, just as well, if not more so than the industrial concessions, but the impact varies based on community characteristics. The market access component of FSC certification also impacts deforestation, although the effect is small.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了危地马拉玛雅生物圈保护区（MBR）中社区森林管理与强制性森林认证的作用。森林管理委员会（FSC）认证旨在通过生态标签和进入国际市场的特殊渠道获得价格溢价，促进可持续森林实践并提高采伐认证木材的经济回报。危地马拉在保护区内设立社区和工业森林特许经营权，以遏制该地区在1990年代的猖獗森林砍伐。特许经营权持有者必须获得FSC认证才能维持其森林采伐权。管理特许经营权的社区在收入、教育程度和先前森林经验等文化和社经人口特征方面各不相同。一些社区特许经营成员在该地区生活了多代，历史上依赖森林维持生计，而其他群体则由主要来自农业背景的新近移民组成。社区森林群体之间的差异，以及私人工业特许经营权，使得能够对不同制度方法的森林管理进行强有力的森林认证影响检验。利用汉森2000年至2017年危地马拉的森林损失数据，我们采用随机效应模型，将社区和工业特许经营权在减少森林砍伐方面的效果与匹配的对照组进行比较。此外，我们检验了FSC认证带来的市场准入增加是否进一步减少了森林砍伐。我们的研究结果表明，可持续森林管理实践继续减少了MBR中的森林损失，其效果与工业特许经营权相当，甚至更好，但影响因社区特征而异。FSC认证的市场准入部分也影响森林砍伐，尽管影响较小。

records.title_en: Adaptation to expected and unexpected weather fluctuations: Evidence from Bangladeshi smallholder farmers
records.title_cn: 对预期和非预期天气波动的适应：来自孟加拉国小农的证据
records.abstract_en: Whether and how quickly farmers adapt to a changing climate is of paramount importance to understanding the potential impacts of climate change on agriculture. Yet the literature on adaptation has paid less attention to the distinction between ex-ante adjustments to expected weather and ex-post responses to unexpected shocks. Using a three-wave, nationally representative Bangladesh Integrated Household Survey, this paper exploits large variation in precipitation and temperature to estimate the weather impacts on Bangladesh agriculture and to identify the associated productive adaptations to expected and unexpected weather changes. It presents evidence that Bangladeshi farmers are resilient to exposure of crops to temperatures below 32°C through various adaptive activities such as reallocation of land and irrigation water between rice and non-rice crops, the adoption of non-rice improved seed varieties, and the adjustment of the input cost composition. But increased exposure to extreme heat above 32°C causes significant declines in agricultural productivity in wet seasons. Although farmers increase irrigation water inputs to aus and aman rice against unexpected extreme heat, the adaptation effect remains limited. The total cash cost associated with cultivation does not respond to weather changes, plausibly due to the presence of financial liquidity constraints. This study’s finding adds to evidence of smallholder farmers’ short- and medium-run productive responses to adverse climate change in the developing world.
records.abstract_cn: 农民是否以及多快地适应气候变化，对于理解气候变化对农业的潜在影响至关重要。然而，关于适应的文献较少关注对预期天气的事前调整与对非预期冲击的事后反应之间的区别。利用三轮全国代表性的孟加拉国综合住户调查，本文利用降水和温度的巨大变化来估计天气对孟加拉国农业的影响，并识别对预期和非预期天气变化的相关生产性适应。本文提供的证据表明，孟加拉国农民通过多种适应性活动，如在水稻和非水稻作物之间重新分配土地和灌溉水、采用非水稻改良种子品种以及调整投入成本构成，能够抵御作物暴露于低于32°C的温度。但暴露于高于32°C的极端高温会导致湿季农业生产率显著下降。尽管农民增加对夏稻和秋稻的灌溉水投入以应对非预期的极端高温，但适应效果仍然有限。与耕作相关的总现金成本对天气变化没有反应，这可能是由于存在金融流动性约束。本研究的发现补充了发展中国家小农对不利气候变化的短期和中期生产性反应的证据。

records.title_en: Unravelling the ‘race to the bottom’ argument: Foreign direct investment and different types of labour rights
records.title_cn: 解析“竞次”论点：外国直接投资与不同类型的劳工权利
records.abstract_en: Does foreign direct investment (FDI) lead to better or worse labour standards in developing countries? We argue that it depends on the type of labour right, and how costly it is to protect it. We propose that governments are likely to follow international pressure and ‘climb to the top’ of improved labour standards, but only for those rights that do not incur direct costs to foreign investors, such as collective bargaining rights. In contrast, we expect that governments engage in a ’race to the bottom’ when it comes to rights that bear immediate costs for firms, such as overtime pay. To test our argument, we use novel data to distinguish between the legal protection of (1) fair working contracts, (2) adequate working time, (3) dismissal protections, which are more costly; versus (4) collective worker representation, and (5) industrial action rights, which are relatively cheaper to grant. Our panel data analysis for 75 developing countries (1982–2010) shows that higher FDI stock and flow is indeed connected to better protection of collective rights, while FDI flow is connected to a decline in relatively expensive outcome rights. These results remain robust across a range of model specifications.
records.abstract_cn: 外国直接投资（FDI）是否会导致发展中国家的劳工标准提高或降低？我们认为这取决于劳工权利的类型以及保护这些权利的成本。我们提出，政府可能会遵循国际压力并“竞优”提高劳工标准，但仅限于那些不会给外国投资者带来直接成本的权利，如集体谈判权。相反，我们预期政府在涉及企业即时成本的权利（如加班费）方面会进行“竞次”。为检验我们的论点，我们使用新数据来区分法律保护中的（1）公平工作合同、（2）适当工作时间、（3）解雇保护（这些成本较高）与（4）集体工人代表权、（5）工业行动权（这些授予成本相对较低）。我们对75个发展中国家（1982-2010年）的面板数据分析表明，较高的FDI存量和流量确实与集体权利的更好保护相关，而FDI流量与相对昂贵的成果权利的下降相关。这些结果在一系列模型设定中保持稳健。

records.title_en: Household welfare in the digital age: Assessing the effect of mobile money on household consumption volatility in developing countries
records.title_cn: 数字时代的家庭福利：评估移动货币对发展中国家家庭消费波动性的影响
records.abstract_en: Based on a sample of 76 developing countries over 1990–2019, we assess the effect of adopting mobile money on consumption volatility using entropy balancing. We reveal that countries with mobile money exhibit lower consumption volatility. After checking the robustness of this result, we show that the key drivers of mobile money’s stabilizing effect are financial inclusion and migrant remittances. Heterogeneity tests conducted indicate the sensitivity of the result to time and type of mobile money and to some structural factors, including trade openness, inflation, rural population, the rule of law, and level of development.
records.abstract_cn: 基于1990-2019年间76个发展中国家的样本，我们使用熵平衡方法评估了采用移动货币对消费波动性的影响。我们发现，采用移动货币的国家表现出较低的消费波动性。在检验了这一结果的稳健性之后，我们表明移动货币稳定效应的关键驱动因素是金融包容性和移民汇款。进行的异质性检验表明，结果对时间和移动货币类型以及一些结构性因素（包括贸易开放度、通货膨胀、农村人口、法治和发展水平）具有敏感性。

records.title_en: Benchmarking Intensity
records.title_cn: 基准强度
records.abstract_en: Benchmarking incentivizes fund managers to invest a fraction of their funds’ assets in their benchmark indexes, and such demand is inelastic. We construct a measure of inelastic demand a stock attracts, benchmarking intensity (BMI), computed as its cumulative weight in all benchmarks, weighted by assets following each benchmark. Exploiting the Russell 1000/2000 cutoff, we show that changes in stocks’ BMIs instrument for changes in ownership of benchmarked investors. The resultant demand elasticities are low. We document that both active and passive fund managers buy additions to their benchmarks and sell deletions. Finally, an increase in BMI lowers future stock returns. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 基准化激励基金经理将其基金资产的一部分投资于其基准指数，而这种需求是无弹性的。我们构建了一个衡量股票吸引无弹性需求的指标——基准强度（BMI），计算方式为该股票在所有基准中的累计权重，并按跟踪每个基准的资产加权。利用罗素1000/2000的断点，我们表明股票BMI的变化可作为基准投资者持股变化的工具变量。由此得出的需求弹性较低。我们记录了主动型和被动型基金经理都会买入新增至其基准的股票，并卖出被剔除的股票。最后，BMI的增加会降低未来股票收益。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁获取。

records.title_en: Risking or Derisking: How Management Fees Affect Hedge Fund Risk-Taking Choices
records.title_cn: 冒险还是去风险：管理费如何影响对冲基金的风险承担选择
records.abstract_en: Hedge fund managers’ risk-taking choices are influenced by their compensation structure. We differ from most studies that focus on incentive fees and the high-water mark by examining how management fees affect managers’ risk-taking. Our simple model shows that managers’ risk-taking is negatively related to their future management fees. Using fund-level data, we find that future management fees are the dominant component of managers’ total compensation. When the contribution of future management fees increases, managers reduce risk-taking to increase survival probabilities. Moreover, funds with higher decreasing returns to scale are more sensitive to future management fees and reduce risk-taking even more. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 对冲基金经理的风险承担选择受到其薪酬结构的影响。我们不同于大多数关注激励费和高水位线的研究，而是考察管理费如何影响经理的风险承担。我们的简单模型表明，经理的风险承担与其未来管理费负相关。使用基金层面数据，我们发现未来管理费是经理总薪酬的主要组成部分。当未来管理费的贡献增加时，经理会减少风险承担以提高生存概率。此外，规模报酬递减程度较高的基金对未来管理费更为敏感，并进一步减少风险承担。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Competition for Attention in the ETF Space
records.title_cn: ETF领域的注意力竞争
records.abstract_en: The interplay between investors’ demand and providers’ incentives has shaped the evolution of exchange-traded funds (ETFs). While early ETFs invested in broad-based indexes and therefore offered diversification at low cost, more recent products track niche portfolios and charge high fees. Strikingly, over their first 5 years, specialized ETFs lose about 30$\%$ (risk-adjusted). This underperformance cannot be explained by high fees or hedging demand. Rather, it is driven by the overvaluation of the underlying stocks at the time of the launch. Our results are consistent with providers catering to investors’ extrapolative beliefs by issuing specialized ETFs that track attention-grabbing themes.
records.abstract_cn: 投资者需求与提供商激励之间的相互作用塑造了交易所交易基金（ETF）的演变。早期ETF投资于广泛基础指数，因此以低成本提供分散化，而近期产品则追踪利基投资组合并收取高额费用。引人注目的是，在其首个5年内，专业化ETF损失约30（风险调整后）。这种表现不佳不能由高费用或对冲需求解释。相反，它是由推出时标的股票的高估所驱动。我们的结果与提供商通过发行追踪吸引注意力主题的专业化ETF来迎合投资者外推信念相一致。

records.title_en: Exchange-Traded Funds and Real Investment
records.title_cn: 交易所交易基金与实际投资
records.abstract_en: We investigate the link between exchange-traded funds and real investment. Cross-sectionally, higher ETF ownership is associated with an increased sensitivity of real investment to Tobin’s q and a heightened ability of stock returns to forecast future earnings. Inclusion of stocks in industry ETFs enhances investment-$q$ sensitivity and implies greater incorporation of earnings information into prices prior to public releases. Greater nonmarket ETF ownership leads to increased (reduced) reliance of real investment on own (peers’) stock prices. Overall, the evidence is consistent with ETFs positively affecting real investment efficiency via greater flows of information. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了交易所交易基金与实际投资之间的联系。横截面来看，较高的ETF持有量与实际投资对托宾q的敏感性增强以及股票回报预测未来盈利的能力提高相关。股票纳入行业ETF增强了投资-q敏感性，并意味着在公开披露之前价格中融入了更多的盈利信息。较高的非市场ETF持有量导致实际投资对自身（同行）股票价格的依赖增加（减少）。总体而言，证据与ETF通过更大的信息流动对实际投资效率产生积极影响相一致。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: The Effect of Stock Liquidity on the Firm’s Investment and Production
records.title_cn: 股票流动性对企业投资和生产的影响
records.abstract_en: We propose that stock market liquidity affects corporate investment and production. Illiquidity, which raises firms’ cost of capital, lowers investment in capital assets, R&D, and inventory. This effect holds after we control for endogeneity using exogenous liquidity events, the 2001 decimalization, and the 1997 Nasdaq reform and after employing instrumental variable estimation. Illiquidity affects investment regardless of firms’ financial constraints. Consequently, illiquidity induces firms to adopt less capital-intensive production processes. Illiquid firms have higher marginal productivity of capital, greater labor input increases for given increases in assets, and lower operating leverage, which means lower reliance on fixed costs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出股票市场流动性影响企业投资和生产。非流动性提高了企业的资本成本，降低了资本资产、研发和存货的投资。在利用外生流动性事件、2001年十进制化和1997年纳斯达克改革控制内生性，并采用工具变量估计后，这一效应仍然成立。非流动性影响投资，无论企业是否面临财务约束。因此，非流动性促使企业采用资本密集度较低的生产流程。非流动性企业具有更高的资本边际生产率，给定资产增加时劳动投入增加更大，以及较低的经营杠杆，这意味着对固定成本的依赖较低。

records.title_en: Information versus Investment
records.title_cn: 信息与投资
records.abstract_en: We quantify the real implications of trade-offs between firm information disclosure and long-term investment efficiency. We estimate a dynamic equilibrium model in which firm managers confront realistic incentives to misreport earnings and distort their real investment choices. The model implies a socially optimal level of disclosure regulation that exceeds the estimated value. Counterfactual analysis reveals that eliminating earnings misreporting completely through disclosure regulation incentivizes managers to distort real investment. Lower earnings informativeness raises the cost of capital, which results in a 5.7$\%$ drop in average firm value, but more modest effects on social welfare and aggregate growth. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化了企业信息披露与长期投资效率之间权衡的实际影响。我们估计了一个动态均衡模型，其中企业管理者面临虚报盈利和扭曲实际投资选择的现实激励。该模型暗示了一个超过估计值的社会最优披露监管水平。反事实分析表明，通过披露监管完全消除盈利虚报会激励管理者扭曲实际投资。较低的盈利信息含量提高了资本成本，导致平均企业价值下降5.7，但对社会福利和总体增长的影响较为温和。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁获取。

records.title_en: High Inflation: Low Default Risk and Low Equity Valuations
records.title_cn: 高通胀：低违约风险与低股票估值
records.abstract_en: We develop an asset pricing model with endogenous corporate policies that explains how inflation jointly affects real asset prices and corporate default risk. Our model includes two empirically founded nominal rigidities: fixed nominal debt coupons (sticky leverage) and sticky cash flows. These two frictions result in lower real equity prices and credit spreads when expected inflation rises. A decrease in expected inflation has opposite effects, with even larger magnitudes. In the cross-section, the model predicts that the negative impact of higher expected inflation on real equity values is stronger for low leverage firms. We find empirical support for the model’s predictions. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个具有内生公司政策的资产定价模型，解释了通胀如何共同影响实际资产价格和公司违约风险。我们的模型包含两个基于实证的名义刚性：固定名义债务息票（粘性杠杆）和粘性现金流。当预期通胀上升时，这两种摩擦导致实际股票价格和信用利差降低。预期通胀下降则产生相反效应，且幅度更大。在横截面上，模型预测较高预期通胀对实际股票价值的负面影响对于低杠杆公司更为强烈。我们找到了支持模型预测的实证证据。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

records.title_en: Horizon Bias and the Term Structure of Equity Returns
records.title_cn: 视野偏差与股票收益的期限结构
records.abstract_en: We label the degree to which individuals are more optimistic at long horizons relative to short horizons as the horizon bias. We examine whether time-series variation in the horizon bias can explain the time-series variation in the equity term structure. We use analyst earnings forecasts to measure the degree of the horizon bias in the stock market. Consistent with the intuition from a stylized present value model, we find that periods of above-average horizon bias are associated with negative term premiums, whereas periods of below-average horizon bias are associated with positive term premiums. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将个体在长期视野相对于短期视野更为乐观的程度称为视野偏差。我们考察视野偏差的时间序列变化能否解释股票期限结构的时间序列变化。我们使用分析师盈利预测来衡量股票市场中视野偏差的程度。与一个简化的现值模型的直觉一致，我们发现视野偏差高于平均水平的时期与负的期限溢价相关，而视野偏差低于平均水平的时期与正的期限溢价相关。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Public and private sector zero-deforestation commitments and their impacts: A case study from South Sumatra Province, Indonesia
records.title_cn: 公共和私营部门的零毁林承诺及其影响：来自印度尼西亚南苏门答腊省的案例研究
records.abstract_en: In Asia, Africa, and Latin America, complex drivers of deforestation have sparked mandatory and voluntary initiatives, including moratorium policies, zero-deforestation pledges and certification systems. The impacts of these different commitments, which aim to reduce deforestation, have yet to be documented or analytically scrutinized. Using South Sumatra as a case study, we used the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework to identify the context and impacts of public and private sector commitments. Public sector commitment was assessed by examining political will reflected in government policies and regulations, while private sector commitment was assessed by looking at compliance with mandatory and voluntary certification schemes. South Sumatra lost 63% of its natural forest between 1990 and 2019. Deforestation is driven by expansion of large-scale commercial plantations, as well as illegal logging and clearing. Our study indicates that public and private sector commitments do matter. Statistically, we found sufficient evidence that private sector commitments were able to significantly reduce deforestation from year of commitments to 2019, at a 90% confidence level. Efforts to support zero-deforestation commitments must involve radical shifts in current policy and practice, with stricter law enforcement to combat illegal activities, greater transparency to inform progress, and the development of strategic and actionable plans.
records.abstract_cn: 在亚洲、非洲和拉丁美洲，毁林的复杂驱动因素引发了强制性和自愿性倡议，包括暂停政策、零毁林承诺和认证体系。这些旨在减少毁林的不同承诺的影响尚未被记录或分析审查。以南苏门答腊为案例，我们使用制度分析与发展（IAD）框架来识别公共和私营部门承诺的背景和影响。公共部门的承诺通过考察政府政策和法规中反映的政治意愿来评估，而私营部门的承诺则通过考察对强制性和自愿性认证计划的遵守情况来评估。南苏门答腊在1990年至2019年间失去了其天然林的63%。毁林是由大规模商业种植园的扩张以及非法采伐和清理所驱动的。我们的研究表明，公共和私营部门的承诺确实重要。统计上，我们发现了足够的证据表明，私营部门的承诺能够从承诺年份到2019年显著减少毁林，置信水平为90%。支持零毁林承诺的努力必须涉及当前政策和实践的根本性转变，包括加强执法以打击非法活动，提高透明度以告知进展，以及制定战略性和可操作的计划。

records.title_en: Using transfer of development rights (TDR) in a legally ambiguous context: Istanbul case
records.title_cn: 在法律模糊背景下使用开发权转移（TDR）：伊斯坦布尔案例
records.abstract_en: This article explores the different ways in which local governments apply TDR in the absence (uncertainty) of a legal framework and its consequences, focusing on the case of Istanbul in Turkey. Municipalities have implemented mandatory and voluntary TDR through plan notes. For this, the council decisions of Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality are examined, and it is determined which district municipalities use TDR through the plan notes. Semi-structured interviews with a total of 15 actors determined by snowball sampling were used to understand the reasons behind such use. Besides, the use of TDR in Bahçelievler and Arnavutköy districts, one of which is the central district and the other is the periphery district with both widely using TDR, and also examples of districts implementing mandatory or voluntary TDR types by plan notes are examined. The used type of TDR is an alternative for the acquisition of social and technical infrastructure needs in the city, is more open to market influence, and has a voluntary basis.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了地方政府在缺乏（不确定性）法律框架的情况下应用开发权转移（TDR）的不同方式及其后果，重点关注土耳其伊斯坦布尔的案例。市政府通过规划说明实施了强制性和自愿性的TDR。为此，对伊斯坦布尔大都市市议会决定进行了审查，并确定了哪些区级市通过规划说明使用TDR。采用滚雪球抽样确定的共15名行动者进行了半结构化访谈，以了解此类使用背后的原因。此外，还考察了Bahçelievler和Arnavutköy区（其中一个是中心区，另一个是边缘区，两者都广泛使用TDR）以及通过规划说明实施强制性或自愿性TDR类型的区级市示例。所使用的TDR类型是获取城市社会和技术基础设施需求的替代方案，更易受市场影响，并具有自愿性基础。

records.title_en: Socioeconomic aspects of riparian vegetation debt in the state of Sao Paulo, Brasil
records.title_cn: 巴西圣保罗州河岸植被债务的社会经济方面
records.abstract_en: Most of Brazilian’s remaining native vegetation occurs inside private properties. Therefore, the effectiveness of environmental policies is affected by landowner’s decisions. Brazilian Native Vegetation Protection Law delimits riparian permanent preservation areas (RPA) defined according to stream and river widths. Restoration legal needs (the environmental debt or liability) can increase native cover in Brazil. However, costly ecological restoration may prevent small owners from doing that. For that matter, it is important to understand and know the socioeconomic variables behind the restoration debt in certain areas in Brazil. Thus, we aimed at analyzing distribution of environmental debt in these RPA and related it to the socio- economic condition of the municipalities. We found that most of Sao Paulo state has environmental debt within its RPA. High environmental debt in Sao Paulo state is associated with the agricultural sector. Some of these regions are wealth and restoration by total planting might be well applied for compliance with legislation. In other places, where environmental debt and poverty are high, assisted natural regeneration might be an efficient technique, along with agroforestry systems. Some regions where low environmental debt coincided with poverty, environmental compensation could play an important role in a policy mix for socially equitable conservation and restoration.
records.abstract_cn: 巴西剩余的原生植被大部分位于私人财产内。因此，环境政策的有效性受到土地所有者决策的影响。巴西原生植被保护法根据溪流和河流宽度划定了河岸永久保护区（RPA）。恢复的法律需求（环境债务或负债）可以增加巴西的原生植被覆盖。然而，昂贵的生态恢复可能会阻止小所有者这样做。因此，了解并知晓巴西某些地区恢复债务背后的社会经济变量非常重要。因此，我们旨在分析这些RPA中环境债务的分布，并将其与各市镇的社会经济状况联系起来。我们发现圣保罗州大部分地区在其RPA内存在环境债务。圣保罗州的高环境债务与农业部门相关。其中一些地区较为富裕，通过全面种植进行恢复可能很好地适用于遵守法规。在其他环境债务和贫困程度较高的地方，辅助自然更新可能是一种有效的技术，同时结合农林复合系统。在一些低环境债务与贫困并存的地区，环境补偿可以在政策组合中发挥重要作用，以实现社会公平的保护和恢复。

records.title_en: Land supply and industrial agglomeration: Extension of the new economic geography model with land elements incorporated
records.title_cn: 土地供给与产业集聚：纳入土地要素的新经济地理模型扩展
records.abstract_en: Many countries and regions have adopted various incentive land policies to promote industrial agglomeration, but the effect of these policies is limited. This paper extends the new economic geography model, introduces the guiding role of land policy on industrial agglomeration, and explores the rules of land supply affecting industrial agglomeration based on the four cases of Chengdu, Beijing, Shandong, and Shenzhen in China. The study shows that (1) A stable equilibrium for the manufacturing industry agglomeration may still be formed for enterprises not highly dependent on land without incentive land policies. (2) For enterprises with moderate dependence on the land, elastic adjustment of the land supply according to the land demand has a positive effect on the stable equilibrium of industrial agglomeration. (3) For enterprises highly dependent on land, the effect of incentive land supply policies to promote industrial agglomeration may not be significant. (4) Small-scale agricultural land expropriation can, to a certain extent, promote the agglomeration of manufacturing industries. However, suppose the cost of manufacturing land reduced by agricultural land expropriation cannot compensate for the increase in the cost of agricultural products due to the reduction of agricultural land. In that case, the market crowding effect that promotes the dispersion of enterprises still exists. Therefore, the government should fully examine the degree of dependence on the land of various enterprises and formulate targeted land policies, measure the scope of land expropriation that does not disturb the agricultural market, stabilize the cost of agricultural products required by the manufacturing industry, and realize the stable agglomeration for the manufacturing industry from a comprehensive perspective with agriculture incorporated.
records.abstract_cn: 许多国家和地区采取了各种激励性土地政策以促进产业集聚，但这些政策的效果有限。本文扩展了新经济地理模型，引入土地政策对产业集聚的引导作用，并基于中国成都、北京、山东和深圳四个案例，探讨土地供给影响产业集聚的规律。研究表明：（1）对于不高度依赖土地的企业，在没有激励性土地政策的情况下，制造业集聚的稳定均衡仍可能形成。（2）对于对土地适度依赖的企业，根据土地需求弹性调整土地供给对产业集聚的稳定均衡有积极作用。（3）对于高度依赖土地的企业，激励性土地供给政策促进产业集聚的效果可能不显著。（4）小规模农地征收在一定程度上可以促进制造业的集聚。然而，如果农地征收所降低的制造业土地成本无法补偿因农地减少而导致的农产品成本上升，那么促进企业分散的市场拥挤效应仍然存在。因此，政府应充分考察各类企业对土地的依赖程度，制定有针对性的土地政策，衡量不扰乱农业市场的土地征收范围，稳定制造业所需的农产品成本，并从包含农业的综合视角实现制造业的稳定集聚。

records.title_en: Social and environmental factors affecting the amount of property taxes collected by local authorities in Israel
records.title_cn: 影响以色列地方政府征收房产税额的社会与环境因素
records.abstract_en: The payable amount of municipal property tax in Israel, locally known as Arnona, is based on the property's physical size, functional use, and several locational attributes, but not on the property's value, as more common elsewhere. This unusual taxation system originated in the late 1960's, when the State of Israel abolished the 1934 British mandatory ad valorem taxation system in order to establish a more stable tax base for local authorities during the period of highly volatile property prices. As the Arnona tax system is not commonly used elsewhere and its studies are infrequent, little is known about its advantages and disadvantages. In particular, the question remains whether the amount of taxes, collected by this system, actually reflects market realities and societal justice, while encouraging local authorities to protect the environment. The present study aims to answer this question, by analyzing the most recent fiscal data on local authorities in Israel, published in 2017. As the study reveals, there appears to be no significant correlation between the amount of Arnona taxes collected, on the one hand, and the market values of properties and environmental conditions in the local authorities, on the other, while the link between the amount of Arnona taxes and socio-economic status of local residents appears to be weak. As an efficient system of property taxation should be equitable, reflect market realities, and help to protect the environment, our conclusion is that the taxation system in question does not meet these requirements and should ultimately be modified or replaced by a more efficient taxation approach. The study’s results might be informative for policy-makers in countries and regions, in which traditional ad valorem taxation system might be difficult to implement due to a limited number of comparable properties transactions, or due to rapidly changing market values of properties, thus leading to a need of choosing an appropriate taxation alternative.
records.abstract_cn: 以色列市政房产税（当地称为Arnona）的应缴金额基于房产的物理面积、功能用途及若干区位属性，而非如其他地方更常见的基于房产价值。这一不寻常的税收制度起源于1960年代末，当时以色列国废除了1934年英国强制性的从价税制，以便在房产价格高度波动的时期为地方政府建立更稳定的税基。由于Arnona税制在其他地方并不常用，且相关研究较少，对其优缺点知之甚少。特别是，这一制度征收的税额是否真正反映市场现实和社会公正，同时鼓励地方政府保护环境，这一问题仍然存在。本研究旨在通过分析以色列地方政府于2017年发布的最新财政数据来回答这一问题。研究显示，Arnona税收金额与房产市场价值及地方政府环境状况之间似乎没有显著相关性，而Arnona税收金额与当地居民社会经济地位之间的联系似乎较弱。由于有效的房产税制应公平、反映市场现实并有助于保护环境，我们的结论是，所讨论的税制不符合这些要求，最终应予以修改或替换为更有效的税收方法。研究结果可能对难以实施传统从价税制的国家和地区政策制定者具有参考价值，这些地区可能因可比房产交易数量有限或房产市场价值快速变化而需要选择适当的税收替代方案。

records.title_en: Exploring the relationship between quality of living and green spaces in cities: Evidence from an Indian megacity region of global south
records.title_cn: 探索城市生活质量与绿色空间之间的关系：来自全球南方印度特大城市的证据
records.abstract_en: Green space (GS) provides a number of environmental and social benefits to the urban residents and these GS are very crucial for a sustainable urban environment and human well-being. However, spatial distributions of GS are rarely uniform over the space, thus creating green injustice. In this, an attempt has been made to assess the relationship between quality of living (QLI) and GS developing greenness Index (GI) across the urban centers in the Kolkata megacity region (KMR), Eastern India. Eighteen variables under three domains were selected to develop the QLI, and three remote sensing indices were used to develop the quality of GS Correlation anslysis was carried out to assess the relationship between QL and GS. Explanatory factor analysis was used to understand the association between factors affecting QL and GS. The Gini coefficient (GC) was used to measure the spatial equity of GS across urban centers. The findings showed that there was a negative correlation between QLI and GI (−0.278). The urban centers with 'very high' and 'high' QLI were characterized by 'very low' and 'low' GI. Most of the urban centers around Kolkata were characterized by 'very high' and 'high' QLI and 'very low and 'low' GI. GS results showed that there was an inequality of GS distribution across the urban centers in KMR. The findings suggest that GS in the cities should be increased and improved for GS justice by enhancing per capita availability and accessibility.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色空间（GS）为城市居民提供了许多环境和社会效益，这些绿色空间对于可持续的城市环境和人类福祉至关重要。然而，绿色空间的空间分布很少是均匀的，从而造成了绿色不公正。在此，我们尝试评估印度东部加尔各答特大城市区域（KMR）各城市中心的生活质量（QLI）与通过开发绿色指数（GI）所衡量的绿色空间之间的关系。选取了三个领域下的十八个变量来开发QLI，并使用三个遥感指数来开发绿色空间质量。进行了相关性分析以评估生活质量与绿色空间之间的关系。使用解释性因子分析来理解影响生活质量和绿色空间的因素之间的关联。使用基尼系数（GC）来衡量各城市中心绿色空间的空间公平性。研究结果显示，QLI与GI之间存在负相关（−0.278）。具有“非常高”和“高”QLI的城市中心以“非常低”和“低”GI为特征。加尔各答周边的大多数城市中心以“非常高”和“高”QLI以及“非常低”和“低”GI为特征。绿色空间结果表明，KMR各城市中心的绿色空间分布存在不平等。研究结果表明，应通过提高人均可用性和可达性来增加和改善城市中的绿色空间，以实现绿色公正。

records.title_en: Taking stock of global land indicators: A comparative analysis of approaches for a globally consistent land tenure security measure
records.title_cn: 全球土地指标盘点：全球一致的土地权属安全衡量方法比较分析
records.abstract_en: Land is important and underpins many of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The need for reporting on SDGs has elicited a boom in efforts to measure land tenure security. As land tenure security has not been the subject of systematic data collection in the past, efforts are underway to develop and implement a globally consistent approach to measuring land tenure security. This paper investigates two approaches - Prindex and the SDG joint land module - that have recently been put forward as consistent and reliable measures for capturing the data needed to advance our understanding of land tenure security. The paper describes the differences between the approaches in terms of sampling, methodology, and questionnaire wording, and highlights their strengths and weaknesses across four dimensions: consistency, cost-effectiveness, sustainability, and accessibility. This study finds that, under many circumstances, the Prindex and SDG approaches will produce different empirical results and policy recommendations. The difference in results does not indicate that one method is better or worse than the other, however, caution should be taken in treating these sources as substitutes. Overall, they are complementary approaches to inform on-going and future policy and programming efforts.
records.abstract_cn: 土地至关重要，是许多可持续发展目标（SDGs）的基础。对SDGs报告的需求引发了衡量土地权属安全努力的热潮。由于过去土地权属安全并非系统数据收集的主题，目前正在努力开发和实施一种全球一致的土地权属安全衡量方法。本文考察了两种方法——Prindex和SDG联合土地模块——它们最近被提出作为一致且可靠的衡量手段，用于获取推进我们对土地权属安全理解所需的数据。本文从抽样、方法和问卷措辞方面描述了两者之间的差异，并强调了它们在四个维度上的优缺点：一致性、成本效益、可持续性和可及性。本研究发现，在许多情况下，Prindex和SDG方法将产生不同的实证结果和政策建议。结果的差异并不表明一种方法优于或劣于另一种方法，但应谨慎对待将这些来源视为替代品。总体而言，它们是互补的方法，为正在进行的和未来的政策和规划工作提供信息。

records.title_en: Utilization and implementation of PPGIS in land use planning and decision-making from the perspective of organizations
records.title_cn: 组织视角下PPGIS在土地利用规划与决策中的利用与实施
records.abstract_en: Public participation GIS (PPGIS) approaches, often online participatory mapping, are used as participatory tools in land use planning. Applying PPGIS is expected to create data that contribute to decision-making processes in different organizations. The challenge with the use of PPGIS is that information often remains at the level of data collection without deeper and concrete use of the data. However, further research is required to better assess the impact of PPGIS approaches in actual land use-related decision-making. The essential questions are how PPGIS data have been used in decision-making, and how the application of the PPGIS approach is beneficial for land use planning processes. We aim to address these questions through three cases in Finnish Lapland, a sparsely populated region with mainly publicly owned land. The analysis is performed from the perspective of the organizations that applied PPGIS surveys. The results show that PPGIS can improve interaction between organizations and respondents in land use planning. PPGIS is particularly beneficial in the early phases of a land use planning process. In addition, for the most beneficial impact we advise using PPGIS to manage practical land use planning-related issues and to store collected data systematically.
records.abstract_cn: 公众参与地理信息系统（PPGIS）方法，通常是在线参与式制图，被用作土地利用规划中的参与工具。应用PPGIS预期能产生有助于不同组织决策过程的数据。PPGIS使用的挑战在于，信息往往停留在数据收集层面，而没有对数据进行更深入和具体的利用。然而，需要进一步研究以更好地评估PPGIS方法在实际土地利用相关决策中的影响。关键问题是PPGIS数据如何在决策中被使用，以及PPGIS方法的应用如何有益于土地利用规划过程。我们旨在通过芬兰拉普兰地区的三个案例来回答这些问题，该地区人口稀少，土地主要为公有。分析从应用PPGIS调查的组织的视角进行。结果表明，PPGIS可以改善土地利用规划中组织与受访者之间的互动。PPGIS在土地利用规划过程的早期阶段尤其有益。此外，为了获得最有益的影响，我们建议使用PPGIS来管理实际的土地利用规划相关问题，并系统性地存储收集到的数据。

records.title_en: Assessing national land administration reform in Mongolia: A mixed method evaluation using bank loan and historical land administration data
records.title_cn: 评估蒙古国家土地管理改革：基于银行贷款和历史土地管理数据的混合方法评价
records.abstract_en: This study presents the findings from a rigorous performance evaluation of a land registry strengthening project in Mongolia. The paper contributes to a small but growing body of systematic evaluations on land administration interventions—and particularly on efforts to build the national capacity of state agencies through institutional strengthening initiatives. The research highlights a methodological approach that utilizes mixed method data sources to explore outcomes in a more rigorous way and through a gendered lens. We rely on a unique set of primary quantitative data sources, including extensive land administration and bank loan data. In addition to ex- ploring outcomes associated with credit access and lending, our extensive data sources enable us to delve into transaction cost, efficiency, and volume. We complement the quantitative data with comprehensive qualitative data from interviews and focus group discussions. This study finds that the project improved Mongolia’s registration process and land administration system. There are notable increases in transaction efficiency; digitization and strengthening of information systems; and improved transparency and access to land records. In contrast, there is more limited evidence about the program’s effect on facilitating improvements in the accuracy of land records, land markets, access to credit, and gender equality in land rights. While the project helped to reduce some instances of corruption, there remain broad challenges to land governance reform.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究展示了对蒙古土地登记强化项目进行严格绩效评估的结果。本文为土地管理干预措施的系统性评估——特别是通过机构强化举措建设国家机构能力的努力——这一虽小但不断增长的研究领域做出了贡献。研究强调了一种利用混合方法数据来源，以更严格的方式并通过性别视角探索结果的方法论途径。我们依赖一组独特的初级定量数据来源，包括广泛土地管理和银行贷款数据。除了探索与信贷获取和贷款相关的结果外，我们广泛的数据来源使我们能够深入研究交易成本、效率和数量。我们用访谈和焦点小组讨论的全面定性数据补充定量数据。本研究发现，该项目改善了蒙古的登记流程和土地管理系统。交易效率显著提高；信息系统数字化和强化；土地记录的透明度和获取性得到改善。相比之下，关于该项目在促进土地记录准确性、土地市场、信贷获取和土地权利性别平等方面改善的证据较为有限。虽然该项目帮助减少了某些腐败现象，但土地治理改革仍面临广泛挑战。

records.title_en: Flexibility of land use plans: Between supporting development and opportunism. Evidence from Poland
records.title_cn: 土地利用规划的灵活性：在支持发展与机会主义之间——来自波兰的证据
records.abstract_en: The main objective of this paper is to examine the relationship between the flexibility of spatial planning at the local level and the natural and socio-economic development indicators of municipalities. Seventy municipalities located around the most dynamically developing large urban centers in Poland (Krakow, Poznań, Tri-City, Warsaw, and Wrocław) were selected for the study, in which the records of 1131 local spatial plans enacted in 2017–2019 were analyzed in detail in terms of indicators including, but not limited to, characterizing the average area of the plans, the duration of the development procedure, and the intensity of residential development, the biologically active area. Development characteristics were identified through 30 indicators in six thematic groups (demographic, socio-professional, economic and settlement structures, natural environment, and spatial planning). The relationships between the two groups of indicators were analyzed using factor analysis. On this basis, three clusters were identified, explaining 32.9% of the variation. Such a relatively low result may indicate that the spatial policy pursued by local governments is highly individualized. It may also be concluded that the flexibility of spatial planning in general is weakly related to the characteristics of development, including natural and socio-economic development, and therefore its absence should not be an obstacle to it.
records.abstract_cn: 本文的主要目标是考察地方层面空间规划的灵活性与 municipalities 的自然和社会经济发展指标之间的关系。研究选取了波兰发展最活跃的大城市中心（克拉科夫、波兹南、三联市、华沙和弗罗茨瓦夫）周边的七十个 municipalities，详细分析了其中在 2017-2019 年颁布的 1131 项地方空间规划记录，涉及指标包括但不限于：规划的平均面积、开发程序的持续时间、住宅开发的强度以及生物活性区域。通过六个主题组（人口、社会职业、经济与居住结构、自然环境以及空间规划）中的 30 项指标确定了发展特征。使用因子分析检验了两组指标之间的关系。在此基础上，识别出三个聚类，解释了 32.9% 的变异。这一相对较低的结果可能表明地方政府实施的空间政策高度个性化。也可以得出结论，空间规划的灵活性总体上与发展特征（包括自然和社会经济发展）的关系较弱，因此其缺失不应成为发展的障碍。

records.title_en: Does climate change leads to severe household-level vulnerability? Evidence from the Western Ghats of Kerala, India
records.title_cn: 气候变化是否导致严重的家庭层面脆弱性？来自印度喀拉拉邦西高止山脉的证据
records.abstract_en: Due to climate change, erratic and extreme rainfall events are rising in Kerala, India. This, in turn, is triggering landslides and floods in the Western Ghats of Kerala. Accordingly, this study analyzes the assessment and distribution of household level vulnerability toward climate change among the occupational categories in the Western Ghats of Kerala. Based on landslide data of Kerala for the years 2018 and 2019, five villages from the Idukki district of Kerala that accounts for the highest number of landslides are selected as the study region. The landslides and floods have either entirely or partially destroyed 3367 households in the study region during 2018 and 2019. Among these, 348 families are chosen for the study. We have adopted a stratified random sampling technique. The households belonging to all occupational categories are included in the sample. To facilitate the analysis, we have developed the concept of adaptive capacity entitlement to analyze the household-level vulnerability differences among occupational categories. Accordingly, data is elicited using an interview schedule and analyzed using robust logistic regression models. The results show that agrarian households are significantly vulnerable to landslides and floods. Among agrarian households, agricultural laborers tend to be the most vulnerable. A substantial number of agricultural laborer households live in hazard-prone regions, resulting in unequally distributed exposure to climatic hazards. The study reveals that the family's historic wealth (landholding) plays a significant role in households' capacity to attain entitlement. Besides, the entitlement enables the household to migrate to safer locations. The study highlights the need to frame a holistic climate adaptation policy for the region. For this reason, a sustainable land use policy has to be developed. Consequently, we recommend further studies to analyze the prospects and challenges of rehabilitation as well as land use regulation policies.
records.abstract_cn: 由于气候变化，印度喀拉拉邦的降雨事件变得不稳定且极端，进而引发西高止山脉的滑坡和洪水。因此，本研究分析了喀拉拉邦西高止山脉不同职业类别中家庭层面气候变化脆弱性的评估与分布。基于喀拉拉邦2018年和2019年的滑坡数据，选取了喀拉拉邦伊杜基区滑坡数量最多的五个村庄作为研究区域。在2018年和2019年期间，滑坡和洪水完全或部分摧毁了研究区域内的3367户家庭。其中，选取了348户家庭进行研究。我们采用了分层随机抽样技术。样本中包含了所有职业类别的家庭。为便于分析，我们提出了适应性能力权利的概念，以分析不同职业类别间家庭层面脆弱性的差异。据此，通过访谈提纲收集数据，并使用稳健逻辑回归模型进行分析。结果表明，农业家庭对滑坡和洪水显著脆弱。在农业家庭中，农业劳动者往往最为脆弱。大量农业劳动者家庭居住在灾害易发地区，导致气候灾害暴露的不平等分布。研究揭示，家庭的历史财富（土地持有）在家庭获得权利的能力中起着重要作用。此外，权利使家庭能够迁移到更安全的地点。研究强调需要为该地区制定整体性的气候适应政策。为此，必须制定可持续的土地利用政策。因此，我们建议进一步研究以分析恢复以及土地利用管制政策的前景和挑战。

records.title_en: Learning from Letchworth and Welwyn Garden City: Garden cities’ policies for the development of existing settlements in the contemporary world
records.title_cn: 从莱奇沃思和韦林花园城学习：花园城市政策在当代世界现有聚落发展中的应用
records.abstract_en: So far, the garden city model has been analysed and adopted by scholars, urban planners, and institutions to design garden cities, new towns, and suburban communities as new settlements from scratch around the world. In contrast, this paper explores the potentialities of such a model to provide a multi-faceted approach based on territorial, socio-economic, and urban planning strategies, thus offering a series of policies to combat a wide range of issues in existing communities. For that purpose, this paper provides a new approach about the garden city model through the case studies of Letchworth and Welwyn Garden City and latest updated models to form a new scheme with the capability to encourage the decentralisation of population and means of production across the territory, develop cooperatives to achieve a self-financing system and affordable housing in existing communities, and implement the garden cities’ design principles for the regeneration and expansion of existing settlements towards a sustainable, attractive, self-reliant and prosperous future.
records.abstract_cn: 迄今为止，花园城市模式已被学者、城市规划者和机构分析和采纳，用于在世界各地从零开始设计花园城市、新城镇和郊区社区作为新聚落。相比之下，本文探讨了该模式在提供基于领土、社会经济和城市规划策略的多层面方法方面的潜力，从而为现有社区中的广泛问题提供一系列政策。为此，本文通过莱奇沃思和韦林花园城的案例研究以及最新更新的模式，提供了一种关于花园城市模式的新方法，以形成一种新方案，该方案有能力鼓励人口和生产资料在领土上的分散，发展合作社以实现自筹资金系统和现有社区的负担得起的住房，并实施花园城市的设计原则，用于现有聚落的更新和扩展，迈向可持续、有吸引力、自力更生和繁荣的未来。

records.title_en: Persistent, pragmatic and prolific: Urban master planning in Accra, Dar es Salaam and Lilongwe
records.title_cn: 持久、务实且多产：阿克拉、达累斯萨拉姆和利隆圭的城市总体规划
records.abstract_en: This paper interrogates the persistence of urban master planning in African cities. Critiques of master planning in Africa label it as a stifling product of colonial legacies, an inappropriate imposition of external ideas, or a device to achieve the goals of global actors, all seen as being at odds with the rapidly changing settlement patterns and needs of many African urban contexts. This paper instead focuses on the role of local planning actors in the demand for and the production of master plans and proposes a different analytical perspective on the role of master planning in African urban contexts. Notably, we point to the weak presence of master planning in colonial contexts, in contrast with the strong activation of master plans to shape the ambitions of newly independent governments. We observe also the nuanced interactions between local actors and transnational circuits and influences in devising and implementing plans. The paper presents three case studies which demonstrate the persistence of master planning practices through the post-independence period and their proliferation in contemporary moments. We document the diverse range of local actors who have chosen to retain or revise colonial planning legacies, initiate new city-wide master planning, or solicit, shape and assume responsibility for master planning promoted by transnational circuits of development and planning. We find that actors embedded in local or national institutions, and a wide variety of transnational actors, are driven by a range of, at times conflicting, interests and ideas about what planning is and is meant to do. Historical surveys and in-depth interviews with current actors, as well as those from the recent past in Accra (Ghana), Dar es Salaam (Tanzania) and Lilongwe (Malawi), help us to identify three aspects of urban master planning which challenge existing interpretations. We observe that master planning has been a persistent presence, although often taking a more ephemeral form in extended “silent” periods when outdated but valued plans remained operative. We note that complex political tensions and institutional landscapes shape enthusiasm for, and control over the nature, preparation, adoption and implementation of master plans, including their being side-lined or resisted – local-national dynamics are crucial here. This leads to a pragmatic engagement with transnational actors to bring forward different kinds of plans. The prolific production of master plans supported by multiple transnational actors in poorly resourced contexts constitutes a dynamic, although at times counterproductive, terrain of visioning and practical planning initiatives seeking to grapple with the pace and unpredictability of urbanisation. Our analysis provides an opening for considering the politics of urban planning from an African-centric perspective and as an active part of African urbanization.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了非洲城市总体规划的持续性。对非洲总体规划的批评将其视为殖民遗产的压抑产物、外部思想的不当强加，或实现全球行动者目标的工具，所有这些都被认为与许多非洲城市环境快速变化的聚落模式和需求相悖。相反，本文关注地方规划行动者在总体规划需求和产生中的作用，并提出对非洲城市环境中总体规划作用的不同分析视角。值得注意的是，我们指出总体规划在殖民背景下的存在薄弱，与独立后新政府利用总体规划塑造雄心的强烈激活形成对比。我们还观察到地方行动者与跨国循环和影响在制定和实施计划中的细微互动。本文呈现了三个案例研究，展示了总体规划实践在独立后时期的持续存在及其在当代的激增。我们记录了选择保留或修订殖民规划遗产、启动新的全市总体规划，或寻求、塑造并承担跨国发展和规划循环推动的总体规划责任的各种地方行动者。我们发现，嵌入地方或国家机构的行动者以及各种跨国行动者，受到关于规划是什么及其应做什么的一系列有时相互冲突的利益和想法的驱动。对阿克拉（加纳）、达累斯萨拉姆（坦桑尼亚）和利隆圭（马拉维）当前行动者及近期过去行动者的历史调查和深入访谈，帮助我们识别出挑战现有解释的城市总体规划的三个层面。我们观察到，总体规划一直持续存在，尽管在过时但有价值的计划仍然有效的延长“沉默”时期，往往采取更短暂的形式。我们注意到，复杂的政治紧张关系和制度格局塑造了对总体规划的性质、准备、采纳和实施的热情和控制，包括其被边缘化或抵制——地方-国家动态在此至关重要。这导致与跨国行动者的务实接触，以提出不同类型的计划。在资源匮乏的环境中，由多个跨国行动者支持的总体规划的多产生产构成了一个动态的，尽管有时适得其反的愿景和实际规划举措领域，试图应对城市化的速度和不可预测性。我们的分析为从非洲中心视角考虑城市规划政治以及作为非洲城市化积极组成部分提供了开端。

records.title_en: Making the ropes: How daily practices in a booming periurban municipality become durable 'gray' institutions shaping land use
records.title_cn: 编织绳索：快速发展的城郊城市中，日常实践如何成为塑造土地利用的持久“灰色”制度
records.abstract_en: Predictable unwritten rules arguably are at the heart of all land development processes. How do these practices emerge and remain in local land governance? While municipal land use offices are increasingly one of the few remaining formal spaces for the state to review and negotiate legal urbanization in Mexico and many other contexts, literatures on implementation in local policy and development in Mexico and the South are nascent, and typically bypass both daily practices and municipal offices as arenas for meaningful institutional emergence or intervention. This article examines how land use officials developed and sustained a small set of repeating daily practices managing requests for development in Tlajomulco de Zúñiga, a rapidly growing outskirt of Guadalajara, Mexico. A sociological-institutionalist approach draws on ethnographic and case study methodologies to examine material from over 40 interviews and 25 hours of observation in the land use permitting department of Tlajomulco as well as internal documents, official laws and plans, and media accounts. The resulting analysis suggests that Tlajomulco's land use officials developed and sustained a broad array of legal yet informal patterns of daily practice ('gray institutions') in part through an unusual fifteen-year period of relative staff continuity. The land use staff also took strategic actions to increase the strength of their gray institutions: these included maintaining discourses of valuing collective knowledge and pride in 'tinkering', promoting skills and abilities to engage with formal regulations, and mediating their relational networks through strategic downplaying of their power and knowledge. Centering institutionalized practices of local land use offices such as Tlajomulco -and outlining how they emerge and remain- can help planners better understand the processes of planning 'as it happens', chart arenas of localized innovation and improvisation, and expand the terrains of decentered planning knowledge and land use implementation.
records.abstract_cn: 可预测的不成文规则可以说是所有土地开发过程的核心。这些实践如何在地方土地治理中出现并持续存在？虽然在墨西哥和许多其他背景下，市政土地利用办公室日益成为国家审查和协商合法城市化的少数剩余正式空间之一，但关于墨西哥和南方国家地方政策与发展的实施文献尚处于萌芽阶段，且通常既绕过了日常实践，也绕过了市政办公室作为有意义制度涌现或干预的舞台。本文考察了墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉快速发展的郊区Tlajomulco de Zúñiga的土地利用官员如何制定并维持一套重复的日常实践来处理开发请求。一种社会学-制度主义方法借鉴了民族志和案例研究方法，考察了来自Tlajomulco土地利用许可部门超过40次访谈和25小时观察的材料，以及内部文件、官方法律和计划及媒体报道。分析结果表明，Tlajomulco的土地利用官员在部分程度上通过一个不寻常的十五年相对人员稳定期，制定并维持了广泛的法律但非正式的日常实践模式（“灰色制度”）。土地利用工作人员还采取了战略行动来增强其灰色制度的力量：这些行动包括维持重视集体知识和“修补”自豪感的话语，提升参与正式法规的技能和能力，并通过战略性地淡化其权力和知识来调解其关系网络。以Tlajomulco等地方土地利用办公室的制度化实践为中心——并概述它们如何出现和持续——可以帮助规划者更好地理解“实际发生中”的规划过程，绘制地方创新和即兴创作的舞台，并扩展去中心化规划知识和土地利用实施的地形。

records.title_en: Institutionalizing ideas about citizens’ initiatives in planning: Emerging discrepancies between rhetoric and assurance
records.title_cn: 将公民倡议理念制度化于规划中：修辞与保障之间出现的不一致
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the institutionalization process regarding ideas about a more prominent role for citizens’ initiatives in planning. Citizens’ initiatives are often considered important for the transition towards sustainable urban development. Although this claim is not undisputed, many planning reforms in Western societies have promoted the inclusion of citizens in planning policies and projects. In the new Dutch Environment and Planning Act (EPA), which is expected to come into force in 2023, similar intentions are stated. The EPA claims to enhance participation of citizens, amongst other stakeholders, such as societal organizations, governmental bodies and businesses, at an early stage in decision-making processes, while in addition the planning system should become better suited to stimulate and facilitate societal initiatives. This study reveals that these ambitions have not resulted in clear rules or norms that strengthen the role for citizens’ initiatives in urban planning. The analysis of the development of the EPA shows that the institutionalization process can be characterized by 1) an emerging discrepancy between the rhetorical key message that all citizens’ initiatives will benefit from the EPA and the limited legal assurance, 2) the assumption that the myriad of forms citizens’ initiatives come in can be moulded into general participatory schemes and 3) a lack of reflections on how lenient planning rules are likely to advance market parties and governments rather than citizens’ initiatives. Because the institutionalization process continues after effectuation, in particular local governments are urged to develop additional policies to ensure a stronger position for citizens’ initiatives in planning.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了关于公民倡议在规划中发挥更突出作用的理念的制度化过程。公民倡议通常被认为对于向可持续城市发展转型至关重要。尽管这一主张并非没有争议，但西方社会的许多规划改革都促进了公民参与规划政策和项目。在预计于2023年生效的荷兰新《环境与规划法》中，也陈述了类似的意图。该法声称要增强公民以及其他利益相关者（如社会组织、政府机构和商业企业）在决策过程早期阶段的参与，此外，规划系统应更好地适应刺激和促进社会倡议。本研究表明，这些雄心并未转化为明确规则或规范，以加强公民倡议在城市规划中的作用。对《环境与规划法》制定过程的分析显示，制度化过程的特点包括：1）修辞上的关键信息——所有公民倡议都将受益于该法——与有限的法律保障之间出现不一致；2）假设公民倡议的多种形式可以被纳入通用的参与计划；3）缺乏对宽松规划规则可能更有利于市场参与者和政府而非公民倡议的反思。由于制度化过程在生效后仍在继续，特别是地方政府被敦促制定额外政策，以确保公民倡议在规划中拥有更强有力的地位。

records.title_en: Modelling the legal spaces of 3D underground objects in 3D land administration systems
records.title_cn: 三维土地管理系统中三维地下对象的法律空间建模
records.abstract_en: One of the significant challenges in current 2D Land Administration Systems (LAS) is defining and registering the Rights, Restrictions and Responsibilities (RRRs) attached to the underground objects. A 3D LAS can facilitate a better understanding, as well as a more efficient registration and clear visualisation of the RRRs than a 2D LAS, through 3D digital modelling of the legal ownership of underground objects below the surface. To register the objects below the surface in a 3D LAS, 3D physical data as well as 3D legal data shall either be registered and integrated into one model, or the physical and legal models shall be linked effectively. In the context of this paper, the IFC (ISO 16739:2018) is used to register the 3D physical data, while the Land Administration Domain Model (LADM, ISO 19152:2012) is used to structure the legal data. To achieve the link of the respective legal and physical data, the classes of the LADM are mapped to the elements of the IFC. A standardised workflow is presented in this paper where the inclusion of the legal, organisational and technical aspects of modelling the legal ownership results in a comprehensive approach to solve the challenges that currently prevent the registration of the RRRs of 3D objects below the surface in LASs. This paper also provides a general method for mapping the LADM classes to the IFC entities. Two case studies were conducted to assess the technical aspect of the workflow, where the RRRs of objects below the surface and the parcels above the surface were registered and visualised on the 3D geospatial visualisation platform CesiumJS.
records.abstract_cn: 当前二维土地管理系统（LAS）面临的重要挑战之一是定义和登记与地下对象相关的权利、限制和责任（RRRs）。三维LAS通过三维数字建模地表以下地下对象的合法所有权，能够比二维LAS更好地理解、更高效地登记以及清晰可视化RRRs。为了在三维LAS中登记地表以下的对象，三维物理数据和三维法律数据要么登记并集成到一个模型中，要么物理模型和法律模型应有效链接。在本文的背景下，使用IFC（ISO 16739:2018）登记三维物理数据，而使用土地管理领域模型（LADM，ISO 19152:2012）构建法律数据。为了实现各自法律和物理数据的链接，将LADM的类映射到IFC的元素。本文提出了一种标准化工作流程，其中纳入法律、组织和技术方面的合法所有权建模，形成一种综合方法来解决当前阻碍LAS中地表以下三维对象RRRs登记的挑战。本文还提供了一种将LADM类映射到IFC实体的通用方法。进行了两个案例研究来评估工作流程的技术方面，其中地表以下对象的RRRs和地表以上地块的RRRs在三维地理空间可视化平台CesiumJS上进行了登记和可视化。

records.title_en: Examining forest transition and collective action in Nepal’s community forestry
records.title_cn: 审视尼泊尔社区林业中的森林转型与集体行动
records.abstract_en: Nepal is going through a major socio-economic transition in rural areas and hence in forest management practices, leading to changes in and evolution of new forest-people relationships. Community forests are experiencing an ecological transition resulting a new pattern of growth, regeneration and diversity in forest composition. The ecological transition of forest corresponds to the shifting local collective actions in community forestry which are emerging from the new socio-economic dynamics in rural areas such as income-diversification, declining subsistence utilization of forest resources and outmigration of the rural population. However, these changes are highly differentiated and variable. The hilly areas are experiencing remarkable forest cover changes than in the lowlands of Terai. In this paper, we examine the evolving intersection between new forest transition and community collective action in Nepal. We draw our analysis on the comparative case study of four villages from three different ecological regions. Our findings show that the forest transition is not static, but a dynamic process shaped by diverse local and external factors. Further, declining utilization of forests for subsistence uses has led to a new dynamic in community collective action which has played a central role in driving forest transition. Community participation in forest management is also declining. Hence, we call for reconceptualizing local collective action in this changed context which can help revise forest policies and reimagine forest institutions that can better respond to the socio-economic changes of the mountain landscape and revitalize local collective actions.
records.abstract_cn: 尼泊尔农村地区正在经历重大的社会经济转型，森林管理实践也随之变化，导致森林与人类关系发生改变并演化出新的形态。社区森林正在经历生态转型，呈现出新的生长、更新和物种组成多样性模式。森林的生态转型与社区林业中正在变化的当地集体行动相对应，这些集体行动源于农村地区新的社会经济动态，如收入多样化、森林资源生计利用减少以及农村人口外迁。然而，这些变化具有高度差异性和可变性。丘陵地区的森林覆盖变化比德赖低地更为显著。本文考察了尼泊尔新的森林转型与社区集体行动之间不断演变的交集。我们基于三个不同生态区四个村庄的比较案例研究进行分析。我们的研究结果表明，森林转型并非静态，而是一个由多种地方和外部因素塑造的动态过程。此外，森林生计利用的减少导致了社区集体行动的新动态，这在推动森林转型中发挥了核心作用。社区对森林管理的参与也在减少。因此，我们呼吁在这一变化背景下重新概念化地方集体行动，这有助于修订森林政策并重新构想森林制度，以更好地应对山区景观的社会经济变化，并振兴地方集体行动。

records.title_en: Socio-ecological impact of forest legislations on forest and forest-people of Jhargram District, West Bengal
records.title_cn: 森林立法对西孟加拉邦杰尔格拉姆区森林及森林居民的社会生态影响
records.abstract_en: For thousands of years, the first settlers of the sub-continent anchored in the vast inland forest ecosystems. These first settlers are still surviving in different residual forest patches and are known as Aboriginals or tribal people. As a livelihood strategy, forest people used to tame the services of the forest ecosystem according to their needs while maintaining a narrow ecological balance. The traditional social, cultural, and religious practices and beliefs of the forest people were not devoid of the forest ecosystem. Secondary data on the overlapping of forest patches indicates their coexistence. The indigenous forest people of Jhargram district, those dependent on the services of forest ecosystems have been deeply affected by the forest policies implemented before and after India's independence. The expansion of government control over the forest resources for maximization of revenue, particularly in colonial times, paved the way to restrict forest people to access the benefits of forest ecosystem services. The main objective of this study is to analyze the impact of various regulations on forest and forest-dependent tribal people in the Jhargram District of West Bengal. The discussion has revealed some specific impacts of the forest legislation, direct and indirect in nature, on their habitat, occupation, and social and nutritional conditions. These impacts have been assessed on the basis of primary data and information generated from the field and some certain indicators. Statistical and computational techniques have been used to assess various impact. The findings attest that the effects of such legislation are consequent more upon the habitat and livelihood of the tribal groups than the non-tribal human communities.
records.abstract_cn: 数千年来，次大陆的首批定居者锚定在广阔的内陆森林生态系统中。这些首批定居者至今仍存活于不同的残余森林斑块中，被称为原住民或部落民。作为生计策略，森林居民过去常根据自身需求驯化森林生态系统的服务，同时维持着狭窄的生态平衡。森林居民的传统社会、文化和宗教习俗及信仰并非脱离森林生态系统。关于森林斑块重叠的二手数据表明了它们的共存。杰尔格拉姆区的土著森林居民依赖森林生态系统服务，他们深受印度独立前后实施的森林政策的影响。政府为了最大化收入而扩大对森林资源的控制，特别是在殖民时期，这为限制森林居民获取森林生态系统服务效益铺平了道路。本研究的主要目的是分析各种法规对西孟加拉邦杰尔格拉姆区森林及依赖森林的部落民的影响。讨论揭示了森林立法对其栖息地、职业以及社会与营养状况的一些具体影响，这些影响具有直接和间接的性质。这些影响基于实地产生的一手数据和信息以及某些特定指标进行评估。使用了统计和计算技术来评估各种影响。研究结果证实，此类立法的后果更多体现在部落群体的栖息地和生计上，而非非部落人类社区。

records.title_en: Pre-certification conditions of independent oil palm smallholders in Indonesia. Assessing prospects for RSPO certification
records.title_cn: 印度尼西亚独立油棕小农的预认证条件：评估RSPO认证前景
records.abstract_en: Smallholders, who cultivate ±30% of the global palm oil land, are critical to the realization of a sustainable palm oil sector. However, particularly independent smallholders, untied to mills, lag behind in yields and experience challenges to market their produce. Sustainability certification, such as by the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO), is proposed as a way to improve smallholder livelihoods, while protecting the environment. However, independent smallholders experience barriers to obtain certification. Through interviews with 18 RSPO certified independent smallholder groups in Indonesia and 9 certification facilitators, this study examines how pre-certification conditions regarding smallholders’ socio-economic backgrounds, legality, group organization, planation management practices, and local supply chain conditions impact prospects for RSPO certification, and how groups who successfully achieved certification have dealt with challenges during the certification process. We found that the majority (77%) of RSPO certified independent smallholders in Indonesia consists of ‘former scheme’ smallholders. These smallholders often have clear land legality and are organized in groups prior to certification, which increases their eligibility for RSPO certification. However, due to upfront and recurrent costs for certification, as well as complexities in meeting RSPO standards, access to certification is strongly dependent on external facilitators. To up-scale certification for independent oil palm smallholders, and include more non-scheme smallholders, certification projects should involve more local actors including local governments and certified smallholder groups. In addition, certification should focus on core social and environmental concerns for smallholders, while being flexible with regards to the forms of proof needed to fulfil legality requirements.
records.abstract_cn: 小农种植了全球约30%的油棕土地，对实现可持续油棕产业至关重要。然而，特别是与加工厂无关联的独立小农，其产量落后，且在销售产品方面面临挑战。可持续性认证，如可持续棕榈油圆桌会议（RSPO）认证，被提议作为改善小农生计同时保护环境的一种方式。然而，独立小农在获得认证方面面临障碍。通过对印度尼西亚18个RSPO认证的独立小农团体和9个认证促进者的访谈，本研究考察了关于小农社会经济背景、合法性、团体组织、种植园管理实践和当地供应链条件的预认证条件如何影响RSPO认证前景，以及成功获得认证的团体如何在认证过程中应对挑战。我们发现，印度尼西亚RSPO认证的独立小农中大多数（77%）是“前计划”小农。这些小农通常在认证前就拥有明确的土地合法性并组织成团体，这增加了他们获得RSPO认证的资格。然而，由于认证的前期和经常性成本，以及满足RSPO标准的复杂性，获得认证在很大程度上依赖于外部促进者。为了扩大独立油棕小农的认证规模，并纳入更多非计划小农，认证项目应涉及更多地方行为者，包括地方政府和已认证的小农团体。此外，认证应侧重于小农的核心社会和环境关切，同时在满足合法性要求所需的证明形式方面保持灵活性。

records.title_en: The spatial heterogeneity and dynamics of land redevelopment: Evidence from 287 Chinese cities
records.title_cn: 土地再开发的空间异质性与动态：来自中国287个城市的证据
records.abstract_en: China is experiencing a tough transformation from rapid growth to quality development, with extensive implementation of land redevelopment. Previous studies have analyzed the mechanisms of land redevelopment at the urban and neighborhood scales, but little attention has been paid to its spatial heterogeneity at national scales, making it impossible to measure the role of macro factors and the central government, and the differences in the driving factors across cities. Using a city-level database of 287 Chinese cities from 2012 to 2018, this paper quantitatively reveals the spatial heterogeneity of land redevelopment among different regions, administrative levels, and city sizes, and analyzes how government and market forces generate such geographic characteristics. The findings reveal that: 1) The national land redevelopment ratio increased from 26.44% in 2012 to 31.95% in 2018, with an average yearly rise of 1%. 2) Eastern cities have the largest land redevelopment scale, while Northeastern cities have the highest proportion of land redevelopment, accounting for about 40%. Despite having the highest amount of land redevelopment, high-level administrative cities and large cities do not have a higher proportion of land redevelopment than other cities. 3) Market mechanism is imperfect and unbalanced. Foreign direct investment affects land redevelopment in eastern cities with a coefficient of 0.19, while real estate development affects the western cities and small cities, with coefficients of 1.72 and 1.11, respectively. Although the government plays a crucial role in propelling land redevelopment in China, the involvement of administrative power in expanding new construction land and non-market transactions has hindered the transition to the redevelopment of existing land.
records.abstract_cn: 中国正经历从快速增长向高质量发展的艰难转型，土地再开发得到广泛实施。以往研究在城市和邻里尺度上分析了土地再开发的机制，但很少关注其在国家尺度上的空间异质性，这使得无法衡量宏观因素和中央政府的作用，以及不同城市驱动因素的差异。利用2012年至2018年中国287个城市的城市级数据库，本文定量揭示了不同区域、行政级别和城市规模之间土地再开发的空间异质性，并分析了政府与市场力量如何产生这些地理特征。研究发现：1）全国土地再开发比例从2012年的26.44%上升至2018年的31.95%，年均增长1%。2）东部城市土地再开发规模最大，而东北城市土地再开发比例最高，约占40%。尽管高行政级别城市和大城市的土地再开发量最高，但其土地再开发比例并不高于其他城市。3）市场机制不完善且不平衡。外商直接投资影响东部城市土地再开发，系数为0.19，而房地产开发影响西部城市和小城市，系数分别为1.72和1.11。尽管政府在中国推动土地再开发中发挥关键作用，但行政权力参与新增建设用地扩张和非市场交易阻碍了向存量土地再开发的转型。

records.title_en: Women’s land ownership in India: Evidence from digital land records
records.title_cn: 印度女性土地所有权：来自数字土地记录的证据
records.abstract_en: Women play critical roles in agricultural operations in many developing countries, yet they have limited ownership and de facto control over agricultural lands. Literature shows that insecure land rights constrain women’s economic prospects and make them vulnerable to poverty and violence. Despite initiating women-friendly amendments in existing polices in India, the situation has remained unresponsive. Clearly, the existing patriarchal mind-set, cultural and social ethos have imposed restrictions on women land ownership. For deriving important policy pointers, ground realities on land distribution and existing iniquities is required which is lacking in available databases. In this context, the paper aims to reinforce with evidence the bias against women in land rights at different stages so that policy can be rethought in new ways. The analysis is based on sex-disaggregated data extracted from nearly 16,000 original digital copies of land records for 12 States/Union Territories (UTs) in rural India, a first of its kind of exercise. Our results show that just having a title won’t resolve the bigger challenge of different levels of inequities that women still face when they own the land in terms of limited access to single land titles, lower shares, smaller size and inferior quality of land holdings. We also analyse the extent to which the States laws and provisions related to women land rights have controlled these biases, for which State-wise laws/ provisions were reviewed. We find mixed impacts of these provisions with significant variations across States, the reasons being lack of proper implementation and prevailing social attitudes/ customs. Finally, while emphasising the need to start rethinking and reinforcing these laws and provisions in a new way, the paper suggests feasible steps in this direction.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中国家，女性在农业经营中扮演着关键角色，但她们对农业土地的所有权和控制权却十分有限。文献表明，不安全的土地权利限制了女性的经济前景，并使她们容易遭受贫困和暴力。尽管印度在现有政策中引入了有利于女性的修正案，但情况仍未得到改善。显然，现有的父权思维、文化和社会习俗对女性土地所有权施加了限制。为了得出重要的政策建议，需要了解土地分配和现有不平等的实际情况，而这在现有数据库中尚属缺乏。在此背景下，本文旨在通过证据强化女性在土地权利不同阶段所面临的偏见，以便以新的方式重新思考政策。分析基于从印度农村地区近16,000份数字土地记录原件中提取的按性别分列的数据，涵盖12个邦/中央直辖区，这是此类研究中的首次尝试。我们的结果表明，仅仅拥有所有权并不能解决女性在拥有土地时仍面临的不同层次不平等这一更大挑战，这些不平等包括获得单一土地所有权的机会有限、份额较低、土地持有规模较小和质量较差。我们还分析了各邦与女性土地权利相关的法律和规定在多大程度上控制了这些偏见，为此审查了各邦的法律/规定。我们发现这些规定的影响不一，各邦之间存在显著差异，原因在于缺乏有效实施以及普遍存在的社会态度/习俗。最后，在强调需要以新方式重新思考和强化这些法律和规定的同时，本文提出了朝着这一方向可行的步骤。

records.title_en: Regeneration in an ecological perspective. Urban and territorial equalisation for the provision of ecosystem services in the Metropolitan City of Milan
records.title_cn: 生态视角下的再生。米兰大都市城市与区域均衡化以提供生态系统服务
records.abstract_en: In Italy, the current reform of the planning system intends to modify the land-use planning model and to address regeneration and environmental issues in contemporary cities, involving both public and private actors. In this perspective, Performance-based planning can use market-based tools such as urban and territorial equalisation, compensation and local taxation to support and incentivise the design of Nature-based solutions, Green and blue infrastructures and Ecosystem services. This article presents research developed for the Metropolitan City of Milan. The research identifies a number of environmental indicators that evaluate the outcomes of the metropolitan and local planning process and actions. The evaluation will allow the Metropolitan City to differentiate financing policies and promote multiple actors to achieve sustainability goals using the territorial and urban equalisation tool and a connected bonus reward system.
records.abstract_cn: 在意大利，当前规划体系的改革旨在修改土地利用规划模式，并处理当代城市的再生与环境问题，涉及公共和私人行为者。在此视角下，基于绩效的规划可以利用市场工具，如城市与区域均衡化、补偿和地方税收，以支持和激励基于自然的解决方案、绿色与蓝色基础设施以及生态系统服务的设计。本文介绍了为米兰大都市开展的研究。该研究确定了一系列环境指标，以评估大都市和地方规划过程及行动的成果。评估将使大都市能够区分融资政策，并利用区域与城市均衡化工具及相关的奖励积分系统，促进多方行为者实现可持续性目标。

records.title_en: Housing and the politics of Nationally Strategic Infrastructure Planning in England
records.title_cn: 住房与英格兰国家战略基础设施规划的政治
