Our results highlight that subsidy law dominated the timeline of policy changes, and years of land use conversions temporally correlated with CAP-related changes. All 13 considered area types with a special legal grassland status showed reduced permanent grassland conversion (with strongly differing conversion rates). In some cases, participation in AES correlated with an additional reduction in conversion. Future policy choices could better harmonize the use of regulatory and incentive-based policy instruments and should consider announcement and avoidance effects.
records.abstract_cn: 草原对于农业景观中的生态系统服务供给至关重要。在欧洲，过去几十年草原面积急剧下降。不同的监管和激励措施已针对此问题，例如欧盟的共同农业政策（CAP）。此外，还有国家法规。在德国，各州在政策制定中有很大的发言权，使其成为评估政策组合中不同要素影响的典型案例。我们的研究将草原相关政策的时间发展和空间分化与德国巴伐利亚州16年（2005-2020年）的实施数据进行了比较。我们基于高分辨率数据（IACS数据）对草原-农田动态进行分类，并包含农业环境计划（AES）的信息，并将其与地理数据（特殊草原地位）相交。我们的结果强调，补贴法主导了政策变化的时间线，土地利用转换的年份与CAP相关变化在时间上相关。所有13种具有特殊法律草原地位的区域类型均显示出永久草原转换减少（但转换率差异很大）。在某些情况下，参与AES与转换的额外减少相关。未来的政策选择可以更好地协调监管和激励政策工具的使用，并应考虑公告效应和规避效应。

records.title_en: On real estate market transparency: The relationship with ICT trade and investment
records.title_cn: 论房地产市场透明度：与ICT贸易和投资的关系
records.abstract_en: The relationship between information and communication technology (ICT) investment, ICT trade, and real estate market transparency is examined in this paper. National-level bi-annual data from a sample of advanced and emerging market economies for the period 2004–2018 underpins this work. The regression analyses suggest greater levels of capital investment in ICT and ICT trade are associated with increased transparency in the real estate market. The effect is more pronounced in emerging economies than in advanced ones. Real estate market transparency is also higher in contexts having less restrictions on foreign real estate investment, coupled with corruption controls. These findings also align with existing literature inferring that countries with common law traditions are often more transparent than those from civil law origins.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了信息通信技术（ICT）投资、ICT贸易与房地产市场透明度之间的关系。该研究基于2004-2018年间发达经济体和新兴市场经济体的国家级双年度数据。回归分析表明，ICT资本投资和ICT贸易水平的增加与房地产市场透明度的提高相关。这一效应在新兴经济体中比在发达经济体中更为显著。在对外国房地产投资限制较少且腐败控制得当的环境中，房地产市场透明度也更高。这些发现也与现有文献一致，即普通法传统的国家通常比大陆法起源的国家更透明。

records.title_en: Steering of land use in the context of sustainable development: A systematic review of economic instruments
records.title_cn: 可持续发展背景下的土地利用调控：经济工具的系统综述
records.abstract_en: To mitigate conflicting land use demands and to reduce increasing land consumption, effective instruments for steering land use are needed. While conventional instruments for land use planning have been increasingly criticised, economic instruments (such as taxes, subsidies and tradeable permits) have received growing attention in practice and research. The purpose of this study is to provide a systematic overview of current research on the application of economic instruments in the context of land use. We thereby identified focus areas in the research field, highlighted research needs and provide an overview of the effectiveness of different economic instruments in the context of land use. Overall, we confirmed that economic instruments have substantial potential in the context of land use steering, primarily in regard to taxes, charges and subsidies.
records.abstract_cn: 为缓解相互冲突的土地利用需求并减少日益增长的土地消耗，需要有效的土地利用调控工具。尽管传统的土地利用规划工具受到越来越多的批评，但经济工具（如税收、补贴和可交易许可证）在实践和研究中受到越来越多的关注。本研究旨在系统概述当前关于经济工具在土地利用背景下应用的研究。我们由此识别了研究领域中的重点领域，强调了研究需求，并概述了不同经济工具在土地利用背景下的有效性。总体而言，我们确认经济工具在土地利用调控方面具有巨大潜力，主要涉及税收、收费和补贴。

records.title_en: Impacts of urban sprawl in the Administrative Region of Ribeirão Preto (Brazil) and measures to restore improved landscapes
records.title_cn: 巴西里贝朗普雷图行政区城市蔓延的影响及恢复改善景观的措施
records.abstract_en: The present study addressed the problem of urban expansion in a large metropolis of Brazil (ARRP – Administrative Region of Ribeirão Preto), relating the evolution of urbanization in the past 35 years with losses of agricultural area and respective equivalent production and economic effects. Besides these food security and agribusiness issues, the study tracked important environmental consequences of the observed growing urbanization. This included water insecurity related with the occupation of watercourse networks, destruction of riparian vegetation that is legally protected as Permanent Preservation Areas (PPAs), and the occupation of Guarani Aquifer recharge areas with impermeable surfaces. The database consisted of Landsat images interpreted and processed in a Geographic Information System (GIS). The results indicate losses of rural area exceeding 350 km2 in the studied timeframe, with equivalent production and economic losses around 1.1 Mton/year and 230 MR$/year, on average. It is worth to mention the 40–75% overlap between the impermeable surfaces of some ARRP municipalities (e.g., Cajuru, Altinópolis) and recharge areas of Guarani Aquifer. The impermeable surfaces within the ARRP also affected approximately 7000 headwaters that were potential hotspots of shallow aquifer recharge. The urban sprawl destroyed more than 9100 km of natural watercourses and nearly 630 km2 of PPAs. The pathways recognized to improve the ARRP landscape included implementation of urban agriculture and landscape planning measures capable to protect the recharge to and the quality of Guarani Aquifer water, mostly anchored in the Municipal Director Plans, the prominent land use policy tools in the ARRP. This integrated, long-term, spatially explicit and quantitative assessment of urban sprawl impacts assembled with indications of landscape restoration policies and measures is novel in Brazil. On the other hand, studying the ARRP is worthwhile because of its historical relationship with the Brazilian ethanol program that brought an accelerated development to the region following the World oil crisis of 1970 s until now.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了巴西一个大都市（ARRP – 里贝朗普雷图行政区）的城市扩张问题，将过去35年的城市化演变与农业面积损失及相应的等效生产和经济影响联系起来。除了这些粮食安全和农业综合企业问题外，研究还追踪了观察到的日益增长的城市化所带来的重要环境后果。这包括与水道网络占用相关的水不安全、对依法保护为永久保护区（PPAs）的河岸植被的破坏，以及瓜拉尼含水层补给区被不透水表面占用。数据库由在 Geographic Information System（GIS）中解释和处理的 Landsat 图像组成。结果表明，在研究时间范围内，农村面积损失超过350平方公里，等效生产和经济损失平均约为每年1.1万吨和每年230亿雷亚尔。值得一提的是，一些 ARRP 市（如 Cajuru、Altinópolis）的不透水表面与瓜拉尼含水层补给区之间有40-75%的重叠。ARRP 内的不透水表面还影响了大约7000个源头，这些源头是浅层含水层补给的潜在热点。城市蔓延摧毁了超过9100公里的自然水道和近630平方公里的永久保护区。改善 ARRP 景观的途径包括实施城市农业和景观规划措施，以保护瓜拉尼含水层的补给和水质，主要依托于市政总体规划，这是 ARRP 中主要的土地利用政策工具。这种对城市蔓延影响的综合、长期、空间明确和定量评估，结合景观恢复政策和措施的指示，在巴西是新颖的。另一方面，研究 ARRP 是值得的，因为它与巴西乙醇计划的历史关系，该计划在1970年代世界石油危机后为该地区带来了加速发展，直至现在。

records.title_en: Effects of protected areas on the expansion of impervious surfaces in their vicinity: Evidence from Dutch Natura 2000
records.title_cn: 保护区对其周边不透水面扩张的影响：来自荷兰Natura 2000的证据
records.abstract_en: Protected areas can fully deliver their nature conservation function if human-induced disturbances are minimized not just inside their boundaries, but also in their immediate surroundings. This is particularly true for urbanization, which is highly disruptive and generally permanent. This paper aims to investigate how urban growth rates vary as a function of distance from Dutch Natura 2000 areas. More specifically, it looks at whether these areas might exert an effect on urbanization rates over a given distance, and which physical and management factors are associated with urbanization rates within this distance. The analysis was conducted by measuring and comparing urbanization rates in the 2006–2015 period in three series of ten 100-m, 250-m and 500-m ring buffers around 144 Natura 2000 areas, and regressing urbanization rates around such areas against several of their characteristics. Results show that urbanization rates are generally constant or slightly increasing as one moves away from these areas, but that on average they are markedly lower in a 200-m strip around the areas than they are elsewhere. Urban growth rates in this strip are particularly associated with the size, imperviousness rate, surrounding population density and administrative fragmentation of the areas. Further research is needed to investigate urbanization patterns around single areas, interactions between adjacent areas and the effect of new protected areas on urbanization in their surroundings.
records.abstract_cn: 保护区若要充分发挥其自然保护功能，不仅需要在其边界内，而且在其周边地区尽量减少人为干扰。这一点对于城市化尤其如此，因为城市化具有高度破坏性且通常是永久性的。本文旨在研究城市增长率如何随距荷兰Natura 2000区域的距离而变化。更具体地说，本文考察了这些区域是否可能对一定距离内的城市化率产生影响，以及哪些物理和管理因素与该距离内的城市化率相关。分析通过测量和比较2006-2015年期间围绕144个Natura 2000区域的三组十个100米、250米和500米环形缓冲区内的城市化率，并将这些区域周边的城市化率对其若干特征进行回归。结果表明，城市化率通常随着远离这些区域而保持恒定或略有增加，但平均而言，在区域周围200米条带内的城市化率明显低于其他地区。该条带内的城市增长率尤其与区域的面积、不透水率、周边人口密度和行政碎片化程度相关。需要进一步研究以探究单个区域周边的城市化模式、相邻区域之间的相互作用以及新保护区对其周边城市化的影响。

records.title_en: Comments on Acosta-Velázquez et al. changes in mangrove coverage classification criteria could impact the conservation of mangroves in Mexico. Land Use Policy, 2023, 129, 106651
records.title_cn: 对Acosta-Velázquez等人关于红树林覆盖分类标准变化可能影响墨西哥红树林保护的评论。土地利用政策，2023，129，106651
records.abstract_en: Accurate and up-to-date mapping of mangrove habitats is crucial for effective conservation and management strategies and policies. As a reply to the comparative assessment realized by Acosta et al. (2023) to the last map produced by the Mexican Mangrove Monitoring System (MMMS) and the conclusions resulting from it, we provide a comprehensive response addressing the concerns raised. We acknowledge that maps are not infallible and are subject to improvement, particularly in the rapidly advancing field of remote sensing technology used in long term monitoring system. The MMMS mapping efforts utilize state-of-the-art remote sensing technologies, such as high-resolution satellite imagery and advanced methodologies, to enhance precision and efficiency. Moreover, MMMS mapping integrates regional external expert knowledge to increase accuracy at uncertain locations. We emphasize the importance of accuracy and reliability in mangrove mapping due to the potential irreversible consequences of mangrove loss. The MMMS provides a valuable tool for monitoring deforestation rates, understanding spatial distribution, supporting management decisions, identifying conservation priorities, and facilitating targeted conservation actions. We highlight the application of the precautionary principle as an environmental imperative for the Mexican government. The inclusion of previously classified "Other wetlands" as mangroves in the MMMS mapping system implies the acknowledgment of their integral role in supporting biodiversity and climate change mitigation efforts. Technological progress and collaborative efforts have made this reclassification possible, enhancing our understanding and expertise in distinguishing mangroves from other wetland types. We conclude that our mapping efforts align with the objective of attaining high classification accuracy in remote sensing, and we remain committed to continuous improvement in our mangrove mapping endeavors.
records.abstract_cn: 准确且最新的红树林栖息地测绘对于有效的保护和管理策略及政策至关重要。作为对Acosta等人（2023）对墨西哥红树林监测系统（MMMS）最新地图进行的比较评估及其结论的回复，我们提供了全面的回应，以解决所提出的关切。我们承认地图并非绝对可靠，且有待改进，特别是在长期监测系统中使用的遥感技术快速发展的领域。MMMS的测绘工作利用最先进的遥感技术，如高分辨率卫星影像和先进方法，以提高精度和效率。此外，MMMS测绘整合了区域外部专家知识，以增加不确定地点的准确性。我们强调红树林测绘中准确性和可靠性的重要性，因为红树林丧失可能带来不可逆转的后果。MMMS为监测森林砍伐率、理解空间分布、支持管理决策、确定保护优先事项以及促进有针对性的保护行动提供了宝贵工具。我们强调将预防原则作为墨西哥政府的环境要务。MMMS测绘系统中将先前分类为“其他湿地”的区域纳入红树林，意味着承认它们在支持生物多样性和减缓气候变化努力中的整体作用。技术进步和协作努力使这一重新分类成为可能，增强了我们区分红树林与其他湿地类型的理解和专业知识。我们得出结论，我们的测绘工作与在遥感中实现高分类准确性的目标一致，并且我们致力于在红树林测绘工作中持续改进。

records.title_en: Opportunities and limitations for Nature-Based Solutions in EU policies – Assessed with a focus on ponds and pondscapes
records.title_cn: 基于自然的解决方案在欧盟政策中的机遇与局限——以池塘和池塘景观为评估重点
records.abstract_en: Nature-Based Solutions (NBS) are growing in popularity to mitigate and adapt to climate change, enhance biodiversity, and secure human well-being. However, the emergence of NBS has not generated equal attention for all ecosystems. One such neglected ecosystem are ponds and pondscapes (i.e. groups of ponds in a landscape), which are deteriorating in quality and diminishing in quantity. As the European Union (EU) is regarded as influential in the conceptualisation and operationalisation of NBS, we conducted a qualitative content analysis of 38 EU policies to identify opportunities and limitations for the implementation of ponds and pondscapes as NBS. We focus our analysis on ponds and pondscapes, but their prevalence in different landscapes and their multitude of benefits allows us to also make some inferences about the implications of the EU policy context for NBS at large. We find that EU policies strengthen NBS linked to existing and potential Natura 2000 sites, as well as to ecosystems protected through the EU’s Birds and Habitats Directives and Water Framework Directive. However, if ecosystems fall outside of these already established policies – as is the case with the vast majority of ponds and pondscapes – their implementation as NBS may be hampered. We also find that the EU emphasises natural water retention measures and carbon-rich ecosystems for climate change adaptation and mitigation, but mostly does not explicitly include ponds and pondscapes despite their potential contributions. Other findings are that the EU’s Horizon Europe research policy will likely influence which ecosystems will be used and financed as NBS, while the exact ambition and selection of NBS rests with lower-level authorities or individuals. Therefore, further studies tracing the impact of the supra-national EU policy framework at lower governance levels are vital.
records.abstract_cn: 基于自然的解决方案（NBS）在减缓和适应气候变化、增强生物多样性以及保障人类福祉方面日益受到欢迎。然而，NBS的出现并未对所有生态系统给予同等关注。其中一个被忽视的生态系统是池塘和池塘景观（即景观中的池塘群），其质量正在恶化，数量正在减少。鉴于欧盟在NBS的概念化和操作化方面具有影响力，我们对38项欧盟政策进行了定性内容分析，以识别将池塘和池塘景观作为NBS实施的机遇和局限。我们的分析聚焦于池塘和池塘景观，但它们在各种景观中的普遍存在及其多重益处，使我们也能对欧盟政策背景对整体NBS的影响做出一些推断。我们发现，欧盟政策强化了与现有和潜在Natura 2000保护区以及通过欧盟鸟类和栖息地指令及水框架指令保护的生态系统相关的NBS。然而，如果生态系统不在这些既有政策范围内——正如绝大多数池塘和池塘景观的情况——它们作为NBS的实施可能会受到阻碍。我们还发现，欧盟强调自然保水措施和富碳生态系统用于气候变化适应和减缓，但大多未明确包括池塘和池塘景观，尽管它们具有潜在贡献。其他发现包括，欧盟的地平线欧洲研究政策可能会影响哪些生态系统将被用作和资助为NBS，而NBS的确切雄心和选择则取决于较低层级的当局或个人。因此，进一步研究追踪超国家欧盟政策框架在较低治理层级的影响至关重要。

records.title_en: Understanding land-use sustainability with a systematical framework: An evaluation case of China
records.title_cn: 用系统化框架理解土地利用可持续性：中国的评估案例
records.abstract_en: Appraisals of land-use sustainability (LUS) are indispensable for the attainment of sustainable land-use planning and management. At present, China is experiencing a pivotal phase of comprehensive reform in land-use policy, engendering a practical necessity for system-oriented land evaluations. Despite this, studies focused on national-scale systematic LUS evaluation remain scarce. Within this context, we developed a hierarchical structural framework for land-use systems based on the assumption that sustainable land-use systems adapted to development needs have mutually adaptable internal subsystems and fewer conflicting system elements. Employing this framework, we assessed the LUS across Chinese counties from 2000 to 2015 by using a newly introduced static equilibrium equation；we also analyzed the natural and socioeconomic influences and driving effect of land-use change to LUS. Findings reveal a significant spatial clustering and urban-rural differentiation within the LUS spatial pattern. Five LUS hot and cold spots and eight metropolitan areas with poor LUS were identified. Furthermore, conflicting land capability elements and the non-adaptability of land function subsystems with capability subsystems are the primary constraints on LUS; gross domestic product (GDP), population growth, and the GDP growth per unit land area had the most significant impacts on LUS; The transformation of construction and cropland into ecological land and the re-purposing of grassland into building land are primary drivers of LUS. Our findings highlight the prospective utility of the proposed LUS framework in integrated natural resource management and territorial spatial planning. Meanwhile, Insights from this evaluation case could be harnessed to optimize land-use in critical regions (including northern arid and semiarid regions, the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau region, the poverty belt around the capital, Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta metropolitan areas, as well as Fuzhou and Xiamen metropolitan areas), thereby enhancing land management decision-making processes.
records.abstract_cn: 土地利用可持续性（LUS）评估对于实现可持续土地利用规划和管理不可或缺。目前，中国正处于土地利用政策全面改革的关键阶段，产生了对系统导向土地评估的实际需求。尽管如此，针对全国尺度的系统性LUS评估研究仍然稀缺。在此背景下，我们基于可持续土地利用系统适应发展需求且具有相互适应的内部子系统和较少冲突系统要素的假设，构建了土地利用系统的层级结构框架。运用该框架，我们通过新引入的静态均衡方程评估了2000年至2015年中国各县的LUS；我们还分析了自然和社会经济影响以及土地利用变化对LUS的驱动效应。研究结果显示，LUS空间格局存在显著的空间集聚和城乡分化。识别出五个LUS热点和冷点区域以及八个LUS较差的都市区。此外，土地能力要素的冲突以及土地功能子系统与能力子系统的非适应性是LUS的主要制约因素；国内生产总值（GDP）、人口增长和单位土地面积GDP增长对LUS的影响最为显著；建设用地和耕地向生态用地的转化以及草地转为建设用地是LUS的主要驱动因素。我们的研究结果凸显了所提出的LUS框架在综合自然资源管理和国土空间规划中的潜在应用价值。同时，该评估案例的见解可用于优化关键区域（包括北方干旱半干旱区、青藏高原地区、首都贫困带、长三角和珠三角都市区，以及福州和厦门都市区）的土地利用，从而增强土地管理决策过程。

records.title_en: Payment for environmental services: Forest conservation and poverty alleviation in a tropical region of Mexico
records.title_cn: 环境服务付费：墨西哥热带地区的森林保护与减贫
records.abstract_en: Payment for environmental services (PES) is a scheme that seeks to reduce human pressure on forest ecosystems by financially rewarding forest landowners for conserving their forests. However, in Mexico, the program is questioned because it prioritizes communities in the poorest regions over areas with a high risk of deforestation. This study evaluates the effectiveness of the PES program for forest cover conservation and poverty alleviation in a tropical region of Mexico. Deforestation and forest cover maintenance was determined by land use/cover change analysis using GIS. Effect on poverty alleviation was analyzed qualitatively in two communities. In the study area, 4738 ha of tropical and temperate forests were deforested during 2007–2017. The deforestation rate is similar in ejidos and private properties with and without PES. Most ejidos where deforestation occurred correspond to areas with higher economic development. Deforestation and the percentage of the population living in poverty are negatively correlated. Compared to other subsidies, the PES represents very low income, nevertheless, the social perception of the program is positive. Based on the lower percentage of deforestation avoided in the poorest areas and the minimal impact on livelihoods, the current PES approach is not highly effective.
records.abstract_cn: 环境服务付费（PES）是一种通过向森林土地所有者提供经济奖励以保护其森林，从而减少人类对森林生态系统压力的方案。然而，在墨西哥，该计划因优先考虑最贫困地区的社区而非森林砍伐高风险地区而受到质疑。本研究评估了PES计划在墨西哥热带地区森林覆盖保护与减贫方面的有效性。通过使用GIS的土地利用/覆盖变化分析确定了森林砍伐和森林覆盖维持情况。对减贫效果在两个社区中进行了定性分析。在研究区域内，2007-2017年间，有4738公顷的热带和温带森林被砍伐。在有和没有PES的ejidos和私人财产中，森林砍伐率相似。大多数发生森林砍伐的ejidos对应于经济发展水平较高的地区。森林砍伐与生活在贫困中的人口比例呈负相关。与其他补贴相比，PES代表的收入非常低，然而，该计划的社会认知是积极的。基于在最贫困地区避免的森林砍伐比例较低以及对生计影响最小，当前的PES方法并非高度有效。

records.title_en: Governmentality in evidence? Evolving rationalities of forest governance in Peru
records.title_cn: 证据中的治理术？秘鲁森林治理的理性演变
records.abstract_en: During the recent decades, the effectiveness, sustainability and equity of environmental and resource policies have become increasingly intertwined in governance reforms. This situation with potentially inherent trade-offs has challenged not only the policy planners and implementers, but also the scientific and expert communities to justify the role of specific forms of scientific knowledge in the pursue of multiple and often conflicting objectives. Evidence is a closure of a particular science-policy interface in which the offered scientific knowledge satisfies institutional decision-making criteria. Therefore, for decision-makers evidence is not only information that is judged useful to make their decisions but also a persuasive tool for them to justify the decisions made through giving reasons. We focus on how different prevailing decision-making and administrative rationalities, governmentalities, have shaped the knowledge base and epistemic requirements of forest governance in Peru. We depict a shift from a forester-dominated to legalistic and neoliberal forest governance structure whose main goal has been to foster the forest economy under an economistic sustainable resource use mentality. Increasingly complex administrative processes to support tracing timber extraction, transport and trade have resulted from the institutional adjustments, but, parallelly, also emerging participatory planning processes have challenged and re-politicized the forest governance structure.
records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，环境与资源政策的有效性、可持续性和公平性日益与治理改革交织在一起。这种可能固有取舍的局面不仅挑战了政策规划者和实施者，也挑战了科学和专家界，要求其在追求多重且往往相互冲突的目标时，为特定形式的科学知识的作用提供正当性。证据是特定科学与政策接口的闭合，其中所提供的科学知识满足制度性决策标准。因此，对于决策者而言，证据不仅是被认为有助于其决策的信息，也是他们通过给出理由来为所做决策辩护的说服工具。我们关注不同的主流决策和行政理性，即治理术，如何塑造了秘鲁森林治理的知识基础和认知要求。我们描绘了从以林业专家为主导的治理结构向法律主义和 neoliberal 森林治理结构的转变，其主要目标是在经济主义可持续资源利用心态下促进森林经济。日益复杂的行政程序以支持追踪木材采伐、运输和贸易，是制度调整的结果，但与此同时，新兴的参与式规划过程也挑战并重新政治化了森林治理结构。

records.title_en: Buildable land overzoning. Have new planning regulations in Poland resolved the issue?
records.title_cn: 可建设用地过度划拨。波兰的新规划法规是否解决了这一问题？
records.abstract_en: The scarcity of space as a resource and dynamic social changes call for rational management of the available land. However, many countries today struggle with inefficient space management. One of the relevant issues is the surplus of land zoned as buildable. The paper investigates whether one of such countries, Poland, has developed an effective tool to resolve the issue. The paper analyses literature, government reports and opinions, and discourses of spatial planners and identifies primary drivers of changes in buildable land zoning policies introduced to the Polish spatial planning law in 2015. It focuses on one factor particularly, the overestimation of the demand for buildable land. An analysis of masterplans drafted according to the new regulations revealed that the new policy that seemingly offered alternative and effective tools for controlling buildable land overzoning turned out to be ambiguous and ineffective. Consequently, the regulations failed to eliminate the abuses they were designed to control. The example of the Polish planning regulations shows that ambiguous laws fail to produce the expected results and need to be specified more precisely, particularly regarding nomenclature, even if the intention behind them is good.
records.abstract_cn: 空间作为资源的稀缺性以及动态的社会变化要求对可用土地进行合理管理。然而，当今许多国家都在努力应对低效的空间管理问题。其中一个相关问题就是可建设用地划拨过剩。本文调查了波兰这样一个国家是否开发出了有效的工具来解决这一问题。本文分析了文献、政府报告和意见、以及空间规划者的论述，并识别了2015年引入波兰空间规划法的可建设用地划拨政策变化的主要驱动因素。本文特别关注一个因素，即对可建设用地需求的过度估计。对根据新法规起草的总体规划的分析表明，看似提供了控制和可建设用地过度划拨的替代且有效工具的新政策，结果却模糊不清且无效。因此，这些法规未能消除其旨在控制的滥用行为。波兰规划法规的例子表明，模糊的法律无法产生预期效果，需要更精确地规定，特别是在术语方面，即使其背后的意图是好的。

records.title_en: Women and timber management: From assigned cook to strategic decision-maker of community land use
records.title_cn: 女性与木材管理：从被指派做饭到社区土地利用的战略决策者
records.abstract_en: Numerous studies on community forest and land use show clear benefits of including women in natural resource management. Women’s empowerment in collaborative timber management, however, is understudied and rarely achieved on the ground. We focused on women’s participation in seven community-based timber projects within three Brazilian Amazonian extractive reserves, asking: 1. What resources (actual allocations, future claims and expectations) have shaped women’s roles in collaborative timber management? 2. How do community women perceive their role in collaborative timber management? 3. Have community members and partner organizations perceived gender equity in collaborative timber management? Over 15 months, we carried out in-depth interviews with 52 respondents, conducted participant observation, and led focus group discussions that included community concept drawing activities. We uncovered that while these collaborative timber management projects still centered on male workers, in two of the three extractive reserves, empowerment processes ultimately opened spaces for greater engagement by women overall in strategic administrative and logging coordinator positions. We added to the scholarly conceptualizations of women’s empowerment, demonstrating that ‘power through’ can lead to more permanent empowerment levels. Although normative values associated with gender (i.e. men stronger than women) were subtly embedded in the actual allocation of both human and social resources (capacity building and networks, respectively) for collaborative timber management, integration of a few women in male-centered training efforts provided venues for transformative agency towards women’s placement in strategic timber management positions. Supporting such transformative processes to empower women in community land use and forestry requires awareness of gender-based discriminatory attitudes and practices on the part of men and women, as well as innovations by policymakers, community members, government, and non-governmental organizations.
records.abstract_cn: 许多关于社区森林和土地利用的研究表明，将女性纳入自然资源管理具有明显益处。然而，女性在合作木材管理中的赋权问题研究不足，且在实践中很少实现。我们聚焦于巴西亚马逊三个采掘保护区内七个社区木材项目中女性的参与情况，提出以下问题：1。哪些资源（实际分配、未来诉求和期望）塑造了女性在合作木材管理中的角色？2。社区女性如何看待自己在合作木材管理中的角色？3。社区成员和合作组织是否认为合作木材管理中实现了性别平等？在15个月的时间里，我们对52名受访者进行了深度访谈，开展了参与式观察，并主持了包括社区概念绘图活动在内的焦点小组讨论。我们发现，尽管这些合作木材管理项目仍以男性工人为中心，但在三个采掘保护区中的两个，赋权过程最终为女性在战略管理和伐木协调职位上的更广泛参与打开了空间。我们丰富了关于女性赋权的学术概念，证明“通过权力”可以带来更持久的赋权水平。尽管与性别相关的规范性价值观（即男性比女性强壮）微妙地嵌入在合作木材管理的人力和社会资源（分别为能力建设和网络）的实际分配中，但少数女性融入以男性为中心的培训努力为女性在战略木材管理职位上的变革性能动性提供了场所。支持这种变革过程以赋权女性参与社区土地利用和林业，需要男性和女性对基于性别的歧视性态度和实践的认识，以及政策制定者、社区成员、政府和非政府组织的创新。

records.title_en: Local to global escalation of land use conflicts: Long-term dynamics on social movements protests against pulp mills and plantation forests in Argentina and Uruguay
records.title_cn: 土地利用冲突从地方到全球的升级：阿根廷和乌拉圭针对纸浆厂和人工林的社会运动抗议的长期动态
records.abstract_en: Land-use conflicts are increasing in number and intensity. In conflicts involving power imbalances and structural asymmetries, actors may attempt to frame the conflict in a manner that would put it on the political agenda, sometimes causing an escalation of the conflict and extending the possibilities of new coalition partners. Consequently, this study aims to analyze the spread of conflict escalation across scales from the local to the international level, following political factors. We analyzed the conflict between Argentina and Uruguay over two pulp mill projects using a qualitative case study design with process tracing building on the content analysis of public documents and expert interviews. The results allow us to analyze the development of the conflict in three stages of escalation: local, international, and global. Our findings provide insights into conflict escalation patterns as important analytical concepts in land-use conflicts resulting from an active, strategic undertaking of political actors in pursuing strong allies at different levels of governance.
records.abstract_cn: 土地利用冲突的数量和强度都在增加。在涉及权力失衡和结构性不对称的冲突中，行动者可能试图以某种方式构建冲突框架，使其进入政治议程，有时会导致冲突升级并扩大新联盟伙伴的可能性。因此，本研究旨在分析冲突升级从地方到国际层面的跨尺度传播，并关注政治因素。我们采用定性案例研究设计，结合过程追踪，基于公共文献的内容分析和专家访谈，分析了阿根廷和乌拉圭之间围绕两个纸浆厂项目的冲突。结果使我们能够分析冲突在三个升级阶段的发展：地方、国际和全球。我们的发现为冲突升级模式提供了见解，这些模式是土地利用冲突中的重要分析概念，源于政治行动者在不同治理层面积极寻求强大盟友的战略性举措。

records.title_en: Effect of e-commerce popularization on farmland abandonment in rural China: Evidence from a large-scale household survey
records.title_cn: 电子商务普及对中国农村耕地撂荒的影响：来自大规模农户调查的证据
records.abstract_en: Uncertainty in the food supply continues to increase due to COVID-19 and geopolitical conflicts, and reducing farmland abandonment is an important measure for ensuring food security. In recent years, the Chinese government has promoted e-commerce demonstration projects in rural areas, so we ask does the spread of e-commerce reduce farmland abandonment? This study first constructs a theoretical framework for the effect of e-commerce on farmland abandonment and then quantifies that effect through spatial analysis and econometric models based on 12,732 households in the China Rural Household Panel Survey (CRHPS). The study found that there was a significant spatial aggregation between the popularization of e-commerce and the distribution of abandoned farmland, with a significant negative correlation between these two factors. The popularization of e-commerce has reduced farmland abandonment. The probability and size of farmland abandonment by farmers dropped by 4.1 % and 17.5 % when e-commerce was promoted in a village; the probability and size of farmland abandonment by farmers dropped by 7.8 % and 38.7 % when the rate of the popularization for e-commerce in villages increased by 1 %, respectively. E-commerce can reduce farmland abandonment in rural areas by absorbing returning labour, stimulating the land transfer market and revitalizing rural industry. With the improvement of physical infrastructure such as rural roads, the government should pay attention to the construction of digital villages including e-commerce infrastructure and continue to innovate new ways small farmers to participate in e-commerce, thus helping transform rural spaces and reusing idle land resources.
records.abstract_cn: 由于COVID-19和地缘政治冲突，粮食供应的不确定性持续增加，减少耕地撂荒是确保粮食安全的重要措施。近年来，中国政府在农村推广电子商务示范项目，因此我们提出疑问：电子商务的普及是否减少了耕地撂荒？本研究首先构建了电子商务对耕地撂荒影响的理论框架，然后基于中国农村家庭追踪调查（CRHPS）中的12,732户家庭，通过空间分析和计量经济模型量化了该影响。研究发现，电子商务普及与撂荒耕地分布之间存在显著的空间聚集性，且这两个因素之间存在显著的负相关关系。电子商务的普及减少了耕地撂荒。当村庄推广电子商务时，农户撂荒耕地的概率和面积分别下降了4.1%和17.5%；当村庄电子商务普及率每提高1%时，农户撂荒耕地的概率和面积分别下降了7.8%和38.7%。电子商务可以通过吸收返乡劳动力、刺激土地流转市场和振兴农村产业来减少农村耕地撂荒。随着农村道路等物理基础设施的改善，政府应重视包括电子商务基础设施在内的数字乡村建设，并持续创新小农户参与电子商务的新方式，从而有助于转变农村空间和重新利用闲置土地资源。

records.title_en: Urban sprawl and home-delivered services: An exploratory analysis of spatial variations of cost and quality in Flanders (Belgium)
records.title_cn: 城市蔓延与上门服务：佛兰德斯（比利时）成本与质量空间差异的探索性分析
records.abstract_en: The phenomenon of urban sprawl is assumed to entail inefficient and cost-ineffective provision of public services. In this study, we investigate the impact of urban sprawl in Flanders on the spatial variation of the quality and cost structure of various services that are provided at home or near homes. Based on a literature review and expert interviews, we collected data with the aim of modelling such cost structures, in particular of local and regional public transport, household waste collection, and postal and parcel services. The findings differ between the various services studied. For public transport, sprawl has hardly any impact on the operational expenses and on the price charged to the traveler, but it does have a direct impact on the quality of the service. In the case of waste collection, differences in operational expenses are consolidated at the level of the collection round or collector, and differences in price or quality are hardly or not at all noticeable by the consumer. Universal postal services are tightly regulated, and consolidate operational expenses at the national level, as a result of which customers do not experience price differences, although they do face differences of distance to access points. These findings indicate that the density of address points along road segments are key to cost effectiveness of home-delivered services. Two new sprawl indicators are proposed for mapping urban sprawl, allowing to model the impact on the provision of various services: the average number of address points per kilometer mapped per road segment, and the inversion, i.e. average road distance between address points mapped per address point of a road segment. The data and models are intended to nourish the debate of whether or how spatially varying costs should be passed on to customers, and allow working towards solutions that serve a more sustainable interaction between urbanization and supply of services.
records.abstract_cn: 城市蔓延现象被认为会导致公共服务供给效率低下且成本不经济。在本研究中，我们考察了佛兰德斯城市蔓延对在家或家附近提供的各种服务的质量和成本结构空间差异的影响。基于文献综述和专家访谈，我们收集了数据，旨在模拟此类成本结构，特别是地方和区域公共交通、生活垃圾收集以及邮政和包裹服务。研究结果因所研究的服务而异。对于公共交通，蔓延对运营费用和向乘客收取的价格几乎没有影响，但对服务质量有直接影响。在垃圾收集方面，运营费用的差异在收集轮次或收集者层面得到整合，而价格或质量的差异消费者几乎或完全察觉不到。普遍邮政服务受到严格监管，并在国家层面整合运营费用，因此客户不会经历价格差异，尽管他们确实面临到访问点距离的差异。这些发现表明，沿道路段地址点的密度是上门服务成本效益的关键。提出了两个新的蔓延指标用于绘制城市蔓延地图，从而能够模拟对各类服务供给的影响：每公里道路段映射的地址点平均数量，以及其倒数，即每个地址点映射的道路段上地址点之间的平均道路距离。数据和模型旨在为是否或如何将空间变化的成本转嫁给客户的辩论提供素材，并推动朝着更可持续的城市化与服务供给互动解决方案努力。

records.title_en: Impact of land tenure on livelihoods of women livestock-keepers in Burkina Faso
records.title_cn: 土地权属对布基纳法索女性牲畜饲养者生计的影响
records.abstract_en: Land is an essential asset for women livestock-keepers that help to increase their livelihoods. The main objective of this study was to assess the impact of land tenure on production systems and the income of women livestock-keeper in Burkina Faso. A face to face survey was conducted on women’s livestock-keeping practices, their access to land and production using semi structured questionnaires. Hierarchical Cluster Analysis was used to assess the women’s livestock production systems. Conditional inference tree–based classification models allowed us to identify factors that mostly determine women’s access to livestock grazing land. A generalized linear model was used to assess the effects of land access parameters on the monthly income. A total of five production systems were identified comprising of two young, two adult and one older women’s systems. Furthermore, the determinants of women’s access to land varied across regions. Overall, the monthly income, animal species kept, herd size, land use rights (e.g., land rental and monthly payment, free use of the land, inheritance, purchase) determined women access to land in Burkina Faso. Only older women widow (7.78%) own land inherited from their husbands while married women had mainly free use of the land previously used by their husbands or their own acquired land. The assessment of the impact of land parameters on monthly income highlighted that in Central-Western Region, the land size and whether women were the landowners or not, had a very high significant and positive influence on the monthly income (p = 0.000444). An increase of one square meter (m2) of land size increased income by USD $3.45 per month. The same trend was observed in Eastern Region where an increase of one m2 increased income by USD $ 8.38 per month. In South-Western region, parameters such as the land size, formal education, training and better knowledge of women's right to land access led to increased income. Based on the findings of this research, it is clear that education as well as access to land are important factors that can improve women’s income from livestock production.
records.abstract_cn: 土地是女性牲畜饲养者增加生计的重要资产。本研究的主要目标是评估土地权属对布基纳法索女性牲畜饲养者生产系统和收入的影响。通过面对面调查，使用半结构化问卷收集了女性牲畜饲养实践、土地获取和生产情况的数据。采用层次聚类分析评估女性牲畜生产系统。基于条件推断树的分类模型用于识别决定女性获取牲畜放牧土地的主要因素。使用广义线性模型评估土地获取参数对月收入的影响。共识别出五种生产系统，包括两种年轻女性、两种成年女性和一种年长女性的系统。此外，女性获取土地的决定因素因地区而异。总体而言，月收入、饲养的动物种类、畜群规模、土地使用权（如土地租赁和月付、免费使用土地、继承、购买）决定了布基纳法索女性获取土地的情况。只有年长寡妇（7.78%）拥有从丈夫那里继承的土地，而已婚女性主要免费使用其丈夫先前使用的土地或自己获得的土地。评估土地参数对月收入的影响表明，在中西部地区，土地面积以及女性是否为土地所有者，对月收入有非常显著的正向影响（p = 0.000444）。土地面积每增加一平方米（m2），月收入增加美元$3.45。东部地区也观察到同样的趋势，每增加一m2，月收入增加美元$8.38。在西南地区，土地面积、正规教育、培训和对女性土地获取权利的更好了解等参数导致收入增加。基于本研究的发现，教育和土地获取是能够提高女性牲畜生产收入的重要因素。

records.title_en: Co-design approaches in land use related sustainability science – A systematic review
records.title_cn: 土地利用相关可持续性科学中的协同设计方法——系统综述
records.abstract_en: “Co-design“ has become a widely used approach in land use science to address complex sustainability challenges. However, the term “co-design” is applied in quite different contexts, often implying different meanings and practices to implementation which leads to terminological fuzziness. Since an overview and synthesis of these different approaches is still missing, this systematic review aims at shedding light on the different meanings of “co-design,“ systematizing the body of literature on land use sciences, and exploring how scientists and experts implement co-design processes in practice. Applying a quantitative meta-analysis of 88 SCOPUS-listed publications, we identified two main objectives and types for conducting co-design research: Seventy-six studies aim at jointly developing problem-solving interventions for sustainable transformations (“intervention type”), whereas 12 studies seek to collaboratively develop research questions or agendas (type: “co-created research designs”). Using a qualitative in-depth analysis, we further divide the “intervention type” corpus into four subtypes: (a) “researcher-led and model-based” and (b) “social science-driven intervention” studies applying a rigorous pre-defined study design where scientists are the dominant actors. Subtype (c) includes studies that develop “design-led and practice-oriented interventions” and rather focus on practical outcomes than on scientific knowledge production. The subtype (d) “transformative transdisciplinary interventions and living labs” shows the strongest ties to transdisciplinary research philosophy, theory, methodology, and practice. Co-citation-network analyses reveal that these subtypes have partly evolved independently from each other by using different theoretical and methodological references. Generally, “co-design“ is applied in various ways, but without an agreement on what exactly “co-design” entails. It is often used intuitively across the subtypes, without carefully reflecting the existing theoretical and methodological foundations. Finally, we provide suggestions for supporting an integration of “co-design“ into future research projects in a more conscious and sound way.
records.abstract_cn: “协同设计”已成为土地利用科学中应对复杂可持续性挑战的广泛使用的方法。然而，“协同设计”一词在不同背景下应用，往往意味着不同的含义和实施实践，导致术语模糊。由于对这些不同方法的概述和综合仍然缺失，本系统综述旨在阐明“协同设计”的不同含义，系统化土地利用科学的文献体系，并探讨科学家和专家在实践中如何实施协同设计过程。通过对88篇SCOPUS收录文献的定量元分析，我们确定了开展协同设计研究的两个主要目标和类型：七十六项研究旨在共同制定可持续转型的问题解决干预措施（“干预类型”），而12项研究寻求合作制定研究问题或议程（类型：“共同创造的研究设计”）。通过定性深入分析，我们进一步将“干预类型”语料库分为四个子类型：（a）“研究者主导和基于模型”和（b）“社会科学驱动的干预”研究，采用严格的预定义研究设计，其中科学家是主导行动者。子类型（c）包括制定“设计主导和实践导向的干预”研究，更侧重于实际成果而非科学知识生产。子类型（d）“变革性跨学科干预和生活实验室”与跨学科研究哲学、理论、方法论和实践的联系最为紧密。共被引网络分析显示，这些子类型部分独立发展，使用了不同的理论和方法论参考。总体而言，“协同设计”以多种方式应用，但对“协同设计”具体包含什么没有共识。它通常在各子类型中被直观使用，而没有仔细反思现有的理论和方法论基础。最后，我们为支持将“协同设计”更自觉和合理地整合到未来研究项目中提供了建议。

records.title_en: Swiss Parks of National Importance as model regions of sustainable development – An economic success story for farmers?
records.title_cn: 瑞士国家重要公园作为可持续发展的模范区域——农民的经济成功故事？
records.abstract_en: Evidence on the socioeconomic effects of the protected area status of affected regions is mixed. While some studies highlight positive outcomes for these regions, others point in the opposite direction. Consequently, this study aimed to add to the discourse on whether protected area status fosters the socioeconomic development of these regions or not. The study focuses on the agricultural sector in protected areas, because this sector is of particular importance for local communes in these regions. Our study aimed to investigate whether the status Swiss Park of National Importance (henceforth park) positively or negatively influenced economic indicators of local farms (i.e., direct payments, income, and revenues). Specifically, the study answers the following question: How would economic farm indicators have developed if the territory had not gained park status? Thus, the study compared the economic indicators of farms located in a park with economic indicators of farms from neighboring regions outside the park. The analyses focused on the United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Biosphere Reserve Entlebuch and the Nature Park Gantrisch as case study regions. The empirical findings revealed that gaining the park status had neither positive nor negative significant effects on income of farms inside a park compared to similar farms outside. However, results also showed that gaining the park status had positive rather than negative effects on further economic indicators such as direct payments and revenues.
records.abstract_cn: 关于受保护区域地位对受影响地区社会经济影响的证据不一。一些研究强调了这些地区的积极成果，而其他研究则指向相反方向。因此，本研究旨在为关于受保护区域地位是否促进这些地区社会经济发展的讨论增添内容。研究聚焦于受保护区域内的农业部门，因为该部门对这些地区的当地社区尤为重要。本研究旨在调查瑞士国家重要公园（以下简称公园）地位是否对当地农场的经济指标（即直接支付、收入和收益）产生正面或负面影响。具体而言，研究回答了以下问题：如果该地区未获得公园地位，农业经济指标将如何发展？因此，研究将位于公园内的农场经济指标与公园外邻近地区的农场经济指标进行了比较。分析聚焦于联合国教育、科学及文化组织（UNESCO）恩特勒布赫生物圈保护区与甘蒂施自然公园作为案例研究区域。实证研究结果显示，获得公园地位对公园内农场收入与公园外类似农场相比，既无显著正面也无显著负面影响。然而，结果也表明，获得公园地位对直接支付和收益等其他经济指标产生了正面而非负面的影响。

records.title_en: Museums for ex situ tangible heritage conservation: A neo-institutional analytical and empirical economic analysis
records.title_cn: 异地有形遗产保护的博物馆：新制度分析及实证经济分析
records.abstract_en: As a first attempt to position the role of museums in land use planning, this paper modifies a neo-institutional economic perspective to canvass the economic advantages of a museum as a form of real property in a community. It explains that a museum, outdoor or indoor, as a derived demand for real property because selected ex situ heritage items need space to concentrate. Such concentration not only reduces the transaction costs of searching for users but also accumulates value by being positioned at a fixed location, as in the case of a heritage building as in situ heritage, so that it may even become a new heritage site (if not also a heritage building) over a period of time. This is demonstrated by the case of London Bus Museum, which stands in sharp contrast to a hidden private collection of retired buses in Hong Kong. An empirical test of the effects on values of neighbouring property of a cattle depot/slaughter house reused as an art museum was conducted to shed light on the economic advantages of a museum. This paper expands the understanding of curating to encompass the formation of a museum and the gaining of heritage value for the museum itself. Some land use implications are discussed, particularly that museums should be purpose-built rather than being accommodated in heritage buildings.
records.abstract_cn: 作为首次尝试定位博物馆在土地利用规划中的作用，本文修正了新制度经济学视角，以考察博物馆作为社区中一种不动产形式的经济优势。本文解释了博物馆，无论是室外还是室内，作为对不动产的派生需求，因为选定的异地遗产物品需要空间来集中。这种集中不仅减少了寻找使用者的交易成本，而且通过固定在某一地点而积累价值，如同建筑遗产作为原地遗产的情况，以至于经过一段时间后，它甚至可能成为一个新的遗产地（如果不是遗产建筑的话）。这一点通过伦敦巴士博物馆的案例得以证明，该案例与香港一个隐藏的退役巴士私人收藏形成鲜明对比。本文还对将牲畜仓库/屠宰场改建为艺术博物馆对邻近物业价值的影响进行了实证检验，以阐明博物馆的经济优势。本文扩展了对策展的理解，将其涵盖博物馆的形成以及博物馆自身遗产价值的获取。本文讨论了一些土地利用方面的启示，特别是博物馆应专门建造，而非安置在遗产建筑中。

records.title_en: Policy development to support ecosystem services on pasture systems in Saskatchewan: A case study
records.title_cn: 萨斯喀彻温省牧场系统生态系统服务支持的政策制定：案例研究
records.abstract_en: Grasslands provide a wide variety of public and private environmental benefits arising from ecosystem services. At the same time, grassland ecosystems are being irreversibly altered. To protect grassland ecosystems and services, many policies have been introduced to encourage private grassland owners and users to adopt management practices to conserve and enhance ecosystem services. However, because such practices are largely voluntary, they are only effective if private ranchers and landowners opt in. The purpose of this case study was to identify acceptable and cost-effective policy tools to increase the provision of ecosystem services on Saskatchewan grasslands. A sample of Saskatchewan ranchers were surveyed to investigate their opinions and attitudes toward ecosystem services produced by grasslands, preferred policy parameters associated with grassland enhancement, and willingness-to-accept (WTA) to forego production in return for grassland conservation. The results indicated Saskatchewan ranchers place positive value on ecosystem services, but would require incentives ranging between $34.83 and $42.58 per acre ($86.06 and $105.21 per hectare) to compensate for a 10 % loss in production associated with increasing grassland conservation. Additionally, ranchers prefer policy options most closely aligned with their values indicating that conservation practices that enhance water quality and wildlife/habitat were far preferred to carbon sequestration. Results have implications for policy options and grassland conservation, particularly in a time where public grasslands in Saskatchewan have been privatized.
records.abstract_cn: 草地通过生态系统服务提供了广泛的公共和私人环境效益。与此同时，草地生态系统正在被不可逆转地改变。为了保护草地生态系统和服务，许多政策已被引入，以鼓励私人草地所有者和使用者采用管理实践来保护和增强生态系统服务。然而，由于这些实践在很大程度上是自愿的，只有私人牧场主和土地所有者选择参与时才有效。本案例研究的目的是确定可接受且成本效益高的政策工具，以增加萨斯喀彻温省草地上生态系统服务的提供。对萨斯喀彻温省牧场主进行了抽样调查，以调查他们对草地产生的生态系统服务的看法和态度、与草地增强相关的首选政策参数，以及为草地保护而放弃生产的接受意愿（WTA）。结果表明，萨斯喀彻温省牧场主对生态系统服务赋予积极价值，但需要每英亩34.83美元至42.58美元（每公顷86.06美元至105.21美元）的激励，以补偿与增加草地保护相关的10%的生产损失。此外，牧场主更倾向于与其价值观最接近的政策选项，表明增强水质和野生动物/栖息地的保护实践远优于碳封存。结果对政策选项和草地保护具有启示意义，特别是在萨斯喀彻温省公共草地已被私有化的时期。

records.title_en: Optimizing land use patterns to improve the contribution of land use planning to carbon neutrality target
records.title_cn: 优化土地利用模式以提升土地利用规划对碳中和目标的贡献
records.abstract_en: Land use planning has the potential to diminish carbon storages and exacerbate carbon emissions, and therefore improving its contribution to achieve carbon neutrality should be a priority. In this study, we proposed an integrated framework to reveal the interrelation between land use and carbon neutrality. We employed the Linear Programming Model (LPM), Markov, Future Land Use Simulation (FLUS), emission coefficients and the Integrated Valuation of Ecosystem Services and Trade-offs (InVEST) to predict land use patterns in Hainan Island, China and assessed the potential for reducing carbon emissions and increasing carbon storages under four scenarios: natural development (ND), spatial planning (SP), low-carbon emission (LE), and high-carbon storage (HS) by 2035. The results demonstrate that the new Territory Spatial Planning in 2035 can effectively reduce carbon emissions and increase carbon sinks. Specifically, compared to the ND scenario, carbon emissions will decrease by 5.37 % and carbon storages increase by 0.11 % in the SP scenario. Furthermore, the optimized land use patterns in the low-carbon scenarios will result in a greater reduction in carbon emissions and a larger increase in carbon sinks than the SP scenario. Specifically, compared to the SP scenario, carbon emissions will decrease by 11.83 % in the LE scenario, and carbon storages increase by 4.81 % in the HS scenario. Through the integration of planning and carbon neutrality via land use optimization, this study broadened the theoretical analysis framework and deepened our comprehension of the relationship between land use and carbon neutrality. Moreover, the insights derived from our findings offer valuable information to policymakers on carbon neutrality policy-making and land use planning in Hainan and other regions facing the similar challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 土地利用规划有可能减少碳储量并加剧碳排放，因此提高其对实现碳中和目标的贡献应成为优先事项。在本研究中，我们提出了一个综合框架来揭示土地利用与碳中和之间的相互关系。我们采用线性规划模型（LPM）、马尔可夫模型、未来土地利用模拟（FLUS）、排放系数以及生态系统服务与权衡综合评估（InVEST）模型，预测了中国海南岛的土地利用模式，并评估了在四种情景下减少碳排放和增加碳储量的潜力：自然发展（ND）、空间规划（SP）、低碳排放（LE）和高碳储量（HS），目标年份为2035年。结果表明，新的国土空间规划到2035年可以有效减少碳排放并增加碳汇。具体而言，与ND情景相比，SP情景下的碳排放将减少5.37%，碳储量增加0.11%。此外，低碳情景下的优化土地利用模式将比SP情景带来更大的碳排放减少和碳汇增加。具体而言，与SP情景相比，LE情景下的碳排放将减少11.83%，HS情景下的碳储量增加4.81%。通过土地利用优化将规划与碳中和相结合，本研究拓宽了理论分析框架，加深了我们对土地利用与碳中和之间关系的理解。此外，我们的研究结果所获得的见解为海南及其他面临类似挑战地区的政策制定者提供了关于碳中和政策制定和土地利用规划的宝贵信息。

records.title_en: Exploring the temporal and spatial effects of city size on regional economic integration: Evidence from the Yangtze River Economic Belt in China
records.title_cn: 城市规模对区域经济一体化的时空效应探究：来自中国长江经济带的证据
records.abstract_en: The continuous expansion of cities has led to prominent threats of urban housing shortage, inefficient land use, and environmental degradation. Determining an appropriate city size to promote REI is a fundamental problem in China’s new-type urbanization period. This study investigated the impact of city size on REI from the spatio-temporal perspective, and performed an empirical investigation of such effects through spatial models, using panel data for 2004–2019 for 108 cities in the Yangtze River Economic Belt (YREB). The results demonstrate that city size has an inverted U-shaped effect on REI, and the effects vary across urban agglomerations in the YREB. Moreover, we calculated their growth potential from the REI perspective based on 2019 data. This study examined 108 cities and found that 30 of them had exceeded their optimal size for efficiency during the REI process, highlighting the need for spatial territorial governance, management, and planning. Of the remaining cities, 68 were near their REI efficiency-maximizing size, with no more than 20% growth potential. Only 6 cities had the potential to expand between 20% and 50%, while 4 cities had the capacity to grow by more than 50%. Therefore, governments must develop tailored land use and urban management policies for each city to enhance their REI.
records.abstract_cn: 城市的持续扩张导致了城市住房短缺、土地利用效率低下和环境退化等突出威胁。确定合适的城市规模以促进区域经济一体化（REI）是中国新型城镇化时期的一个基本问题。本研究从时空视角考察了城市规模对REI的影响，并利用长江经济带（YREB）108个城市2004-2019年的面板数据，通过空间模型对这些效应进行了实证研究。结果表明，城市规模对REI具有倒U型效应，且该效应在长江经济带的不同城市群之间存在差异。此外，我们基于2019年的数据从REI角度计算了它们的增长潜力。本研究考察了108个城市，发现其中30个城市在REI过程中已超过其效率最优规模，凸显了空间领土治理、管理和规划的必要性。在其余城市中，68个城市接近其REI效率最大化规模，增长潜力不超过20%。只有6个城市的扩张潜力在20%至50%之间，而4个城市具备超过50%的增长能力。因此，政府必须针对每个城市制定量身定制的土地利用和城市管理政策，以增强其REI。

records.title_en: Conflicts in urban peripheries in Europe
records.title_cn: 欧洲城市边缘区的冲突
records.abstract_en: Urbanization is a global trend which is taking place at the costs of agricultural, forest, and other natural or semi-natural areas. As a result of urbanization, transitioning zones in urban peripheries located between urban and rural areas have a mixed character from a spatial, ecological, socio-demographic, and economic point of view. Different land use mixes and interests exist there in parallel and cause tensions and conflicts. In our research, we aimed at investigating the specific characteristics of conflicts in urban peripheries across Europe, showing striking examples and discussing possible recommendations for policy and planning addressing those conflicts. A structured literature review of 94 papers was conducted. The findings reflected a huge diversity in locations, contexts, and methods. Conflicts in urban peripheries in Europe is an interdisciplinary topic that is handled by social as well as natural sciences. We have identified four main conflict categories in urban peripheries: (a) land-use conflicts that relate to diverging interest in land use, (b) socio-economic conflicts that related to social aspects emerging between governance actors and different economic interests, (c) ethnic conflicts that related to race, religion, and custom, and (d) human-wildlife conflicts. The majority of papers were found in the category of land-use conflicts in urban peripheries. The main conflict topics in urban peripheries were related to socio-economic imbalances, house construction, and ethnic differences. Several types of governance actors and conflict topics could be assigned to each conflict category showing the variety in this context. A general recommendation to mitigate conflicts in urban peripheries could be a combination of various top-down and bottom-up policy and planning approaches, consulted and implemented by the governance actors who have been sensitized for the different viewpoints.
records.abstract_cn: 城市化是一个全球性趋势，其代价是农业、森林及其他自然或半自然区域的减少。城市化的结果是，位于城市与农村之间的城市边缘过渡地带，在空间、生态、社会人口和经济方面具有混合特征。不同的土地利用混合和利益并存于此，引发紧张和冲突。在我们的研究中，旨在调查欧洲城市边缘区冲突的具体特征，展示显著案例，并讨论针对这些冲突的政策和规划的可能建议。对94篇论文进行了结构化文献综述。研究结果反映了地点、背景和方法的巨大多样性。欧洲城市边缘区的冲突是一个跨学科主题，由社会科学和自然科学共同处理。我们确定了城市边缘区的四大冲突类别：(a) 与土地利用利益分歧相关的土地利用冲突，(b) 与治理行动者和不同经济利益之间出现的社会方面相关的社会经济冲突，(c) 与种族、宗教和习俗相关的民族冲突，以及(d) 人类与野生动物冲突。大多数论文属于城市边缘区土地利用冲突类别。城市边缘区的主要冲突主题与社会经济失衡、房屋建设和民族差异有关。每一冲突类别可对应多种治理行动者和冲突主题，显示了该背景下的多样性。缓解城市边缘区冲突的一般建议可能是自上而下和自下而上的政策与规划方法的结合，由对不同观点敏感的治理行动者咨询和实施。

records.title_en: Identification and analysis of transitional zone patterns along urban-rural-natural landscape gradients: An application to China’s southwest mountains
records.title_cn: 城乡-自然景观梯度过渡带模式的识别与分析：以中国西南山区为例
records.abstract_en: Urban-rural-natural (U-R-N) gradients can integrate numerous landscapes with distinct regional functions to illustrate the uncertainty, dynamics, and gradients of the mountainous socio-ecological systems. Hence, identifying transitional zones (TZs) along U-R-N landscape gradients, which contain cohesively various landscapes, and analyzing their transition trends and patterns are of paramount significance for regional landscape planning. Through the integration of geographically weighted principal component analysis (GWPCA), raster rearrangement, and abrupt bin detection, this study aims to develop a novel framework approach for identifying TZs and analyzing transition trends and type patterns along U-R-N gradients in southwestern mountains, China. The findings indicate that TZs cover 61,880 km2 and account for 5.37 % of southwestern mountains, primarily in the hills and mountains of the Sichuan Basin and the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau. TZs are typically found along U-R-N gradients; however, they are most concentrated in the R1 and R2 of rural landscapes, with farmlands being the most extensively distributed land use type inside TZs. In the southwest mountains, the TZs patterns along U-R-N gradients cover 9 landscape types, including 4 TZ types, of which urban-rural transition zones (U-RTZ) account for 49.36 % of all TZs and comprise the most complete U-R-N gradients. Gradients may also be detected in the component structures of TZs, and TZs have become increasingly sharp and prominent along U-R-N and topographical gradients. This framework approach overcomes the restrictions of previous TZs that were limited to nearby geographical boundaries, and can contribute to our understanding the mutual feedbacks and interactive processes of mountainous coupled socioecological systems, thus empowering the provision of a more elastic space for revolutionary growth while still protecting variegated natural habitats in mountains for future generations.
records.abstract_cn: 城乡-自然（U-R-N）梯度可以整合具有不同区域功能的众多景观，以说明山区社会-生态系统的不确定性、动态性和梯度性。因此，识别沿U-R-N景观梯度的过渡带（TZs），这些过渡带包含多种景观，并分析其过渡趋势和模式，对于区域景观规划具有重要意义。通过整合地理加权主成分分析（GWPCA）、栅格重排和突变区间检测，本研究旨在开发一种新的框架方法，用于识别中国西南山区沿U-R-N梯度的过渡带，并分析其过渡趋势和类型模式。研究结果表明，过渡带覆盖61,880平方公里，占西南山区的5.37%，主要分布在四川盆地和云贵高原的丘陵和山区。过渡带通常沿U-R-N梯度分布；然而，它们最集中在农村景观的R1和R2区域，农田是过渡带内分布最广泛的土地利用类型。在西南山区，沿U-R-N梯度的过渡带模式涵盖9种景观类型，包括4种过渡带类型，其中城乡过渡带（U-RTZ）占所有过渡带的49.36%，并构成最完整的U-R-N梯度。梯度也可以在过渡带的组分结构中检测到，并且过渡带沿U-R-N和地形梯度变得越来越尖锐和突出。该框架方法克服了以往过渡带仅限于邻近地理边界的限制，有助于我们理解山区耦合社会-生态系统之间的相互反馈和互动过程，从而为革命性增长提供更具弹性的空间，同时为子孙后代保护山区多样化的自然栖息地。

records.title_en: Digital twins and land management in South Korea
records.title_cn: 数字孪生与韩国土地管理
records.abstract_en: Use of digital twins is becoming a global trend according to Gartner, the United Nations Committee of Experts on Global Geospatial Information Management (UN-GGIM) and the Centre for Digital Built Britain (CDBB). In line with this trend, South Korea has applied digital twins to land systems. To this end, a pilot project has been performed in Jeonju city. This study reviews digital twins and land conceptually and analyses the case in Jeonju. Conceptually, in terms of effective policy decision support, digital twins and land have shared characteristics, encompassing physical land, virtual land, and land-related data. The case of Jeonju city has been reviewed in terms of the relationship between digital twins and land. In the process of collection and renewal of data from physical land, systematic data-management systems and collaboration among related departments and/or persons in charge are important. In terms of processing for digitalization in the virtual space, sufficient budget and human resource management have been identified as important elements. As for analysis and simulation conducted in the virtual space, trust in the model of analysis and simulation needs to be developed through verification and job rotation in the civil service; without proper transfer of duties and responsibilities, this could be an obstacle. In the process of decision-making with regard to physical land, social issues that could be caused by digital technologies need to be carefully considered. Last but not least, legal and institutional support is required. In order to improve the case of Jeonju city, the establishment of a digital twin committee with appropriate authority under the mayor is recommended, because single departments tend to have difficulty in dealing with diverse issues.
records.abstract_cn: 根据高德纳咨询公司、联合国全球地理空间信息管理专家委员会（UN-GGIM）和英国数字建造中心（CDBB）的说法，数字孪生的使用正成为一种全球趋势。顺应这一趋势，韩国已将数字孪生应用于土地系统。为此，在全州市开展了一个试点项目。本研究从概念上审视数字孪生与土地，并分析全州的案例。在概念上，就有效的政策决策支持而言，数字孪生与土地具有共同特征，涵盖物理土地、虚拟土地和土地相关数据。全州市的案例已从数字孪生与土地之间关系的角度进行了审视。在从物理土地收集和更新数据的过程中，系统化的数据管理系统以及相关部门和/或负责人之间的协作至关重要。在虚拟空间中进行数字化处理方面，充足的预算和人力资源管理已被确定为重要因素。至于在虚拟空间中进行的分析和模拟，需要通过验证和公务员轮岗来建立对分析和模拟模型的信任；如果没有适当的职责和责任的移交，这可能成为一个障碍。在涉及物理土地的决策过程中，需要仔细考虑数字技术可能引发的社会问题。最后但同样重要的是，需要法律和制度支持。为了改进全州市的案例，建议在市长领导下设立一个具有适当权力的数字孪生委员会，因为单一部门往往难以处理各种问题。

records.title_en: Urban agriculture business models and value propositions: Mixed methods approach based on evidence from Polish and Italian case studies
records.title_cn: 城市农业商业模式与价值主张：基于波兰和意大利案例研究的混合方法
records.abstract_en: Nowadays, trends related to alternative promotion options for small farmers in changing agri-food supply chains stand out. Urban Agriculture (UA) is a multifaceted system ranging from traditional production, processing, distribution, and consumption to a collection of new and less imagined goods and services. UA generally differs from conventional food chains in the origins, the place of production, and the production conditions. This paper focuses on an aspect less addressed by previous research: the analysis of strategic business models adopted by urban farm (UF) practitioners. The work uses a meta-model called Business Model Canvas (BMC), expanding on it with Value Proposition Canvas (VPC) model to explore how they communicate value to target customers and different market segments. Accordingly, in-depth interviews and participant observation were conducted from February 2020 – to February 2021 to gather extensive qualitative information. We selected two European economies in Eastern and Western Europe, Poland and Italy, with different UA relevance and functionality, to better identify potential UF business models. We identified three UF business strategies: service-oriented, product-oriented and land-use-oriented. UFs are gaining traction by impacting beyond financial and economic significance. The new value proposition is a powerful way to create a broader customer base and develop innovative product and service solutions to deliver unique value. It is a development path for UFs and urban agglomerations’ sustainable development. This study led to the conceptualization of the cross-cultural business meta-model of UF. It recognizes UFs as distinct entities with diverse functions and value propositions and informs the emergent UA theory and practical applications in UFs.
records.abstract_cn: 如今，在变化的农产品供应链中，与小农户替代推广选择相关的趋势尤为突出。城市农业（UA）是一个多方面的系统，从传统的生产、加工、分配和消费，到一系列新的和难以想象的商品和服务。城市农业通常在来源、生产地点和生产条件方面与传统食品链不同。本文关注的是以往研究较少涉及的方面：城市农场（UF）从业者采用的战略商业模式分析。本研究使用一个称为商业模式画布（BMC）的元模型，并扩展了价值主张画布（VPC）模型，以探索他们如何向目标客户和不同市场细分传达价值。据此，在2020年二月至2021年二月期间进行了深度访谈和参与观察，以收集广泛的定性信息。我们选择了东欧和西欧的两个欧洲经济体，波兰和意大利，它们具有不同的城市农业相关性和功能，以更好地识别潜在的城市农场商业模式。我们确定了三种城市农场商业策略：服务导向型、产品导向型和土地利用导向型。城市农场通过超越财务和经济意义的影响而获得关注。新的价值主张是创造更广泛客户群和开发创新产品和服务解决方案以提供独特价值的强大方式。这是城市农场和城市群可持续发展的一个发展路径。本研究导致了城市农场跨文化商业元模型的概念化。它承认城市农场是具有不同功能和价值主张的独特实体，并为新兴的城市农业理论和城市农场的实际应用提供了信息。

records.title_en: Assessing the effectiveness, practicality and cost effectiveness of mitigation measures to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from intensively cultivated peatlands
records.title_cn: 评估减少集约耕作泥炭地温室气体排放缓解措施的有效性、实用性和成本效益
records.abstract_en: Peatlands drained for agriculture are among the most intensive sources of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from the land-use sector. Policy decisions on the most effective strategies to reduce GHG emissions in line with Paris Agreement goals, alongside strategies that can halt any ongoing soil and biodiversity losses, are hindered by a lack of understanding on how proposed mitigation measures are likely to be received by the farming sector. Research has identified effective GHG reduction measures, but successful on-farm adoption of these measures is contingent upon farmer perceptions of the relative practicality of implementing the measures, and the economic impact that adoption will have on the farm business. In this study, Best–Worst Scaling, a discrete choice survey method, was utilised to elicit expert (climate change, policy and biodiversity) and farmer opinion on the relative effectiveness, practicality and level of economic cost of mitigation measures that can reduce GHG emissions at the farm level. The method enabled individual mitigation measures to be ranked by effectiveness (expert opinion), practicality and economic cost (farmer opinions). There were no measures ranked as both effective and practical, or effective with low cost, but there were measures ranked by farmers as practical and low cost to implement. These included: more effective nutrient management, reduced or no tillage, the installation of buffer zones, increased fossil fuel efficiency and the optimisation of irrigation systems. The strong divergence of ‘effective’ measures on the one hand, and ‘practical’ and ‘economic’ measures on the other, highlights the major challenges involved in reducing high GHG emissions from agricultural organic soils. Resolving these challenges will require a combination of financial mechanisms to compensate farmers for higher costs and/or reduced yields, engagement and advice to support farmers in adopting changes in management practice, and agricultural innovation and adaptation to maintain overall food production and economic viability. If these challenges are overcome, more sustainable landscape management on agricultural lowland peat could make significant contributions to achieve national and international climate change targets.
records.abstract_cn: 为农业而排水的泥炭地是土地利用部门温室气体（GHG）排放最密集的来源之一。根据《巴黎协定》目标制定最有效的温室气体减排战略，以及能够阻止持续土壤和生物多样性损失的战略，其政策决策因缺乏对拟议缓解措施可能被农业部门接受程度的理解而受阻。研究已确定了有效的温室气体减排措施，但这些措施在农场层面的成功采用取决于农民对实施措施相对实用性的看法，以及采用这些措施对农场经营的经济影响。在本研究中，采用最佳-最差标度法（一种离散选择调查方法）来征询专家（气候变化、政策和生物多样性）和农民对农场层面可减少温室气体排放的缓解措施相对有效性、实用性和经济成本水平的意见。该方法使各项缓解措施能够按有效性（专家意见）、实用性和经济成本（农民意见）进行排序。没有措施被同时评为有效且实用，或有效且低成本，但有一些措施被农民评为实用且实施成本低。这些措施包括：更有效的养分管理、减少或免耕、安装缓冲区、提高化石燃料效率以及优化灌溉系统。一方面“有效”措施与另一方面“实用”和“经济”措施之间的强烈分歧，凸显了减少农业有机土壤高温室气体排放所涉及的重大挑战。解决这些挑战需要结合财务机制以补偿农民较高的成本和/或较低的产量，参与和咨询以支持农民采用管理实践的改变，以及农业创新和适应以维持整体粮食生产和经济可行性。如果这些挑战得到克服，农业低地泥炭上更可持续的景观管理可以为实现国家和国际气候变化目标做出重大贡献。

records.title_en: Reciprocity principle and private property rights in land: Coasean world is neither neoclassical nor capitalist
records.title_cn: 互惠原则与土地私有产权：科斯世界既非新古典也非资本主义
records.abstract_en: The “Coase theorem” states that in a zero-transaction cost neoclassical world society’s wealth is not affected by the allocation of liabilities rules. The “theorem” rests upon two fundamental premises: the first concerns Coase’s view of mutual causation of harm, namely the reciprocity principle, and the second refers to his understanding of private property as a bundle of use rights. However, when these two premises are specifically applied in cases of trespass to land, not only portray a blur picture of private property, but they also contradict the very nature of rights over property. Specifically, I am arguing that these two premises undermine the centrality of exclusion rights to the institution of land property, hence violate the de jure basis of these rights, as well their private nature. This is turn implies that Coasean world is a world where the prevalent idea of mutual causation of harm creates idiosyncratic and partial rather than standardized de jure private property rights in land. As such, this Coasean version of the world fundamentally breaks from the neoclassical view of the capitalist world, where the security and exercise of private property rights in land is a sine qua non condition for the working of the economic system.
records.abstract_cn: “科斯定理”指出，在一个零交易成本的新古典世界中，社会财富不受责任规则分配的影响。该“定理”基于两个基本前提：第一个涉及科斯关于损害相互因果关系的观点，即互惠原则；第二个则指他将私有财产理解为一系列使用权的集合。然而，当这两个前提具体应用于土地侵权案件时，不仅描绘了私有财产的模糊图景，而且与财产权利的本质相矛盾。具体而言，我认为这两个前提削弱了排他权在土地产权制度中的核心地位，从而违反了这些权利的法律基础及其私有性质。这反过来意味着，科斯世界是一个相互损害因果关系的主流观念创造出特殊且部分而非标准化的法律上的土地私有产权的世界。因此，这种科斯版本的世界从根本上背离了新古典对资本主义世界的看法，在资本主义世界中，土地私有产权的安全与行使是经济体系运行的必要条件。

records.title_en: Pro-poor change in the aftermath of disasters – Exploring possibilities at the intersection of disaster politics and land rights issues in Central Philippines
records.title_cn: 灾后亲贫变革——探索菲律宾中部灾害政治与土地权利问题交叉的可能性
records.abstract_en: This article demonstrates how natural disasters can rearrange arenas of contestation over land use, ownership and titling. It analyses how state agents, organized civil society, communities and powerful business groups in three cases in rural Philippines dealt with the challenges and opportunities for agrarian reform after being hit by typhoon Haiyan in 2013. Understanding this connection between agrarian reform and disasters will become increasingly important to address the vulnerabilities of the marginalized in the context of climate change and related rise in disasters. An actor-oriented perspective and a case study method was used to unravel how specific communities engage with processes of agrarian reform after a disaster and how a crisis can change dynamics between actors from above and below in agrarian reform processes. This is needed since the people’s perspective on these processes is often missing and knowledge on the everyday experiences of social change is limited. The cases show that disasters are a window of opportunity to reverse or accelerate complicated agrarian reform processes: by restructuring dynamics between actors from below and above in existing, sometimes stagnated agrarian reform processes, by revealing political dynamics that were invisible before or by creating new possibilities to mobilize actors from above and below to claim access to land.
records.abstract_cn: 本文展示了自然灾害如何重新安排围绕土地利用、所有权和土地确权的争议领域。它分析了菲律宾农村三个案例中的国家代理人、有组织的公民社会、社区和强大的商业集团在遭受2013年台风海燕袭击后如何应对土地改革的挑战和机遇。理解土地改革与灾害之间的这种联系，对于在气候变化及相关灾害增加的背景下解决边缘群体的脆弱性将变得越来越重要。本研究采用行动者导向的视角和案例研究方法，以揭示特定社区如何在灾后参与土地改革进程，以及危机如何改变土地改革进程中自上而下和自下而上的行动者之间的动态。这是必要的，因为人们对这些进程的视角常常缺失，关于社会变革日常经验的知识有限。案例表明，灾害是逆转或加速复杂土地改革进程的窗口机会：通过重组现有有时停滞的土地改革进程中自下而上和自上而下的行动者之间的动态，通过揭示以前不可见的政治动态，或通过创造新的可能性来动员自上而下和自下而上的行动者主张土地获取权。

records.title_en: Adopting Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA) model to assess land governance in the peri-urban areas of Ibadan, Nigeria
records.title_cn: 采用重要性-绩效分析（IPA）模型评估尼日利亚伊巴丹城郊地区的土地治理
records.abstract_en: The issue of land governance is central to the New Urban Agenda and 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda. Earlier studies have extensively reported the failure of land governance in different African cities. However, none of these studies has examined possible (in)consistencies between residents' expectations and the acutal performance of land governance based on the opinion of residents, who are usually victims of land maladministration. Therefore, this study adopted the Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA) model to examine the performance of land governance indicators relative to the level of importance (expectations) in Ibadan peri-urban areas. Approximately 514 household heads across residential neighbourhoods from four peri-urban local government areas of Ibadan were sampled, and 452 questionnaires (87.9%) were retrieved for analysis. The analysis reveals that land governance underperformed when compared with residents’ expectations. In particular, some key governance indicators such as efficiency, transparency, control of corruption, and land rights recognition were highly important to the residents but on the contrary, performed very weakly and unsatisfactorily. Thus, going by the IPA model, these are the governance issues that should be given utmost attention to further improve land governance performance in the Ibadan peri-urban areas.
records.abstract_cn: 土地治理问题是新城市议程和2030年可持续发展议程的核心。早期研究已广泛报道了非洲不同城市土地治理的失败。然而，这些研究均未基于居民（通常是土地管理不善的受害者）的意见，考察居民期望与土地治理实际绩效之间可能存在的（不）一致性。因此，本研究采用重要性-绩效分析（IPA）模型，考察伊巴丹城郊地区土地治理指标相对于重要性（期望）水平的绩效。研究从伊巴丹四个城郊地方政府区域的居民社区中抽样了约514户户主，并回收了452份问卷（87.9%%）用于分析。分析显示，与居民期望相比，土地治理表现不佳。特别是，一些关键治理指标，如效率、透明度、腐败控制和土地权利认可，对居民而言非常重要，但相反，这些指标的表现非常薄弱且不尽人意。因此，根据IPA模型，这些是应给予最大关注以进一步改善伊巴丹城郊地区土地治理绩效的治理问题。

records.title_en: Implications of institutional interplay on land management: A case of traditional land tenure and formal laws in the Uluguru Mountains, Tanzania
records.title_cn: 制度相互作用对土地管理的影响：坦桑尼亚乌卢古鲁山区传统土地保有权和正式法律的案例
records.abstract_en: Despite land management efforts since colonial times in the Uluguru Mountains, land degradation persists. Formal land laws and traditional land tenure system were examined to show the implications of formal and informal institutional interplay on land management. Participatory rural appraisal and interviews were employed to collect data. Content analysis and descriptive statistics were used for qualitative and quantitative data respectively. The study brings to light multi-faceted institutional interactions demonstrated by interplay between formal land laws and the traditional land tenure system, with each type of institutions influencing the other. Predominant form of land tenure regime in the Uluguru Mountains is individual land property. In pre-colonial, colonial and the immediate post-independence eras, clan-based land tenure regime and inter-institutional conflict dominated. Individual land property can enhance land management as it can enhance land security. However, it does not guarantee conservation of farmland water sources. Arguably, the implications of land tenure regimes on land management are not adequately explained by the property rights theory as the theory rejects rationalities other than that of maximizing individual utility, which is contrary to the study findings. There is a need for forming/strengthening institutions for regulating water sources in individually owned farmland.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管乌卢古鲁山脉自殖民时代起就进行了土地管理，但土地退化现象依然存在。对正式土地法和传统土地保有权制度进行了审查，以显示正式和非正式制度相互作用对土地管理的影响。采用参与式农村评估和访谈来收集数据。内容分析和描述性统计分别用于定性和定量数据。该研究揭示了正式土地法与传统土地保有权制度之间相互作用所体现的多方面的制度相互作用，每种制度都相互影响。乌鲁古鲁山区土地保有权制度的主要形式是个人土地财产。在前殖民、殖民地和独立后不久的时代，以宗族为基础的土地保有制度和机构间冲突占主导地位。个人土地财产可以加强土地管理，因为它可以增强土地安全。然而，它并不能保证农田水源的保护。可以说，土地保有权制度对土地管理的影响并没有被产权理论充分解释，因为该理论拒绝个人效用最大化之外的理性，这与研究结果相反。需要建立/加强个体农田水源监管机构。

records.title_en: Impacts of urban living lab (ULL) on learning to design inclusive, sustainable, and climate-resilient urban environments
records.title_cn: 城市生活实验室（ULL）对设计包容、可持续和气候韧性城市环境学习的影响
records.abstract_en: Urban design education research increasingly acknowledges the crucial need to create partnerships and collaborations with relevant stakeholders to support urban environments’ planning, governance, design, and decision-making processes in the most holistic manner. However, an inclusive and sustainable urban environment does not have the same meaning for every city, making its design more challenging. The sensory spatial qualities of cities are complex and depend on many social, economic, political, cultural, and natural factors. Thus, this study explores the role of the urban living lab (ULL) methodology in designing inclusive, sustainable, and climate-resilient urban environments in a graduate design studio course. In this study, the ULL was more than a lab. It opened up the critical awareness of multiple links between research, experience, and practice in land use policy. This ULL pedagogical approach could be replicated in different urban contexts to support the decision and design phase of the land use policy process.
records.abstract_cn: 城市设计教育研究日益认识到，需要与相关利益相关者建立伙伴关系和合作，以最全面的方式支持城市环境的规划、治理、设计和决策过程。然而，包容和可持续的城市环境对每个城市而言并非具有相同的含义，这使得其设计更具挑战性。城市的感官空间品质复杂，取决于许多社会、经济、政治、文化和自然因素。因此，本研究探讨了城市生活实验室（ULL）方法论在研究生设计工作室课程中设计包容、可持续和气候韧性城市环境的作用。在本研究中，ULL不仅仅是一个实验室。它开启了对土地利用政策中研究、经验和实践之间多重联系的关键意识。这种ULL教学方法可以在不同的城市背景下复制，以支持土地利用政策过程的决策和设计阶段。

records.title_en: Is a village level always relevant to describe land cover changes? Analysing the landscape to understand socio-environmental changes in western Burkina Faso
records.title_cn: 村庄层面是否总是与描述土地覆盖变化相关？分析景观以理解布基纳法索西部的社会环境变化
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a study about land management in western Burkina Faso. A landscape approach combining surveys and spatial analysis was used to identify key, levels of land management. While the village level provides us with current key data for, a detailed understanding of population dynamics (i), and the household level provides, explanations of economic conditions (ii), these two traditional levels were not able to, fully explain local variability in environmental resources. We therefore question the, relative dominance of traditional levels (village, households) and introduce a spatial, dimension of environmental management to examine the variability of plural legal, rights in several places. We demonstrate the impact of lineage strategies on observed, changes at different levels. Our results provide evidence that, although land cover has, changed, the local land management system seems relatively stable due to historic, lineage alliances. This paper highlights the importance of understanding how the, localized social position of inhabitants, inside and outside the village level, can strongly affect local resource management and thus contribute to a certain inefficiency of public policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一项关于布基纳法索西部土地管理的研究。采用结合调查与空间分析的景观方法，以识别土地管理的关键层面。虽然村庄层面为我们提供了当前人口动态的详细关键数据（i），家庭层面则提供了经济状况的解释（ii），但这两个传统层面未能完全解释环境资源的局部变异性。因此，我们质疑传统层面（村庄、家庭）的相对主导地位，并引入环境管理的空间维度，以考察多个地点多元法律权利的变异性。我们证明了世系策略对观察到的不同层面变化的影响。我们的结果提供了证据表明，尽管土地覆盖已经发生变化，但由于历史上的世系联盟，当地土地管理系统似乎相对稳定。本文强调了理解居民在村庄内外的地方化社会地位如何强烈影响当地资源管理，从而可能导致公共政策一定程度的低效的重要性。

records.title_en: The nature of a ‘forest transition’ in Thừa Thiên Huế Province, Central Vietnam – A study of land cover changes over five decades
records.title_cn: 越南中部承天顺化省“森林转型”的性质——一项跨越五十年的土地覆盖变化研究
records.abstract_en: Informed from historical case studies of land cover change and development in northern countries, forest transition (FT) theories have a tendency to precast specific conclusions. Considering the case of a so-called FT in Thừa Thiên Huế Province in tropical Central Vietnam, we investigated 1.) whether such a ‘FT’ indeed reflects a resurgence of genuine forest, 2.) whether the land cover changes can be explained through conventional ‘pathways’ of FT, and 3.) in which ways the changes may or may not portend ‘sustainable development’. Using satellite imagery and topographic maps, we produced maps for twenty land cover types for the years 1966, 1973, 1979, 1988, 1998, 2008, 2016 and 2019 and analysed land cover change over time. We contextualize these results with reference to the historical and scientific literature on Vietnam, and find that 1.) the forestlands represent a historically rich bio-cultural landscape; 2.) considerable forest destruction resulted from the Second Indochina War rather than classical degradation pathways; 3.) in the post-war period altered forestland spaces and re-emerging land uses interacted with state-led re-territorialization and socialist plans for land resource development, influencing shifts in forest cover; 4.) during 1979–1988 state-led intensive timber logging in remaining rainforests (causing widespread forest degradation) somewhat paradoxically (in terms of conventional FT models and theories) coincided already with a slight increase in lower-biomass tree cover; 5.) after 1988 logging in natural forests was officially prohibited (logging bans), and forestry shifted to a reliance on wood produced in acacia-based plantations (largely on lands officially allocated to households); and 6.) this shift went along with a significant state-led restructuring and development of land use policies and the promotion of forest-relevant economic industries. ‘Restoration’ of tree cover mainly consisted of the expansion of exotic tree plantations, but – at least intermittently – this may also have mitigated impacts on natural forests. We conclude with some reflections on the FT-outcome, its ‘sustainability’, and future trajectories and possibilities of land cover changes in TTHP.
records.abstract_cn: 基于北方国家土地覆盖变化与发展的历史案例研究，森林转型（FT）理论倾向于预设特定结论。以热带越南中部承天顺化省所谓的FT为例，我们调查了1.）这种“FT”是否确实反映了真正森林的复苏，2.）土地覆盖变化能否通过FT的常规“路径”来解释，以及3.）这些变化可能或不可能预示“可持续发展”的方式。利用卫星影像和地形图，我们为1966、1973、1979、1988、1998、2008、2016和2019年制作了二十种土地覆盖类型的地图，并分析了随时间变化的土地覆盖变化。我们结合越南历史和科学文献对这些结果进行背景化分析，发现1.）林地代表了历史上丰富的生物文化景观；2.）相当规模的森林破坏源于第二次印度支那战争，而非典型的退化路径；3.）战后时期，林地空间的变化和重新出现的土地利用与国家主导的再领土化及社会主义土地资源开发计划相互作用，影响了森林覆盖的变化；4.）在1979-1988年间，国家主导的剩余雨林高强度木材采伐（导致广泛的森林退化）与低生物量树木覆盖的轻微增加同时发生，这在常规FT模型和理论看来有些矛盾；5.）1988年后，天然林采伐被正式禁止（禁伐令），林业转向依赖相思树种植园（主要在正式分配给农户的土地上）生产的木材；以及6.）这一转变伴随着国家主导的土地利用政策重组和发展以及森林相关经济产业的推广。“恢复”树木覆盖主要包括外来树种种植园的扩张，但至少间歇性地，这可能也减轻了对天然林的影响。最后，我们对FT结果、其“可持续性”以及TTHP土地覆盖变化的未来轨迹和可能性进行了一些反思。

records.title_en: An analysis of territorial cohesion in the Colombian context: The case of the municipalities of the Caldas Department
records.title_cn: 哥伦比亚背景下的领土凝聚力分析：卡尔达斯省各市案例
records.abstract_en: In the area of development, one of the defining characteristics of the Latin American and Caribbean Region is the persistent inequality that can be observed between many of its territories. This inequality is particularly evident in Colombia, a country that has been strongly affected both socially and politically by the internal armed conflict that was going on for over 50 years. Moreover, the effects of this conflict have increased territorial imbalances between departments and municipalities in the country. Therefore, in the postconflict context that Colombia finds itself in, it is relevant to pursue research that addresses the current challenges faced by its territories in terms of cohesion. Thus, this paper analyzes territorial cohesion in the municipalities that make up the Caldas Department, which possesses several characteristics that make it an ideal location for carrying out this type of analysis. To this end, a methodological proposal has been designed to allow for an empirical study, from a multidimensional and dynamic perspective, the measurement of territorial cohesion, and the identification of different factors associated with this process. The results obtained will be useful for the design and implementation of public policies aimed at achieving harmonious and balanced development of the concerned territories.
records.abstract_cn: 在发展领域，拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的一个显著特征是许多领土之间持续存在的不平等。这种不平等在哥伦比亚尤为明显，该国因持续超过50年的内部武装冲突而在社会和政治上受到严重影响。此外，这一冲突的影响加剧了该国各省和市之间的领土失衡。因此，在哥伦比亚所处的冲突后背景下，开展针对其领土在凝聚力方面当前挑战的研究具有重要意义。为此，本文分析了构成卡尔达斯省的各个市的领土凝聚力，该省具有若干特点，使其成为进行此类分析的理想地点。为此，设计了一种方法论建议，以便从多维度、动态的角度进行实证研究，衡量领土凝聚力，并识别与这一过程相关的不同因素。所得结果将有助于设计和实施旨在实现相关领土和谐与平衡发展的公共政策。

records.title_en: Land observatories, discourses and struggles beyond the smokescreen. A case study in Senegal
records.title_cn: 土地观测站、话语与烟幕之外的斗争：塞内加尔案例研究
records.abstract_en: Sub-Saharan Africa is confronted with land issues such as the private appropriation of farmland, land use conflicts, and access to land for women and younger generations. These diverse issues and the promotion of evidence-based policies encourage actors in land reform to equip themselves with steering, evaluation, and monitoring tools capable of producing information to accompany decision-making processes for land policy. Land observatories are viewed as mechanisms of information production and diffusion that can inform choices and help in these processes. In this context, they also occupy a central place in the international development discourse among research institutes, national institutions, and civil society organizations.
