Also, the findings indicate that households in communities where LSAIs took place received higher wages and spent fewer hours in agriculture. Though, female-headed households spent more time on agricultural activities than the male-headed households, they earn less. The analysis from the qualitative study show, among others things, that female-headed households spent more time on off-farm business despite the fact that they earn less. The study concludes by recommending that the possible adverse employment effects of LSAIs could be reduced by optimising its positive impact, especially with respect to female-headed households in rural communities where most of such investments occur.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了大规模农业投资（LSAIs）如何影响尼日利亚女性户主家庭的就业结果。研究重点关注发生LSAIs的社区中的家庭与未发生LSAIs的社区中的家庭在工资收入和劳动力配置方面的差异。研究采用混合方法，包括定量和定性分析。定量数据来源于生活水平测量研究-农业综合调查（LSMS-ISA），并使用倾向得分匹配（PSM）进行分析。定性分析包括深度访谈（IDIs）和焦点小组讨论（FGDs）。结果显示，生活在有LSAIs社区的家庭收入呈正相关，但与农业活动劳动力配置呈负相关。此外，研究结果表明，发生LSAIs的社区中的家庭获得更高的工资，并在农业上花费更少的时间。尽管女性户主家庭在农业活动上花费的时间多于男性户主家庭，但她们的收入更低。定性研究的分析显示，除其他事项外，女性户主家庭在非农业务上花费更多时间，尽管她们的收入较低。研究最后建议，通过优化LSAIs的积极影响，可以减少其可能的不利就业效应，特别是在大多数此类投资发生的农村社区中的女性户主家庭方面。

records.title_en: Private-led land assembly and urban consolidation: The relative influence of regulatory zoning mechanisms
records.title_cn: 私人主导的土地整合与城市集约化：监管分区机制的相对影响
records.abstract_en: From the time a city is first subdivided, its structure of lots act as a precursor to all future redevelopment, forming the spatial bounds of land ownership that force buildings to develop and evolve in their place. It is therefore critical for planning systems that intend to contain urban sprawl to encourage the lot superstructure to adapt to the emerging needs of a city. This study assesses the role that existing regulatory planning mechanisms play in directing the spatial distribution and frequency of private developer-led land assembly. Drawing on two inner city local government areas in Melbourne, Australia, this research analyses the relative influence of local zone-led development controls on the occurrence of land assembly over an eleven-year period. A descriptive spatial analysis and global logistic regression model reveal that an interplay of maximum height restrictions, existing plot boundaries, and sales prices, have led to a disordered distribution of parcel amalgamations. A geographically weighted logistic regression model highlights spatial variation in the influence of these factors, with small lots in the inner city being subject to the least influence of development controls. The results are supplemented by a small sample of interviews with local planners and developers, who suggest that regulatory planning controls inadvertently turn desired built form outcomes into a tool for capital appreciation and landowner holdouts. In combination, the findings suggest that zone-led development controls do little to influence market forces in a manner that induces private-led land assembly in favour of the public good.
records.abstract_cn: 从城市首次细分之时起，其地块结构便成为所有未来再开发的先导，形成土地所有权的空间边界，迫使建筑在其位置上发展和演变。因此，对于旨在遏制城市蔓延的规划系统而言，鼓励地块上层结构适应城市新兴需求至关重要。本研究评估了现有监管规划机制在引导私人开发商主导的土地整合的空间分布和频率方面所发挥的作用。本研究以澳大利亚墨尔本两个内城区地方政府区域为对象，分析了地方分区主导的开发控制对十一年期间土地整合发生的相对影响。描述性空间分析和全局逻辑回归模型揭示，最大高度限制、现有地块边界和销售价格的相互作用导致了地块合并的无序分布。地理加权逻辑回归模型突出了这些因素影响的空间差异，内城区的小地块受开发控制的影响最小。研究结果辅以对当地规划者和开发商的小样本访谈，他们表示，监管规划控制无意中将期望的建筑形式结果转变为资本增值和土地所有者抵制开发的工具。综合来看，研究结果表明，分区主导的开发控制对市场力量的影响甚微，无法以有利于公共利益的方式诱导私人主导的土地整合。

records.title_en: The commons in an age of uncertainty: Decolonizing nature, economy, and society, by Franklin Obeng-Odoom, University of Toronto Press, 2021
records.title_cn: 不确定性时代的公地：去殖民化自然、经济与社会，富兰克林·奥本-奥多姆著，多伦多大学出版社，2021年
records.abstract_en: •The review examines Franklin Obeng-Odoom's new book.•The book provides a long-overdue rethinking of land privatization in the Global South.•The book provides a valuable alternative to existing approaches to governing the commons in the Global South.•The review summarizes the main contentions of the book and critically analyzes its main contributions to the literature.
records.abstract_cn: •本评论考察了富兰克林·奥本-奥多姆的新书。•该书对全球南方土地私有化进行了迟来的重新思考。•该书为全球南方公地治理的现有方法提供了宝贵的替代方案。•本评论总结了该书的主要论点，并批判性地分析了其对文献的主要贡献。

records.title_en: How to halt deforestation in the Amazon? A Bayesian process-tracing approach
records.title_cn: 如何遏制亚马逊地区的森林砍伐？一种贝叶斯过程追踪方法
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we employ for the first time a Bayesian process-tracing approach to assess the role of different interventions designed to halt deforestation. We applied the methodology to six initiatives implemented between 2006 and 2019 in the municipality of São Felix do Xingu, namely: (i) institution of protected areas, (ii) environmental monitoring and enforcement, (iii) credit restrictions, (iv) commodity agreements, (v) multi-stakeholder processes, and (vi) value chain projects. Bayesian process tracing is an alternative to traditional counterfactual approaches that allows the gleaning of in-depth insights into ‘causal chain’ mechanisms and complex interrelationships in individual cases, rather than identifying common or cross-cutting features across different cases. Contrary to traditional process-tracing methodologies, the Bayesian approach provides analytical transparency and replicability through a formal and fine-grained assessment of the strength of the evidence. We assessed 31 individual pieces of evidence, developed using data collected through a variety of quantitative and qualitative methods. We grouped these into interventions spanning three periods of time and traced the causal mechanisms linked to their success or failure. In total, we developed nine theory components. Our results reveal that we are practically certain that four theory components are true. We are also reasonably certain or highly confident that four other theory components are true, and only cautiously confident that one component is true. Drawing on the nine components, we offer a composite theory explaining deforestation outcomes. Our findings provide four implications for global debates. Namely, they provide a strong case for the importance of conceptually distinguishing: the types of actors targeted (e.g., smallholder or medium-to-large landholders) and the frontier status (i.e., whether interventions take place in active frontiers or in consolidated areas). They also prove that interventions may be well implemented for a certain period but can lose effectiveness over time. Finally, our findings call attention to synergies among interventions, and in particular to the combination of regulatory interventions to halt frontier expansion with market-based approaches to incentivize non-deforestation behaviour.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们首次采用贝叶斯过程追踪方法来评估旨在遏制森林砍伐的不同干预措施的作用。我们将该方法应用于2006年至2019年间在圣费利克斯杜辛古市实施的六项举措，即：（i）设立保护区，（ii）环境监测与执法，（iii）信贷限制，（iv）商品协议，（v）多方利益相关者进程，以及（vi）价值链项目。贝叶斯过程追踪是传统反事实方法的一种替代方案，它允许深入洞察个别案例中的“因果链”机制和复杂相互关系，而不是识别不同案例中的共同或跨领域特征。与传统的过程追踪方法相比，贝叶斯方法通过正式且细粒度的证据强度评估提供了分析透明度和可复制性。我们评估了31项独立的证据，这些证据是利用通过多种定量和定性方法收集的数据开发的。我们将这些证据分组为跨越三个时间段的干预措施，并追踪了与其成功或失败相关的因果机制。我们总共开发了九个理论组成部分。我们的结果表明，我们几乎确定四个理论组成部分是真实的。我们也相当确定或高度自信另外四个理论组成部分是真实的，并且仅对一个组成部分持谨慎信心。基于这九个组成部分，我们提供了一个解释森林砍伐结果的综合理论。我们的发现为全球辩论提供了四个启示。即，它们为概念上区分目标行动者类型（例如，小农或中大型土地所有者）和前沿状态（即，干预措施是在活跃前沿还是在整合区域进行）的重要性提供了有力论据。它们还证明，干预措施可能在某一时期实施良好，但随着时间的推移可能失去效力。最后，我们的发现呼吁关注干预措施之间的协同作用，特别是将遏制前沿扩张的监管干预措施与激励非砍伐行为的市场方法相结合。

records.title_en: Gains and losses of farmland associated with farmland protection policy and urbanization in China: An integrated perspective based on goal orientation
records.title_cn: 中国耕地保护政策与城市化进程中耕地的增减变化：基于目标导向的综合视角
records.abstract_en: The Requisition-Compensation Balance of Farmland (RCBF) policy remedies the situation where valuable farmland becomes occupied for non-agricultural objectives during the rapid urbanization in China. However, there has been little systematic and provincial research on the RCBF policy. This study explores the establishment of an optimized and differentiated RCBF policy, adapted to regional resource endowments, socioeconomic developments based on the current policy system. We evaluated the holistic performance of gains and losses of farmland in Jiangsu Province from 1995 to 2015. The aims of this framework include the well-known “quantity-quality-ecological-yield” balance and a significant but undervalued farmland quality improvement object. We compared the differences between gained farmland and lost farmland using the quantity balance index, quality balance index, ecosystem service value benefits-and-losses method, and grain yield spatialization method, respectively. The structural transformation of “dry land to paddy” has been used to evaluate quality improvement. The evaluation results revealed that the challenges of “more occupation than compensation” in quantity have existed for a long time. Additionally, some ecological land was exploited to replenish the farmland, resulting in the unsustainable phenomenon of “dual development and dual loss.” Moreover, the average productivity and average utilization intensity of the gained farmland were superior to those of the lost farmland. This confirms the grain yield gap could be narrowed by increasing farmland utilization intensity. Furthermore, our results demonstrated that a low percentage of farmland in Jiangsu Province had improved in quality and that significant improvement was required. Based on these findings, we encourage Jiangsu Province to focus on improving the quality and productivity of farmland to precisely achieve “quality against quantity and yield balance” to address the quantity imbalance and the resulting ecological risks.
records.abstract_cn: 耕地占补平衡（RCBF）政策弥补了中国快速城市化过程中宝贵耕地被非农用途占用的状况。然而，关于RCBF政策的系统性省级研究较少。本研究基于现行政策体系，探讨建立适应区域资源禀赋和社会经济发展的优化差异化RCBF政策。我们评估了江苏省1995年至2015年耕地增减的整体绩效。该框架的目标包括众所周知的“数量-质量-生态-产量”平衡以及一个显著但被低估的耕地质量提升目标。我们分别使用数量平衡指数、质量平衡指数、生态系统服务价值损益法和粮食产量空间化方法比较了新增耕地与减少耕地之间的差异。采用“旱地改水田”的结构转型来评估质量提升。评估结果显示，数量上“占多补少”的挑战长期存在。此外，一些生态用地被开发用于补充耕地，导致“双发展双损失”的不可持续现象。而且，新增耕地的平均生产力和平均利用强度优于减少的耕地。这证实了通过提高耕地利用强度可以缩小粮食产量差距。此外，我们的结果表明，江苏省耕地质量提升的比例较低，需要显著改进。基于这些发现，我们鼓励江苏省注重提高耕地质量和生产力，以精准实现“质量对冲数量和产量平衡”，以解决数量失衡及其带来的生态风险。

records.title_en: Social acceptance of NIMBY facilities: A comparative study between public acceptance and the social license to operate analytical frameworks
records.title_cn: 邻避设施的社会接受度：公众接受度与社会许可运营分析框架的比较研究
records.abstract_en: Not-In-My-Backyard (NIMBY) facilities play a significant role globally in the sustainable and healthy development of countries, and their successful introduction and operation has become increasingly critically influenced by local communities. Two mainstream research approaches have been proposed to enhance this, in the form of a “public acceptance” (PA) framework and a “social license to operate” (SLO) framework. However, the outcomes of social acceptance within the two approaches in typical NIMBY facilities in China have not been examined empirically. In response, this study introduces the emerging SLO framework, and discusses its applicability to the NIMBY facilities by a comparative analysis with PA, based on a questionnaire survey of residents (with a final sample size of 94) adjacent to a typical waste-to-energy (WTE) incineration plant located in Zhejiang province, China. The results show that, firstly, social acceptance assessed under the two frameworks is similar. Second, the community acceptance of Jiufeng case measured by SLO is non-linear and multi-dimensional, and there is a lack of institutional trust. Third, the viability of SLO is constrained by its social vulnerability and may occur through collective protests. These findings theoretically enrich the existing literature concerning social acceptance assessment and management of the dynamic industry-community relationships involved in the provision of NIMBY facilities. The findings will also be of practical value for government agencies and industrial sectors in gaining the social license needed from local communities.
records.abstract_cn: 邻避设施在全球范围内对国家的可持续和健康发展起着重要作用，其成功引入和运营越来越受到当地社区的关键影响。为提升这一点，已提出两种主流研究方法，即“公众接受度”（PA）框架和“社会许可运营”（SLO）框架。然而，这两种方法在中国典型邻避设施中的社会接受度结果尚未得到实证检验。为此，本研究引入新兴的SLO框架，并通过对位于中国浙江省一座典型垃圾焚烧发电厂附近居民的问卷调查（最终样本量为94），与PA进行对比分析，探讨其适用于邻避设施的情况。结果表明：首先，两种框架下评估的社会接受度相似。其次，以SLO衡量的九峰案例的社区接受度是非线性和多维度的，且存在制度信任缺失。第三，SLO的可行性受其社会脆弱性制约，并可能通过集体抗议发生。这些发现从理论上丰富了现有关于邻避设施提供中动态产业-社区关系的社会接受度评估和管理的文献。研究结果对政府机构和工业部门在获得当地社区所需的社会许可方面也具有实践价值。

records.title_en: Housing accessibility in densifying cities: Entangled housing and land use policy limitations and insights from Oslo
records.title_cn: 密集化城市中的住房可及性：纠缠的住房与土地利用政策限制及奥斯陆的启示
records.abstract_en: Several cities have introduced densification policies to counteract urban sprawl, protect natural land and resources, and create socially diverse and inclusive urban areas. The common assumption, present especially in policy recommendations for sustainable urban development, that densification is the most favourable way to achieve urban sustainability in a broad sense, including economic and social dimensions, powerfully depoliticizes densification. However, within the housing sector, the implementation of densification policies might be linked to the intensification of existing - and the creation of new - social and spatial challenges. In Oslo, the case study of this investigation, urban densification has been implemented since the 1980 s, and has produced strongly exclusionary housing markets with negative socio-spatial implications. In this article, I explore the mechanisms behind such outcomes. Specifically, employing a qualitative analysis of policy documents and interviews with key-informants, I explore how the systematic prioritization of environmental sustainability and green growth goals in planning for densification, together with the lack of legal tools and economic resources to provide affordable housing, have shaped the production of exclusionary outcomes, limiting the possibilities to combine urban densification and housing accessibility at the local level.
records.abstract_cn: 多个城市已引入密集化政策以应对城市蔓延、保护自然土地和资源，并创造社会多元和包容的城市区域。尤其在可持续城市发展的政策建议中，普遍假设密集化是在广泛意义上实现城市可持续性（包括经济和社会维度）的最有利方式，这一假设有力地使密集化去政治化。然而，在住房部门，密集化政策的实施可能与现有社会空间挑战的加剧以及新挑战的产生相关联。在奥斯陆（本研究的案例），自1980年代以来一直实施城市密集化，并产生了具有负面社会空间影响的强烈排斥性住房市场。在本文中，我探讨了这些结果背后的机制。具体而言，通过对政策文件的定性分析和对关键信息提供者的访谈，我探讨了在密集化规划中系统性地优先考虑环境可持续性和绿色增长目标，加上缺乏提供可负担住房的法律工具和经济资源，如何塑造了排斥性结果的产生，限制了在地方层面将城市密集化与住房可及性相结合的可能性。

records.title_en: Institutional analysis and informal urban settlements: A proposition for a new institutionalist grounded property rights perspective
records.title_cn: 制度分析与非正规城市住区：一种新制度主义扎根产权视角的提议
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a generic process for conducting research on property rights in informal settlements from a new institutionalist perspective. The paper is premised on the fact that informal urban settlements have peculiar characteristics that complicate investigations using conventional methods. However, analytical approaches based on new institutionalism have gradually gained prominence over more traditional approaches amongst scholars in developing countries. New institutionalist methods of juxtaposing investigations of formal and informal institutions and relaxing some of the assumptions of conventional theories have enabled the inclusion of situations involving incomplete or imperfect property rights and positive transaction costs in the analysis. This paper shows that a “new institutionalist perspective” is not one coherent school of thought but rather a diverse group of theories with some common tenets dominated by three varieties of institutionalism, namely, rational choice, historical, and sociological. While a common framework would be ideal, this paper instead advocates for a dynamic research process that can be customised for examinations of property rights in different informal settlements, thus contributing to the literature by extending the application of new institutionalism to situations with “incomplete” property rights.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种从新制度主义视角对非正规住区产权进行研究的一般性过程。本文的前提是非正规城市住区具有特殊特征，这些特征使采用常规方法进行调查复杂化。然而，在发展中国家学者中，基于新制度主义的分析方法已逐渐比更传统的方法更为突出。新制度主义方法将正式与非正式制度的调查并列，并放宽了传统理论的一些假设，使得在分析中能够纳入涉及不完整或不完全产权以及正交易成本的情况。本文表明，“新制度主义视角”并非一个连贯的思想流派，而是一组具有某些共同原则的多样化理论，主要由三种制度主义变体主导，即理性选择、历史和社会学。虽然一个共同框架是理想的，但本文反而倡导一种动态研究过程，该过程可针对不同非正规住区的产权考察进行定制，从而通过将新制度主义的应用扩展到“不完整”产权的情况来为文献做出贡献。

records.title_en: Understanding barriers and opportunities for promoting transit-oriented development with bus rapid transit in Bogotá and Quito
records.title_cn: 理解波哥大和基多快速公交系统促进公交导向开发的障碍与机遇
records.abstract_en: The implementation of bus rapid transit (BRT) in several Latin American cities has provided researchers with an opportunity to study the capacity of BRT in promoting transit-oriented development (TOD) and the issues associated with the unintended consequences of their impacts on equity outcomes. Using a qualitative data analysis of semi-structured interviews involving key participants in Quito and Bogotá, in this paper five emerging themes are identified explaining the framework of BRT-associated barriers and opportunities for TOD: coordination, expertise, development, management, and equity. Issues are highlighted related to the timing difficulties between the land use sector and the transportation sector, the complex relationship between public and private sectors with different perspectives on urban development in an uncertain environment with little trust between the parties, the complexities of redevelopment and renewal measures in already urbanized areas, and the general perception of TOD as a concept foreign to all except transportation planners.
records.abstract_cn: 拉丁美洲多个城市实施快速公交系统（BRT）为研究者提供了研究BRT促进公交导向开发（TOD）能力及其对公平结果意外影响相关问题的机会。通过对基多和波哥大关键参与者进行半结构化访谈的定性数据分析，本文识别出五个新兴主题，用以解释BRT相关TOD障碍与机遇的框架：协调、专业知识、开发、管理和公平。研究强调了土地利用部门与交通部门之间时机协调的困难、在不确定环境中缺乏信任且对城市发展持有不同观点的公私部门之间的复杂关系、已城市化地区再开发与更新措施的复杂性，以及除交通规划者外，TOD普遍被视为外来概念的看法。

records.title_en: Spillover effect of the oil palm boom on the growth of surrounding towns in the eastern Amazon
records.title_cn: 油棕繁荣对巴西亚马逊东部周边城镇增长的溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Although oil palm production has been suggested as a driver of development in some countries, this relationship has yet to be established in Brazilian territory. In Brazil, 90% of oil palm production is concentrated in the eastern Amazon, where socioenvironmental costs associated with medium and large agro industries have already been demonstrated. However, there is still a lack of understanding of the contribution of this production to the economic growth of surrounding towns and of how this activity influences nonagricultural sectors. This study investigated the spillover effects of the value of oil palm fruit bunch production in the largest Brazilian producing region, located in the northeast of the state of Pará, and analysed the impact on economic growth, demographics and the labour market from 2002 to 2017. The results of an econometric analysis of fixed effects panel including dummy variables with individual, temporal and two-way effects show a relation between the oil palm fruit bunch production value and nonagricultural sectors (e.g., service sectors). This may have contributed to the formal nonagricultural labour market, population growth and tax generation of the surrounding towns and industrial dynamization, mainly since 2010, coinciding with the period of incentive policies. However, the growth of the economy and urban demography was concentrated in one microregion (Tomé-Açu). We argue that oil palm agribusiness may play an important role in urban growth by providing economic improvement, increasing the value added to services, contributing to urbanization, and promoting intersectoral links. On the other hand, towns dependent on the production of a commodity may be susceptible to market fluctuations with an impact on their economic growth. For greater benefits, socioenvironmental externalities also need to be monitored and controlled.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管油棕生产在一些国家被认为是发展的驱动力，但这种关系在巴西领土上尚未得到证实。在巴西，90%的油棕生产集中在亚马逊东部，那里与中大型农业工业相关的社会环境成本已被证明。然而，对于这种生产对周边城镇经济增长的贡献以及这种活动如何影响非农业部门，仍然缺乏了解。本研究调查了巴西最大生产地区（位于帕拉州东北部）油棕果串生产价值的溢出效应，并分析了2002年至2017年对经济增长、人口统计和劳动力市场的影响。包含个体、时间和双向效应的虚拟变量的固定效应面板计量经济分析结果显示，油棕果串生产价值与非农业部门（如服务业）之间存在关系。这可能促进了正式非农业劳动力市场、人口增长和周边城镇税收的产生以及工业活力，主要自2010年以来，与激励政策时期相吻合。然而，经济和城市人口的增长集中在一个微区域（托梅-阿苏）。我们认为，油棕农业综合企业可能通过提供经济改善、增加服务附加值、促进城市化和推动部门间联系，在城市增长中发挥重要作用。另一方面，依赖单一商品生产的城镇可能容易受到市场波动的影响，从而影响其经济增长。为了获得更大的利益，社会环境外部性也需要得到监测和控制。

records.title_en: Territorial planning of rustic land constructions and their adaptation to climate change in the province of Málaga, Spain
records.title_cn: 西班牙马拉加省乡村土地建设的领土规划及其对气候变化的适应
records.abstract_en: Incorporating risk analysis into physical planning is increasingly necessary to anticipate and take appropriate measures to prevent and defend against disasters. This paper extends the concept of carrying capacity by studying two models: an ecosystem-bringing capacity model and a territorial model of construction on rural land. A climate change variable was integrated into both models, and the changes that occurred depending on the emissions scenario and the time horizons were considered for developing the suitability, impact, and risk models. The data obtained in this study give us an idea of the difficulties that may exist in most of the territory for the construction location on rural land. In fact, only 14% of the occupied study area reaches positive values for the carrying capacity of ecosystems; besides, there are no constructions on rural land located on positive values if we include the risks in the planning. Contextually, assigning a value to the comparable carrying capacity, based on a holistic conception of planning and scientific data, can facilitate the decision-making to initiate future studies and work. Moreover, this study enables to anticipate the effects of climate change when drawing up adaptation and mitigation policies, plans, or programs.
records.abstract_cn: 将风险分析纳入实体规划日益必要，以便预见并采取适当措施预防和抵御灾害。本文通过研究两个模型扩展了承载力的概念：一个生态系统承载力模型和一个乡村土地建设的领土模型。将气候变化变量整合到两个模型中，并根据排放情景和时间范围考虑发生的变化，以开发适宜性、影响和风险模型。本研究获得的数据让我们了解到在大部分领土上乡村土地建设选址可能存在的困难。事实上，仅占研究区域14%的已占用面积达到生态系统承载力的正值；此外，如果我们将风险纳入规划，乡村土地上的建筑没有位于正值区域。从背景来看，基于整体规划理念和科学数据，为可比承载力赋值可以促进决策，以启动未来的研究和工程。此外，本研究能够在制定适应和减缓政策、计划或方案时预见气候变化的影响。

records.title_en: Are there trade-offs between conservation and development caused by Mexican protected areas?
records.title_cn: 墨西哥保护区是否导致了保护与发展之间的权衡？
records.abstract_en: Protected areas (PAs) are essential for biodiversity conservation, but their restrictive policies could accentuate poverty. Such a possibility may occur with the more restrictive PAs (e.g., national parks), which prioritize conservation while limiting the use of natural resources. However, less restrictive PAs, such as biosphere reserves, which allow the sustainable use of natural resources, may be better at alleviating poverty. However, such permissibility may reduce the effectiveness of preventing deforestation. Here, we assessed this conservation-development tradeoff by testing changes in marginalization (an indicator of poverty) and forest loss between two contrasting PAs management scheme types (MST, national parks and biosphere reserves) in Mexico. We quantified forest loss inside PAs and unprotected areas during the 2000–2019 period. Also, we contrasted marginalization changes during the 2000–2020 period between municipalities included in PAs (n = 288) and municipalities not directly influenced by PAs (n = 1615). Using a matching analysis approach, we tested for differences in forest loss and marginalization between protected and unprotected areas and between MST, in all cases controlling for the potential effects of confounding factors (e.g., slope, altitude, distance to cities, economic sector). We also evaluated potential conservation-development trade-offs resulting from the interaction of MST with the biophysical-socioeconomic context. PAs did not accentuate marginalization comparing unprotected areas. After matching, both national parks and biosphere reserves showed similar average changes in marginalization and forest loss probability. However, national parks showed higher marginalization than biosphere reserves in areas far from cities and sites with poor agriculture suitability, probably because restrictive policies in such adverse contexts might work against the development of the local communities. Also, national parks showed higher forest loss than biosphere reserves in areas suitable for agriculture. Our results suggest that, in the Mexican protected areas system, the interaction between MST and biophysical-socioeconomic contexts may lead to conservation-development tradeoffs. The more restrictive MST does not provide greater protection to the forest than the less restrictive MST and, under certain biophysical conditions, may reduce the capability of communities to cope with poverty.
records.abstract_cn: 保护区（PAs）对生物多样性保护至关重要，但其限制性政策可能加剧贫困。这种情况可能发生在更具限制性的保护区（如国家公园）中，这些保护区优先考虑保护，同时限制自然资源的利用。然而，限制较少的保护区，如生物圈保护区，允许自然资源的可持续利用，可能更有利于缓解贫困。然而，这种许可性可能降低防止森林砍伐的有效性。在此，我们通过测试墨西哥两种对比鲜明的保护区管理方案类型（MST，国家公园和生物圈保护区）之间边缘化（贫困指标）和森林损失的變化，评估了这种保护与发展之间的权衡。我们量化了2000-2019年期间保护区内和未保护区的森林损失。同时，我们对比了2000-2020年期间包含在保护区内的市镇（n = 288）和未受保护区直接影响的市镇（n = 1615）的边缘化变化。使用匹配分析方法，我们检验了保护区和未保护区之间以及不同MST之间在森林损失和边缘化方面的差异，在所有情况下都控制了潜在混杂因素（如坡度、海拔、距城市距离、经济部门）的影响。我们还评估了MST与生物物理-社会经济背景相互作用可能产生的保护与发展权衡。保护区并未加剧边缘化，与未保护区相比。匹配后，国家公园和生物圈保护区在边缘化和森林损失概率的平均变化上相似。然而，在远离城市和农业适宜性差的地区，国家公园的边缘化程度高于生物圈保护区，这可能是因为在这些不利背景下，限制性政策可能不利于当地社区的发展。此外，在适合农业的地区，国家公园的森林损失高于生物圈保护区。我们的结果表明，在墨西哥保护区系统中，MST与生物物理-社会经济背景的相互作用可能导致保护与发展之间的权衡。更具限制性的MST并不比限制较少的MST提供更大的森林保护，并且在某些生物物理条件下，可能降低社区应对贫困的能力。

records.title_en: Impact of land tenure security through customary law on agricultural productivity in Burkina Faso: Propensity score matching approaches
records.title_cn: 布基纳法索习惯法下土地保有权保障对农业生产率的影响：倾向得分匹配方法
records.abstract_en: Land tenure security plays an important role in agricultural production systems. The objective of this paper is to empirically assess the impact of land tenure security through customary law on agricultural productivity in Burkina Faso. We use panel data from 15,627 agricultural households over the period 2019–2021. Four propensity score matching methods are used: the nearest neighbor method, the stratification method, the radius method and the kernel method. The instrumental variables technique was used to control for endogeneity. Overall, the results indicate that household land security improves agricultural productivity. The minimum gain in agricultural productivity is estimated to be USD 86.4 per agricultural asset per season for households with customary land tenure. In terms of economic policy implications, the results call on the authorities in charge of conducting agricultural policies to promote comprehensive land policies by adapting them to local contexts through the recognition of customary institutions for rural land management.
records.abstract_cn: 土地保有权保障在农业生产系统中扮演着重要角色。本文旨在实证评估布基纳法索习惯法下土地保有权保障对农业生产率的影响。我们使用了2019-2021年间15,627个农业家庭的面板数据。采用了四种倾向得分匹配方法：最近邻法、分层法、半径法和核法。工具变量技术被用于控制内生性。总体而言，结果表明家庭土地保障提高了农业生产率。对于拥有习惯土地保有权家庭，农业生产率的最小增益估计为每季每项农业资产86.4美元。在经济政策含义方面，结果呼吁负责实施农业政策的当局通过承认农村土地管理的习惯制度，将综合土地政策适应当地情况，以促进土地政策的实施。

records.title_en: “The cost of doing business”: Private rights, public resources, and the resulting diversity of state-level forestry policies in the U.S
records.title_cn: “做生意的成本”：私人权利、公共资源以及美国各州林业政策的多样性
records.abstract_en: In the U.S., the combination of federal, state, and local forest rules and programs create the policy environment in which private forest landowners manage their land, which in turn impacts the quality and conservation of ecosystem services produced. While previous studies provide overviews of forest policies impacting private landowners at moments in time, they lack the depth and perspective needed to describe the political context of forest policies, including the mechanisms underlying this diversity: the how and why of particular policies. This study fills that gap by utilizing interviews with policy experts from 12 case-study states to investigate the range of forest policies present in the U.S. We also explored the perceived trade-offs between protection of public trust resources and private property rights on private forest lands in their states, and the key actors (groups) influencing policy changes over time. Overall, the strong role of private property rights in the United States was consistent across case-study states, although most experts indicated a balance between protecting public trust resources and private property rights. The variability of policy tools employed among states suggests many avenues to achieve this balance, including policies that are created through market-based mechanisms rather than the state (i.e., certification). We also found that local-level regulations contributed to diversity and, at times, conflict and confusion within states. Finally, although landowner stewardship is not a policy tool, we found that states implicitly and explicitly relied on landowner knowledge and values to protect public trust resources, a strategy that some participants agreed fostered trust between the state and its private forest landowners.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，联邦、州和地方森林法规与项目的组合构成了私人森林土地所有者管理其土地的政策环境，这进而影响了所产生生态系统服务的质量和保护。虽然以往的研究提供了在特定时间点影响私人土地所有者的森林政策概述，但它们缺乏描述森林政策政治背景所需的深度和视角，包括这种多样性背后的机制：特定政策的如何和为何。本研究通过利用来自12个案例研究州的政策专家访谈来填补这一空白，以调查美国存在的森林政策范围。我们还探讨了各州在私人森林土地上保护公共信托资源与私人财产权之间的感知权衡，以及随时间推移影响政策变化的关键行动者（群体）。总体而言，私人财产权在美国的强大作用在案例研究州中是一致的，尽管大多数专家表示在保护公共信托资源和私人财产权之间存在平衡。各州采用的政策工具的差异性表明，实现这种平衡有多种途径，包括通过基于市场的机制而非国家制定的政策（即认证）。我们还发现，地方层面的法规增加了各州内部的多样性，有时也导致了冲突和混乱。最后，尽管土地所有者管理不是一种政策工具，但我们发现各州隐含地和明确地依赖土地所有者的知识和价值观来保护公共信托资源，一些参与者认为这一策略促进了州与其私人森林土地所有者之间的信任。

records.title_en: Viewpoint: Sovereignty and reversing Brazil’s history of Amazon destruction
records.title_cn: 观点：主权与扭转巴西亚马逊破坏的历史
records.abstract_en: Brazilians have lived for many years under governments with discourse proclaiming the need to occupy and develop the Amazon to integrate this vast territory into the rest of the country. Increasing the region’s population, economic activity and infrastructure have been promoted to expand agricultural production and to protect Brazil's Amazonian borders and natural resources from foreign nations; but the processes of occupation and development have taken pathways with severe impacts. Infrastructure to connect to markets now facilitates the destruction of the region’s forests, and illegal activities were openly supported until recently by Jair Bolsonaro’s (2019–2022) presidential administration. Although Brazil’s sovereignty over its Amazonian territory is uncontested, today it is a space that is largely controlled by those who exploit the region’s commodities, often, ironically, led by foreign interests.
records.abstract_cn: 多年来，巴西人民生活在一些政府之下，这些政府的言论宣称需要占领和开发亚马逊，以将这片广阔领土融入国家其他部分。增加该地区的人口、经济活动及基础设施一直被推动，以扩大农业生产，并保护巴西的亚马逊边境和自然资源免受外国侵害；但占领和开发的过程却走上了具有严重影响的道路。连接市场的基础设施如今促进了该地区森林的破坏，而非法活动直到最近还得到雅伊尔·博索纳罗（2019-2022）总统政府的公开支持。尽管巴西对其亚马逊领土的主权无可争议，但今天这片空间在很大程度上由那些开采该地区商品的人控制，往往具有讽刺意味的是，这些活动由外国利益主导。

records.title_en: Uncertainty in policy transfer across contaminated land management regimes: Examining the Nigerian experience
records.title_cn: 污染土地管理制度间政策转移中的不确定性：审视尼日利亚经验
records.abstract_en: Weak and developing contaminated land management regimes have continued to transfer perceived effective contaminated land management policies into their regimes, without considering the effects of variability in risk perceptions, available scientific data, expertise, and contextual differences in the implementation process of such policies. Such transferred policy is a foundation for faulty contaminated land management decisions and potentially exposes receptors to higher levels of risk and affects confidence in decisions and future land use. In addition, because the technical capacity to interpret and implement the transferred policy are often lacking, it becomes difficult to justify contaminated land management decisions and to involve local communities and other stakeholders in the decision-making process. It is argued that too much emphasis has been placed on policy transfer, without attention to contextualization and this results in uncertainties linked to lack of capacity, expertise, data, risk perception and human factor, during the implementation of transferred policies particularly in developing regimes. This article examines uncertainties related to policy transfer using the Nigerian experience of contaminated land management. The study concludes that uncertainty affects confidence in contaminated management decision-making, exposes receptors to unacceptable risks and threatens future land use. Developing contaminated land management regimes intending to transfer policy from effective regimes should consider country-specific peculiarities and use effective regimes as guidance rather than stark transfer of policy without consideration of contextual differences.
records.abstract_cn: 薄弱且发展中的污染土地管理制度持续将认为有效的污染土地管理政策转移至其制度中，而未考虑风险认知的变异性、现有科学数据、专业知识以及此类政策实施过程中的背景差异的影响。这种转移的政策是错误污染土地管理决策的基础，并可能使受体暴露于更高风险水平，影响决策信心及未来土地利用。此外，由于通常缺乏解释和实施转移政策的技术能力，难以证明污染土地管理决策的合理性，并难以让当地社区和其他利益相关者参与决策过程。本文认为，过多强调政策转移而忽视背景化，导致在转移政策实施过程中出现与能力、专业知识、数据、风险认知和人为因素相关的确定性不足，尤其是在发展中制度中。本文通过尼日利亚污染土地管理的经验，审视了与政策转移相关的不确定性。研究得出结论，不确定性影响污染管理决策的信心，使受体暴露于不可接受的风险，并威胁未来土地利用。意图从有效制度转移政策的发展中污染土地管理制度应考虑国家特定情况，并将有效制度作为指导，而非不考虑背景差异的严格政策转移。

records.title_en: Jurisdictional approaches to reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation in Brazil: Why do states adopt jurisdictional policies?
records.title_cn: 巴西减少毁林和森林退化排放的辖区方法：各州为何采纳辖区政策？
records.abstract_en: Although the role of subnational governments in multi-level climate governance is recognized by scholars and policymakers, we still know little about whether and why some subnational jurisdictions in the Global South decide to engage in decentralized climate action. This article yields new insights on this question by explaining variations in the decision of Brazilian states to establish legal frameworks for jurisdictional REDD+, enabling them to receive transnational climate finance, in the early stages of the emergence of REDD+ in Brazil between 2007 and 2017. We draw on key informant interviews with policy entrepreneurs and actors to understand the roles played by (1) the transnational pathways of influence associated with the regime complex for REDD+ and (2) the strategies adopted by state-level policy entrepreneurs in subnational REDD+ readiness policy processes in Brazil in five case studies (Amazonas, Acre, Mato Grosso, Pará and Amapá). According to respondents, credible market incentives were the key influence for state governors to adopt a jurisdictional framework to channel REDD+ funds, but transnational norms and material assistance played important mediating roles. The perceived credibility of market incentives was influenced by: (1) the presence of policy entrepreneurs at the state level; (2) the timing of strategies employed by policy entrepreneurs; (3) the policy beliefs held by the governor regarding environmental issues; and (4) evidence regarding availability of REDD+ finance for states.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管学者和政策制定者认识到次国家级政府在多层次气候治理中的作用，但我们对全球南方一些次国家级辖区是否以及为何决定参与分散化气候行动仍知之甚少。本文通过解释巴西各州在2007年至2017年间REDD+兴起初期建立辖区REDD+法律框架（使其能够接收跨国气候融资）的决策差异，为这一问题提供了新的见解。我们利用对政策企业家和行动者的关键知情人访谈，了解（1）与REDD+机制复合体相关的跨国影响路径，以及（2）州级政策企业家在巴西次国家级REDD+准备政策过程中采取的策略，在五个案例研究（亚马孙州、阿克里州、马托格罗索州、帕拉州和阿马帕州）中的作用。据受访者称，可信的市场激励是州长采纳辖区框架以引导REDD+资金的关键影响因素，但跨国规范和物质援助发挥了重要的中介作用。市场激励的可信度感知受到以下因素影响：（1）州级政策企业家的存在；（2）政策企业家采取策略的时机；（3）州长对环境问题的政策信念；以及（4）关于各州可获得REDD+资金的证据。

records.title_en: Farm typology and structure of farmer decision making: The case of the production basin of the forest-savannah transition zone, Centre Cameroon Region
records.title_cn: 农场类型学与农民决策结构：喀麦隆中部地区森林-稀树草原过渡带生产流域的案例
records.abstract_en: Despite having a similar environment, not all of the farmers in a given region have the same history. They don't always share the same traits, and they don't always have the same access to land or diverse natural environment resources. This study aims to describe how agricultural production is organized in the Mbangassina-Ntui-Batchenga-Obala areas to improve food security, where agriculture is the primary economic activity. On 180 farms, mixed data were gathered, and a factorial analysis of the mixed data, along with a hierarchical ascending classification, allowed for the differentiation of 4 groups of farms. Farms in Type 1 (44.44%) have an average size of 2.51 ha, are predominately run by men, primarily employ family labor, and have the highest proportion of farmers. The majority of Type 3 farms (34.44%), which have an average area of 6.62 ha, are run by men and mostly employ family labor. The producers in this group are vulnerable to climate change and lack adaptation plans. Finally, 4 types of farms, which have an average size of 10.9 ha and are operated by both men and women utilizing family labor, account for 5.56% of all farms. All of these farmers are creating adaptation strategies as they recognize the effects of climate change. Through a correct understanding of the reasons that underpin the diversity of farms, this classification serves as a basis for the design of appropriate public policies. Taking into account this diversity of agricultural situations in the northern part of the Centre Cameroon Region is essential for the success of research and rural development operations. In addition, it would allow a more relevant use of typologies of knowledge on farms as a tool for sustainable development and decision support.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管环境相似，但某一地区的农民并非都有相同的历史。他们并不总是具有相同的特征，也不总是拥有相同的土地或多样化自然环境资源的获取途径。本研究旨在描述姆班加西纳-恩图伊-巴琴加-奥巴拉地区的农业生产组织方式，以改善粮食安全，该地区农业是主要经济活动。在180个农场收集了混合数据，对混合数据进行因子分析，并结合层次升序分类，区分出4组农场。类型1的农场（44.44%）平均面积为2.51公顷，主要由男性经营，主要使用家庭劳动力，且农民比例最高。类型3的农场（34.44%）平均面积为6.62公顷，主要由男性经营，主要使用家庭劳动力。该群体的生产者易受气候变化影响，且缺乏适应计划。最后，类型4的农场平均面积为10.9公顷，由男性和女性共同经营并使用家庭劳动力，占所有农场的5.56%。所有这些农民都认识到气候变化的影响，并正在制定适应策略。通过正确理解农场多样性背后的原因，该分类为设计适当的公共政策提供了基础。考虑到喀麦隆中部地区北部农业情况的多样性，对于研究和农村发展行动的成功至关重要。此外，它将允许更相关地使用农场知识类型学作为可持续发展和决策支持的工具。

records.title_en: Land and housing price increases due to metro effect: An empirical analysis of Santiago, Chile, 2008–2019
records.title_cn: 地铁效应导致的土地和房价上涨：对智利圣地亚哥的实证分析，2008-2019
records.abstract_en: This research investigates whether properties near metro lines in Santiago, Chile, are sold for higher prices. To achieve this, a multiple regression analysis is carried out, considering fixed and temporal effects, comparing data within and outside a 1 km buffer zone around each metro station. The study focuses on three variables: (1) capitalization by landowners, (2) capitalization by apartment prices, and (3) a "land incidence" ratio, which is the proportion of land cost-to-apartment prices and acts as a proxy for residential density. The results indicate a positive correlation between metro proximity and capitalization by landowners and apartment prices, at 5.1% and 9.2%, respectively. However, the land incidence shows a negative correlation of − 11.8%, which suggests that apartment prices and residential densities increase more than land costs near metro stations. An approximate estimation also finds 23.5% higher premium to developers within the metro buffer zone, based on apartment prices, density, land cost, and average building cost. These findings support previous studies that show the positive impact of the metro on land and housing values. The study sees the influence of the metro in transforming Santiago's residential densities and private profits.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究调查智利圣地亚哥地铁线路附近的房产是否以更高的价格出售。为此，进行了多元回归分析，考虑固定效应和时间效应，比较每个地铁站周围1公里缓冲区内外的数据。研究聚焦于三个变量：（1）土地所有者的资本化，（2）公寓价格的资本化，以及（3）“土地发生率”比率，即土地成本占公寓价格的比例，作为住宅密度的代理指标。结果表明，地铁邻近性与土地所有者和公寓价格的资本化呈正相关，分别为5.1%和9.2%。然而，土地发生率呈负相关，为11.8%，这表明地铁站附近的公寓价格和住宅密度的增长超过了土地成本。近似估算还发现，基于公寓价格、密度、土地成本和平均建筑成本，地铁缓冲区内的开发商溢价高出23.5%。这些发现支持了先前关于地铁对土地和住房价值积极影响的研究。该研究认为地铁影响了圣地亚哥住宅密度和私人利润的转变。

records.title_en: Multifunctional agriculture in a peri-urban fringe: Chinese farmers’ responses to shifts in policy and changing socio-economic conditions
records.title_cn: 城郊多功能农业：中国农民对政策转变和社会经济条件变化的响应
records.abstract_en: Recent Five-Year Plans and No. 1 Central Documents have emphasised the need for Chinese agriculture to play multiple functions to enhance rural development, alleviate rural poverty and increase agricultural productivity. The concept of Chinese agriculture as multifunctional is explored, linking it to specific policy aims, with three key historical phases of the development of multifunctional agriculture (MFA) recognised. MFA has progressed rapidly in rural-urban fringes across China, and its recent evolution is investigated herewith within two case-study districts (Baqiao and Lintong) in the megacity of Xi’an, Shaanxi Province. Since the economic reforms of the late 1970s, farmers in the area have greatly increased horticultural production to supply the substantial local urban market, displacing traditional grain cultivation, although much high-quality farmland has been lost to urban development, especially in Baqiao. The city has also supplied tourists for farm-based tourism activities (nong jia le), including pick-your-own fruit. A questionnaire survey of sample farm households in 17 villages in the two districts generated detailed information on land management, including farm-based enterprises, participation in co-operatives, marketing, and both recent and future planned changes to farms. Factor analysis of mixed (qualitative and quantitative) data (FAMD) and hierarchical clustering of principal components (HCPC) were used to examine typical characteristics of MFA in the peri-urban fringe. This yielded five principal dimensions of farming, with on-farm environmental actions as a key characteristic. There were also three different clusters of farmers, differentiated between commercial horticultural production, contrasting less intensive part-time farmers with farmers in co-operatives and/or producing for ‘dragonhead’ enterprises. Renewed government support for grain cultivation to increase food availability has led to a minor reversion to cereal production, while multifunctionality has been impacted negatively by the Covid pandemic, with reduced tourist numbers. Loss of revenue from tourism is prompting farmers to search for other income streams via increased agricultural outputs, new marketing outlets, and contributions to a more diversified rural economy involving value-adding to agricultural products.
records.abstract_cn: 最近的五年计划和中央一号文件强调了中国农业需要发挥多种功能，以促进农村发展、减轻农村贫困和提高农业生产率。本文探讨了中国农业作为多功能的概念，将其与具体的政策目标联系起来，并确认了多功能农业（MFA）发展的三个关键历史阶段。多功能农业在中国城乡结合部发展迅速，本文在陕西省西安市的两个案例研究区（灞桥和临潼）调查了其近期演变。自1世纪1970年代末经济改革以来，该地区农民大幅增加了园艺生产，以供应庞大的当地城市市场，取代了传统的粮食种植，尽管大量优质农田已因城市发展而流失，尤其是在灞桥。该市还为游客提供了基于农场的旅游活动（农家乐），包括采摘水果。对两个区17个村庄的样本农户进行的问卷调查，产生了关于土地管理的详细信息，包括农场企业、参与合作社、市场营销以及近期和未来计划中的农场变化。对混合（定性和定量）数据的因子分析（FAMD）和主成分层次聚类（HCPC）用于考察城郊多功能农业的典型特征。这产生了农业的五个主要维度，其中农场环境行动是一个关键特征。还有三个不同的农户群体，区分了商业园艺生产，将不太集约的兼业农民与合作社和/或为“龙头”企业生产的农民进行了对比。政府重新支持粮食种植以提高粮食供应，导致谷物生产略有恢复，而多功能性受到新冠疫情的负面影响，游客数量减少。旅游收入损失正促使农民通过增加农业产出、寻找新的销售渠道以及为农业产品增值，为更多元化的农村经济做出贡献，来寻找其他收入来源。

records.title_en: To what extent are cities prepared for their residents’ deaths? An example of cemetery management in large Polish cities
records.title_cn: 城市在多大程度上为居民的死亡做好了准备？波兰大城市墓地管理示例
records.abstract_en: The progressing urbanization of space along with a desire for maintaining the existing cemetery resources aggravates the problem of guaranteeing a supply of new burial sites. The problem is particularly noticeable in large urban centers, irrespective of their geographic location. The paper focuses on the largest Polish cities and analyses the modes of cemetery management for the purpose of securing future burial places for their residents. By compiling existing data and sourcing information via direct contacts with representatives of municipal offices and managers of municipal cemeteries, a number of significant facts were collected, diagnosing the modes of cemetery management and hitherto burial practices. Clear differences were identified in the transparency of the pursued municipal policies with respect to cemeteries and styles of management, yet every city retains a continuous supply of burial sites. Furthermore, common regularities are perceptible on the national level, such as: priority of extension of existing cemeteries and investments increasing their burial density (e.g. construction of columbaria), planning new cemeteries at city outskirts with good accessibility with respect to the residential areas, no plans to liquidate the existing cemeteries, irrespective of their status of preservation.
records.abstract_cn: 空间城市化的不断发展以及对维护现有墓地资源的渴望加剧了保证新墓地供应的问题。这个问题在大城市中心尤为明显，无论其地理位置如何。本文重点关注波兰最大的城市，并分析了墓地管理模式，以确保其居民未来的墓地。通过汇编现有数据并通过与市政办公室代表和市政公墓管理者的直接联系获取信息，收集了许多重要事实，诊断了公墓管理模式和迄今为止的埋葬实践。在墓地和管理方式方面，所推行的市政政策的透明度存在明显差异，但每个城市都保留了墓地的持续供应。此外，在国家层面上也存在一些共同规律，例如：优先扩建现有墓地并投资增加埋葬密度（例如建造骨灰安置所）、在与居民区交通便利的城市郊区规划新墓地、不计划清算现有墓地，无论其保护状况如何。

records.title_en: The effect of spatial and temporal planning scale on the trade-off between the financial value and carbon storage in production forests
records.title_cn: 空间与时间规划尺度对生产林碳储量经济价值权衡的影响
records.abstract_en: Increasing carbon stock in standing forests is one of the proposed ways to mitigate climate change. However, in production forests, this typically would lead to reduced harvesting possibilities and thus reduced financial gain for the forest owners. The size of this reduction should depend on the chosen target level of the carbon stock as well as the required speed of accumulation. Furthermore, due to landscape heterogeneity, the size of the loss can be expected to vary the planning scale, often related to forest property size.
records.abstract_cn: 增加现存森林的碳储量是减缓气候变化的提议途径之一。然而，在生产林中，这通常会导致采伐可能性降低，从而减少森林所有者的经济收益。这种减少的幅度应取决于所选择的碳储量目标水平以及所需的积累速度。此外，由于景观异质性，损失的规模预计会随规划尺度（通常与森林财产规模相关）而变化。

records.title_en: How to recognize the role of policy clusters in built-up land intensity: An empirical case of the Yangtze River Economic Belt of China
records.title_cn: 如何识别政策集群在建设用地强度中的作用：以中国长江经济带为例的实证研究
records.abstract_en: The dependence of economic and population growth on built-up land cannot be overly blamed, but it needs to be looked at closely when it goes against the principles of sustainable growth. Rapid urbanization and industrialization have led to extensive land use, and many policies have been introduced with the aim of creating clustering effects to mitigate this issue. The Yangtze River Economic Belt (YREB) of China is a typical case to make up for the fact that the role of policy clusters in built-up land intensity (BLI) is not yet fully recognized. First, the intensive use policy clusters (IUPC) of the YREB have undergone evolutionary characteristics of growth, maturity and renewal since their formal birth in 2008. Second, quantitative evidence from time-series observations and policy simulations demonstrates an effective contribution of IUPC to BLI (an average 43.1% enhancement). Worryingly, however, despite the "lifting benefit", the BLI is expected to show a "decreasing trend". Finally, the combined results are fed back to the IUPC, showing that both the abundance and heterogeneity of the policy clusters affect the impact. Specific recommendations for future policy development are made based on the above results. This study provides a pragmatic and rigorous mindset and case for policy research.
records.abstract_cn: 经济增长和人口增长对建设用地的依赖不应被过度指责，但当其违背可持续增长原则时，需要密切关注。快速的城市化和工业化导致了土地粗放利用，许多政策旨在通过形成集群效应来缓解这一问题。中国长江经济带（YREB）是一个典型案例，用以弥补政策集群在建设用地强度（BLI）中的作用尚未被充分认识的事实。首先，自2008年正式诞生以来，长江经济带的集约利用政策集群（IUPC）经历了增长、成熟和更新的演化特征。其次，来自时间序列观测和政策模拟的定量证据表明，IUPC对BLI有有效贡献（平均增强43.1%）。然而，令人担忧的是，尽管存在“提升效益”，BLI预计将呈现“下降趋势”。最后，将综合结果反馈给IUPC，表明政策集群的丰富性和异质性都会影响其影响。基于上述结果，提出了未来政策制定的具体建议。本研究为政策研究提供了务实且严谨的思路和案例。

records.title_en: Land market concentration, developers’ pricing decisions, and class monopoly rent in urban China
records.title_cn: 中国城市土地市场集中度、开发商定价决策与阶级垄断租金
records.abstract_en: Drawing on Harvey’s assertion on class monopoly rent, this paper investigates developers’ monopolist pricing decisions in urban China, with an additional focus on the heterogeneity between state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and private developers. By contextualizing Harvey to China’s urban political economy, we find that when developers maximize profits and local governments maximize land revenues, their individual activities forge a collective to create “island-like” markets that lead to class monopoly rents, and that local governments seek to realize social goals primarily through the operation of SOEs, making SOE developers act differently. We specify a set of hypotheses on the relationship between private developers’ monopolist pricing and their power in local secondary land markets and SOEs’ imparity. We organize a city-level, national-scale dataset and use a fixed effects model and the instrumental variable approach to test our hypotheses. This research has implications for China’s land and housing policies, and suggests that a deeper examination of the concept of class monopoly rent would facilitate a better understanding of contemporary neoliberal cities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文借鉴哈维关于阶级垄断租金的论断，研究中国城市开发商的垄断定价决策，并额外关注国有企业与私营开发商之间的异质性。通过将哈维理论置于中国城市政治经济背景下，我们发现，当开发商追求利润最大化而地方政府追求土地收入最大化时，它们的个体行为共同形成了一种“岛屿式”市场，导致阶级垄断租金的产生；地方政府主要通过国有企业运作来实现社会目标，这使得国有开发商的行为有所不同。我们针对私营开发商垄断定价与其在当地二级土地市场中的权力以及国有企业的不平等性之间的关系，提出了一系列假设。我们构建了一个城市级、全国范围的数据集，并采用固定效应模型和工具变量方法来检验我们的假设。本研究对中国土地和住房政策具有启示意义，并表明对阶级垄断租金概念的深入考察将有助于更好地理解当代新自由主义城市。

records.title_en: Tillage conditions or social economy? An analysis of the dominant driving force of farmland marginalization from the farmers' perspective
records.title_cn: 耕作条件还是社会经济？——基于农户视角的耕地边际化主导驱动力分析
records.abstract_en: Farmland marginalization has been one of the main directions of land use transition in the process of industrialization and urbanization in recent years. With the increase in rural labor opportunity costs, the influence of natural resource endowment and socioeconomic conditions on farmers' farmland marginalization behavior at the micro level remains unknown, and the relevant literature is insufficient. In this study, the quantile regression method is adopted to explore the evolutionary trend of the role of tilling-based factors and socioeconomic factors under mild, moderate and severe marginalization levels of cultivated land. The results show that with farmland marginalization aggravation, the influence of tillage-based factors represented by tillage conditions on marginalization weakens while that of socioeconomic factors deepens. This study elucidates various regulation strategies at different farmland marginalization levels. At mild marginalization levels, attention should be given to improving tillage conditions; at moderate and severe marginalization levels, efforts should be made to improve the economic production capacity of farmland and promote the transfer of marginalized farmland to new agricultural business entities.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，耕地边际化已成为工业化和城镇化进程中土地利用转型的主要方向之一。随着农村劳动力机会成本的增加，自然资源禀赋和社会经济条件对农户微观层面耕地边际化行为的影响尚不明确，相关文献亦显不足。本研究采用分位数回归方法，探讨在耕地轻度、中度和重度边际化水平下，耕作因素与社会经济因素作用的演变趋势。结果表明，随着耕地边际化的加剧，以耕作条件为代表的耕作因素对边际化的影响减弱，而社会经济因素的影响则加深。本研究阐明了不同耕地边际化水平下的多种调控策略。在轻度边际化水平下，应注重改善耕作条件；在中度和重度边际化水平下，应着力提升农田的经济生产能力，并促进边际化耕地向新型农业经营主体流转。

records.title_en: Fiscal incentive, political incentive, and strategic interaction of illegal land use by local governments
records.title_cn: 地方政府违法用地的财政激励、政治激励与战略互动
records.abstract_en: The Chinese-style decentralization that emerged in the 1990 s has brought about a period of economic growth. However, the drawbacks of decentralized reforms have also gradually drawn the attention of scholars. Local governments themselves, who are supposed to be the custodians of local land, have become the subjects of violations. The study analyzes illegal land use by local governments in the macro context of the entire Chinese economic transition. The trade-offs and constraints faced by local governments in committing illegal land use are evaluated, relevant hypotheses proposed, and a time-spatial dynamic panel data model is constructed through theoretical analysis. Finally, the results of the theoretical and empirical analyses are combined to initiate a more in-depth discussion on the underlying mechanisms of illegal land use by local government, thus attempting to further clarify the logic behind local government land violations in the context of economic growth. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) The development impulse of local governments under the Chinese-style decentralized structure, coupled with the imperfect horizontal accountability mechanism and the inherent defects of the land plan management system, has led to local governments’ repeated violation of land law. (2) There are significant strategic features of such illegal land use, which are manifested in path dependence in time and horizontal competition imitation in space. (3) The financial incentives of local governments and the promotion incentives of local officials have varying degrees of impact on the development of local governments.
records.abstract_cn: 1990年代出现的中国式的分权带来了一段经济增长时期。但分权改革的弊端也逐渐引起学者们的关注。地方政府本身本应是当地土地的管理者，却成为了侵权行为的主体。该研究在整个中国经济转型的宏观背景下分析了地方政府的非法土地使用情况。评估地方政府违法用地所面临的权衡和约束，提出相关假设，并通过理论分析构建时空动态面板数据模型。最后，结合理论分析和实证分析的结果，对地方政府违法用地的深层机制展开更深入的探讨，试图进一步厘清经济增长背景下地方政府土地违法行为背后的逻辑。主要结论如下：(1)中国式分权结构下地方政府的发展冲动，加上横向问责机制的不完善和土地规划管理制度的固有缺陷，导致地方政府屡屡违法土地违法行为。 (2)此类违法用地具有显着的战略特征，表现为时间上的路径依赖和空间上的同业竞争模仿。 (3)地方政府的财政激励和地方官员的晋升激励对地方政府的发展都有不同程度的影响。

records.title_en: To own or not to own? Land tenure security and production risk in small-scale farming
records.title_cn: 拥有还是不拥有？小规模农业中的土地保有权保障与生产风险
records.abstract_en: While the impact of land tenure security on farm yield has been extensively investigated in the literature, little is known about the role tenure security plays in mitigating risk exposure. Using a nationally representative dataset collected through a multistage stratified random sampling of 1820 maize farmers in Nigeria during the 2014/2015 production season, we fill this knowledge gap by analysing the treatment effect of land ownership on production risk, measured by expected yield, yield variability (variance), and downside risk (skewness). To do so, we employ an endogenous switching regression model to sufficiently tackle selectivity bias that may arise from observed and unobserved factors. Our findings reveal that land ownership raises maize yield by 1.6% and reduces variability and downside risk by 95% and 164%, respectively. The robustness of these findings is established by further analyses using propensity score matching and inverse-probability-weighted regression adjustment approaches. Moreover, we find that the impacts of land ownership differ across landowners with different farmer characteristics and farm-level factors. Our results suggest that promoting policies that seek to encourage secure land tenure arrangements can be effective in mitigating production risk and crop failure, particularly in small-scale farming.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管土地保有权保障对农场产量的影响已在文献中得到广泛研究，但关于保有权保障在缓解风险暴露中的作用却知之甚少。利用通过多阶段分层随机抽样收集的尼日利亚1820名玉米种植者在2014/2015生产季的全国代表性数据集，我们通过分析土地所有权对生产风险的处理效应来填补这一知识空白，生产风险以预期产量、产量变异性（方差）和下行风险（偏度）衡量。为此，我们采用内生转换回归模型来充分处理可能由可观测和不可观测因素引起的选择性偏差。我们的研究结果表明，土地所有权使玉米产量提高1.6%，并将变异性和下行风险分别降低95%和164%。通过使用倾向得分匹配和逆概率加权回归调整方法的进一步分析，这些发现的稳健性得到了证实。此外，我们发现土地所有权的影响因具有不同农户特征和农场层面因素的土地所有者而异。我们的结果表明，促进鼓励有保障的土地保有权安排的政策可有效缓解生产风险和作物歉收，尤其是在小规模农业中。

records.title_en: Zoning for character: Contextual rezoning and socioeconomic change in New York City neighborhoods, 1986–2019
records.title_cn: 为特色而分区：纽约市街区的文脉性重新分区与社会经济变迁，1986-2019年
records.abstract_en: Empirical research is increasingly evaluating how municipal rezonings may affect the racial and socioeconomic characteristics of neighborhoods over time. There are also some zoning types that are not intended to affect development capacity and are based on the policy rationale of protecting urban character. Contextual rezonings are one such type and apply a layer of mandatory regulation on building height, setbacks from the street line, and yard requirements to create more restrictive but visually interesting building envelopes. In the American context, bundled with the notion of urban character are also discriminatory biases about the demographic characteristics of who should be allowed to live in urban neighborhoods and whose presence adds economic value. There is a need for additional studies that examine how character-based zoning controls may also be implicated in forms of neighborhood change, particularly exclusionary practices. This paper contributes to the literature by examining the neighborhood socioeconomic impacts of contextual rezonings implemented in New York City between 1986 and 2019 using a difference-in-difference method. The findings indicate that after implementation, contextually zoned neighborhoods tend to increase in socioeconomic status and become more predominately white and affluent. These changes represent a further entrenchment of white isolation that solidifies related privileges.
records.abstract_cn: 实证研究越来越多地评估市政重新分区如何可能随时间影响街区的种族和社会经济特征。也有一些分区类型并非旨在影响开发容量，而是基于保护城市特色的政策理由。文脉性重新分区就是其中一种类型，它对建筑高度、街道线后退距离和庭院要求施加一层强制性规定，以创造更具限制性但视觉上有趣的建筑轮廓。在美国背景下，与城市特色概念捆绑在一起的还有关于谁应该被允许居住在城市街区以及谁的存在增加经济价值的人口特征的歧视性偏见。需要更多的研究来考察基于特色的分区控制是否也可能涉及街区变化的形式，特别是排斥性做法。本文通过使用双重差分法，考察了1986年至2019年间在纽约市实施的文脉性重新分区的街区社会经济影响，为文献做出了贡献。研究结果表明，实施后，文脉性分区的街区往往社会经济地位上升，并变得更加以白人和富裕人口为主。这些变化代表了白人隔离的进一步固化，从而巩固了相关特权。

records.title_en: Rethinking developmental state intervention in the housing supply of a transitional economy: Evidence from Hanoi, Vietnam
records.title_cn: 重新思考转型经济体住房供应中的发展型国家干预：来自越南河内的证据
records.abstract_en: The Vietnamese government has consistently played the role of policy initiator to achieve mass affordable housing provision through mobilising resources from the private sector since the Doi Moi policy was proclaimed. Consequently, high-rise apartments have gradually changed Hanoi's cityscape, while self-built row-houses still dominate the housing market. This study explores the evolution in housing types from the perspective of policy deviation. It aims to examine Hanoi's housing development using the developmental state model's theoretical framework to verify the impact of government intervention. The research methods involved collecting official statistics and survey data on apartment plans; an in-depth literature review on the local laws and regulations; and focus group interviews with government officials, professors, and construction industry businesspeople. This study shows that crude regulations and mismatches in actual housing demand led to malfunctions in ambitious housing supply plans during policy implementation. It also identifies that public land ownership and centralised planning authority are critical elements of the state's incentive-control scheme for housing provision. The public entities' market independence, ensuring the private sector's profitability, and financial instruments that promote housing affordability are essential for the state-led housing development policy's success.
records.abstract_cn: 自革新政策宣布以来，越南政府一直扮演政策发起者的角色，通过调动私营部门资源来实现大规模可负担住房供应。因此，高层公寓逐渐改变了河内的城市景观，而自建排屋仍主导着住房市场。本研究从政策偏离的角度探讨住房类型的演变，旨在运用发展型国家模型的理论框架考察河内的住房发展，以验证政府干预的影响。研究方法包括收集官方统计数据和公寓计划调查数据；对地方法律法规进行深入文献综述；以及与政府官员、教授和建筑行业商人进行焦点小组访谈。本研究表明，粗略的法规和实际住房需求的不匹配导致政策实施过程中雄心勃勃的住房供应计划失灵。研究还指出，公共土地所有权和集中规划权力是国家激励-控制住房供应计划的关键要素。公共实体的市场独立性、确保私营部门的盈利能力以及促进住房可负担性的金融工具，对于国家主导的住房发展政策的成功至关重要。

records.title_en: Mapping regional accessibility of public transport and services in support of spatial planning: A case study in Flanders
records.title_cn: 绘制公共交通和服务区域可达性以支持空间规划：佛兰德斯案例研究
records.abstract_en: The Flemish region in Belgium is characterised by a high and ever-growing proportion of settlement area. Moreover, the historical growth pattern has resulted in fragmented urban development causing societal and environmental problems such as strong competition for space by multiple sectors and traffic congestion. The Flemish government has incorporated in its Spatial Policy Plan the goal to reduce land take to zero by 2040 and to guide future urban development according to the Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) planning model. One of the principles of the plan is to concentrate urban development (to house the growing population and employment) at locations with good access to public transport and public and private services. Moreover, accessibility should be reached by means of active modes of transportation (e.g. walking, cycling). This paper offers a method to assist spatial planners that operate at a regional scale level by operationalizing these TOD-principles through mapping the urban development potential area-wide at high resolution. The proposed method builds upon the ‘node-place model’ put forward by Bertolini (1999). The method is applied to assess the urban development potential of locations in Flanders at a full-scale (i.e. for every location in Flanders, not only in areas around train stations). The method can be used to support policy makers operating at various levels (regional – local) to identify and prioritise locations that qualify for expansion, densification or reduction of the built-up area.
records.abstract_cn: 比利时佛兰德斯地区的定居区比例高且持续增长。此外，历史增长模式导致了碎片化的城市发展，引发社会和环境问题，如多部门对空间的激烈竞争和交通拥堵。佛兰德斯政府在其《空间政策规划》中纳入了到2040年将土地占用减少至零的目标，并根据公交导向开发（TOD）规划模型指导未来城市发展。该规划的原则之一是将城市发展（以容纳增长的人口和就业）集中在公共交通以及公共和私人服务可达性良好的地点。此外，可达性应通过主动交通方式（如步行、骑行）实现。本文提供了一种方法，通过以高分辨率绘制区域范围内的城市发展潜力，帮助在区域尺度上运作的空间规划者实施这些TOD原则。所提出的方法建立在Bertolini（1999）提出的“节点-场所模型”基础上。该方法被应用于评估佛兰德斯各地点的城市发展潜力，覆盖全区域（即佛兰德斯每个地点，不仅限于火车站周边区域）。该方法可用于支持不同层级（区域-地方）的政策制定者识别和优先考虑适合扩建、密集化或减少建成区的地点。

records.title_en: Engaging citizens in land use policy in the smart city context
records.title_cn: 智慧城市背景下公民参与土地利用政策
records.abstract_en: In the otherwise rich debate on smart cities, the intersection of land use and spatial planning, on the one hand, their social and societal implications, on the other hand, and finally, the potential inherent in ICT-enhanced tools underlying the functioning, operation, management, and administration of smart city, remain overlooked. Considering that, due to multiple environmental and societal pressures, land use, has become more political than ever, whereby pleas for open and transparent methods of coordination, deliberation, and participation proliferate, it is imperative that citizens are involved in the land use policymaking at the level of the city and the neighborhoods. Even if substantial literature addressing each of these issues exists, approaches that would fit these multiple pieces of the puzzle together in one equation are still missing. By elaborating on the findings of an online survey (N = 5752) involving the citizens of a smart city (Lublin, Poland), this paper responds to this imperative. The findings suggest that utilizing insights from e-participation tools and surveys, in combination with more traditional instruments, such as meetings, debates, and workshops, may significantly improve land use policies in (smart) cities.
records.abstract_cn: 在关于智慧城市的丰富讨论中，土地利用与空间规划、其社会和社会影响，以及ICT增强工具在智慧城市运作、运营、管理和行政中的潜在作用，这三者的交集仍被忽视。考虑到由于多重环境和社会压力，土地利用变得比以往任何时候都更具政治性，要求开放透明的协调、审议和参与方法的呼声日益增多，因此公民参与城市和社区层面的土地利用政策制定势在必行。尽管已有大量文献分别涉及这些问题，但将这些碎片整合到一个方程中的方法仍然缺失。通过阐述一项涉及智慧城市（波兰卢布林）公民的在线调查（N = 5752）的结果，本文回应了这一要求。研究结果表明，利用电子参与工具和调查的见解，结合会议、辩论和研讨会等更传统的工具，可以显著改善（智慧）城市的土地利用政策。

records.title_en: The private in the public: The case of Norwegian private zoning plans
records.title_cn: 公共中的私人：挪威私人分区规划案例
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the Norwegian practice of private regulation planning (or private zoning plans), seeking to discern if and how the processes and resulting plans align with the acknowledged benefits of public private partnership (PPP). To assess the topic, we have employed a mixed-methods case-study approach, combining document studies with stakeholder interviews. Two cases were studied in two different municipalities in mid-Norway. We focused on the role of participation and the adaptation between private zoning plans and the holistic ambitions in the local comprehensive plans. Public participation is mandated by law in all municipal planning but the incentives to develop the role of participation might be neglected in private plans. Another observation is the challenge with aligning private initiatives with the overall ambitions phrased in the local comprehensive plan. As a general conclusion we state that these observations and the fact that the Norwegian planning system allows for private actors to take an active role in the planning process, could trigger more studies on the effects of the public-private partnership in the Norwegian planning system.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了挪威的私人监管规划（或私人分区规划）实践，旨在探究其过程及由此产生的规划是否以及如何与公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）公认的益处相一致。为评估该主题，我们采用了混合方法的案例研究方法，将文献研究与利益相关者访谈相结合。在挪威中部的两个不同城市中研究了两个案例。我们关注了参与的作用以及私人分区规划与地方综合规划中整体目标之间的适应性。公众参与在所有市政规划中都是法律规定的，但在私人规划中，发展参与角色的激励措施可能被忽视。另一个观察结果是，将私人倡议与地方综合规划中所述的整体目标相协调存在挑战。作为一般结论，我们指出，这些观察结果以及挪威规划体系允许私人行为者在规划过程中发挥积极作用的事实，可能会引发更多关于挪威规划体系中公私合作伙伴关系影响的研究。

records.title_en: What factors guide the recent Spanish model for the disposal of military land in the neoliberal era?
records.title_cn: 新自由主义时代西班牙军事用地处置模式的影响因素是什么？
records.abstract_en: This work drafts a general framework about the disposal policies fostered by the Spanish Ministry of Defence since the 1980 s, which is apparently understudied in comparison with emerging international research. The research seeks two main goals. The first is to demonstrate that these policies have followed the general trend of neoliberal restructuring of the public sector, as it happened in countries like France, Italy, and the UK. In the face of austerity and deep state cuts in military spending, the MoD sells (off) its estate to reduce the real estate management and maintenance costs and generate financial gains from sales. The second goal is to highlight the primarily financial approach of the MoD disposal policies. Although military land may catalyse significant urban transformation, the disposal policies have sought direct economic revenue for the central government and the MoD.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个关于西班牙国防部自1980年代以来推行的处置政策的总体框架，与国际上新兴的研究相比，这一主题显然研究不足。研究旨在实现两个主要目标。第一是证明这些政策遵循了公共部门新自由主义重组的总体趋势，正如法国、意大利和英国等国家所发生的那样。面对紧缩政策和国家军事开支的大幅削减，国防部出售其地产以降低房地产管理和维护成本，并从销售中产生财务收益。第二个目标是强调国防部处置政策的主要财务导向。尽管军事用地可能催化显著的城市转型，但处置政策旨在为中央政府和国防部带来直接的经济收入。

records.title_en: Crop diversification as a household livelihood strategy under environmental stress. Factors contributing to the adoption of crop diversification in shrimp cultivation and agricultural crop farming zones of coastal Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 环境压力下作物多样化作为家庭生计策略：孟加拉国沿海虾养殖区和农作物种植区采用作物多样化的影响因素
records.abstract_en: Environmental stressors, potentially aggravated by climate change, pose significant challenges to households whose livelihoods rely primarily on crop production in agriculture or aquaculture, particularly in countries of the Global South. In this context, diversified farming systems, or crop diversification, have been discussed as one adaptation strategy of smallholder farming households to reduce their livelihood vulnerability and increase farm resilience. In coastal Bangladesh, livelihoods based on cultivation of shrimp, prawn, fish, paddy (rice) and other crops are likely to become more vulnerable with accelerated sea level rise, extreme flooding events, cyclone activity, river bank erosion and salinization. While crop diversification in Bangladesh is still low overall, it has been increasing. To understand the factors driving the uptake of diversified cropping in different farming production contexts and allow for policy measures addressing regionally specific needs, we explore the (relative) impact and significance of relevant factors contributing to the adoption of crop diversification practices for (i) shrimp cultivation and (ii) agricultural crop farming zones. We specifically include variables representing subjectively perceived risks to study their role in climate change adaptation. Our findings are based on a quantitative household survey (n = 1188) in nine purposefully selected unions across the Bangaleshi part of the Ganges-Brahmaputra-Meghna delta to capture the diversity of the region. Our results show that the prevalence of crop diversification measures is relatively high in the shrimp cultivation zone, but relatively low in the agricultural crop farming regions. In sum, the results show that even though direct economic factors seem to be (still) more important for diversification decisions, our study also suggests that perceived environmental threats and changes can have a favourable influence on crop diversification and should hence be included in studies investigating causes for land use changes. Yet, there are significant differences with regard to the influence of specific factors on the likelihood to diversify in the two respective zones. We conclude that greater uptakes of agriculture and aquaculture diversification could represent a promising and more sustainable approach for smallholders in coastal Bangladesh given appropriate supportive institutional conditions and measures that address specific needs of local communities. A “one-size-fits-all” approach to pushing crop diversification is unlikely to produce adequate and sustainable results.
records.abstract_cn: 环境压力源，可能因气候变化而加剧，对主要依赖农业或水产养殖作物生产的家庭构成重大挑战，尤其是在全球南方国家。在此背景下，多样化农业系统或作物多样化已被讨论为小农家庭减少生计脆弱性和提高农场恢复力的一种适应策略。在孟加拉国沿海，基于虾、罗氏沼虾、鱼、水稻（稻谷）和其他作物种植的生计可能随着海平面加速上升、极端洪水事件、气旋活动、河岸侵蚀和盐碱化而变得更加脆弱。尽管孟加拉国的作物多样化总体仍然较低，但一直在增加。为了解不同农业生产背景下推动多样化种植采用的因素，并允许针对区域特定需求的政策措施，我们探讨了影响（i）虾养殖区和（ii）农作物种植区采用作物多样化实践的相关因素的（相对）影响和显著性。我们特别纳入了代表主观感知风险的自变量，以研究它们在气候变化适应中的作用。我们的发现基于一项定量家庭调查（n = 1188），该调查在恒河-布拉马普特拉-梅克纳三角洲的孟加拉国部分有目的地选取了九个联合村，以捕捉该地区的多样性。结果表明，虾养殖区作物多样化措施的普及率相对较高，而农作物种植区则相对较低。总之，结果表明，尽管直接经济因素似乎（仍然）对多样化决策更重要，但我们的研究也表明，感知到的环境威胁和变化可能对作物多样化产生有利影响，因此应纳入调查土地利用变化原因的研究中。然而，在各自区域中，特定因素对多样化可能性的影响存在显著差异。我们得出结论，在适当的支持性制度条件和针对当地社区特定需求的措施下，农业和水产养殖多样化的更大采用可能代表孟加拉国沿海小农的一个有前景且更可持续的方法。推动作物多样化的“一刀切”方法不太可能产生充分和可持续的结果。

records.title_en: Understanding cropland abandonment from economics within a representative village and its empirical analysis in Chinese mountainous areas
records.title_cn: 理解中国山区代表性村庄的耕地撂荒经济学及其实证分析
records.abstract_en: China has been experiencing "Lewis Turning-Point", which means rural labor has been continuously transmitting to manufacturing sector and urban areas, ended up with old or female labor left in agricultural sector. One immediate result from agricultural labor shortage, some pieces of farmland will be abandoned, especially in mountainous area where large-farming-machinery cannot be applied due to terrain restrictions, and labor loss from agriculture cannot be supplemented. In this context, understanding land abandonment is critical for land planning and management. Specifically, it is necessary to figure out which cropland is more likely to be abandoned? To what scale of the land will be abandoned in the future? This article aims to figure out the basic rules behind land use or abandonment decision from a perspective of economics. In China, village is the basic unit for land use and land use rights transferring, thus we introduced a representative village, featured by an average farmland size with distribution pattern following questionnaire survey carried out in Wulong district, Chongqing city. We developed a theoretical land use decision-making model with its objective of maximizing land use incomes among ‘representative village’. This model is employed to simulate land abandonment rate in the year of 2011 and 2020 by changing the external variables given by the market survey, with a result of 9.25% and 33.40% respectively. The simulated land abandonment rate shows only 3.84 percentage point difference with the official data, which certified that this model is reasonable and applicable for land use decision in mountain areas in China. The model also shows a rise of labor wage will lead to huge land abandonment. To counter land abandonment, government should take some measures, such as rise of agricultural product sale price or decline the chemical fertilizer price, to alleviate land abandonment effectively.
records.abstract_cn: 中国正在经历“刘易斯拐点”，这意味着农村劳动力持续向制造业部门和城市转移，最终导致农业部门只剩下老年或女性劳动力。农业劳动力短缺的一个直接结果是，一些农田将被撂荒，尤其是在山区，由于地形限制，大型农业机械无法应用，农业劳动力流失无法得到补充。在此背景下，理解土地撂荒对于土地规划和管理至关重要。具体而言，有必要弄清楚哪些耕地更可能被撂荒？未来土地撂荒的规模将达到多少？本文旨在从经济学角度揭示土地利用或撂荒决策背后的基本规律。在中国，村庄是土地利用和土地使用权流转的基本单位，因此我们引入了一个代表性村庄，其特点是平均农田面积和分布模式遵循在重庆市武隆区进行的问卷调查。我们建立了一个理论土地利用决策模型，其目标是在“代表性村庄”中最大化土地利用收益。该模型用于通过改变市场调查给出的外部变量来模拟2011年和2020年的土地撂荒率，结果分别为9.25%和33.40%。模拟的土地撂荒率与官方数据仅相差3.84个百分点，这证明该模型在中国山区土地利用决策中是合理且适用的。模型还显示，劳动力工资的上涨将导致大量土地撂荒。为了应对土地撂荒，政府应采取一些措施，如提高农产品销售价格或降低化肥价格，以有效缓解土地撂荒。

records.title_en: Where did the forest go? Post-deforestation land use dynamics in the Dry Chaco region in Northwestern Argentina
records.title_cn: 森林去哪儿了？阿根廷西北部干旱查科地区森林砍伐后的土地利用动态
records.abstract_en: Land transformation is a major component of global change, directly altering habitat composition and spatial configuration, biodiversity, and ecosystem functioning. Over the last decades, the Dry Chaco region in Northwestern Argentina has become one of the regions most heavily transformed worldwide due to the expansion of its agricultural frontier. Many questions remain unanswered about how this process of change occurred. In this study, a parcel-scale database was used to assess the conversion of natural landscapes to different agroecosystems. The magnitude and direction of land use transitions during the last 20 years (2001–2019) were analyzed. Ranching is the main proximate cause of deforestation, accounting for more than 63% of the area cleared annually, though the land use expansion pattern has varied in space and time. Trajectories of land use transitions revealed a spatial arrangement where croplands have displaced ranching to drier areas. The analysis of the intensity of these transitions has shown that the trajectory of post-deforestation land use dynamics has followed a permanent systematic spatio-temporal pattern of change: (1) Dry Forest to Pastures; (2) Pastures to Single Crops; and (3) Single Cropping and Double Cropping systems, where processes of expansion, replacement, and intensification have been identified. Information on transition patterns has allowed us to develop a deeper understanding of land transformation processes, essential in the design of effective land use management strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 土地转化是全球变化的主要组成部分，直接改变栖息地组成和空间格局、生物多样性以及生态系统功能。在过去几十年中，阿根廷西北部的干旱查科地区由于农业边界的扩张，已成为全球土地转化最严重的地区之一。关于这一变化过程如何发生，许多问题仍未得到解答。本研究使用地块尺度数据库评估自然景观向不同农业生态系统的转化。分析了最近20年（2001-2019年）土地利用转变的幅度和方向。畜牧业是森林砍伐的主要直接原因，占每年砍伐面积的63%以上，尽管土地利用扩张模式在空间和时间上有所变化。土地利用转变的轨迹揭示了耕地将畜牧业推向更干旱地区的空间布局。对这些转变强度的分析表明，森林砍伐后土地利用动态的轨迹遵循了永久性的系统性时空变化模式：（1）干旱森林转为牧场；（2）牧场转为单作；（3）单作和双作系统，其中识别出扩张、替代和集约化过程。关于转变模式的信息使我们能够更深入地理解土地转化过程，这对于设计有效的土地利用管理策略至关重要。

records.title_en: Calibrating Nepal's scientific forest management practices in the measure of forest restoration
records.title_cn: 以森林恢复为尺度校准尼泊尔的科学森林管理实践
records.abstract_en: Various restoration programs have been implemented worldwide to recover degraded ecosystems. Nepal implemented a signature policy— Scientific Forest Management (SciFM)—with the aim of restoring and enhancing forest conditions, as well as increasing employment, timber production and economic growth in the last decade. While SciFM might achieve these objectives, it may conflict with Nepal’s own biodiversity and emission reduction policies. So far, various aspects of SciFM, such as stakeholders' opinion, policy issues, and financial analysis have been conducted. However, the effect of SciFM in achieving various restoration objectives remains unexplored. Taking a case of Sal (Shorea robusta) dominated forest which resembles productive forests in the lowlands of Nepal, we evaluated land productivity, carbon, and biodiversity outcomes of SciFM. Employing the methods of policy review (n = 6), literature review (n = 35), expert consultations (n = 15), and forest and soil inventory, we found that SciFM has been beneficial for establishing regeneration of Sal. However, in the short-run, SciFM was found to be counterproductive to achieve national objectives of REDD+ (reducing carbon emissions from forestry sector), biodiversity conservation, and land productivity enhancement. Based on our analysis, we have discussed some learning areas from SciFM practices to align with the restoration objectives at a national and global scale. Implications of the findings in the other parts of the world, who are also implementing intensive forest management programs, are highlighted.
records.abstract_cn: 全球范围内已实施各种恢复计划以恢复退化的生态系统。尼泊尔在过去十年中实施了一项标志性政策——科学森林管理（SciFM），旨在恢复和改善森林状况，同时增加就业、木材生产和经济增长。虽然SciFM可能实现这些目标，但它可能与尼泊尔自身的生物多样性和减排政策相冲突。迄今为止，已对SciFM的各个方面进行了研究，如利益相关者意见、政策问题和财务分析。然而，SciFM在实现各种恢复目标方面的效果仍未得到探索。以尼泊尔低地类似生产性森林的Sal（Shorea robusta）优势林为例，我们评估了SciFM的土地生产力、碳和生物多样性结果。采用政策审查（n = 6）、文献综述（n = 35）、专家咨询（n = 15）以及森林和土壤清查的方法，我们发现SciFM有利于建立Sal的更新。然而，在短期内，SciFM被发现对实现REDD+（减少林业部门碳排放）、生物多样性保护和土地生产力提升的国家目标适得其反。基于我们的分析，我们讨论了SciFM实践中一些可借鉴的经验，以与国家及全球层面的恢复目标保持一致。研究结果对世界上其他也在实施集约森林管理计划的地区具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Are we promoting green cities in Latin America and the Caribbean? Exploring the patterns and drivers of change for urban vegetation
records.title_cn: 我们是否在推动拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的绿色城市？探索城市植被变化的模式与驱动因素
records.abstract_en: As cities opt for green policies to address urban socio-ecological challenges it becomes important to evaluate how the urban landscape responds to them, and if these responses are strengthening the benefits of nature for all. The Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) region is one of the most biodiverse and urbanized regions of the world, which makes it imperative to understand how greening policies have impacted the distribution, accessibility, and quantity of vegetated areas in cities through time. Using a landscape ecology approach, we explored the effects of local urban dynamics on the pathways of urban vegetation in ten LAC capital cities in the last 20 years. Our results showed a great fluctuation of vegetation cover change for the region, with Santiago (Chile) losing more than 10% of its urban vegetation to Brasilia gaining 19%, while fragmentation and inequities in the distribution of vegetation increased in all cities. Cities followed four pathways of vegetation change, displaying different patterns of change in fragmentation, size of the vegetated patches and their clustering. This discloses that the greening policies and actions adopted in LAC cities led to increased vegetation cover, or avoided its loss, but did not assure a better distribution of the green and its benefits. Vegetation in LAC cities are still fragmented, where vegetation is not connected and is not equitably distributed, showing that policies in place have not addressed distributional injustice yet. This is corroborated by the assessment of drivers of change where we found social factors were the most important determinants of urban vegetation dynamics. Results from our study provide evidence for developing policies towards urban greening and connectivity, not only to prevent further biodiversity loss but also for creating more resilient communities and cities that address environmental inequities.
