records.abstract_cn: 美国政治目前以对原本可验证的现实持有两极分化的信念为特征，这种病态现象常被归因于“回音室”对志同道合的党派人士的影响。党派人士可能出于工具性原因（即假定同党派人士知道得更多）或表达性原因（即学习或确认“党派亲和”信念）而寻求志同道合者的观点。我们进行了一项在线实验，以刻画对政治信念社会信息的需求和使用。我们发现，参与者对同党派人士和混合党派群体的线索都有反应，但不太倾向于咨询对立党派人士或遵循其信念。然而，当可靠的外部信息来源可用时，参与者寻求任何类型社会信息的可能性大大降低，这与工具性动机而非表达性动机一致。简言之，党派之间存在不信任，但也存在为追求“正确信念”而咨询社会信息的意愿。进一步的观察表明，那些确实咨询同伴的人并不更常正确，这强调了可靠私人信息作为抵御回音室某些有害影响的重要屏障作用。

records.title_en: The long run effects of de jure discrimination in the credit market: How redlining increased crime
records.title_cn: 信贷市场中法律上歧视的长期效应：红线划分如何增加了犯罪
records.abstract_en: Today in the United States the welfare costs of crime are disproportionately borne by individuals living in predominately African-American or Hispanic neighborhoods. This paper shows that redlining practices established in the wake of the Great Depression made lasting contributions to this inequity. First I use an unannounced population cutoff that determined which cities were redline mapped to show that redline mapping increased present-day city level crime. Secondly, I use a spatial regression discontinuity to show that redlining influenced the present-day neighborhood level distribution of crime in Los Angeles, California. I also identify channels though which redline mapping influenced crime including increasing racial segregation and decreasing educational attainment.
records.abstract_cn: 当今美国，犯罪福利成本不成比例地由主要居住着非裔美国人或西班牙裔美国人社区的个人承担。本文表明，大萧条后确立的红线划分实践对这一不平等现象产生了持久影响。首先，我使用一个未公布的、决定哪些城市被红线绘制的入口截止点来表明，红线绘制增加了当今城市层面的犯罪。其次，我使用空间断点回归来表明，红线划分影响了加利福尼亚州洛杉矶市当今社区层面的犯罪分布。我还识别了红线绘制影响犯罪的渠道，包括增加种族隔离和降低教育成就。

records.title_en: The $100 million nudge: Increasing tax compliance of firms using a natural field experiment
records.title_cn: 100 百万美元的推动：利用自然实地实验提高公司的税收合规性
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a natural field experiment to examine the effectiveness of deterrence messages on tax compliance in the Dominican Republic. In collaboration with the tax authority, we sent messages to 56,310 firms that collectively paid $700 million in the year before the experiment. Our field experiment complements a tax enforcement reform in the Dominican Republic a year before our intervention. Sharing information about prison sentences or the public disclosure of evasion arising from the tax enforcement reform increases tax revenue by $184 million (0.22% of GDP). Using a unique sample that covers the entire firm size distribution, we show that the largest firms, that pay 84% of all corporate income taxes and typically have been excluded from this type of intervention, are highly responsive to our information treatments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用自然现场实验来检验威慑信息对多米尼加共和国税收合规性的有效性。我们与税务机关合作，向 56,310 公司发送了消息，这些公司在实验前一年总共支付了 700 百万美元。我们的实地实验补充了我们干预前一年多米尼加共和国的税务执法改革。分享有关监禁刑期或公开披露税收执法改革引起的逃税行为的信息可增加税收收入184百万美元（占GDP的0.22%。使用涵盖整个企业规模分布的独特样本，我们表明，支付84%所有企业所得税且通常被排除在此类干预之外的最大企业对我们的信息处理高度敏感。

records.title_en: Combining rules and discretion in economic development policy: Evidence on the impacts of the California Competes Tax Credit
records.title_cn: 经济发展政策中规则与自由裁量的结合：加州竞争税收抵免影响的证据
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the effects of one of a new generation of economic development programs, the California Competes Tax Credit (CCTC), on local job creation. Incorporating perceived best practices from previous initiatives, the CCTC combines explicit eligibility thresholds with some discretion on the part of program officials to select tax credit recipients. The structure and implementation of the program facilitates rigorous evaluation. We exploit detailed data on accepted and rejected applicants to the CCTC, including information on the scoring of applicants with regard to program goals as well as on funding decisions, together with restricted-access American Community Survey (ACS) data on local economic conditions. Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that each CCTC-incentivized job in a census tract increases the number of individuals working in that tract by close to 3 – a significant local multiplier. Local multipliers are larger for non-manufacturing awards than for manufacturing awards. CCTC awards increase employment among workers across socioeconomic groups and in more- as well as less-advantaged neighborhoods, but have limited impact on residents of affected communities. We validate our empirical strategy and confirm our core results using an alternative dataset and recently developed difference-in-differences methods that correct for potential biases generated by variation in treatment timing and treatment effect heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估新一代经济发展项目之一——加州竞争税收抵免（CCTC）对当地就业创造的影响。CCTC结合了先前项目的公认最佳实践，将明确的资格门槛与项目官员选择税收抵免接受者的一定自由裁量权相结合。该项目的结构和实施便于进行严格评估。我们利用CCTC接受和拒绝申请者的详细数据，包括申请者在项目目标方面的评分信息以及资金决策信息，并结合限制访问的美国社区调查（ACS）关于当地经济状况的数据。采用双重差分方法，我们发现人口普查区中每个CCTC激励的就业岗位使该区域工作人数增加接近3——这是一个显著的本地乘数效应。非制造业奖励的本地乘数大于制造业奖励。CCTC奖励增加了各社会经济群体工人以及优势与劣势社区的就业，但对受影响社区的居民影响有限。我们使用替代数据集和最近开发的双重差分方法验证了我们的实证策略并确认了核心结果，这些方法纠正了处理时间变化和处理效应异质性可能产生的偏差。

records.title_en: Climate adaptation policies and infant health: Evidence from a water policy in Brazil
records.title_cn: 气候适应政策与婴儿健康：来自巴西一项水政策的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how in utero exposure to a large-scale climate adaptation program affects birth outcomes. The program built around one million cisterns in Brazil’s poorest and driest region to promote small-scale decentralized rainfall harvesting. Access to cisterns during early pregnancy increased birth weight, particularly for more educated mothers. Data suggest that more educated women complied more with the program’s water disinfection training, highlighting that even simple, low-cost technologies require final users’ compliance (“the last mile”) to be effective. In the context of growing water scarcity, adaptation policies can foster neonatal health and thus have positive long-run implications.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在子宫内暴露于大规模气候适应项目对出生结局的影响。该项目在巴西最贫困和最干旱的地区建造了约一百万个蓄水池，以推广小规模分散式雨水收集。怀孕早期获得蓄水池增加了出生体重，尤其是对受教育程度更高的母亲而言。数据表明，受教育程度更高的女性更遵守该项目的饮水消毒培训，这凸显了即使是简单、低成本的技术也需要最终用户的配合（“最后一公里”）才能发挥作用。在水资源日益稀缺的背景下，适应政策可以促进新生儿健康，从而产生积极的长期影响。

records.title_en: Anti-corruption campaign, political connections, and court bias: Evidence from Chinese corporate lawsuits
records.title_cn: 反腐败运动、政治关联与法院偏见：来自中国企业诉讼的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper establishes the presence of political corruption in court and identifies a novel channel—interfering with court decisions—through which local corrupt politicians provide political favors for politically connected firms. Using a unique data set of 11,238 commercial lawsuits involving Chinese listed firms, we examine how China's recent anti-corruption campaign, one of whose goals is to combat political interference in the courts, affects court advantages of politically connected firms. We find that connected firms' win rates dropped by 6.3% after the anti-corruption, suggesting that the campaign stopped corrupt politicians transferring 1.8% of total monetary amounts of commercial disputes from unconnected to politically connected parties by influencing trials. The effect is more salient for firms connected to more powerful officials, noncontract-based cases, lower-level courts, regions with weak legal environments, and courts that depend more on local government. Moreover, anti-corruption promotes a better judicial environment, not only improves the quality of judicial decisions, but also boosts public confidence in the judicial system, and encourages firms to settle conflicts through court. Finally, we explore the campaign's broader economic influences and find that after the campaign, cities with initially poorly functioning judiciaries gained more investment, employed more labor, produced more output, and attracted more new firms, particularly in those industries with high contract intensity. Overall, the anti-corruption campaign significantly improved the judicial and economic environment in China.
records.abstract_cn: 本文证实了法院中存在政治腐败，并识别出一条新的渠道——干预法院判决——地方腐败官员通过该渠道为政治关联企业提供政治庇护。利用包含中国上市公司涉及的11,238起商业诉讼的独特数据集，我们考察了中国近期反腐败运动（其目标之一是打击对法院的政治干预）如何影响政治关联企业的法院优势。我们发现，反腐败运动后，关联企业的胜诉率下降了6.3%，这表明该运动阻止了腐败官员通过影响审判将商业纠纷总金额的1.8%从非关联方转移给政治关联方。这一效应在与更有权势的官员有关联的企业、非合同案件、下级法院、法律环境薄弱地区以及更依赖地方政府的法院中更为显著。此外，反腐败运动促进了更好的司法环境，不仅提高了司法判决的质量，还增强了公众对司法系统的信心，并鼓励企业通过法院解决纠纷。最后，我们探讨了该运动更广泛的经济影响，发现运动后，最初司法功能不佳的城市获得了更多投资、雇佣了更多劳动力、产出了更多产品，并吸引了更多新企业，尤其是在合同密集度高的行业中。总体而言，反腐败运动显著改善了中国司法和经济环境。

records.title_en: Overclaimed refunds, undeclared sales, and invoice mills: Nature and extent of noncompliance in a value-added tax
records.title_cn: 过度申报退税、未申报销售与发票工厂：增值税不遵从的性质与程度
records.abstract_en: Value-added tax has seen phenomenal expansion in recent decades. Its appeal in part lies in its robustness to tax evasion relative to other tax instruments. Exploiting a tax reform from Pakistan that cuts the tax rate on five major industries of the country substantially, I estimate the size and nature of VAT evasion in the treated industries, finding that it ranges from 31–46% of the potential revenue. One important channel through which the evasion occurs is the overclaim of refunds, which constitute 11–23% of the potential revenue. Roughly two-fifths of the overclaimed refund is based on spurious invoices issued by invoice mills. Qualitatively, noncompliance is stronger in the latter stages of the supply chain, but it runs deep inside the chain, suggesting that on their own the self-enforcement mechanisms built into a VAT do not deter tax evasion fully.
records.abstract_cn: 增值税在近几十年经历了显著扩张。其吸引力部分在于相对于其他税收工具，它对逃税的稳健性。利用巴基斯坦的一项税制改革，该改革大幅降低了该国五个主要行业的税率，我估计了受处理行业中增值税逃税的规模与性质，发现其占潜在收入的31-46%。逃税发生的一个重要渠道是过度申报退税，这占潜在收入的11-23%。大约五分之二的过度申报退税基于发票工厂开具的虚假发票。从性质上看，不遵从在供应链的后端更为严重，但深入供应链内部，这表明增值税内置的自我执行机制本身并不能完全阻止逃税。

records.title_en: Violence-induced migration and peer effects in academic performance
records.title_cn: 暴力引发的迁移与学业表现的同伴效应
records.abstract_en: We document that local violence generates spillover effects beyond areas where violence takes place, via out-migration from violence-affected areas and peer exposure to violence. In the context of the Mexican war on drugs, we use violence-induced student migration as an exogenous source of variation in peer exposure to violence to estimate its effects on the academic performance of non-moving students in areas not directly affected by violence. Our results show that municipalities that face more violence experience higher rates of student out-migration. In receiving schools in areas not directly affected by violence, adding a new peer who was exposed to local violence to a class of 20 students decreases incumbents’ academic performance by 2 percent of a standard deviation. Negative effects are more pronounced among girls and high-achieving students.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了地方暴力通过暴力影响地区的向外迁移和同伴暴露于暴力，对暴力发生地区以外产生溢出效应。在墨西哥毒品战争的背景下，我们利用暴力引发的学生迁移作为同伴暴露于暴力的外生变异来源，估计其对未直接受暴力影响地区未迁移学生学业表现的影响。我们的结果显示，面临更多暴力的城市学生向外迁移率更高。在未直接受暴力影响地区的接收学校中，在一个由20名学生组成的班级中加入一名曾暴露于地方暴力的新同伴，会使原有学生的学业表现下降标准差的一个2%。负面影响在女生和高成就学生中更为显著。

records.title_en: Children’s patience and school-track choices several years later: Linking experimental and field data
records.title_cn: 儿童的耐心与数年后的学校轨道选择：将实验数据与实地数据联系起来
records.abstract_en: We present direct evidence on the link between children’s patience and educational-track choices years later. Combining an incentivized patience measure of 493 primary-school children with their high-school track choices taken at least three years later at the end of middle school, we find that patience significantly predicts choosing an academic track. This relationship remains robust after controlling for a rich set of covariates, such as family background, school-class fixed effects, risk preferences, and cognitive abilities, and is not driven by sample attrition. Accounting for middle-school GPA as a potential mediating factor suggests a direct link between patience and educational-track choice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于儿童耐心与数年后教育轨道选择之间联系的直接证据。将493名小学生的激励性耐心测量与他们至少三年后初中结束时的高中轨道选择相结合，我们发现耐心显著预测了选择学术轨道的可能性。在控制了丰富的协变量集（如家庭背景、班级固定效应、风险偏好和认知能力）后，这一关系仍然稳健，且并非由样本流失驱动。将初中平均绩点作为潜在中介因素考虑，表明耐心与教育轨道选择之间存在直接联系。

records.title_en: Identity breeds inequality: Evidence from a laboratory experiment on redistribution
records.title_cn: 身份滋生不平等：来自再分配实验室实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Politics is increasingly driven by identity cleavages, which also affect the discussion about inequality and redistribution. Typically, redistribution is meant to reduce inequality, implying that redistribution neither makes the rich richer nor the former poor the new rich. However, if identity affects redistribution, these limits might no longer be binding, and redistribution could further increase existing inequalities (making the rich richer) or reverse the income ordering to favor the once-poor (which can even be inequality increasing if redistribution is strong). In a laboratory experiment, we investigate redistribution via a novel smooth one-dimensional distribution mechanism that also allows for an increase or reversal of inequality. Decision-makers receive information about the recipients' political orientation, nationality, or seat number during the experiment, and we vary the structure and source of income inequality (income is either earned, random, or unfair). We find most choices of the decision-makers involve redistribution, with only 8 % of choices sticking with the status quo. While most redistribution choices reduce inequality, a larger share—(18 %)—increase inequality by making the rich richer, 13 % of choices reduce overall inequality but make the poor the new rich, and 9 % increase inequality by making the poor very rich. Thus, 40 % of decisions are redistributions that are typically unobserved in common redistribution designs. Ingroup favoritism is a strong motive for redistribution in general, and it is the most important motive for redistribution to increase or reverse inequality. Indeed, 85 % of the inequality-increasing or reversing decisions favor the ingroup. Complementary eye-tracking data show that decision-makers’ attention to information about the recipients’ groups and to poor outliers are related to higher levels of redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 政治日益受到身份分裂的驱动，这也影响了关于不平等和再分配的讨论。通常，再分配旨在减少不平等，意味着再分配既不会使富人更富，也不会使曾经的穷人成为新的富人。然而，如果身份影响再分配，这些限制可能不再具有约束力，再分配可能进一步加剧现有的不平等（使富人更富）或逆转收入排序以偏袒曾经的穷人（如果再分配力度大，甚至可能增加不平等）。在实验室实验中，我们通过一种新颖的光滑一维分配机制研究再分配，该机制也允许不平等的增加或逆转。决策者在实验期间接收关于接受者政治倾向、国籍或座位号的信息，并且我们改变收入不平等的结构和来源（收入要么是挣得的、随机的，要么是不公平的）。我们发现决策者的大多数选择涉及再分配，只有8%的选择维持现状。虽然大多数再分配选择减少了不平等，但更大比例——（18%）——通过使富人更富来增加不平等，13%的选择减少了总体不平等但使穷人成为新的富人，9%的选择通过使穷人非常富有来增加不平等。因此，40%的决策是常见再分配设计中通常观察不到的再分配。内群体偏袒是再分配的一个强烈动机，并且是增加或逆转不平等的再分配的最重要动机。事实上，85%的增加或逆转不平等的决策偏袒内群体。补充的眼动追踪数据显示，决策者对接受者群体信息和贫困异常值的关注与更高水平的再分配相关。

records.title_en: The returns to an additional year of education for college graduates
records.title_cn: 大学毕业生额外一年教育的回报
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the returns to an additional year of advanced undergraduate education among students who would otherwise graduate with a bachelor’s degree using administrative student records merged with survey data on earnings from the largest public university in Singapore. We use a regression discontinuity design that exploits the fact that in some faculties, enrollment in the fourth (honors) year is governed by a grade-based eligibility rule. Students with average grades in their third year just above the threshold are significantly more likely to complete the fourth year and have higher earnings after graduation relative to students who narrowly missed the grade cutoff. The implied earnings return to the additional year of college is about 12 % six months after graduation. Linked administrative tax data confirm persistent gains in the longer run for at least 4 years after graduation. Moreover, the return remains substantial even after the university lowers the threshold to encourage more students to enroll in the fourth year, suggesting an effect not entirely driven by signaling of student ability.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用新加坡最大公立大学的行政学生记录与收入调查数据相结合，估计了那些原本将获得学士学位的学生额外接受一年高级本科教育的回报。我们采用断点回归设计，利用在某些学院，第四年（荣誉）入学受基于成绩的资格规则约束这一事实。第三年平均成绩刚好超过门槛的学生，完成第四年的可能性显著更高，并且毕业后收入高于那些勉强未达到成绩截止线的学生。额外一年大学教育所隐含的收入回报在毕业后六个月约为12%。关联的行政税务数据证实，毕业后至少4年内，长期收益持续存在。此外，即使大学降低门槛以鼓励更多学生进入第四年，回报仍然可观，这表明效应并非完全由学生能力的信号传递所驱动。

records.title_en: When (and why) providers do not respond to changes in reimbursement rates
records.title_cn: 当（以及为什么）提供者不响应报销率的变化
records.abstract_en: Policies to reduce health care payments can lead to health care access issues if providers reduce their supply in response to reimbursement rate reductions. We examine the impact of a policy that reduced reimbursement rates by 30% in a workers’ compensation insurance system that provided generous reimbursement rates relative to other payers even after the rate reduction. The results suggest that providers’ supply is inelastic at the part of the reimbursement distribution that we study. Our estimates indicate that the policy reduced annual workers’ compensation medical costs by over $400 million without affecting injured workers’ health care utilization or health.
records.abstract_cn: 降低医疗支付的政策可能导致医疗可及性问题，如果提供者因报销率降低而减少其供给。我们考察了一项政策的影响，该政策在一个相对于其他支付方即使降低后仍提供慷慨报销率的工人赔偿保险系统中，将报销率降低了30%。结果表明，在我们研究的报销分布部分，提供者的供给是无弹性的。我们的估计表明，该政策将年度工人赔偿医疗费用减少了超过$400百万美元，而没有影响受伤工人的医疗利用或健康。

records.title_en: “Model minorities” in the classroom? Positive evaluation bias towards Asian students and its consequences
records.title_cn: 课堂中的“模范少数族裔”？对亚裔学生的正向评价偏差及其后果
records.abstract_en: The fast-growing demographic group of Asian Americans is often perceived as a “model minority.” This paper establishes empirical evidence of this stereotype in the context of education and then analyzes its consequences. We show that teachers rate Asian students’ academic skills more favorably than observationally similar White students in the same class, even after accounting for test performance and behavior. This contrasts with teachers’ lower likelihood of favoring Black and Hispanic students. Notably, teachers respond to the presence of any Asian student in the classroom by widening Black-White and Hispanic-White assessment gaps. This suggests that the “model minority” stereotype can negatively impact other minority groups despite its ostensibly positive connotation.
records.abstract_cn: 亚裔美国人这一快速增长的人口群体常被视为“模范少数族裔”。本文在教育背景下建立了这一刻板印象的经验证据，并分析了其后果。我们表明，教师对亚裔学生学术技能的评价优于同班级中可观测特征相似的白人学生，即使在考虑了考试成绩和行为之后也是如此。这与教师对黑人和西班牙裔学生较低的可能性形成对比。值得注意的是，教师对课堂中任何亚裔学生的存在反应是扩大黑人与白人、西班牙裔与白人之间的评估差距。这表明，“模范少数族裔”的刻板印象尽管表面上具有积极含义，却可能对其他少数群体产生负面影响。

records.title_en: Smoking gun? Linking gun ownership to crime victimization
records.title_cn: 确凿证据？将枪支拥有与犯罪受害联系起来
records.abstract_en: Using linked individual data on concealed handgun permits (CHP), reported crimes and arrests, I examine the dynamics of gun-ownership and criminal victimization. I initially show that being male, Republican, older, born in-state and a recent crime victim increases the probability that an adult obtains a CHP. Having a CHP increases property crime victimization by 46% with the largest impact on having a firearm stolen. Individual CHP holders see no change in violent crime victimization thus dispelling any benefits in terms of protection. Obtaining a CHP has a small (2%) increase in total crime and a larger increase on violent crime using a gun (8%) within the CHP holders neighborhood. Results suggest stolen guns spillover to neighborhood crime which is an important component of the larger social costs of gun ownership.
records.abstract_cn: 利用关于隐蔽手枪许可证（CHP）、报告犯罪和逮捕的关联个体数据，我考察了枪支拥有与犯罪受害的动态关系。我首先表明，男性、共和党人、年长者、本州出生者以及近期犯罪受害者会增加成年人获得CHP的概率。持有CHP会使财产犯罪受害率增加46%，其中对枪支被盗的影响最大。个体CHP持有者的暴力犯罪受害情况没有变化，从而消除了任何保护方面的益处。获得CHP会使CHP持有者所在社区的总犯罪率小幅增加2%，并使使用枪支的暴力犯罪增加8%。结果表明，被盗枪支会溢出到社区犯罪中，这是枪支拥有更大社会成本的重要组成部分。

records.title_en: Measuring corruption in the field using behavioral games
records.title_cn: 使用行为博弈在实地测量腐败
records.abstract_en: Corruption is often harmful for economic development, yet it is difficult to measure due to its illicit nature. We propose a novel corruption game to characterize the interaction between actual political leaders and citizens, and implement it in Northern Mozambique. Contrary to the game-theoretic prediction, both leaders and citizens engage in corruption. Importantly, corruption in the game is correlated with real-world corruption by leaders: citizens send bribes to leaders whom we observe appropriating community money. In corrupt behavior, we identify an important trust dimension captured by a standard trust game.
records.abstract_cn: 腐败常常对经济发展有害，但由于其非法性质，难以测量。我们提出了一种新颖的腐败博弈来刻画实际政治领导人与公民之间的互动，并在莫桑比克北部实施。与博弈论预测相反，领导人和公民都参与了腐败。重要的是，博弈中的腐败与领导人在现实世界中的腐败相关：公民向那些我们观察到挪用社区资金的领导人行贿。在腐败行为中，我们识别出一个由标准信任博弈捕捉的重要信任维度。

records.title_en: Majority choice of taxation and redistribution in a federation
records.title_cn: 联邦中税收与再分配的多数选择
records.abstract_en: To study redistribution and taxation in a federation, we provide a model with a central government and multiple local governments, the former with power to levy an income tax for redistribution, and the latter choosing a local income tax, property tax, lump-sum tax or subsidy, and a local public good. Policy is set by majority choice at each tier of government by households that differ by income and by ability to move among local jurisdictions. We provide sufficient conditions for existence of equilibrium and examine its properties. Central findings are federal income distribution, little local redistribution, and local preference for property taxation over income taxation to fund local public goods.
records.abstract_cn: 为了研究联邦中的再分配与税收，我们构建了一个包含中央政府与多个地方政府的模型，前者有权征收所得税用于再分配，后者则选择地方所得税、财产税、一次性总付税或补贴，以及地方公共品。政策由各级政府中按收入和在不同地方辖区间迁移能力差异的家庭通过多数选择决定。我们给出了均衡存在的充分条件并考察其性质。核心发现是联邦层面的收入分配、地方再分配有限，以及地方倾向于用财产税而非所得税来为地方公共品融资。

records.title_en: Intergenerational spillover effects of language training for refugees
records.title_cn: 难民语言培训的代际溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Children of refugees are among the most economically disadvantaged youth in several European countries. They are more likely to drop out of school and to commit crime. We find that a reform in Denmark in 1999 that expanded language training for adult refugees and was shown to improve their earnings and job market outcomes permanently, also increased lower secondary school completion rates and decreased juvenile crime rates for their children. The crime effect is entirely due to boys who were below school age when their parents received language training. The older cohorts who were in elementary school when their parents received language training performed better in lower secondary school. Boys were more likely to finish lower secondary school and to sit the final exams, and girls achieved higher grade point averages in the exams.
records.abstract_cn: 在一些欧洲国家，难民子女是经济上最弱势的年轻人群体之一。他们更有可能辍学和犯罪。我们发现，丹麦在1999年进行的一项改革扩大了成年难民的语言培训，并已被证明能永久提高他们的收入和就业市场表现，同时也提高了其子女的初中毕业率并降低了青少年犯罪率。犯罪效应完全归因于在父母接受语言培训时尚未达到学龄的男孩。在父母接受语言培训时正在上小学的年长队列在初中表现更好。男孩更有可能完成初中学业并参加期末考试，而女孩在考试中取得了更高的平均绩点。

records.title_en: Does information affect homophily?
records.title_cn: 信息是否影响同质性？
records.abstract_en: It is common for mentorship programs to use race, gender, and nationality to match mentors and mentees. Despite the popularity of these programs, there is little evidence on whether mentees value mentors with shared traits. Using novel administrative data from an online college mentoring platform connecting students and alumni, we document that female students indeed disproportionately reach out to female mentors. We investigate whether female students make costly trade-offs in order to access a female mentor. By eliciting students’ preferences over mentor attributes, we find that female students are willing to trade off occupational match in order to access a female mentor. This willingness to pay for female mentors declines to zero when information on mentor quality is provided. The evidence suggests that female students use mentor gender to alleviate information problems, but do not derive direct utility from it. We discuss the implications of these results for the design of initiatives that match on shared traits.
records.abstract_cn: 导师计划通常使用种族、性别和国籍来匹配导师和学员。尽管这些项目很受欢迎，但关于学员是否重视具有共同特征的导师的证据很少。利用来自一个连接学生和校友的在线大学辅导平台的新颖行政数据，我们记录了女学生确实不成比例地联系女性导师。我们调查女学生是否为了接触女性导师而做出代价高昂的权衡。通过引出学生对导师属性的偏好，我们发现女学生愿意为了接触女性导师而牺牲职业匹配。当提供导师质量信息时，这种为女性导师支付的意愿降至零。证据表明，女学生利用导师性别来缓解信息问题，但并未从中获得直接效用。我们讨论了这些结果对基于共同特征匹配的倡议设计的影响。

records.title_en: Do elections affect immigration? Evidence from French municipalities
records.title_cn: 选举是否影响移民？来自法国市镇的证据
records.abstract_en: Using thirty years of municipal elections in France, we show that election results affect the share of immigrants across municipalities. In municipalities where a left- instead of right-wing mayor has been elected, the share of immigrants in the population grows faster by 1.5 p.p. within six years after the elections, and by 3 p.p. within twelve years. To a large extent, these effects are driven by partisan differences in public housing constructions and changes in the composition of the population within existing public housing units. They also are associated with greater incumbency advantage, in line with a model of strategic partisan behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 利用法国三十年的市政选举数据，我们表明选举结果影响各市镇移民的比例。在选举出左翼而非右翼市长的市镇中，选举后六年内移民人口比例增长更快，高出1.5个百分点，十二年内高出3个百分点。在很大程度上，这些效应是由公共住房建设中的党派差异以及现有公共住房单元内人口构成的变化所驱动的。它们还与更大的在位优势相关，这与战略性党派行为模型一致。

records.title_en: Primary care providers’ influence on opioid use and its adverse consequences
records.title_cn: 初级保健提供者对阿片类药物使用及其不良后果的影响
records.abstract_en: Primary care is the most frequently utilized health service and is the source of nearly half of all opioids prescribed in the United States. This paper studies the impact of exposure to high prescribing primary care providers (PCP) on opioid use, opioid use disorder, and mental health. Using electronic health records, we exploit within-facility quasi-random assignment of providers, who differ in their opioid prescribing tendency, to 650,000 new patients enrolling in care with the Veterans Health Administration. We find that assignment to a PCP who prescribes opioids at a 2.54 percentage point (pp) higher rate (equivalent to the average difference between a 90th and 10th percentile prescriber within a facility) increases the probability of long-term opioid use by 20% (or 0.43 pp) and development of opioid use disorder by 4% (or 0.035 pp). Veterans’ mental health deteriorates: the three-year likelihood of a depression diagnosis increases by 1.3% (or 0.31 pp). We find that PCPs with more cautious prescribing behavior rely more on non-opioid pain management and adhere more to clinical recommendations on naloxone distribution.
records.abstract_cn: 初级保健是最常使用的卫生服务，并且是美国所有阿片类药物处方中近一半的来源。本文研究了接触高处方量的初级保健提供者（PCP）对阿片类药物使用、阿片类药物使用障碍和心理健康的影响。利用电子健康记录，我们利用了设施内提供者的准随机分配，这些提供者在阿片类药物处方倾向上存在差异，涉及650,000名加入退伍军人健康管理局护理的新患者。我们发现，被分配到阿片类药物处方率高出2.54个百分点（pp）的PCP（相当于设施内第90和第10百分位处方者之间的平均差异）会使长期阿片类药物使用的概率增加20%（或0.43 pp），并使阿片类药物使用障碍的发生率增加4%（或0.035 pp）。退伍军人的心理健康状况恶化：三年内抑郁症诊断的可能性增加1.3%（或0.31 pp）。我们发现，处方行为更为谨慎的PCP更依赖于非阿片类疼痛管理，并更遵守关于纳洛酮分配的临床建议。

records.title_en: Can beneficiary information improve hospital accountability? Experimental evidence from a public health insurance scheme in India
records.title_cn: 受益人信息能否提高医院问责制？来自印度公共卫生保险计划的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We study the role of hospital compliance in the effectiveness of government health insurance in India. Using patient surveys, we document that participating hospitals charge unauthorized fees to poor patients eligible to receive free care. Average out-of-pocket payments (OOPP) for chronic kidney care patients are $43 per month, or 25% annual GDP per capita, and are high at both public and private hospitals. Awareness of program benefits is low despite patients having used insurance for several months. We conduct a randomized experiment to test whether phone-based information about program benefits can enable insurance beneficiaries to hold hospitals accountable and lower OOPP. The intervention effectively increases program awareness by 0.17 standard deviations but has no effect on OOPP overall. However, effects differ dramatically by hospital sector: patients at private hospital see no change in OOPP despite increased bargaining and search; monthly OOPP among patients visiting public hospitals, who are poorer and lower caste, drop by $12 (35%), because they are able to negotiate to get more of their benefits at the hospital instead of paying for them off-site. The findings suggest that patient-driven accountability can meaningfully improve public service delivery, even in the context of specialized tertiary care, but may not substitute for top-down monitoring of private agents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了医院合规性在印度政府医疗保险有效性中的作用。通过患者调查，我们记录了参与医院向符合免费护理条件的贫困患者收取未经授权的费用。慢性肾脏护理患者的平均自付费用（OOPP）为每月$43，占人均年GDP的25%，在公立和私立医院均较高。尽管患者已使用保险数月，但对计划福利的认知度仍然较低。我们进行了一项随机实验，以测试基于电话的福利信息是否能使保险受益人能够追究医院责任并降低OOPP。干预有效提高了计划认知度0.17个标准差，但对总体OOPP没有影响。然而，效果因医院部门而异：私立医院患者的OOPP没有变化，尽管议价和搜索增加；就诊于公立医院（更贫困和低种姓）的患者每月OOPP下降$12（35%），因为他们能够在医院协商获得更多福利，而不是在院外支付。研究结果表明，患者驱动的问责制可以显著改善公共服务提供，即使在专科三级护理背景下，但可能无法替代对私营机构的自上而下的监督。

records.title_en: Cigarette taxes, smoking, and health in the long run
records.title_cn: 长期视角下的香烟税、吸烟与健康
records.abstract_en: Medical experts have argued forcefully that using cigarettes harms health, prompting the adoption of myriad anti-smoking policies. The association between smoking and mortality may, however, be influenced by unobserved factors, making it difficult to discern the underlying long-term causal relationship. In this study, we explore the effects of cigarette taxes experienced as a teenager, which are arguably exogenous, on adult smoking participation and mortality. A one-dollar increase in cigarette taxes experienced at ages 14–17 is associated with an 8 percent reduction in adult smoking participation and a 4 percent reduction in mortality. Mortality effects are most pronounced for heart disease and lung cancer.
records.abstract_cn: 医学专家强烈主张吸烟有害健康，促使众多反吸烟政策的采纳。然而，吸烟与死亡率之间的关联可能受到未观测因素的影响，使得辨别潜在的长期因果关系变得困难。在本研究中，我们探讨了青少年时期所经历的香烟税（可视为外生变量）对成年吸烟参与率和死亡率的影响。在14-17岁期间经历的每增加一美元香烟税，与成年吸烟参与率降低8%和死亡率降低4%相关。死亡率影响在心脏病和肺癌方面最为显著。

records.title_en: Lost boys? Secondary education and crime
records.title_cn: 迷失的男孩？中等教育与犯罪
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of secondary education on criminal behavior of young men in Finland. We exploit admission cut-offs in over-subscribed programs and estimate the effect of gaining access to a) any secondary school vs no access, b) general vs vocational school, and c) selective vs less selective general school. Our results show that admission to any secondary school has a sizeable negative effect on the propensity to commit crime. There are no effects at the other two margins. The negative effects at the extensive margin are largest in the years following school admission and result in a reduction of the probability of ever committing crime rather than simply delaying the onset of crime. Our results suggest that keeping youth at school at a critical age has effects that last beyond years where effects on enrollment are observed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中等教育对芬兰年轻男性犯罪行为的影响。我们利用超额报名项目中的录取分数线，估计了获得以下机会的效果：a) 进入任何中等学校与无法进入，b) 普通学校与职业学校，以及 c) 选择性普通学校与选择性较低的普通学校。我们的结果表明，进入任何中等学校对犯罪倾向有显著的负向影响。在其他两个边际上没有影响。广泛边际上的负向影响在入学后的几年中最大，并导致犯罪概率的降低，而不仅仅是延迟犯罪的发生。我们的结果表明，在关键年龄让青少年留在学校，其影响持续到观察到入学效应之后的年份。

records.title_en: Offshore tax evasion and wealth inequality: Evidence from a tax amnesty in the Netherlands
records.title_cn: 离岸逃税与财富不平等：来自荷兰税收特赦的证据
records.abstract_en: Exploiting unique datasets covering over 29,000 tax evaders in the Netherlands, we investigate the distribution of tax evasion and its implications for the measurement of wealth inequality. Tax evasion is concentrated at the top of the wealth distribution with over 10% of the wealthiest 0.01% of households – the “super rich” – evading taxes. At the top, households evade around 8% of their true tax liability. The “merely rich” (P90-P99.9) own 67% of hidden wealth, while the “super rich” account for only 7%. Consequently, the correction for offshore wealth has a modest effect on top wealth shares. We describe a number of explanations for the distribution of tax evasion by Dutch households: low-cost tax evasion opportunities in neighbouring countries for the “merely rich”, sophisticated forms of tax evasion for, low effective tax rates on and migration to low tax jurisdictions by the “super rich”. Taken together, these explanations suggest that the distribution of tax evasion strongly depends on a country’s geographical and institutional settings.
records.abstract_cn: 利用覆盖荷兰超过29,000名逃税者的独特数据集，我们研究了逃税的分布及其对财富不平等测量的影响。逃税集中在财富分布的顶端，超过10%的最富有的0.01%家庭——即“超级富豪”——在逃税。在顶端，家庭逃避了其真实税负的约8%。“仅富有”群体（P90-P99.9）拥有67%的隐藏财富，而“超级富豪”仅占7%。因此，对离岸财富的修正对顶端财富份额的影响不大。我们描述了荷兰家庭逃税分布的若干解释：邻近国家为“仅富有”群体提供的低成本逃税机会，“超级富豪”采用的复杂逃税形式、较低的有效税率以及向低税收管辖区的迁移。综合来看，这些解释表明逃税的分布强烈依赖于一个国家的地理和制度环境。

records.title_en: The political consequences of resource scarcity: Targeted spending in a water-stressed democracy
records.title_cn: 资源稀缺的政治后果：水资源紧张民主国家中的定向支出
records.abstract_en: We study whether resource scarcity enhances the scope for targeted spending in India. Farmers without access to groundwater during dry seasons cope using a large public-aid program controlled by local politicians. We leverage a multidimensional regression discontinuity for exogenous variation in whether local politicians are aligned with the state’s ruling party. We find that the state government channels disproportionate funds to politically-aligned jurisdictions in water-stressed areas and gains votes in subsequent elections. However, we find no partisan differences in aid allocation for non-water-stressed areas, suggesting a selective targeting of public funds to garner votes in the highest-return regions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究资源稀缺是否增强了印度定向支出的空间。在旱季无法获得地下水的农民通过一个由地方政治家控制的大型公共援助项目来应对。我们利用多维回归不连续性来获取地方政治家是否与执政党结盟的外生变化。我们发现，州政府将不成比例的资金引导至水资源紧张地区中政治结盟的辖区，并在随后的选举中获得选票。然而，我们发现在非水资源紧张地区的援助分配中没有党派差异，这表明公共资金的选择性定向是为了在回报最高的地区争取选票。

records.title_en: Window dressing in the public sector: Evidence from China’s compulsory education promotion program
records.title_cn: 公共部门的橱窗装饰：来自中国义务教育促进计划的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyze the window-dressing behavior of China’s local governments throughout the 1990s, when they were required to fulfill compulsory education targets imposed by the central government. County officials faced severe negative career consequences if they failed to fulfill these targets. We found that county-level education expenditures increased progressively as the pre-specified inspection period drew near but decreased dramatically after the inspection. This phenomenon was interpreted as evidence of the window-dressing behavior of county governments. Further analysis suggests that local officials with longer tenure and who were thus closer to promotion evaluations tended to engage in more aggressively window-dressing. Window-dressing behavior generates real consequences for school-age teenagers: those exposed to local governments’ window-dressing behavior recorded considerably lower junior high school graduation rates and poorer labor market outcomes later in life.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了中国地方政府在整个1990年代的橱窗装饰行为，当时他们被要求完成中央政府设定的义务教育目标。县级官员若未能完成这些目标，将面临严重的负面职业后果。我们发现，随着预定的检查期临近，县级教育支出逐渐增加，但在检查后急剧下降。这一现象被解释为县级政府橱窗装饰行为的证据。进一步分析表明，任期较长且因此更接近晋升评估的地方官员倾向于更积极地进行橱窗装饰。橱窗装饰行为对学龄青少年产生了实际后果：那些暴露于地方政府橱窗装饰行为的人，其初中毕业率显著较低，且日后劳动力市场表现较差。

records.title_en: Nonlinear taxation and international mobility in general equilibrium
records.title_cn: 一般均衡中的非线性税收与国际流动性
records.abstract_en: Migration and general equilibrium forces are both known to limit the extent of redistribution due to a migration threat and a trickle-down rationale, respectively. In this paper, we consider these two forces jointly and study the optimal nonlinear taxation of internationally mobile workers in general equilibrium. We show that both forces partly offset each other. In general equilibrium, migration may lower the bottom tax rate but raises the top tax rate, challenging the classical migration-threat argument. Moreover, we demonstrate that migration responses weaken the trickle-down rationale. Both findings can be explained by a novel wage effect on migration and a migration effect on wages, calling for higher top tax rates to amplify pre-tax wage inequality and prevent high-skilled emigration. We calibrate our model to the U.S. economy and illustrate the new effects by comparing the optimal tax schemes with and without migration, as well as with and without endogeneity of wages.
records.abstract_cn: 迁移和一般均衡力量均已知分别通过迁移威胁和涓滴效应限制再分配的程度。在本文中，我们共同考虑这两种力量，并研究一般均衡中国际流动工人的最优非线性税收。我们表明，这两种力量部分相互抵消。在一般均衡中，迁移可能降低底部税率但提高顶部税率，挑战了经典的迁移威胁论点。此外，我们证明迁移反应削弱了涓滴效应。这两个发现都可以通过迁移对工资的新效应和工资对迁移的效应来解释，这要求更高的顶部税率以扩大税前工资不平等并防止高技能移民。我们将模型校准到美国经济，并通过比较有迁移和无迁移、以及工资内生和工资外生的最优税收方案来说明新效应。

records.title_en: Do environmental markets cause environmental injustice? Evidence from California’s carbon market
records.title_cn: 环境市场会导致环境不公正吗？来自加利福尼亚碳市场的证据
records.abstract_en: Market-based environmental policies are widely adopted on the basis of allocative efficiency. However, there is growing concern that market-induced spatial reallocation of pollution could widen existing pollution concentration gaps between disadvantaged and other communities. We examine how this “environmental justice” (EJ) gap changed following the 2013 introduction of California’s carbon market, the world’s second largest and the most subjected to EJ critiques. We estimate that the program lowered GHG, PM2.5, PM10, and NOx emissions by 3–9% annually between 2012–2017 for sample industrial facilities regulated only by the carbon market. Using a pollution dispersal model to characterize resulting spatial changes in pollution concentrations, we find the program caused EJ gaps in PM2.5, PM10, and NOx from these facilities to narrow by 6–10% annually. We demonstrate that explicit modeling of pollution dispersal is critical for detecting these results.
records.abstract_cn: 基于市场的环境政策因配置效率而被广泛采用。然而，人们日益担心市场引起的污染空间重新分配可能扩大弱势社区与其他社区之间现有的污染集中差距。我们研究了在2013年加利福尼亚碳市场（世界第二大且最受环境正义批评的市场）引入后，这种“环境正义”（EJ）差距如何变化。我们估计，在2012-2017年间，该计划使仅受碳市场监管的样本工业设施的温室气体、PM2.5、PM10和氮氧化物排放每年降低3-9%。使用污染扩散模型来表征由此产生的污染浓度空间变化，我们发现该计划使这些设施的PM2.5、PM10和氮氧化物的环境正义差距每年缩小6-10%。我们证明，明确模拟污染扩散对于检测这些结果至关重要。

records.title_en: Competence-loyalty tradeoff under dominant minority rule: The case of Manchu rule, 1650-1911
records.title_cn: 主导少数统治下的能力-忠诚权衡：满族统治案例，1650-1911
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how a million Manchus, as a dominant minority, partly relied on a cross-ethnic personnel strategy to rule over 100 million Han Chinese for 267 years. Under this strategy, Han elites were appointed to handle daily administrative issues, on top of whom Manchu superiors were assigned for oversight. We find that more frequent local extreme weather – a proxy for governance complexity – led to higher likelihood of such cross-ethnic arrangements. This link is stronger in regions where Han elites accumulated more discretionary power. Moreover, the cross-ethnic strategy was associated with better local economic development, more efficient policy execution, and enhanced recognition of imperial authority.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了作为主导少数的百万满族人如何部分依赖跨族群人事策略来统治100亿汉族人长达267年。在这一策略下，汉族精英被任命处理日常行政事务，而满族上级则被指派进行监督。我们发现，更频繁的当地极端天气——作为治理复杂性的代理指标——导致此类跨族群安排的可能性更高。这种联系在汉族精英积累更多自由裁量权的地区更为显著。此外，跨族群策略与更好的地方经济发展、更高效的政策执行以及帝国权威认可度的提升相关联。

records.title_en: Crowding in with impure altruism: Theory and evidence from volunteerism in national parks
records.title_cn: 不纯利他主义下的挤入效应：来自国家公园志愿服务的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: This paper makes three contributions to the literature on private provision of public goods. First, we identify limitations of the frequently used specification test that distinguishes between the standard models of pure and impure altruism based on the extent of crowding out. While the literature takes as given the result that crowding out should be less with impure altruism than with pure altruism, we show that it can be either more or less. Second, we propose a new, more general test based on the presence of crowding in or greater than one-for-one crowding out, both of which are consistent with impure altruism only. Third, we provide empirical evidence. Using a unique panel data set on volunteerism in U.S. National Parks, we estimate the causal effect of changes in a park’s public funding on the amount of within-park volunteerism. The overall finding is that each additional dollar of public expenditure crowds in 27 cents worth of volunteerism on average. We show how the estimates of crowding in, along with heterogeneity based on park and volunteer hour types, are theoretically consistent with the mainstay model of impure altruism.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对公共物品私人供给的文献做出了三点贡献。首先，我们识别了常用于区分纯利他主义与不纯利他主义标准模型的规范检验的局限性，该检验基于挤出效应的程度。虽然文献普遍认为不纯利他主义下的挤出效应应小于纯利他主义，但我们证明其可能更大或更小。其次，我们提出了一种新的、更一般的检验，基于挤入效应或大于一对一的挤出效应，这两种情况均仅与不纯利他主义一致。第三，我们提供了经验证据。利用美国国家公园志愿服务的独特面板数据集，我们估计了公园公共资金变化对园内志愿服务量的因果效应。总体发现是，每增加一美元公共支出，平均挤入27美分的志愿服务。我们展示了挤入效应的估计值，以及基于公园和志愿服务小时类型的异质性，如何在理论上与不纯利他主义的主流模型一致。

records.title_en: Provider turf wars and Medicare payment rules
records.title_cn: 提供者地盘之争与医疗保险支付规则
records.abstract_en: Barriers to entry and scope of work restrictions are common features of US labor markets, especially within healthcare industries. However, concerns over access and costs of care have encouraged some deregulation. We empirically explore relaxed occupational rules of anesthesia care whereby physician-trained anesthesiologists and certified registered nurse anesthetists (CRNAs) perform overlapping services but often engage in joint production. After CRNAs were granted practice independence, we find only modest (3%) reductions in anesthesiologist billing for CRNA supervision and no evidence of greater use of CRNAs. Our results caution policymakers against overestimating the downstream impact resulting from removing these provider regulations.
records.abstract_cn: 进入壁垒和工作范围限制是美国劳动力市场的常见特征，尤其是在医疗保健行业。然而，对护理获取和成本的担忧促使了一些放松管制。我们实证探讨了麻醉护理中放宽的职业规则，即由医师培训的麻醉师和认证注册护士麻醉师（CRNAs）执行重叠服务，但往往进行联合生产。在CRNAs获得执业独立性后，我们发现麻醉师对CRNA监督的计费仅适度（3%）减少，且没有证据表明CRNAs的使用增加。我们的结果提醒政策制定者不要高估取消这些提供者法规所带来的下游影响。

records.title_en: Judicial subversion: The effects of political power on court outcomes
records.title_cn: 司法颠覆：政治权力对法院判决结果的影响
records.abstract_en: Are politicians in power treated more leniently in court? We show that Brazilian mayoral candidates charged with misconduct are 65 percent less likely to be convicted if they narrowly win the election. Politicians play no direct role in the judges’ careers, suggesting that formal independence does not completely insulate the judiciary from political influence. The effect is driven by districts with few judges and by judges with higher career instability.
records.abstract_cn: 掌权的政治家在法庭上是否受到更宽大的对待？我们表明，被指控行为不当的巴西市长候选人，如果以微弱优势赢得选举，被定罪的可能性要低65%。政治家在法官的职业生涯中不直接发挥作用，这表明形式上的独立并不能完全使司法机构免受政治影响。这种效应在法官数量少的地区和职业稳定性较低的法官中更为明显。

records.title_en: Does candidates’ media exposure affect vote shares? Evidence from Pope breaking news
records.title_cn: 候选人的媒体曝光是否影响选票份额？来自教皇突发新闻的证据
records.abstract_en: I study the impact of politicians’ media exposure in campaign on their vote share, exploiting an exogenous change in coverage during the Italian 2013 electoral race. Right before the election, the Pope Benedict XVI suddenly resigned and broadcast coverage of politics markedly dropped. Only five days of lower visibility of the right-wing leader and TV tycoon Berlusconi (-26 percentage points) caused a 2 percentage points dip in his vote share, and lead to his defeat by 0.4 percentage points. Following the TV coverage disruption, a part of Berlusconi’s electorate resorted to Internet for political news, and later favored a new party with Internet-centred propaganda.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了竞选期间政治家的媒体曝光对其选票份额的影响，利用了意大利2013年选举期间媒体报道的外生变化。就在选举前，教皇本笃十六世突然辞职，广播对政治的报道显著减少。仅五天右翼领导人和电视大亨贝卢斯科尼的较低曝光度（-26个百分点）就导致其选票份额下降2个百分点，并导致他以0.4个百分点的差距落败。在电视报道中断后，贝卢斯科尼的部分选民转而通过互联网获取政治新闻，并后来支持了一个以互联网为中心宣传的新政党。

records.title_en: The persistent impact of electoral incentives on the quality of infrastructure
records.title_cn: 选举激励对基础设施质量的持续影响
records.abstract_en: What determines the quality of a nation’s infrastructure? We show that electoral incentives at the time of construction have persistent effects on the functionality of contemporary African water systems. We apply a common event-study approach to the universe of water points in Nigeria, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania built over the period from 1970–2014. Across all three settings, we find that infrastructure installed in the run-up to an election is significantly more likely to be functioning today than those installed shortly after elections. Our results suggest that politicians respond to electoral incentives by adjusting the provider of installed water systems. Together, the findings suggest that public officials optimally respond to responsive but myopic citizen evaluations of public performance.
records.abstract_cn: 什么决定了一个国家基础设施的质量？我们表明，建设时期的选举激励对当代非洲供水系统的功能性具有持续影响。我们将一种常见的事件研究方法应用于尼日利亚、塞拉利昂和坦桑尼亚在1970年至2014年间建造的所有供水点。在所有三个环境中，我们发现，在选举前夕安装的基础设施今天比选举后不久安装的设施更有可能正常运行。我们的结果表明，政治家通过调整已安装供水系统的提供者来回应选举激励。总之，这些发现表明，公共官员会最优地回应公民对公共绩效的响应性但短视的评价。

records.title_en: Taxation, accountability, and cash transfers: Breaking the resource curse
records.title_cn: 税收、问责与现金转移：打破资源诅咒
records.abstract_en: Why is governance in resource-rich countries so poor? We argue that it is because governments in these countries do not rely on taxation, which is an important instrument for citizens to hold their governments accountable. Using a game-theoretic model, we show that the combination of low taxes and weak governance can be an equilibrium in an economy with sizeable mineral revenues. As income from natural resources ultimately declines, replacing it with tax revenues may require governments to give control of these proceeds to citizens, in the form of cash transfers say, as a credible commitment to accountability, thereby breaking the country out of its resource curse.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么资源丰富国家的治理如此糟糕？我们认为，这是因为这些国家的政府不依赖税收，而税收是公民问责政府的重要工具。通过博弈论模型，我们表明，在拥有可观矿产收入的经济体中，低税收和弱治理的组合可以成为一种均衡。随着自然资源收入最终下降，用税收收入替代它可能需要政府以现金转移等形式将这些收入的控制权交给公民，作为对问责的可信承诺，从而使国家摆脱资源诅咒。

records.title_en: Ordinal rank and the structure of ability peer effects
records.title_cn: 序数排名与能力同伴效应的结构
records.abstract_en: Exposure to high-ability peers entails positive learning externalities, but it also decreases students’ academic self-concept because of lower ordinal ability rank. We show that, as a result, the linear-in-means parameter identifies a composite (i.e., reduced form) effect. We illustrate the empirical relevance of this issue using data from two experiments that randomly assign students to groups. We find that the structural effect of mean peer ability estimated by a model that includes rank is much larger than the reduced form effect obtained when rank is omitted. This finding also holds in non-linear and heterogeneous peer effects models and helps clarify the mechanisms behind the effects of ability tracking policies.
records.abstract_cn: 接触高能力同伴会带来积极的学习外部性，但也会因较低的序数能力排名而降低学生的学业自我概念。我们表明，因此，线性均值参数识别的是一个复合（即简化形式）效应。我们使用两个随机分配学生到小组的实验数据来说明这一问题的实证相关性。我们发现，包含排名的模型所估计的平均同伴能力的结构效应远大于省略排名时获得的简化形式效应。这一发现在非线性和异质性同伴效应模型中也成立，并有助于阐明能力分组政策效应背后的机制。

records.title_en: Progressive consumption taxes
records.title_cn: 累进消费税
records.abstract_en: Whether consumption or labor income is progressively taxed is irrelevant to household choices and welfare in a static setting. Add dynamics to the problem and these two forms of progressivity have markedly different implications for how earnings vary along the life cycle: in a stylized life-cycle model, the progressive income tax reduces Frisch elasticities of labor supply whereas the progressive consumption tax reduces the elasticity of inter-temporal substitution. We explore the consequences of replacing the current U.S. tax system with one in which labor income taxes are linear and consumption taxes are progressive. We find welfare gains that exceed 10% in consumption equivalent variation terms in steady-state comparisons. An indirect consequence of the more variable earnings profile, greater asset accumulation, is found to be a very if not the most important quantitative aspect of progressive consumption taxes. Also important, when compared to labor income taxes, progressive consumption taxes are more positively correlated with inherited wealth. We take this aspect into account by considering a non–homothetic warm-glow motive that approximates the empirical distribution of wealth. We discuss several issues related to implementation and find that approximately half of the welfare gains are attained by using the information gathered by social security to implement income averaging in the sense of Vickrey (1947).
records.abstract_cn: 在静态环境中，消费或劳动收入是否累进征税与家庭选择和福利无关。将动态引入问题后，这两种累进形式对收入在生命周期内的变化方式有着显著不同的影响：在一个典型生命周期模型中，累进所得税降低了劳动供给的弗里希弹性，而累进消费税降低了跨期替代弹性。我们探讨了用线性劳动所得税和累进消费税取代当前美国税收体系的后果。在稳态比较中，我们发现以消费等价变量衡量的福利收益超过10%%。收入曲线更具变动性的间接后果——更大的资产积累——被发现是累进消费税非常甚至最重要的量化方面。同样重要的是，与劳动所得税相比，累进消费税与继承财富的正相关性更强。我们通过考虑一个非齐次暖光动机来考虑这一方面，该动机近似于财富的经验分布。我们讨论了与实施相关的几个问题，并发现大约一半的福利收益是通过利用社会保障收集的信息来实现维克里（1947）意义上的收入平均化而获得的。

records.title_en: Food subsidies in general equilibrium
records.title_cn: 一般均衡中的食品补贴
records.abstract_en: The Atkinson-Stiglitz theorem on uniform consumption taxation breaks down if prices are endogenous. This paper investigates the implications for optimal food subsidies in China. To do so, we build a general equilibrium model where low-skilled workers have a comparative advantage in the production of food. Food subsidies raise the relative demand for low-skilled workers, which reduces the skill premium and indirectly redistributes income from high-skilled to low-skilled workers. The optimal food subsidy balances these distributional gains against the costs of distorting consumption decisions. We calibrate our model to match key moments from the Chinese economy, including sectoral production and spending patterns that we obtain from micro-level survey data. Our results suggest that general equilibrium effects rationalize only very modest food subsidies that generate tiny welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: Atkinson-Stiglitz关于统一消费税的定理在价格内生时不再成立。本文研究了中国最优食品补贴的含义。为此，我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中低技能工人在食品生产方面具有比较优势。食品补贴提高了对低技能工人的相对需求，从而降低了技能溢价，并间接地将收入从高技能工人再分配给低技能工人。最优食品补贴在分配收益与扭曲消费决策的成本之间取得平衡。我们将模型校准以匹配中国经济的关键特征，包括我们从微观调查数据中获得的部门生产和支出模式。我们的结果表明，一般均衡效应只能为非常适度的食品补贴提供合理性，而这些补贴带来的福利收益微乎其微。

records.title_en: Organizational design for making a difference
records.title_cn: 为创造差异而进行的组织设计
records.abstract_en: We address organizations that rely on donors, when those donors are motivated by making a difference. We show that when donors care sufficiently about their marginal impact, firms use practices that would normally be deemed inefficient. These include prioritizing less valuable opportunities over better ones, investing most in their weakest initiatives, and benefiting from not identifying the quality of their projects. These all arise from a distinction between marginal and average returns generated by donor preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究依赖捐赠者的组织，当这些捐赠者受到创造差异的动机驱动时。我们表明，当捐赠者足够关心他们的边际影响时，企业会采用通常被认为低效的做法。这些做法包括优先考虑价值较低的机会而非更好的机会，将最多的投资用于最弱的项目，以及从不识别其项目质量中获益。所有这些都源于捐赠者偏好所产生的边际回报与平均回报之间的区别。

records.title_en: Pretrial juvenile detention
records.title_cn: 审前青少年拘留
records.abstract_en: Roughly one in four juveniles arrested in the U.S. spend time in a detention center prior to their court date. To study the consequences of this practice for youth, we link the universe of individual public school records in Michigan to juvenile and adult criminal justice records. Using a selection-on-observables design, we estimate that juvenile detention leads to a 38% decline in the likelihood of graduating high school and a 27% increase in the likelihood of being arrested as an adult by age 19. Falsification tests suggest the results are not driven by unobserved heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，大约每四名被捕青少年中就有一人在开庭日期前在拘留中心度过一段时间。为了研究这种做法对青少年的后果，我们将密歇根州所有公立学校记录与青少年和成人刑事司法记录相关联。利用基于可观测变量的选择设计，我们估计青少年拘留导致高中毕业可能性下降38%，并在19岁前作为成年人被捕的可能性增加27%。证伪测试表明，结果并非由未观测到的异质性驱动。

records.title_en: Income tax credits for consumer services: A tool for tackling VAT evasion?
records.title_cn: 消费者服务所得税抵免：应对增值税逃税的工具？
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the effects of an income tax credit for hard-to-tax consumer services on evasion of the value-added-tax (VAT). Based on the individual tax files of the universe of VAT payers in Germany, our analysis shows that harnessing incentives for consumers through tax credits fosters firms’ compliance with VAT by bringing in an element of third-party reporting at the last VAT stage. Our results point at strong stimulating effects of the introduction of the tax credit on reported sales as well as on the ratio of reported sales to inputs and we find limited price effects. While two thirds of the revenue losses in the income tax are recovered by an increase in VAT revenues, at least a quarter and up to a half of the revenue gain is associated with a response at the VAT evasion margin. The policy thus fosters considerable formalization effects.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了针对难以征税的消费者服务的所得税抵免对增值税逃税的影响。基于德国所有增值税纳税人的个人税务档案，我们的分析表明，通过税收抵免激励消费者，在增值税最后阶段引入第三方报告元素，有助于促进企业遵守增值税规定。我们的结果指出，引入税收抵免对报告销售额以及报告销售额与投入之比产生了强烈的刺激效应，并且我们发现价格效应有限。虽然所得税收入损失的三分之二通过增值税收入的增加得到弥补，但至少四分之一至一半的收入增长与增值税逃税边际上的反应相关。因此，该政策促进了显著的正式化效应。

records.title_en: The impacts of Covid-19 absences on workers
records.title_cn: Covid-19缺勤对工人的影响
records.abstract_en: We show that Covid-19 illnesses and related work absences persistently reduce labor supply. Using an event study, we estimate that workers with week-long Covid-19 absences are 7 percentage points less likely to be in the labor force one year later compared to otherwise-similar workers who do not miss a week of work for health reasons. Our estimates suggest Covid-19 absences have reduced the U.S.labor force by approximately 500,000 people (0.2 percent of adults) and imply an average labor supply loss per Covid-19 absence equivalent to $9,000 in forgone earnings, about 90 percent of which reflects losses beyond the initial absence week.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现，新冠肺炎19疾病和相关缺勤持续减少劳动力供应。通过一项事件研究，我们估计，与因健康原因没有缺勤一周的其他类似工人相比，因新冠肺炎19缺勤一周的工人一年后加入劳动力队伍的可能性要低7个百分点。我们的估计表明，Covid-19缺勤使美国劳动力减少了约500,000人（成年人的0.2%），并且意味着每次Covid-19缺勤造成的平均劳动力供应损失相当于$9,000美元的收入损失，其中约90%反映了最初缺勤周之后的损失。

records.title_en: Affirmative action and its race-neutral alternatives
records.title_cn: 平权行动及其种族中立替代方案
records.abstract_en: As affirmative action loses political feasibility, many universities have implemented race-neutral alternatives like top percent policies and holistic review to increase enrollment among disadvantaged students. I study these policies’ application, admission, and enrollment effects using University of California administrative data. UC’s affirmative action and top percent policies increased underrepresented minority (URM) enrollment by over 20 percent and less than 4 percent, respectively. Holistic review increases implementing campuses’ URM enrollment by about 7 percent. Top percent policies and holistic review have negligible effects on lower-income enrollment, while race-based affirmative action modestly increased enrollment among very low-income students. These findings highlight that the most common race-neutral alternatives to affirmative action increase Black and Hispanic enrollment far less than affirmative action itself and reveal that none of these policies substantially affect universities’ socioeconomic composition.
records.abstract_cn: 随着平权行动在政治上失去可行性，许多大学实施了种族中立的替代方案，如顶尖百分比政策和整体性审查，以增加弱势学生的入学率。我利用加州大学行政数据研究这些政策的申请、录取和入学效应。加州大学的平权行动和顶尖百分比政策分别使 underrepresented minority (URM) 入学率增加了超过 20% 和不到 4%。整体性审查使实施校园的 URM 入学率增加了约 7%。顶尖百分比政策和整体性审查对低收入家庭学生的入学率影响甚微，而基于种族的平权行动则适度增加了极低收入学生的入学率。这些发现强调，最常见的平权行动种族中立替代方案对黑人和西班牙裔学生入学率的提升远不及平权行动本身，并揭示这些政策均未显著影响大学的社会经济构成。

records.title_en: The salary taboo privacy norms and the diffusion of information
records.title_cn: 薪酬禁忌、隐私规范与信息扩散
records.abstract_en: The diffusion of salary information has implications for labor markets, such as wage discrimination policies and collective bargaining. Access to salary information is believed to be limited and unequal, but there is little direct evidence on the sources of these information frictions. Social scientists have long conjectured that privacy norms around salary (i.e., the “salary taboo”) play an important role. We provide unique evidence of this phenomenon based on a field experiment with 755 employees at a large commercial bank in Southeast Asia. We show that many of its employees are both unwilling to reveal their salaries to coworkers and reluctant to ask coworkers about their salaries. These frictions persist, in smaller magnitude, when sharing less sensitive information on seniority. We discuss implications for pay transparency policies and the gender wage gap.
records.abstract_cn: 薪酬信息的扩散对劳动力市场具有重要影响，例如工资歧视政策和集体谈判。人们认为获取薪酬信息的机会有限且不平等，但关于这些信息摩擦来源的直接证据很少。社会科学家长期以来推测，围绕薪酬的隐私规范（即“薪酬禁忌”）起着重要作用。我们基于对东南亚一家大型商业银行755名员工的实地实验，提供了这一现象的独特证据。我们表明，其许多员工既不愿向同事透露自己的薪酬，也不愿询问同事的薪酬。当分享关于资历的较不敏感信息时，这些摩擦仍然存在，但程度较小。我们讨论了对薪酬透明政策和性别工资差距的影响。

records.title_en: Credence goods markets, online information and repair prices: A natural field experiment
records.title_cn: 信任品市场、在线信息与维修价格：一项自然实地实验
records.abstract_en: Credence goods markets are characterized by large informational asymmetries between consumers and expert sellers. In two waves of a natural field experiment in the market for computer repairs we study whether consumers benefit from accessing online information about their needs or previous consumers’ experience with particular sellers. We find that gaining noisy knowledge about one’s needs and revealing it to the seller is a costly mistake, since seemingly better informed customers pay, on average, higher prices. By contrast, accessing online ratings helps identifying sellers who provide appropriate quality at reasonable prices, in particular on rating platforms that filter out untrustworthy reviews.
records.abstract_cn: 信任品市场的特征在于消费者与专家卖家之间存在巨大的信息不对称。我们在电脑维修市场的两轮自然实地实验中，研究了消费者是否能从获取关于自身需求的在线信息或先前消费者对特定卖家的体验中受益。我们发现，获得关于自身需求的模糊知识并将其透露给卖家是一个代价高昂的错误，因为看似信息更充分的顾客平均支付了更高的价格。相比之下，访问在线评分有助于识别以合理价格提供适当质量的卖家，尤其是在那些过滤掉不可信评论的评分平台上。

records.title_en: Suing the government under weak rule of law: Evidence from administrative litigation reform in China
records.title_cn: 在法治薄弱环境下起诉政府：来自中国行政诉讼改革的证据
records.abstract_en: There is a long-standing debate in the literature about the effectiveness of strengthening judicial independence in developing countries with weak rule of law. This paper exploits a recent Chinese judicial reform in administrative litigation, which changed the jurisdiction rule from intra-regional to trans-regional, to estimate the effects of improved judicial independence on protecting private entities against potential abuses of public authority. We find a significant increase in the probability of successfully suing local governments after the reform, especially when the defendants are more powerful government departments and when the plaintiffs are individual citizens with fewer legal resources than firms. But this effect is more limited for higher-level governments. The reform also results in increased case filings, prolonged trial time, and enhanced judicial quality. In addition, it raises the awareness of both governments and citizens about the rule of law, increases firm entry, and worsens general public attitudes toward local governments, at least in the short term. Our study highlights trans-regional jurisdiction as a new source of judicial independence in a party state and its potential limitations.
records.abstract_cn: 文献中长期以来一直存在关于在法治薄弱的发展中国家加强司法独立有效性的争论。本文利用中国近期一项行政诉讼司法改革，该改革将管辖权规则从区域内变更为跨区域，以估计司法独立性的提升对保护私人实体免受公共权力潜在滥用的影响。我们发现改革后成功起诉地方政府的概率显著增加，尤其是当被告是更强大的政府部门，且原告是法律资源少于企业的个人公民时。但这一效应对更高级别的政府更为有限。改革还导致案件受理量增加、审判时间延长以及司法质量提升。此外，改革提高了政府和公民对法治的认识，增加了企业进入，并在短期内恶化了公众对地方政府的总体态度。我们的研究强调了跨区域管辖作为党国体制下司法独立的新来源及其潜在局限性。

records.title_en: The inequality impact of consumption taxes: An international comparison
records.title_cn: 消费税的不平等影响：一项国际比较
records.abstract_en: Consumption taxes are often considered as the most regressive component of the tax system. However, there are only few estimates, and even fewer international comparisons, of the redistributive impact of consumption taxes in the literature, due to scarce data on household expenditures. We use household budget and income surveys and microsimulation to provide consistent estimates of the regressivity of consumption taxes for a large panel of countries and years. We propose a new method for imputing household consumption expenditure across countries: this can be applied to any dataset that contains income information and potentially other socio-demographic variables. We stress that using housing rents, when available, to impute household consumption and calculate consumption taxes significantly improves the accuracy of the model. We have three results. First, in almost all countries, consumption taxes fall disproportionately on low-income households: the top income decile pays a share of its income in consumption taxes that is only 60 percent of what the bottom half pays. Second, income inequality is higher when calculated after consumption taxes, and this rise in inequality offsets one-third of the redistributive effect of tax-benefit systems. Last, cross-country differences in the inequality effect of consumption taxes are mainly explained by different implicit tax rates (from 7 to 30 percent in our sample), rather than variations in the distribution of household consumption patterns. Consumption taxes should therefore be taken into account when comparing income inequality and tax-benefit systems across countries, as the most-redistributive systems generally come with high consumption taxes.
records.abstract_cn: 消费税通常被视为税制中最具累退性的组成部分。然而，由于家庭支出数据稀缺，文献中关于消费税再分配影响的估计很少，国际比较更是寥寥无几。我们利用家庭预算和收入调查以及微观模拟，为大量国家和年份提供了消费税累退性的一致估计。我们提出了一种跨国家推算家庭消费支出的新方法：该方法可应用于任何包含收入信息以及可能包含其他社会人口变量的数据集。我们强调，在可获取的情况下，使用住房租金来推算家庭消费并计算消费税，能显著提高模型的准确性。我们有三项结果。首先，在几乎所有国家，消费税不成比例地落在低收入家庭身上：最高收入十分位数的家庭所缴纳的消费税占其收入的比例仅为最低收入一半家庭所缴比例的60%。其次，在计入消费税后计算的收入不平等程度更高，且这种不平等的加剧抵消了税收-福利制度再分配效应的三分之一。最后，消费税不平等效应的跨国差异主要归因于不同的隐含税率（在我们的样本中从7到30%），而非家庭消费模式分布的差异。因此，在比较各国的收入不平等和税收-福利制度时，应考虑消费税，因为再分配程度最高的制度通常伴随着高消费税。

records.title_en: A preference-based theory unifying monetary and non-monetary poverty measurement
records.title_cn: 基于偏好的统一货币与非货币贫困测量理论
records.abstract_en: Multidimensional poverty measures are increasingly used in practice even though they face criticism and generate long-lasting debates. These contentions primarily find their origin in the divergence between standard poverty identification practices and a preference-based definition of the poor. This paper fills this gap by proposing a poverty measurement theory that (i) adopts a preference-based definition of the poor, (ii) acknowledges that the relevant preference is only partially known and (iii) encompasses both market and non-market dimensions of well-being. A preference-based definition satisfying two mild substitutability assumptions implies that two types of individuals are poor: individuals who experience an extremely low outcome in at least one dimension (“extremors”) and individuals who cumulate moderately low outcomes in several dimensions (“cumulators”). The paper shows that standard identification practices are not flexible enough to properly identify both types of poor individuals and proposes a simple refinement that improves on this issue. The theory provides a conceptual foundation from which practitioners may derive guidance for the many choices they face.
records.abstract_cn: 多维贫困测量在实践中日益广泛使用，尽管它们面临批评并引发长期争论。这些争议主要源于标准贫困识别实践与基于偏好的贫困定义之间的分歧。本文通过提出一种贫困测量理论来填补这一空白，该理论（i）采用基于偏好的贫困定义，（ii）承认相关偏好仅部分已知，并且（iii）涵盖福祉的市场和非市场维度。满足两个温和替代性假设的基于偏好的定义意味着两类个体是贫困的：在至少一个维度上经历极低结果的个体（“极端者”）和在多个维度上累积中等偏低结果的个体（“累积者”）。本文表明，标准识别实践不够灵活，无法正确识别这两类贫困个体，并提出了一种简单的改进方法以改善这一问题。该理论为实践者面对众多选择时提供了概念基础，可从中获得指导。

records.title_en: Moving to density: Half a century of housing costs and wage premia from Queens to King Salmon
records.title_cn: 向密度迁移：从皇后区到国王鲑鱼镇的半世纪住房成本与工资溢价
records.abstract_en: Have workers stopped moving to the highest-density, highest-productivity places in the country because of a decline in the urban wage premium, or because the rent is too high? We analyze how important these two explanations are by studying them in one and the same empirical analysis. We find that non-college workers now effectively face a housing-inclusive urban wage penalty, while workers with college education continue to face a significant urban wage premium. We relate these findings to the share of native-born cross-state migrants across different parts of the country, and find that native-born cross-state migrants, especially non-college workers, have become less likely to live in the highest-productivity areas.
records.abstract_cn: 工人是否因为城市工资溢价的下降，或者因为租金过高，而停止迁往全国密度最高、生产率最高的地方？我们通过在同一实证分析中研究这两种解释来评估它们的重要性。我们发现，非大学学历工人现在实际上面临包含住房在内的城市工资惩罚，而受过大学教育的工人则继续面临显著的城市工资溢价。我们将这些发现与本土出生的跨州移民在全国不同地区的比例联系起来，并发现本土出生的跨州移民，尤其是非大学学历工人，居住在最高生产率地区的可能性已经降低。

records.title_en: Supply-side health policy: The impact of scope-of-practice laws on mortality
records.title_cn: 供给侧卫生政策：执业范围法律对死亡率的影响
records.abstract_en: The increased use of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physician assistants/associates (PAs) to provide healthcare represents an important supply-side policy option to expand access to care. However, restrictive scope-of-practice laws limit their ability to deliver care. I examine the effect of relaxing these scope-of-practice laws on healthcare amenable deaths, which are sensitive to access to care. Analyzing deaths in the United States between 2005 and 2019, I find that relaxing NP scope-of-practice laws reduces healthcare amenable deaths by 12 per 100,000 individuals and that relaxing PA scope-of-practice laws reduces these deaths by 10 per 100,000, with larger reductions in rural areas.
records.abstract_cn: 增加使用执业护士（NPs）和医师助理/助理医师（PAs）提供医疗服务，代表了扩大医疗服务可及性的重要供给侧政策选择。然而，限制性的执业范围法律限制了其提供医疗服务的能力。我研究了放宽这些执业范围法律对医疗可避免死亡的影响，这些死亡对医疗服务的可及性敏感。通过分析2005年至2019年间美国的死亡数据，我发现放宽NP执业范围法律可使医疗可避免死亡每100,000人减少12例，而放宽PA执业范围法律可使这些死亡每100,000人减少10例，且在农村地区减少幅度更大。

records.title_en: Getting Dynamic Implementation to Work
records.title_cn: 让动态实施发挥作用
records.abstract_en: We develop a new class of two-stage mechanisms, which fully implement any social choice function under initial rationalizability in complete information environments. We show theoretically that our Simultaneous Report (SR) mechanisms are robust to small amounts of incomplete information about the state of nature. We also highlight the robustness of the mechanisms to a wide variety of reasoning processes and behavioral assumptions. We show experimentally that a SR mechanism performs well in inducing truth-telling in both complete and incomplete information environments and that it can induce efficient investment in a two-sided hold-up problem with ex-ante investment. The SR mechanism also outperforms a variety of other mechanisms proposed in the literature in terms of both efficiency and truth-telling rates and individuals are willing to use the mechanism when given the choice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一类新的两阶段机制，在完全信息环境中，通过初始理性化，这类机制能够完全实施任何社会选择函数。我们从理论上证明，我们的同时报告（SR）机制对于关于自然状态的小量不完全信息具有稳健性。我们还强调了该机制对各种推理过程和行为假设的稳健性。我们通过实验表明，SR机制在完全和不完全信息环境中都能很好地诱导说真话，并且它能在具有事前投资的双边敲竹杠问题中诱导有效投资。SR机制在效率和说真话率方面也优于文献中提出的各种其他机制，并且当个体有选择时，他们愿意使用该机制。

records.title_en: Sources of Wage Growth
records.title_cn: 工资增长的来源
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the sources of wage growth over the life cycle, determined by sectoral and firm mobility, unobserved ability, the accumulation of cognitive-abstract or routine-manual skills, and whether workers enroll in vocational training at the start of their career. Our analysis uses longitudinal administrative data over three decades and shows that routine-manual skills drive early wage growth, while cognitive-abstract skills become more important later. Moreover, job amenities are an important determinant of mobility decisions. Vocational training has long-term effects on career outcomes through various channels and generates returns for both the individual and society.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了生命周期中工资增长的来源，这些来源由部门和企业的流动性、未观测到的能力、认知抽象或常规手工技能的积累，以及工人是否在职业生涯开始时参加职业培训所决定。我们的分析使用了跨越三十年的纵向行政数据，并表明常规手工技能推动了早期的工资增长，而认知抽象技能在后期变得更加重要。此外，工作福利是流动性决策的重要决定因素。职业培训通过多种渠道对职业结果产生长期影响，并为个人和社会带来回报。

records.title_en: Costless Information and Costly Verification: A Case for Transparency
records.title_cn: 无成本信息与昂贵验证：透明性的理由
records.abstract_en: A principal has to take a binary decision. She relies on information privately held by an agent who prefers the same action regardless of his type. The principal cannot incentivize with transfers but can learn the agent’s type at a cost. Additionally, the principal privately observes a signal correlated with the agent’s type. Transparent mechanisms are optimal: the principal’s payoff is the same as if her signal was public. A simple cutoff form is optimal: favorable signals ensure the agent’s preferred action. Signals below this cutoff lead to the nonpreferred action unless the agent appeals. An appeal always triggers type verification.
records.abstract_cn: 委托人需要做出一个二元决策。她依赖于代理人私下持有的信息，而代理人无论其类型如何都偏好相同的行动。委托人无法通过转移支付进行激励，但可以花费成本了解代理人的类型。此外，委托人私下观察到一个与代理人类型相关的信号。透明机制是最优的：委托人的收益与她信号公开时相同。一个简单的截断形式是最优的：有利信号确保代理人偏好的行动。低于此截断的信号导致非偏好行动，除非代理人提出申诉。申诉总是触发类型验证。

records.title_en: Large-Scale Education Reform in General Equilibrium: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 一般均衡中的大规模教育改革：来自印度的断点回归证据
records.abstract_en: The economic consequences of large-scale government investments in education depend on general equilibrium effects in both the labor market and the education sector. I develop a general equilibrium model capturing the consequences of massive countrywide schooling initiatives. I provide unbiased estimates of the model’s elasticities, using a regression discontinuity derived from Indian government policy. The earnings returns to a year of education are 13.4%, and the general equilibrium labor market effects substantially depress returns, by 6.6 percentage points. These general equilibrium effects have distributional consequences across cohorts and skill groups, whereby unskilled workers are better off and skilled workers worse off.
records.abstract_cn: 大规模政府教育投资的经济后果取决于劳动力市场和教育部门的一般均衡效应。我构建了一个一般均衡模型，用以捕捉全国性大规模教育倡议的后果。我利用印度政府政策产生的断点回归，提供了模型弹性的无偏估计。一年教育的收益回报为13.4%，而一般均衡劳动力市场效应使回报大幅下降，降幅为6.6个百分点。这些一般均衡效应对不同队列和技能群体产生了分配性后果，其中非技术工人状况改善，而技术工人状况恶化。

records.title_en: Time series analysis of COVID-19 infection curve: A change-point perspective
records.title_cn: COVID-19感染曲线的时间序列分析：变点视角
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we model the trajectory of the cumulative confirmed cases and deaths of COVID-19 (in log scale) via a piecewise linear trend model. The model naturally captures the phase transitions of the epidemic growth rate via change-points and further enjoys great interpretability due to its semiparametric nature. On the methodological front, we advance the nascent self-normalization (SN) technique (Shao, 2010) to testing and estimation of a single change-point in the linear trend of a nonstationary time series. We further combine the SN-based change-point test with the NOT algorithm (Baranowski et al., 2019) to achieve multiple change-point estimation. Using the proposed method, we analyze the trajectory of the cumulative COVID-19 cases and deaths for 30 major countries and discover interesting patterns with potentially relevant implications for effectiveness of the pandemic responses by different countries. Furthermore, based on the change-point detection algorithm and a flexible extrapolation function, we design a simple two-stage forecasting scheme for COVID-19 and demonstrate its promising performance in predicting cumulative deaths in the U.S.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们通过分段线性趋势模型对COVID-19累计确诊病例和死亡人数（对数尺度）的轨迹进行建模。该模型通过变点自然地捕捉了疫情增长率的阶段转变，并因其半参数性质而具有很好的可解释性。在方法论方面，我们将新兴的自标准化（SN）技术（Shao，2010）推进到非平稳时间序列线性趋势中单一变点的检验和估计。我们进一步将基于SN的变点检验与NOT算法（Baranowski等，2019）相结合，以实现多个变点的估计。使用所提出的方法，我们分析了30个主要国家的COVID-19累计病例和死亡轨迹，并发现了有趣的模式，这些模式可能对不同国家疫情应对措施的有效性具有潜在意义。此外，基于变点检测算法和灵活的 extrapolation 函数，我们设计了一个简单的两阶段COVID-19预测方案，并展示了其在预测美国累计死亡人数方面的良好性能。

records.title_en: Volatility measurement with pockets of extreme return persistence
records.title_cn: 具有极端收益持续性的波动率测量
records.abstract_en: Increasing evidence points towards the episodic emergence of pockets with extreme return persistence. This notion refers to intraday periods of non-trivial duration, for which stock returns are highly positively autocorrelated. Such episodes include, but are not limited to, gradual jumps and prolonged bursts in the drift component. In this paper, we develop a family of integrated volatility estimators, labeled differenced-return volatility (DV) estimators, which provide robustness to these types of Itô semimartingale violations. Specifically, we show that, by using differences in consecutive high-frequency returns, our DV estimators can reduce the non-trivial bias that all commonly-used estimators exhibit during such periods of apparent short-term intraday return predictability. A Monte Carlo study demonstrates the reliability of the newly developed volatility estimators in finite samples. In our empirical volatility forecasting application to S&P 500 index futures and individual equities, our DV-based Heterogeneous Autoregressive (HAR) model performs well relative to existing procedures according to standard out-of-sample MSE and QLIKE criteria.
records.abstract_cn: 越来越多的证据指向极端收益持续性口袋的偶发出现。这一概念指的是日内持续一段非平凡时间的时期，在此期间股票收益高度正自相关。此类事件包括但不限于漂移分量中的渐进跳跃和持续爆发。在本文中，我们开发了一系列积分波动率估计量，称为差分收益波动率（DV）估计量，它们对这些类型的Itô半鞅违规具有稳健性。具体来说，我们表明，通过使用连续高频收益的差异，我们的DV估计量可以减少所有常用估计量在此类明显的短期日内收益可预测性期间表现出的非平凡偏差。蒙特卡洛研究证明了新开发的波动率估计量在有限样本中的可靠性。在我们对S&P 500指数期货和个股的实证波动率预测应用中，基于DV的异质自回归（HAR）模型在标准样本外MSE和QLIKE准则下相对于现有程序表现良好。

records.title_en: State-domain change point detection for nonlinear time series regression
records.title_cn: 非线性时间序列回归中的状态域变点检测
records.abstract_en: Change point detection in time series has attracted substantial interest, but most of the existing results have been focused on detecting change points in the time domain. This paper considers the situation where nonlinear time series have potential change points in the state domain. We apply a density-weighted anti-symmetric kernel function to the state domain and therefore propose a nonparametric procedure to test the existence of change points. When the existence of change points is affirmative, we further introduce an algorithm to estimate the number of change points together with their locations. Theoretical results of the proposed detection and estimation procedures are given and a real dataset is used to illustrate our methods.
records.abstract_cn: 时间序列中的变点检测引起了广泛关注，但现有的大多数结果都集中在时间域中的变点检测上。本文考虑了非线性时间序列在状态域中可能存在变点的情况。我们将密度加权反对称核函数应用于状态域，因此提出了一种非参数程序来检验变点的存在性。当变点的存在性得到肯定时，我们进一步引入一种算法来估计变点的数量及其位置。给出了所提出的检测和估计程序的理论结果，并使用一个真实数据集来说明我们的方法。

records.title_en: Multi-dimensional latent group structures with heterogeneous distributions
records.title_cn: 具有异质性分布的多维潜在分组结构
records.abstract_en: This paper aims to identify the multi-dimensional latent grouped heterogeneity of distributional effects. We consider a panel quantile regression model with additive cross-section and time fixed effects. The cross-section effects and quantile slope coefficients are both characterized by grouped patterns of heterogeneity, but each unit can belong to different groups for cross-section effects and slopes. We propose a composite-quantile approach to jointly estimate multi-dimensional group memberships, slope coefficients, and fixed effects. We show that using multiple quantiles improves clustering accuracy if memberships are quantile-invariant. We apply the methods to examine the relationship between managerial incentives and risk-taking behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在识别分布效应的多维潜在分组异质性。我们考虑一个带有可加截面和时间固定效应的面板分位数回归模型。截面效应和分位数斜率系数均以分组异质性模式为特征，但每个单元在截面效应和斜率上可以属于不同的组。我们提出了一种复合分位数方法，用于联合估计多维组成员身份、斜率系数和固定效应。我们表明，如果成员身份是分位数不变的，使用多个分位数可以提高聚类准确性。我们将这些方法应用于检验管理层激励与风险承担行为之间的关系。

records.title_en: It ain’t where you’re from, it’s where you’re at: Hiring origins, firm heterogeneity, and wages
records.title_cn: 关键不在于你来自哪里，而在于你现在何处：招聘来源、企业异质性与工资
records.abstract_en: Sequential auction models of labor market competition predict that the wages required to successfully poach a worker from a rival employer will depend on the productivities of both the poached and poaching firms. We develop a theoretically grounded extension of the two-way fixed effects model of Abowd et al. (1999) in which log hiring wages are comprised of a worker fixed effect, a fixed effect for the “destination” firm hiring the worker, and a fixed effect for the “origin” firm, or labor market state, from which the worker was hired. This specification is shown to nest the reduced form for hiring wages delivered by semi-parametric formulations of the canonical sequential auction model of Postel-Vinay and Robin (2002b) and its generalization in Bagger et al. (2014). Fitting the model to Italian social security records, origin effects are found to explain only 0.7% of the variance of hiring wages among job movers, while destination effects explain more than 23% of the variance. Across firms, destination effects are more than 13 times as variable as origin effects. Interpreted through the lens of Bagger et al. (2014)’s model, this finding requires that workers possess implausibly strong bargaining strength. Studying a cohort of workers entering the Italian labor market in 2005, we find that differences in origin effects yield essentially no contribution to the evolution of the gender gap in hiring wages, while differences in destination effects explain the majority of the gap at the time of labor market entry. These results suggest that where a worker is hired from tends to be relatively inconsequential for their wages in comparison to where they are currently employed.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动力市场竞争的序贯拍卖模型预测，成功从竞争对手雇主处挖走工人所需的工资将取决于被挖工人和挖人企业的生产率。我们在Abowd等人（1999）的双向固定效应模型基础上，发展了一个有理论基础的扩展，其中对数招聘工资由工人固定效应、雇佣工人的“目的地”企业固定效应以及工人被雇佣的“来源”企业或劳动力市场状态的固定效应组成。该设定被证明包含了Postel-Vinay和Robin（2002b）的经典序贯拍卖模型的半参数形式及其在Bagger等人（2014）中的推广所给出的招聘工资简化形式。将该模型拟合意大利社会保障记录，发现来源效应仅解释工作流动者招聘工资方差的0.7%，而目的地效应解释了超过23%的方差。在企业间，目的地效应的变异性是来源效应的13倍以上。通过Bagger等人（2014）模型的视角解释，这一发现要求工人拥有难以置信的强议价能力。研究2005年进入意大利劳动力市场的一组工人队列，我们发现来源效应的差异对招聘工资性别差距的演变几乎没有贡献，而目的地效应的差异解释了劳动力市场进入时的大部分差距。这些结果表明，与工人当前受雇地点相比，其被招聘的来源地对其工资的影响相对微不足道。

records.title_en: Isotonic regression discontinuity designs
records.title_cn: 等距回归断点设计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the estimation and inference for the isotonic regression at the boundary point, an object that is particularly interesting and required in the analysis of monotone regression discontinuity designs. We show that the isotonic regression is inconsistent in this setting and derive the asymptotic distributions of boundary corrected estimators. Interestingly, the boundary corrected estimators can be bootstrapped without subsampling or additional nonparametric smoothing which is not the case for the interior point. The Monte Carlo experiments indicate that shape restrictions can improve dramatically the finite-sample performance of unrestricted estimators. Lastly, we estimate the causal effect of incumbency in U.S. House elections via the isotonic regression discontinuity design.
