records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了边界点处等距回归的估计与推断，这一对象在单调回归断点设计的分析中尤为有趣且必要。我们证明等距回归在此设定下不一致，并推导了边界校正估计量的渐近分布。有趣的是，边界校正估计量可以通过自助法进行推断，无需子抽样或额外的非参数平滑，而内点情形则不然。蒙特卡洛实验表明，形状约束能显著改善无约束估计量的有限样本表现。最后，我们通过等距回归断点设计估计了美国众议院选举中在位效应的因果效应。

records.title_en: A structural analysis of simple contracts
records.title_cn: 简单契约的结构分析
records.abstract_en: This paper provides an econometric framework for analyzing two-period simple contracts where an agent chooses between a fixed-price option and a cost-reimbursement option provided by a principal in each contracting period. First, we propose a consistent procedure for testing the null hypothesis of a corresponding cost function being linear, which is widely assumed for tractability in the literature. Motivated by the rejection of such a null based on our empirical data, next we establish nonparametric identification, without restricting the cost function to be linear, for all model primitives conditioned on the agent exerting nonzero effort. These primitives include agent’s cost and disutility functions, distribution of agent efficiency type, and parameters that characterize agent’s bargaining power and intertemporal preference. Moreover, we propose a consistent procedure to implement the identification results for estimation. In our empirical study, we find strong evidence against linearity of the cost function. The importance of this empirical finding is further evidenced by a welfare analysis, which shows the welfare assessment to be sensitive to the specification of cost function.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个计量经济学框架，用于分析两期简单契约，其中代理人在每个契约期内在委托人提供的固定价格选项和成本补偿选项之间进行选择。首先，我们提出了一种一致的程序来检验相应成本函数为线性的原假设，这一假设在文献中因可处理性而被广泛采用。基于我们的实证数据拒绝了这一原假设，接下来我们在不限制成本函数为线性的情况下，建立了所有模型原始量在代理人付出非零努力条件下的非参数识别。这些原始量包括代理人的成本和负效用函数、代理人效率类型的分布，以及刻画代理人议价能力和跨期偏好的参数。此外，我们提出了一种一致的程序来实现识别结果的估计。在我们的实证研究中，我们发现了反对成本函数线性的有力证据。这一实证发现的重要性进一步通过福利分析得到证实，该分析表明福利评估对成本函数的设定是敏感的。

records.title_en: Policy evaluation during a pandemic
records.title_cn: 疫情期间的政策评估
records.abstract_en: National and local governments have implemented a large number of policies in response to the Covid-19 pandemic. Evaluating the effects of these policies, both on the number of Covid-19 cases as well as on other economic outcomes is a key ingredient for policymakers to be able to determine which policies are most effective as well as the relative costs and benefits of particular policies. In this paper, we consider the relative merits of common identification strategies that exploit variation in the timing of policies across different locations by checking whether the identification strategies are compatible with leading epidemic models in the epidemiology literature. We argue that unconfoundedness type approaches, that condition on the pre-treatment “state” of the pandemic, are likely to be more useful for evaluating policies than difference-in-differences type approaches due to the highly nonlinear spread of cases during a pandemic. For difference-in-differences, we further show that a version of this problem continues to exist even when one is interested in understanding the effect of a policy on other economic outcomes when those outcomes also depend on the number of Covid-19 cases. We propose alternative approaches that are able to circumvent these issues. We apply our proposed approach to study the effect of state level shelter-in-place orders early in the pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: 国家和地方政府为应对Covid-19疫情实施了大量政策。评估这些政策对Covid-19病例数量以及其他经济结果的影响，是政策制定者确定哪些政策最有效以及特定政策的相对成本和收益的关键要素。在本文中，我们通过检查识别策略是否与流行病学文献中的主要流行病模型兼容，来考虑利用不同地点政策实施时间差异的常见识别策略的相对优点。我们认为，由于疫情期间病例传播的高度非线性，以疫情前处理“状态”为条件的无混杂性方法可能比双重差分法更有助于评估政策。对于双重差分法，我们进一步表明，即使当人们感兴趣的是政策对其他经济结果的影响，而这些结果也依赖于Covid-19病例数量时，这个问题的一个版本仍然存在。我们提出了能够规避这些问题的替代方法。我们将我们提出的方法应用于研究疫情早期州级居家令的效果。

records.title_en: Cluster-robust inference: A guide to empirical practice
records.title_cn: 聚类稳健推断：实证实践指南
records.abstract_en: Methods for cluster-robust inference are routinely used in economics and many other disciplines. However, it is only recently that theoretical foundations for the use of these methods in many empirically relevant situations have been developed. In this paper, we use these theoretical results to provide a guide to empirical practice. We do not attempt to present a comprehensive survey of the (very large) literature. Instead, we bridge theory and practice by providing a thorough guide on what to do and why, based on recently available econometric theory and simulation evidence. To practice what we preach, we include an empirical analysis of the effects of the minimum wage on labor supply of teenagers using individual data.
records.abstract_cn: 聚类稳健推断方法在经济学及许多其他学科中被常规使用。然而，直到最近，这些方法在许多实证相关情境中的理论基础才得以发展。在本文中，我们利用这些理论结果为实证实践提供指南。我们不试图对（非常庞大的）文献进行全面综述。相反，我们通过基于近期可得的计量经济学理论和模拟证据，提供关于做什么以及为什么这样做的详尽指南，从而架起理论与实践的桥梁。为践行我们所倡导的，我们使用个体数据对最低工资对青少年劳动力供给的影响进行了实证分析。

records.title_en: Identification-robust nonparametric inference in a linear IV model
records.title_cn: 线性IV模型中的识别稳健非参数推断
records.abstract_en: For a linear IV regression, we propose two new inference procedures on parameters of endogenous variables that are robust to any identification pattern, do not rely on a linear first-stage equation, and account for heteroskedasticity of unknown form. Building on Bierens (1982), we first propose an Integrated Conditional Moment (ICM) type statistic constructed by setting the parameters to the value under the null hypothesis. The ICM procedure tests at the same time the value of the coefficient and the specification of the model. We then adopt a conditionality principle to condition on a set of ICM statistics that informs on identification strength. Our two procedures uniformly control size irrespective of identification strength. They are powerful irrespective of the nonlinear form of the link between instruments and endogenous variables and are competitive with existing procedures in simulations and application.
records.abstract_cn: 对于线性IV回归，我们提出了两种新的推断程序，针对内生变量参数，这些程序对任何识别模式均稳健，不依赖线性第一阶段方程，并考虑未知形式的异方差性。基于Bierens（1982），我们首先提出一种积分条件矩（ICM）型统计量，通过将参数设定为零假设下的值来构建。ICM程序同时检验系数的值和模型的设定。然后，我们采用条件性原则，基于一组告知识别强度的ICM统计量进行条件推断。我们的两种程序在识别强度方面统一控制大小。它们在工具与内生变量之间链接的非线性形式下均具有功效，并且在模拟和应用中与现有程序相比具有竞争力。

records.title_en: Nowcasting the output gap
records.title_cn: 实时预测产出缺口
records.abstract_en: We propose a way to directly nowcast the output gap using the Beveridge–Nelson decomposition based on a mixed-frequency Bayesian VAR. The mixed-frequency approach produces similar but more timely estimates of the U.S. output gap compared to those based on a quarterly model, the CBO measure of potential, or the HP filter. We find that within-quarter nowcasts for the output gap are more reliable than for output growth, with monthly indicators for a credit risk spread, consumer sentiment, and the unemployment rate providing particularly useful new information about the final estimate of the output gap. An out-of-sample analysis of the COVID-19 crisis anticipates the exceptionally large negative output gap of −8.3% in 2020Q2 before the release of real GDP data for the quarter, with both conditional and scenario nowcasts tracking a dramatic decline in the output gap given the April data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种直接实时预测产出缺口的方法，该方法基于混合频率贝叶斯向量自回归模型的贝弗里奇-纳尔逊分解。与基于季度模型、国会预算办公室潜在产出衡量指标或HP滤波器的估计相比，混合频率方法产生了相似但更及时的美国产出缺口估计。我们发现，季度内产出缺口的实时预测比产出增长的预测更可靠，其中信用利差、消费者情绪和失业率的月度指标为产出缺口的最终估计提供了特别有用的新信息。对COVID-19危机的样本外分析在2020Q2实际GDP数据发布之前，就预测到了异常大的负产出缺口（-8.3%），条件预测和情景预测均追踪了四月数据所显示的产出缺口的急剧下降。

records.title_en: Dynamic conditional eigenvalue GARCH
records.title_cn: 动态条件特征值GARCH
records.abstract_en: In this paper we introduce a multivariate generalized autoregressive conditional heteroskedastic (GARCH) class of models with time-varying conditional eigenvalues. The dynamics of the eigenvalues is derived for the cases with underlying Gaussian and Student’s t-distributed innovations based on the general theory of dynamic conditional score models by Creal, Koopman and Lucas (2013) and Harvey (2013). The resulting time-varying eigenvalue GARCH models – labeled ‘λ-GARCH’ models – differ for the two cases of innovations, similar to, and generalizing, univariate linear Gaussian GARCH and Student’s t-based Beta-t-GARCH models. Asymptotic theory is provided for the Gaussian-based quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE). In addition, and in order to test for the number of (linear combinations of) the time-varying eigenvalues, we consider testing and inference under the hypothesis of reduced rank of the GARCH loading matrices. The conditional Gaussian and Student’s t distributed λ-GARCH models are applied to US return data, and it is found that the eigenvalue structure for the sample considered indeed satisfies the hypothesis of reduced rank. Specifically, it is possible to disentangle time-varying linear combinations of the eigenvalues, or factors, from time-invariant factors which drive the dynamics of the conditional covariance.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们引入了一类具有时变条件特征值的多元广义自回归条件异方差（GARCH）模型。基于Creal、Koopman和Lucas（2013）以及Harvey（2013）的动态条件得分模型的一般理论，推导了在潜在高斯和Student t分布创新情况下的特征值动态。由此产生的时变特征值GARCH模型——标记为“λ-GARCH”模型——在两种创新情况下有所不同，类似于并推广了单变量线性高斯GARCH和基于Student t的Beta-t-GARCH模型。为基于高斯拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）提供了渐近理论。此外，为了检验时变特征值（的线性组合）的数量，我们考虑了在GARCH载荷矩阵降秩假设下的检验和推断。条件高斯和Student t分布的λ-GARCH模型应用于美国收益数据，发现所考虑样本的特征值结构确实满足降秩假设。具体而言，可以将时变的特征值线性组合（或因子）与驱动条件协方差动态的时不变因子分离开来。

records.title_en: Improved marginal likelihood estimation via power posteriors and importance sampling
records.title_cn: 通过幂后验和重要性抽样改进边际似然估计
records.abstract_en: Power posteriors have become popular in estimating the marginal likelihood of a Bayesian model. A power posterior is referred to as the posterior distribution that is proportional to the likelihood raised to a power b∈[0,1]. Important power-posterior-based algorithms include thermodynamic integration (TI) of Friel and Pettitt (2008) and steppingstone sampling (SS) of Xie et al. (2011). In this paper, it is shown that the Bernstein–von Mises (BvM) theorem holds for power posteriors under regularity conditions. Due to the BvM theorem, power posteriors, when adjusted by the square root of the auxiliary constant, have the same limit distribution as the original posterior distribution, facilitating the implementation of the modified TI and SS methods via importance sampling. Unlike the TI and SS methods that require repeated sampling from the power posteriors, the modified methods only need the original posterior output and hence, are computationally more efficient. Moreover, they completely avoid the coding efforts associated with sampling from the power posteriors. Primitive conditions, under which the TI and modified TI algorithms can produce consistent estimators of the marginal likelihood, are provided. The numerical efficiency of the proposed methods is illustrated using two models.
records.abstract_cn: 幂后验在估计贝叶斯模型的边际似然方面已变得流行。幂后验是指与似然函数的b次幂成比例的后验分布，其中b∈[0,1]。基于幂后验的重要算法包括Friel和Pettitt（2008）的热力学积分（TI）以及Xie等人（2011）的踏脚石抽样（SS）。本文表明，在正则条件下，伯恩斯坦-冯·米塞斯（BvM）定理对幂后验成立。由于BvM定理，幂后验在通过辅助常数的平方根调整后，与原始后验分布具有相同的极限分布，从而便于通过重要性抽样实施改进的TI和SS方法。与需要从幂后验中重复抽样的TI和SS方法不同，改进方法仅需要原始后验输出，因此在计算上更为高效。此外，它们完全避免了与从幂后验抽样相关的编码工作。本文提供了原始条件，在这些条件下，TI和改进的TI算法可以产生边际似然的一致估计量。通过两个模型说明了所提出方法的数值效率。

records.title_en: Canonical correlation-based model selection for the multilevel factors
records.title_cn: 基于典型相关的多层次因子模型选择
records.abstract_en: We develop a novel approach based on the canonical correlation analysis to identify the number of the global factors in the multilevel factor model. We propose the two consistent selection criteria, the canonical correlations difference (CCD) and the modified canonical correlations (MCC). Via Monte Carlo simulations, we show that CCD and MCC select the number of global factors correctly even in small samples, and they are robust to the presence of serially correlated and weakly cross-sectionally correlated idiosyncratic errors as well as the correlated local factors. Finally, we demonstrate the utility of our approach with an application to the multilevel asset pricing model for the stock return data in 12 industries in the U.S.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种基于典型相关分析的新方法，用于识别多层次因子模型中全局因子的数量。我们提出了两个一致的选取准则，即典型相关差异（CCD）和修正典型相关（MCC）。通过蒙特卡洛模拟，我们表明即使在样本较小的情况下，CCD和MCC也能正确选择全局因子的数量，并且它们对序列相关和弱横截面相关的特质误差以及相关的局部因子的存在具有稳健性。最后，我们通过将我们的方法应用于美国12个行业的股票收益数据的多层次资产定价模型，展示了其效用。

records.title_en: Do firm effects drift? Evidence from Washington administrative data
records.title_cn: 企业效应会漂移吗？来自华盛顿行政数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the time-series properties of firm effects in the two-way fixed effects model popularized by Abowd et al. (1999) (AKM) using two approaches. The first—the rolling AKM approach (R-AKM)—estimates AKM models separately for successive two-year intervals. The second—the time-varying AKM approach (TV-AKM)—is an extension of the original AKM model that allows for unrestricted interactions of year and firm indicators. We apply to both approaches the leave-out methodology of Kline et al. (2020) to correct for biases in the estimated variance components. Using administrative wage records from Washington State, we find, first, that firm effects for hourly wage rates are highly persistent with an autocorrelation coefficient between firm effects in 2002 and 2014 of 0.74. Second, the R-AKM approach reveals cyclicality in firm effects and worker–firm sorting. During the Great Recession the variability in firm effects increased, while the degree of worker–firm sorting decreased. Third, misspecification of standard AKM models resulting from restricting firm effects to be fixed over time appears to be minimal.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用两种方法研究Abowd等人（1999）推广的双向固定效应模型中企业效应的时间序列性质。第一种——滚动AKM方法（R-AKM）——分别对连续的两年区间估计AKM模型。第二种——时变AKM方法（TV-AKM）——是原始AKM模型的扩展，允许年份和企业指标的交互项不受限制。我们将Kline等人（2020）的留出法应用于这两种方法，以纠正估计方差分量中的偏差。使用华盛顿州的行政工资记录，我们首先发现，小时工资率的企业效应高度持久，2002年和2014年企业效应之间的自相关系数为0.74。其次，R-AKM方法揭示了企业效应和工人-企业匹配的周期性。在大衰退期间，企业效应的变异性增加，而工人-企业匹配程度下降。第三，由于将企业效应限制为随时间固定而导致的标准AKM模型的错误设定似乎很小。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference for policy relevant treatment effects
records.title_cn: 政策相关处理效应的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: The policy relevant treatment effect (PRTE) measures the average effect of switching from a status-quo policy to a counterfactual policy under consideration. Estimation of the PRTE involves estimation of multiple preliminary parameters, including propensity scores, conditional expectation functions of the outcome and covariates given the propensity score, and marginal treatment effects. These preliminary estimators can affect the asymptotic distribution of the PRTE estimator in complicated and intractable manners. In this light, we propose an orthogonal score for double debiased estimation of the PRTE, whereby the asymptotic distribution of the PRTE estimator is obtained without any influence of preliminary parameter estimators as far as they satisfy mild requirements of convergence rates. To our knowledge, this paper is the first to develop limit distribution theories for inference about the PRTE.
records.abstract_cn: 政策相关处理效应（PRTE）衡量从现状政策转向所考虑的反事实政策时的平均效应。PRTE的估计涉及多个初步参数的估计，包括倾向得分、结果和协变量在给定倾向得分下的条件期望函数，以及边际处理效应。这些初步估计量可能以复杂且难以处理的方式影响PRTE估计量的渐近分布。鉴于此，我们提出了一个用于PRTE双重去偏估计的正交得分，从而在初步参数估计量仅满足温和的收敛速度要求时，PRTE估计量的渐近分布不受其任何影响。据我们所知，本文是首个为PRTE推断建立极限分布理论的研究。

records.title_en: Moments, shocks and spillovers in Markov-switching VAR models
records.title_cn: 马尔可夫转换向量自回归模型中的矩、冲击与溢出效应
records.abstract_en: To investigate how economies, financial markets or institutions can deal with stress, we often analyze the effects of shocks conditional on being in a recession or a bear market. MSVAR models are perfectly suited for such analyses because they combine gradual movements with sudden regime switches. In this paper, we develop a comprehensive methodology to conduct these analyses. We derive first and second moments conditional only on the regime distribution and propose impulse response functions for both moments. By formulating the MSVAR as an extended linear non-Gaussian VAR, all results are available in closed-form. We illustrate our methods with an application to stock and bond return predictability. We show how forecasts of means, volatilities and (auto-)correlations depend on the regimes. The effect of shocks becomes highly nonlinear, and they propagate via different channels. During bear markets, shocks have stronger effects on means and volatilities and die out more slowly.
records.abstract_cn: 为了研究经济体、金融市场或机构如何应对压力，我们经常分析在衰退或熊市条件下冲击的影响。MSVAR模型非常适合此类分析，因为它们结合了渐进变动与突然的制度转换。在本文中，我们开发了一套全面的方法来进行这些分析。我们推导了仅依赖于制度分布的一阶和二阶矩，并提出了针对这两个矩的脉冲响应函数。通过将MSVAR表述为扩展的线性非高斯VAR，所有结果都可以以闭式形式获得。我们通过一个应用于股票和债券收益可预测性的例子来说明我们的方法。我们展示了均值、波动率和（自）相关性的预测如何依赖于制度。冲击的影响变得高度非线性，并且它们通过不同的渠道传播。在熊市期间，冲击对均值和波动率的影响更强，并且消失得更慢。

records.title_en: Identification of auction models using order statistics
records.title_cn: 利用次序统计量识别拍卖模型
records.abstract_en: Auction data often contain information on only the most competitive bids as opposed to all bids. The usual measurement error approaches to unobserved heterogeneity are inapplicable due to dependence among order statistics. We bridge this gap by providing a set of positive identification results. First, we show that symmetric auctions with discrete unobserved heterogeneity are identifiable using two consecutive order statistics and an instrument. Second, we extend the results to ascending auctions with unknown competition and unobserved heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 拍卖数据通常仅包含最具竞争力的出价信息，而非所有出价。由于次序统计量之间的依赖性，通常用于未观测异质性的测量误差方法并不适用。我们通过提供一组正向识别结果来弥合这一差距。首先，我们证明具有离散未观测异质性的对称拍卖可以利用两个连续的次序统计量和一个工具变量进行识别。其次，我们将结果扩展到竞争未知且存在未观测异质性的升价拍卖。

records.title_en: Fully modified least squares cointegrating parameter estimation in multicointegrated systems
records.title_cn: 多协整系统中完全修正最小二乘协整参数估计
records.abstract_en: Multicointegration is traditionally defined as a particular long run relationship among variables in a parametric vector autoregressive model that introduces additional cointegrating links between these variables and partial sums of the equilibrium errors. This paper departs from the parametric model, using a semiparametric formulation that reveals the explicit role that singularity of the long run conditional covariance matrix plays in determining multicointegration. The semiparametric framework has the advantage that short run dynamics do not need to be modeled and estimation by standard techniques such as fully modified least squares (FM-OLS) on the original I1 system is straightforward. The paper derives FM-OLS limit theory in the multicointegrated setting, showing how faster rates of convergence are achieved in the direction of singularity and that the limit distribution depends on the distribution of the conditional one-sided long run covariance estimator used in FM-OLS estimation. Wald tests of restrictions on the regression coefficients have nonstandard limit theory which depends on nuisance parameters in general. The usual tests are shown to be conservative when the restrictions are isolated to the directions of singularity and, under certain conditions, are invariant to singularity otherwise. Simulations show that approximations derived in the paper work well in finite samples. The findings are illustrated empirically in an analysis of fiscal sustainability of the US government over the post-war period.
records.abstract_cn: 多协整传统上被定义为参数向量自回归模型中变量之间的一种特定长期关系，该模型在这些变量与均衡误差的部分和之间引入了额外的协整联系。本文偏离参数模型，采用半参数公式，揭示了长期条件协方差矩阵的奇异性在决定多协整中所起的明确作用。半参数框架的优势在于短期动态不需要建模，并且通过标准技术如完全修正最小二乘（FM-OLS）对原始I1系统进行估计是直接的。本文推导了多协整设定下的FM-OLS极限理论，展示了在奇异性方向上如何实现更快的收敛速度，以及极限分布取决于FM-OLS估计中使用的条件单侧长期协方差估计量的分布。对回归系数限制的Wald检验具有非标准极限理论，该理论通常依赖于干扰参数。当限制被隔离在奇异性方向上时，通常的检验被证明是保守的，并且在某些条件下，在其他情况下对奇异性是不变的。模拟表明，本文推导的近似在有限样本中表现良好。这些发现通过对美国政府在战后时期财政可持续性的分析进行了实证说明。

records.title_en: Over-identified Doubly Robust identification and estimation
records.title_cn: 过度识别的双重稳健识别与估计
records.abstract_en: Consider two parametric models. At least one is correctly specified, but we do not know which. Both models include a common vector of parameters. An estimator for this common parameter vector is called Doubly Robust (DR) if it is consistent no matter which model is correct. We provide a general technique for constructing DR estimators (assuming the models are over identified). Our Over-identified Doubly Robust (ODR) technique is a simple extension of the Generalized Method of Moments. We illustrate our ODR with a variety of models. Our empirical application is instrumental variables estimation, where either one of two instrument vectors might be invalid.
records.abstract_cn: 考虑两个参数模型。至少有一个是正确设定的，但我们不知道是哪一个。两个模型都包含一个共同的参数向量。如果无论哪个模型正确，该共同参数向量的估计量都是一致的，则称该估计量为双重稳健（DR）估计量。我们提供了一种构建DR估计量的一般技术（假设模型是过度识别的）。我们的过度识别双重稳健（ODR）技术是广义矩方法的简单扩展。我们用多种模型来说明我们的ODR。我们的实证应用是工具变量估计，其中两个工具向量中的一个可能是无效的。

records.title_en: Time varying Markov process with partially observed aggregate data: An application to coronavirus
records.title_cn: 具有部分观测聚合数据的时变马尔可夫过程：在冠状病毒中的应用
records.abstract_en: A major difficulty in the analysis of Covid-19 transmission is that many infected individuals are asymptomatic. For this reason, the total counts of infected individuals and of recovered immunized individuals are unknown, especially during the early phase of the epidemic. In this paper, we consider a parametric time varying Markov process of Coronavirus transmission and show how to estimate the model parameters and approximate the unobserved counts from daily data on infected and detected individuals and the total daily death counts. This model-based approach is illustrated in an application to French data, performed on April 6, 2020.
records.abstract_cn: 分析Covid-19传播的一个主要困难在于许多感染者没有症状。因此，感染个体和康复免疫个体的总数是未知的，尤其是在疫情早期阶段。在本文中，我们考虑了一个参数化的时变马尔可夫过程来描述冠状病毒传播，并展示了如何从每日感染和检测个体数据以及每日总死亡人数中估计模型参数并近似未观测的计数。这种基于模型的方法在法国数据的应用中得到了说明，该应用于四月 6, 2020进行。

records.title_en: A dynamic conditional score model for the log correlation matrix
records.title_cn: 对数相关矩阵的动态条件得分模型
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new model for the dynamics of correlation matrices, where the dynamics are driven by the likelihood score with respect to the matrix logarithm of the correlation matrix. In analogy to the exponential GARCH model for volatility, this transformation ensures that the correlation matrices remain positive definite, even in high dimensions. For the conditional distribution of returns, we assume a student-t copula to explain the dependence structure and univariate student-t for the marginals with potentially different degrees of freedom. The separation into volatility and correlation parts allows for a two-step estimation, which facilitates estimation in high dimensions. We derive estimation theory for one-step and two-step estimation. In an application to a set of six asset indices including financial and alternative assets we show that the model performs well in terms of diagnostics, specification tests, and out-of-sample forecasting.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新的相关矩阵动态模型，其中动态由相关矩阵的对数矩阵的似然得分驱动。与波动率的指数GARCH模型类似，这种变换确保了相关矩阵即使在维数较高的情况下也保持正定。对于收益的条件分布，我们假设使用学生t copula来解释依赖结构，并使用具有可能不同自由度的单变量学生t分布作为边际分布。将波动率和相关部分分离允许两步估计，这有助于在高维情况下进行估计。我们推导了一步和两步估计的估计理论。在对包括金融和另类资产在内的六个资产指数的应用中，我们表明该模型在诊断、规范检验和样本外预测方面表现良好。

records.title_en: Bias reduction in spot volatility estimation from options
records.title_cn: 期权隐含瞬时波动率估计中的偏差缩减
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem of nonparametric spot volatility estimation from options that is robust to time-variation in volatility and presence of jumps in the underlying asset price. Using a higher-order expansion of the characteristic function of the underlying price increment over shrinking time intervals and option-based estimates of the latter over two distinct horizons, we achieve asymptotic bias-reduction in spot volatility estimation, relative to existing methods, that is due to time-variation in volatility and presence of jumps. Further asymptotic improvement is achieved by de-biasing the volatility estimator using an estimate for the bias in it due to the small jumps in the price process. The gains from the newly-developed volatility estimation approach are illustrated on simulated data and in an empirical application.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑从期权中非参数估计瞬时波动率的问题，该估计对波动率的时间变化和标的资产价格中跳跃的存在具有稳健性。利用特征函数在收缩时间区间上的高阶展开以及基于期权的两个不同期限的估计，我们实现了相对于现有方法在瞬时波动率估计中的渐近偏差缩减，该偏差源于波动率的时间变化和跳跃的存在。通过使用对价格过程中小跳跃引起的偏差的估计来对波动率估计量进行去偏，进一步实现了渐近改进。新开发的波动率估计方法的优势在模拟数据和实证应用中得到了展示。

records.title_en: Estimation of panel group structure models with structural breaks in group memberships and coefficients
records.title_cn: 具有组成员关系和系数结构突变的面板分组结构模型的估计
records.abstract_en: This paper considers linear panel data models with a grouped pattern of heterogeneity when the latent group membership structure and/or the values of slope coefficients change at a break point. We propose a least squares approach to jointly estimate the break point, group membership structure, and coefficients. The proposed estimators are consistent, and the asymptotic distribution of the coefficient estimators is identical to that under known break point and group structure even when the cross-sectional sample size is much larger than the length of time series. Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical example illustrate the use of the approach and associated inference.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了当潜在组成员结构和/或斜率系数值在断点处发生变化时，具有分组异质性模式的线性面板数据模型。我们提出了一种最小二乘方法，用于联合估计断点、组成员结构和系数。所提出的估计量是一致的，并且即使当横截面样本量远大于时间序列长度时，系数估计量的渐近分布也与已知断点和组结构下的渐近分布相同。蒙特卡洛模拟和一个实证例子说明了该方法及相关推断的使用。

records.title_en: Firm pay dynamics
records.title_cn: 企业薪酬动态
records.abstract_en: We study the nature of firm pay dynamics. To this end, we propose a statistical model that extends the seminal framework by Abowd et al. (1999) to allow for idiosyncratically time-varying firm pay policies. We estimate the model using linked employer–employee data for Sweden from 1985 to 2016. By drawing on detailed firm financials data, we show that firms that become more productive and accumulate capital raise pay, whereas firms lower pay as they add workers. A secular increase in firm-year pay dispersion in Sweden since 1985 is accounted for by greater persistence of firm pay among incumbent firms as well as greater dispersion in firm pay among entrant firms, as opposed to more volatile firm pay.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究企业薪酬动态的性质。为此，我们提出了一个统计模型，该模型扩展了Abowd等人（1999）的开创性框架，以允许企业薪酬政策具有异质性的时变特征。我们使用瑞典从1985年到2016年的关联雇主-雇员数据来估计该模型。通过利用详细的企业财务数据，我们表明，变得更具生产力并积累资本的企业会提高薪酬，而随着员工增加，企业会降低薪酬。自1985年以来，瑞典企业-年度薪酬离散度的长期增长，可归因于在位企业薪酬持续性的增强以及新进入企业薪酬离散度的增大，而非企业薪酬波动性的增加。

records.title_en: Estimation of treatment effects under endogenous heteroskedasticity
records.title_cn: 内生异方差下处理效应的估计
records.abstract_en: This paper considers a treatment effect model in which individual treatment effect may be heterogeneous, even among observationally identical individuals. Specifically, by extending the classical instrumental-variables (IV) model with an endogenous binary treatment, the heteroskedasticity of the error disturbance is allowed to vary with the treatment variable so that the treatment generates both mean and variance effect on the outcome. In this endogenous heteroskedasticity IV (EHIV) model, the standard IV estimator can be inconsistent for the average treatment effect (ATE) and lead to incorrect inference. After nonparametric identification is established, closed-form estimators are provided under the linear EHIV specification for the mean and variance treatment effect, as well as the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT). Asymptotic properties of the estimators are derived. We use Monte Carlo experiments to investigate the performance of the proposed approach and then consider an empirical application regarding the effect of fertility on female labor supply. Our findings demonstrate the importance of accounting for endogenous heteroskedasticity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑一个处理效应模型，其中个体处理效应可能是异质的，即使在观测上相同的个体之间也是如此。具体而言，通过扩展具有内生二元处理变量的经典工具变量（IV）模型，允许误差扰动的异方差随处理变量变化，使得处理对结果产生均值和方差效应。在这种内生异方差IV（EHIV）模型中，标准IV估计量对于平均处理效应（ATE）可能不一致，并导致错误的推断。在建立非参数识别后，在线性EHIV设定下提供了均值和方差处理效应以及处理组平均处理效应（ATT）的闭式估计量。推导了估计量的渐近性质。我们使用蒙特卡洛实验来研究所提出方法的性能，然后考虑一个关于生育对女性劳动力供给影响的实证应用。我们的发现证明了考虑内生异方差的重要性。

records.title_en: Inference and forecasting for continuous-time integer-valued trawl processes
records.title_cn: 连续时间整数值拖网过程的推断与预测
records.abstract_en: This paper develops likelihood-based methods for estimation, inference, model selection, and forecasting of continuous-time integer-valued trawl processes. The full likelihood of integer-valued trawl processes is, in general, highly intractable, motivating the use of composite likelihood methods, where we consider the pairwise likelihood in lieu of the full likelihood. Maximizing the pairwise likelihood of the data yields an estimator of the parameter vector of the model, and we prove consistency and, in the short memory case, asymptotic normality of this estimator. When the underlying trawl process has long memory, the asymptotic behaviour of the estimator is more involved; we present some partial results for this case. The pairwise approach further allows us to develop probabilistic forecasting methods, which can be used to construct the predictive distribution of integer-valued time series. In a simulation study, we document the good finite sample performance of the likelihood-based estimator and the associated model selection procedure. Lastly, the methods are illustrated in an application to modelling and forecasting financial bid–ask spread data, where we find that it is beneficial to carefully model both the marginal distribution and the autocorrelation structure of the data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了基于似然的方法，用于连续时间整数值拖网过程的估计、推断、模型选择和预测。整数值拖网过程的完全似然通常高度难以处理，这促使使用复合似然方法，其中我们考虑用成对似然代替完全似然。最大化数据的成对似然得到模型参数向量的估计量，我们证明了该估计量的一致性，并在短记忆情形下证明了其渐近正态性。当底层拖网过程具有长记忆时，估计量的渐近行为更为复杂；我们对此情形给出了一些部分结果。成对方法进一步使我们能够开发概率预测方法，可用于构建整数值时间序列的预测分布。在模拟研究中，我们记录了基于似然的估计量和相关模型选择过程良好的有限样本性能。最后，这些方法在金融买卖价差数据的建模和预测应用中得到了说明，我们发现仔细建模数据的边际分布和自相关结构是有益的。

records.title_en: Dynamic discrete choice models with incomplete data: Sharp identification
records.title_cn: 数据不完整的动态离散选择模型：锐化识别
records.abstract_en: In many empirical studies, those states that are relevant for forward-looking economic agents to make decisions may not be included in the data to which researchers have access. This problem often arises in the context of declining/booming industries. In this paper, we develop the sharp identified sets of structural parameters and counterfactuals for dynamic discrete choice models when empirical data do not cover realizations of relevant future states. Applying the proposed method to the annual Toyo Keizai database, we study the behaviors of Japanese firms on foreign direct investments in China without observing the future states after Chinese economy slows down.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多实证研究中，那些对前瞻性经济主体做出决策至关重要的状态可能并未包含在研究人员可获得的数据中。这一问题在衰退/繁荣行业中经常出现。在本文中，我们开发了当经验数据未涵盖相关未来状态的实现时，动态离散选择模型的结构参数和反事实的锐化识别集。将所提出的方法应用于年度东洋经济数据库，我们研究了日本企业在中国经济放缓后未观察未来状态的情况下对中国直接投资的决策行为。

records.title_en: High dimensional semiparametric moment restriction models
records.title_cn: 高维半参数矩限制模型
records.abstract_en: We consider nonlinear moment restriction semiparametric models where both the dimension of the parameter vector and the number of restrictions are divergent with sample size and an unknown smooth function is involved. We propose an estimation method based on the sieve generalized method of moments (sieve-GMM). We establish consistency and asymptotic normality for the estimated quantities when the number of parameters increases modestly with sample size. We also consider the case where the number of potential parameters/covariates is very large, i.e., increases rapidly with sample size, but the true model exhibits sparsity. We use a penalized sieve GMM approach to select the relevant variables, and establish the oracle property of our method in this case. We also provide new results for inference. We propose several new test statistics for the over-identification and establish their large sample properties. We provide a simulation study and an application to data from the NLSY79 used by Carneiro et al. (2011).
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑非线性矩限制半参数模型，其中参数向量的维度和限制的数量都随样本量发散，并且涉及一个未知的光滑函数。我们提出了一种基于筛广义矩方法（sieve-GMM）的估计方法。当参数数量随样本量适度增加时，我们建立了估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。我们还考虑了潜在参数/协变量数量非常大的情况，即随样本量迅速增加，但真实模型表现出稀疏性。我们使用惩罚筛GMM方法来选择相关变量，并在这种情况下建立了我们方法的预言性质。我们还为推断提供了新的结果。我们提出了几个新的过度识别检验统计量，并建立了它们的大样本性质。我们提供了一个模拟研究，并将其应用于Carneiro等人（2011）使用的NLSY79数据。

records.title_en: Modeling realized covariance measures with heterogeneous liquidity: A generalized matrix-variate Wishart state-space model
records.title_cn: 具有异质性流动性的已实现协方差度量建模：广义矩阵变量Wishart状态空间模型
records.abstract_en: We propose to generalize the Wishart state-space model for realized covariance matrices of asset returns in order to capture complex measurement error structures induced by modern robust and data efficient realized covariance estimators and heterogeneous liquidity across assets. Our model assumes that the latent covariance matrix of the assets is observed through their realized covariance matrix with a Riesz measurement density, which generalizes the Wishart to monotone missing data. The Riesz alleviates the Wishart-implied attenuation of measurement errors and translates into a convenient likelihood factorization which facilitates inference using simple Bayesian MCMC procedures. The state-space approach allows for a flexible description of the covariance dynamics implied by the data and an empirical application shows that the model performs very well in- and out-of-sample.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出推广针对资产收益已实现协方差矩阵的Wishart状态空间模型，以捕捉由现代稳健且数据高效的已实现协方差估计量和资产间异质性流动性所引发的复杂测量误差结构。我们的模型假设资产的潜在协方差矩阵通过其已实现协方差矩阵观测，并具有Riesz测量密度，该密度将Wishart推广至单调缺失数据情形。Riesz缓解了Wishart隐含的测量误差衰减，并转化为便利的似然分解，从而便于使用简单的贝叶斯MCMC程序进行推断。状态空间方法允许对数据隐含的协方差动态进行灵活描述，实证应用表明该模型在样本内和样本外均表现良好。

records.title_en: Nowcasting in a pandemic using non-parametric mixed frequency VARs
records.title_cn: 疫情期间使用非参数混合频率VAR进行即时预测
records.abstract_en: This paper develops Bayesian econometric methods for posterior inference in non-parametric mixed frequency VARs using additive regression trees. We argue that regression tree models are ideally suited for macroeconomic nowcasting in the face of extreme observations, for instance those produced by the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020. This is due to their flexibility and ability to model outliers. In an application involving four major euro area countries, we find substantial improvements in nowcasting performance relative to a linear mixed frequency VAR.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了使用加法回归树进行非参数混合频率VAR后验推断的贝叶斯计量经济学方法。我们认为，回归树模型非常适合在极端观测值（例如2020年COVID-19疫情产生的观测值）面前进行宏观经济即时预测，这得益于其灵活性和对异常值的建模能力。在一项涉及四个主要欧元区国家的应用中，我们发现相对于线性混合频率VAR，即时预测性能有了显著提升。

records.title_en: Beta observation-driven models with exogenous regressors: A joint analysis of realized correlation and leverage effects
records.title_cn: 带有外生回归变量的Beta观测驱动模型：实现相关性与杠杆效应的联合分析
records.abstract_en: We consider a general class of observation-driven models with exogenous regressors for double bounded data that are based on the beta distribution. We obtain a stationary and ergodic beta observation-driven process subject to a contraction condition on the stochastic dynamic model equation. We derive conditions for strong consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator. The general results are used to study the properties of a beta autoregressive process with threshold effects and to establish the asymptotic properties of the maximum likelihood estimator. We employ beta autoregressive models to describe leverage effects in realized correlations for several pairs of stocks. We find that the impact of past values of realized correlation on future values is significantly higher when stock or market returns are negative rather than positive. The results also indicate that the size of the leverage depends on the magnitude of the market news as measured by daily market returns. These findings support the conjecture that correlation between stock returns tends to be higher when stock prices are falling, and lower when there is a surge in stock prices. Finally, we conduct an out-of-sample study that shows that the models with leverage effects can enhance the accuracy of point and density forecasts of realized correlations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一类基于Beta分布的、适用于双有界数据的、带有外生回归变量的观测驱动模型的一般类别。在随机动态模型方程的收缩条件下，我们获得了一个平稳且遍历的Beta观测驱动过程。我们推导了极大似然估计强一致性和渐近正态性的条件。一般结果被用于研究具有阈值效应的Beta自回归过程的性质，并建立极大似然估计的渐近性质。我们采用Beta自回归模型来描述几对股票实现相关性中的杠杆效应。我们发现，当股票或市场收益为负而非正时，实现相关性的过去值对未来值的影响显著更高。结果还表明，杠杆的大小取决于以每日市场收益衡量的市场新闻的幅度。这些发现支持了股票收益之间的相关性在股价下跌时往往更高，而在股价飙升时更低的猜想。最后，我们进行了一项样本外研究，表明带有杠杆效应的模型可以提高实现相关性的点预测和密度预测的准确性。

records.title_en: Maximum likelihood estimation of stochastic frontier models with endogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有内生性的随机前沿模型的最大似然估计
records.abstract_en: We propose and study a maximum likelihood estimator of stochastic frontier models with endogeneity in cross-section data when the composite error term may be correlated with inputs and environmental variables. Our framework is a generalization of the normal half-normal stochastic frontier model with endogeneity. We derive the likelihood function in closed form using three fundamental assumptions: the existence of control functions that fully capture the dependence between regressors and unobservables; the conditional independence of the two error components given the control functions; and the conditional distribution of the stochastic inefficiency term given the control functions being a folded normal distribution. We also provide a Battese–Coelli estimator of technical efficiency. Our estimator is computationally fast and easy to implement. We present some of its asymptotic properties, and we showcase its finite sample behavior in Monte-Carlo simulations and an empirical application to farmers in Nepal.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出并研究了一种在横截面数据中具有内生性的随机前沿模型的最大似然估计器，此时复合误差项可能与投入和环境变量相关。我们的框架是带有内生性的正态半正态随机前沿模型的一种推广。我们利用三个基本假设以闭式形式推导出似然函数：存在完全捕捉回归量与不可观测变量之间依赖关系的控制函数；给定控制函数时两个误差分量的条件独立性；以及给定控制函数时随机无效率项的条件分布为折叠正态分布。我们还提供了技术效率的Battese–Coelli估计量。我们的估计量计算速度快且易于实现。我们展示了其一些渐近性质，并在蒙特卡洛模拟和针对尼泊尔农民的经验应用中展示了其有限样本行为。

records.title_en: Shrinkage estimation of network spillovers with factor structured errors
records.title_cn: 因子结构误差下网络溢出效应的收缩估计
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the estimation of a panel data model with cross-sectional interaction that is flexible both in its approach to specifying the network of connections between cross-sectional units, and in controlling for unobserved heterogeneity. It is assumed that there are different sources of information available on a network, which can be represented in the form of multiple weights matrices. These matrices may reflect observed links, different measures of connectivity, groupings or other network structures, and the number of matrices may be increasing with sample size. A penalised quasi-maximum likelihood estimator is proposed which aims to alleviate the risk of network misspecification by shrinking the coefficients of irrelevant weights matrices to exactly zero. Moreover, controlling for unobserved factors in estimation provides a safeguard against the misspecification that might arise from unobserved heterogeneity. The asymptotic properties of the estimator are derived in a framework where the true value of each parameter remains fixed as the total number of parameters increases. A Monte Carlo simulation is used to assess finite sample performance, and in an empirical application the method is applied to study the prevalence of network spillovers in determining growth rates across countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了具有横截面交互作用的面板数据模型的估计，该模型在设定横截面单元之间的网络连接方式以及控制未观测异质性方面均具有灵活性。假设存在关于网络的不同信息来源，这些信息可以以多个权重矩阵的形式表示。这些矩阵可能反映观测到的联系、不同的连通性度量、分组或其他网络结构，且矩阵的数量可能随样本量增加而增加。本文提出了一种惩罚拟极大似然估计器，旨在通过将无关权重矩阵的系数收缩至精确为零来减轻网络误设的风险。此外，在估计中控制未观测因子为可能由未观测异质性引起的误设提供了保障。在总参数数量增加而每个参数真实值保持固定的框架下，推导了该估计量的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估有限样本性能，并在一个实证应用中，将该方法用于研究网络溢出效应在决定各国增长率中的普遍性。

records.title_en: Establishment age and wages
records.title_cn: 企业年龄与工资
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between establishment age and wages. A key challenge is that new establishments differ from mature establishments along many dimensions due to non-random survival of establishments. Furthermore, worker composition changes as establishments age. To get around this, the paper uses linked employer–employee data from Germany and estimates the establishment age–wage relationship controlling for establishment and worker fixed effects and focuses on starting wages of workers. I show a striking pattern: starting wages in new establishments are 9 percent higher than in mature establishments (older than 20 years). I also report evidence that this difference is not driven by differences in hours, compensation for unemployment risk or slower future wage growth. Instead, I show that the difference is driven by, on average, high growth rates in new establishments as would be predicted by monopsonistic search models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业年龄与工资之间的关系。一个关键挑战是，由于企业存活的非随机性，新企业在许多方面与成熟企业存在差异。此外，随着企业年龄的增长，工人构成也会发生变化。为了解决这一问题，本文使用了来自德国的关联雇主-雇员数据，并在控制企业和工人固定效应的基础上估计了企业年龄-工资关系，重点关注工人的起始工资。我展示了一个显著的模式：新企业的起始工资比成熟企业（年龄超过20年）高出9%。我还报告了证据表明，这种差异并非由工时差异、失业风险补偿或未来工资增长放缓所驱动。相反，我表明这种差异是由新企业平均较高的增长率所驱动的，这与垄断性搜寻模型的预测一致。

records.title_en: Identifying treatment effects in the presence of confounded types
records.title_cn: 在存在混杂类型的情况下识别处理效应
records.abstract_en: In this paper, I consider identification of treatment effects when the treatment is endogenous. The use of instrumental variables is a popular solution to deal with endogeneity, but this may give misleading answers when the instrument is invalid. I show that when an (unobserved) instrument is invalid due to correlation with the first stage unobserved heterogeneity, a proxy for the instrument helps partially identify not only the local average treatment effect, but also the entire potential outcomes distributions for compliers. I exploit the fact that the distribution of the observed outcome in each group defined by the treatment and the instrument is a mixture of the distributions of interest. I write the identified set in the form of conditional moment inequalities, and provide an easily implementable inference procedure. Under some tail restrictions, the potential outcomes distributions are point-identified for compliers. Finally, I illustrate my methodology on data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Young Men to estimate returns to college using college proximity as a proxy for the instrument low college cost. I find that a college degree increases the average hourly wage of the compliers by 15%–30%.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我考虑了当处理变量是内生的时候处理效应的识别问题。使用工具变量是处理内生性的一种流行解决方案，但当工具无效时，这可能会给出误导性的答案。我表明，当一个（未观测的）工具由于与第一阶段未观测异质性相关而无效时，该工具的一个代理变量有助于部分识别不仅局部平均处理效应，而且还有助于识别依从者的整个潜在结果分布。我利用了这样一个事实：由处理变量和工具定义的每个组中观测结果的分布是感兴趣分布的混合。我将识别集写成条件矩不等式的形式，并提供了一种易于实施的推断程序。在一些尾部限制下，依从者的潜在结果分布可以被点识别。最后，我将我的方法应用于全国年轻男性纵向调查的数据，以使用大学 proximity 作为低大学成本工具的代理来估计大学教育的回报。我发现大学学位使依从者的平均小时工资增加了 15%–30%。

records.title_en: A solution to the global identification problem in DSGE models
records.title_cn: DSGE模型中全局识别问题的一个解决方案
records.abstract_en: We develop an analytical framework to study global identification in structural models with forward-looking expectations. Our identification condition combines the similarity transformation linking the observationally equivalent state space systems with the constraints imposed on them by the model parameters. The key step of solving the identification problem then reduces to finding all roots of a system of polynomial equations. We show how it can be done using the concept of a Gröbner basis and recently developed algorithms to compute it analytically. In contrast to frameworks relying on numerical search, our approach can prove whether a model is identified or not at a given parameter point, explicitly delivering the complete set of observationally equivalent parameter vectors. We present the solution to the global identification problem for several popular dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个分析框架来研究具有前瞻性预期的结构模型中的全局识别。我们的识别条件结合了连接观测等价的状态空间系统的相似变换以及模型参数对其施加的约束。解决识别问题的关键步骤因此简化为找到多项式方程系统的所有根。我们展示了如何使用Gröbner基的概念以及最近开发的算法来解析地计算它。与依赖数值搜索的框架相比，我们的方法可以证明在给定参数点上模型是否被识别，并明确给出完整的观测等价的参数向量集合。我们为几个流行的动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型提供了全局识别问题的解决方案。

records.title_en: Identification-robust beta pricing, spanning, mimicking portfolios, and the benchmark neutrality of catastrophe bonds
records.title_cn: 识别稳健的贝塔定价、跨越、模拟投资组合以及巨灾债券的基准中性
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes inference strategies for conditional and unconditional asset pricing models, which cover beta pricing, the zero-beta rate, risk prices, Jensen’s alphas, mean–variance spanning and intersection. We derive analytical conditions that link the identification of the zero-beta rate to spanning. Following finite-sample statistical considerations, the proposed procedures correct for measurement error with mimicking portfolios, and are invariant to fund repacking as well as and robust to: (i) missing factors, (ii) identification of risk price, and (iii) the quality of conditioning information. Empirically, we study benchmark neutrality of Catastrophe bond mutual funds. Results show that potential for diversification is significant before the 2008 financial crisis, yet lack support thereafter.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了条件和无条件资产定价模型的推断策略，涵盖贝塔定价、零贝塔利率、风险价格、詹森阿尔法、均值-方差跨越和交集。我们推导了将零贝塔利率的识别与跨越联系起来分析条件。遵循有限样本统计考虑，所提出的程序通过模拟投资组合纠正测量误差，并且对基金重新打包具有不变性，同时对以下方面具有稳健性：（i）缺失因子，（ii）风险价格的识别，以及（iii）条件信息的质量。实证上，我们研究了巨灾债券共同基金的基准中性。结果表明，在2008年金融危机之前，分散化的潜力显著，但此后缺乏支持。

records.title_en: Second-order refinements for t-ratios with many instruments
records.title_cn: 多工具变量下t比率的二阶修正
records.abstract_en: This paper studies second-order properties of the many instruments robust t-ratios based on the limited information maximum likelihood and Fuller estimators for instrumental variable regression models with homoskedastic errors under the many instruments asymptotics, where the number of instruments may increase proportionally with the sample size n, and proposes second-order refinements to the t-ratios to improve the size and power properties. Based on asymptotic expansions of the null and non-null distributions of the t-ratios derived under the many instruments asymptotics, we show that the second-order terms of those expansions may have non-trivial impacts on the size as well as the power properties. Furthermore, we propose adjusted t-ratios whose approximation errors for the null rejection probabilities are of order O(n−1) in contrast to the ones for the unadjusted t-ratios of order O(n−1/2), and show that these adjustments induce some desirable power properties in terms of the local maximinity. Although these results are derived under homoskedastic errors, we also establish a stochastic expansion for a heteroskedasticity robust t-ratio, and propose an analogous adjustment under slight deviations from homoskedasticity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在工具变量回归模型中，当工具变量数量可能随样本量n成比例增加时，基于有限信息最大似然和Fuller估计量的多工具变量稳健t比率的二阶性质，并提出了t比率的二阶修正以改善其规模和功效性质。基于在多工具变量渐近下推导的t比率零分布和非零分布的渐近展开，我们表明这些展开的二阶项可能对规模和功效性质产生非平凡影响。此外，我们提出了调整后的t比率，其零拒绝概率的近似误差阶为O(n−1)，而未调整的t比率的误差阶为O(n−1/2)，并表明这些调整在局部最大最小性方面带来了一些理想的功效性质。尽管这些结果是在同方差误差下推导的，我们也建立了异方差稳健t比率的随机展开，并提出了在同方差性轻微偏离下的类似调整。

records.title_en: A higher-order correct fast moving-average bootstrap for dependent data
records.title_cn: 相依数据的高阶正确快速移动平均自助法
records.abstract_en: We develop the theory of a novel fast bootstrap for dependent data. Our scheme deploys i.i.d. resampling of smoothed moment indicators. We characterize the class of parametric and semiparametric estimation problems for which the method is valid. We show the asymptotic refinements of the new procedure, proving that it is higher-order correct under mild assumptions on the time series, the estimating functions, and the smoothing kernel. We illustrate the applicability and the advantages of our procedure for M-estimation, generalized method of moments, and generalized empirical likelihood estimation. In a Monte Carlo study, we consider an autoregressive conditional duration model and we compare our method with other extant, routinely-applied first- and higher-order correct methods. The results provide numerical evidence that the novel bootstrap yields higher-order accurate confidence intervals, while remaining computationally lighter than its higher-order correct competitors. A real-data example on dynamics of trading volume of US stocks illustrates the empirical relevance of our method.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发展了针对相依数据的一种新颖快速自助法的理论。我们的方案采用对平滑矩指标的独立同分布重抽样。我们刻画了该方法有效的参数和半参数估计问题类别。我们证明了新过程的渐近改进，表明在时间序列、估计函数和平滑核的温和假设下，它是高阶正确的。我们展示了我们的程序在M估计、广义矩方法和广义经验似然估计中的适用性和优势。在蒙特卡洛研究中，我们考虑了一个自回归条件持续时间模型，并将我们的方法与其他现存的、常规应用的一阶和高阶正确方法进行了比较。结果提供了数值证据，表明新颖的自助法产生高阶精确的置信区间，同时计算上比其高阶正确的竞争者更轻量。一个关于美国股票交易量动态的真实数据示例说明了我们方法的实证相关性。

records.title_en: How to go viral: A COVID-19 model with endogenously time-varying parameters
records.title_cn: 如何走红：一个具有内生时变参数的COVID-19模型
records.abstract_en: We estimate a panel model with endogenously time-varying parameters for COVID-19 cases and deaths in U.S. states. The functional form for infections incorporates important features of epidemiological models but is flexibly parameterized to capture different trajectories of the pandemic. Daily deaths are modeled as a spike-and-slab regression on lagged cases. Our Bayesian estimation reveals that social distancing and testing have significant effects on the parameters. For example, a 10 percentage point increase in the positive test rate is associated with a 2 percentage point increase in the death rate among reported cases. The model forecasts perform well, even relative to models from epidemiology and statistics.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一个针对美国各州COVID-19病例和死亡人数的内生时变参数面板模型。感染数的函数形式包含了流行病学模型的重要特征，但通过灵活参数化以捕捉大流行的不同轨迹。每日死亡数被建模为对滞后病例数的尖峰-平板回归。我们的贝叶斯估计显示，社交距离和检测对参数有显著影响。例如，阳性检测率增加10个百分点与报告病例中死亡率增加2个百分点相关。该模型的预测表现良好，甚至相对于流行病学和统计学的模型也是如此。

records.title_en: Comparing forecasting performance in cross-sections
records.title_cn: 横截面数据中预测绩效的比较
records.abstract_en: This paper develops new methods for pairwise comparisons of predictive accuracy with cross-sectional data. Using a common factor setup, we establish conditions on cross-sectional dependencies in forecast errors which allow us to test the null of equal predictive accuracy on a single cross-section of forecasts. We consider both unconditional tests of equal predictive accuracy as well as tests that condition on the realization of common factors and show how to decompose forecast errors into exposures to common factors and idiosyncratic components. An empirical application compares the predictive accuracy of financial analysts’ short-term earnings forecasts across six brokerage firms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了用于横截面数据预测准确性成对比较的新方法。利用共同因子设定，我们建立了预测误差中横截面依赖的条件，这些条件允许我们在单一预测横截面上检验等预测准确性的原假设。我们既考虑了等预测准确性的无条件检验，也考虑了以共同因子实现为条件的检验，并展示了如何将预测误差分解为对共同因子的暴露和特质成分。一项实证应用比较了六家经纪公司金融分析师短期盈利预测的预测准确性。

records.title_en: Irregular identification of structural models with nonparametric unobserved heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有非参数不可观测异质性的结构模型的不规则识别
records.abstract_en: One of the most important empirical findings in microeconometrics is the pervasiveness of heterogeneity in economic behavior (cf. Heckman, 2001). This paper shows that cumulative distribution functions and quantiles of the nonparametric unobserved heterogeneity have an infinite efficiency bound in many structural economic models of interest. The paper presents general and precise conditions to prove such results. The usefulness of the theory is demonstrated with several relevant examples in economics, including, among others, the proportion of individuals with severe long term unemployment duration, Average Marginal Effects (AME) in a correlated random coefficient model without monotonicity, and the distribution and quantiles of random coefficients in linear, binary and the popular semiparametric Mixed Logit model.
records.abstract_cn: 微观计量经济学中最重要的实证发现之一是经济行为中异质性的普遍存在（参见Heckman，2001）。本文表明，在许多感兴趣的结构经济模型中，非参数不可观测异质性的累积分布函数和分位数具有无限效率界。本文提出了证明此类结果的一般且精确的条件。该理论的实用性通过经济学中的几个相关例子得到证明，其中包括严重长期失业持续时间个体的比例、无单调性的相关随机系数模型中的平均边际效应（AME），以及线性、二元和流行的半参数混合Logit模型中随机系数的分布和分位数。

records.title_en: A test for Kronecker Product Structure covariance matrix
records.title_cn: 克罗内克积结构协方差矩阵的检验
records.abstract_en: We propose a test for a covariance matrix to have Kronecker Product Structure (KPS). KPS implies a reduced rank restriction on a certain transformation of the covariance matrix and the new procedure is an adaptation of the Kleibergen and Paap (2006) reduced rank test. To derive the limiting distribution of the Wald type test statistic proves challenging partly because of the singularity of the covariance matrix estimator that appears in the weighting matrix. We show that the test statistic has a χ2 limiting null distribution with degrees of freedom equal to the number of restrictions tested. Local asymptotic power results are derived. Monte Carlo simulations reveal good size and power properties of the test. Re-examining fifteen highly cited papers conducting instrumental variable regressions, we find that KPS is not rejected in 56 out of 118 specifications at the 5% nominal size.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种检验协方差矩阵是否具有克罗内克积结构（KPS）的方法。KPS意味着协方差矩阵的某种变换存在降秩限制，新程序是对Kleibergen和Paap（2006）降秩检验的改编。推导Wald型检验统计量的极限分布具有挑战性，部分原因是权重矩阵中出现的协方差矩阵估计量的奇异性。我们证明该检验统计量具有χ2极限零分布，自由度等于所检验的限制数量。推导了局部渐近功效结果。蒙特卡洛模拟揭示了该检验良好的大小和功效性质。重新审视十五篇进行工具变量回归的高被引论文，我们发现KPS在118个规范中的56个中在5%名义大小下未被拒绝。

records.title_en: Twisting the demand curve: Digitalization and the older workforce
records.title_cn: 扭转需求曲线：数字化与老年劳动力
records.abstract_en: Software represents a major and fast-growing share of firms’ capital investment, impacting demand for labor and what workers do on their jobs. Using U.S. Census Bureau panel data that link firms and workers, this paper estimates the effect of firm software capital on the earnings of workers by age group. We extend the AKM framework to include job-spell fixed effects that account for potential correlation between the worker–firm match and employee age, as well as including time-varying firm effects that allow for a correlation between wage-enhancing productivity shocks and software investments. Within job-spell, capitalized software investment raises worker earnings. However, it does so at a rate that declines after the age of 50, to about zero beyond 65. Our data further show that software capital increases the earnings of high-wage workers relative to low-wage workers and earnings in high-wage firms relative to low-wage firms, thereby widening earnings inequality within and across firms.
records.abstract_cn: 软件在企业资本投资中占据主要且快速增长份额，影响劳动力需求及员工工作内容。利用美国人口普查局连接企业与工人的面板数据，本文估计了企业软件资本对不同年龄段工人收入的影响。我们将AKM框架扩展至包含工作期固定效应，以考虑工人-企业匹配与员工年龄之间的潜在相关性，同时纳入时变企业效应，允许工资提升的生产率冲击与软件投资之间存在相关性。在工作期内，资本化软件投资提高了工人收入。然而，其提升幅度在50岁后递减，至65岁后趋近于零。我们的数据进一步显示，软件资本提高了高工资工人相对于低工资工人的收入，以及高工资企业相对于低工资企业的收入，从而扩大了企业内及企业间的收入不平等。

records.title_en: Forward-selected panel data approach for program evaluation
records.title_cn: 项目评估的前向选择面板数据方法
records.abstract_en: Policy evaluation is central to economic data analysis, but economists mostly work with observational data in view of limited opportunities to carry out controlled experiments. In the potential outcome framework, the panel data approach (Hsiao et al., 2012) constructs the counterfactual by exploiting the correlation between cross-sectional units in panel data. The choice of cross-sectional control units, a key step in its implementation, is nevertheless unresolved in data-rich environments when many possible controls are at the researcher’s disposal. We propose the forward selection method to choose control units, and establish validity of the post-selection inference. Our asymptotic framework allows the number of possible controls to grow much faster than the time dimension. The easy-to-implement algorithms and their theoretical guarantee extend the panel data approach to big data settings.
records.abstract_cn: 政策评估是经济数据分析的核心，但由于进行受控实验的机会有限，经济学家大多使用观测数据。在潜在结果框架下，面板数据方法（Hsiao等，2012）通过利用面板数据中横截面单元之间的相关性来构造反事实。然而，在数据丰富的环境中，当研究者可用的可能控制变量很多时，横截面控制单元的选择——这一实施中的关键步骤——仍未得到解决。我们提出了前向选择方法来选择控制单元，并建立了选择后推断的有效性。我们的渐近框架允许可能控制变量的数量远快于时间维度增长。易于实现的算法及其理论保证将面板数据方法扩展到大数据环境。

records.title_en: When will Arctic sea ice disappear? Projections of area, extent, thickness, and volume
records.title_cn: 北极海冰何时消失？面积、范围、厚度和体积的预测
records.abstract_en: Rapidly diminishing Arctic summer sea ice is a strong signal of the pace of global climate change. We provide point, interval, and density forecasts for four measures of Arctic sea ice: area, extent, thickness, and volume. Importantly, we enforce the joint constraint that these measures must simultaneously arrive at an ice-free Arctic. We apply this constrained joint forecast procedure to models relating sea ice to atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration and models relating sea ice directly to time. The resulting “carbon-trend” and “time-trend” projections are mutually consistent and predict a nearly ice-free summer Arctic Ocean by the mid-2030s with an 80% probability. Moreover, the carbon-trend projections show that global adoption of a lower carbon path would likely delay the arrival of a seasonally ice-free Arctic by only a few years.
records.abstract_cn: 北极夏季海冰的迅速减少是全球气候变化速度的一个强烈信号。我们针对北极海冰的四个指标提供了点预测、区间预测和密度预测：面积、范围、厚度和体积。重要的是，我们强制执行联合约束，即这些指标必须同时达到无冰北极的状态。我们将这种受约束的联合预测程序应用于将海冰与大气二氧化碳浓度相关联的模型以及将海冰直接与时间相关联的模型。由此产生的“碳趋势”和“时间趋势”预测相互一致，并预测到2030年代中期，北极夏季海洋几乎无冰的概率为80%。此外，碳趋势预测表明，全球采用较低碳路径可能只会将季节性无冰北极的到来推迟几年。

records.title_en: Semiparametric estimation of latent variable asset pricing models
records.title_cn: 潜变量资产定价模型的半参数估计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies semiparametric identification and estimation of consumption-based asset pricing models with latent state variables. First, we measure how consumption, dividends, and prices depend on Markovian state variables describing aggregate output growth. Subsequently, we identify state-dependent components in the stochastic discount factor using the Euler equation. We develop tractable algorithms for filtering, smoothing, and sieve maximum likelihood estimation, and establish its consistency. Empirically, we find sizable nonlinearities in the impact of expected growth and volatility on the price–dividend ratio and discount factor.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有潜在状态变量的消费型资产定价模型的半参数识别与估计。首先，我们衡量消费、股息和价格如何依赖于描述总产出增长的马尔可夫状态变量。随后，我们利用欧拉方程识别随机贴现因子中的状态依赖成分。我们开发了用于滤波、平滑和筛极大似然估计的易处理算法，并建立了其一致性。实证上，我们发现预期增长和波动率对价格-股息比率和贴现因子的影响存在显著的非线性。

records.title_en: Smoothed quantile regression with large-scale inference
records.title_cn: 平滑分位数回归与大尺度推断
records.abstract_en: Quantile regression is a powerful tool for learning the relationship between a response variable and a multivariate predictor while exploring heterogeneous effects. This paper focuses on statistical inference for quantile regression in the “increasing dimension” regime. We provide a comprehensive analysis of a convolution smoothed approach that achieves adequate approximation to computation and inference for quantile regression. This method, which we refer to as conquer, turns the non-differentiable check function into a twice-differentiable, convex and locally strongly convex surrogate, which admits fast and scalable gradient-based algorithms to perform optimization, and multiplier bootstrap for statistical inference. Theoretically, we establish explicit non-asymptotic bounds on estimation and Bahadur–Kiefer linearization errors, from which we show that the asymptotic normality of the conquer estimator holds under a weaker requirement on dimensionality than needed for conventional quantile regression. The validity of multiplier bootstrap is also provided. Numerical studies confirm conquer as a practical and reliable approach to large-scale inference for quantile regression. Software implementing the methodology is available in the R package conquer.
records.abstract_cn: 分位数回归是学习响应变量与多元预测变量之间关系并探索异质性效应的强大工具。本文关注“递增维度”情形下分位数回归的统计推断。我们针对一种卷积平滑方法提供了全面分析，该方法能够充分逼近分位数回归的计算与推断。这一方法，我们称之为conquer，将不可微的检查函数转化为二次可微、凸且局部强凸的替代函数，从而允许使用快速且可扩展的基于梯度的算法进行优化，以及使用乘子自助法进行统计推断。理论上，我们建立了估计误差和Bahadur–Kiefer线性化误差的显式非渐近界，由此表明conquer估计量的渐近正态性在比传统分位数回归所需维度更弱的条件下成立。同时提供了乘子自助法的有效性证明。数值研究证实conquer是分位数回归大尺度推断的一种实用且可靠的方法。实现该方法的软件可在R包conquer中获得。

records.title_en: On the power of the conditional likelihood ratio and related tests for weak-instrument robust inference
records.title_cn: 关于条件似然比及其相关检验在弱工具变量稳健推断中的功效
records.abstract_en: Power curves of the Conditional Likelihood Ratio (CLR) and related tests for testing H0:β=β0 in linear models with a single endogenous variable, y=xβ+u, estimated using potentially weak instrumental variables have been presented for two different designs. One design keeps the variance matrix of the structural and first-stage errors, Σ, constant, the other instead keeps the variance matrix of the reduced-form and first-stage errors, Ω, constant. The values of Σ govern the endogeneity features of the model. The fixed-Ω design changes these endogeneity features with changing values of β in a way that makes it less suitable for an analysis of the behaviour of the tests in low to moderate endogeneity settings, or when β and the correlation of the structural and first-stage errors, ρuv, have the same sign. At larger values of |β|, the fixed-Ω design implicitly selects values for Σ where the power of the CLR test is high. We further show that the Likelihood Ratio statistic is identical to the t0(βˆL)2 statistic as proposed by Mills et al. (2014), where βˆL is the Liml estimator. In fixed-Σ design Monte Carlo simulations, we find that Liml- and Fuller-based conditional Wald tests and the Fuller-based conditional t02 test are more powerful than the CLR test when the degree of endogeneity is low to moderate. The conditional Wald tests are further the most powerful of these tests when β and ρuv have the same sign. We show that in the fixed-Ω design, setting β0=0 and the diagonal elements of Ω equal to 1 is not without loss of generality, unlike in the fixed-Σ design.
records.abstract_cn: 条件似然比（CLR）检验及相关检验在检验线性模型中单一内生变量y=xβ+u的假设H0:β=β0时的功效曲线，已在两种不同设计下给出，其中模型使用潜在弱工具变量进行估计。一种设计保持结构方程和第一阶段误差的方差矩阵Σ恒定，另一种设计则保持简化形式和第一阶段误差的方差矩阵Ω恒定。Σ的值决定了模型的内生性特征。固定Ω的设计在β值变化时会改变这些内生性特征，这种方式使其不太适合分析在低至中度内生性设置下检验的行为，或当β与结构方程和第一阶段误差的相关系数ρuv同号时的情况。在|β|值较大时，固定Ω的设计隐式选择了Σ的值，使得CLR检验的功效较高。我们进一步证明，似然比统计量与Mills等人（2014）提出的t0(βˆL)2统计量相同，其中βˆL是Liml估计量。在固定Σ设计的蒙特卡洛模拟中，我们发现当内生性程度低至中度时，基于Liml和Fuller的条件Wald检验以及基于Fuller的条件t02检验比CLR检验更具功效。当β与ρuv同号时，条件Wald检验在这些检验中功效最高。我们证明，在固定Ω设计中，设置β0=0且Ω的对角元素等于1并非不失一般性，这与固定Σ设计不同。

records.title_en: Nonparametric comparison of epidemic time trends: The case of COVID-19
records.title_cn: 流行病时间趋势的非参数比较：COVID-19的案例
records.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic is one of the most pressing issues at present. A question which is particularly important for governments and policy makers is the following: Does the virus spread in the same way in different countries? Or are there significant differences in the development of the epidemic? In this paper, we devise new inference methods that allow to detect differences in the development of the COVID-19 epidemic across countries in a statistically rigorous way. In our empirical study, we use the methods to compare the outbreak patterns of the epidemic in a number of European countries.
records.abstract_cn: COVID-19大流行是目前最紧迫的问题之一。对政府和政策制定者来说，一个特别重要的问题是：病毒在不同国家的传播方式是否相同？或者疫情的发展是否存在显著差异？在本文中，我们设计了新的推断方法，能够以统计上严谨的方式检测各国COVID-19疫情发展的差异。在我们的实证研究中，我们使用这些方法比较了多个欧洲国家疫情的爆发模式。

records.title_en: Evaluating forecast performance with state dependence
records.title_cn: 评估具有状态依赖性的预测绩效
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel forecast evaluation methodology to assess models’ absolute and relative forecasting performance when it is a state-dependent function of economic variables. In our framework, the forecasting performance, measured by a forecast error loss function, is modeled via a hard or smooth threshold model with unknown threshold values. Existing tests either assume a constant out-of-sample forecast performance or use non-parametric techniques robust to time-variation; consequently, they may lack power against a state-dependent performance. Our tests can be applied to relative forecast comparisons, forecast encompassing, forecast efficiency, and, more generally, moment-based tests of forecast evaluation. Monte Carlo results suggest that our proposed tests perform well in finite samples and have better power than existing tests in selecting the best forecast or assessing its efficiency in the presence of state dependence. Our tests uncover “pockets of predictability” in U.S. equity premia; although the term spread is not a useful predictor on average over the sample, it forecasts significantly better than the benchmark forecast when real GDP growth is low. In addition, we find that leading indicators, such as measures of vacancy postings and new orders for durable goods, improve the forecasts of U.S. industrial production when financial conditions are tight.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的预测评估方法，用以评估模型在预测绩效作为经济变量的状态依赖函数时的绝对和相对预测绩效。在我们的框架中，预测绩效通过预测误差损失函数来衡量，并采用具有未知阈值的硬或平滑阈值模型进行建模。现有检验要么假设样本外预测绩效恒定，要么使用对时间变化稳健的非参数技术；因此，它们可能对状态依赖的绩效缺乏检验功效。我们的检验可应用于相对预测比较、预测包含、预测效率，以及更一般地，基于矩的预测评估检验。蒙特卡洛结果表明，我们提出的检验在有限样本中表现良好，并且在存在状态依赖时，在选择最佳预测或评估其效率方面比现有检验具有更好的功效。我们的检验揭示了美国股票溢价的“可预测性口袋”；尽管期限利差在样本期间平均而言不是有用的预测因子，但当实际GDP增长较低时，它的预测显著优于基准预测。此外，我们发现领先指标，如职位发布和耐用品新订单的衡量指标，在金融条件紧张时能改善美国工业生产的预测。

records.title_en: Vector copulas
records.title_cn: 向量联结函数
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces vector copulas associated with multivariate distributions with given multivariate marginals, based on the theory of measure transportation, and establishes a vector version of Sklar’s theorem. The latter provides a theoretical justification for the use of vector copulas to characterize nonlinear or rank dependence between a finite number of random vectors (robust to within vector dependence), and to construct multivariate distributions with any given non-overlapping multivariate marginals. We construct Elliptical and Kendall families of vector copulas, derive their densities, and present algorithms to generate data from them. The use of vector copulas is illustrated with a stylized analysis of international financial contagion.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于测度输运理论，引入了与具有给定多元边际分布的多元分布相关联的向量联结函数，并建立了Sklar定理的向量版本。后者为使用向量联结函数来刻画有限个随机向量之间的非线性或秩相关（对向量内部依赖具有稳健性），以及构造具有任意给定非重叠多元边际分布的多元分布提供了理论依据。我们构造了向量联结函数的椭圆族和Kendall族，推导了它们的密度函数，并提出了从它们生成数据的算法。通过一个关于国际金融传染的程式化分析，说明了向量联结函数的应用。

records.title_en: Factor-based imputation of missing values and covariances in panel data of large dimensions
records.title_cn: 基于因子的高维面板数据缺失值与协方差插补
records.abstract_en: Economists are blessed with a wealth of data for analysis, but more often than not, values in some entries of the data matrix are missing. Various methods have been proposed to handle missing observations in a few variables. We exploit the factor structure in panel data of large dimensions. Our tall-project algorithm first estimates the factors from a tall block in which data for all rows are observed, and projections of unit specific sample size are then used to estimate the factor loadings. A missing value is imputed by its estimated common component which we show is consistent and asymptotically normal without further iteration. Implications for using imputed data in factor augmented regressions are then discussed. To compensate for the downward bias in sample covariance matrices created by an omitted noise in each imputed value, we overlay the imputed data with re-sampled idiosyncratic residuals many times and use the average of the covariances to estimate the parameters of interest. Simulations show that the procedures have desirable finite sample properties.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家有幸拥有丰富的数据进行分析，但往往数据矩阵中某些条目的值是缺失的。针对少数变量中的缺失观测，已有多种方法被提出。我们利用大维度面板数据中的因子结构。我们的高块投影算法首先从所有行数据均被观测到的高块中估计因子，然后利用单位特定样本量的投影来估计因子载荷。缺失值通过其估计的共同成分进行插补，我们证明该插补值是一致的且渐近正态的，无需进一步迭代。随后讨论了在因子增强回归中使用插补数据的含义。为了弥补每个插补值中省略噪声导致的样本协方差矩阵向下偏差，我们多次将插补数据与重采样的特质残差叠加，并使用协方差的平均值来估计感兴趣参数。模拟表明，这些程序具有良好的有限样本性质。

records.title_en: Social connections and the sorting of workers to firms
records.title_cn: 社会关系与工人向企业的分类
records.abstract_en: We assess the presumption that social networks reinforce inequality by providing high-wage workers’ with preferential access to high-wage establishments. Our results based on very detailed Swedish register data contradict this view. We do show that high-wage job seekers tend to be connected to high-wage workers employed in high-wage establishments. Furthermore, social connections appear to directly cause the allocation of workers to jobs. But the sorting resulting from hires within social networks is less unequal than the sorting resulting from market hires, essentially because low-wage firms rely on social connections to hire high-wage workers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了社会网络通过为高工资工人提供进入高工资企业的优先途径而加剧不平等的假设。基于非常详细的瑞典登记数据，我们的结果反驳了这一观点。我们确实表明，高工资求职者往往与在高工资企业工作的高工资工人有联系。此外，社会关系似乎直接导致工人向工作的分配。但社会网络内部招聘产生的分类不如市场招聘产生的分类不平等，主要是因为低工资企业依赖社会关系来招聘高工资工人。

records.title_en: Partially identifying competing risks models: An application to the war on cancer
records.title_cn: 部分识别竞争风险模型：应用于抗癌战争
records.abstract_en: Competing risks models for discretely measured durations are partially identifying due to the unknown dependence structure between risks and the discrete nature of the outcome. This article develops a highly tractable bounds approach for underlying distributions of latent durations by exploiting the discreteness. Bounds are obtained from a system of nonlinear (in)equalities. I devise a sequential solution method that requires much less computational burden than existing methods. Asymptotic properties of bound estimators and a simple bootstrap procedure are provided. I apply the proposed approach to re-evaluate trends in cancer mortality extending the data studied in Honoré and Lleras-Muney (2006). Estimated patterns differ from the original findings.
records.abstract_cn: 对于离散测量的持续时间，竞争风险模型由于风险之间未知的依赖结构和结果的离散性质而只能部分识别。本文利用离散性，为潜在持续时间的分布开发了一种高度易处理的界限方法。界限通过一个非线性（不）等式系统获得。我设计了一种顺序求解方法，其计算负担远小于现有方法。提供了界限估计量的渐近性质和一个简单的自助法程序。我将所提出的方法应用于重新评估癌症死亡率的趋势，扩展了Honoré和Lleras-Muney（2006）研究的数据。估计的模式与原始发现不同。

records.title_en: Two-way fixed effects and differences-in-differences estimators with several treatments
records.title_cn: 双向固定效应与多重处理的差分中差分估计量
records.abstract_en: We study two-way-fixed-effects regressions (TWFE) with several treatment variables. Under a parallel trends assumption, we show that the coefficient on each treatment identifies a weighted sum of that treatment’s effect, with possibly negative weights, plus a weighted sum of the effects of the other treatments. Thus, those estimators are not robust to heterogeneous effects and may be contaminated by other treatments’ effects. We further show that omitting a treatment from the regression can actually reduce the estimator’s bias, unlike what would happen under constant treatment effects. We propose an alternative difference-in-differences estimator, robust to heterogeneous effects and immune to the contamination problem. In the application we consider, the TWFE regression identifies a highly non-convex combination of effects, with large contamination weights, and one of its coefficients significantly differs from our heterogeneity-robust estimator.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有多个处理变量的双向固定效应回归（TWFE）。在平行趋势假设下，我们表明每个处理的系数识别了该处理效应的加权和，权重可能为负，再加上其他处理效应的加权和。因此，这些估计量对异质性效应不稳健，并可能受到其他处理效应的污染。我们进一步表明，从回归中省略一个处理实际上可以减少估计量的偏差，这与在恒定处理效应下会发生的情况不同。我们提出了一种替代的差分中差分估计量，它对异质性效应稳健且不受污染问题影响。在我们考虑的应用程序中，TWFE回归识别了一个高度非凸的效应组合，具有较大的污染权重，并且其一个系数显著不同于我们的异质性稳健估计量。

records.title_en: Structural VAR models in the Frequency Domain
records.title_cn: 频域中的结构向量自回归模型
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a joint methodology for the identification and inference of structural vector autoregressive models in the frequency domain. We show that identifying restrictions can be written naturally as an asymptotic least squares problem (Gouriéroux et al., 1985) in which there is a continuum of nonlinear estimating equations. Following Carrasco and Florens (2000), we then propose a continuum asymptotic least squares estimator (C-ALS) that efficiently exploits the continuum of estimating equations, thereby allowing to obtain optimal consistent estimates of impulse responses and reliable confidence intervals. Moreover, the identifying restrictions can be formally tested using an appropriate J-stat, and the frequency band can be selected using a data-driven procedure. Finally, we provide some Monte Carlo simulations and an application regarding the hours–productivity debate.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种在频域中识别和推断结构向量自回归模型的联合方法。我们表明，识别限制可以自然地写成渐近最小二乘问题（Gouriéroux等，1985），其中存在连续统的非线性估计方程。遵循Carrasco和Florens（2000）的方法，我们随后提出了一种连续统渐近最小二乘估计量（C-ALS），该估计量有效利用连续统的估计方程，从而能够获得脉冲响应的最优一致估计和可靠的置信区间。此外，识别限制可以使用适当的J统计量进行正式检验，频率带可以通过数据驱动程序选择。最后，我们提供了一些蒙特卡洛模拟和关于工时-生产率争论的应用。

records.title_en: Modeling and forecasting realized volatility with the fractional Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process
records.title_cn: 分数奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程对已实现波动率的建模与预测
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes to model and forecast realized volatility (RV) using the fractional Ornstein–Uhlenbeck (fO–U) process with a general Hurst parameter, H. A two-stage method is introduced for estimating parameters in the fO–U process based on discrete-sampled observations. In the first stage, H is estimated based on the ratio of two second-order differences of observations from different frequencies. In the second stage, with the estimated H, the other parameters of the model are estimated by the method of moments. All estimators have closed-form expressions and are easy to implement. A large sample theory of the proposed estimators is derived. Extensive simulations show that the proposed estimators and the large-sample theory perform well in finite samples. We apply the model and the method to the logarithmic daily RV series of various financial assets. Our empirical findings suggest that H is much smaller than 1/2, indicating that the RV series have rough sample paths, and that the mean reversion parameter takes a small positive number, indicating that the RV series are stationary but have slow mean reversion. The proposed model is compared with many alternative models, including the fractional Brownian motion, ARFIMA, and HAR, in forecasting RV and logarithmic RV.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出使用具有一般赫斯特参数H的分数奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克（fO–U）过程来建模和预测已实现波动率（RV）。基于离散采样观测，介绍了一种两阶段方法来估计fO–U过程中的参数。在第一阶段，基于不同频率观测的二阶差分之比来估计H。在第二阶段，利用估计的H，通过矩方法估计模型的其他参数。所有估计量都有闭式表达式，易于实现。推导了所提出估计量的大样本理论。大量模拟表明，所提出的估计量和大样本理论在有限样本中表现良好。我们将该模型和方法应用于各种金融资产的对数日已实现波动率序列。我们的实证发现表明，H远小于1/2，表明已实现波动率序列具有粗糙的样本路径，且均值回复参数取小的正数，表明已实现波动率序列是平稳的但均值回复缓慢。所提出的模型与许多替代模型（包括分数布朗运动、ARFIMA和HAR）在预测已实现波动率和对数已实现波动率方面进行了比较。

records.title_en: A corrected Clarke test for model selection and beyond
records.title_cn: 修正的Clarke检验及其在模型选择中的应用
records.abstract_en: We introduce a large family of model selection tests based on the expectation of an arbitrary, possibly non-smooth, parametric criterion function of the data. The considered methodology is illustrated for several econometric problems, including linear and quantile regression. It covers the case of strictly locally non-nested models and some overlapping models. The asymptotic theory of the proposed test statistic is stated. A general exchangeable bootstrap scheme allows the evaluation of its limiting law as well as its asymptotic variance. Our framework includes the tests for non-nested model selection of Vuong (1989) and Clarke (2007) as particular cases. We show that the statistic of the latter test is not Binomial distributed as originally stated and we provide its corrected limiting law. In a simulation study, we empirically verify the distributional approximation of our test statistic in a finite sample and examine the empirical level and power of the corresponding model selection tests in various settings. Finally, an analysis of a financial dataset illustrates the proposed model selection procedure at work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一大类基于数据任意参数准则函数（可能非光滑）期望的模型选择检验。所考虑的方法论在若干计量经济学问题中得到了说明，包括线性回归和分位数回归。它涵盖了严格局部非嵌套模型以及一些重叠模型的情形。我们给出了所提出的检验统计量的渐近理论。一个一般的可交换自助法方案允许评估其极限分布及其渐近方差。我们的框架包括Vuong（1989）和Clarke（2007）的非嵌套模型选择检验作为特例。我们表明后一检验的统计量并非如最初所述服从二项分布，并提供了其修正的极限分布。在模拟研究中，我们实证验证了我们的检验统计量在有限样本中的分布近似，并考察了相应模型选择检验在各种设置下的经验水平和功效。最后，对一个金融数据集的分析说明了所提出的模型选择程序的实际应用。

records.title_en: Who should get vaccinated? Individualized allocation of vaccines over SIR network
records.title_cn: 谁应该接种疫苗？SIR网络上的个体化疫苗分配
records.abstract_en: How to allocate vaccines over heterogeneous individuals is one of the important policy decisions in pandemic times. This paper develops a procedure to estimate an individualized vaccine allocation policy under limited supply, exploiting social network data containing individual demographic characteristics and health status. We model the spillover effects of vaccination based on a Heterogeneous-Interacted-SIR network model and estimate an individualized vaccine allocation policy by maximizing an estimated social welfare (public health) criterion incorporating these spillovers. While this optimization problem is generally an NP-hard integer optimization problem, we show that the SIR structure leads to a submodular objective function, and provide a computationally attractive greedy algorithm for approximating a solution that has a theoretical performance guarantee. Moreover, we characterize a finite sample welfare regret bound and examine how its uniform convergence rate depends on the complexity and riskiness of the social network. In the simulation, we illustrate the importance of considering spillovers by comparing our method with targeting without network information.
records.abstract_cn: 如何在异质性个体之间分配疫苗是疫情期间重要的政策决策之一。本文开发了一种程序，在有限供应下，利用包含个体人口统计特征和健康状况的社交网络数据来估计个体化疫苗分配政策。我们基于异质性交互SIR网络模型对疫苗接种的溢出效应进行建模，并通过最大化纳入这些溢出效应的估计社会福利（公共卫生）标准来估计个体化疫苗分配政策。虽然该优化问题通常是一个NP难的整数优化问题，但我们表明SIR结构导致子模目标函数，并提供了一种计算上吸引人的贪心算法来近似求解，该算法具有理论性能保证。此外，我们刻画了有限样本福利遗憾界，并检验了其一致收敛速率如何依赖于社交网络的复杂性和风险性。在模拟中，我们通过将我们的方法与不考虑网络信息的定向方法进行比较，说明了考虑溢出效应的重要性。

records.title_en: CRPS learning
records.title_cn: CRPS学习
records.abstract_en: Combination and aggregation techniques can significantly improve forecast accuracy. This also holds for probabilistic forecasting methods where predictive distributions are combined. There are several time-varying and adaptive weighting schemes such as Bayesian model averaging (BMA). However, the quality of different forecasts may vary not only over time but also within the distribution. For example, some distribution forecasts may be more accurate in the center of the distributions, while others are better at predicting the tails. Therefore, we introduce a new weighting method that considers the differences in performance over time and within the distribution. We discuss pointwise combination algorithms based on aggregation across quantiles that optimize with respect to the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS). After analyzing the theoretical properties of pointwise CRPS learning, we discuss B- and P-Spline-based estimation techniques for batch and online learning, based on quantile regression and prediction with expert advice. We prove that the proposed fully adaptive Bernstein online aggregation (BOA) method for pointwise CRPS online learning has optimal convergence properties. They are confirmed in simulations and a probabilistic forecasting study for European emission allowance (EUA) prices.
