records.abstract_cn: 组合和聚合技术可以显著提高预测准确性。这也适用于概率预测方法，其中预测分布被组合。存在多种时变和自适应加权方案，如贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）。然而，不同预测的质量不仅可能随时间变化，也可能在分布内部变化。例如，一些分布预测在分布中心可能更准确，而另一些则更擅长预测尾部。因此，我们引入了一种新的加权方法，该方法考虑了随时间变化和分布内部的性能差异。我们讨论了基于分位数聚合的逐点组合算法，这些算法针对连续排序概率得分（CRPS）进行优化。在分析了逐点CRPS学习的理论性质后，我们讨论了基于B样条和P样条的估计技术，用于批量学习和在线学习，这些技术基于分位数回归和专家建议预测。我们证明了所提出的用于逐点CRPS在线学习的完全自适应伯恩斯坦在线聚合（BOA）方法具有最优收敛性质。这些性质在模拟和欧洲排放配额（EUA）价格的概率预测研究中得到了证实。

records.title_en: Most powerful test against a sequence of high dimensional local alternatives
records.title_cn: 针对高维局部备择序列的最强检验
records.abstract_en: We develop a powerful quadratic test for the overall significance of many covariates in a dense regression model in the presence of nuisance parameters. By equally weighting the sample moments, the test is asymptotically correct in high dimensions even when the number of coefficients is larger than the sample size. Our theory allows a non-parametric error distribution and weakly exogenous nuisance variables, in particular autoregressors in many applications. Using random matrix theory, we show that the test has the optimal asymptotic testing power among a large class of competitors against local alternatives whose coordinates are dense in the eigenbasis of the high dimensional sample covariance matrix among regressors. The asymptotic results are adaptive to the covariates’ cross-sectional and temporal dependence structure and do not require a limiting spectral law of their sample covariance matrix. In the most general case, the nuisance estimation may play a role in the asymptotic limit and we give a robust modification for these irregular scenarios. Monte Carlo studies suggest a good power performance of our proposed test against high dimensional dense alternative for various data generating processes. We apply the test to detect the significance of over one hundred exogenous variables in the FRED-MD database for predicting the monthly growth in the US industrial production index.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种强大的二次型检验，用于在存在干扰参数的情况下，检验密集回归模型中众多协变量的整体显著性。通过等权重地赋予样本矩，该检验在高维情况下即使系数数量大于样本量时也是渐近正确的。我们的理论允许非参数误差分布和弱外生干扰变量，特别是在许多应用中的自回归项。利用随机矩阵理论，我们证明了在回归变量高维样本协方差矩阵的特征基上坐标密集的局部备择中，该检验在一大类竞争者中具有最优的渐近检验功效。渐近结果适应于协变量的横截面和时间依赖性结构，并且不需要其样本协方差矩阵的极限谱律。在最一般的情况下，干扰估计可能在渐近极限中起作用，我们为这些不规则情形提供了稳健的修正。蒙特卡洛研究表明，我们提出的检验在各种数据生成过程下对高维密集备择具有良好的功效表现。我们将该检验应用于检测FRED-MD数据库中超过一百个外生变量对预测美国工业生产指数月度增长的显著性。

records.title_en: Group fused Lasso for large factor models with multiple structural breaks
records.title_cn: 具有多重结构突变的大型因子模型的组融合Lasso方法
records.abstract_en: This paper reformulates the identification of multiple structural breaks in factor loadings as a problem of detecting structural breaks in a factor regression, where the estimated pseudo factor corresponding to the largest eigenvalue is regressed on the remaining estimated factors. As a result, a group fused Lasso based estimation procedure is proposed to identify the break dates. Our procedure is practically easy-to-implement with standard statistical packages, overcoming the drawbacks of the existing methods that they often involve multiple tuning parameters and are computationally demanding in dealing with multiple unknown breaks. Theoretical properties of the proposed estimators are established, with a data driven choice of tuning parameter in the procedure. The Monte Carlo simulations and a real data application demonstrate that our procedure is fast implementable with desirable accuracy performance, and thus enjoys practical merits.
records.abstract_cn: 本文将因子载荷中多重结构突变的识别问题重新表述为因子回归中结构突变的检测问题，其中对应于最大特征值的估计伪因子对剩余估计因子进行回归。因此，提出了一种基于组融合Lasso的估计程序来识别突变日期。我们的程序在标准统计软件包中易于实现，克服了现有方法通常涉及多个调谐参数且在处理多个未知突变时计算量大的缺点。所提出估计量的理论性质得以建立，并在程序中采用数据驱动的调谐参数选择。蒙特卡洛模拟和实际数据应用表明，我们的程序实现快速且具有理想的准确性表现，因此具有实际应用价值。

records.title_en: Gender differences in sorting on wages and risk
records.title_cn: 工资与风险分类中的性别差异
records.abstract_en: We use Brazilian matched employer–employee data to provide new evidence on gender disparities in labor market sorting on wages and workplace safety. We show that women and men sort in highly disparate, but systematic, ways on the basis of physical risk, despite sorting almost identically on financial risk. To understand what factors might explain these gender differences in sorting, we begin by ruling out the possibility that men and women receive different compensating wage differentials for risk. We find that women do earn smaller establishment wage premia than men on average, but this difference is also unlikely to explain the sorting patterns. Despite having little direct effect on wages, sorting on safety may have large indirect effects on the wage gap through its outsized influence on the segregation of women and men across establishments. This segregation results in men earning substantially higher establishment wage premia, which explains 28% of the entire gender wage gap in Brazil.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用巴西匹配的雇主-雇员数据，提供关于劳动力市场中工资和工作场所安全分类的性别差异的新证据。我们表明，女性和男性在基于身体风险的分类方式上高度不同但系统化，尽管在金融风险上的分类几乎相同。为了理解可能解释这些分类中性别差异的因素，我们首先排除了男性和女性因风险获得不同补偿性工资差异的可能性。我们发现，女性平均确实比男性获得更小的企业工资溢价，但这种差异也不太可能解释分类模式。尽管对工资几乎没有直接影响，但安全分类可能通过对女性和男性跨企业隔离的巨大影响，对工资差距产生较大的间接效应。这种隔离导致男性获得显著更高的企业工资溢价，这解释了巴西整个性别工资差距的28%。

records.title_en: Identifying marginal treatment effects in the presence of sample selection
records.title_cn: 存在样本选择时识别边际处理效应
records.abstract_en: This article presents identification results for the marginal treatment effect (MTE) when there is sample selection. We show that the MTE is partially identified for individuals who are always observed regardless of treatment, and derive uniformly sharp bounds on this parameter under three increasingly restrictive sets of assumptions. The first result imposes standard MTE assumptions with an unrestricted sample selection mechanism. The second set of conditions imposes monotonicity of the sample selection variable with respect to treatment, considerably shrinking the identified set. Finally, we incorporate a stochastic dominance assumption which tightens the lower bound for the MTE. Our analysis extends to discrete instruments. The results rely on a mixture reformulation of the problem where the mixture weights are identified, extending Lee’s (2009) trimming procedure to the MTE context. We propose estimators for the bounds derived and use data made available by Deb et al. (2006) to empirically illustrate the usefulness of our approach.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了在存在样本选择时边际处理效应（MTE）的识别结果。我们表明，对于无论处理状态如何总是被观测到的个体，MTE是部分识别的，并在三组逐渐严格的假设下推导出该参数的均匀尖锐界。第一个结果施加了标准的MTE假设，并允许不受限制的样本选择机制。第二组条件对样本选择变量关于处理施加单调性，显著缩小了识别集。最后，我们纳入一个随机占优假设，该假设收紧MTE的下界。我们的分析扩展到离散工具。结果依赖于问题的混合重新表述，其中混合权重是可识别的，将Lee（2009）的修剪程序扩展到MTE背景。我们为推导出的界提出了估计量，并使用Deb等人（2006）提供的数据来实证说明我们方法的实用性。

records.title_en: Out-of-sample tests for conditional quantile coverage an application to Growth-at-Risk
records.title_cn: 条件分位数覆盖率的样本外检验：增长风险的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes tests for out-of-sample comparisons of interval forecasts based on parametric conditional quantile models. The tests rank the distance between actual and nominal conditional coverage with respect to the set of conditioning variables from all models, for a given loss function. We propose a pairwise test to compare two models for a single predictive interval. The set-up is then extended to a comparison across multiple models and/or intervals. The limiting distribution varies depending on whether models are strictly non-nested or overlapping. In the latter case, degeneracy may occur. We establish the asymptotic validity of wild bootstrap based critical values across all cases. An empirical application to Growth-at-Risk (GaR) uncovers situations in which a richer set of financial indicators are found to outperform a commonly-used benchmark model when predicting downside risk to economic activity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了基于参数条件分位数模型的区间预测样本外比较检验。这些检验根据所有模型的条件变量集，针对给定的损失函数，对实际条件覆盖率与名义条件覆盖率之间的距离进行排序。我们提出了一种成对检验，用于比较单一预测区间的两个模型。该设置随后扩展到多个模型和/或区间的比较。极限分布根据模型是严格非嵌套还是重叠而有所不同。在后一种情况下，可能出现退化。我们建立了野生自助法临界值在所有情况下的渐近有效性。对增长风险（GaR）的实证应用揭示了在预测经济活动下行风险时，更丰富的金融指标集优于常用基准模型的情况。

records.title_en: We modeled long memory with just one lag!
records.title_cn: 我们用一阶滞后建模了长记忆！
records.abstract_en: Two recent contributions have found conditions for large dimensional networks or systems to generate long memory in their individual components. We build on these and provide a multivariate methodology for modeling and forecasting series displaying long range dependence. We model long memory properties within a vector autoregressive system of order 1 and consider Bayesian estimation or ridge regression. For these, we derive a theory-driven parametric setting that informs a prior distribution or a shrinkage target. Our proposal significantly outperforms univariate time series long-memory models when forecasting a daily volatility measure for 250 U.S. company stocks over twelve years. This provides an empirical validation of the theoretical results showing long memory can be sourced to marginalization within a large dimensional system.
records.abstract_cn: 最近的两项贡献发现了大规模网络或系统在其各个组成部分中产生长记忆的条件。我们在此基础上，提供了一种用于建模和预测具有长程依赖性的序列的多元方法论。我们在一个阶数为1的向量自回归系统内建模长记忆特性，并考虑贝叶斯估计或岭回归。对于这些，我们推导出一个理论驱动的参数设置，为先验分布或收缩目标提供信息。我们的提议在预测250家美国公司股票的日波动率指标超过十二年的情况下，显著优于单变量时间序列长记忆模型。这为理论结果提供了实证验证，表明长记忆可以源于大规模系统中的边缘化。

records.title_en: A discrete-time hedging framework with multiple factors and fat tails: On what matters
records.title_cn: 具有多因子和肥尾的离散时间对冲框架：什么才是重要的
records.abstract_en: This article presents a quadratic hedging framework for a general class of discrete-time affine multi-factor models and investigates the extent to which multi-component volatility factors, fat tails, and a non-monotonic pricing kernel can improve the hedging performance. A semi-explicit hedging formula is derived for our general framework which applies to a myriad of the option pricing models proposed in the discrete-time literature. We conduct an extensive empirical study of the impact of modelling features on the hedging effectiveness of S&P 500 options. Overall, we find that fat tails can be credited for half of the hedging improvement observed, while a second volatility factor and a non-monotonic pricing kernel each contribute to a quarter of this improvement. Moreover, our study indicates that the added value of these features for hedging is different than for pricing. A robustness analysis shows that a similar conclusion can be reached when considering the Dow Jones Industrial Average. Finally, the use of a hedging-based loss function in the estimation process is investigated in an additional robustness test, and this choice has a rather marginal impact on hedging performance.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对一般类别的离散时间仿射多因子模型提出了一个二次对冲框架，并研究了多成分波动率因子、肥尾和非单调定价核能在多大程度上改善对冲绩效。我们为一般框架推导了一个半显式对冲公式，该公式适用于离散时间文献中提出的众多期权定价模型。我们对建模特征对S&P 500期权对冲有效性的影响进行了广泛的实证研究。总体而言，我们发现肥尾可以归因于观察到的对冲改善的一半，而第二个波动率因子和非单调定价核各自贡献了四分之一的改善。此外，我们的研究表明，这些特征对对冲的附加价值与对定价的附加价值不同。稳健性分析表明，在考虑道琼斯工业平均指数时，可以得出类似的结论。最后，在额外的稳健性检验中，研究了在估计过程中使用基于对冲的损失函数，这一选择对对冲绩效的影响相当有限。

records.title_en: Bootstrap inference for Hawkes and general point processes
records.title_cn: Hawkes及一般点过程的Bootstrap推断
records.abstract_en: Inference and testing in general point process models such as the Hawkes model is predominantly based on asymptotic approximations for likelihood-based estimators and tests. As an alternative, and to improve finite sample performance, this paper considers bootstrap-based inference for interval estimation and testing. Specifically, for a wide class of point process models we consider a novel bootstrap scheme labeled ‘fixed intensity bootstrap’ (FIB), where the conditional intensity is kept fixed across bootstrap repetitions. The FIB, which is very simple to implement and fast in practice, extends previous ideas from the bootstrap literature on time series in discrete time, where the so-called ‘fixed design’ and ‘fixed volatility’ bootstrap schemes have shown to be particularly useful and effective. We compare the FIB with the classic recursive bootstrap, which is here labeled ‘recursive intensity bootstrap’ (RIB). In RIB algorithms, the intensity is stochastic in the bootstrap world and implementation of the bootstrap is more involved, due to its sequential structure. For both bootstrap schemes, we provide new bootstrap (asymptotic) theory which allows to assess bootstrap validity, and propose a ‘non-parametric’ approach based on resampling time-changed transformations of the original waiting times. We also establish the link between the proposed bootstraps for point process models and the related autoregressive conditional duration (ACD) models. Lastly, we show effectiveness of the different bootstrap schemes in finite samples through a set of detailed Monte Carlo experiments, and provide applications to both financial data and social media data to illustrate the proposed methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 在一般点过程模型（如Hawkes模型）中，推断和检验主要基于似然估计量和检验的渐近近似。作为替代方案，并为了改善有限样本性能，本文考虑了基于bootstrap的区间估计和检验推断。具体而言，对于一大类点过程模型，我们提出了一种新颖的bootstrap方案，称为“固定强度bootstrap”（FIB），其中条件强度在bootstrap重复中保持固定。FIB实现非常简单且在实践中快速，它扩展了离散时间序列bootstrap文献中的先前思想，其中所谓的“固定设计”和“固定波动率”bootstrap方案已被证明特别有用和有效。我们将FIB与经典的递归bootstrap进行比较，后者在此称为“递归强度bootstrap”（RIB）。在RIB算法中，强度在bootstrap世界中是随机的，并且由于顺序结构，bootstrap的实现更为复杂。对于这两种bootstrap方案，我们提供了新的bootstrap（渐近）理论，允许评估bootstrap的有效性，并提出了一种基于重采样原始等待时间的时间变换的“非参数”方法。我们还建立了点过程模型的提议bootstrap与相关自回归条件持续时间（ACD）模型之间的联系。最后，我们通过一组详细的蒙特卡洛实验展示了不同bootstrap方案在有限样本中的有效性，并提供了对金融数据和社交媒体数据的应用来说明所提出的方法。

records.title_en: Sparse spatio-temporal autoregressions by profiling and bagging
records.title_cn: 基于剖面和袋装的稀疏时空自回归模型
records.abstract_en: We consider a new class of spatio-temporal models with sparse autoregressive coefficient matrices and exogenous variable. To estimate the model, we first profile the exogenous variable out of the response. This leads to a profiled model structure. Next, to overcome endogeneity issue, we propose a class of generalized methods of moment (GMM) estimators to estimate the autoregressive coefficient matrices. A novel bagging-based estimator is further developed to conquer the over-determined issue which also occurs in Chang et al. (2015) and Dou et al. (2016). An adaptive forward–backward greedy algorithm is proposed to learn the sparse structure of the autoregressive coefficient matrices. A new BIC-type selection criteria is further developed to conduct variable selection for GMM estimators. Asymptotic properties are further studied. The proposed methodology is illustrated with extensive simulation studies. A social network dataset is analyzed for illustration purpose.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一类新的时空模型，其具有稀疏自回归系数矩阵和外生变量。为了估计该模型，我们首先从响应中剖面掉外生变量，从而得到剖面模型结构。接下来，为克服内生性问题，我们提出一类广义矩（GMM）估计量来估计自回归系数矩阵。进一步开发了一种新颖的基于袋装的估计量，以解决过度确定问题，该问题也出现在Chang等人（2015）和Dou等人（2016）的研究中。提出了一种自适应前向-后向贪婪算法来学习自回归系数矩阵的稀疏结构。进一步开发了一种新的BIC型选择准则，用于GMM估计量的变量选择。进一步研究了渐近性质。通过广泛的模拟研究说明了所提出的方法。为说明目的，分析了一个社交网络数据集。

records.title_en: Extensions to IVX methods of inference for return predictability
records.title_cn: IVX推断方法在收益可预测性中的扩展
records.abstract_en: The contribution of this paper is threefold. First, we demonstrate that, provided either a suitable bootstrap implementation is employed or heteroskedasticity-consistent standard errors are used, the IVX-based predictability tests of Kostakis et al. (2015) retain asymptotically valid inference under the null hypothesis under considerably weaker assumptions on the innovations than are required by Kostakis et al. (2015). Second, under the same assumptions, we develop asymptotically valid bootstrap implementations of the IVX tests. Monte Carlo simulations show that the bootstrap tests deliver considerably more accurate finite sample inference than the asymptotic implementations of the tests under certain problematic parameter constellations, most notably for one-sided testing, and where multiple predictors are included. Third, we show how sub-sample implementations of the IVX approach can be used to develop asymptotically valid one-sided and two-sided tests for the presence of temporary windows of predictability.
records.abstract_cn: 本文的贡献有三方面。首先，我们证明，在采用适当的自举实现或使用异方差一致性标准误的情况下，基于IVX的可预测性检验（Kostakis等，2015）在原假设下，在比Kostakis等（2015）所要求的更弱的创新假设下，仍保持渐近有效的推断。其次，在相同假设下，我们开发了IVX检验的渐近有效自举实现。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，在某些有问题的参数组合下，特别是对于单侧检验以及包含多个预测因子的情况，自举检验比检验的渐近实现提供了更准确的有限样本推断。第三，我们展示了如何使用IVX方法的子样本实现来开发渐近有效的单侧和双侧检验，以检测暂时性可预测性窗口的存在。

records.title_en: Conditional asymmetry in Power ARCH(∞) models
records.title_cn: Power ARCH(∞)模型中的条件不对称性
records.abstract_en: We consider an extension of ARCH(∞) models to account for conditional asymmetry in the presence of high persistence. After stating existence and stationarity conditions, this paper develops the statistical inference of such models and proves the consistency and asymptotic distribution of a Quasi Maximum Likelihood estimator. Some particular specifications are studied and we introduce a Portmanteau goodness-of-fit test. Additionally, test procedures for asymmetry and GARCH validity are derived. Finally, we present an application on a set of equity indices to reexamine the preeminence of GARCH(1,1) specifications. We find strong evidence that the short memory feature of such models is not suitable for peripheral assets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑ARCH(∞)模型的一个扩展，以在高持久性存在的情况下解释条件不对称性。在陈述存在性和平稳性条件之后，本文发展了此类模型的统计推断，并证明了拟极大似然估计量的一致性和渐近分布。研究了一些特定设定，并引入了Portmanteau拟合优度检验。此外，推导了不对称性和GARCH有效性的检验程序。最后，我们在一组股票指数上进行了应用，以重新检验GARCH(1,1)设定的优越性。我们发现强有力的证据表明，此类模型的短记忆特征不适用于外围资产。

records.title_en: High-dimensional VARs with common factors
records.title_cn: 含共同因子的高维向量自回归模型
records.abstract_en: This paper studies high-dimensional vector autoregressions (VARs) augmented with common factors that allow for strong cross-sectional dependence. Models of this type provide a convenient mechanism for accommodating the interconnectedness and temporal co-variability that are often present in large dimensional systems. We propose an ℓ1-nuclear-norm regularized estimator and derive the non-asymptotic upper bounds for the estimation errors as well as large sample asymptotics for the estimates. A singular value thresholding procedure is used to determine the correct number of factors with probability approaching one. Both the LASSO estimator and the conservative LASSO estimator are employed to improve estimation precision. The conservative LASSO estimates of the non-zero coefficients are shown to be asymptotically equivalent to the oracle least squares estimates. Simulations demonstrate that our estimators perform reasonably well in finite samples given the complex high-dimensional nature of the model. In an empirical illustration we apply the methodology to explore dynamic connectedness in the volatilities of financial asset prices and the transmission of ‘investor fear’. The findings reveal that a large proportion of connectedness is due to the common factors. Conditional on the presence of these common factors, the results still document remarkable connectedness due to the interactions between the individual variables, thereby supporting a common factor augmented VAR specification.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究由允许强横截面依赖的共同因子增强的高维向量自回归（VAR）模型。此类模型为容纳大型维度系统中常见的互联性和时间协变性提供了便捷机制。我们提出了一种ℓ1-核范数正则化估计器，并推导了估计误差的非渐近上界以及估计量的大样本渐近性质。采用奇异值阈值化程序以概率趋近于一地确定因子的正确数量。同时使用LASSO估计器和保守LASSO估计器以提高估计精度。保守LASSO对非零系数的估计被证明与Oracle最小二乘估计渐近等价。模拟表明，鉴于模型复杂的高维性质，我们的估计器在有限样本中表现良好。在实证示例中，我们将该方法应用于探索金融资产价格波动率中的动态连通性以及‘投资者恐惧’的传导。研究结果显示，连通性的很大一部分归因于共同因子。在存在这些共同因子的条件下，结果仍记录了由于个体变量之间相互作用而产生的显著连通性，从而支持了共同因子增强的VAR设定。

records.title_en: Cyclical labor market sorting
records.title_cn: 周期性劳动力市场分类
records.abstract_en: We consider sorting in the labor market, that is, whether high- or low-productivity workers and firms tend to match with each other, and how this varies over time using U.S. linked employer–employee data. Composition changes of workers and firms move in opposite directions over the business cycle. During and after recessions, low-rank workers are less likely to work, while the employment share of low-rank firms increases. The agreement between worker and firm ranks increases in the early stages of labor market downturns.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑劳动力市场中的分类，即高生产率或低生产率的工人与企业是否倾向于相互匹配，以及这种匹配如何随时间变化，使用美国关联雇主-雇员数据。工人和企业的构成变化在商业周期中呈相反方向移动。在经济衰退期间及之后，低排名工人就业的可能性较低，而低排名企业的就业份额增加。工人与企业排名之间的一致性在劳动力市场衰退初期有所增加。

records.title_en: Identification and estimation of triangular models with a binary treatment
records.title_cn: 二元处理三角模型的识别与估计
records.abstract_en: I study the identification and estimation of a nonseparable triangular model with an endogenous binary treatment. I impose neither rank invariance nor rank similarity on the unobservable term of the outcome equation. Identification is achieved by using continuous variation of the instrument and a shape restriction on the distribution of the unobservables, which is modeled with a copula. The latter captures the endogeneity of the model and is one of the components of the marginal treatment effect, making it informative about the effects of extending the treatment to untreated individuals. The estimation is a multi-step procedure based on rotated quantile regression. Finally, I use the estimator to revisit the effects of Work First Job Placements on future earnings.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了具有内生二元处理的不可分离三角模型的识别与估计。我既不对结果方程中不可观测项施加秩不变性，也不施加秩相似性。通过使用工具的连续变化以及对不可观测项分布的形状限制来实现识别，该分布用copula建模。后者捕捉了模型的内生性，并且是边际处理效应的组成部分之一，使其能够提供关于将处理扩展到未处理个体效果的信息。估计是一个基于旋转分位数回归的多步骤过程。最后，我使用该估计量重新审视了工作优先工作安置对未来收入的影响。

records.title_en: Bayesian Artificial Neural Networks for frontier efficiency analysis
records.title_cn: 贝叶斯人工神经网络在前沿效率分析中的应用
records.abstract_en: Artificial neural networks have offered their share of econometric insights, given their power to model complex relationships. One area where they have not been readily deployed is the estimation of frontiers. The literature on frontier estimation has seen its share of research comparing and contrasting data envelopment analysis (DEA) and stochastic frontier analysis (SFA), the two workhorse estimators. These studies rely on both Monte Carlo experiments and actual data sets to examine a range of performance issues which can be used to elucidate insights on the benefits or weaknesses of one method over the other. As can be imagined, neither method is universally better than the other. The present paper proposes an alternative approach that is quite flexible in terms of functional form and distributional assumptions and it amalgamates the benefits of both DEA and SFA. Specifically, we bridge these two popular approaches via Bayesian artificial neural networks while accounting for possible endogeneity of inputs. We examine the performance of this new machine learning approach using Monte Carlo experiments which is found to be very good, comparable to, or often better than, the current standards in the literature. To illustrate the new techniques, we provide an application of this approach to a data set of large US banks.
records.abstract_cn: 人工神经网络因其建模复杂关系的能力，已经提供了其在计量经济学中的见解。然而，它们尚未被广泛应用于前沿估计领域。关于前沿估计的文献中，已有大量研究对数据包络分析（DEA）和随机前沿分析（SFA）这两种主要估计方法进行了比较和对比。这些研究依赖于蒙特卡洛实验和实际数据集，以考察一系列性能问题，从而揭示一种方法相对于另一种方法的优势或劣势。可以想象，这两种方法都不是普遍优于对方的。本文提出了一种替代方法，该方法在函数形式和分布假设方面非常灵活，并融合了DEA和SFA的优点。具体而言，我们通过贝叶斯人工神经网络将这两种流行方法联系起来，同时考虑投入可能的内生性。我们使用蒙特卡洛实验检验了这种新的机器学习方法的性能，发现其表现非常好，与文献中的现有标准相当，甚至往往更优。为了说明新技术，我们将该方法应用于一组美国大型银行的数据集。

records.title_en: High-dimensional conditionally Gaussian state space models with missing data
records.title_cn: 高维条件高斯状态空间模型中的缺失数据处理
records.abstract_en: We develop an efficient sampling approach for handling complex missing data patterns and a large number of missing observations in conditionally Gaussian state space models. Two important examples are dynamic factor models with unbalanced datasets and large Bayesian VARs with variables in multiple frequencies. A key observation underlying the proposed approach is that the joint distribution of the missing data conditional on the observed data is Gaussian. Furthermore, the inverse covariance or precision matrix of this conditional distribution is sparse, and this special structure can be exploited to substantially speed up computations. We illustrate the methodology using two empirical applications. The first application combines quarterly, monthly and weekly data using a large Bayesian VAR to produce weekly GDP estimates. In the second application, we extract latent factors from unbalanced datasets involving over a hundred monthly variables via a dynamic factor model with stochastic volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种高效的采样方法，用于处理条件高斯状态空间模型中复杂的缺失数据模式及大量缺失观测。两个重要例子是数据集不平衡的动态因子模型和包含多频率变量的大型贝叶斯VAR。所提出方法的一个关键观察是，给定观测数据时缺失数据的联合分布是高斯分布。此外，该条件分布的逆协方差或精度矩阵是稀疏的，这种特殊结构可以被利用来大幅加速计算。我们通过两个实证应用来说明该方法。第一个应用使用大型贝叶斯VAR结合季度、月度和周度数据来生成周度GDP估计。在第二个应用中，我们通过具有随机波动率的动态因子模型从不平衡数据集中提取潜在因子，该数据集包含超过一百个月度变量。

records.title_en: Estimating the variance of a combined forecast: Bootstrap-based approach
records.title_cn: 估计组合预测的方差：基于自助法的方法
records.abstract_en: This paper considers bootstrap inference in model averaging for predictive regressions. We first show that the standard pairwise bootstrap is not valid in the context of model averaging. This common bootstrap approach induces a bias-related term in the bootstrap variance of averaging estimators. We then propose and justify a fixed-design residual-based bootstrap resampling approach for model averaging. In a local asymptotic framework, we show the validity of the bootstrap in estimating the variance of a combined forecast and the asymptotic covariance matrix of a combined parameter vector with fixed weights. Our proposed method preserves non-parametrically the cross-sectional dependence between different models and the time series dependence in the errors simultaneously. The finite sample performance of these methods is assessed via Monte Carlo simulations. We illustrate our approach using an empirical study of the Taylor rule equation with 24 alternative specifications.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了预测回归中模型平均的自助法推断。我们首先证明标准配对自助法在模型平均的背景下是无效的。这种常见的自助法方法会在平均估计量的自助法方差中引入一个与偏差相关的项。然后，我们提出并论证了一种用于模型平均的固定设计残差自助重采样方法。在局部渐近框架下，我们证明了该方法在估计组合预测方差和具有固定权重的组合参数向量的渐近协方差矩阵方面的有效性。我们提出的方法非参数地同时保留了不同模型之间的横截面依赖性和误差中的时间序列依赖性。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估了这些方法的有限样本性能。我们使用泰勒规则方程的经验研究说明了我们的方法，该方程有24种替代规格。

records.title_en: Statistical inference for linear mediation models with high-dimensional mediators and application to studying stock reaction to COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: 高维中介变量的线性中介模型统计推断及其在股票对COVID-19疫情反应研究中的应用
records.abstract_en: Mediation analysis draws increasing attention in many research areas such as economics, finance and social sciences. In this paper, we propose new statistical inference procedures for high dimensional mediation models, in which both the outcome model and the mediator model are linear with high dimensional mediators. Traditional procedures for mediation analysis cannot be used to make statistical inference for high dimensional linear mediation models due to high-dimensionality of the mediators. We propose an estimation procedure for the indirect effects of the models via a partially penalized least squares method, and further establish its theoretical properties. We further develop a partially penalized Wald test on the indirect effects, and prove that the proposed test has a χ2 limiting null distribution. We also propose an F-type test for direct effects and show that the proposed test asymptotically follows a χ2-distribution under null hypothesis and a noncentral χ2-distribution under local alternatives. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to examine the finite sample performance of the proposed tests and compare their performance with existing ones. We further apply the newly proposed statistical inference procedures to study stock reaction to COVID-19 pandemic via an empirical analysis of studying the mediation effects of financial metrics that bridge company’s sector and stock return.
records.abstract_cn: 中介分析在经济学、金融学和社会科学等许多研究领域日益受到关注。本文针对高维中介模型提出了新的统计推断方法，其中结果模型和中介模型均为具有高维中介变量的线性模型。由于中介变量的高维性，传统的中介分析程序无法用于高维线性中介模型的统计推断。我们通过部分惩罚最小二乘法提出了模型间接效应的估计程序，并进一步建立了其理论性质。我们还开发了针对间接效应的部分惩罚Wald检验，并证明所提出的检验具有χ2极限零分布。我们还提出了针对直接效应的F型检验，并表明所提出的检验在原假设下渐近服从χ2分布，在局部备择假设下服从非中心χ2分布。通过蒙特卡洛模拟来检验所提出检验的有限样本性能，并与现有检验进行比较。我们进一步将新提出的统计推断程序应用于研究股票对COVID-19疫情的反应，通过实证分析研究连接公司行业与股票收益的财务指标的中介效应。

records.title_en: Efficient closed-form estimation of large spatial autoregressions
records.title_cn: 大型空间自回归的高效闭式估计
records.abstract_en: Newton-step approximations to pseudo maximum likelihood estimates of spatial autoregressive models with a large number of parameters are examined, in the sense that the parameter space grows slowly as a function of sample size. These have the same asymptotic efficiency properties as maximum likelihood under Gaussianity but are of closed form. Hence they are computationally simple and free from compactness assumptions, thereby avoiding two notorious pitfalls of implicitly defined estimates of large spatial autoregressions. When commencing from an initial least squares estimate, the Newton step can also lead to weaker regularity conditions for a central limit theorem than some extant in the literature. A simulation study demonstrates excellent finite sample gains from Newton iterations, especially in large multiparameter models for which grid search is costly. A small empirical illustration shows improvements in estimation precision with real data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了具有大量参数的空间自回归模型的伪极大似然估计的牛顿步近似，其中参数空间随样本量缓慢增长。这些近似在高斯性下具有与极大似然相同的渐近效率性质，但形式为闭式。因此，它们在计算上简单且无需紧性假设，从而避免了大型空间自回归隐式估计的两个著名陷阱。当从初始最小二乘估计开始时，牛顿步还可以导致比文献中某些现有中心极限定理更弱的正则条件。模拟研究展示了牛顿迭代在有限样本中的显著增益，尤其是在网格搜索成本高昂的大型多参数模型中。一个小型实证说明显示了使用真实数据时估计精度的改进。

records.title_en: Dynamic clustering of multivariate panel data
records.title_cn: 多元面板数据的动态聚类
records.abstract_en: We propose a dynamic clustering model for uncovering latent time-varying group structures in multivariate panel data. The model is dynamic in three ways. First, the cluster location and scale matrices are time-varying to track gradual changes in cluster characteristics over time. Second, all units can transition between clusters based on a Hidden Markov model (HMM). Finally, the HMM’s transition matrix can depend on lagged time-varying cluster distances as well as economic covariates. Monte Carlo experiments suggest that the units can be classified reliably in a variety of challenging settings. Incorporating dynamics in the cluster composition proves empirically important in a study of 299 European banks between 2008Q1 and 2018Q2. We find that approximately 3% of banks transition per quarter on average. Transition probabilities are in part explained by differences in bank profitability, suggesting that factors contributing to low profitability for some banks can lead to long-lasting changes in financial industry structure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种动态聚类模型，用于揭示多元面板数据中潜在时变群体结构。该模型在三个方面具有动态性。首先，聚类位置和尺度矩阵随时间变化，以跟踪聚类特征随时间的逐渐变化。其次，所有单位可以基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）在聚类之间转换。最后，HMM的转移矩阵可以依赖于滞后的时变聚类距离以及经济协变量。蒙特卡洛实验表明，在各种具有挑战性的情境下，单位可以被可靠地分类。在2008Q1至2018Q2期间对299家欧洲银行的研究中，将动态性纳入聚类组成在实证上具有重要意义。我们发现平均每季度约有3%的银行发生转换。转移概率部分由银行盈利能力的差异解释，这表明导致某些银行低盈利的因素可能导致金融行业结构的长期变化。

records.title_en: Quantile regression with censoring and sample selection
records.title_cn: 带删失和样本选择的分位数回归
records.abstract_en: Arellano and Bonhomme (2017) considered nonparametric identification and semiparametric estimation of a quantile selection model, and Arellano and Bonhomme (2017s) extended the estimation approach to the case with censoring. However, there are some major drawbacks associated with the approach in Arellano and Bonhomme (2017s). In this paper we consider nonparametric and semiparametric identification of the quantile selection model with censoring, and we further propose a semiparametric estimation procedure by making some major adjustments to Arellano and Bonhomme’s (2017, 2017s) approaches to overcome the above mentioned drawbacks. Our estimator is shown to be consistent and asymptotically normal. A Monte Carlo study indicates that our estimator performs well in finite samples. Our method is illustrated with a CPS data to study wage inequality.
records.abstract_cn: Arellano和Bonhomme（2017）考虑了分位数选择模型的非参数识别和半参数估计，而Arellano和Bonhomme（2017）将估计方法扩展到带删失的情形。然而，Arellano和Bonhomme（2017）的方法存在一些主要缺陷。在本文中，我们考虑了带删失的分位数选择模型的非参数和半参数识别，并进一步通过对Arellano和Bonhomme（2017，2017）的方法进行一些重大调整，提出了一种半参数估计程序，以克服上述缺陷。我们的估计量被证明是一致的且渐近正态的。蒙特卡洛研究表明，我们的估计量在有限样本中表现良好。我们用CPS数据来说明我们的方法，以研究工资不平等。

records.title_en: Treatment effects in interactive fixed effects models with a small number of time periods
records.title_cn: 短时间周期交互固定效应模型中的处理效应
records.abstract_en: This paper considers identifying and estimating the Average Treatment Effect on the Treated (ATT) when untreated potential outcomes are generated by an interactive fixed effects model. That is, in addition to time-period and individual fixed effects, we consider the case where there is an unobserved time invariant variable whose effect on untreated potential outcomes may change over time and which can therefore cause outcomes (in the absence of participating in the treatment) to follow different paths for the treated group relative to the untreated group. The models that we consider in this paper generalize many commonly used models in the treatment effects literature including difference in differences and individual-specific linear trend models. Unlike the majority of the literature on interactive fixed effects models, we do not require the number of time periods to go to infinity to consistently estimate the ATT. Our main identification result relies on having the effect of some time invariant covariate (e.g., race or sex) not vary over time. Using our approach, we show that the ATT can be identified with as few as three time periods and with panel or repeated cross sections data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了当未处理潜在结果由交互固定效应模型生成时，识别和估计处理组平均处理效应（ATT）的问题。也就是说，除了时间周期和个体固定效应外，我们考虑存在一个未观测到的时不变变量，其对未处理潜在结果的影响可能随时间变化，因此可能导致处理组相对于未处理组的结果（在未参与处理的情况下）遵循不同的路径。本文考虑的模型推广了处理效应文献中许多常用模型，包括双重差分和个体特定线性趋势模型。与大多数关于交互固定效应模型的文献不同，我们不需要时间周期数趋于无穷大即可一致估计ATT。我们的主要识别结果依赖于某些时不变协变量（如种族或性别）的影响不随时间变化。使用我们的方法，我们表明ATT可以在至少三个时间周期以及面板或重复横截面数据下被识别。

records.title_en: Employer policies and the immigrant–native earnings gap
records.title_cn: 雇主政策与移民-本地人收入差距
records.abstract_en: We use longitudinal data from the income tax system to study the impacts of firms’ employment and wage-setting policies on the level and change in immigrant–native wage differences in Canada. We focus on immigrants who arrived in the early 2000s, distinguishing between those with and without a college degree from two broad groups of countries – the U.S., the U.K. and Northern Europe, and the rest of the world. Consistent with a growing literature based on the two-way fixed effects model of Abowd, Kramarz, and Margolis (1999), we find that firm-specific wage premiums explain a significant share of earnings inequality in Canada and contribute to the average earnings gap between immigrants and natives. In the decade after receiving permanent status, earnings of immigrants rise relative to those of natives. Compositional effects due to selective outmigration and changing participation play no role in this gain. About one-sixth is attributable to movements up the job ladder to employers that offer higher pay premiums for all groups, with particularly large gains for immigrants from the “rest of the world” countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用所得税系统的纵向数据，研究企业就业和工资设定政策对加拿大移民与本地人工资差异水平及变化的影响。我们重点关注2000世纪初抵达的移民，区分那些拥有或未拥有大学学位的人，他们来自两大国家群体——美国、英国和北欧，以及世界其他地区。与基于Abowd、Kramarz和Margolis（1999）双向固定效应模型的日益增长的文献一致，我们发现企业特定工资溢价解释了加拿大收入不平等的显著部分，并导致移民与本地人之间的平均收入差距。在获得永久身份后的十年里，移民的收入相对于本地人有所上升。由于选择性移出和参与变化引起的构成效应在这一增长中不起作用。大约六分之一的增长归因于沿着工作阶梯向为所有群体提供更高工资溢价的雇主移动，其中来自“世界其他地区”国家的移民获益尤为显著。

records.title_en: Treatment recommendation with distributional targets
records.title_cn: 具有分布目标的治疗推荐
records.abstract_en: We study the problem of a decision maker who must provide the best possible treatment recommendation based on an experiment. The desirability of the outcome distribution resulting from the policy recommendation is measured through a functional capturing the distributional characteristic that the decision maker is interested in optimizing. This could be, e.g., its inherent inequality, welfare, level of poverty or its distance to a desired outcome distribution. If the functional of interest is not quasi-convex or if there are constraints, the optimal recommendation may be a mixture of treatments. This vastly expands the set of recommendations that must be considered. We characterize the difficulty of the problem by obtaining maximal expected regret lower bounds. Furthermore, we propose two (near) regret-optimal policies. The first policy is static and thus applicable irrespectively of the subjects arriving sequentially or not in the course of the experimentation phase. The second policy can utilize that subjects arrive sequentially by successively eliminating inferior treatments and thus spends the sampling effort where it is most needed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个决策者必须基于实验提供最佳治疗推荐的问题。通过一个捕捉决策者感兴趣优化的分布特征的泛函来衡量由政策推荐导致的结果分布的合意性。这可以是，例如，其固有的不平等性、福利、贫困水平或其与期望结果分布的距离。如果感兴趣的泛函不是拟凸的或存在约束，最优推荐可能是治疗的混合。这极大地扩展了必须考虑的推荐集合。我们通过获得最大期望遗憾下界来刻画问题的难度。此外，我们提出了两种（接近）遗憾最优策略。第一种策略是静态的，因此无论受试者在实验阶段是否顺序到达都适用。第二种策略可以利用受试者顺序到达的特点，通过连续消除劣质治疗来利用采样努力，从而将采样工作用在最需要的地方。

records.title_en: Treatment effect models with strategic interaction in treatment decisions
records.title_cn: 治疗决策中存在策略互动的治疗效应模型
records.abstract_en: This study considers treatment effect models in which others’ treatment decisions can affect both one’s own treatment and outcome. Focusing on the case of two-player interactions, we formulate treatment decision behavior as a complete information game with multiple equilibria. Using a latent index framework and assuming a stochastic equilibrium selection, we prove that the marginal treatment effect from one’s own treatment and that from the partner are identifiable on the conditional supports of certain threshold variables determined through the game model. Based on our constructive identification results, we propose a two-step semiparametric procedure for estimating the marginal treatment effects using series approximation. We show that the proposed estimator is uniformly consistent and asymptotically normally distributed. As an empirical illustration, we investigate the impacts of risky behaviors on adolescents’ academic performance.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考虑了治疗效应模型，其中他人的治疗决策可能影响自己的治疗和结果。聚焦于两人互动的情形，我们将治疗决策行为构建为具有多重均衡的完全信息博弈。使用潜在指数框架并假设随机均衡选择，我们证明了自己治疗的边际治疗效应和来自同伴的边际治疗效应在通过博弈模型确定的某些阈值变量的条件支撑上是可识别的。基于我们的构造性识别结果，我们提出了一种使用级数逼近的两步半参数程序来估计边际治疗效应。我们证明了所提出的估计量是一致且渐近正态分布的。作为实证说明，我们调查了风险行为对青少年学业成绩的影响。

records.title_en: Maximum likelihood estimation for α-stable double autoregressive models
records.title_cn: α-稳定双自回归模型的最大似然估计
records.abstract_en: The paper investigates the maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) for a first-order double autoregressive model with standardized non-Gaussian symmetric α-stable innovation (sDAR) within a unified framework of stationary and explosive cases. It is shown that the MLE of all parameters, including the stable exponent in the innovation, are strongly consistent and asymptotically normal (with the exception of the intercept for the explosive case). Particularly, the MLE of the parameter in the conditional location is always asymptotically normal, regardless of the stationary or explosive case. This point totally differs from that for linear α-stable AR models in Andrews et al. (2009). Furthermore, it is the first time to provide exact values of the quantities related to the innovation in the asymptotic covariance matrices when the true innovation is the standard Cauchy distribution. Additionally, a modified Kolmogorov-type test statistic is proposed for model diagnostic checking in the stationary case. Monte Carlo simulation studies are conducted to confirm our theoretical findings and assess the finite-sample performance of the MLE and the modified Kolmogorov-type test. An empirical example is analyzed to illustrate the usefulness of sDAR models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在平稳和爆炸情形的统一框架下，具有标准化非高斯对称α-稳定新息的一阶双自回归模型（sDAR）的最大似然估计（MLE）。结果表明，所有参数（包括新息中的稳定指数）的MLE都是强相合且渐近正态的（爆炸情形下的截距项除外）。特别地，条件位置参数的MLE在平稳或爆炸情形下总是渐近正态的。这一点与Andrews等人（2009）的线性α-稳定AR模型完全不同。此外，当真实新息为标准柯西分布时，本文首次提供了渐近协方差矩阵中与新息相关的量的精确值。另外，本文提出了一种修正的Kolmogorov型检验统计量，用于平稳情形下的模型诊断检验。进行了蒙特卡洛模拟研究以证实我们的理论发现并评估MLE和修正的Kolmogorov型检验的有限样本性能。通过一个实证例子分析了sDAR模型的有用性。

records.title_en: When bias contributes to variance: True limit theory in functional coefficient cointegrating regression
records.title_cn: 当偏差导致方差：函数系数协整回归中的真实极限理论
records.abstract_en: Limit distribution theory in the econometric literature for functional coefficient cointegrating regression is incorrect in important ways, influencing rates of convergence, distributional properties, and practical work. The correct limit theory reveals that components from both bias and variance terms contribute to variability in the asymptotics. The errors in the literature arise because random variability in the bias term has been neglected in earlier research. In stationary regression this random variability is of smaller order and can be ignored in asymptotic analysis but not without consequences for finite sample performance. Implications of the findings for rate efficient estimation are discussed. Simulations in the Online Supplement provide further evidence supporting the new limit theory in nonstationary functional coefficient regressions.
records.abstract_cn: 计量经济学文献中关于函数系数协整回归的极限分布理论在重要方面存在错误，影响了收敛速率、分布性质以及实际工作。正确的极限理论揭示了偏差项和方差项中的成分都对渐近性中的变异性有所贡献。文献中的错误源于早期研究忽略了偏差项中的随机变异性。在平稳回归中，这种随机变异性阶数较小，在渐近分析中可以忽略，但并非对有限样本表现没有影响。本文讨论了这些发现对速率有效估计的启示。在线补充材料中的模拟进一步支持了非平稳函数系数回归中新极限理论的证据。

records.title_en: Time series estimation of the dynamic effects of disaster-type shocks
records.title_cn: 灾害型冲击动态效应的时间序列估计
records.abstract_en: This paper provides three results for SVARs under the assumption that the primitive shocks are mutually independent. First, a framework is proposed to accommodate a disaster-type variable with infinite variance into a SVAR. We show that the least squares estimates of the SVAR are consistent but have non-standard asymptotics. Second, the disaster shock is identified as the component with the largest kurtosis. An estimator that is robust to infinite variance is used to recover the mutually independent components. Third, an independence test on the residuals pre-whitened by the Choleski decomposition is proposed to test the restrictions imposed on a SVAR. The test can be applied whether the data have fat or thin tails, and to over as well as exactly identified models. Three applications are considered. In the first, the independence test is used to shed light on the conflicting evidence regarding the role of uncertainty in economic fluctuations. In the second, disaster shocks are shown to have short term economic impact arising mostly from feedback dynamics. The third uses the framework to study the dynamic effects of economic shocks post-covid.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在原始冲击相互独立的假设下，为SVAR提供了三个结果。首先，提出了一个框架，将具有无限方差的灾害型变量纳入SVAR。我们表明，SVAR的最小二乘估计是一致的，但具有非标准渐近性。其次，灾害冲击被识别为具有最大峰度的成分。使用对无限方差稳健的估计器来恢复相互独立的成分。第三，提出了对经Choleski分解预白化的残差进行独立性检验，以检验对SVAR施加的限制。该检验可应用于厚尾或薄尾数据，以及过度识别和恰好识别的模型。考虑了三个应用。在第一个应用中，独立性检验被用来阐明关于不确定性在经济波动中作用的相互矛盾的证据。在第二个应用中，灾害冲击被证明具有短期经济影响，主要来自反馈动态。第三个应用使用该框架研究疫情后经济冲击的动态效应。

records.title_en: Spatial econometrics for misaligned data
records.title_cn: 错位数据的空间计量经济学
records.abstract_en: We produce methodology for regression analysis when the geographic locations of the independent and dependent variables do not coincide, in which case we speak of misaligned data. We develop and investigate two complementary methods for regression analysis with misaligned data that circumvent the need to estimate or specify the covariance of the regression errors. We carry out a detailed reanalysis of Maccini and Yang (2009) and find economically significant quantitative differences but sustain most qualitative conclusions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了当自变量和因变量的地理位置不一致时的回归分析方法论，这种情况下我们称之为错位数据。我们开发并研究了两种互补的错位数据回归分析方法，这些方法避免了估计或指定回归误差协方差的需要。我们对Maccini和Yang（2009）进行了详细的再分析，发现了经济上显著的定量差异，但维持了大多数定性结论。

records.title_en: Machine learning panel data regressions with heavy-tailed dependent data: Theory and application
records.title_cn: 机器学习面板数据回归与重尾相依数据：理论与应用
records.abstract_en: The paper introduces structured machine learning regressions for heavy-tailed dependent panel data potentially sampled at different frequencies. We focus on the sparse-group LASSO regularization. This type of regularization can take advantage of the mixed frequency time series panel data structures and improve the quality of the estimates. We obtain oracle inequalities for the pooled and fixed effects sparse-group LASSO panel data estimators recognizing that financial and economic data can have fat tails. To that end, we leverage on a new Fuk–Nagaev concentration inequality for panel data consisting of heavy-tailed τ-mixing processes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了针对可能以不同频率采样的重尾相依面板数据的结构化机器学习回归。我们关注稀疏组LASSO正则化。这种类型的正则化可以利用混合频率时间序列面板数据结构，并提高估计质量。我们获得了池化和固定效应稀疏组LASSO面板数据估计量的oracle不等式，认识到金融和经济数据可能具有肥尾。为此，我们利用了一个新的针对由重尾τ混合过程组成的面板数据的Fuk–Nagaev浓度不等式。

records.title_en: A new robust inference for predictive quantile regression
records.title_cn: 预测分位数回归的一种新的稳健推断
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel approach to offer a robust inferential theory across all types of persistent regressors in a predictive quantile regression model. We first estimate a quantile regression with an auxiliary regressor, which is generated as a weighted combination of an exogenous random walk process and a bounded transformation of the original regressor. With a similar spirit of rotation in factor analysis, one can then construct a weighted estimator using the estimated coefficients of the original predictor and the auxiliary regressor. Under some mild conditions, it shows that the self-normalized test statistic based on the weighted estimator converges to a standard normal distribution. Our new approach enjoys a good property that it can reach the local power under the optimal rate T with nonstationary predictor and T for stationary predictor, respectively. More importantly, our approach can be easily used to characterize mixed persistency degrees in multiple regressions. Simulations and empirical studies are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the newly proposed approach. The heterogeneous predictability of US stock returns at different quantile levels is reexamined.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新方法，为预测分位数回归模型中的各类持久性回归因子提供稳健的推断理论。我们首先使用一个辅助回归因子估计分位数回归，该辅助回归因子由外生随机游走过程与原始回归因子的有界变换的加权组合生成。类似于因子分析中的旋转思想，我们可以利用原始预测变量和辅助回归因子的估计系数构造加权估计量。在温和条件下，基于加权估计量的自归一化检验统计量收敛于标准正态分布。我们的新方法具有良好的性质，对于非平稳预测因子和平稳预测因子，分别能在最优速率T和T下达到局部功效。更重要的是，我们的方法可以轻松用于刻画多元回归中的混合持久性程度。通过模拟和实证研究证明了新方法的有效性。本文重新检验了美国股票收益在不同分位数水平下的异质可预测性。

records.title_en: Quasi-maximum likelihood estimation of break point in high-dimensional factor models
records.title_cn: 高维因子模型中断点的拟极大似然估计
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a quasi-maximum likelihood (QML) estimator of the break point for large-dimensional factor models with a single structural break in the factor loading matrix. We show that the QML estimator is consistent for the true break point when the covariance matrix of the pre- or post-break factor loading (or both) is singular. Consistency here means that the deviation of the estimated break date from the true break date k0 converges to zero as the sample size grows. This is a much stronger result than the break fraction kˆ/T being T-consistent (super-consistent) for k0/T. Also, singularity occurs for most types of structural changes, except for a rotational change. Even for a rotational change, the QML estimator is still T-consistent in terms of the break fraction. Simulation results confirm the theoretical properties of our estimator, and it significantly outperforms existing estimators for change points in factor models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对因子载荷矩阵存在单一结构断点的大维因子模型，提出了一种断点的拟极大似然（QML）估计量。我们证明，当断点前或断点后因子载荷（或两者）的协方差矩阵奇异时，QML估计量对于真实断点是一致的。这里的一致性意味着，随着样本量的增长，估计断点日期与真实断点日期k0的偏差收敛到零。这比断点分数kˆ/T对于k0/T具有T一致性（超一致性）的结果要强得多。此外，除旋转变化外，大多数类型的结构变化都会出现奇异性。即使对于旋转变化，QML估计量在断点分数方面仍然具有T一致性。模拟结果证实了我们估计量的理论性质，并且它显著优于现有的因子模型变点估计量。

records.title_en: The determinants of displaced workers’ wages: Sorting, matching, selection, and the Hartz reforms
records.title_cn: 失业工人工资的决定因素：分类、匹配、选择与哈茨改革
records.abstract_en: We present a simple new method to decompose the wage effects of displacement into components due to differences in the way that displaced and non-displaced workers are sorted across higher- and lower-paying employers (a sorting effect), differences in the quality of worker–employer matches that they enter into (a matching effect), and differences in their unobservable characteristics (a selection effect). In an extended application, we apply our decomposition to understand how the determinants of displaced workers’ wages in Germany changed following the 2003–2005 Hartz reforms. We find that the wages of displaced workers fell substantially after the reforms, and that over 80 percent of the decline was because they found re-employment at lower-paying employers. Sorting into worse matches explains a smaller 5–9 percent of the wage decline experienced by men, and 12–23.5 percent of the female wage decline. Collectively, the sorting and matching channels explain almost all of the post-reform decline in displaced workers’ wages, and selection played little role.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种简单的新方法，将失业的工资效应分解为以下组成部分：失业工人与非失业工人在高薪和低薪雇主之间的分类差异（分类效应）、他们进入的工人-雇主匹配质量的差异（匹配效应）以及他们不可观测特征的差异（选择效应）。在一个扩展应用中，我们应用我们的分解方法来理解德国失业工人工资的决定因素在2003-2005年哈茨改革后如何变化。我们发现，改革后失业工人的工资大幅下降，其中超过80%的下降是因为他们在低薪雇主处重新就业。分类到更差的匹配解释了男性工资下降的较小部分5-9%，以及女性工资下降的12-23.5%。总体而言，分类和匹配渠道几乎解释了改革后失业工人工资下降的全部，而选择所起的作用很小。

records.title_en: Probabilistic prediction for binary treatment choice: With focus on personalized medicine
records.title_cn: 二元治疗选择的概率预测：聚焦个性化医疗
records.abstract_en: This paper extends my research applying statistical decision theory to treatment choice with sample data, using maximum regret to evaluate the performance of statistical treatment rules. The specific new contribution is to study as-if optimization using estimates of illness probabilities in a class of medical decisions. Beyond its specifics, the paper sends a broad message. Statisticians and computer scientists have addressed conditional prediction for decision making in indirect ways, the former applying classical statistical theory and the latter measuring prediction accuracy in test samples. Neither approach is satisfactory. Statistical decision theory provides a coherent, generally applicable methodology.
records.abstract_cn: 本文扩展了我将统计决策理论应用于样本数据治疗选择的研究，使用最大遗憾来评估统计治疗规则的性能。具体的新贡献是研究在医疗决策类别中使用疾病概率估计的拟优化。除具体内容外，本文传达了一个广泛的信息。统计学家和计算机科学家以间接方式解决了决策的条件预测问题，前者应用经典统计理论，后者在测试样本中衡量预测准确性。这两种方法都不令人满意。统计决策理论提供了一种连贯且普遍适用的方法论。

records.title_en: Generalized linear models with structured sparsity estimators
records.title_cn: 具有结构化稀疏估计量的广义线性模型
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce structured sparsity estimators for use in Generalized Linear Models. Structured sparsity estimators in the least squares loss are introduced by Stucky and van de Geer (2018). Their proofs exclusively depend on their use of fixed design and normal errors. We extend their results to debiased structured sparsity estimators with Generalized Linear Model based loss through incorporating random design and non-sub Gaussian data. Structured sparsity estimation means that penalized loss functions with a possible sparsity structure in a norm. These norms include norms generated from convex cones.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们介绍了用于广义线性模型的结构化稀疏估计量。Stucky和van de Geer（2018）在最小二乘损失中引入了结构化稀疏估计量。他们的证明完全依赖于固定设计和正态误差的使用。我们将他们的结果扩展到基于广义线性模型损失的去偏结构化稀疏估计量，通过纳入随机设计和非次高斯数据。结构化稀疏估计意味着在范数中具有可能稀疏结构的惩罚损失函数。这些范数包括由凸锥生成的范数。

records.title_en: Testing many restrictions under heteroskedasticity
records.title_cn: 异方差下多重约束的检验
records.abstract_en: We propose a hypothesis test that allows for many tested restrictions in a heteroskedastic linear regression model. The test compares the conventional F statistic to a critical value that corrects for many restrictions and conditional heteroskedasticity. This correction uses leave-one-out estimation to correctly center the critical value and leave-three-out estimation to appropriately scale it. The large sample properties of the test are established in an asymptotic framework where the number of tested restrictions may be fixed or may grow with the sample size, and can even be proportional to the number of observations. We show that the test is asymptotically valid and has non-trivial asymptotic power against the same local alternatives as the exact F test when the latter is valid. Simulations corroborate these theoretical findings and suggest excellent size control in moderately small samples, even under strong heteroskedasticity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种假设检验方法，允许在异方差线性回归模型中对许多被检验的约束进行检验。该检验将传统的F统计量与一个针对多重约束和条件异方差进行修正的临界值进行比较。这种修正使用留一法估计来正确居中临界值，并使用留三法估计来适当缩放临界值。该检验的大样本性质在一个渐近框架中建立，其中被检验的约束数量可以是固定的，也可以随样本量增长，甚至可以与观测数量成比例。我们证明该检验是渐近有效的，并且在精确F检验有效时，对相同的局部备择假设具有非平凡的渐近功效。模拟结果证实了这些理论发现，并表明在中等偏小的样本中，即使在强异方差下，也能很好地控制检验水平。

records.title_en: Relaxing conditional independence in an endogenous binary response model
records.title_cn: 放宽内生二元响应模型中的条件独立性
records.abstract_en: For binary response models, the literature primarily addresses endogeneity by a control function approach assuming conditional independence (CF-CI). However, as the literature also notes, CF-CI implies conditions like homoskedasticity (of the latent error with respect to the instruments) that fail in many empirical settings. I propose an alternative approach that allows for heteroskedasticity, achieving identification with a conditional mean restriction. These identification results apply to a latent Gaussian error term with flexibly parametrized heteroskedasticity. I propose a two step conditional maximum likelihood estimator and derive its asymptotic distribution. In simulations, the new estimator outperforms others when CF-CI fails and is fairly robust to distributional misspecification.
records.abstract_cn: 对于二元响应模型，文献主要通过假设条件独立性的控制函数方法（CF-CI）来处理内生性。然而，正如文献也指出的，CF-CI隐含了诸如（潜在误差相对于工具变量的）同方差性等条件，这些条件在许多实证环境中不成立。我提出了一种允许异方差性的替代方法，通过条件均值限制实现识别。这些识别结果适用于具有灵活参数化异方差性的潜在高斯误差项。我提出了一个两步条件最大似然估计器，并推导了其渐近分布。在模拟中，当CF-CI失效时，新估计器优于其他估计器，并且对分布误设相当稳健。

records.title_en: Asymptotic properties of Bayesian inference in linear regression with a structural break
records.title_cn: 结构突变线性回归中贝叶斯推断的渐近性质
records.abstract_en: This paper studies large sample properties of a Bayesian approach to inference about slope parameters γ in linear regression models with a structural break. In contrast to the conventional approach to inference about γ that does not take into account the uncertainty of the unknown break date, the Bayesian approach that we consider incorporates such uncertainty. Our main theoretical contribution is a Bernstein–von Mises type theorem (Bayesian asymptotic normality) for γ under a wide class of priors, which essentially indicates an asymptotic equivalence between the conventional frequentist and Bayesian inference. Consequently, a frequentist researcher could look at credible intervals of γ to check robustness with respect to the uncertainty of the break date. Simulation studies show that the conventional confidence intervals of γ tend to undercover in finite samples whereas the credible intervals offer more reasonable coverages in general. As the sample size increases, the two methods coincide, as predicted from our theoretical conclusion. Using data from Paye and Timmermann (2006) on stock return prediction, we illustrate that the traditional confidence intervals on γ might underrepresent the true sampling uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在具有结构突变的线性回归模型中，关于斜率参数γ的贝叶斯推断方法的大样本性质。与传统的推断γ的方法不考虑未知突变日期的不确定性不同，我们所考虑的贝叶斯方法纳入了这种不确定性。我们的主要理论贡献是，在广泛的先验类别下，针对γ的Bernstein–von Mises型定理（贝叶斯渐近正态性），这本质上表明了传统频率学派推断与贝叶斯推断之间的渐近等价性。因此，频率学派研究者可以查看γ的置信区间，以检查相对于突变日期不确定性的稳健性。模拟研究表明，传统的γ置信区间在有限样本中往往覆盖不足，而置信区间通常提供更合理的覆盖率。随着样本量的增加，两种方法趋于一致，正如我们的理论结论所预测的那样。利用Paye和Timmermann（2006）关于股票收益预测的数据，我们说明传统的γ置信区间可能低估了真实的抽样不确定性。

records.title_en: A spatial panel quantile model with unobserved heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有不可观测异质性的空间面板分位数模型
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a spatial panel quantile model with unobserved heterogeneity. The proposed model is capable of capturing high-dimensional cross-sectional dependence and allows heterogeneous regression coefficients. For estimating model parameters, a new estimation procedure is proposed. When both the time and cross-sectional dimensions of the panel go to infinity, the uniform consistency and the asymptotic normality of the estimated parameters are established. In order to determine the dimension of the interactive fixed effects, we propose a new information criterion. It is shown that the criterion asymptotically selects the true dimension. Monte Carlo simulations document the satisfactory performance of the proposed method. Finally, the method is applied to study the quantile co-movement structure of the U.S. stock market by taking into account the input–output linkages as firms are connected through the input–output production network.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种具有不可观测异质性的空间面板分位数模型。所提出的模型能够捕捉高维截面依赖性，并允许异质性回归系数。为了估计模型参数，提出了一种新的估计程序。当面板的时间维度和截面维度都趋于无穷大时，建立了估计参数的一致性和渐近正态性。为了确定交互固定效应的维度，我们提出了一种新的信息准则。结果表明，该准则渐近地选择了真实维度。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了所提出方法的良好性能。最后，该方法被应用于研究美国股市的分位数共同运动结构，通过考虑投入产出联系，因为企业通过投入产出生产网络相互连接。

records.title_en: Transformed regression-based long-horizon predictability tests
records.title_cn: 基于变换回归的长期可预测性检验
records.abstract_en: We propose new tests for long-horizon predictability based on IVX estimation of a transformed regression which explicitly accounts for the over-lapping nature of the dependent variable in the long-horizon regression arising from temporal aggregation. To improve efficiency, we moreover incorporate the residual augmentation approach recently used in the context of short-horizon predictability testing by Demetrescu and Rodrigues (2022). Our proposed tests improve on extant tests in the literature in a number of ways. First, they allow practitioners to remain ambivalent over the strength of the persistence of the predictors. Second, they are valid under much weaker conditions on the innovations than extant long-horizon predictability tests; in particular, we allow for general forms of conditional and unconditional heteroskedasticity in the innovations, neither of which are tied to a parametric model. Third, unlike the popular Bonferroni-based methods in the literature, our proposed tests can handle multiple predictors, and can be easily implemented as either one or two-sided hypotheses tests. Monte Carlo analysis suggests that our preferred tests offer improved finite sample properties compared to the leading tests in the literature. We report results from an empirical application investigating the use of real exchange rates for predicting nominal exchange rates and inflation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了新的长期可预测性检验，基于对变换回归的IVX估计，该估计明确考虑了长期回归中因变量因时间聚合而产生的重叠性质。为了提高效率，我们还纳入了Demetrescu和Rodrigues（2022）在短期可预测性检验中最近使用的残差增强方法。我们提出的检验在多个方面优于文献中现有的检验。首先，它们允许实践者对预测变量的持续性强度保持模糊态度。其次，它们在比现有长期可预测性检验弱得多的创新条件下有效；特别是，我们允许创新中存在一般形式的条件和非条件异方差性，这两者都不依赖于参数模型。第三，与文献中流行的基于Bonferroni的方法不同，我们提出的检验可以处理多个预测变量，并且可以轻松实现为单侧或双侧假设检验。蒙特卡洛分析表明，与文献中的主要检验相比，我们首选的检验提供了改进的有限样本性质。我们报告了一个实证应用的结果，该应用调查了使用实际汇率预测名义汇率和通货膨胀的情况。

records.title_en: Quasi score-driven models
records.title_cn: 准得分驱动模型
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces the class of quasi score-driven (QSD) models. This new class inherits and extends the basic ideas behind the development of score-driven (SD) models and addresses a number of unsolved issues in the score literature. In particular, the new class of models (i) generalizes many existing models, including SD models, (ii) disconnects the updating equation from the log-likelihood implied by the conditional density of the observations, (iii) allows testing of the assumptions behind SD models that link the updating equation of the conditional moment to the conditional density, (iv) allows QML estimation of SD models, (v) and allows explanatory variables to enter the updating equation. We establish the asymptotic properties of the QLE, QMLE and MLE of the proposed QSD model as well as the likelihood ratio and Lagrange multiplier test statistics. The finite sample properties are studied by means of an extensive Monte Carlo study. Finally, we show the empirical relevance of QSD models to estimate the conditional variance of 400 US stocks.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了准得分驱动（QSD）模型这一类模型。这一新类别继承并扩展了得分驱动（SD）模型发展背后的基本思想，并解决了得分文献中若干未解决的问题。特别是，新模型类别（i）推广了许多现有模型，包括SD模型，（ii）将更新方程与观测条件密度所隐含的对数似然断开联系，（iii）允许检验SD模型背后的假设，这些假设将条件矩的更新方程与条件密度联系起来，（iv）允许对SD模型进行QML估计，（v）并允许解释变量进入更新方程。我们建立了所提出的QSD模型的QLE、QMLE和MLE的渐近性质，以及似然比和拉格朗日乘子检验统计量。通过广泛的蒙特卡洛研究来研究有限样本性质。最后，我们展示了QSD模型在估计400只美国股票的条件方差方面的实证相关性。

records.title_en: Information criteria for latent factor models: A study on factor pervasiveness and adaptivity
records.title_cn: 潜在因子模型的信息准则：因子普遍性与适应性的研究
records.abstract_en: We study the information criteria extensively under general conditions for high-dimensional latent factor models. Upon carefully analyzing the estimation errors of the principal component analysis method, we establish theoretical results on the estimation accuracy of the latent factor scores, incorporating the impact from possibly weak factor pervasiveness; our analysis does not require the same factor strength of all the leading factors. To estimate the number of the latent factors, we propose a new penalty specification with a two-fold consideration: i) being adaptive to the strength of the factor pervasiveness, and ii) favoring more parsimonious models. Our theory establishes the validity of the proposed approach under general conditions. Additionally, we construct examples to demonstrate that when the factor strength is too weak, scenarios exist such that no information criterion can consistently identify the latent factors. We illustrate the performance of the proposed adaptive information criteria with extensive numerical examples, including simulations and a real data analysis.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在高维潜在因子模型的一般条件下广泛研究了信息准则。通过仔细分析主成分分析方法的估计误差，我们建立了潜在因子得分估计精度的理论结果，并纳入了可能较弱的因子普遍性的影响；我们的分析不要求所有主要因子具有相同的因子强度。为了估计潜在因子的数量，我们提出了一种新的惩罚规范，具有双重考虑：i) 适应因子普遍性的强度，ii) 倾向于更简约的模型。我们的理论在一般条件下确立了所提出方法的有效性。此外，我们构造了例子来证明当因子强度过弱时，存在没有任何信息准则能够一致识别潜在因子的情况。我们通过广泛的数值例子（包括模拟和真实数据分析）展示了所提出的自适应信息准则的性能。

records.title_en: The persistence of wages
records.title_cn: 工资的持续性
records.abstract_en: This paper documents the extent to which wage persistence can be explained by permanent worker, employer, and match heterogeneity. Standard methods used to perform such decompositions for industry or racial wage gaps are inappropriate for decomposing wage persistence in dynamic panel data models because of the incidental parameter problem. When we apply these methods without bias correction, we find that the majority, 59.3 percent, of wage persistence is explained by worker heterogeneity, with employer and match heterogeneity explaining 29.7 and 11.0 percent, respectively. We evaluate three methods for addressing incidental parameter bias using a Monte Carlo study. An empirical application to Portuguese linked employer–employee data shows that the uncorrected estimates tend to understate wage persistence by around 24 to 42 percent, depending on the choice of the bias correction estimator used, and overstate the extent to which wage persistence arises from permanent unobserved heterogeneity. Furthermore, results indicate that the uncorrected estimates overstate the role of permanent worker heterogeneity, and understate the role of firm heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了工资持续性在多大程度上可由永久性工人、雇主和匹配异质性来解释。用于对行业或种族工资差距进行此类分解的标准方法不适用于分解动态面板数据模型中的工资持续性，因为存在 incidental parameter 问题。当我们在没有偏差校正的情况下应用这些方法时，我们发现工资持续性的主要部分（59.3%）由工人异质性解释，雇主和匹配异质性分别解释 29.7 和 11.0%。我们通过蒙特卡洛研究评估了三种解决 incidental parameter 偏差的方法。对葡萄牙关联雇主-雇员数据的实证应用表明，未校正的估计往往低估工资持续性约 24 至 42%%，具体取决于所使用的偏差校正估计量，并高估工资持续性源于永久性未观测异质性的程度。此外，结果表明未校正的估计高估了永久性工人异质性的作用，而低估了企业异质性的作用。

records.title_en: Nonparametric difference-in-differences in repeated cross-sections with continuous treatments
records.title_cn: 重复截面数据中连续处理的非参数双重差分法
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the identification of causal effects of a continuous treatment using a new difference-in-difference strategy. Our approach allows for endogeneity of the treatment, and employs repeated cross-sections. It requires an exogenous change over time which affects the treatment in a heterogeneous way, stationarity of the distribution of unobservables and a rank invariance condition on the time trend. On the other hand, we do not impose any functional form restrictions or an additive time trend, and we are invariant to the scaling of the dependent variable. Under our conditions, the time trend can be identified using a control group, as in the binary difference-in-differences literature. In our scenario, however, this control group is defined by the data. We then identify average and quantile treatment effect parameters. We develop corresponding nonparametric estimators and study their asymptotic properties. Finally, we apply our results to the effect of disposable income on consumption.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究使用一种新的双重差分策略来识别连续处理因果效应。我们的方法允许处理的内生性，并采用重复截面数据。它要求随时间发生的外生变化以异质方式影响处理，不可观测变量分布的平稳性，以及时间趋势上的秩不变条件。另一方面，我们不施加任何函数形式限制或加性时间趋势，并且对因变量的缩放不变。在我们的条件下，时间趋势可以使用对照组来识别，如同二元双重差分文献中那样。然而，在我们的情景中，这个对照组由数据定义。然后我们识别平均和分位数处理效应参数。我们开发相应的非参数估计器并研究其渐近性质。最后，我们将我们的结果应用于可支配收入对消费的影响。

records.title_en: Post-processed posteriors for sparse covariances
records.title_cn: 稀疏协方差的后处理后验
records.abstract_en: We consider Bayesian inference of sparse covariance matrices and propose a post-processed posterior. This method consists of two steps. In the first step, posterior samples are obtained from the conjugate inverse-Wishart posterior without considering the sparse structural assumption. The posterior samples are transformed in the second step to satisfy the sparse structural assumption through a generalized thresholding function. This non-traditional Bayesian procedure is justified by showing that the post-processed posterior attains the optimal minimax rates under the spectral norm loss in high-dimensional settings. We also propose the post-processed posterior for contaminated data and apply it to the estimation of the sparse idiosyncratic covariance of the approximate factor model. The advantages of our method are demonstrated via a simulation study and a real data analysis with S&P 500 data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑稀疏协方差矩阵的贝叶斯推断，并提出一种后处理的后验。该方法包括两个步骤。第一步，在不考虑稀疏结构假设的情况下，从共轭逆威沙特后验中获得后验样本。第二步，通过广义阈值函数对后验样本进行变换，以满足稀疏结构假设。这种非传统的贝叶斯程序通过证明后处理的后验在高维设置下在谱范数损失下达到最优极小极大速率而得到合理性证明。我们还提出了针对污染数据的后处理的后验，并将其应用于近似因子模型的稀疏特质协方差的估计。通过模拟研究和S&P 500数据的实际数据分析，展示了我们方法的优势。

records.title_en: Scalable inference for a full multivariate stochastic volatility model
records.title_cn: 全多元随机波动率模型的可扩展推断
records.abstract_en: We introduce a multivariate stochastic volatility model that imposes no restrictions on the structure of the volatility matrix and treats all its elements as functions of latent stochastic processes. Inference is achieved via a carefully designed feasible and scalable MCMC that has quadratic, rather than cubic, computational complexity for evaluating the multivariate normal densities required. We illustrate how our model can be applied on macroeconomic applications through a stochastic volatility VAR model, comparing it to competing approaches in the literature. We also demonstrate how our approach can be applied to a large dataset containing 571 stock daily returns of Euro STOXX index.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个多元随机波动率模型，该模型对波动率矩阵的结构不加任何限制，并将其所有元素视为潜在随机过程的函数。通过精心设计的可行且可扩展的MCMC实现推断，该MCMC在评估所需多元正态密度时具有二次而非三次的计算复杂度。我们通过一个随机波动率VAR模型说明了我们的模型如何应用于宏观经济应用，并与文献中的竞争方法进行比较。我们还展示了我们的方法如何应用于包含Euro STOXX指数571只股票日收益的大型数据集。

records.title_en: A condition for the identification of multivariate models with binary instruments
records.title_cn: 二元工具变量下多元模型识别的一个条件
records.abstract_en: This article introduces an empirical condition for the nonparametric point-identification of multivariate instrumental variable models with continuous endogenous variables using binary instruments. Verifying this condition can confirm point-identification in settings in which traditional approaches are not applicable. In particular, it shows that nonlinear instrumental variable models with general heterogeneity can be point-identified with only a binary instrument. This generalizes existing identification results which either restrict the unobserved heterogeneity substantially or require the instrument to have a large support. The main assumption on the instrumental variable model is cyclic monotonicity of its first stage, a multivariate generalization of the classical rank-invariance assumption for univariate models. Asymptotic convergence results for the empirical observable distributions are derived that allow to check the condition in practice. The identification rests on a fixed-set convergence result of cyclically monotone maps between quasi-concave functions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一个经验条件，用于在连续内生变量和二元工具变量的情况下，实现多元工具变量模型的非参数点识别。验证该条件可以确认在传统方法不适用的设定中的点识别。特别地，它表明具有一般异质性的非线性工具变量模型可以仅通过二元工具变量实现点识别。这推广了现有的识别结果，这些结果要么大幅限制未观测异质性，要么要求工具变量具有大支撑集。对工具变量模型的主要假设是其第一阶段的循环单调性，这是单变量模型经典秩不变假设的多元推广。推导了经验可观测分布的渐近收敛结果，使得在实践中可以检验该条件。识别依赖于拟凹函数之间循环单调映射的固定集收敛结果。

records.title_en: Estimation of spatial sample selection models: A partial maximum likelihood approach
records.title_cn: 空间样本选择模型的估计：一种部分极大似然方法
records.abstract_en: We study estimation of sample selection models with the spatially lagged latent dependent variable or spatial errors in both the selection and outcome equations under cross-sectional dependence. Since there is no estimation framework for the spatial-lag model and the existing estimators for the spatial-error model are computationally demanding or have poor small sample properties, we suggest to estimate these models by the partial maximum likelihood estimator. We show that the estimator is consistent and asymptotically normally distributed. To facilitate easy and precise estimation of the variance matrix, we propose the parametric bootstrap method. Simulations demonstrate the advantages of the estimators.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在截面依赖下，选择方程和结果方程中均包含空间滞后潜变量或空间误差的样本选择模型的估计问题。由于空间滞后模型缺乏估计框架，且现有空间误差模型的估计器计算量大或小样本性质不佳，我们建议通过部分极大似然估计器来估计这些模型。我们证明了该估计器是一致的且渐近正态分布。为了便于对方差矩阵进行简单而精确的估计，我们提出了参数自助法。模拟实验证明了这些估计器的优势。

records.title_en: On the aggregation of probability assessments: Regularized mixtures of predictive densities for Eurozone inflation and real interest rates
records.title_cn: 概率评估的聚合：欧元区通胀与实际利率的预测密度正则化混合
records.abstract_en: We propose methods for constructing regularized mixtures of density forecasts. We explore a variety of objectives and regularization penalties, and we use them in a substantive exploration of Eurozone inflation and real interest rate density forecasts. All individual inflation forecasters (even the ex post best forecaster) are outperformed by our regularized mixtures. From the Great Recession onward, the optimal regularization tends to move density forecasts’ probability mass from the centers to the tails, correcting for overconfidence.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了构建密度预测正则化混合的方法。我们探索了多种目标和正则化惩罚，并将其用于对欧元区通胀和实际利率密度预测的实质性研究。所有个体通胀预测者（即使是事后最优预测者）都被我们的正则化混合方法超越。自大衰退以来，最优正则化倾向于将密度预测的概率质量从中心移至尾部，以修正过度自信。

records.title_en: Structural inference in sparse high-dimensional vector autoregressions
records.title_cn: 稀疏高维向量自回归中的结构推断
records.abstract_en: We consider statistical inference for impulse responses and forecast error variance decompositions in sparse, structural high-dimensional vector autoregressive (SVAR) systems. We introduce consistent estimators of impulse responses in the high-dimensional setting and suggest valid inference procedures for the same parameters. Statistical inference in our setting is much more involved since standard procedures, like the delta-method, do not apply. By using local projection equations, we first construct a de-sparsified version of regularized estimators of the moving average parameters associated with the VAR system. We then obtain estimators of the structural impulse responses by combining the aforementioned de-sparsified estimators with a non-regularized estimator of the contemporaneous impact matrix, also taking into account the high-dimensionality of the system. We show that the distribution of the derived estimators of structural impulse responses has a Gaussian limit. We also present a valid bootstrap procedure to estimate this distribution. Applications of the inference procedure in the construction of confidence intervals for impulse responses as well as in tests for forecast error variance decomposition are presented. Our procedure is illustrated by means of simulations and an empirical application.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑稀疏、结构性高维向量自回归（SVAR）系统中脉冲响应和预测误差方差分解的统计推断。我们引入了高维设置下脉冲响应的一致估计量，并为这些参数提出了有效的推断程序。由于标准程序（如delta方法）不适用，我们设置中的统计推断更为复杂。通过使用局部投影方程，我们首先构建了与VAR系统相关的移动平均参数的正则化估计量的去稀疏化版本。然后，我们通过将上述去稀疏化估计量与同期影响矩阵的非正则化估计量相结合，同时考虑系统的高维性，获得结构性脉冲响应的估计量。我们证明了所导出的结构性脉冲响应估计量的分布具有高斯极限。我们还提出了一种有效的自助法程序来估计该分布。我们展示了推断程序在构建脉冲响应置信区间以及预测误差方差分解检验中的应用。我们的程序通过模拟和实证应用进行了说明。

records.title_en: Identifying latent factors based on high-frequency data
records.title_cn: 基于高频数据识别潜在因子
records.abstract_en: This paper tests whether the continuous component of an observable candidate factor is in the space spanned by the counterparts of latent common factors with high-frequency financial data. We introduce two identification strategies corresponding to two types of regressions: the regressions of intraday asset returns on the estimated factors and the candidate, and the regression of the candidate factor on the estimated ones. We construct the test statistics by adding randomness to the statistics obtained from residuals of the regressions, and demonstrate the consistency of the novel randomized tests. Simulations are conducted to evaluate the performance of the tests in finite samples. We also perform empirical applications to identify the relationships between some candidate factors and the latent ones, and further use the factors selected by the tests for portfolio allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文检验了可观测候选因子的连续成分是否位于由潜在共同因子的对应成分所张成的空间中，使用的是高频金融数据。我们引入了两种识别策略，对应于两类回归：日内资产收益率对估计因子和候选因子的回归，以及候选因子对估计因子的回归。我们通过向回归残差所得的统计量中添加随机性来构造检验统计量，并证明了新颖的随机化检验的一致性。我们进行了模拟以评估检验在有限样本中的表现。我们还进行了实证应用，以识别某些候选因子与潜在因子之间的关系，并进一步使用检验选出的因子进行投资组合配置。

records.title_en: Union membership density and wages: The role of worker, firm, and job-title heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 工会密度与工资：工人、企业和职位异质性的作用
records.abstract_en: We examine the association between union density and wages in Portugal where just 10 percent of all workers are union members but nine-tenths of them are covered by collective agreements. Using a unique dataset on workers, firms, and collective bargaining agreements, we examine the union density wage gap in total monthly wages and its sources – namely, worker, firm, and job-title or ‘occupational’ heterogeneity – using the Gelbach decomposition. The most important source of the mark-up associated with union density is the firm fixed effect, reflecting the differing wage policies of more and less unionized workplaces, which explains two-thirds of the wage gap. Next in importance is the job-title fixed effect, capturing occupational heterogeneity across industries. It makes up one-third of the gap, the inference being that the unobserved skills of workers contribute at most only trivially to the union density wage gap. In a separate analysis based on disaggregations of the total wage, it is also found that employers can in part offset the impact of the bargaining power of unions on wages through firm-specific wage arrangements in the form of the wage cushion. Finally, union density is shown to be associated with a modest reduction in wage inequality as the union density wage gap is highest among low-wage workers. This result is driven by the job-title fixed effect, low-wage workers benefiting more from being placed in higher paying ‘occupations.’
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了葡萄牙工会密度与工资之间的关联，在葡萄牙，只有10%的工人是工会会员，但其中十分之九的工人受到集体协议的覆盖。利用关于工人、企业和集体谈判协议的独特数据集，我们使用Gelbach分解考察了工会密度在月总工资中的工资差距及其来源——即工人、企业和职位或‘职业’异质性。与工会密度相关的加成最重要的来源是企业固定效应，反映了工会化程度高和低的 workplaces 的不同工资政策，这解释了工资差距的三分之二。其次是职位固定效应，捕捉了跨行业的职业异质性。它构成了差距的三分之一，推断是工人的未观察技能对工会密度工资差距的贡献至多是微不足道的。在基于总工资分解的单独分析中，还发现雇主可以通过企业特定的工资安排（以工资缓冲的形式）部分抵消工会谈判力量对工资的影响。最后，工会密度与工资不平等的适度减少相关，因为工会密度工资差距在低工资工人中最高。这一结果由职位固定效应驱动，低工资工人从被安排在更高薪酬的‘职业’中获益更多。

records.title_en: Synthetic Learner: Model-free inference on treatments over time
records.title_cn: 合成学习者：随时间推移的治疗效果的模型无关推断
records.abstract_en: Understanding the effect of a particular treatment or a policy pertains to many areas of interest, ranging from political economics, marketing to healthcare. In this paper, we develop a non-parametric algorithm for detecting the effects of treatment over time in the context of Synthetic Controls. The method builds on counterfactual predictions from many algorithms without necessarily assuming that the algorithms correctly capture the model. We introduce an inferential procedure to detect treatment effects and show that the testing procedure controls size asymptotically for stationary, beta mixing processes without imposing any restriction on the set of base algorithms under consideration. We discuss consistency guarantees for average treatment effect estimates and derive regret bounds for the proposed methodology. The class of algorithms may include Random Forest, Lasso, or any other machine-learning estimator. Numerical studies and an application illustrate the advantages of the method.
records.abstract_cn: 理解特定治疗或政策的效果涉及许多感兴趣的领域，从政治经济学、市场营销到医疗保健。在本文中，我们开发了一种非参数算法，用于在合成控制的背景下检测随时间推移的治疗效果。该方法基于许多算法的反事实预测，而不必假设这些算法正确捕捉了模型。我们引入了一种推断程序来检测治疗效果，并表明该检验程序在平稳、β混合过程下渐近控制规模，而无需对所考虑的基础算法集施加任何限制。我们讨论了平均治疗效果估计的一致性保证，并为所提出的方法推导了遗憾界。算法类别可包括随机森林、Lasso或任何其他机器学习估计器。数值研究和应用说明了该方法的优势。

records.title_en: Large stochastic volatility in mean VARs
records.title_cn: 均值向量自回归中的大随机波动性
records.abstract_en: Bayesian vector autoregressions with stochastic volatility in both the conditional mean and variance (SVMVARs) are widely used for studying the macroeconomic effects of uncertainty. Despite their popularity, intensive computational demands when estimating such models has constrained researchers to specifying a small number of latent volatilities, and made out-of-sample forecasting exercises impractical. In this paper, we propose an efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm that facilitates timely posterior and predictive inference with large SVMVARs. In a simulation exercise, we show that the new algorithm is significantly faster than the state-of-the-art particle Gibbs with ancestor sampling algorithm, and exhibits superior mixing properties. In two applications, we show that large SVMVARs are generally useful for structural analysis and out-of-sample forecasting, and are especially useful in periods of high uncertainty such as the Great Recession and the COVID-19 pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: 在条件均值和方差中均包含随机波动性的贝叶斯向量自回归（SVMVARs）被广泛用于研究不确定性对宏观经济的影响。尽管这些模型很受欢迎，但估计此类模型时密集的计算需求限制了研究者只能指定少量潜在波动性，并使样本外预测练习变得不切实际。在本文中，我们提出了一种高效的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）算法，该算法有助于对大型SVMVARs进行及时的后验和预测推断。在模拟练习中，我们表明新算法显著快于最先进的粒子吉布斯与祖先采样算法，并表现出更优的混合性能。在两个应用中，我们表明大型SVMVARs通常对结构分析和样本外预测有用，并且在高不确定性时期（如大衰退和COVID-19大流行）尤其有用。

records.title_en: A simple joint model for returns, volatility and volatility of volatility
records.title_cn: 收益、波动率与波动率的波动率的简单联合模型
