records.abstract_en: We propose a model that allows for conditional heteroskedasticity in the volatility of asset returns and incorporates current return information into the volatility nowcast and forecast. Our model can capture all stylised facts of asset returns even with Gaussian innovations and is simple to implement. Moreover, we show that our model converges weakly to the GARCH-type diffusion as the length of the discrete time intervals between observations goes to zero. Empirical evidence shows that our model has a better fit, a more efficient parameter estimator as well as more accurate volatility and VaR forecasts than other common GARCH-type models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个允许资产收益波动率存在条件异方差性，并将当前收益信息纳入波动率即时预测和预测的模型。我们的模型即使在高斯扰动下也能捕捉资产收益的所有典型事实，并且易于实现。此外，我们证明了当观测之间的离散时间间隔长度趋近于零时，我们的模型弱收敛于GARCH型扩散。实证证据表明，与其他常见的GARCH型模型相比，我们的模型具有更好的拟合度、更有效的参数估计量以及更准确的波动率和VaR预测。

records.title_en: Bootstrap analysis of mutual fund performance
records.title_cn: 共同基金业绩的Bootstrap分析
records.abstract_en: We study bootstrap methods for fund performance evaluation. We first show that two prominent bootstrap tests have biased test sizes in a large cross-section with short time series and lack test power to detect skilled funds when a substantial number of unskilled funds are present. We then develop the theory for a valid bootstrap Hotelling’s T-squared test for zero alpha. We apply the proposed bootstrap test in a practical two-step procedure to identify skilled funds. Our empirical analysis finds that skilled funds are more engaged in active management and hold stocks with higher expected anomalous returns.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了用于基金业绩评估的bootstrap方法。我们首先表明，在时间序列较短的大截面中，两种著名的bootstrap检验存在有偏的检验规模，并且在存在大量无技能基金时，缺乏检测有技能基金的检验功效。然后，我们为零alpha开发了有效的bootstrap Hotelling T平方检验的理论。我们将所提出的bootstrap检验应用于实际的两步程序中，以识别有技能的基金。我们的实证分析发现，有技能的基金更积极参与主动管理，并持有预期异常收益较高的股票。

records.title_en: Higher-order least squares inference for spatial autoregressions
records.title_cn: 空间自回归的高阶最小二乘推断
records.abstract_en: We develop refined inference for spatial regression models with predetermined regressors. The ordinary least squares estimate of the spatial parameter is neither consistent nor asymptotically normal, unless the elements of the spatial weight matrix uniformly vanish as sample size diverges. We develop refined testing of the hypothesis of no spatial dependence, without requiring such negligibility of spatial weights, by formal Edgeworth expansions. We also develop such higher-order expansions for both an unstudentized and a studentized transformed estimate, where the studentized one can be used to provide refined interval estimates. A Monte Carlo study of finite sample performance is included.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为具有预定回归量的空间回归模型开发了精细推断。除非空间权重矩阵的元素随样本量发散而均匀消失，否则空间参数的普通最小二乘估计既不一致也不渐近正态。我们通过正式的Edgeworth展开，在不要求空间权重可忽略的情况下，开发了对无空间依赖性假设的精细检验。我们还为未学生化和学生化的变换估计开发了此类高阶展开，其中学生化的可用于提供精细的区间估计。文中包含有限样本性能的蒙特卡洛研究。

records.title_en: Semiparametric modeling of multiple quantiles
records.title_cn: 多个分位数的半参数建模
records.abstract_en: We develop a semiparametric model to track a large number of quantiles of a time series. The model satisfies the condition of non-crossing quantiles and the defining property of fixed quantiles. A key feature of the specification is that the updating scheme for time-varying quantiles at each probability level is based on the gradient of the check loss function. Theoretical properties of the proposed model are derived such as weak stationarity of the quantile process and consistency of the estimators of the fixed parameters. The model can be applied for filtering and prediction. We also illustrate a number of possible applications such as: (i) semiparametric estimation of dynamic moments of the observables, (ii) density prediction, and (iii) quantile predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个半参数模型来追踪时间序列的大量分位数。该模型满足分位数不交叉的条件以及固定分位数的定义性质。该规范的一个关键特征是，在每个概率水平上，时变分位数的更新方案基于检查损失函数的梯度。推导了所提出模型的理论性质，如分位数过程的弱平稳性和固定参数估计量的一致性。该模型可应用于滤波和预测。我们还说明了若干可能的应用，例如：（i）可观测变量动态矩的半参数估计，（ii）密度预测，以及（iii）分位数预测。

records.title_en: Identification of unobserved distribution factors and preferences in the collective household model
records.title_cn: 集体家庭模型中未观测分配因素与偏好的识别
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a non-parametric collective random utility model with a continuous choice of consumption and sharing. We allow for a heterogeneous population by introducing unobserved distribution factors and preferences that are non-separable in the stochastic household choice system. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for invertibility with respect to the vector of unobserved heterogeneity. Further, we show non-parametric identification of each individual’s idiosyncratic preferences and Pareto weights from the distribution of observed choices. Based on this result we develop a non-parametric two-step estimation procedure and estimate individual counterfactuals in a collective labour supply model for households with children using the LISS panel.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个具有连续消费与分享选择的非参数集体随机效用模型。我们通过引入在随机家庭选择系统中不可分离的未观测分配因素与偏好，允许异质性总体存在。我们提供了关于未观测异质性向量可逆性的充分必要条件。进一步，我们从观测选择分布中展示了每个个体特质偏好与帕累托权重的非参数识别。基于此结果，我们开发了一种非参数两步估计程序，并利用LISS面板数据估计了有子女家庭集体劳动供给模型中的个体反事实。

records.title_en: Large dimensional latent factor modeling with missing observations and applications to causal inference
records.title_cn: 大规模维度潜因子建模中的缺失观测及其在因果推断中的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper develops the inferential theory for latent factor models estimated from large dimensional panel data with missing observations. We propose an easy-to-use all-purpose estimator for a latent factor model by applying principal component analysis to an adjusted covariance matrix estimated from partially observed panel data. We derive the asymptotic distribution for the estimated factors, loadings and the imputed values under an approximate factor model and general missing patterns. The key application is to estimate counterfactual outcomes in causal inference from panel data. The unobserved control group is modeled as missing values, which are inferred from the latent factor model. The inferential theory for the imputed values allows us to test for individual treatment effects at any time under general adoption patterns where the units can be affected by unobserved factors.
records.abstract_cn: 本文发展了从具有缺失观测的大规模面板数据中估计潜因子模型的推断理论。我们提出了一种易于使用的通用潜因子模型估计方法，通过对部分观测面板数据估计的调整协方差矩阵进行主成分分析。在近似因子模型和一般缺失模式下，我们推导了估计因子、载荷和插补值的渐近分布。关键应用是从面板数据中估计因果推断的反事实结果。未观测的控制组被建模为缺失值，这些缺失值从潜因子模型中推断出来。插补值的推断理论使我们能够在一般采纳模式下，在任意时间点检验个体处理效应，其中个体可能受到未观测因素的影响。

records.title_en: Unequal use of social insurance benefits: The role of employers
records.title_cn: 社会保险福利的不平等使用：雇主的作用
records.abstract_en: Disability Insurance (DI) and Paid Family Leave (PFL) programs are important sources of social insurance, but there is considerable inequality in benefit take-up, and little is known about the role of firms in determining benefit use. Using administrative data from California, we find that firms that pay higher earnings premiums also have substantially higher public DI and PFL take-up rates, and that this relationship is particularly strong among the lowest-earning workers within the firm. Our results suggest that changes in firm behavior may impact social insurance use, thus reducing an important dimension of inequality in America.
records.abstract_cn: 残疾保险（DI）和带薪家庭假（PFL）项目是社会保险的重要来源，但在福利领取方面存在相当大的不平等，且关于企业在决定福利使用中的作用知之甚少。利用加利福尼亚州的行政数据，我们发现支付更高收入溢价的企业的公共DI和PFL领取率也显著更高，并且这种关系在企业内收入最低的工人中尤为强烈。我们的结果表明，企业行为的变化可能影响社会保险的使用，从而减少美国不平等的一个重要维度。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference of treatment effects with L2-boosting in high-dimensional settings
records.title_cn: 高维设定下基于L2-boosting的治疗效应估计与推断
records.abstract_en: Empirical researchers are increasingly faced with rich data sets containing many controls or instrumental variables, making it essential to choose an appropriate approach to variable selection. In this paper, we provide results for valid inference after post- or orthogonal L2-boosting is used for variable selection. We consider treatment effects after selecting among many control variables and instrumental variable models with potentially many instruments. To achieve this, we establish new results for the rate of convergence of iterated post-L2-boosting and orthogonal L2-boosting in a high-dimensional setting similar to Lasso, i.e., under approximate sparsity without assuming the beta-min condition. These results are extended to the 2SLS framework and valid inference is provided for treatment effect analysis. We give extensive simulation results for the proposed methods and compare them with Lasso. In an empirical application, we construct efficient IVs with our proposed methods to estimate the effect of pre-merger overlap of bank branch networks in the US on the post-merger stock returns of the acquirer bank.
records.abstract_cn: 实证研究者日益面临包含众多控制变量或工具变量的丰富数据集，因此选择适当的变量选择方法至关重要。在本文中，我们提供了在采用后验或正交L2-boosting进行变量选择后有效推断的结果。我们考虑在众多控制变量中选择后的治疗效应，以及可能具有众多工具变量的工具变量模型。为此，我们在类似于Lasso的高维设定下，即在近似稀疏性而不假设beta-min条件的情况下，建立了迭代后验L2-boosting和正交L2-boosting收敛速率的新结果。这些结果被扩展到2SLS框架，并为治疗效应分析提供了有效推断。我们对所提出的方法进行了广泛的模拟研究，并与Lasso进行了比较。在一个实证应用中，我们使用所提出的方法构建有效的工具变量，以估计美国银行分支网络合并前重叠对收购银行合并后股票收益的影响。

records.title_en: Testing and support recovery of correlation structures for matrix-valued observations with an application to stock market data
records.title_cn: 矩阵值观测的相关结构检验与支撑恢复及其在股票市场数据中的应用
records.abstract_en: Estimation of the covariance matrix of asset returns is crucial to portfolio construction. As suggested by economic theories, the correlation structure among assets differs between emerging markets and developed countries. It is therefore imperative to make rigorous statistical inference on correlation matrix equality between the two groups of countries. However, if the traditional vector-valued approach is undertaken, such inference is either infeasible due to limited number of countries comparing to the relatively abundant assets, or invalid due to the violations of temporal independence assumption. This highlights the necessity of treating the observations as matrix-valued rather than vector-valued. With matrix-valued observations, our problem of interest can be formulated as statistical inference on covariance structures under sub-Gaussian distributions, i.e., testing non-correlation and correlation equality, as well as the corresponding support estimations. We develop procedures that are asymptotically optimal under some regularity conditions. Simulation results demonstrate the computational and statistical advantages of our procedures over certain existing state-of-the-art methods for both normal and non-normal distributions. Application of our procedures to stock market data reveals interesting patterns and validates several economic propositions via rigorous statistical testing.
records.abstract_cn: 资产收益协方差矩阵的估计对投资组合构建至关重要。经济理论表明，新兴市场与发达国家的资产间相关结构存在差异。因此，对这两组国家之间的相关矩阵相等性进行严格的统计推断至关重要。然而，若采用传统的向量值方法，由于国家数量相对于资产数量较少，此类推断可能不可行，或因违反时间独立性假设而无效。这凸显了将观测视为矩阵值而非向量值的必要性。对于矩阵值观测，我们关注的问题可以表述为次高斯分布下协方差结构的统计推断，即非相关性和相关相等性的检验，以及相应的支撑估计。我们开发了在某些正则条件下渐近最优的程序。模拟结果表明，对于正态和非正态分布，我们的程序在计算和统计上均优于某些现有最先进方法。将我们的程序应用于股票市场数据，揭示了有趣的模式，并通过严格的统计检验验证了若干经济命题。

records.title_en: The effects of training incidence and planned training duration on labor market transitions
records.title_cn: 培训发生率和计划培训时长对劳动力市场转换的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a dynamic model for employment and training transitions in discrete time to estimate average employment effects of training incidence and planned training duration for the treated. We account for the dynamics of program start and continuation while treatment and outcome transitions are linked through correlated individual-specific effects. Identification relies on a consistency condition, conditional sequential randomization, time-varying covariates, and exclusion restrictions. We implement our framework applying MCMC methods to rich administrative data for a large training program in Germany. In addition to finding a positive training effect on employment between 6 and 12 percentage points 2.5 years after program start, we demonstrate that a longer planned training duration typically results in higher medium- to long-term employment gains.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用一个离散时间下的就业和培训转换动态模型，来估计培训发生率和计划培训时长对受训者的平均就业效应。我们考虑了项目开始和持续的动态过程，而处理和结果转换通过相关的个体特定效应相联系。识别依赖于一致性条件、条件顺序随机化、时变协变量和排除限制。我们通过将MCMC方法应用于德国一个大型培训项目的丰富行政数据来实施我们的框架。除了发现培训在项目开始后2.5年对就业有6到12个百分点的积极影响外，我们还证明了更长的计划培训时长通常会导致更高的中期至长期就业收益。

records.title_en: A flexible predictive density combination for large financial data sets in regular and crisis periods
records.title_cn: 常规与危机时期大型金融数据集的灵活预测密度组合
records.abstract_en: A flexible predictive density combination is introduced for large financial data sets which allows for model set incompleteness. Dimension reduction procedures that include learning allocate the large sets of predictive densities and combination weights to relatively small subsets. Given the representation of the probability model in extended nonlinear state-space form, efficient simulation-based Bayesian inference is proposed using parallel dynamic clustering as well as nonlinear filtering, implemented on graphics processing units. The approach is applied to combine predictive densities based on a large number of individual US stock returns of daily observations over a period that includes the Covid-19 crisis period. Evidence on dynamic cluster composition, weight patterns and model set incompleteness gives valuable signals for improved modelling. This enables higher predictive accuracy and better assessment of uncertainty and risk for investment fund management.
records.abstract_cn: 针对大型金融数据集引入了一种灵活的预测密度组合方法，该方法允许模型集不完整。包含学习的降维程序将大型预测密度集和组合权重分配给相对较小的子集。鉴于概率模型在扩展非线性状态空间形式中的表示，提出了基于并行动态聚类和非线性滤波的高效模拟贝叶斯推断，并在图形处理单元上实现。该方法应用于组合基于大量美国个股日度观测值的预测密度，时间跨度包括Covid-19危机时期。关于动态聚类组成、权重模式和模型集不完整性的证据为改进建模提供了有价值的信号。这有助于提高预测准确性，并更好地评估投资基金管理的不确定性和风险。

records.title_en: Finite-sample corrected inference for two-step GMM in time series
records.title_cn: 时间序列中两步GMM的有限样本校正推断
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a finite-sample corrected inference for the efficient generalized method of moments (GMM) in time series. To capture a higher-order uncertainty embodied in estimating the time series GMM weight matrix, we extend the finite-sample corrected variance formula of Windmeijer (2005) to heteroskedasticity autocorrelated robust (HAR) inference. Using fixed-smoothing asymptotics, we show that our finite-sample corrected test statistics lead to standard asymptotic t or F critical values and suffer from less over-rejection of the null hypothesis than existing GMM procedures on finite-samples, including continuously updating GMM. Not only does our finite-sample corrected variance formula correct for the bias arising from the plugged-in long-run variance estimation, but it is also not exposed to a potential side effect of Windmeijer’s formula, which can introduce an additional source of over-rejection after the correction.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对时间序列中的高效广义矩方法（GMM）发展了有限样本校正推断。为了捕捉估计时间序列GMM权重矩阵时体现的高阶不确定性，我们将Windmeijer（2005）的有限样本校正方差公式扩展到异方差自相关稳健（HAR）推断。利用固定平滑渐近理论，我们证明我们的有限样本校正检验统计量导致标准的渐近t或F临界值，并且在有限样本上比现有GMM程序（包括连续更新GMM）更少过度拒绝原假设。我们的有限样本校正方差公式不仅校正了由插入长期方差估计引起的偏差，而且不会暴露于Windmeijer公式的潜在副作用，该副作用可能在校正后引入额外的过度拒绝来源。

records.title_en: Testing for structural changes in large dimensional factor models via discrete Fourier transform
records.title_cn: 基于离散傅里叶变换的大维因子模型结构变化检验
records.abstract_en: We propose a new test for structural changes in large dimensional factor models using a discrete Fourier transform (DFT) approach. When structural changes occur, the conventional principal component analysis may fail to estimate the common factors and factor loadings consistently, and the estimated residuals contain information about the structural changes. This allows us to compare the DFT of the estimated residuals weighted by the estimated common factors with the null (zero) spectrum implied by no structural change. The proposed test is powerful against both smooth structural changes and abrupt structural breaks with an unknown number of breaks and unknown break dates in factor loadings. It can detect a class of local alternatives at the rate N−1/2T−1/2, where N and T are the numbers of cross-sectional units and time periods, respectively. Monte Carlo studies demonstrate that the proposed test has reasonable size and excellent power in detecting various structural changes in factor loadings. When applied to the U.S. macroeconomic data, the test reveals significant and robust evidence of time-varying factor loadings for the post-Great Moderation sample and the pre-Great Recession subsample, which the existing literature may fail to address.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种利用离散傅里叶变换（DFT）方法检验大维因子模型中结构变化的新检验。当结构变化发生时，传统的主成分分析可能无法一致地估计公共因子和因子载荷，估计残差中包含结构变化的信息。这使得我们可以将估计残差（由估计的公共因子加权）的DFT与无结构变化所隐含的零谱进行比较。所提出的检验对平滑结构变化和突变结构断裂均具有功效，且无需知道断裂次数和因子载荷中的断裂日期。它可以检测一类局部备择假设，其速率为N−1/2T−1/2，其中N和T分别为截面单位数和时间期数。蒙特卡洛研究表明，所提出的检验在检测因子载荷的各种结构变化方面具有合理的水平和优异的功效。当应用于美国宏观经济数据时，该检验揭示了大稳健时期之后样本和大衰退之前子样本中因子载荷时变性的显著且稳健的证据，而现有文献可能未能解决这一问题。

records.title_en: Internal labor markets: A worker flow approach
records.title_cn: 内部劳动力市场：一种工人流动方法
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a new method to study how workers’ career and wage profiles are shaped by internal labor markets (ILM) and job hierarchies in firms. We tackle the conceptual challenge of organizing jobs within firms into hierarchy levels by proposing a data-driven ranking method based on observed worker flows between occupations within firms. We apply our method to linked employer–employee data from Norway that record fine-grained occupational codes and track contract changes within firms. Our findings confirm existing evidence that is primarily based on case studies for single firms. We expand on this by documenting substantial heterogeneity in the structure and hierarchy of ILMs across a broad range of large firms. Our findings on wage and promotion dynamics in ILMs are consistent with models of careers in organizations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种新方法来研究工人的职业和工资曲线如何受到企业内部劳动力市场（ILM）和工作层级的影响。我们通过提出一种基于数据驱动的排名方法来解决将企业内部工作组织为层级水平的概念挑战，该方法基于观察到的企业内部职业间工人流动。我们将该方法应用于挪威的关联雇主-雇员数据，这些数据记录了细粒度的职业代码并跟踪了企业内的合同变更。我们的发现证实了主要基于单一企业案例研究的现有证据。我们通过记录广泛大型企业中ILM结构和层级的显著异质性来扩展这一点。我们对ILM中工资和晋升动态的发现与组织中职业的模型一致。

records.title_en: Multiple treatments with strategic substitutes
records.title_cn: 具有战略替代品的多种治疗方法
records.abstract_en: We develop an empirical framework to identify and estimate the effects of treatments on outcomes of interest when the treatments are the result of strategic interaction (e.g., bargaining, oligopolistic entry, peer effects). We consider a model where agents play a discrete game of complete information and strategic substitutability, whose equilibrium actions (i.e., binary treatments) determine a post-game outcome in a nonseparable model with endogeneity. Due to the simultaneity in the first stage, the model as a whole is incomplete and the selection process fails to exhibit the conventional monotonicity. Without imposing parametric restrictions or large support assumptions, this poses challenges in recovering treatment parameters. To address these challenges, we establish a monotonic pattern of the equilibria in the first-stage game in terms of the number of treatments selected. Based on this finding, we derive bounds on the average treatment effects (ATE’s) under nonparametric shape restrictions and the existence of excluded exogenous variables. We show that the instrument variation that compensates strategic substitution helps solve the multiple equilibria problem. We apply our method to data on airlines and air pollution in cities in the U.S. We find that (i) the causal effect of each airline on pollution is positive, and (ii) the effect is increasing in the number of firms but at a decreasing rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个实证框架来识别和估计当治疗是战略互动（例如讨价还价、寡头垄断进入、同行效应）的结果时治疗对感兴趣结果的影响。我们考虑一个模型，其中代理玩完整信息和策略可替代性的离散博弈，其均衡行为（即二元处理）决定具有内生性的不可分离模型中的博弈后结果。由于第一阶段的同时性，模型整体上是不完整的，选择过程无法表现出传统的单调性。在不施加参数限制或大的支持假设的情况下，这对恢复治疗参数提出了挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们在第一阶段游戏中根据所选治疗的数量建立了单调的平衡模式。基于这一发现，我们推导出非参数形状限制和排除外生变量存在下的平均治疗效果（ATE）的界限。我们证明，补偿战略替代的工具变化有助于解决多重均衡问题。我们将我们的方法应用于有关美国城市的航空公司和空气污染的数据，我们发现（i）每家航空公司对污染的因果影响是积极的，并且（ii）公司数量的影响在增加，但速度在下降。

records.title_en: Why randomize? Minimax optimality under permutation invariance
records.title_cn: 为何随机化？排列不变性下的极小极大最优性
records.abstract_en: This paper studies finite sample minimax optimal randomization schemes and estimation schemes in estimating parameters including the average treatment effect, when treatment effects are heterogeneous. A randomization scheme is a distribution over a group of permutations of a given treatment assignment vector. An estimation scheme is a joint distribution over assignment vectors, linear estimators, and permutations of assignment vectors. The key element in the minimax problem is that the worst case is over a class of distributions of the data which is invariant to a group of permutations. First, I show that given any assignment vector and any estimator, the uniform distribution over the same group of permutations, namely the complete randomization scheme, is minimax optimal. Second, under further assumptions on the class of distributions and the objective function, I show the minimax optimal estimation scheme involves completely randomizing an assignment vector, while the optimal estimator is the difference-in-means under complete invariance and a weighted average of within-block differences under a block structure, and the number of treated units is determined by the Neyman allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在治疗效果异质时，估计包括平均治疗效果在内的参数中的有限样本极小极大最优随机化方案和估计方案。随机化方案是给定治疗分配向量的一组排列上的分布。估计方案是分配向量、线性估计量和分配向量排列的联合分布。极小极大问题的关键要素是，最坏情况是在对一组排列不变的数据分布类别上考虑的。首先，我证明给定任何分配向量和任何估计量，同一组排列上的均匀分布，即完全随机化方案，是极小极大最优的。其次，在对分布类别和目标函数进一步假设下，我证明极小极大最优估计方案涉及完全随机化分配向量，而最优估计量在完全不变性下是均值差，在块结构下是块内差异的加权平均，处理单元的数量由内曼分配决定。

records.title_en: Model averaging prediction by K-fold cross-validation
records.title_cn: 基于K折交叉验证的模型平均预测
records.abstract_en: This paper considers the model averaging prediction in a quasi-likelihood framework that allows for parameter uncertainty and model misspecification. We propose an averaging prediction that selects the data-driven weights by minimizing a K-fold cross-validation. We provide two theoretical justifications for the proposed method. First, when all candidate models are misspecified, we show that the proposed averaging prediction using K-fold cross-validation weights is asymptotically optimal in the sense of achieving the lowest possible prediction risk. Second, when the model set includes correctly specified models, we demonstrate that the proposed K-fold cross-validation asymptotically assigns all weights to the correctly specified models. Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed averaging prediction achieves lower empirical risk than other existing model averaging methods. As an empirical illustration, the proposed method is applied to credit card default prediction.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在准似然框架下考虑模型平均预测，该框架允许参数不确定性和模型误设。我们提出了一种平均预测方法，通过最小化K折交叉验证来选择数据驱动的权重。我们为所提出的方法提供了两个理论依据。首先，当所有候选模型都被误设时，我们证明了使用K折交叉验证权重的所提出的平均预测在实现最低可能预测风险的意义上是渐近最优的。其次，当模型集包含正确设定的模型时，我们证明了所提出的K折交叉验证渐近地将所有权重分配给正确设定的模型。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的平均预测实现了比其他现有模型平均方法更低的经验风险。作为实证说明，所提出的方法被应用于信用卡违约预测。

records.title_en: Predictive quantile regression with mixed roots and increasing dimensions: The ALQR approach
records.title_cn: 混合根与递增维数下的预测分位数回归：ALQR方法
records.abstract_en: In this paper we propose the adaptive lasso for predictive quantile regression (ALQR). Reflecting empirical findings, we allow predictors to have various degrees of persistence and exhibit different signal strengths. The number of predictors is allowed to grow with the sample size. We study regularity conditions under which stationary, local unit root, and cointegrated predictors are present simultaneously. We next show the convergence rates, model selection consistency, and asymptotic distributions of ALQR. We apply the proposed method to the out-of-sample quantile prediction problem of stock returns and find that it outperforms the existing alternatives. We also provide numerical evidence from additional Monte Carlo experiments, supporting the theoretical results.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了自适应lasso预测分位数回归（ALQR）。反映实证发现，我们允许预测变量具有不同程度的持久性并表现出不同的信号强度。预测变量的数量允许随样本量增长。我们研究了平稳、局部单位根和协整预测变量同时存在时的正则性条件。接下来，我们展示了ALQR的收敛速度、模型选择一致性和渐近分布。我们将所提出的方法应用于股票收益的样本外分位数预测问题，并发现其优于现有替代方法。我们还提供了额外的蒙特卡洛实验数值证据，支持理论结果。

records.title_en: PELVE: Probability Equivalent Level of VaR and ES
records.title_cn: PELVE：VaR与ES的概率等价水平
records.abstract_en: In the recent Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB), the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision proposed the shift from the 99% Value-at-Risk (VaR) to the 97.5% Expected Shortfall (ES) for internal models in market risk assessment. Inspired by the above transition, we introduce a new distributional index, the probability equivalence level of VaR and ES (PELVE), which identifies the balancing point for the equivalence between VaR and ES. PELVE enjoys many desirable theoretical properties and it distinguishes empirically heavy-tailed distributions from light-tailed ones via a threshold of 2.72. Convergence properties and asymptotic normality of the empirical PELVE estimators are established. Applying PELVE to financial asset and portfolio data leads to interesting observations that are not captured by VaR or ES alone. We find that, in general, the transition from VaR to ES in the FRTB yields an increase in risk capital for single-asset portfolios, but for well-diversified portfolios, the capital requirement remains almost unchanged. This leads to both a theoretical justification and an empirical evidence for the conclusion that the use of ES rewards portfolio diversification more than the use of VaR.
records.abstract_cn: 在最近的交易账簿基本审查（FRTB）中，巴塞尔银行监管委员会提议在市场风险评估的内部模型中将99%的风险价值（VaR）转换为97.5%的预期损失（ES）。受上述转变的启发，我们引入了一个新的分布指数，即VaR与ES的概率等价水平（PELVE），它确定了VaR与ES等价性的平衡点。PELVE具有许多理想的理论性质，并通过2.72的阈值区分经验上的重尾分布与轻尾分布。建立了经验PELVE估计量的收敛性和渐近正态性。将PELVE应用于金融资产和组合数据，得出了单独使用VaR或ES无法捕捉的有趣观察结果。我们发现，总体而言，FRTB中从VaR到ES的转变导致单一资产组合的风险资本增加，但对于充分分散的投资组合，资本要求几乎保持不变。这为使用ES比使用VaR更能奖励投资组合多样化这一结论提供了理论依据和经验证据。

records.title_en: Estimation of spillover effects with matched data or longitudinal network data
records.title_cn: 利用匹配数据或纵向网络数据估计溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Social interactions often play a key role in determining the impact of policies, but measuring the magnitude of spillover effects empirically is notoriously challenging because, in most applications, a person’s relationships are likely to reflect her own characteristics (homophily), and people who are connected are likely to be affected by the same shocks (common factors). In addition, a significant share of social interactions is likely to occur through variables that are not observed by the researcher. When matched data are used, observations corresponding to the same cross-sectional units (e.g., workers or students) can be linked over time, and a cross-sectional unit’s relationships (e.g., co-workers or classmates) are indexed in each time period. We show that comparisons over time in the outcomes of individuals whose relationships changed can be used to measure the importance of social interactions in the presence of flexible patterns of selection on unobservables and common factors, even if social interactions only occur through unobservables. We apply our results to estimate the importance of peer effects in student learning in elementary school.
records.abstract_cn: 社会互动通常在决定政策影响中发挥关键作用，但实证测量溢出效应的规模是出了名的困难，因为在大多数应用中，一个人的关系可能反映其自身特征（同质性），并且有联系的人可能受到相同冲击的影响（共同因素）。此外，很大一部分社会互动可能通过研究者未观察到的变量发生。当使用匹配数据时，对应于同一横截面单位（如工人或学生）的观测值可以随时间链接，并且横截面单位的关系（如同事或同学）在每个时间段内被索引。我们表明，在存在灵活不可观测选择模式和共同因素的情况下，即使社会互动仅通过不可观测变量发生，比较关系发生变化个体的结果随时间的变化可以用来衡量社会互动的重要性。我们将我们的结果应用于估计小学学生学习的同伴效应的重要性。

records.title_en: Regression-adjusted estimation of quantile treatment effects under covariate-adaptive randomizations
records.title_cn: 协变量自适应随机化下分位数处理效应的回归调整估计
records.abstract_en: Datasets from field experiments with covariate-adaptive randomizations (CARs) usually contain extra covariates in addition to the strata indicators. We propose to incorporate these additional covariates via auxiliary regressions in the estimation and inference of unconditional quantile treatment effects (QTEs) under CARs. We establish the consistency and limit distribution of the regression-adjusted QTE estimator and prove that the use of multiplier bootstrap inference is non-conservative under CARs. The auxiliary regression may be estimated parametrically, nonparametrically, or via regularization when the data are high-dimensional. Even when the auxiliary regression is misspecified, the proposed bootstrap inferential procedure still achieves the nominal rejection probability in the limit under the null. When the auxiliary regression is correctly specified, the regression-adjusted estimator achieves the minimum asymptotic variance. We also discuss forms of adjustments that can improve the efficiency of the QTE estimators. The finite sample performance of the new estimation and inferential methods is studied in simulations, and an empirical application to a well-known dataset concerned with expanding access to basic bank accounts on savings is reported.
records.abstract_cn: 来自协变量自适应随机化（CARs）的实地实验数据集通常除了分层指标外还包含额外协变量。我们提出在CARs下，通过辅助回归将这些额外协变量纳入无条件分位数处理效应（QTEs）的估计和推断中。我们建立了回归调整QTE估计量的一致性及极限分布，并证明在CARs下使用乘子自助法推断是非保守的。辅助回归可以通过参数、非参数或在高维数据时通过正则化进行估计。即使辅助回归被错误设定，所提出的自助推断程序在零假设下仍能在极限中达到名义拒绝概率。当辅助回归被正确设定时，回归调整估计量达到最小渐近方差。我们还讨论了能够提高QTE估计量效率的调整形式。通过模拟研究了新估计和推断方法的有限样本性能，并报告了一个关于扩大基本银行账户获取对储蓄影响的知名数据集的实证应用。

records.title_en: Identification of time-varying transformation models with fixed effects, with an application to unobserved heterogeneity in resource shares
records.title_cn: 带固定效应的时变转换模型的识别及其在资源份额未观测异质性中的应用
records.abstract_en: We provide new results showing identification of a large class of fixed-T panel models, where the response variable is an unknown, weakly monotone, time-varying transformation of a latent linear index of fixed effects, regressors, and an error term drawn from an unknown stationary distribution. Our results identify the transformation, the coefficient on regressors, and features of the distribution of the fixed effects. We then develop a full-commitment intertemporal collective household model, where the implied quantity demand equations are time-varying functions of a linear index. The fixed effects in this index equal logged resource shares, defined as the fractions of household expenditure enjoyed by each household member. Using Bangladeshi data, we show that women’s resource shares decline with household budgets and that half of the variation in women’s resource shares is due to unobserved household-level heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了新的结果，证明了一大类固定T面板模型的识别，其中响应变量是固定效应、回归变量和来自未知平稳分布的误差项的潜在线性指数的未知、弱单调、时变转换。我们的结果识别了转换、回归变量的系数以及固定效应分布的特征。然后，我们开发了一个完全承诺的代际集体家庭模型，其中隐含的数量需求方程是线性指数的时变函数。该指数中的固定效应等于对数资源份额，定义为每个家庭成员享有的家庭支出比例。使用孟加拉国的数据，我们表明女性的资源份额随家庭预算下降，且女性资源份额变化的一半是由于未观测的家庭层面异质性造成的。

records.title_en: Logical differencing in dyadic network formation models with nontransferable utilities
records.title_cn: 不可转移效用下二元网络形成模型中的逻辑差分法
records.abstract_en: This paper considers a semiparametric model of dyadic network formation under nontransferable utilities (NTU). Such dyadic links arise frequently in real-world social interactions that require bilateral consent but by their nature induce additive non-separability. In our model we show how unobserved individual heterogeneity in the network formation model can be canceled out without requiring additive separability. The approach uses a new method we call logical differencing. The key idea is to construct an observable event involving the intersection of two mutually exclusive restrictions—derived based on weak multivariate monotonicity—on the fixed effects. Based on this identification strategy we provide consistent estimators of the network formation model under NTU. Finite-sample performance of our method is analyzed in a simulation study, and an empirical illustration using the risk-sharing network data from Nyakatoke demonstrates that our proposed method is able to obtain economically intuitive estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个在不可转移效用（NTU）下的二元网络形成的半参数模型。这种二元联系在现实世界的社会互动中频繁出现，这些互动需要双方同意，但本质上会导致加性不可分离性。在我们的模型中，我们展示了如何在不要求加性可分离性的情况下消除网络形成模型中未观测到的个体异质性。该方法使用了一种我们称之为逻辑差分的新方法。关键思想是构造一个可观测事件，该事件涉及基于弱多元单调性推导出的两个互斥限制的交集，这些限制作用于固定效应。基于这一识别策略，我们提供了在NTU下网络形成模型的一致估计量。我们通过模拟研究分析了我们方法的有限样本性能，并使用Nyakatoke的风险分担网络数据进行的实证说明表明，我们提出的方法能够获得经济上直观的估计结果。

records.title_en: Uniform predictive inference for factor models with instrumental and idiosyncratic betas
records.title_cn: 具有工具性和特质性贝塔的因子模型的统一预测推断
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of allowing for characteristic-based time-varying factor betas on the diffusion-index type forecasts. The factor beta consists of two distinct components: the “instrumental beta” is a function of some observable characteristics, while the “idiosyncratic beta” captures more volatile residual movements. To estimate these characteristic-based time-varying betas and the corresponding factors, we apply the projected principal component analysis (P-PCA) method on high-frequency returns data. The primary advantage of this method is that it refines the estimators of latent factors, which shall be used in the forecasting models. We show that various leading components of the conditional mean forecast error are all asymptotically normal and pairwise independent. Extensive simulation studies show the good finite-sample properties of the P-PCA estimators and demonstrate the advantage of the P-PCA method relative to the classic PCA method in forecasting. In our empirical experiments of volatility prediction, we find that the factor-augmented model associated with the P-PCA method is more parsimonious and achieves better performance for a wide variety of target assets. We also find evidence on different levels of variation over time in the idiosyncratic beta, which necessitates our uniform predictive inference procedure.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了允许基于特征时变因子贝塔对扩散指数型预测的影响。因子贝塔由两个不同的部分组成：“工具性贝塔”是一些可观测特征的函数，而“特质性贝塔”捕捉更波动的残差变动。为了估计这些基于特征的时变贝塔和相应的因子，我们将投影主成分分析（P-PCA）方法应用于高频收益数据。该方法的主要优势在于它改进了潜在因子的估计量，这些估计量将用于预测模型。我们证明了条件均值预测误差的各种主要组成部分都是渐近正态且两两独立的。广泛的模拟研究显示了P-PCA估计量良好的有限样本性质，并证明了P-PCA方法相对于经典PCA方法在预测中的优势。在我们的波动率预测实证实验中，我们发现与P-PCA方法相关的因子增强模型更加简洁，并且在各种目标资产上取得了更好的表现。我们还发现了特质性贝塔随时间变化的不同水平的证据，这需要我们的统一预测推断程序。

records.title_en: Dynamic factor copula models with estimated cluster assignments
records.title_cn: 动态因子copula模型与估计的聚类分配
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a dynamic multi-factor copula for use in high-dimensional time series applications. A novel feature of our model is that the assignment of individual variables to groups is estimated from the data, rather than being pre-assigned using SIC industry codes, market capitalization ranks, or other ad hoc methods. We adapt the k-means clustering algorithm for use in our application and show that it has excellent finite-sample properties. Applying the new model to returns on 110 US equities, we find around 20 clusters to be optimal. In out-of-sample forecasts, we find that a model with as few as five estimated clusters significantly outperforms an otherwise identical model with 21 clusters formed using two-digit SIC codes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种动态多因子copula，用于高维时间序列应用。我们模型的一个新颖特征是，个体变量到组的分配是从数据中估计的，而不是使用SIC行业代码、市值排名或其他临时方法预先分配。我们将k-means聚类算法应用于我们的应用中，并证明其具有优异的有限样本性质。将该新模型应用于110只美国股票的收益，我们发现约20个聚类是最优的。在样本外预测中，我们发现，具有仅五个估计聚类的模型显著优于使用两位SIC代码形成的具有21个聚类的其他相同模型。

records.title_en: A penalized two-pass regression to predict stock returns with time-varying risk premia
records.title_cn: 一种带惩罚的两步回归法以时变风险溢价预测股票收益
records.abstract_en: We develop a penalized two-pass regression with time-varying factor loadings. The penalization in the first pass enforces sparsity for the time-variation drivers while also maintaining compatibility with the no-arbitrage restrictions by regularizing appropriate groups of coefficients. The second pass delivers risk premia estimates to predict equity excess returns. Our Monte Carlo results and our empirical results on a large cross-sectional data set of US individual stocks show that penalization without grouping can yield to nearly all estimated time-varying models violating the no-arbitrage restrictions. Moreover, our results demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the prediction errors compared to a penalized approach without appropriate grouping or a time-invariant factor model.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种具有时变因子载荷的惩罚两步回归法。第一步中的惩罚强制时变驱动因素的稀疏性，同时通过对适当的系数组进行正则化来保持与无套利限制的兼容性。第二步提供风险溢价估计以预测股票超额收益。我们的蒙特卡洛结果以及在美国个股大型横截面数据集上的实证结果表明，没有分组的惩罚可能导致几乎所有估计的时变模型违反无套利限制。此外，我们的结果表明，与没有适当分组的惩罚方法或时不变因子模型相比，所提出的方法减少了预测误差。

records.title_en: Taking stock of long-horizon predictability tests: Are factor returns predictable?
records.title_cn: 长期预测检验的评估：因子收益是否可预测？
records.abstract_en: This study provides a critical assessment of long-horizon return predictability tests using highly persistent regressors. We show that the commonly used statistics are typically oversized, leading to spurious inference. Instead, we propose a Wald statistic, which accommodates multiple predictors of (unknown) arbitrary persistence degree within the I(0)-I(1) range. The test statistic, based on an adaptation of the IVX procedure to a long-horizon regression framework, is shown to have a standard chi-squared asymptotic distribution (regardless of the stochastic properties of the regressors used as predictors) and to exhibit excellent finite-sample size and power properties. Employing this test statistic, we find evidence of predictability for “old” and “new” pricing factors with monthly returns, but this becomes weaker as the predictive horizon increases. The predictability evidence substantially weakens with annual data. Overall, we question the incremental value of using long-horizon predictive regressions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究对使用高度持久回归变量的长期收益可预测性检验进行了批判性评估。我们表明，常用的统计量通常存在过度拒绝问题，导致虚假推断。相反，我们提出了一种Wald统计量，它能够适应I(0)-I(1)范围内（未知）任意持久性程度的多个预测变量。该检验统计量基于IVX程序对长期回归框架的改编，被证明具有标准的卡方渐近分布（无论用作预测变量的回归变量的随机性质如何），并展现出优异的有限样本功效和规模性质。采用此检验统计量，我们发现“旧”和“新”定价因子在月度收益上存在可预测性证据，但随着预测期限的增加，这种证据变弱。使用年度数据时，可预测性证据显著减弱。总体而言，我们对使用长期预测回归的增量价值提出质疑。

records.title_en: Time-varying forecast combination for high-dimensional data
records.title_cn: 高维数据的时变预测组合
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new nonparametric estimator of time-varying forecast combination weights. When the number of individual forecasts is small, we study the asymptotic properties of the local linear estimator. When the number of candidate forecasts exceeds or diverges with the sample size, we consider penalized local linear estimation with the group SCAD penalty. We show that the estimator exhibits the oracle property and correctly selects relevant forecasts with probability approaching one. Simulations indicate that the proposed estimators outperform existing combination schemes when structural changes exist. An empirical application on inflation and unemployment forecasting highlights the merits of our approach relative to other popular methods in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新的非参数估计器，用于时变预测组合权重。当单个预测的数量较少时，我们研究了局部线性估计器的渐近性质。当候选预测的数量超过或与样本量一起发散时，我们考虑了带有组SCAD惩罚的惩罚局部线性估计。我们表明，该估计器具有预言性质，并以趋近于一的概率正确选择相关预测。模拟表明，当存在结构性变化时，所提出的估计器优于现有的组合方案。关于通货膨胀和失业预测的实证应用突出了我们的方法相对于文献中其他流行方法的优点。

records.title_en: Are bond returns predictable with real-time macro data?
records.title_cn: 债券收益能否用实时宏观数据预测？
records.abstract_en: We investigate the predictability of bond returns using real-time macro variables and consider the possibility of a nonlinear predictive relationship and the presence of weak factors. To address these issues, we propose a scaled sufficient forecasting (sSUFF) method and analyze its asymptotic properties. Using both the existing and the new method, we find empirically that real-time macro variables have significant forecasting power both in-sample and out-of-sample. Moreover, they generate sizable economic values, and their predictability is not spanned by the yield curve. We also observe that the forecasted bond returns are countercyclical, and the magnitude of predictability is stronger during economic recessions, which lends empirical support to well-known macro finance theories.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用实时宏观变量研究债券收益的可预测性，并考虑非线性预测关系的可能性以及弱因子的存在。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种缩放充分预测（sSUFF）方法，并分析了其渐近性质。使用现有方法和新方法，我们实证发现实时宏观变量在样本内和样本外均具有显著的预测能力。此外，它们产生了可观的经济价值，且其可预测性未被收益率曲线所涵盖。我们还观察到预测的债券收益是逆周期的，且在经济衰退期间预测能力的强度更大，这为著名的宏观金融理论提供了实证支持。

records.title_en: Time-Varying Parameters in Econometrics: The editor’s foreword
records.title_cn: 计量经济学中的时变参数：主编前言
records.abstract_en: The Themed Issue Time-Varying Parameters in Econometrics consists of eight papers where theoretical, methodological and empirical developments are reported. Particular attention is given to observation-driven time-varying parameter models of which score-driven models is a sub-class. We will introduce the Themed Issue and review its contributions.
records.abstract_cn: 专题《计量经济学中的时变参数》包含八篇论文，报告了理论、方法和实证方面的发展。特别关注观测驱动的时变参数模型，其中得分驱动模型是其一个子类。我们将介绍该专题并回顾其贡献。

records.title_en: Business-cycle consumption risk and asset prices
records.title_cn: 商业周期消费风险与资产定价
records.abstract_en: Aggregation is routinely employed in asset pricing to capture frequency-specific effects. We formalize the theoretical mapping between aggregates of time series and their frequency-specific components as well as the mapping between factor loadings obtained upon aggregation of returns and factors and frequency-specific factor loadings. We show that business-cycle consumption, a component of the consumption growth process with cycles between 4 and 8 years, provides valuable pricing signal. In agreement with the implications of theory, we document that consumption growth aggregated over a 4-year horizon (4-year consumption) has analogous pricing ability, cross-sectionally and in the time series, to business-cycle consumption.
records.abstract_cn: 聚合在资产定价中常被用来捕捉频率特定的效应。我们形式化了时间序列聚合与其频率特定成分之间的理论映射，以及通过聚合收益和因子获得的因子载荷与频率特定因子载荷之间的映射。我们表明，商业周期消费，即消费增长过程中周期在4至8年之间的组成部分，提供了有价值的定价信号。与理论的含义一致，我们记录了在4年时间跨度上聚合的消费增长（4年消费）在横截面和时间序列上具有与商业周期消费类似的定价能力。

records.title_en: Score-driven models for realized volatility
records.title_cn: 已实现波动率的得分驱动模型
records.abstract_en: This paper sets up a statistical framework for modeling realized volatility (RV) using a Dynamic Conditional Score (DCS) model. It first shows how, for a dataset on stock indices, a preliminary analysis of RV, based on fitting a linear Gaussian model to its logarithm, suggests the use of a two component dynamic specification. It also indicates a departure from normality, a weekly pattern in the data and the presence of heteroscedasticity. Fitting the two component DCS specification with leverage and a day of the week effect is then carried out directly on RV with a Generalized Beta of the Second Kind (GB2) conditional distribution or, equivalently, on the logarithm of RV with an Exponential Generalized Beta of the Second Kind (EGB2) distribution. The forecasting performance of this model, with and without heteroscedasticity, is compared with that of the Heterogeneous Autoregression (HAR), some extensions of it and some other models. Overall there is a clear gain from using the GB2-DCS model, even when the HAR model uses additional information, such as realized semi-variance. When the aim is to forecast tail behavior, the fat-tailed GB2 model performs much better than models with thin-tailed distributions. A further exercise uses a dataset on exchange rates to compare GB2-DCS models with models that use realized quarticity. Again the additional information offers no forecasting advantage. Overall the GB2-DCS models are transparent, provide a comprehensive description of the properties of RV, and are difficult to beat for forecasting.
records.abstract_cn: 本文建立了一个使用动态条件得分（DCS）模型对已实现波动率（RV）进行建模的统计框架。首先，对于股票指数数据集，通过对数线性高斯模型的拟合对RV进行初步分析，结果表明应采用双分量动态设定。该分析还指出了偏离正态性、数据中的周内模式以及异方差性的存在。随后，直接对RV拟合具有杠杆效应和星期效应的双分量DCS设定，使用第二类广义贝塔（GB2）条件分布，或等价地，对RV的对数使用指数第二类广义贝塔（EGB2）分布。该模型（含和不含异方差性）的预测性能与异质自回归（HAR）模型及其一些扩展模型和其他模型进行了比较。总体而言，使用GB2-DCS模型有明显的收益，即使HAR模型使用了额外信息，如已实现半方差。当目标是预测尾部行为时，厚尾的GB2模型比薄尾分布的模型表现好得多。进一步的练习使用汇率数据集来比较GB2-DCS模型与使用已实现四次方的模型。同样，额外信息并未带来预测优势。总体而言，GB2-DCS模型透明，提供了对RV性质的全面描述，并且难以被超越。

records.title_en: Score-driven asset pricing: Predicting time-varying risk premia based on cross-sectional model performance
records.title_cn: 得分驱动的资产定价：基于横截面模型表现预测时变风险溢价
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new parametric approach for estimating linear factor pricing models with dynamic risk premia. Time-varying risk prices and exposures follow an observation-driven updating scheme that reduces the one-step-ahead prediction error from a cross-sectional factor model at the current observation. This agnostic approach is particularly useful in situations where predictors are unknown or of uncertain quality. Updating schemes for elliptically distributed returns are derived and propose cross-sectional regression errors as driving sequence for the parameter dynamics. Estimation and inference are performed by likelihood maximization. A simulation study confirms that the novel method is capable of filtering and predicting substantial risk price movements. The empirical performance of the method is illustrated by an application to a panel of equity portfolios.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新的参数方法，用于估计具有动态风险溢价的线性因子定价模型。时变风险价格和暴露遵循观测驱动更新方案，该方案在当前观测值处减少横截面因子模型的一步前向预测误差。这种不可知方法在预测因子未知或质量不确定的情况下尤为有用。推导了椭圆分布收益的更新方案，并提出将横截面回归误差作为参数动态的驱动序列。估计和推断通过似然最大化进行。模拟研究证实，该新方法能够过滤和预测显著的风险价格变动。通过应用于股票投资组合面板，说明了该方法的实证表现。

records.title_en: Better bunching, nicer notching
records.title_cn: 更好的聚束，更优的断点
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the bunching identification strategy for an elasticity parameter that summarizes agents’ responses to changes in slope (kink) or intercept (notch) of a schedule of incentives. We show that current bunching methods may be very sensitive to implicit assumptions in the literature about unobserved individual heterogeneity. We overcome this sensitivity concern with new non- and semi-parametric estimators. Our estimators allow researchers to show how bunching elasticities depend on different identifying assumptions and when elasticities are robust to them. We follow the literature and derive our methods in the context of the iso-elastic utility model and an income tax schedule that creates a piece-wise linear budget constraint. We demonstrate bunching behavior provides robust estimates for self-employed and not-married taxpayers in the context of the U.S. Earned Income Tax Credit. In contrast, estimates for self-employed and married taxpayers depend on specific identifying assumptions, which highlight the value of our approach. We provide the Stata package bunching to implement our procedures.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了聚束识别策略，该策略针对一个弹性参数，该参数概括了代理人对激励计划斜率（拐点）或截距（断点）变化的反应。我们表明，当前的聚束方法可能对文献中关于未观测到的个体异质性的隐含假设非常敏感。我们通过新的非参数和半参数估计量克服了这一敏感性担忧。我们的估计量允许研究人员展示聚束弹性如何依赖于不同的识别假设，以及弹性何时对这些假设具有稳健性。我们遵循文献，在等弹性效用模型和产生分段线性预算约束的所得税表的背景下推导出我们的方法。我们证明，在美国劳动所得税抵免的背景下，聚束行为为自雇和未婚纳税人提供了稳健的估计。相比之下，自雇和已婚纳税人的估计依赖于特定的识别假设，这突显了我们方法的价值。我们提供了Stata包bunching来实现我们的程序。

records.title_en: What is a standard error? (And how should we compute it?)
records.title_cn: 什么是标准误？（以及我们应如何计算它？）
records.abstract_en: I review the definition of a standard error from a frequentist perspective, including both exact analysis and asymptotic analysis. Using the linear model for illustration, I discuss the model-based, design-based, and sampling-based approaches to uncertainty in obtaining standard errors. The model-based approach is widely applicable and produces reasonable measures of estimator precision in many settings. In some situations, particularly in the context of clustering, the model-based approach can suffer from ambiguity, and can lead to standard errors that are systematically biased. A combination of the design-based and sampling-based approaches requires the researcher to think about the variation in key explanatory variables when computing standard errors, and it can even apply to cases where the entire population is observed.
records.abstract_cn: 我从频率学派的视角回顾了标准误的定义，包括精确分析和渐近分析。以线性模型为例，我讨论了在获得标准误时基于模型、基于设计和基于抽样的不确定性方法。基于模型的方法应用广泛，在许多情况下能产生合理的估计量精度度量。在某些情况下，特别是在聚类背景下，基于模型的方法可能面临模糊性，并可能导致标准误出现系统性偏差。基于设计和基于抽样的方法相结合，要求研究者在计算标准误时考虑关键解释变量的变异，甚至适用于观察到整个总体的情况。

records.title_en: Instrument validity for heterogeneous causal effects
records.title_cn: 异质性因果效应中的工具有效性检验
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a general framework for testing instrument validity in heterogeneous causal effect models. The generalization includes the cases where the treatment can be multivalued ordered or unordered. Based on a series of testable implications, we propose a nonparametric test which is proved to be asymptotically size controlled and consistent. Compared to the tests in the literature, our test can be applied in more general settings and may achieve power improvement. Refutation of instrument validity by the test helps detect invalid instruments that may yield implausible results on causal effects. Evidence that the test performs well on finite samples is provided via simulations. We revisit the empirical study on return to schooling to demonstrate application of the proposed test in practice. An extended continuous mapping theorem and an extended delta method, which may be of independent interest, are provided to establish the asymptotic distribution of the test statistic under null.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为异质性因果效应模型中的工具有效性检验提供了一个一般性框架。该推广涵盖了处理变量可以是多值有序或无序的情形。基于一系列可检验的蕴含关系，我们提出了一种非参数检验，并证明其渐近控制大小且具有一致性。与文献中的检验相比，我们的检验适用于更一般的设定，并可能实现功效改进。该检验对工具有效性的否定有助于检测可能产生不合理因果效应结果的无效工具。通过模拟提供了检验在有限样本中表现良好的证据。我们重新审视了关于教育回报的实证研究，以展示所提检验在实际中的应用。我们还提供了扩展的连续映射定理和扩展的德尔塔方法，这些可能具有独立的研究价值，用于建立检验统计量在原假设下的渐近分布。

records.title_en: Some impossibility results for inference with cluster dependence with large clusters
records.title_cn: 大聚类下聚类依赖推断的若干不可能性结果
records.abstract_en: This paper focuses on a setting with observations having a cluster dependence structure and presents two main impossibility results. First, we show that when there is only one large cluster, i.e., the researcher does not have any knowledge on the dependence structure of the observations, it is not possible to consistently discriminate the mean. When within-cluster observations satisfy the uniform central limit theorem, we also show that a sufficient condition for consistent n-discrimination of the mean is that we have at least two large clusters. This result shows some limitations for inference when we lack information on the dependence structure of observations. Our second result provides a necessary and sufficient condition for the cluster structure that the long run variance is consistently estimable. Our result implies that when there is at least one large cluster, the long run variance is not consistently estimable.
records.abstract_cn: 本文关注观测值具有聚类依赖结构的情形，并提出了两个主要的不可能性结果。首先，我们表明当只有一个大聚类时，即研究者对观测值的依赖结构没有任何了解，无法一致地判别均值。当聚类内观测值满足一致中心极限定理时，我们还表明，一致判别均值的充分条件是至少有两个大聚类。这一结果揭示了当缺乏观测值依赖结构信息时推断的局限性。我们的第二个结果提供了聚类结构下长期方差可一致估计的充要条件。我们的结果意味着，当至少存在一个大聚类时，长期方差无法一致估计。

records.title_en: Semiparametric estimation of long-term treatment effects
records.title_cn: 长期处理效应的半参数估计
records.abstract_en: Long-term outcomes of experimental evaluations are necessarily observed after long delays. We develop semiparametric methods for combining the short-term outcomes of experiments with observational measurements of short-term and long-term outcomes, in order to estimate long-term treatment effects. We characterize semiparametric efficiency bounds for various instances of this problem. These calculations facilitate the construction of several estimators. We analyze the finite-sample performance of these estimators with a simulation calibrated to data from an evaluation of the long-term effects of a poverty alleviation program.
records.abstract_cn: 实验评估的长期结果必然在长时间延迟后才能观察到。我们开发了半参数方法，将实验的短期结果与短期和长期结果的观测测量相结合，以估计长期处理效应。我们刻画了该问题各种实例的半参数效率界。这些计算促进了若干估计量的构建。我们通过一个校准到扶贫项目长期效应评估数据的模拟，分析了这些估计量的有限样本性能。

records.title_en: Two-stage weighted least squares estimator of the conditional mean of observation-driven time series models
records.title_cn: 观测驱动时间序列模型条件均值的两阶段加权最小二乘估计
records.abstract_en: General parametric forms are assumed for the conditional mean λt(θ0) and variance υt of a time series. These conditional moments can for instance be derived from count time series, Autoregressive Conditional Duration or Generalized Autoregressive Score models. In this paper, our aim is to estimate the conditional mean parameter θ0, trying to be as agnostic as possible about the conditional distribution of the observations. Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimators (QMLEs) based on the linear exponential family fulfill this goal, but they may be inefficient and have complicated asymptotic distributions when θ0 contains boundary coefficients. We thus study alternative Weighted Least Square Estimators (WLSEs), which enjoy the same consistency property as the QMLEs when the conditional distribution is misspecified, but have simpler asymptotic distributions when components of θ0 are null and gain in efficiency when υt is well specified. We compare the asymptotic properties of the QMLEs and WLSEs, and determine a data driven strategy for finding an asymptotically optimal WLSE. Simulation experiments and illustrations on realized volatility forecasting are presented.
records.abstract_cn: 对时间序列的条件均值λt(θ0)和方差υt假设了一般参数形式。这些条件矩例如可以从计数时间序列、自回归条件持续时间或广义自回归得分模型中推导出来。在本文中，我们的目标是在尽可能不依赖于观测条件分布的情况下估计条件均值参数θ0。基于线性指数族的拟极大似然估计量(QMLEs)实现了这一目标，但当θ0包含边界系数时，它们可能效率低下且具有复杂的渐近分布。因此，我们研究了替代的加权最小二乘估计量(WLSEs)，当条件分布被错误指定时，它们具有与QMLEs相同的相合性，但当θ0的分量为零时具有更简单的渐近分布，并且当υt被正确指定时效率更高。我们比较了QMLEs和WLSEs的渐近性质，并确定了一种数据驱动策略来寻找渐近最优的WLSE。进行了模拟实验和实际波动率预测的说明。

records.title_en: Optimal model averaging based on forward-validation
records.title_cn: 基于前向验证的最优模型平均
records.abstract_en: In this paper, noting that the prediction of time series follows the temporal order of data, we propose a frequentist model averaging method based on forward-validation. Our method also considers the uncertainty of the window size in estimation, i.e., we allow the sample size to vary among candidate models. We establish the asymptotic optimality of our method in the sense of achieving the lowest possible squared prediction risk. We also prove that if there exists one or more correctly specified models, our method will automatically assign all the weights to them. The promising performance of our method for finite samples is demonstrated by simulations and an empirical example of predicting the equity premium.
records.abstract_cn: 本文注意到时间序列的预测遵循数据的时间顺序，提出了一种基于前向验证的频率学派模型平均方法。我们的方法还考虑了估计中窗口大小的不确定性，即允许候选模型之间的样本量不同。我们建立了该方法在实现最低可能平方预测风险意义上的渐近最优性。我们还证明，如果存在一个或多个正确设定的模型，我们的方法将自动将所有权重分配给它们。通过模拟和预测股权溢价的实证例子，证明了我们方法在有限样本下的良好性能。

records.title_en: Business cycle asymmetry and input-output structure: The role of firm-to-firm networks
records.title_cn: 商业周期不对称性与投入产出结构：企业间网络的作用
records.abstract_en: We study the network origins of business cycle asymmetries using cross-country and administrative firm-level data. At the country level, we document that countries with a larger number of non-zero intersectoral linkages (denser networks) display a more negatively skewed cyclical component of output. At the firm level, we find that firms with a larger number of suppliers and customers (degrees) display a more negatively-skewed distribution of their output growth. To rationalize these findings, we construct a multisector model with input-output linkages and show that the relationship between output skewness and network density naturally arises once we consider non-linearities in production. In an economy with low production flexibility (inputs are gross complements), denser production structures imply that relying on more inputs becomes a risk that further amplifies the effects of negative productivity shocks. The opposite holds if firms display high production flexibility (inputs are gross substitutes): having more inputs to choose from becomes an opportunity to diversify the effects of negative productivity shocks. We calibrate the model using our rich firm-to-firm network Chilean data and show that more connected firms experience larger declines in output in response to a COVID-19 shock, consistent with the data. We also show that, as in the data, the cross-sectional distribution of output growth in the model displays a fatter left tail during downturns. The previous result is shaped by the interplay between production complementarities and network interconnectedness, rather than by the asymmetry of the shocks. The size of the shock determines the strength of the relationship between degrees and output decline, which highlights the importance of non-linearities and the limitations of local approximations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用跨国和行政企业层面数据研究商业周期不对称性的网络起源。在国家层面，我们记录了具有更多非零部门间联系（更密集网络）的国家，其产出周期成分呈现更负的偏度。在企业层面，我们发现拥有更多供应商和客户（度数）的企业，其产出增长的分布呈现更负的偏度。为合理化这些发现，我们构建了一个具有投入产出联系的多部门模型，并表明一旦考虑生产中的非线性，产出偏度与网络密度之间的关系自然出现。在生产灵活性较低（投入品为总互补品）的经济中，更密集的生产结构意味着依赖更多投入品成为一种风险，进一步放大负面生产率冲击的影响。如果企业表现出高生产灵活性（投入品为总替代品），则相反：拥有更多投入品可供选择成为分散负面生产率冲击影响的机会。我们使用丰富的企业间网络智利数据校准模型，并表明更互联的企业在应对COVID-19冲击时产出下降幅度更大，与数据一致。我们还表明，与数据一样，模型中产出增长的横截面分布在衰退期间呈现更厚的左尾。前述结果由生产互补性与网络互联性之间的相互作用塑造，而非冲击的不对称性。冲击的大小决定了度数与企业产出下降之间关系的强度，这突显了非线性的重要性和局部逼近的局限性。

records.title_en: Identification with External Instruments in Structural VARs
records.title_cn: 结构VAR中外部工具变量的识别
records.abstract_en: IV methods have become the leading approach to identify the effects of macroeconomic shocks. Conditions for identification generally involve all the shocks in the VAR even when only a subset of them is of interest. This paper provides more general conditions that only involve the shocks of interest and the properties of the instrument of choice. We introduce a heuristic and a formal test to guide the specification of the empirical models, and provide formulas for the bias when the conditions are violated. We apply our results to the study of the transmission of conventional and unconventional monetary policy shocks.
records.abstract_cn: IV方法已成为识别宏观经济冲击效应的主要方法。识别条件通常涉及VAR中的所有冲击，即使仅对其中一部分感兴趣。本文提供了更一般的条件，仅涉及感兴趣的冲击和所选工具的性质。我们引入了一种启发式方法和正式检验来指导实证模型的设定，并提供了条件违反时的偏差公式。我们将结果应用于常规和非常规货币政策冲击传导的研究。

records.title_en: The real effects of monetary shocks: Evidence from micro pricing moments
records.title_cn: 货币冲击的实际效应：来自微观定价矩的证据
records.abstract_en: Empirically, what pricing moments are informative about monetary non-neutrality? The frequency of price changes is robustly informative among a set of pricing moments and across specifications: A lower frequency is statistically significantly associated with higher monetary non-neutrality, in line with models of price rigidities. Other moments that describe the price change distribution are not consistently or significantly related to monetary non-neutrality. While the frequency explains the largest share of variation in non-neutrality, no pricing moments individually or jointly explain a majority of the variation in a linear empirical setting. Non-pricing moments explain additional variation, however are not consistently associated with monetary non-neutrality. A multi-sector menu cost model featuring different price adjustment technologies across sectors can rationalize our main findings.
records.abstract_cn: 实证上，哪些定价矩对货币非中性具有信息量？在一组定价矩和不同规格中，价格调整频率具有稳健的信息量：较低的频率与较高的货币非中性在统计上显著相关，这与价格刚性模型一致。描述价格变化分布的其他矩与货币非中性的关系不一致或不显著。虽然频率解释了非中性变异的最大份额，但在线性实证设定中，没有任何定价矩单独或联合解释非中性变异的大部分。非定价矩解释了额外的变异，但与货币非中性的关联并不一致。一个具有跨部门不同价格调整技术的多部门菜单成本模型可以合理化我们的主要发现。

records.title_en: Unequal growth
records.title_cn: 不平等增长
records.abstract_en: Over the past 50 years, households in the United States have experienced changes in earnings dynamics that have resulted in a large increase in inequality. This paper assesses the impact of these changes on aggregate growth and welfare. We begin by inspecting a simple statistical decomposition of aggregate earnings growth using data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics for the period 1967–2018. The decomposition expresses aggregate earnings growth as the sum of two terms. The first is the covariance between the level and growth of household earnings, which depends only on micro earnings dynamics. The second is the average growth across households, which depends on both micro and macro factors, such as a common labor productivity growth. In order to identify the impact of the changes in the micro dynamics on aggregate outcomes, we map a simple model of micro-founded growth onto the terms of the decomposition. We find that changes in households’ earnings dynamics that are consistent with the micro data imply unequal growth across the earnings distribution that is, a transition period during which there is a change in the shape of the distribution of incomes that is not mean preserving, so that aggregate growth is affected. This change yields a positive effect on aggregate growth and, with incomplete markets, an ex-ante negative welfare effect.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去50年里，美国家庭的 earnings dynamics 经历了变化，导致不平等大幅增加。本文评估了这些变化对总体增长和福利的影响。我们首先利用1967-2018年收入动态面板研究（Panel Study of Income Dynamics）的数据，检查了总体 earnings growth 的一个简单统计分解。该分解将总体 earnings growth 表示为两项之和。第一项是家庭收入水平与增长之间的协方差，仅取决于微观 earnings dynamics。第二项是家庭间的平均增长，既取决于微观因素，也取决于宏观因素，如共同的劳动生产率增长。为了识别微观动态变化对总体结果的影响，我们将一个简单的微观基础增长模型映射到分解的各项上。我们发现，与微观数据一致的家庭 earnings dynamics 变化意味着收入分配上的不平等增长，即收入分配形状发生变化且非均值保持的过渡期，从而影响总体增长。这种变化对总体增长产生正向效应，而在市场不完全的情况下，会产生事前的负福利效应。

records.title_en: Fiscal foresight and the effects of government spending: It’s all in the monetary-fiscal mix
records.title_cn: 财政前瞻与政府支出的效应：关键在于货币-财政政策组合
records.abstract_en: Announcements of future government spending have different effects on economic activity depending on the monetary-fiscal policy mix. Upon announcement, they are contractionary in the monetary regime but expansionary in the fiscal regime, in contrast with the expansionary nature of government spending at implementation in both regimes. Anticipation effects can therefore help empirically distinguish between the two regimes. Data support our theoretical insight, reconciling conflicting results in the empirical literature that disappear once conditioning on the policy regime. This evidence suggests that it could be (un)wise to anticipate future fiscal policies, depending on the regime in place.
records.abstract_cn: 未来政府支出的公告对经济活动的影响取决于货币-财政政策组合。在公告时，它们在货币体制下是紧缩性的，但在财政体制下是扩张性的，这与政府支出在实施时在两个体制下均为扩张性的性质形成对比。因此，预期效应可以在实证上有助于区分这两种体制。数据支持我们的理论见解，调和了实证文献中相互矛盾的结果，这些结果在考虑政策体制后便消失了。这一证据表明，根据现行体制，预期未来财政政策可能是（不明智的）明智的。

records.title_en: Myopic fiscal objectives and long-Run monetary efficiency
records.title_cn: 短视财政目标与长期货币效率
records.abstract_en: Is the pursuit of myopic fiscal objectives, such as short-run redistribution or public spending, a threat to long-run monetary efficiency? We answer this question in the context of a textbook overlapping generations model where we introduce a sequence of one-period fiscal authorities that can tax endowments and trade money. Each authority is myopic in that it cares only about current agents’ utility and its own consumption, without any concern about the future. Nonetheless, we show that the sequence of fiscally-backed money purchases that maximize the current authority’s objective also selects a unique equilibrium – one in which money is traded at the efficient intertemporal price – as a by-product. In fact, myopic redistribution policies ensure equality in marginal utilities making up for incomplete markets, without interfering with the efficiency of private intertemporal choices. Multiplicity and sub-optimality emerge as fiscal capacity is bounded, inducing authorities to use money trades to generate resources for public consumption.
records.abstract_cn: 追求短视财政目标，如短期再分配或公共支出，是否威胁长期货币效率？我们在一个教科书式的代际交叠模型中回答这个问题，其中引入一系列单期财政当局，它们可以对禀赋征税并进行货币交易。每个当局都是短视的，因为它只关心当前代理人的效用和自身的消费，而不关心未来。尽管如此，我们表明，最大化当前当局目标的财政支持的货币购买序列也选择一个唯一均衡——其中货币以有效的跨期价格交易——作为副产品。事实上，短视的再分配政策确保了边际效用的平等，弥补了不完整的市场，而不干扰私人跨期选择的效率。当财政能力受限时，会出现多重性和次优性，促使当局利用货币交易为公共消费创造资源。

records.title_en: Consumption heterogeneity and monetary policy in an open economy
records.title_cn: 开放经济中的消费异质性与货币政策
records.abstract_en: We incorporate two types of agents (Ricardian versus Keynesian) into a standard open economy macro model. We find that consumption heterogeneity has major implications for the impact of monetary policy shocks, the international transmission mechanism, and the design of optimal monetary policy. With sticky prices, the existence of Keynesian agents causes a spillover of shocks across countries, and leads to the interdependence of optimal monetary targeting rules. In the case of local currency pricing, consumer heterogeneity leads an optimal monetary policy to generate currency misalignment and deviations from the law of one price. Theoretically, there are ranges of household heterogeneity in which monetary policy becomes ineffective, but this depends sensitively on the interaction of aggregate demand and relative price effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将两类代理人（李嘉图型与凯恩斯型）纳入一个标准的开放经济宏观模型。我们发现，消费异质性对货币政策冲击的影响、国际传导机制以及最优货币政策的设计具有重要含义。在价格粘性条件下，凯恩斯型代理人的存在导致冲击在国家间的溢出，并引起最优货币盯住规则的相互依赖。在本地货币定价的情况下，消费者异质性导致最优货币政策产生货币错位和背离一价定律。理论上，存在家庭异质性范围使得货币政策失效，但这取决于总需求与相对价格效应的相互作用。}

records.title_en: Local information and firm expectations about aggregates
records.title_cn: 本地信息与企业对总量的预期
records.abstract_en: Using new survey data on quantitative growth expectations of firms in Germany, we show that firms resort to local information when forming expectations about aggregate growth. Firms extrapolate from the economic situation in their county, industry growth and their individual business situation. Variables (fixed effects) measuring local signals account for up to 26 % (47 %) of the expectation dispersion across firms. The effect is particularly strong for small firms. Our results confirm predictions of theoretical models with rational inattention.
records.abstract_cn: 利用关于德国企业定量增长预期的新调查数据，我们表明企业在形成对总量增长的预期时会诉诸本地信息。企业从所在县的经济状况、行业增长和自身经营状况进行外推。衡量本地信号的变量（固定效应）解释了企业间预期差异的至多26%（47%）。这一效应对于小企业尤为显著。我们的结果证实了具有理性疏忽的理论模型的预测。

records.title_en: Propagation of shocks in an input-output economy: Evidence from disaggregated prices
records.title_cn: 投入产出经济中冲击的传导：来自分类价格的经验证据
records.abstract_en: Using disaggregated industry-level data, this paper empirically evaluates predictions for the cross-sectional price change distribution made by input-output models with sticky prices. The response of prices to shocks is found to be consistent with the price sensitivities predicted by the input-output model. Moreover, moments of the sectoral price change distribution vary over time in response to the evolution of the network structure. Finally, through a quantitative analysis, demand and supply shocks are disentangled during the pandemic period. Counterfactual analyses show that sectoral supply shocks, aggregate demand shocks and the production network structure contributed significantly to the inflation surge in 2021–2022.
records.abstract_cn: 利用分类行业层面的数据，本文实证评估了具有价格粘性的投入产出模型对横截面价格变化分布的预测。研究发现，价格对冲击的反应与投入产出模型预测的价格敏感性一致。此外，部门价格变化分布的矩随时间变化，以响应网络结构的演变。最后，通过定量分析，在疫情期间区分了需求冲击和供给冲击。反事实分析表明，部门供给冲击、总需求冲击和生产网络结构对2021-2022年的通胀飙升有显著贡献。

records.title_en: Public financing with financial frictions and underground economy
records.title_cn: 金融摩擦与地下经济中的公共融资
records.abstract_en: What are the aggregate effects of informality in a financially constrained economy? We develop and calibrate an entrepreneurship model to data on matched employer-employee from both formal and informal sectors in Brazil. The model distinguishes between informality on the business side and the hiring of informal workers by formal businesses. Policies that reduce business informality increase aggregate output by 10.8%, TFP by 6.6%, and tax revenue by 33.2%. On the contrary, output and TFP decrease when policies reduce the intensive margin of informality, underscoring that the informal economy can play a positive role in an economy with financial frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 在金融受限的经济体中，非正规性的总体效应是什么？我们开发并校准了一个创业模型，使用巴西正规和非正规部门的匹配雇主-雇员数据。该模型区分了企业层面的非正规性以及正规企业雇佣非正规工人的情况。减少企业非正规性的政策使总产出增加10.8%，全要素生产率增加6.6%，税收收入增加33.2%。相反，当政策减少非正规性的集约边际时，产出和全要素生产率下降，这强调了在存在金融摩擦的经济中，非正规经济可以发挥积极作用。

records.title_en: Financial heterogeneity and monetary union
records.title_cn: 金融异质性与货币联盟
records.abstract_en: During the 2010–12 eurozone crisis, deviations of price and wage dynamics from those implied by canonical Phillips curves were systematically related to differences in financial strains across countries. Most notably, markups in financially “weak” (periphery) countries rose, while those in financially “strong” (core) countries declined. In a monetary union model, where financial frictions interact with the firms’ pricing decisions because of customer-market considerations, firms in the periphery maintain cashflows in response to an adverse financial shock by raising markups in both domestic and export markets, while firms in the core reduce markups, undercutting their financially constrained competitors to gain market share. In this framework, a unilateral fiscal-devaluation-style policy by the periphery stabilizes the local economy by improving the condition of firm balance sheets and by boosting household demand—it does not, however, reverse the real exchange rate appreciation in the periphery.
records.abstract_cn: 在2010-12年欧元区危机期间，价格和工资动态偏离经典菲利普斯曲线所隐含的水平，这种偏离与各国金融压力的差异系统性相关。最显著的是，金融“弱”（外围）国家的加成率上升，而金融“强”（核心）国家的加成率下降。在一个货币联盟模型中，由于客户市场考量，金融摩擦与企业定价决策相互作用，外围国家企业为应对不利金融冲击，通过提高国内和出口市场的加成率来维持现金流，而核心国家企业则降低加成率，以低于其受金融约束的竞争对手的价格来获取市场份额。在这一框架下，外围国家单方面的财政贬值式政策通过改善企业资产负债表状况和提振家庭需求来稳定本地经济——然而，这并不能逆转外围国家实际汇率的升值。

records.title_en: Comments on unequal growth
records.title_cn: 关于不平等增长的评论
records.abstract_en: What is the relationship between income inequality and aggregate growth? Through an ingenious decomposition, Lippi and Perri cast this relationship as a function of simple moments of the distribution of changes in household income. Their study delivers new evidence linking heterogeneous micro-level income changes to macro-level growth outcomes. Faster income growth among rich households has mitigated the slowdown of aggregate growth in the US, especially after 2000. These findings bring forth questions about the origins of unequal growth and its impact on the welfare of different subsets of the population.
records.abstract_cn: 收入不平等与总体增长之间有何关系？通过巧妙的分解，Lippi和Perri将这种关系表述为家庭收入变化分布的简单矩的函数。他们的研究提供了新的证据，将微观层面的异质性收入变化与宏观层面的增长结果联系起来。富裕家庭收入的更快增长缓解了美国总体增长的放缓，尤其是在2000年之后。这些发现引发了关于不平等增长的起源及其对不同人口群体福利影响的问题。

records.title_en: Barriers to black entrepreneurship: Implications for welfare and aggregate output over time
records.title_cn: 黑人创业的障碍：对福利和总产出的长期影响
records.abstract_en: The number of black-owned businesses in the U.S. has increased dramatically since the 1980s, even compared to the number of non-black-owned businesses and the rise in black labor-market participation. From 1982 to 2012 the fraction black labor-market participants who owned businesses rose from 4 to 16 percent, compared to an increase of 14 to 19 percent for other participants. Combined with other evidence, this suggests black entrepreneurs have faced significant barriers to starting and running businesses and these barriers have declined over time. Interpreted through a model of entrepreneurship, we find declining barriers led to a permanent 14.4 percent increase in (consumption-equivalent) black welfare, a 5.2 percent increase in output per worker (compared to an observed 70 percent increase), and a 9 percent increase in the welfare of other labor-market participants. These impacts are in addition to any gains from declining labor-market barriers.
records.abstract_cn: 自1980年代以来，美国黑人拥有的企业数量急剧增加，即使与黑人劳动力市场参与率的上升以及非黑人拥有的企业数量相比也是如此。从1982年到2012年，拥有企业的黑人劳动力市场参与者比例从4上升到16%，而其他参与者的比例则从14上升到19%。结合其他证据，这表明黑人企业家在创办和经营企业方面面临了重大障碍，且这些障碍随时间推移而减少。通过创业模型进行解释，我们发现障碍的减少导致黑人福利（以消费等价衡量）永久性提高14.4%，人均产出增加5.2%（相比之下，观察到的增长为70%），以及其他劳动力市场参与者福利增加9%。这些影响是在劳动力市场障碍减少带来的任何收益之外的额外收益。

records.title_en: Government debt and risk premia
records.title_cn: 政府债务与风险溢价
records.abstract_en: Risk premia increase with government debt. Debt-to-GDP ratios positively predict stock returns at short and long horizons in the U.S. and other advanced economies. Higher debt is also associated with higher bond premia and lower risk-free rates. Major government debt theories (liquidity, safety, crowding out) either do not address or are inconsistent with these findings. New evidence suggests that the increased risk premia provide compensation for larger fiscal risk; during periods of elevated debt, fiscal policy becomes more uncertain and less effective and can lead to debt crises. I quantify these mechanisms in an equilibrium model.
records.abstract_cn: 风险溢价随政府债务增加而上升。在美国及其他发达经济体中，债务与GDP之比在短期和长期内正向预测股票回报。较高的债务还与较高的债券溢价和较低的无风险利率相关。主要的政府债务理论（流动性、安全性、挤出效应）要么未涉及这些发现，要么与之不一致。新证据表明，增加的风险溢价为更大的财政风险提供了补偿；在债务高企时期，财政政策变得更加不确定且效果减弱，并可能导致债务危机。我在一个均衡模型中量化了这些机制。

records.title_en: The effectiveness of a negative interest rate policy
records.title_cn: 负利率政策的有效性
records.abstract_en: In a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model that is calibrated for the euro area, a negative interest rate policy (NIRP) can have contractionary effects on the economy when interest rates on household deposits reach the zero lower bound, and such deposits are the only source of bank funding and household savings. However, by introducing additional assets to households’ portfolios and alternative sources of bank funding, such as bank bonds, the NIRP becomes expansionary. Because both features characterize the euro area well, they are essential to study the effectiveness of NIRP policies.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个针对欧元区校准的动态随机一般均衡模型中，当家庭存款利率达到零下限，且此类存款是银行融资和家庭储蓄的唯一来源时，负利率政策（NIRP）可能对经济产生紧缩效应。然而，通过向家庭投资组合引入额外资产以及银行融资的替代来源（如银行债券），负利率政策变得具有扩张性。由于这两个特征都很好地描述了欧元区的情况，它们对于研究负利率政策的有效性至关重要。

records.title_en: Deposit market power, funding stability and long-term credit
records.title_cn: 存款市场力量、融资稳定性与长期信贷
records.abstract_en: By increasing funding stability, deposit market power reduces banks’ funding risk over the cycle and provides the flexibility to originate long-term loans. Banks with deposit HHI one standard deviation above average extend loans with about 20% longer maturity than those one standard deviation below average. Deposit market power also allows banks to charge lower maturity premiums. The effects persist in the sample of zero-duration, floating rate loans. This has real effects: access to banks raising funds in less competitive markets improves growth in bank-dependent borrowers needing long-term finance. Deposit market power, by stabilizing bank funding costs, helps alleviate credit cycles.
records.abstract_cn: 通过提高融资稳定性，存款市场力量降低了银行在周期中的融资风险，并为发放长期贷款提供了灵活性。存款赫芬达尔指数高于平均水平一个标准差的银行，其贷款期限比低于平均水平一个标准差的银行长约20%。存款市场力量还允许银行收取较低的期限溢价。这些效应在零期限浮动利率贷款样本中依然存在。这具有实际影响：在竞争较不激烈的市场中筹集资金的银行，其可及性改善了依赖银行且需要长期融资的借款人的增长。存款市场力量通过稳定银行融资成本，有助于缓解信贷周期。

records.title_en: Stress relief? Funding structures and resilience to the covid shock
records.title_cn: 缓解压力？资金结构和抵御新冠冲击的能力
records.abstract_en: How did funding structures—the source, instrument, currency, and counterparty location of financing—relate to the financial stress experienced in different countries and sectors during Covid-19? Banks and corporates with a higher share of funding from non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) or in US dollars experienced significantly greater stress, while more funding in debt instruments (versus loans) or cross-border (versus domestically) did not affect resilience. Policies targeting these structural vulnerabilities (US$ swap lines and NBFI policies) were more effective at mitigating stress than policies supporting banks, even controlling for macroeconomic policies. Macroprudential regulations should prioritize exposures to NBFI and dollar funding.
records.abstract_cn: 融资结构（融资来源、工具、货币和交易对手地点）与新冠疫情期间不同国家和部门经历的财务压力有何关系19？来自非银行金融机构（NBFI）或美元融资比例较高的银行和企业承受的压力明显更大，而债务工具（相对于贷款）或跨境（相对于国内）融资的增加并没有影响弹性。针对这些结构性脆弱性的政策（美元互换额度和非银行金融机构政策）在缓解压力方面比支持银行的政策更有效，甚至可以控制宏观经济政策。宏观审慎监管应优先考虑非银行金融机构和美元融资的风险敞口。

records.title_en: Threats to central bank independence: High-frequency identification with twitter
records.title_cn: 中央银行独立性的威胁：基于推特的高频识别
records.abstract_en: A high-frequency approach is used to analyze the effects of President Trump’s tweets that criticize the Federal Reserve on financial markets. Identification exploits a short time window around the precise timestamp for each tweet. The average effect on the expected fed funds rate is negative and statistically significant, with the magnitude growing by horizon. The tweets also lead to an increase in stock prices and to a decrease in long-term U.S. Treasury yields. VAR evidence shows that the tweets had an important impact on actual monetary policy, the stock market, bond premia, and the macroeconomy.
records.abstract_cn: 采用高频方法分析特朗普总统批评美联储的推文对金融市场的影响。识别利用了每条推文精确时间戳周围的短时间窗口。对预期联邦基金利率的平均效应为负且统计显著，其幅度随期限增长而增大。推文还导致股价上涨和美国长期国债收益率下降。VAR证据表明，推文对实际货币政策、股票市场、债券溢价和宏观经济产生了重要影响。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous beliefs and the Phillips curve
records.title_cn: 异质性信念与菲利普斯曲线
records.abstract_en: Heterogeneous beliefs modify the New Keynesian Phillips curve by introducing a term in the cross-section distribution of expectations. To take that model to the data, we develop a novel functional data approach to estimation and inference that accounts for variation in distributions of expectations. We find that this variation may be summarized using a handful of functional factors, and demonstrate their statistical and economic relevance for inflation dynamics. Our results are among the first to highlight the potential benefits to be gained in empirical work from a rigorous treatment of diverse beliefs in the study of macroeconomic outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 异质性信念通过引入预期横截面分布的一项来修正新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线。为了将该模型应用于数据，我们开发了一种新颖的函数型数据方法进行估计和推断，该方法考虑了预期分布的变化。我们发现这种变化可以用少数几个函数型因子来概括，并证明了它们对通胀动态的统计和经济相关性。我们的结果率先强调了在宏观经济结果研究中，对多样化信念进行严格处理可能为实证工作带来的潜在益处。

records.title_en: Wealth inequality dynamics in europe and the united states: Understanding the determinants
records.title_cn: 欧洲与美国的财富不平等动态：理解其决定因素
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the interaction between the long-term dynamics of aggregate household wealth and the wealth distribution in Europe and the United States. We do so by building the first Distributional Wealth Accounts for Europe, including households’ assets, liabilities, investment flows, and the wealth distribution for most European countries from 1970–2020. We find that although aggregate household wealth to income ratios have followed a similar increasing pattern in both Europe and the United States since 1970, wealth concentration has increased much faster in the United States. Using wealth accumulation decompositions and counterfactual simulations, we show that the weaker rise in labor income inequality and the stronger rise in house prices relative to financial assets in Europe versus the United States appear to explain why Europe has experienced a more moderate rise in wealth concentration since the mid-1980s.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了欧洲和美国总家庭财富的长期动态与财富分配之间的相互作用。为此，我们构建了首个欧洲分配财富账户，包括家庭资产、负债、投资流动以及大多数欧洲国家从1970-2020年的财富分配。我们发现，尽管自1970年以来，欧洲和美国的总家庭财富与收入之比呈现出相似的上升模式，但美国的财富集中度上升速度要快得多。通过财富积累分解和反事实模拟，我们表明，与美国相比，欧洲劳动收入不平等上升幅度较小以及房价相对于金融资产上涨幅度较大，似乎解释了为什么自1980年代中期以来欧洲财富集中度的上升更为温和。

records.title_en: Rising earnings inequality and optimal income tax and social security policies
records.title_cn: 收入不平等加剧与最优所得税和社会保障政策
