records.abstract_en: I develop a dynamic theory of exporting that synthesizes two approaches: static models, in which exporting costs depend on the number of foreign customers a firm serves in the present; and dynamic models, in which these costs depend on whether a firm exported in the past. The theory simultaneously accounts for two sets of established empirical findings: (i) larger markets attract exports from more firms and these exports are more concentrated; and (ii) new exporters are generally smaller and more likely to exit than incumbents. It also accounts for a new set of findings from Brazilian microdata showing that differences between new exporters and incumbents are more pronounced in larger markets. When calibrated to match all of these findings, the theory predicts that trade reforms cause greater but also slower trade growth in smaller markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我发展了一个出口的动态理论，综合了两种方法：静态模型，其中出口成本取决于企业在当前所服务的外国客户数量；以及动态模型，其中这些成本取决于企业过去是否出口。该理论同时解释了两组成熟的经验发现：（i）较大的市场吸引更多企业的出口，且这些出口更为集中；（ii）新出口商通常规模较小，且比在位者更可能退出。它还解释了来自巴西微观数据的一组新发现，表明新出口商与在位者之间的差异在较大的市场中更为显著。当校准以匹配所有这些发现时，该理论预测贸易改革在较小的市场中会导致更大但更慢的贸易增长。

records.title_en: The globalization of corporate control
records.title_cn: 公司控制权的全球化
records.abstract_en: The internationalization of corporate control is a complex and poorly understood aspect of globalization, as it is challenging to trace controlling shareholders due to often opaque structures of ownership. We identify controlling shareholders for 22,000 listed firms to study the globalization of control. The network of international control appears very sparse, with strong home bias. A baseline gravity structure works well, as bilateral links are more potent for populous, affluent, and proximate countries. Institutions and tax haven status at source and destination play a modest role. Legal similarities, economic policy coordination, and cultural, linguistic, and historical ties play a non-negligible role telling of asset market and informational frictions; policy and legal similarities matter for financial institutions and banks, while informational/cultural barriers for individuals/families. International diversification motives play no major role. The results have implications for theoretical works on the internationalization of corporate control markets.
records.abstract_cn: 公司控制权的国际化是全球化中一个复杂且鲜为人知的方面，因为由于所有权结构往往不透明，追踪控股股东颇具挑战性。我们识别了22,000家上市公司的控股股东，以研究控制权的全球化。国际控制网络显得非常稀疏，存在强烈的本土偏好。一个基准引力结构表现良好，因为双边联系在人口众多、富裕且邻近的国家之间更为显著。来源国和目的地国的制度及避税天堂地位作用适中。法律相似性、经济政策协调以及文化、语言和历史联系发挥着不可忽视的作用，这反映了资产市场和信息摩擦；政策和法律相似性对金融机构和银行重要，而信息/文化障碍对个人/家庭重要。国际多元化动机不起主要作用。研究结果对关于公司控制权市场国际化的理论工作具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Asset purchase bailouts and endogenous implicit guarantees
records.title_cn: 资产购买救助与内生隐性担保
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a theory of endogenous implicit guarantees on risky assets, in which a government’s bailouts take the form of asset purchases to alleviate asymmetric information on private liquidity needs. As a result of asymmetric information, direct transfers to agents are imperfect so that, when more constrained agents are also more exposed to a given asset, asset purchases by the government are optimal. When anticipated, this form of bailouts leads to an endogenous implicit guarantee premium so that otherwise risky assets can be traded as if there are risk-free. This possibility of implicit guarantee is amplified by other financial frictions such as risk-shifting. Finally, I show how this form of bailouts can shed light on the buildup of the euro area's sovereign debt crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个关于风险资产内生隐性担保的理论，其中政府的救助采取资产购买的形式，以缓解私人流动性需求方面的信息不对称。由于信息不对称，对代理人的直接转移支付是不完善的，因此，当受更多约束的代理人同时也对某一特定资产有更高的风险敞口时，政府的资产购买是最优的。当这种救助形式被预期到时，会导致内生隐性担保溢价，从而使原本有风险的资产可以像无风险资产一样交易。这种隐性担保的可能性会被其他金融摩擦（如风险转移）放大。最后，我展示了这种救助形式如何有助于揭示欧元区主权债务危机的积累过程。

records.title_en: The open-economy ELB: Contractionary monetary easing and the trilemma
records.title_cn: 开放经济下的有效下限：紧缩性货币宽松与三难困境
records.abstract_en: Contrary to Mundell's trilemma, we show that free capital mobility may prevent monetary policy from ensuring output stability even if the exchange rate is flexible due to the existence of an Effective Lower Bound. The ELB is an interest rate threshold below which monetary easing becomes contractionary because of adverse effects on credit supply. A tightening in global monetary and financial conditions increases the ELB and may force central banks to hike rates even though domestic economic activity contracts. We also show that the ELB gives rise to a novel inter-temporal trade-off for monetary policy and calls for using a broad range of policy tools to restore monetary transmission.
records.abstract_cn: 与蒙代尔的三难困境相反，我们表明，即使汇率灵活，由于有效下限的存在，自由资本流动也可能阻止货币政策确保产出稳定。有效下限是一个利率阈值，低于该阈值时，货币宽松因对信贷供给的不利影响而变得紧缩。全球货币和金融状况的收紧提高了有效下限，并可能迫使央行即使在国内经济活动收缩时也提高利率。我们还表明，有效下限为货币政策带来了新的跨期权衡，并呼吁使用广泛的政策工具来恢复货币传导。

records.title_en: Risk sharing and the adoption of the Euro
records.title_cn: 风险分担与欧元采用
records.abstract_en: This paper empirically evaluates whether adopting a common currency has changed the level of consumption smoothing of euro area member states. We construct a counterfactual dataset of macroeconomic variables through the synthetic control method. We then use the output variance decomposition of Asdrubali et al. (1996) on both the actual and the synthetic data to study if there has been a change in risk sharing and through which channels. We find that the euro adoption has reduced risk sharing and consumption smoothing. We further show that this reduction is mainly driven by the periphery countries of the euro area who have experienced a decrease in risk sharing through private credit.
records.abstract_cn: 本文实证评估了采用共同货币是否改变了欧元区成员国的消费平滑水平。我们通过合成控制法构建了一个反事实的宏观经济变量数据集。然后，我们使用Asdrubali等人（1996）的产出方差分解方法，对实际数据和合成数据进行分析，以研究风险分担是否发生变化以及通过哪些渠道发生变化。我们发现，欧元采用降低了风险分担和消费平滑。我们进一步表明，这种降低主要由欧元区外围国家驱动，这些国家通过私人信贷的风险分担有所减少。

records.title_en: Quantum prices
records.title_cn: 量子价格
records.abstract_en: Many retailers practice an extreme form of discrete pricing defined as quantum prices: differentiated products are priced using few and sparse price buckets. To show this, online data was collected for 350,000 products from over 65 fashion retailers in the U.S. and the U.K. This pricing strategy is observed within categories and across categories (i.e., similar or even disparately distinct products like jeans and bags have an identical price), as well as in product introductions, where new products come in at previous price buckets. Normalized indices indicate substantial price clustering after controlling for popular prices, convenient prices, assortment size, or digit endings. Quantum prices have implications for price adjustments through product shares, markdown prices, and for the law-of-one-price. A behavioral model of price salience and recall is discussed.
records.abstract_cn: 许多零售商实行一种极端形式的离散定价，定义为量子价格：使用很少且稀疏的价格区间对差异化产品进行定价。为了证明这一点，我们收集了来自美国和英国超过 65 家时尚零售商的 350,000 产品的在线数据。这种定价策略在类别内和跨类别（即类似甚至完全不同的产品，如牛仔裤和包袋，具有相同的价格）以及产品介绍中观察到，其中新产品以之前的价格区间出现。标准化指数表明在控制流行价格、便利价格、品种大小或数字结尾后存在大量价格聚集。量子价格通过产品份额、降价和一价定律对价格调整产生影响。讨论了价格显着性和召回率的行为模型。

records.title_en: Global banking and the international transmission of shocks: A quantitative analysis
records.title_cn: 全球银行业与国际冲击传导：一项定量分析
records.abstract_en: Regulatory reforms typically follow financial crises. We propose a model of global banking that can be used proactively to study alternative regulatory policies. The model mimics the US regulatory framework and highlights the organizational choices that banks face when entering a foreign market: branching versus subsidiarization. The model is able to replicate the response of the US banking sector to the European sovereign debt crisis. Counterfactual analysis suggests that pervasive subsidiarization, higher capital requirements, or an ad hoc monetary policy intervention would have avoided entirely the negative effects of the sovereign debt crisis on US lending. However, the same measures would have had limited effects in more severe scenarios.
records.abstract_cn: 监管改革通常紧随金融危机之后。我们提出了一个全球银行业模型，可用于主动研究替代性监管政策。该模型模拟了美国监管框架，并强调了银行进入外国市场时面临的组织选择：分行制与子行制。该模型能够复制美国银行业对欧洲主权债务危机的反应。反事实分析表明，普遍的子行制、更高的资本要求或临时的货币政策干预本可以完全避免主权债务危机对美国贷款的负面影响。然而，同样的措施在更严重的情景下效果有限。

records.title_en: What can stockouts tell us about inflation? Evidence from online micro data
records.title_cn: 缺货能告诉我们关于通胀的什么信息？来自在线微观数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We use a detailed micro dataset on product availability and stockouts to construct a direct high-frequency measure of consumer product shortages during the 2020–2022 pandemic. We document a widespread multi-fold rise in stockouts in nearly all sectors early in the pandemic. Over time, the composition evolved from temporary to more permanently discontinued products, concentrated in fewer sectors. We show that unexpected shocks to stockout levels have significant inflationary effects within three months. These effects are larger and more persistent for imported goods and import-intensive sectors. We develop a model of inventories in a sector facing both demand and cost disturbances, and use the observed joint dynamics of stockouts and prices to show that these effects can be associated with elevated costs of replenishing inventories and higher exposure to trade.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个关于产品可得性和缺货的详细微观数据集，构建了2020-2022疫情期间消费者产品短缺的直接高频度量。我们记录了疫情初期几乎所有行业缺货现象普遍且多倍上升的情况。随着时间的推移，构成从暂时性缺货演变为更永久性停产产品，并集中在少数行业。我们表明，缺货水平的意外冲击在三个月内具有显著的通胀效应。这些效应对进口商品和进口密集型行业更大且更持久。我们建立了一个面临需求和成本扰动的行业库存模型，并利用观察到的缺货和价格的联合动态来表明，这些效应可能与补充库存成本上升和更高的贸易敞口有关。

records.title_en: Real interest rates and productivity in small open economies
records.title_cn: 小型开放经济中的实际利率与生产率
records.abstract_en: We construct factor utilization-adjusted measures of aggregate TFP for a sample of advanced (AEs) and emerging market small open economies (EMEs). We estimate the effects of real interest rate shocks on TFP and GDP using structural VARs. The results are starkly different in the two groups of countries. While TFP is pro-cyclical in both sets of countries, lower real interest rates - a proxy for capital inflows - lead to productivity booms in EMEs, whereas they lead to a contraction in productivity in AEs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为一系列发达经济体（AEs）和新兴市场小型开放经济体（EMEs）构建了经要素利用率调整的总要素生产率（TFP）度量。我们使用结构向量自回归（VARs）估计实际利率冲击对TFP和GDP的影响。两组国家的结果截然不同。虽然两组国家的TFP都是顺周期的，但较低的实际利率——作为资本流入的代理变量——在新兴市场经济体中导致生产率繁荣，而在发达经济体中则导致生产率收缩。

records.title_en: Sovereign credit and exchange rate risks: Evidence from Asia-Pacific local currency bonds
records.title_cn: 主权信用与汇率风险：来自亚太本币债券的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the dynamic properties of sovereign bonds in emerging markets and their associated risk premiums. We focus on the properties of credit spreads, exchange rates, and their interaction. Relying on the term structure of local currency bonds issued by Asia-Pacific sovereigns, we find that local variables are significant in the dynamics of currency and credit risk, and the components of bond risk premiums reflecting these risks. Local currency bonds dramatically improve the investment frontier.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了新兴市场主权债券的动态特性及其相关风险溢价。我们关注信用利差、汇率及其相互作用的特性。基于亚太地区主权国家发行的本币债券的期限结构，我们发现本地变量在货币和信用风险的动态以及反映这些风险的债券风险溢价组成部分中具有显著性。本币债券显著改善了投资前沿。

records.title_en: Sudden stops and optimal foreign exchange intervention
records.title_cn: 骤停与最优外汇干预
records.abstract_en: We model sudden stops in a small open economy as rare discrete events precipitated by increases in the world risk-free rate. When external debt is large, the model exhibits multiple equilibria, one where external debt and consumption remain high, and one with a collapse in external debt and consumption. Private agents delever following an increase in the world interest rate, but they fail to internalize the impact of deleveraging on the price of collateral. For high levels of external debt, even a small increase in the world interest rate can eliminate the high debt equilibrium and the economy experiences a sudden stop. The central bank can use foreign exchange intervention to prevent the sudden stop. If reserves cannot be borrowed, optimal policy is to “lean against the wind”, buying foreign reserves ex-ante when private borrowing is high and selling them after an interest rate shock when private agents are deleveraging.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个小型开放经济中，将骤停建模为由世界无风险利率上升引发的罕见离散事件。当外部债务较大时，模型表现出多重均衡，一种是外部债务和消费保持高位的均衡，另一种是外部债务和消费崩溃的均衡。私人部门在世界利率上升后去杠杆，但他们未能内化去杠杆对抵押品价格的影响。对于高外部债务水平，即使世界利率小幅上升也可能消除高债务均衡，经济经历骤停。中央银行可以使用外汇干预来防止骤停。如果储备不能借入，最优政策是“逆风而行”，在私人借贷高时事前购买外汇储备，并在利率冲击后私人部门去杠杆时出售储备。

records.title_en: Immigration and occupational comparative advantage
records.title_cn: 移民与职业比较优势
records.abstract_en: Job selection by high-skilled foreign-born workers in the US correlates strongly with country of origin. We use a Fréchet-Roy model of occupational choice to evaluate the causes of immigrant sorting. We find that revealed comparative advantage in the US is stronger for workers from countries with higher education quality in occupations that are more intensive in cognitive reasoning, and for workers from countries that are more linguistically similar to the US in occupations that are more intensive in communication. Our findings hold for immigrants who arrived in the US at age 18 or older (who received their K-12 education abroad) but not for immigrants who arrived in the US as children (who received their K-12 education domestically). We obtain similar results for immigrant sorting in Canada, consistent with origin-country education quality, rather than US immigration policy, being what drives sorting patterns.
records.abstract_cn: 美国高技能外国出生工人的职业选择与来源国密切相关。我们使用Fréchet-Roy职业选择模型来评估移民分类的原因。我们发现，在认知推理更密集的职业中，来自教育质量较高国家的工人在美国显示出更强的显性比较优势；在沟通更密集的职业中，来自语言与美国更相似国家的工人也显示出更强的显性比较优势。我们的发现适用于在18岁或以上到达美国（在国外接受K-12教育）的移民，但不适用于作为儿童到达美国（在国内接受K-12教育）的移民。我们在加拿大的移民分类中获得了类似的结果，这与来源国教育质量而非美国移民政策驱动分类模式相一致。

records.title_en: The aggregate effects of global and local supply chain disruptions: 2020–2022
records.title_cn: 全球与本地供应链中断的总体效应：2020-2022年
records.abstract_en: We study the aggregate effects of supply-chain disruptions in the post-pandemic period in a heterogeneous-firm, general equilibrium model with input-output linkages and a rich set of supply chain frictions: uncertain shipping delays, fixed order costs, and storage costs. Firms optimally hold inventories that depend on the source of supply, domestic or imported. Increases in shipping times are contractionary, raise prices, and increase stockouts, particularly for goods intensive in delayed inputs. These effects are larger when inventories are already at low levels. We fit the model to the U.S. and global economies from 2020 to 2022 and estimate large aggregate effects of supply disruptions. Our model predicts that the boost in output from reducing delays will be smaller than the contraction from the waning effects of stimulus.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了后疫情时期供应链中断在异质性企业、具有投入产出联系和一系列供应链摩擦（不确定的运输延迟、固定订单成本和存储成本）的一般均衡模型中的总体效应。企业最优地持有取决于供应来源（国内或进口）的库存。运输时间的增加具有紧缩效应，推高价格，并增加缺货，尤其是对延迟投入密集型商品而言。当库存已经处于低位时，这些效应更大。我们将模型拟合到2020年至2022年的美国和全球经济，并估计出供应中断的较大总体效应。我们的模型预测，减少延迟带来的产出提升将小于刺激效应减弱带来的收缩。

records.title_en: Exchange rate policy and heterogeneity in small open economies
records.title_cn: 汇率政策与小开放经济中的异质性
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the role of exchange rate regimes in shaping the distributional effects of external monetary shocks. I model a small open economy where agents differ in wealth and in exposure to international trade, producing either tradable or non-tradable goods. The central bank responds to a foreign interest rate hike by a monetary tightening to stabilize the exchange rate or lets the currency depreciate, keeping the interest rate low. I find that exchange rate flexibility distributes consumption gains to the poorer agents. The monetary tightening required to stabilize the currency disproportionately affects their disposable income through interest payments on loans and falling wages. Attempts to fix the exchange rate increase consumption inequality. Flexibility also benefits the non-tradable sector because conditions in this sector are more sensitive to domestic demand and sharply deteriorate when domestic interest rates rise.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究汇率制度在塑造外部货币冲击分配效应中的作用。我构建了一个小开放经济模型，其中代理人财富不同，且对国际贸易的敞口不同，生产可贸易或不可贸易商品。中央银行通过货币紧缩来应对外国利率上升以稳定汇率，或者让货币贬值，保持低利率。我发现汇率灵活性将消费收益分配给较贫穷的代理人。为稳定货币所需的货币紧缩通过贷款利息支付和工资下降不成比例地影响他们的可支配收入。试图固定汇率会增加消费不平等。灵活性也有利于不可贸易部门，因为该部门的状况对国内需求更为敏感，当国内利率上升时会急剧恶化。

records.title_en: Trade intermediation by producers
records.title_cn: 生产者的贸易中介
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that manufacturing exporters export goods that they have not produced and thus also act as trade intermediaries. The geographical dimension of the data reveals that almost half of these exports of “sourced” products are purely intermediated: to many destinations, firms export sourced products only. We find that this type of intermediation is ubiquitous across firms, products, and destinations, and is robust to a battery of alternative definitions. These findings show that trade intermediation by producers (TIP) is not solely driven by carry-along trade, where produced and sourced products are bundled when exported. Our decomposition of TIP highlights that trade intermediation should be identified at the firm-product-destination level. The prevalence of pure intermediation for all manufacturing exporters, including the largest ones, suggests that intermediation plays an important role in firms' participation and success in international markets.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，制造业出口商出口其未生产的产品，因此也充当贸易中介。数据的地理维度显示，这些“采购”产品出口中近一半是纯中介的：对许多目的地，企业仅出口采购产品。我们发现，这种类型的中介在企业、产品和目的地中普遍存在，并且对一系列替代定义具有稳健性。这些发现表明，生产者的贸易中介（TIP）并非仅由携带贸易驱动，即出口时生产和采购产品捆绑在一起。我们对TIP的分解强调，贸易中介应在企业-产品-目的地层面进行识别。纯中介在所有制造业出口商（包括最大的出口商）中的普遍性表明，中介在企业参与国际市场和取得成功中扮演着重要角色。

records.title_en: Sudden stops and reserve accumulation in the presence of international liquidity risk
records.title_cn: 国际流动性风险下的突然停止与储备积累
records.abstract_en: We propose a small open economy model where agents borrow internationally and invest in liquid foreign assets to insure against liquidity shocks, which temporarily shut out the economy of short-term credit markets. Due to a pecuniary externality, individual agents overborrow and hold too little liquid assets relative to a social planner. This inefficiency rationalizes macroprudential policy intervention in the form of reserve accumulation at the central bank to stabilize trade and the real exchange rate. Our model quantitatively matches the depreciation of the real exchange rate and contractions in output, gross trade flows, and foreign reserve holdings during Sudden Stops.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个小型开放经济模型，其中代理人从国际借款并投资于流动性外国资产，以防范流动性冲击，这种冲击会暂时将经济排除在短期信贷市场之外。由于货币外部性，个体代理人相对于社会计划者会过度借款并持有过少的流动性资产。这种低效率为宏观审慎政策干预提供了合理性，即中央银行积累储备以稳定贸易和实际汇率。我们的模型在数量上匹配了突然停止期间实际汇率贬值以及产出、总贸易流量和外汇储备持有量的收缩。

records.title_en: Trade networks and firm value: Evidence from the U.S.-China trade war
records.title_cn: 贸易网络与企业价值：来自中美贸易战的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the financial implications of the 2018–2019 U.S.-China trade war for global supply chains. Around the dates when higher tariffs are announced, U.S. firms that depend more on exports to and imports from China experience larger declines in market value, with the negative effect spilling over to the affected firms' suppliers and customers through production networks. The trade war effect is mainly concentrated among U.S. firms that sell to Chinese customers with low R&D intensity or outsource to Chinese differentiated input suppliers. We also exploit the within-firm variation in tariff exposure according to the detailed product lists and conduct a reverse experiment based on the 2019 trade talks. To explain the findings, we propose a theoretical model that highlights how complex trade structures shape shareholder wealth.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2018-2019年中美贸易战对全球供应链的财务影响。在宣布提高关税的日期前后，更依赖对华出口和从中国进口的美国企业市值下降幅度更大，且负面效应通过生产网络溢出到受影响企业的供应商和客户。贸易战效应主要集中在向研发强度低的的中国客户销售产品或从中国差异化投入品供应商采购的美国企业。我们还利用详细产品清单中关税暴露的企业内差异，并基于2019年贸易谈判进行了反向实验。为解释这些发现，我们提出了一个理论模型，强调复杂的贸易结构如何影响股东财富。

records.title_en: Climate risks and FDI
records.title_cn: 气候风险与外国直接投资
records.abstract_en: Climate-related risks have increased in recent decades, both in terms of the frequency of extreme weather events (physical risk) and the implementation of climate-change mitigation policies (transition risk). This paper explores whether multinational firms react to such risks by altering their presence in countries that are more affected. We measure this by examining foreign direct investment (FDI) dynamics at different levels of aggregation as well as at the firm level. We propose a theoretical framework for firm production location choice that explicitly incorporates transition and physical risks. The model predicts a reduction in FDI resulting from both physical and transition risks but an ambiguous interaction effect of these risks with emission productivity. In an extensive empirical analysis, we find some support for model predictions, but overall we do not find consistent evidence for statistically significant effects of physical and transition risks on FDI. However, firm-level evidence suggests that firms that are more exposed to climate risks react more negatively to physical climate risk following Paris Climate Accord. We also find that FDI outflows following extreme weather events from affected countries are smaller for industries with higher emission productivity (greener industries). Our theory and empirical results point to the importance of accounting for heterogeneity in emission productivity when analyzing the effects of climate risks.
records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，气候相关风险有所增加，无论是极端天气事件的频率（物理风险）还是气候变化减缓政策的实施（转型风险）方面。本文探讨了跨国公司是否通过改变其在受影响较大国家的存在来应对此类风险。我们通过考察不同聚合水平以及企业层面的外国直接投资（FDI）动态来衡量这一点。我们提出了一个企业生产区位选择的理论框架，明确纳入了转型风险和物理风险。该模型预测，物理风险和转型风险都会导致FDI减少，但这些风险与排放生产率之间的交互效应不明确。在广泛的实证分析中，我们发现了对模型预测的一些支持，但总体而言，我们没有找到一致证据表明物理风险和转型风险对FDI具有统计上显著的影响。然而，企业层面的证据表明，在《巴黎气候协定》之后，气候风险暴露程度较高的企业对物理气候风险的反应更为负面。我们还发现，极端天气事件后受影响国家的FDI流出对于排放生产率较高的行业（更绿色的行业）而言较小。我们的理论和实证结果指出了在分析气候风险影响时考虑排放生产率异质性的重要性。

records.title_en: Bailout dynamics in a monetary union
records.title_cn: 货币联盟中的救助动态
records.abstract_en: The Eurozone bailouts consisted of credit lines with favorable lending conditions, equivalent to countries receiving implicit fiscal transfers. They are often interpreted as meant to prevent a default in the Eurozone or resolve the crisis. Contrary to this narrative, Greece defaulted on its debt and went through a deep and prolonged recession, despite receiving fiscal assistance. This paper analyzes country bailouts in a monetary union within a framework where sovereign default and exit from the union are two separate decisions. The studied bailouts prevent an exit and, thus, do not exclude subsequent defaults. The model replicates the experience of Greece and captures the coexistence of bailouts, defaults, and recession. It also sheds new light on the moral hazard discussion of bailouts by showing no significant effects from exit-driven bailouts.
records.abstract_cn: 欧元区的救助包括具有优惠贷款条件的信贷额度，相当于国家获得隐性财政转移。这些救助通常被解释为旨在防止欧元区违约或解决危机。与这种说法相反，希腊尽管获得了财政援助，却对其债务违约，并经历了深度且长期的衰退。本文在一个主权违约和退出联盟是两个独立决策的框架内分析了货币联盟中的国家救助。所研究的救助防止了退出，因此并不排除随后的违约。该模型复制了希腊的经验，并捕捉了救助、违约和衰退的共存。它还通过显示退出驱动的救助没有显著影响，为救助的道德风险讨论提供了新的视角。

records.title_en: Migration, tariffs, and China's export surge
records.title_cn: 移民、关税与中国出口激增
records.abstract_en: We build a multi-sector spatial general equilibrium model that features heterogeneous firms' and workers' location choices to account for China's export surge between 1990 and 2005 using three policy changes: China's import tariffs, tariffs imposed against China's exports, and barriers to internal migration in China. We find that tariff and migration policies jointly accounted for 30% of China's export growth. We also find evidence that suggests a positive interaction effect of tariff and migration policies. As migration reform prepared the country to become more export oriented, China enjoyed faster export growth after opening to trade than it would have otherwise.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个多部门空间一般均衡模型，该模型包含异质性企业和工人的区位选择，以解释1990年至2005年间中国的出口激增，并利用三项政策变化：中国的进口关税、针对中国出口的关税以及中国国内移民壁垒。我们发现，关税和移民政策共同解释了中国出口增长的30%。我们还发现了关税与移民政策之间存在正向交互效应的证据。由于移民改革使国家为更加出口导向型经济做好了准备，中国在开放贸易后享受了比原本情况下更快的出口增长。

records.title_en: The importance of business travel for trade: Evidence from the liberalization of the Soviet airspace
records.title_cn: 商务旅行对贸易的重要性：来自苏联领空开放的证据
records.abstract_en: The strong negative relationship between geographical distance and trade is not well understood. I use the liberalization of the Soviet airspace to estimate the causal impact of business travel cost on trade. The liberalization radically reduced travel time between Europe and East Asia and was followed by a significant increase in trade. I find that the cost of business travel can account for a large share of the trade frictions that cause trade to sharply decline with distance. A plausible explanation for these results is that face-to-face interaction through business travel is important for trade.
records.abstract_cn: 地理距离与贸易之间的强烈负相关关系尚未得到很好的理解。我利用苏联领空的开放来估计商务旅行成本对贸易的因果影响。这一开放大幅缩短了欧洲与东亚之间的旅行时间，随后贸易显著增加。我发现商务旅行成本可以解释导致贸易随距离急剧下降的贸易摩擦中的很大一部分。对这些结果的一个合理解释是，通过商务旅行进行的面对面互动对贸易很重要。

records.title_en: Selection effects, inequality, and aggregate gains from trade
records.title_cn: 选择效应、不平等与贸易的总体收益
records.abstract_en: This paper argues that the cost of trade-induced inequality in terms of aggregate gains from trade is decreasing with globalization. I use a general equilibrium model of trade and show that at low levels of trade openness, a 1% point increase in real per capita income due to higher trade is associated with percentage point increases of 0.5, 0.85, and 0.92 in the Gini, Atkinson and Theil indices, respectively. These trade-offs, however, quickly decline upon opening up to trade and converge toward zero as trade barriers disappear. I find that at high levels of openness, more firms are exporters such that the elasticity of income inequality to reductions in trade costs converges to a constant, whereas the elasticity of average real income keeps increasing. Trade liberalization has positive marginal welfare effects for a wide range of social welfare function parameters. Existing taxation and redistributive policies can reinforce this relationship.
records.abstract_cn: 本文认为，贸易引发的不平等在贸易总体收益方面的成本随着全球化而递减。我使用一个贸易的一般均衡模型，并表明在贸易开放度较低时，实际人均收入因贸易增加而提高1%个百分点，分别与基尼系数、阿特金森指数和泰尔指数上升0.5、0.85和0.92个百分点相关。然而，这些权衡在开放贸易后迅速下降，并随着贸易壁垒的消失而趋近于零。我发现，在高开放度下，更多的企业成为出口商，使得收入不平等对贸易成本下降的弹性趋近于一个常数，而平均实际收入的弹性则持续增加。对于广泛的社会福利函数参数，贸易自由化具有正的边际福利效应。现有的税收和再分配政策可以强化这种关系。

records.title_en: Endogenous product adjustment and exchange rate pass-through
records.title_cn: 内生性产品调整与汇率传递
records.abstract_en: We document how product quality responds to exchange rate movements and quantify the extent to which these quality changes affect the aggregate pass-through into export prices. We analyze the substantial sudden appreciation of the Swiss franc post removal of the 1.20-CHF-per-euro lower bound in 2015 using export data representing a large share of the universe of goods exports from Switzerland. We find that firms upgrade the quality of their products after the appreciation. Furthermore, they disproportionately remove lower-quality products from their product ranges. This quality upgrading and quality sorting effect accounts for a substantial share of the total pass-through one year after the appreciation. We cross-check our results with the microdata underlying the Swiss export price index, which includes an adjustment factor for quality based on firms' reported product replacements, and obtain similar results.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了产品质量如何对汇率变动做出反应，并量化了这些质量变化对出口价格总体传递程度的影响。我们利用代表瑞士商品出口绝大部分的出口数据，分析了2015年瑞士法郎兑欧元1.20下限取消后的大幅突然升值。我们发现，企业在升值后提升了其产品质量。此外，它们不成比例地从产品系列中移除低质量产品。这种质量升级和质量筛选效应在升值一年后的总传递中占据了相当大的份额。我们使用瑞士出口价格指数背后的微观数据进行了交叉验证，该数据包含基于企业报告的产品替换的质量调整因子，并获得了相似的结果。

records.title_en: The economic costs of trade sanctions: Evidence from North Korea
records.title_cn: 贸易制裁的经济成本：来自朝鲜的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the economic costs of the recent United Nations sanctions on North Korea. Exploiting a novel data set on North Korean firms, we construct measures of regional exposure to export and intermediate input sanctions and show that trade sanctions cause sharp declines in local nighttime luminosity. Additional analysis of newly available product-level price data reveals that import sanctions led to significant increases in market prices. We then estimate a quantitative spatial equilibrium model using cross-region variations. The model implies that the sanctions reduced the country's manufacturing output by 12.9% and real income by 15.3%. We further quantify the potential impact of alternative sanction scenarios.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了近期联合国对朝鲜制裁的经济成本。利用关于朝鲜企业的新数据集，我们构建了区域对出口和中间投入品制裁暴露程度的度量，并表明贸易制裁导致当地夜间灯光亮度急剧下降。对新获取的产品级价格数据的进一步分析显示，进口制裁导致市场价格显著上涨。随后，我们利用跨区域差异估计了一个定量空间均衡模型。该模型表明，制裁使该国制造业产出减少了12.9%，实际收入减少了15.3%。我们进一步量化了替代制裁情景的潜在影响。

records.title_en: Growth and risk: A view from international trade
records.title_cn: 增长与风险：国际贸易视角
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the cross-country patterns of risky innovation and growth through the lens of international trade. We use a simple theoretical framework of risky quality upgrading by firms under varying levels of financial development to derive two predictions. First, the mean rate of quality growth and the corresponding cross-sectional variance of quality growth in a country are positively correlated. Second, both the mean and variance of quality changes are positively correlated with the country's level of financial development. We then test these two hypotheses using data on disaggregated (HS10) bilateral exports to the United States. The patterns in the data are consistent with the theory. The mean and the variance of quality growth are strongly positively correlated with each other. Countries with greater financial depth are systematically characterized by higher mean and higher variance in the growth of product quality. Our findings suggest a mean-variance trade-off in product quality improvements along the development path. Increases in financial depth do not imply lower variability of changes in the product space.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过国际贸易的视角研究风险创新和增长的跨国模式。我们使用一个简单的理论框架，即在不同程度的金融发展下企业进行有风险的质量升级，从而得出两个预测。第一，一个国家质量增长的平均速率与质量增长的横截面方差呈正相关。第二，质量变化的均值和方差都与该国的金融发展水平呈正相关。然后，我们使用向美国出口的细分（HS10）双边出口数据来检验这两个假设。数据中的模式与理论一致。质量增长的均值和方差彼此强烈正相关。金融深度较大的国家系统性地表现为产品质量增长的均值和方差都较高。我们的研究结果表明，在发展路径上产品质量改进存在均值-方差权衡。金融深度的增加并不意味着产品空间变化波动性的降低。

records.title_en: Capital flows in an aging world
records.title_cn: 老龄化世界中的资本流动
records.abstract_en: We investigate the importance of worldwide demographic evolutions in shaping capital flows across countries. Our lifecycle model incorporates cross-country differences in fertility and longevity as well as differences in countries' ability to borrow inter-temporally and across generations through social security. In this environment, global aging triggers uphill capital flows from emerging to advanced economies, while country-specific demographic evolutions reallocate capital towards countries aging more slowly. Our quantitative multi-country overlapping generations model explains a large fraction of long-term capital flows across advanced and emerging countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了全球人口演变在塑造跨国资本流动中的重要性。我们的生命周期模型纳入了各国在生育率和预期寿命上的差异，以及各国通过社会保障进行跨期和跨代借贷能力的差异。在这种环境下，全球老龄化引发了从新兴经济体向发达经济体的上坡资本流动，而特定国家的人口演变则将资本重新配置到老龄化速度较慢的国家。我们的定量多国重叠世代模型解释了发达国家和新兴国家之间长期资本流动的很大一部分。

records.title_en: Original sin and the great depression
records.title_cn: 原罪与大萧条
records.abstract_en: Do exchange rate movements matter for how markets price foreign currency denominated sovereign bonds? High-frequency bond price data from 1931 show that depreciation against the dollar/gold was associated with elevated risk premia on US dollar/gold public debt. We use a theoretical model to illustrate how foreign currency debt influences exchange rate policy and foreign currency bond prices. We use these theoretical results, the timing of sterling's devaluation in September 1931, and historically determined fundamentals to identify the impact of exchange rate policy on hard-currency bond yields in the Great Depression.
records.abstract_cn: 汇率变动对于市场如何对外币计价的主权债券定价重要吗？ 1931 的高频债券价格数据显示，美元/黄金贬值与美元/黄金公共债务风险溢价升高相关。我们用一个理论模型来说明外币债务如何影响汇率政策和外币债券价格。我们利用这些理论结果、九月1931英镑贬值的时间以及历史确定的基本面来确定大萧条时期汇率政策对硬通货债券收益率的影响。

records.title_en: Gains from trade liberalization with flexible extensive margin adjustment
records.title_cn: 贸易自由化收益与灵活的外延边际调整
records.abstract_en: We propose a sufficient statistic to measure the ex-post welfare gains from trade in CES models featuring any productivity distribution and any pattern of selection into production and exporting. This statistic is based on a single data moment, the change in the market share of continuing domestic producers, and a single structural parameter, the elasticity of substitution between products. We apply our statistic to measure Canada's gains from the Canada-US Free Trade Agreement using data on observed firm selection. We find that welfare gains can substantially deviate from welfare estimates implied by formulas that assume a constant extensive margin trade elasticity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个充分统计量，用于衡量在具有任意生产率分布和任意生产与出口选择模式的CES模型中，贸易带来的事后福利收益。该统计量基于单一数据矩，即持续经营的国内生产商市场份额的变化，以及单一结构参数，即产品间的替代弹性。我们应用该统计量，利用观察到的企业选择数据，衡量加拿大从《加美自由贸易协定》中获得的收益。我们发现，福利收益可能显著偏离于假设外延边际贸易弹性为常数时公式所隐含的福利估计。

records.title_en: Monetary policy shocks and consumer expectations in the euro area
records.title_cn: 货币政策冲击与欧元区消费者预期
records.abstract_en: We study how consumers assess the effects of monetary policy shocks in euro area countries using survey data. Our findings provide evidence that consumers form expectations in a way that is broadly consistent with empirical and theoretical models of the monetary transmission mechanism, both at the aggregate level and at the country level. Although the euro area countries are characterized by economic and institutional heterogeneity, consumers' interpretations of the macroeconomic effects of monetary policy are relatively homogenous. Monetary policy is particularly effective in coordinating consumer price expectations, while the updating of unemployment expectations is more disperse across countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用调查数据研究消费者如何评估欧元区国家货币政策冲击的影响。我们的发现提供了证据，表明消费者形成预期的方式在总体上与货币传导机制的经验和理论模型基本一致，无论是在总体层面还是国家层面。尽管欧元区国家具有经济和制度上的异质性，但消费者对货币政策宏观经济效应的解读相对同质。货币政策在协调消费者价格预期方面尤为有效，而失业预期的更新在各国间则更为分散。

records.title_en: International effects of quantitative easing and foreign exchange intervention
records.title_cn: 量化宽松与外汇干预的国际效应
records.abstract_en: A two-country general equilibrium model is developed to study the global consequences of quantitative easing and foreign exchange intervention. The model incorporates financial frictions such as limited commitment, differential pledgeability of assets as collateral, and a low supply of collateralizable assets. Due to differential asset pledgeability, financial intermediaries acquire different asset portfolios particular to their home country. Quantitative easing can reduce long-term nominal interest rates, mitigate financial frictions globally, and depreciate the currency of the country that supplies more pledgeable assets. The international effects of foreign exchange intervention depend on the implementing country. If implemented by the country that supplies more pledgeable assets, such intervention can ease financial frictions and enhance welfare globally.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个两国一般均衡模型，以研究量化宽松与外汇干预的全球后果。该模型纳入了金融摩擦，如有限承诺、资产作为抵押品的可质押性差异以及可抵押资产供给不足。由于资产可质押性的差异，金融中介机构会持有与其母国特定的不同资产组合。量化宽松可以降低长期名义利率，缓解全球金融摩擦，并使提供更多可质押资产的国家货币贬值。外汇干预的国际效应取决于实施国。如果由提供更多可质押资产的国家实施，此类干预可以缓解金融摩擦并提升全球福利。

records.title_en: China's dazzling transport-infrastructure growth: Measurement and effects
records.title_cn: 中国交通基础设施的惊人增长：测度与效应
records.abstract_en: We document an unprecedented change in the size and the quality of China's transport-infrastructure network between 2000 and 2013 based on hand-collected and digitized data on roads and railways. The changes are summarized and portrayed as shortest-possible transport times of people and goods between 330 prefectures of mainland China. A quantitative model of China's prefectures and a Rest of the World, featuring both goods trade and migration, suggests that the transport-infrastructure changes induced regional convergence of lagging-behind prefectures in terms of population density and, to a lesser extent, of real per-capita income. Not only changes in highway and high-speed-railway networks but also ones in lower-level road and railway networks are quantitatively important.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于手工收集和数字化的公路与铁路数据，记录了2000年至2013年间中国交通基础设施网络在规模和质量上的空前变化。这些变化被概括并描绘为中国大陆330个地级市之间人员与货物最短运输时间。一个涵盖中国各地级市及世界其他地区、同时包含商品贸易与人口迁移的定量模型表明，交通基础设施的变化促使落后地级市在人口密度方面实现区域趋同，并在较小程度上实现实际人均收入的趋同。不仅高速公路和高铁网络的变化，而且低等级公路和铁路网络的变化，在数量上都具有重要意义。

records.title_en: The rise in foreign currency bonds: The role of US monetary policy and capital controls
records.title_cn: 外币债券的兴起：美国货币政策与资本管制的作用
records.abstract_en: An unintended consequence of loose US monetary policy is the increase in currency risk exposure abroad. Using firm-level data on corporate bond issuances in 16 emerging market economies (EMEs) between 2003 and 2017, we find that EME companies are more likely to issue bonds in foreign currency when US interest rates are low. This effect is driven by non-exporters. Interestingly, capital controls on bond inflows significantly decrease the likelihood of issuing in foreign currency and can even eliminate the adverse impact of low US interest rates. In contrast, macroprudential foreign exchange regulations increase foreign currency issuances among nonfinancial companies.
records.abstract_cn: 宽松的美国货币政策的一个意外后果是海外货币风险敞口的增加。利用2003年至2017年间16个新兴市场经济体（EMEs）公司债券发行的企业层面数据，我们发现当美国利率较低时，新兴市场经济体公司更有可能发行外币债券。这一效应由非出口企业驱动。有趣的是，对债券流入的资本管制显著降低了以外币发行的可能性，甚至能消除低美国利率的不利影响。相比之下，宏观审慎的外汇监管增加了非金融公司以外币发行的规模。

records.title_en: No country is an island. International cooperation and climate change
records.title_cn: 没有哪个国家是孤岛。国际合作与气候变化
records.abstract_en: We explore the cross-country implications of climate-related mitigation policies. Specifically, we set up and estimate a three-country, two-sector (brown vs green) DSGE model with negative production externalities stemming from carbon-dioxide emissions. The model is used to characterize the welfare-enhancing equilibrium under alternative containment policies. According to the optimal policy mix: i) fiscal policy focuses on reducing emissions; ii) countries cooperate with each other to reduce the losses generated by climate policies; iii) monetary policy looks through environmental objectives but adapts its strategy when the costs of the environmental transition materialize. All other policy combinations either fall short of the Paris agreement's objective or are not incentive-compatible, i.e. the implied short-term losses would prevent the implementation of efficient long-term climate policies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了气候相关减缓政策的跨国影响。具体而言，我们建立并估计了一个三国、两部门（棕色与绿色）的DSGE模型，该模型包含二氧化碳排放带来的负生产外部性。该模型用于刻画在替代性遏制政策下的福利增进均衡。根据最优政策组合：i) 财政政策侧重于减少排放；ii) 各国相互合作以减少气候政策产生的损失；iii) 货币政策不直接针对环境目标，但在环境转型成本显现时调整其策略。所有其他政策组合要么达不到《巴黎协定》的目标，要么缺乏激励相容性，即隐含的短期损失将阻碍高效长期气候政策的实施。

records.title_en: Banking across borders with heterogeneous banks
records.title_cn: 异质性银行跨境银行业务
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a model of banking across borders where banks differ in their efficiencies. Operating abroad allows the most efficient banks that have a large enough scale to overcome the associated fixed costs to increase their leverage, size and profits even more. Banking globalization increases welfare because these banks, by maximizing the return on loans and minimizing funding costs, improve the allocation of capital by channeling capital across borders. At the same time, global banking sector efficiency increases because the least efficient banks exit. Foreign exposures data for German banks deliver new model-derived stylized facts. In particular, the average efficiency of banks that operate abroad is lower for host countries that have a less efficient banking sector, are larger and feature lower impediments to foreign bank entry.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个跨境银行业模型，其中银行效率存在差异。在海外经营使得效率最高且规模足够大的银行能够克服相关固定成本，从而进一步提高其杠杆率、规模和利润。银行业全球化增进了福利，因为这些银行通过最大化贷款回报和最小化融资成本，跨境引导资本，改善了资本配置。同时，由于效率最低的银行退出，全球银行业效率得以提升。德国银行的国外敞口数据提供了模型推导出的新典型事实。特别是，对于银行业效率较低、规模较大且外国银行进入障碍较小的东道国，在海外经营的银行平均效率较低。

records.title_en: Low pass-through and international synchronization in general equilibrium: Reassessing vertical integration
records.title_cn: 一般均衡中的低传导与国际同步：重新评估垂直整合
records.abstract_en: We investigate the difficulties of the canonical open New Keynesian model to i) reproduce the observed exchange rate pass-through disconnect, i.e. a pass-through high for import prices and low for consumer prices, and ii) to generate international business cycle synchronization. The literature tackled them separately: i) strategic complementarities for exporting firms to mitigate the pass-through to consumer prices and ii) intermediate inputs trade to enhance cross-border spillovers. We prove that foreign intermediate inputs also efficiently address the pass-through dimension, but, unlike strategic complementarities, solve the exchange rate pass-through disconnect puzzle. These results carry over to the general equilibrium effects of a depreciation. Furthermore, we show analytically that both types of vertical integration weaken sharply the expenditure switching effect. This feature strengthens real synchronization in response to productivity and monetary policy shocks, but lowers it in response to private demand shocks, a point which complements the existing literature.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了经典开放新凯恩斯模型在以下两方面的困难：i) 重现观察到的汇率传导脱节，即进口价格传导高而消费者价格传导低；ii) 产生国际商业周期同步。文献分别处理了这些问题：i) 出口企业的战略互补性以缓解对消费者价格的传导，以及 ii) 中间投入品贸易以增强跨境溢出效应。我们证明外国中间投入品也能有效解决传导维度的问题，但与战略互补性不同，它解决了汇率传导脱节的难题。这些结果同样适用于贬值的一般均衡效应。此外，我们分析性地表明，两种类型的垂直整合都显著削弱了支出转换效应。这一特征增强了应对生产率和货币政策冲击时的实际同步性，但降低了对私人需求冲击的同步性，这一点补充了现有文献。

records.title_en: Gold as international reserves: A barbarous relic no more?
records.title_cn: 黄金作为国际储备：不再是一种野蛮的遗迹？
records.abstract_en: After falling for decades, central bank gold holdings have risen since the Global Financial Crisis. We identify 14 “active diversifiers,” countries that purchased gold and raised its share in total reserves by 5 or more percentage points over the last two decades. In contrast to the diversification of foreign currency reserves, which has been undertaken by advanced and developing country central banks alike, diversifiers into gold are exclusively emerging markets. We document two sets of factors contributing to this trend. First, gold is seen as a safe haven in periods of economic, financial and geopolitical volatility. Second, financial sanctions by the US, UK, EU and Japan, the main reserve-issuing economies, are associated with an increase in the share of central bank reserves held in the form of gold.
records.abstract_cn: 在经历了数十年的下降之后，自全球金融危机以来，各国央行的黄金持有量有所上升。我们识别出14个“积极分散化者”，即在过去二十年中购买黄金并将其在总储备中的份额提高5个或更多百分点的国家。与由发达和发展中国家央行共同进行的外汇储备分散化不同，黄金分散化者完全属于新兴市场。我们记录了两组促成这一趋势的因素。首先，黄金被视为经济、金融和地缘政治波动时期的避险资产。其次，美国、英国、欧盟和日本（主要储备发行经济体）实施的金融制裁与央行以黄金形式持有的储备份额增加有关。

records.title_en: MPCs in an emerging economy: Evidence from Peru
records.title_cn: 新兴经济体中的边际消费倾向：来自秘鲁的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) out of transitory income shocks for an emerging economy, Peru, using its nationally representative household survey. The mean quarterly MPC across Peruvian income deciles is 0.204, which translates to a mean annualized MPC of 0.545–0.592 under both model-free and model-based annualization methods. To compare Peruvian and U.S. MPCs reflecting the different reference periods of the underlying surveys, I employ a standard incomplete-market model. Two striking differences emerge. First, the mean annual MPC in Peru is three times as large as that in the U.S. Second, the MPCs are substantially more heterogeneous over income deciles in Peru than in the U.S. The model predicts that precautionary saving behavior drives both the higher mean MPC and stronger MPC heterogeneity in Peru.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用秘鲁具有全国代表性的家庭调查，估计了新兴经济体秘鲁的暂时性收入冲击的边际消费倾向（MPC）。秘鲁各收入十分位数的平均季度MPC为0.204，在无模型和基于模型的年化方法下，这转化为平均年化MPC为0.545-0.592。为了比较反映基础调查不同参考期的秘鲁和美国MPC，我采用了一个标准的不完全市场模型。出现了两个显著差异。首先，秘鲁的平均年度MPC是美国的三倍。其次，秘鲁各收入十分位数的MPC比美国更具异质性。模型预测，预防性储蓄行为推动了秘鲁更高的平均MPC和更强的MPC异质性。

records.title_en: Differential treatment in the bond market: Sovereign risk and mutual fund portfolios
records.title_cn: 债券市场中的差别待遇：主权风险与共同基金投资组合
records.abstract_en: How do international investors adjust their portfolios in response to sovereign risk? We answer this question by combining data on default probabilities for 31 developed and emerging markets with monthly data on the portfolios of individual bond mutual funds. We show that bond funds reduce their exposure to a country when sovereign default risk increases, indicating that changes in yields do not fully compensate investors for additional sovereign risk. We find that the magnitude of the response is heterogeneous. Portfolio weights of high-risk countries are more sensitive to sovereign risk, while core developed markets appear to enjoy preferential treatment, with their portfolio weights little affected by sovereign risk. Fund characteristics, such as past performance, also affect sensitivity to sovereign risk. Finally, we document what determines the destination of reallocation flows. Funds shift their assets to countries outside the immediate geographic region while avoiding markets to which they are heavily exposed.
records.abstract_cn: 国际投资者如何根据主权风险调整其投资组合？我们通过将31个发达市场和新兴市场的违约概率数据与个人债券共同基金投资组合的月度数据相结合来回答这个问题。我们发现，当主权违约风险增加时，债券基金会减少对某个国家的敞口，这表明收益率的变化并不能完全补偿投资者承担的额外主权风险。我们发现，这种反应的幅度是异质的。高风险国家的投资组合权重对主权风险更为敏感，而核心发达市场似乎享有优惠待遇，其投资组合权重受主权风险影响较小。基金特征，如过往业绩，也会影响对主权风险的敏感性。最后，我们记录了决定再配置资金流向的因素。基金将资产转移到其直接地理区域之外的国家，同时避开它们敞口较大的市场。

records.title_en: Judgment day: Algorithmic trading around the Swiss franc cap removal
records.title_cn: 审判日：瑞士法郎上限取消前后的算法交易
records.abstract_en: A key issue for decentralised markets like FX is how the market responds to extreme situations. Using data on FX transactions with a precise identification of Algorithmic trading (AT), we find that AT, broadly defined, appears to have contributed to the deterioration of market quality following the removal of the cap on the Swiss franc on 15 January 2015 by withdrawing liquidity and generating uninformative volatility. We also find that the Swiss National Bank, after initially stepping aside, played an important role, though more by signalling rather than trading. This perhaps explains why human trading – that could most easily interpret those signals – was important in stabilising the market.
records.abstract_cn: 外汇等去中心化市场的一个关键问题是市场如何应对极端情况。利用外汇交易数据并精确识别算法交易（AT），我们发现，广义上的算法交易在2015年一月15日瑞士法郎上限取消后，通过撤出流动性和产生无信息波动，似乎加剧了市场质量的恶化。我们还发现，瑞士国家银行在最初退让后，发挥了重要作用，尽管更多是通过信号而非交易。这或许解释了为什么人类交易——最能解读这些信号——在稳定市场中至关重要。

records.title_en: A second-best argument for low optimal tariffs on intermediate inputs
records.title_cn: 中间投入品低最优关税的次优论证
records.abstract_en: We derive a new formula for the optimal uniform tariff in a small-country, heterogeneous-firm model with roundabout production and a nontraded good. Tariffs are applied on imported intermediate inputs. First-best policy requires that markups on domestic intermediate inputs are offset by subsidies. In a second-best setting where such subsidies are not used, roundabout production and the monopoly distortion in the traded sector create strong incentives to lower the optimal tariff on imported inputs. In a quantitative version of our two-sector small open economy, we find that the optimal tariff is lowered under nearly all parameter values considered, and can be negative.
records.abstract_cn: 我们推导了一个小国、异质性企业模型中，在循环生产和非贸易品存在的情况下，最优统一关税的新公式。关税适用于进口的中间投入品。最优政策要求通过补贴来抵消国内中间投入品的加成。在不使用此类补贴的次优环境中，循环生产和贸易部门的垄断扭曲创造了降低进口投入品最优关税的强大激励。在我们两部门小型开放经济的量化版本中，我们发现，在几乎所有考虑的参数值下，最优关税都会降低，并且可能为负。

records.title_en: Intellectual property infringement by foreign firms: Import protection through the ITC or court
records.title_cn: 外国企业的知识产权侵权：通过ITC或法院的进口保护
records.abstract_en: This paper examines intellectual property litigation as a method of protection from patent-infringing imports. Claims against patent-infringing imports entering the United States may be filed before the International Trade Commission (ITC) or in district court. The ITC applies injunctions (import prohibitions) that would seem to provide more protection from infringing imports than the standard license fee remedy in court. Settlements prior to legal adjudication are common in both venues. Using a model with Nash bargaining and Cournot competition, we show that an ITC filing may restrict imports by less than in court. This result tends to apply if product differentiation is high and the size of the patented cost-reducing innovation is large.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了知识产权诉讼作为对专利侵权进口品保护的一种方法。针对进入美国的专利侵权进口品的索赔可以向国际贸易委员会（ITC）或地区法院提起。ITC适用禁令（进口禁止），这似乎比法院的标准许可费救济更能提供对侵权进口品的保护。在两种场所中，法律裁决前的和解都很常见。使用纳什谈判和古诺竞争的模型，我们表明ITC立案可能比法院更少限制进口。如果产品差异化程度高且专利成本降低创新的规模大，这一结果往往适用。

records.title_en: COVID-19 and emerging markets: A SIR model, demand shocks and capital flows
records.title_cn: COVID-19与新兴市场：SIR模型、需求冲击与资本流动
records.abstract_en: We quantify the macroeconomic effects of COVID-19 for a small open economy. We use a two-country framework combined with a sectoral SIR model to estimate the effects of collapses in foreign demand and supply. The small open economy (country one) suffers from domestic demand and supply shocks due to its own pandemic. In addition, there are external shocks coming from the rest of the world (country two). Aggregate exports of the small open economy decline when foreign demand goes down, and aggregate imports suffer from lockdowns in the rest of the world. We calibrate the model to Turkey. Our results show that the optimal policy, which yields the lowest output loss and saves the maximum number of lives, for the small open economy, is an early and globally coordinated full lockdown of 39 days.
records.abstract_cn: 我们量化了COVID-19对小型开放经济的宏观经济影响。我们使用两国框架结合部门SIR模型来估计外国需求和供应崩溃的影响。小型开放经济体（国家一）因自身疫情遭受国内需求和供应冲击。此外，还有来自世界其他地区（国家二）的外部冲击。当外国需求下降时，小型开放经济体的总出口下降，而总进口则受到世界其他地区封锁的影响。我们将模型校准到土耳其。我们的结果表明，对于小型开放经济体而言，能够产生最低产出损失并挽救最多生命的最优政策是早期且全球协调的全面封锁，持续39天。

records.title_en: Testing classic theories of migration in the lab
records.title_cn: 在实验室中检验经典移民理论
records.abstract_en: We test different classic migration theories by using incentivized laboratory experiments to investigate how potential migrants decide between working in different destinations. We assess theories of income maximization, skill-selection, and multi-destination choice, as we vary migration costs, risk, social benefits, and incomplete information. The standard income maximization model leads to a much higher migration rate and more negative skill-selection than occurs when migration decisions take place under more realistic assumptions. The independence of irrelevant alternatives assumption mostly holds when decisions just involve wages and moving costs, but breaks down once we add risk and incomplete information. Cost-minimization, rather than income maximization, seems to be key in some migration decisions. The deviations found in our study between migration decisions and the predictions of classic migration theories call for richer models of migration to explain global migration patterns.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过使用激励性实验室实验来检验不同的经典移民理论，以调查潜在移民如何在不同的目的地之间选择工作。我们评估了收入最大化、技能选择和多目的地选择理论，同时变化移民成本、风险、社会福利和不完全信息。标准收入最大化模型导致的移民率和负技能选择远高于在更现实假设下进行移民决策时的情况。当决策仅涉及工资和迁移成本时，无关选择的独立性假设大多成立，但一旦加入风险和不完全信息，该假设即失效。在某些移民决策中，成本最小化而非收入最大化似乎是关键。我们的研究中发现的移民决策与经典移民理论预测之间的偏差，要求更丰富的移民模型来解释全球移民模式。

records.title_en: The effects of countercyclical interest rates: Evidence from the classical gold standard
records.title_cn: 逆周期利率的影响：来自古典金本位制的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of countercyclical interest rates on macroeconomic outcomes in open economies. To identify countercyclical interest rates, we construct a new database of short-term interest rates, principal exports, and commodity prices for 40 economies from 1870–1913. Specialization and trade integration subjected economies to a “commodity lottery” in the form of price fluctuations in world markets. Capital mobility and a currency peg exposed them to interest-rate movements originating in the U.K., the largest economy and linchpin of the classical gold standard. We use these two exogenous shocks to identify positive effects of commodity-export prices on real GDP and the domestic price level and negative effects of exogenous changes in short-term interest rates on the same variables. We show that countercyclical interest rates, defined relative to export-price shocks, stabilized both output and the domestic price level. This stabilization was more effective for the price level than for output.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了逆周期利率对开放经济中宏观经济结果的影响。为了识别逆周期利率，我们构建了一个涵盖1870-1913年间40个经济体的短期利率、主要出口商品和商品价格的新数据库。专业化和贸易一体化使经济体面临世界市场价格波动的“商品彩票”形式的风险。资本流动性和货币挂钩使它们暴露于源自英国（最大的经济体和古典金本位制的关键）的利率变动之中。我们利用这两个外生冲击来识别商品出口价格对实际GDP和国内价格水平的正向影响，以及短期利率外生变动对相同变量的负向影响。我们表明，相对于出口价格冲击定义的逆周期利率，稳定了产出和国内价格水平。这种稳定对价格水平比对产出更有效。

records.title_en: Robots, tasks, and trade
records.title_cn: 机器人、任务与贸易
records.abstract_en: We examine the effects of robotization on North–South trade patterns, wages and welfare. The empirical analysis uses ordinary least squares and instrumental-variable regressions exploiting variation in exposure to robots across countries and sectors. Both reveal that greater robot intensity in own production leads to: (i) a rise in imports sourced from less developed countries in the same industry; and (ii) an even stronger increase in exports to those countries. To explain these findings we develop a stylized Ricardian model featuring two-stage production and trade in intermediate and final goods in which robots can take over some tasks previously performed by humans in a subset of industries. An increase in robot adoption in the North impacts trade in final and intermediate goods with the South, as well as wages and welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了机器人化对南北贸易模式、工资和福利的影响。实证分析采用普通最小二乘法和工具变量回归，利用各国和各行业机器人暴露程度的差异。两者均表明，本国生产中机器人强度的提高导致：（i）同一行业中来自欠发达国家的进口增加；（ii）对这些国家的出口增长更为强劲。为解释这些发现，我们构建了一个简约的李嘉图模型，该模型包含两阶段生产以及中间品和最终品的贸易，其中机器人可以在某些行业中接管以前由人类执行的部分任务。北方机器人采用率的提高会影响与南方的最终品和中间品贸易，以及工资和福利。

records.title_en: Unilateral tax policy in the open economy
records.title_cn: 开放经济中的单边税收政策
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of a unilateral reform of a redistributive tax-transfer system in an open economy. Compared to autarky, a tax increase leads to a smaller decline in aggregate income in the open economy, and it is also more effective at reducing income inequality, provided the tax rates are sufficiently low. Aggregating effects on income and income inequality using an Atkinson social welfare function, we find that optimal tax rates are positive in the open economy and higher than under autarky. The key mechanism is a tax-induced reduction in the market size of the reforming country relative to its trading partner, resulting in a firm selection effect towards exporting in line with a terms-of-trade improvement. From the perspective of a non-reforming trading partner, this resembles a unilateral increase in trade costs leading to a deterioration of terms of trade and a decline in aggregate real income and inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了开放经济中再分配税收-转移支付体系单边改革的影响。与自给自足相比，在开放经济中，税收增加导致的总收入下降幅度较小，并且在税率足够低的情况下，税收增加在减少收入不平等方面也更有效。使用Atkinson社会福利函数对收入和收入不平等的影响进行加总，我们发现开放经济中的最优税率为正，且高于自给自足下的最优税率。关键机制是税收导致改革国相对于其贸易伙伴的市场规模缩小，从而产生企业向出口选择的效应，这与贸易条件改善一致。从非改革贸易伙伴的角度来看，这类似于单方面提高贸易成本，导致贸易条件恶化和实际总收入及不平等程度下降。

records.title_en: Global impacts of US monetary policy uncertainty shocks
records.title_cn: 美国货币政策不确定性冲击的全球影响
records.abstract_en: We build a new empirical model, which admits time-varying variances of local structural shocks, to estimate the global impact of an increase in the volatility of US monetary policy shocks. By allowing for rich dynamic interaction between the endogenous variables and time-varying volatility in the global setting, we find that US interest rate uncertainty not only drives local output and inflation volatility, but also causes declines in output, inflation, and the interest rate. Moreover, we document strong global impacts, making the world move in a very synchronous way. Crucially, spillback effects are found to be significant even for the US economy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个新的实证模型，该模型允许局部结构性冲击的方差随时间变化，用以估计美国货币政策冲击波动性增加对全球的影响。通过允许内生变量与全球环境中的时变波动性之间存在丰富的动态交互，我们发现美国利率不确定性不仅驱动了局部产出和通胀波动，还导致了产出、通胀和利率的下降。此外，我们记录了强烈的全球影响，使世界以一种非常同步的方式运动。至关重要的是，即使对美国经济而言，回溢效应也被发现是显著的。

records.title_en: Mitigating information frictions in trade: Evidence from export credit guarantees
records.title_cn: 缓解贸易中的信息摩擦：来自出口信用担保的证据
records.abstract_en: Information frictions make foreign trade risky. In particular, the risk of buyer default deters firms from selling abroad. To address this issue, many countries offer export credit guarantees to provide insurance to exporters. In this paper, we investigate the causal effects of guarantees by exploiting a quasi-natural experiment in Sweden and rich register data on guarantees, firms and trade. Estimates from a fuzzy regression discontinuity design show large positive effects on the probability of exporting and the value of exports to the destination for which the guarantees are issued. These results are robust to an alternative approach using a difference-in-differences matching estimator. Further findings suggest that guarantees impact firms heterogeneously and play an important role in resolving buyer default risk and easing liquidity constraints. Larger impacts are observed in non-OECD countries, on smaller, liquidity constrained exporters and for firms selling products that face a relatively high cost of buyer default.
records.abstract_cn: 信息摩擦使对外贸易具有风险。特别是，买方违约的风险阻碍了企业向国外销售。为了解决这一问题，许多国家提供出口信用担保，为出口商提供保险。在本文中，我们利用瑞典的一个准自然实验以及关于担保、企业和贸易的丰富注册数据，研究担保的因果效应。模糊断点回归设计的估计显示，对出口概率和向担保签发目的地的出口价值有较大的正向影响。这些结果对于使用双重差分匹配估计量的替代方法也是稳健的。进一步的研究结果表明，担保对企业的影响具有异质性，并在解决买方违约风险和缓解流动性约束方面发挥重要作用。在非OECD国家、规模较小且受流动性约束的出口商以及销售面临相对较高买方违约成本产品的企业中，观察到更大的影响。

records.title_en: The international transmission of local economic shocks through migrant networks
records.title_cn: 地方经济冲击通过移民网络的国际传导
records.abstract_en: Using newly validated data on geographic migration networks, we study how labor demand shocks in the United States propagate across the border with Mexico. We show that the large exogenous decline in US employment brought about by the Great Recession affected demographic and economic outcomes in Mexican communities that were highly connected to the most affected markets in the US. In the Mexican locations with strong initial ties to the hardest hit US migrant destinations, return migration increased, emigration decreased, and remittance receipt declined. These changes significantly increased local employment and hours worked, but wages were unaffected. Investment in children’s education also slowed in these communities. These findings document the effects in Mexico when potential migrants lose access to a strong US labor market, providing insight into the potential impacts of stricter US migration restrictions.
records.abstract_cn: 利用新验证的地理迁移网络数据，我们研究了美国劳动力需求冲击如何跨越墨西哥边境传播。我们表明，大衰退带来的美国就业的大幅外生下降，影响了与美国受影响最严重市场高度关联的墨西哥社区的人口和经济结果。在与美国受影响最严重的移民目的地有紧密初始联系的墨西哥地区，回返移民增加，向外移民减少，汇款收入下降。这些变化显著增加了当地就业和工作时间，但工资未受影响。这些社区对子女教育的投资也放缓了。这些发现记录了当潜在移民失去进入强大美国劳动力市场的机会时对墨西哥的影响，为更严格的美国移民限制的潜在影响提供了见解。

records.title_en: Determinants of global neutral interest rates
records.title_cn: 全球中性利率的决定因素
records.abstract_en: We provide a comprehensive account of the determinants of global longer-run neutral interest rates—the real component of policy interest rates consistent with both economic activity and inflation at their longer-run trends. Using a cross-country model for 11 advanced economies in the 1960–2019 period, we simultaneously account for productivity, demographics, global supply of safe assets, demand factors for safe assets, and global spillovers faced by each economy from the rest of the world’s developments. We find two main results: safe asset supply is a major determinant of neutral rates, with its positive contribution since 2008 counteracting negative contributions from many other determinants, and global spillovers are important determinants of neutral rates’ trajectories and co-movements.
records.abstract_cn: 我们全面阐述了全球长期中性利率——即与经济活动和通胀长期趋势相一致的政策利率的实际组成部分——的决定因素。利用一个涵盖11个发达经济体、时间跨度为1960-2019年的跨国模型，我们同时考虑了生产率、人口结构、全球安全资产供给、安全资产需求因素以及各经济体所面临的来自世界其他地区发展的全球溢出效应。我们得出两个主要结果：安全资产供给是中性利率的主要决定因素，自2008年以来其正向贡献抵消了许多其他决定因素的负向贡献；全球溢出效应是中性利率轨迹及其联动的重要决定因素。

records.title_en: Making sovereign debt safe with a financial stability fund
records.title_cn: 通过金融稳定基金实现主权债务安全
records.abstract_en: We develop an optimal design of a Financial Stability Fund that coexists with the international debt market. The sovereign can borrow defaultable bonds on the private international market, while having with the Fund a long-term contingent contract subject to limited enforcement constraints. The Fund contract does not have ex ante conditionality, but requires an accurate country-specific risk-assessment (DSA), accounting for the Fund contract. The Fund periodically announces the level of liabilities the country can sustain to achieve the constrained efficient allocation. The Fund is only required minimal absorption of the sovereign debt, but it must provide insurance (Arrow-securities) to the country. Furthermore, with the Fund all sovereign debt is safe independently of the seniority structure; however, for the Fund, seniority may require a greater minimal absorption than a pari passu regime. We calibrate our model to the Italian economy and show it would have had a more efficient path of debt accumulation with the Fund.
records.abstract_cn: 我们设计了一个与国际债务市场共存的金融稳定基金的最优方案。主权国家可以在私人国际市场上发行违约债券，同时与基金签订受有限执行约束的长期或有合同。基金合同没有事前条件性，但要求进行准确的国家特定风险评估（DSA），并考虑基金合同。基金定期公布国家能够承受的负债水平，以实现约束有效配置。基金仅需对主权债务进行最低限度的吸收，但必须向国家提供保险（阿罗证券）。此外，有了基金，所有主权债务都是安全的，无论优先权结构如何；然而，对于基金而言，优先权可能需要比同等优先权制度更大的最低吸收。我们将模型校准到意大利经济，并表明有了基金，债务积累路径本可以更有效。

records.title_en: Escaping import competition in China
records.title_cn: 逃离中国的进口竞争
records.abstract_en: In panel data on Chinese establishments spanning the 2001 WTO accession, import competition is associated with increases in revenue productivity. We propose a model that interprets this (and additional evidence) as firms choosing to differentiate their products to escape import competition. In the model, the profit from endogenous differentiating is decreasing in trade costs and is an inverted U-shaped function of productivity. We estimate the model and study a counterfactual trade liberalization. In response to import competition, firms differentiate their products and increase their markups, thereby increasing revenue productivity as in the data. Since product differentiation is underprovided by the market, the endogenous differentiation increases welfare relative to a model without firms’ option to differentiate. So, the model rationalizes the positive relationship between import competition and revenue productivity in the data, and it puts forth a new source of gain from trade.
records.abstract_cn: 在覆盖2001年加入世界贸易组织的中国企业面板数据中，进口竞争与收入生产率的提高相关。我们提出了一个模型，将这一现象（以及其他证据）解释为企业选择差异化其产品以逃离进口竞争。在该模型中，内生差异化的利润随贸易成本递减，并且是生产率的倒U型函数。我们估计了该模型，并研究了一个反事实的贸易自由化。面对进口竞争，企业差异化其产品并提高加成率，从而如数据所示提高收入生产率。由于市场提供的产品差异化不足，与没有企业差异化选项的模型相比，内生差异化增加了福利。因此，该模型合理化了数据中进口竞争与收入生产率之间的正相关关系，并提出了贸易收益的一个新来源。

records.title_en: Precautionary protectionism
records.title_cn: 预防性保护主义
records.abstract_en: We characterize optimal trade policy when there is a potential crisis: an increase in demand for goods produced abroad. In our model, comparative advantage is endogenous, as countries cannot start producing new goods after the shock. In anticipation, the optimal policy uses tariffs to encourage the production of more goods. For marginally competitive goods, the optimal policy trades off comparative advantage and demand. However, the home planner never protects goods where comparative advantage is low, even those with large demand shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了存在潜在危机时的最优贸易政策：即对国外生产的商品需求增加。在我们的模型中，比较优势是内生的，因为各国在冲击后无法开始生产新产品。预期到这一点，最优政策利用关税鼓励生产更多商品。对于边际竞争商品，最优政策在比较优势和需求之间进行权衡。然而，国内规划者从不保护比较优势低的商品，即使是那些需求冲击大的商品。

records.title_en: Macroprudential policy for internal financial dollarization
records.title_cn: 内部金融美元化的宏观审慎政策
records.abstract_en: We study macroprudential policy aimed at domestic debt denominated in different currencies. We model a small open economy with entrepreneurs and workers who save and borrow in domestic and foreign currency. Financial frictions make dollar debt on entrepreneurs’ balance sheets especially disruptive when the exchange rate depreciates. Falling output causes additional depreciation; this amplification provides a rationale for de-dollarization. On the other hand, de-dollarization is costly because the dollar savings of domestic workers provide them with insurance. We characterize the social marginal benefits and costs of de-dollarization in this context. The social marginal costs are associated with a deterioration in risk-sharing and can be expressed in terms of the interest rate premium on domestic currency assets. We find that these costs are of second order around the unregulated equilibrium, but play a role for optimal policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究针对以不同货币计价的国内债务的宏观审慎政策。我们建立了一个小型开放经济模型，其中企业家和工人以本币和外币进行储蓄和借贷。金融摩擦使得企业家资产负债表上的美元债务在汇率贬值时尤其具有破坏性。产出下降导致进一步贬值；这种放大效应为去美元化提供了理由。另一方面，去美元化是有代价的，因为国内工人的美元储蓄为他们提供了保险。我们在此背景下刻画了去美元化的社会边际收益和成本。社会边际成本与风险分担的恶化相关，可以用本币资产的利率溢价来表示。我们发现，这些成本在无监管均衡附近是二阶的，但对最优政策有影响。

records.title_en: Dollar invoicing, global value chains, and the business cycle dynamics of international trade
records.title_cn: 美元计价、全球价值链与国际贸易的商业周期动态
records.abstract_en: This paper reexamines the relationship between monetary policy, exchange rates and international trade in a world characterized by the dominant currency paradigm and global value chains. Using a three-country dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model, it documents key differences between the response of gross and value added trade flows to interest rate shocks, and offers a framework to test them in the data. The exercise uncovers a new margin of adjustment where value added trade flows react significantly to shocks, even as gross trade flows that are typically measured in the data remain relatively flat. This provides a reconciliation between the output effects of textbook models that assume producer currency pricing and no value chains, and the low aggregate exchange rate passthrough and muted adjustment of gross trade flows that has been documented in the data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在主导货币范式和全球价值链特征化的世界中重新审视货币政策、汇率与国际贸易之间的关系。通过使用三国动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，本文记录了总贸易流量和增加值贸易流量对利率冲击反应的显著差异，并提供了一个在数据中检验这些差异的框架。该研究揭示了一个新的调整边际，其中增加值贸易流量对冲击反应显著，即使数据中通常衡量的总贸易流量保持相对平稳。这为假设生产者货币定价且无价值链的教科书模型的产出效应，与数据中记录的低总体汇率传递和总贸易流量调整迟缓之间提供了一种调和。

records.title_en: Regulatory arbitrage and loan location decisions by multinational banks
records.title_cn: 监管套利与跨国银行的贷款地点决策
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of international differences in capital regulation on multinational banks' loan origination location decisions. International loan location decisions represent a key banking margin that has previously not been examined in the literature on regulatory arbitrage by banks. Our estimation relies on within-loan contribution variation in location options for individual multinational banks that participate in a syndicated loan. We examine how the loan location choice and the intensity of regulatory arbitrage are affected by borrower transparency. We find that greater borrower transparency to a local bank establishment makes loan location at this establishment more likely, and that regulatory arbitrage is more intense in the case of more transparent borrowers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了资本监管的国际差异对跨国银行贷款发放地点决策的影响。国际贷款地点决策代表了银行的一个关键业务维度，此前在银行监管套利的文献中尚未被研究。我们的估计依赖于参与银团贷款的个别跨国银行在贷款内对地点选项的贡献变化。我们考察了借款人透明度如何影响贷款地点选择和监管套利的强度。我们发现，借款人对当地银行机构的更高透明度使得贷款更可能在该机构发放，并且对于更透明的借款人，监管套利更为激烈。

records.title_en: Endogenous production networks with fixed costs
records.title_cn: 内生生产网络与固定成本
records.abstract_en: We develop a model of endogenous production networks with fixed costs in the formation of links between firms. We show that the closed economy equilibrium is unique if the set of feasible networks consists only of networks that are acyclic and the buyer initiates the link formation while having full bargaining power in price negotiations with the supplier. We provide examples of multiple equilibria if the supplier initiates the link formation in both cyclic and acyclic feasible networks or if the buyer initiates the link formation in a cyclic production network. We take the acyclic production network model to Belgian data on firm-to-firm production networks and show that it matches well the salient features of the network. The model generates substantial churn in domestic firm-to-firm linkages in response to trade shocks, while delivering only moderately different welfare changes compared to a model with fixed linkages.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个内生生产网络模型，其中企业间链接的形成存在固定成本。我们证明，如果可行网络集合仅包含无环网络，且买方在发起链接形成的同时在与供应商的价格谈判中拥有完全议价能力，则封闭经济均衡是唯一的。我们提供了在可行网络为有环或无环时由供应商发起链接形成，或由买方在有环生产网络中发起链接形成时存在多重均衡的示例。我们将无环生产网络模型应用于比利时企业间生产网络的数据，并表明该模型很好地匹配了网络的显著特征。该模型在应对贸易冲击时产生了国内企业间链接的大量更替，而与固定链接模型相比，其福利变化仅存在适度差异。

records.title_en: Longevity and the value of trade relationships
records.title_cn: 长期关系与贸易关系的价值
records.abstract_en: More than 80 percent of U.S. imports occur in preexisting firm-to-firm relationships, and disruptions to them can have large and long-lasting effects. Using U.S. Census data, this paper shows that as importers and their suppliers transact repeatedly, traded quantities and survival probabilities rise. We develop a general equilibrium trade model with relationship dynamics that is consistent with these facts. The quantification implies that long-term relationships are substantially more valuable to firms than new relationships, with wide variation across source countries. Losing relationship capital is costly for an economy, with disruptions to relationships causing notably lower levels of consumption and trade in the short- to medium term.
records.abstract_cn: 美国超过80%的进口发生在既有的企业间关系中，而对这些关系的干扰可能产生巨大且持久的影响。利用美国人口普查数据，本文表明，随着进口商及其供应商反复交易，交易数量和生存概率会上升。我们建立了一个具有关系动态的一般均衡贸易模型，与这些事实一致。量化结果表明，长期关系对企业而言比新关系更有价值，且在不同来源国之间存在显著差异。失去关系资本对一个经济体来说代价高昂，对关系的干扰会在短期至中期内导致消费和贸易水平显著下降。

records.title_en: Reallocation and productivity in resource-rich economies
records.title_cn: 资源丰富经济体中的重新配置与生产率
records.abstract_en: I study the firm-level dynamic response of a commodity-exporting economy to global cycles in commodity prices. I propose a heterogeneous-firms model endogenizing manufacturing productivity slowdowns through reallocation towards less productive firms. Within a given sector, commodity booms reallocate market share away from exporters because of exchange rate appreciation and away from capital-intensive firms because of the increase in the required rate of return to capital. Using microdata for Chile, the largest copper producer worldwide, I provide empirical evidence for these channels. When fed with the commodity super-cycle of 2004–2012, the calibrated model generates between 13% to 32% of the observed productivity slowdown.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了商品出口经济体对企业层面动态响应全球商品价格周期的情况。我提出了一个异质性企业模型，通过向生产率较低的企业重新配置，内生化了制造业生产率的放缓。在给定部门内，商品繁荣因汇率升值而将市场份额从出口商手中重新分配，并因资本所需回报率上升而将市场份额从资本密集型企业手中重新分配。利用智利（全球最大的铜生产国）的微观数据，我为这些渠道提供了经验证据。当以2004-2012年的商品超级周期作为输入时，校准模型产生了观察到的生产率放缓的13%至32%。

records.title_en: GVCs and trade elasticities with multistage production
records.title_cn: 全球价值链与多阶段生产中的贸易弹性
records.abstract_en: We build a quantitative model of trade with multistage manufacturing value chains, which features many countries, iceberg trade costs, and technology differences across both goods and production stages. We estimate technology and trade costs via the simulated method of moments, matching bilateral shipments of final goods and inputs. Applying the model, we investigate how comparative advantage and trade costs shape the structure of global value chains and trade flows. As the level of trade costs falls, we show that the gravity elasticity of bilateral trade to trade costs increases, due to the endogenous reorganization of value chains and increased export platform production. Surprisingly, however, the resulting increase in world trade (as a share of GDP) is not magnified by multistage production, relative to a benchmark Ricardian model with roundabout production.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含多阶段制造业价值链的贸易定量模型，该模型具有多国、冰山贸易成本以及商品和生产阶段之间的技术差异。我们通过模拟矩方法估计技术和贸易成本，匹配最终产品和投入品的双边运输。应用该模型，我们研究了比较优势和贸易成本如何塑造全球价值链的结构和贸易流动。随着贸易成本水平的下降，我们表明双边贸易对贸易成本的引力弹性会增加，这是由于价值链的内生重组和出口平台生产的增加。然而，令人惊讶的是，相对于具有循环生产的基准李嘉图模型，由此产生的世界贸易（占GDP的比重）增长并未因多阶段生产而放大。

records.title_en: International trade and job polarization: Evidence at the worker level
records.title_cn: 国际贸易与就业极化：基于工人层面的证据
records.abstract_en: We employ employer-employee matched data from Denmark and utilize plausibly exogenous variation in the rise of import competition due to the dismantling of import quotas as China entered the World Trade Organization to show, first, that rising import competition has led to reduced employment in mid-wage occupations compensated by an increased likelihood of employment in both low-wage and high-wage occupations. Workers with higher education are more likely to move from mid- to high-wage occupations due to trade compared to moving from mid- to low-wage occupations. Employing task content information of detailed occupations, we also show that workers performing manual tasks are the ones most affected by import competition independently of the routine-task intensity of occupations. This implies that the effect of import competition is distinct from that of routine task-replacing technological change.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用丹麦的雇主-雇员匹配数据，并利用中国加入世界贸易组织时进口配额取消所导致的进口竞争加剧的似外生变化，首先表明，进口竞争的加剧导致中等工资职业的就业减少，而低工资和高工资职业的就业可能性增加。受教育程度较高的工人更可能因贸易而从中等工资职业转向高工资职业，而非转向低工资职业。利用详细职业的任务内容信息，我们还表明，从事体力任务的工人受进口竞争影响最大，这与职业的常规任务强度无关。这意味着进口竞争的影响不同于常规任务替代型技术变革的影响。

records.title_en: The global minimum tax raises more revenues than you think, or much less
records.title_cn: 全球最低税带来的收入比你想象的多，或少得多
records.abstract_en: The OECD’s global minimum tax (GMT) of 15% on what is deemed excess profit of multinationals aims to reduce profit shifting to low-tax jurisdictions. . We study the revenue effects of the GMT by focusing on strategic tax setting effects. The direct effect from less profit shifting increases revenues in high-tax countries. A secondary effect, however, is that the value of attracting foreign investments increases, which intensifies tax competition. We show that when governments compete via lump sum subsidies, the revenue gains from less profit shifting are exactly offset by higher subsidies. When competition is by tax rates, revenues may increase, however.
records.abstract_cn: OECD对跨国公司视为超额利润征收的15%全球最低税（GMT）旨在减少向低税辖区的利润转移。我们通过关注战略性税收设定效应来研究GMT的收入效应。减少利润转移的直接效应增加了高税国家的收入。然而，次要效应是吸引外国投资的价值增加，这加剧了税收竞争。我们表明，当政府通过一次性补贴进行竞争时，减少利润转移带来的收入收益恰好被更高的补贴所抵消。然而，当竞争通过税率进行时，收入可能会增加。

records.title_en: Soil zinc deficiency and child stunting: Evidence from Nepal
records.title_cn: 土壤锌缺乏与儿童发育迟缓：来自尼泊尔的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the negative child health impacts of soil zinc (Zn) deficiency in Nepal. Soil Zn deficiency limits both crop yields and the Zn concentration in food crops, leading many to speculate that it underlies human Zn deficiency and child stunting, globally and particularly in South Asia. We find strong evidence that soil Zn deficiency does have a causal impact on child stunting in Nepal’s Tarai region, the breadbasket of the country. Using causal bounds, we find that a 1 part per million increase in plant-available soil Zn – achievable with application of Zn-enriched fertilizer – decreases child stunting by between 1 and 7.5 percentage points. Multiple statistical sensitivity tests indicate that this relationship is unlikely to be manufactured by omitted, relevant variables.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了尼泊尔土壤锌（Zn）缺乏对儿童健康的不利影响。土壤锌缺乏既限制了作物产量，也降低了粮食作物中的锌浓度，导致许多人推测它是全球尤其是南亚人类锌缺乏和儿童发育迟缓的根本原因。我们发现强有力的证据表明，土壤锌缺乏确实对尼泊尔塔莱地区（该国的粮仓）的儿童发育迟缓产生因果影响。利用因果界限，我们发现植物可利用土壤锌每增加1百万分之一（通过施用富锌肥料可实现），儿童发育迟缓率下降1至7.5个百分点。多项统计敏感性检验表明，这种关系不太可能由遗漏的相关变量人为造成。

records.title_en: A drop of love? Rainfall shocks and spousal abuse: Evidence from rural Peru
records.title_cn: 一滴爱？降雨冲击与配偶虐待：来自秘鲁农村的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether exposure to rainfall shocks affects the experience of physical intimate partner violence (P-IPV) among women in rural areas of the Peruvian Andes. Using data from the Demographic and Health Surveys over 2005–2014, we track changes in the probability that a woman experiences recent instances of P-IPV after being exposed to a rainfall shock during the last cropping season. Our results indicate that the probability that a woman experiences P-IPV increases by 8.5 percentage points (65 percent) after exposure to a dry, but not a wet, shock during the cropping season. We identify two complementary causal pathways of this effect: increased economic insecurity and poverty-related stress that deteriorates men’s emotional well-being and mental health, and reduced female empowerment that affects women’s ability to negotiate their preferences within the relationship.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了降雨冲击的暴露是否影响秘鲁安第斯农村地区女性遭受身体亲密伴侣暴力（P-IPV）的经历。利用2005-2014年人口与健康调查数据，我们追踪了在最近一个种植季节暴露于降雨冲击后，女性经历近期P-IPV概率的变化。我们的结果表明，在种植季节暴露于干旱（而非洪涝）冲击后，女性经历P-IPV的概率增加了8.5个百分点（65%）。我们识别了该效应的两条互补因果路径：经济不安全感增加和与贫困相关的压力导致男性情绪健康和心理健康的恶化，以及女性赋权减少影响其在关系中协商自身偏好的能力。

records.title_en: Effects of organized screening programs on breast cancer screening, incidence, and mortality in Europe
records.title_cn: 组织性筛查项目对欧洲乳腺癌筛查、发病率及死亡率的影响
records.abstract_en: We link data on regional Organized Screening Programs (OSPs) throughout Europe with survey data and population-based cancer registries to estimate effects of OSPs on breast cancer screening (mammography), incidence, and mortality. Identification is from regional variation in the existence and timing of OSPs, and in their age-eligibility criteria. We estimate that OSPs, on average, increase mammography by 25 percentage points, increase breast cancer incidence by 16% five years after the OSPs implementation, and reduce breast cancer mortality by about 10% ten years after.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将欧洲各地区组织性筛查项目（OSPs）的数据与调查数据和基于人群的癌症登记数据相链接，以估计OSPs对乳腺癌筛查（乳腺X线摄影）、发病率和死亡率的影响。识别来源于各地区在OSPs的存在性、实施时间及其年龄资格标准方面的差异。我们估计，OSPs平均使乳腺X线摄影增加25个百分点，在OSPs实施五年后使乳腺癌发病率增加16%，并在十年后使乳腺癌死亡率降低约10%。

records.title_en: Competitive effects of federal and state opioid restrictions: Evidence from the controlled substance laws
records.title_cn: 联邦和州阿片类药物限制的竞争效应：来自受控物质法的证据
records.abstract_en: A significant concern in the policy landscape of the U.S. opioid crisis is whether supply-side controls can reduce opioid prescribing without harmful substitution. We consider an unstudied policy: the federal Controlled Substance Act (CSA) restrictions placed in August 2014 on tramadol, the second most popular opioid medication.
