Borrowing affects employment through a ‘debt bargaining channel’: higher debt improves the bargaining position of employers with workers and increases the incentive to hire. We estimate the model structurally and find that the debt bargaining channel accounts for 26 percent of unemployment fluctuations. We find empirical support for the channel at the micro level using firm level data from Compustat.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有匹配摩擦且企业在有限执行下借贷的模型中，研究金融市场对（非）就业波动的重要性。借贷通过“债务谈判渠道”影响就业：更高的债务改善了雇主与工人谈判中的地位，并增加了雇佣激励。我们对模型进行了结构化估计，发现债务谈判渠道解释了失业波动的26%。我们使用来自Compustat的企业层面数据，在微观层面找到了该渠道的经验支持。

records.title_en: The fundamental-to-market ratio and the value premium decline
records.title_cn: 基本面市值比与价值溢价的下降
records.abstract_en: Recent evidence indicates the value premium declined over time. We argue this decline happened because book equity, BE, is no longer a good proxy for fundamental equity, FE, defined as the present value of cash flows under a common discount rate across firms. Specifically, we estimate FE for public US firms over time and find that the premium associated with the fundamental-to-market ratio, FE/ME, subsumes the BE/ME premium and has been relatively stable while the cross-sectional correlation between FE/ME and BE/ME decreased over time, inducing an apparent decline in the value premium. We also show that FE/ME captures the value premium better than several alternative value signals beyond BE/ME.
records.abstract_cn: 近期证据表明价值溢价随时间下降。我们认为这一下降的发生是因为账面权益（BE）不再是基本面权益（FE）的良好代理变量，其中FE定义为在跨公司共同贴现率下的现金流现值。具体而言，我们估计了美国上市公司随时间变化的FE，并发现与基本面市值比（FE/ME）相关的溢价涵盖了BE/ME溢价，且相对稳定，而FE/ME与BE/ME之间的横截面相关性随时间下降，导致价值溢价出现表面上的下降。我们还表明，FE/ME比BE/ME之外的几种替代价值信号更好地捕捉了价值溢价。

records.title_en: Dynamics of subjective risk premia
records.title_cn: 主观风险溢价动态
records.abstract_en: We examine subjective risk premia implied by return expectations of individual investors and professionals for portfolios of stocks, bonds, currencies, and commodity futures. While in-sample predictive regressions with realized excess returns suggest that objective risk premia vary countercyclically with business-cycle and asset-valuation measures, subjective risk premia extracted from survey data are largely acyclical. Out-of-sample forecasts of excess returns exhibit a similar lack of cyclicality, which suggests that investors’ learning of forecasting relationships in real time may help explain the cyclicality gap. There is a subjective risk-return tradeoff, with subjective risk premia increasing in subjective perceptions of risk quantity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了个人投资者和专业人士对股票、债券、货币和商品期货组合的收益预期所隐含的主观风险溢价。虽然使用已实现超额收益的样本内预测回归表明，客观风险溢价随商业周期和资产估值指标呈逆周期变化，但从调查数据中提取的主观风险溢价在很大程度上是非周期性的。超额收益的样本外预测表现出类似的缺乏周期性，这表明投资者实时学习预测关系可能有助于解释周期性差距。存在主观风险-收益权衡，主观风险溢价随主观风险数量感知的增加而增加。

records.title_en: Market power in wholesale funding: A structural perspective from the triparty repo market
records.title_cn: 批发融资中的市场势力：来自三方回购市场的结构视角
records.abstract_en: I model and structurally estimate the equilibrium rates and volume in the Triparty repo market to study imperfect competition in wholesale funding. Even in this systemically important market, where seemingly homogeneous repos trade, I document persistent rate differences paid by dealers. I characterize the Triparty market as cash-lenders allocating their portfolios among differentiated dealers who set repo rates. I find that cash-lenders’ aversion to portfolio concentration and preference for stable lending grant dealers substantial market power: between 2011 and 2017, dealers borrowed at rates that were 26 bps lower than their marginal value from intermediating the borrowed repo funds. Dealers’ market power makes the observed wholesale repo rate understate the financing rate available to market participants who rely on repo funding, and offers a novel explanation for funding spreads such as the Treasury cash-futures basis and the Treasury swap spread.
records.abstract_cn: 我建立模型并对三方回购市场的均衡利率和交易量进行结构估计，以研究批发融资中的不完全竞争。即使在这个具有系统重要性的市场中，看似同质的回购交易，我也记录了交易商支付的持续利率差异。我将三方市场描述为现金贷方在设定回购利率的差异化交易商之间配置其投资组合。我发现现金贷方对投资组合集中的厌恶和对稳定贷款的偏好赋予了交易商显著的市场势力：在2011年至2017年间，交易商以比其中介借入回购资金边际价值低26个基点的利率借款。交易商的市场势力使得观察到的批发回购利率低估了依赖回购融资的市场参与者可获得的融资利率，并为资金利差（如国债现金期货基差和国债互换利差）提供了新的解释。

records.title_en: A credit-based theory of the currency risk premium
records.title_cn: 基于信用的货币风险溢价理论
records.abstract_en: This paper uncovers a novel component for exchange rate predictability based on the price difference between sovereign credit default swaps denominated in different currencies. This new forecasting variable – the credit-implied risk premium – captures the expected currency depreciation conditional on a severe but rare credit event. Using data for 16 Eurozone countries, we find that the credit-implied risk premium positively forecasts the dollar-euro exchange rate return at various horizons. Moreover, a currency strategy that exploits the informative content of our predictor generates substantial out-of-sample economic value against the naïve random walk benchmark.
records.abstract_cn: 本文基于不同货币计价的主权信用违约互换价格差异，揭示了汇率可预测性的一个新组成部分。这一新的预测变量——信用隐含风险溢价——捕捉了在严重但罕见的信用事件条件下预期的货币贬值。利用16个欧元区国家的数据，我们发现信用隐含风险溢价在不同时间跨度上正向预测美元兑欧元汇率回报。此外，利用我们预测变量信息内容的货币策略，相对于朴素随机游走基准，产生了显著的样本外经济价值。

records.title_en: The short- and long-run effects of remote work on U.S. housing markets
records.title_cn: 远程工作对美国住房市场的短期和长期影响
records.abstract_en: Remote work has increased the demand for housing and changed the demand for the location of that housing. Because housing supply is heterogeneous across space and more elastic in the long-run, the effects on rents and populations may differ over time. We use the lens of a spatial housing model with heterogeneous housing supply elasticities to identify the housing and location demand changes from 2020–2022, and show that the same shocks will have different effects in the long run. Even though rents and prices increased significantly in the short-run, we estimate that in the long-run, increased housing demand will increase rents by only 1.8 percentage points, and that changing location demand will decrease rents by 0.3 percentage points, with a more negative impact on cities in which CPI is measured and cities that were initially expensive.
records.abstract_cn: 远程工作增加了对住房的需求，并改变了住房位置的需求。由于住房供应在空间上存在异质性，且在长期更具弹性，其对租金和人口的影响可能随时间而不同。我们利用一个具有异质性住房供应弹性的空间住房模型来识别2020-2022年的住房和位置需求变化，并表明同样的冲击在长期将产生不同的影响。尽管短期内租金和价格显著上涨，我们估计在长期，住房需求的增加将使租金仅上涨1.8个百分点，而位置需求的变化将使租金下降0.3个百分点，对CPI测量所在的城市和最初昂贵的城市产生更大的负面影响。

records.title_en: Treasury option returns and models with unspanned risks
records.title_cn: 国债期权收益与含未跨度风险模型
records.abstract_en: We document the phenomenon that average excess returns of out-of-the-money puts and calls on bond futures are negative, both unconditionally and conditionally on economic states. To explain these findings, we develop economically motivated restrictions in the context of a theory in which the pricing kernel is a general diffusion process with spanned and unspanned components. Our reconciliation is a framework that introduces market incompleteness and priced unspanned volatility risks, allowing for time-varying downside and upside futures risk premiums. The estimated model shows consistency with data on bond yields, yield volatilities, bond futures return volatilities, option prices, and option risk premiums.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了债券期货价外看跌期权和看涨期权的平均超额收益为负的现象，无论是在无条件情况下还是在经济状态条件下均如此。为解释这些发现，我们在定价核为具有跨度和非跨度成分的一般扩散过程的理论背景下，提出了经济动机驱动的限制条件。我们的调和框架引入了市场不完全性和已定价的非跨度波动率风险，允许时变的下行和上行期货风险溢价。估计模型与债券收益率、收益率波动率、债券期货收益波动率、期权价格和期权风险溢价的数据保持一致。

records.title_en: Collateral quality and intervention traps
records.title_cn: 抵押品质量与干预陷阱
records.abstract_en: What determines the supply of good collateral? We study a dynamic model in which borrowers must exert effort to maintain collateral quality and markets become illiquid when average quality is too low. Average quality grows quickly when it is high initially, but deteriorates or grows slowly otherwise. As such, even long-run market conditions are sensitive to a wide array of fundamental and non-fundamental shocks. Recoveries from illiquidity can occur, but only if funding is inefficiently rationed for some time. Policymakers without commitment may fall into intervention traps in which ex-post efficient liquidity injections cause permanent declines in collateral quality.
records.abstract_cn: 什么决定了优质抵押品的供给？我们研究了一个动态模型，在该模型中，借款人必须付出努力以维持抵押品质量，而当平均质量过低时，市场会变得缺乏流动性。平均质量在初始较高时增长迅速，否则会恶化或增长缓慢。因此，即使是长期市场状况也对广泛的根本性和非根本性冲击敏感。从流动性不足中复苏可能发生，但前提是资金在某种程度上被低效配给一段时间。没有承诺能力的政策制定者可能会陷入干预陷阱，其中事后有效的流动性注入会导致抵押品质量的永久性下降。

records.title_en: The negativity bias and perceived return distributions: Evidence from a pandemic
records.title_cn: 负面偏见与感知收益分布：来自一场流行病的证据
records.abstract_en: We hypothesize that the well-documented negativity bias, the psychological tendency to asymmetrically emphasize negative over positive aspects, can help explain several financial market phenomena: why most individuals hold strongly bearish views of both short- and long-term equity return distributions, why individuals exhibit heterogeneous beliefs, and the stock market participation puzzle. Using variation in the perceived risk of mortality from the swine flu pandemic as our primary proxy for an individual's negativity bias, we find strong support for our hypothesis even when controlling for alternative mechanisms including optimism, risk aversion, ambiguity aversion, and anxiety.
records.abstract_cn: 我们假设，有充分文献记载的负面偏见，即心理上不对称地强调负面而非正面方面的倾向，有助于解释几个金融市场现象：为什么大多数人对短期和长期股票收益分布都持有强烈的看跌观点，为什么个体表现出异质性信念，以及股市参与之谜。使用猪流感大流行期间感知死亡风险的变异作为个体负面偏见的主要代理变量，我们发现，即使控制了包括乐观主义、风险厌恶、模糊厌恶和焦虑在内的替代机制，我们的假设也得到了强有力的支持。

records.title_en: Dynamic asset (mis)pricing: Build-up versus resolution anomalies
records.title_cn: 动态资产（错误）定价：累积异常与消解异常
records.abstract_en: We classify asset pricing anomalies into those exacerbating mispricing (build-up anomalies) and those resolving it (resolution anomalies). We estimate the dynamics of price wedges for well-known anomaly portfolios and map them to firm-level mispricings. We find that several prominent anomalies like momentum and profitability further dislocate prices. Multi-factor models designed to eliminate one-month alphas still produce large price wedges. Our estimates yield a novel decomposition of Tobin’s q, revealing that q’s mispricing component has substantial explanatory power for firm investment. Overall, our results suggest that financial intermediaries chasing build-up anomalies negatively affect price efficiency and associated real capital allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将资产定价异常分为加剧错误定价的异常（累积异常）和消解错误定价的异常（消解异常）。我们估计了知名异常投资组合的价格楔子动态，并将其映射到公司层面的错误定价。我们发现，几个显著的异常，如动量异常和盈利能力异常，进一步扭曲了价格。旨在消除一个月阿尔法的多因子模型仍然会产生较大的价格楔子。我们的估计得出了托宾q的一种新颖分解，揭示出q的错误定价成分对公司投资具有显著的解释力。总体而言，我们的结果表明，追逐累积异常的金融中介对价格效率及相关实际资本配置产生负面影响。

records.title_en: Do the rich gamble in the stock market? Low risk anomalies and wealthy households
records.title_cn: 富人在股市中赌博吗？低风险异象与富裕家庭
records.abstract_en: Contrary to the theoretical principle that higher risk is compensated with higher expected return, the literature shows that low-risk stocks outperform high-risk stocks. Using a large-scale household dataset, we provide an explanation for this puzzling result that the anomalous negative risk-return relation is only confined to those stocks predominantly held by rich households, whereas the anomaly disappears for stocks held by non-rich households and institutional investors. We find that social status concern of rich households and the induced lottery preference explain wealthy investors’ demand for high-risk stocks, leading to overpricing and low future returns for such stocks.
records.abstract_cn: 与高风险获得高预期回报的理论原则相反，文献表明低风险股票的表现优于高风险股票。利用大规模家庭数据集，我们为这一令人费解的结果提供了一种解释，即异常的负风险-收益关系仅限于那些主要由富裕家庭持有的股票，而对于非富裕家庭和机构投资者持有的股票，这种异象则消失。我们发现，富裕家庭的社会地位关注及其引发的彩票偏好解释了富裕投资者对高风险股票的需求，导致此类股票定价过高且未来回报较低。

records.title_en: Loan guarantees, bank underwriting policies and financial stability
records.title_cn: 贷款担保、银行承销政策与金融稳定
records.abstract_en: Loan guarantees represent a form of government intervention to support bank lending. However, their use raises concerns as to their effect on bank risk-taking incentives. In a model of financial fragility that incorporates bank capital and a bank incentive problem, we show that loan guarantees reduce depositor runs and improve bank underwriting standards, except for the most poorly capitalized banks. We highlight a novel feedback effect between banks’ underwriting choices and depositors’ run decisions, and show that the effect of loan guarantees on banks’ incentives is different from that of other types of guarantees, such as deposit insurance.
records.abstract_cn: 贷款担保是政府支持银行贷款的一种干预形式。然而，其使用引发了对其影响银行风险承担激励的担忧。在一个包含银行资本和银行激励问题的金融脆弱性模型中，我们表明，贷款担保减少了存款人挤兑并改善了银行的承销标准，但资本状况最差的银行除外。我们强调了银行承销选择与存款人挤兑决策之间的一种新颖反馈效应，并表明贷款担保对银行激励的影响不同于其他类型的担保，如存款保险。

records.title_en: Debt dynamics and credit risk
records.title_cn: 债务动态与信用风险
records.abstract_en: We investigate how the dynamics of corporate debt policy affect the pricing of corporate bonds. We find empirically that debt issuance has a significant stochastic component that is imperfectly correlated with shocks to asset value. As a consequence, the volatility of leverage is significantly higher than asset volatility over short horizons. At long horizons, the relation between leverage and asset volatility is reversed due to mean reversion in leverage. We incorporate these stochastic debt dynamics into structural models of credit risk, both standard diffusion models as well as newer models with stochastic volatility and jumps. Including stochastic debt gives more accurate predictions of credit spreads in both the cross-section and the time series.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了公司债务政策的动态如何影响公司债券的定价。我们实证发现，债务发行具有显著的随机成分，该成分与资产价值的冲击并非完全相关。因此，在短期内，杠杆的波动性显著高于资产波动性。在长期内，由于杠杆的均值回归，杠杆与资产波动性的关系发生逆转。我们将这些随机债务动态纳入信用风险的结构模型中，包括标准扩散模型以及具有随机波动率和跳跃的新模型。纳入随机债务在横截面和时间序列上都能更准确地预测信用利差。

records.title_en: Machine learning and fund characteristics help to select mutual funds with positive alpha
records.title_cn: 机器学习与基金特征有助于选择具有正阿尔法的共同基金
records.abstract_en: Machine-learning methods exploit fund characteristics to select tradable long-only portfolios of mutual funds that earn significant out-of-sample annual alphas of 2.4% net of all costs. The methods unveil interactions in the relation between fund characteristics and future performance. For instance, past performance is a particularly strong predictor of future performance for more active funds. Machine learning identifies managers whose skill is not sufficiently offset by diseconomies of scale, consistent with informational frictions preventing investors from identifying the outperforming funds. Our findings demonstrate that investors can benefit from active management, but only if they have access to sophisticated prediction methods.
records.abstract_cn: 机器学习方法利用基金特征来选择可交易的仅做多的共同基金投资组合，这些组合在扣除所有成本后获得了显著的样本外年度阿尔法，平均为2.4%。这些方法揭示了基金特征与未来表现之间关系中的交互作用。例如，对于更活跃的基金，过去的表现是未来表现的一个特别强的预测因子。机器学习识别出那些管理者的技能未被规模不经济充分抵消的基金，这与信息摩擦阻止投资者识别出表现优异的基金相一致。我们的研究结果表明，投资者可以从主动管理中受益，但前提是他们能够使用复杂的预测方法。

records.title_en: Sovereign risk premia and global macroeconomic conditions
records.title_cn: 主权风险溢价与全球宏观经济状况
records.abstract_en: We study how shifting global macroeconomic conditions affect sovereign bond prices. Bondholders earn premia for two sources of systematic risk: exposure to low-frequency changes in the state of the economy, as captured by expected macroeconomic growth and volatility, and exposure to higher-frequency macroeconomic shocks. Our model predicts that the first source, labeled long-run macro risk, is the primary driver of the level and the cross-sectional variation in sovereign bond premia. We find support for this prediction using sovereign bond return data for 43 countries over the 1994–2018 period. A long-short portfolio based on long-run macro risk earns 8.11% per year in our sample.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究全球宏观经济状况的变化如何影响主权债券价格。债券持有人因两种系统性风险来源而获得溢价：对经济状态低频变化的暴露（以预期宏观经济增长和波动性衡量），以及对高频宏观经济冲击的暴露。我们的模型预测，第一种来源，即所谓的长期宏观风险，是主权债券溢价水平及其横截面变化的主要驱动因素。我们使用43个国家在1994-2018年期间的主权债券回报数据，为这一预测提供了支持。在我们的样本中，基于长期宏观风险的多空组合每年可获得8.11%的收益。

records.title_en: Supporting small firms through recessions and recoveries
records.title_cn: 支持小企业度过衰退与复苏
records.abstract_en: We use variation in the access to a government credit certification program to estimate the financial and real effects of supporting small firms. This program was first implemented during the global financial crisis, but has remained active ever since, allowing us to analyze its effects both during recessions and recoveries. Eligible firms have access to government loan guarantees and a credit quality certification. We estimate real effects using a multidimensional regression discontinuity design. We find that eligible firms borrow more and at lower rates than non-eligible firms, allowing them to increase investment and employment during crises. Industry-level analysis shows reduced productivity heterogeneity in more exposed industries, which is consistent with improved credit allocation. However, when the economy is recovering the effects of the program are less pronounced and centered on the certification component. The cost-per-job in the recovery period is half of the one estimated for the crisis period (5784€ and 11,788€, respectively).
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用政府信贷认证项目获取渠道的差异来估计支持小企业的金融和实际效应。该项目在全球金融危机期间首次实施，但此后一直保持活跃，使我们能够分析其在衰退和复苏期间的影响。符合条件的企业可以获得政府贷款担保和信用质量认证。我们使用多维断点回归设计来估计实际效应。我们发现，符合条件的企业比不符合条件的企业借款更多且利率更低，使它们能够在危机期间增加投资和就业。行业层面的分析显示，在受影响较大的行业中，生产率异质性降低，这与信贷配置改善一致。然而，当经济复苏时，该项目的效应不太明显，且集中在认证部分。复苏期的每岗位成本是危机期估计值的一半（分别为5784欧元和11,788欧元）。

records.title_en: Pirates without borders: The propagation of cyberattacks through firms’ supply chains
records.title_cn: 无国界的海盗：网络攻击通过企业供应链的传播
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the supply chain effects of the most damaging cyberattack in history so far. The attack propagated from the directly hit firms to their customers, causing a four-fold amplification of the initial drop in profits. These losses were larger for affected customers with fewer alternative suppliers. Internal liquidity buffers and increased borrowing, mainly through bank credit lines, helped firms navigate the shock. Nonetheless, the cyberattack led to persistent adjustments to the supply chain network, with affected customers terminating trading relations with directly hit firms and forming new ones with alternative suppliers with a stronger cybersecurity posture.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了迄今为止历史上最具破坏性的网络攻击的供应链效应。攻击从直接受害企业传播至其客户，导致初始利润下降的四倍放大。对于替代供应商较少的受影响客户，这些损失更大。内部流动性缓冲和增加借款（主要通过银行信贷额度）帮助企业应对冲击。尽管如此，网络攻击导致了供应链网络的持续调整，受影响客户终止与直接受害企业的贸易关系，并与具有更强网络安全态势的替代供应商建立新关系。

records.title_en: Cross-stock momentum and factor momentum
records.title_cn: 跨股票动量与因子动量
records.abstract_en: Cross-stock momentum builds on the asymmetry in lead-lag linkages and the difference between long-run and short-run contemporaneous co-movements. Data-driven cross-stock linkages generate a monthly alpha of 1.62% (t-stat=10.03). The asymmetry distinguishes cross-stock momentum from factor momentum, and industry momentum is not subsumed by factor momentum. Factor momentum profit is mostly due to the high cross-stock links. The data-driven linkages vary faster over time than those in previous studies because short-run co-movements incorporate persistent linkages.
records.abstract_cn: 跨股票动量建立在领先-滞后联系的不对称性以及长期与短期同期共同运动之间的差异之上。数据驱动的跨股票联系产生月度阿尔法收益为1.62%（t统计量=10.03）。这种不对称性将跨股票动量与因子动量区分开来，且行业动量并未被因子动量所包含。因子动量的利润主要归因于高跨股票联系。数据驱动的联系随时间变化的速度比以往研究中的更快，因为短期共同运动包含了持续的联系。

records.title_en: Firm-bank linkages and optimal policies after a rare disaster
records.title_cn: 企业-银行关联与罕见灾害后的最优政策
records.abstract_en: We study optimal government support following a rare disaster that creates heterogeneous firm liquidity needs. Firms’ increase in debt reduces their output due to moral hazard. Banks are subject to a minimum capital requirement that limits deposit insurance costs upon bad aggregate shocks. Without government support, firms’ moral hazard and banks’ funding frictions reinforce each other amplifying output losses. Optimal support is implemented with firm-specific transfers combined with the provision of aggregate risk insurance through a capital requirement relaxation and a public preferred equity stake in banks. Our results shed light on suboptimality features in the actual policy responses to Covid-19 lockdowns.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在造成企业流动性需求异质性的罕见灾害后，最优政府支持。企业债务增加会因道德风险而降低其产出。银行受到最低资本要求的约束，该要求限制了在不利总体冲击下存款保险的成本。在没有政府支持的情况下，企业的道德风险与银行的融资摩擦相互强化，放大了产出损失。最优支持通过企业特定转移支付，并结合通过放宽资本要求和银行中的公共优先股权益提供的总体风险保险来实施。我们的结果揭示了实际政策应对Covid-19封锁中的次优特征。

records.title_en: Collateral competition: Evidence from central counterparties
records.title_cn: 抵押品竞争：来自中央对手方的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyze competition and risk management at central counterparties (CCPs) using a granular transaction-level dataset, and find that CCPs decrease collateral in response to lower collateral at their competitors, an effect that becomes stronger as the correlation between positions increases. To interpret our findings, we derive a model in which collateral is driven by risk and CCP competition. Our results are consistent with the model and suggest that a single monopolistic CCP would require more collateral. We also show that amid the substantial increase in collateral during the Covid-19 pandemic, the probability of a margin breach did not significantly change.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个细粒度的交易级数据集分析中央对手方（CCPs）的竞争和风险管理，发现CCPs会因竞争对手的抵押品降低而减少自身抵押品，且当头寸之间的相关性增加时，这一效应会更强。为了解释我们的发现，我们构建了一个模型，其中抵押品由风险和CCP竞争驱动。我们的结果与模型一致，并表明一个垄断性的CCP将需要更多的抵押品。我们还表明，在Covid-19大流行期间抵押品大幅增加的情况下，保证金违约的概率并未显著变化。

records.title_en: Institutional investors, the dollar, and U.S. credit conditions
records.title_cn: 机构投资者、美元与美国信贷状况
records.abstract_en: A strong dollar has been associated with lower lending to emerging markets and tighter global financial conditions. This paper documents similar patterns for credit in the U.S. economy: when the U.S. broad dollar index appreciates by 1 percent, U.S. banks’ corporate loan originations fall by 4.5 percent, with banks tightening credit standards and lending to safer borrowers. This negative correlation, which we term the U.S. dollar credit channel, is at least in part driven by institutional investors, who reduce their demand for risky loans on the secondary loan market when the dollar appreciates. As it becomes harder to sell loans to these investors, banks lend less.
records.abstract_cn: 美元走强与对新兴市场的贷款减少以及全球金融状况收紧有关。本文记录了美国经济中信贷的类似模式：当美元广义指数升值1%时，美国银行的企业贷款发放下降4.5%，银行收紧信贷标准并向更安全的借款人放贷。这种负相关关系，我们称之为美元信贷渠道，至少部分是由机构投资者驱动的，当美元升值时，他们会减少在二级贷款市场上对风险贷款的需求。随着向这些投资者出售贷款变得更加困难，银行的贷款减少。

records.title_en: Open banking: Credit market competition when borrowers own the data
records.title_cn: 开放银行：借款人拥有数据时的信贷市场竞争
records.abstract_en: Open banking facilitates data sharing consented to by customers who generate the data, with the regulatory goal of promoting competition between traditional banks and challenger fintech entrants. We study lending market competition when sharing banks’ customer transaction data enables better borrower screening for fintechs. Open banking promotes competition if it helps level the playing field for all lenders in screening borrowers; however, if it over-empowers fintechs, it can also hinder competition and leave all borrowers worse off. Due to the credit quality inference from borrowers’ sign-up decisions, this remains true even if borrowers have the control of whether to share their banking data. We also study extensions with fintech affinities and data sharing on borrower preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 开放银行促进了由生成数据的客户同意进行的数据共享，其监管目标是促进传统银行与挑战者金融科技新进入者之间的竞争。我们研究了当共享银行的客户交易数据使金融科技公司能够更好地筛选借款人时，贷款市场的竞争情况。如果开放银行有助于为所有贷款人在筛选借款人方面提供公平的竞争环境，则促进竞争；然而，如果它过度赋权金融科技公司，也可能阻碍竞争并使所有借款人状况恶化。由于从借款人的注册决策中推断信用质量，即使借款人控制是否共享其银行数据，这一结论仍然成立。我们还研究了金融科技亲和力和借款人偏好数据共享的扩展情况。

records.title_en: The labor effects of judicial bias in bankruptcy
records.title_cn: 破产司法偏见的劳动力效应
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of judicial bias favoring firm continuation in bankruptcy on the labor market outcomes of employees by exploiting the random assignment of cases across courts in the State of São Paulo in Brazil. Employees of firms assigned to courts that favor firm continuation are more likely to stay with their employer, but they earn, on average, lower wages three to five years after bankruptcy. We discuss several potential mechanisms that can rationalize this result, and provide evidence that imperfect information about outside options in the local labor market and adjustment costs associated with job change play an important role.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用巴西圣保罗州法院案件随机分配的情况，研究了破产中偏向企业存续的司法偏见对员工劳动力市场结果的影响。被分配到偏向企业存续的法院的企业员工更有可能留在雇主处，但他们在破产后三到五年内平均工资较低。我们讨论了可以合理解释这一结果的几种潜在机制，并提供了证据表明，关于当地劳动力市场外部机会的不完全信息以及与工作变动相关的调整成本发挥了重要作用。

records.title_en: The Big Three and board gender diversity: The effectiveness of shareholder voice
records.title_cn: 三大机构投资者与董事会性别多样性：股东发声的有效性
records.abstract_en: In 2017, “The Big Three” institutional investors launched campaigns to increase gender diversity on corporate boards. We estimate that their campaigns led American corporations to add at least 2.5 times as many female directors in 2019 as they had in 2016. Firms increased diversity by identifying candidates beyond managers’ existing networks and by placing less emphasis on candidates’ executive experience. Firms also promoted more female directors to key board positions, indicating firms’ responses went beyond tokenism. Our results highlight index investors’ ability to effectuate broad-based governance changes and the impact of investor buy-in in increasing corporate-leadership diversity.
records.abstract_cn: 在2017年，“三大”机构投资者发起了提高公司董事会性别多样性的运动。我们估计，他们的运动使得美国公司在2019年新增的女性董事数量至少是2016年的2.5倍。公司通过识别经理人现有网络之外的候选人，并减少对候选人高管经验的重视，从而增加了多样性。公司还将更多女性董事提升至关键董事会职位，表明公司的回应超越了象征性。我们的结果凸显了指数投资者实施广泛治理变革的能力，以及投资者支持在提高企业领导层多样性方面的影响。

records.title_en: Deputizing financial institutions to fight elder abuse
records.title_cn: 授权金融机构打击老年人虐待
records.abstract_en: Permissive laws deputize financial professionals to screen for misbehavior without providing explicit incentives. These are very common in financial markets. To evaluate their effectiveness, we exploit the staggered adoption of the 2016 Model Act provisions intended to curb elder abuse. We find a drop in reports of abuse by financial professionals to the Department of Treasury and, separately, in financial crimes against the elderly as monitored by the FBI. The effect is stronger where the elderly are more isolated. Our results highlight the role financial professionals play in combating social problems and the impact of permissive policies.
records.abstract_cn: 许可性法律授权金融专业人士筛查不当行为，但未提供明确激励。这类法律在金融市场中非常普遍。为评估其有效性，我们利用了旨在遏制老年人虐待的2016年《示范法》条款的分阶段实施。我们发现，金融专业人士向财政部报告的虐待事件有所下降，同时，联邦调查局监测的针对老年人的金融犯罪也有所减少。在老年人更为孤立的地方，这一效应更为显著。我们的结果凸显了金融专业人士在解决社会问题中所扮演的角色，以及许可性政策的影响。

records.title_en: What are the events that shake our world? Measuring and hedging global COVOL
records.title_cn: 哪些事件撼动了我们的世界？衡量与对冲全球共同波动率
records.abstract_en: Some events impact volatilities of most assets, asset classes, sectors and countries, causing serious damage to investment portfolios. The magnitude of such shocks is defined as global COVOL which is an abbreviation for global common volatility, a broad measure of all types of global financial risk. This paper introduces a statistical formulation of such events as common volatility innovations in both a multivariate volatility and an asset pricing context. Simulations verify the statistical performance of a simple but novel estimator and of a test to detect global COVOL. Two empirical examples show the events that have had the biggest impact on financial markets. The results are useful for portfolio optimization and risk forecasting.
records.abstract_cn: 某些事件会影响大多数资产、资产类别、行业和国家的波动率，对投资组合造成严重损害。此类冲击的幅度被定义为全球共同波动率（global COVOL），这是全球共同波动率的缩写，是对所有类型全球金融风险的广泛度量。本文在多元波动率和资产定价背景下，将此类事件统计性地表述为共同波动率创新。模拟验证了一种简单但新颖的估计量以及检测全球共同波动率的检验的统计性能。两个实证例子展示了对金融市场影响最大的事件。研究结果对投资组合优化和风险预测具有实用价值。

records.title_en: Self-imposed liquidity constraints via voluntary debt repayment
records.title_cn: 通过自愿偿还债务施加的自我流动性约束
records.abstract_en: Debt-repayment flexibility should help temporarily liquidity-constrained households but not necessarily households struggling to save. In a natural experiment in which households can apply for free mortgage-repayment flexibility, I find that two-thirds of liquidity-constrained applicants with high-cost debt voluntarily restrict flexibility and forgo, on average, 4,070 EUR of low-cost liquidity. An overconsumption tendency reflecting self-control problems can explain the voluntary liquidity restrictions as well as the persistent liquidity constraints, the consumption drop at the predictable end of flexibility, and saving in other illiquid assets. Self-imposed liquidity constraints reflect characteristics instead of circumstances and reduce the potency of debt-forbearance offers in recessions.
records.abstract_cn: 债务偿还的灵活性应有助于暂时面临流动性约束的家庭，但不一定有助于那些难以储蓄的家庭。在一项自然实验中，家庭可以申请免费的抵押贷款偿还灵活性，我发现三分之二的面临流动性约束且持有高成本债务的申请人自愿限制灵活性，并平均放弃4,070欧元的低成本流动性。反映自我控制问题的过度消费倾向可以解释自愿流动性限制以及持续的流动性约束、在可预见的灵活性结束时的消费下降，以及在其他非流动性资产中的储蓄。自我施加的流动性约束反映的是特征而非环境，并降低了衰退中债务宽限提议的有效性。

records.title_en: Fire sale risk and expected stock returns
records.title_cn: 火售风险与预期股票收益
records.abstract_en: We measure a stock’s exposure to fire sale risk through its ownership links to mutual funds that anticipate significant outflows during periods of systematic outflows from the fund industry. We find that stocks with higher exposure to this risk earn higher average returns: a portfolio that buys (shorts) stocks with the highest (lowest) exposure outperforms by 3-7% annually. Our findings cannot be explained by several known determinants of average returns and support the ex-ante pricing of the risk of fire sales. We conclude that stocks’ exposures to risks inherited from the constraints of shareholders have important implications for stock prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过股票与共同基金的所有权联系来衡量其对火售风险的暴露，这些基金在基金行业系统性流出期间预计会有大量流出。我们发现，暴露于该风险较高的股票获得较高的平均收益：买入（卖空）暴露最高（最低）的股票的投资组合每年跑赢3-7%。我们的发现无法由几个已知的平均收益决定因素解释，并支持火售风险的事前定价。我们得出结论，股票对股东约束所继承的风险的暴露对股票价格具有重要影响。

records.title_en: Industry asset revaluations around public and private acquisitions
records.title_cn: 行业资产在公开和私人收购中的重估
records.abstract_en: Revaluations of industry peers around horizontal acquisitions are negative when targets are private, but positive when they are public. We posit this “revaluation spread” arises because acquiring managers favor private targets when public firms are overvalued. Targets’ ownership status thus conveys information about industry assets’ misvaluation and triggers predictable revaluations. Supporting this idea, private acquisitions occur when private targets appear “cheaper” than public firms based on valuation multiples or the trading activity of industry insiders. The revaluation spread varies with overall market misvaluation, predicts future industry returns, and is unrelated to peers’ and industries’ fundamentals.
records.abstract_cn: 当目标公司为私人时，横向收购的行业同行的重估为负，但当目标公司为公开时则为正。我们假设这种“重估价差”的产生是因为当公开公司被高估时，收购经理偏好私人目标。因此，目标公司的所有权状态传达了关于行业资产错误估值的信息，并引发可预测的重估。支持这一观点的是，当基于估值倍数或行业内部人士的交易活动，私人目标看起来比公开公司“更便宜”时，就会发生私人收购。重估价差随整体市场错误估值而变化，预测未来行业回报，并且与同行和行业的基本面无关。

records.title_en: Rational inattention with multiple attributes
records.title_cn: 多属性下的理性疏忽
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a new measure for the cost of learning that allows the different attributes of the options faced by an agent to differ in their associated learning costs. The new measure maintains the tractability of Shannon's classic measure but produces richer choice predictions and identifies a new form of informational bias significant for welfare and counterfactual analysis that is conducted with the multinomial logit model. Necessary and sufficient conditions are provided for optimal agent behavior under the new measure for the cost of learning.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一种新的学习成本度量，该度量允许代理人面临的选项的不同属性具有不同的相关学习成本。新度量保持了香农经典度量的可处理性，但产生了更丰富的选择预测，并识别出一种新的信息偏差形式，这对于使用多项逻辑模型进行的福利和反事实分析具有重要意义。本文提供了在新学习成本度量下代理人最优行为的必要且充分条件。

records.title_en: Symmetry in n-player games
records.title_cn: n人博弈中的对称性
records.abstract_en: This paper regards symmetry in games with more than two players. It is often said that a two-player game is symmetric if it looks the same to both players. However, there are n-player games, such as Salop's circle model, that seem intuitively to look the same to all players, but do not meet the common definition of a symmetric n-player game. This paper proposes a more general symmetry condition that is satisfied by such models. Previous authors have established that games which are symmetric in the common sense have a number of useful properties relating to equilibrium characterization and comparative statics. With few exceptions, those properties continue to hold in the richer class of games that meet the symmetry condition proposed here.
records.abstract_cn: 本文关注多于两个参与人的博弈中的对称性。通常认为，如果一个两人博弈对两个参与人来说看起来相同，那么它就是对称的。然而，有些n人博弈，如萨洛普的圆形模型，直觉上对所有参与人看起来相同，但并不满足对称n人博弈的常见定义。本文提出了一个更一般的对称性条件，这类模型满足该条件。先前的作者已经证明，在通常意义上对称的博弈具有一些与均衡刻画和比较静态相关的有用性质。除少数例外，这些性质在满足本文提出的对称性条件的更丰富的博弈类中仍然成立。

records.title_en: The paradox of safe asset creation
records.title_cn: 安全资产创造的悖论
records.abstract_en: Safe asset demand increases loan risk. This arises in a competitive model in which securitization vehicles create safe assets by pooling loan payoffs purchased from loan originators. Equity investors allocate their wealth between originators, who need skin-in-the-game due to moral hazard, and vehicles, who need loss-absorption capacity against aggregate risk. An increase in demand for safety fosters safe asset creation through a securitization boom: originators sell more of their loan payoffs to vehicles, equity is reallocated from originators to vehicles, and the two effects contribute to an increase in loan risk. The model is consistent with a broad set of facts in the run-up to the Global Financial Crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 安全资产需求增加了贷款风险。这出现在一个竞争性模型中，其中证券化工具通过汇集从贷款发起人处购买的贷款收益来创造安全资产。股权投资者将财富分配在发起人（由于道德风险需要风险共担）和工具（需要针对总体风险的损失吸收能力）之间。安全需求的增加通过证券化繁荣促进了安全资产的创造：发起人向工具出售更多贷款收益，股权从发起人重新分配至工具，这两种效应共同导致贷款风险增加。该模型与全球金融危机前的一系列广泛事实相符。

records.title_en: Strategy-proof and envy-free random assignment
records.title_cn: 策略性防伪与无嫉妒的随机分配
records.abstract_en: We study the random assignment of indivisible objects among a set of agents with strict preferences. We show that there exists no mechanism which is unanimous, strategy-proof and envy-free. Weakening the first requirement to q-unanimity – i.e., when every agent ranks a different object at the top, then each agent shall receive his most-preferred object with probability of at least q – we show that a mechanism satisfying strategy-proofness, envy-freeness and ex-post weak non-wastefulness can be q-unanimous only for q≤2n (where n is the number of agents). To demonstrate that this bound is tight, we introduce a new mechanism, Random-Dictatorship-cum-Equal-Division (RDcED), and show that it achieves this maximal bound when all objects are acceptable. In addition, for three agents, RDcED is characterized by the first three properties and ex-post weak efficiency. If objects may be unacceptable, strategy-proofness and envy-freeness are jointly incompatible even with ex-post weak non-wastefulness.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有严格偏好的代理人集合中不可分割物品的随机分配问题。我们证明不存在同时满足一致性、策略性防伪和无嫉妒的机制。将第一个要求弱化为q-一致性——即当每个代理人将不同物品排在首位时，每个代理人应以至少q的概率获得其最偏好的物品——我们证明满足策略性防伪、无嫉妒和事后弱非浪费性的机制仅当q≤2n（其中n为代理人数量）时才能实现q-一致性。为证明该界限是紧的，我们引入一种新机制，随机独裁-均分（RDcED），并证明当所有物品均可接受时，该机制能达到此最大界限。此外，对于三个代理人，RDcED由前三个性质及事后弱效率所刻画。若物品可能不可接受，则策略性防伪与无嫉妒即使与事后弱非浪费性结合也是不相容的。

records.title_en: Electoral competition with costly policy changes: A dynamic perspective
records.title_cn: 代价高昂的政策变更下的选举竞争：一个动态视角
records.abstract_en: We analyze two-party electoral competition with a one-dimensional policy space, costly policy changes, and random negative shocks to a party's viability over an infinite horizon. We show the existence and uniqueness of stationary Markov perfect equilibria in which parties use so-called simple strategies. Regardless of the initial policy, party choices converge in the long run to a stochastic alternation between two policies, with transitions occurring if and only if parties suffer a negative shock to their viability. Although costs of change have a moderating effect on policies, full convergence to the median voter position does not take place when parties are polarized.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在一维政策空间、政策变更代价高昂以及政党生存能力受到随机负面冲击的无限期界下的两党选举竞争。我们证明了存在且唯一存在使用所谓简单策略的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡。无论初始政策如何，政党选择在长期内收敛于两种政策之间的随机交替，且仅当政党遭受生存能力负面冲击时才会发生转换。尽管变更成本对政策具有缓和作用，但当政党极化时，并不会完全收敛至中位选民位置。

records.title_en: Contagion in graphons
records.title_cn: 图极限中的传染
records.abstract_en: The analysis of threshold contagion processes in large networks is challenging. While the lack of accurate network data is often a major obstacle, finding optimal interventions is computationally intractable even in well-measured large networks. To obviate these issues we consider threshold contagion over networks sampled from a graphon—a flexible stochastic network formation model—and show that in this case the contagion outcome can be predicted by only exploiting information about the graphon. To this end, we exploit a second interpretation of graphons as graph limits to formally define a threshold contagion process on a graphon for infinite populations. We then show that contagion in large but finite sampled networks is well approximated by graphon contagion. This convergence result suggests that one can design interventions for large sampled networks by first solving the equivalent problem for an infinite population interacting according to the limiting graphon. We show that, under suitable regularity assumptions, the latter is a tractable problem and we provide analytical characterizations for the extent of contagion and for optimal seeding policies in graphons with both finite and infinite agent types.
records.abstract_cn: 大型网络中阈值传染过程的分析具有挑战性。虽然缺乏准确的网络数据往往是一个主要障碍，但即使在测量良好的大型网络中，找到最优干预措施在计算上也是难以处理的。为了规避这些问题，我们考虑从图极限（一种灵活的随机网络形成模型）中采样的网络上的阈值传染，并表明在这种情况下，传染结果可以通过仅利用关于图极限的信息来预测。为此，我们利用图极限作为图极限的第二种解释，正式定义了无限总体上图极限上的阈值传染过程。然后我们表明，大型但有限的采样网络中的传染很好地由图极限传染近似。这一收敛结果表明，可以通过首先解决根据极限图极限相互作用的无限总体的等价问题来设计大型采样网络的干预措施。我们表明，在适当的正则性假设下，后者是一个可处理的问题，并且我们为具有有限和无限智能体类型的图极限中的传染程度和最优播种策略提供了分析特征。

records.title_en: Mediated talk: An experiment
records.title_cn: 中介性谈话：一项实验
records.abstract_en: We experimentally compare mediated (cheap) talk with direct (cheap) talk. Theory, guided by a characterization of equilibria in both environments, suggests that mediated talk has the potential to improve information sharing and welfare relative to direct talk. We sharpen the theory prediction by invoking Crawford's (2003) language-anchored level-k analysis. In the experiment, we find that mediated talk can indeed facilitate information transmission. We also find, however, that this requires that the language employed conforms with the mediation mechanism: mediation mechanisms improve information sharing for a variety of conforming languages, but fail to do so with a nonconforming language. These experimental findings match the predictions from the language-anchored level-k analysis. Strikingly, this is the case even when a whole array of alternative selection criteria (including iterative deletion of dominated strategies, strict equilibrium, Pareto efficiency, etc.) make a unique common prediction that sharply disagrees with the language-anchored level-k prediction.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验比较了中介性（廉价）谈话与直接（廉价）谈话。理论，以两种环境中的均衡特征为指导，表明相对于直接谈话，中介性谈话有潜力改善信息共享和福利。我们通过引用Crawford（2003）的语言锚定层级-k分析来强化理论预测。在实验中，我们发现中介性谈话确实可以促进信息传递。然而，我们也发现，这要求所使用的语言符合中介机制：中介机制对于各种符合性语言都能改善信息共享，但对于不符合性语言则无法做到。这些实验发现与语言锚定层级-k分析的预测相符。令人惊讶的是，即使当一系列替代选择标准（包括剔除劣势策略的迭代、严格均衡、帕累托效率等）做出与语言锚定层级-k预测尖锐分歧的独特共同预测时，情况也是如此。

records.title_en: Optimal contest design: Tuning the heat
records.title_cn: 最优竞赛设计：调节热度
records.abstract_en: We consider the design of contests when the principal can choose both the prize profile and how the prizes are allocated as a function of a possibly noisy signal about the agents' efforts. We provide sufficient conditions that guarantee optimality of a contest. Optimal contests have a minimally competitive prize profile and an intermediate degree of competitiveness in the contest success function. Whenever observation is not too noisy, the optimum can be achieved by an all-pay contest with a cap. When observation is perfect, the optimum can also be achieved by a nested Tullock contest. We relate our results to a recent literature which has asked similar questions but has typically focused on the design of either the prize profile or the contest success function.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑当委托人可以选择奖金分配方案以及如何根据可能包含噪声的关于代理人努力程度的信号来分配奖金时的竞赛设计问题。我们提供了保证竞赛最优性的充分条件。最优竞赛具有最小竞争性的奖金分配方案和中等程度的竞赛成功函数竞争性。当观测噪声不太大时，最优可以通过带有上限的全支付竞赛实现。当观测完美时，最优也可以通过嵌套的图洛克竞赛实现。我们将我们的结果与近期文献联系起来，这些文献提出了类似的问题，但通常侧重于奖金分配方案或竞赛成功函数的设计。

records.title_en: Block-recursive equilibria in heterogeneous-agent models
records.title_cn: 异质性主体模型中的块递归均衡
records.abstract_en: Equilibrium models with heterogeneous agents and aggregate uncertainty are difficult to analyze since policy functions and market prices usually depend on the cross-sectional distribution over agents' state variables which is a high-dimensional object. This paper considers a general model framework in which this curse of dimensionality does not arise because equilibrium prices are determined by market entry conditions and are independent of the cross-sectional distribution (block-recursive equilibrium). The paper first establishes existence and ergodic theorems which are useful for the theoretical analysis and numerical implementation of block-recursive equilibria. Then these results are applied to models of firm dynamics with competitive or frictional input markets and to incomplete-market economies with endogenous asset market participation.
records.abstract_cn: 具有异质性主体和总体不确定性的均衡模型难以分析，因为政策函数和市场价格通常依赖于主体状态变量的横截面分布，而这是一个高维对象。本文考虑了一个一般模型框架，在该框架中，由于均衡价格由市场进入条件决定且独立于横截面分布（块递归均衡），因此不会出现这种维度灾难。本文首先建立了存在性和遍历性定理，这些定理对于块递归均衡的理论分析和数值实现非常有用。然后，将这些结果应用于具有竞争性或摩擦性投入品市场的企业动态模型，以及具有内生资产市场参与的不完全市场经济体。

records.title_en: Communication with endogenous deception costs
records.title_cn: 内生欺骗成本下的沟通
records.abstract_en: We study how the suspicion that communicated information might be deceptive affects the nature of what can be communicated in a sender-receiver game. Sender is said to deceive Receiver if she sends a message that induces a belief that is different from the belief that should have been induced in the realized state. Deception is costly to Sender and the cost is endogenous: it is increasing in the distance between the induced belief and the belief that should have been induced. A message function that induces Sender to engage in deception is not credible and cannot be part of an equilibrium. We study credible communication with state-dependent and state-independent Sender's preferences. The cost of deception parametrizes the sender's ability to commit to her strategy. Through varying this cost, our model spans the range from cheap talk, or no commitment (Crawford and Sobel, 1982) to full commitment (Kamenica and Gentzkow, 2011).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在发送者-接收者博弈中，对沟通信息可能具有欺骗性的怀疑如何影响可沟通内容的性质。如果发送者发送的消息诱导的信念与在实现状态下本应诱导的信念不同，则称发送者欺骗了接收者。欺骗对发送者而言是有成本的，且该成本是内生的：它随诱导信念与本应诱导信念之间的距离递增。诱导发送者进行欺骗的消息函数是不可信的，不能成为均衡的一部分。我们研究了在发送者偏好依赖于状态和不依赖于状态的情况下的可信沟通。欺骗成本参数化了发送者对其策略的承诺能力。通过改变这一成本，我们的模型涵盖了从廉价交谈或无承诺（Crawford和Sobel，1982）到完全承诺（Kamenica和Gentzkow，2011）的范围。

records.title_en: Capability accumulation and conglomeratization in the information age
records.title_cn: 信息时代的 capability 积累与企业集团化
records.abstract_en: The past twenty years have witnessed the emergence of internet conglomerates fueled by acquisitions. We build a simple model of network formation to study this. Following the resource-based view of competitive advantage from the management literature we endow firms with capabilities which drive their competitiveness across markets. Firms can merge to combine their capabilities, spin-off new firms by partitioning their capabilities, or procure unassigned capabilities. We study stable industry structures (stable networks) in which none of these deviations are profitable. We find an upper and lower bound on the size of the largest firm, and show that as markets value more of the same capabilities abrupt increases in these bounds occur.
records.abstract_cn: 过去二十年见证了由收购推动的互联网企业集团的出现。我们构建了一个简单的网络形成模型来研究这一现象。遵循管理学文献中基于资源的竞争优势观点，我们赋予企业能力，这些能力驱动它们在各市场中的竞争力。企业可以通过合并来组合其能力，通过分割其能力来分拆新企业，或获取未分配的能力。我们研究稳定的行业结构（稳定网络），在这种结构中，这些偏离行为均无利可图。我们找到了最大企业规模的上下界，并表明随着市场对更多相同能力的重视，这些界限会发生突变性增加。

records.title_en: Moral hazard and subjective evaluation
records.title_cn: 道德风险与主观评价
records.abstract_en: This study investigates optimal contracts to solve the moral hazard problem with subjective evaluation in a static environment with multiple agents wherein the principal observes agents' performances privately. Despite the limitations of feasible contracts that the principal can credibly offer, we show the irrelevance theorem that even under subjective evaluation, the principal can be as well off as if agents' performances are objective and verifiable, provided there are at least two risk-neutral agents whose actions satisfy a certain condition on their output distributions. Our irrelevance result encompasses a large class of moral hazard problems, including statistically correlated and technologically interdependent performance signals. We also extend the model to include multidimensional actions, limited liability constraints, and collusion among agents.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在静态环境中，多个代理人且委托人私下观察代理人表现的情况下，解决主观评价道德风险问题的最优契约。尽管委托人能够可信地提供的可行契约存在限制，我们证明了无关性定理：即使在主观评价下，只要至少有两个风险中性的代理人，其行动满足其产出分布的特定条件，委托人也能达到如同代理人表现客观且可验证时的福利水平。我们的无关性结果涵盖了广泛的道德风险问题，包括统计相关和技术上相互依赖的绩效信号。我们还将模型扩展到包括多维行动、有限责任约束和代理人之间的合谋。

records.title_en: Preference for Knowledge
records.title_cn: 对知识的偏好
records.abstract_en: We examine the subjective value of gaining knowledge in a version of Savage's model for decisions under uncertainty in which the received outcome provides information about which event has obtained. Decision makers commonly value such knowledge either because they want to use it in future decisions or because they are personally interested in it. We find that in our model, the sure-thing principle and several other axioms of Savage are inconsistent with this value for knowledge about events. We provide a representation theorem for a subjective value of knowledge consisting of the sum of expected utility and a function of the information partition generated by the outcomes of an act. We characterize when the value of knowledge can be represented by a subjective value of knowledge about an information partition plus a Shannon entropy cost of processing information. Our results also provide a novel critique of the necessity of Savage's axioms for rational decisions under uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在萨维奇不确定性决策模型的一个版本中考察获取知识的主观价值，在该版本中，所获得的结果提供了关于哪个事件已经发生的信息。决策者通常重视此类知识，要么因为他们想在未来的决策中使用它，要么因为他们个人对此感兴趣。我们发现，在我们的模型中，确定事态原则和萨维奇的几个其他公理与这种对事件知识的价值不一致。我们提供了一个关于知识主观价值的表示定理，该价值由期望效用之和以及由行为结果生成的信息划分的函数组成。我们刻画了何时知识价值可以用关于信息划分的主观知识价值加上处理信息的香农熵成本来表示。我们的结果也为萨维奇公理在不确定性下理性决策中的必要性提供了新的批判。

records.title_en: Random utility models with ordered types and domains
records.title_cn: 具有有序类型和域随机效用模型
records.abstract_en: Random utility models in which heterogeneity of preferences is modeled by means of an ordered collection of utilities, or types, provide a powerful framework for understanding a variety of economic behaviors. This paper studies the micro-foundations of ordered random utility models with the objective of meeting empirical requirements. This is done by working with arbitrary collections of ordered menus of alternatives, and by making no parametric assumptions about the type distribution. The model is characterized by a simple monotonicity axiom. Goodness-of-fit measures are proposed, with proof provided of the strong consistency of extremum estimators defined upon them. A statistical test for the model is also provided.
records.abstract_cn: 随机效用模型中，偏好的异质性通过有序的效用集合（即类型）来建模，为理解各种经济行为提供了强有力的框架。本文研究有序随机效用模型的微观基础，旨在满足实证需求。为此，我们处理任意有序的备选菜单集合，并且不对类型分布做任何参数假设。该模型由一个简单的单调性公理刻画。我们提出了拟合优度度量，并证明了基于这些度量的极值估计量的强一致性。此外，还提供了该模型的统计检验。

records.title_en: Optimal orchestration of rewards and punishments in rank-order contests
records.title_cn: 排名竞赛中奖励与惩罚的最优编排
records.abstract_en: We allow negative prizes and investigate effort-maximizing prize design in rank-order contests with incomplete information. Endogenous participation arises due to less-efficient types' incentive to avoid punishments. The optimum features winner-take-all for the best performer and at most one punishment for the worst performer among all potential contestants, whenever they enter the competition. Based on this, we then (1) provide a necessary and sufficient condition for the optimality of pure winner-take-all without punishment; and (2) show that the optimal entry threshold increases with the total number of contestants and converges to the Myerson cutoff in the limit. Finally, we characterize the optimal entry-dependent prize structure, allowing the prize sequence to vary with the number of entrants. The optimal design must entail endogenous entry, and it harmonically integrates both winner-take-all and egality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们允许负奖金，并研究不完全信息下排名竞赛中努力最大化的奖金设计。内生参与源于低效率类型避免惩罚的激励。最优方案具有以下特征：最佳表现者获得赢家通吃，且在所有潜在参赛者中，只要他们进入竞赛，最多对最差表现者施加一次惩罚。基于此，我们随后（1）提供了纯赢家通吃而无惩罚的最优性的必要且充分条件；（2）表明最优进入门槛随参赛者总数增加而提高，并在极限情况下收敛于迈尔森截断值。最后，我们刻画了最优的进入依赖奖金结构，允许奖金序列随进入者数量变化。最优设计必须包含内生进入，并和谐地整合了赢家通吃和平等主义。

records.title_en: Strategy-proof and envy-free mechanisms for house allocation
records.title_cn: 住房分配中的防策略与无嫉妒机制
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem of allocating indivisible objects to agents when agents have strict preferences over objects. There are inherent trade-offs between competing notions of efficiency, fairness and incentives in such assignment mechanisms. It is, therefore, natural to consider mechanisms that satisfy two of these three properties in their strongest notions, while trying to improve on the third dimension. In this paper, we are motivated by the following question: Is there a strategy-proof and envy-free random assignment mechanism more efficient than equal division?
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑当代理人对物品具有严格偏好时，将不可分割物品分配给代理人的问题。在此类分配机制中，效率、公平和激励等相互竞争的概念之间存在固有的权衡。因此，自然要考虑在最强意义上满足这三个属性中的两个，同时试图改进第三个维度的机制。在本文中，我们受以下问题驱动：是否存在比均等分配更有效的防策略且无嫉妒的随机分配机制？

records.title_en: Derandomization of persuasion mechanisms
records.title_cn: 说服机制的随机化消除
records.abstract_en: We consider a setting where one sender can communicate with several privately informed receivers through a persuasion mechanism before the receivers play a game. We show that for any potentially randomized persuasion mechanism, under certain conditions, there is an effectively equivalent deterministic persuasion mechanism, and these two mechanisms have the same set of equilibria. We exhibit the usefulness of our result in an information disclosure application, where our technique helps to derive the optimal persuasion mechanism. Overall, this paper provides a rationale for the fact that persuasion mechanisms are often deterministic in practice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个场景，其中一位发送者可以通过说服机制在接收者进行博弈之前与多位拥有私人信息的接收者进行沟通。我们证明，对于任何可能随机化的说服机制，在特定条件下，存在一个有效等价的确定性说服机制，且这两种机制具有相同的均衡集合。我们在一个信息披露应用中展示了我们结果的有用性，在该应用中，我们的技术有助于推导出最优说服机制。总体而言，本文为说服机制在实践中通常是确定性的这一事实提供了理论依据。

records.title_en: Comment on “A theoretical foundation of ambiguity measurement” [J. Econ. Theory 187 (2020) 105001]
records.title_cn: 对“模糊度量的理论基础”一文的评论 [J. Econ. Theory 187 (2020) 105001]
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we study asymptotic expansions for distorted probabilities under ambiguity, revisiting the framework and analysis of Izhakian (2020b). We argue that the first order terms in these expansions need to be corrected and provide alternatives. We also revisit later results in this paper on the separation of ambiguity and ambiguity attitudes. We argue that a crucial lemma is flawed implying that Izhakian's ambiguity measure ℧2 is not an equivalent way of representing the preferences it is supposed to represent.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了模糊下扭曲概率的渐近展开，重新审视了Izhakian (2020b)的框架和分析。我们认为这些展开中的一阶项需要修正，并提供了替代方案。我们还重新审视了本文中关于模糊与模糊态度分离的后续结果。我们认为一个关键引理存在缺陷，这意味着Izhakian的模糊度量℧2并不是其所声称要表示的偏好的等价表示方式。

records.title_en: Efficiency and surplus distribution in majoritarian reputational bargaining
records.title_cn: 多数规则下声誉讨价还价中的效率与剩余分配
records.abstract_en: This paper studies majoritarian reputational bargaining. Three agents bargain over the division of one dollar under majority rule, and proposers are randomly chosen. Each agent has private information about whether she is a rational type that maximizes her expected share of the dollar or an obstinate type that commits to claiming a certain share of the dollar. Efficiency and surplus distribution in majoritarian reputational bargaining may differ from their counterparts in bilateral reputational bargaining. In a particular equilibrium of our majoritarian game, efficiency loss vanishes asymptotically as the agents become patient, and bargaining ends immediately if all agents are rational. Moreover, the agent who has the lowest positive ex ante probability of being obstinate achieves the highest ex ante payoff, when such probabilities for all agents are sufficiently low.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究多数规则下的声誉讨价还价。三个代理人在多数规则下就一美元的分配进行讨价还价，提议者随机选择。每个代理人拥有关于其类型的私人信息，即她是最大化其预期美元份额的理性类型，还是承诺要求一定美元份额的固执类型。多数规则下声誉讨价还价中的效率与剩余分配可能不同于双边声誉讨价还价中的对应情况。在我们的多数规则博弈的一个特定均衡中，随着代理人变得有耐心，效率损失渐近消失，如果所有代理人都是理性的，讨价还价立即结束。此外，当所有代理人的事前固执概率足够低时，事前固执概率最低的正值代理人获得最高的事前收益。

records.title_en: Optimal transparency of monitoring capability
records.title_cn: 监控能力的最优透明度
records.abstract_en: This paper studies information design in an inspection game. A principal first privately decides whether to acquire a costly monitoring capability that is needed to detect shirking by an agent; subsequently, the agent decides whether to work or shirk. I show that overall efficiency can be improved by providing the agent with a partially — instead of fully — informative signal about the principal's decision; however, the resulting equilibrium involves the agent shirking with a positive probability and all the efficiency gained is captured by the agent. Overall efficiency can be further improved by providing the principal with private information about the signal generating process; this additional feature also allows the principal to capture the efficiency gained. The analysis sheds light on the extent to which information control can be used to improve monitoring efficiency in such inspection games.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了检查博弈中的信息设计。委托人首先私下决定是否获取一项昂贵的监控能力，该能力对于检测代理人的偷懒行为是必需的；随后，代理人决定工作是偷懒。我表明，通过向代理人提供关于委托人决策的部分信息（而非完全信息）信号，可以提高整体效率；然而，由此产生的均衡涉及代理人以正概率偷懒，且所有效率收益均由代理人获得。通过向委托人提供关于信号生成过程的私人信息，可以进一步提高整体效率；这一额外特征还允许委托人获取效率收益。该分析揭示了在此类检查博弈中，信息控制可用于提高监控效率的程度。

records.title_en: Virus dynamics with behavioral responses
records.title_cn: 行为响应下的病毒动力学
records.abstract_en: Motivated by epidemics such as COVID-19, we study the spread of a contagious disease when behavior responds to the disease's prevalence. We extend the SIR epidemiological model to include endogenous meeting rates. Individuals benefit from economic activity, but activity involves interactions with potentially infected individuals. The main focus is a theoretical analysis of contagion dynamics and behavioral responses to changes in risk. We obtain a simple condition for when public-health interventions or variants of a disease will have paradoxical effects on infection rates due to risk compensation. Behavioral responses are most likely to undermine public-health interventions near the peak of severe diseases.
records.abstract_cn: 受COVID-19等流行病启发，我们研究了当行为对疾病流行程度作出响应时传染病的传播。我们将SIR流行病学模型扩展为包含内生相遇率。个体从经济活动中获益，但活动涉及与潜在感染者的互动。主要焦点是对传染动力学和风险变化行为响应的理论分析。我们得到了一个简单条件，在该条件下，公共卫生干预或疾病变种会因风险补偿而对感染率产生悖论性影响。行为响应最可能在严重疾病高峰期附近破坏公共卫生干预措施。

records.title_en: Market areas in general equilibrium
records.title_cn: 一般均衡中的市场区域
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a spatial model with a realistic geography where a continuous distribution of agents (e.g., farmers) engages in economic interactions with one location from a finite set (e.g., cities). The spatial structure of the equilibrium consists of a tessellation, i.e., a partition of space into a collection of mutually exclusive market areas. After proving the existence of a unique equilibrium, we characterize how the location of borders and, in the case with mobile labor, the set of inhabited cities change in response to economic shocks. To deal with a two-dimensional space, we draw on tools from computational geometry and from the theory of shape optimization. Finally, we provide an empirical application to illustrate the usefulness of the framework for applied work.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个具有现实地理特征的空间模型，其中连续分布的代理人（例如农民）与有限集合中的一个位置（例如城市）进行经济互动。均衡的空间结构由镶嵌构成，即将空间划分为一组互斥的市场区域。在证明了唯一均衡的存在性之后，我们刻画了边界位置以及，在劳动力可流动的情况下，有人居住的城市集合如何随经济冲击而变化。为了处理二维空间，我们借鉴了计算几何和形状优化理论中的工具。最后，我们提供了一个实证应用，以说明该框架对应用研究的实用性。

records.title_en: Legislative informational lobbying
records.title_cn: 立法信息游说
records.abstract_en: Whom should an interest group lobby in a legislature? I develop a model of informational lobbying, in which a legislature must decide on the allocation of district-specific goods and projects. An interest group chooses to search and provide information on districts' valuations of the goods. The setting is one of distributive politics, where the proposed allocation of goods and projects is endogenous to the information provided by the interest group. I characterize the information search strategy of the interest group. I furthermore establish that the relationship between informational lobbying and legislative majority requirement is non-monotonic. I also determine who gains and who loses from lobbying, identifying circumstances in which legislators would unanimously prefer to ban informational lobbying. Finally, I provide an informational rationale for why interest groups sometimes lobby legislative allies (friendly lobbying).
records.abstract_cn: 利益集团在立法机构中应游说谁？我建立了一个信息游说模型，其中立法机构必须决定地区特定商品和项目的分配。利益集团选择搜索并提供关于各地区对商品估价的信息。该设定属于分配政治，其中商品和项目的拟议分配内生于利益集团提供的信息。我刻画了利益集团的信息搜索策略。此外，我证明了信息游说与立法多数要求之间的关系是非单调的。我还确定了谁从游说中获益、谁受损，并识别了立法者一致倾向于禁止信息游说的情形。最后，我为利益集团有时游说立法盟友（友好游说）提供了信息层面的解释。

records.title_en: A complete characterization of infinitely repeated two-player games having computable strategies with no computable best response under limit-of-means payoff
records.title_cn: 极限平均收益下具有可计算策略且无可计算最优响应的无限重复两人博弈的完整刻画
records.abstract_en: It is well-known that for infinitely repeated games, there are computable strategies that have best responses, but no computable best responses. These results were originally proved for either specific games (e.g., Prisoner's dilemma), or for classes of games satisfying certain conditions not known to be both necessary and sufficient.
records.abstract_cn: 众所周知，对于无限重复博弈，存在具有最优响应但无可计算最优响应的可计算策略。这些结果最初是针对特定博弈（如囚徒困境）或满足某些条件且未知其既必要又充分的博弈类别证明的。

records.title_en: Speculation in procurement auctions
records.title_cn: 采购拍卖中的投机行为
records.abstract_en: A speculator can take advantage of a procurement auction by acquiring items for sale before the auction. The accumulated market power can then be exercised in the auction and may lead to a large enough gain to cover the acquisition costs. I show that speculation always generates a positive expected profit in second-price auctions but could be unprofitable in first-price auctions. In the case where speculation is profitable in first-price auctions, it is more profitable in second-price auctions. This comparison in profitability is driven by different competition patterns in the two auction mechanisms: in first-price auctions, sellers who refuse to sell to the speculator bid more aggressively than in second-price auctions. In terms of welfare, speculation causes private value destruction and harms efficiency. Sellers benefit from the acquisition offer made by the speculator. Therefore, speculation comes at the expense of the auctioneer.
records.abstract_cn: 投机者可以通过在拍卖前购买待售物品来利用采购拍卖。积累的市场势力随后可以在拍卖中行使，并可能带来足以覆盖收购成本的收益。我表明，投机在第二价格拍卖中总是产生正的预期利润，但在第一价格拍卖中可能无利可图。在投机在第一价格拍卖中有利可图的情况下，它在第二价格拍卖中更有利可图。这种盈利能力的比较是由两种拍卖机制中不同的竞争模式驱动的：在第一价格拍卖中，拒绝向投机者出售的卖家比在第二价格拍卖中出价更具攻击性。在福利方面，投机导致私人价值破坏并损害效率。卖家从投机者提出的收购要约中受益。因此，投机是以拍卖人的利益为代价的。

records.title_en: Pledge-and-review bargaining
records.title_cn: 承诺与审议谈判
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel dynamic bargaining game where every party is proposing only its own contribution, before all pledges must be unanimously approved. I show that, with uncertain tolerance for delay, each equilibrium pledge maximizes an asymmetric Nash product. The weights on others' payoffs increase in the uncertainty, but decrease in the correlation of the shocks. The weights vary pledge to pledge, and this implies that the outcome is generically inefficient. The Nash demand game and its mapping to the Nash bargaining solution follow as a limiting case. The model sheds light on the Paris climate change agreement, but it also applies to negotiations between policymakers or business partners that have differentiated responsibilities or expertise.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的动态谈判博弈，其中每一方仅提出自己的贡献，之后所有承诺必须获得一致通过。我证明，在对延迟的容忍度不确定的情况下，每个均衡承诺最大化一个不对称的纳什积。他人收益的权重随不确定性增加而增加，但随冲击的相关性增加而减少。权重因承诺而异，这意味着结果通常是低效的。纳什需求博弈及其与纳什谈判解的映射作为一个极限情形出现。该模型揭示了巴黎气候变化协议，但也适用于具有不同责任或专长的政策制定者或商业伙伴之间的谈判。

records.title_en: Extrapolative asset pricing
records.title_cn: 外推资产定价
records.abstract_en: This paper studies implications of return extrapolation in a consumption-based asset pricing model. We show that return extrapolation has strong implications for the pricing kernel. The time variation in the agent's return expectations is mainly reflected in the short rate and little in return volatility and equity premium. Return extrapolation causes return volatility and equity premium to be lower than the rational counterparts. In addition to the risk premium, the equity premium can include a sentiment premium that is due to dividend expectation bias rather than return extrapolation bias. Thus, time-varying dividend (rather than return) expectation bias helps produce a volatile equity premium. These results show that return extrapolation exacerbates asset pricing puzzles and fundamental extrapolation helps resolve puzzles.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了基于消费的资产定价模型中收益外推的含义。我们表明，收益外推对定价核有强烈的影响。代理人收益预期的时间变化主要反映在短期利率上，而对收益波动率和股权溢价的影响很小。收益外推导致收益波动率和股权溢价低于理性对应值。除了风险溢价外，股权溢价还可以包括一个情绪溢价，该溢价源于股息预期偏差而非收益外推偏差。因此，时变的股息（而非收益）预期偏差有助于产生波动的股权溢价。这些结果表明，收益外推加剧了资产定价难题，而基本面外推有助于解决这些难题。

records.title_en: Optimal technology design
records.title_cn: 最优技术设计
records.abstract_en: This paper considers a moral hazard model with agent limited liability. Prior to interacting with the principal, the agent designs the production technology, which is a specification of his cost of generating each output distribution. After observing the production technology, the principal offers a payment scheme and then the agent chooses a distribution over outputs. We show that there is an optimal design involving only binary distributions (i.e., the cost of any other distribution is prohibitively high), and we characterize the equilibrium technology defined on the binary distributions. Notably, the equilibrium payoff of both players is 1/e.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个具有代理人有限责任的道德风险模型。在与委托人互动之前，代理人设计生产技术，该技术规定了其产生每种产出分布的成本。在观察到生产技术后，委托人提供支付方案，然后代理人选择产出上的分布。我们证明存在一个仅涉及二元分布的最优设计（即任何其他分布的成本都高得令人望而却步），并且我们刻画了定义在二元分布上的均衡技术。值得注意的是，两个参与者的均衡收益均为1/e。

records.title_en: On the voluntary disclosure of redundant information
records.title_cn: 论冗余信息的自愿披露
records.abstract_en: Why do firms engage in costly, voluntary disclosure of information which is subsumed by a later announcement? We consider a model in which the firm's manager can choose to disclose short-term information which becomes redundant later. When disclosure costs are sufficiently low, the manager discloses even if she only cares about the long-term price of the firm. Intuitively, by disclosing, she causes early investors to trade less aggressively, reducing price informativeness, which in turn increases information acquisition by late investors. The subsequent increase in acquisition more than offsets the initial decrease in price informativeness and, consequently, improves long term prices.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么企业会进行有成本的、自愿的信息披露，而这些信息后来会被后续公告所包含？我们考虑一个模型，其中企业经理可以选择披露后来变得冗余的短期信息。当披露成本足够低时，即使经理只关心企业的长期价格，她也会进行披露。直觉上，通过披露，她导致早期投资者交易不那么激进，降低了价格信息含量，这反过来又增加了后期投资者的信息获取。随后信息获取的增加超过了对价格信息含量初始减少的抵消，从而改善了长期价格。

records.title_en: When to ask for an update: Timing in strategic communication
records.title_cn: 何时请求更新：战略沟通中的时机选择
records.abstract_en: A principal (receiver) considers whether to accept a project whose total value depends on two aspects. In each period, an agent (sender) privately learns the value of one aspect with positive probability. We compare two common reporting protocols: frequent updating, which requires the sender to report in each period, and infrequent updating, which requires him to report only at the end of the learning process. The sender is biased towards acceptance; he may conceal his signal, but cannot otherwise misrepresent.
records.abstract_cn: 委托人（接收者）考虑是否接受一个总价值取决于两个方面的项目。在每个时期，代理人（发送者）以正概率私下了解其中一个方面的价值。我们比较两种常见的报告协议：频繁更新，要求发送者在每个时期报告；以及不频繁更新，要求他仅在学习过程结束时报告。发送者偏向于接受；他可能隐瞒其信号，但不能以其他方式歪曲事实。

records.title_en: The Luce model with replicas
records.title_cn: 带有复制品的卢斯模型
records.abstract_en: We propose the notion of replicas in the context of discrete choices and introduce axioms that characterize the Luce model with replicas. This model does not fall prey to the well-known “red bus-blue bus” example originally proposed by Debreu (1960) and later made famous by McFadden. Our model satisfies regularity, strong stochastic transitivity, and is a random utility model. Due to its simplicity, this model is more parsimonious than others aimed at overcoming the “duplicates problem”.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了离散选择背景下复制品的概念，并引入了刻画带有复制品的卢斯模型的公理。该模型不会陷入由Debreu（1960）最初提出、后由McFadden使之闻名的“红巴士-蓝巴士”例子。我们的模型满足正则性、强随机传递性，并且是一个随机效用模型。由于其简单性，该模型比旨在克服“重复问题”的其他模型更为简约。

records.title_en: Signaling, screening, and core stability
records.title_cn: 信号传递、筛选与核心稳定性
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a noncooperative approach to core stability in an economy with incomplete information. We study the perfect Bayesian equilibria of an extensive form mechanism that extends the one used by Serrano and Vohra (1997) to implement the core of a complete-information economy. This leads to a version of the core that we refer to as the sequential core, which allows for information to be transmitted among the agents during the process of coalition formation. Such information flows include proposals that can be viewed as signaling devices and/or screening contracts. Equilibrium refinements are then used to provide justifications for the coarse core and the fine core. As a robustness check, we show that the sequential core corresponds to stationary PBE outcomes of an infinite horizon bargaining game.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一种在信息不完全的经济中研究核心稳定性的非合作方法。我们研究了一个扩展型机制的完美贝叶斯均衡，该机制扩展了Serrano和Vohra（1997）用于实施完全信息经济核心的机制。这引出了我们称之为序贯核心的核心版本，它允许在联盟形成过程中信息在代理人之间传递。这种信息流包括可被视为信号传递工具和/或筛选合同的提议。然后使用均衡精炼来为粗核心和细核心提供合理性论证。作为稳健性检验，我们表明序贯核心对应于无限期讨价还价博弈的平稳PBE结果。

records.title_en: The dark side of transparency: When hiding in plain sight works
records.title_cn: 透明的阴暗面：当公开隐藏奏效时
records.abstract_en: A hider publicly commits to the number of seekers and then privately gets involved in a story, which may be compromising. Each seeker aims to be the first to learn and report a compromising story. The seekers learn the story privately and in continuous time. With more seekers, the hider's story gets revealed at a faster rate, but each seeker gets discouraged and ceases learning more quickly. To reduce the probability of a compromising report, the hider may optimally choose infinitely many seekers. Nevertheless, the hider unambiguously benefits from making it harder for each seeker to learn her story.
records.abstract_cn: 隐藏者公开承诺搜寻者的数量，然后私下卷入一个可能具有损害性的故事。每个搜寻者旨在成为第一个得知并报告损害性故事的人。搜寻者私下且连续地得知故事。随着搜寻者增多，隐藏者的故事被揭露的速度加快，但每个搜寻者会气馁并更快停止学习。为了降低损害性报告的概率，隐藏者可能最优地选择无限多的搜寻者。然而，隐藏者明确地从使每个搜寻者更难得知她的故事中获益。

records.title_en: Homophily and influence
records.title_cn: 同质性影响
records.abstract_en: We study how learning and influence co-evolve in a social network by extending the classical model of DeGroot (1974) in two fundamental ways:
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过以两种基本方式扩展DeGroot（1974）的经典模型，研究社会网络中学习与影响如何共同演化：

records.title_en: Endogenous liquidity and volatility
records.title_cn: 内生流动性与波动性
records.abstract_en: Is asset liquidity a source of price volatility? We answer this question within a continuous-time, New Monetarist economy under extrinsic uncertainty where the role of an asset to finance expenditure shocks depends on its pledgeability. If assets are intrinsically valuable and pledgeability is exogenous, then their prices are invariant to extrinsic uncertainty – unlike environments with discrete-time pricing that can feature sunspot equilibria. We derive conditions under which extrinsic uncertainty matters when pledgeability is endogenous and varies with the asset price or its rate of return. In the latter case, we link sunspot equilibria to deterministic cycles.
records.abstract_cn: 资产流动性是价格波动的来源吗？我们在一个连续时间的新货币主义经济体中，在外部不确定性下回答这个问题，其中资产在融资支出冲击中的作用取决于其可质押性。如果资产具有内在价值且可质押性是外生的，那么它们的价格对外部不确定性是不变的——这与具有离散时间定价且可能出现太阳黑子均衡的环境不同。我们推导出当可质押性是内生的且随资产价格或其回报率变化时，外部不确定性起作用的条件。在后一种情况下，我们将太阳黑子均衡与确定性周期联系起来。

records.title_en: Public education expenditures, growth and income inequality
records.title_cn: 公共教育支出、增长与收入不平等
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the relationship between public education spending, long-run growth and income inequality. We propose an endogenous growth model with occupational choice and an endogenous supply of teachers and education quality. We show that endogenous school quality alters the shape of those relationships in a way that has new policy implications. First, growth depends on the level of public education expenditures and on the shape of the human capital distribution. Second, the relationship between public education and inequality can be either positive or negative. Calibrating our model to US state data, we find that a significant share of states faces a trade-off between increasing growth and decreasing inequality through public education spending. We find that this trade-off is overall more likely in states with higher public education expenditures, teacher employment share and relative wage, and intergenerational mobility. Finally, the existence of such a trade-off depends on how public education spending is financed.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了公共教育支出、长期增长与收入不平等之间的关系。我们提出了一个具有职业选择和内生教师供给及教育质量的内生增长模型。我们表明，内生学校质量以具有新政策含义的方式改变了这些关系的形态。首先，增长取决于公共教育支出的水平和人力资本分布的形态。其次，公共教育与不平等之间的关系既可以是正的也可以是负的。将我们的模型校准到美国各州数据，我们发现相当大比例的州在通过公共教育支出增加增长和减少不平等之间面临权衡。我们发现，这种权衡在公共教育支出、教师就业份额和相对工资以及代际流动性较高的州总体上更可能出现。最后，这种权衡的存在取决于公共教育支出的融资方式。

records.title_en: A fiscal theory of money and bank liquidity provision
records.title_cn: 货币与银行流动性供给的财政理论
records.abstract_en: Fiscal-backed money can provide additional liquidity to consumers and mitigate the liquidity shortage problem in an economy with banks where agents face idiosyncratic liquidity shocks without being fully insured. The government issues fiat money and creates real value for money by levying a tax and accepting money for tax payments. Tax reallocates the distribution of liquidity in the economy. An increase in tax, by increasing fiscal surplus and the real value of money, reduces the equilibrium investment. Additionally, imposing taxes influences the incentive of private information production, which may impose a constraint on optimal fiscal policy.
records.abstract_cn: 财政支持的货币可以为消费者提供额外流动性，并在存在银行的经济中缓解流动性短缺问题，在该经济中，代理人面临特质性流动性冲击且未完全保险。政府发行法定货币，并通过征税和接受货币用于纳税来为货币创造实际价值。税收重新分配了经济中的流动性分布。税收增加，通过增加财政盈余和货币的实际价值，降低了均衡投资。此外，征税影响私人信息生产的激励，这可能对最优财政政策施加约束。

records.title_en: Bayesian persuasion with costly information acquisition
records.title_cn: 成本信息获取下的贝叶斯说服
records.abstract_en: We consider a Bayesian persuasion model, in which the receiver can gather independent information about the state at a uniformly posterior-separable cost. We show that the sender provides information that prevents the receiver from gathering independent information in equilibrium. When the receiver faces a lower cost of information, her ‘threat’ of gathering independent information increases, thus decreasing the sender's power to persuade. Lower cost of information can also hurt the receiver, because the sender may provide strictly less information in equilibrium. Furthermore, we propose a solution method that can be used to solve our model in specific applications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个贝叶斯说服模型，其中接收者可以以均匀后验可分离的成本收集关于状态的独立信息。我们表明，发送者提供的信息在均衡中阻止了接收者收集独立信息。当接收者面临较低的信息成本时，她收集独立信息的“威胁”增加，从而降低了发送者的说服力。较低的信息成本也可能损害接收者，因为发送者在均衡中可能提供严格更少的信息。此外，我们提出了一种可用于在特定应用中解决我们模型的求解方法。

records.title_en: Optimal contingent delegation
records.title_cn: 最优或有委托
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates a two-agent mechanism design problem without transfers, where the principal must decide one action for each agent. In our framework, agents only care about their own adaptation, and any deterministic dominant incentive compatible decision rule is equivalent to contingent delegation: the delegation set offered to one agent depends on the other's report. By contrast, the principal cares about both adaptation and coordination. We provide sufficient conditions under which contingent interval delegation is optimal and solve the optimal contingent interval delegation under fairly general conditions. Remarkably, the optimal interval delegation is completely determined by combining and modifying the solutions to a class of simple single-agent problems, where the other agent is assumed to report truthfully and choose his most preferred action.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个无转移支付的两代理人机制设计问题，其中委托人必须为每个代理人决定一个行动。在我们的框架中，代理人只关心自身的适应性，任何确定性占优激励相容决策规则都等价于或有委托：提供给一个代理人的委托集合取决于另一个代理人的报告。相比之下，委托人既关心适应性也关心协调性。我们提供了在或有区间委托最优的充分条件，并在相当一般的条件下求解了最优或有区间委托。值得注意的是，最优区间委托完全由一类简单单代理人问题的解组合和修改决定，其中假设另一个代理人如实报告并选择其最偏好的行动。

records.title_en: Money-metrics in local welfare analysis: Pareto improvements and equity considerations
records.title_cn: 地方福利分析中的货币度量：帕累托改进与公平考量
records.abstract_en: We identify local Pareto improvements from a valuation equilibrium, and extend the results of Hirshleifer, Arrow-Lind, Milleron, and Radner on the evaluation of small projects to behavioral or nonstandard choice models. We use the sign of directional derivative of the sum of McKenzie-Samuelson money metrics to evaluate small projects, but, rather than assume its differentiability, furnish preference conditions that guarantee it. Our methods yield, as an unintended consequence, (i) a refutation of Samuelson's (1974) conjecture that the money metric is locally concave in a neighborhood of a demand point, thereby settling an issue open for five decades; and (ii) a substantive extension of the 1988 Blackorby-Donaldson theorem that the money metric is concave in consumption only if preferences are quasihomothetic. We explain some equity implications of our local-welfare result, and as part of the rehabilitation of money metrics, suggest a case for using a second-order approximation to a money metric for local welfare. We illustrate when our results hold and don't hold with several non-standard choice models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们从估值均衡中识别出局部帕累托改进，并将Hirshleifer、Arrow-Lind、Milleron和Radner关于小项目评估的结果扩展到行为或非标准选择模型。我们使用McKenzie-Samuelson货币度量之和的方向导数符号来评估小项目，但并非假设其可微性，而是提供保证其可微性的偏好条件。我们的方法作为意外结果，产生了（i）对Samuelson（1974）关于货币度量在需求点邻域内局部凹性的猜想的反驳，从而解决了悬而未决五十年之久的问题；（ii）对Blackorby-Donaldson（1988）定理的实质性扩展，该定理认为货币度量仅在偏好拟位似时才是消费的凹函数。我们解释了局部福利结果的一些公平含义，并在货币度量复兴的背景下，建议使用货币度量的二阶近似进行局部福利分析。我们通过几个非标准选择模型说明了我们的结果何时成立及何时不成立。

records.title_en: Learning and selfconfirming equilibria in network games
records.title_cn: 网络博弈中的学习与自我确认均衡
records.abstract_en: Consider a set of agents who play a network game repeatedly. Agents may not know the network. They may even be unaware that they are interacting with other agents in a network. Possibly, they just understand that their optimal action depends on an unknown state that is, actually, an aggregate of the actions of their neighbors. In each period, every agent chooses an action that maximizes her instantaneous subjective expected payoff and then updates her beliefs according to what she observes. In particular, we assume that each agent only observes her realized payoff. A steady state of the resulting dynamic is a selfconfirming equilibrium given the assumed feedback.
records.abstract_cn: 考虑一组在重复进行的网络博弈中互动的代理人。代理人可能不知道网络结构。他们甚至可能没有意识到自己正在与网络中的其他代理人互动。可能他们只是理解到自己的最优行动依赖于一个未知状态，而该状态实际上是其邻居行动的加总。在每个时期，每个代理人选择使其瞬时主观期望收益最大化的行动，然后根据其观察到的信息更新信念。特别地，我们假设每个代理人只观察到其实现的收益。在给定假设反馈下，由此产生的动态的稳态即为自我确认均衡。

records.title_en: On perfect pairwise stable networks
records.title_cn: 关于完美成对稳定网络
records.abstract_en: We extend standard tools from equilibrium refinement theory in non-cooperative games to a cooperative framework of network formation. First, we introduce the new concept of perfect pairwise stability. It transposes the idea of “trembling hand” perfection to network formation theory and strictly refines the pairwise stability concept of Jackson and Wolinsky (1996). Second, we study basic properties of perfect pairwise stability: existence, admissibility and perturbation. We further show that our concept is distinct from the concept of strongly stable networks introduced by Jackson and Van den Nouweland (2005), and perfect Nash equilibria of the Myerson network formation game studied by Calvó-Armengol and İlkılıç (2009). Finally, we apply perfect pairwise stability to sequential network formation and prove that it enables a refinement of sequential pairwise stability, a natural analogue of subgame perfection in a setting with cooperative, pairwise link formation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将非合作博弈中均衡精炼理论的标准工具扩展到网络形成的合作框架中。首先，我们引入了完美成对稳定性的新概念。它将“颤抖手”完美性的思想转置到网络形成理论中，并严格精炼了Jackson和Wolinsky（1996）的成对稳定性概念。其次，我们研究了完美成对稳定性的基本性质：存在性、可接受性和扰动性。我们进一步表明，我们的概念不同于Jackson和Van den Nouweland（2005）引入的强稳定网络概念，也不同于Calvó-Armengol和İlkılıç（2009）研究的Myerson网络形成博弈中的完美纳什均衡。最后，我们将完美成对稳定性应用于序贯网络形成，并证明它能够精炼序贯成对稳定性，这是在具有合作性、成对链接形成的环境中子博弈完美性的自然类比。

records.title_en: Information transmission in voluntary disclosure games
records.title_cn: 自愿披露博弈中的信息传递
records.abstract_en: Does a better-informed sender transmit more accurate information in equilibrium? We show that, in a general class of voluntary disclosure games, unlike other strategic communication environments, the answer is positive. If the sender's evidence is more Blackwell informative, then the receiver's equilibrium utility increases. We apply our main result to show that an uninformed sender who chooses a test from a Blackwell-ordered set does so efficiently.
records.abstract_cn: 在均衡中，信息更充分的发送者会传递更准确的信息吗？我们证明，在一类一般的自愿披露博弈中，与其他战略沟通环境不同，答案是肯定的。如果发送者的证据更具布莱克威尔信息量，那么接收者的均衡效用会增加。我们应用我们的主要结果来表明，一个不知情的发送者从布莱克威尔有序集合中选择测试时，会高效地这样做。

records.title_en: A test of (weak) certainty independence
records.title_cn: （弱）确定性独立性检验
records.abstract_en: We provide a test of the axioms of certainty and weak certainty independence in models of decision-making under subjective uncertainty.
