We show that it is through these two weakenings of the classic independence axiom that prominent ambiguity models retain properties that stand in conflict with the ambiguity-sensitive behavior that is revealed in our experiment. Our findings suggest that this conflict may be of a more fundamental nature than what most of these models can accommodate. Our results call for the use of ambiguity models that can accommodate an ambiguity attitude which depends on the chances of winning.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了主观不确定性下决策模型中确定性和弱确定性独立性公理的检验。我们表明，正是通过这些对经典独立性公理的两种弱化，著名的模糊模型保留了与我们实验中揭示的模糊敏感行为相冲突的性质。我们的发现表明，这种冲突可能比这些模型中的大多数所能容纳的更为根本。我们的结果呼吁使用能够容纳依赖于获胜机会的模糊态度的模糊模型。

records.title_en: Coherence without rationality at the zero lower bound
records.title_cn: 零下限处的无理性一致性
records.abstract_en: Standard rational expectations models with an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint either admit no solutions (incoherence) or multiple solutions (incompleteness). This paper shows that deviations from full-information rational expectations mitigate concerns about incoherence and incompleteness. Models with no rational expectations equilibria admit self-confirming equilibria involving the use of simple mis-specified forecasting models. Completeness and coherence are restored if expectations are adaptive or if agents are less forward-looking due to some information or behavioral friction. In the case of incompleteness, the E-stability criterion selects an equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 具有偶尔约束的零下限约束的标准理性预期模型要么没有解（不一致），要么有多个解（不完全）。本文表明，偏离完全信息理性预期的做法减轻了对不一致和不完全的担忧。没有理性预期均衡的模型允许存在涉及使用简单错误设定预测模型的自确认均衡。如果预期是适应性的，或者由于某些信息或行为摩擦而使代理人的前瞻性减弱，则完整性和一致性得以恢复。在不完全的情况下，E-稳定性准则选择一个均衡。

records.title_en: Comparing information in general monotone decision problems
records.title_cn: 一般单调决策问题中的信息比较
records.abstract_en: I study the value of information in monotone decision problems with potentially multidimensional action spaces. As a criterion for comparing information structures, I develop a condition called monotone quasi-garbling, which involves adding reversely monotone noise to an existing information structure. Specifically, this noise is more likely to return a higher signal in a lower state and a lower signal in a higher state. I show that monotone quasi-garbling is a necessary and sufficient condition for decision makers to obtain a higher ex-ante expected payoff. This new criterion refines the garbling condition by Blackwell (1951, 1953) and is equivalent to the accuracy condition by Lehmann (1988) under the monotone likelihood ratio property. To illustrate, I apply the result to problems in nonlinear monopoly pricing and optimal insurance.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了在可能具有多维行动空间的单调决策问题中信息的价值。作为比较信息结构的一个标准，我提出了一个称为单调拟噪声化的条件，该条件涉及向现有信息结构添加反向单调噪声。具体来说，这种噪声更可能在较低状态下返回较高的信号，在较高状态下返回较低的信号。我证明了单调拟噪声化是决策者获得更高事前期望收益的必要且充分条件。这一新标准细化了Blackwell（1951，1953）的噪声化条件，并在单调似然比性质下等价于Lehmann（1988）的精确性条件。为了说明，我将该结果应用于非线性垄断定价和最优保险问题。

records.title_en: Rational inattention in the frequency domain
records.title_cn: 频域中的理性疏忽
records.abstract_en: This paper solves a dynamic rational inattention problem by formulating it in the frequency domain. The main result is a rational inattention version of the classical Wiener-Kolmogorov filter. This filter permits an infinite-dimensional state vector, provides a new line of attack for obtaining closed-form solutions, and can be implemented numerically using a simple iterative algorithm. The frequency-domain approach also sheds new light on why rational inattention produces forward-looking behavior: inattentive agents are willing to accept more uncertainty about the timing of disturbances in exchange for less uncertainty about fluctuations at the most important frequencies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过在频域中构建动态理性疏忽问题来求解该问题。主要结果是经典维纳-科尔莫戈罗夫滤波器的理性疏忽版本。该滤波器允许无限维状态向量，为获得闭式解提供了新的途径，并可通过简单的迭代算法进行数值实现。频域方法还揭示了理性疏忽为何会产生前瞻性行为的新见解：疏忽的代理人愿意接受更多关于扰动时点的不确定性，以换取在最重要频率上波动的不确定性减少。

records.title_en: Strength of preference over complementary pairs axiomatizes alpha-MEU preferences
records.title_cn: 互补对上的偏好强度公理化α-最大最小期望效用偏好
records.abstract_en: Preferences over acts have an α-Maxmin Expected Utility (α-MEU) representation if they can be represented by the α-mixture of the worst and the best expected utility over a set of priors. The case α=1 is the Maxmin Expected Utility (MEU) model characterized in Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989).
records.abstract_cn: 如果行为上的偏好可以通过对一组先验上的最差和最好期望效用的α-混合来表示，则它们具有α-最大最小期望效用（α-MEU）表示。α=1的情形是Gilboa和Schmeidler（1989）中刻画的最大最小期望效用（MEU）模型。

records.title_en: Equality in legislative bargaining
records.title_cn: 立法谈判中的平等
records.abstract_en: I study a distributive model of legislative bargaining in which the surplus generated by a winning coalition equals the sum of productivities of coalition members. The heterogeneous ability of players to generate surplus leads to asymmetric bargaining prospects in otherwise symmetric environments. More productive players are recruited more often by other players despite having higher expected payoffs; however, the players who are recruited in every coalition have equal expected payoffs despite having different productivity. I show that an increase in the required quota raises equality as measured by the Gini coefficient. The distribution of expected payoffs is more equal than the distribution of productivities but this advantage disappears under the less-than-unanimity voting as players become perfectly patient.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个分配性的立法谈判模型，在该模型中，获胜联盟产生的剩余等于联盟成员生产力的总和。参与者在产生剩余方面的异质能力导致了在其他对称环境中不对称的谈判前景。生产力更高的参与者尽管预期收益更高，却更常被其他参与者招募；然而，在每个联盟中都被招募的参与者尽管生产力不同，却拥有相等的预期收益。我表明，所需配额的增加会提高以基尼系数衡量的平等程度。预期收益的分配比生产力的分配更平等，但这种优势在非一致同意投票规则下随着参与者变得完全耐心而消失。

records.title_en: Randomization is optimal in the robust principal-agent problem
records.title_cn: 随机化在稳健委托-代理问题中是最优的
records.abstract_en: A principal contracts with an agent, who takes a hidden action. The principal does not know all of the actions the agent can take and evaluates her payoff from any contract according to its worst-case performance. Carroll (2015) showed that there exists a linear contract that is optimal within the class of deterministic contracts. This paper shows that, whenever there is an optimal linear contract with non-zero slope, the principal can strictly increase her payoff by randomizing over deterministic, linear contracts. Hence, if the principal believes that randomization can alleviate her ambiguity aversion, then restricting attention to the study of deterministic contracts is with loss of generality.
records.abstract_cn: 委托人（principal）与代理人（agent）签订契约，代理人采取隐藏行动。委托人并不知晓代理人可能采取的所有行动，并根据任何契约的最坏情况表现来评估其收益。Carroll（2015）证明了在确定性契约类别中存在一个最优的线性契约。本文表明，只要存在一个斜率非零的最优线性契约，委托人就可以通过对确定性线性契约进行随机化来严格提高其收益。因此，如果委托人相信随机化能够缓解其模糊厌恶，那么将注意力限制在确定性契约的研究上就会丧失一般性。

records.title_en: Opinion aggregation: Borda and Condorcet revisited
records.title_cn: 意见聚合：重新审视博尔达与孔多塞
records.abstract_en: In a world admitting a fixed finite set of alternatives, an opinion is an ordered pair of alternatives. Such a pair expresses the idea that one alternative is superior to another in some sense, and an opinion aggregator assigns an aggregate relation on the set of alternatives to every possible state of opinion. Our primary motivation is to extend the standard model of social choice theory to a more general one in which no specific reference to agents generating or holding opinions is needed. Although our analysis has some bearing on those cases where opinions reflect the goodness relations of agents in a society, it is not limited to them. In addition to that interpretation, opinions can also be used to represent other forms of comparative assessments emerging from different sources. The main results of the paper provide characterizations of two essential aggregation methods that remain well-defined in our larger context. These are the Borda rule and Condorcet's majority rule formulated in terms of opinion aggregation. Moreover, we show that these two opinion aggregators agree with the plurality rule and with the approval-voting rule when opinions are generated by ballots that are specific to these two well-established voting rules.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个承认固定有限备选方案集合的世界中，一个意见是备选方案的有序对。这样的有序对表达了某一备选方案在某种意义下优于另一备选方案的想法，而意见聚合器将备选方案集合上的一个聚合关系分配给每一种可能的意见状态。我们的主要动机是将社会选择理论的标准模型扩展到一个更一般的模型，在该模型中无需具体提及产生或持有意见的个体。尽管我们的分析对意见反映社会中个体优劣关系的情况有一定影响，但并不限于此。除了这种解释外，意见还可以用来表示来自不同来源的其他形式的比较评估。本文的主要结果提供了在我们更大背景下仍然定义良好的两种基本聚合方法的特征刻画。这两种方法是博尔达规则和以意见聚合形式表述的孔多塞多数规则。此外，我们表明，当意见由特定于这两种既定投票规则的选票产生时，这两种意见聚合器与 plurality 规则和 approval-voting 规则一致。

records.title_en: Continuous implementation with payoff knowledge
records.title_cn: 具有收益知识的连续实施
records.abstract_en: The literature on robust mechanism design assumes players' knowledge about a fixed payoff environment and investigates global robustness of optimal mechanisms to large changes in the information structure. Acknowledging global robustness as a demanding requirement, we propose continuous implementation as a notion of local robustness. Keeping the assumption of payoff knowledge, we say that an SCF is continuously implementable if there exists a mechanism which yields the outcome close to the desired one for all types close to the planner's initial model. We show that when a generic correlation condition is imposed on the class of interdependent-value environments, any (interim) incentive compatible SCF is continuously implementable with arbitrarily small transfers imposed on and off the equilibrium. This stands in stark contrast to Bergemann and Morris (2005), who show that their global robustness amounts to ex post incentive compatibility, as well as to Oury and Tercieux (2012), who show that continuous implementation without payoff knowledge generates a substantial restriction on the SCF, tightly connected to full implementation in rationalizable strategies.
records.abstract_cn: 关于稳健机制设计的文献假设参与者对固定收益环境具有知识，并研究最优机制对信息结构大幅变化的全局稳健性。鉴于全局稳健性是一个要求较高的概念，我们提出连续实施作为局部稳健性的一种概念。在保持收益知识假设的前提下，我们说一个社会选择函数（SCF）是连续可实施的，如果存在一个机制，使得对于所有接近规划者初始模型的类型，其结果都接近期望结果。我们证明，当对相互依赖价值环境类别施加一个一般的相关性条件时，任何（中期）激励相容的SCF都可以通过施加在均衡上和非均衡上的任意小转移来实现连续实施。这与Bergemann和Morris（2005）形成鲜明对比，他们表明其全局稳健性等同于事后激励相容性，也与Oury和Tercieux（2012）形成对比，他们表明没有收益知识的连续实施会对SCF产生实质性限制，这与理性化策略中的完全实施紧密相关。

records.title_en: Signaling covertly acquired information
records.title_cn: 秘密获取信息的信号传递
records.abstract_en: We study the interplay between information acquisition and signaling. A sender decides whether to learn his type at a cost prior to taking a signaling action. A receiver observes the signaling action and responds. We characterize equilibria and apply a version of never a weak best response refinement in the environment where the information acquisition is observable as well as in the environment where it is covert. Covert information acquisition always leads to information acquisition when information is cheap. Observable information acquisition, on the other hand, does not necessarily.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究信息获取与信号传递之间的相互作用。发送者在采取信号行动之前，决定是否以一定成本了解自己的类型。接收者观察信号行动并作出回应。我们刻画了均衡，并在信息获取可观察以及秘密获取的环境中应用了从不弱最佳反应精炼的一个版本。当信息廉价时，秘密信息获取总是导致信息获取。另一方面，可观察的信息获取则不一定如此。

records.title_en: Endogenous ambiguity and rational miscommunication
records.title_cn: 内生模糊与理性误沟通
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a sender-receiver game in which both players want the receiver to choose the state-optimal action. Before observing the state, the sender observes a “contextual signal,” a payoff-irrelevant signal that correlates with states and is imperfectly shared with the receiver. Once the sender observes the state, the sender sends a message to the receiver, incurring a small messaging cost. It is shown that there is no miscommunication in any efficient equilibrium if the messaging cost is uniform or contextual information is poorly shared between players. However, if the messaging costs are different between some messages, and contextual information can affect the probability ranking of states and is shared reasonably well, any efficient equilibrium that favors the sender exhibits miscommunication. Furthermore, the messages that cause miscommunication can be coarse or ambiguous, depending on how well players share contextual information.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个发送者-接收者博弈，其中双方都希望接收者选择状态最优行动。在观察状态之前，发送者观察到一个“情境信号”，即与状态相关但与支付无关的信号，并与接收者不完全共享。一旦发送者观察到状态，发送者向接收者发送一条消息，并承担较小的消息成本。研究表明，如果消息成本是统一的，或者情境信息在双方之间共享不佳，则任何有效均衡中都不存在误沟通。然而，如果某些消息之间的消息成本不同，并且情境信息能够影响状态的概率排序且共享得相当好，则任何偏向发送者的有效均衡都会表现出误沟通。此外，导致误沟通的消息可以是粗糙的或模糊的，具体取决于双方共享情境信息的程度。

records.title_en: On the foundations of competitive search equilibrium with and without market makers
records.title_cn: 论有无市场做市商的竞争性搜索均衡的基础
records.abstract_en: The literature offers two interpretations of competitive search equilibrium, one based on a Nash approach and the other on a market-maker approach. When each buyer visits only one seller, the two approaches are equivalent. However, when each buyer visits multiple sellers, this equivalence can break down. We present a model in which every buyer visits 2 sellers. A buyer who trades with one seller receives a value of s, while a buyer who trades with 2 sellers receives value 1. Letting s vary from 0 (perfect complements) to 1 (perfect substitutes) we characterize the competitive search equilibrium under the two interpretations. We show that for low values of s, the Nash and market-maker competitive search equilibria coincide, but the common equilibrium is inefficient. For intermediate values of s, the two equilibria again coincide and are efficient. Finally, for high values of s, the Nash and market-maker equilibria differ, and only the latter is efficient.
records.abstract_cn: 文献对竞争性搜索均衡提供了两种解释，一种基于纳什方法，另一种基于市场做市商方法。当每个买家只访问一个卖家时，这两种方法是等价的。然而，当每个买家访问多个卖家时，这种等价性可能会被打破。我们提出了一个模型，其中每个买家访问2个卖家。与一个卖家交易的买家获得价值s，而与2个卖家交易的买家获得价值1。让s从0（完全互补）变化到1（完全替代），我们刻画了两种解释下的竞争性搜索均衡。我们表明，对于较低的s值，纳什和市场做市商的竞争性搜索均衡重合，但共同均衡是无效率的。对于中间的s值，两种均衡再次重合且是有效率的。最后，对于较高的s值，纳什和市场做市商的均衡不同，且只有后者是有效率的。

records.title_en: Best-response dynamics in directed network games
records.title_cn: 有向网络博弈中的最优反应动态
records.abstract_en: We study public goods games played on networks with possibly non-reciprocal relationships between players. These include one-sided relationships, mutual but unequal relationships, and parasitism. It is known that many learning processes converge to the game's Nash equilibrium if interactions are reciprocal, but this is not true in general for directed networks. Under one-sided and parasitic relationships, best-response dynamics may cycle. The production of the locally public good of players may fail to converge to an equilibrium, making static analysis less insightful in an applied setting. In this paper we show that the strong convergence results of the undirected case are retained for two economically relevant classes of directed networks: those with transitive relative importance of players and those rescalable into networks with weak externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在玩家之间可能存在非互惠关系的网络上进行的公共品博弈。这些关系包括单向关系、互惠但不平等的关系以及寄生关系。已知在许多学习过程中，如果互动是互惠的，则会收敛到博弈的纳什均衡，但对于有向网络，这通常不成立。在单向和寄生关系下，最优反应动态可能会循环。玩家本地公共品的生产可能无法收敛到均衡，这使得静态分析在应用环境中缺乏洞察力。在本文中，我们证明了无向情况下的强收敛结果对于两类经济上有意义的有向网络仍然成立：那些具有传递性相对重要性的玩家网络和那些可重新缩放为弱外部性网络的网络。

records.title_en: The effects of rivalry on scientific progress under public vs private learning
records.title_cn: 公共学习与私人学习下竞争对科学进步的影响
records.abstract_en: We offer a model of scientific progress in which uncertainty resolves over time. We show that rivalry leads to less experimentation, extending results for preemption games to experimentation with uncertain outcomes. We compare experimentation duration and welfare when experimental outcomes are publicly versus privately observable. We show that public learning can generate more experimentation and higher welfare when uncertainty about the feasibility of a breakthrough is large; breakthroughs are rare even when they are feasible; and experiments produce results infrequently. Our results shed light on recent criticism of the science system.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个科学进步模型，其中不确定性随时间消解。我们表明，竞争导致更少的实验，将抢占博弈的结果扩展到具有不确定结果的实验。我们比较了实验结果公开可观察与私下可观察时的实验持续时间和福利。我们表明，当突破可行性的不确定性较大时，公共学习可以产生更多的实验和更高的福利；即使突破可行，突破也很罕见；并且实验产生结果的频率较低。我们的结果为最近对科学体系的批评提供了启示。

records.title_en: Information design through scarcity and social learning
records.title_cn: 通过稀缺性和社会学习进行信息设计
records.abstract_en: We show that a firm may benefit from strategically creating scarcity for its product, in order to trigger herding behaviour from consumers in situations where such behaviour is otherwise unlikely. We consider a setting with social learning, where consumers observe sales from previous cohorts and update beliefs about product quality before making their purchase. Imposing a capacity constraint directly limits sales but also makes information coarser for consumers, who react favourably to a sell-out because they infer only that demand must exceed capacity. Consumer learning is then limited even with large cohorts and unbounded private signals, because the firm acts strategically to influence the consumers' learning environment. Our results suggest that in suitable environments capacity constraints can serve as a useful tool to implement optimal information design in practice: if private signals are not too precise and capacity can be changed over time, then in large markets the firm's optimal choice of capacity delivers the same expected sales as the Bayesian persuasion solution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，企业可能通过战略性地制造产品稀缺性而受益，以在消费者行为通常不太可能发生从众行为的情况下触发从众行为。我们考虑一个具有社会学习的设定，其中消费者观察前几批次的销售情况，并在购买前更新对产品质量的信念。施加产能约束直接限制了销售，但也使消费者的信息变得粗糙，消费者对售罄反应积极，因为他们仅推断需求必定超过产能。即使有大批次和无界私人信号，消费者学习也是有限的，因为企业战略性地行动以影响消费者的学习环境。我们的结果表明，在合适的环境中，产能约束可以作为实践中实施最优信息设计的有用工具：如果私人信号不是太精确且产能可以随时间变化，那么在大型市场中，企业的最优产能选择带来的预期销售与贝叶斯说服解决方案相同。

records.title_en: Asset bubbles, entrepreneurial risks, and economic growth
records.title_cn: 资产泡沫、创业风险与经济增长
records.abstract_en: Entrepreneurs are exposed to large uninsured risks, which may discourage them from creating productive assets. This may generate productive asset shortages and stimulate speculative demand for bubbles. This study introduces uninsured entrepreneurial risks into a textbook growth model with infinitely-lived agents. In the model, entrepreneurs face no credit constraints. If the degree of entrepreneurial risks is in the middle range, bubbles are likely to emerge. If the degree is high, bubbles promote growth because of the wealth effect. Otherwise, bubbles lower growth. The effect of the collapse of bubbles also depends on the degree of the risks. Moreover, asset bubbles amplify a small and temporal negative technology shock.
records.abstract_cn: 创业者面临大量未保险的风险，这可能阻碍他们创造生产性资产。这可能导致生产性资产短缺，并刺激对泡沫的投机需求。本研究将未保险的创业风险引入一个具有无限期生命主体的教科书式增长模型中。在该模型中，创业者不面临信贷约束。如果创业风险程度处于中等范围，泡沫可能出现。如果风险程度较高，泡沫会通过财富效应促进增长。否则，泡沫会降低增长。泡沫破裂的影响也取决于风险程度。此外，资产泡沫会放大一个微小且暂时的负面技术冲击。

records.title_en: Motivated naivete
records.title_cn: 动机性天真
records.abstract_en: We study a decision maker's ex-ante choices over menus. The decision maker has in mind a set of possible future preferences that can be justified, for instance, by her past behavior, and she naively evaluates each menu according to the best option in the menu among those that can be rationalized by her future preferences. We provide a characterization for this menu preference, discuss the uniqueness of its representation, and propose a comparative measure of the decision maker's naivete. We apply our model to study two behavioral biases: naivete about present bias and the disjunction effect.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究决策者对菜单的事前选择。决策者心中有一组可能的未来偏好，这些偏好可以例如由她过去的行为来证明其合理性，而她天真地根据菜单中那些能被其未来偏好合理化的最佳选项来评估每个菜单。我们为这种菜单偏好提供了特征化描述，讨论了其表示的独特性，并提出了决策者天真程度的比较度量。我们将模型应用于研究两种行为偏差：对现时偏差的天真和分离效应。

records.title_en: Information, market power and welfare
records.title_cn: 信息、市场势力与福利
records.abstract_en: We study the market for a risky asset in which traders are heterogeneous both in terms of their value for the asset and the information that they have about this value. Traders behave strategically and use the equilibrium price to extract information that is relevant to them. Due to adverse selection, uninformed traders are less willing than the informed to provide liquidity. We evaluate the impact of a change in the size or composition of the investor population on price informativeness, liquidity and welfare, with applications to the rise of passive investing and the adoption of ESG standards.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个风险资产市场，其中交易者在其资产价值以及他们关于该价值所拥有的信息方面都是异质的。交易者行为具有策略性，并利用均衡价格来提取与他们相关的信息。由于逆向选择，不知情交易者比知情交易者更不愿意提供流动性。我们评估投资者群体规模或构成的变化对价格信息含量、流动性和福利的影响，并将其应用于被动投资的兴起和ESG标准的采纳。

records.title_en: Selecting a winner with external referees
records.title_cn: 借助外部评审选择获胜者
records.abstract_en: We consider a problem of mechanism design without money, where a planner selects a winner among a set of agents with binary types and receives outside signals (like the report of external referees). We show that there is a gap between the optimal Dominant Strategy Incentive Compatible (DSIC) mechanism and the optimal Bayesian Incentive Compatible (BIC) mechanism. In the optimal BIC mechanism, the planner can leverage the outside signal to elicit information about agents' types. BIC mechanisms are lexicographic mechanisms, where the planner first shortlists agents who receive high reports from the referees and then uses agents' reports to break ties among agents in the shortlist. We compare the “self-evaluation” mechanism with a “peer evaluation” mechanism where agents evaluate other agents, and show that for the same signal precision, the self- evaluation mechanism outperforms the peer evaluation mechanism. We show that optimal Ex Post Incentive Compatible (EPIC) mechanisms give the planner an intermediate value between the optimal DSIC and BIC mechanisms
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个无货币机制设计问题，其中计划者在一组具有二元类型的代理人中选出一名获胜者，并接收外部信号（如外部评审的报告）。我们表明，最优占优策略激励相容（DSIC）机制与最优贝叶斯激励相容（BIC）机制之间存在差距。在最优BIC机制中，计划者可以利用外部信号来获取关于代理人类型的信息。BIC机制是字典序机制，其中计划者首先筛选出获得评审高报告的代理人，然后利用代理人的报告在候选名单中的代理人之间打破平局。我们比较了“自我评估”机制与“同行评估”机制（代理人评估其他代理人），并表明在相同信号精度下，自我评估机制优于同行评估机制。我们表明，最优事后激励相容（EPIC）机制为计划者提供了介于最优DSIC和BIC机制之间的中间值。

records.title_en: Renegotiation and dynamic inconsistency: Contracting with non-exponential discounting
records.title_cn: 重新谈判与动态不一致：非指数贴现下的契约设计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a continuous-time, finite-horizon contracting problem with renegotiation and dynamic inconsistency arising from non-exponential discounting. The problem is formulated as a dynamic game played among the agent, the principal and their respective future “selves”, each with their own discount function. We identify the principal optimal renegotiation-proof contract as a Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) of the game, prove that such an MPE exists, and characterize the optimal contract via an extended Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman system. We solve the optimal contract in closed-form when discounting is a function of the time-difference only and demonstrate the applicability of the results in several different settings.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了连续时间、有限期限的重新谈判契约问题，该问题源于非指数贴现导致的动态不一致。该问题被构建为代理人、委托人及其各自未来“自我”之间的动态博弈，每个参与者都有自己的贴现函数。我们确定了委托人最优的防重新谈判契约作为博弈的马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE），证明了该MPE的存在性，并通过扩展的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman系统刻画了最优契约。当贴现函数仅依赖于时间差时，我们以闭式解形式求解了最优契约，并在多个不同情境中展示了结果的适用性。

records.title_en: Talent, basic research and growth
records.title_cn: 人才、基础研究与增长
records.abstract_en: Due to the public good nature of basic research, the mechanisms for rewarding talent are very different from those prevailing in the production of applied research by private actors. We develop a growth model in which such mechanisms are taken explicitly into account. This allows us to address the following fundamental questions: how do policies in the public research sector influence the effort and risk-taking decisions of researchers of different talent? How do these choices affect the aggregate production of basic research? What is the final impact on growth? The analysis shows that the design of research evaluation policies crucially affects both the long run rate of growth and the relationship between taxation and growth. A key and novel channel through which this occurs is the effect of basic research policy on the expected non-monetary benefits from being a researcher.
records.abstract_cn: 由于基础研究的公共产品性质，人才奖励机制与私人行为者进行应用研究的机制大不相同。我们构建了一个增长模型，明确考虑了这些机制。这使我们能够解决以下基本问题：公共研究部门的政策如何影响不同才能研究者的努力和风险承担决策？这些选择如何影响基础研究的总体产出？对增长的最终影响是什么？分析表明，研究评估政策的设计对长期增长率和税收与增长之间的关系都有至关重要的影响。实现这一影响的一个关键且新颖的渠道是基础研究政策对研究者预期非货币收益的影响。

records.title_en: Collateral and bank screening as complements: A spillover effect
records.title_cn: 抵押品与银行筛选的互补性：一种溢出效应
records.abstract_en: I analyze a novel spillover effect from collateralized to uncollateralized loans. High-type borrowers have good projects, while low-type borrowers do not know their project quality. High-type borrowers post collateral, and a monopolist bank screens only low-type borrowers' projects. Different from existing models, equilibrium collateral requirements are stricter than the minimum necessary to achieve separation, even if collateral is costly. When high-type borrowers post more collateral, the bank charges a higher interest rate to low-type borrowers. This, in turn, enhances the bank's incentives to screen the low-types' projects, thereby improving the average quality of uncollateralized loans.
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了一种从抵押贷款到无抵押贷款的新型溢出效应。高类型借款人拥有好项目，而低类型借款人不知道其项目质量。高类型借款人提供抵押品，垄断银行仅筛选低类型借款人的项目。与现有模型不同，均衡抵押品要求比实现分离所需的最低要求更严格，即使抵押品是有成本的。当高类型借款人提供更多抵押品时，银行对低类型借款人收取更高的利率。这反过来增强了银行筛选低类型项目的激励，从而提高了无抵押贷款的平均质量。

records.title_en: Task allocation and on-the-job training
records.title_cn: 任务分配与在职培训
records.abstract_en: We study dynamic task allocation when providers' expertise evolves endogenously through training. We characterize optimal assignment protocols and compare them to discretionary procedures, where it is the clients who select their service providers. Our results indicate that welfare gains from centralization are greater when tasks arrive more rapidly, and when training technologies improve. Monitoring seniors' backlog of clients always increases welfare but may decrease training. Methodologically, we explore a matching setting with endogenous types, and illustrate useful adaptations of queueing theory techniques for such environments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当服务提供者的专业知识通过培训内生演化时的动态任务分配问题。我们刻画了最优分配协议，并将其与由客户自行选择服务提供者的自由裁量程序进行比较。我们的结果表明，当任务到达更频繁以及培训技术改进时，集中化带来的福利收益更大。监控资深服务提供者的客户积压情况总是能提高福利，但可能减少培训。在方法论上，我们探索了一个具有内生类型的匹配设定，并展示了排队论技术在此类环境中的有用改编。

records.title_en: The negative value of private information in illiquid markets
records.title_cn: 非流动性市场中私人信息的负价值
records.abstract_en: In the standard perfectly competitive rational expectations model of information acquisition, the marginal benefit of private information to each trader is always positive. We show that with imperfect competition, characterized by a finite number of traders, the value of private information can be negative, resulting in a zero-information equilibrium even if information is free. This zero-information equilibrium arises when noise-trading volume is sufficiently large that price informativeness is weak, and when noise traders are sufficiently bullish or bearish. Given the evidence suggesting that retail traders behave as noise traders, our findings suggest that retail traders can play a significant role in investors' information-acquisition decisions in financial markets.
records.abstract_cn: 在标准完全竞争理性预期信息获取模型中，私人信息对每个交易者的边际收益总是正的。我们证明，在不完全竞争（以有限数量的交易者为特征）下，私人信息的价值可能为负，即使信息免费也会导致零信息均衡。当噪声交易量足够大以至于价格信息含量较弱，且噪声交易者足够看多或看空时，就会出现这种零信息均衡。鉴于有证据表明散户交易者表现为噪声交易者，我们的研究结果表明，散户交易者在金融市场投资者的信息获取决策中可以发挥重要作用。

records.title_en: Sufficient conditions for a “simple” decentralization with consumption externalities
records.title_cn: 消费外部性下“简单”分权的充分条件
records.abstract_en: We consider a pure exchange economy with consumption externalities in preferences. We use the notion of competitive equilibrium à la Nash. We provide the Social Redistribution assumption to restore the Second Welfare Theorem. We then introduce the differentiable characterizations of Social and Strong Redistribution. We show that all these conditions are weaker than other relevant assumptions studied in the literature. Our conditions entail interesting results on the decentralized implementation of Pareto optima, that link together the competitive supporting price and the shadow price of the utilitarian social planner. Finally, we provide a specific condition for Bergson-Samuelson utility functions, which has a nice interpretation in terms of positive or negative externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个具有消费外部性偏好的纯交换经济。我们使用纳什意义上的竞争均衡概念。我们提出社会再分配假设以恢复第二福利定理。然后我们引入社会和强再分配的可微特征。我们表明所有这些条件都弱于文献中研究的其他相关假设。我们的条件产生了关于帕累托最优分散实施的有趣结果，这些结果将竞争性支持价格与功利主义社会计划者的影子价格联系起来。最后，我们为伯格森-萨缪尔森效用函数提供了一个特定条件，该条件在正或负外部性方面具有很好的解释。

records.title_en: Connecting friends
records.title_cn: 连接朋友
records.abstract_en: We study how people form networks through introductions. We consider a model where players with different ability levels are connected in a network. The players seek to match with someone they are linked to in the network (i.e., their neighbors), and they prefer high-ability neighbors over low-ability ones. We investigate whether a player will strategically introduce two unacquainted neighbors to each other to improve her own matching outcome. We find that this is possible if (i) the player making the introduction is less capable than both of the neighbors she considers introducing, and (ii) there exists an even-length alternating path—a sequence of linked players that alternate between matching and not matching with the next player on the sequence—from one of the neighbors to the introducer. The characterization based on alternating paths arises because an introduction can trigger a chain of rematches along these paths. Then, we characterize stable networks and efficient networks, and we show that stability and efficiency do not imply each other. Finally, we consider several extensions, such as alternative matching processes and incomplete information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究人们如何通过介绍形成网络。我们考虑一个模型，其中具有不同能力水平的参与者在一个网络中相连。参与者寻求与网络中与之相连的人（即他们的邻居）匹配，并且他们偏好高能力的邻居而非低能力的邻居。我们研究一个参与者是否会策略性地将两个互不相识的邻居介绍给彼此，以改善自己的匹配结果。我们发现，如果（i）进行介绍的参与者比她要介绍的两个邻居的能力都低，并且（ii）存在一条偶数长度的交替路径——即一系列相连的参与者，他们依次与序列中的下一个参与者匹配或不匹配——从其中一个邻居到介绍者，那么这种介绍是可能的。基于交替路径的特征描述之所以出现，是因为一次介绍可以触发沿着这些路径的一系列重新匹配。然后，我们刻画了稳定网络和有效网络，并表明稳定性和有效性并不相互蕴含。最后，我们考虑了几个扩展，例如替代匹配过程和不完全信息。

records.title_en: A new approach to the uniqueness of equilibrium with CRRA preferences
records.title_cn: 具有CRRA偏好的均衡唯一性新方法
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the uniqueness of equilibrium in the economy where agents have preferences with possibly distinct levels of relative risk aversion. Equilibrium prices exist in a price range determined by micro and macroeconomic information. Macroeconomic information is inferred from two representative-agent economies, which provide lower and upper bounds on aggregate demand, respectively. Analysis of the first and second-order price effects shows that individual demand has a unique inflection point at which the income effect maximally dominates the substitution effect. In contrast, aggregate demand may have multiple inflection points, which creates multiple equilibria. Sufficient conditions for the uniqueness of equilibrium are characterized by the local behavior of individual demand at the inflection point. They require that aggregate demand must have no more than two inflection points in the equilibrium price range. The result of this paper sheds light on the Sonnenschein-Mantel-Debreu theory that has negative implications for the uniqueness of equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在代理人具有可能不同相对风险厌恶水平的偏好经济中均衡的唯一性。均衡价格存在于由微观和宏观经济信息确定的价格范围内。宏观经济信息从两个代表性代理人经济中推断得出，它们分别提供了总需求的下界和上界。对一阶和二阶价格效应的分析表明，个体需求在收入效应最大程度主导替代效应的点上具有唯一的拐点。相比之下，总需求可能具有多个拐点，这导致了多重均衡。均衡唯一性的充分条件由个体需求在拐点处的局部行为刻画。这些条件要求总需求在均衡价格范围内不得有多于两个拐点。本文的结果对Sonnenschein-Mantel-Debreu理论中关于均衡唯一性的负面含义提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Information design for selling search goods and the effect of competition
records.title_cn: 销售搜索品的信息设计及竞争效应
records.abstract_en: I study optimal information provision by a search goods seller. While the seller controls a consumer's pre-search information, he cannot control post-search information because the consumer will inevitably learn the product's match after search. A relaxed problem approach is developed to solve the optimal design, which accommodates both continuous value distributions and ex-ante heterogeneous consumers with privately known outside options. The optimal design is shown to crucially depend on the outside option value distribution, and can be implemented by a simple upper-censorship signal under certain regularity conditions. Several applications are provided, including comparing information designs for search goods and experience goods, and studying the effect of competition with a large number of sellers.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了搜索品销售者的最优信息提供。虽然销售者控制消费者的搜索前信息，但他无法控制搜索后信息，因为消费者在搜索后不可避免地会了解产品的匹配度。我开发了一种松弛问题方法来求解最优设计，该方法同时适用于连续价值分布和具有私人已知外部选项的事前异质消费者。结果表明，最优设计关键取决于外部选项价值分布，并且在某些正则条件下可以通过简单的上限截断信号来实现。我提供了几个应用，包括比较搜索品和体验品的信息设计，以及研究大量销售者竞争的影响。

records.title_en: Private disclosure with multiple agents
records.title_cn: 多代理人下的私人信息披露
records.abstract_en: This study examines a mechanism design problem where the principal can affect the agents' knowledge of a payoff-relevant state, namely, the principal designs and commits to an information disclosure policy that generates agent-specific private signals, while the principal directly observes neither the state nor the signal profile. We solve this problem by constructing a novel class of disclosure policies that exhibit individually uninformative, aggregately revealing, and immune to unilateral misreporting properties and show that the principal achieves the same payoff as if she could directly observe the state and implement state-contingent allocation rules. Moreover, we prove that our disclosure policy is robust to information-sharing among a certain number of agents and remains optimal in various settings.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了一个机制设计问题，其中委托人可以影响代理人对与收益相关状态的认知，即委托人设计并承诺一种信息披露政策，该政策生成代理人特定的私人信号，而委托人既不直接观察状态也不观察信号分布。我们通过构建一类新颖的披露政策来解决这个问题，这些政策具有个体无信息、总体揭示和对单方面误报免疫的特性，并表明委托人可以实现与直接观察状态并实施状态依赖分配规则相同的收益。此外，我们证明了我们的披露政策对一定数量代理人之间的信息共享具有稳健性，并在各种设置中保持最优。

records.title_en: Loss aversion in strategy-proof school-choice mechanisms
records.title_cn: 策略证明学校选择机制中的损失厌恶
records.abstract_en: Evidence suggests that participants in strategy-proof matching mechanisms play dominated strategies. To explain the data, we introduce expectation-based loss aversion into a school-choice setting and characterize choice-acclimating personal equilibria. We find that non-truthful preference submissions can be strictly optimal if and only if they are top-rank monotone. In equilibrium, inefficiency or justified envy may arise in seemingly stable or efficient mechanisms. Specifically, students who are more loss averse or less confident than their peers obtain suboptimal allocations.
records.abstract_cn: 有证据表明，参与策略证明匹配机制的参与者会采取被支配策略。为解释这些数据，我们将基于期望的损失厌恶引入学校选择环境，并刻画了适应选择的个人均衡。我们发现，非真实偏好提交严格最优当且仅当它们是顶级排名单调的。在均衡中，看似稳定或高效的机制可能出现低效率或合理嫉妒。具体而言，比同龄人更损失厌恶或更不自信的学生会获得次优配置。

records.title_en: Maxmin expected utility in Savage's framework
records.title_cn: Savage框架下的最大最小期望效用
records.abstract_en: We axiomatize the maxmin expected utility model in Savage's original framework, which does not require a rich set of consequences nor objective probabilities. The key conditions in our result reformulate Gilboa–Schmeidler's (1989) Uncertainty Aversion and Certainty Independence for Savage's acts. Also, we propose a definition for comparative ambiguity aversion in this context.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在Savage的原始框架中对最大最小期望效用模型进行了公理化，该框架既不要求丰富的后果集，也不要求客观概率。我们结果中的关键条件重新表述了Gilboa–Schmeidler（1989）的不确定性厌恶和确定性独立性，适用于Savage的行为。此外，我们在此背景下提出了比较模糊厌恶的定义。

records.title_en: Existence of an equilibrium in arrowian markets for consumption externalities
records.title_cn: 消费外部性阿罗市场中均衡的存在性
records.abstract_en: We study the existence of quasi-equilibria and equilibria for pure exchange economies with consumption externalities and Arrowian markets with personalized Lindahl prices. We provide examples showing first that quasi-equilibria and equilibria of the externality economy fail to exist under assumptions guaranteeing existence for economies without externalities. We show that the externality economy has identical equilibrium allocations of an appropriately defined constant returns to scale production economy without externalities. We exploit this equivalence to map sufficient conditions for the existence of quasi-equilibria and equilibria of the production economy into sufficient conditions of the pure exchange economy with externalities, thereby unveiling suitable irreducibility conditions and survival conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有消费外部性和个性化林达尔价格的阿罗市场中纯交换经济的准均衡和均衡的存在性。我们提供的例子首先表明，在保证无外部性经济存在均衡的假设下，外部性经济的准均衡和均衡可能不存在。我们证明，外部性经济与一个适当定义的、无外部性的规模报酬不变生产经济具有相同的均衡配置。我们利用这一等价性，将生产经济准均衡和均衡存在的充分条件映射到具有外部性的纯交换经济的充分条件，从而揭示了适当的不可约性条件和生存条件。

records.title_en: Bargaining under almost complete information
records.title_cn: 几乎完全信息下的讨价还价
records.abstract_en: We consider the canonical frequent-offer Rubinstein bargaining game between two leaders on a policy issue. The public sentiment on this issue leans toward one leader or the other. Public sentiment determines the maximum compromise a leader can make without risking getting primaried. We introduce a positive probability ε that the leaders are uninformed about the sentiment. We show that a unique equilibrium emerges that resembles a war of attrition, in which one of the leaders may demand too much even after learning that the sentiment leans the other way. For a given bargaining environment, as ε converges to zero, in every state, the leaders almost immediately agree to the same policy position as they do under complete information. However, this convergence does not hold in the uniform sense, nor does it necessarily hold for more than two states.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在政策问题上两位领导人之间进行经典的高频出价鲁宾斯坦讨价还价博弈。公众情绪在此问题上倾向于其中一位领导人或另一位。公众情绪决定了领导人在不冒被初选击败风险的情况下所能做出的最大妥协。我们引入一个正概率ε，即领导人可能不了解公众情绪。我们证明存在一个独特的均衡，类似于消耗战，其中一位领导人即使在得知情绪倾向于另一方后，也可能要求过多。对于给定的讨价还价环境，当ε趋近于零时，在每种状态下，领导人几乎立即同意与完全信息下相同的政策立场。然而，这种收敛并非一致收敛，也不一定适用于多于两种状态的情况。

records.title_en: The analogical foundations of cooperation
records.title_cn: 合作的类比基础
records.abstract_en: We offer an approach to cooperation in repeated games of private monitoring in which players construct models of their opponents' behavior by observing the frequencies of play in a record of past plays of the game in which actions but not signals are recorded. Players construct models of their opponent's behavior by grouping the histories in the record into a relatively small number of analogy classes for which they estimate probabilities of cooperation. The incomplete record and the limited number of analogy classes lead to misspecified models that provide the incentives to cooperate. We provide conditions for the existence of equilibria supporting cooperation and equilibria supporting high payoffs for some nontrivial analogy partitions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种在私人监测的重复博弈中实现合作的方法，其中参与者通过观察博弈过去记录中行动（而非信号）的频率来构建对手行为的模型。参与者通过将记录中的历史划分为相对较少的类比类别来构建对手行为的模型，并估计这些类别中的合作概率。不完整的记录和有限的类比类别导致了错误设定的模型，这些模型为合作提供了激励。我们为支持合作的均衡以及在某些非平凡类比划分下支持高收益的均衡的存在性提供了条件。

records.title_en: Testing negative value of information and ambiguity aversion
records.title_cn: 信息负价值与模糊厌恶的检验
records.abstract_en: The standard Subjective Expected Utility model of decision-making implies that information can never have a negative value ex-ante. Many ambiguity theories have since questioned this property. We provide an experimental test of the connection between the value of information and ambiguity attitude. Our results show that the value of information can indeed be negative when new information renders hedging against ambiguity impossible. Moreover, the value of information is correlated with ambiguity aversion. This confirms the predictions from ambiguity theories and may have implications for decision-making in uncertain and dynamic environments. Neither complexity avoidance nor information with ambiguous reliability can reproduce the results.
records.abstract_cn: 标准的主观期望效用决策模型意味着信息在事前不可能具有负价值。许多模糊理论自此对这一性质提出了质疑。我们提供了一个关于信息价值与模糊态度之间联系的实验检验。我们的结果表明，当新信息使得针对模糊性的对冲变得不可能时，信息价值确实可能为负。此外，信息价值与模糊厌恶相关。这证实了模糊理论的预测，并可能对不确定和动态环境中的决策产生影响。复杂性规避和具有模糊可靠性的信息都不能重现这些结果。

records.title_en: Foreseen risks
records.title_cn: 预见风险
records.abstract_en: Large crises tend to follow rapid credit expansions. Causality, however, is far from obvious. We show how this pattern arises naturally when financial intermediaries optimally exploit economic rents that drive their franchise value. As this franchise value fluctuates over the business cycle, so too do the incentives to engage in risky lending. The model leads to novel insights on the effects of unconventional monetary policies in developed economies. We argue that bank lending might have responded less than expected to these interventions because they enhanced franchise value, inadvertently encouraging banks to pursue safer investments in low-risk government securities.
records.abstract_cn: 大型危机往往紧随快速的信贷扩张。然而，因果关系远非显而易见。我们展示了当金融中介机构最优地利用驱动其特许经营权价值的经济租金时，这种模式如何自然出现。随着这种特许经营权价值在经济周期中波动，从事风险贷款的激励也随之波动。该模型为发达经济体中非常规货币政策的效果提供了新颖的见解。我们认为，银行贷款对这些干预措施的反应可能不如预期，因为它们增强了特许经营权价值，无意中鼓励银行追求低风险政府证券中的更安全投资。

records.title_en: When (not) to publicize inspection results
records.title_cn: 何时（不）公开检查结果
records.abstract_en: We consider a dynamic inspection problem between a principal and several agents. The principal observes the full inspection history, whereas each agent only observes inspections imposed on himself. When inspection resources are limited, the inspection intensities for agents are negatively correlated, and hence each agent cares not only about his own inspection history, but also about the inspection histories of the other agents. In such cases, should the principal publicly reveal past inspection history, or should she conceal this information? We show that the principal benefits from concealing inspection history. Nevertheless, this benefit becomes less significant as the number of agents increases, and disappears in the limit case with a continuum of agents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个委托人与多个代理人之间的动态检查问题。委托人观察完整的检查历史，而每个代理人只观察施加在自己身上的检查。当检查资源有限时，各代理人的检查强度呈负相关，因此每个代理人不仅关心自己的检查历史，还关心其他代理人的检查历史。在这种情况下，委托人应该公开过去的检查历史，还是应该隐瞒这一信息？我们表明，委托人从隐瞒检查历史中获益。然而，随着代理人数量增加，这种收益变得不那么显著，并在代理人连续统的极限情况下消失。

records.title_en: The strategic decentralization of recruiting
records.title_cn: 招聘的战略性分权
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of strategic delegation in professional labor markets in which big and fringe firms compete for heterogeneous workers. In this context, big firms decide whether to exercise their market power to suppress wages (wage suppression) or to delegate hiring to divisions, thereby committing to bidding more fiercely for more skilled workers (talent acquisition). This reduces the incentive for other firms to go toe-to-toe with the decentralizing firm. In equilibrium, a big firm commanding labor market power opts for either of these two strategies. We find that the presence of a big firm in the labor market is detrimental to social welfare only if its size exceeds the tipping point beyond which it ceases to decentralize. Moreover, our model is compatible with recent studies that negatively link labor market concentration and labor share. Finally, the introduction of a wage floor encourages the big firm to decentralize, increasing match quality, such that social welfare may increase despite a drop in employment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个专业劳动力市场中战略委托的模型，其中大公司和边缘公司竞争异质性工人。在此背景下，大公司决定是行使其市场力量来压低工资（工资压制），还是将招聘委托给各部门，从而承诺更激烈地竞标技能更高的工人（人才获取）。这降低了其他公司与分权公司正面竞争的激励。在均衡中，拥有劳动力市场力量的大公司会选择这两种策略之一。我们发现，劳动力市场中大公司的存在只有在规模超过其停止分权的临界点时才对社会福利有害。此外，我们的模型与最近将劳动力市场集中度与劳动份额负相关的研究相一致。最后，引入最低工资标准鼓励大公司分权，提高匹配质量，因此尽管就业下降，社会福利仍可能增加。

records.title_en: A model of the gold standard
records.title_cn: 金本位模型
records.abstract_en: We present a micro-founded monetary model of a small open economy to examine the behavior of money, prices, and output under the gold standard. In particular, we formally analyze Hume's celebrated price-specie flow mechanism. Our framework incorporates the influence of international trade on the money supply in the Home country through gold flows. In the short run, a positive correlation exists between the quantity of money and the price level. Additionally, we demonstrate that money is non-neutral during the transition to the steady state, which has implications for welfare. While the gold standard exposes the Home country to short-term fluctuations in money, prices, and output caused by external shocks, it ensures long-term price stability as the quantity of money and prices only temporarily deviate from their steady-state levels. We discuss the importance of policy coordination for achieving efficiency under the gold standard and consider the role of fiat money in this environment. We also develop a version of the model with two large economies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个小型开放经济的微观基础货币模型，以考察金本位下货币、价格和产出的行为。特别是，我们正式分析了休谟著名的价格-铸币流动机制。我们的框架通过黄金流动将国际贸易对本国货币供应的影响纳入其中。在短期内，货币数量与价格水平之间存在正相关关系。此外，我们证明了在向稳态过渡期间货币是非中性的，这对福利具有影响。虽然金本位使本国面临由外部冲击引起的货币、价格和产出的短期波动，但它确保了长期价格稳定，因为货币数量和价格只是暂时偏离其稳态水平。我们讨论了在金本位下实现效率的政策协调的重要性，并考虑了法定货币在这种环境中的作用。我们还开发了一个包含两个大型经济体的模型版本。

records.title_en: Ambiguous information and dilation: An experiment
records.title_cn: 模糊信息与扩张：一项实验
records.abstract_en: With standard models of updating under ambiguity, new information may increase the amount of relevant ambiguity: the set of beliefs may ‘dilate.’ We experimentally test one sharp case: agents bet on a risky urn and get information that is truthful or not based on the draw from an Ellsberg urn. With common models, the set of beliefs dilates, and the value of bets decreases for ambiguity-averse agents and increases for ambiguity-seeking ones. Instead, we find that the value of bets does not change for ambiguity-averse individuals, while it increases substantially for ambiguity-seeking ones. We also test bets on ambiguous urns, in which case we find sizable reactions to ambiguous information.
records.abstract_cn: 在模糊性下的标准更新模型中，新信息可能增加相关模糊性的数量：信念集合可能‘扩张’。我们实验性地检验了一个尖锐的情形：代理人押注于一个有风险的瓮，并根据从埃尔斯伯格瓮中抽取的结果获得真实或非真实的信息。在常见模型下，信念集合扩张，对于模糊厌恶的代理人，赌注价值下降，而对于模糊寻求的代理人则上升。相反，我们发现对于模糊厌恶的个体，赌注价值不变，而对于模糊寻求的个体则显著上升。我们还测试了押注于模糊瓮的情况，在这种情况下，我们发现对模糊信息有显著的反应。

records.title_en: The folk theorem for the prisoner's dilemma with endogenous private monitoring
records.title_cn: 内生私人监督下囚徒困境的民间定理
records.abstract_en: We study the repeated prisoner's dilemma with private monitoring under the assumption that the monitoring structure is endogenously chosen by the players in each period. We allow the players to choose from all possible monitoring structures. If the players disagree on the monitoring structure they would like, the realized monitoring structure is determined by a function that aggregates their choices. When one player can dictate the monitoring structure, then the repetition of the stage Nash is the only sequential equilibrium outcome. In contrast, when no player can dictate the monitoring structure, we provide conditions on the aggregation function under which any strictly individually rational and feasible payoff vector can be supported in sequential equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在每期监督结构由参与者内生选择的假设下，具有私人监督的重复囚徒困境。我们允许参与者从所有可能的监督结构中进行选择。如果参与者对期望的监督结构意见不一致，则实际实现的监督结构由汇总其选择的函数决定。当某一参与者能够主导监督结构时，阶段纳什均衡的重复是唯一的序贯均衡结果。相反，当没有参与者能够主导监督结构时，我们提供了汇总函数的条件，在这些条件下，任何严格个体理性且可行的支付向量都可以在序贯均衡中得到支持。

records.title_en: Uniformly self-justified equilibria
records.title_cn: 一致自证均衡
records.abstract_en: We consider dynamic stochastic economies with heterogeneous agents and introduce the concept of uniformly self-justified equilibria (USJE)—temporary equilibria for which expectations satisfy the following rationality requirements: i) individuals' forecasting functions for the next period's endogenous variables are assumed to lie in a compact, finite-dimensional set of functions, and ii) the forecasts constitute the best uniform approximation to a selection of the equilibrium correspondence. We show that in contrast to rational expectations equilibria, USJE always exist, and we develop a simple algorithm to compute them. As an application, we discuss a stochastic overlapping generations exchange economy. We give an example where recursive (rational expectations) equilibria fail to exist and explain how to construct USJE for that example. In addition, we provide numerical examples to illustrate our computational method.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有异质性主体的动态随机经济，并引入一致自证均衡（USJE）的概念——即对于这些均衡，预期满足以下理性要求：i) 个体对下一期内生变量的预测函数被假定位于一个紧的、有限维的函数集合中，且ii) 预测构成对均衡对应选择的最佳一致逼近。我们表明，与理性预期均衡相反，USJE总是存在，并且我们开发了一种简单的算法来计算它们。作为一个应用，我们讨论了一个随机世代交叠交换经济。我们给出了一个递归（理性预期）均衡不存在的例子，并解释了如何为该例子构造USJE。此外，我们提供了数值例子来说明我们的计算方法。

records.title_en: Repeated communication with private lying costs
records.title_cn: 具有私人说谎成本的重复沟通
records.abstract_en: I study a repeated communication game between a patient sender and a sequence of myopic receivers. The sender has persistent private information about his cost of lying. Each period, the sender privately observes an i.i.d. state and recommends an action. The receiver takes an action after observing this recommendation and the full history of states and recommendations. I provide conditions under which a sufficiently patient sender can attain his optimal commitment payoff in the repeated game. My results provide justifications for the commitment assumption in Bayesian persuasion models using a repeated communication game without any commitment. My results also imply that the sender's equilibrium payoff is not monotone with respect to the receiver's belief about his lying cost.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个有耐心的发送者与一系列短视接收者之间的重复沟通博弈。发送者对其说谎成本拥有持久的私人信息。每个时期，发送者私下观察一个独立同分布的状态并推荐一个行动。接收者在观察到这一推荐以及状态和推荐的完整历史后采取行动。我提供了条件，在这些条件下，一个足够有耐心的发送者可以在重复博弈中达到其最优承诺收益。我的结果为贝叶斯说服模型中无需任何承诺的重复沟通博弈中的承诺假设提供了合理性依据。我的结果还意味着，发送者的均衡收益相对于接收者对其说谎成本的信念不是单调的。

records.title_en: Structural unemployment, underemployment, and secular stagnation
records.title_cn: 结构性失业、就业不足与长期停滞
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that underemployment and not necessarily high unemployment becomes the main measure of economic slack in the labor market under secular stagnation. Specifically, involuntary underemployment in the form of a persistent shortfall of working hours occurs in the search and matching model, provided that households derive utility from holding wealth, and quickly dominates the total employment gap under stagnation. Conventional policy measures aimed at reducing unemployment may increase the labor market gap through their effects on underemployment and should be used with caution. In contrast, increases in aggregate demand improve unemployment and working hours, while increases in labor productivity worsen underemployment without improving unemployment (“paradox of toil”). Our analysis provides new insights into empirical puzzles such as Japan's seemingly decent employment record during its lost decades.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们表明在长期停滞下，就业不足而非必然的高失业成为劳动力市场经济松弛的主要衡量指标。具体而言，只要家庭从持有财富中获得效用，在搜寻匹配模型中就会出现非自愿性就业不足，表现为工作时间的持续短缺，并在停滞状态下迅速主导总就业缺口。旨在降低失业的传统政策措施可能通过其对就业不足的影响而扩大劳动力市场缺口，应谨慎使用。相比之下，总需求的增加会改善失业和工作时间，而劳动生产率的提高会恶化就业不足而不改善失业（“辛劳悖论”）。我们的分析为诸如日本在失去的几十年中看似体面的就业记录等经验谜题提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Endogenous criteria for success
records.title_cn: 成功的内生标准
records.abstract_en: Economic agents are motivated to undertake costly actions by the prospect of being rewarded for successes and punished for failures. But what determines what a success looks like? This paper endogenizes the criteria for success in an otherwise standard principal-agent model with risk neutrality and limited liability. The set of feasible contracts is constrained by incentive constraints and possibly by a budget constraint. The first-order approach is not required to solve the problem. If the principal manipulates the criteria for success only to lower implementation costs, and depending on which type of constraint is more restrictive, the second-best action may be above or below the first-best action. In a class of problems where the principal's payoff depends directly on the criteria for success, the second-best solution features either more stringent criteria for success or a lower action (or both) than the first-best solution.
records.abstract_cn: 经济主体因预期成功会得到奖励、失败会受到惩罚而采取有成本的行为。但什么决定了成功的样子？本文在一个具有风险中性和有限责任的标准委托-代理模型中，将成功标准内生化。可行契约集受到激励约束以及可能的预算约束的限制。求解该问题不需要一阶方法。如果委托人仅为了降低实施成本而操纵成功标准，并且取决于哪种类型的约束更具限制性，次优行动可能高于或低于最优行动。在一类委托人的收益直接取决于成功标准的问题中，次优解的特征是比最优解更严格的成功标准或更低的行动（或两者兼有）。

records.title_en: Fostering collusion through action revision in duopolies
records.title_cn: 通过行动修订促进双头垄断中的合谋
records.abstract_en: We design an experiment to study the implications of allowing players to revise their actions in a Cournot duopoly game. Payoffs are determined only by the quantities selected at the end in a real-time revision game. On the other hand, in a stochastic revision game, opportunities to adjust quantities arrive randomly, and the quantities selected at the last revision opportunity are implemented. Contrasting results emerge: while real-time revision results in choices that are more competitive than the static Cournot-Nash, significantly lower quantities are implemented when revisions are stochastic. The results hold for different arrival rates of revision opportunities. Our findings demonstrate that the ability to revise actions can sustain partial cooperation. Although quantity adjustment choices display substantial heterogeneity, the main implication of the theory of revision games put forth by Kamada and Kandori (2020) is supported.
records.abstract_cn: 我们设计了一个实验来研究在古诺双头垄断博弈中允许玩家修订其行动的含义。在实时修订博弈中，收益仅由结束时选择的产量决定。另一方面，在随机修订博弈中，调整产量的机会随机到达，并且实施的是在最后一次修订机会时选择的产量。出现了对比鲜明的结果：实时修订导致的选择比静态古诺-纳什更具竞争性，而当修订是随机时，实施的产量显著更低。这些结果对于不同的修订机会到达率均成立。我们的发现表明，修订行动的能力可以维持部分合作。尽管产量调整选择显示出显著的异质性，但Kamada和Kandori（2020）提出的修订博弈理论的主要含义得到了支持。

records.title_en: Linear Riley equilibria in quadratic signaling games
records.title_cn: 二次信号博弈中的线性Riley均衡
records.abstract_en: We study signaling games with quadratic payoffs. As signaling games admit multiple separating equilibria, many equilibrium selection rules are proposed and a well-known solution is Riley equilibria. They are separating equilibria in which the sender achieves the highest equilibrium payoff for all types among all separating equilibria. We analyze the conditions for Riley equilibria to be linear, a common assumption in many applications. We derive a sufficient and necessary condition for the existence and uniqueness of linear Riley equilibria. We apply the result to confirm the dominance of linear equilibria in some classic examples, and we show that, in some other examples, there exist previously unknown nonlinear Riley equilibria.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有二次收益的信号博弈。由于信号博弈允许多个分离均衡，许多均衡选择规则被提出，其中著名的解是Riley均衡。它们是分离均衡，其中发送者在所有分离均衡中对所有类型获得最高的均衡收益。我们分析了Riley均衡为线性的条件，这是许多应用中的常见假设。我们推导了线性Riley均衡存在且唯一的充分必要条件。我们将结果应用于确认一些经典例子中线性均衡的主导地位，并表明在其他一些例子中，存在先前未知的非线性Riley均衡。

records.title_en: Regulating oligopolistic competition
records.title_cn: 规制寡头竞争
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem of how to regulate an oligopoly when firms have private information about their costs. In the environment, consumers make discrete choices over goods, and minimal structure is placed on the manner in which firms compete. In the optimal regulatory policy, firms compete on price margins, and based on firms' prices, the regulator charges them taxes or give them subsidies, and imposes on each firm a “yardstick” price cap that depends on the posted prices of competing firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑当企业对其成本拥有私人信息时如何规制寡头垄断的问题。在该环境中，消费者对商品进行离散选择，并且对企业竞争方式施加了最小的结构限制。在最优规制政策下，企业在价格加成上竞争，并且基于企业的价格，规制者对其征税或给予补贴，并对每个企业施加一个“标杆”价格上限，该上限取决于竞争对手的标价。

records.title_en: Herding through booms and busts
records.title_cn: 繁荣与萧条中的羊群行为
records.abstract_en: This paper explores whether rational herding can generate endogenous aggregate fluctuations. We embed a tractable model of rational herding into a business cycle framework. In the model, technological innovations arrive with unknown qualities, and agents have dispersed information about how productive the technology really is. Rational investors decide whether to invest based on their private information and the investment behavior of others. Herd-driven boom-bust cycles arise endogenously in this environment when the technology is unproductive but investors' initial information is overly optimistic. Their overoptimism leads to high investment rates, which investors mistakenly attribute to good fundamentals, leading to a self-reinforcing pattern of higher optimism and higher investment until the economy reaches a peak, followed by a crash when agents ultimately realize their mistake. We calibrate the model to the U.S. economy and show that it can broadly explain boom-and-bust cycles like the dot-com bubble of the 1990s.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨理性羊群行为能否产生内生总体波动。我们将一个易处理的理性羊群行为模型嵌入商业周期框架。在模型中，技术创新的质量未知，代理人关于技术实际生产率的信息分散。理性投资者根据私人信息和其他人的投资行为决定是否投资。当技术无生产力但投资者初始信息过于乐观时，羊群驱动的繁荣-萧条周期在该环境中内生出现。他们的过度乐观导致高投资率，投资者错误地将其归因于良好的基本面，从而形成更高乐观和更高投资的自我强化模式，直到经济达到顶峰，随后当代理人最终意识到错误时崩溃。我们将模型校准到美国经济，并表明它可以大致解释如1990年代互联网泡沫那样的繁荣-萧条周期。

records.title_en: Learning with limited memory: Bayesianism vs heuristics
records.title_cn: 有限记忆下的学习：贝叶斯主义与启发式
records.abstract_en: Bayesian analysis is considered the optimal way of processing information. However, it often leads to problems for decision-makers with constrained cognitive capacity. Modeling such constrained capacity by finite automata, we answer two questions in the context of Wald's (1947) sequential analysis, namely in what environments is optimal Bayesian analysis possible even with constraints; also, when it is not possible what simplifications in the analysis enable us to obtain a satisfactory outcome. We identify two features of the simplified analysis: information stickiness (ignoring information) and rule stickiness (ignoring small differences in the environment).
records.abstract_cn: 贝叶斯分析被认为是处理信息的最优方式。然而，对于认知能力受限的决策者来说，它往往会导致问题。通过有限自动机对这类受限能力进行建模，我们在Wald（1947）序贯分析的背景下回答了两个问题，即在什么环境下，即使存在约束，最优贝叶斯分析也是可能的；此外，当不可能时，分析中的哪些简化使我们能够获得令人满意的结果。我们识别了简化分析的两个特征：信息粘性（忽略信息）和规则粘性（忽略环境中的微小差异）。

records.title_en: The ratchet effect: A learning perspective
records.title_cn: 棘轮效应：一个学习视角
records.abstract_en: We examine the ratchet effect under moral hazard and symmetric learning by worker and firm about new technology. Shirking increases the worker's future payoffs, since the firm overestimates job difficulty. High-powered incentives to deter shirking induce the agent to over-work, since he can quit if the firm thinks the job is too easy. With continuous effort choices, no deterministic interior effort is implementable. We provide conditions under which randomized effort is implementable, so that a profit-maximizing distribution over efforts exists.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在道德风险和工人与企业对新技术的对称学习下的棘轮效应。偷懒会增加工人未来的收益，因为企业会高估工作难度。为防止偷懒而设的高强度激励会诱使代理人过度工作，因为如果企业认为工作太容易，他可以辞职。在连续努力选择下，任何确定性的内部努力都是不可实施的。我们提供了随机努力可实施的条件，从而存在一个利润最大化的努力分布。

records.title_en: Schumpeterian competition in a Lucas economy
records.title_cn: 卢卡斯经济中的熊彼特竞争
records.abstract_en: We model a rent-seeking game where agents experiment with a new technology and compete for claims to a consumption stream. We characterize how creative destruction affects risk, wealth, and asset prices. Competition not only imposes excessive disruption risk on existing assets and higher technological uncertainty, it also increases the wealth duration (the weighted-average maturity of wealth). Because of hedging motives, a complementarity between wealth duration and technological uncertainty decreases systematic risk. If competition is sufficiently intense, a negative risk premium may arise. The model generates price paths consistent with boom-bust patterns and transient episodes of negative expected excess returns. We show that Schumpeterian competition may worsen income inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个寻租博弈模型，其中经济主体尝试新技术并争夺消费流的索取权。我们刻画了创造性破坏如何影响风险、财富和资产价格。竞争不仅给现有资产带来过度的破坏风险并提高技术不确定性，还增加了财富久期（财富的加权平均到期期限）。由于对冲动机，财富久期与技术不确定性之间的互补性降低了系统性风险。如果竞争足够激烈，可能会出现负的风险溢价。该模型生成的价格路径与繁荣-萧条模式以及负的预期超额收益的短暂时期相一致。我们表明，熊彼特竞争可能加剧收入不平等。

records.title_en: Co-essentiality of money and credit: A mechanism-design view
records.title_cn: 货币与信用的共同本质性：一种机制设计视角
records.abstract_en: Under what conditions are money and credit jointly essential for trade? We answer this question by applying a mechanism-design approach to a standard monetary search model, augmented with two types of credit technologies. First, payment can be enforced up to some exogenous amount (enforcement-based credit). Second, default on past promises can be partially monitored by future trading partners (monitoring-based credit). We characterize implementable allocations subject to individual rationality and bilateral efficiency of trades. Consistent with prior literature, we find that money and monitoring-based credit cannot be jointly essential. However, we show that money and enforcement-based credit are jointly essential as long as neither payment instrument by itself is sufficient to implement a first-best. Money is memory, but it is not enforcement.
records.abstract_cn: 在什么条件下，货币和信用对于交易是共同本质性的？我们通过将机制设计方法应用于一个标准货币搜寻模型来回答这个问题，该模型增加了两种类型的信用技术。首先，支付可以被强制执行到某个外生金额（基于强制执行的信用）。其次，对未来承诺的违约可以被未来的交易伙伴部分监控（基于监控的信用）。我们刻画了受制于个体理性和交易双边效率的可实施配置。与先前文献一致，我们发现货币和基于监控的信用不能共同本质性。然而，我们表明，只要任何一种支付工具本身不足以实现最优，货币和基于强制执行的信用就是共同本质性的。货币是记忆，但它不是强制执行。

records.title_en: Information design in optimal auctions
records.title_cn: 最优拍卖中的信息设计
records.abstract_en: We study the information design problem in a single-unit auction setting. The information designer controls independent private signals according to which the buyers infer their binary private values. Assuming that the seller adopts the optimal auction due to Myerson (1981) in response, we characterize both the buyer-optimal information structure, which maximizes the buyers' surplus, and the seller-worst information structure, which minimizes the seller's revenue. We translate both information design problems into finite-dimensional, constrained optimization problems in which one can explicitly solve for the optimal information structure. In contrast to the case with one buyer (Roesler and Szentes, 2017), we show that with two or more buyers, the symmetric buyer-optimal information structure is different from the symmetric seller-worst information structure. The good is always sold under the seller-worst information structure but not under the buyer-optimal information structure. Nevertheless, as the number of buyers goes to infinity, both symmetric information structures converge to no disclosure. We also show that in our ex ante symmetric setting, an asymmetric information structure is never seller-worst but can generate a strictly higher surplus for the buyers than the symmetric buyer-optimal information structure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究单单位拍卖环境中的信息设计问题。信息设计者控制独立的私人信号，买家根据这些信号推断其二元私人价值。假设卖方采用迈尔森（Myerson, 1981）提出的最优拍卖作为回应，我们刻画了买家最优信息结构（最大化买家剩余）和卖方最差信息结构（最小化卖方收入）。我们将这两个信息设计问题转化为有限维约束优化问题，在其中可以显式求解最优信息结构。与只有一个买家的情况（Roesler 和 Szentes, 2017）相比，我们表明当有两个或更多买家时，对称的买家最优信息结构与对称的卖方最差信息结构不同。在卖方最差信息结构下商品总是被售出，但在买家最优信息结构下则不然。然而，随着买家数量趋于无穷，两种对称信息结构都收敛于不披露。我们还表明，在我们的事前对称环境中，非对称信息结构永远不会是卖方最差的，但可以为买家产生比对称买家最优信息结构严格更高的剩余。

records.title_en: Public disclosure and private information acquisition: A global game approach
records.title_cn: 公开披露与私人信息获取：一种全局博弈方法
records.abstract_en: This paper studies public information disclosure in a model of dynamic financial markets with endogenous information acquisition. Due to an information complementarity, multiple equilibria may emerge, complicating comparative statics analysis. By adding noise to agents' information costs, we establish equilibrium uniqueness using global-game techniques. We show that while public information always crowds out private information in all underlying equilibria, it can crowd in private information acquisition in the unique global-game equilibrium. This result is driven by the strategic uncertainty introduced through the global-game refinement. The crowding-in effect is more pronounced when there is a high level of fundamental uncertainty, which supports the case for greater information disclosure during times of increased market volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在具有内生信息获取的动态金融市场模型中研究公开信息披露。由于信息互补性，可能出现多重均衡，这使得比较静态分析复杂化。通过在代理人的信息成本中加入噪声，我们利用全局博弈技术建立了均衡唯一性。我们表明，虽然公开信息在所有潜在均衡中总是挤出私人信息，但在唯一的全局博弈均衡中，它可以挤入私人信息获取。这一结果是由通过全局博弈精炼引入的战略不确定性驱动的。当基本不确定性水平较高时，挤入效应更为显著，这支持在市场波动加剧时期增加信息披露的理由。

records.title_en: Dynamic banking with non-maturing deposits
records.title_cn: 非到期存款的动态银行业务
records.abstract_en: The majority of bank liabilities are deposits typically not withdrawn for extended periods. We propose a dynamic model of banks in which depositors forecast banks' leverage and default decisions, and withdraw optimally by trading off current against future liquidity needs. Endogenous deposit maturity creates a time-varying dilution problem that has major effects on bank dynamics. Interest rate cuts produce delayed increases in bank risk which are stronger in low rate regimes. Deposit insurance can exacerbate the deposit dilution and amplify the increase in bank risk.
records.abstract_cn: 银行负债的大部分是存款，这些存款通常不会在短期内被提取。我们提出了一个银行的动态模型，其中存款人预测银行的杠杆和违约决策，并通过权衡当前与未来的流动性需求来最优地提取存款。内生存款期限产生了一个时变的稀释问题，这对银行动态有重大影响。降息会导致银行风险的延迟增加，在低利率环境下这种影响更为显著。存款保险可能加剧存款稀释，并放大银行风险的增加。

records.title_en: Sequential Bayesian persuasion
records.title_cn: 序贯贝叶斯说服
records.abstract_en: I study a Bayesian persuasion model in which multiple senders sequentially persuade one receiver, after observing signal structures of prior senders and their realizations. I develop a geometric method, recursive concavification, to characterize the Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium paths. I prove the existence of the silent equilibrium, where at most one sender provides nontrivial information. I also show that when there are only two senders and the receiver has a finite action space, it is generically without loss to focus on silent equilibrium. Finally, I show that if there are two senders who have zero-sum payoffs, the truth-telling signal structure is always supported in equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个贝叶斯说服模型，其中多个发送者在观察到先前发送者的信号结构及其实现后，序贯地说服一个接收者。我开发了一种几何方法，即递归凹化，来刻画完美贝叶斯均衡路径。我证明了沉默均衡的存在性，其中至多一个发送者提供非平凡信息。我还表明，当只有两个发送者且接收者具有有限行动空间时，通常不失一般性地可以关注沉默均衡。最后，我表明如果存在两个具有零和收益的发送者，那么说真话的信号结构总是在均衡中得到支持。

records.title_en: Regulatory mechanism design with extortionary collusion
records.title_cn: 含勒索性合谋的监管机制设计
records.abstract_en: We study regulatory mechanism design with collusion between a privately informed agent and a less well-informed supervisor, incorporating ‘extortion’ which permits redistribution of rents within the coalition. We show the Collusion Proof Principle holds, and that the allocation of bargaining power between the supervisor and agent matters. Specifically, the Principal does not benefit from hiring the supervisor if the latter has less bargaining power vis-a-vis the agent. We provide an example where hiring the supervisor is valuable if she has greater bargaining power. These results indicate the importance of anti-collusion strategies that augment bargaining power of supervisors vis-a-vis agents.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了监管机制设计中，私人信息代理人与信息较不充分的监管者之间的合谋问题，并纳入了允许联盟内部租金再分配的“勒索”行为。我们证明了合谋证明原理成立，且监管者与代理人之间的议价能力分配至关重要。具体而言，如果监管者相对于代理人的议价能力较弱，委托人不会从雇佣监管者中获益。我们提供了一个例子，说明当监管者拥有更强的议价能力时，雇佣监管者是有价值的。这些结果表明，增强监管者相对于代理人议价能力的反合谋策略具有重要意义。

records.title_en: On sustainable equilibria
records.title_cn: 论可持续均衡
records.abstract_en: Following the ideas laid out in Myerson (1996), Hofbauer (2003) defined a Nash equilibrium of a finite game as sustainable if it can be made the unique Nash equilibrium of a game obtained by deleting/adding a subset of the strategies that are inferior replies to it. This paper proves a result about sustainable equilibria and uses it to provide a refinement as well. Our result concerns the Hofbauer-Myerson conjecture about the relationship between the sustainability of an equilibrium and its index: for a generic class of games, an equilibrium is sustainable iff its index is +1. von Schemde and von Stengel (2008) proved this conjecture for bimatrix games; we show that the conjecture is true for all finite games. More precisely, we prove that an equilibrium is isolated and has index +1 if and only if it can be made unique in a larger game obtained by adding finitely many strategies that are inferior replies to that equilibrium. It follows in a straightforward way from our result that sustainable equilibria fail the Decomposition Axiom for games as formulated by Mertens (1989a). In order to rectify this problem we propose a refinement, called strongly sustainable equilibria, which is shown to exist for all regular games.
records.abstract_cn: 遵循Myerson（1996）和Hofbauer（2003）提出的思想，本文定义了有限博弈中的纳什均衡为可持续的，如果它可以通过删除/添加一部分对该均衡为劣等回应的策略而成为某个博弈的唯一纳什均衡。本文证明了关于可持续均衡的一个结果，并利用该结果提供了一个精炼。我们的结果涉及Hofbauer-Myerson猜想，即关于均衡的可持续性与其指数之间的关系：对于一类一般博弈，一个均衡是可持续的当且仅当其指数为+1。von Schemde和von Stengel（2008）证明了该猜想对双矩阵博弈成立；我们证明该猜想对所有有限博弈成立。更确切地说，我们证明一个均衡是孤立的且指数为+1，当且仅当它可以通过添加有限多个对该均衡为劣等回应的策略而成为更大博弈中的唯一均衡。由我们的结果直接可得，可持续均衡不满足Mertens（1989a）所表述的博弈分解公理。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种精炼，称为强可持续均衡，并证明其存在于所有正则博弈中。

records.title_en: Asset bubbles and inflation as competing monetary phenomena
records.title_cn: 资产泡沫与通胀作为相互竞争的货币现象
records.abstract_en: In an economy in which adjusting prices comes at a fixed menu cost, a baseline Taylor rule generates multiple equilibria with varying price rigidity, inflation, and real interest rate. Asset bubbles may be sustained as long as prices are rigid, they burst as inflation picks up and the real rate reverts to a long-term value at which bubbles are no longer sustainable. Unlike natural bubbles, these policy-induced bubbles once issued always crowd out investment by draining resources from the most financially constrained agents.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个调整价格需支付固定菜单成本的经济体中，基准泰勒规则会产生具有不同价格刚性、通胀和实际利率的多重均衡。只要价格具有刚性，资产泡沫就可能持续存在；当通胀上升且实际利率回归至泡沫不再可持续的长期值时，泡沫便会破裂。与自然泡沫不同，这些政策引发的泡沫一旦产生，总是通过从财务约束最紧的代理人那里抽取资源来挤出投资。

records.title_en: Marital preferences and stable matching in cultural evolution
records.title_cn: 文化演化中的婚姻偏好与稳定匹配
records.abstract_en: Building on previous literature that examines the influence of intergenerational transmission in cultural evolution, we highlight the importance of the marriage market in the determination of cultural homogeneity (“melting pot”) versus heterogeneity (“diversity”). To do so, we characterize cultural evolutionary processes under different distributions of marital preferences and stable matching schemes. In our setting, cultural substitutability (Bisin and Verdier, 2001) is neither sufficient nor necessary for cultural heterogeneity. We introduce a new concept, elasticity of cultural substitution, to capture the degree of increase in vertical socialization efforts in response to minority population decline. With perfect or inelastic vertical transmission in homogamous families, cultural heterogeneity is sustained only if all proposers are homophilic or all members of a cultural group are homophilic. With imperfect vertical transmission in homogamous families, the presence of heterophilic agents may destabilize cultural heterogeneity, and the proportion of heterophilic agents and elasticity of cultural substitution determine whether cultural heterogeneity can be sustained. We discuss the model's implications for the long-lasting impact of temporary gender imbalance on cultural evolution as well as the cultural assimilation and preservation of minorities and immigrants under distinct governmental and religious attitudes toward intermarriage.
records.abstract_cn: 基于先前研究代际传递在文化演化中影响的文献，我们强调婚姻市场在决定文化同质性（“熔炉”）与异质性（“多样性”）中的重要性。为此，我们在不同的婚姻偏好分布和稳定匹配方案下刻画了文化演化过程。在我们的设定中，文化替代性（Bisin和Verdier，2001）既不是文化异质性的充分条件也不是必要条件。我们引入了一个新概念，文化替代弹性，用以捕捉垂直社会化努力随少数群体人口下降而增加的程度。在同质婚家庭中，若垂直传递完美或无弹性，则只有当所有提议者均为同质偏好或某一文化群体的所有成员均为同质偏好时，文化异质性才能持续。在同质婚家庭中垂直传递不完美的情况下，异质偏好个体的存在可能破坏文化异质性，而异质偏好个体的比例和文化替代弹性决定了文化异质性能否持续。我们讨论了该模型对暂时性性别失衡对文化演化的长期影响，以及在不同政府和宗教对通婚态度下少数群体和移民的文化同化与保留的启示。

records.title_en: A central limit theorem, loss aversion and multi-armed bandits
records.title_cn: 中心极限定理、损失厌恶与多臂老虎机
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a multi-armed bandit problem where the decision-maker is loss averse, in particular she is risk averse in the domain of gains and risk loving in the domain of losses. The focus is on large horizons. Consequences of loss aversion for asymptotic (large horizon) properties are derived in a number of analytical results. The analysis is based on a new central limit theorem for a set of measures under which conditional variances can vary in a largely unstructured history-dependent way subject only to the restriction that they lie in a fixed interval.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个多臂老虎机问题，其中决策者是损失厌恶的，特别是她在收益领域风险厌恶，在损失领域风险偏好。研究重点是长期视野。通过一系列分析结果，推导了损失厌恶对渐近（长期）性质的影响。该分析基于一个新的中心极限定理，该定理适用于一组测度，在这些测度下，条件方差可以在很大程度上无结构地依赖于历史，仅受限于它们位于一个固定区间内。

records.title_en: Evolutionary foundation for heterogeneity in risk aversion
records.title_cn: 风险厌恶异质性的演化基础
records.abstract_en: We examine the evolutionary basis for risk aversion with respect to aggregate risk. We study populations in which agents face choices between alternatives with different levels of aggregate risk. We show that the choices that maximize the long-run growth rate are induced by a heterogeneous population in which the least and most risk-averse agents are indifferent between facing an aggregate risk and obtaining its linear and harmonic mean for sure, respectively. Moreover, approximately optimal behavior can be induced by a simple distribution according to which all agents have constant relative risk aversion, and the coefficient of relative risk aversion is uniformly distributed between zero and two.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了针对总体风险的风险厌恶的演化基础。我们研究了面临不同总体风险水平选择的人群。我们表明，最大化长期增长率的抉择是由一个异质性人群引发的，在该人群中，风险厌恶程度最低和最高的个体分别对面对总体风险与确定获得其线性均值和调和均值无差异。此外，近似最优行为可以通过一个简单的分布引发，根据该分布，所有个体都具有常数相对风险厌恶，且相对风险厌恶系数在零和二之间均匀分布。

records.title_en: Behavioral implementation under incomplete information
records.title_cn: 不完全信息下的行为实施
records.abstract_en: We investigate implementation under incomplete information allowing for individuals' choices featuring violations of rationality. Our primitives are individuals' interim choices that do not have to satisfy the weak axiom of revealed preferences. In this setting, we provide necessary as well as sufficient conditions for behavioral implementation under incomplete information. We also introduce behavioral interim incentive Pareto efficiency and investigate its implementability under incomplete information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究不完全信息下的实施问题，允许个体的选择行为违反理性。我们的基本设定是个体的临时选择，这些选择不必满足显示偏好的弱公理。在此设定下，我们为不完全信息下的行为实施提供了必要条件和充分条件。我们还引入了行为临时激励帕累托效率，并研究了其在不完全信息下的可实施性。

records.title_en: Market-making with search and information frictions
records.title_cn: 具有搜索与信息摩擦的做市
records.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic model of trading through market-makers that incorporates two canonical sources of illiquidity: trading (or search) frictions, which imply that investors can rebalance their portfolio only with a delay; and information frictions, which imply that market-makers face some degree of adverse selection. We use this model to study the effects of various technological innovations and regulatory initiatives that have reduced trading frictions in over-the-counter markets. Our main result is that reducing trading frictions can lead to less liquidity, as measured by bid-ask spreads. The key insight is that more frequent trading makes investors' behavior less dependent on asset quality. As a result, dealers learn about asset quality more slowly and set wider bid-ask spreads to compensate for this increase in uncertainty. We also show that widening bid-ask spreads do not necessarily correspond to a decline in trading volume or welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个通过做市商进行交易的动态模型，该模型融合了两种经典的流动性不足来源：交易（或搜索）摩擦，意味着投资者只能延迟调整其投资组合；以及信息摩擦，意味着做市商面临一定程度的不利选择。我们利用该模型研究各种技术创新和监管举措对场外市场交易摩擦减少的影响。我们的主要结果是，减少交易摩擦可能导致流动性下降，以买卖价差衡量。关键见解在于，更频繁的交易使投资者的行为较少依赖于资产质量。因此，做市商了解资产质量的速度变慢，并设定更宽的买卖价差以补偿这种不确定性的增加。我们还表明，买卖价差的扩大并不一定对应于交易量或福利的下降。

records.title_en: Allocating losses: Bail-ins, bailouts and bank regulation
records.title_cn: 损失分配：内部纾困、外部纾困与银行监管
records.abstract_en: We study the interaction between the government's bailout policy and a bank's willingness to impose losses on (or “bail in”) investors based on its private information. In the absence of regulation, bail-ins in the early stages of a crisis are too small, while bailouts are too large and too frequent. Moreover, the bank may face a run by informed investors, creating further distortions and leading to a larger bailout. We show how a regulator with limited information can raise welfare and, in some cases, improve financial stability. The optimal policy involves partial delegation: the regulator sets bounds on the size of the bank's bail-in, but allows the bank to choose within these bounds.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了政府的纾困政策与银行基于其私人信息向投资者施加损失（或“内部纾困”）的意愿之间的相互作用。在缺乏监管的情况下，危机初期的内部纾困规模过小，而外部纾困规模过大且过于频繁。此外，银行可能面临知情投资者的挤兑，造成进一步扭曲并导致更大的外部纾困。我们展示了信息有限的监管者如何能够提高福利，并在某些情况下改善金融稳定。最优政策涉及部分授权：监管者对银行的内部纾困规模设定界限，但允许银行在这些界限内进行选择。

records.title_en: Committee formation under constraints through randomized voting rules on separable domains
records.title_cn: 约束条件下基于可分离域上随机投票规则的委员会形成
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem of choosing a committee from a set of available candidates through a randomized social choice function when there are restrictions on the committee to be formed and agents have separable preferences over the committees. We show that when the set of feasible committees is non-vacuously restricted, that is, cannot be seen as the set of all committees with a subset of members, a random social choice function is onto and strategy-proof if and only if it is random dictatorial.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在委员会形成存在限制且代理人具有可分离偏好时，通过随机社会选择函数从一组可用候选人中选择委员会的问题。我们证明，当可行委员会集合受到非空限制（即不能被视为包含某个成员子集的所有委员会的集合）时，一个随机社会选择函数是满射且策略-proof的，当且仅当它是随机独裁的。

records.title_en: Rational inattention when decisions take time
records.title_cn: 当决策需要时间时的理性疏忽
records.abstract_en: Decisions take time, and the time taken to reach a decision is likely to be informative about the cost of more precise judgments. We formalize this insight using a dynamic model of optimal evidence accumulation. We provide conditions under which the resulting belief dynamics resemble either diffusion processes or processes with large jumps. We then consider the in which discounting effects are small relative to the opportunity cost of time, and show that the state-contingent choice probabilities predicted by our model are identical to those predicted by a static rational inattention model, providing a micro-foundation for such models. In the diffusion case, our model provides a normative foundation for a variant of the drift-diffusion model from mathematical psychology.
records.abstract_cn: 决策需要时间，而做出决策所花费的时间可能反映了更精确判断的成本。我们使用最优证据积累的动态模型来形式化这一见解。我们提供了条件，在这些条件下，由此产生的信念动态类似于扩散过程或具有大跳跃的过程。然后，我们考虑贴现效应相对于时间机会成本较小的情况，并表明我们的模型预测的状态依赖选择概率与静态理性疏忽模型预测的相同，为这类模型提供了微观基础。在扩散情况下，我们的模型为数学心理学中的漂移扩散模型变体提供了规范基础。

records.title_en: Competition in costly talk
records.title_cn: 昂贵话语中的竞争
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a communication game between an uninformed decision maker and two perfectly informed senders with conflicting interests.
