Senders can misreport information at a cost that increases with the size of the misrepresentation. The main result concerns the characterization of equilibria with desirable properties: they always exist, are essentially unique, and are robust. Information transmission is partial in these equilibria, and persuasion occurs on the equilibrium path. By contrast, equilibria where the decision maker obtains her complete-information payoff are not robust, and hinge on beliefs with potentially undesirable properties.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个不知情的决策者与两个利益冲突且完全知情的发送者之间的沟通博弈。发送者可以虚报信息，其成本随虚报程度的增加而增加。主要结果涉及具有理想性质的均衡的表征：它们总是存在，本质上是唯一的，并且是稳健的。在这些均衡中，信息传递是部分的，并且说服发生在均衡路径上。相比之下，决策者获得其完全信息收益的均衡并不稳健，并且依赖于可能具有不良性质的信念。

records.title_en: Evolutionarily rational mutations in structured populations
records.title_cn: 结构化种群中的演化理性突变
records.abstract_en: This paper considers an evolutionary dynamic to study games played in large populations that consist of many identical, potentially small subpopulations, where individuals interact with others in their subpopulation, rarely moving between them.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑一种演化动态，用以研究由许多相同且可能较小的子种群组成的大种群中所进行的博弈，其中个体与其子种群中的其他个体互动，并很少在子种群之间迁移。

records.title_en: Doubts about the model and optimal policy
records.title_cn: 对模型的疑虑与最优政策
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes optimal policy in setups where both the policymaker and the private sector have doubts about the probability model of uncertainty and form endogenous worst-case beliefs. There are two forces that shape optimal policy results: a) the manipulation of the endogenous beliefs of the private sector so that the forward-looking constraints that the policymaker is facing are relaxed, b) the discrepancy (if any) in pessimistic beliefs between a paternalistic policymaker and the private sector, which captures ultimately differences in welfare evaluation. I illustrate the methodology in an optimal fiscal policy problem and show that manipulation of beliefs materializes as an effort to make government debt cheaper through the endogenous beliefs of the household. This force may lead to either mitigation or amplification of the household's pessimism, depending on the problem's parameters. The policymaker's relative pessimism determines whether paternalism reinforces or opposes the price manipulation incentives.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在政策制定者和私人部门都对不确定性的概率模型存有疑虑并形成内生最坏情况信念的环境中的最优政策。塑造最优政策结果的有两股力量：a) 操纵私人部门的内生信念，以放松政策制定者面临的向前看的约束；b) 家长式政策制定者与私人部门之间悲观信念的差异（如果有的话），这最终反映了福利评估的差异。我在一个最优财政政策问题中阐述了该方法，并表明信念的操纵表现为通过家庭的内生信念使政府债务更便宜的努力。这股力量可能导致家庭悲观情绪的缓解或放大，具体取决于问题的参数。政策制定者的相对悲观程度决定了家长式作风是强化还是反对价格操纵激励。

records.title_en: Random quasi-linear utility
records.title_cn: 随机拟线性效用
records.abstract_en: We propose a random quasi-linear utility model (RQUM) where quasi-linear utility functions are drawn randomly via some probability distribution π, and utility ties are broken by a convenient lexicographic rule. We characterize RQUM and identify π uniquely in terms of stochastic choice data. McFadden's (1973) additive random utility model is obtained as a special case where utility ties have a zero probability in all menus. Another distinct case of RQUM captures finite populations and derives π with a finite support. Our main axioms are testable. They prohibit context and reference dependence, and also modify the non-negativity of Block-Marschack polynomials for monetary cost variations. We also characterize RQUM through a stronger version of McFadden and Richter's (1990) axiom of revealed stochastic preferences (ARSP). This approach extends to incomplete datasets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个随机拟线性效用模型（RQUM），其中拟线性效用函数通过某个概率分布π随机抽取，效用平局通过一个方便的字典序规则打破。我们刻画了RQUM，并根据随机选择数据唯一地识别π。McFadden（1973）的加性随机效用模型作为特例获得，其中效用平局在所有菜单中概率为零。RQUM的另一个独特情形捕捉有限总体，并推导出具有有限支撑的π。我们的主要公理是可检验的。它们禁止情境和参考依赖，并修改了Block-Marschack多项式对货币成本变化的非负性。我们还通过McFadden和Richter（1990）的显示随机偏好公理（ARSP）的更强版本刻画了RQUM。该方法扩展到不完整数据集。

records.title_en: Markets for financial innovation
records.title_cn: 金融创新的市场
records.abstract_en: We develop a theory of financial innovation in which both market structure and the payoffs of the claims being traded are determined endogenously. Intermediaries use the cash flows of an underlying asset to design securities for investors. Demand for securities arises as investors choose markets then trade using strategies represented by quantity-price schedules. We show that intermediaries create increasingly riskier asset-backed securities when facing deeper markets in which investors trade more competitively. In turn, investors elicit less risky securities when they choose thinner markets, revealing a novel role for market fragmentation in the creation of safer securities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个金融创新理论，其中市场结构和所交易权益的收益都是内生决定的。中介机构利用基础资产的现金流为投资者设计证券。对证券的需求产生于投资者选择市场，然后使用由数量-价格计划表代表的策略进行交易。我们表明，当面对投资者交易更具竞争性的更深市场时，中介机构会创造风险越来越高的资产支持证券。反过来，当投资者选择更薄的市场时，他们会引出风险较低的证券，这揭示了市场碎片化在创造更安全证券中的新作用。

records.title_en: Inefficiency of Random Serial Dictatorship under incomplete information
records.title_cn: 不完全信息下随机序列独裁机制的低效率
records.abstract_en: We study the problem of allocating n objects to n agents without monetary transfers in a setting where each agent's preference over objects is private. We assume that each agent's value vector (values for n objects) is independently drawn from an exchangeable distribution and show that the celebrated Random Serial Dictatorship mechanism is welfare inferior to another allocation method, the Random Boston mechanism, when the number of agents and objects is large. Specifically, every type of every agent has a strictly higher interim expected utility under the Random Boston mechanism than under the Random Serial Dictatorship mechanism. Moreover, this strict dominance holds even at the limit.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在没有货币转移的情况下将n个物品分配给n个代理人的问题，其中每个代理人对物品的偏好是私有的。我们假设每个代理人的价值向量（对n个物品的价值）独立地从可交换分布中抽取，并表明当代理人和物品数量较大时，著名的随机序列独裁机制在福利上劣于另一种分配方法，即随机波士顿机制。具体来说，每个代理人的每种类型在随机波士顿机制下的中期预期效用严格高于随机序列独裁机制下的效用。此外，这种严格优势即使在极限情况下也成立。

records.title_en: Self-evident events and the value of linking
records.title_cn: 自明事件与关联的价值
records.abstract_en: We study a T-period contracting game between a group of players without access to external financing. We show that the long-term efficiency loss is bounded from below by the need to vary incentives across self-evident events. When T is large, the efficiency bound can be approached by a contract that involves side payments between players. Our results apply to all monitoring structures and strategy profiles. They encompass the inefficiency result in Abreu et al. (1991), as well as the approximate-efficiency results in Compte (1998), Obara (2009), and Chan and Zhang (2016).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个T期缔约博弈，其中一组玩家无法获得外部融资。我们证明，长期效率损失的下界由跨自明事件调整激励的需要所决定。当T很大时，通过玩家之间的侧支付合同可以接近效率界限。我们的结果适用于所有监控结构和策略组合。它们涵盖了Abreu等人（1991）中的无效率结果，以及Compte（1998）、Obara（2009）和Chan与Zhang（2016）中的近似效率结果。

records.title_en: The A/B testing problem with Gaussian priors
records.title_cn: 高斯先验下的A/B测试问题
records.abstract_en: A risk-neutral firm can perform a randomized experiment (A/B test) to learn about the effects of implementing an idea of unknown quality. The firm's goal is to decide the experiment's sample size and whether or not the idea should be implemented after observing the experiment's outcome. We show that when the distribution for idea quality is Gaussian and there are linear costs of experimentation, there are exact formulae for the firm's optimal implementation decisions, the value of obtaining more data, and optimal experiment sizes. Our formulae—which assume that companies use randomized experiments to help them maximize expected profits—provide a simple alternative to i) the standard rules-of-thumb of power calculations for determining the sample size of an experiment, and also to ii) ad hoc thresholds based on statistical significance to interpret the outcome of an experiment.
records.abstract_cn: 一个风险中性的企业可以进行随机实验（A/B测试）来了解实施一个质量未知的想法的效果。企业的目标是决定实验的样本量以及在观察实验结果后是否应该实施该想法。我们表明，当想法质量的分布为高斯分布且实验成本为线性时，存在关于企业最优实施决策、获取更多数据的价值以及最优实验规模的精确公式。我们的公式——假设公司使用随机实验来帮助其最大化预期利润——为确定实验样本量的标准功效计算经验法则以及基于统计显著性来解释实验结果的临时阈值提供了一种简单的替代方案。

records.title_en: Post-auction investment by financially constrained bidders
records.title_cn: 财务受限投标人的拍卖后投资
records.abstract_en: This study examines auctions in which the value of goods is endogenously determined by ex post investment while bidders face financial constraints. The main results are twofold. First, we characterize performance comparisons on revenue and investment between standard auctions. When the valuation is linear in investment, we have the equivalence theorem with respect to the seller's expected revenue and the winner's expected investment. When the valuation is concave in investment, the first-price auction yields higher expected revenue than the second-price auction. In addition, under additional conditions, the expected investment is larger in the second-price auction. Second, we analyze mechanisms other than simple auctions when sellers aim to promote investment. Scoring auctions increase the winner's investment at the expense of a decrease in revenue compared to price-only auctions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了商品价值由事后投资内生决定且投标人面临财务约束的拍卖。主要结果有两方面。首先，我们刻画了标准拍卖之间在收入和投资方面的绩效比较。当估值关于投资是线性的，我们得到了关于卖方预期收入和赢家预期投资的等价定理。当估值关于投资是凹的，第一价格拍卖产生的预期收入高于第二价格拍卖。此外，在附加条件下，第二价格拍卖中的预期投资更大。其次，当卖方旨在促进投资时，我们分析了简单拍卖之外的机制。与仅价格拍卖相比，评分拍卖增加了赢家的投资，但以收入减少为代价。

records.title_en: Strategic mistakes
records.title_cn: 策略性错误
records.abstract_en: To study the equilibrium implications of decision frictions, we introduce a new class of control costs in continuum-player, continuum-action games in which agents interact via an aggregate of the actions of others. The costs that we study accommodate a rich class of decision frictions, including ex post misoptimization, imperfect ex ante planning, cognitive constraints that depend endogenously on the behavior of others, and consideration sets. We provide primitive conditions such that equilibria exist, are unique, are efficient, and feature monotone comparative statics for action distributions, aggregates, and the size of agents' mistakes. We apply the model to make robust equilibrium predictions in a monetary business-cycle model of price-setting with planning frictions and a model of consumption and savings during a liquidity trap when endogenous stress worsens decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 为了研究决策摩擦的均衡含义，我们在连续参与者、连续行动的博弈中引入了一类新的控制成本，其中代理人通过他人行动的加总进行互动。我们研究的成本能够容纳丰富的决策摩擦类别，包括事后错误优化、事前不完美规划、内生依赖于他人行为的认知约束以及考虑集。我们提供了原始条件，使得均衡存在、唯一、有效，并且行动分布、加总以及代理人错误规模具有单调比较静态特征。我们将该模型应用于一个具有规划摩擦的货币商业周期价格设定模型，以及一个在流动性陷阱中内生压力恶化决策时的消费和储蓄模型，以做出稳健的均衡预测。

records.title_en: A model of the formation of multilayer networks
records.title_cn: 多层网络形成的模型
records.abstract_en: We study the formation of multilayer networks where payoffs are determined by the degrees of players in each network. We begin by imposing either concavity or convexity in degree on the payoff function of the players. We then explore distinct network relationships that result from inter- and intra-network spillovers captured by the properties of supermodularity/submodularity and strategic complementarity respectively. We show the existence of equilibria and characterize them. Additionally, we establish both necessary and sufficient conditions for an equilibrium to occur. We also highlight the connection, in equilibrium, between inter-network externalities and the identity of linked players in one network given the identity of linked players in the other network. Furthermore, we analyze efficient multilayer networks. Finally, we extend our models to contexts with more than two layers, and scenarios where agents receive a bonus for being connected to the same individuals in both networks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究多层网络的形成，其中收益由玩家在每个网络中的度数决定。我们首先对玩家的收益函数施加度数的凹性或凸性。然后，我们探讨由网络间和网络内溢出效应所产生的不同网络关系，这些溢出效应分别通过超模性/子模性和策略互补性的性质来捕捉。我们证明了均衡的存在性并对其进行了刻画。此外，我们建立了均衡发生的必要条件和充分条件。我们还强调了在均衡中，网络间外部性与一个网络中链接玩家的身份（给定另一个网络中链接玩家的身份）之间的联系。进一步地，我们分析了有效的多层网络。最后，我们将模型扩展到超过两层的情境，以及代理人在两个网络中连接到相同个体时获得奖金的情景。

records.title_en: Semi-endogenous or fully endogenous growth? A unified theory
records.title_cn: 半内生还是完全内生增长？一个统一理论
records.abstract_en: Is growth ultimately fully endogenous or semi-endogenous? Three decades of theoretical and empirical growth economics have kept both possibilities open. Here, R&D-driven growth is a general combination of both semi-endogenous and fully endogenous mechanisms.
records.abstract_cn: 增长最终是完全内生还是半内生的？三十年的理论和实证增长经济学使这两种可能性都保持开放。在此，研发驱动的增长是半内生和完全内生机制的一般组合。

records.title_en: Sequentially mixed search and equilibrium price dispersion
records.title_cn: 序贯混合搜索与均衡价格离散度
records.abstract_en: Many markets feature sequentially mixed search (SMS), which is search directed toward a price distribution followed by noisy matching with multiple offers. I construct a tractable model of SMS, establish existence of a unique equilibrium, and prove that the equilibrium is constrained efficient. Although individuals on each side of the market are homogeneous and search is directed, the equilibrium has a non-degenerate and continuous distribution of posted prices on a connected support. Despite the possibility of multiple offers, the highest price is lower than the joint value of a match so that both sides of the market obtain strictly positive surpluses of trade at all equilibrium prices. This feature captures the common practice that searchers restrict search below a price bound. Moreover, I show that an increase in the meeting efficiency widens price dispersion, which helps explain the puzzling fact that the increased use of the Internet has not reduced price dispersion.
records.abstract_cn: 许多市场具有序贯混合搜索（SMS）的特征，即针对价格分布的定向搜索，随后伴随多个报价的噪声匹配。我构建了一个易于处理的SMS模型，证明了唯一均衡的存在性，并证明了该均衡是约束有效的。尽管市场双方个体是同质的且搜索是定向的，均衡中在连通支撑上存在非退化且连续的报价分布。尽管可能存在多个报价，最高价格仍低于匹配的联合价值，因此市场双方在所有均衡价格下均获得严格正的交易剩余。这一特征捕捉了搜索者将搜索限制在价格界限以下的常见做法。此外，我表明匹配效率的提高会扩大价格离散度，这有助于解释互联网使用增加并未减少价格离散度这一令人困惑的事实。

records.title_en: Economic Sanctions: Evolution, Consequences, and Challenges
records.title_cn: 经济制裁：演变、后果与挑战
records.abstract_en: Taking an interdisciplinary perspective, we examine the evolution of economic sanctions in the post-World War II era and reflect on the lessons that could be drawn from their features and patterns of use. We observe that, during this time, there has been a remarkable increase in the use of sanctions as an instrument of foreign policy. We classify this period into four ‘eras’ and discuss, in this context, how the evolution of sanctions may be linked to salient features of the contemporaneous international political and economic orders. Our review of the related literatures in economics and political science suggests, among other things, that our understanding of sanction processes could be significantly advanced by marrying these perspectives. We conclude by identifying several questions and challenges, and by discussing how interdisciplinary research could address them.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采取跨学科的视角，考察了二战后经济制裁的演变，并反思了从其特征和使用模式中可能汲取的教训。我们观察到，在此期间，制裁作为外交政策工具的使用显著增加。我们将这一时期划分为四个“时代”，并在此背景下讨论制裁的演变如何与同时期国际政治和经济秩序的显著特征相关联。我们对经济学和政治学相关文献的回顾表明，除其他外，通过结合这些视角，我们对制裁过程的理解可以得到显著推进。最后，我们指出了几个问题和挑战，并讨论了跨学科研究如何应对这些挑战。

records.title_en: Financial Sanctions, SWIFT, and the Architecture of the International Payment System
records.title_cn: 金融制裁、SWIFT与国际支付体系架构
records.abstract_en: Financial sanctions, alongside economic sanctions, are components of the toolkit used by governments as part of international diplomacy. The use of sanctions, especially financial, has increased over the last 70 years. Financial sanctions have been particularly important whenever the goals of the sanctioning countries were related to democracy and human rights. Financial sanctions restrict entities—countries, businesses, or even individuals—from purchasing or selling financial assets, or from accessing custodial or other financial services. They can be imposed on a sanctioned entity’s ability to access the infrastructures that are in place to execute international payments, irrespective of whether such payments underpin financial or real activity. This article explains how financial sanctions can be designed to limit access to the international payment system and, in particular, the SWIFT network, and provides some recent examples.
records.abstract_cn: 金融制裁与经济制裁一样，是政府在国际外交中使用的工具之一。制裁的使用，尤其是金融制裁，在过去70年中有所增加。每当制裁国家的目标与民主和人权相关时，金融制裁尤为重要。金融制裁限制实体——国家、企业甚至个人——购买或出售金融资产，或获取托管或其他金融服务。它们可以施加于受制裁实体进入执行国际支付的现有基础设施的能力，无论这些支付是否支撑金融或实体活动。本文解释了金融制裁如何被设计以限制进入国际支付体系，特别是SWIFT网络，并提供了一些近期例子。

records.title_en: Monetary Policy When the Central Bank Shapes Financial-Market Sentiment
records.title_cn: 当中央银行塑造金融市场情绪时的货币政策
records.abstract_en: Recent research has found that monetary policy works in part by influencing the risk premiums on both traded financial-market securities and intermediated loans. Research has also shown that when risk premiums are compressed, there is an increased likelihood of a reversal that damages the credit-supply mechanism and the real economy. Together these effects create an intertemporal tradeoff for monetary policy, as stimulating the economy today can sow the seeds of a future downturn that might be difficult to offset. We draw out some implications of this tradeoff for the conduct of monetary policy.
records.abstract_cn: 近期研究发现，货币政策在一定程度上通过影响交易性金融市场证券和中介贷款的风险溢价来发挥作用。研究还表明，当风险溢价被压缩时，出现逆转的可能性增加，这会损害信贷供给机制和实体经济。这些效应共同为货币政策创造了一个跨期权衡，因为今天刺激经济可能为未来难以抵消的衰退埋下种子。我们阐述了这一权衡对货币政策实施的一些启示。

records.title_en: Risk Appetite and the Risk-Taking Channel of Monetary Policy
records.title_cn: 风险偏好与货币政策的风险承担渠道
records.abstract_en: Monetary policy affects financial markets and the broader economy in part by changing the risk appetite of investors. This article provides new evidence for this so-called risk-taking channel of monetary policy by revisiting and extending event-study analysis of Federal Open Market Committee announcements. We document significant effects of unexpected monetary policy changes on risk indicators drawn from equity, fixed-income, credit, and foreign exchange markets. We develop a new index of risk appetite based on the common component of these indicators. Surprise monetary easing leads to strong and persistent increases in our index, and vice versa for tightening surprises, consistent with the view that monetary policy affects asset prices in large part through its effects on risk appetite. We discuss the implications of the risk-taking channel for monetary policy transmission, optimal monetary policy, and financial stability.
records.abstract_cn: 货币政策通过改变投资者的风险偏好，在一定程度上影响金融市场和整体经济。本文通过重新审视并扩展联邦公开市场委员会公告的事件研究分析，为所谓的货币政策风险承担渠道提供了新的证据。我们记录了意外的货币政策变化对来自股票、固定收益、信贷和外汇市场的风险指标的显著影响。我们基于这些指标的共同成分开发了一个新的风险偏好指数。意外的货币宽松导致我们的指数强劲且持续上升，而紧缩的意外则相反，这与货币政策在很大程度上通过其对风险偏好的影响来影响资产价格的观点一致。我们讨论了风险承担渠道对货币政策传导、最优货币政策和金融稳定的影响。

records.title_en: Landings, Soft and Hard: The Federal Reserve, 1965–2022
records.title_cn: 软着陆与硬着陆：美联储，1965-2022
records.abstract_en: “Soft landings,” that is, cases in which the central bank tightens monetary policy to fight inflation but does not cause a recession (which would be a “hard landing”, are thought to be difficult to achieve and extremely rare. According to the conventional wisdom, the Federal Reserve has managed to achieve only one soft landing in the past 60 years—in 1994–1995. This paper studies the eleven episodes of monetary policy tightening by the Fed since 1965, and concludes that the central bank has a better record than that—that as long as the criteria for softness are not too stringent, and Fed was actually trying to land the economy softly, the Fed has succeeded several times. Achieving a soft landing, however, requires both skill in managing monetary policy and the absence of adverse external shocks.
records.abstract_cn: “软着陆”，即中央银行收紧货币政策以对抗通胀但未导致衰退（衰退则为“硬着陆”）的情况，被认为难以实现且极为罕见。传统观点认为，美联储在过去60年中仅成功实现过一次软着陆——即在1994-1995年。本文研究了自1965年以来美联储的十一次货币政策收紧事件，并得出结论：美联储的实际记录优于上述观点——只要软着陆的标准不过于严苛，且美联储确实在努力使经济软着陆，那么美联储已多次成功。然而，实现软着陆既需要货币政策管理的技巧，也需要避免不利的外部冲击。

records.title_en: Monetary Policy and Inequality
records.title_cn: 货币政策与不平等
records.abstract_en: We ask three questions about the connection between monetary policy and inequality. First, does monetary policy affect inequality? While different households respond to changes in monetary policy for different reasons, we argue that the overall consumption effects are relatively evenly distributed across households. Second, does household heterogeneity change our understanding of monetary policy transmission? A more careful account of microeconomic consumption behavior materially alters our understanding of transmission channels, but has rather limited effect on our general view of the aggregate effects of monetary policy. Third, does inequality affect the optimal conduct of monetary policy? Since monetary policy is a rather blunt distributional tool, we argue that even a central bank with an explicit distributional mandate would not deviate much from conventional policy prescriptions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出关于货币政策与不平等之间联系的三个问题。首先，货币政策是否影响不平等？虽然不同家庭因不同原因对货币政策变化作出反应，但我们认为总体消费效应在家庭间分布相对均匀。其次，家庭异质性是否改变了我们对货币政策传导的理解？对微观经济消费行为更细致的考量实质上改变了我们对传导渠道的理解，但对货币政策总体效应的普遍看法影响相当有限。第三，不平等是否影响最优货币政策的制定？由于货币政策是一种相当粗略的分配工具，我们认为即使是一个具有明确分配任务的中央银行也不会偏离传统政策建议太多。

records.title_en: Unraveling the Hispanic Health Paradox
records.title_cn: 解析西班牙裔健康悖论
records.abstract_en: In 2019, Hispanics in the US had a life expectancy advantage of 3.0 years and 7.1 years over non-Hispanic Whites and non-Hispanic Blacks, respectively, despite having real-household income values 26 percentage points lower than Non-Hispanic White households. Hispanics appear to have equal or even better health outcomes relative to non-Hispanic Whites across various health measures. This is known as the Hispanic health paradox. This paper underscores the importance of disaggregating Hispanics by ancestry and age profile when discussing the paradox across key health outcomes. It also provides an overview of the leading explanations, such as the salmon bias and the healthy immigrant effect. Further, it highlights the role of healthcare access and usage in this discussion. Ignoring these sources of bias have important consequences for how morbidity and mortality among Hispanics are measured within widely used national datasets.
records.abstract_cn: 在2019年，美国西班牙裔人的预期寿命比非西班牙裔白人和非西班牙裔黑人分别高出3.0年和7.1年，尽管其实际家庭收入值比非西班牙裔白人家庭低26个百分点。在各种健康指标上，西班牙裔人相对于非西班牙裔白人似乎拥有相同甚至更好的健康结果。这被称为西班牙裔健康悖论。本文强调了在讨论关键健康结果中的悖论时，按祖籍和年龄特征对西班牙裔人进行细分的重要性。文章还概述了主要解释，如鲑鱼偏倚和健康移民效应。此外，文章强调了医疗保健获取和使用在这一讨论中的作用。忽视这些偏倚来源对于在广泛使用的国家数据集中衡量西班牙裔人的发病率和死亡率具有重要影响。

records.title_en: Hispanic Americans in the Labor Market: Patterns over Time and across Generations
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场中的西班牙裔美国人：跨时间与跨代的模式
records.abstract_en: This article reviews evidence on the labor market performance of Hispanics in the United States, with a particular focus on the US-born segment of this population. After discussing critical issues that arise in the US data sources commonly used to study Hispanics, we document how Hispanics currently compare with other Americans in terms of education, earnings, and labor supply, and then we discuss long-term trends in these outcomes. Relative to non-Hispanic Whites, US-born Hispanics from most national origin groups possess sizeable deficits in earnings, which in large part reflect corresponding educational deficits. Over time, rates of high school completion by US-born Hispanics have almost converged to those of non-Hispanic Whites, but the large Hispanic deficits in college completion have instead widened. Finally, from the perspective of immigrant generations, Hispanics experience substantial improvements in education and earnings between first-generation immigrants and the second-generation consisting of the US-born children of immigrants. Continued progress beyond the second generation is obscured by measurement issues arising from high rates of Hispanic intermarriage and the fact that later-generation descendants of Hispanic immigrants often do not self-identify as Hispanic when they come from families with mixed ethnic origins.
records.abstract_cn: 本文回顾了关于美国西班牙裔劳动力市场表现的证据，特别关注这一人群中美国出生的部分。在讨论了美国常用数据源中研究西班牙裔时出现的关键问题后，我们记录了西班牙裔目前在教育、收入和工作供给方面与其他美国人的比较情况，然后讨论了这些结果的长期趋势。相对于非西班牙裔白人，来自大多数原籍国的美国出生西班牙裔在收入上存在相当大的差距，这很大程度上反映了相应的教育差距。随着时间的推移，美国出生的西班牙裔高中毕业率几乎与非西班牙裔白人趋同，但西班牙裔在大学毕业方面的巨大差距反而扩大了。最后，从移民代际的角度来看，西班牙裔在第一代移民与由移民的美国出生子女组成的第二代之间经历了教育和收入的显著改善。第二代之后的持续进步被西班牙裔高比例的族际通婚以及后来几代西班牙裔移民后裔在来自混合族裔背景家庭时往往不自我认同为西班牙裔这一事实所导致的测量问题所掩盖。

records.title_en: US Immigration from Latin America in Historical Perspective
records.title_cn: 历史视角下的拉丁美洲移民美国
records.abstract_en: The share of US residents who were born in Latin America and the Caribbean plateaued recently, after a half century of rapid growth. Our review of the evidence on the US immigration wave from the region suggests that it bears many similarities to the major immigration waves of the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, that the demographic and economic forces behind Latin American migrant inflows appear to have weakened across most sending countries, and that a continued slowdown of immigration from Latin America post-pandemic has the potential to disrupt labor-intensive sectors in many US regional labor markets.
records.abstract_cn: 在经历了半个世纪的快速增长后，出生于拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的美国居民占比近期趋于平稳。我们对来自该地区的美国移民浪潮证据的回顾表明，它与十九世纪和二十世纪初的主要移民浪潮有许多相似之处，拉丁美洲移民流入背后的人口和经济力量在大多数输出国似乎已经减弱，并且疫情后拉丁美洲移民持续放缓有可能扰乱美国许多地区劳动力市场中的劳动密集型行业。

records.title_en: Oleg Itskhoki: 2022 John Bates Clark Medalist
records.title_cn: 奥列格·伊茨霍基：2022年约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖得主
records.abstract_en: The 2022 John Bates Clark Medal of the American Economic Association was awarded to Oleg Itskhoki, Professor of Economics at the University of California, Los Angeles for his path breaking contributions in international economics. This article summarizes Oleg Itskhoki’s work and places it in the context of the broader literature and emphasizes how it has shed new light on a number of long-standing puzzles regarding the behavior of exchange rates and international relative prices more generally and their connection to macroeconomic fluctuations and government’s choices of monetary and fiscal policies.
records.abstract_cn: 美国经济学会将2022年约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖授予加州大学洛杉矶分校经济学教授奥列格·伊茨霍基，以表彰他在国际经济学领域的开创性贡献。本文总结了奥列格·伊茨霍基的研究工作，并将其置于更广泛的文献背景中，强调他的研究如何为关于汇率和国际相对价格行为的一系列长期存在的谜题提供了新的解释，以及这些行为与宏观经济波动和政府货币政策与财政政策选择之间的联系。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Global climate governance in the light of geoengineering: A shot in the dark?
records.title_cn: 地球工程视角下的全球气候治理：盲人摸象？
records.abstract_en: Solar radiation management (SRM), as one form of geoengineering, has been proposed as a last exit strategy to address global warming. Even though SRM is expected to be cheap, it may be risky and associated with high collateral damages. We analyze how SRM affects equilibrium mitigation strategies, the governance architecture of a climate agreement and whether and how signatories to a climate agreement can avoid the deployment of geoengineering, either by all or a subgroup of countries. We show under which conditions the threat to deploy geoengineering can stabilize a large climate agreement.
records.abstract_cn: 太阳辐射管理（SRM）作为地球工程的一种形式，已被提议作为应对全球变暖的最后退出策略。尽管SRM预计成本低廉，但它可能存在风险，并伴随高额的附带损害。我们分析了SRM如何影响均衡减缓策略、气候协议的治理架构，以及气候协议的签署国能否以及如何避免地球工程的部署，无论是所有国家还是部分国家。我们展示了在何种条件下，部署地球工程的威胁能够稳定一个大型气候协议。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: National expenditures on local amenities
records.title_cn: 地方性便利设施的国民支出
records.abstract_en: We develop a framework for estimating Americans’ implicit expenditures on spatially varying nonmarket amenities. We focus on location-specific factors that affect the quality of life but are not formally traded. Examples include climate, geography, pollution, local public goods, and transportation infrastructure. Households pay for residential access to these amenities indirectly, through housing prices, wages and property taxes. We construct a database of 75 amenities, match it to 5 million households’ location choices, and use hedonic methods to estimate their total amenity expenditures. Our benchmark estimate for the year 2000 is $562 billion--equivalent to 8% of Americans’ personal consumption expenditures.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架来估算美国人对空间变化的非市场便利设施的隐性支出。我们关注那些影响生活质量但未正式交易的区位特定因素。例子包括气候、地理、污染、地方公共物品和交通基础设施。家庭通过房价、工资和财产税间接为居住在这些便利设施附近付费。我们构建了一个包含75项便利设施的数据库，将其与5万户家庭的区位选择相匹配，并使用特征价格法来估算他们的总便利设施支出。我们2000年的基准估计为562亿美元——相当于美国人个人消费支出的8%。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Too many or too few? On the optimal number of firms in the commons
records.title_cn: 太多还是太少？论公共资源中最优企业数量
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider common-pool non-renewable resource industries and study the socially optimal industry size. Our analysis is conducted in terms of an infinite-horizon differential game (with either open-loop or feedback strategies). We derive two main results. First, we show that there exists a unique state-independent efficiency-inducing industry size, ranging between 1 and infinity, if and only if the elasticity of the price-cost margin (capturing static market power) and the elasticity of the difference between social and private resource rents (capturing the tragedy of the commons) are the same. Second, allowing for entry/exit, we show that the regulator can set a license fee to be paid by firms to get access to the resource such that the endogenous number of firms in the equilibrium with regulated entry is socially optimal.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑公共池不可再生资源产业，并研究社会最优的产业规模。我们的分析基于无限时域微分博弈（采用开环或反馈策略）。我们得出两个主要结果。首先，我们证明存在一个唯一的、与状态无关的效率诱导产业规模，其范围在1和无穷大之间，当且仅当价格成本边际弹性（反映静态市场势力）与社会与私人资源租金之差的弹性（反映公地悲剧）相等时。其次，允许进入/退出，我们表明监管者可以设定一个许可费，由企业支付以获得资源使用权，使得受监管进入的均衡中的内生企业数量是社会最优的。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Adaptation to climate change: Air-conditioning and the role of remittances
records.title_cn: 适应气候变化：空调与汇款的作用
records.abstract_en: Do remittances improve the ability of households to adapt to global warming? We try to answer this question by studying the behaviours of households in Mexico, a country that experiences a large and stable flow of remittances. Using an instrumental variable approach, we find an important role of remittances in the climate adaptation process. Remittances are used for adopting air-conditioning, which is an important cooling device for responding to high temperatures and to maintain thermal comfort at home. We exploit climate and income heterogeneity by showing that large differences exist in the use of remittances for climate adaptation between coastal and inland regions, as well as among different income groups. We conclude by quantifying the overall increase in welfare that households attain by adopting air-conditioning.
records.abstract_cn: 汇款是否提高了家庭适应全球变暖的能力？我们试图通过研究墨西哥家庭的行为来回答这个问题，墨西哥是一个经历大量且稳定汇款流入的国家。使用工具变量方法，我们发现汇款在气候适应过程中发挥着重要作用。汇款被用于采用空调，这是应对高温和维持家庭热舒适的重要降温设备。我们利用气候和收入的异质性，展示了沿海和内陆地区以及不同收入群体之间在利用汇款进行气候适应方面存在巨大差异。最后，我们量化了家庭通过采用空调所获得的总体福利增加。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Does land conservation raise property taxes? Evidence from New England cities and towns
records.title_cn: 土地保护会提高房产税吗？来自新英格兰城镇的证据
records.abstract_en: Protected lands provide high ecological and social value, yet a perception that land protection erodes local property tax bases and shifts tax burdens to other owners creates barriers for new protection. We investigate the impact of land protection on local property tax rates using panel data from more than 1400 towns and cities in New England between 1990 and 2015, including both ownership and easement-based protection. We find that on average, new protection results in a small increase in annual tax rates, with an expected change of $0.0231 per $1000 of value for a 1 percentage point increase in the percent of municipal area protected. This corresponds to an increase in a homeowner's annual property tax bill of $1.16 per $100,000 of value for 100 acres of new land protection. We do not find that taxes continue to increase over time or reduce municipal expenditures. However, for towns that are growing slowly, have lower household incomes, or use municipal land protection, we estimate greater tax bill increases of up to $10 for each $100,000 of value. These results provide evidence that land protection does not have a substantial impact on property taxes, but also highlight the importance of maintaining and expanding public compensation mechanisms, such as payments in lieu of taxes, where expected burdens from new protection may be greater.
records.abstract_cn: 受保护土地具有很高的生态和社会价值，但认为土地保护会侵蚀地方房产税基并将税收负担转移给其他业主的看法，为新的保护设置了障碍。我们利用1400年至1990年间新英格兰超过2015个城镇的面板数据，研究了土地保护对地方房产税率的影响，包括所有权和地役权保护。我们发现，平均而言，新的保护导致年税率小幅上升，市政区域保护比例每增加0.0231个百分点，预期变化为每1000美元价值增加1美元。这相当于对于1.16万美元价值的房产，每100000英亩新增土地保护，房主年房产税账单增加100美元。我们没有发现税收随时间持续增加或市政支出减少。然而，对于增长缓慢、家庭收入较低或使用市政土地保护的城镇，我们估计每10万美元价值的税收账单增加幅度更大，最高可达100000美元。这些结果证明土地保护对房产税没有实质性影响，但也强调了在预期新保护负担可能更大的地方，维持和扩大公共补偿机制（如代替税收的支付）的重要性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The value of information disclosure: Evidence from mask consumption in China
records.title_cn: 信息披露的价值：来自中国口罩消费的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of information provision on defensive expenditures, using China’s roll-out of air pollution information as a quasi-natural experiment. With a unique dataset of high-frequency mask purchase transactions, our difference-in-differences estimates show that the provision of air pollution information increases expenditures on PM2.5 respirators by 32%, which is mainly driven by improved information quality and the addition of PM2.5 index. The effect is enhanced by increased attention to pollution alerts and it is more pronounced during heavily polluted days. Our results shed light on the benefits of information provision through inducing defensive expenditures to reduce air pollution exposure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国空气污染信息的逐步公开作为准自然实验，研究信息提供对防御性支出的影响。基于高频口罩购买交易的独特数据集，我们的双重差分估计显示，空气污染信息的提供使PM2.5呼吸器的支出增加了32%，这主要归因于信息质量的提升和PM2.5指数的加入。该效应因对污染警报关注度的提高而增强，并且在重度污染日更为显著。我们的研究结果揭示了信息提供通过诱导防御性支出以减少空气污染暴露的益处。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: International climate aid and trade
records.title_cn: 国际气候援助和贸易
records.abstract_en: Foreign aid allocation by donor countries to developing economies is known to be motivated by the donor country’s bilateral trade interests. Does this apply also to bilateral climate aid? In this paper, we combine theoretical and empirical analyses to investigate how bilateral trade affects donor countries’ allocations of bilateral climate aid. Our theoretical analysis develops a simple model to support our hypothesis that bilateral trade has a positive impact on climate aid transfers. The model highlights the terms-of-trade and positive income effects of climate aid, and predicts a positive relationship between donor countries’ exports to and imports from recipient countries and their climate aid transfers. The empirical analysis is based on bilateral climate aid data for 2002 to 2017. We employ fixed effects and instrumental variable-2 stage least square estimations (IV-2SLS) with a shift-share instrument to overcome the endogeneity of trade. Our empirical results show that donors’ exports have a significant, robust, positive effect on climate aid transfers.
records.abstract_cn: 众所周知，捐助国向发展中经济体分配外国援助是出于捐助国的双边贸易利益。这是否也适用于双边气候援助？在本文中，我们结合理论和实证分析来研究双边贸易如何影响捐助国双边气候援助的分配。我们的理论分析开发了一个简单的模型来支持我们的假设，即双边贸易对气候援助转移具有积极影响。该模型强调了气候援助的贸易条件和积极的收入影响，并预测捐助国对受援国的出口和进口与其气候援助转移之间存在正相关关系。实证分析基于2002至2017的双边气候援助数据。我们采用固定效应和工具变量2阶段最小二乘估计（IV-2SLS）和移位份额工具来克服贸易的内生性。我们的实证结果表明，捐助者的出口对气候援助转移具有显着、强劲和积极的影响。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The spillover effect of peak pricing
records.title_cn: 峰值定价的溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Understanding consumer behaviours is important in designing dynamic tariffs, which are usually considered the first-best solution when the conventional flat tariff does not reflect the varying cost of electricity generation. I estimate households’ own- and cross-price elasticities using dataset from a smart metering project, and investigate which household specific characteristics determine the impact of peak prices on electricity consumption. I find peak prices (17:00–20:00) reduce peak and post-peak consumption (20:00–23:00), indicating a spillover effect of peak prices. The underlying mechanisms that could be generating the spillover effect have been further discussed and investigated. Finally, I estimate dynamic tariffs’ distributional and welfare effects, and demonstrate that the spillover effect is crucial in determining the cost effectiveness of a smart metering programme.
records.abstract_cn: 理解消费者行为对于设计动态电价至关重要，当传统固定电价不能反映发电成本的变化时，动态电价通常被视为最优解决方案。我利用智能计量项目的数据集估计了家庭的自价格弹性和交叉价格弹性，并研究了哪些家庭特定特征决定了峰值电价对电力消耗的影响。我发现峰值电价（17:00-20:00）减少了峰值和峰值后（20:00-23:00）的用电量，表明峰值电价存在溢出效应。本文进一步讨论和研究了可能产生溢出效应的潜在机制。最后，我估计了动态电价的分配效应和福利效应，并证明溢出效应在决定智能计量项目的成本效益方面至关重要。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The impact of urban road pricing on the use of bike sharing
records.title_cn: 城市道路收费对共享单车使用的影响
records.abstract_en: We empirically analyse the effect of road pricing on the use of bike sharing. We exploit two sudden policy changes in Milan's congestion pricing scheme resulting in a shift from priced to unpriced road use: a temporary suspension of the scheme in 2012, and a durable reduction in its application schedule. We find that the sudden removal of road pricing decreases bike-sharing use by about 5%. The policy impact mainly occurs through the increase of road traffic congestion, which makes cycling less safe and pleasant. The reduction in the schedule leads to an 8% decline in bike-sharing use in the affected time window. Our findings indicate that policies inducing drivers to internalise the external costs of car use also promote the uptake of non-polluting transport modes. This widens the spectrum of benefits that need to be considered in the design and implementation of road pricing policies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们实证分析了道路收费对共享单车使用的影响。我们利用了米兰拥堵收费方案中的两次突然政策变化，导致从收费道路使用转向免费道路使用：2012年该方案的暂时中止，以及其适用时间表的持久缩减。我们发现，道路收费的突然取消使共享单车的使用量减少了约5%。政策影响主要通过道路交通拥堵的增加来实现，这使得骑行变得不那么安全和愉快。时间表的缩减导致受影响时间段内共享单车的使用量下降了8%。我们的研究结果表明，促使驾驶员将汽车使用的外部成本内部化的政策也促进了无污染交通方式的采用。这拓宽了在设计和实施道路收费政策时需要考虑的效益范围。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: We didn’t start the fire: Effects of a natural disaster on consumers’ financial distress
records.title_cn: 我们并未点燃火焰：自然灾害对消费者财务困境的影响
records.abstract_en: Global climate change is increasing the frequency and severity of natural disasters. We use detailed consumer credit data to investigate the impact of the 2016 Fort McMurray Wildfire, the costliest wildfire disaster in Canadian history, on consumers’ financial stress. We focus on the arrears of insured mortgages because of their important implications for financial institutions and insurers’ business risk and relevant management practices. Our findings suggest that wildfires have caused more mortgage arrears in severely damaged areas, with both economic and statistical significance. For other areas with relatively minor damage, the increase in arrears is small and statistically insignificant.
records.abstract_cn: 全球气候变化正在增加自然灾害的频率和严重程度。我们使用详细的消费者信贷数据来调查2016年麦克默里堡野火（加拿大历史上损失最惨重的野火灾害）对消费者财务压力的影响。我们关注保险抵押贷款的拖欠情况，因为它们对金融机构和保险公司的业务风险及相关管理实践具有重要意义。我们的研究结果表明，野火在严重受损地区导致了更多的抵押贷款拖欠，这在经济上和统计上均具有显著性。对于受损相对较轻的其他地区，拖欠的增加幅度较小且统计上不显著。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The charisma premium: Iconic individuals and wildlife values
records.title_cn: 魅力溢价：标志性个体与野生动物价值
records.abstract_en: We develop a new theory of the wildlife-viewing value of particularly “charismatic” individuals in a population. In contrast to the existing recreation literature, which typically treats all individuals as interchangeable, we allow for heterogeneous charisma within a population, and ask how this heterogeneity affects each individual’s marginal value. We find that more charismatic individuals confer higher value than their nondescript peers, populations with heterogeneous charisma are more valuable than homogeneous populations, and populations with more heterogeneous charisma raise the value of their most charismatic individuals. These results suggest that traditional approaches to wildlife-viewing valuation are inappropriate when specific individuals within the population are singled out as being more charismatic by wildlife viewers. We apply the model to bear viewing in Katmai National Park, Alaska (site of the famous Fat Bear competition). We find that the most charismatic individual (“Otis”) is more than an order of magnitude more valuable than the median bear. These results have implications for government agencies assigning damage values when individuals within a population are poached or accidentally killed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新理论，用以评估种群中特别“有魅力”个体的野生动物观赏价值。与现有休闲文献通常将所有个体视为可互换的不同，我们允许种群内存在异质性魅力，并探讨这种异质性如何影响每个个体的边际价值。我们发现，更有魅力的个体比其普通同伴带来更高的价值，具有异质性魅力的种群比同质种群更有价值，且魅力异质性更强的种群会提升其最具魅力个体的价值。这些结果表明，当野生动物观赏者特别指出种群中某些个体更具魅力时，传统的野生动物观赏价值评估方法并不适用。我们将该模型应用于阿拉斯加卡特迈国家公园（著名的胖熊比赛举办地）的观熊活动。我们发现，最具魅力的个体（“奥蒂斯”）的价值比中位数熊高出超过一个数量级。这些结果对政府机构在种群中个体被偷猎或意外杀死时确定损害价值具有启示意义。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Quantifying COVID-19’s silver lining: Avoided deaths from air quality improvements in Bogotá
records.title_cn: 量化COVID-19的一线希望：波哥大空气质量改善所避免的死亡
records.abstract_en: In cities around the world, COVID-19 lockdowns have significantly improved outdoor air quality. Even if only temporary, these improvements could have longer-lasting effects by making chronic air pollution more salient and boosting political pressure for change. To that end, it is important to develop objective estimates of both the air quality improvements associated with lockdowns and the benefits they generate. We use panel data econometric models to estimate the effect of Bogotá’s 16-month lockdown on PM2.5 and NO2 pollution, epidemiological models to simulate the effect of reductions in these pollutants on long- and short-term mortality, and benefit transfer methods to value the avoided mortality. We find that on average, Bogotá’s lockdown cut PM2.5 pollution by 15% and NO2 pollution by 21%. However, the magnitude of these effects varied considerably over time and across the city's neighborhoods. Equivalent permanent reductions in these pollutants would reduce long-term premature deaths from air pollution by 23% each year, a benefit valued at $1 billion annually. Finally, we estimate that if they occurred ceteris paribus, the temporary reductions in pollutant concentrations in 2020–2021 due to Bogotá’s lockdown would have cut short-term deaths from air pollution by 19%, a benefit valued at $244 million.
records.abstract_cn: 在世界各地的城市中，COVID-19封锁显著改善了室外空气质量。即使这些改善只是暂时的，它们也可能通过使慢性空气污染问题更加突出并增强政治变革压力而产生更持久的影响。为此，重要的是要客观估计封锁带来的空气质量改善及其产生的效益。我们使用面板数据计量经济模型来估计波哥大16个月封锁对PM2.5和NO2污染的影响，使用流行病学模型来模拟这些污染物减少对长期和短期死亡率的影响，并使用效益转移方法来评估避免死亡的货币价值。我们发现，平均而言，波哥大的封锁使PM2.5污染降低了15%，NO2污染降低了21%。然而，这些影响的幅度在时间和城市各社区之间存在显著差异。这些污染物的等效永久性减少将使每年因空气污染导致的长期过早死亡减少23%，这一效益每年价值1亿美元。最后，我们估计，如果其他条件不变，2020-2021年波哥大封锁导致的污染物浓度暂时性减少将使空气污染导致的短期死亡减少19%，这一效益价值244亿美元。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Air pollution and mortality impacts of coal mining: Evidence from coalmine accidents in China
records.title_cn: 煤炭开采的空气污染与死亡率影响：来自中国煤矿事故的证据
records.abstract_en: We leverage the timing of coalmine accidents to examine the effect of coal mining on air pollution. Safety regulations mandate that coal mining be suspended if a mine experiences an accident with 10 or more fatalities. We use a stacked difference-in-differences approach to compare counties with an accident to those experiencing an accident more than two years earlier or later. We provide evidence that the timing of accidents cannot be predicted. Next, we combine satellite-based air pollution data at the county-day level with the dates of accidents to show that on average, suspending coal mining reduces local air pollution by 8%. Changes in the level of coal consumption do not drive this reduction. We also find significant decreases in respiratory mortality after suspending coal mining with particularly large effects on vulnerable populations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用煤矿事故的时间点来考察煤炭开采对空气污染的影响。安全法规规定，如果煤矿发生事故导致10人或以上死亡，则必须暂停开采。我们采用堆叠双重差分法，将发生事故的县与早于或晚于两年以上发生事故的县进行比较。我们提供的证据表明，事故的时间点无法预测。接下来，我们将基于卫星的县级日度空气污染数据与事故日期相结合，表明平均而言，暂停煤炭开采可使当地空气污染降低8%。煤炭消费水平的变化并非导致这一降低的原因。我们还发现，暂停煤炭开采后，呼吸系统死亡率显著下降，其中对脆弱人群的影响尤为显著。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Solidarity under heterogenous adaptation costs: Experimental evidence on coping after climate hazards
records.title_cn: 异质适应成本下的团结：气候灾害后应对的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Climate hazards destroy the livelihoods and assets of millions of people worldwide, but also spur solidarity within affected communities. We conducted a pre-registered incentivized online experiment with a sample of 769 UK residents to better understand solidarity behavior framed in the context of flooding. In the experiment, participants make costly adaptation decisions that reduce their own risk of endowment loss. Moreover, they can make solidarity transfers to affected partners if unaffected themselves. Participants are matched with a partner who takes adaptation decisions, too. We experimentally vary the adaptation costs of the partner to be either the same (control condition) or heterogenous (known or uncertain). In the control condition, participants show less solidarity with non-adapted partners than with adapted ones. On average, the heterogenous adaptation cost treatments do not significantly affect observed solidarity transfers. Explorative analyses indicate, however, that differences in transfers to adapted and non-adapted partners are mediated by one's adaptation behavior. Under known heterogenous adaptation costs, risk-averse players (who adapted themselves) show as much solidarity with adapted as with non-adapted partners. Overall, the results suggest that information about adaptation cost heterogeneity may promote solidarity after exogenous shocks when people cannot easily adapt proactively.
records.abstract_cn: 气候灾害摧毁了全球数百万人的生计和资产，但也激发了受影响社区内部的团结。我们进行了一项预先注册的激励性在线实验，样本为769名英国居民，以更好地理解以洪水为背景的团结行为。在实验中，参与者做出代价高昂的适应决策，以降低自身 endowment 损失的风险。此外，如果自身未受影响，他们可以向受影响的伙伴进行团结转移。参与者与同样做出适应决策的伙伴配对。我们实验性地改变伙伴的适应成本，使其相同（控制条件）或异质（已知或不确定）。在控制条件下，参与者对未适应伙伴的团结程度低于对适应伙伴的团结程度。平均而言，异质适应成本处理并未显著影响观察到的团结转移。然而，探索性分析表明，对适应和未适应伙伴的转移差异受自身适应行为的中介作用。在已知异质适应成本下，风险规避型参与者（自身已适应）对适应和未适应伙伴表现出同等的团结。总体而言，结果表明，当人们无法轻易主动适应时，关于适应成本异质性的信息可能促进外生冲击后的团结。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Natural disasters and bank stability: Evidence from the U.S. financial system
records.title_cn: 自然灾害与银行稳定性：来自美国金融体系的证据
records.abstract_en: We show that weather-related natural disasters in the United States significantly weaken the financial stability of banks with business activities in affected regions. This is reflected in higher probabilities of default, lower z-scores, higher non-performing assets ratios, higher foreclosure ratios, lower returns on assets and lower equity ratios of affected banks in the years following a natural disaster. The effects are economically relevant and highlight the financial vulnerability of banks and their borrowers despite insurances and public aid programs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美国与天气相关的自然灾害显著削弱了在受灾地区有业务活动的银行的金融稳定性。这反映在自然灾害后几年内，受影响银行的违约概率更高、z-score更低、不良资产比率更高、止赎比率更高、资产回报率更低以及股权比率更低。这些影响在经济上具有相关性，并凸显了银行及其借款人在保险和公共援助计划存在下的金融脆弱性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Unseen annihilation: Illegal fishing practices and nautical patrol
records.title_cn: 看不见的毁灭：非法捕捞行为与海上巡逻
records.abstract_en: A host of regulations should protect fish, a common-pool resource, from overexploitation, but detecting violations of these regulations is challenging, both at sea and in port. We present a novel approach to uncover a supposedly widespread and particularly harmful illegal fishing practice, the use of nets with illegally small mesh size. Our approach relies on readily available data on reported fish landings. We focus on bottom trawling, the world’s most widely used fishing method. We exploit the fact that using illegally small mesh size increases the share of small fish in the catch. Using quasi-random variation in nautical patrol as a source of variation in the incentive to comply, we show that in weeks without patrol the share of small fish in the landed catch is systematically larger than in adjacent weeks with patrol. Our results are in line with widespread use of illegally small mesh. The resulting catch and discard of juvenile fish is many times larger than the gain in the catch of marketable fish. This harm has thus far been largely ignored in estimates of the externalities from fishing.
records.abstract_cn: 一系列法规本应保护鱼类这一公共池资源免遭过度开发，但在海上和港口发现违反这些法规的行为都具有挑战性。我们提出了一种新方法，以揭示一种据称普遍存在且特别有害的非法捕捞行为，即使用网目尺寸非法过小的渔网。我们的方法依赖于现成的报告鱼类上岸量数据。我们聚焦于底拖网捕捞，这是世界上使用最广泛的捕捞方法。我们利用这样一个事实：使用非法小网目会增加渔获中小鱼的比例。利用海上巡逻的准随机变化作为合规激励变化的来源，我们表明，在没有巡逻的周，上岸渔获中小鱼的比例系统性地高于相邻有巡逻的周。我们的结果与非法小网目的广泛使用相一致。由此产生的幼鱼捕捞和丢弃量比可销售鱼类渔获的增加量要大得多。这种危害迄今为止在捕捞外部性的估计中很大程度上被忽视了。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Tax incentives, environmental regulation and firms’ emission reduction strategies: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 税收激励、环境规制与企业减排策略：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Policy interaction is an important way to deal with increasingly complex environmental problems. This paper examines the investment-related tax cuts and the policy interaction with environmental regulation on firms' emission reduction strategies. Taking China's value-added tax (VAT) reform as a quasi-natural experiment and considering the interaction with the emission reduction target policy, our difference-in-differences estimation shows that: the average effect of the VAT reform reduces firms' sulfur dioxide (SO2) emission intensity by 16.6%, due to the adoption of emissions reduction strategies in the production processes; the interaction effect between the VAT reform and environmental regulation incentivizes firms to additionally reduce SO2 emission intensity, due to the adoption of both production processes and end-of-pipe reduction strategies. Our findings are more evident for firms with tight financial constraints. Overall, this paper reveals the micro-mechanisms of how the tax policies incentivize firms to choose emission reduction strategies and highlights the importance of the interaction effects between environmental and non-environmental policies, thus providing implications for the policy mix of environmental regulation and tax-cut incentives to promote pollution reduction and improve business performance.
records.abstract_cn: 政策互动是应对日益复杂的环境问题的重要途径。本文考察了与投资相关的税收减免及其与环境规制在企业的减排策略上的政策互动。以中国的增值税改革作为准自然实验，并考虑与减排目标政策的互动，我们的双重差分估计表明：增值税改革的平均效应使企业的二氧化硫（SO2）排放强度降低了16.6%，这是由于在生产过程中采用了减排策略；增值税改革与环境规制之间的互动效应激励企业额外降低SO2排放强度，这是由于同时采用了生产过程和末端治理的减排策略。我们的发现在财务约束紧张的企业中更为明显。总体而言，本文揭示了税收政策如何激励企业选择减排策略的微观机制，并强调了环境政策与非环境政策之间互动效应的重要性，从而为环境规制与减税激励的政策组合以促进污染减排和改善企业绩效提供了启示。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Economic development and conservation impacts of China's nature reserves
records.title_cn: 中国自然保护区经济发展与保护影响
records.abstract_en: Protected areas are a dominant but contentious instrument of conservation policy. Restrictions on resource extraction and land use constrain livelihoods but may also support alternate pathways to development through sustainable use, tourism, and landscape amenities. We investigate the economic development and environmental impacts of China's Nature Reserves using county-level panel data between 1980 and 2010. We find small positive impacts on an aggregate household development index and that Nature Reserves maintained natural land cover within their boundaries. We also find employment shifts from resource-extractive to service-based activity, but an overall negative impact on reported employment. Household development gains and shifts towards service-based employment were greater closer to locations that were already more developed and had higher baseline assets. These results indicate both the promise of protected areas as a sustainable development strategy and the need for institutional mechanisms to ensure that local benefits and employment opportunities are broadly distributed.
records.abstract_cn: 保护区是保护政策中占主导地位但具有争议性的工具。对资源开采和土地使用的限制制约了生计，但也可能通过可持续利用、旅游和景观宜人性为发展提供替代途径。我们利用1980年至2010年间的县级面板数据，研究了中国自然保护区的经济发展和环境影响。我们发现，总体家庭发展指数有小幅正面影响，且自然保护区维持了其边界内的自然土地覆盖。我们还发现就业从资源开采型向服务型活动转变，但对报告就业总体有负面影响。家庭发展收益和向服务型就业的转变在靠近原本更发达且初始资产较高的地区更为显著。这些结果表明，保护区作为可持续发展战略具有前景，同时也需要制度机制来确保地方利益和就业机会得到广泛分配。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Information, awareness, and mental health: Evidence from air pollution disclosure in China
records.title_cn: 信息、意识与心理健康：来自中国空气污染披露的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper assesses mental health responses to information on environmental risks. We exploit the progressive implementation of a national program in China that introduces more comprehensive air pollution monitoring and provides real-time air-pollution information to the public. The program leads to a sharp increase in public awareness and attention to air pollution issues and results in a large increase in the sensitivity of individual’s mental health to changes in air quality, especially among those with more exposure to pollution information and those more susceptible to mental illnesses. Information of worsening air quality has a direct effect on mental health as a source of stressors and an indirect behavioral effect through reducing outdoor activities and social integration. Our findings shed light on the design and delivery of environmental information disclosure programs, especially for countries with pressing environmental threats.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了心理健康对环境风险信息的反应。我们利用中国一项国家计划的逐步实施，该计划引入了更全面的空气污染监测，并向公众提供实时空气污染信息。该计划导致公众对空气污染问题的意识和关注度急剧增加，并使个人心理健康对空气质量变化的敏感性大幅提高，尤其是在那些接触污染信息更多和更容易患精神疾病的人群中。空气质量恶化的信息作为压力源对心理健康有直接影响，并通过减少户外活动和社交整合产生间接行为效应。我们的研究为环境信息披露计划的设计和交付提供了启示，特别是对于面临紧迫环境威胁的国家。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Health, air pollution, and location choice
records.title_cn: 健康、空气污染与选址
records.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence that air-pollution-related health conditions change how households evaluate clean air and, as a result, incentivize them to relocate to locations with better air quality. The evidence implies that naive estimations of the adverse effect of air pollution on health are biased, as people sort on air quality differently depending on their health. I employ a spatial-equilibrium model in which households choose a county to live in based on county-level characteristics including air pollution. Using National Longitudinal Survey of Youth data, I create a panel tracking respondents’ respiratory health shocks and county-level location for over three decades. The estimates from a multinomial mixed logit model support the hypothesis that households move to cleaner-air locations after an adult is diagnosed with asthma. I find that households react more strongly to an asthma diagnosis for an adult than to a child’s diagnosis. The estimated median increase in marginal willingness to pay for a one-unit reduction in Air Quality Index after a diagnosis of adult-onset asthma is $157–$830 (in constant 1982–84 dollars).
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了证据表明，与空气污染相关的健康状况会改变家庭对清洁空气的评价方式，并因此激励他们迁移到空气质量更好的地方。这些证据意味着，对空气污染对健康不利影响的朴素估计是有偏的，因为人们根据自身健康状况的不同而对空气质量进行不同的分类选择。我采用了一个空间均衡模型，其中家庭根据包括空气污染在内的县级特征来选择居住的县。利用全国青年纵向调查数据，我构建了一个追踪受访者呼吸系统健康冲击和县级位置超过三十年的面板数据。来自多项混合logit模型的估计支持了这样的假设：在成年人被诊断出哮喘后，家庭会迁移到空气质量更清洁的地方。我发现，家庭对成年人哮喘诊断的反应比对儿童诊断的反应更强烈。在成年发病哮喘诊断后，对空气质量指数每降低一个单位的边际支付意愿的估计中位数增加为$157–$830（以1982-84年不变美元计）。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The discounting premium puzzle: Survey evidence from professional economists
records.title_cn: 折现溢价之谜：来自专业经济学家的调查证据
records.abstract_en: We surveyed economists’ attitudes toward adjusting discount rates to the risk profile of public programs. Three-quarters of respondents recommend to use project-specific discount rates. For example, on average, respondents discount railway infrastructures more than hospitals and climate mitigation. But the degree of discount discrimination between distinct risk profiles of different projects is fairly limited in our sample given the differences in risk profiles for these projects. Economic experts thus penalize risky public projects far less than financial markets penalize private investments. We call this the ”discount premium puzzle”. Finally, among experts in favor of a single discount rate, there is no consensus on whether it should be based on the average cost of capital in the economy, the sovereign borrowing cost, or the Ramsey rule, which gives rise to disagreement over the level of the recommended discount rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们调查了经济学家对根据公共项目风险状况调整折现率的态度。四分之三的受访者建议使用项目特定的折现率。例如，平均而言，受访者对铁路基础设施的折现率高于医院和气候减缓项目。但在我们的样本中，鉴于这些项目风险状况的差异，对不同项目不同风险状况的折现区分程度相当有限。因此，经济专家对风险公共项目的惩罚远低于金融市场对私人投资的惩罚。我们称之为“折现溢价之谜”。最后，在支持单一折现率的专家中，对于折现率应基于经济中的平均资本成本、主权借款成本还是拉姆齐规则，没有共识，这导致了对推荐折现率水平的分歧。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: First lead, now no bed? The unintended impacts of lead abatement laws on eviction
records.title_cn: 先铅中毒，现在无家可归？铅消除法对驱逐的意外影响
records.abstract_en: Lead paint in old houses is the leading cause of lead poisoning in children under 6 today. To combat this problem, several states have passed lead abatement laws, forcing landlords to remove lead in the homes they rent if tenants have children under the age of 6. However, these laws have unintended consequences, causing landlords to evict tenants rather than abate lead. I use a difference-in-differences approach while employing various model specifications with various fixed effects and sets of controls to examine the impact of Ohio’s 2003 lead abatement law on eviction rates. Using newly collected data from the Eviction Lab at Princeton University, I find that the passage of Ohio’s lead abatement law sharply increased targeted evictions. Due to the law’s passage, the average census district in Ohio faced an increased eviction rate of roughly 0.457 points, corresponding to an additional 13.93 evictions a year. These impacts are highly statistically significant, sizeable, and economically meaningful, indicating that policy makers should incorporate distributional consequences when designing future lead abatement laws in order to avoid unintended consequences and ensure equitable outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 老房子中的含铅涂料是当今6岁以下儿童铅中毒的主要原因。为了解决这一问题，几个州通过了铅消除法，强制房东在租户有6岁以下儿童时清除其出租房屋中的铅。然而，这些法律产生了意想不到的后果，导致房东驱逐租户而非消除铅。我采用双重差分法，同时使用各种固定效应和控制变量组合的多种模型设定，考察俄亥俄州2003年铅消除法对驱逐率的影响。利用从普林斯顿大学驱逐实验室新收集的数据，我发现俄亥俄州铅消除法的通过急剧增加了针对性的驱逐。由于该法律的通过，俄亥俄州的平均人口普查区面临约0.457个百分点的驱逐率上升，相当于每年额外增加13.93起驱逐。这些影响在统计上高度显著、规模可观且具有经济意义，表明政策制定者在设计未来的铅消除法时应纳入分配后果，以避免意外影响并确保公平结果。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Estimating environmental and cultural/heritage damages of a tailings dam failure: The case of the Fundão dam in Brazil
records.title_cn: 估算尾矿坝溃坝的环境与文化/遗产损害：以巴西Fundão大坝为例
records.abstract_en: We present the results of a contingent valuation study aimed at estimating the monetary value of environmental and cultural/heritage injuries caused by the Fundão (tailings) Dam failure in Brazil in 2015 as perceived by the Brazilian population. While the valuation literature on mining-related externalities is considerable, valuation studies of environmental and cultural/heritage injuries resulting from mining incidents are scarce and most available damage assessments apply market valuation methods, while rarely considering environmental and other nonmarket-valued impacts. The flooding and the release of tailings from the Fundão Dam failure led to injuries to sediments, watercourse opacity, and oxygenation, changes in riparian morphology, damages to cultural/heritage resources, mortality to fish and wildlife, changes in the food chain and more along the 675 km watercourse of the Doce River. This was arguably the greatest environmental and cultural/heritage injury ever caused by a single tailings dam collapse. The study followed state-of-the-art recommendations for the development, administration, and data analysis of stated-preference valuation methods. The survey of a representative sample of 5195 Brazilian urban households revealed that the average lower-bound willingness-to-pay estimate to avoid a similar incident in the near future was 137 USD and the parametric-based estimate was 230 USD per household, which aggregates to 7.96 or 12.91 billion USD, respectively. This corresponds to environmental damages of 176 or 295 USD per m3 of tailings released.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了一项条件价值评估研究的结果，旨在估算巴西人口感知的2015年Fundão（尾矿）大坝溃坝所造成的环境和文化/遗产损害的经济价值。虽然关于采矿相关外部性的价值评估文献相当丰富，但针对采矿事故造成的环境和文化/遗产损害的价值评估研究却很少，且大多数可用的损害评估采用市场价值方法，很少考虑环境和其他非市场价值影响。Fundão大坝溃坝引发的洪水和尾矿释放导致沉积物受损、水道浑浊度和含氧量改变、河岸形态变化、文化/遗产资源受损、鱼类和野生动物死亡、食物链变化等，影响范围沿Doce河675公里的水道。这可以说是单一尾矿坝坍塌造成的最大环境和文化/遗产损害。该研究遵循了陈述偏好价值评估方法在开发、实施和数据分析方面的最新建议。对5195户巴西城市家庭的代表性样本进行的调查显示，为避免近期发生类似事故，平均下限支付意愿估计为137美元，基于参数估计为每户230美元，分别合计为7.96亿或12.91亿美元。这相当于每立方米尾矿释放造成176或295美元的环境损害。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Environmental goods provision and gentrification: Evidence from MillionTreesNYC
records.title_cn: 环境物品供给与绅士化：来自百万棵树纽约计划的证据
records.abstract_en: Urban trees offer extensive environmental benefits. However, the distribution of trees in urban areas often disproportionately favors higher-income neighborhoods. Implementing tree-planting programs in lower-income neighborhoods may provide environmental amenity values but may also lead to unintended consequences, such as gentrification. This paper focuses on one of the largest tree-planting programs in the U.S., the MillionTreesNYC Program, and estimates the impact of an increased supply of urban street trees on housing values and neighborhood compositions. The results demonstrate that the additional urban street trees did serve as an environmental amenity, resulting in higher housing values and attracting more white, educated, and young households to areas with new trees. However, the gentrification effects of this tree-planting program were relatively small, with minimal change in community composition. These findings suggest that it is possible to provide public goods without significant displacement of the existing population while also reaping the numerous benefits trees offer to urban areas.
records.abstract_cn: 城市树木提供了广泛的 environmental 效益。然而，城市地区树木的分布往往不成比例地偏向于高收入社区。在低收入社区实施植树计划可能提供环境舒适价值，但也可能导致意想不到的后果，如绅士化。本文聚焦于美国最大的植树计划之一——百万棵树纽约计划，并估计增加城市街道树木供应对住房价值和社区构成的影响。结果表明，额外的城市街道树木确实起到了环境舒适的作用，导致住房价值上升，并吸引了更多白人、受过教育和年轻的家庭到有新树的地区。然而，这一植树计划的绅士化效应相对较小，社区构成变化甚微。这些发现表明，在提供公共物品的同时，有可能不显著迁移现有居民，同时也能收获树木为城市地区带来的众多益处。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Into the tropics: Temperature, mortality, and access to health care in Colombia
records.title_cn: 进入热带：哥伦比亚的温度、死亡率与医疗服务的可及性
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the relationship between temperature, mortality, and adaptation opportunities in a tropical country. Such countries host almost 40% of the world’s population and face inherently different environmental, demographic, and socio-economic conditions than their counterparts in temperate areas. Using detailed data from all Colombian municipalities, I show that anomalously hot or cold days increase mortality even at narrow temperature ranges, which are characteristic of the tropics. An additional day with a mean temperature above 27 °C (80.6 ∘F) increases mortality rates by approximately 0.24 deaths per 100,000, equivalent to 0.7% of monthly death rates. Unlike temperate locations, I find that deaths attributed to infectious diseases and respiratory illnesses drive this relationship in the hot part of the distribution, mainly affecting children aged 0–9. These findings uncover new factors and populations at risk and imply that the average person who dies after a hot temperature shock loses approximately 30 years of life. I also provide evidence that access to health care and quality of services could mediate between temperature and mortality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了热带国家中温度、死亡率与适应机会之间的关系。这类国家居住着全球近40%的人口，并且面临着与温带地区截然不同的环境、人口和社会经济条件。利用哥伦比亚所有城市的详细数据，我表明即使在热带特有的狭窄温度范围内，异常炎热或寒冷的日子也会增加死亡率。平均温度高于27°C（80.6°F）的额外一天会使死亡率增加约每100,000人0.24例死亡，相当于月死亡率的0.7%。与温带地区不同，我发现传染病和呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡推动了这一关系在高温分布端的表现，主要影响0-9岁的儿童。这些发现揭示了新的风险因素和风险人群，并意味着在高温冲击后死亡的平均个体大约损失30年的寿命。我还提供了证据表明，医疗服务的可及性和服务质量可能在温度与死亡率之间起到中介作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Endogenous bifurcation into environmental CSR and non-environmental CSR firms by activist shareholders
records.title_cn: 由激进股东内生分化出环境企业社会责任与非环境企业社会责任企业
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new and simple partial equilibrium model in which environmental corporate social responsibility (ECSR) firms arise endogenously through changes in the composition of their shareholders. Our model has two types of shareholders: profit seekers who aim to maximize dividends from their equities and environmental activists who demand not only monetary profits but also environmental investments from firms. The objective function of firms is a weighted average of both types of shareholders' utilities, and its weight is the proportion of their shareholdings. As a result of equity trades in a perfect competitive market, firms bifurcate into ECSR and non-ECSR firms even if they were homogeneous at establishment.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个新的简单局部均衡模型，在该模型中，环境企业社会责任（ECSR）企业通过其股东构成的变化内生地产生。我们的模型有两类股东：追求利润者，旨在最大化其股权的股息；以及环境活动家，他们不仅要求货币利润，还要求企业的环境投资。企业的目标函数是两类股东效用的加权平均，其权重是他们的持股比例。在完全竞争市场中的股权交易结果下，即使企业在成立时是同质的，也会分化为ECSR和非ECSR企业。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Cross-border environmental regulation and firm labor demand
records.title_cn: 跨境环境规制与企业劳动力需求
records.abstract_en: In 1994, due to environmental concerns, Germany banned a chemical called ‘Azo-dyes’, a primary input for the leather and textiles firms in India (a key exporter). Exploiting this as a quasi-natural experiment, we examine the effects of this cross-border regulatory change on labor compensation, particularly managerial, for both Indian upstream (dye-producing) and downstream (leather and textile) firms. We find that the regulation increased compensation of managers by 1.3%–18% in dye-producing firms compared to other chemical firms. This is due to the combination of changes such as investing in R&D, product churning, import of high-quality intermediates, due to the ban, which led to this change in within-firm labor composition. This increase in overall compensation is driven only by fixed component (wages), consistent with the effects of a long-run shock. We find no such effects for downstream firms. We believe, our study is one of the first to show that just like tariff, non-tariff barriers (NTBs) can also significantly affect within-firm labor composition.
records.abstract_cn: 在1994年，出于环境考虑，德国禁止了一种名为“偶氮染料”的化学品，这是印度皮革和纺织企业的主要投入品（印度是主要出口国）。利用这一事件作为准自然实验，我们考察了这一跨境监管变化对印度上游（染料生产）和下游（皮革和纺织）企业劳动力补偿，特别是管理层补偿的影响。我们发现，与其他化工企业相比，该法规使染料生产企业的管理者补偿增加了1.3%–18%。这是由于禁令导致的研发投资、产品更替、高质量中间品进口等变化的组合，进而引起了企业内部劳动力构成的这种变化。总体补偿的增加仅由固定部分（工资）驱动，这与长期冲击的影响一致。我们未发现对下游企业有此类影响。我们认为，我们的研究是首批表明非关税壁垒（NTBs）与关税一样，也能显著影响企业内部劳动力构成的研究之一。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Optimal climate policy under tipping risk and temporal risk aversion
records.title_cn: 临界风险与时间风险厌恶下的最优气候政策
records.abstract_en: We investigate the implications of absolute risk aversion with respect to intertemporal utility, i.e. temporal risk aversion, in the presence of a stylized climate tipping risk affecting productivity irreversibly. Optimal climate policy is more stringent under temporal risk aversion, in order to reduce all present and future probabilities of crossing the tipping point and avoid a situation where all generations are badly off. Temporal risk aversion implies a 30% increase in the social cost of carbon (SCC) under our benchmark calibration and for a 10% irreversible increase in the level of economic damage from climate change. The optimal SCC under temporal risk aversion increases sharply with the level of damage brought by a potential tipping point.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在存在一种风格化的气候临界风险（对生产率产生不可逆影响）的情况下，对跨期效用的绝对风险厌恶（即时间风险厌恶）的含义。在时间风险厌恶下，最优气候政策更为严格，以减少当前和未来所有跨越临界点的概率，并避免所有世代都遭受糟糕结果的情况。在我们的基准校准下，时间风险厌恶意味着碳的社会成本（SCC）增加30%，而气候变化经济损失水平不可逆增加10%。在时间风险厌恶下，最优SCC随着潜在临界点带来的损害水平急剧增加。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: The effects of observability and an information nudge on food choice
records.title_cn: 可观察性与信息助推对食物选择的影响
records.abstract_en: Our choice of food has major impacts on the environment. At the same time, it is visible to all people with whom we spend our daily lives. This raises the question of whether people are adapting their diets to gain a green reputation, as has been observed for other environmentally relevant consumption choices. Using an experiment in which participants can choose between vegan, vegetarian, and meat-based food vouchers, we examine how observation by others and the provision of an information nudge influence food choices. The results show that providing an information nudge reduces the likelihood of choosing meat by 12 percentage points. Observation by others does not significantly reduce the likelihood of choosing meat. Contrary to our prediction, when participants are observed and receive the information nudge, they are less inclined to choose one of the more sustainable options. We discuss the reasons for the partly surprising results and the implications for policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们的食物选择对环境有重大影响。同时，这一选择对我们日常生活中接触的所有人都是可见的。这引发了一个问题：人们是否会像在其他与环境相关的消费选择中观察到的那样，调整饮食以获取绿色声誉。通过一项实验，参与者可以在素食、纯素和肉类食品券之间进行选择，我们考察了他人观察以及提供信息助推如何影响食物选择。结果显示，提供信息助推使选择肉类的可能性降低了12个百分点。他人观察并未显著降低选择肉类的可能性。与我们的预测相反，当参与者被观察并收到信息助推时，他们更不倾向于选择更可持续的选项之一。我们讨论了部分结果出人意料的原因及其对政策的影响。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: This site is closed! The effect of decommissioning mining waste facilities on mortality in the long run
records.title_cn: 该站点已关闭！退役采矿废料设施对长期死亡率的影响
records.abstract_en: Mining is typically linked to industrial development. However, waste generated by mineral extraction is a major source of environmental deterioration. This poses a trade-off between preserving the environment and fostering growth. We assess the long-run consequences of reduced exposure to mining waste on health by exploiting municipality-level variation in the staggered closure of facilities that treat and store mining waste in Italy over the course of five decades. We find that shutting down waste facilities decreases decadal mortality by 126 deaths per 100,000 inhabitants (i.e., by nearly 15%), while also improving the literacy and employment rates of the resident population. Our results point to positive health effects dominating potentially negative wealth effects.
records.abstract_cn: 采矿通常与工业发展相关联。然而，矿物开采产生的废料是环境恶化的主要来源。这构成了在保护环境与促进增长之间的权衡。我们利用意大利五十年来处理及储存采矿废料的设施交错关闭的市级差异，评估减少暴露于采矿废料对健康的长期影响。我们发现，关闭废料设施使十年期死亡率每100,000名居民减少126例死亡（即减少近15%），同时提高了常住人口的识字率和就业率。我们的结果表明，积极的健康效应主导了潜在的负面财富效应。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Directed technical change, environmental sustainability, and population growth
records.title_cn: 定向技术变革、环境可持续性与人口增长
records.abstract_en: Population growth has two potentially counteracting effects on pollution emissions: (i) more people imply more production and thereby more emissions, and (ii) more people imply a larger research capacity which might reduce the emission intensity of production, depending on the direction of research. This study investigates how to achieve a given climate goal in the presence of these two effects. A growth model featuring both directed technical change and population growth is developed. The model allows for simultaneous research in polluting and non-polluting technologies. Both analytical and numerical results indicate that population growth is a burden on the environment, even when all research efforts are directed toward non-polluting technologies. Thus, research subsidies alone cannot ensure environmental sustainability. Instead, the analysis highlights the importance of carbon taxes for climate change mitigation.
records.abstract_cn: 人口增长对污染排放有两种可能相互抵消的影响：（i）更多的人口意味着更多的生产，从而产生更多的排放；（ii）更多的人口意味着更大的研究能力，这可能降低生产的排放强度，具体取决于研究的方向。本研究探讨了在存在这两种效应的情况下如何实现给定的气候目标。本文构建了一个同时包含定向技术变革和人口增长的增长模型。该模型允许同时研究污染型和非污染型技术。分析和数值结果均表明，即使所有研究努力都指向非污染技术，人口增长仍然是环境的负担。因此，仅靠研究补贴无法确保环境可持续性。相反，分析强调了碳税在减缓气候变化中的重要性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Is environmental regulation the answer to pollution problems in urbanizing economies?
records.title_cn: 环境规制是城市化经济体污染问题的答案吗？
records.abstract_en: This paper seeks to better understand the persistent environmental problems in urbanizing economies. We examine the effectiveness of environmental policy in an economy with agglomeration economies and endogenous firm relocation and entry/exit. We show that, although environmental regulation is effective in the short run, in the presence of agglomeration economies, spatial relocation of firms in response to environmental regulation can undermine the effectiveness of regulations, rendering them less effective or even ineffective. In fact, we show that regulation might even be counter-productive, i.e., exacerbate environmental problems, at certain stages of development. We present initial empirical evidence in the context of water pollution in China that demonstrates the importance of agglomeration economies in determining the impacts of environmental regulation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在更好地理解城市化经济体中持续存在的环境问题。我们考察了在集聚经济和内生企业迁移及进入/退出条件下环境政策的有效性。我们表明，尽管环境规制在短期内有效，但在集聚经济存在的情况下，企业为应对环境规制而进行的空间迁移可能会削弱规制的有效性，使其效果降低甚至无效。事实上，我们表明，在发展的某些阶段，规制甚至可能适得其反，即加剧环境问题。我们提供了中国水污染背景下的初步经验证据，证明了集聚经济在决定环境规制影响中的重要性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Safety first? The effect of studded tyres on traffic accidents and local air pollution
records.title_cn: 安全第一？镶钉轮胎对交通事故和当地空气污染的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper offers empirical insights into the trade-off between local air pollution and traffic accidents by exploiting an annual studded tyre ban in Norway. Studded tyres offer superior traction on icy roads, but also contribute to harmful particulate matter pollution. The use of studs is therefore restricted to certain dates which, due to its dependence on Easter, can differ by over a month from one year to another. I exploit this variation in a type of regression discontinuity in time design. The findings suggest that the use of studded tyres does not decrease the number of traffic accidents. Moreover, there is no evidence that studded tyres increase particulate matter pollution. As studded tyres increases road wear and tear and appears to not contribute to road safety, this paper raises the question of whether North-American and European countries where studded tyres are widely used should revisit their traffic safety policies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用挪威每年一次的镶钉轮胎禁令，对当地空气污染与交通事故之间的权衡提供了实证见解。镶钉轮胎在结冰路面上提供更好的抓地力，但也导致有害颗粒物污染。因此，镶钉的使用仅限于特定日期，由于这些日期取决于复活节，不同年份之间可能相差一个多月。我在一种时间回归不连续设计中利用了这种变化。研究结果表明，使用镶钉轮胎并不会减少交通事故的数量。此外，没有证据表明镶钉轮胎会增加颗粒物污染。由于镶钉轮胎加剧了道路磨损，且似乎并未有助于道路安全，本文提出了一个问题：广泛使用镶钉轮胎的北美和欧洲国家是否应重新审视其交通安全政策。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Waste import and air pollution: Evidence from China's waste import ban
records.title_cn: 废物进口与空气污染：来自中国废物进口禁令的证据
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the impact on air pollution of China's 2017 policy banning waste imports. We exploit a difference-in-differences strategy combining the time variation and cross-prefecture variation in waste imports before the policy change. We find that prefectures that imported waste in the prepolicy period experienced greater air quality improvements after the policy shock. This effect is stronger in regions with loose environmental regulations and poor waste utilization capacity. Further investigation shows that reductions in both the burning of unrecyclable waste and the level of industrial production are channels through which the waste import ban reduced air pollution.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了中国2017年禁止废物进口政策对空气污染的影响。我们利用双重差分策略，结合政策变化前废物进口的时间变化和跨地级市差异。我们发现，在政策前时期进口废物的地级市在政策冲击后经历了更大的空气质量改善。这一效应在环境监管宽松和废物利用能力较差的地区更为显著。进一步研究表明，不可回收废物的焚烧减少和工业生产水平的降低是废物进口禁令减少空气污染的渠道。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Information processing in stated preference surveys
records.title_cn: 陈述偏好调查中的信息处理
records.abstract_en: For valid preference elicitation, stated preference surveys must provide information on the good to be valued, and respondents must process and recall the information. Previous studies show that the amount and type of information can affect stated preferences and the validity of value estimates, but how respondents process this information has been less researched. Some studies find correlations between preferences and respondent engagement with the information, but our study is the first to randomly and exogenously manipulate factors of engagement in a stated preference survey. Drawing on stated preference guidance and psychological concepts, we estimate the effect of quiz questions (asking about the content of the information) and self-reference questions (asking how the information personally relates to the respondent) on (i) engagement, (ii) information recall, and (iii) stated preferences in a discrete choice experiment survey valuing the ecosystem services of urban gardens in the German cities of Berlin and Stuttgart. Our results indicate that respondents spend more time on the information page when confronted with quiz rather than self-reference questions. For both question types, we do not find effects on recall or stated preferences. The results suggest that questions which increase engagement offer no simple fix to enhance information processing. Thus, alternative ways of reinforcing engagement, comprehension, and information recall in stated preference surveys should be developed and applied.
records.abstract_cn: 为了有效引出偏好，陈述偏好调查必须提供关于被评估商品的信息，并且受访者必须处理和回忆这些信息。以往的研究表明，信息的数量和类型可以影响陈述偏好和价值估计的有效性，但受访者如何处理这些信息的研究较少。一些研究发现偏好与受访者对信息的参与度之间存在相关性，但我们的研究是首个在陈述偏好调查中随机且外生地操纵参与因素的研究。借鉴陈述偏好指南和心理学概念，我们估计了测验问题（询问信息内容）和自我参照问题（询问信息如何与受访者个人相关）对（i）参与度，（ii）信息回忆，以及（iii）陈述偏好的影响，这些影响是在一项离散选择实验调查中评估德国柏林和斯图加特城市花园的生态系统服务时得出的。我们的结果表明，当面对测验问题而非自我参照问题时，受访者在信息页面上花费的时间更多。对于两种问题类型，我们均未发现对回忆或陈述偏好的影响。结果表明，增加参与度的问题并不能简单解决信息处理问题。因此，应开发和应用在陈述偏好调查中加强参与度、理解力和信息回忆的替代方法。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
