records.abstract_cn: 本文认为，无政府社会能够成功进行军事创新。为此，本文探讨了1917-21年乌克兰内战及内斯特·马赫诺无政府主义运动的新案例。无政府主义者的主要军事创新是塔昌卡，一种由四匹马拉动的弹簧轮马车，配备机枪平台，可在行进中射击。塔昌卡构成了马赫诺军队的核心，使其能够对数量上占优的国家军队取得多次压倒性胜利。马赫诺的部队能够成功创新有三个原因。首先，由于人数少且需要防守的领土广阔，无政府主义者有动力用创新的资本组合替代劳动力。其次，无政府主义者利用其地方知识，在乌克兰东南部扩展影响力，这是唯一拥有塔昌卡中心创新所需特定资产——弹簧轮马车——丰富的地区。第三，通过社会亲近和规范获得的乌克兰农民合作，使无政府主义者能够建立一个创新的换马站系统，通过该系统塔昌卡保持了最高机动性。我的分析补充了关于军事创新和无国家创新的文献，并对现代时期具有启示意义，特别是在俄罗斯与乌克兰冲突中，因为它表明即使国家可能崩溃，军事创新也能继续。

records.title_en: Beauty, underage drinking, and adolescent risky behaviours
records.title_cn: 美貌、未成年饮酒与青少年冒险行为
records.abstract_en: Physically attractive individuals experience a range of advantages in adulthood including higher earnings; yet, how attractiveness influences earlier consequential decisions is not well understood. This paper estimates the effect of attractiveness on engagement in risky behaviours in adolescence. We find marked effects across a range of risky behaviours with notable contrasts. Attractive adolescents are more likely to engage in drinking; the gap between attractive and unattractive adolescents in terms of propensity to drink constitutes about 15% of the baseline mean. In contrast, more attractive adolescents are less likely to smoke, use drugs, or practice unprotected sex. Investigation into the underlying channels reveals that physically attractive adolescents are more popular, and have higher self-esteem and personality attractiveness. Popularity leads to a higher likelihood of engagement in “cool” risky behaviours and a lower likelihood for “uncool” behaviours, while self-esteem and personality generally predict a lower likelihood of engaging in all risky behaviours. Our findings suggest physical attractiveness in adolescence carries long-lasting consequences over the life course.
records.abstract_cn: 外表有吸引力的人在成年期会享有一系列优势，包括更高的收入；然而，吸引力如何影响早期的重要决策尚不清楚。本文估计了吸引力对青少年时期参与冒险行为的影响。我们发现，在一系列冒险行为中存在显著影响，且具有明显对比。有吸引力的青少年更可能饮酒；有吸引力与无吸引力的青少年在饮酒倾向上的差距约占基线均值的15%。相比之下，更有吸引力的青少年吸烟、吸毒或进行无保护性行为的可能性较低。对潜在渠道的调查显示，外表有吸引力的青少年更受欢迎，并且具有更高的自尊和人格吸引力。受欢迎程度导致参与“酷”冒险行为的可能性更高，而参与“不酷”行为的可能性更低，而自尊和人格通常预示着参与所有冒险行为的可能性较低。我们的研究结果表明，青少年时期的外表吸引力在生命历程中具有长期影响。

records.title_en: Information and the trade-off between food safety and food security in rural markets: Experimental evidence from Malawi
records.title_cn: 信息与农村市场中食品安全和食品安全的权衡：来自马拉维的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We implemented a clustered randomized control trial with experimental auctions among 1,098 rural households in Malawi to evaluate whether providing training about food safety increased demand for safe groundnut. We measured the impact of training on demand for observable and unobservable dimensions of quality, at harvest and in the lean season. We found that the control group who was not trained valued sorted grains (an indicator of observable quality) only. At harvest, both trained and untrained consumers placed statistically equal premiums on food safety labeling (an indicator of otherwise-unobservable quality). However, in the lean season, untrained consumers’ premiums for food safety labeling disappeared, while trained consumers’ premiums for food safety labeling increased.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在马拉维的1,098户农村家庭中实施了一项整群随机对照试验，并进行了实验性拍卖，以评估提供食品安全培训是否增加了对安全花生的需求。我们测量了培训对可观察和不可观察质量维度需求的影响，分别在收获季节和淡季进行。我们发现，未接受培训的对照组仅重视分选谷物（可观察质量的指标）。在收获季节，受过培训和未受培训的消费者对食品安全标签（不可观察质量的指标）的溢价在统计上相等。然而，在淡季，未受培训的消费者对食品安全标签的溢价消失，而受过培训的消费者对食品安全标签的溢价增加。

records.title_en: Watch your words: An experimental study on communication and the opportunity cost of delegation
records.title_cn: 注意你的言辞：关于沟通与委托机会成本的实验研究
records.abstract_en: We investigate how the opportunity cost of delegation influences the impact of communication on trust, trustworthiness and communication style. To do this, we adopt a modified trust game in which the trustee may send a message to the trustor, before the latter chooses whether to delegate decision rights to the former. Our analysis shows that, only when the opportunity cost of delegation is high does communication have a positive effect on the beliefs (first and second order) relative to the amount the trustor will receive if he chooses to delegate, as well on the trustee's beliefs on the probability of delegation occurring. This implies that the incentives to use communication to increase trust are greater when the opportunity cost of delegation is higher, even if it does not affect the decision to delegate and is associated with deception. Regarding communication style, our analysis shows that non-precise promises are used more frequently when the opportunity cost of delegation is low, and the trustor has less to lose from delegating. We also document an “illusion effect” whereby trustees erroneously expect non-precise promises to have an impact on the beliefs of trustors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了委托的机会成本如何影响沟通对信任、可信赖性及沟通风格的作用。为此，我们采用了一个修改版的信任博弈，其中受托人可以在委托人选择是否将决策权委托给受托人之前向委托人发送信息。我们的分析表明，仅当委托的机会成本较高时，沟通才对委托人关于若选择委托将获得的金额的信念（一阶和二阶）以及受托人关于委托发生概率的信念产生积极影响。这意味着，当委托的机会成本较高时，利用沟通来增加信任的激励更大，即使这并不影响委托决策且与欺骗相关。关于沟通风格，我们的分析显示，当委托的机会成本较低且委托人因委托而损失较少时，非精确承诺的使用更为频繁。我们还记录了一种“幻觉效应”，即受托人错误地期望非精确承诺会对委托人的信念产生影响。

records.title_en: Forced displacement and migrants' location choices: Evidence from the Japanese-Canadian experience during World War II
records.title_cn: 强制迁移与移民的选址决策：来自二战期间日裔加拿大人经历的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines whether a forced displacement of an ethnic group can lead to long-run changes to their spatial distribution and whether this shock can also lead to changes in where new migrants settle. I use the Canadian government’s internment of Japanese Canadians during World War II, as well as their post-war forced resettlement, as a natural experiment. I find that the policy led to dramatic resettlement patterns; areas where Japanese Canadians were removed from had far fewer Japanese Canadians after World War II, with this effect persisting for decades. Despite these displacement patterns, I find that both the pre-war and post-war settlement patterns drive where new Japanese migrants settle within Canada, suggesting that the disruption of the connections and networks formed by Japanese migrants before World War II were not fully dismantled by the Canadian government’s wartime policies. Reinforcing this mechanism, I show using Facebook’s social connectedness data that Japanese population shares from both 1931 and 1951 predict whether a Canadian Census Division is more socially connected with Japan today. The results from this paper show that, despite Canada’s forced dispersal of its Japanese population across the country, networks and forces that connect Census Divisions to Japan and draw in new migrants continued to persist.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了一个族裔群体的强制迁移是否会导致其空间分布的长期变化，以及这一冲击是否也会导致新移民定居地点的变化。我利用加拿大政府在二战期间对日裔加拿大人的拘禁以及战后强制重新安置作为自然实验。我发现该政策导致了戏剧性的重新安置模式；日裔加拿大人被迁出的地区在二战后日裔加拿大人数量大幅减少，且这一效应持续数十年。尽管存在这些迁移模式，我发现战前和战后的定居模式共同决定了新的日裔移民在加拿大境内的定居地点，这表明二战前日裔移民形成的联系和网络并未被加拿大政府的战时政策完全瓦解。为强化这一机制，我使用Facebook的社交连接数据显示，来自1931年和1951年的日裔人口比例能够预测当今加拿大人口普查分区与日本的社会连接程度。本文的结果表明，尽管加拿大对其日裔人口进行了全国范围内的强制分散，但连接人口普查分区与日本并吸引新移民的网络和力量持续存在。

records.title_en: Do economists replicate?
records.title_cn: 经济学家会进行复制研究吗？
records.abstract_en: Reanalyses of empirical studies and replications in new contexts are important for scientific progress. Journals in economics increasingly require authors to provide data and code alongside published papers, but how much does the economics profession actually replicate? This paper summarizes existing replication definitions and reviews how much economists replicate other scholars’ work. We argue that in order to counter incentive problems potentially leading to a replication crisis, replications in the spirit of Merton's ‘organized skepticism’ are needed – what we call ‘policing replications’. We review leading economics journals to show that policing replications are rare and conclude that more incentives to replicate are needed to reap the fruits of rising transparency standards.
records.abstract_cn: 对实证研究的重新分析以及在新情境下的复制对于科学进步至关重要。经济学领域的期刊越来越要求作者在发表论文的同时提供数据和代码，但经济学界实际上进行了多少复制研究呢？本文总结了现有的复制定义，并回顾了经济学家复制他人工作的程度。我们认为，为了应对可能导致复制危机的激励问题，需要秉持默顿“有组织的怀疑主义”精神进行复制——我们称之为“监管性复制”。我们回顾了主要的经济学期刊，表明监管性复制很少见，并得出结论，需要更多的激励措施来促进复制，以收获日益提高的透明度标准所带来的成果。

records.title_en: Semivariance below the maximum: Assessing the performance of economic and financial prospects
records.title_cn: 最大值下方的半方差：评估经济与金融前景的表现
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the ordering of economic and financial prospects using a rescaled semivariance below the maximum (SVBMax). This indicator is consistent with stochastic dominance (SD) until order three, but is distinct from any expected utility framework, both in terms of construction and in terms of economic implications, despite an apparent formal similarity with the quadratic expected utility framework. SVBMax is able to deal with economic puzzles such as the restaurant puzzle or Rabin’s paradox. SVBMax also provides a consistent alternative performance measure to popular measures such as the Sharpe ratio, the Omega ratio, or lower partial moments with exogenous thresholds. Compared to almost stochastic dominance, SVBMax is devoid of the drawbacks associated with the determination of violation areas. SVBMax can also replace the Aumann-Serrano and Foster-Hart riskiness indicators, which do not conform to third order SD. Further, SVBMax can provide a way of reaching an optimal diversification of stock portfolios. Besides, we also show that SVBMax is consistent with mean-variance-skewness preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用重标定的最大值下方半方差（SVBMax）来考察经济与金融前景的排序。该指标与三阶以内的随机占优（SD）一致，但在构造和经济含义上均不同于任何期望效用框架，尽管与二次期望效用框架在形式上看似相似。SVBMax能够处理诸如餐厅谜题或拉宾悖论等经济难题。SVBMax还为夏普比率、欧米茄比率或具有外生阈值的低阶矩等流行指标提供了一致的替代绩效度量。与几乎随机占优相比，SVBMax避免了与违规区域确定相关的缺陷。SVBMax还可以替代不符合三阶SD的Aumann-Serrano和Foster-Hart风险指标。此外，SVBMax可以为股票投资组合的最优分散化提供一种途径。另外，我们还表明SVBMax与均值-方差-偏度偏好一致。

records.title_en: Economic Calculation in Light of Advances in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
records.title_cn: 大数据与人工智能进展下的经济计算
records.abstract_en: In his 1920 essay “Economic Calculation in the Socialist Commonwealth,” Ludwig von Mises argued that economic calculation is impossible in a socialist system absent private property and exchange in the means of production. Without the social appraisement process by which the actions of consumers and entrepreneurs produce a money price structure, the commensurate cardinal numbers necessary to engage in capital accounting are not available. We argue that any claims regarding how advances in computer technology can solve the problem of economic calculation are based on an insufficient understanding of Mises' original argument. We restate Mises’ argument in consideration of recent developments in big data and artificial intelligence and argue that Mises’ original argument concerning the impossibility of economic calculation absent the institutional prerequisites of private property and monetary exchange in goods of all orders remains unrefuted.
records.abstract_cn: 在1920年的论文《社会主义共同体中的经济计算》中，路德维希·冯·米塞斯认为，在缺乏生产资料私有制和交换的社会主义制度下，经济计算是不可能的。没有消费者和企业家行为产生货币价格结构的社会评估过程，进行资本核算所需的相应基数便不可得。我们认为，任何关于计算机技术进步能够解决经济计算问题的说法，都是基于对米塞斯原始论证的误解。我们结合大数据和人工智能的最新发展，重新阐述米塞斯的论证，并认为米塞斯关于在缺乏私有制和所有等级商品货币交换的制度前提条件下经济计算不可能的原始论证仍然未被驳倒。

records.title_en: Investor trade allocation patterns in stock markets
records.title_cn: 股票市场中投资者的交易分配模式
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we statistically analyze how investors distribute their trading intensity to different securities in stock markets. We find that trade allocation distributions are distinctive between investors. More importantly, the patterns of trade allocation across securities are surprisingly persistent for each investor, even when there is a turnover of securities in their portfolios. This suggests that even if investors have security-specific strategies, the securities can be replaced by others while the strategies remain. We also find that time constraints do not appear to limit investors’ activeness: the larger the set of securities an investor trades, the more frequently she trades each security on average.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们统计分析了投资者如何在股票市场中将交易强度分配给不同证券。我们发现，交易分配分布在投资者之间具有差异性。更重要的是，每个投资者的跨证券交易分配模式惊人地持久，即使其投资组合中的证券发生更替也是如此。这表明，即使投资者具有特定证券的策略，证券可以被其他证券替代，而策略保持不变。我们还发现，时间限制似乎并不限制投资者的活跃度：投资者交易的证券集合越大，她平均交易每种证券的频率就越高。

records.title_en: Dissonance minimization and conversation in social networks
records.title_cn: 失调最小化与社会网络中的对话
records.abstract_en: We are examining social learning in networks, where agents aim to minimize cognitive dissonance resulting from disagreement by adjusting their statements in conversations to align with those of their associates, rather than truthfully sharing their beliefs. Our analysis investigates the impact of this adjustment, known as audience tuning, on belief revision, limiting beliefs, consensus conditions, and convergence speed. Our findings demonstrate that audience tuning facilitates extensive belief propagation beyond immediate associates, resulting in faster convergence in most of the societies considered. It also leads to a redistribution of influences on long-run beliefs, favoring agents with lower dissonance sensitivity. We also show that endogenous changes in the network, driven by dissonance minimization, can impede society from reaching a consensus.
records.abstract_cn: 我们正在研究网络中的社会学习，其中代理人旨在通过调整他们在对话中的陈述以与同伴保持一致，而非真实分享他们的信念，来最小化因分歧而产生的认知失调。我们的分析考察了这种调整（称为受众调适）对信念修正、极限信念、共识条件和收敛速度的影响。我们的研究结果表明，受众调适促进了超越直接同伴的广泛信念传播，导致在所考虑的大多数社会中收敛更快。它还导致了对长期信念影响的重新分配，有利于失调敏感性较低的代理人。我们还表明，由失调最小化驱动的网络内生变化可能阻碍社会达成共识。

records.title_en: Measuring the welfare and spillover effects of rank information
records.title_cn: 衡量排名信息的福利和溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Rank information is often provided to improve task performance; however, its welfare and spillover effects have rarely been measured. To fill this gap, we conduct a controlled laboratory experiment in which participants complete a simple cognitive task and report their willingness-to-pay (WTP) to receive or avoid rank information provided in different manners and then make choices in subsequent games. We find that providing rank information with a full public announcement improves performance; however, the unconditional WTP results suggest that doing so brings a negative shift in the overall welfare of the participants in comparison to a partial or no announcement. Based on conditional WTP data, we find that participants' social comparison utilities are on average positive; it is the case even conditional on low rankings. In contrast, the public recognition utilities can be negative, while their negativity is reduced by adopting a partial announcement scheme, in which only the rankings of those among the top third are announced. Estimates from a structural estimation indicate that the partial public announcement scheme together with financial incentives is the most socially efficient intervention combination. Finally, no spillover effects are found in subsequent games.
records.abstract_cn: 排名信息通常被提供以改善任务表现；然而，其福利和溢出效应很少被衡量。为填补这一空白，我们进行了一项受控实验室实验，参与者完成一项简单的认知任务，并报告他们接受或避免以不同方式提供的排名信息的支付意愿（WTP），然后在后续游戏中进行选择。我们发现，以全面公开公告方式提供排名信息能改善表现；然而，无条件的WTP结果表明，与部分公告或无公告相比，这样做导致参与者整体福利的负面变化。基于有条件的WTP数据，我们发现参与者的社会比较效用平均为正；即使在低排名的情况下也是如此。相比之下，公开认可效用可能为负，而采用部分公告方案（仅公告排名前三分之一的参与者）可减少其负面性。结构估计的结果表明，部分公开公告方案加上财务激励是最具社会效率的干预组合。最后，在后续游戏中未发现溢出效应。

records.title_en: Foreign bias in institutional portfolio allocation: The role of social trust
records.title_cn: 机构投资组合配置中的外国偏见：社会信任的作用
records.abstract_en: We study the role of social trust in the equity allocation decisions of global investors using a large sample of institutionally managed portfolios of 8,088 investors from 33 countries over the 2000 through 2017 period. The negative relationship between social trust and foreign bias suggests that institutional investors from high-social trust countries are less prone to underinvesting in foreign equity. Our results provide credence to an information-based explanation, indicating that social trust reduces foreign bias by compensating for the lack of information about foreign stock markets. Moreover, the effect of social trust on foreign bias is stronger if host-country institutions are weak, while it vanishes when the host country is characterized by strong institutions. The informal institution of social trust compensates for the lack of well-functioning formal country-level institutions in international portfolio decisions. Finally, the allocation effect resulting from social trust is different from “blind” trust. The portfolios of high-trust investors exhibit higher cross-country diversification and an enhanced portfolio risk-return trade-off.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用2000年至2017年期间来自33个国家的8,088名投资者的机构管理投资组合的大样本，研究了社会信任在全球投资者股权配置决策中的作用。社会信任与外国偏见之间的负相关关系表明，来自高社会信任国家的机构投资者不太容易对外国股权进行低配。我们的结果为基于信息的解释提供了依据，表明社会信任通过弥补对外国股票市场信息的缺乏来减少外国偏见。此外，当东道国制度薄弱时，社会信任对外国偏见的影响更强，而当东道国具有强制度时，这种影响则消失。社会信任这一非正式制度弥补了国际投资组合决策中缺乏运作良好的正式国家制度的不足。最后，由社会信任产生的配置效应不同于“盲目”信任。高信任投资者的投资组合表现出更高的跨国分散化和增强的投资组合风险-收益权衡。

records.title_en: Do women shy away from risky skill games?
records.title_cn: 女性是否回避高风险技能游戏？
records.abstract_en: A risky skill game is a game in which skill plays an important role but outcomes are also strongly influenced by random factors. Examples are poker or blackjack but also many economic activities like trading on financial markets. In an online experiment we let subjects choose how often they want to play a risky skill game. We find that women play only half as many rounds in risky skill games with high variance. In contrast, there is no gender difference if the outcomes depend exclusively on chance or (mostly) on skill. Our results indicate that previous research on gender effects in risky environments (such as tournaments) may have greater applicability than previously thought.
records.abstract_cn: 高风险技能游戏是一种技能发挥重要作用但结果也受到随机因素强烈影响的游戏。例如扑克或二十一点，但也包括许多经济活动，如金融市场交易。在一项在线实验中，我们让受试者选择他们想要玩高风险技能游戏的次数。我们发现，在高方差的高风险技能游戏中，女性玩的轮数仅为男性的一半。相比之下，如果结果完全取决于运气或（大部分）取决于技能，则不存在性别差异。我们的结果表明，先前关于风险环境（如锦标赛）中性别效应的研究可能具有比先前认为的更广泛的适用性。

records.title_en: Food demand and cash transfers: A collective household approach with Homescan data
records.title_cn: 食品需求与现金转移：基于Homescan数据的集体家庭方法
records.abstract_en: I study how individual preferences and bargaining power within older couples affects the impact of cash transfers on food demand. Using longitudinal Homescan data, I find that wives have stronger preferences for food than husbands, and that household demand patterns for food are affected by spouse’s relative bargaining power. Failure to account for these effects leads to underestimates of older couples’ total food demand, and of their implied response (at both intensive and extensive margins) to a counterfactual experiment of a cash transfer program with equivalent benefit size as the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). I find that the cash transfer can achieve the goals of SNAP to some extent.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了老年夫妇中个人偏好和议价能力如何影响现金转移对食品需求的影响。利用纵向Homescan数据，我发现妻子对食品的偏好强于丈夫，且家庭食品需求模式受到配偶相对议价能力的影响。未能考虑这些效应会导致对老年夫妇总食品需求及其对现金转移计划（其福利规模与补充营养援助计划（SNAP）相当）的反事实实验的隐含反应（在集约边际和广延边际上）的低估。我发现现金转移可以在一定程度上实现SNAP的目标。

records.title_en: Why does happiness respond differently to an increase vs. decrease in income?
records.title_cn: 为什么幸福对收入增加与减少的反应不同？
records.abstract_en: The answer is that people's evaluations of their income situation are based on different considerations when the economy is expanding and when it is contracting. When, in the course of economic growth, incomes generally are rising, evaluations of one's own income—whether it is satisfactory –tend to be dominated by comparisons with the incomes of others—by “social comparison”. If one's income is just “keeping up with the Joneses”, happiness is unchanged. But in a recession, as incomes decline and people increasingly have difficulty satisfying consumption habits and fixed financial obligations acquired when incomes were higher, the benchmark for income evaluations shifts to comparisons with one's past experience– how current income compares with one's previous peak income. The greater the shortfall, the less one's happiness. The shift when income declines, from comparison with others to comparison with one's past experience, is typically forced on individuals by the growing pressure of meeting fixed financial obligations.
records.abstract_cn: 答案在于，当经济扩张和收缩时，人们对其收入状况的评价基于不同的考量。在经济增长过程中，当收入普遍上升时，对自身收入（是否满意）的评价往往受与他人收入比较——即“社会比较”——的主导。如果一个人的收入仅仅是“跟上琼斯家”，幸福则不变。但在经济衰退中，随着收入下降，人们越来越难以满足在收入较高时形成的消费习惯和固定财务义务，收入评价的基准转向与自身过去经历的比较——即当前收入与先前峰值收入的比较。缺口越大，幸福越少。当收入下降时，从与他人比较转向与自身过去经历的比较，通常是个人在满足固定财务义务的压力日益增大下被迫做出的转变。

records.title_en: On the Internet you can be anyone: An experiment on strategic avatar choice in online marketplaces
records.title_cn: 在互联网上你可以成为任何人：在线市场中策略性头像选择的实验研究
records.abstract_en: In order to decrease social distance and increase trust on their platforms, many online marketplaces allow traders to be represented by profile pictures or avatars. In a laboratory experiment, we investigate whether the presence of seller avatars affects trading behavior in a market. We contrast markets without avatars with markets where avatars genuinely represent traders and markets where avatars can be freely changed at any time and may thus be chosen strategically. At the aggregate level, we find that the presence of genuine avatars increases the trustworthiness of sellers, but that this effect is undone when avatars can be chosen strategically. We do not detect aggregate effects on buyers’ trusting choices. Female avatars are more trusted, and correspondingly in the treatment with free avatar choice men are more likely to represent themselves with a female avatar than vice versa.
records.abstract_cn: 为了减少社交距离并增加平台上的信任，许多在线市场允许交易者使用个人资料图片或头像来代表自己。在一项实验室实验中，我们调查了卖家头像的存在是否会影响市场中的交易行为。我们对比了没有头像的市场、头像真实代表交易者的市场以及头像可以随时自由更改并因此可能被策略性选择的市场。在总体层面上，我们发现真实头像的存在提高了卖家的可信度，但当头像可以被策略性选择时，这种效应被抵消了。我们没有检测到买家信任选择的总体效应。女性头像更受信任，相应地，在自由选择头像的处理组中，男性比女性更可能使用女性头像来代表自己。

records.title_en: Famous after death: The effect of a writer's death on book sales
records.title_cn: 死后成名：作家去世对其书籍销量的影响
records.abstract_en: In the market for books we investigate whether the death of an author has an impact on the demand for his/her books, that is, we ask whether consumers are affected by factors such as emotions and limited attention, as highlighted in behavioral economics. We use bestseller lists at a weekly level over 30 years (1975–2005) and, by exploiting the panel nature of our data (at author-week level), we implement an Event Study Design to evaluate the impact of a writer's death on the probability of his/her books entering the bestseller list in the period immediately following his/her death. Controlling for individual and time fixed effects and some individual characteristics, we find that a writer's death increases the probability of his/her being on the bestseller list by more than 100%. As a robustness check, we also use a Regression Discontinuity in Time and obtain very similar results. In an attempt to investigate what mechanisms drive consumers’ decisions, we find a greater impact when writers die at an early age, when they are famous writers or when the news is covered extensively. These findings represent suggestive evidence that emotions and media attention are the main drivers of the impact.
records.abstract_cn: 在图书市场中，我们研究作者的去世是否对其书籍的需求产生影响，即我们探讨消费者是否受到行为经济学所强调的情感和有限注意力等因素的影响。我们使用30年（1975-2005）的周度畅销书榜单数据，并利用数据的面板性质（作者-周层面），实施事件研究设计来评估作家去世后紧接着的时期内，其书籍进入畅销书榜单概率的变化。在控制个体和时间固定效应以及一些个体特征后，我们发现作家的去世使其进入畅销书榜单的概率增加了超过100%。作为稳健性检验，我们还使用了时间断点回归，得到了非常相似的结果。在探究驱动消费者决策的机制时，我们发现当作家英年早逝、是知名作家或新闻被广泛报道时，影响更大。这些发现提供了暗示性证据，表明情感和媒体关注是影响的主要驱动因素。

records.title_en: The emergence of social inequality: A Co-Evolutionary analysis
records.title_cn: 社会不平等的涌现：一项共同演化分析
records.abstract_en: Social inequality is an important issue at the core of economic thought. Based on a stylized pie-sharing game, this article proposes a co-evolutionary computational model to study the interaction between social classes, aiming to answer the following questions: Why do social classes exist, and how do they affect social efficiency and individual effectiveness? Why are wealth inequality and social exclusion persistent? From a methodological perspective, this article extends the pie-sharing game to include a network of interactions and classes, social mobility, evolving wealth, and learning agents. The results show that social inequality is self-emergent. Surprisingly, in the simulations, the existence of social classes increases individual effectiveness, mainly benefiting the poor. Nonetheless, flatter societies (where social classes exist) have a higher average individual effectiveness. As expected, it was observed that wealth inequality is persistent in hierarchical societies, and the upper classes keep a higher proportion of wealth. Furthermore, the analysis extends the bargaining game to include social mobility, showing that, surprisingly, it increases the robustness of the class system and wealth inequality. Finally, the simulation of dual societies shows that these are an evolutionary equilibrium: social exclusion is persistent and accepted by wealthy and poor individuals, and resources are efficiently used.
records.abstract_cn: 社会不平等是经济思想核心的重要议题。基于一个程式化的分饼博弈，本文提出了一个共同演化的计算模型来研究社会阶层之间的互动，旨在回答以下问题：为什么存在社会阶层，它们如何影响社会效率和个人效能？为什么财富不平等和社会排斥持续存在？从方法论角度看，本文扩展了分饼博弈，纳入了互动网络和阶层、社会流动性、演化中的财富以及学习型主体。结果表明，社会不平等是自我涌现的。令人惊讶的是，在模拟中，社会阶层的存在提高了个人效能，主要惠及穷人。尽管如此，更扁平的社会（即存在社会阶层的社会）具有更高的平均个人效能。正如预期，观察到在等级社会中财富不平等持续存在，上层阶级保持更高比例的财富。此外，分析扩展了讨价还价博弈以纳入社会流动性，表明令人惊讶的是，它增强了阶级体系和财富不平等的稳健性。最后，对二元社会的模拟表明，这些是演化均衡：社会排斥持续存在并被富人和穷人个体接受，资源得到有效利用。

records.title_en: Do workers discriminate against their out-group employers? Evidence from an online platform economy
records.title_cn: 工人是否会歧视其外群体雇主？来自在线平台经济的证据
records.abstract_en: We study possible labor market discrimination by workers towards their out-group employers as manifested via social preferences (altruism and reciprocity). We run a well-powered, model-based, lab-in-the-field experiment, recruiting 6,000 white American worker subjects from Amazon's M-Turk platform for a real-effort task. We also hire trainer subjects, our stand-in for employers, from a university. To worker subjects, we randomly (and unobtrusively) reveal the racial identity of the trainers, who may be white or black. We find evidence that white workers may discriminate against white employers based on altruism (working harder due to concern for the employer's well-being). However, they may discriminate in favor of their white employers based on reciprocity (working harder because of a small gift). From the perspective of black (white) employers, altruism evokes a stronger (weaker) effort response, but gift-giving has no (positive) effect. Taken together, the combined effect of altruism and reciprocity on worker effort is the same for black and white employers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了工人可能通过社会偏好（利他主义和互惠）对其外群体雇主表现出的劳动力市场歧视。我们进行了一项基于模型、功效充足的实地实验室实验，从亚马逊的M-Turk平台招募了6,000名美国白人工人受试者，执行一项真实努力任务。我们还从一所大学雇佣了培训师受试者，作为雇主的代表。对于工人受试者，我们随机（且不引人注意地）透露培训师的种族身份，培训师可能是白人或黑人。我们发现证据表明，白人工人可能基于利他主义（因关心雇主福祉而更加努力工作）歧视白人雇主。然而，他们可能基于互惠（因小额礼物而更加努力工作）而偏袒白人雇主。从黑人（白人）雇主的角度来看，利他主义引发更强（更弱）的努力反应，但送礼没有（有正向）效果。总体而言，利他主义和互惠对工人努力的联合效应在黑人和白人雇主之间是相同的。

records.title_en: Do experts and laypersons differ? Some evidence from international classical music competitions
records.title_cn: 专家与外行有区别吗？来自国际古典音乐比赛的证据
records.abstract_en: Do experts and laypersons differ in their judgments of quality? We investigate this question in the context of classical music performance, taking advantage of the fact that in many international music competitions, lay audiences as well as expert juries award prizes. Using novel data on 370 competition-editions held between 1979 and 2021, we find that jury and audience preferences match only 38% of the time. We then explore gender bias and host country bias as possible explanations for the divergence between jury and audience judgments by comparing first prizewinners and audience prizewinners with other finalists. Additionally, we use the fact that many musicians compete repeatedly to examine the predictive value of prizewinning on success in future competitions. We find that being female and being from the competition host country are negatively correlated with the likelihood of being the jury's top choice but have no relationship with the likelihood of winning an audience prize. Additionally, winning an audience prize predicts winning future competitions but being ranked first by the jury does not. Importantly, our findings extend the literature on the value of expert opinion to a new setting, using an explicitly non-expert counterfactual.
records.abstract_cn: 专家和外行在质量判断上是否存在差异？我们在古典音乐表演的背景下研究这一问题，利用在许多国际音乐比赛中，外行观众和专家评审团都会颁发奖项这一事实。利用1979年至2021年间举办的370场比赛的新数据，我们发现评审团和观众的偏好仅有38%的时间是一致的。然后，我们通过比较一等奖获得者和观众奖获得者与其他决赛选手，探讨性别偏见和东道国偏见作为评审团与观众判断分歧的可能解释。此外，我们利用许多音乐家反复参赛的事实，来检验获奖对未来比赛成功的预测价值。我们发现，女性身份和来自比赛东道国与成为评审团首选的可能性呈负相关，但与赢得观众奖的可能性无关。此外，赢得观众奖能预测未来比赛的胜利，而评审团排名第一则不能。重要的是，我们的发现将专家意见价值的文献扩展到了一个新的情境，使用了明确的非专家反事实。

records.title_en: Random network consideration: Theory and experiment
records.title_cn: 随机网络考虑：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: In many settings, it is natural to think of limited consideration exhibiting spillovers: attention paid to a particular alternative may “spill over” to another alternative based on shared characteristics, complementarities, features of the choice environment, shared advertising campaigns, product bundling, etc. Limited consideration of this form gives rise to new methods of revealing preferences and attention. Using a novel laboratory experiment, I test the attention properties of a deterministic Network Consideration model proposed in previous work and find a plethora of violations thereof, even at the individual level. I then propose a stochastic generalization, Random Network Consideration, and analyze its properties regarding the formation of consideration sets. When applied to the laboratory data, I find greater consistency with the general Random Network Consideration model. These results reveal that intuitively appealing features of theories of limited attention may indeed be too stringent in practice, an insight which should guide future theoretical research.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多情境中，自然可以认为有限考虑表现出溢出效应：对某一特定备选方案的关注可能基于共同特征、互补性、选择环境特征、共享广告活动、产品捆绑等而“溢出”到另一备选方案。这种形式的有限考虑产生了揭示偏好和关注的新方法。通过一项新颖的实验室实验，我检验了先前工作中提出的确定性网络考虑模型的关注属性，并发现大量违反该模型的情况，即使在个体层面也是如此。随后，我提出了一个随机推广模型，即随机网络考虑，并分析了其在考虑集形成方面的性质。当应用于实验室数据时，我发现与一般随机网络考虑模型具有更高的一致性。这些结果表明，有限关注理论中直观吸引人的特征在实践中可能确实过于严格，这一见解应指导未来的理论研究。

records.title_en: The economics of free speech: Subjective wellbeing and empowerment of marginalized citizens
records.title_cn: 言论自由的经济学：边缘化公民的主观幸福感与赋权
records.abstract_en: We analyse whether people value free speech differently depending on their resources (income or education levels). Our analysis includes both stated preferences towards free speech and the realized relationship of free speech with people's subjective wellbeing. In each case, we test whether free speech is a ‘luxury good’ valued more highly by high-income earners and the well-educated, or a ‘necessary good’ valued more highly by those with fewer resources. The analysis uses two population survey datasets (World Values Survey and Latino Barometer) and two datasets covering country-level free speech and human rights measures (CIRIGHTS and VDEM). The analyses control for country and wave fixed effects, personal and macroeconomic factors, and for other human rights. We find that, when surveyed, individuals with greater resources place greater stated priority on freedom of speech, but it is individuals with fewer resources who realize the greatest benefits from free speech.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了人们是否因其资源（收入或教育水平）不同而对言论自由的重视程度不同。我们的分析包括对言论自由的陈述偏好以及言论自由与人们主观幸福感之间已实现的关系。在每种情况下，我们检验言论自由是‘奢侈品’（高收入者和受过良好教育者更重视）还是‘必需品’（资源较少者更重视）。分析使用了两个人口调查数据集（世界价值观调查和拉丁美洲晴雨表）以及两个涵盖国家层面言论自由和人权措施的数据集（CIRIGHTS和VDEM）。分析控制了国家和波次固定效应、个人和宏观经济因素以及其他人权。我们发现，在调查中，资源较多的个体对言论自由的陈述优先性更高，但资源较少的个体从言论自由中获得的实际收益最大。

records.title_en: Policy initiatives, self-sorting, and labor market effects of tertiary education for adult workers
records.title_cn: 政策举措、自我选择与成人劳动者高等教育的劳动力市场效应
records.abstract_en: We investigate the differences in labor market effects between a regular tertiary degree and a tertiary degree obtained while working a job. Using multiple-year data that span the drastic policy initiatives targeting on-job education in China, we find significantly lower returns to an on-job degree compared to a regular degree at the bachelor's and graduate levels, but no significant differences at the junior college level. However, when applying the correlated random coefficient model with heterogeneous returns, the estimated gaps from the conventional model disappeared in earlier years and reversed their signs in later years in general. We find that the results are affected by the extent of workers’ self-sorting into on-job schooling based on unobserved heterogeneity and anticipated future returns. Policies that change the returns to on-job degrees for specific workers can create different incentives and thus may alter the nature of self-selection for adult workers when pursuing education at work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了普通高等教育学位与在职获得的高等教育学位在劳动力市场效应上的差异。利用涵盖中国针对在职教育的大规模政策举措的多年数据，我们发现，在本科和研究生层次，在职学位的回报显著低于普通学位，但在大专层次没有显著差异。然而，当应用具有异质性回报的相关随机系数模型时，传统模型估计的差距在早期年份消失，并在后期年份普遍逆转了符号。我们发现，结果受到工人基于未观测异质性和预期未来回报对在职教育自我选择程度的影响。改变特定工人在职学位回报的政策可以产生不同的激励，从而可能改变成年工人在职追求教育时自我选择的性质。

records.title_en: Arbitrage bots in experimental asset markets
records.title_cn: 实验资产市场中的套利机器人
records.abstract_en: Trading algorithms are an integral component of modern asset markets. In twin experimental markets for long-lived correlated assets we examine the impact of alternative types of arbitrage-seeking algorithms. These arbitrage robot traders vary in their latency and whether they make or take market liquidity. All arbitrage robot traders we examine generate greater conformity to the law-of-one-price across the twin markets. However, only the liquidity providing arbitrage robot trader moves prices into closer alignment with fundamental values. The reduced mispricing comes with varying social costs; arbitrage robot traders’ gains reduce the earnings of human traders. We identify factors which drive differences in human trader performance and find that the presence of an arbitrage robot trader has no disproportionate effect with respect to these factors on subjects’ earnings.
records.abstract_cn: 交易算法是现代资产市场不可或缺的组成部分。在针对长期相关资产的双胞胎实验市场中，我们考察了不同类型的寻求套利算法的影响。这些套利机器人交易者在延迟以及是否提供或获取市场流动性方面有所不同。我们考察的所有套利机器人交易者都使得双胞胎市场之间的一价定律更加一致。然而，只有提供流动性的套利机器人交易者使价格更接近基本价值。错误定价的减少伴随着不同的社会成本；套利机器人交易者的收益减少了人类交易者的收入。我们识别了导致人类交易者表现差异的因素，并发现套利机器人交易者的存在对这些因素对受试者收入的影响没有不成比例的作用。

records.title_en: The effect of cognitive load on economic decision-making: a replication attempt
records.title_cn: 认知负荷对经济决策的影响：一项复制尝试
records.abstract_en: When cognitive load exceeds cognitive capacity, individuals may make poorer decisions, especially when substantial deliberation is required. Deck and Jahedi’s (2015) influential work on cognitive load found that individuals whose arithmetic performance is most impacted by high cognitive load become more risk averse, less patient and more subject to the anchoring effect. Since results of cognitive load manipulation studies are mixed, replication of influential studies is essential to strengthen our understanding of the effects of cognitive load. In this paper, we attempt to closely replicate Experiment 1 in Deck and Jahedi (2015). Though we observe similar effects of cognitive load on arithmetic performance, we fail to replicate their overall results on risky choice and impatience. While we are unable to clearly identify the reasons for this non-replication, the evidence points to subtle differences in the allocation of attention and effort across subject pools.
records.abstract_cn: 当认知负荷超过认知能力时，个体可能做出更差的决策，尤其是在需要大量深思熟虑的情况下。Deck和Jahedi（2015）关于认知负荷的开创性研究发现，算术表现受高认知负荷影响最大的个体变得更加风险厌恶、更缺乏耐心，并且更容易受到锚定效应的影响。由于认知负荷操纵研究的结果不一，复制有影响力的研究对于加深我们对认知负荷效应的理解至关重要。在本文中，我们尝试紧密复制Deck和Jahedi（2015）中的实验1。尽管我们观察到认知负荷对算术表现的类似效应，但我们未能复制他们在风险选择和缺乏耐心方面的总体结果。虽然我们无法明确识别这种未复制的原因，但证据指向不同受试者群体在注意力和努力分配上的细微差异。

records.title_en: Mothers, fathers, and others: Competition and cooperation in the aftermath of conflict
records.title_cn: 母亲、父亲及其他：冲突后遗症中的竞争与合作
records.abstract_en: We investigate the possibility that women and men have distinct behavioral reactions to victimization. We conducted an experiment to elicit preferences for in-group egalitarianism and individual competitiveness for a random sample of 751 individuals in Sierra Leone (aged 18–85) to contrast the behavioral consequences of victimization during the 1991–2003 civil war across sex and parental status. Our results show that mothers and fathers display the highest level of cooperation, yet conflict exposure does not affect them. Egalitarianism increases after victimization only among non-parents, with an effect stronger for males, who are the least egalitarian to start with. Conflict exposure tames everyone's competitive tendencies, but has the opposite effect for mothers, the least competitive group in the absence of conflict. Measures of competitiveness among 191 parents from Colombia show a similar pattern. Our results suggests that conflict, by closing sex and parental gaps in behavior, may prime individuals toward strategies that either benefit the group or the individual, depending on sex and parental role.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了女性和男性在遭受暴力侵害后是否表现出不同的行为反应。我们进行了一项实验，以引致群体内平等主义和个人竞争力的偏好，样本为塞拉利昂随机抽取的751名个体（年龄18-85岁），以对比1991-2003年内战期间遭受暴力侵害对性别和父母身份的行为后果。我们的结果显示，母亲和父亲表现出最高水平的合作，但冲突暴露并不影响他们。平等主义仅在非父母中因遭受暴力而增强，且对男性影响更强，而男性起初是最不平等的群体。冲突暴露抑制了每个人的竞争倾向，但对母亲却有相反效果，母亲在无冲突时是最不具竞争力的群体。来自哥伦比亚的191名父母的竞争力测量显示出类似模式。我们的结果表明，冲突通过缩小性别和父母身份在行为上的差距，可能促使个体根据性别和父母角色选择有利于群体或个体的策略。

records.title_en: Asymmetric shocks in contests: Theory and experiment
records.title_cn: 竞赛中的非对称冲击：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: Under optimal tournament design, equilibrium effort is invariant to the shape of the mean-zero additive stochastic component, often referred to as a “shock” or “noise”. We report data from laboratory experiments providing the first test of this prediction. Consistent with theory, we find that average effort does not significantly differ between a negatively skewed and uniform shock distribution. In addition, we test a second theoretical prediction that, in winner tournaments, when the shock distribution is asymmetric as in our design, one should exert minimum effort whenever one's competitors are exerting above equilibrium effort. With a symmetric shock distribution as in our design, efforts should generally remain substantial, even when one's competitors are exerting effort above equilibrium value. Our data reveal that subjects actively engage in the tournament even when faced with aggressive competitors under both shock distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 在最优锦标赛设计下，均衡努力对均值零的加性随机成分（通常称为“冲击”或“噪声”）的形状不变。我们报告了实验室实验数据，提供了对这一预测的首次检验。与理论一致，我们发现负偏态冲击分布和均匀冲击分布之间的平均努力没有显著差异。此外，我们检验了第二个理论预测，即在获胜者锦标赛中，当冲击分布如我们的设计那样非对称时，每当竞争对手的努力超过均衡努力时，人们应付出最小努力。在如我们设计的对称冲击分布下，即使竞争对手的努力超过均衡值，努力通常也应保持可观。我们的数据揭示，在两种冲击分布下，即使面对激进的竞争对手，受试者也会积极参与锦标赛。

records.title_en: Private provision of price excludable public goods by rivals
records.title_cn: 竞争对手对价格排他性公共物品的私人供给
records.abstract_en: We uniquely study the private provision of price excludable public goods in a duopoly. Simultaneous price competition generates only a mixed strategy equilibrium. Price leadership generates a pure strategy equilibrium with the leader setting a lower price and serving most consumers. This leadership game is the endogenous timing choice and improves welfare relative to monopoly provision. We re-examine these results under production in advance. The leadership game no longer remains a unique timing choice but the profit under production in advance is strictly larger.
records.abstract_cn: 我们独特地研究了双头垄断中价格排他性公共物品的私人供给。同时价格竞争仅产生混合策略均衡。价格领导产生纯策略均衡，领导者设定较低价格并服务大多数消费者。该领导博弈是内生时序选择，相对于垄断供给改善了福利。我们在预先生产下重新审视这些结果。领导博弈不再保持唯一的时序选择，但预先生产下的利润严格更大。

records.title_en: The gender gap among top business executives
records.title_cn: 高层企业高管中的性别差距
records.abstract_en: This paper examines gender differences among top US business executives using a large executive-employer matched data set spanning the last quarter century. Female executives make up 6% of the sample and exhibit more labor market churning – both higher entry and higher exit rates. Unconditionally, women earn 26% less than men, which decreases to 8% once executive characteristics, firm characteristics, and in particular job title are accounted for. We find that female executives are disproportionately represented in firms with more temporal flexibility and female-friendly corporate cultures, but this does not explain the gender pay gap. Rather, corporate culture is correlated with gender pay gaps within firms; specifically the within-firm gender pay gap is significantly smaller at female-friendly firms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用覆盖过去四分之一个世纪的大型高管-雇主匹配数据集，考察了美国高层企业高管中的性别差异。女性高管占样本的6%%，并表现出更高的劳动力市场流动性——无论是进入率还是退出率都更高。无条件地看，女性收入比男性低26%%，但在考虑高管特征、企业特征，特别是职位头衔后，这一差距缩小至8%%。我们发现，女性高管在提供更多时间灵活性和女性友好企业文化的公司中比例过高，但这并不能解释性别薪酬差距。相反，企业文化与公司内部的性别薪酬差距相关；具体而言，在女性友好的公司中，公司内部的性别薪酬差距显著更小。

records.title_en: “O Youth and Beauty:” Children's looks and children's cognitive development
records.title_cn: “哦，青春与美丽：”儿童的外貌与儿童的认知发展
records.abstract_en: We use data from the 11 waves of the U.S. Study of Early Child Care and Youth Development 1991–2005, following children from ages 6 months through 15 years. Observers rated videos of them, obtaining measures of looks at each age. Given their family income, parents’ education, race/ethnicity, and gender, being better-looking raised subsequent changes objective learning outcomes. The gains imply a long-run impact on cognitive achievement of about 0.04 standard deviations per standard deviation of differences in looks. Similarly specified models describing changes in reading and arithmetic scores at ages 7, 11 and 16 in the U.K. National Child Development Survey 1958 cohort show larger effects, 0.20 standard deviations. The extra gains persist when instrumenting children's looks by their mother's looks, and do not work through measures of teachers’ reports of closeness to children, mothers’ reports of children's behavior, their victimization by bullies, or self-confidence. Results from the U.K. data show that greater childhood beauty raises educational attainment both directly and indirectly, through impacts on test scores, thus contributing to higher adult earnings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用了美国儿童保育与青年发展研究1991-2005的11波数据，追踪了从6个月大到15岁的儿童。观察者对他们进行录像评分，获得了每个年龄段的外貌测量。在控制了家庭收入、父母教育、种族/民族和性别后，外貌更好会提高后续客观学习成果的变化。这些收益意味着外貌差异每增加一个标准差，对认知成就的长期影响约为0.04个标准差。类似地，在英国国家儿童发展调查1958队列中，描述7、11和16岁阅读和算术分数变化的模型显示效应更大，为0.20个标准差。当使用母亲的外貌作为儿童外貌的工具变量时，额外收益仍然存在，并且不是通过教师报告的与儿童亲近程度、母亲报告的儿童行为、受欺凌情况或自信心等指标起作用的。英国数据的结果表明，童年时期更高的美貌通过影响测试分数，直接和间接地提高了教育成就，从而有助于提高成年后的收入。

records.title_en: All geared towards success? Cultural origins of gender gaps in student achievement
records.title_cn: 一切为了成功？学生成就性别差距的文化起源
records.abstract_en: Although geographical and temporal variations in gender achievement gaps have received considerable attention, the role of culture in explaining this variation is not well understood. We exploit a large Swedish administrative data set to study gender gaps in education among second-generation immigrant youth with different cultural backgrounds. Guided by hypotheses we derive from the economics literature on gender differences and gender convergence, we explore the predictive power of a set of cultural dimensions including achievement orientation, acceptance of inequality, risk avoidance, and long-term orientation. Using a variety of empirical tests that refine the classical epidemiological approach, we find that the central cultural dimension that matters for gender gaps in student achievement is the extent to which a society emphasizes ambition, competition, and achievement, which is strongly predictive of a relative achievement disadvantage of girls compared with boys. Exploring factors that may explain the results, we find that parents from achievement-oriented cultures choose higher quality schools for their children, and that boys benefit more from exposure to higher quality schools than girls do. Using PISA data to probe external validity, we find qualitatively and quantitatively remarkably similar results in a very different sample of second-generation immigrant youth.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管性别成就差距的地理和时间变化已受到相当关注，但文化在解释这种变化中的作用尚未得到充分理解。我们利用瑞典大型行政数据集，研究具有不同文化背景的第二代移民青年在教育中的性别差距。在经济学文献关于性别差异和性别趋同的假设指导下，我们探索了一系列文化维度的预测能力，包括成就导向、不平等接受度、风险规避和长期导向。通过多种精炼经典流行病学方法的实证检验，我们发现影响学生成就性别差距的核心文化维度是社会对雄心、竞争和成就的强调程度，这强烈预测了女孩相对于男孩的成就劣势。在探索可能解释这些结果的因素时，我们发现来自成就导向文化的父母为孩子选择更高质量的学校，且男孩从高质量学校中获益多于女孩。使用PISA数据检验外部有效性，我们在一个非常不同的第二代移民青年样本中发现了定性和定量上显著相似的结果。

records.title_en: Trust, social protection, and compliance: Moral hazard in Latin America during the COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: 信任、社会保障与合规：拉丁美洲COVID-19疫情期间的道德风险
records.abstract_en: Political trust is an important predictor of compliance with government policies, especially in the face of natural disasters or public health emergencies. During the COVID-19 pandemic, for example, multiple studies related political trust to increased compliance with mobility restrictions. Yet these findings come mostly from high-income countries where political trust and wealth correlate positively. In Latin America, both variables correlate negatively, allowing for better testing of competing explanations. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that in Latin America wealth and, counterintuitively, low political trust predict increased compliance. To understand mechanisms, we decompose political trust and wealth into underlying predictors (social protection, corruption, and education) and reinsert them into the model. While education, as a wealth proxy, predicts decreased mobility across all periods, social protection, which was the strongest predictor of political trust, relates significantly to increased mobility, but only at the beginning of the lockdown prior to distribution of emergency support. This suggests the existence of a public health moral hazard early in the pandemic, whereby citizens who benefited previously from government benefits may have been more risk tolerant in the face of the COVID-19 threat. We interpret these findings within the context of the region's recent “inclusionary turn.” Future studies should explore the distinct relationships between political trust, risk perception, and compliance, especially in low- and middle-income countries, and their implications for policy responses to national emergencies.
records.abstract_cn: 政治信任是政府政策合规的重要预测因素，尤其是在面对自然灾害或公共卫生紧急情况时。例如，在COVID-19疫情期间，多项研究将政治信任与流动性限制的更高合规性联系起来。然而，这些发现大多来自高收入国家，在这些国家中，政治信任与财富呈正相关。在拉丁美洲，这两个变量呈负相关，从而可以更好地检验竞争性解释。利用双重差分设计，我们发现，在拉丁美洲，财富以及反直觉的低政治信任预测了更高的合规性。为了理解机制，我们将政治信任和财富分解为潜在预测因素（社会保障、腐败和教育），并将其重新纳入模型。虽然教育作为财富的代理变量，在所有时期都预测了流动性降低，但社会保障（政治信任的最强预测因素）与流动性增加显著相关，但仅限于封锁初期，即紧急援助分配之前。这表明，在疫情早期存在公共卫生道德风险，即先前受益于政府福利的公民在面对COVID-19威胁时可能更具风险容忍度。我们在该地区最近的“包容性转向”背景下解释这些发现。未来的研究应探讨政治信任、风险感知和合规之间的不同关系，特别是在低收入和中等收入国家，及其对国家紧急情况政策应对的影响。

records.title_en: Relative risk taking and social curiosity
records.title_cn: 相对风险承担与社会好奇心
records.abstract_en: We present an experiment providing (a) a horse race among different models combining social preferences and risk preferences, and (b) a test of whether agents are socially curious, that is wanting to know about the risk taking of others and the outcomes of their risk taking. We distinguish outcome driven models (that is, models where agents care about the earning outcomes for themselves and others) from action driven models (that is, models where agents care about one's risk taking actions relative to the actions of others). We embed outcome and action driven competitive preferences, inequality aversion, conformism, and social loss aversion, within a single theoretical framework generalized from Bolton and Ockenfels (2000). We find that competitive preferences models best explain investment decisions in our setting, with almost 50% of subjects influenced both by their co-participants’ actions and outcomes. Social information is sought 90% of the times when it is free. When it is costly, it is sought 30% of the times if the information is instrumental for one's own investment decision and 10% to 20% of the times if it is not. Competitive preferences can help explain social curiosity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了一个实验，该实验提供了（a）对结合社会偏好和风险偏好的不同模型进行赛马比较，以及（b）对代理人是否具有社会好奇心（即想知道他人的风险承担行为及其风险承担结果）的检验。我们区分了结果驱动模型（即代理人关心自己和他人收入结果的模型）与行动驱动模型（即代理人关心自己的风险承担行为相对于他人行为的模型）。我们将结果驱动和行动驱动的竞争偏好、不平等厌恶、从众行为和社会损失厌恶嵌入到一个从Bolton和Ockenfels（2000）推广的单一理论框架中。我们发现，在我们的设定中，竞争偏好模型最能解释投资决策，几乎有50%的受试者同时受到共同参与者行为和结果的影响。当社会信息免费时，有90%的时间会被寻求。当信息需要成本时，如果信息对个人投资决策有工具性作用，则有30%的时间会被寻求；如果信息不具有工具性作用，则有10%到20%的时间会被寻求。竞争偏好有助于解释社会好奇心。

records.title_en: Taxation, health system endowment and institutional quality: ‘Social media’ perceptions across Europe
records.title_cn: 税收、卫生系统禀赋与制度质量：欧洲的‘社交媒体’感知
records.abstract_en: In this paper we analyse how health system endowment and the quality of institutions impact perceptions towards taxation. We conduct a sentiment analysis of Twitter users' tweets to determine whether the impact of the Covid-19 health emergency has modified the attitudes of the citizens towards taxation in the four largest European countries: France, Germany, Italy and Spain. We use a difference-in-differences estimation strategy, comparing the average sentiments of individual tweets regarding taxation in different European NUTS-2 regions, before and after the spread of the Covid-19 pandemic. Our results highlight that in regions characterised by higher health system endowment people adopted more positive attitudes towards taxation with respect to those living in regions with low levels of health system endowment over the period 2019-2020. In addition, we show how higher quality institutions led to more positive perceptions in relative and absolute terms, suggesting a greater predisposition for a more progressive tax system.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们分析了卫生系统禀赋和制度质量如何影响对税收的感知。我们对Twitter用户的推文进行了情感分析，以确定Covid-19卫生紧急事件的影响是否改变了法国、德国、意大利和西班牙这四个欧洲最大国家公民对税收的态度。我们采用双重差分估计策略，比较了Covid-19大流行传播前后，欧洲不同NUTS-2地区关于税收的个人推文的平均情感。我们的结果强调，在卫生系统禀赋较高的地区，人们相对于生活在卫生系统禀赋较低地区的人，在2019-2020期间对税收采取了更积极的态度。此外，我们展示了更高质量的机构如何在相对和绝对条件下带来更积极的感知，表明对更累进税制有更大的倾向。

records.title_en: A simple model of panic buying
records.title_cn: 恐慌性购买的简单模型
records.abstract_en: We study a simple dynamic model to rationalize episodes of excess demand that resemble “panic buying” episodes in actual markets. In such episodes, consumers compete for a scarce good. Scarcity is triggered by an anticipated negative supply shock that takes place in a future period with positive probability. To avoid the risk of non-consumption, consumers can stockpile the good in earlier periods. We demonstrate that these stockpiling decisions can reinforce each other, creating a cascade of excess demand in several periods similar to “panic buying” episodes observed, for instance, during the Corona crisis. In our model, stockpiling is always detrimental to welfare, and we develop a suitable policy response.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个简单的动态模型，以合理化实际市场中类似于“恐慌性购买”事件的过度需求。在这些事件中，消费者竞争一种稀缺商品。稀缺性是由未来某个时期以正概率发生的预期负面供给冲击引发的。为了避免不消费的风险，消费者可以在更早的时期囤积该商品。我们证明，这些囤积决策可以相互强化，在多个时期形成过度需求的级联效应，类似于在例如新冠危机期间观察到的“恐慌性购买”事件。在我们的模型中，囤积总是对福利有害，我们制定了一个合适的政策应对措施。

records.title_en: Inflation expectations and household expenditure: Evidence from pseudo-panel data in Japan
records.title_cn: 通胀预期与家庭支出：来自日本伪面板数据的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines to what extent a rise in inflation expectations stimulates current household expenditure in Japan. Using matched household datasets, we find the following. First, to the extent that the rise in inflation expectations is from about 0% to the 2−10% range, durable goods expenditure is significantly stimulated. Second, total expenditure increases by 1.0% in response to a one percentage point rise in inflation expectations, about 82% of which is explained by the response of durable goods expenditure. Third, storable and non-storable non-durable goods expenditures (especially the latter) do not respond significantly to the inflation expectations. Finally, a temporary rise in inflation expectations immediately stimulates total expenditure, but produces a similar degree of decline over a few quarters, with virtually no long-run impact.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在日本，通胀预期的上升在多大程度上刺激了当前的家庭支出。利用匹配的家庭数据集，我们发现以下结果。第一，当通胀预期从约0%上升至2至10%的区间时，耐用品支出受到显著刺激。第二，通胀预期每上升一个百分点，总支出增加1.0%，其中约82%由耐用品支出的反应所解释。第三，可储存和不可储存的非耐用品支出（尤其是后者）对通胀预期的反应不显著。最后，通胀预期的暂时上升会立即刺激总支出，但在几个季度内会产生类似程度的下降，且几乎没有长期影响。

records.title_en: Coordinating donations via an intermediary: The destructive effect of a sunk overhead cost
records.title_cn: 通过中介协调捐赠：沉没间接费用的破坏性影响
records.abstract_en: Donors often use the services of an intermediary to prevent their donations from being too thinly distributed over multiple public projects. We explore whether donors’ willingness to coordinate their funds via an intermediary depends on the extent of the intermediary’s discretion over their contributions, as well as the organizational overhead costs incurred by the intermediary. We investigate this using a laboratory experiment in which donors face multiple identical threshold public goods and the opportunity to coordinate their contributions via another donor assigned to the role of intermediary. In line with standard game theoretic predictions, we find that donors make use of the intermediary only when they know she is heavily restricted in terms of the proportion of their contributions she can expropriate for herself. However, we find strong evidence that the positive effect of these restrictions is undone once the intermediary incurs a sunk overhead cost. Our analysis suggests that the ex-ante inequality created as a result of this sunk cost reduces the trustworthiness of the intermediary in the donors’ eyes, which in turn reduces the donors’ willingness to use the intermediary to coordinate their contributions effectively.
records.abstract_cn: 捐赠者通常使用中介服务，以防止其捐赠在多个公共项目中被过度分散。我们探讨捐赠者通过中介协调资金的意愿是否取决于中介对其捐款的自由裁量权程度，以及中介产生的组织间接费用。我们通过实验室实验对此进行研究，实验中捐赠者面临多个相同的门槛公共物品，并有机会通过另一名被指定为中介的捐赠者来协调其捐款。与标准博弈论预测一致，我们发现只有当捐赠者知道中介在可为自己侵占的捐款比例方面受到严格限制时，他们才会利用中介。然而，我们发现强有力的证据表明，一旦中介产生沉没间接费用，这些限制的积极效应就会被抵消。我们的分析表明，这种沉没成本导致的先验不平等降低了捐赠者眼中中介的可信度，进而降低了捐赠者利用中介有效协调其捐款的意愿。

records.title_en: Disease and democracy: Political regimes and countries responsiveness to COVID-19
records.title_cn: 疾病与民主：政治体制与国家应对COVID-19的响应能力
records.abstract_en: A widely held belief is that autocratic governments have been more effective in reducing the movement of people to curb the spread of COVID-19. Using daily information on lockdown measures and geographic mobility across more than 130 countries, we find that autocratic regimes have indeed imposed more stringent lockdowns and relied more on contact tracing. However, we find no evidence that autocratic governments were more effective in reducing travel, and evidence to the contrary: compliance with the lockdown measures taken was higher in countries with democratically accountable governments. Exploring a host of potential mechanisms, we provide suggestive evidence that democratic institutions are associated with attitudes that support collective action, such as mounting a coordinated response to a pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: 一个广泛持有的观点是，专制政府在减少人员流动以遏制COVID-19传播方面更为有效。利用超过130个国家的封锁措施和地理流动性的每日信息，我们发现专制政权确实实施了更严格的封锁，并更依赖接触者追踪。然而，我们没有发现证据表明专制政府在减少旅行方面更有效，反而有相反的证据：在民主问责制政府国家，对封锁措施的遵守程度更高。通过探索一系列潜在机制，我们提供了暗示性证据，表明民主制度与支持集体行动的态度相关，例如协调应对疫情。

records.title_en: Firms’ entry choices across export products and markets, and the consequences of trade in an open economy: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 企业在出口产品和市场间的进入选择，以及开放经济中贸易的后果：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: We outline a model of endogenous choices of market entry and product scope in a partial-equilibrium model of heterogeneous firms with arbitrary productivity. Firms’ choices of interest depend on market characteristics including variable trade and fixed market-entry costs. Conditional on fixed costs, the extent to which firms respond to shocks depends on their (potentially nonparametric) density around the zero-profit threshold. Accordingly, identical changes in, e.g., variable trade costs per product and market can lead to vastly different responses across not only markets and products but also firms. We shed light on the heterogeneity of these responses by estimating parameters and otherwise calibrating the model to firm-and-product-level bilateral trade data for China.
records.abstract_cn: 我们概述了一个内生选择市场进入和产品范围的模型，该模型基于具有任意生产率的异质性企业的局部均衡框架。企业感兴趣的选择取决于市场特征，包括可变贸易成本和固定市场进入成本。在固定成本条件下，企业对冲击的反应程度取决于其（可能非参数的）密度在零利润阈值附近的情况。因此，例如，每个产品和市场的可变贸易成本的相同变化，不仅可能导致不同市场和产品之间的反应差异巨大，而且企业之间的反应也可能截然不同。我们通过估计参数并以其他方式将模型校准到中国的企业-产品层面双边贸易数据，揭示了这些反应的异质性。

records.title_en: Potential in-group bias at work: Evidence from performance evaluations
records.title_cn: 工作中的潜在内群体偏见：来自绩效评估的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the existence of in-group bias (preferential treatment of one’s own group) in performance evaluations. Drawing information from an educational setting and employing a unique dataset, we use principals’ observational assessment of teachers to examine the impact of gender interactions on evaluation of employees. Our results indicate that average classroom observation ratings for female teachers, relative to males, were 0.19 of a standard deviation higher when they were evaluated by female principals. We explore the mechanisms and present convincing sets of results consistent with the tendency of superiors to favor same-gender subordinates. Several robustness checks and different placebo tests support our findings.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了绩效评估中内群体偏见（对自己群体的优待）的存在性。通过利用教育环境中的信息并采用独特的数据集，我们使用校长对教师的观察性评估来考察性别互动对员工评估的影响。我们的结果表明，当女性教师由女性校长评估时，其平均课堂观察评分相对于男性教师高出0.19个标准差。我们探讨了其机制，并呈现了与上级倾向于偏袒同性下属相一致的有说服力的结果集。多项稳健性检验和不同的安慰剂测试支持了我们的发现。

records.title_en: Polycentricity and adaptation: A multilevel selectionist approach
records.title_cn: 多中心性与适应性：一种多层次选择论方法
records.abstract_en: Polycentric organizations allow highly functional, or “group-beneficial,” outcomes to emerge from the myopic behavior of rule-guided individuals. How does polycentricity achieve this feat? Drawing on multilevel selection theory, I argue that polycentric orders support successful outcomes by defining group boundaries and reducing within-group fitness variance relative to between-group variance. The Price equation suggests that, by doing so, polycentric orders facilitate a process of collectively beneficial adaptation, including the capacity to evolve mechanisms for monitoring and punishing rule violators.
records.abstract_cn: 多中心组织允许高度功能性或“群体利益”的结果从规则引导个体的短视行为中涌现。多中心性如何实现这一壮举？借鉴多层次选择理论，我认为多中心秩序通过界定群体边界并降低群体内适应度方差相对于群体间方差的比率来支持成功的结果。普莱斯方程表明，通过这样做，多中心秩序促进了集体有益适应的过程，包括演化出监督和惩罚违规者机制的能力。

records.title_en: The effects of increased monitoring on high wealth individuals: Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in Indonesia
records.title_cn: 加强对高财富个人的监控效应：来自印度尼西亚准自然实验的证据
records.abstract_en: In 2009, Indonesia introduced a specialised tax office focused on High Wealth Individuals (HWIs), increasing the audit probability and monitoring of around 1200 wealthy taxpayers in Jakarta. Leveraging a quasi-natural experiment and analysing 141,097 de-identified individual tax return records between 2006 and 2012, we developed a set of counterfactuals to evaluate the post- and pre-treatment tax declarations of the monitored taxpayers relative to their synthetic control groups. Our results indicate that although post-treatment declaration of taxable and earned income, as well as income tax, increased, the effect was short-lived. The increase in reported earned income was larger relative to taxable income, suggesting that monitored individuals exerted efforts to reduce tax payments. Furthermore, we identified a comparable positive spillover effect on income declaration for non-treated taxpayers in Jakarta who met the HWI criteria. We also demonstrated that the spillover effect drastically decreased as financial characteristics (such as income and wealth) diverged from those of the targeted population. Overall, the additional tax revenue generated from this program is small in comparison to the total tax revenue collected.
records.abstract_cn: 2009年，印度尼西亚设立了一个专门针对高财富个人（HWIs）的税务办公室，提高了雅加达约1200名富裕纳税人的审计概率和监控力度。利用准自然实验并分析2006年至2012年间141,097份去标识化的个人纳税申报记录，我们构建了一组反事实，以评估受监控纳税人在处理前后相对于其合成对照组的税收申报情况。我们的结果表明，尽管处理后应税收入和劳动收入的申报以及所得税有所增加，但这一效应是短暂的。劳动收入申报的增加幅度大于应税收入，表明受监控的个人努力减少纳税。此外，我们发现在雅加达符合HWI标准但未受处理的纳税人中，存在类似的正向溢出效应。我们还证明，随着财务特征（如收入和财富）与目标人群的差异增大，溢出效应急剧下降。总体而言，该计划产生的额外税收收入与总税收收入相比微不足道。

records.title_en: How do firms adjust when trade stops?
records.title_cn: 当贸易停止时，企业如何调整？
records.abstract_en: We investigate how firms adjust to the introduction of sudden, unanticipated, and eventually long-lasting economic sanctions. In 2014, Russia introduced sanctions on imports from Europe, which caused an abrupt negative shock to the food production sector in Lithuania. We find that part-time employment is used as the first shock absorber, followed by full-time employment. Investment reacts immediately but also additionally in the later periods if part-time employment adjustments that proxy for the firm's exposure to the permanence of the shock are large. At the same time, firms dampen shock effects by expanding to other export markets. To rationalize this firm behavior, we provide a theoretical mechanism where forward-looking firms face nonconvexities in the labor market along with heterogeneous variable trade costs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业如何适应突然、未预料到且最终长期持续的经济制裁。2014年，俄罗斯对来自欧洲的进口实施了制裁，这对立陶宛的食品生产部门造成了突然的负面冲击。我们发现，兼职就业被用作第一道冲击吸收器，随后是全职就业。投资立即做出反应，但如果代表企业对冲击持久性暴露程度的兼职就业调整幅度较大，投资在后期也会额外做出反应。同时，企业通过扩展到其他出口市场来减轻冲击效应。为了合理化这种企业行为，我们提供了一个理论机制，其中前瞻性企业在劳动力市场面临非凸性，同时面临异质性的可变贸易成本。

records.title_en: Market reactions to stock splits: Experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 市场对股票拆分的反应：实验证据
records.abstract_en: Stock splits and reverse splits often result in short-term abnormal returns even though such split events do not change any fundamental factors affecting the valuation of a firm's stock. In this paper we report an experiment designed to better understand market reactions to stock splits and reverse splits. In one treatment, two assets have increasing fundamental values, and one asset is subject to a 2-for-1 share split while the other asset is not. In a second treatment, the fundamental values of both assets are decreasing, and one asset is subject to a 1-for-2 reverse split while the other asset is not. We find that in both cases, share prices do not fully adjust to changes in fundamental values per share following a split announcement. We provide evidence that the incomplete adjustment of share prices to splits or reverse splits can be attributed to heterogeneity in traders' cognitive abilities.
records.abstract_cn: 股票拆分和反向拆分通常会导致短期异常收益，尽管此类拆分事件并未改变影响公司股票估值的任何基本面因素。在本文中，我们报告了一项旨在更好地理解市场对股票拆分和反向拆分反应的实验。在一项处理中，两种资产的基本价值递增，其中一种资产进行2比1的股票拆分，而另一种资产则不进行。在第二项处理中，两种资产的基本价值递减，其中一种资产进行1比2的反向拆分，而另一种资产则不进行。我们发现，在两种情况下，拆分公告后股价并未完全调整以反映每股基本价值的变化。我们提供的证据表明，股价对拆分或反向拆分的不完全调整可归因于交易者认知能力的异质性。

records.title_en: The effect of quantity and quality of information in strategy tournaments
records.title_cn: 策略锦标赛中信息数量与质量的影响
records.abstract_en: It is increasingly common for algorithms rather than people to take complex decisions. Many of those algorithms are however written by people and the information available to them when developing an algorithm will influence the algorithm they write. We implement such a setting in a controlled environment where participants program an explicit strategy to play the minority game on their behalf in a multi-round strategy tournament. The minority game is a stylized example of the large and important class of games with strategic substitutes such as market-entry and congestion games. Given the large strategy space and multiplicity of equilibria of the minority game, developing a successful strategy is no easy task. Over three experiments we vary the information available to participants to study whether more or better information can help people to improve their strategies over time. Providing participants with the strategies played by others turns out to reduce overall performance, while reducing the noise in feedback about the potential performance of a strategy under consideration increases efficiency. We argue that these different information structures put different types of strategies in a good light. The increased popularity of the favored strategies in turn drives overall efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 由算法而非人类做出复杂决策的情况日益普遍。然而，许多此类算法是由人类编写的，他们在开发算法时可获得的信息将影响他们编写的算法。我们在受控环境中实现了这样一种设置，参与者编写明确的策略，在多轮策略锦标赛中代表他们玩少数派博弈。少数派博弈是战略替代品这一大类重要博弈（如市场进入和拥堵博弈）的一个典型例子。鉴于少数派博弈的策略空间庞大且均衡多重，制定成功的策略并非易事。在三个实验中，我们改变参与者可获得的信息，以研究更多或更好的信息是否能帮助人们随时间改进其策略。向参与者提供他人采用的策略反而降低了整体绩效，而减少关于所考虑策略潜在绩效反馈中的噪声则提高了效率。我们认为，这些不同的信息结构使不同类型的策略显得更具优势。受青睐策略的日益普及反过来又推动了整体效率的提升。

records.title_en: Reply and counter-reply: On cybersocialism
records.title_cn: 回复与反回复：论网络社会主义

records.title_en: Gender wage and longevity gaps and the design of retirement systems
records.title_cn: 性别工资与寿命差距及退休制度设计
records.abstract_en: We study the design of pension benefits for male and female workers. Women live longer than men but have a lower wage. Individuals can be single or live in couples who pool their incomes. Social welfare is utilitarian but an increasing concave transformation of individuals’ lifetime utilities introduces the concern for redistribution across individuals with different lifespans.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究男性和女性工人的养老金福利设计。女性比男性寿命更长，但工资较低。个体可以是单身或生活在收入共享的夫妻中。社会福利是功利主义的，但对个体终身效用的递增凹变换引入了对不同寿命个体间再分配的关注。

records.title_en: Hidden inefficiency: Strategic inflation of project schedules
records.title_cn: 隐藏的低效率：项目工期的策略性膨胀
records.abstract_en: Establishing realistic project plans and completing the resulting business projects on schedule is crucial for organizations striving to effectively utilize their resources. However, incentivizing on-time project delivery may result in moral hazard, as people could respond to estimation accuracy incentives by strategically inflating duration estimates and subsequently prolonging project execution. While the project is delivered on time, the resources are underutilized. We conjecture that the possibility of moral hazard can be mitigated by introducing speed incentives in addition to the schedule accuracy incentives. We conduct a diagnostic test of the effect of accuracy and speed incentives on the process of project estimation and delivery. Our study presents direct empirical evidence that the incentive structure rewarding solely the estimation accuracy can result in hidden inefficiency due to inflated estimates and deliberately slower project execution. When speed incentives are implemented alongside estimation accuracy incentives, the estimates are significantly lower and the project is completed more quickly, without compromising the schedule accuracy or output quality. Aligning the objectives of a project owner with those of planners, by incentivizing the planners for both estimation accuracy and quick project completion, fosters more compressed but still accurate and reliable project schedules, and accelerated project delivery.
records.abstract_cn: 制定现实的项目计划并按期完成由此产生的业务项目，对于努力有效利用资源的组织至关重要。然而，激励按时交付项目可能会导致道德风险，因为人们可能会通过策略性地夸大工期估计并随后延长项目执行来回应估计准确性激励。虽然项目按时交付，但资源未得到充分利用。我们推测，通过在进度准确性激励之外引入速度激励，可以减轻道德风险的可能性。我们对准确性和速度激励对项目估计和交付过程的影响进行了诊断性测试。我们的研究提供了直接的实证证据，表明仅奖励估计准确性的激励结构可能因膨胀的估计和故意放缓的项目执行而导致隐藏的低效率。当速度激励与估计准确性激励同时实施时，估计显著降低，项目完成更快，且不损害进度准确性或产出质量。通过激励规划者同时追求估计准确性和快速项目完成，使项目所有者的目标与规划者的目标保持一致，有助于形成更紧凑但仍准确可靠的项目进度，并加速项目交付。

records.title_en: Mountains of evidence: The effects of abnormal air pollution on crime
records.title_cn: 如山铁证：异常空气污染对犯罪的影响
records.abstract_en: We find that air pollution increases crime in a city that ranks in the worst two percentiles worldwide for dirty winter air. Our identification strategy employs distinct geographic features of Almaty, Kazakhstan: cleaner mountain winds and frequent temperature inversions. Using these variables to instrument for PM2.5 air pollution, we estimate a PM2.5 elasticity of the expected crime rate more than four times as large as similar estimates from cleaner cities. Among crime types, we estimate statistically significant effects of air pollution on property crime, and we find no evidence of an effect on violent crime. These results are consistent with theory that air pollution induces higher discounting rather than aggression. We extend this theory and find that whether air pollution has distinct effects on crimes of varying severity depends on whether the population is more heterogenous in the outside option or in the discount factor. Using microdata on crime severity, we find statistically significant increases in both major and minor crime rates from air pollution, and we fail to reject common PM2.5 elasticities of minor and major crime rates. The greater scale of major crimes implies that they contribute more to the total crime rate increase from air pollution.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现空气污染会增加一个在全球冬季空气质量最差的两个百分位城市中的犯罪率。我们的识别策略利用了哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图独特的地理特征：更清洁的山风和频繁的逆温现象。使用这些变量作为PM2.5空气污染的工具变量，我们估计的预期犯罪率对PM2.5的弹性比类似清洁城市的估计值大四倍以上。在犯罪类型中，我们估计出空气污染对财产犯罪有统计上显著的影响，并且没有发现其对暴力犯罪有影响的证据。这些结果与空气污染导致更高的贴现而非攻击性的理论一致。我们扩展了这一理论，发现空气污染对严重程度不同的犯罪是否有不同影响，取决于人口在外部选择或贴现因子方面是否更加异质。利用犯罪严重程度的微观数据，我们发现空气污染导致重大和轻微犯罪率均出现统计上显著的增加，并且我们无法拒绝轻微和重大犯罪率对PM2.5具有共同弹性的假设。重大犯罪的规模更大意味着它们对空气污染导致的总犯罪率上升贡献更大。

records.title_en: Flexible time horizon planning, learning and aggregate fluctuations
records.title_cn: 灵活的时间跨度规划、学习与总体波动
records.abstract_en: A dynamic general equilibrium model is constructed and analyzed under the assumptions that the representative decision maker is endowed with incomplete knowledge about his environment of interest along with limited cognitive skills. Under various beliefs about the long-run growth prospects consistent with Kaldor's, 1961 stylized facts, the benchmark infinite-dimensional decentralized planning problem collapses into infinite sequences of T>1 dimensional sub-problems which are each within the decision maker's limited computing range. Based on the time length of the planning horizon and the nature of expectations, the resulting framework in which both forecasts and plans may get revised in the light of new information encompasses at the limits the benchmark infinite horizon case with perfect foresight, a rolling infinite horizon case, a self-fulfilling static planning case and Day's, 1969 two-period heuristic case. Under exogenous price and quantity growth forecasts consistent with the perfect foresight steady-state balanced growth path, the time length of the planning horizon may have no effect on the resulting competitive equilibrium which may deviate dramatically from the optimal solution. When these growth forecasts are endogenous, the competitive equilibrium effects of the planning horizon time length depend on the characteristics of the information sets. The resulting model may help us to better understand how economies respond to shocks by unraveling new propagation mechanisms related to changes in optimism or pessimism about short-run and/or long-run growth prospects.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建并分析了一个动态一般均衡模型，其假设是代表性决策者对其关注的环境拥有不完全知识，且认知能力有限。在符合Kaldor（1961）典型化事实的关于长期增长前景的各种信念下，基准的无限维分散规划问题分解为无限序列的T>1维子问题，每个子问题均在决策者有限的计算能力范围内。基于规划时间跨度的长度和预期的性质，所得到的框架中，预测和计划都可能根据新信息进行修订，该框架在极限情况下涵盖了具有完美预见性的基准无限期情形、滚动无限期情形、自我实现的静态规划情形以及Day（1969）的两期启发式情形。在符合完美预见稳态平衡增长路径的外生价格和数量增长预测下，规划时间跨度的长度可能对竞争均衡没有影响，而该均衡可能严重偏离最优解。当这些增长预测是内生的时候，规划时间跨度长度对竞争均衡的影响取决于信息集的特征。所得到的模型可能有助于我们更好地理解经济如何通过揭示与短期和/或长期增长前景的乐观或悲观情绪变化相关的新传导机制来应对冲击。

records.title_en: Effects of cultural origin on entrepreneurship
records.title_cn: 文化渊源对创业的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of cultural origin on entrepreneurship. Using Swedish registry data on second-generation immigrants and risk appetite measures from the Global Preference Survey (GPS), we investigate whether risk preferences in parents’ home countries affect entrepreneurship. We find that children of immigrants from more risk-loving cultures are more likely to start up a business, although of poorer quality. We also find that entrepreneurs with parents from cultures with higher risk appetite earn a lower personal income. Our analysis demonstrates that culturally transmitted risk appetite has significant effects beyond individual and parental socioeconomic characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了文化渊源对创业的影响。利用瑞典关于第二代移民的登记数据以及全球偏好调查（GPS）中的风险偏好度量，我们考察了父母原籍国的风险偏好是否影响创业。我们发现，来自更具风险偏好文化的移民子女更有可能创业，尽管企业质量较差。我们还发现，父母来自风险偏好较高文化的创业者个人收入较低。我们的分析表明，文化传递的风险偏好对个人及父母社会经济特征之外具有显著影响。

records.title_en: When less is more: Information and the financing of innovation
records.title_cn: 少即是多：信息与创新融资
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of informational frictions when the entrepreneur anticipates having little or no bargaining power in negotiating with the financier and can select ex ante the innovation/venture he wants to develop. In this environment the entrepreneur faces a tradeoff between selecting an innovation that creates high value but one which only allows him to capture little or none of that value; or selecting a “pet-project” innovation that creates lower value but yields private benefits to him. In the baseline scenario, without contractual frictions, the financier is able to elicit first-best entrepreneurial effort, but cannot commit not to extract all innovation rents from the entrepreneur, leading the entrepreneur to select his favored but inefficient innovation. The key insight of the model is that the introduction of informational frictions like non-verifiability of effort or talent information asymmetry, while leading to reductions in effort (for a given innovation choice), may lead to more efficient (i.e. higher value) innovation choices ex ante, and indeed could generate a superior payoff to the financier and a greater total surplus from innovation. This yields several empirical implications, not least of which the potential motivation for financiers to commit to “opacity of information” when the resulting improvements in innovation selection dominate the impact of effort reduction.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了当企业家预期在与金融家谈判时几乎没有或没有议价能力，并且可以事前选择他想要开发的创新/风险项目时，信息摩擦的影响。在这种环境下，企业家面临一种权衡：选择一种创造高价值但只能让他获得很少或无法获得该价值的创新；或者选择一种创造较低价值但为他带来私人利益的“宠物项目”创新。在基准情景中，没有合同摩擦，金融家能够诱使第一最佳的企业家努力，但不能承诺不从企业家那里榨取所有创新租金，导致企业家选择他偏好的但低效的创新。该模型的关键见解是，引入信息摩擦，如努力不可验证性或人才信息不对称，虽然会导致努力减少（对于给定的创新选择），但可能事前导致更高效（即更高价值）的创新选择，并且确实可能为金融家产生更高的回报和更大的创新总剩余。这产生了若干实证含义，尤其是金融家可能承诺“信息不透明”的动机，当由此产生的创新选择改进主导努力减少的影响时。

records.title_en: Clash of norms judicial leniency on defendant birthdays
records.title_cn: 规范的冲突：被告生日当天的司法宽大处理
records.abstract_en: We document judicial leniency on defendant birthdays across 4.8 million decisions. Our results are consistent with reference-dependent social preferences. First, French sentences are 1% fewer and around 5% shorter. Second, U.S. federal judges also round down sentences except when rounding up makes available sentencing reductions for good behavior. No leniency appears on the days before or after a defendant's birthday.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了在4.8百万个判决中，被告生日当天存在司法宽大处理现象。我们的结果与参照依赖的社会偏好一致。首先，法国的刑期减少了1%，且刑期长度缩短了约5%。其次，美国联邦法官也会向下取整刑期，除非向上取整能够使良好行为获得减刑机会。在被告生日前后几天，没有出现宽大处理现象。

records.title_en: Physics, Biology and Human Faculties: A Structural Stepwise Approach to Modeling Human Behavior
records.title_cn: 物理学、生物学与人类官能：建模人类行为的一种结构性逐步方法
records.abstract_en: Seeking a better understanding of human behavior and social phenomena were the primary pursuits of Richard Day's scholarship, and of the Journal he co-founded and edited. In that pioneering spirit of adventure, we structure approaches to modeling human behavior in three steps with respect to scientific disciplines, their associated principles, and subject matters: human faculties, biology and physics. We note that the extant practice of modeling human behavior in social sciences starts from psycho-sociological features and principles before moving to biological ones, and finally using physical laws for formalization. These formalizations are often presented with the disclaimer: of course, human behavior extends beyond our physical existence. Alternatively, but less often, they are defended in a reductionist spirit. In the present contribution we propose reversing this extant order of deploying scientific principles and argue that this exercise will help link social sciences to biology and physics, without reductionism.
records.abstract_cn: 寻求对人类行为和社会现象的更好理解是Richard Day学术研究及其共同创办并编辑的期刊的主要追求。本着这种开拓性的冒险精神，我们按照科学学科、其相关原理和主题，将建模人类行为的方法结构化为三个步骤：人类官能、生物学和物理学。我们注意到，社会科学中现有的建模人类行为实践从心理-社会学特征和原理开始，然后转向生物学原理，最后使用物理定律进行形式化。这些形式化通常带有免责声明：当然，人类行为超越了我们的物理存在。或者，较少见的是，它们以还原论的精神进行辩护。在本文中，我们提出逆转这种部署科学原理的现有顺序，并论证这一工作将有助于将社会科学与生物学和物理学联系起来，而无需还原论。

records.title_en: Cognitive reflection and 2D:4D: Evidence from a large population sample
records.title_cn: 认知反思与2D:4D：来自大样本人口的证据
records.abstract_en: Bosch-Domènech et al. (2014) reported a negative association between 2D:4D, a suggested marker of prenatal testosterone exposure, and the Cognitive Reflection Test (CRT) in a sample of 623 university students. In this pre-registered study, we test if we can replicate their findings in a general population sample of over 2,500 individuals from Germany. We find no statistically significant association between 2D:4D and the CRT in any of our primary hypothesis tests, or in any of our pre-registered exploratory analyses and robustness tests. The evidence is strong (based on the 99.5% confidence intervals in all three primary hypothesis tests) against effect sizes in the hypothesized direction larger than 0.075 CRT units (0.073 of the CRT standard deviation) for a one standard deviation change in 2D:4D.
records.abstract_cn: Bosch-Domènech等人（2014）在623名大学生样本中报告了2D:4D（一种产前睾酮暴露的潜在标志物）与认知反思测试（CRT）之间的负相关。在这项预注册研究中，我们检验了能否在来自德国的超过2,500人的一般人群样本中复制他们的发现。我们在任何主要假设检验中，或任何预注册的探索性分析和稳健性检验中，均未发现2D:4D与CRT之间存在统计学显著关联。证据强烈（基于所有三项主要假设检验中的99.5%置信区间）反对假设方向上的效应量大于2D:4D每变化一个标准差对应0.075个CRT单位（0.073个CRT标准差）。

records.title_en: Persistence of incumbents and female access to political positions
records.title_cn: 现任者的持续性与女性获得政治职位的机会
records.abstract_en: This article studies whether the incumbent advantage for reelection reduces female access to political positions. I use a regression discontinuity exploiting close electoral races in French municipalities to randomize the eligibility of incumbent mayors for reappointment. After a male incumbent, I show that incumbency largely reduces the stock of places where women have historically been appointed mayor by about 24%. After a female incumbent, I find that there are fewer women appointed mayor than after a male one. I investigate the mechanisms and argue that this effect is consistent with a backlash or stereotype threat effect penalizing women after a female incumbent.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了现任者连任优势是否减少了女性获得政治职位的机会。我利用法国市镇中激烈的选举竞争作为断点回归，以随机化现任市长连任的资格。在男性现任者之后，我表明现任者大幅减少了历史上女性被任命为市长的职位存量约24%。在女性现任者之后，我发现被任命为市长的女性少于男性现任者之后。我调查了机制，并认为这一效应与女性现任者之后对女性的反弹或刻板印象威胁效应一致。

records.title_en: The impact of Covid-19 containment lockdowns on MSMEs in India and resilience of exporting firms
records.title_cn: 新冠19封锁对印度中小微企业的影响及出口企业的韧性
records.abstract_en: This study uses data from a survey of micro, small, and medium enterprises in India to document the impact of Covid-19 containment lockdowns on firms, their responses, and adaptation strategies.
