records.abstract_en: Our study uses administrative data on firm-to-firm transactions and quasi- experimental variation in the rollout of electronic invoicing reforms in Peru to study the diffusion of e-invoicing through firm networks and its effect on tax compliance. We find that voluntary e-invoicing adoption is higher amongst firms with partners who have been mandated to adopt e-invoicing, implying positive technology adoption spillovers. Spillovers are stronger from downstream partners and from export-oriented firms, consistent with incentives in the VAT system. Trading partners of firms who have been mandated to adopt e-invoicing report lower taxable purchases. Transaction-level data suggests that this decline comes from the termination of firm-supplier relationships. Lower purchases result in lower VAT credits, and higher VAT payments following the reform, suggesting positive tax compliance spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们的研究使用企业间交易的行政数据以及秘鲁电子发票改革推行中的准实验变异，来研究电子发票通过企业网络的扩散及其对税收合规的影响。我们发现，在合作伙伴被强制采用电子发票的企业中，自愿采用电子发票的比例更高，这表明存在正向的技术采用溢出效应。溢出效应在下游合作伙伴和出口导向型企业中更强，这与增值税体系中的激励措施一致。被强制采用电子发票的企业的交易伙伴报告的应税采购额较低。交易层面的数据表明，这种下降源于企业与供应商关系的终止。采购减少导致增值税抵扣减少，改革后增值税缴纳增加，这表明存在正向的税收合规溢出效应。

records.title_en: Renewable resource use with imperfect self-control
records.title_cn: 不完全自我控制下的可再生资源利用
records.abstract_en: We investigate renewable resource use when the harvesting agents face self-control problems. Individuals are conceptualized as dual selves. The rational long-run self plans for the infinite future while the affective short-run self desires to maximize instantaneous profits or utility. Depending on the degree of self-control, actual behavior is partly driven by short-run desires. In a model of a single harvesting agent (e.g. a fishery), we discuss how self-control problems affect harvesting behavior, resource conservation, and sustainability and discuss policies to curb overuse and potential collapse of the resource due to limited self-control. We then extend the model to several harvesting agents and show how limited self-control exacerbates the common pool problem. Finally, we investigate heterogenous agents and show that there are spillover effects of limited self-control in the sense that perfectly rational agents also behave less conservatively when they interact with agents with imperfect self-control.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当采掘者面临自我控制问题时可再生资源的利用。个体被概念化为双重自我。理性的长期自我规划无限未来，而情感性的短期自我则希望最大化瞬时利润或效用。根据自我控制的程度，实际行为部分由短期欲望驱动。在单一采掘者（如渔业）的模型中，我们讨论了自我控制问题如何影响采掘行为、资源保护与可持续性，并探讨了因有限自我控制而导致的过度利用和资源潜在崩溃的政策。随后，我们将模型扩展到多个采掘者，并展示有限自我控制如何加剧公共池问题。最后，我们研究了异质性主体，并表明有限自我控制存在溢出效应，即完全理性的主体在与不完全自我控制的主体互动时，其行为也会变得不那么保守。

records.title_en: Political Turnover Negatively Affects the Quality of Public Services: A Replication
records.title_cn: 政治更替对公共服务质量产生负面影响：一项复制研究
records.abstract_en: The politically motivated replacement in local governments is a pervasive fact in our modern democracies. Whether it has causal effects on the quality of public services, such as education, is a critical question and yet understudied. This paper uses a regression discontinuity design (RDD) for close elections to replicate Akthari, Moreira and Trucco (2022) who find negative effects on the quality of public education in Brazil (.05-.08 standard deviations of lower test scores). I first reproduce these main results, finding minor computational differences that have no effect on the conclusions. I also show that the estimates for Brazil are in general robust to different specifications following Brodeur, Cook and Heyes (2020). Finally, I implement the same RDD framework now applied to Chilean administrative records to find null effects on test scores. Taken together, these results suggest that political turnover has weakly negative effects on service quality.
records.abstract_cn: 地方政府中出于政治动机的更替在我们现代民主国家中普遍存在。它是否对公共服务（如教育）质量产生因果影响，是一个关键问题，但研究不足。本文使用断点回归设计（RDD）针对势均力敌的选举，复制了Akthari、Moreira和Trucco（2022）的研究，他们发现巴西公共教育质量受到负面影响（考试成绩下降05-08个标准差）。我首先重现了这些主要结果，发现微小的计算差异对结论没有影响。我还表明，遵循Brodeur、Cook和Heyes（2020）的方法，巴西的估计结果总体上对各种设定具有稳健性。最后，我将相同的RDD框架应用于智利的行政记录，发现对考试成绩没有影响。综合来看，这些结果表明政治更替对服务质量有微弱的负面影响。

records.title_en: Role models, aspirations and desire to migrate
records.title_cn: 榜样、志向与迁移意愿
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of role models on aspirations and the desire to migrate in rural Mali, implementing an RCT. Three documentaries are shown, depicting two successful life stories of non-migrants and migrants, and one unsuccessful migrant’s life story. We find that an identification process takes place, and that positive migrant and non-migrant role models increase aspirations and the feeling of control over one’s future, and decrease depression symptoms. None has a significant average impact on the desire to migrate. Heterogeneity analysis on the desire to migrate using Machine Learning suggests that belonging to migrant-prone households increases responses to positive and negative migrant role models. It also suggests working in agriculture, bad health conditions, low aspirations and living with migrants induce a stronger response to the film about local opportunities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过实施一项随机对照试验，研究了榜样对马里农村地区志向和迁移意愿的影响。研究展示了三部纪录片，分别描绘了非迁移者和迁移者的两个成功人生故事，以及一个不成功迁移者的人生故事。我们发现存在一个认同过程，积极的迁移者和非迁移者榜样提高了志向和对未来掌控感，并减少了抑郁症状。但没有任何榜样对迁移意愿产生显著的平均影响。使用机器学习对迁移意愿进行的异质性分析表明，属于倾向迁移的家庭会增加对积极和消极迁移者榜样的反应。该分析还表明，从事农业工作、健康状况不佳、志向低下以及与迁移者同住会促使对关于本地机会的影片产生更强的反应。

records.title_en: Bilingual education and child labor: Lessons from Peru
records.title_cn: 双语教育与童工：来自秘鲁的经验
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of bilingual education reform in Peru on child labor. The reform aimed to improve access to schooling for indigenous children in rural areas with greater integration of education providers and the delivery of lessons and material in vernacular indigenous languages. The core specifications use child-level panel data from the Young Lives Study and a two-way fixed effects difference-in-difference approach to test the causal effect of the program on child labor. The results show evidence to suggest that access to bilingual education has a negative and statistically significant effect on the extensive margin of child labor, with some specifications showing consistent results for its intensive margin counterpart. The preferred estimates are sizeable, with some specifications showing a decrease in the likelihood that an indigenous child enters child labor by between 12 and 18 percentage points. The findings are robust to several specifications including randomized inference techniques, synthetic difference-in-difference, and placebo tests. The paper also shows that concurrent policies, including Peru's conditional cash transfer program, are unlikely drivers of the core results. The paper's findings also suggest that the program resulted in greater inputs (i.e., time) into schooling and improved outcomes of education for indigenous children.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了秘鲁双语教育改革对童工的影响。该改革旨在通过加强教育提供者的整合以及用土著语言授课和提供教材，改善农村地区土著儿童接受教育的机会。核心规范使用来自“青年生活研究”的儿童层面面板数据和双向固定效应双重差分方法，检验该项目对童工的因果效应。结果表明，有证据显示获得双语教育对童工的广泛边际有负向且统计显著的影响，部分规范对其密集边际也显示出一致的结果。优先估计值相当大，部分规范显示土著儿童进入童工的可能性下降了12至18个百分点。这些发现在多种规范下均稳健，包括随机推断技术、合成双重差分和安慰剂检验。本文还表明，包括秘鲁有条件现金转移计划在内的同期政策不太可能是核心结果的驱动因素。本文的发现还表明，该项目增加了教育投入（即时间），并改善了土著儿童的教育成果。

records.title_en: An experimental exploration of reasonable doubt
records.title_cn: 合理怀疑的实验探索
records.abstract_en: The “beyond a reasonable doubt” standard is a constitutional requirement in U.S. criminal cases, but jury instructions on “reasonable doubt” vary across jurisdictions. We use a controlled experiment to analyze the relationship between the definition of reasonable doubt and juror decisions. In our novel (pre-registered) experiment, we vary the definition of reasonable doubt between subjects and elicit the level of evidence required for subjects to convict a defendant. We analyze juror decisions under two state definitions that are markedly different (Wisconsin and West Virginia) and analyze juror decisions when reasonable doubt is not explicitly defined. We find similar behavior in each treatment. We ran three additional treatments to determine why behavior does not seem to vary across definitions. Our data is consistent with subjects having pre-conceived notions of reasonable doubt that are not affected by jury instructions.
records.abstract_cn: “排除合理怀疑”标准是美国刑事案件中的宪法要求，但各司法管辖区对“合理怀疑”的陪审团指示各不相同。我们使用一项受控实验来分析合理怀疑的定义与陪审员决策之间的关系。在我们新颖的（预注册）实验中，我们在受试者之间改变合理怀疑的定义，并引出受试者定罪被告所需的证据水平。我们分析了在两种显著不同的州定义（威斯康星州和西弗吉尼亚州）下的陪审员决策，并分析了在未明确定义合理怀疑时的陪审员决策。我们发现每种处理中的行为相似。我们进行了三项额外处理，以确定为什么行为似乎不随定义而变化。我们的数据与受试者具有先入为主的合理怀疑观念且不受陪审团指示影响的观点一致。

records.title_en: Marx's concept of “exploitation” and the problem of measurement
records.title_cn: 马克思的“剥削”概念与测量问题
records.abstract_en: The paper scrutinizes Marx's proposal to measure the “degree of exploitation” in terms of the “rate of surplus value”. This amounts to defining an equivalent to the device of the thermometer in measuring temperature. The condition to be met is that a concept must be suggested that allows one to express the degree of exploitation in an independent manner and to show that the two move in parallel with one another. It is then shown that the rate of surplus value does not satisfy the sought criterion, because it may move in opposite direction of the degree of exploitation. This is demonstrated in terms of a simple numerical example with a choice of technique concerning the lengthening of the working day.
records.abstract_cn: 本文审视了马克思以“剩余价值率”来衡量“剥削程度”的提议。这相当于在测量温度时定义了一个与温度计装置等效的东西。需要满足的条件是，必须提出一个概念，使人们能够以独立的方式表达剥削程度，并表明两者是平行变动的。然后表明，剩余价值率不满足所寻求的标准，因为它可能与剥削程度的方向相反。这一点通过一个简单的数值例子来证明，其中涉及关于工作日延长的技术选择。

records.title_en: Joint vs. Individual performance in a dynamic choice problem
records.title_cn: 动态选择问题中的联合绩效与个体绩效
records.abstract_en: This paper compares the relative ability of individuals and pairs to solve a finite, stochastic lifecycle problem that requires borrowing and saving to achieve the rational benchmark. We find that pairs significantly outperform individuals, especially when allowing subjects to account for past mistakes along conditionally-optimal consumption paths. Joint decision-makers out-earn individuals by about 23%. Though pairs and individuals both overreact to income and wealth balances, these distortions are twice as large for individuals. Analyzing chat data reveals that pairs bargain to balance idiosyncratic consumption preferences, which reduces consumption errors. We estimate consumption heuristics at the observation level and study their dynamics. We show that about half our subjects (or pairs of subjects) stick to heuristics for the majority of the experiment. These ‘stable’ subjects significantly outperform their ‘unstable’ counterparts in the dynamic optimization task. Finally, we provide suggestive evidence that subjects who have a nuanced view of debt outperform subjects who think of debt as always bad, even after controlling for cognitive ability.
records.abstract_cn: 本文比较了个人和两人组合在解决一个有限的、随机的生命周期问题上的相对能力，该问题需要借贷和储蓄以达到理性基准。我们发现，两人组合的表现显著优于个人，尤其是在允许受试者沿着条件最优消费路径考虑过去错误的情况下。联合决策者的收入比个人高出约23%。尽管两人组合和个人都对收入和财富余额反应过度，但这些扭曲对个人来说是其两倍。分析聊天数据揭示，两人组合通过讨价还价来平衡异质性的消费偏好，这减少了消费错误。我们在观察层面估计消费启发式并研究其动态。我们表明，大约一半的受试者（或受试者组合）在实验的大部分时间内坚持启发式。这些“稳定”的受试者在动态优化任务中的表现显著优于其“不稳定”的对应者。最后，我们提供提示性证据表明，对债务有细致看法的受试者优于认为债务总是坏的受试者，即使在控制认知能力之后也是如此。

records.title_en: Compulsory class attendance versus autonomy
records.title_cn: 强制课堂出勤与自主权
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of an increased autonomy policy for higher-performing students on short- and longer-term school outcomes. We exploit an institutional setting with high demand for autonomy. Identification comes from a nationwide natural experiment that allowed higher-achieving students to miss 44 percent more classes with parental approval. Using a difference-in-difference-in-differences approach, we find that allowing higher-achieving students to skip more classes increases their performance in subjects that matter for university admission and improves the quality of their enrolled college degree. Top-performing students and students in more academically diverse classrooms demand more autonomy when it is offered.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了针对成绩较高学生的自主权增加政策对短期和长期学校成果的影响。我们利用了一个对自主权有高需求的制度环境。识别策略来自一项全国性的自然实验，该实验允许成绩较高的学生在获得家长同意的情况下缺课比例增加44%。使用三重差分法，我们发现允许成绩较高的学生跳过更多课程会提高他们在大学入学相关科目中的表现，并改善他们被录取大学学位的质量。表现最好的学生和学术多样性更强的课堂中的学生在提供自主权时要求更多自主权。

records.title_en: Drinking into friends: Alcohol drinking culture and CEO social connections
records.title_cn: 饮酒交友：酒文化与CEO社会关系
records.abstract_en: The impacts of a CEO's social connections to a firm have received much attention. However, less is known on between-CEOs differences in building connections. This paper is a step towards filling this gap by investigating whether CEOs social connections are influenced by China's local alcohol drinking culture. We use the sample of Chinese listed companies to test our hypotheses. We find that CEOs whose firms are located in regions with strong alcohol drinking culture have more social connections, both inside and outside the firms. We further find that the drinking culture only significantly affects the social connections of male CEOs, but not female CEOs. These findings remain robust after accounting for endogeneity by instrumental variable approach and matched sample analysis. Besides, we find CEO's inter-firm but not intra-firm social connections established from alcohol drinking can help firms acquire more trade credit.
records.abstract_cn: CEO的社会关系对公司的影响已受到广泛关注。然而，关于CEO之间在建立关系方面的差异知之甚少。本文通过调查CEO的社会关系是否受到中国当地饮酒文化的影响，向填补这一空白迈出了一步。我们使用中国上市公司样本检验我们的假设。我们发现，公司位于饮酒文化浓厚地区的CEO拥有更多的社会关系，无论是在公司内部还是外部。我们进一步发现，饮酒文化仅显著影响男性CEO的社会关系，而不影响女性CEO。在使用工具变量法和匹配样本分析处理内生性后，这些发现仍然稳健。此外，我们发现，CEO通过饮酒建立的跨公司而非公司内部的社会关系有助于公司获得更多的商业信用。

records.title_en: Personal safety first: Do workers value safer jobs?
records.title_cn: 人身安全第一：工人是否重视更安全的工作？
records.abstract_en: We elicit college students’ willingness to pay (WTP) for an early versus late job shift in an unsafe neighborhood. We find that concerns about late shift safety and gender are determinants of differences in WTP: Subjects with higher personal safety concerns (i.e., feeling unsafe on the way to or around work) and women forego more earnings to secure the early shift. Yet, we find no differences in WTP when the job is remote. Controlling for a wide range of confounders, such as risk preferences, morning preferences, time use, demographic characteristics, victimization, and information about crime, does not meaningfully affect the effect of safety concerns. Victimization and time use mediate the gender gap. Exploiting past administrative data, we find that subjects with higher WTP for the safer on-site shift are less likely to enroll in evening classes and leave campus earlier during the term, providing evidence for the external validity of our study.
records.abstract_cn: 我们调查了大学生在不安全社区中，对早班与晚班工作时间的支付意愿（WTP）。我们发现，对晚班安全的担忧和性别是WTP差异的决定因素：人身安全担忧较高（即在上班途中或工作地点周围感到不安全）的受试者和女性，会放弃更多收入以确保早班。然而，当工作是远程时，我们没有发现WTP的差异。控制广泛的混杂因素，如风险偏好、早晨偏好、时间使用、人口特征、受害经历和犯罪信息，并不会显著影响安全担忧的效果。受害经历和时间使用在性别差距中起中介作用。利用过去的行政数据，我们发现，对更安全的现场工作有更高WTP的受试者，在学期中更不可能注册晚间课程，并且更早离开校园，这为我们的研究提供了外部有效性的证据。

records.title_en: Economic insecurity, nativism, and the erosion of institutional trust
records.title_cn: 经济不安全感、本土主义与制度信任的侵蚀
records.abstract_en: We study markers of economic insecurity and nativism as factors explaining recent declines in institutional confidence. Taking microdata from 59 middle and upper-income nations, we show that hostility towards immigrants/immigration and a synthetic measure of economic insecurity are both significant predictors of individual-level institutional mistrust. Our parameter estimates are slightly larger and more robust for economic insecurity, and the results are stronger for developed, western countries (UK, USA, Australia, Canada) than in Asia or South America. The correlations appear for a wide variety of trust metrics and do not differ meaningfully between profit-driven and non-profit making institutions. In line with the concept of economic nationalism, we also find evidence of an ‘amplification’ effect, where individuals exposed to higher levels of economic insecurity are more responsive to nativist beliefs. The results have implications for policymakers looking to promote institutional confidence and social cohesion.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了经济不安全感和本土主义的标志，作为解释近期制度信心下降的因素。利用来自59个中高收入国家的微观数据，我们表明，对移民/移民的敌意以及经济不安全感的综合衡量指标都是个体层面制度不信任的显著预测因子。我们的参数估计在经济不安全感方面略大且更稳健，且结果在发达国家（英国、美国、澳大利亚、加拿大）比在亚洲或南美洲更强。这些相关性出现在各种信任指标中，并且在营利性和非营利性机构之间没有显著差异。与经济民族主义的概念一致，我们还发现了“放大”效应的证据，即面临更高水平经济不安全的个体对本土主义信念的反应更强烈。这些结果对寻求促进制度信心和社会凝聚力的政策制定者具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Does tertiary education expansion affect the fertility of women past the college-entry age?
records.title_cn: 高等教育扩张是否影响已过大学入学年龄女性的生育率？
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of tertiary education expansion on fertility outcomes of women past the usual college-entry age. We show that the tertiary education expansion in Taiwan led to a decrease in fertility for these mature women both with and without tertiary education, suggesting that the effect did not operate through education alone. Our findings also highlight two empirical concerns with previous studies: (i) the mis-classification of women past college-entry age as “unexposed” to the expansion in the difference-in-differences studies, and (ii) the potential violation of exclusion restriction when using the expansion as an instrument for female education in the instrumental variable studies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了高等教育扩张对已过通常大学入学年龄女性生育结果的影响。我们表明，台湾的高等教育扩张导致这些成熟女性（无论是否受过高等教育）的生育率下降，这表明该效应并非仅通过教育途径起作用。我们的发现还凸显了以往研究中的两个实证问题：（i）在双重差分研究中，将已过大学入学年龄的女性错误分类为“未暴露”于扩张；（ii）在工具变量研究中，使用扩张作为女性教育的工具时，可能违反排他性限制。

records.title_en: The green-MKS system: A baseline environmental macro-dynamic model
records.title_cn: 绿色MKS系统：一个基准的环境宏观动态模型
records.abstract_en: This paper extends the Marx-Keynes-Schumpeter model in Flaschel (2015) to study the social dimension of climate change. Agents are divided between those supporting and those opposing taxing Green House Gas (GHG) emissions. The composition of the population varies according to a continuous-time version of the discrete-choice approach. Conditional to the level of interaction between players, society chooses the respective carbon tax rate. Higher taxes reduce capital accumulation but support the development of energy-saving production techniques. Output growth and employment rates will be higher or lower depending on which effect prevails. Economic activity generates GHG emissions and determines the employment rate, which, in turn, endogenously feedback on environmental sentiments. Lower emissions reinforce sustainable attitudes, while falling employment increases households’ concerns with more “urgent” needs, decreasing support for taxation. Hence, the model is compatible with a positive relationship between environmental attitudes and energy efficiency but not a clear association with output. A sufficiently strong response of attitudes to emissions combined with a “sentiments-autonomous” carbon tax may lead to the disappearance of the equilibrium in which most agents oppose regulation, controlling for multi-stability. Our 3-dimensional system admits endogenous persistent and bounded fluctuations, where the interaction between green attitudes and the macro-economy appears as a novel source of growth-cycle dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 本文扩展了Flaschel（2015）中的马克思-凯恩斯-熊彼特模型，以研究气候变化的社会维度。代理人被分为支持征收温室气体（GHG）排放税和反对征收该税的群体。人口构成根据离散选择方法的连续时间版本而变化。根据参与者之间的互动水平，社会选择相应的碳税率。较高的税收减少资本积累，但支持节能生产技术的发展。产出增长和就业率将根据哪种效应占主导而更高或更低。经济活动产生温室气体排放并决定就业率，这反过来又内生地反馈到环境情绪上。较低的排放强化可持续态度，而就业下降则增加家庭对更“紧迫”需求的关注，减少对税收的支持。因此，该模型与环境态度和能源效率之间的正相关关系相容，但与产出的关联并不明确。态度对排放的响应足够强，加上“情绪自主”的碳税，可能导致大多数代理人反对监管的均衡消失，控制多重稳定性。我们的3维系统允许内生持久且有界的波动，其中绿色态度与宏观经济之间的互动作为增长-周期动态的新来源出现。

records.title_en: On social norms and observability in (dis)honest behavior
records.title_cn: 关于社会规范与（不）诚实行为中的可观察性
records.abstract_en: Transparency and observability have been shown to foster ethical decision-making as people tend to comply with an underlying norm for honesty. However, in situations implying a social norm for dishonesty, this might be different. In a die-rolling experiment, we investigate whether observability can also have detrimental effects. We thus introduce a norm nudge toward honesty or dishonesty and make participants’ decisions observable and open to the judgement of other participants in order to manipulate the observability of people’s decisions as well as the underlying social norm. We find that a nudge toward honesty indeed increases the level of honesty, suggesting that such a norm nudge can successfully induce behavioral change. Our introduction of social image concerns via observability, however, does not affect honesty and does not interact with our norm nudge.
records.abstract_cn: 透明度和可观察性已被证明能促进道德决策，因为人们倾向于遵守潜在的诚实规范。然而，在涉及不诚实的社会规范的情况下，情况可能有所不同。在掷骰子实验中，我们调查可观察性是否也可能产生不利影响。因此，我们引入了朝向诚实或不诚实的规范助推，并让参与者的决策可被观察且对其他参与者的评判开放，以操纵人们决策的可观察性以及潜在的社会规范。我们发现，朝向诚实的助推确实提高了诚实水平，表明这种规范助推能成功诱导行为改变。然而，我们通过可观察性引入的社会形象关注并不影响诚实，也不与我们的规范助推相互作用。

records.title_en: Costly verification and commitment in persuasion
records.title_cn: 说服中的昂贵验证与承诺
records.abstract_en: Misrepresentation of information is ubiquitous in communication, while verification is often costly. This paper studies the role of verification in persuasion and its interaction with commitment in a Bayesian persuasion framework in which the sender is not fully bound by the committed plan. Both theoretically and experimentally, we demonstrate that making verification easier can significantly improve information transmission when commitment is low, but its effect is limited when commitment is high. However, empirically receivers do not respond to commitment as strongly as predicted by theory, which is consistent with base-rate neglect and conservatism. On the other hand, senders generally anticipate receivers’ actions and best respond to the empirical behavior of receivers. Verification is instrumental in improving information transmission when the cost is not high, and commitment is low.
records.abstract_cn: 信息误传在沟通中普遍存在，而验证往往代价高昂。本文在发送者不完全受承诺计划约束的贝叶斯说服框架中，研究了验证在说服中的作用及其与承诺的互动。理论和实验均表明，当承诺程度低时，使验证更容易能显著改善信息传递，但当承诺程度高时，其效果有限。然而，实证中接收者对承诺的反应不如理论预测的强烈，这与基准率忽视和保守主义一致。另一方面，发送者通常能预见接收者的行为，并对接收者的经验行为做出最佳反应。当验证成本不高且承诺程度低时，验证在改善信息传递方面具有重要作用。

records.title_en: Under pressure? Performance evaluation of police officers as an incentive to cheat
records.title_cn: 压力之下？警察绩效考核作为作弊激励
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the use of high-powered performance-based incentives for civil servants, focusing on drug-related cases registered by the Russian police. Using an event study approach and bunching analysis, I show that the incentives arising from the performance evaluation system of police officers can significantly influence their behavior. Specifically, I find evidence suggesting that this impact can result in the manipulation of drug quantities seized by the police, moving offenders from below to above the punishment threshold. Further negative consequences of the strong performance-based incentives are inequality in the enforcement of law, prolonged sentences, and increased probability of pretrial detention. Thus, I determine that police officers are more likely to manipulate the drug quantities seized from men. I also find that the manipulation increases the probability of pretrial detention by 9% and adds one more year of incarceration, which is a 67% increase on the average sentence length without manipulation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了公务员高强度绩效激励的使用，重点关注俄罗斯警方登记的毒品相关案件。通过事件研究法和聚束分析，我表明警察绩效考核体系产生的激励可以显著影响其行为。具体而言，我发现的证据表明，这种影响可能导致警方查获毒品数量的操纵，使罪犯从处罚门槛以下移至以上。高强度绩效激励的进一步负面后果包括执法不平等、刑期延长以及审前拘留概率增加。因此，我确定警察更可能操纵从男性身上查获的毒品数量。我还发现，这种操纵使审前拘留概率增加9%，并增加了一年的监禁，这相对于无操纵的平均刑期增加了67%。

records.title_en: The Innovative choice as an out-of-equilibrium process: Towards an adaptive (or sequence) approach
records.title_cn: 作为非均衡过程的创新选择：走向适应性（或序列）方法
records.abstract_en: As Richard Day pointed out, an evolutionary approach focuses on the characterization of the way economies function when they work out of equilibrium and represents their capacity to change structure. Our paper aims at providing the basis of the analysis of qualitative change as learning process whose evolution is not predetermined but depends on what happens along the way, that is, on the recurrent distortions in the time structure of productive capacity due to co-ordination failures. Qualitative change is a change that implies a structural modification, which can only be brought about through a process in real, irreversible time. Physical, human, and financial capital are complementary in this process of reshaping and may constrain each other. Viability of the disequilibrium process depends then on the interaction between behaviors and policies.
records.abstract_cn: 正如理查德·戴所指出的，演化方法侧重于刻画经济体在非均衡状态下运行的方式，并体现其改变结构的能力。本文旨在为定性变化分析提供基础，将其视为一个学习过程，其演化并非预先决定，而是取决于过程中的事件，即由于协调失败导致的生产能力时间结构的反复扭曲。定性变化是一种意味着结构修改的变化，只能通过真实、不可逆的时间过程来实现。在这一重塑过程中，物质资本、人力资本和金融资本是互补的，并可能相互制约。非均衡过程的可行性因此取决于行为与政策之间的相互作用。

records.title_en: Growth-induced crises and transitions in the governance of firm organizations
records.title_cn: 企业组织治理中的增长引发的危机与转型
records.abstract_en: This paper discusses why organizational growth can cause crises in the governance of firms, how such crises typically unfold, and what options for responding they leave for management. More specifically, focus is on growth-induced changes in how the governance of an organization coordinates its members on, and motivate them to contribute to, the pursuit of the common purpose. As outlined by means of two distinct examples, governance approaches differ with respect to the solution of coordination and motivation problems. Nonetheless, when the organization size grows, adaptations in the firm members’ cognitive and motivational attitudes occur and tend to similarly undermine the governance of the organization. As a consequence, confusion, frictions, and internal rivalries increase and work effort declines. The unfolding of such crises is shown to be a case of a self-organizing criticality, a unique feature of nonlinear dynamics. Once the crisis has emerged, the cognitive and motivational conditions characterizing the outmoded governance approach constrain the options for making a transition to one that is better suited for the growing number of employees. Failure to accomplish such a transition results in any case in a state of muddling through with an outmoded governance approach that jeopardizes profitability and, in the longer run, the existence of the firm.
records.abstract_cn: 本文讨论了为什么组织增长会导致企业治理危机，这类危机通常如何展开，以及它们为管理层留下了哪些应对选择。更具体地说，关注的是增长引发的组织治理方式变化，即如何协调成员并激励他们为共同目标做出贡献。通过两个不同的例子概述，治理方法在解决协调和激励问题方面有所不同。然而，当组织规模增长时，企业成员的认知和动机态度会发生适应，并倾向于同样削弱组织的治理。结果，混乱、摩擦和内部竞争加剧，工作努力下降。这类危机的展开被证明是自组织临界性的一个案例，这是非线性动力学的一个独特特征。一旦危机出现，过时治理方法所特有的认知和动机条件限制了向更适合不断增长的员工数量的治理方法过渡的选择。未能完成这种过渡在任何情况下都会导致以过时的治理方法陷入泥潭，危及盈利能力，并在长期内危及企业的生存。

records.title_en: Delay the Pension Age or Adjust the Pension Benefit? Implications for Labor Supply and Individual Welfare in China
records.title_cn: 延迟退休年龄还是调整养老金待遇？对中国劳动力供给和个人福利的影响
records.abstract_en: We develop and calibrate a life-cycle model of labor supply and consumption to quantify the implications of alternative pension reforms on labor supply, individual welfare, and government budget for Chinas basic old-age insurance program. We distinguish low-skilled and high-skilled individuals, who differ in their preferences, health and labor income dynamics, and medical expense processes. We use the calibrated model to evaluate three potential pension reforms: (i) increasing the pension eligibility age from 60 to 65, but keeping the current pension benefit formula unchanged; (ii) keeping the pension eligibility age at 60, but proportionally lowering pension benefits so that the pension program’s budget is the same as under Reform (i); and (iii) increasing the pension eligibility age to 65 and simultaneously increasing the pension benefits so that individuals of both skill types attain the same individual welfare levels as in the status quo. We find that relative to the baseline, both Reforms (i) and (ii) can substantially improve the budgets of the pension system, but at the cost of substantial individual welfare loss for both skill types. In contrast, we find that Reform (iii) can modestly improve the budget of the pension system while ensuring that both skill types are as well off as in the status quo. We find that Reforms (i) and (ii) slightly increase, but Reform (iii) slightly decreases, the overall labor supply.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发并校准了一个劳动力供给和消费的生命周期模型，以量化替代性养老金改革对中国基本养老保险计划中劳动力供给、个人福利和政府预算的影响。我们区分了低技能和高技能个体，他们在偏好、健康和劳动收入动态以及医疗支出过程方面存在差异。我们使用校准模型评估三种潜在的养老金改革：（i）将养老金领取资格年龄从60岁提高到65岁，但保持现行养老金待遇公式不变；（ii）将养老金领取资格年龄保持在60岁，但按比例降低养老金待遇，使养老金计划的预算与改革（i）下的预算相同；（iii）将养老金领取资格年龄提高到65岁，同时增加养老金待遇，使两种技能类型的个体都达到与现状相同的个人福利水平。我们发现，相对于基准情况，改革（i）和（ii）都能显著改善养老金体系的预算，但以两种技能类型个体的大量福利损失为代价。相比之下，我们发现改革（iii）可以适度改善养老金体系的预算，同时确保两种技能类型的福利水平与现状相同。我们发现改革（i）和（ii）略微增加了总体劳动力供给，而改革（iii）略微减少了总体劳动力供给。

records.title_en: Central bank communication and website characteristics
records.title_cn: 中央银行沟通与网站特征
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the characteristics of central bank websites across a large sample of central banks. We systematically derive and quantify these characteristics across three dimensions: text, visual presentation, and website performance. We then conduct a survey to isolate the main determinants of user experience. We find that websites with higher visual complexity and lower visual contrast are perceived as more clear and credible. We build a set of time series metrics based on historical website data to capture the evolution of central bank websites with respect to clarity, attractiveness, ease of navigation, and credibility.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了大量中央银行样本中中央银行网站的特征。我们系统地推导并量化了这些特征在三个维度上的表现：文本、视觉呈现和网站性能。随后，我们进行了一项调查，以隔离用户体验的主要决定因素。我们发现，视觉复杂度较高且视觉对比度较低的网站被认为更清晰、更可信。我们基于历史网站数据构建了一套时间序列指标，以捕捉中央银行网站在清晰度、吸引力、导航便捷性和可信度方面的演变。

records.title_en: What we tweet about when we tweet about taxes: A topic modelling approach
records.title_cn: 当我们谈论税收时我们在推特上谈论什么：一种主题建模方法
records.abstract_en: Recent literature on taxation suggests that a “service and client” approach by the authorities is required in order to establish a synergistic tax climate between taxpayers and tax offices and thus enhance voluntary tax compliance. The present study investigates whether lay people's conceptions about taxation reflect such a synergistic (vs. an antagonistic) climate. Applying an unsupervised machine learning approach (i.e., topic modeling) to over a million tax related tweets from 2010 to 2020, we identified 30 topics with different content. Using the theoretical framework differentiating between synergistic and antagonistic tax climate, we were able to further categorize these topics into four broader groups: 1. Opinions about Tax Politics, 2. Enforcement (antagonistic climate), 3. Information & Service (synergistic climate), and 4. Emotions. The most frequently observed group was Information & Service (synergistic climate), which also steadily gained prominence during the past decade. We proceeded by analyzing the information diffusion properties and sentiment of the tweets associated with the four groups. Information & Service tweets had the most positive sentiment but were shared the least, while tweets regarding Opinions about Tax Politics were shared most often. In sum, the results suggest that lay people's conceptions about taxation – as discerned from conversations on social media (Twitter) – largely reflect a synergistic (vs. an antagonistic) climate, and contribute to the literature on tax climate and social media.
records.abstract_cn: 近期关于税收的文献表明，税务机关需要采取“服务与客户”的方法，以在纳税人与税务机关之间建立协同的税收氛围，从而增强自愿税收遵从。本研究调查了外行人对税收的观念是否反映了这种协同（相对于对抗）氛围。应用无监督机器学习方法（即主题建模）对2010年至2020年间超过一百万条与税收相关的推文进行分析，我们识别出30个不同内容的主题。利用区分协同与对抗税收氛围的理论框架，我们进一步将这些主题归类为四个更广泛的组别：1. 关于税收政治的观点，2. 执法（对抗氛围），3. 信息与服务（协同氛围），以及4. 情绪。最常观察到的组别是信息与服务（协同氛围），并且在过去十年中其重要性稳步上升。我们接着分析了与这四个组别相关的推文的信息扩散特性和情感。信息与服务的推文情感最为积极，但分享最少，而关于税收政治观点的推文分享最多。总之，结果表明，外行人对税收的观念——从社交媒体（推特）上的对话中可以看出——在很大程度上反映了协同（相对于对抗）氛围，并为税收氛围和社交媒体的文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: Overexertion of Effort under Working Time Autonomy and Feedback Provision
records.title_cn: 工作时间自主性与反馈提供下的过度努力
records.abstract_en: Working time autonomy is often accompanied by output-based incentives to counterbalance the loss of monitoring that comes with granting autonomy. However, in such settings, overprovision of effort could arise if workers are uncertain whether their performance suffices to secure the output-based rewards. Performance feedback can reduce or eliminate such uncertainty. We demonstrate in a laboratory experiment that a precautionary effort motive can lead to overprovision of costly effort in work environments with working time autonomy in the absence of feedback. A key feature of our design is that it allows for a clean measurement of effort overprovision by keeping performance per unit of time fixed, which we achieve by calibrating subjects’ productivity on a real effort task ex ante. This novel design can serve as a workhorse for various experiments as it allows for exogenous variation of performance certainty (i.e., by providing feedback), working time autonomy, productivity, effort costs, and the general incentive structure. We find that subjects provide significantly more costly effort beyond a level necessary to meet their performance targets in the presence of uncertainty, i.e., the absence of feedback, which suggests that feedback shields workers from overprovision of costly effort.
records.abstract_cn: 工作时间自主性通常伴随着基于产出的激励，以抵消因授予自主权而带来的监督损失。然而，在这种情境下，如果工人不确定其绩效是否足以确保获得基于产出的奖励，就可能出现过度提供努力的情况。绩效反馈可以减少或消除这种不确定性。我们在实验室实验中证明，在没有反馈的工作时间自主性工作环境中，预防性努力动机可能导致过度提供昂贵努力。我们设计的一个关键特征是，通过事先校准受试者在真实努力任务上的生产率，保持单位时间绩效固定，从而能够干净地测量过度努力。这种新颖的设计可以作为各种实验的工作母机，因为它允许对绩效确定性（即通过提供反馈）、工作时间自主性、生产率、努力成本和一般激励结构进行外生变化。我们发现，在存在不确定性（即缺乏反馈）的情况下，受试者提供的昂贵努力显著超过达到其绩效目标所需的水平，这表明反馈保护工人免受过度提供昂贵努力的影响。

records.title_en: Conformity and adaptation in groups
records.title_cn: 群体中的从众与适应
records.abstract_en: Empirical and experimental evidence suggests that individual behavior in group interactions is affected by perceived norms of behavior within the group. We design an experiment to test this hypothesis. We find that (a) when agents interact within a group, the initial diverse behaviors converge to the group average and individuals cluster more tightly around this benchmark as they learn the average, (b) actions further from this benchmark in a self-serving direction are less acceptable by others, and (c) when an agent is moved to a group with a different benchmark, s/he conforms quickly to the new benchmark.
records.abstract_cn: 实证和实验证据表明，群体互动中个体行为受到群体内感知行为规范的影响。我们设计了一个实验来检验这一假设。我们发现：（a）当个体在群体内互动时，初始的多样化行为趋同于群体平均值，并且随着个体了解平均值，他们更紧密地聚集在该基准周围；（b）在利己方向上偏离该基准更远的行动更不被他人接受；（c）当个体被转移到具有不同基准的群体时，他/她会迅速适应新基准。

records.title_en: Money supply, opinion dispersion, and stock prices
records.title_cn: 货币供应、意见分歧与股票价格
records.abstract_en: This study develops a simple model that shows how money matters in the determination of stock prices. When investors have different opinions on the stock's value and face market frictions, the money supply in an economy influences the demand for stocks and hence positively affects stock prices. Unlike the discounted-cash-flow model, the present model indicates that stock prices routinely depart from the fundamentals; overpricing or underpricing occurs depending on the amount of money in the economy. The results of the model suggest that stock prices fluctuate because of money supply changes and that monetary policy may cause a disconnect between the stock market and the real economy.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究构建了一个简单模型，用以说明货币在股票价格决定中的作用。当投资者对股票价值持有不同意见并面临市场摩擦时，经济中的货币供应会影响对股票的需求，从而对股票价格产生正向影响。与贴现现金流模型不同，本模型表明股票价格经常偏离基本面；高估或低估取决于经济中的货币量。模型结果表明，股票价格因货币供应变化而波动，货币政策可能导致股票市场与实体经济脱节。

records.title_en: Pumps, prosperity and household power: Experimental evidence on irrigation pumps and smallholder farmers in Kenya
records.title_cn: 水泵、繁荣与家庭权力：肯尼亚灌溉水泵与小农户的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Irrigation is a potentially effective technology to improve agricultural incomes in Sub-Saharan Africa, and hand powered irrigation pumps have received significant interest and investment as a solution appropriate to small-scale farmers in this context. This paper describes the results of an RCT impact evaluation of household irrigation pumps in Kenya, where we randomly allocated free pumps to the female head of household via public lotteries. After two years farmers are still making significant use of their pumps and allocating increased time to irrigated agriculture. We find that pumps increase net farm revenue by approximately 13% of the control mean, and pay for themselves within three years. In addition, we find that farmers with irrigation pumps spent less time on off-farm economic activity. Finally, we find that female decisionmaking power increased and domestic violence decreased among treatment households.
records.abstract_cn: 灌溉是撒哈拉以南非洲提高农业收入的一种潜在有效技术，而手动灌溉水泵作为一种适合该地区小规模农户的解决方案，已受到广泛关注和投资。本文描述了一项在肯尼亚进行的家庭灌溉水泵随机对照试验影响评估的结果，我们通过公开抽签将免费水泵随机分配给女性户主。两年后，农民仍在使用水泵，并将更多时间用于灌溉农业。我们发现，水泵使净农场收入相对于对照组均值增加了约13%，并在三年内收回成本。此外，我们发现拥有灌溉水泵的农民减少了非农经济活动的时间。最后，我们发现处理组家庭的女性决策权增强，家庭暴力减少。

records.title_en: Grandmothers and the gender gap in the Mexican labor market
records.title_cn: 祖母与墨西哥劳动力市场中的性别差距
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the effect of childcare availability on parents’ employment probability using the timing of the grandmothers’ death – the primary childcare provider in Mexico – as identifying variation. I use a triple-difference to disentangle the effect of coinhabiting grandmothers’ deaths due to their impact on childcare from their effects due to alternative mechanisms. Through their impact on childcare availability, grandmothers’ deaths reduce mothers’ employment rate by 12 percentage points (27 percent) and do not affect fathers’ employment rate. The negative effect on mothers’ employment is smaller where public daycare is more available, or private daycare or schools are more affordable.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用祖母去世的时间——墨西哥主要的儿童照护提供者——作为识别变异，估计了儿童照护可及性对父母就业概率的影响。我使用三重差分法来区分共同居住祖母去世因影响儿童照护而产生的影响与因其他机制而产生的影响。通过其对儿童照护可及性的影响，祖母去世使母亲的就业率降低了12个百分点（27%），且不影响父亲的就业率。在公共日托更可及，或私人日托或学校更负担得起的地区，对母亲就业的负面影响较小。

records.title_en: Exposure to collective gender-based violence causes intimate partner violence
records.title_cn: 集体性别暴力的暴露导致亲密伴侣暴力
records.abstract_en: Globally, one in three women experience intimate partner violence (IPV) over their lifetimes. Yet, the factors that cause men to commit IPV remain poorly understood. We propose and test a causal long-term link from past exposure to gender-based collective violence to violent behavior against an intimate partner. Combining novel survey data from Angolan war veteran families and a natural experiment, we find that exposure to sexual violence by armed groups against women makes male veterans about 30 percentage points more likely to commit physical – but not sexual – violence against a female intimate partner 18 years later (on average). Our results are not consistent with standard explanations of IPV based on group norms and intra-household bargaining. Instead, we attribute the effect to a lasting reduction in self-control skills. These findings challenge standard approaches to preventing IPV and emphasize the potential of working with men, especially after war-time episodes of collective violence.
records.abstract_cn: 全球范围内，三分之一的女性一生中经历过亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）。然而，导致男性实施IPV的因素仍知之甚少。我们提出并检验了从过去暴露于基于性别的集体暴力到对亲密伴侣的暴力行为之间的因果长期联系。结合来自安哥拉退伍军人家庭的新调查数据和一项自然实验，我们发现，武装团体对女性实施性暴力的暴露使男性退伍军人在平均18年后对女性亲密伴侣实施身体暴力（而非性暴力）的可能性增加约30个百分点。我们的结果与基于群体规范和家庭内部议价的IPV标准解释不一致。相反，我们将这种效应归因于自我控制技能的持久下降。这些发现挑战了预防IPV的标准方法，并强调了与男性合作，特别是在战争时期集体暴力事件后，的潜在价值。

records.title_en: Impact of self- or social-regarding health messages: Experimental evidence based on antibiotics purchases
records.title_cn: 自我或社会导向健康信息的影响：基于抗生素购买的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We study two interventions in Beijing, China, that provide patients with information on antibiotic resistance via text message to discourage the overuse of antibiotics. The messages were sent once a month for five months. One intervention emphasizes the threat to the recipient's own health and is found to have negligible effects. The other intervention, which highlights the overall threat to society, reduces antibiotics purchases by 17% in dosage without discouraging healthcare visits and other medicine purchases. The results demonstrate that prosocial messaging can have the potential to address public health issues that require collective action.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国北京的两项干预措施，通过短信向患者提供抗生素耐药性信息，以阻止抗生素的过度使用。这些信息每月发送一次，持续五个月。一项干预措施强调对接收者自身健康的威胁，发现其效果可忽略不计。另一项干预措施强调对整个社会的威胁，使抗生素购买剂量减少了17%，且未阻碍就医和其他药品购买。结果表明，亲社会信息有可能解决需要集体行动的公共卫生问题。

records.title_en: Poverty and perseverance: The detrimental effect of poverty on effort provision
records.title_cn: 贫困与毅力：贫困对努力供给的不利影响
records.abstract_en: Perseverance, known as provision and continuation of effort, is a decisive factor in the accomplishment of all goals. Poverty, however, can impair this crucial skill. In this paper, I analyze the causal effect of poverty on perseverance in an education context with adolescents in Iran. Using a difference-in-differences design to manipulate perceptions of own scarcities and deprivations, I measure adolescents’ perseverance while they complete a real-effort task. Results reveal a large and significant negative effect of poverty on perseverance, and consequently, performance. Participants from economically disadvantaged backgrounds exert 25% less effort than those from affluent backgrounds. This study suggests that poverty is one of the possible underlying causes to impair perseverance demonstration in effort-demanding situations.
records.abstract_cn: 毅力，即努力的提供与持续，是达成所有目标的关键因素。然而，贫困可能损害这一关键技能。在本文中，我分析了在伊朗青少年教育背景下贫困对毅力的因果效应。采用双重差分设计来操纵对自身匮乏和剥夺的感知，我在他们完成一项真实努力任务时测量青少年的毅力。结果显示，贫困对毅力有显著且较大的负面影响，并进而影响表现。来自经济不利背景的参与者比来自富裕背景的参与者少付出25%的努力。这项研究表明，贫困是损害在要求努力的情境中展现毅力的潜在原因之一。

records.title_en: Empowering women or increasing response bias? Experimental evidence from Congo
records.title_cn: 赋权女性还是增加回答偏差？来自刚果的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Women’s empowerment interventions are an important component of many development programs; surveys are a popular tool to measure how such programs affect gender-related attitudes. We consider how differences in gender response bias between the treatment and control groups complicate the use of attitudinal questions to evaluate women’s empowerment interventions. We examine data from two experiments: a randomized development program aimed to empower women in 1,250 Congolese villages and a follow-up survey experiment. After demonstrating strong response biases in gender-related questions as a function of interviewer gender, we show that these biases vary as a function of program treatment status. These findings mean that the estimated average treatment effects of women’s empowerment programs are sensitive to both the gender composition of the respondent sample as well as the interviewer pool. We conclude with lessons for survey implementation and pre-analysis plans.
records.abstract_cn: 女性赋权干预是许多发展项目的重要组成部分；调查是衡量此类项目如何影响性别相关态度的常用工具。我们考虑了治疗组和对照组之间性别回答偏差的差异如何使态度问题在评估女性赋权干预时变得复杂。我们检验了两项实验的数据：一项旨在赋权刚果1,250个村庄女性的随机发展项目，以及一项后续调查实验。在证明了性别相关问题中作为访问员性别函数的强烈回答偏差后，我们表明这些偏差随项目治疗状态而变化。这些发现意味着女性赋权项目的估计平均治疗效果对受访者样本的性别构成以及访问员群体都很敏感。最后，我们总结了调查实施和预分析计划的经验教训。

records.title_en: Assessors influence results: Evidence on enumerator effects and educational impact evaluations
records.title_cn: 评估员影响结果：关于访员效应和教育影响评估的证据
records.abstract_en: A significant share of education research uses data collected by “enumerators.” It is well-documented that “enumerator effects”—or inconsistent practices among the people who administer measurement tools—can be a key source of error in survey data collection. However, it is less understood whether this is a problem for academic assessments. We leverage a remote phone-based mathematics assessment of primary school students and survey of their parents in Kenya. Enumerators, who were teachers in our partner's network, were randomized to students to study the presence of enumerator effects. We find that both the academic assessment and survey were prone to enumerator effects and use simulation to show that these effects were large enough to lead to spurious results at a troubling rate in impact evaluations. We therefore recommend assessment administrators randomize enumerators at the student level, orthogonal to categories being compared (e.g., treatment/control groups), and train enumerators to minimize bias.
records.abstract_cn: 相当大比例的教育研究使用由“访员”收集的数据。已有充分文献记载，“访员效应”——即管理测量工具的人员之间不一致的做法——可能是调查数据收集中的一个关键误差来源。然而，对于学术评估而言，这是否是一个问题，目前了解较少。我们利用了一项针对肯尼亚小学生的远程电话数学评估及其家长的调查。访员是我们合作伙伴网络中的教师，他们被随机分配到学生中，以研究访员效应的存在。我们发现，学术评估和调查都容易受到访员效应的影响，并通过模拟表明，这些效应足够大，以至于在影响评估中以令人担忧的频率导致虚假结果。因此，我们建议评估管理者在学生层面随机分配访员，使其与所比较的类别（例如，治疗组/对照组）正交，并培训访员以尽量减少偏差。

records.title_en: Federal and state audits do not increase compliance with a grant program to improve municipal infrastructure: A pre-registered field experiment
records.title_cn: 联邦和州审计并未提高改善市政基础设施拨款项目的合规性：一项预注册的实地实验
records.abstract_en: Government audits usually have a broad mandate to monitor compliance with program rules. We conducted a field experiment in collaboration with Mexico’s Superior Auditor of the Federation to investigate if federal or state audits increase municipal compliance with the allocation, reporting, and transparency rules of an intergovernmental grant to improve local infrastructure. We randomly assigned 85 municipalities to be audited by a federal auditor, a state one, or a control group. We find that audits do not increase compliance and examine the reasons behind this null effect. Drawing from audit reports and a survey of municipal administrators, we show that, even though audits produced verifiable information and increased expectations of future audits, their effect on administrators’ perceived career prospects was limited. We conclude with a discussion of the policy implications of our results.
records.abstract_cn: 政府审计通常具有广泛的职责，以监督项目规则的合规性。我们与墨西哥联邦最高审计机关合作进行了一项实地实验，以调查联邦或州审计是否提高了市政当局在分配、报告和透明度规则方面的合规性，这些规则涉及一项旨在改善地方基础设施的政府间拨款。我们随机分配了85个市政当局，由联邦审计员、州审计员或对照组进行审计。我们发现审计并未提高合规性，并考察了这一无效效应背后的原因。根据审计报告和对市政管理人员的调查，我们表明，尽管审计产生了可验证的信息并增加了对未来审计的预期，但它们对管理人员感知的职业前景的影响有限。最后，我们讨论了我们的结果对政策的影响。

records.title_en: Measuring time use in rural India: Design and validation of a low-cost survey module
records.title_cn: 衡量印度农村的时间使用：低成本调查模块的设计与验证
records.abstract_en: Time use data facilitate understanding of labor supply, especially for women who often undertake unpaid care and home production. Although assisted diary-based time use surveys are suitable for low-literacy populations, they are costly and rarely used. We create a low-cost, scalable alternative that captures contextually-determined broad time categories; here, allocations across market work, household labor, and leisure. Using fewer categories and larger time intervals takes 33% less time than traditional modules. Field experiments show the module measures average time across the broader categories as well as the traditional approach, particularly for our target female population. The module can also capture multitasking for a specific category of interest. Its shortcomings are short duration activity capture and the need for careful category selection. The module’s brevity and low cost make it a viable method to use in household and labor force surveys, facilitating tracking of work and leisure patterns as economies develop.
records.abstract_cn: 时间使用数据有助于理解劳动力供给，尤其是对于经常从事无偿照料和家庭生产的女性。尽管基于辅助日记的时间使用调查适用于低识字率人群，但成本高昂且很少使用。我们创建了一种低成本、可扩展的替代方案，捕捉由情境决定的宽泛时间类别；此处为市场工作、家务劳动和休闲之间的分配。使用更少的类别和更大的时间间隔比传统模块节省33%的时间。实地实验表明，该模块在衡量更广泛类别的平均时间方面与传统方法相当，尤其是针对我们的目标女性群体。该模块还能捕捉特定兴趣类别的多任务处理。其缺点在于短时活动的捕捉以及对类别选择的谨慎要求。该模块的简洁性和低成本使其成为家庭和劳动力调查中可行的方法，有助于随着经济发展追踪工作和休闲模式。

records.title_en: Public governance versus corporate governance: Evidence from oil drilling in forests
records.title_cn: 公共治理与企业治理：来自森林石油钻探的证据
records.abstract_en: Petroleum companies look for oil and gas in some of the most remote and biodiverse forested areas on the planet. To study how local environmental footprints vary across countries and companies, we combine global company-level geo-coded data on oil drilling with high resolution data on forest loss. We find that oil wells drilled in countries with better public governance, measured by democracy scores, are associated with substantially lower forest loss in the period after drilling. In contrast, we do not find evidence of less forest clearance among companies with presumptively ‘better’ corporate governance practices, such as major international companies, publicly listed companies, or members of an industry association committed to high environmental standards. These results do not support a “pollution halo” effect, whereby companies might bring better environmental practices with them, exceeding domestic environmental standards.
records.abstract_cn: 石油公司在全球一些最偏远、生物多样性最丰富的森林地区寻找石油和天然气。为了研究不同国家和公司的当地环境足迹如何变化，我们将全球公司层面的石油钻探地理编码数据与高分辨率的森林损失数据相结合。我们发现，在公共治理更好（以民主得分衡量）的国家钻探的油井，在钻探后的时期内与显著较低的森林损失相关。相比之下，我们没有发现证据表明，那些被假定具有“更好”企业治理实践的公司（如大型国际公司、上市公司或承诺高环境标准的行业协会成员）会减少森林砍伐。这些结果不支持“污染光环”效应，即公司可能带来更好的环境实践，超过国内环境标准。

records.title_en: Impersonal trust in a Just and Unjust world: Evidence from an educational intervention
records.title_cn: 公正与不公正世界中的非个人信任：来自教育干预的证据
records.abstract_en: We provide causal evidence on how impersonal trust and reciprocity create prosperity and shape its distribution. For this, we leverage a large-scale randomized educational intervention that boosts trust and reciprocity in children. We show that in a world where individuals trust anonymous others, prosperity grows but so does inequality. While impersonal trust unambiguously creates wealth, redistribution is needed to tame the inequality it brings. Our results suggest that harnessing prosocial psychology through educational actions may pave the way for a prosperous and just society. However, for these actions to ultimately achieve this end, they should be pervasive and universally accessible.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于非个人信任和互惠如何创造繁荣并塑造其分配结果的因果证据。为此，我们利用了一项大规模随机教育干预，该干预增强了儿童的信任和互惠。我们表明，在一个个体信任匿名他人的世界中，繁荣增长，但不平等也随之加剧。虽然非个人信任明确地创造财富，但需要再分配来抑制其带来的不平等。我们的结果表明，通过教育行动利用亲社会心理可能为繁荣公正的社会铺平道路。然而，要使这些行动最终实现这一目标，它们应当是普遍且可及的。

records.title_en: Learning by searching: Spatial mismatches and imperfect information in Southern labor markets
records.title_cn: 边寻边学：南方劳动力市场中的空间错配与信息不完全
records.abstract_en: Youth unemployment remains extremely high throughout the developing world, at times coexisting with unmet demand for labour and high job turnover. We examine one possible explanation for this: spatial mismatches between jobs and job-seekers combined with high search costs can lead young job-seekers to have overly optimistic beliefs about their employment prospects. As a result, job-seekers under-search but also hold out for better jobs. Through a field experiment we find that reducing search costs through transport subsidies leads job-seekers to search more intensively and to adjust their beliefs in line with their search experience. When jobs fail to materialize immediately, job-seekers who believed that dropping CVs at prospective employers in the city centre was an effective search strategy become more impatient, they lower their reservation wage and they settle for low-paying jobs closer to home. This does not increase their likelihood of being employed, since nearby jobs are also scarce. These findings underscore both the importance and the complexity of the interaction between search costs and beliefs, and how they can lead to spatial and occupational mistargeting in the job search.
records.abstract_cn: 在整个发展中世界，青年失业率仍然极高，有时与劳动力需求未得到满足和高工作流动率并存。我们考察了对此的一种可能解释：工作与求职者之间的空间错配加上高搜索成本，可能导致年轻求职者对其就业前景持有过于乐观的信念。结果，求职者搜索不足，但也坚持等待更好的工作。通过一项实地实验，我们发现通过交通补贴降低搜索成本会使求职者更密集地搜索，并根据其搜索经验调整信念。当工作未能立即实现时，那些认为在市中心潜在雇主处投递简历是有效搜索策略的求职者会变得更加不耐烦，他们降低保留工资，并接受离家更近的低薪工作。这并未增加他们就业的可能性，因为附近的工作也很稀缺。这些发现强调了搜索成本与信念之间相互作用的重要性和复杂性，以及它们如何导致求职中的空间和职业错配。

records.title_en: Circle of fortune: The long-term impact of Western customs institution in China
records.title_cn: 命运之环：西方海关制度在中国的长期影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the long-run effect of the customs institution founded by the Chinese Maritime Customs (CMC), a foreign-run customs agency established in the mid-19th century in China. A historical natural experiment is exploited to identify a causal effect: in 1902, the CMC took over a number of Chinese Native Customs stations, for which it established clear procedural guidelines and improved transparency and efficiency, while the other Native Customs stations remained under Chinese authority. Using the historical criterion that determined which Native Customs stations were taken over – those located within a 25 km radius of a CMC customs station – as a source of exogenous variation in the quality of the local customs institution, I show that counties historically affected by the CMC institution are more developed today relative to nearby but unaffected areas. Moreover, today’s business and bureaucracy in the affected counties suffer less from corruption, suggesting that the long-run effect of institutions can be explained by the cultural norms it fostered in the local society.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了中国海关（CMC）这一成立于19世纪中叶的外国管理海关机构所建立的海关制度的长期效应。利用一个历史自然实验来识别因果效应：1902年，中国海关接管了一些中国常关，为其制定了明确的程序指南，并提高了透明度和效率，而其他常关仍由中国当局管理。利用决定哪些常关被接管的历史标准——那些位于中国海关站25公里半径内的常关——作为当地海关制度质量外生变化的来源，我表明，历史上受中国海关制度影响的县相对于附近未受影响的地区如今更为发达。此外，受影响县的当今商业和官僚机构腐败程度较低，这表明制度的长期效应可以通过其在当地社会培育的文化规范来解释。

records.title_en: Skill bias, financial frictions, and selection into entrepreneurship
records.title_cn: 技能偏向、金融摩擦与创业选择
records.abstract_en: Financial frictions adversely affect productivity by discouraging entrepreneurship, which is often measured by the self-employed. This paper distinguishes different types of self-employment when studying this question. Using micro data for 77 countries from all income levels, we show that employers’ labor shares are increasing with GDP per capita, whereas own-account employment (self-employed without employees) is decreasing. We also find almost universally negative selection on education into own-account status relative to wage workers and positive selection into employers. To quantitatively match these facts, we introduce skill-biased technological change across countries in an occupational choice model with financial frictions. Our model predicts an average of 19% output gains in low-income countries from removing financial frictions. In contrast, an alternative model with skill-neutral technological change cannot match the high own-account employment share in low-income countries, thus overestimating the output gains by 13 percentage points.
records.abstract_cn: 金融摩擦通过抑制创业（通常以自雇来衡量）对生产率产生不利影响。本文在研究这一问题时区分了不同类型的自雇。利用来自所有收入水平77个国家的微观数据，我们表明雇主的劳动份额随人均GDP增加而增加，而自雇（无雇员的自我雇佣）则减少。我们还发现，相对于工资工人，教育对自雇身份的负向选择几乎普遍存在，而对雇主身份则存在正向选择。为了定量匹配这些事实，我们在一个具有金融摩擦的职业选择模型中引入了跨国技能偏向的技术变革。我们的模型预测，消除金融摩擦在低收入国家平均带来19%%的产出收益。相比之下，一个技能中性的技术变革替代模型无法匹配低收入国家的高自雇就业份额，从而高估了产出收益13个百分点。

records.title_en: A global map of amenities: Public goods, ethnic divisions and decentralization
records.title_cn: 全球便利设施地图：公共物品、民族分裂与地方分权
records.abstract_en: I analyze the effects of ethnic divisions on the provision of public goods in countries throughout the world. Using OpenStreetMap data, I construct a new, global dataset that pinpoints locations of public amenities, such as schools, hospitals, and libraries. I devise two new proxies to address the variability in the completeness of such data. I find that more autonomous subnational regions with a high degree of ethnic fractionalization provide significantly fewer productive public goods. Therefore, decentralization can decrease the provision of local public goods in areas characterized by higher levels of ethnic heterogeneity than those that prevail nationwide.
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了世界各国的民族分裂对公共物品供给的影响。利用OpenStreetMap数据，我构建了一个新的全球数据集，精确定位了学校、医院和图书馆等公共便利设施的位置。我设计了两个新的代理变量来解决此类数据完整性的变异性问题。我发现，具有高度民族分裂化的自治地方区域提供的生产性公共物品显著较少。因此，在民族异质性高于全国平均水平的地区，地方分权可能会减少地方公共物品的供给。

records.title_en: Irrigation and gender roles
records.title_cn: 灌溉与性别角色
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes that ancestral irrigation is associated with lower levels of contemporary female labor force participation. We test and provide support for this novel hypothesis using an exogenous measure of irrigation and cross-country data, data from the World Values Survey, the Afrobarometer, and the Asian Barometer. To explore a possible mechanism and cultural persistence, we use the Standard Cross-Cultural Sample, the European Social Survey, and the American Community Survey. The gender-based division of labor in pre-modern agriculture appears to be a possible channel between irrigation and contemporary female labor force participation rates. Evidence from second-generation immigrants suggests cultural transmission across generations, especially via males.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出，祖先灌溉与当代女性劳动力参与率较低相关。我们使用外生的灌溉度量、跨国数据、世界价值观调查、非洲晴雨表和亚洲晴雨表的数据来检验并支持这一新假设。为了探索可能的机制和文化持续性，我们使用了标准跨文化样本、欧洲社会调查和美国社区调查。前现代农业中基于性别的劳动分工似乎是灌溉与当代女性劳动力参与率之间的可能渠道。来自第二代移民的证据表明，文化代际传递，尤其是通过男性传递。

records.title_en: Child marriage as informal insurance: Empirical evidence and policy simulations
records.title_cn: 童婚作为非正式保险：实证证据与政策模拟
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between child marriage and economic incentives in a setting where the bride price – a transfer from the groom to the bride’s parents at marriage – is customary. First, we develop a dynamic model in which households are exposed to income volatility and have no access to credit markets. If a daughter marries, her household obtains a bride price. In this framework, girls may have a higher probability of marrying early when their parents have a higher marginal utility of consumption because of adverse income shocks. Second, we measure the responsiveness of child marriage to income fluctuations by exploiting variation in rainfall shocks over a woman’s life cycle, using a survey dataset from rural Tanzania. We find that adverse shocks during teenage years increase the probability of early marriages. Third, we use these empirical results to estimate the parameters of our model and isolate the role of the bride price custom for consumption smoothing. In counterfactual exercises, we show that enforcing child marriage bans can have lasting effects on the timing of marriage even after a woman has exceeded the minimal age of marriage. The utility cost to parents of such enforcement is not large. Cash transfers, both conditional on avoiding child marriage and unconditional, can reduce early marriages, especially when they target low-income households.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在彩礼（即结婚时新郎向新娘父母支付的转移支付）习俗盛行的背景下，童婚与经济激励之间的关系。首先，我们构建了一个动态模型，其中家庭面临收入波动且无法进入信贷市场。如果女儿结婚，其家庭可获得彩礼。在此框架下，当父母因不利收入冲击而具有较高的边际消费效用时，女孩早婚的概率可能更高。其次，我们利用坦桑尼亚农村地区的调查数据，通过考察女性生命周期中降雨冲击的变化，来衡量童婚对收入波动的反应程度。我们发现，青少年时期的不利冲击会增加早婚的概率。第三，我们利用这些实证结果来估计模型参数，并分离彩礼习俗在消费平滑中的作用。在反事实模拟中，我们表明，即使女性已超过法定最低结婚年龄，执行童婚禁令也可能对结婚时间产生持久影响。此类执行给父母带来的效用成本并不大。现金转移支付，无论是附带避免童婚条件还是无条件的，都能减少早婚，尤其是当它们针对低收入家庭时。

records.title_en: Marriage markets and the rise of dowry in India
records.title_cn: 婚姻市场与印度嫁妆的兴起
records.abstract_en: Dowry payments are common in many marriage markets. This paper uses data on over 74,000 marriages in rural India over the last century to explain why the institution of dowry emerges and how it evolves over time. We find that the proportion of Indian marriages including dowry payments doubled between 1930 and 1975, and the average real value of payments tripled. We empirically test whether four prominent theories of dowry can explain this rise, and find support for only one: increased differentiation in groom quality as a result of modernization. We also find a decline in the average real value of dowry payments after 1975 and demonstrate that this could be rationalized within a search model of marriage markets.
records.abstract_cn: 嫁妆支付在许多婚姻市场中普遍存在。本文利用过去一个世纪印度农村超过74,000桩婚姻的数据，来解释嫁妆制度为何出现以及如何随时间演变。我们发现，包含嫁妆支付的印度婚姻比例在1930年至1975年间翻了一番，平均实际支付价值增长了两倍。我们实证检验了四种主要的嫁妆理论是否能解释这一增长，结果仅支持一种：现代化导致的 groom 质量差异增大。我们还发现1975年后嫁妆平均实际价值有所下降，并证明这可以在婚姻市场的搜索模型中得到合理化解释。

records.title_en: Curriculum and national identity: Evidence from the 1997 curriculum reform in Taiwan
records.title_cn: 课程与国家认同：来自台湾1997年课程改革的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the causal effects of textbook content on individuals’ national identity, by exploiting a curriculum reform that introduced a new perspective on Taiwan’s history for students entering junior high school after September 1997. Using a repeated nationally representative survey and a regression discontinuity design, we show that students exposed to the new textbooks were more likely to hold exclusive Taiwanese identity rather than dual identity (i.e. Taiwanese and Chinese). The effect was greater for academic track students and those living in neighborhoods where fewer people identify as Taiwanese. In addition, our results suggest that the new curriculum had little impact on people’s political preferences related to Taiwan independence. Finally, we find that the probability of reporting as Taiwanese among old textbook readers converges with that of people reading new textbooks in the long run since the perspectives of old textbooks are in conflict with the recent social trends.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过利用一项课程改革，该改革为1997年九月之后进入初中的学生引入了关于台湾历史的新视角，考察了教科书内容对个人国家认同的因果效应。使用重复的全国代表性调查和断点回归设计，我们表明接触新教科书的学生更可能持有排他性的台湾人认同，而非双重认同（即台湾人和中国人）。这种效应对于学术轨道学生和居住在以台湾人自居人数较少的社区的学生更为显著。此外，我们的结果表明，新课程对人们与台湾独立相关的政治偏好影响甚微。最后，我们发现，由于旧教科书的视角与近期社会趋势相冲突，长期来看，旧教科书读者中报告为台湾人的概率与新教科书读者趋同。

records.title_en: Rural roads, agricultural extension, and productivity
records.title_cn: 农村道路、农业推广与生产率
records.abstract_en: Low agricultural productivity is a persistent challenge for developing economies. Expansions of rural roads and agricultural extension, separately, have been proposed as solutions with mixed effectiveness. In this paper, I show that it is critical to consider roads and extension together due to their strong complementarities. I study the concurrent but independent expansions of rural roads and extension in Ethiopia, and find that, while ineffective in isolation, access to both a road and extension increases productivity by 6%. The key mechanisms include increased take up of advice, adoption of modern inputs, and advantageous shifts in crop choice and labor allocation.
records.abstract_cn: 低农业生产力是发展中经济体面临的持续挑战。农村道路和农业推广的扩展，分别被提出作为解决方案，但效果不一。在本文中，我表明由于道路和推广之间存在强烈的互补性，将它们一起考虑至关重要。我研究了埃塞俄比亚农村道路和推广的同时但独立的扩展，发现虽然单独来看无效，但同时获得道路和推广的接入会使生产率提高6%。关键机制包括增加建议的采纳、现代投入品的采用，以及作物选择和劳动力分配的有利转变。

records.title_en: The health costs of dirty energy: Evidence from the capacity market in Colombia
records.title_cn: 脏能源的健康成本：来自哥伦比亚容量市场的证据
records.abstract_en: The health effects of “dirty” (fossil fuel driven) energy production are difficult to measure accurately due to the endogeneity of fuel choice. We exploit an electricity policy in Colombia that generates a price-based trigger for the use of thermal energy sources. Comparing municipalities near high versus low capacity plants, we first document that the activation of this trigger – which increased thermal energy production – led to significantly higher local pollution levels. This change increased cardiovascular-related ER mortality by 56% and respiratory-related morbidity by 9%. Our results translate to a cost of 996 million USD in terms of lives lost and higher healthcare costs.
records.abstract_cn: 由于燃料选择的内生性，“脏”（化石燃料驱动）能源生产的健康影响难以准确衡量。我们利用哥伦比亚的一项电力政策，该政策为热能来源的使用生成了一个基于价格的触发机制。比较高容量与低容量电厂附近的市政区域，我们首先记录了该触发机制的激活——这增加了热能生产——导致了显著更高的当地污染水平。这一变化使心血管相关的急诊死亡率增加了56%，呼吸系统相关的发病率增加了9%。我们的结果转化为因生命损失和更高医疗成本而产生的996百万美元的成本。

records.title_en: Information, migration, and the value of clean air
records.title_cn: 信息、迁移与清洁空气的价值
records.abstract_en: Using a variant of the Rosen-Roback model of inter-city migration that incorporates public access to air quality information, we demonstrate that information constraints create a wedge between revealed and true hedonic prices for pollution that depends upon individuals’ perception biases. We empirically test our theoretical predictions by leveraging the unexpected disclosure of PM2.5 data in China. We find that migration decisions become much more responsive to pollution and that the hedonic price of avoiding PM2.5 exposure nearly doubles – from 171 to 336 Chinese Yuan – in response to the information shock. Our results highlight the role of imperfect information in migration decisions and its impact on non-market valuation in countries where public access to information is restricted.
records.abstract_cn: 利用罗森-罗巴克城市间迁移模型的一个变体，该模型纳入了公众获取空气质量信息的途径，我们证明了信息约束会在污染的表露价格与真实特征价格之间造成楔子，这一楔子取决于个体的感知偏差。我们利用中国PM2.5数据的意外披露，对我们的理论预测进行了实证检验。我们发现，迁移决策对污染的反应变得更加敏感，且避免PM2.5暴露的特征价格几乎翻倍——从171元人民币增至336元人民币——以响应这一信息冲击。我们的结果凸显了不完全信息在迁移决策中的作用，以及在公众信息获取受限的国家中，不完全信息对非市场估值的影响。

records.title_en: Road expansion, allocative efficiency, and pro-competitive effect of transport infrastructure: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 道路扩张、配置效率与交通基础设施的促进竞争效应：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper exploits the rapid expansion of China’s road infrastructure in the 2000s to empirically investigate the pro-competitive effect of transport infrastructure via the allocative efficiency channel. Dispersion of firm markups is used to gauge allocative efficiency of resources. We address the endogenous provincial road length by instrumenting road using a least-cost path route, and deal with the endogenous timing of road construction by using a network theory algorithm to predict road construction time. Our results show the mass construction of new road infrastructure, by lowering domestic trade costs, can significantly reduce markup dispersion of industries with high reliance on transportation. The baseline estimation indicates that the road expansion in China during 1998–2007 has induced at least 28.8% reduction in markup dispersion. Further analysis by disentangling price and marginal cost indicates that the reduced markup dispersion is primarily caused by the price drop of high-markup firms in the product market instead of cost reduction in the input market. This finding validates the presence of pro-competitive effect of road infrastructure. The heterogeneous analyses show several scenarios in which market competition is strengthened and the pro-competitive effect is more clearly manifested.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用2000年代中国公路基础设施的快速扩张，实证研究交通基础设施通过配置效率渠道产生的促进竞争效应。企业加成率离散度被用来衡量资源的配置效率。我们通过使用最低成本路径路线作为工具变量来处理省级公路长度的内生性问题，并利用网络理论算法预测公路建设时间以处理公路建设时间的内生性。结果表明，新建交通基础设施的大规模建设通过降低国内贸易成本，可以显著降低对交通运输依赖度高的行业的加成率离散度。基准估计显示，1998-2007年间中国的道路扩张至少使加成率离散度降低了28.8%。通过分解价格和边际成本的进一步分析表明，加成率离散度的降低主要是由高加成率企业在产品市场上的价格下降引起的，而非投入市场的成本降低。这一发现验证了道路基础设施促进竞争效应的存在。异质性分析显示了市场竞争加强且促进竞争效应更为明显的几种情景。

records.title_en: Transnational terrorism and the internet
records.title_cn: 跨国恐怖主义与互联网
records.abstract_en: Does the internet enable the recruitment of transnational terrorists? Using geo-referenced population census data and personnel records from the Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant – a highly tech-savvy terrorist organization – this paper shows that internet access has facilitated the organization’s recruitment of foreign fighters from Tunisia. The positive association between internet access and Daesh recruitment is concentrated among younger cohorts.
records.abstract_cn: 互联网是否促进了跨国恐怖分子的招募？利用地理参照的人口普查数据以及伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国——一个高度精通技术的恐怖组织——的人事记录，本文表明互联网接入促进了该组织从突尼斯招募外国战斗人员。互联网接入与达伊沙招募之间的正相关关系集中在较年轻的群体中。

records.title_en: Competition and corruption: Highway corruption in West Africa
records.title_cn: 竞争与腐败：西非公路腐败
records.abstract_en: Petty corruption in the developing world impedes citizens from receiving public services and operating their businesses. In this paper, we show the importance of market structure in determining a corruption equilibrium. We do this in the context of highway merchandise transportation in West Africa, where checkpoint officials frequently stop truck drivers for petty bribes. We exploit a road system with two alternative corridors to develop a model which predicts that checkpoints in the two competing corridors follow a Bertrand game as they set price equal to the marginal cost. Moreover, when costs to pass through one corridor increase due to road construction, checkpoints in the other corridor raise prices and keep drivers waiting for longer. We estimate a difference-in-differences model to confirm that road construction did increase both bribes and enforced delays for stops in the unaffected corridor. This work demonstrates the importance of competition among corrupted officials to facilitate public services for drivers and suggests that the effectiveness of a local intervention can be offset by reallocating customers towards officials who are not affected by it.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的琐碎腐败阻碍了公民获得公共服务和经营企业。在本文中，我们展示了市场结构在决定腐败均衡中的重要性。我们以西非公路货物运输为背景，那里的检查站官员经常拦下卡车司机索取小额贿赂。我们利用一个具有两条替代走廊的道路系统，开发了一个模型，预测两条竞争走廊中的检查站遵循伯特兰博弈，将价格设定为等于边际成本。此外，当由于道路建设导致通过一条走廊的成本增加时，另一条走廊的检查站会提高价格并让司机等待更长时间。我们估计了一个双重差分模型，以确认道路建设确实增加了未受影响走廊中检查站的贿赂和强制延误。这项工作证明了腐败官员之间的竞争对于促进司机获得公共服务的重要性，并表明地方干预的有效性可能会因将客户重新分配给不受干预影响的官员而被抵消。

records.title_en: Efficient irrigation and water conservation: Evidence from South India
records.title_cn: 高效灌溉与水资源保护：来自南印度的证据
records.abstract_en: Widespread adoption of efficient irrigation technologies, including drip irrigation, has been proposed to limit groundwater over-exploitation, especially in water-stressed South Asia. This paper evaluates the potential productivity and water-saving benefits of smallholder drip irrigation by conducting a randomized control trial in Andhra Pradesh, India. A group of well-owners was offered a subsidy to adopt drip irrigation, while a comparable group acted as controls. After three years, the drip group shifted more into horticultural crops, enjoyed higher farm profit, and transferred (primarily through cash sales) more of its groundwater to adjacent plots. There is no difference in groundwater pumping, which is constrained by electricity rationing in this setting. The evidence thus suggests that drip adoption in South India, while increasing irrigation efficiency, will not save groundwater.
records.abstract_cn: 广泛采用高效灌溉技术，包括滴灌，已被提议用于限制地下水过度开采，尤其是在水资源紧张的南亚。本文通过在印度安得拉邦进行一项随机对照试验，评估了小农滴灌的潜在生产力和节水效益。一组井主被提供补贴以采用滴灌，而另一组可比的井主作为对照组。三年后，滴灌组更多地转向园艺作物，享有更高的农场利润，并将其更多的地下水（主要通过现金销售）转移到邻近地块。地下水抽水量没有差异，这在此环境中受到电力配给的限制。因此，证据表明，在南印度采用滴灌虽然提高了灌溉效率，但不会节省地下水。

records.title_en: Top Talent, Elite Colleges, and Migration: Evidence from the Indian Institutes of Technology
records.title_cn: 顶尖人才、精英大学与移民：来自印度理工学院的经验证据
records.abstract_en: We study migration in the right tail of the talent distribution using a novel dataset of Indian high school students taking the Joint Entrance Exam (JEE), a college entrance exam used for admission to the prestigious Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT). We find a high incidence of migration after students complete college: among the top 1000 scorers on the exam, 36% have migrated abroad, rising to 62% for the top 100 scorers. We next document that students who attended the original “Top 5” IIT were 5 percentage points more likely to migrate for graduate school compared to equally talented students who studied in other institutions. We explore two mechanisms for these patterns: signaling, for which we study migration after one university suddenly gained the IIT designation; and alumni networks, using information on the location of IIT alumni in U.S. computer science departments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项新颖的数据集研究人才分布右尾的移民现象，该数据集涵盖参加联合入学考试（JEE）的印度高中生，JEE是进入享有盛誉的印度理工学院（IIT）的大学入学考试。我们发现学生完成大学学业后移民的发生率很高：在考试前1000名考生中，36%已移民海外，前100名考生的这一比例上升至62%。接下来，我们记录到，与在其他院校就读的天赋相当的学生相比，就读于最初“前5所”IIT的学生攻读研究生阶段移民的可能性高出5个百分点。我们探讨了这两种模式的两种机制：信号传递，我们研究了在一所大学突然获得IIT称号后的移民情况；以及校友网络，利用美国计算机科学系中IIT校友的位置信息。

records.title_en: Transparency, governance, and water and sanitation: Experimental evidence from schools in rural Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 透明度、治理与水和卫生设施：来自孟加拉国农村学校的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Can transparency interventions improve WASH service provision? We use a randomized experiment to evaluate the impacts of a transparency intervention, a deliberative multi-stakeholder workshop initiated with a community scorecard exercise, in schools in rural Bangladesh. To measure impacts, we combine survey data, direct observations, and administrative data. The intervention leads to moderate but consistent improvements in knowledge of WASH standards and practices, and institutions for WASH service management, but does not improve school WASH service provision or change WASH facility use patterns. Drawing on rich descriptive data, we suggest several reasons why the intervention we evaluate did not improve WASH service outcomes and propose ways to improve the design of future interventions.
records.abstract_cn: 透明度干预能否改善水和卫生设施（WASH）服务供给？我们利用一项随机实验，评估了在孟加拉国农村学校中实施的透明度干预（以社区记分卡活动启动的多方利益相关者协商研讨会）的影响。为衡量影响，我们结合了调查数据、直接观察和行政数据。该干预措施在WASH标准和实践知识以及WASH服务管理机构方面带来了适度但一致的改善，但并未改善学校WASH服务供给或改变WASH设施使用模式。基于丰富的描述性数据，我们提出了我们所评估的干预未能改善WASH服务结果的一些原因，并提出了改进未来干预设计的建议。

records.title_en: Labeled loans and human capital investments
records.title_cn: 标签贷款与人力资本投资
records.abstract_en: Imperfect capital markets and commitment problems impede lumpy human capital investments. Labeled loans have been postulated as a potential solution to both constraints, but little is known about the role of the label in influencing investment choices in practice. We draw on a cluster randomized controlled trial in rural India to test predictions from a theoretical model, providing novel evidence that labeled microcredit is effective in influencing household borrowing and investment decisions and increasing take-up of a lumpy human capital investment, a toilet.
records.abstract_cn: 不完善的资本市场和承诺问题阻碍了非平滑的人力资本投资。标签贷款被认为是解决这两个约束的潜在方案，但关于标签在实践中影响投资选择的作用知之甚少。我们利用印度农村的一项群组随机对照试验来检验理论模型的预测，提供了新的证据表明标签小额信贷能有效影响家庭借贷和投资决策，并增加对非平滑人力资本投资（即厕所）的采用。

records.title_en: In-kind transfers, marketization costs and household specialization: Evidence from Indian farmers
records.title_cn: 实物转移、市场化成本与家庭专业化：来自印度农民的证据
records.abstract_en: I examine the effect of in-kind staple transfers on agricultural production in a setting where transactions with markets are costly for households and result in interlinked consumption and production decisions. The expansion of India’s Public Distribution system between 1993–2009 led to large variation in the quantity and value of staple grain transfers across households, districts and states. I find that an increase in PDS quantity crowds out consumption from home production and decreases staple production, while increases in the PDS subsidy per unit have zero or opposite effects. PDS quantity expansion has larger effects for households and districts that initially have less market-oriented production.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了在家庭与市场交易成本高昂且消费与生产决策相互关联的背景下，实物主食转移对农业生产的影响。印度公共分配系统在1993年至2009年间的扩张导致了家庭、地区和邦之间主食谷物转移数量和价值的巨大差异。我发现，公共分配系统数量的增加挤出了家庭自产消费并减少了主食生产，而公共分配系统单位补贴的增加则没有影响或产生相反的影响。公共分配系统数量的扩张对初始市场化生产程度较低的家庭和地区影响更大。

records.title_en: The lesser shades of labor coercion: The impact of seigneurial tenure in nineteenth-century Quebec
records.title_cn: 劳动胁迫的较轻阴影：十九世纪魁北克领主土地保有制的影响
records.abstract_en: Can mild forms of labor coercion generate welfare effects as large as more extreme forms? Do these effects persist over time? To answer both questions, we use Quebec’s system of seigneurial tenure (in effect until 1854) that granted landlords market power in the establishment of factories, and restricted worker mobility. This created a mild form of labor coercion as landlords had incentives to reduce employment and wage rates. To measure these effects, we rely on the Constitutional Act of 1791 which stated that all new lands had to be settled under a different tenure system. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that seigneurial tenure significantly depressed wages. The effect on wages is as large, or larger than, causal estimates of significantly more coercive labor regimes. We also find that by 1871, seventeen years after the institution’s abolition, these effects had fully dissipated, suggesting that persistence is not an issue.
records.abstract_cn: 较轻形式的劳动胁迫能否产生与更极端形式同样大的福利效应？这些效应是否会随时间持续存在？为回答这两个问题，我们利用魁北克的领主土地保有制（有效至1854年），该制度赋予地主在工厂设立中的市场权力，并限制工人流动性。这造成了一种较轻形式的劳动胁迫，因为地主有动机降低就业和工资率。为衡量这些效应，我们依据1791年《宪法法案》，该法案规定所有新土地必须在不同的土地保有制度下定居。利用断点回归设计，我们发现领主土地保有制显著压低了工资。其工资效应与显著更具胁迫性的劳动制度的因果估计值一样大，甚至更大。我们还发现，到1871年，即该制度废除十七年后，这些效应已完全消散，表明持续性问题并不存在。

records.title_en: Public sentiment in times of terror
records.title_cn: 恐怖时期的公众情绪
records.abstract_en: How do public sentiments towards the government change following terror attacks? The literature has traditionally answered this question using temporally aggregated voting data. This paper proposes an alternative, fine-grained approach to explore the short term dynamics underlying public sentiments. I first use high-frequency, media-reported event data to quantify PublicDiscontent, for 135 countries, over the period 2002–2020. Comparing the change in PublicDiscontent in country-months with successful terror attacks against country-months with failed terror attacks, I find that the average level of PublicDiscontent increases by approximately 11% in the 11 months following a successful terror attack. Information on government capability, political institutions and exposure to violence are incorporated in the response. Interestingly, characteristics of the national leader, such as gender, age, length of tenure and military experience, also affect the public response. Findings highlight short term dynamics of public sentiments as a critical component in shaping the citizen-state relationship.
records.abstract_cn: 公众对政府的情绪在恐怖袭击后如何变化？文献传统上使用时间聚合的投票数据来回答这个问题。本文提出了一种替代性的、细粒度的方法来探索公众情绪背后的短期动态。我首先使用高频、媒体报告的事件数据来量化公众不满，覆盖135个国家，时间跨度为2002-2020年。比较成功恐怖袭击国家月份与失败恐怖袭击国家月份的公众不满变化，我发现成功恐怖袭击后11个月内，公众不满的平均水平大约增加11%。政府能力、政治制度和暴力暴露的信息被纳入响应中。有趣的是，国家领导人的特征，如性别、年龄、任期长度和军事经验，也影响公众响应。研究结果强调了公众情绪的短期动态作为塑造公民-国家关系的关键组成部分。

records.title_en: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on children’s learning and wellbeing: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫情对儿童学习和福祉的影响：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and associated school closure on primary school children’s learning and mental wellbeing in Assam, India. Using a comprehensive dataset that tracked and repeatedly surveyed approximately 5000 children across 200 schools between 2018 and 2022, we find that children lost the equivalent of nine months of learning in mathematics and eleven months in language, during the pandemic. Children lacking resources and parental support experienced the largest losses. Regular practice, teacher interaction, and technology were associated with less learning loss. Over the same period, children’s psychological wellbeing improved. Our research provides valuable insights for designing post-emergency programs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了COVID-19疫情及相关学校关闭对印度阿萨姆邦小学生学习和心理健康的影响。利用一项综合数据集，该数据集在2018至2022年间追踪并反复调查了约5000名儿童，涉及200所学校，我们发现疫情期间儿童在数学学习上损失相当于九个月，语言学习上损失相当于十一个月。缺乏资源和父母支持的儿童损失最大。定期练习、教师互动和技术与较少的学习损失相关。在同一时期，儿童的心理健康有所改善。我们的研究为设计紧急后项目提供了宝贵的见解。

records.title_en: Sanitation and marriage markets in India: Evidence from the Total Sanitation Campaign
records.title_cn: 印度卫生设施与婚姻市场：来自全面卫生运动的证据
