records.abstract_cn: 遵循博弈论的决策理论方法，我们将Epstein和Wang（1996）以及Di Tillio（2008）的分析从偏好关系层级扩展到选择函数层级。然后，我们构建了包含所有这些选择层级的通用选择结构，并展示了Di Tillio（2008）中的通用偏好结构是如何嵌入其中的。

records.title_en: The cost of strategy-proofness in school choice
records.title_cn: 学校选择中策略防范的成本
records.abstract_en: We compare the outcomes of the most prominent strategy-proof and stable algorithm (Deferred Acceptance, DA) and the most prominent strategy-proof and Pareto optimal algorithm (Top Trading Cycles, TTC) to the allocation generated by the rank-minimizing mechanism (RM). While one would expect that RM improves upon both DA and TTC in terms of rank efficiency, the size of the improvement is nonetheless surprising. Moreover, while it is not explicitly designed to do so, RM also significantly improves the placement of the worst-off student. Furthermore, RM generates less justified envy than TTC. We corroborate our findings using data on school admissions in Budapest.
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了最著名的策略防范且稳定的算法（延迟接受，DA）和最著名的策略防范且帕累托最优的算法（顶级交易循环，TTC）与排名最小化机制（RM）产生的分配结果。虽然人们会预期RM在排名效率方面优于DA和TTC，但改进的幅度仍然令人惊讶。此外，尽管RM并非明确设计用于此目的，它也显著改善了最差处境学生的安置。再者，RM产生的合理嫉妒少于TTC。我们使用布达佩斯学校招生的数据证实了我们的发现。

records.title_en: Group lending, sorting, and risk sharing
records.title_cn: 小组贷款、分类与风险分担
records.abstract_en: This paper studies group lending with joint-liability contracts offered by Microfinance Institutions (MFIs). We develop a model of group lending where heterogeneous agents form groups, obtain capital from the MFI, and share risks among themselves. We show that the composition of the groups is not always homogeneous once risk-sharing is introduced, rationalizing the empirical evidence of risk heterogeneity within groups. Moreover, we find that joint liability introduces inefficiency for risk-averse borrowers, which explains why MFIs are moving away from joint-liability contracts. Surprisingly, the first-best outcome can be achieved even in the presence of information asymmetry.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了小额信贷机构（MFIs）提供的连带责任合同下的小组贷款。我们构建了一个小组贷款模型，其中异质代理人组成小组，从MFI获得资本，并在彼此之间分担风险。我们表明，一旦引入风险分担，小组的构成并不总是同质的，这为小组内风险异质性的经验证据提供了合理化解释。此外，我们发现连带责任对风险规避的借款人引入了无效率，这解释了为什么MFIs正在远离连带责任合同。令人惊讶的是，即使在信息不对称的情况下，也能实现最优结果。

records.title_en: Unique stable matchings
records.title_cn: 唯一稳定匹配
records.abstract_en: In this paper we consider the issue of a unique prediction in one-to-one two-sided matching markets, as defined by Gale and Shapley (1962), and we prove the following: TheoremLet P be a one-to-one two-sided matching market and letP⁎be its associated normal form, a (weakly) smaller matching market with the same set of stable matchings that can be obtained using procedures introduced inIrving and Leather (1986)andBalinski and Ratier (1997). The following three statements are equivalent:(a)P has a unique stable matching.(b)Preferences onP⁎are acyclic, as defined byChung (2000).(c)InP⁎every market participant's preference list is a singleton.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑由Gale和Shapley（1962）定义的一对一双边匹配市场中的唯一预测问题，并证明以下定理：设P是一个一对一双边匹配市场，P⁎是其关联的规范形式，一个（弱）更小的匹配市场，具有相同的稳定匹配集合，可通过Irving和Leather（1986）以及Balinski和Ratier（1997）引入的程序获得。以下三个陈述等价：（a）P具有唯一稳定匹配。（b）P⁎上的偏好是无环的，如Chung（2000）所定义。（c）在P⁎中，每个市场参与者的偏好列表是单元素集。

records.title_en: Continuous level-k mechanism design
records.title_cn: 连续层级k机制设计
records.abstract_en: In de Clippel et al. (2019), it is shown that, perhaps surprisingly, the set of implementable social choice functions is essentially the same whether agents have bounded depth of reasoning or rational expectations. The picture is quite different when taking into account the possibility of small modeling mistakes. While continuous (strict) equilibrium implementation becomes very demanding (Oury and Tercieux (2012) – OT), continuity in level-k implementation obtains essentially for free. A decomposition of the conditions implied by the OT implementation notion confirms that it is the use of equilibrium, and not continuity per se, that is responsible for the difference.
records.abstract_cn: 在de Clippel等人（2019）的研究中表明，或许令人惊讶的是，无论代理人的推理深度是有界的还是具有理性预期，可实施的社会选择函数的集合基本上是相同的。当考虑到小建模错误的可能性时，情况则大不相同。虽然连续（严格）均衡实施变得非常苛刻（Oury和Tercieux（2012）——OT），但层级k实施中的连续性基本上可以免费获得。对OT实施概念所隐含条件的分解证实，是均衡的使用，而非连续性本身，导致了这种差异。

records.title_en: Expropriation power in private dealings: Quota rule in collective sales
records.title_cn: 私人交易中的征收权：集体销售中的配额规则
records.abstract_en: Complementarity is common in land-assembly problems, such as a developer buying the entirety of apartment units to complete a development project. Holdout (delay or block of projects by sellers) is common in these problems under unanimity-rule. Motivated by the recent policy practices in strata-sales, we introduce a new bargaining model with quota-rule. We show that under quota-rule, there is no holdout when there are two sellers or players are sufficiently patient. No-holdout equilibrium is unique, efficient and yields immediate sale of all goods as outcome. When quota rule is used, efficient equilibrium is still obtained under alternative bargaining protocols and with multiple sellers. We also show that the no-holdout result is not due to the specific bargaining protocol.
records.abstract_cn: 互补性在土地整合问题中很常见，例如开发商购买全部公寓单元以完成开发项目。在一致同意规则下，这些问题的卖方抵制（卖方拖延或阻止项目）很常见。受近期分层销售政策实践的启发，我们引入了一个带有配额规则的新议价模型。我们表明，在配额规则下，当有两个卖方或参与者足够有耐心时，不存在抵制。无抵制均衡是唯一的、有效的，并且导致所有商品立即出售的结果。当使用配额规则时，在替代议价协议和多个卖方的情况下，仍然可以获得有效均衡。我们还表明，无抵制结果并非由于特定的议价协议所致。

records.title_en: Competition with list prices
records.title_cn: 标价竞争
records.abstract_en: Retail prices in stores are often lower than widely advertised list prices. We study the competitive role of such list prices in a homogeneous product duopoly where firms first set list prices before setting possibly reduced retail prices. Building on Varian (1980), we assume that some consumers observe no prices, some observe all prices, and some only observe the more salient list prices. We show that when the latter group chooses myopically, firms' ability to use list prices lowers average transaction prices. This effect is weakened when these consumers are rational. The possibility to use list prices facilitates collusion.
records.abstract_cn: 商店中的零售价格通常低于广泛宣传的标价。我们研究了在 homogeneous 产品双头垄断中此类标价的竞争作用，其中企业首先设定标价，然后再设定可能降低的零售价格。基于 Varian (1980)，我们假设一些消费者不观察任何价格，一些观察所有价格，而一些只观察更显著的标价。我们表明，当后一组消费者选择短视行为时，企业使用标价的能力降低了平均交易价格。当这些消费者理性时，这种效应会减弱。使用标价的可能性促进了合谋。

records.title_en: Strategic rationing in Stackelberg games
records.title_cn: Stackelberg博弈中的策略性配给
records.abstract_en: This paper examines Stackelberg price-quantity competition with imperfectly substitutable products. Under general cost and demand conditions, we establish existence of a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium and provide a full characterization of the set of subgame-perfect Nash equilibria. In each equilibrium, the leader rations part of its clientele. Assuming linear demand and cost functions, first- and second-mover advantages are shown to critically depend on the degree of spillover demand, i.e., how many of the unserved customers visit the follower. We identify the presence of a spillover demand paradox. The leader may be the bigger firm and make more profit, but only when a sufficiently large part of its unmet demand shifts to the follower.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了具有不完全替代产品的Stackelberg价格-数量竞争。在一般成本和需求条件下，我们建立了子博弈完美纳什均衡的存在性，并对子博弈完美纳什均衡集进行了完整刻画。在每个均衡中，领导者对其部分客户进行配给。假设线性的需求和成本函数，先动者和后动者优势被证明关键取决于溢出需求的程度，即有多少未得到服务的顾客转向追随者。我们识别出溢出需求悖论的存在。领导者可能是更大的企业并赚取更多利润，但仅当其未满足需求的足够大一部分转移到追随者时才会如此。

records.title_en: Designing weighted and directed networks under complementarities
records.title_cn: 在互补性下设计加权和有向网络
records.abstract_en: Strategic complementarities influence various social and economic activities. This study introduces a model to design a weighted and directed complementarity network to achieve a planner's objectives. The network represents the direction and intensity of complementarities between agents, influencing their best-responses to one another and determining equilibrium efforts. The planner's objective function can be convex, as commonly assumed in prior research, or arbitrarily concave to represent scenarios with diminishing marginal returns to each agent's effort. In all scenarios, optimal networks are generalized nested split graphs (GNSGs) which exhibit a link-dominance hierarchy among agents. These optimal networks are often strictly hierarchical, leading to inequality between ex ante identical agents. Additional analysis of a non-cooperative network formation game reveals that all decentralized equilibrium networks are inefficient GNSGs.
records.abstract_cn: 战略互补性影响各种社会和经济活动。本研究引入一个模型来设计加权和有向的互补性网络，以实现规划者的目标。该网络表示代理人之间互补性的方向和强度，影响他们彼此的最佳反应，并决定均衡努力。规划者的目标函数可以是凸的，如先前研究通常假设的，也可以是任意凹的，以表示每个代理人努力边际收益递减的情景。在所有情景中，最优网络是广义嵌套分裂图（GNSGs），其表现出代理人之间的链接支配层级。这些最优网络通常是严格分层的，导致事前相同的代理人之间出现不平等。对非合作网络形成博弈的进一步分析表明，所有分散均衡网络都是低效的GNSGs。

records.title_en: The non-dismal science of intergenerational affective interactions
records.title_cn: 代际情感互动的非悲观科学
records.abstract_en: We prove that if each generation cares, non-paternalistically, about other generations' wellbeing rather than about their choices, and do not curb or otherwise alter future generations' choice sets, then backward induction intergenerational choice paths are efficient. This somewhat surprising result implies that intergenerational inefficiencies, to the extent that they do occur, are not due to different generations having different preferences, and prior generations trying to tip the scales in favor of their own tastes and values.
records.abstract_cn: 我们证明，如果每一代人都非家长式地关心其他代人的福祉而非其选择，并且不限制或以其他方式改变未来世代的选择集，那么逆向归纳的代际选择路径是有效率的。这一有些令人惊讶的结果意味着，代际无效率，即便确实发生，也并非源于不同世代拥有不同偏好，以及前代试图使天平偏向于自身品味和价值观。

records.title_en: Review: Taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages: Political economy, and effects on prices, purchases, and consumption
records.title_cn: 综述：含糖饮料税：政治经济学及其对价格、购买和消费的影响
records.abstract_en: In response to a rise in obesity and diet-related chronic diseases such as diabetes, countries worldwide have sought ways to incentivize healthier diets. One of the most common recent policies is taxing sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs). This article introduces a virtual special collection of selected scholarship on SSB taxes that was published in Elsevier journals such as Food Policy, the Journal of Health Economics, and Economics & Human Biology. This article also summarizes the results of those studies regarding the political economy of SSB taxes, and how SSB taxes affect prices, sales, consumption, employment, and tax avoidance behaviors.
records.abstract_cn: 为应对肥胖和与饮食相关的慢性疾病（如糖尿病）的上升，世界各国纷纷寻求激励更健康饮食的方法。近期最常见的政策之一是对含糖饮料（SSBs）征税。本文介绍了一个关于SSB税收的虚拟特辑，该特辑收录了发表在《食品政策》、《健康经济学杂志》和《经济学与人类生物学》等爱思唯尔期刊上的精选学术研究。本文还总结了这些研究关于SSB税收的政治经济学，以及SSB税收如何影响价格、销售、消费、就业和避税行为的结果。

records.title_en: Aspirations, risk preferences, and investments in agricultural technologies
records.title_cn: 抱负、风险偏好与农业技术投资
records.abstract_en: We investigate the relationship between aspirations, risk preferences, and investment in agricultural technologies using data collected among cacao farmers in Ecuador. We first find that an inverted U-shaped relationship between the income aspirations gap and investments exists when considering relatively long-term investments (e.g., farm renovations) but not when considering relatively short-term investments (e.g., fertilizer use). Next, using lab-in-the-field experiments and survey instruments designed to elicit risk preferences, we show that the observed inverted U-shaped relationship is robust to the inclusion of risk preference parameters in our regression specification—a potentially important omitted variable in previous studies. Our empirical results are consistent with existing theory suggesting that aspirations that are ahead, but not too far ahead, of current levels provide the best incentives for investments in the future, and suggest the presence of psychological constraints to investments in agricultural technology.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用在厄瓜多尔可可种植户中收集的数据，研究了抱负、风险偏好与农业技术投资之间的关系。我们首先发现，在考虑相对长期的投资（如农场翻新）时，收入抱负差距与投资之间存在倒U型关系，但在考虑相对短期的投资（如化肥使用）时则不存在这种关系。接下来，利用实验室实地实验和旨在引出风险偏好的调查工具，我们表明观察到的倒U型关系在我们回归设定中加入风险偏好参数后依然稳健——这可能是以往研究中一个重要的遗漏变量。我们的实证结果与现有理论一致，该理论表明，抱负超前但不过分超前于当前水平，能为未来投资提供最佳激励，并暗示了农业技术投资中存在心理约束。

records.title_en: Take an inch for a mile. About an error of metrics in WTO rules and its impact on the ability of countries to build public stocks for food security
records.title_cn: 得寸进尺：WTO规则中的度量误差及其对各国建立粮食安全公共储备能力的影响
records.abstract_en: Many developing countries use public stocks to provide free or subsidised grain to food-insecure households or to mitigate sharp increases in grain prices. However, the building of public stocks is regulated by the WTO, as public procurement may be used to provide farmers with a price support. This support is bounded jointly with the other forms of non-exempt domestic support for agriculture. Since 2012, WTO rules on public stockholding programmes have been questioned by a group of 33 member countries, and are at the top of the WTO negotiation agenda. The topics debated are i) the way this support should be calculated, and ii) the maximum level of support allowed. This article addresses the first topic. It identifies three biases in WTO rules and estimates the magnitude of the gap between the support actually provided and the support calculated according to WTO rules. It appears that, for grains, the support calculated is generally several times higher than the real support, compromising countries’ compliance with their domestic support commitments and thereby significantly reducing their ability to build public stocks. Moreover, the gap is not the same for all countries and is generally much higher for poor countries: the countries that most need public stocks for food security are those with the least freedom to build them. This article thus proposes a simple way to correct the rules that specify how the support provided by public stockholding programmes should be calculated.
records.abstract_cn: 许多发展中国家利用公共储备向粮食不安全家庭提供免费或补贴谷物，或缓解谷物价格的急剧上涨。然而，公共储备的建立受到WTO的监管，因为公共采购可能被用来向农民提供价格支持。这种支持与非豁免的国内农业支持的其他形式共同受到约束。自2012年以来，WTO关于公共储备计划的规则受到33个成员国的质疑，并处于WTO谈判议程的首要位置。争论的主题包括：i) 这种支持的计算方式，以及ii) 允许的最大支持水平。本文针对第一个主题。它识别了WTO规则中的三个偏差，并估计了实际提供的支持与根据WTO规则计算的支持之间的差距大小。结果表明，对于谷物，计算出的支持通常比实际支持高出数倍，这损害了各国遵守其国内支持承诺的能力，从而显著降低了它们建立公共储备的能力。此外，这种差距并非对所有国家都相同，对贫穷国家而言通常要大得多：最需要公共储备以保障粮食安全的国家，恰恰是建立储备自由度最小的国家。因此，本文提出了一种简单的方法来修正规定公共储备计划支持计算方式的规则。

records.title_en: The impacts of climate change on cropland allocation, crop production, output prices and social welfare in Israel: A structural econometric framework
records.title_cn: 气候变化对以色列农作物分配、作物生产、产出价格和社会福利的影响：一个结构计量经济学框架
records.abstract_en: We propose a model that simulates climate change impacts on crop production and food prices under partial equilibrium. Our model incorporates a system of Laspeyres price and quantity indices that link structurally estimated community-level produce supply functions to market level demand functions. The supply estimation accounts for corner solutions associated with disaggregate land use observations and is constrained to reproduce aggregate supply data. We use the model to assess climate change impacts in Israel, which protects local agriculture by import tariffs and quotas. The simulation results vary greatly when we allow prices to change as a response to supply changes, highlighting the importance of endogenizing prices in climate change simulations. The results imply that climate changes projected for Israel are expected to be beneficial to farmers, particularly due to the positive impact of the forecasted large temperature rise on field crop production. Fruit outputs are projected to decline, and reduce consumer surplus, but to a lower extent than the increase in total agricultural profits. Nearly 20% of the profit rise is attributed to farmers’ adaptation through land reallocation. Adaptation to the projected reduction in precipitation by increasing irrigation is found to be warranted from the farmers’ perspective; however, it is not beneficial to society as a whole. Abolishing import tariffs effectively transfers surpluses from producers to consumers, but the impact of this policy on social welfare is relatively modest.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个模型，在局部均衡下模拟气候变化对作物生产和粮食价格的影响。我们的模型包含了一个拉斯佩耶斯价格和数量指数系统，将结构估计的社区级农产品供给函数与市场级需求函数联系起来。供给估计考虑了与分解土地利用观测相关的角点解，并受限于再现总体供给数据。我们使用该模型评估以色列的气候变化影响，该国通过进口关税和配额保护本地农业。当我们允许价格随供给变化而调整时，模拟结果差异很大，这凸显了在气候变化模拟中将价格内生化的必要性。结果表明，预计以色列的气候变化对农民有利，特别是由于预测的大幅升温对大田作物生产的积极影响。水果产量预计将下降，并减少消费者剩余，但下降幅度低于农业总利润的增加。利润增长的近20%归因于农民通过土地重新分配的适应。从农民的角度来看，通过增加灌溉来适应预测的降水减少是合理的；然而，对整个社会而言并无益处。取消进口关税有效地将剩余从生产者转移给消费者，但这一政策对社会福利的影响相对较小。

records.title_en: How responsive are nutrients in India? Some recent evidence
records.title_cn: 印度的营养摄入对收入变化的响应程度如何？一些近期证据
records.abstract_en: The relationship between nutrient intake and income is an issue of huge policy relevance, especially in the developing world. Using large-scale household-level data from India, this paper analyzes how macronutrient and micronutrient intakes respond to changes in income in both rural and urban areas. It also investigates how food consumption patterns change over time. In a first, this paper employs different estimation approaches i.e., parametric, semi-parametric and non-parametric estimation models to obtain more recent and robust nutrient-income elasticity estimates for three macronutrients and four essential micronutrients. The parametric (OLS) calorie-expenditure elasticities were lower than those estimated for protein and fat. Micronutrients also yielded positive and statistically significant elasticities. In terms of the parametric (IV) estimation, elasticities also declined over time and had lower magnitudes than the parametric (OLS) estimates. Relative to protein, fat and micronutrient intakes, caloric intakes are less sensitive to changes in income. According to parametric (OLS and IV) estimation, calcium is the most income-responsive micronutrient, while zinc is the least. The preferred semi-parametric estimation strategy provides full flexibility to income effects while also simultaneously controlling for additional covariates parametrically, assisting in determining the true relationship between nutrient intake and income. Consistent with the parametric estimation, elasticities were positive and statistically significant. The augmented semi-parametric elasticities, which address endogeneity concerns, were lower than the non-augmented ones. The semi-parametric elasticity curves depict that the relationship between demand for nutrients and income is indeed non-linear and non-monotonic. The findings from this research demonstrate that it is critical to evaluate the effect of income across the entire income distribution, and not just at the means. Even when the elasticities are low, they are always more pronounced for the poor, who are the most vulnerable to malnutrition. The study conducts a battery of checks that further lend credence to the robustness of the main findings. Given the current landscape of India’s nutrition economy, the findings of this study would serve to be useful for designing apt future nutritional interventions and public health policies.
records.abstract_cn: 营养摄入与收入之间的关系是一个具有巨大政策相关性的问题，尤其是在发展中国家。利用来自印度的大规模住户层面数据，本文分析了农村和城市地区宏量营养素和微量营养素的摄入如何响应收入变化，并研究了食物消费模式随时间的变化。本文首次采用了不同的估计方法，即参数、半参数和非参数估计模型，以获得三种宏量营养素和四种必需微量营养素更近期且稳健的营养-收入弹性估计。参数（OLS）卡路里-支出弹性低于蛋白质和脂肪的估计值。微量营养素也产生了正且统计显著的弹性。就参数（IV）估计而言，弹性随时间下降，且幅度低于参数（OLS）估计。相对于蛋白质、脂肪和微量营养素的摄入，卡路里摄入对收入变化的敏感度较低。根据参数（OLS和IV）估计，钙是对收入最敏感的微量营养素，而锌是最不敏感的。优选的半参数估计策略为收入效应提供了完全灵活性，同时以参数方式控制额外的协变量，有助于确定营养摄入与收入之间的真实关系。与参数估计一致，弹性为正且统计显著。增强的半参数弹性解决了内生性问题，其值低于非增强的弹性。半参数弹性曲线表明，营养需求与收入之间的关系确实是非线性和非单调的。本研究的发现表明，评估收入对整个收入分布的影响至关重要，而不仅仅是均值处。即使弹性较低，它们对最易受营养不良影响的贫困人群而言总是更为显著。本研究进行了一系列检验，进一步支持了主要发现的稳健性。鉴于印度营养经济的当前状况，本研究的发现将有助于设计适当的未来营养干预措施和公共卫生政策。

records.title_en: Cashew processing in Ghana – A case for infant industry support?
records.title_cn: 加纳的腰果加工——支持幼稚产业的案例？
records.abstract_en: West Africa produces almost half of the world's cashew nuts. With the domestic cashew processing industry still in its infancy, however, most of it is exported as raw material and processed in India and Vietnam. In Ghana, this is provoking discussions about market interventions to support domestic processing. Since different price policies have diverging implications for farmers and processors, the choice of the policy instrument leads to conflicts of interest between the two groups. In this study, we analyse the short- and long-term economic impacts of enhancing cashew processing through (i.) a temporary export tax on raw cashew nuts, (ii.) a temporary subsidy to cashew processors, and (iii.)a temporary export tax on raw cashew nuts, with government revenues passed on to cashew growers. For this purpose, we develop a partial equilibrium model for the Ghanaian cashew market including the processing from raw cashew nuts to kernels. We find that in the short run, all price policies lead to a substantial increase in processing at the expense of net welfare. We argue, however, that the sector may experience productivity gains through learning by doing and thus, after price policies are phased out, stick to its increased level of output such that short-term welfare losses could be recouped. Therefore, temporarily introduced price policies could help the infant cashew processing industry to grow up, promote the development of the domestic cashew sector, and be welfare-enhancing in the long run. A subsidy to processors is the most appropriate option to achieve this.
records.abstract_cn: 西非生产了全球近一半的腰果。然而，由于国内腰果加工业仍处于起步阶段，大部分腰果作为原材料出口，并在印度和越南进行加工。在加纳，这引发了关于支持国内加工的市场干预措施的讨论。由于不同的价格政策对农民和加工商有不同的影响，政策工具的选择导致两个群体之间的利益冲突。在本研究中，我们分析了通过（i）对生腰果征收临时出口税，（ii）对腰果加工商提供临时补贴，以及（iii）对生腰果征收临时出口税并将政府收入转给腰果种植者，来促进腰果加工的短期和长期经济影响。为此，我们为加纳腰果市场开发了一个部分均衡模型，包括从生腰果到腰果仁的加工过程。我们发现，在短期内，所有价格政策都会导致加工量大幅增加，但以净福利为代价。然而，我们认为，该行业可能通过干中学获得生产率提升，因此在价格政策逐步取消后，仍能保持其增加后的产出水平，从而短期福利损失可以得到弥补。因此，临时引入的价格政策可以帮助幼稚的腰果加工业成长，促进国内腰果部门的发展，并在长期内提高福利。对加工商提供补贴是实现这一目标的最合适选择。

records.title_en: The economics of reducing food losses: Experimental evidence from improved storage technology in India
records.title_cn: 减少粮食损失的经济学：来自印度改进储存技术的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Understanding the economics of food loss-reduction technologies is crucial to promote their adoption. We offer experimental evidence on returns to technology that studies a wide range of food security outcomes and accounts for the quality, quantity, and economic gains from adoption. Using two randomized experiments on improved storage with farmers in India, we find that food loss-reduction technology delivers large gains on multiple aspects of food security. The largest benefits of loss-reduction technology come from reduced quality and economic losses. Using a novel within-farmer experiment, we offer evidence of significant economic incentives for investing in loss-reduction technology in local rural markets. Our cost-benefit analysis shows that farmers recover the full unsubsidized cost of the reusable improved storage technology in one agricultural season.
records.abstract_cn: 理解减少粮食损失技术的经济学对于促进其采用至关重要。我们提供了关于技术回报的实验证据，该研究涵盖了广泛的粮食安全结果，并考虑了采用带来的质量、数量和经济收益。通过在印度对农民进行两项关于改进储存的随机实验，我们发现减少粮食损失技术在粮食安全的多个方面带来了巨大收益。减少损失技术的最大好处来自于减少质量和经济损失。通过一项新颖的农民内部实验，我们提供了在当地农村市场投资于减少损失技术具有显著经济激励的证据。我们的成本效益分析表明，农民在一个农业季节内即可收回可重复使用的改进储存技术的全部未补贴成本。

records.title_en: Ethnicity, information and cooperation: Evidence from a group-based nutrition intervention
records.title_cn: 族裔、信息与合作：基于群体营养干预的证据
records.abstract_en: Development programs often rely on locally hired agents for service delivery, especially for interventions promoting agricultural practices, health, and nutrition. These agents are key to reaching underserved communities, especially women, with information and services around recommended practices. However, where societies are socially stratified, differences in ethnic identities between agents and beneficiaries may impact the effectiveness of information and service delivery and the uptake of recommended behaviors. We explore the salience of shared ethnic identity between agents and beneficiaries in promoting collective action using a field experiment with women’s self-help groups (SHGs) in India. We cross-randomize an information treatment and a group-agent shared ethnicity treatment at the SHG level. We measure impacts on individual group member information retention and willingness to contribute to a group-owned kitchen garden that could improve access to a diverse and nutritious diet. We find information retention is better when the group is matched with an agent lower in the ethnic hierarchy, but that agents higher in the hierarchy elicit greater individual contributions to the group-owned kitchen garden. We suggest some hypotheses for these seemingly contradictory results. Other characteristics like education, group cohesion and perceived agent ability also matter in changing knowledge and contribution. Our findings have important implications for effective program design and implementation, suggesting that implementers need to consider factors beyond the information content, target group and pedagogical mode of delivery for their strategies to be transformative.
records.abstract_cn: 发展项目通常依赖当地聘用的代理人来提供服务，尤其是那些推广农业实践、健康和营养的干预措施。这些代理人是接触服务不足社区（尤其是女性）并传递推荐实践信息和服务的关键。然而，在社会分层的社会中，代理人与受益者之间的族裔身份差异可能会影响信息和服务传递的有效性以及推荐行为的采纳。我们通过印度女性自助小组（SHGs）的实地实验，探讨了代理人与受益者之间共享族裔身份在促进集体行动中的显著性。我们在SHG层面交叉随机化了一个信息处理和一个小组-代理人共享族裔处理。我们测量了对个体小组成员信息保留和贡献于小组拥有的菜园（可改善多样化营养饮食获取）意愿的影响。我们发现，当小组与族裔等级较低的代理人匹配时，信息保留更好，但等级较高的代理人能引发对小组拥有的菜园更大的个人贡献。我们提出了一些关于这些看似矛盾结果的假设。其他特征如教育、小组凝聚力和感知的代理人能力也在改变知识和贡献方面起作用。我们的发现对有效的项目设计和实施具有重要意义，表明实施者需要考虑信息内容、目标群体和教学传递方式之外的因素，以使他们的策略具有变革性。

records.title_en: When increasing vegetable production may worsen food availability gaps: A simulation model in India
records.title_cn: 当增加蔬菜生产可能加剧食物供应缺口时：印度的一个模拟模型
records.abstract_en: Translating agricultural productivity into food availability depends on food supply chains. Agricultural policy and research efforts promote increased horticultural crop production and yields, but the ability of low-resource food supply chains to handle increased volumes of perishable crops is not well understood. This study developed and used a discrete event simulation model to assess the impact of increased production of potato, onion, tomato, brinjal (eggplant), and cabbage on vegetable supply chains in Odisha, India. Odisha serves as an exemplar of vegetable supply chain challenges in many low-resource settings.
records.abstract_cn: 将农业生产力转化为食物供应依赖于食物供应链。农业政策和研究工作促进了园艺作物产量和单产的提高，但低资源食物供应链处理易腐作物数量增加的能力尚不明确。本研究开发并使用了离散事件模拟模型，评估印度奥里萨邦马铃薯、洋葱、番茄、茄子（茄子）和卷心菜产量增加对蔬菜供应链的影响。奥里萨邦是许多低资源环境中蔬菜供应链挑战的典型代表。

records.title_en: Assessment of the importance of climate, land, and soil on the global supply for agricultural products and global food security: Evidence from Madagascar
records.title_cn: 气候、土地和土壤对全球农产品供应和全球粮食安全重要性的评估：来自马达加斯加的证据
records.abstract_en: Sub-Saharan Africa is home to 63.00% of the global food-insecure people (IPC/CH Phase 3 or above) and endowed with more than 50.00% of uncultivated land. The production environment in the region is subject to numerous constraints imposed by climate, physical infrastructure, and human activities. This study highlights the importance of countries’ natural endowment and crop-specific requirements, namely soil and climate characteristics, on agricultural trade and food security. To analyze the global supply of crops, we based our research on the comparative advantage theory with the factor endowment approach. We found that the climate in the tropical region lowered the soil quality and the agricultural productivity in the region. Compared to most developing Asian countries, least developed countries from Africa, including Madagascar, struggle with soil management which lowers their comparative advantage in the agricultural sector. We also found that the crops’ requirements give a comparative advantage to well-endowed countries. This research exposed that the climate and soil combined, along with the geography variables are important for the international trade pattern. It also brings light to the importance of international trade in the achievement of global food security. Our findings suggested that foreign direct investment (FDI) can be used to boost the global agricultural sector and improve global food security. For Madagascar in particular, we found that FDI could help the country sustain the global supply of spices, specifically vanilla, cloves, and cocoa.
records.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区居住着全球63.00%的粮食不安全人口（IPC/CH阶段3或以上），并拥有超过50.00%的未开垦土地。该地区的生产环境受到气候、物理基础设施和人类活动带来的诸多限制。本研究强调了国家自然禀赋和作物特定需求（即土壤和气候特征）对农业贸易和粮食安全的重要性。为了分析全球作物供应，我们基于比较优势理论和要素禀赋方法进行研究。我们发现热带地区的气候降低了该地区的土壤质量和农业生产力。与大多数亚洲发展中国家相比，包括马达加斯加在内的非洲最不发达国家在土壤管理方面面临困难，这降低了它们在农业部门的比较优势。我们还发现，作物的需求赋予了资源禀赋充足的国家比较优势。这项研究揭示了气候和土壤相结合，以及地理变量，对国际贸易格局的重要性。它也阐明了国际贸易在实现全球粮食安全中的重要性。我们的研究结果表明，外国直接投资（FDI）可用于促进全球农业部门并改善全球粮食安全。特别是对于马达加斯加，我们发现外国直接投资可以帮助该国维持全球香料的供应，特别是香草、丁香和可可。

records.title_en: True to type? EU-style date marking and the valuation of perishable food
records.title_cn: 名副其实？欧盟式日期标注与易腐食品的估值
records.abstract_en: Date marking is intended to help consumers make informed food safety and quality choices when confronted with perishable food products. We provide causal in-store evidence on how EU-style date marking (best before and use by) influences consumers’ valuation of perishable food around the expiry date. In a preparatory survey (n=100), we first identify perishable food items amenable to experimental manipulation. A modified multiple price list (MPL) experiment (n=200) then tests shoppers’ valuation of perishable food with expiry dates in the future and the past. We vary date mark type (use-by versus best-before) and information status (with and without education) while preventing free disposal censoring. We find that expiry dates affect consumer valuation. Variation in date mark type has little practical relevance. Educating consumers about the meaning of date mark types reduces willingness to pay for potentially unsafe food, but does not increase it for more durable items. An attentiveness experiment (n=160) finds that inattention and consumers’ native understanding of current date marks can explain the evidence from the modified MPL experiment. Jointly, these results help explaining existing observational evidence and assessing the prospects of consumer education campaigns.
records.abstract_cn: 日期标注旨在帮助消费者在面对易腐食品时做出明智的食品安全和质量选择。我们提供了关于欧盟式日期标注（最佳食用日期和保质期）如何影响消费者在到期日前后对易腐食品估值的因果性店内证据。在一项预备调查（n=100）中，我们首先确定了适合实验操作的易腐食品项目。随后，一项修改后的多重价格表（MPL）实验（n=200）测试了购物者对具有未来和过去到期日的易腐食品的估值。我们变化日期标注类型（保质期与最佳食用日期）和信息状态（有教育与无教育），同时防止自由处置审查。我们发现到期日影响消费者估值。日期标注类型的变化几乎没有实际相关性。教育消费者了解日期标注类型的含义降低了他们对潜在不安全食品的支付意愿，但并未增加对更耐储存物品的支付意愿。一项注意力实验（n=160）发现，注意力不集中和消费者对当前日期标注的本能理解可以解释修改后的MPL实验中的证据。综合来看，这些结果有助于解释现有的观察性证据，并评估消费者教育运动的前景。

records.title_en: The impact of CAP subsidies on the productivity of cereal farms in six European countries: A historical perspective (2008–2018)
records.title_cn: CAP补贴对六个欧洲国家谷物农场生产率的影响：历史视角（2008-2018）
records.abstract_en: Productivity is an always-hotly-debated issue within the EU agricultural policymaking, particularly concerning the effect of subsidies distributed via the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). The cereal sector is under particular political scrutiny nowadays, with the Ukraine conflict and environmental issues menacing food security levels for both developing and developed countries.
records.abstract_cn: 生产率是欧盟农业政策制定中一个始终激烈争论的问题，特别是关于通过共同农业政策（CAP）分配的补贴的影响。如今，谷物部门受到特别的政治关注，乌克兰冲突和环境问题威胁着发展中国家和发达国家的粮食安全水平。

records.title_en: Greenhouse farming and employment: Evidence from Ecuador
records.title_cn: 温室农业与就业：来自厄瓜多尔的证据
records.abstract_en: The transforming agri-food sector is an important contributor to employment generation in rural areas of lower-income countries. However, little attention has been paid to the question of how technology affects the quality and quantity of employment in the sector. In this paper, we provide the first empirical evidence of how the rise in greenhouse farming changes labor demand (i.e., the number of employees), using large-scale and nationally representative agricultural survey data from Ecuador between 2014 and 2021 and pseudo-panel as well as event-study estimation techniques. Contrary to fears that more technologically advanced production methods displace large shares of the workforce, we find that greenhouse farming is associated with higher labor demand. Specifically, greenhouse farms hire more female workers and workers on permanent contracts.
records.abstract_cn: 转型中的农食部门是低收入国家农村地区就业创造的重要贡献者。然而，关于技术如何影响该部门就业质量和数量的问题，却鲜少受到关注。在本文中，我们利用厄瓜多尔2014年至2021年间大规模且具有全国代表性的农业调查数据，以及伪面板和事件研究估计技术，首次提供了温室农业兴起如何改变劳动力需求（即雇员数量）的经验证据。与更先进的生产方法会取代大量劳动力的担忧相反，我们发现温室农业与更高的劳动力需求相关。具体而言，温室农场雇佣了更多的女性工人和签订永久合同的工人。

records.title_en: Turning FOP nutrition labels into action: A systematic review of label+ interventions
records.title_cn: 将FOP营养标签转化为行动：标签+干预措施的系统综述
records.abstract_en: The effectiveness of nutrition labels in modifying dietary choices remains limited. Information provision alone is a necessary yet insufficient condition for behavior change to occur. Individuals need to (1) turn information into knowledge and (2) turn knowledge into behavior. This article provides a theoretical framework that suggests that complementary interventions may be needed to target barriers that prevent individuals from processing and acting upon FOP nutrition labels. Evidence about which interventions can support nutrition labels for behavioral change is scattered. This article addresses this research gap through a systematic review of multicomponent nutrition label interventions (label+ interventions) and their effects on the actual healthfulness of dietary choices. From the 3519 records identified, 85 label+ interventions were included. The findings provide limited evidence for the effectiveness of supporting nutrition labels with educational material or reference information. The evidence for supporting nutrition labels with interactive digital interventions, such as basket feedback, or financial incentives is promising. Overall, the findings indicate that more intrusive interventions are required to give cause to act on nutrition labels. Implications and future research avenues for the various label+ categories are discussed.
records.abstract_cn: 营养标签在改变饮食选择方面的有效性仍然有限。仅提供信息是行为改变发生的必要但不充分条件。个体需要（1）将信息转化为知识，以及（2）将知识转化为行为。本文提供了一个理论框架，表明可能需要补充性干预措施来针对阻碍个体处理和响应FOP营养标签的障碍。关于哪些干预措施可以支持营养标签促进行为改变的证据较为分散。本文通过对多组分营养标签干预措施（标签+干预措施）及其对饮食选择实际健康程度影响的系统综述，填补了这一研究空白。从识别的3519条记录中，纳入了85项标签+干预措施。研究结果为支持营养标签与教育材料或参考信息的有效性提供了有限证据。支持营养标签与交互式数字干预措施（如购物篮反馈）或经济激励的证据是有前景的。总体而言，研究结果表明，需要更具侵入性的干预措施来促使个体对营养标签采取行动。本文讨论了各类标签+干预措施的含义和未来研究方向。

records.title_en: Income diversification and household welfare in Uganda 1992–2012
records.title_cn: 乌干达的收入多样化与家庭福利（1992-2012）
records.abstract_en: We use five waves of household surveys in Uganda, from 1992/3 to 2011/12, to study income diversification and its effect on the welfare of rural and urban households during a period of sustained economic growth and poverty reduction, comparing the 1990s to the 2000s, and disaggregating by gender of the household head. Diversification is measured in terms of access to incomes from agriculture (farming), agricultural wage, self-employment (informal), wage employment and remittances. The analysis shows substantial and evolving variation in the effects of diversification across rural/urban locations and gender of the household head. Diversification became increasingly beneficial for welfare over time in rural areas, particularly for male headed households, but not for female headed households that diversified into agricultural wage employment. Diversification was also important for the livelihoods of urban households, but with large differences across male and female headed households likely reflecting differentials in the returns to non-agricultural employment. Remittances were associated with increasing welfare in the 2000s for all households, although the proportion of households receiving remittances has been declining.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用乌干达从1992/3到2011/12的五轮家庭调查数据，研究在持续经济增长和减贫时期，收入多样化及其对农村和城市家庭福利的影响，比较1990年代与2000年代，并按户主性别进行分解。多样化以获取农业（耕作）、农业工资、自雇（非正式）、工资就业和汇款收入的途径来衡量。分析显示，多样化效应在农村/城市地区和户主性别之间存在显著且不断变化的差异。随着时间的推移，多样化对农村地区家庭的福利越来越有益，特别是对男性户主家庭，但对那些多样化进入农业工资就业的女性户主家庭则不然。多样化对城市家庭的生计也很重要，但男性和女性户主家庭之间存在较大差异，这可能反映了非农就业回报的差异。在2000年代，汇款与所有家庭的福利增加相关，尽管收到汇款的家庭比例一直在下降。

records.title_en: The effects of crime and violence on food insecurity and consumption in Nigeria
records.title_cn: 犯罪与暴力对尼日利亚粮食不安全和消费的影响
records.abstract_en: Households living in conflict-affected areas are vulnerable to violence and crime perpetrated by various types of actors. By exploiting variation in the timing, intensity, and spatial distribution of attacks against households in Nigeria, this study finds that becoming a victim leads to higher food insecurity and decreased food and non-food consumption. Property crimes are more detrimental to consumption and food insecurity than violence is. The findings remain robust to accounting for conflict in the geographical proximity to the household. Our results indicate that information on victimization can be used for building safety nets in conflict-affected areas.
records.abstract_cn: 生活在受冲突影响地区的家庭容易遭受各类行为者实施的暴力和犯罪。通过利用尼日利亚针对家庭的袭击在时间、强度和空间分布上的变化，本研究发现成为受害者会导致更高的粮食不安全和食品及非食品消费的减少。财产犯罪对消费和粮食不安全的影响比暴力更为严重。在考虑家庭地理邻近区域的冲突后，研究结果依然稳健。我们的结果表明，受害信息可用于在受冲突影响地区建立安全网。

records.title_en: Earn a living? What the Côte d’Ivoire–Ghana cocoa living income differential might deliver on its promise
records.title_cn: 谋生？科特迪瓦-加纳可可生活收入差价可能兑现其承诺
records.abstract_en: Despite the high value of the global chocolate market and the high profitability of the few multinational companies dominating it, the farmers growing cocoa beans remain poor. To change this, the two biggest cocoa producers, Côte d’Ivoire and Ghana, have jointly introduced the cocoa Living Income Differential (LID) policy. Charging higher prices for beans, the policy might help mitigate both poverty and the serious child labour and deforestation issues associated with cocoa farming, for which poverty is regarded as a root cause. Nevertheless, the design of the policy and the current lack of complementary measures raise doubts about the success and longevity of the policy and concerns about the implications for farmers in other countries. Accounting for the repercussions with international cocoa markets, this study quantifies the magnitude of the policy’s effects in the LID countries and elsewhere under several alternative configurations of policies and market reactions with the support of model simulations and finds increases in farmer income ranging from zero to sizeable. Discussing the policy’s potential impacts in the past and present context of the cocoa industry, it identifies a number of issues threatening its sustainability. Moreover, it underlines the strong dependence of the policy’s success on chocolate manufacturers’ support unless complemented by supply management measures. Such measures could limit the aggravation of, or even improve, the income situation for farmers elsewhere and the child labour and deforestation issues.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管全球巧克力市场价值高昂，且主导该市场的少数跨国公司盈利能力很强，但种植可可豆的农民仍然贫困。为了改变这一状况，两大可可生产国科特迪瓦和加纳联合推出了可可生活收入差价（LID）政策。该政策对可可豆收取更高的价格，可能有助于缓解贫困以及与可可种植相关的严重童工和森林砍伐问题，而贫困被视为这些问题的根源。然而，该政策的设计以及目前缺乏配套措施，使人们对政策的成功和持久性产生怀疑，并担忧其对其他国家农民的影响。考虑到国际可可市场的连锁反应，本研究通过模型模拟，在几种不同的政策组合和市场反应情景下，量化了该政策在LID国家及其他地区的影响程度，发现农民收入的增加从零到可观不等。结合可可行业过去和现在的背景讨论该政策的潜在影响，本研究指出了若干威胁其可持续性的问题。此外，研究强调，除非辅以供应管理措施，否则该政策的成功在很大程度上取决于巧克力制造商的支持。此类措施可以限制甚至改善其他国家农民的收入状况以及童工和森林砍伐问题。

records.title_en: Consumers' preferences for commons-based and open-source produce: A discrete choice experiment with directional information manipulations
records.title_cn: 消费者对基于共有和开源农产品的偏好：一项带有方向性信息操纵的离散选择实验
records.abstract_en: The increasing privatization of seeds and varieties through intellectual property rights such as patents and exclusive seed multiplication rights has led to power imbalances and contributes to the continuous decline of genetic diversity. Diversified agricultural systems are, however, essential for climate change adaptation and the long-term resilience of our food systems. Common ownership of seeds and varieties can play a central role in supporting the development of diversified agricultural systems. With the first commons/open-source varieties entering consumer markets, consumer preferences and willingness-to-pay (WTP) for these varieties are worth exploring. On the example of tomatoes, we carried out a representative consumer survey with a discrete choice experiment. We find that consumers prefer commons/open-source varieties to company-owned varieties and are willing to pay a premium for these varieties. However, the premium they are willing to pay is smaller than for locally grown and organic produce. Providing additional information on the advantages of commons/open-source varieties positively affects WTP. There are no differences in WTP values for ‘commons varieties’ and ‘open-source varieties’. Our findings contribute to academic and policy discourses on consumers’ role in agrobiodiversity conservation and enhancement.
records.abstract_cn: 通过专利和独家种子繁殖权等知识产权，种子和品种的日益私有化导致了权力失衡，并加剧了遗传多样性的持续下降。然而，多样化的农业系统对于适应气候变化和我们粮食系统的长期韧性至关重要。种子和品种的共有所有权可以在支持多样化农业系统发展中发挥核心作用。随着首批共有/开源品种进入消费市场，消费者对这些品种的偏好和支付意愿（WTP）值得探讨。以番茄为例，我们进行了一项具有代表性的消费者调查，并采用了离散选择实验。我们发现，消费者偏好共有/开源品种而非公司拥有的品种，并愿意为这些品种支付溢价。然而，他们愿意支付的溢价低于本地种植和有机农产品。提供关于共有/开源品种优势的额外信息对支付意愿有积极影响。‘共有品种’和‘开源品种’的支付意愿值没有差异。我们的发现为关于消费者在农业生物多样性保护和增强中作用的学术和政策讨论做出了贡献。

records.title_en: From “good for people” to “good for people and planet” – Placing health and environment on equal footing when developing food-based dietary guidelines
records.title_cn: 从“有益于人类”到“有益于人类与地球”——在制定基于食物的膳食指南时将健康与环境置于同等地位
records.abstract_en: Dietary guidelines are a primary tool for promoting healthier and more sustainable diets. Despite several examples of dietary guidelines that consider - to various degrees - aspects of environmental sustainability, there is currently no framework that systematically incorporates environmental sustainability as a primary consideration. We present a five-step framework for developing environmentally sustainable dietary guidelines that would simultaneously meet nutritional requirements while staying within environmental boundaries. The steps comprise: 1) determining an average healthy diet for different population groups and criteria for healthy diets; 2) identifying relevant environmental aspects and establishing corresponding boundaries; 3) identifying systemic effects and crucial sustainability aspects; 4) altering the average diet to meet environmental goals and resolve trade-offs between environmental and nutritional goals; and 5) formulating sustainable food-based dietary guidelines. To exemplify the framework, we pilot it in the Swedish context, but it could be utilised for any other country.
records.abstract_cn: 膳食指南是促进更健康和更可持续饮食的主要工具。尽管有一些膳食指南在不同程度上考虑了环境可持续性的方面，但目前尚无系统地将环境可持续性作为首要考虑因素的框架。我们提出了一个五步框架，用于制定环境可持续的膳食指南，该指南将同时满足营养需求并保持在环境边界内。这些步骤包括：1）确定不同人群的平均健康饮食和健康饮食标准；2）识别相关的环境方面并建立相应的边界；3）识别系统性效应和关键可持续性方面；4）调整平均饮食以达到环境目标并解决环境与营养目标之间的权衡；以及5）制定可持续的基于食物的膳食指南。为举例说明该框架，我们在瑞典背景下进行了试点，但它也可用于任何其他国家。

records.title_en: A meta-analysis on the effectiveness of food-waste reducing nudges
records.title_cn: 关于减少食物浪费的助推措施有效性的元分析
records.abstract_en: Food waste is a global concern and is increasingly addressed by various policies and campaigns, especially in the consumption stage. Among these efforts, a promising instrument is gentle interventions based on nudges. To investigate whether and how a nudge works, we develop a theoretical framework and conduct a meta-analysis to synthesize empirical effects of nudges on reducing consumption food waste. The meta-analysis’s summary effect size of cognitively-oriented nudges is a 0.27 SD (Cohen’s d) reduction in food waste, and that of behaviorally-oriented ones is a 0.54 SD reduction. The effects of nudges are robust across sampled populations (i.e., U.S. vs. non-U.S. samples) but vary across settings (i.e., public vs. private). We further map nudge interventions to the driving factors of food waste behaviors and reveal potential research gaps in the literature. Based on these findings, we discuss implications for policy making to reduce food waste.
records.abstract_cn: 食物浪费是一个全球性问题，越来越多地通过各种政策和运动来解决，尤其是在消费阶段。在这些努力中，一种有前景的工具是基于助推的温和干预措施。为了探究助推是否以及如何发挥作用，我们开发了一个理论框架，并进行了一项元分析，以综合助推对减少消费性食物浪费的实证效果。元分析中，认知导向助推的汇总效应量为食物浪费减少0.27个标准差（Cohen's d），而行为导向助推的汇总效应量为减少0.54个标准差。助推的效果在不同抽样人群（即美国与非美国样本）中稳健，但在不同环境（即公共与私人）中存在差异。我们进一步将助推干预措施映射到食物浪费行为的驱动因素，并揭示了文献中潜在的研究空白。基于这些发现，我们讨论了减少食物浪费的政策制定启示。

records.title_en: A global view of aquaculture policy
records.title_cn: 水产养殖政策的全球视角
records.abstract_en: Aquaculture is among the most dynamic sectors in the global food system, yet it remains surprisingly under-represented in the mainstream literature on food policy. This article reviews 204 published articles and reports and shows that government policies have strongly influenced the geographic distribution of aquaculture growth, as well as the types of species, technology, management practices, and infrastructure adopted in different locations. Global cross-section studies reveal a broad spectrum of under- to over-regulated aquaculture systems that correspond, respectively, to high- and low-growth areas for aquaculture. The bulk of this paper centers on aquaculture policy as it plays out six individual countries plus the EU: Bangladesh, Zambia, Chile, China, USA, and Norway. These case studies shed light on aquaculture policies aimed at economic development, aquaculture disease management, siting, environmental performance, and trade protection. Experiences from these countries point to the need to find the right policy balance between semi-subsistence farms, small and medium enterprises (SME), and large-scale commercial operations, particularly in low-income settings. The cases also highlight the importance of addressing aquaculture disease pressures and misuse of antimicrobials in many parts of the world, and identifying successful aquaculture policy instruments and institutions that can be transferred between countries. The review underscores the challenges of establishing nutrition-sensitive aquaculture policies and of incorporating aquaculture directly into food policy and global food system dialogues and action.
records.abstract_cn: 水产养殖是全球食品体系中最具活力的部门之一，但在主流食品政策文献中却出人意料地代表性不足。本文回顾了204篇已发表的文章和报告，并表明政府政策强烈影响了水产养殖增长的地理分布，以及不同地点采用的物种、技术、管理实践和基础设施类型。全球横截面研究揭示了从监管不足到过度监管的水产养殖系统的广泛谱系，这些系统分别对应于水产养殖的高增长和低增长区域。本文的大部分内容集中在六个国家加上欧盟的水产养殖政策：孟加拉国、赞比亚、智利、中国、美国和挪威。这些案例研究揭示了旨在促进经济发展、水产养殖疾病管理、选址、环境绩效和贸易保护的水产养殖政策。这些国家的经验表明，需要找到半自给农场、中小企业和大型商业运营之间的适当政策平衡，特别是在低收入环境中。这些案例还强调了解决世界许多地区水产养殖疾病压力和抗菌药物滥用问题的重要性，以及识别可在国家间转移的成功水产养殖政策工具和制度。本综述强调了制定营养敏感型水产养殖政策以及将水产养殖直接纳入食品政策和全球食品体系对话与行动的挑战。

records.title_en: Real-time monitoring of food price policy interventions during the first two years of COVID-19
records.title_cn: COVID-19前两年食品价格政策干预的实时监测
records.abstract_en: COVID-19 has resulted in a shock to agrifood systems around the world, with the potential for low- and middle-income countries to be particularly affected. Although policy responses were more muted than during the 2007–2008 world food crisis, efforts to insulate from supply shocks and ensure local availability during COVID-19 have generally included export restrictions and import tariff reductions, among other responses. In an effort to enable rapid market monitoring and realignment, we develop a new indicator defined as a monthly nominal rate of protection “express” which seeks to indicate how policies enacted are affecting prices domestically in real-time in order to understand how they responded. This analysis examines changes to this indicator during the first two years of the pandemic in 24 low- and middle-income countries for the most-consumed staple cereals of the poor and food insecure. We show that gaps between domestic and international prices declined by a median of 20.3 percentage points compared to the same months in recent previous years. While policies were enacted to mitigate price increases that would have eventually been transmitted to poor consumers, other factors related to international demand and supply chain disruptions may also have contributed to the observed trend in the analyzed countries. Moreover, impacts on prices varied across countries and commodities, depending on region, net trade, and previous gap levels. Finally, this indicator can contribute to examining primary drivers of changes and conducting causal analysis to facilitate adequate agrifood policy responses to support economic recovery in the post-COVID-19 era.
records.abstract_cn: COVID-19对世界各地的农业食品系统造成了冲击，中低收入国家可能尤其受到影响。尽管政策反应比2007-2008年世界粮食危机期间更为温和，但在COVID-19期间，为隔离供应冲击和确保本地供应所做的努力通常包括出口限制和进口关税削减等措施。为了能够快速进行市场监测和重新调整，我们开发了一个新指标，定义为月度名义保护率“快速版”，旨在实时指示所实施的政策如何影响国内价格，以了解其反应。本分析考察了疫情前两年中24个中低收入国家最常消费的贫困和粮食不安全人群的主粮谷物的这一指标变化。我们显示，与最近前几年的同月相比，国内与国际价格之间的差距中位数下降了20.3个百分点。虽然实施政策是为了缓解最终可能传导给贫困消费者的价格上涨，但与国际需求和供应链中断相关的其他因素也可能对分析国家的观察趋势有所贡献。此外，价格影响因国家和大宗商品而异，取决于地区、净贸易和先前的差距水平。最后，该指标有助于考察变化的主要驱动因素并进行因果分析，以促进适当的农业食品政策反应，支持后COVID-19时代的经济复苏。

records.title_en: Indigenous bone fertilizer for growth and food security: A local solution to a global challenge
records.title_cn: 本土骨肥促进增长与粮食安全：应对全球挑战的地方解决方案
records.abstract_en: We examine the process of recycling the phosphorus that naturally occurs in animal bones, compare the cost of recycled phosphorus to that of conventional phosphorus fertilizer, and measure farmers’ willingness to pay for recycled phosphorus. In our research setting of rural Ethiopia, we reach three conclusions. First, we demonstrate that it is possible to make a suitable pelletized P fertilizer from animal bones. Second, we estimate that the recycled P fertilizer costs 16% to 39% less than importing conventional fertilizer. Third, we find that farmer’s willingness to pay for recycled phosphorus fertilizer is the same as that for conventional fertilizer.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了动物骨骼中天然存在的磷的回收过程，比较了回收磷与传统磷肥的成本，并衡量了农民对回收磷的支付意愿。在我们的研究背景——埃塞俄比亚农村中，我们得出三个结论。首先，我们证明利用动物骨骼可以制造出合适的颗粒状磷肥。其次，我们估计回收磷肥的成本比进口传统肥料低16%至39%。第三，我们发现农民对回收磷肥的支付意愿与传统肥料相同。

records.title_en: Food system labor and bargaining power
records.title_cn: 食品系统劳动力与议价能力
records.abstract_en: Historically, pandemics lead to labor shortages, and the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020-21 proved to be no different. While there are many explanations for supply-chain issues reported in a number of industries, the proximate cause for ongoing problems in producing, processing, and delivering food to consumers has been attributed to a lack of labor. If this is the case, then the apparent shortage is likely to manifest in greater bargaining power by workers in the food and agriculture industry, defined generally, during the COVID pandemic. In this paper, we test whether the COVID-19 pandemic is associated with greater bargaining power among food and agriculture workers using a structural model of labor search-and-bargaining, and examine the effect of policy responses to COVID-19 on labor-market outcomes. Using data from the American Community Survey (ACS, Bureau of Census) for wage outcomes in 2019 and 2020, we find that the COVID pandemic was responsible for a 5.7% increase in bargaining power for employed workers. Our counterfactual simulations examine the impact of two labor-market interventions – minimum-wages and unemployment insurance – on equilibrium wages. We find that lower minimum wages leave more employment surplus to employers, allowing them to bid up equilibrium wages, while more generous unemployment insurance reduces the supply of labor, and increases equilibrium wages.
records.abstract_cn: 历史上，流行病导致劳动力短缺，而2020-21年的COVID-19疫情也不例外。尽管对多个行业报告的供应链问题有多种解释，但生产、加工和向消费者交付食品的持续问题的直接原因被归因于劳动力缺乏。如果是这样，那么明显的短缺很可能在COVID疫情期间表现为食品和农业行业（广义定义）工人议价能力的增强。在本文中，我们使用劳动力搜索与议价的结构模型，检验COVID-19疫情是否与食品和农业工人议价能力的增强相关，并考察COVID-19政策应对措施对劳动力市场结果的影响。利用美国社区调查（ACS，人口普查局）2019年和2020年的工资结果数据，我们发现COVID疫情导致就业工人议价能力增加了5.7%。我们的反事实模拟考察了两种劳动力市场干预措施——最低工资和失业保险——对均衡工资的影响。我们发现，较低的最低工资给雇主留下更多的就业剩余，使他们能够抬高均衡工资，而更慷慨的失业保险减少了劳动力供给，并提高了均衡工资。

records.title_en: Interplay between China’s grain self-sufficiency policy shifts and interregional, intertemporal productivity differences
records.title_cn: 中国粮食自给政策转变与区域间、跨期生产率差异的相互作用
records.abstract_en: In 2013, the Communist Party of China decided to partially relax its self-sufficiency targets for grain, historically first recognizing moderate imports as a policy option for ensuring food security in the country. This study empirically examines the interplay between the policy shifts and the interregional, intertemporal productivity differences in Chinese agriculture. It employs a meta-frontier stochastic output distance function approach. Our empirical result shows that input augmentation was the main contributor to the agricultural output growth during 1984–2000, whereas total factor productivity is the main driver of the growth during 2001–2020. This lends strong support to an argument in the literature that Chinese crop production has recently transformed from a resource-input-driven activity to one driven by science and technology. Our study also demonstrates that the western region, which far lagged behind others in the past in terms of agricultural technology, has made remarkable progress during 2001–2020, which confirms the cross-regional productivity convergence over time. It is likely that farmers in this region were better able to gain a higher economic return from crop diversification into horticulture, for which they might have been all the more motivated to improve their productivity.
records.abstract_cn: 2013年，中国共产党决定部分放宽粮食自给目标，历史上首次将适度进口视为确保国家粮食安全的政策选项。本研究实证考察了政策转变与中国农业区域间、跨期生产率差异之间的相互作用。研究采用元前沿随机产出距离函数方法。实证结果表明，1984-2000年间，投入扩张是农业产出增长的主要贡献因素，而2001-2020年间，全要素生产率是增长的主要驱动力。这有力支持了文献中的一种观点，即中国作物生产近年来已从资源投入驱动型活动转变为科技驱动型活动。本研究还表明，过去在农业技术方面远远落后的西部地区在2001-2020年间取得了显著进步，这证实了跨区域生产率随时间的趋同。该地区农民可能更能从作物多样化转向园艺作物中获得更高的经济回报，这或许更加激励他们提高生产率。

records.title_en: Willing or complying? The delicate interplay between voluntary and mandatory interventions to promote farmers' environmental behavior
records.title_cn: 愿意还是顺从？自愿与强制性干预在促进农民环境行为中的微妙互动
records.abstract_en: Agri-environmental policies generally build around two complementary approaches: mandatory requirements and (compensated) voluntary measures. One of the challenges of the future EU Common Agricultural Policy is precisely to find the right balance between these two types of interventions. We conducted an experiment with farmers in three EU Member States to assess the impact of (1) increasing mandatory contributions to the environment, and of (2) decreasing unconditional income support. We also assess the effect of two key behavioural factors: environmental concern and trait reactance. Results show that both interventions reduce voluntary contributions to the environment, but the reduction is higher when mandatory contributions increase than when income decreases.. However, when mandatory contribution increases substantially, this more than offsets the reduction of voluntary contributions, leading to higher total contributions.
records.abstract_cn: 农业环境政策通常围绕两种互补的方法构建：强制性要求和（补偿性的）自愿措施。未来欧盟共同农业政策的挑战之一正是要在这两类干预之间找到适当的平衡。我们在三个欧盟成员国对农民进行了一项实验，以评估（1）增加对环境的强制性贡献，以及（2）减少无条件收入支持的影响。我们还评估了两个关键行为因素的影响：环境关注和特质抗拒。结果表明，两种干预都减少了自愿的环境贡献，但强制性贡献增加时的减少幅度大于收入减少时。然而，当强制性贡献大幅增加时，这超过了对自愿贡献减少的抵消，导致总贡献更高。

records.title_en: Mobile Phones and Mozambique Traders: Size, Composition and Distribution of Reduced Transaction Costs
records.title_cn: 手机与莫桑比克贸易商：交易成本降低的规模、构成与分布
records.abstract_en: I use unique transport cost data along with spatial market prices to measure the size, composition and distribution of reduced transactions costs due to the roll-out of the mobile phone network in Mozambique. My estimations are based on weekly transport costs of maize grain and weekly maize market prices. The mobile phone roll-out explains a 9%-15% reduction in the spatial price dispersion of maize. The evidence suggests that 70% to 80% comes from lower transport costs. Traders use mobile phones for multiple alternative purposes which explains the large contribution of transport costs. The evidence also indicates that the reduction in spatial price dispersion corresponds with a relatively large drop in destination markets’ prices: the benefits of mobile phones appear to accrue mainly to urban consumer markets and much less to producer areas. My results are robust for the non-random roll-out of the mobile phone network and several other threats, and align with evidence found elsewhere in the literature.
records.abstract_cn: 我利用独特的运输成本数据以及空间市场价格来衡量莫桑比克移动电话网络推广所导致的交易成本降低的规模、构成与分布。我的估计基于玉米谷物的每周运输成本和每周玉米市场价格。移动电话的推广解释了玉米空间价格离散度降低的9%-15%。证据表明，其中70%至80%来自较低的运输成本。贸易商将手机用于多种替代目的，这解释了运输成本的巨大贡献。证据还表明，空间价格离散度的降低与目的地市场价格的相对大幅下降相对应：移动电话的收益似乎主要归于城市消费市场，而生产者地区受益较少。我的结果对于移动电话网络的非随机推广及其他若干威胁是稳健的，并与文献中其他地方发现的证据一致。

records.title_en: Employment and wage effects of sugar-sweetened beverage taxes and front-of-package warning label regulations on the food and beverage industry: Evidence from Peru
records.title_cn: 含糖饮料税和包装正面警示标签法规对食品饮料行业就业和工资的影响：来自秘鲁的证据
records.abstract_en: Peru increased its sugar-sweetened beverage tax by 8 percentage points (from 17% to 25%) in 2018 and in 2019 imposed front-of-package warning labels on processed and ultra-processed foods and beverages high in sugar, saturated fats, and sodium or containing trans fats. We assess the pre-COVID-19 impacts of these two policies on aggregate formal employment and average wages in the food and beverage industry. In the analysis we use monthly administrative data from the Ministry of Labor in Peru for 127 manufacturing industries from January 2016 through February 2020 and pair an interrupted time series analysis with the synthetic control method. Overall we find that the sugar-sweetened beverage tax increase and the front-of-package label regulations did not result in job or wage losses. These results are consistent with outcomes from previous studies that have separately looked at the effects of sugar-sweetened beverage taxes (in the United States and Mexico) and front-of-package label regulations (in Chile). Our key contribution is that we assess the effects of both policies for the same country. Consistent with the global literature, our findings suggest that, due to industry substitutions and other actions, employment and wages were not impacted even in industries affected by both policies in a short time. The lack of job and wage losses in the Peruvian experience, the scope of the country’s policies, and the form of implementation can advise other countries engaging in similar reforms.
records.abstract_cn: 秘鲁在2018年将含糖饮料税提高了8个百分点（从17%提高到25%），并于2019年对高糖、高饱和脂肪、高钠或含反式脂肪的加工和超加工食品及饮料实施包装正面警示标签。我们评估了这两项政策在COVID-19之前对食品饮料行业总体正规就业和平均工资的影响。分析中，我们使用了秘鲁劳动部2016年一月至2020年二月期间127个制造业行业的月度行政数据，并将中断时间序列分析与合成控制法相结合。总体而言，我们发现含糖饮料税的提高和包装正面警示标签法规并未导致就业或工资损失。这些结果与先前分别研究含糖饮料税（在美国和墨西哥）和包装正面警示标签法规（在智利）影响的研究结果一致。我们的主要贡献在于评估了这两项政策在同一国家的影响。与全球文献一致，我们的研究结果表明，由于行业替代和其他行动，即使在短期内受到两项政策影响的行业，就业和工资也未受到影响。秘鲁经验中缺乏就业和工资损失、该国政策的范围以及实施形式，可以为其他进行类似改革的国家提供参考。

records.title_en: Recall information heterogeneity and perceived health risk: The impact of food recall on fresh meat market in the U.S
records.title_cn: 召回信息异质性与感知健康风险：美国鲜肉市场食品召回的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the heterogeneous impact of various recall information on consumers’ perceived health risks and quantifies the overall impact of food recalls on demand. Using the fresh meat market as a case study, this paper formulates a structural random coefficient discrete choice model of consumer demand. Among various characteristics of food recalls, our focuses are the number of recalls and the volume of food recalled. In addition to the latest recall information, the historical recall information may also change consumers’ perception of health risks and we include the interaction terms of the historical recall information and the latest recall information into the model. Results show that both the number of recalls and the volume of food recalled have negative and significant effects on the demand. Historical recalls are also important to mitigate the negative impact of the latest recalls on the market. To minimize the negative impact of recalls, the highest priority should be given to preventing large-scale recalls, Class I recalls, product contamination recalls, and recalls due to being produced without benefit of inspection or import violation. Food companies should take the initiative to recall when problems arise. Further, simulation results imply that the number of recalls plays a much larger role than the volume of food recalled in meat demand.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了不同召回信息对消费者感知健康风险的异质性影响，并量化了食品召回对需求的总体影响。以鲜肉市场为案例，本文构建了一个结构化的随机系数离散选择模型来刻画消费者需求。在食品召回的各种特征中，我们重点关注召回次数和被召回食品的数量。除了最新的召回信息外，历史召回信息也可能改变消费者对健康风险的认知，我们将历史召回信息与最新召回信息的交互项纳入模型。结果表明，召回次数和被召回食品的数量对需求均有显著的负向影响。历史召回对于缓解最新召回对市场的负面影响也很重要。为最小化召回的负面影响，应优先防止大规模召回、I级召回、产品污染召回以及因未经检验或违反进口规定而生产的召回。食品企业在出现问题时应主动召回。此外，模拟结果表明，在肉类需求中，召回次数所起的作用远大于被召回食品的数量。

records.title_en: The crop insurance demand response to premium subsidies: Evidence from U.S. Agriculture
records.title_cn: 作物保险需求对保费补贴的响应：来自美国农业的证据
records.abstract_en: Premium subsidies are a common policy tool to promote crop insurance participation in many countries. However, the relationship between subsidies and demand is not entirely obvious given the variation in the use of subsidies and crop insurance participation within the international crop insurance landscape. Focusing on the U.S. Federal Crop Insurance Program (FCIP) demand is modeled as a system of equations representing decisions at the intensive [coverage level] and extensive [net insured acres] margins. The model makes use of an identification strategy that leverages exogenous variation in government-set pricing policy to address potential sources of endogeneity. Applying the model to over one million insurance pool level FCIP observations spanning two decades (2001–2022) suggest an inelastic response at both extensive and intensive margins to changes in producer-paid premium rates with the response to premium rates becoming increasingly more elastic as subsidies decrease. These estimated elasticities are on the low end compared to previous literature, however, significant heterogeneity across commodity, production practices, policy type, and location are observed suggesting subsets of producers are likely to respond to changes in the cost of insurance in different ways.
records.abstract_cn: 保费补贴是许多国家促进作物保险参与度的常见政策工具。然而，鉴于国际作物保险格局中补贴使用和作物保险参与度的差异，补贴与需求之间的关系并不完全明显。聚焦于美国联邦作物保险计划（FCIP），需求被建模为一个方程组，代表集约边际（保障水平）和粗放边际（净投保面积）上的决策。该模型利用了一种识别策略，该策略利用政府设定的定价政策中的外生变化来解决潜在的内生性来源。将该模型应用于跨越二十年（2001-2022年）的超过一百万个保险池层面的FCIP观测值，结果表明，在粗放边际和集约边际上，对生产者支付的保费率变化的响应均缺乏弹性，且随着补贴减少，对保费率的响应变得越来越有弹性。与以往文献相比，这些估计的弹性处于较低端，然而，观察到商品、生产实践、政策类型和地点之间存在显著的异质性，这表明生产者子集可能以不同方式对保险成本的变化做出响应。

records.title_en: Where is the value? The impacts of sow gestation crate laws on pork supply and consumer value perceptions
records.title_cn: 价值何在？母猪妊娠限位栏法律对猪肉供应和消费者价值感知的影响
records.abstract_en: Despite varying farm animal welfare laws being enacted and considered, it is unclear and unknown whether they generate sufficient benefits to justify their costs. This study asks how sow gestation crate laws that dictate minimum crate size, a particular farm animal welfare law, impact meat production and the subsequent value that consumers place on meat produced under the laws. An observational analysis leverages the 8 states that have implemented laws regarding gestating sow crates in a difference-in-differences framework using staggered adoption robust estimators. We then perform a consumer preference experiment using a contingent valuation design with treatment effects to separate out the heterogeneous beliefs about animal welfare law effects. The results of the study show that such laws initially reduce gross income and supply, but only gross income recovers. For consumers, they value the corresponding pork products more in accordance with their animal welfare beliefs but not quality. Such information on costs and benefits should be considered in future laws relating to gestation crate bans.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管各种农场动物福利法律被制定和考虑，但尚不清楚它们是否产生足够的效益以证明其成本合理。本研究探讨了规定最小限位栏尺寸的母猪妊娠限位栏法律（一种特定的农场动物福利法律）如何影响肉类生产以及消费者对依据该法律生产的肉类所赋予的价值。一项观察性分析利用已实施关于妊娠母猪限位栏法律的8个州，在交错采用稳健估计器的双重差分框架下进行。随后，我们进行了一项消费者偏好实验，采用条件价值评估设计并设置处理效应，以分离关于动物福利法律效果的异质性信念。研究结果表明，此类法律最初会减少总收入和供应量，但只有总收入会恢复。对于消费者而言，他们根据其动物福利信念而非质量，对相应猪肉产品的价值评价更高。这些关于成本和效益的信息应在未来涉及限位栏禁令的法律中予以考虑。

records.title_en: Culture and agricultural biodiversity conservation
records.title_cn: 文化与农业生物多样性保护
records.abstract_en: Farmers’ behavior towards sustainable agricultural production is key to reducing the environmental footprint of agriculture and conserving biodiversity. We investigate the causal effect of culture on pro-environmental behaviors of farmers, and how policy instruments interact with culture to influence behavior. We exploit a unique natural experiment in Switzerland, which consists of two parts. First, there is an inner-Swiss cultural border between German- and French-speaking farmers who share the same natural environment, economy, and institutions, but differ culturally in their norms and values. Second, we exploit the effects of an agri-environmental policy reform that increased the monetary incentives to enroll land into biodiversity conservation. Using a spatial difference-in-discontinuities design and panel census data of all Swiss farms between 2010 and 2017, we show the following findings: Before the reform, farmers on the French-speaking side of the cultural border systematically enrolled less land into biodiversity conservation, compared to the German-speaking side. With increased monetary incentives following the policy reform in 2014, the French-speaking farmers enrolled relatively more additional land than the German-speaking farmers, shrinking the discontinuity. These findings indicate that while there exist cultural differences in pro-environmental behaviors, increased monetary incentives can reduce the importance of cultural differences. We discuss the implications for policy.
records.abstract_cn: 农民对可持续农业生产的行为是减少农业环境足迹和保护生物多样性的关键。我们研究了文化对农民亲环境行为的因果效应，以及政策工具如何与文化相互作用影响行为。我们利用了瑞士的一个独特自然实验，该实验包含两部分。首先，在瑞士内部，德语区和法语区农民之间存在一条文化边界，他们共享相同的自然环境、经济和制度，但在规范和价值观上存在文化差异。其次，我们利用了一项农业环境政策改革的影响，该改革增加了将土地纳入生物多样性保护的货币激励。使用空间断点回归不连续设计以及2010年至2017年间所有瑞士农场的面板普查数据，我们展示了以下发现：改革前，文化边界法语区的农民系统性地将较少的土地纳入生物多样性保护，与德语区相比。随着2014年政策改革后货币激励的增加，法语区农民相对增加了更多额外土地，缩小了这一不连续性。这些发现表明，虽然亲环境行为存在文化差异，但增加的货币激励可以减少文化差异的重要性。我们讨论了对政策的启示。

records.title_en: Review: Purchased agricultural input quality and small farms
records.title_cn: 综述：购买的农业投入品质量与小农户
records.abstract_en: Adoption of non-labor agricultural inputs remains low among small-scale farmers in many low-income countries. Accurate measurement of the quality of these inputs and quantities used is essential for assessing economic returns, understanding the drivers of agricultural productivity, and proposing and evaluating policies for increasing agricultural production. We review evidence regarding the quality of planting material, fertilizer and pesticides used by small farmers in low-income countries with a focus on Sub-Saharan Africa where the literature is most extensive. We distill four key findings. First, empirical evidence to date has centered on a limited set of agricultural inputs and locations. Second, some of this evidence is difficult to evaluate or may be misleading because best testing practices either were not followed or were not sufficiently documented. Third, while farmers are generally suspicious about input quality and therefore may hesitate to invest, these beliefs may exaggerate the severity of the problem. Farmers may attribute too much blame to poor quality inputs for bad crop yield outcomes. Fourth, most evidence comes from on-farm or in-shop samples; where input quality issues emerge at these downstream stages it is typically unclear where and how problems enter the upstream supply chain. We argue that while accurate documentation of measured and perceived agricultural input quality is important, the marginal productivity effects of input use hinge on the timing and method of application and on a host of complementary inputs (e.g., soils, moisture, labor). We conclude with specific priorities for future research that are linked to these key findings.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入国家，小农户对非劳动农业投入品的采用率仍然较低。准确衡量这些投入品的质量和使用数量对于评估经济回报、理解农业生产率的驱动因素以及提出和评估增加农业生产的政策至关重要。我们回顾了关于低收入国家小农户使用的种植材料、化肥和农药质量的证据，重点关注文献最为丰富的撒哈拉以南非洲地区。我们提炼出四个关键发现。第一，迄今为止的经验证据集中在有限的农业投入品种类和地点上。第二，其中一些证据难以评估或可能具有误导性，因为最佳测试实践要么未被遵循，要么未被充分记录。第三，虽然农民通常对投入品质量持怀疑态度，因此可能犹豫是否投资，但这些信念可能夸大了问题的严重性。农民可能将作物产量不佳的结果过多归咎于投入品质量差。第四，大多数证据来自农场或商店内的样本；当投入品质量问题在这些下游阶段出现时，通常不清楚问题在何处以及如何进入上游供应链。我们认为，虽然准确记录测量和感知的农业投入品质量很重要，但投入品使用的边际生产力效应取决于施用的时间和方法以及一系列互补投入品（例如土壤、水分、劳动力）。最后，我们提出了与这些关键发现相关的未来研究的具体优先事项。

records.title_en: The impact of peer effect on students' consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages- instrumental variable evidence from north China
records.title_cn: 同伴效应对学生含糖饮料消费的影响——来自中国北方的工具变量证据
records.abstract_en: Sugar intake is approaching problematic levels among Chinese children and adolescents. Chinese governments have issued and supervised the implementation of relevant administrative regulations, which have not achieved good results. Peers are the most important social factors influencing children and adolescents' behavior and decision-making besides family members. This study examines how the peer effect impacts SSB consumption. To clarify this relationship, we use the nutritional cognition of peers' parents as an instrumental variable to resolve the endogeneity problem and employ the two-stage least squares estimation method to investigate the data of 4,118 students in north China. The results show a significant positive correlation between sugar intake among peers, indicating that individuals are more likely to consume excessive amounts of sugar when their peers also engage in this behavior. We find that the peer effect is enhanced with increased popularity among one's peers and gradually decreases as the distance within the social network increases. It is also more significant in short-term friendships than in long-term friendships. Our findings provide a basis for school-level intervention programs from the perspective of social interaction to regulate healthy eating behaviors and nutritional perceptions among children and adolescents through peer relationships. It also confirms the feasibility of reducing individual sugar intake by increasing nutritional awareness among adolescents and parents.
records.abstract_cn: 中国儿童和青少年的糖摄入量正接近问题水平。中国政府已发布并监督实施相关行政法规，但未取得良好效果。同伴是除家庭成员外影响儿童和青少年行为及决策的最重要社会因素。本研究考察同伴效应如何影响含糖饮料消费。为阐明这一关系，我们使用同伴父母的营养认知作为工具变量来解决内生性问题，并采用两阶段最小二乘估计方法研究中国北方4,118名学生的数据。结果表明，同伴间的糖摄入量存在显著正相关，表明当同伴也摄入过量糖时，个体更可能摄入过量糖。我们发现，同伴效应随着个体在同伴中受欢迎程度的提高而增强，并随着社交网络内距离的增加而逐渐减弱。在短期友谊中，同伴效应也比长期友谊中更为显著。我们的研究结果为学校层面的干预项目提供了依据，从社会互动的角度，通过同伴关系调节儿童和青少年的健康饮食行为和营养认知。这也证实了通过提高青少年和父母的营养意识来减少个体糖摄入量的可行性。

records.title_en: Evaluating cereal market (dis)integration in less developed and fragile markets: The case of Sudan
records.title_cn: 评估欠发达和脆弱市场中的谷物市场（非）一体化：苏丹案例
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates spatial market integration in cereal markets in Sudan, focusing on wheat and sorghum, two major cereal crops. Sudan’s context provides important insights on the functioning of markets in economies marred by sanctions, conflicts, soaring inflation, and macroeconomic imbalances. We use long-ranging monthly cereal price data and a vector of error-correction cointegration model (VECM) to characterize both short-term and long-term spatial price adjustment across cereal markets. Among the 15 wheat and 18 sorghum markets considered, we can only detect significant spatial market integration among 6 wheat and 11 sorghum markets. Despite some strong spatial market integration among a few neighboring markets, there is no spatial market integration between several markets, including between major wheat consumption and production hotspots. For example, cereal markets in Darfur are not integrated with cereal markets in the rest of the country, despite exhibiting some level of spatial integration within the Darfur region. Finally, we also observe relatively stronger spatial market integration in sorghum markets than in wheat markets. These findings have important policy implications for improving the efficiency of cereal markets in Sudan and other comparable settings.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了苏丹谷物市场的空间市场一体化，重点关注小麦和高粱这两种主要谷物作物。苏丹的背景为受制裁、冲突、恶性通货膨胀和宏观经济失衡困扰的经济体中的市场运作提供了重要见解。我们使用长期月度谷物价格数据和误差修正协整模型（VECM）来刻画谷物市场间短期和长期的空间价格调整。在考虑的15个小麦市场和18个高粱市场中，我们仅能检测到6个小麦市场和11个高粱市场之间存在显著的空间市场一体化。尽管少数邻近市场之间存在较强的空间市场一体化，但多个市场之间，包括主要小麦消费和生产热点地区之间，不存在空间市场一体化。例如，达尔富尔的谷物市场与该国其他地区的谷物市场并未一体化，尽管在达尔富尔地区内部表现出一定程度的空间一体化。最后，我们还观察到高粱市场的空间市场一体化程度相对强于小麦市场。这些发现对于提高苏丹及其他类似环境中谷物市场效率具有重要的政策意义。

records.title_en: Agri-food importing firms amid a global health crisis
records.title_cn: 全球健康危机中的农产品进口企业
records.abstract_en: This paper exploits daily customs transaction data on the universe of Swiss agri-food importing firms to assess the response of firms to a global shock. Estimating a linear model that regresses product-level import margins on daily COVID19 shocks and a host of fixed effects, we find that the pandemic had a substantial trade-reducing effect on imports. The trade effects were driven mainly by a reduction in the number of importing firms (i.e., 63% of the total effect), and much less by the number of products imported and the average import value per product per firm. We explore several sources of heterogeneity and show, among others, that larger and incumbent firms were affected more by the trade adjustments. Our results also reveal that the relative contribution of each import margin to the decline in aggregate imports depends on the level of data aggregation (i.e., daily, weekly or monthly). Finally, we validate and confirm our main findings by testing two mechanisms: (i) third-country supply-side effects using insights from structural gravity models and (ii) changes to consumer demand using consumer mobility, and retailer and consumer scanner data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用瑞士农产品进口企业全样本的每日海关交易数据，评估企业对全球冲击的反应。通过估计一个将产品层面的进口边际回归于每日COVID19冲击及一系列固定效应的线性模型，我们发现疫情对进口产生了显著的贸易减少效应。贸易效应主要由进口企业数量的减少驱动（占总效应的63%），而产品进口数量和企业每产品平均进口价值的影响较小。我们探讨了多种异质性来源，并表明，在其他因素中，规模较大和现有企业受贸易调整的影响更大。我们的结果还揭示，每个进口边际对总进口下降的相对贡献取决于数据聚合的水平（即每日、每周或每月）。最后，我们通过测试两种机制来验证并确认我们的主要发现：（i）使用结构引力模型的见解来检验第三国供应侧效应，以及（ii）使用消费者流动性、零售商和消费者扫描数据来检验消费者需求的变化。

records.title_en: Processed foods, socio-economic status, and peri-urban obesity in India
records.title_cn: 印度的加工食品、社会经济地位和城郊肥胖
records.abstract_en: The ‘State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World 2020′ report states that switching to healthy diets will both prevent backsliding into hunger and help countries meet their sustainability goals. In 2019–2020, 17 percent of India’s adult population was undernourished. At the same time, however, 23 percent of all adults were obese. The increasing prevalence of obesity implies that improving diets and reducing risks for obesity and non-communicable diseases (NCDs) is a major food security challenge for India in the coming years. Overconsumption of calories from processed foods is known to increase the risk of obesity. To gain insights into the dietary transition and its relationship with obesity, we use cross-sectional data from a primary socio-economic survey conducted in the rural-urban interface of Bangalore, a mega-city in India that is characterized by high economic development. We show that for women in lower-middle socio-economic status (SES) groups, higher share of calories from semi-processed foods (SPF) is associated with a higher prevalence of obesity, while excess consumption of calories from ultra-processed foods (UPF) is associated with a higher obesity prevalence among women in higher SES groups. Older women and women who consume above the recommended daily allowance (RDA) of calories are more vulnerable to excess calories from SPF consumption than younger women and women who consume less than the RDA of calories. Furthermore, a lower prevalence of obesity is observed among women who consume excess calories from SPF but engage in labor-intensive occupational activity. These results speak to the need for interventions that incentivize weight loss and increased physical activity. The result that SPF consumption is associated with an increased prevalence of obesity especially among lower-middle SES group calls for interventions that increase access to and affordability of healthy diets. Policy instruments such as diversifying the public distribution system (PDS) are important to improve accessibility and affordability of healthy diets. In addition, increasing sugar and processed food taxes and incentivizing companies to invest in culturally sensitive food labeling should be considered to shift consumer demand towards healthier diet choices.
records.abstract_cn: 《世界粮食安全和营养状况2020》报告指出，转向健康饮食既可以防止重新陷入饥饿，又可以帮助各国实现可持续发展目标。在2019-2020，17%的印度成年人口营养不良。然而，与此同时，23% 的所有成年人都肥胖。肥胖症患病率的日益增加意味着改善饮食并降低肥胖和非传染性疾病（NCD）风险是印度未来几年粮食安全的主要挑战。众所周知，过量摄入加工食品中的热量会增加肥胖的风险。为了深入了解饮食转变及其与肥胖的关系，我们使用了在班加罗尔城乡交界处进行的一项主要社会经济调查的横截面数据，班加罗尔是印度的一个以经济高度发展为特征的大城市。我们发现，对于中低社会经济地位（SES）群体的女性来说，来自半加工食品（SPF）的卡路里比例较高与较高的肥胖患病率相关，而来自超加工食品（UPF）的卡路里的过量消耗与较高社会经济地位群体的女性较高的肥胖患病率相关。与年轻女性和摄入热量低于建议每日摄入量 (RDA) 的女性相比，老年女性和摄入热量高于建议每日摄入量 (RDA) 的女性更容易因 SPF 摄入而摄入过量热量。此外，从 SPF 中摄入过量热量但从事劳动密集型职业活动的女性肥胖患病率较低。这些结果表明需要采取干预措施来激励减肥和增加体力活动。 SPF 消费与肥胖患病率增加相关，特别是在中低社会经济地位群体中，因此需要采取干预措施，增加健康饮食的获取和负担能力。公共分配系统（PDS）多样化等政策工具对于提高健康饮食的可及性和可负担性非常重要。此外，应考虑增加糖和加工食品的税收，并激励企业投资文化敏感的食品标签，以将消费者的需求转向更健康的饮食选择。

records.title_en: Slim or Plus-Size Burrito? A natural experiment of consumers’ restaurant choice
records.title_cn: 苗条还是加大号卷饼？消费者餐厅选择的自然实验
records.abstract_en: Anthropomorphic food labels, such as “Thin cookie” or “Fat burger”, are often used to describe the size and shape of food and have been shown to affect consumers’ food choices. More crucially, this effect may differ among vulnerable populations such as individuals with overweight and obesity due to self-image similitudes. We explore how anthropomorphic food labels influence the food choices of restaurant patrons with different weight status. We conduct a natural field experiment in a restaurant where the portion sizes in the menu are labeled using anthropomorphic human body features. Small/Large portions are presented as Slim/Regular in one treatment to reflect a desirable weight status. In a second treatment, Small/Large portions are presented as Regular/Plus Size to represent a less ideal weight status. Overall, we find that the Regular/Plus Size label increases the selection of small portions by 14.3 percentage points when objective portion size information is provided. In particular, individuals with overweight/obesity are 23.4 percentage points more likely to choose a small portion item under the Regular/Plus Size label compared to the Slim/Regular label. These results have marketing and policy implications for food labeling and their effect on food consumption among vulnerable populations.
records.abstract_cn: 拟人化的食品标签，如“薄饼干”或“胖汉堡”，常被用来描述食物的尺寸和形状，并已被证明会影响消费者的食品选择。更重要的是，这种效应可能在弱势群体中有所不同，例如超重和肥胖个体，因为存在自我形象相似性。我们探讨拟人化食品标签如何影响不同体重状况的餐厅顾客的食品选择。我们在一家餐厅进行了自然实地实验，菜单中的份量大小使用拟人化的人体特征进行标注。在一种处理中，小份/大份被呈现为苗条/常规，以反映理想的体重状况。在第二种处理中，小份/大份被呈现为常规/加大号，以代表不太理想的体重状况。总体而言，我们发现当提供客观份量信息时，常规/加大号标签使小份的选择增加了14.3个百分点。特别是，与苗条/常规标签相比，在常规/加大号标签下，超重/肥胖个体选择小份项目的可能性高出23.4个百分点。这些结果对食品标签及其对弱势群体食品消费的影响具有营销和政策意义。

records.title_en: Geographical Indications and Innovation: Evidence from EU regions
records.title_cn: 地理标志与创新：来自欧盟地区的证据
