We show how research on GEMR took off and developed in France and Belgium from the mid-1970s, before expanding all around Europe. We also argue that three main factors enabled the deployment of GEMR in Europe over the 1970s and 1980s. First, GEMR opened up research opportunities in areas in which European economists had specific interests (e.g., general equilibrium theory). Second, GEMR benefited from the support of some leading academic figures who mobilized institutional resources to keep stimulating research over years (e.g., Jacques Drèze, at the Center for Operations Research and Econometrics). Third, there were problems specific to the Old Continent that stimulated research on GEMR, namely persistent unemployment in Western Europe and planning in Eastern Europe.
records.abstract_cn: 与美国不同，欧洲是配给的一般均衡模型（GEMR）的温床。我们的目标是解释GEMR如何以及为何成为“欧洲特色”（Portes，1987：第1332页）。我们展示了GEMR研究如何从1970年代中期在法国和比利时起步并发展，随后扩展到整个欧洲。我们还认为，三个主要因素促成了GEMR在欧洲1970和1980年代的部署。首先，GEMR在欧洲经济学家具有特定兴趣的领域（如一般均衡理论）开辟了研究机会。其次，GEMR受益于一些领先学术人物的支持，他们调动机构资源以持续刺激多年的研究（例如，Jacques Drèze，在运筹与计量经济学中心）。第三，旧大陆特有的问题刺激了GEMR的研究，即西欧持续失业和东欧的计划经济。

records.title_en: The effects of uncertainty shocks: Implications of wealth inequality
records.title_cn: 不确定性冲击的影响：财富不平等的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether and how the effects of time-varying macroeconomic uncertainty depend on the distribution of wealth. I show that increases in wealth inequality amplify the responses to uncertainty shocks. Using deciles of the distribution of wealth along with a series of macroeconomic volatility for the United States, I find that consumption growth falls by approximately 0.25 percentage points more in response to a one standard deviation uncertainty shock when wealth inequality is high relative to when it is low. In order to understand the nonlinear effects of uncertainty on consumption growth, I consider a two-agent New Keynesian model. I calibrate this simple model to qualitatively match the empirical responses of consumption growth to a one standard deviation uncertainty shock and show that nominal rigidities are key to magnifying the effects of uncertainty under high wealth inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了时变宏观经济不确定性的影响是否以及如何取决于财富分配。我表明，财富不平等的加剧放大了对不确定性冲击的反应。利用美国财富分配十分位数以及一系列宏观经济波动性数据，我发现，当财富不平等程度较高时，消费增长对一标准差不确定性冲击的反应比不平等程度较低时大约多下降0.25个百分点。为了理解不确定性对消费增长的非线性影响，我考虑了一个双主体新凯恩斯模型。我将这个简单模型校准为定性地匹配消费增长对一标准差不确定性冲击的经验反应，并表明名义刚性是在高财富不平等下放大不确定性影响的关键。

records.title_en: Assignats or death: The politics and dynamics of hyperinflation in revolutionary France
records.title_cn: 指券或死亡：法国大革命时期恶性通货膨胀的政治与动态
records.abstract_en: Following a revolution precipitated by unsustainable government deficits, an explosion of paper money called the assignat caused a rapid increase in prices not seen in Europe again until the widespread adoption of discretionary fiat standards in the 20th century. The value of the assignat depended on the property the revolutionary government had expropriated to back it. The decision to retire the assignats from circulation using the revenue collected from the sale of the expropriated property was ultimately a political one. We examine how shifts in the political equilibrium affected the demand for the assignat and find evidence of two money demand shocks that correspond to the collapse of the political support for the assignats. Our estimates of the demand for the assignat indicate that the first shock reduced the demand for real balances by up to 70%. The second shock caused the negative relationship between real balances and inflation to break down entirely. Our results point to politics’ critical role in determining a currency’s fiscal backing and, thus, the demand for money.
records.abstract_cn: 在由不可持续的政府赤字引发的革命之后，被称为指券的纸币泛滥导致价格迅速上涨，这种上涨在欧洲直到20世纪广泛采用自由裁量的法定货币标准之前都未曾再次出现。指券的价值取决于革命政府为支持其而没收的财产。决定用出售被没收财产所得收入来回收指券，最终是一个政治决定。我们考察了政治均衡的变化如何影响对指券的需求，并发现了两次货币需求冲击的证据，这两次冲击与对指券政治支持的崩溃相对应。我们对指券需求的估计表明，第一次冲击使实际余额需求减少了高达70%。第二次冲击导致实际余额与通货膨胀之间的负向关系完全瓦解。我们的结果指出了政治在决定货币的财政支持以及由此产生的货币需求中的关键作用。

records.title_en: Worker selectivity and fiscal externalities from unemployment insurance
records.title_cn: 工人选择性与失业保险的财政外部性
records.abstract_en: A robust prediction of job search models is that unemployment insurance (UI) makes workers more selective about which jobs they accept, thereby raising average accepted wages and thus generating a positive fiscal externality. We provide a sufficient-statistics formula for evaluating the size of this selectivity effect and argue theoretically that it is likely to be small. In a standard sequential search model, the effect of UI on wages is linked to its effect on the job-finding hazard; the slope of the relationship between these elasticities depends on a small number of estimable statistics, key among them observed worker flows. Plausible calibrations of the model imply that the magnitude of the wage elasticity is small relative to the job-finding elasticity. Although ignoring the wage effect of UI would over-estimate its fiscal cost and under-estimate its welfare benefit, the model-implied formula predicts the magnitude of this bias to be small.
records.abstract_cn: 工作搜寻模型的一个稳健预测是，失业保险（UI）使工人在接受哪些工作方面更具选择性，从而提高平均接受工资，并由此产生正的财政外部性。我们提供了一个充分统计量公式来评估这种选择性效应的大小，并从理论上论证其可能很小。在标准序贯搜寻模型中，UI对工资的影响与其对工作找到率的影响相关联；这些弹性之间关系的斜率取决于少数可估计的统计量，其中关键的是观察到的工人流动。合理的模型校准表明，工资弹性的幅度相对于工作找到弹性较小。尽管忽略UI的工资效应会高估其财政成本并低估其福利收益，但模型隐含的公式预测这种偏差的幅度很小。

records.title_en: Asylum policies and international tensions
records.title_cn: 庇护政策与国际紧张关系
records.abstract_en: This article examines how international relation dynamics shape asylum policies. Using data on asylum applications in the European Union (EU) and international events from 1999 to 2017, we document that EU Member States admit relatively more refugees when diplomatic relations with the country of origin deteriorate. This result holds after controlling for push and pull factors as well as bilateral determinants of refugee migration. Our results highlight the importance of non-humanitarian factors in the grant of political asylum.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了国际关系动态如何影响庇护政策。利用1999年至2017年欧盟（EU）的庇护申请数据和国际事件数据，我们记录了当与来源国的外交关系恶化时，欧盟成员国接纳的难民相对更多。在控制了推动和拉动因素以及难民迁移的双边决定因素后，这一结果依然成立。我们的结果强调了非人道主义因素在授予政治庇护中的重要性。

records.title_en: Promise keeping and reliance damage
records.title_cn: 信守承诺与信赖损害
records.abstract_en: This paper experimentally investigates the hypothesis that promise-keeping behavior is affected by the “reliance damage” that a counterpart would suffer as a result of a breach. Reliance damage is defined as the difference between the counterfactual benefit that the counterpart would have obtained had they not relied on the promise and that which they would obtain following a breach. We discuss two motivational mechanisms that could drive such an effect. One is that people intrinsically dislike causing reliance damage per se. The other is that people dislike causing regret in another person. We experimentally test these ideas in the context of an experimental trust game. Our evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that promise keeping is affected by reliance damage, and that the underlying mechanism involves a desire not to cause regret in others.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过实验研究了信守承诺行为是否受到对方因违约而遭受的“信赖损害”影响的假设。信赖损害被定义为对方若未依赖承诺本可获得的反事实收益与违约后其将获得的收益之间的差额。我们讨论了可能驱动这种效应的两种动机机制。一种是人们本质上不喜欢造成信赖损害本身。另一种是人们不喜欢在他人身上引发后悔情绪。我们在实验性信任博弈的背景下对这些想法进行了实验检验。我们的证据与信守承诺受信赖损害影响，且其潜在机制涉及不希望给他人带来后悔的愿望这一假设相一致。

records.title_en: The effect of foreign students in higher education on native students’ outcomes
records.title_cn: 高等教育中外籍学生对本国学生成果的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper offers new evidence of the role of immigration in shaping the educational and labour market outcomes of natives. We use administrative data on the entire English higher education system and exploit the idiosyncratic variation of foreign students within university-degree across four cohorts of undergraduate students. Foreign peers have zero to mild effects on natives’ educational outcomes, such as graduation probability and degree classification. Significant effects are found on displacement across universities and degree types after enrolment, although these outcomes are rare occurrences. In line with the mild effects on education outcomes, we also find little evidence of foreign peers affecting early labour market outcomes of native graduates.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于移民在塑造本国居民教育与劳动力市场成果方面作用的新证据。我们使用英格兰整个高等教育系统的行政数据，并利用四届本科生中大学学位内留学生构成的特殊变动。外国同伴对本国学生的教育成果（如毕业概率和学位等级）影响为零到轻微。在入学后跨大学和学位类型的流动方面发现了显著影响，尽管这些结果较为罕见。与教育成果的轻微影响一致，我们也发现外国同伴对本国毕业生早期劳动力市场成果影响甚微的证据。

records.title_en: Macroeconomic effects of tax rate and base changes: Evidence from fiscal consolidations
records.title_cn: 税率与税基变动的宏观经济效应：来自财政整顿的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the macroeconomic effects of tax changes during fiscal consolidations. We build a new narrative dataset of tax changes during fiscal consolidation years, containing detailed information on the expected yield, motivation, and announcement and implementation dates of more than 2000 tax measures across 10 OECD countries. Using this data, we then analyze the macroeconomic impact of tax changes, distinguishing between tax rate and tax base changes, and further differentiating between changes in personal income, corporate income, and value added taxes. Our results suggest that base broadening during fiscal consolidations leads to smaller output and employment declines compared to rate hikes, even when distinguishing between tax types.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了财政整顿期间税收变动的宏观经济效应。我们构建了一个新的财政整顿年份税收变动的叙事数据集，包含超过2000项税收措施的预期收益、动机以及公告和实施日期的详细信息，覆盖10个OECD国家。利用这些数据，我们分析了税收变动的宏观经济影响，区分了税率变动和税基变动，并进一步区分了个人所得税、公司所得税和增值税的变动。我们的结果表明，与提高税率相比，财政整顿期间扩大税基导致的产出和就业下降幅度更小，即使在区分税种的情况下也是如此。

records.title_en: Estimating social preferences using stated satisfaction: Novel support for inequity aversion
records.title_cn: 使用陈述满意度估计社会偏好：对不公平厌恶的新支持
records.abstract_en: Experimental identification of social preferences often uses a revealed-preference approach, whereby participants make choices over payment distributions for themselves and others. We introduce an alternative “stated satisfaction” approach: participants directly report their satisfaction with various payment-profiles that hold their own payment constant while varying another participant's payment. We then use our data to estimate the unrestricted parameters of the Fehr and Schmidt (1999) model to determine participants’ social preferences. While the Fehr and Schmidt parameter-assumptions make it a model of inequity aversion, alternate parameter-assumptions can reflect different social preferences. Our methodology yields support for the Fehr and Schmidt assumptions (i.e., that both disadvantageous and advantageous inequity are utility-diminishing, the former more so than the latter) at both the aggregate and individual levels. Methodologically, eliciting satisfaction can be an easy-to-implement complement to choice-based preference-measures in contexts other than social preferences that are of interest to economists.
records.abstract_cn: 社会偏好的实验识别通常采用显示性偏好方法，即参与者对自己和他人的支付分配做出选择。我们引入了一种替代性的“陈述满意度”方法：参与者直接报告他们对各种支付组合的满意度，这些组合保持自己的支付不变，同时改变另一参与者的支付。然后我们使用数据来估计Fehr和Schmidt（1999）模型的无限制参数，以确定参与者的社会偏好。虽然Fehr和Schmidt的参数假设使其成为不公平厌恶模型，但替代参数假设可以反映不同的社会偏好。我们的方法在总体和个体层面上都支持Fehr和Schmidt的假设（即不利不公平和有利不公平都会降低效用，前者比后者更甚）。在方法论上，在经济学感兴趣的社会偏好以外的情境中，引出满意度可以作为一种易于实施的补充，补充基于选择的偏好测量方法。

records.title_en: Endogenous technology cycles in dynamic R&D networks
records.title_cn: 动态研发网络中的内生技术周期
records.abstract_en: We study the coevolutionary dynamics of knowledge creation and diffusion with the formation of R&D collaboration networks. The novel examination of a large R&D collaboration network over several decades reveals a pronounced oscillatory (cyclical) pattern in the R&D collaboration intensity, which is not captured by existing theoretical studies. Here, we propose a new model of R&D network formation in which firms form R&D collaborations with others possessing a complementary portfolio of technologies. Innovations and knowledge spillovers alter the composition of these portfolios over time, leading to changes in the network of R&D collaborations. We show that our model is not only able to explain the emergence of oscillatory dynamics in R&D networks, but also has important policy implications. First, we demonstrate that there exists a critical threshold level for spillovers between R&D collaborating firms that must be exceeded for R&D collaborations to effectively contribute to knowledge creation in the economy. The threshold indicates that policies promoting collaborative R&D can only be successful in fostering innovations if they are substantial enough so that spillovers are above the threshold. Second, policies strengthening competition in R&D networks are found to promote oscillatory fluctuations, potentially destabilizing the network.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了知识创造与扩散的协同演化动态，以及研发合作网络的形成。对大型研发合作网络跨越数十年的新颖考察揭示了研发合作强度中显著的振荡（周期）模式，而现有理论研究并未捕捉到这一点。在此，我们提出了一个新的研发网络形成模型，在该模型中，企业与其他拥有互补技术组合的企业建立研发合作。创新和知识溢出随时间改变这些组合的构成，导致研发合作网络发生变化。我们表明，我们的模型不仅能够解释研发网络中振荡动态的出现，而且具有重要的政策含义。首先，我们证明，研发合作企业之间的溢出存在一个临界阈值水平，必须超过该阈值，研发合作才能有效促进经济中的知识创造。该阈值表明，促进合作研发的政策只有在足够有力以使溢出高于阈值时，才能成功促进创新。其次，我们发现，加强研发网络竞争的政策会促进振荡波动，可能破坏网络的稳定性。

records.title_en: Reversal interest rate and macroprudential policy
records.title_cn: 逆转利率与宏观审慎政策
records.abstract_en: Could a monetary policy loosening in a low interest rate environment have unintended recessionary effects? Using a non-linear macroeconomic model fitted to the euro area economy, we show that the effectiveness of monetary policy can decline in negative territory until it reaches an endogenous turning point, where monetary policy becomes contractionary. The framework demonstrates that the risk of hitting the rate at which the effect reverses depends on the capitalization of the banking sector. The possibility of the reversal interest rate gives rise to a novel motive for macroprudential policy. We show that macroprudential policy in the form of a countercyclical capital buffer, which prescribes the build-up of buffers in good times, substantially mitigates the probability of encountering the reversal rate and increases the effectiveness of negative interest rate policies. This new motive emphasizes the strategic complementarities between monetary policy and macroprudential policy.
records.abstract_cn: 在低利率环境下，货币政策的宽松是否可能产生意想不到的衰退效应？通过使用一个拟合欧元区经济的非线性宏观经济模型，我们表明货币政策的有效性在负利率区间内可能下降，直至达到一个内生转折点，此时货币政策变得具有紧缩性。该框架表明，触及效应逆转利率的风险取决于银行部门的资本充足状况。逆转利率的可能性为宏观审慎政策提供了一个新的动机。我们表明，以逆周期资本缓冲形式存在的宏观审慎政策，即在经济繁荣时期积累缓冲，能够显著降低遭遇逆转利率的概率，并提高负利率政策的有效性。这一新动机强调了货币政策与宏观审慎政策之间的战略互补性。

records.title_en: Reducing the gender gap in early learning: Evidence from a field experiment in Norwegian preschools
records.title_cn: 缩小早期学习中的性别差距：挪威幼儿园的一项实地实验证据
records.abstract_en: Substantial gender differences in key academic skills appear even before children start formal schooling. Although increasing investments in early-childhood programs is motivated by efforts to promote equality of opportunity in education, program attendance seems to have less effect on boys. In this field experiment, we investigate whether a more structured curriculum can help preschools reduce the gender gap in early learning. While girls have higher skills at baseline, we find that the intervention primarily benefits boys, thereby reducing the gender skill gap, with effects persisting into formal schooling.
records.abstract_cn: 即使在儿童开始正式学校教育之前，关键学术技能方面就出现了显著的性别差异。尽管增加对早期儿童项目的投资是出于促进教育机会平等的动机，但项目参与似乎对男孩的影响较小。在这项实地实验中，我们调查了更结构化的课程是否有助于幼儿园缩小早期学习中的性别差距。虽然女孩在基线时技能较高，但我们发现干预措施主要惠及男孩，从而缩小了性别技能差距，且这种影响持续到正式学校教育阶段。

records.title_en: Between lives and economy: COVID-19 containment policy in open economies
records.title_cn: 生命与经济之间：开放经济体中的COVID-19防控政策
records.abstract_en: This paper studies containment policies for combating a pandemic in an open-economy context. It does so via quantitative analyses using a model that incorporates a standard epidemiological compartmental model in a general equilibrium multi-country, multi-sector Ricardian model of international trade with input–output linkages. We quantitatively evaluate the long-run welfare and real-income losses due to the short-run pandemic shocks, and we study the role of trade in these effects. We devise a novel approach to computing national optimal policies. We find that (1) the long-run welfare and real-income losses due to just two years of pandemic shocks are substantial; (2) international trade helps buffer both the welfare and real-income losses, and it also saves lives; (3) the computed optimal policies indicate that most countries should have tightened their containment measures relative to what was done; and (4) compared to the case of autarky, the optimal policy under trade is generally more stringent.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在开放经济体背景下抗击大流行的防控政策。通过定量分析，我们使用一个模型，该模型将标准流行病学舱室模型纳入具有投入产出联系的一般均衡多国、多部门李嘉图国际贸易模型中。我们定量评估了短期大流行冲击导致的长期福利和实际收入损失，并研究了贸易在这些影响中的作用。我们设计了一种计算国家最优政策的新方法。我们发现：（1）仅两年的大流行冲击导致的长期福利和实际收入损失是巨大的；（2）国际贸易有助于缓冲福利和实际收入损失，并且还能挽救生命；（3）计算出的最优政策表明，大多数国家应该比实际采取的措施更加收紧防控；（4）与自给自足的情况相比，贸易条件下的最优政策通常更为严格。

records.title_en: How do wealth–income ratios react to slowing growth in the long run? On Piketty’s second fundamental law of capitalism
records.title_cn: 财富-收入比率在长期内如何应对增长放缓？——论皮凯蒂的资本主义第二基本定律
records.abstract_en: Thomas Piketty and some of his coauthors have suggested an economic law named the Second Fundamental Law of Capitalism by Piketty, implying that a long-lasting and considerable growth slowdown will cause substantial increases in wealth–income ratios in the long run. Critics have pointed out that the reaction of wealth–income ratios depends on the reaction of saving/investment rates and, in particular, that sufficiently large decreases in these rates in response to a growth slowdown will revert the direction of Piketty’s law. We conduct a theoretical investigation in a framework that endogenizes the reaction of saving rates in a standard way and find support for a version of Piketty’s Second Law based on an exogenous gross saving rate, but not for Piketty’s original version assuming an exogenous net saving rate. Consequently, the reaction of wealth–income ratios to a substantial growth slowdown will be smaller than suggested by Piketty’s version of the law, but in the same direction and still substantial.
records.abstract_cn: 托马斯·皮凯蒂及其一些合著者提出了一个名为皮凯蒂资本主义第二基本定律的经济学定律，暗示长期且显著的增长放缓将导致长期内财富-收入比率大幅上升。批评者指出，财富-收入比率的反应取决于储蓄/投资率的反应，特别是，如果这些比率因增长放缓而大幅下降，将逆转皮凯蒂定律的方向。我们在一个以标准方式内生储蓄率反应的框架中进行了理论调查，发现支持基于外生总储蓄率的皮凯蒂第二定律版本，但不支持皮凯蒂原始版本中假设外生净储蓄率的版本。因此，财富-收入比率对显著增长放缓的反应将小于皮凯蒂定律版本所暗示的，但方向相同且仍然显著。

records.title_en: Does working from home work? A natural experiment from lockdowns
records.title_cn: 居家办公有效吗？来自封锁政策的自然实验
records.abstract_en: Using tracked changes from a large open-source software platform, this paper studies how working from home affected the output of individuals working in tech. The basis of the natural experiment comes from idiosyncratic and state-imposed workplace closures during the COVID-19 pandemic. I find a negative but almost-negligible change in individual-level output of 0.5 percent (standard error of 0.091 percent). Overall, and based on descriptive analyses of the time-stamped data, tracked changes in software development cadences approximate regular work activity and provide a useful avenue for future studies of work.
records.abstract_cn: 利用大型开源软件平台上的追踪变更，本文研究了居家办公如何影响科技行业从业者的产出。该自然实验的基础源于COVID-19疫情期间各州实施的、具有特异性的工作场所关闭政策。我发现个体层面的产出出现了负向但几乎可忽略的变化，为0.5%（标准误为0.091%）。总体而言，基于对带时间戳数据的描述性分析，软件开发节奏中的追踪变更近似于常规工作活动，并为未来的工作研究提供了有用的途径。

records.title_en: Do monetary condition news at the zero lower bound influence households’ expectations and readiness to spend?
records.title_cn: 零利率下限时的货币政策消息是否影响家庭预期和消费意愿？
records.abstract_en: We investigate how households update their interest rate and inflation expectations upon hearing monetary condition news, and to what extent this changes their readiness to spend. Using data from the Michigan Survey of Consumers from December 2008 to December 2015, we find (1) the likelihood of higher expected interest rates significantly increases upon hearing news of tighter monetary condition; (2) monetary condition news is irrelevant for both short- and medium-run inflation expectations; (3) the main information content of this perceived news is most likely from forward guidance and professional forecasts; and (4) households update their readiness to spend on houses, cars and durable goods upon perceiving monetary condition news. Our evidence points towards interest rate expectations as the most likely mediator through which monetary condition news drives households’ readiness to spend.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了家庭在听到货币政策消息后如何更新其利率和通胀预期，以及这在多大程度上改变了他们的消费意愿。利用密歇根消费者调查从2008年十二月至2015年十二月的数据，我们发现（1）在听到货币政策收紧的消息后，预期利率上升的可能性显著增加；（2）货币政策消息对短期和中期通胀预期均无影响；（3）这种感知消息的主要信息内容很可能来自前瞻性指引和专业预测；（4）家庭在感知到货币政策消息后会更新其对住房、汽车和耐用品的消费意愿。我们的证据表明，利率预期是货币政策消息驱动家庭消费意愿的最可能中介因素。

records.title_en: The effects of exposure to refugees on crime: Evidence from the Greek islands
records.title_cn: 难民涌入对犯罪的影响：来自希腊岛屿的证据
records.abstract_en: Recent political instability in the Middle East has triggered one of the largest influxes of refugees into Europe. The different departure points along the Turkish coast generate exogenous variation in refugee arrivals across Greek islands. We construct a new dataset on the number and nature of crime incidents and arrested offenders at island level using official police records and newspaper reports. Instrumental variables and difference-in-differences are employed to study the causal relationship between immigration and crime. We find that a 1-percentage-point increase in the share of refugees on destination islands increases crime incidents by 1.7–2.5 percentage points compared with neighboring unexposed islands. This is driven by crime incidents committed by refugees; there is no change in crimes committed by natives on those islands. We find a significant rise in property crime, knife attacks, and rape, but no increase in drug crimes. Results based on reported crimes exhibit a similar pattern. Our findings highlight the need for government provision in terms of infrastructure, social benefits, quicker evaluation for asylum, and social security.
records.abstract_cn: 中东近期的政治不稳定引发了欧洲最大规模的难民涌入之一。土耳其海岸的不同出发点在希腊各岛屿间产生了难民到达的外生变化。我们利用官方警察记录和报纸报道，构建了一个关于岛屿层面犯罪事件数量和性质及被捕罪犯的新数据集。采用工具变量法和双重差分法研究移民与犯罪之间的因果关系。我们发现，难民在目的地岛屿所占比例每增加1个百分点，与未受影响的邻近岛屿相比，犯罪事件增加1.7-2.5个百分点。这一增长由难民实施的犯罪事件驱动；这些岛屿上本地人实施的犯罪没有变化。我们发现财产犯罪、持刀袭击和强奸显著增加，但毒品犯罪没有增加。基于报案犯罪的结果呈现类似模式。我们的发现凸显了政府在基础设施、社会福利、加快庇护申请评估和社会保障方面提供支持的必要性。

records.title_en: The heterogeneous welfare effects of business cycles
records.title_cn: 经济周期波动的异质性福利效应
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the welfare effects of business cycle fluctuations from a distributional perspective. To this end, we develop a quantitative heterogeneous-agent model which incorporates market incompleteness and non-convexity into the mapping from the time devoted to work to labor services. In this setup, households can insure against aggregate uncertainty using labor and savings and have substantially different labor supply elasticities. We find that the welfare effects are heterogeneous across households, with wealth-rich households benefiting most from business cycles. Wealth-rich households enjoy business cycles more than wealth-poor households, because they experience less volatile consumption and can enjoy higher average income through reallocating savings intertemporally.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究从分配视角探讨经济周期波动的福利效应。为此，我们构建了一个定量异质性主体模型，该模型将市场不完全性和非凸性纳入从工作时间到劳动服务的映射中。在此设定下，家庭可以通过劳动和储蓄来对冲总体不确定性，并且具有显著不同的劳动供给弹性。我们发现，福利效应在家庭间是异质的，其中富裕家庭从经济周期中获益最多。富裕家庭比贫穷家庭更能享受经济周期，因为它们经历的消费波动较小，并且可以通过跨期重新配置储蓄来享受更高的平均收入。

records.title_en: The unbundling of journalism
records.title_cn: 新闻业的解捆绑
records.abstract_en: Due to the switching behavior of online consumers, news outlets increasingly compete with each other to attract audience for each single news item they produce, rather than for complete editions of their newspapers: the so called unbundling of journalism. Using a standard Hotelling model, I show that online competition unambiguously reduces news articles’ quality, as compared to the scenario in which outlets compete to sell their newspapers (content bundles) to single-homing consumers. The unbundling of journalism also dampens outlets’ newsgathering activities when their ideological positions are relatively unimportant from consumers’ viewpoint. In this case, consumers are worse off in the online market for news, even though they consume more articles and have low disutility from switching.
records.abstract_cn: 由于在线消费者的切换行为，新闻媒体越来越相互竞争，以吸引受众关注它们生产的每一条新闻，而不是它们的完整报纸版本：即所谓的新闻业解捆绑。使用标准的霍特林模型，我表明，与媒体竞争向单一归属消费者销售其报纸（内容捆绑）的情景相比，在线竞争明确降低了新闻文章的质量。当媒体的意识形态立场从消费者角度看相对不重要时，新闻业的解捆绑也削弱了媒体的新闻采集活动。在这种情况下，消费者在在线新闻市场中境况更差，尽管他们消费了更多文章，并且切换带来的负效用较低。

records.title_en: The effects of seemingly nonbinding price floors: An experimental analysis
records.title_cn: 看似非约束性价格下限的影响：一项实验分析
records.abstract_en: Price floors are common policies in markets for storable goods such as commodities, bankable emissions permits, and currencies. Hard price floors are implemented as unlimited government buybacks and prevent the price from falling below the floor; soft floors, whether implemented as limited buybacks or as reserve prices in emission permit auctions, allow the market price to fall below the floor. We specify and then test in the laboratory a two-period model with the same properties as our infinite-horizon model, Salant et al. (2022). Theory predicts that asset prices will respond to price floors even in a set of circumstances where the floor seems nonbinding. Most of our experimental findings are consistent with theoretical predictions: a seemingly nonbinding floor can cause the price and carryover to jump up, the jump is higher with a hard floor than a soft one, and when the floor is so low that the theory predicts no effect, none is observed. In contrast to theoretical predictions, however, the soft floor fails to increase the carryover and market price in our experiment.
records.abstract_cn: 价格下限是商品、可存储排放许可证和货币等可储存商品市场的常见政策。硬性价格下限通过政府无限回购实施，防止价格跌破下限；软性价格下限，无论是通过有限回购还是排放许可证拍卖中的保留价实施，都允许市场价格跌破下限。我们在实验室中设定并测试了一个两期模型，该模型与我们的无限期模型具有相同的性质，即Salant等人（2022）。理论预测，即使在价格下限看似非约束的情况下，资产价格也会对价格下限作出反应。我们的大部分实验结果与理论预测一致：看似非约束的下限可能导致价格和结转量跳升，硬性下限的跳升幅度高于软性下限，并且当下限低到理论预测无影响时，确实没有观察到影响。然而，与理论预测相反，在我们的实验中，软性下限未能增加结转量和市场价格。

records.title_en: Diamond–Dybvig and beyond: On the instability of banking
records.title_cn: 戴蒙德-迪布维格及其超越：论银行业的不稳定性
records.abstract_en: Are financial intermediaries – in particular, banks – inherently unstable or fragile, and if so, why? We address this theoretically by analyzing whether model economies with financial intermediation are more prone than those without it to multiple, cyclic, or stochastic equilibria. Several formalizations are considered: Insurance-based banking; models with reputational considerations; those with fixed costs and delegated investment; and those where bank liabilities serve as payment instruments. Importantly for the issue at hand, in each case banking arrangements arise endogenously. While the economics and mathematics differ across specifications, they all predict that financial intermediation engenders instability in a precise sense.
records.abstract_cn: 金融中介机构——尤其是银行——是否天生不稳定或脆弱，如果是，原因何在？我们通过分析具有金融中介的模型经济体是否比没有金融中介的经济体更容易出现多重均衡、周期均衡或随机均衡，从理论上解决这一问题。我们考虑了多种形式化：基于保险的银行业；具有声誉考虑的模型；具有固定成本和委托投资的模型；以及银行负债作为支付工具的模型。对于所讨论的问题重要的是，在每种情况下，银行业安排都是内生出现的。尽管不同设定下的经济学和数学有所不同，但它们都预测金融中介在精确意义上会产生不稳定性。

records.title_en: Unequal bequests
records.title_cn: 不平等的遗产分配
records.abstract_en: Using data from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS), we make two contributions to the literature on end-of-life transfers. First, we show that unequal bequests are much more prevalent than generally recognized, with more than one-third of parents with wills planning to divide their estates unequally among their children. Plans for unequal division are particularly concentrated in “weak relationships”, i.e., families with stepchildren and families with genetic children with whom parents have limited or no contact. Second, we find that many older Americans have no wills. Although the probability of having a will increases with age, 30 percent of individuals aged 70 plus are without a will and, of the HRS respondents who died between 1995 and 2012, nearly 40 percent died intestate.
records.abstract_cn: 利用健康与退休研究（HRS）的数据，我们对临终转移文献做出了两项贡献。首先，我们表明不平等的遗产分配比普遍认识到的更为普遍，超过三分之一的立有遗嘱的父母计划在子女间不平等地分配遗产。不平等分配的计划特别集中在“弱关系”中，即涉及继子女的家庭以及父母与亲生子女联系有限或没有联系的家庭。其次，我们发现许多美国老年人没有遗嘱。尽管立遗嘱的概率随年龄增长而增加，但70岁及以上的人群中有30%没有遗嘱，并且在1995年至2012年间去世的HRS受访者中，近40%未立遗嘱去世。

records.title_en: The politicized pandemic: Ideological polarization and the behavioral response to COVID-19
records.title_cn: 政治化的疫情：意识形态极化与对COVID-19的行为反应
records.abstract_en: In a representative sample of the U.S. population during the first summer of the COVID-19 pandemic, we investigate how prosociality and ideology interact in their relationship with health-protecting behavior and trust in the government to handle the crisis. We find that an experimental measure of prosociality based on standard economic games positively relates to protective behavior. Conservatives are less compliant with COVID-19-related behavioral restrictions than liberals and evaluate the government's handling of the crisis significantly more positively. We show that prosociality does not mediate the impact of political ideology. This finding means that conservatives are less compliant with protective health guidelines - independent of differences in prosociality between both ideological camps. Behavioral differences between liberals and conservatives are roughly only one-fourth of the size of their differences in judging the government's crisis management. This result suggests that Americans were more polarized in their political views than in their acceptance of public health advice.
records.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19大流行第一个夏季的美国代表性样本中，我们研究了亲社会性与意识形态如何在其与健康保护行为和信任政府处理危机的关系中相互作用。我们发现，基于标准经济博弈的实验性亲社会性测量与保护行为正相关。保守派比自由派更不遵守与COVID-19相关的行为限制，并且对政府处理危机的评价显著更为积极。我们表明，亲社会性并不中介政治意识形态的影响。这一发现意味着保守派更不遵守保护性健康指南——独立于两个意识形态阵营之间亲社会性的差异。自由派与保守派之间的行为差异大约仅为他们评判政府危机管理差异的四分之一。这一结果表明，美国人在政治观点上的极化程度高于他们在接受公共卫生建议方面的分歧。

records.title_en: Fiscal stimulus in liquidity traps: Conventional or unconventional policies?
records.title_cn: 流动性陷阱中的财政刺激：常规还是非常规政策？
records.abstract_en: Recent influential work argue that a gradual increase in the sales tax stimulates economic activity in a liquidity trap by boosting inflation expectations. Higher public infrastructure investment should also be more expansive in a liquidity trap than in normal times by raising the potential interest rate and increasing aggregate demand. We analyze the relative merits of these policies in New Keynesian models with and without endogenous private capital formation and heterogeneity when monetary policy does not respond by raising policy rates. Our key finding is that the effectiveness of sales tax hikes differs notably across various model specifications, whereas the benefits of higher public infrastructure investment are more robust in alternative model environments. We therefore conclude that fiscal policymakers in liquidity traps should consider spending opportunities and not merely rely on tax policies to stimulate growth.
records.abstract_cn: 近期有影响力的研究认为，在流动性陷阱中，逐步提高销售税通过提升通胀预期来刺激经济活动。更高的公共基础设施投资也应通过提高潜在利率和增加总需求，在流动性陷阱中比正常时期更具扩张性。我们在有和没有内生私人资本形成及异质性的新凯恩斯模型中，分析这些政策的相对优劣，此时货币政策不通过提高政策利率来回应。我们的关键发现是，销售税上调的有效性在不同模型设定下差异显著，而更高公共基础设施投资的益处在替代模型环境中更为稳健。因此，我们得出结论，流动性陷阱中的财政政策制定者应考虑支出机会，而不仅仅依赖税收政策来刺激增长。

records.title_en: Human-algorithm interaction: Algorithmic pricing in hybrid laboratory markets
records.title_cn: 人机交互：混合实验室市场中的算法定价
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates pricing in laboratory markets when human players interact with an algorithm. We compare the degree of competition when exclusively humans interact to the case of one firm delegating its decisions to an algorithm, an n-player generalization of tit-for-tat. We further vary whether participants know about the presence of the algorithm. When one of three firms in a market is an algorithm, we observe significantly higher prices compared to human-only markets. Firms employing an algorithm earn significantly less profit than their rivals. (Un)certainty about the actual presence of an algorithm does not significantly affect collusion, although humans do seem to perceive algorithms as more disruptive.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当人类玩家与算法互动时实验室市场中的定价问题。我们比较了仅由人类互动时的竞争程度与一家公司将其决策委托给算法（一种n人版的以牙还牙策略）的情况。我们还进一步变化了参与者是否知道算法的存在。当市场中的三家公司之一为算法时，我们观察到价格显著高于仅有人类的市场。采用算法的公司所获利润显著低于其竞争对手。关于算法实际存在的不确定性并未显著影响合谋，尽管人类似乎确实认为算法更具破坏性。

records.title_en: The interdependencies between the private and public sectors in open economies
records.title_cn: 开放经济中私人部门与公共部门的相互依存关系
records.abstract_en: Empirical evidence shows that countries with larger public sectors also have larger trade shares and a larger share of firms that export. These links between the public and the private sector are reconciled in an analytically tractable general equilibrium model allowing for a two-way causal relation between size (and the composition) of the public sector and openness and industry structure of the private sector. First, a larger public sector or a larger share of public expenditure used for public employment (alternative to transfers) results in a more open private sector (trade share and fraction of firms exporting), and it is also associated with more fat-tailedness of the firm size distribution, higher average productivity, lower average unit labour costs, and better wage competitiveness and terms of trade. These outcomes are driven by endogenous entry and selection of firms. Second, for optimal fiscal policies, international spillovers imply that non-cooperative policies have an upward bias in the overall size of the public sector, but a downward bias in transfers as a share of public expenditures. Trade liberalization and the degree of firm heterogeneity magnify these biases and thereby influence the size and structure of public expenditures.
records.abstract_cn: 实证证据表明，公共部门规模较大的国家，其贸易份额和出口企业占比也较大。本文在一个可解析处理的一般均衡模型中调和了公共部门与私人部门之间的这些联系，该模型允许公共部门的规模（及构成）与私人部门的开放度和产业结构之间存在双向因果关系。首先，较大的公共部门或用于公共就业（替代转移支付）的公共支出份额较大，会导致私人部门更加开放（贸易份额和出口企业比例更高），并且还与企业规模分布的更厚尾特征、更高的平均生产率、更低的平均单位劳动成本以及更好的工资竞争力和贸易条件相关。这些结果由企业的内生进入和选择驱动。其次，对于最优财政政策，国际溢出效应意味着非合作政策在公共部门总体规模上存在向上偏差，但在转移支付占公共支出比例上存在向下偏差。贸易自由化和企业异质性程度放大了这些偏差，从而影响公共支出的规模和结构。

records.title_en: Backward versus forward integration of firms in global value chains
records.title_cn: 全球价值链中企业的后向与前向整合
records.abstract_en: This paper seeks to understand the forces determining the pattern of asset ownership in global value chains. We augment a standard model of vertical integration rooted in the property-rights theory to account for fixed integration costs and derive four channels of influence for the cross-country and cross-sector pattern of asset ownership: the relative investment intensity of sectors and countries; the relative density of markets; the relative reliance on and importance of supplying and producing country-sectors; and the relative importance of fixed integration costs. We confirm the relevance of these determinants for the observed pattern of asset ownership in a large panel of worldwide directed ownership linkages.
records.abstract_cn: 本文旨在理解决定全球价值链中资产所有权模式的力量。我们在产权理论的基础上，对标准的纵向整合模型进行扩展，以考虑固定整合成本，并推导出影响资产所有权跨国和跨部门模式的四个渠道：部门和国家的相对投资强度；市场的相对密度；对供应和生产国部门的相对依赖及其重要性；以及固定整合成本的相对重要性。我们通过一个包含全球定向所有权联系的大型面板数据，证实了这些决定因素与观察到的资产所有权模式的相关性。

records.title_en: Silence the media or the story? Theory and evidence of media capture
records.title_cn: 让媒体沉默还是让报道沉默？媒体俘获的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We propose a new theory of media capture where a principal can either influence journalistic investigation (internal capture) or let the media investigate and suppress stories at the publication stage (external capture). We predict that the likelihood of internal capture increases with perceived corruption. Conversely, external capture increases with perceived corruption if the number of media outlets is large enough and decreases otherwise. Exploiting new survey data from Reporters Without Borders, we use the Panama Papers as a shock to perceived corruption to provide empirical support for our two predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新的媒体俘获理论，其中委托人既可以影响新闻调查（内部俘获），也可以让媒体进行调查并在发布阶段压制报道（外部俘获）。我们预测，内部俘获的可能性随着感知腐败程度的增加而增加。相反，如果媒体数量足够多，外部俘获随着感知腐败程度的增加而增加，否则减少。利用无国界记者组织的新调查数据，我们将巴拿马文件作为感知腐败的冲击，为我们的两个预测提供实证支持。

records.title_en: A dynamic quantile model for distinguishing intertemporal substitution from risk aversion
records.title_cn: 区分跨期替代与风险厌恶的动态分位数模型
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a dynamic quantile model to estimate the elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS) and risk attitude using large disaggregated data from the NielsenIQ Consumer Panel. This data is transactional at the consumption purchase level, which minimizes measurement error, and the final sample contains more than two million observations. In the quantile model, the risk attitude is captured by the quantile and is, therefore, separable from the EIS. To estimate the parameters of interest we use the Euler equation along with instrumental variables quantile regression. First, we estimate the model across different levels of risk attitude. Empirical results document evidence of monotonically decreasing EIS along quantiles. For large risk aversion, the EIS is greater than one, whereas for small risk aversion it descends into negative values. Subsequently, we estimate the risk attitude and the EIS simultaneously. The results substantiate a risk attitude close to the median, with EIS consistently positive and smaller than one.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用动态分位数模型，利用NielsenIQ消费者面板的大规模分类数据来估计跨期替代弹性（EIS）和风险态度。该数据在消费购买层面具有交易性质，从而最小化测量误差，最终样本包含超过两百万个观测值。在分位数模型中，风险态度由分位数捕捉，因此与EIS是可分离的。为了估计感兴趣的参数，我们使用欧拉方程以及工具变量分位数回归。首先，我们在不同风险态度水平下估计模型。实证结果记录了沿分位数EIS单调递减的证据。对于高风险厌恶，EIS大于一，而对于低风险厌恶，EIS降至负值。随后，我们同时估计风险态度和EIS。结果证实风险态度接近中位数，EIS始终为正且小于一。

records.title_en: Biased expectations
records.title_cn: 有偏预期
records.abstract_en: We propose two novel measures of the cognitive bias of over-optimism, ex ante optimism and ex post optimism, using a quarterly consumer expectations survey. We demonstrate the micro-foundations of the proposed measures and show empirically that excessive consumer optimism about future family finances impacts the real economy. Ex ante, excessive optimism compels consumers to save less and borrow more, putting upward pressure on consumption growth. Ex post, when family finances improve persistently less than expected, consumers cut back on credit and save more which puts downward pressure on consumption growth. This saving and borrowing channel of the optimism bias is robust to consumer age.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用季度消费者预期调查，提出了过度乐观这一认知偏差的两种新度量：事前乐观和事后乐观。我们展示了所提出度量的微观基础，并实证表明，消费者对未来家庭财务的过度乐观会影响实体经济。事前，过度乐观促使消费者减少储蓄、增加借贷，对消费增长产生上行压力。事后，当家庭财务状况的改善持续低于预期时，消费者会减少信贷并增加储蓄，这对消费增长产生下行压力。这种乐观偏差的储蓄和借贷渠道在不同年龄的消费者中均稳健存在。

records.title_en: Non-confrontational extremists
records.title_cn: 非对抗性的极端主义者
records.abstract_en: In many contexts individuals are subject to norms and decisions they disagree with ideologically. What is the effect of regularly being in an ideological minority on the propensity to confront majority norms and decisions? We study this in an ideologically-salient field setting – US appeals courts – using exogenous predictors of ideology and random assignment of judges. We find that ideological interaction silences extremists: Judges who are ideologically extreme relative to their peers are less confrontational – dissent less often – than other judges, despite shaping case outcomes the least. Considering many mechanisms, we find that a model of peer pressure where agents perceive concave ideological costs can explain the observations.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多情境中，个体受到他们在意识形态上不认同的规范和决策的约束。经常处于意识形态少数派地位对对抗多数派规范和决策的倾向有何影响？我们在一个意识形态突出的实地环境中——美国上诉法院——利用意识形态的外生预测因子和法官的随机分配来研究这一问题。我们发现意识形态互动使极端主义者沉默：相对于同僚在意识形态上极端的法官对抗性较弱——较少提出异议——尽管他们对案件结果的影响最小。考虑多种机制后，我们发现一个同侪压力模型，其中行动者感知到凹性的意识形态成本，可以解释这些观察结果。

records.title_en: Business dynamism, sectoral reallocation and productivity in a pandemic
records.title_cn: 疫情中的商业活力、部门重新配置与生产率
records.abstract_en: Asymmetric effects across sectors are the distinctive features of the Covid-19 shock. An Epidemiological-Industry Dynamic model with heterogeneous firms and endogenous firms dynamics mimics the deep recession suffered by sectors characterized by high exposure, the reallocation of entry and exit opportunities across sectors, and the dynamics of aggregate productivity during the first wave of the pandemic. The cleansing effect induced by the Covid-19 crisis is sector-specific. Monetary policy and sticky wages are central ingredients to capture reallocation effects. Social distancing, by smoothing out cleansing in the social sector, slows down the reallocation process and prolongs the recession, but saves lives.
records.abstract_cn: 跨部门的非对称效应是Covid-19冲击的显著特征。一个具有异质性企业和内生企业动态的流行病-产业动态模型，模拟了高暴露部门所遭受的深度衰退、跨部门的进入与退出机会的重新配置，以及疫情第一波期间总体生产率的动态。Covid-19危机引发的清洁效应具有部门特异性。货币政策和工资粘性是捕捉重新配置效应的核心要素。社交距离通过平滑社会部门的清洁效应，减缓了重新配置过程并延长了衰退，但挽救了生命。

records.title_en: Consumer mobility and expenditure during the COVID-19 containments: Evidence from French transaction data
records.title_cn: COVID-19封锁期间的消费者流动与支出：来自法国交易数据的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of the pandemic containment periods in France on individuals’ movements, expenditure and adaptation to the shock, using billions of French bank card transactions measured before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. We measure not only the effect on consumer expenditure, but also on quantities directly related to the containment restrictions, such as consumer mobility, number of retailers visited, and inter-regional purchases. The results show large effects on these measures of consumers’ movements, as well as on both online and offline measures of expenditure, particularly in the first containment period. We also find evidence that consumers adjusted rapidly during the first containment period, mitigating the effects of mobility restrictions via an increasing shift toward online purchasing, and that the nature of the adaptation differed for different types of purchase.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用法国数十亿笔银行卡交易数据（涵盖COVID-19疫情前后），研究了法国疫情封锁期对个人流动、支出及对冲击适应性的影响。我们不仅衡量了对消费者支出的影响，还衡量了与封锁限制直接相关的数量指标，如消费者流动性、访问的零售商数量以及跨区域购买。结果显示，这些消费者流动指标以及线上和线下支出指标均受到显著影响，尤其是在第一次封锁期间。我们还发现，在第一次封锁期间，消费者迅速调整，通过转向线上购买来缓解流动性限制的影响，并且不同购买类型的适应性质有所不同。

records.title_en: Corporate debt maturity and investment over the business cycle
records.title_cn: 企业债务期限与商业周期中的投资
records.abstract_en: The business cycle dynamics of firms’ debt maturity vary across the firm size distribution. Small and medium-sized firms have a more pro-cyclical debt maturity than large firms. This paper explores the determinants of firms’ debt maturity, and the importance of firms’ debt maturity for their investment and leverage dynamics. To do so, it embeds a maturity choice in a model of firm investment and financing. Firms shorten debt maturity during times when default risk premiums are high and their internal funds are scarce. This behavior is consistent with both the life cycle and business cycle dynamics of firms’ debt maturity. Endogenous debt maturity helps firms to deleverage faster in response to negative shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 企业债务期限的商业周期动态在企业规模分布中有所不同。中小型企业的债务期限比大型企业更具顺周期性。本文探讨了企业债务期限的决定因素，以及企业债务期限对其投资和杠杆动态的重要性。为此，本文将期限选择嵌入企业投资和融资模型中。企业在违约风险溢价高且内部资金稀缺时缩短债务期限。这种行为与企业债务期限的生命周期和商业周期动态一致。内生债务期限有助于企业在应对负面冲击时更快地去杠杆化。

records.title_en: Crisis experience and the deep roots of COVID-19 vaccination preferences
records.title_cn: 危机经历与COVID-19疫苗接种偏好的深层根源
records.abstract_en: We examine the deep roots of preferences for vaccination against COVID-19, moving beyond proximate factors which can only account for part of the observable heterogeneity in the willingness to get vaccinated. Our model on experience-based learning predicts that exposure to past disruptive crises increases individuals’ willingness to acquire and take a promising remedy when new crises occur. Using micro-level data on vaccination preferences for individuals from 19 countries, we find strong evidence for our prediction. We investigate the role of competing vaccines exploiting original geocoded survey data from Russia. Consistent with our theory, past crisis experience decreases vaccination willingness when individuals have learned to distrust the effectiveness of government-administered remedies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了针对COVID-19疫苗接种偏好的深层根源，超越了仅能解释可观察到的接种意愿异质性一部分的近因因素。我们基于经验学习的模型预测，过去破坏性危机的经历会增加个体在新危机出现时获取并采取有前景疗法的意愿。利用来自19个国家个体的微观层面疫苗接种偏好数据，我们发现了支持我们预测的有力证据。我们利用来自俄罗斯的原始地理编码调查数据，研究了竞争性疫苗的作用。与我们的理论一致，当个体已学会不信任政府管理的疗法的有效性时，过去的危机经历会降低接种意愿。

records.title_en: Euro area sovereign bond risk premia before and during the Covid-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: Covid-19大流行之前和期间的欧元区主权债券风险溢价
records.abstract_en: We provide a novel modeling framework to decompose euro area sovereign bond yields into five distinct components: (i) expected future short-term risk-free rates and a term premium, (ii) a default risk premium, (iii) redenomination risk premium, (iv) liquidity risk premium, and (v) segmentation (convenience) premium. Identification is achieved by considering sovereign yields jointly with other rates, including sovereign credit default swap spreads with and without redenomination as a credit event trigger. We illustrate our model by studying yield components embedded in German, French, Italian, and Spanish sovereign bonds, before and after the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, and by examining the impact of European Central Bank (ECB) monetary policy and European Union (EU) fiscal policy announcements in response to the pandemic. We find that all five risk premia became sizable following the onset of the pandemic, and that both monetary and fiscal policy announcements had a pronounced effect on yields, mostly through default, redenomination, and segmentation (convenience) premia.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个新颖的模型框架，将欧元区主权债券收益率分解为五个不同的组成部分：(i) 预期未来短期无风险利率和期限溢价，(ii) 违约风险溢价，(iii) 重新计价风险溢价，(iv) 流动性风险溢价，以及 (v) 分割（便利）溢价。识别是通过结合考虑主权收益率和其他利率来实现的，包括在有或没有重新计价作为信用事件触发因素的情况下的主权信用违约掉期利差。我们通过研究2020新冠病毒19大流行爆发前后德国、法国、意大利和西班牙主权债券中嵌入的收益率组成部分，并研究欧洲央行 (ECB) 货币政策和欧盟 (EU) 财政政策公告针对这一流行病的影响来说明我们的模型。我们发现，大流行爆发后，所有五种风险溢价都变得相当大，而且货币和财政政策公告都对收益率产生了显着影响，主要是通过违约、重新计价和分割（便利）溢价。

records.title_en: What citation tests really tell us about bias in academic publishing
records.title_cn: 引用检验真正告诉我们关于学术出版中的偏见
records.abstract_en: The concept of status bias in the academic publishing process has been studied for decades, and economists have often used citation tests to address the question: if editors are biased in favour of high-status economists, their published papers will tend to be of lower quality and thus receive fewer citations. While this literature has tended to find bias against high-status economists rather than in their favour, I argue that these citation tests are quite uninformative, as their interpretation depends on the very strong assumption that authors are unbiased when choosing which papers to cite. I then use publication and citation data to estimate a model of the publication process, and find that the results depend strongly on this same (untested) assumption: the data are consistent with editor bias in favour of high-status economists if I assume that authors are also significantly biased in favour of high-status economists when choosing which papers to cite. My findings indicate important shortcomings of citation tests, as well as the need to find new approaches to study the question of status bias.
records.abstract_cn: 学术出版过程中地位偏见的概念已被研究数十年，经济学家经常使用引用检验来解决这个问题：如果编辑偏向于高地位经济学家，他们发表的论文往往质量较低，因此获得的引用较少。尽管这一文献倾向于发现对高地位经济学家的偏见而非有利于他们，但我认为这些引用检验相当缺乏信息量，因为其解释依赖于一个非常强的假设，即作者在选择引用哪些论文时是无偏的。然后我使用出版和引用数据来估计一个出版过程的模型，并发现结果强烈依赖于这一相同的（未经检验的）假设：如果我假设作者在选择引用哪些论文时也显著偏向于高地位经济学家，那么数据与编辑偏向于高地位经济学家的情形一致。我的发现指出了引用检验的重要缺陷，以及需要寻找新方法来研究地位偏见问题的必要性。

records.title_en: Risk without strike: Nuclear crisis and corporate investment
records.title_cn: 无打击的风险：核危机与企业投资
records.abstract_en: While prior works of literature have noted that a crisis brings in not only a strike but also risk, empirical studies on crisis management are largely focusing on the impact of the strike. In this study, we estimate the pure effect of disaster risk on corporate decisions by using the setting of the North Korea nuclear crisis, which brought risk but no actual strike to the neighboring countries. We find that the nuclear tests are significant events for corporate investments and the risk of these tests will lead firms to postpone their long-term investments. The negative impact spreads from the test site and dwindles when firms locate further away, and the geodesic distance rather than the driving distance to the test site matters. Our further analyses show that the negative impact on corporate investment decisions is channeled by the fear of environmental pollution, instead of the geopolitical concern like the outbreak of a war.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管先前的文献已经注意到危机不仅带来打击，还带来风险，但关于危机管理的实证研究主要集中于打击的影响。在本研究中，我们利用朝鲜核危机的背景，该危机给邻国带来了风险但未造成实际打击，从而估计了灾害风险对企业决策的纯效应。我们发现核试验对企业投资是显著事件，这些试验的风险将导致企业推迟其长期投资。负面影响从试验地点扩散，并随着企业距离更远而减弱，且到试验地点的测地距离而非驾驶距离起作用。我们的进一步分析表明，对企业投资决策的负面影响是由对环境污染的恐惧所传导的，而非如战争爆发这样的地缘政治关切。

records.title_en: The political economy of lighthouses in antebellum America
records.title_cn: 美国内战前灯塔的政治经济学
records.abstract_en: The study of the lighthouse features prominently in debates over the private provision of public services. However, little attention has been devoted to how lighthouse systems operated once governments took charge of its production. We exploit the fact that Antebellum America came close to the ideal textbook solution to providing public goods and we assess how the government allocated lighthouses before the Civil War. We find some evidence that the lighthouses were built according to commercial needs. However, we discover stronger evidence that political considerations played a role in selecting where lighthouses would be built.
records.abstract_cn: 灯塔的研究在关于公共服务私人提供的辩论中占有重要地位。然而，一旦政府接管了灯塔的生产，关于灯塔系统如何运作的关注却很少。我们利用美国内战前接近教科书式公共物品提供理想解决方案的事实，评估了政府在南北战争前如何分配灯塔。我们发现一些证据表明，灯塔是根据商业需求建造的。然而，我们发现了更有力的证据表明，政治考量在选择灯塔建造地点方面发挥了作用。

records.title_en: Comment on “Sectoral shocks, reallocation, and labor market policies” by Joaquín García-Cabo, Anna Lipińska, and Gastón Navarro
records.title_cn: 对《部门冲击、重新配置与劳动力市场政策》一文的评论——作者：Joaquín García-Cabo、Anna Lipińska和Gastón Navarro
records.abstract_en: This comment discusses the article “Sectoral Shocks, Reallocation, and Labor Market Policies” by Joaquin Garcia-Cabo, Anna Lipinska, and Gaston Navarro. The comment highlights issues that receive only little attention in the article or could be addressed in future research. It focuses on aspects that are relevant for policy makers in order to design effective policies which mitigate the effects of asymmetric recessions, but which also facilitate a smooth recovery.
records.abstract_cn: 本评论讨论了Joaquin Garcia-Cabo、Anna Lipinska和Gaston Navarro的文章《部门冲击、重新配置与劳动力市场政策》。评论强调了文章中较少关注或可在未来研究中解决的问题。评论聚焦于对政策制定者设计有效政策以减轻不对称衰退影响并促进平稳复苏的相关方面。

records.title_en: Inflation and wage growth since the pandemic
records.title_cn: 疫情以来的通货膨胀与工资增长
records.abstract_en: Following the worst of the COVID-19 pandemic, inflation surged to levels last seen in the 1980s. Motivated by vast differences in pandemic support across countries, we investigate the subsequent response of inflation and its feedback to wages. We exploit the differences in pandemic support to identify the effect that these programs had on inflation and the passthrough to wages. Our empirical approach focuses on a novel dynamic difference-in-differences method based on local projections. Our estimates suggest that an increase of 5 percentage points in direct transfers (relative to trend) translates into about a peak 3 percentage points boost to inflation and wage growth. Moreover, higher inflation accentuates the role of inflation expectations on wage-setting dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19疫情最严重时期之后，通货膨胀飙升至1980年代以来未见的高位。鉴于各国在疫情支持方面的巨大差异，我们研究了通货膨胀随后的反应及其对工资的反馈效应。我们利用疫情支持政策的差异来识别这些项目对通货膨胀的影响及其向工资的传导。我们的实证方法基于局部投影，采用一种新颖的动态双重差分法。我们的估计表明，直接转移支付（相对于趋势）增加5个百分点，大约会转化为通货膨胀和工资增长峰值提高3个百分点。此外，更高的通货膨胀加剧了通胀预期在工资设定动态中的作用。

records.title_en: Monetary–fiscal crosswinds in the European Monetary Union
records.title_cn: 欧洲货币联盟中的货币-财政交叉风
records.abstract_en: We study the monetary–fiscal mix in the European Monetary Union. The medium and long-run effects of conventional and unconventional monetary policy are analysed by combining monetary policy shocks identified in a Structural VAR, and the general government budget constraint featuring a single central bank and multiple fiscal authorities. In response to a conventional easing of the policy rate, the cumulated response of the fiscal deficit is positive. Conversely, in response to an unconventional easing affecting the long end of the yield curve, the primary fiscal position barely moves. This is consistent with the long-run effect of unconventional monetary easing on the price index, which is about half that of conventional easing. The aggregate long-run cumulated surplus is mainly driven by Germany’s fiscal policy during the period in which unconventional monetary policy was adopted.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究欧洲货币联盟中的货币-财政组合。通过结合结构向量自回归中识别的货币政策冲击，以及具有单一中央银行和多个财政当局的广义政府预算约束，分析常规和非常规货币政策的中期和长期效应。对于政策利率的常规宽松，财政赤字的累积响应为正。相反，对于影响收益率曲线长端的非常规宽松，基本财政状况几乎不变。这与非常规货币宽松对价格指数的长期效应一致，该效应约为常规宽松的一半。在采用非常规货币政策的时期，总体长期累积盈余主要由德国的财政政策驱动。

records.title_en: Inflation, Output, and Welfare in the Laboratory
records.title_cn: 实验室中的通货膨胀、产出与福利
records.abstract_en: We develop an experimental framework to investigate the quantity theory of money and the real effects of inflation in an economy where money serves as a medium of exchange. We test the classical view that inflation reduces output and welfare by taxing monetary exchange. Inflation is engineered by constant money growth where newly-issued money is injected in one of three ways: to finance government spending, lump-sum transfers, or proportional transfers. Experimental results largely support theoretical predictions. Higher money growth leads to higher inflation. Output and welfare are significantly lower with government spending, output is significantly lower with lump-sum transfers, while there are no significant real effects with proportional transfers. A deviation from theory is that the detrimental effect of money growth depends on the implementation scheme and is stronger with government spending relative to lump-sum transfers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个实验框架，以研究货币数量论以及货币作为交换媒介的经济体中通货膨胀的实际效应。我们检验了古典观点，即通货膨胀通过对货币交换征税来降低产出和福利。通货膨胀是通过恒定的货币增长来实现的，新发行的货币以三种方式之一注入：用于政府支出、一次性转移支付或比例转移支付。实验结果在很大程度上支持理论预测。较高的货币增长导致较高的通货膨胀。在政府支出情况下，产出和福利显著降低；在一次性转移支付情况下，产出显著降低；而在比例转移支付情况下，没有显著的实际效应。与理论的一个偏差是，货币增长的不利影响取决于实施方案，并且相对于一次性转移支付，政府支出的影响更强。

records.title_en: Oligarchy, underutilized capacity, and government policy
records.title_cn: 寡头统治、产能利用不足与政府政策
records.abstract_en: We examine an oligarchic economy where only elites can establish firms. In monopolistic competition when the size of the elite is sufficiently small, there is an absolute exclusive equilibrium where wages are driven to the reservation wage. Because of the possession of market power by firms, total equilibrium output is insufficient to warrant the employment of the entire labor force, leading to inadequate aggregate demand for labor and underutilized capacity. The economy inefficiently operates inside its production possibilities frontier. Then, the adoption of rather unorthodox left-wing fiscal and labor policies may boost capacity utilization and lead to a Pareto improvement.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了一个只有精英能够建立企业的寡头经济。在垄断竞争中，当精英规模足够小时，存在一个绝对排他性均衡，其中工资被压低至保留工资水平。由于企业拥有市场势力，总均衡产出不足以雇佣全部劳动力，导致对劳动力的总需求不足和产能利用不足。经济在其生产可能性边界内部低效运行。因此，采取相当非正统的左翼财政和劳动政策可能会提高产能利用率，并实现帕累托改进。

records.title_en: It Pays to be big: Price discrimination in maritime shipping
records.title_cn: 大者有利：海运中的价格歧视
records.abstract_en: We explore theoretically and empirically the within-route price discrimination in liner shipping and condition it on the market density. Our simple model with informational frictions predicts carrier price discrimination against smaller importing firms under the condition that the number of available carriers on the route is sufficiently large. Using transaction-level data from over 200 Chilean import port-to-port routes, we confirm our theoretical predictions and demonstrate their robustness and economic significance. Ranked by their annual importing size, importers in the 10th percentile pay 18% higher freight rates than importers in the 90th percentile, but only on routes with more than three carriers. Our results indicate that reducing market power distortion in the upstream sector (transportation) may amplify the informational friction distortion and price discrimination in the downstream sectors (importing industries).
records.abstract_cn: 我们从理论和实证上探讨了班轮运输中的航线内价格歧视，并将其与市场密度相联系。我们的简单模型包含信息摩擦，预测在航线上的可用承运人数量足够多的情况下，承运人会对较小的进口企业实施价格歧视。利用来自智利超过200个港口到港口航线的交易级数据，我们证实了我们的理论预测，并展示了其稳健性和经济显著性。按年度进口规模排名，第10百分位的进口商支付的运费率比第90百分位的进口商高18%，但仅限于承运人超过三家的航线。我们的结果表明，减少上游部门（运输）的市场力量扭曲可能会放大下游部门（进口行业）的信息摩擦扭曲和价格歧视。

records.title_en: Price setting frequency and the Phillips curve
records.title_cn: 价格设定频率与菲利普斯曲线
records.abstract_en: We develop a New Keynesian (NK) model with endogenous price setting frequency. Whether a firm updates its price is a discrete choice: when expected benefits outweigh expected costs, prices are reset optimally. The model gives rise to a non-linear Phillips curve as prices are more flexible during demand-driven expansions and less so during demand-driven recessions. Monetary policy can have substantial real effects despite the model having a state-dependent pricing component. Our quantitative analysis shows that contrary to the standard NK model, the assumed price setting behavior: (i) is consistent with micro data on price setting frequency; (ii) generates a direct effect of the time-varying price setting frequency on inflation; (iii) creates time-variation in the Phillips curve slope that explains shifts in the Phillips curve associated with different historical episodes; (iv) explains inflation dynamics without relying on implausible high cost-push shocks and nominal rigidities inconsistent with micro data; (v) reconciles the NK model with observed inflation moments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个具有内生价格设定频率的新凯恩斯主义（NK）模型。企业是否更新其价格是一个离散选择：当预期收益超过预期成本时，价格会被最优地重置。该模型产生了一条非线性的菲利普斯曲线，因为价格在需求驱动的扩张期间更具灵活性，而在需求驱动的衰退期间灵活性较低。尽管模型具有状态依赖的定价成分，货币政策仍能产生实质性的实际效应。我们的定量分析表明，与标准NK模型相反，所假设的价格设定行为：（i）与关于价格设定频率的微观数据一致；（ii）对通胀产生时变价格设定频率的直接效应；（iii）产生菲利普斯曲线斜率的时变性，这解释了与不同历史时期相关的菲利普斯曲线变动；（iv）在不依赖不可信的高成本推动冲击和与微观数据不一致的名义刚性情况下解释通胀动态；（v）使NK模型与观察到的通胀矩相协调。

records.title_en: Corporate tax evasion: Evidence from international trade
records.title_cn: 企业逃税：来自国际贸易的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how firms misreport their imports and exports to lower their reported taxable profits and evade corporate income taxes (CIT), which I call the trade evasion channel. Based on correlations between tax rates and mirror statistics of trade flows between countries at the product level, I find evidence suggesting that firms under-report exports (sales) and imports (costs) simultaneously to lower reported taxable profits while maintaining consistent income statements. For a representative firm, the resulting elasticity of reported taxable profits is 0.24, which suggests that the trade evasion channel is quantitatively important. Multinational firms do not exploit this channel, nor do firms in countries with a large informal economy, where other evasion options are available.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业如何虚报其进口和出口以降低其报告的应税利润并逃避企业所得税（CIT），我称之为贸易逃税渠道。基于税率与产品层面国家间贸易流动镜像统计之间的相关性，我发现的证据表明，企业同时低报出口（销售额）和进口（成本），以降低报告的应税利润，同时保持损益表的一致性。对于一家代表性企业，由此产生的报告应税利润弹性为0.24，这表明贸易逃税渠道在数量上很重要。跨国公司不利用这一渠道，拥有大量非正规经济国家的企业也不利用这一渠道，因为这些企业有其他逃税选择。

records.title_en: Long-term inflation expectations and monetary policy in the euro area before the pandemic
records.title_cn: 疫情前欧元区的长期通胀预期与货币政策
records.abstract_en: Survey-based long-term inflation expectations in the euro area reached historically low levels at the end of 2019. A structural VAR analysis shows that the decline in long-term expectations exerted a downward pressure on inflation during the 2013–14 disinflation and in 2019. Counterfactual simulations show that the decrease in inflation would have been larger and output would have declined had the European Central Bank not responded to the fall in expectations. A small New Keynesian model, in which the private sector's estimate of the inflation target varies with inflation, can rationalise the VAR evidence.
records.abstract_cn: 基于调查的欧元区长期通胀预期在2019年底达到历史低位。结构VAR分析显示，长期预期的下降在2013-14年通缩期间和2019年对通胀产生了下行压力。反事实模拟表明，如果欧洲央行未对预期下降作出反应，通胀下降幅度会更大，产出会下降。一个小型新凯恩斯模型，其中私人部门对通胀目标的估计随通胀变化，可以合理化VAR证据。

records.title_en: Beyond the “Comforts” of work from home: Child health and the female wage penalty
records.title_cn: 超越居家办公的“舒适”：儿童健康与女性工资惩罚
records.abstract_en: Using data on American women and the health status of their children, this paper provides estimates of the effect of remote work on female wages. A temporary child health shock, which does not affect a woman's labor market outcomes beyond inducing her to work at home, is used as an instrument. Instrumental variable estimates indicate a substantial wage penalty that is more likely attributed to women's choices or assignments of less promotable job tasks when working from home. The findings are valuable in assessing the costs associated with remote flexibility, especially when children are required to stay at home during episodes of illness.
records.abstract_cn: 利用美国女性及其子女健康状况的数据，本文估计了远程工作对女性工资的影响。一个暂时的儿童健康冲击，除了促使女性在家工作外，并不影响其劳动力市场结果，被用作工具变量。工具变量估计表明存在显著的工资惩罚，这更可能归因于女性在家工作时选择或被分配了晋升机会较少的工作任务。这些发现对于评估远程灵活性的成本具有价值，尤其是在孩子生病需要留在家中的情况下。

records.title_en: Wall Street QE vs. Main Street Lending
records.title_cn: 华尔街量化宽松与主街贷款
records.abstract_en: Monetary and fiscal authorities reacted swiftly to the COVID-19 pandemic by purchasing assets (or “Wall Street QE”) and lending directly to non-financial firms (or “Main Street Lending”). Our paper develops a new framework to compare and contrast these different policies. For the Great Recession, characterized by impaired balance sheets of financial intermediaries, Main Street Lending and Wall Street QE are perfect substitutes and both stimulate aggregate demand. In contrast, for the COVID-19 recession, where non-financial firms faced significant cash flow shortages, Wall Street QE is almost completely ineffective, whereas Main Street Lending can be highly stimulative.
records.abstract_cn: 货币和财政当局通过购买资产（即“华尔街量化宽松”）和直接向非金融企业贷款（即“主街贷款”）迅速应对COVID-19疫情。我们的论文开发了一个新框架来比较和对比这些不同的政策。对于以大萧条为特征的金融中介机构资产负债表受损的情况，主街贷款和华尔街量化宽松是完全替代品，两者都能刺激总需求。相比之下，对于非金融企业面临显著现金流短缺的COVID-19衰退，华尔街量化宽松几乎完全无效，而主街贷款则可能具有高度刺激性。

records.title_en: Structural change and productivity growth in Europe — Past, present and future
records.title_cn: 欧洲的结构变化与生产率增长——过去、现在与未来
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of structural change on the historical path of aggregate labor productivity growth for a large sample of European countries, and it builds a quantitative multi-sector growth model to analyze the potential impact that structural change may have on future productivity growth. We document that the observed reallocation of economic activity since the 1970s towards the service sector has exerted a strongly negative effect on aggregate productivity growth in most European countries. Moreover, we perform a quantitative analysis to show that the expected path of structural change might continue to have a sizeable dent on future productivity growth in Europe. By contrast, the impact in the U.S. is expected to rapidly diminish. We show that this differential result can be explained by the large expansion, in Europe, of certain service sub-sectors characterized by stagnant productivity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了结构变化对欧洲国家大样本历史总劳动生产率增长路径的影响，并构建了一个定量多部门增长模型来分析结构变化可能对未来生产率增长产生的潜在影响。我们记录了自1970年以来观察到的经济活动向服务业部门的重新配置对大多数欧洲国家总生产率增长产生了强烈的负面影响。此外，我们进行了定量分析，表明预期的结构变化路径可能继续对欧洲未来的生产率增长产生显著影响。相比之下，美国的影响预计将迅速减弱。我们表明，这种差异结果可以解释为欧洲某些以生产率停滞为特征的特定服务子部门的大幅扩张。

records.title_en: Immigration and work schedules: Theory and evidence
records.title_cn: 移民与工作时间安排：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a theoretical framework to analyze the effects of immigration on native job amenities, focusing on work schedules. Immigrants have a comparative advantage in production at, and lower disamenity cost for nighttime work, which leads them to disproportionately choose nighttime employment. Because day and night tasks are imperfect substitutes, the relative price of day tasks increases as their supply becomes relatively more scarce. We provide empirical support for our theory. Native workers in local labor markets that experienced higher rates of immigration are more likely to work day shifts and receive a lower compensating differential for nighttime work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个理论框架来分析移民对本地居民工作福利的影响，重点关注工作时间安排。移民在生产夜班工作方面具有比较优势，且对夜班工作的不适成本较低，这导致他们不成比例地选择夜间就业。由于白天和夜间任务是不完全替代的，随着白天任务供给相对变得更加稀缺，其相对价格上升。我们为我们的理论提供了实证支持。在移民率较高的地方劳动力市场中，本地工人更可能上白班，并且获得的夜班补偿性工资差异较低。

records.title_en: Planning and saving for retirement
records.title_cn: 退休规划与储蓄
records.abstract_en: In this paper, I analyse the interplay between costly planning and imperfect self-control in the context of a dynamic retirement saving problem. For an exogenous planning horizon, poor self-control leads to fewer periods with positive savings and to under-accumulation of pension wealth. Consequently, an agent characterised by poor self-control postpones planning for retirement, or does not take action at all, if the cost of planning is high enough. The agent’s level of income emerges as another determinant of the planning decision, and thus the wealth-to-income ratio can be income dependent, even with CRRA preferences. Considering a mandatory pension scheme with rigid contribution and decumulation schedules, I demonstrate how the extent of crowding out of private savings and the associated welfare effects vary with the agent’s propensity to plan actively.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我分析了在动态退休储蓄问题中，高成本规划与不完全自我控制之间的相互作用。对于外生规划期限，较差的自我控制会导致正储蓄期数减少以及养老金财富积累不足。因此，如果规划成本足够高，自我控制较差的代理人会推迟退休规划，或者根本不采取行动。代理人的收入水平成为规划决策的另一个决定因素，因此即使在CRRA偏好下，财富收入比也可能依赖于收入。考虑到具有刚性缴费和累积提取计划的强制性养老金计划，我证明了私人储蓄被挤出的程度以及相关的福利效应如何随代理人积极规划的倾向而变化。

records.title_en: Comment on “Optimal monetary policy in an estimated SIR model by G. Benmir, I. Jaccard, and G. Vermandel”
records.title_cn: 评论“G. Benmir、I. Jaccard和G. Vermandel的估计SIR模型中的最优货币政策”

records.title_en: Sexual identity, gender, and anticipated discrimination in prosocial behavior
records.title_cn: 性身份、性别与亲社会行为中的预期歧视
records.abstract_en: We study whether individuals strategically mask signals about their affinity with the LGBTQ+ community in response to anticipated discrimination in prosocial behavior. We use a sharing (dictator) game in an online experiment where recipients are given the opportunity to signal their LGBTQ+ affinity. Decision-makers, upon observing these signals, decide how much of their endowment to share with their matched recipients. Overall, there is a decrease (although statistically insignificant) in the proportions of recipients who signal their affinity with the LGBTQ+ community when they are informed that these signals will be revealed to decision-makers. Importantly, we find a gender difference: women are more likely to hide such signals given information about how the signals will be used. Auxiliary analysis suggests that this gender difference is likely due to women’s higher propensity to anticipate discrimination. Moreover, we find that decision-makers do not differ in their treatment of individuals based on signals of their LGBTQ+ affinity. However, the intersection between decision-makers’ perceptions of these signals, and both their political stance on social issues and their views about LGBTQ+ rights, matter in shaping their sharing behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究个体是否会策略性地掩盖其与LGBTQ+群体亲和性的信号，以应对亲社会行为中的预期歧视。我们在在线实验中采用分享（独裁者）博弈，其中接受者有机会发出其LGBTQ+亲和性的信号。决策者在观察到这些信号后，决定将其禀赋中的多少分享给匹配的接受者。总体而言，当接受者被告知这些信号将向决策者披露时，发出LGBTQ+亲和性信号的接受者比例有所下降（尽管在统计上不显著）。重要的是，我们发现存在性别差异：在获知信号将如何被使用的情况下，女性更可能隐藏此类信号。辅助分析表明，这种性别差异可能源于女性更高的预期歧视倾向。此外，我们发现决策者对待个体的方式并不因其LGBTQ+亲和性信号而有所不同。然而，决策者对这些信号的感知，以及他们在社会问题上的政治立场和对LGBTQ+权利的看法，共同影响了他们的分享行为。

records.title_en: Competitive search with two-sided risk aversion
records.title_cn: 双边风险厌恶下的竞争性搜寻
records.abstract_en: Search theory is widely used in economics to study markets where trading frictions are prevalent. However, all existing theoretical models assume that either buyers or sellers (or both) are risk neutral, and the case where both parties are risk averse remains unexplored. This paper is a first step to fill this gap. I analyze a static competitive search model where risk-averse agents with different wealth seek to exchange an indivisible good. The housing market is an important application since a home typically represents a large part of a person’s wealth. I prove that a competitive search equilibrium is constrained efficient, and derive a generalized Hosios condition that relates the gains of the two parties in each transaction. Under risk aversion, wealthier buyers are more concerned with increasing their trading probability than with getting the best price. The opposite is true for sellers when the coefficient of absolute risk aversion is non-increasing. This results in positive sorting in equilibrium, that is, wealthier (poorer) buyers and sellers trading with each other at higher (lower) prices. This sorting mechanism offers a novel explanation for why the separation between rich and poor neighborhoods can be persistent.
records.abstract_cn: 搜寻理论在经济学中被广泛用于研究交易摩擦普遍存在的市场。然而，所有现有的理论模型都假设买方或卖方（或双方）是风险中性的，而双方均风险厌恶的情形尚未被探索。本文是填补这一空白的初步尝试。我分析了一个静态竞争性搜寻模型，其中具有不同财富的风险厌恶主体寻求交换一种不可分割的商品。住房市场是一个重要的应用，因为住房通常代表个人财富的很大一部分。我证明了竞争性搜寻均衡是受约束有效的，并推导出一个广义的Hosios条件，该条件将每笔交易中双方的收益联系起来。在风险厌恶下，较富有的买方更关心提高其交易概率，而非获得最优价格。当绝对风险厌恶系数非递增时，卖方的情况则相反。这导致均衡中的正向分类，即较富有（较贫穷）的买方和卖方以较高（较低）的价格相互交易。这种分类机制为富裕与贫困社区之间的分离为何可能持续存在提供了一种新颖的解释。

records.title_en: Unconventional monetary policy and local fiscal policy
records.title_cn: 非常规货币政策与地方财政政策
records.abstract_en: Following the onset of the pandemic, the Federal Reserve employed an unconventional monetary policy that directly intervened in municipal bond markets. We characterize the fiscal and macroeconomic implications of such central bank actions in a New Keynesian model of a monetary union. We assume that state and local governments are subject to a loan-in-advance constraint, reflecting that with lumpy cash flows, they often finance a fraction of expenditures by issuing short-term bonds. The municipal debt is held by financial intermediaries, who also supply credit to the private sector. Direct central bank purchases can transmit to the economy through two main channels: (1) by alleviating cash flow problems of the regional governments and (2) by accelerating lending to the private sector if credit constraints ease more broadly. By quantifying the relative importance of these channels, we highlight that the central bank’s actions lead to sizable increases in private investment but have more muted effects on state and local government expenditures. In addition, we also show the transmission of direct federal government aid through intergovernmental transfers is markedly different from unconventional policy.
records.abstract_cn: 疫情爆发后，美联储采取了直接干预市政债券市场的非常规货币政策。我们在一个货币联盟的新凯恩斯模型中刻画了此类央行行动的财政和宏观经济影响。我们假设州和地方政府面临贷款预付约束，这反映了由于现金流不规律，它们通常通过发行短期债券来为部分支出融资。市政债务由金融中介持有，这些中介同时也向私人部门提供信贷。央行的直接购买可以通过两个主要渠道传导至经济：（1）缓解地方政府的现金流问题；（2）如果信贷约束更广泛地放松，则加速对私人部门的贷款。通过量化这些渠道的相对重要性，我们强调央行的行动导致私人投资显著增加，但对州和地方政府支出的影响则较为温和。此外，我们还表明，通过政府间转移支付的联邦政府直接援助的传导与非常规政策显著不同。

records.title_en: The macroeconomics of age-varying epidemics
records.title_cn: 年龄变化流行病的宏观经济学
records.abstract_en: We incorporate age-specific socio-economic interactions in a SIR macroeconomic model to study the role of demographic factors for the COVID-19 epidemic evolution, its macroeconomic effects and possible containment measures. We capture the endogenous response of rational individuals who choose to reduce inter- and intra-generational social interactions, consumption- and labor-related personal exposure to the virus, while not internalizing the impact of their actions on others. We find that social distancing measures targeted to the elderly (who face higher mortality risk and are not part of the labor force) are best suited to save lives and mitigate output losses. The optimal economic shutdown generates small gains in terms of lives saved and large output losses, for any given type of social distancing. These results are confirmed by calibrating the model to match real epidemic and economic data in the context of a scenario exercise.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在SIR宏观经济模型中纳入年龄特定的社会经济互动，以研究人口因素对COVID-19疫情演变、其宏观经济影响及可能的遏制措施的作用。我们捕捉理性个体的内生反应，他们选择减少代际间和代际内的社会互动、消费和劳动相关的个人病毒暴露，同时不内化其行为对他人的影响。我们发现，针对老年人（他们面临更高的死亡风险且不属于劳动力）的社交距离措施最适合拯救生命并减轻产出损失。最优的经济停摆在任何给定的社交距离类型下，在拯救生命方面产生微小收益，而在产出损失方面产生巨大损失。这些结果通过校准模型以匹配情景演练中的真实疫情和经济数据得到证实。

records.title_en: Absolute income mobility and the effect of parent generation inequality: An extended decomposition approach
records.title_cn: 绝对收入流动性与父代不平等的影响：一种扩展分解方法
records.abstract_en: We use full-population data to study trends in intergenerational absolute income mobility, measured as the ratio of children earning more than their parents, for 11 Swedish cohorts born 1972–1983. Absolute mobility during this period increases from 72% to 84% for men and from 76% to 86% for women—higher figures than in most other countries studied. To explain these results, we outline a novel decomposition strategy that accounts for cohort variation in parent-generation income inequality. All else equal, if income inequality is higher in the parent generation, more economic growth is required to achieve any given level of absolute mobility. We discuss implications for comparative research in intergenerational income mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用全人口数据研究代际绝对收入流动性的趋势，以子女收入超过父母的比率衡量，针对1972-1983年出生的11个瑞典队列。在此期间，绝对流动性从男性的72%增加到84%，女性从76%增加到86%——高于大多数其他研究国家。为解释这些结果，我们提出了一种新颖的分解策略，该策略考虑了父代收入不平等的队列变异。在其他条件相同的情况下，如果父代收入不平等程度更高，则需要更多的经济增长才能实现任何给定的绝对流动性水平。我们讨论了对代际收入流动性比较研究的启示。

records.title_en: Testing rational hypotheses in signaling games
records.title_cn: 信号博弈中理性假设的检验
records.abstract_en: We introduce a solution concept for signaling games, called Rational Hypothesis Testing Equilibrium (RHTE). Beliefs are updated via Ortoleva’s (2012) Hypothesis Testing model, allowing for conditioning on information sets off the path. Hypotheses are conjectures by the uninformed player about opponent’s strategies that rationalize sending an unexpected message. Each RHTE is a Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium, but not vice versa. RHTE features a number of desirable properties: First, beliefs are structurally consistent in the spirit of Kreps and Wilson (1982). Second, beliefs are consistent with mutual knowledge of rationality. Third, RHTE can be related to the prominent refinement concepts, including the Intuitive Criterion, strategic stability, and undefeated equilibrium. In the Spence game, RHTE restricts the admissible wages, significantly reducing the number of equilibria. Finally, we show that our equilibrium notion offers an alternative explanation for the experimental results in Brandts and Holt (1992, 1993).
records.abstract_cn: 我们为信号博弈引入了一个解概念，称为理性假设检验均衡（RHTE）。信念通过Ortoleva（2012）的假设检验模型进行更新，允许对路径之外的信息集进行条件化。假设是未获知信息的参与者关于对手策略的猜想，这些猜想使发送意外信息合理化。每个RHTE都是完美贝叶斯均衡，但反之不然。RHTE具有若干理想性质：首先，信念在结构上与Kreps和Wilson（1982）的精神一致。其次，信念与理性的共同知识一致。第三，RHTE可以与著名的精炼概念相关联，包括直觉标准、战略稳定性和不败均衡。在Spence博弈中，RHTE限制了可接受的工资，显著减少了均衡的数量。最后，我们表明我们的均衡概念为Brandts和Holt（1992，1993）的实验结果提供了另一种解释。

records.title_en: Inflation and wage growth since the pandemic: A comment
records.title_cn: 疫情以来的通胀与工资增长：评论

records.title_en: Energy shortages and aggregate demand: Output loss and unequal burden from HANK
records.title_cn: 能源短缺与总需求：来自HANK的产出损失与不平等负担
records.abstract_en: I study the effects of a reduction in energy supply using a quantitative Heterogeneous Agents New Keynesian (HANK) model with energy consumption by households and firms. I find that changes in aggregate demand due to an increase in energy prices and labor market adjustments amplify the macroeconomic effects of the energy shock, but these effects remain manageable. In the model a 10% reduction in the energy supply leads to a Gross National Income (GNI) loss in range between 0.8% and 2%. The economic burden is highly nonlinear across the income distribution: most households face similar and relatively contained costs, while low-income households bear the heaviest burden. I show that monetary and fiscal policy can mitigate the economic costs and the unequal effects of energy shortages.
records.abstract_cn: 我使用一个包含家庭和企业能源消费的定量异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型，研究了能源供应减少的影响。我发现，由于能源价格上涨和劳动力市场调整引起的总需求变化放大了能源冲击的宏观经济效应，但这些效应仍然可控。在模型中，能源供应减少10%会导致国民总收入（GNI）损失在0.8%至2%之间。经济负担在收入分配中高度非线性：大多数家庭面临相似且相对有限的成本，而低收入家庭承担最沉重的负担。我表明，货币政策和财政政策可以缓解能源短缺的经济成本和不平等影响。

records.title_en: The Great Lockdown: Pandemic response policies and bank lending conditions
records.title_cn: 大封锁：疫情应对政策与银行贷款条件
records.abstract_en: This study analyses the effects of monetary and prudential policies taken in response to the outbreak of the coronavirus pandemic to support bank lending conditions. More precisely, we focus on the effects of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs) and their interaction with supervisory measures taken in the euro area. For identification, we use proprietary data on participation in central bank liquidity operations, high-frequency reactions to monetary policy announcements, and confidential supervisory information on bank capital requirements. We show that, in the absence of the funding cost relief associated with the pandemic response measures, banks’ ability to supply credit would have been severely affected. The results are robust to controlling for other concomitant policy measures such as government guarantees or quantitative easing. Our findings also indicate that the coordinated intervention by monetary and prudential authorities amplified the effects of the individual measures in supporting liquidity conditions and helping to sustain the flow of credit to the private sector. Finally, we find that, while monetary and prudential policies did not promote “zombie” lending and “zombie” firms, in absence of these measures the pandemic would have led to a significantly larger decline in firms’ employment.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了为应对新冠疫情爆发而采取的货币和审慎政策对支持银行贷款条件的影响。更确切地说，我们关注定向长期再融资操作（TLTROs）及其与欧元区采取的监管措施相互作用的效果。为了识别，我们使用了关于参与中央银行流动性操作的专有数据、对货币政策公告的高频反应以及关于银行资本要求的保密监管信息。我们表明，如果没有与疫情应对措施相关的融资成本减免，银行提供信贷的能力将受到严重影响。结果在控制其他伴随政策措施（如政府担保或量化宽松）后依然稳健。我们的发现还表明，货币和审慎当局的协调干预放大了各项措施在支持流动性条件和帮助维持向私营部门信贷流动方面的效果。最后，我们发现，虽然货币和审慎政策并未促进“僵尸”贷款和“僵尸”企业，但如果没有这些措施，疫情将导致企业就业显著更大的下降。

records.title_en: Preventing financial disasters: Macroprudential policy and financial crises
records.title_cn: 防范金融灾难：宏观审慎政策与金融危机
records.abstract_en: The ultimate goal of macroprudential policy is to prevent and reduce the costs of systemic financial crises, and thus contribute to promoting sustainable economic growth.
