However, despite the active role played by such policies in recent decades, there is still limited empirical evidence regarding whether prudential regulation is effective to enhance financial stability by preventing and mitigating crisis risk. This paper seeks to close that gap by studying the relationship between macroprudential policy and both the likelihood and severity of financial crises. The contribution of the paper is twofold. First, I show that macroprudential policy tightenings are successful at reducing the frequency of systemic financial crises. Moreover, this result holds even if macroprudential policies are implemented when the economy is already experiencing a financial boom or when monetary conditions are rather accommodative. I point to the prevention and mitigation of financial booms as the main transmission mechanism through which macroprudential policy defuses crisis risk. Second, I find that macroprudential policy enhances the resilience of the financial system, by dampening the output losses associated with future systemic financial crises. The latter result implies that macroprudential policy not only makes financial crises less likely, but also less painful.
records.abstract_cn: 宏观审慎政策的最终目标是预防和降低系统性金融危机的成本，从而促进可持续的经济增长。然而，尽管此类政策在近几十年中发挥了积极作用，关于审慎监管是否能有效通过预防和缓解危机风险来增强金融稳定性的经验证据仍然有限。本文旨在通过研究宏观审慎政策与金融危机的可能性和严重性之间的关系来填补这一空白。本文的贡献有两方面。首先，我表明宏观审慎政策的收紧能够成功降低系统性金融危机的发生频率。此外，即使在经济已经经历金融繁荣或货币条件相当宽松时实施宏观审慎政策，这一结果仍然成立。我将预防和缓解金融繁荣视为宏观审慎政策化解危机风险的主要传导机制。其次，我发现宏观审慎政策通过抑制与未来系统性金融危机相关的产出损失，增强了金融体系的韧性。后一结果意味着宏观审慎政策不仅使金融危机更不可能发生，而且使其痛苦程度更低。

records.title_en: Pioneer, early follower or late entrant: Entry dynamics with learning and market competition
records.title_cn: 先驱、早期跟随者或晚期进入者：具有学习和市场竞争的进入动态
records.abstract_en: Timing of market entry is one of the most important strategic decisions a firm must make, but its decision process becomes convoluted with information and payoff externalities. The threat of competition pushes firms to enter earlier to preempt their rivals while the possibility of learning makes them cautiously wait for others to take action. This combination amounts to a new class of timing games where a first-mover advantage first emerges as in preemption games but a second-mover advantage later prevails as in wars of attrition. Our model identifies under what conditions a firm becomes a pioneer, early follower or late entrant and provides efficiency implications by highlighting an elusive link between static market competition and dynamic entry competition.
records.abstract_cn: 市场进入时机是企业必须做出的最重要的战略决策之一，但其决策过程因信息和支付外部性而变得复杂。竞争的威胁促使企业更早进入以抢占先机，而学习的可能性则使它们谨慎地等待他人采取行动。这种组合构成了一类新的时机博弈，其中先发优势首先如抢占博弈中那样出现，但后发优势随后如消耗战中那样占据上风。我们的模型识别了在何种条件下企业成为先驱、早期跟随者或晚期进入者，并通过强调静态市场竞争与动态进入竞争之间难以捉摸的联系，提供了效率方面的启示。

records.title_en: Lying aversion and vague communication: An experimental study
records.title_cn: 厌恶说谎与模糊沟通：一项实验研究
records.abstract_en: An agent may strategically employ a vague message to mislead an audience’s belief about the state of the world, but this may cause the agent to feel guilt or negatively impact how the audience perceives the agent. Using a novel experimental design that allows participants to be vague while at the same time isolating the internal cost of lying from the social identity cost of appearing dishonest, we explore the extent to which these two types of lying costs affect communication. We find that participants exploit vagueness to be consistent with the truth, while at the same time leveraging the imprecision to their own benefit. More participants use vague messages in treatments where concern with social identity is relevant. In addition, we find that social identity concerns substantially affect the length and patterns of vague messages used across the treatments.
records.abstract_cn: 代理人可能策略性地使用模糊信息来误导受众对世界状态的信念，但这可能导致代理人感到内疚，或对受众如何看待代理人产生负面影响。通过一种新颖的实验设计，该设计允许参与者模糊表达，同时将说谎的内部成本与显得不诚实的社会身份成本分离开来，我们探讨了这两类说谎成本对沟通的影响程度。我们发现，参与者利用模糊性来与事实保持一致，同时利用不精确性为自己谋利。在关注社会身份的处理组中，更多参与者使用模糊信息。此外，我们发现社会身份关注显著影响了各处理组中模糊信息的长度和模式。

records.title_en: Adolescent development and the math gender gap
records.title_cn: 青少年发育与数学性别差距
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the determinants of the gap between girls and boys in mathematics performance (the ‘math gap’). We are particularly interested in the role played by pubertal development in explaining the widening of the math gap over adolescence. We estimate rich production function models of math skills, using data from the 1958 British National Child Development Study (NCDS), a longitudinal survey of all British children born in a single week in March 1958 which contains unique information on pubertal development and educational outcomes. Using (cumulative) value-added models, we show that the impact of puberty varies by the age and gender of the child, and that this heterogeneity can explain about two thirds of the math gap that emerges between the ages of 11 and 16. We find also that the widening of the math gap during adolescence is driven by markers of pubertal development which are publicly evident, rather than by markers which are only privately evident; and that the relationship between puberty and math scores is strongly associated with children's self-perceived ability in math. Taken together, these results suggest that the mechanisms underlying the relationship between pubertal development and the math gender gap are socially rather than biologically driven.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了女孩与男孩在数学表现上差距（“数学差距”）的决定因素。我们特别关注青春期发育在解释数学差距随青春期扩大中所起的作用。我们使用1958年英国国家儿童发展研究（NCDS）的数据，这是一项针对1958年三月某一周出生的所有英国儿童的纵向调查，其中包含关于青春期发育和教育结果的独特信息，来估计数学技能的丰富生产函数模型。使用（累积）增值模型，我们表明青春期的影响因儿童的年龄和性别而异，并且这种异质性可以解释在11岁至16岁之间出现的约三分之二的数学差距。我们还发现，青春期数学差距的扩大是由公开可见的青春期发育标志驱动的，而不是由仅私下可见的标志驱动的；并且青春期与数学成绩之间的关系与儿童自我感知的数学能力密切相关。综合来看，这些结果表明，青春期发育与数学性别差距之间关系的机制是社会性的而非生物性的。

records.title_en: Revisiting the New Keynesian policy paradoxes under QE
records.title_cn: 重新审视量化宽松下的新凯恩斯政策悖论
records.abstract_en: Standard New Keynesian models deliver puzzling results at the effective lower bound of short-term interest rates: greater price flexibility amplifies the fall in the output gap in response to adverse demand shocks; labour tax cuts are contractionary; the multiplier of wasteful government spending is large. These outcomes stem from a failure to characterise monetary policy correctly. Both analytically and numerically, we show that allowing the central bank to respond to inflation with quantitative easing can resolve all these paradoxes. In quantitative terms, mild adjustments to the central bank’s balance sheet are sufficient to obtain results more in line with conventional wisdom.
records.abstract_cn: 标准的新凯恩斯模型在短期利率有效下限处产生了令人困惑的结果：更大的价格灵活性放大了不利需求冲击下产出缺口的下降；劳动税削减是紧缩性的；浪费性政府支出的乘数很大。这些结果源于未能正确描述货币政策。通过分析和数值方法，我们表明允许中央银行通过量化宽松对通胀作出反应可以解决所有这些悖论。在数量上，对中央银行资产负债表的温和调整就足以获得更符合传统智慧的结果。

records.title_en: Commodity terms of trade volatility and industry growth
records.title_cn: 大宗商品贸易条件波动与行业增长
records.abstract_en: The rising volatility of commodity terms of trade (CTOT) is associated with a high cost of capital and a low credit supply for producers in commodity-dependent countries. In this paper, we examine how volatile CTOT influences various industries’ growth performance based on sector-level panel data for countries specializing in commodity exports. We find robust evidence that CTOT volatility causes a more significant growth loss in manufacturing sectors facing tighter credit constraints. The adverse growth effects operate through lower total factor productivity in industries heavily reliant on external finance for long-term investments and through lower capital accumulation in industries with high liquidity needs for short-term working capital. Our findings offer a complementary explanation for the “resource curse” through the credit constraint channel.
records.abstract_cn: 大宗商品贸易条件（CTOT）波动性的上升与依赖大宗商品的国家中生产者面临的高资本成本和低信贷供给相关。在本文中，我们基于专门出口大宗商品的国家的部门层面面板数据，考察了CTOT波动如何影响各行业的增长表现。我们发现了稳健的证据，表明CTOT波动对面临更严格信贷约束的制造业部门造成的增长损失更为显著。不利的增长效应通过以下途径发挥作用：在长期投资中严重依赖外部融资的行业，其全要素生产率下降；在短期营运资金流动性需求高的行业，资本积累减少。我们的发现通过信贷约束渠道为“资源诅咒”提供了补充解释。

records.title_en: Immigrant intergenerational mobility: A focus on childhood environment
records.title_cn: 移民的代际流动性：关注童年环境
records.abstract_en: Over 60% of immigrant parents in Sweden start off in the bottom quintile of the income distribution, yet only about 30% of their children are still in the bottom income quintile in adulthood. This progress notwithstanding, we show using administrative data that immigrant children who grow up in the 20th income percentile place three income ranks lower than native children of similarly low-income parents. This income gap cannot be explained by differences in parent education levels, family structure, or municipality of residence. The gap can, however, be explained by differences in immediate, 100 × 100 - m neighborhoods. Immigrant children grow up in relatively denser neighborhoods with fewer native-born and high-earning neighbors. Data from Stockholm suggest that immigrant families sort into different neighborhoods than natives due to Sweden’s rental housing allocation mechanism that is based on waiting time rather than market rents.
records.abstract_cn: 瑞典超过60%的移民父母起初处于收入分配的最底层的五分之一，但他们的子女中只有约30%在成年后仍处于收入最底层的五分之一。尽管有这种进步，我们使用行政数据表明，在收入百分位第20位成长的移民子女，其收入排名比收入同样低的本地父母所生的子女低三个收入等级。这一收入差距无法用父母教育水平、家庭结构或居住城市的差异来解释。然而，这一差距可以用直接的、100×100米的邻里差异来解释。移民子女成长的邻里相对更密集，且本地出生和高收入的邻居较少。来自斯德哥尔摩的数据表明，由于瑞典的租赁住房分配机制基于等待时间而非市场租金，移民家庭与本地家庭会选择不同的邻里居住。

records.title_en: Market competition and discrimination
records.title_cn: 市场竞争与歧视
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of competition on ethnic discrimination by carrying out a field experiment in the context of the rice market in Bangladesh. We recruit professional rice buyers (middlemen) to act as judges in a rice competition by providing a quality rating and a price quote for rice samples that we randomly associate with farmers bearing ethnic majority or minority names. First, we find that there is no ethnic difference in buyers’ evaluation of rice quality. Second, we find that local buyers, who have local monopsony power, discriminate against ethnic minority farmers by quoting a lower price for their rice relative to that of ethnic majority farmers. Third, we find that wholesale buyers, who face fierce competition in the marketplace, do not price discriminate against ethnic minority farmers. A second lab-in-the-field experiment and survey information indicate that both local and wholesale buyers are prejudiced against ethnic minority farmers. This suggests that market competition can eliminate the discrimination of wholesale buyers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过在孟加拉国大米市场进行实地实验，研究竞争对种族歧视的影响。我们招募专业大米买家（中间商）作为大米竞赛的评委，对大米样品进行质量评级和报价，这些样品被随机与具有多数或少数族裔姓名的农民相关联。首先，我们发现买家对大米质量的评价不存在种族差异。其次，我们发现拥有当地买方垄断权力的本地买家会歧视少数族裔农民，对其大米报价低于多数族裔农民。第三，我们发现面临激烈市场竞争的批发买家不会对少数族裔农民进行价格歧视。第二个实验室实地实验和调查信息表明，本地和批发买家都对少数族裔农民存在偏见。这表明市场竞争可以消除批发买家的歧视。

records.title_en: Can self-set goals encourage resource conservation? Field experimental evidence from a smartphone app
records.title_cn: 自我设定的目标能否促进资源节约？来自智能手机应用的实地实验证据
records.abstract_en: This study leverages a large RCT to examine the potential of goal-setting nudges to encourage resource conservation at scale. We randomize a feature that allows subjects to set themselves energy consumption targets in a popular smartphone app. We document negative effects of the nudge on app utilization and estimate null effects on energy consumption with confidence intervals that rule out estimates from observational studies. A complementary survey identifies the mechanisms underlying these behavioral responses. Using a structural model and random variation of the app’s price, we estimate that the average user is willing to pay 7.41 EUR to avoid the nudge.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用一项大规模随机对照试验，考察了目标设定助推措施在规模上鼓励资源节约的潜力。我们在一个流行的智能手机应用中随机化了一项功能，允许用户为自己设定能源消耗目标。我们记录了该助推措施对应用使用的负面影响，并估计了对能源消耗的零效应，其置信区间排除了观察性研究的估计值。一项补充调查揭示了这些行为反应背后的机制。利用结构模型和应用价格的随机变动，我们估计平均用户愿意支付7.41欧元以避免该助推措施。

records.title_en: The impact of group identity on experimental markets with externalities
records.title_cn: 群体身份对外部性实验市场的影响
records.abstract_en: Existing evidence demonstrates that the degree of social homogeneity in a society correlates with various economic indicators. Using experimental techniques, we establish the causal impact of social distance on socially responsible behavior, market prices, market efficiency and income inequality. We develop an experimental market where low-cost production generates a negative externality to a third party, while high-cost production eliminates the externality. We compare behavior in groups varying whether the third party shares a common identity with buyers and sellers (in-group condition) or not (out-group condition). Our findings indicate that socially responsible behavior is generally robust across our treatments. However, boosting group identity improves economic welfare indicators, as it leads to a striking reduction of economic inequality through changes in market price levels and improves market efficiency. Overall, our experiment shows that the social environment of market interactions matters a great deal and has significant implications for the design of institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 现有证据表明，社会中的社会同质性程度与各种经济指标相关。通过实验技术，我们确立了社会距离对社会责任行为、市场价格、市场效率和收入不平等的因果影响。我们开发了一个实验市场，其中低成本生产对第三方产生负外部性，而高成本生产则消除外部性。我们比较了第三方与买卖双方共享共同身份（内群体条件）或不共享（外群体条件）的群体行为。我们的研究结果表明，社会责任行为在我们的处理中普遍稳健。然而，增强群体身份改善了经济福利指标，因为它通过市场价格水平的变化显著减少了经济不平等，并提高了市场效率。总体而言，我们的实验表明，市场互动的社会环境非常重要，对制度设计具有重大意义。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous expectations, forecast accuracy and firms’ credit demand
records.title_cn: 异质性预期、预测准确性与企业信贷需求
records.abstract_en: Firm heterogeneity in formulating expectations constitutes a source of friction for the credit market. An expected improvement of credit conditions in the future may slacken current credit demand. Using a panel of European firms in the period 2010–2019, I find that better expectations on future (six-month) access to credit reduce the probability of a firm to apply for bank loans by 3 percent. Results also suggest that access to credit expectations are adaptive. Although firms fail 43 percent of their access to credit forecasts, they adjust their expectations learning from previous forecast errors.
records.abstract_cn: 企业在形成预期时的异质性构成了信贷市场摩擦的一个来源。对未来信贷条件的预期改善可能会削弱当前的信贷需求。利用2010-2019年期间欧洲企业的面板数据，我发现对未来（六个月）信贷获取的更好预期会使企业申请银行贷款的概率降低3%。结果还表明，信贷获取预期是适应性的。尽管企业在其信贷获取预测中有43%的失败率，但它们会从先前的预测错误中学习来调整其预期。

records.title_en: Banning volume discounts to curb excessive consumption: A cautionary tale
records.title_cn: 禁止数量折扣以遏制过度消费：一个警示故事
records.abstract_en: Volume discounts encourage consumers to buy more. Banning such discounts should then lead to consumers buying less. This is the thinking behind banning multiple-unit discounts, including multibuy price promotions, to curb excessive harmful consumption of alcohol and high-fat, -sugar, and -salt (HFSS) foods. However, our analysis questions the validity of this thinking, which ignores the possible restraining effect of volume discounts. We find that such a ban for retailing alcohol in Scotland increased rather than reduced sales. Retailers switched to using more straight (single-unit) discounts, which encouraged high-consumption households to increase their shopping frequency and buy more.
records.abstract_cn: 数量折扣鼓励消费者购买更多。禁止此类折扣应导致消费者减少购买。这是禁止多单位折扣（包括多买优惠促销）以遏制酒精和高脂肪、高糖、高盐（HFSS）食品过度有害消费背后的逻辑。然而，我们的分析质疑了这一逻辑的有效性，因为它忽略了数量折扣可能具有的抑制作用。我们发现，苏格兰对酒精零售实施此类禁令反而增加了而非减少了销售量。零售商转而使用更多直接（单单位）折扣，这鼓励了高消费家庭增加购物频率并购买更多。

records.title_en: Germany’s capacity to work from home
records.title_cn: 德国居家办公能力
records.abstract_en: We propose an index of working from home (WFH) capacity for the German economy, drawing on rich survey and administrative data. We find that 56 percent of jobs are WFH feasible, most of which are located in urban areas and in highly digitized industries. Using individual-level data on tasks and work conditions, we show that heterogeneity in WFH feasibility is largely explained by differences in task content. WFH feasible jobs are typically characterized by cognitive, non-manual tasks, and PC usage. We compare our survey-based measure with popular task-based measures of WFH capacity, which usually rely on determining tasks that are incompatible with WFH, and show that task-based approaches capture variation in WFH capacity across occupations fairly accurately. A simple measure of PC use intensity will generally constitute a suitable proxy for WFH capacity. Finally, we demonstrate that our WFH index is a strong predictor of actual WFH outcomes during the Covid-19 crisis and discuss applications in the context of the pandemic and the future of work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用丰富的调查和行政数据，为德国经济提出一个居家办公（WFH）能力指数。我们发现56%的工作岗位适合居家办公，其中大部分位于城市地区和高数字化行业。利用关于任务和工作条件的个体层面数据，我们表明居家办公可行性的异质性在很大程度上由任务内容的差异所解释。适合居家办公的工作通常具有认知性、非体力任务和电脑使用的特点。我们将基于调查的度量与流行的基于任务的居家办公能力度量进行比较，后者通常依赖于确定与居家办公不相容的任务，并表明基于任务的方法能够相当准确地捕捉各职业居家办公能力的差异。一个简单的电脑使用强度度量通常可以作为居家办公能力的合适代理指标。最后，我们证明我们的居家办公指数是新冠19危机期间实际居家办公结果的强预测因子，并讨论了在疫情和未来工作背景下的应用。

records.title_en: Model selection accuracy in behavioral game theory: A simulation
records.title_cn: 行为博弈论中的模型选择准确性：一项模拟研究
records.abstract_en: We simulate a horse race between several behavioral models of play in one-shot games. First, we find that many models can lead to identical predictions, making it impossible to select a unique winning model. This is largely avoided by comparing only two models. But even then we find that cross-validation sometimes fails to select the true model, often because models are be estimated to be noiseless but then fail to predict out-of-sample data. The Bayesian Information Criterion avoids this problem, though the inflexibility of its parameter penalty appears to cause poor performance in certain settings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们模拟了一场在一次性博弈中几种行为模型之间的赛马。首先，我们发现许多模型可能产生相同的预测，使得无法选择唯一的优胜模型。通过仅比较两个模型，这在很大程度上得以避免。但即便如此，我们发现交叉验证有时无法选择真实模型，这通常是因为模型被估计为无噪声，但随后无法预测样本外数据。贝叶斯信息准则避免了这一问题，尽管其参数惩罚的不灵活性似乎在特定情境下导致性能不佳。

records.title_en: Dissecting the impact of imports from low-wage countries on inflation
records.title_cn: 解析来自低工资国家的进口对通货膨胀的影响
records.abstract_en: Using micro data on import values and quantities by product and countries of origin, we quantify the effect of imports from low-wage countries (LWCs) on inflation in France from 1994 to 2014. Imports of varieties produced in LWCs affect the cost-of-living price index through pure-price and taste-shock variations (which, conditional on prices, drive expenditure shares). The pure-price effect includes both the contribution of imported inflation (given the share of imports in consumption) and the effect of imports of intermediate goods from LWCs on domestic prices. Taste shocks cannot be directly observed but are recovered from expenditure shares and relative prices, using estimated values for the elasticity of substitution. We derive an expression of inflation that allows us to disentangle the impact of imports of consumption goods from LWCs on cost-of-living versus CPI inflation — the latter abstracting for composition effects. Overall, we estimate that imports from LWCs lowered CPI inflation by 0.02 pp per year on average, and had a much larger effect on cost-of-living inflation (between 0.13 to 0.20 pp per year depending on how we measure unit values).
records.abstract_cn: 利用按产品和原产国划分的进口值和数量的微观数据，我们量化了1994年至2014年间来自低工资国家（LWCs）的进口对法国通货膨胀的影响。来自低工资国家生产的品种通过纯价格和口味冲击变化（在给定价格的条件下，这些变化驱动支出份额）影响生活成本价格指数。纯价格效应既包括进口通胀的贡献（给定进口在消费中的份额），也包括来自低工资国家的中间品进口对国内价格的影响。口味冲击无法直接观察，但通过支出份额和相对价格，利用估计的替代弹性值来恢复。我们推导出一个通胀表达式，使我们能够区分来自低工资国家的消费品进口对生活成本通胀与CPI通胀的影响——后者抽象了构成效应。总体而言，我们估计来自低工资国家的进口平均每年将CPI通胀降低了0.02个百分点，并对生活成本通胀产生了更大的影响（根据我们衡量单位价值的方式，每年在0.13至0.20个百分点之间）。

records.title_en: Immigration, household production, and native women’s labor market outcomes: A survey of a global phenomenon
records.title_cn: 移民、家庭生产与本土女性劳动力市场结果：全球现象综述
records.abstract_en: Most of the literature on how immigration affects the labor market focuses on the outcomes of natives in direct competition with immigrants. This paper reviews a growing literature on an alternative channel. Immigrants, particularly low-skilled women, are disproportionately represented in the household services sector, a global phenomenon that is seen to some extent in most regions. A simple time-use model suggests that by lowering the price of market-provided household services, immigrant workers allow high-skilled native women to reduce their unpaid household production and increase their participation in the labor market. I review existing evidence that the presence of foreign domestic workers has increased the labor supply of high-skilled native women, has helped narrow the gender earnings gap in high-paying powered occupations, and that these advances have not come at the cost of native women investing less time in their children or having lower birth rates. I discuss the policy implications of these results, as well as some ethical considerations.
records.abstract_cn: 关于移民如何影响劳动力市场的大部分文献关注的是与移民直接竞争的本地人的结果。本文回顾了一个日益增长的关于替代渠道的文献。移民，特别是低技能女性，在家庭服务部门中的比例过高，这是一个全球现象，在大多数地区都有一定程度的表现。一个简单的时间使用模型表明，通过降低市场提供的家庭服务的价格，移民工人使高技能本土女性能够减少其无酬家庭生产，并增加其劳动力市场参与。我回顾了现有证据，表明外籍家政工人的存在增加了高技能本土女性的劳动力供给，有助于缩小高薪职业中的性别收入差距，并且这些进步并非以本土女性在子女身上投入更少时间或生育率降低为代价。我讨论了这些结果的政策含义，以及一些伦理考量。

records.title_en: Tuition fees and educational attainment
records.title_cn: 学费与教育成就
records.abstract_en: Following a landmark court ruling in 2005, more than half of Germany’s universities started charging tuition fees, which were later abolished in a staggered manner. We exploit the fact that even students who were already enrolled had to start paying fees. We show that fees increase study effort and degree completion among these students. However, fees also decrease first-time university enrollment among high school graduates. Combining this enrollment impact with the effect on completion, we find that fees around the zero-price margin have only little effect on overall educational attainment. We conclude by discussing policies targeting the separate effect margins of fees and caution against a general abolition.
records.abstract_cn: 在2005年一项具有里程碑意义的法院裁决之后，德国超过一半的大学开始收取学费，这些费用后来以交错的方式被废除。我们利用了一个事实，即即使是已经入学的学生也必须开始支付费用。我们表明，费用增加了这些学生的学业努力和学位完成率。然而，费用也降低了高中毕业生首次大学入学的比例。将这一入学影响与对完成率的影响相结合，我们发现，在零价格边际附近的费用对整体教育成就的影响很小。最后，我们讨论了针对费用不同影响边际的政策，并警告不要普遍废除学费。

records.title_en: Firms’ financing dynamics around lumpy capacity adjustments
records.title_cn: 企业围绕块状产能调整的融资动态
records.abstract_en: We study how firms adjust their financial positions around the times when they undertake lumpy adjustments in capital or employment. Using U.S. firm level data, we document systematic patterns of cash and debt financing around lumpy adjustment, remarkably similar across capital and employment. Firm-specific fundamentals reflected in Tobin’s Q, profitability and productivity are leading indicators of lumpy adjustment. Cash and debt capacity are actively manipulated, and contribute significantly quantitatively, to increase financial resources in anticipation of the expansion of firm capacity. Lumpy contractions in productive capacity follow years where firms reduce cash balances and hold above average levels of debt. During and after contractions, firms rebuild cash and reduce debt growth significantly in a concerted effort to restore financial resources by adjusting their productive operations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业在进行资本或就业的块状调整时如何调整其财务状况。利用美国企业层面数据，我们记录了围绕块状调整的现金和债务融资的系统性模式，这些模式在资本和就业方面惊人地相似。反映在托宾Q、盈利能力和生产率中的企业特定基本面因素是块状调整的领先指标。现金和债务能力被积极操纵，并在数量上显著地有助于增加财务资源，以预期企业产能的扩张。产能的块状收缩发生在企业减少现金余额并持有高于平均水平的债务之后的几年。在收缩期间和之后，企业重建现金并显著降低债务增长，通过调整其生产运营来协同努力恢复财务资源。

records.title_en: Saving constraints, inequality, and the credit market response to fiscal stimulus
records.title_cn: 储蓄约束、不平等与财政刺激的信贷市场反应
records.abstract_en: We document substantial heterogeneity in the interest rate response to fiscal stimulus (IRRF) across OECD economies. The IRRF is negative in half of the OECD countries, and it declines with income inequality. To interpret this evidence we develop a model in which moderately-low-income households take on debt to maintain a consumption threshold (effectively a saving constraint). Now burdened with debt, these households use additional income to deleverage. In more unequal economies with more saving-constrained households, increases in government spending tighten credit conditions less (relax credit conditions more), leading to smaller increases (larger declines) in the interest rate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了OECD经济体中财政刺激利率反应（IRRF）的显著异质性。IRRF在半数OECD国家为负，且随收入不平等程度下降而降低。为解释这一证据，我们构建了一个模型，其中中等偏低收入家庭为维持消费阈值（实际上是储蓄约束）而举债。这些家庭现在背负债务，利用额外收入去杠杆。在储蓄约束家庭更多的不平等经济体中，政府支出增加对信贷条件的收紧程度较小（放松程度较大），导致利率上升幅度较小（下降幅度较大）。

records.title_en: News shocks to investment-specific technology in business cycles
records.title_cn: 商业周期中投资专用技术的新闻冲击
records.abstract_en: Recent research in DSGE and VAR models has indicated that the most important drivers of business cycles are IST shocks, not traditional TFP and other shocks. Research in VAR models has also empirically identified IST news shocks as a significant driving force behind the U.S. business cycle. However, recent New-Keynesian DSGE models have found that IST news shocks do not produce comovement of aggregate variables, with the share of the forecast error variance explained by IST news shocks being very small in a flexible-price model and essentially zero in a sticky-price model. This paper uses the Bayesian methods to estimate the parameters and shock processes to study the business cycle effects of IST news shocks in a two-sector sticky-price DSGE model with consumer durables and collateral constraints. Our variance decompositions indicate that IST news shocks are a more relevant source of uncertainty than IST non-news and other shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 近期DSGE和VAR模型的研究表明，商业周期最重要的驱动因素是IST冲击，而非传统的TFP和其他冲击。VAR模型的研究也实证识别出IST新闻冲击是美国商业周期的重要驱动力。然而，近期的新凯恩斯DSGE模型发现，IST新闻冲击不能产生总量变量的共同运动，在弹性价格模型中，IST新闻冲击解释的预测误差方差份额非常小，在粘性价格模型中基本为零。本文使用贝叶斯方法估计参数和冲击过程，研究在包含耐用消费品和抵押品约束的两部门粘性价格DSGE模型中IST新闻冲击的商业周期效应。我们的方差分解表明，IST新闻冲击比IST非新闻冲击和其他冲击是更相关的不确定性来源。

records.title_en: Temporary foreign work permits: Honing the tools to defeat human smuggling
records.title_cn: 临时外国工作许可：完善打击人口走私的工具
records.abstract_en: We study how temporary visa schemes can be designed to drive smugglers out of business while meeting labor market needs in host countries. After discussing their compatibility with a large range of policy objectives, we show how combining internal and external controls with a regulated market for temporary visas alleviates the policy trade-off between migration control and ending human smuggling. We use information on irregular migration from Senegal to Spain and the Democratic Republic of Congo to South Africa to calibrate the “eviction” prices of visas for these two routes, which are set to throttle smuggling activities. Our results highlight important constraints for governments seeking to prevent temporary workers from overstaying, especially on south–north routes such as Senegal to Spain. They suggest combining a regulated market for visas with tighter sanctions against employers of undocumented workers as a way forward.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究如何设计临时签证计划，以在满足东道国劳动力市场需求的同时，将走私者逐出市场。在讨论了这些计划与广泛政策目标的兼容性之后，我们展示了将内部和外部控制与受监管的临时签证市场相结合如何缓解移民控制与结束人口走私之间的政策权衡。我们利用从塞内加尔到西班牙以及从刚果民主共和国到南非的非正规移民信息，校准了这两条路线的签证“驱逐”价格，这些价格旨在遏制走私活动。我们的结果凸显了政府试图防止临时工人逾期居留时所面临的重要约束，尤其是在诸如塞内加尔至西班牙这样的南北路线上。他们建议将受监管的签证市场与对雇佣无证工人的雇主实施更严厉的制裁相结合，作为前进的方向。

records.title_en: The COVID-19 recession on both sides of the Atlantic: A model-based comparison
records.title_cn: 大西洋两岸的COVID-19衰退：基于模型的比较
records.abstract_en: This paper compares the COVID-19 recession in the euro area (EA) and the US using an estimated multi-region New Keynesian macroeconomic model. To capture quarterly dynamics from 2020 onwards, we introduce relevant extensions such as ‘forced’ savings, extensive versus intensive employment margins, and trade in commodities as inputs to production and final demand. Transitory (‘forced’) savings are central to account for the behaviour of economic activity in both regions during the pandemic, which was strongly driven by private consumption, alongside other shocks to domestic demand and shocks to foreign activity. The model highlights the importance of demand recovery and rising commodity prices for the inflation acceleration during 2021–22. EA inflation has a stronger supply component (including commodity prices) compared to a stronger demand component in the US.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用一个估计的多区域新凯恩斯主义宏观经济模型，比较了欧元区（EA）和美国的COVID-19衰退。为了捕捉从2020年起的季度动态，我们引入了相关扩展，如‘强制’储蓄、广泛与密集就业边际，以及商品作为生产和最终需求投入的贸易。暂时性（‘强制’）储蓄对于解释疫情期间两个地区经济活动的行为至关重要，这主要由私人消费以及其他国内需求和外国活动冲击驱动。模型强调了需求复苏和大宗商品价格上涨对2021-22年通胀加速的重要性。与美国的较强需求成分相比，欧元区的通胀具有更强的供给成分（包括大宗商品价格）。

records.title_en: Costly multi-unit search
records.title_cn: 昂贵的多单位搜索
records.abstract_en: We formulate and solve a costly multi-unit search problem for the optimal selling of a stock of goods. Our showcase application is an inventory liquidation problem with holding costs, such as warehousing, salaries or floor planning. A seller faces a stream of buyers periodically arriving with random capped demands. At each decision point, he decides how to price each unit and also whether to stop searching or not. We set this as a dynamic programming problem and solve it inductively by characterizing optimal search rules and reservation prices. Our inductive logic does not rely in the use of the first order conditions for optimal pricing and optimal search decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建并解决了一个昂贵的多单位搜索问题，用于商品库存的最优销售。我们的展示应用是一个带有持有成本（如仓储、工资或地板规划）的库存清算问题。卖方面临着一系列定期到达的买家，这些买家具有随机的有上限需求。在每个决策点，他决定如何为每个单位定价，以及是否停止搜索。我们将其设定为一个动态规划问题，并通过刻画最优搜索规则和保留价格来归纳地解决它。我们的归纳逻辑不依赖于最优定价和最优搜索决策的一阶条件。

records.title_en: Do markets overcome repugnance? Muslim trade response to anti-Muhammad cartoons
records.title_cn: 市场能否克服厌恶？穆斯林对反穆罕默德漫画的贸易反应
records.abstract_en: What is the effect of religious beliefs on economic choices? And in light of this effect, what is the cost of free speech? After Danish newspapers published anti-Muhammad cartoons, the religious status of trade with Denmark changed exogenously in Muslim countries. Exports from Denmark to Muslim countries decreased by 31%, while close substitute countries like Finland gained export share. Final goods were more affected than intermediate goods, as were more religious Muslim countries. Denmark did not shift exports to other countries, but trade quantity rebounded in 20 months. Notably, Muslim exports to Denmark were unaffected, which is consistent with money overcoming repugnance.
records.abstract_cn: 宗教信仰对经济选择有何影响？鉴于这种影响，言论自由的代价是什么？在丹麦报纸刊登反穆罕默德漫画后，穆斯林国家与丹麦贸易的宗教地位发生了外生变化。丹麦对穆斯林国家的出口下降了31%，而像芬兰这样的近似替代国家则获得了出口份额。最终产品比中间产品受影响更大，宗教性更强的穆斯林国家也是如此。丹麦并未将出口转向其他国家，但贸易量在20个月后回升。值得注意的是，穆斯林对丹麦的出口未受影响，这与金钱克服厌恶的观点一致。

records.title_en: Gender-based price discrimination in the annuity market: Evidence from Chile
records.title_cn: 年金市场中的性别价格歧视：来自智利的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper provides the first evidence for discriminatory behaviour against female consumers in the annuity market. It focuses on Chile, where an electronic bidding system allows retirees to receive offers, simultaneously from several firms in the market for the same standardised annuity product. By exploiting within-individual variation in initial offers across firms, this analysis shows that firms with market power offer more unfairly priced annuities to women than to men. This result is driven by highly rated firms. Gender differences in financial literacy can explain why firms find it profitable to offer higher prices to women.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了年金市场中针对女性消费者歧视行为的首个证据。研究聚焦于智利，该国采用电子竞价系统，使退休人员能够同时从市场中的多家公司收到针对同一标准化年金产品的报价。通过利用个体内部不同公司初始报价的差异，本分析表明，拥有市场势力的公司向女性提供的年金定价比男性更不公平。这一结果由高评级公司驱动。金融素养的性别差异可以解释为何公司发现向女性提供更高价格是有利可图的。

records.title_en: Leadership under the shadow of the future: Intelligence and strategy choice in infinitely repeated games
records.title_cn: 未来阴影下的领导力：无限重复博弈中的智力与策略选择
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of intelligence on decision making in an infinitely repeated sequential public goods game. Using a two-part experiment, we collect data on subjects’ intelligence and a wide range of preference characteristics, and match these to their full contingent strategy profiles. We find that leaders are less likely to play a free-riding strategy as their intelligence increases. Followers are less likely to play a grim-trigger strategy as intelligence increases. Performing simulations using players’ strategies, we find that groups contribute more and are more profitable as intelligence increases. Our results have implications for the design of policies promoting group success.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了智力对无限重复序贯公共品博弈中决策的影响。通过一个两部分实验，我们收集了受试者智力及广泛偏好特征的数据，并将其与他们的完整条件策略概况相匹配。我们发现，随着智力的提高，领导者更不可能采取搭便车策略。随着智力的提高，追随者更不可能采取冷酷触发策略。利用参与者的策略进行模拟，我们发现随着智力的提高，群体贡献更多且更有利可图。我们的结果对促进群体成功的政策设计具有启示意义。

records.title_en: The last temptation: Is group-based voting resilient to pivotal considerations?
records.title_cn: 最后的诱惑：基于群体的投票能否抵御关键性考量？
records.abstract_en: Group-based reasoning asserts that a voter will adopt the strategy that maximizes their payoff, assuming that this strategy will also be employed by all voters of their type. In this paper, we examine a general model involving multiple candidates and voter types, and we demonstrate that, in mandatory or costless elections, group-based voting remains resilient to pivotal considerations (i.e. the impulse to deviate from the strategy that maximizes the group’s payoffs in favor of one’s own payoff). This finding strengthens the connection between two important theories on voting behavior – group-based reasoning and individual utility maximization – and highlights that they do not always produce starkly different predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 基于群体的推理认为，选民会采取最大化其收益的策略，并假设所有同类型的选民也会采取这一策略。在本文中，我们考察了一个涉及多个候选人和选民类型的通用模型，并证明在强制或无成本的选举中，基于群体的投票仍然能够抵御关键性考量（即偏离最大化群体收益的策略而偏向个人收益的冲动）。这一发现加强了关于投票行为的两个重要理论——基于群体的推理和个体效用最大化——之间的联系，并强调它们并不总是产生截然不同的预测。

records.title_en: Love of variety and gains from trade
records.title_cn: 品种偏好与贸易收益
records.abstract_en: We show analytically and quantitatively how gains from trade depend on love of variety, defined as the extent to which an additional product variety generates benefits in either final or intermediate consumption. To do this, we use a multi-country, multi-sector heterogeneous-firm gravity trade model where love of variety is parameterized separately from product substitutability using a generalized CES demand function. Counterfactual simulations based on a calibrated version of this model show that the gains from trade commonly vary by a proportion of one to three depending on the value of the love-of-variety elasticity. Trade war simulations also point to the strong sensitivity of the assessed impacts. We conclude that love of variety may be an important determinant of the gains from trade, an aspect that has so far been overlooked for the sake of convenience in the modeling framework and due to lack of empirical estimates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们从解析和数量上展示了贸易收益如何依赖于品种偏好，即额外产品品种在最终或中间消费中产生收益的程度。为此，我们使用了一个多国、多部门异质性企业引力贸易模型，其中品种偏好通过广义CES需求函数与产品替代性分别参数化。基于该模型校准版本的反事实模拟显示，贸易收益通常根据品种偏好弹性的值以一比三的比例变化。贸易战模拟也指出了评估影响的强烈敏感性。我们得出结论，品种偏好可能是贸易收益的重要决定因素，而这一方面迄今为止因建模框架的便利性和缺乏经验估计而被忽视。

records.title_en: Robust trade policy to offset foreign market power
records.title_cn: 稳健的贸易政策以抵消外国市场势力
records.abstract_en: While it is well known that trade policy can be used to counter foreign firm market power, it suffers from a lack of robustness over what form it should take. If the import demand function has a certain curvature then a tariff will improve importer welfare while an import subsidy will lower it. However, the opposite holds if the import demand function has a different shape. Picking the right option is made even more difficult as there is little hope of confidently identifying the curvature of import demand. This paper demonstrates that moving beyond the either/or dichotomy and using a combination of an ad valorem tariff and a specific import subsidy can completely offset a foreign firm’s market power. This policy is not subject to the information constraints that undermine the single instrument choice, making it more robust. Combining it with a simple fiscal neutrality constraint delivers an efficient outcome, which is also robust to; country size; whether the market power is in the hands of a foreign exporter (monopoly) or importer (monopsony); and, more generally, the nature of conduct when more than one foreign firm has market power (oligopoly/oligopsony).
records.abstract_cn: 尽管众所周知，贸易政策可用于对抗外国企业的市场势力，但其应采取何种形式却缺乏稳健性。如果进口需求函数具有某种曲率，那么关税将改善进口国福利，而进口补贴则会降低福利。然而，如果进口需求函数具有不同形状，则情况相反。由于几乎没有希望可靠地识别进口需求的曲率，选择正确的选项变得更加困难。本文证明，超越非此即彼的二分法，采用从价关税与特定进口补贴的组合，可以完全抵消外国企业的市场势力。该政策不受削弱单一工具选择的信息约束影响，因此更具稳健性。将其与简单的财政中性约束相结合，可实现有效结果，并且该结果对以下方面也具有稳健性：国家规模；市场势力掌握在外国出口商（垄断）还是进口商（买方垄断）手中；以及更一般地，当多个外国企业拥有市场势力（寡头垄断/寡头买方垄断）时的行为性质。

records.title_en: Wealth preference and rational bubbles
records.title_cn: 财富偏好与理性泡沫
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that rational bubbles can exist within a neoclassical economy, provided that households derive utility from holding wealth. Hence, we provide a microfoundation for bubbles that relies on a frictionless economy with an infinitely-lived representative household. While our bubbly equilibria are very similar to those obtained by Tirole (1985) in an overlapping generation economy, the underlying mechanism is fundamentally different. Instead of relying on an exchange across heterogeneous households, the bubble relies on the representative household’s willingness to accumulate wealth without the intention of spending it. Turning to public debt, we carefully review the similarities and the differences between rational bubbles and Ponzi schemes. We establish that the Ricardian equivalence must hold in any of our equilibria. Finally, within a monetary economy, we show that the preference for wealth is fundamentally different from money-in-the-utility-function.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们表明，只要家庭从持有财富中获得效用，理性泡沫就可以存在于新古典经济中。因此，我们为泡沫提供了一个微观基础，该基础依赖于一个无摩擦的经济，其中有一个无限期生存的代表性家庭。虽然我们的泡沫均衡与Tirole（1985）在重叠世代经济中获得的均衡非常相似，但潜在机制根本不同。泡沫不依赖于异质家庭之间的交换，而是依赖于代表性家庭积累财富而不打算花费的意愿。转向公共债务，我们仔细回顾了理性泡沫与庞氏骗局之间的相似之处和不同之处。我们确定，李嘉图等价在我们的任何均衡中都必须成立。最后，在货币经济中，我们表明财富偏好与效用函数中的货币根本不同。

records.title_en: Gains from monetary policy cooperation under asymmetric currency pricing
records.title_cn: 非对称货币定价下货币政策合作的收益
records.abstract_en: In most international trade transactions, the U.S. dollar is used. Hence, this study considers optimal monetary policy in a two-country model under asymmetric currency pricing (ACP) in which U.S. (Home) firms use producer currency pricing (PCP) while firms in the rest of the world (Foreign) use local currency pricing (LCP). In the ACP model, there is an additional inefficiency, namely, the internal relative price distortion compared with the LCP model and the distortion arising from deviations from the law of one price compared with the PCP model. Consequently, welfare gains from monetary policy cooperation in the ACP model are substantially greater compared with the LCP and PCP models. Moreover, the noncooperative Foreign policymakers in the ACP model can manipulate not only the internal relative price but also deviations from the law of one price in favor of their own welfare through nominal exchange rate adjustment, whereas the noncooperative Home policymakers can control neither. This result rationalizes the fact that the U.S. designates currency manipulators to protect its welfare. Therefore, gains from cooperation in Home are larger than in Foreign. Furthermore, I find that there are substantial gains from cooperation in the ACP model even under the conditions that remove gains from cooperation in the LCP and PCP models.
records.abstract_cn: 在国际贸易交易中，美元被广泛使用。因此，本研究考虑在非对称货币定价（ACP）的两国模型中的最优货币政策，其中美国（本国）企业采用生产者货币定价（PCP），而世界其他地区（外国）企业采用当地货币定价（LCP）。在ACP模型中，存在额外的低效率，即与LCP模型相比的内部相对价格扭曲，以及与PCP模型相比的一价定律偏离所产生的扭曲。因此，与LCP和PCP模型相比，ACP模型中货币政策合作的福利收益要大得多。此外，在ACP模型中，非合作的外国政策制定者不仅可以通过名义汇率调整操纵内部相对价格，还可以操纵一价定律的偏离以利于自身福利，而本国的非合作政策制定者则无法控制这两者。这一结果解释了美国指定汇率操纵国以保护其福利的事实。因此，本国合作的收益大于外国。此外，我发现即使在消除LCP和PCP模型中合作收益的条件下，ACP模型中仍存在可观的合作收益。

records.title_en: Sources of Economic Policy Uncertainty in the euro area
records.title_cn: 欧元区经济政策不确定性的来源
records.abstract_en: We create economic policy uncertainty (EPU) indicators for the four largest euro area countries by applying two unsupervised machine learning algorithms to news articles. The procedure allows to uncover components of EPU endogenously for the four European languages. The uncertainty indices computed from January 2000 to May 2019 capture episodes of regulatory change, trade tensions and financial stress. In an evaluation exercise, we use a structural vector autoregression model to study the effects of uncertainty on investment and on private consumption. We document considerable effects for the political and domestic regulation uncertainty components on investment, while the other types show heterogeneous effects across countries. For instance, trade uncertainty influences Germany’s investment more than its counterparts. Moreover, we observe strong negative effects of uncertainty on consumption for countries such as Italy (political) and Spain (fiscal, political and domestic regulation).
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过将两种无监督机器学习算法应用于新闻文章，为欧元区四个最大的国家创建了经济政策不确定性（EPU）指标。该程序允许内生地揭示四种欧洲语言中EPU的组成部分。从2000年一月到2019年五月计算的不确定性指数捕捉了监管变化、贸易紧张和金融压力的时期。在评估练习中，我们使用结构向量自回归模型来研究不确定性对投资和私人消费的影响。我们记录了政治和国内监管不确定性成分对投资的显著影响，而其他类型在不同国家表现出异质性效应。例如，贸易不确定性对德国投资的影响大于其对应国家。此外，我们观察到不确定性对消费的强烈负面影响，例如意大利（政治）和西班牙（财政、政治和国内监管）。

records.title_en: Religion, Covid-19 and mental health
records.title_cn: 宗教、Covid-19与心理健康
records.abstract_en: Covid-19 and the resulting lockdowns affected various aspects of people’s lives, including their mental health. Using data from an online survey, we investigate the role of religiosity in mediating the effect of Covid-19 on mental health. From February-March 2021, we conducted online surveys in the USA among 5178 individuals. These surveys elicited responses on (i) the incidence of Covid-19 infections among the respondents or their immediate social networks, (ii) religious beliefs and practices, and (iii) mental health. Employing the CES-D scale, which tests for depression in clinical settings, we find that while the incidence of a Covid-19 infection is associated with significantly worse mental health, this negative association is significantly smaller for religious people. We show that the mental health benefits of being religious emanate from the ability to participate in religious activities.
records.abstract_cn: Covid-19及其导致的封锁影响了人们生活的各个方面，包括心理健康。利用在线调查数据，我们研究了宗教信仰在调节Covid-19对心理健康影响中的作用。从2021年二月至三月，我们在美国对5178人进行了在线调查。这些调查收集了以下方面的回应：（i）受访者或其直接社交网络中Covid-19感染的发生情况，（ii）宗教信仰与实践，以及（iii）心理健康。采用临床环境中用于检测抑郁症的CES-D量表，我们发现虽然Covid-19感染的发生与显著较差的心理健康相关，但这种负面关联在宗教人士中显著较小。我们表明，宗教信仰带来的心理健康益处源于参与宗教活动的能力。

records.title_en: An independent European macroeconomics? A history of European macroeconomics through the lens of the European Economic Review
records.title_cn: 独立的欧洲宏观经济学？以《欧洲经济评论》为视角的欧洲宏观经济学史
records.abstract_en: Economics in Europe has become more international since the 1970s. To a certain extent, this internationalisation is also an ‘Americanisation’ as many European economists have adopted the standards and approaches of US economics. This prompts an important question: amidst this convergence, are there any fields that have managed to retain a distinctively European character?
records.abstract_cn: 自1970年代以来，欧洲经济学变得更加国际化。在一定程度上，这种国际化也是一种“美国化”，因为许多欧洲经济学家采用了美国经济学的标准和方法。这引发了一个重要问题：在这种趋同中，是否有任何领域设法保留了独特的欧洲特色？

records.title_en: Green technology policies versus carbon pricing: An intergenerational perspective
records.title_cn: 绿色技术政策与碳定价：代际视角
records.abstract_en: Technology policy is the most widespread form of climate policy and is often preferred over seemingly efficient carbon pricing. We propose a new explanation for this observation: gains that predominantly accrue to households with large capital assets and that influence majority decisions in favor of technology policy. We study climate policy choices in an overlapping generations model with heterogeneous energy technologies and distortionary income taxation. Compared to carbon pricing, green technology policy leads to a pronounced capital subsidy effect that benefits most of the current generations but burdens future generations. Based on majority voting which disregards future generations, green technology policies are favored over a carbon tax. Smart “polluter-pays” financing of green technology policies enables obtaining the support of current generations while realizing efficiency gains for future generations.
records.abstract_cn: 技术政策是气候政策最普遍的形式，且通常优于看似高效的碳定价。我们对此现象提出一种新的解释：收益主要归于拥有大量资本资产的家庭，并影响多数决策偏向技术政策。我们在一个具有异质性能源技术和扭曲性所得税的重叠世代模型中研究气候政策选择。与碳定价相比，绿色技术政策产生显著的资本补贴效应，惠及当前大多数世代，但加重未来世代的负担。基于忽视未来世代的多数投票，绿色技术政策优于碳税。绿色技术政策的明智“污染者付费”融资方式，能够在实现未来世代效率收益的同时，获得当前世代的支持。

records.title_en: Optimal monetary policy in an estimated SIR model
records.title_cn: 估计SIR模型中的最优货币政策
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the design of Ramsey optimal monetary policy in a Health New Keynesian (HeNK) model with Susceptible, Infected and Recovered (SIR) agents. The nonlinear model is estimated with maximum likelihood techniques on Euro Area data. Our objective is to deconstruct the mechanism by which contagion risk affects the conduct of monetary policy. If monetary policy is the only game in town, we find that optimal policy features significant deviations from price stability to mitigate the effect of the pandemic. The best outcome is obtained when the optimal Ramsey policy is combined with a lockdown strategy of medium intensity. In this case, monetary policy can concentrate on its price stabilization objective.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个包含易感、感染和康复（SIR）主体的健康新凯恩斯（HeNK）模型中研究了拉姆齐最优货币政策的设计。该非线性模型使用最大似然技术对欧元区数据进行估计。我们的目标是解构传染风险影响货币政策执行的机制。如果货币政策是唯一的政策工具，我们发现最优政策表现出显著偏离价格稳定的特征，以减轻疫情的影响。当最优拉姆齐政策与中等强度的封锁策略相结合时，可获得最佳结果。在这种情况下，货币政策可以专注于其价格稳定目标。

records.title_en: Levelling the debt–equity playing field: Evidence from Belgium
records.title_cn: 平衡债务与股权的竞争环境：来自比利时的证据
records.abstract_en: I explore whether a Belgian policy that reduced the corporate tax bias towards debt finance was successful in lowering firm leverage. Using putatively exogenous time series variation in the cost of equity financing and a difference-in-differences strategy that includes similar firms from surrounding countries, I find that the policy did lead to increased equity ratios, with some evidence of a shift from short-term debt to long-term debt.
records.abstract_cn: 我探讨了比利时一项减少企业税收偏向债务融资的政策是否成功降低了企业杠杆。利用股权融资成本中假定外生的时间序列变化，以及一个包含周边国家类似企业的双重差分策略，我发现该政策确实导致了股权比率的提高，并有一些证据表明从短期债务转向长期债务。

records.title_en: Climate, technology, family size; on the crossroad between two ultimate externalities
records.title_cn: 气候、技术、家庭规模；处于两个最终外部性之间的十字路口
records.abstract_en: We extend the Brock–Mirman model with endogenous growth through variety expansion, temperature rise affecting both the level and build up of TFP, human capital, and endogenous fertility. We derive closed-form solutions for capital investments, research, and the Social Cost of Carbon. Calibration of the fundamentals show that the social costs of carbon associated with reduced TFP growth are very large (median: 161 €/tCO2) compared to previous SCC estimates based on climate change TFP-level effects. We also compare the contribution of population growth to welfare through its effects on knowledge creation versus its effect on accelerated climate change. We find in most cases a net positive externality of children on average welfare for other dynasties (median: 22 k€/child).
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过品种扩张、影响全要素生产率水平和建设、人力资本和内生生育力的温度上升，扩展了布罗克-米尔曼模型的内生增长。我们为资本投资、研究和碳社会成本得出封闭式解决方案。基本面校准表明，与 SCC 之前基于气候变化 TFP 水平影响的估计相比，与 TFP 增长下降相关的碳社会成本非常大（中位数：161 €/tCO2）。我们还通过人口增长对知识创造的影响和对加速气候变化的影响来比较人口增长对福利的贡献。我们发现在大多数情况下，其他王朝的儿童平均福利具有净正外部性（中位数：22千欧元/儿童）。

records.title_en: On portfolio frictions, asset returns and volatility
records.title_cn: 论投资组合摩擦、资产回报与波动性
records.abstract_en: We rationalize the observed short-run differences in corporate and long-term government bond yields in an financial-accelerator model with frictions that restrict changes in portfolio shares. We estimate the model on quarterly data for the Euro Area from 1999 to 2019, and show that the portfolio friction parameter is positive and significant. Portfolio frictions not only generate a time-varying wedge between the two returns that fits the data, but also raise the volatility of return differentials, and the precautionary motive of savers. As a result, the macroeconomic effects of uncertainty shocks are amplified by portfolio frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个金融加速器模型中，通过限制投资组合份额变化的摩擦，合理化了企业和长期政府债券收益率在短期内的差异。我们使用1999年至2019年欧元区的季度数据估计该模型，并表明投资组合摩擦参数为正且显著。投资组合摩擦不仅产生了与数据相符的两种回报之间的时变楔形，还提高了回报差异的波动性以及储蓄者的预防性动机。因此，不确定性冲击的宏观经济效应被投资组合摩擦放大。

records.title_en: Multi-country modelling at the commission of the European communities: Centralised and decentralised approaches
records.title_cn: 欧洲共同体委员会的多国建模：集中与分散方法
records.abstract_en: Since the early days of the European economic and monetary integration, European institutions have faced policy challenges requiring an assessment of the economic interdependencies across countries and the spillover effects of national policies. Some of these challenges have been addressed by developing multi-country models. By looking at the origins of multi-country modelling, we highlight the existence of a long-standing dilemma: the choice between the “centralized” approach, relying on homogeneous specifications of national economies and the “decentralized” approach, which “links” heterogeneous pre-existing national models. This article documents the debates over these two approaches, as the dilemma was confronted by macroeconomists working for the Directorate General of Economic and Financial Affairs (“DG II”) in the 1970s and 1980s. We explore the intellectual and institutional reasons that brought DG II to follow the decentralized approach for their first in-house multi-country model (“EUROLINK”), and later caused it to abandon this model in favour of a centralized approach. We also document the innovative solutions proposed by European economists to model trade linkages across countries, and their struggle with formalizing financial flows. Overall, this case study sheds light on the issues at stake when modelling economic interdependencies.
records.abstract_cn: 自欧洲经济和货币一体化初期以来，欧洲机构面临的政策挑战需要评估各国之间的经济相互依存关系以及国家政策的溢出效应。其中一些挑战通过开发多国模型得以解决。通过审视多国建模的起源，我们强调了一个长期存在的困境：依赖于国家经济同质化设定的“集中”方法与“链接”异质性既有国家模型的“分散”方法之间的选择。本文记录了关于这两种方法的辩论，因为这一困境在1970年代和1980年代被经济与金融事务总局（“DG II”）工作的宏观经济学家所面对。我们探讨了促使DG II在其首个内部多国模型（“EUROLINK”）中采用分散方法，以及后来放弃该模型转而采用集中方法的智识和制度原因。我们还记录了欧洲经济学家为建模国家间贸易联系所提出的创新解决方案，以及他们在形式化金融流动方面的挣扎。总体而言，本案例研究揭示了在建模经济相互依存关系时所涉及的问题。

records.title_en: Uncertainty shocks in emerging economies: A global to local approach for identification
records.title_cn: 新兴经济体的不确定性冲击：一种从全球到局部的识别方法
records.abstract_en: The paper investigates the effects of uncertainty shocks in emerging economies (EMEs). I construct novel measures of uncertainty for fifteen small EMEs and to address endogeneity I instrument them with fluctuations in global uncertainty. My results show that uncertainty shocks have substantial contractionary effects on GDP, stock prices and local currencies and the recessionary effect is much stronger in EMEs compared to advanced economies (AEs). I also estimate a negative co-movement between prices and output which triggers a delayed monetary tightening in correspondence to the inflationary peak. Counterfactual scenarios reveal that in the absence of uncertainty shocks, the fall in GDP recorded in EMEs during the 2008–2009 crisis would have been attenuated by around 2%.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了不确定性冲击对新兴经济体（EMEs）的影响。我为十五个小型新兴经济体构建了新的不确定性度量，并为了解决内生性问题，使用全球不确定性的波动作为工具变量。我的结果表明，不确定性冲击对GDP、股票价格和本币汇率具有显著的紧缩效应，且与发达经济体（AEs）相比，新兴经济体的衰退效应更为强烈。我还估计了价格与产出之间的负向联动，这引发了在通胀峰值对应的延迟货币紧缩。反事实情景显示，在没有不确定性冲击的情况下，2008-2009年危机期间新兴经济体记录的GDP下降幅度将减少约2%。

records.title_en: The global financial cycle and capital flows during the COVID-19 pandemic
records.title_cn: 全球金融周期与COVID-19疫情期间的资本流动
records.abstract_en: We estimate the heterogeneous effect of the global financial cycle on exchange rates and cross-border capital flows during the COVID-19 pandemic, using weekly exchange rate and portfolio flow data for a panel of 59 advanced and emerging market economies. We estimate a global financial cycle (GFC) index at the weekly frequency with data through the end of 2021. We then estimate the country-specific sensitivities of exchange rates and capital flows to fluctuations in the GFC. The ability of the GFC to explain fluctuations in exchange rates and capital flows increased dramatically during the pandemic. There is significant cross-country heterogeneity in the response of exchange rates or capital flows to fluctuations in the GFC. During the pandemic, high-frequency indicators like weekly changes in Covid cases and vaccination rates were just as important as standard macroeconomic fundamentals like the current account, reserves, and net foreign assets in explaining this heterogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用59个发达和新兴市场经济体的每周汇率和组合流动数据，估计了COVID-19疫情期间全球金融周期对汇率和跨境资本流动的异质性影响。我们使用截至2021年底的数据，以周度频率估计全球金融周期（GFC）指数。然后，我们估计了各国汇率和资本流动对GFC波动的敏感性。疫情期间，GFC解释汇率和资本流动波动的能力显著增强。汇率或资本流动对GFC波动的响应存在显著的跨国异质性。疫情期间，诸如每周新冠病例变化和疫苗接种率等高频指标，在解释这种异质性方面，与经常账户、储备和净外国资产等标准宏观经济基本面同样重要。

records.title_en: Indebted sellers, liquidity and mortgage standards
records.title_cn: 负债卖家、流动性与抵押贷款标准
records.abstract_en: The effects of households’ indebtedness on their house selling decisions, the implications of these decisions for default and the effects of policies intended to reduce the incentive to default are studied in a dynamic model with search in the housing market and defaultable long-term mortgages. In equilibrium, both sellers’ asking prices and time-to-sell increase with the relative size of their outstanding debt. For sellers in financial distress, this behavior results in a positive relationship between debt and their individual risk of default. Prices and time-to-sell determine both the liquidity of the housing market and the aggregate risk of default. As such they determine the extent of profitable lending by competitive lenders. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the model also generates, as observed, positive correlations (i) across sellers of asking prices with loan-to-value ratios, and (ii) over time of both house prices and time-to-sell with mortgage loan-to-value ratios at mortgage origination. Policies aimed at reducing default may be counterproductive if they raise the value of mortgages and thus lower lending standards, ultimately increasing the rate of default and reducing aggregate welfare. We consider also the implications of these policies for the effects of aggregate shocks on house prices and the rate and severity of mortgage default.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在一个具有住房市场搜索和可违约长期抵押贷款的动态模型中，研究了家庭负债对其房屋出售决策的影响、这些决策对违约的启示，以及旨在减少违约激励的政策效果。在均衡状态下，卖家的要价和售出时间均随其未偿债务的相对规模增加而增加。对于陷入财务困境的卖家，这种行为导致债务与其个人违约风险之间存在正相关关系。价格和售出时间决定了住房市场的流动性和总体违约风险，因此也决定了竞争性贷款机构可盈利贷款的程度。以美国经济为校准对象，该模型还如观察所示，产生了以下正相关关系：（i）不同卖家的要价与贷款价值比之间，（ii）房价和售出时间随时间与抵押贷款发放时的贷款价值比之间。旨在减少违约的政策如果提高了抵押贷款的价值从而降低了贷款标准，最终可能增加违约率并降低总体福利，从而适得其反。我们还考虑了这些政策对总冲击影响房价以及抵押贷款违约率和严重程度的影响。

records.title_en: How residence permits affect the labor market attachment of foreign workers: Evidence from a migration lottery in Liechtenstein
records.title_cn: 居留许可如何影响外国工人的劳动力市场依附：来自列支敦士登移民抽签的证据
records.abstract_en: We analyze the impact of obtaining a residence permit on foreign workers’ labor market and residential attachment. To overcome the usually severe selection issues, we exploit a unique migration lottery that randomly assigns access to residence permits for (prospective and current) workers with an employment contract in Liechtenstein, which is situated centrally in Europe. Using an instrumental variable approach, our results show that lottery compliers raise their employment probability in Liechtenstein by on average 24 percentage points across outcome periods (2008 to 2018) as a result of receiving a permit. Relatedly, their activity level and employment duration in Liechtenstein increase by on average 20 percentage points and 1.15 years, respectively, over the outcome window. These substantial and statistically significant effects are predominantly driven by individuals not (yet) working in Liechtenstein prior to the lottery rather than by previous cross-border commuters, but even for the latter group (generally living relatively close to the border), important positive employment effects emerge in the longer run. Indeed, we find both the labor market and residential effects to be persistent even several years after the lottery with no sign of fading out. These results suggest that granting resident permits to foreign workers can be effective to foster labor supply, despite the alternative of commuting cross-border from adjacent regions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了获得居留许可对外国工人劳动力市场和居住依附的影响。为克服通常严重的选样问题，我们利用了一项独特的移民抽签，该抽签随机分配在列支敦士登（位于欧洲中部）持有雇佣合同的（潜在和现有）工人获得居留许可的机会。使用工具变量方法，我们的结果显示，抽签合规者因获得许可而在列支敦士登的就业概率在结果期间（2008年至2018年）平均提高24个百分点。相应地，他们在列支敦士登的活动水平和就业持续时间在结果窗口内平均分别增加20个百分点和1.15年。这些显著且统计上显著的效果主要由抽签前未（尚未）在列支敦士登工作的个体驱动，而非之前的跨境通勤者，但即使对于后者群体（通常居住地相对靠近边境），在长期内也出现了重要的积极就业效应。实际上，我们发现劳动力市场和居住效应在抽签后数年仍然持续，没有消退迹象。这些结果表明，尽管存在从邻近地区跨境通勤的替代选择，但向外国工人发放居留许可可以有效促进劳动力供给。

records.title_en: Asymmetric effects of trade and FDI: The role of country size and bridge multinational production
records.title_cn: 贸易与外商直接投资的非对称效应：国家规模与桥梁型跨国生产的作用
records.abstract_en: Gains from trade in goods stem from three channels: (i) trade, (ii) domestic multinational production (DMP), and (iii) bridge multinational production (BMP). We develop a quantitative theory to measure the effects of trade barriers and country size on the gains from openness through each of these channels. We show that gains are sensitive to country size and larger in Europe than in South America (i.e larger in countries with low barriers). Country size is a crucial determinant of the contribution of each of these channels to the total gains from openness: smaller countries gain more. DMP is more important in large countries, whereas the BMP channel is more important in small countries.
records.abstract_cn: 商品贸易的收益来源于三个渠道：（i）贸易，（ii）国内跨国生产（DMP），以及（iii）桥梁型跨国生产（BMP）。我们开发了一个定量理论来衡量贸易壁垒和国家规模通过每个渠道对开放收益的影响。我们表明，收益对国家规模敏感，且在欧洲大于南美洲（即在壁垒较低的国家更大）。国家规模是决定每个渠道对总开放收益贡献的关键因素：较小的国家获益更多。DMP在大型国家中更为重要，而BMP渠道在小型国家中更为重要。

records.title_en: Are the effects of uncertainty shocks big or small?
records.title_cn: 不确定性冲击的影响是大还是小？
records.abstract_en: Previous works have reached widely divergent conclusions on the macroeconomic relevance of uncertainty shocks. We show that this disagreement reflects identification problems linked to the use of financial data in low-frequency VAR models. To bypass this difficulty, we identify uncertainty shocks using daily data and use their monthly averages as instruments in VARs. This novel identification approach captures within-month interactions between uncertainty and asset prices, providing a full picture of the pivotal role of financial markets in propagating uncertainty to the real economy. Once these interactions are accounted for, the disagreement disappears: uncertainty shocks have a small but significant impact on economic activity across specifications and identification schemes.
records.abstract_cn: 以往的研究在不确定性冲击对宏观经济的重要性上得出了截然不同的结论。我们表明，这种分歧反映了与在低频VAR模型中使用金融数据相关的识别问题。为了绕过这一困难，我们使用日度数据识别不确定性冲击，并将其月度平均值作为VAR中的工具变量。这种新颖的识别方法捕捉了不确定性与资产价格在月内的相互作用，提供了金融市场在将不确定性传导至实体经济中关键作用的完整图景。一旦考虑到这些相互作用，分歧便消失了：不确定性冲击对各种设定和识别方案下的经济活动都有较小但显著的影响。

records.title_en: The maturity composition of government debt: A comprehensive database
records.title_cn: 政府债务的期限结构：一个综合数据库
records.abstract_en: We present a novel dataset which covers all central government debt issued by twenty OECD economies over the last quarter century and describe common features of debt management and the composition of debt across time and countries. Just like debt levels, debt maturity has substantially increased over this sample period. Despite this long term positive co-movement, there is a clear short term tendency for debt maturity to shorten as debt increases. Maturity is actively reshuffled, even at constant levels of debt. The majority of fluctuations in maturity are consistent with cost-minimization.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个新颖的数据集，涵盖了二十个OECD经济体在过去四分之一世纪中发行的所有中央政府债务，并描述了债务管理的共同特征以及债务在不同时间和国家间的构成。与债务水平一样，债务期限在该样本期间也大幅增加。尽管存在这种长期的正向共同运动，但短期内存在明显的趋势，即随着债务增加，债务期限缩短。即使在债务水平不变的情况下，期限也会被积极调整。期限波动的大部分与成本最小化一致。

records.title_en: Sectoral shocks, reallocation, and labor market policies
records.title_cn: 部门冲击、再配置与劳动力市场政策
records.abstract_en: Unemployment insurance and wage subsidies are key tools to support labor markets in recessions. We develop a multisector search-and-matching model with on-the-job human capital accumulation to study labor market policy responses to sector-specific shocks. Our calibration accounts for structural differences in labor markets between the United States and the euro area, including a lower job-finding rate in the latter. We use the model to evaluate unemployment insurance and wage subsidy policies in recessions of different duration. After a temporary sector-specific shock, unemployment insurance improves reallocation toward productive sectors at the cost of initially higher unemployment and, thus, human capital destruction. By contrast, wage subsidies reduce unemployment and preserve human capital at the cost of limiting reallocation. In the United States, unemployment insurance is preferred to wage subsidies when it does not distort job creation for too long. In the euro area, wage subsidies are preferred, given the lower job-finding rate and reallocation.
records.abstract_cn: 失业保险和工资补贴是衰退时期支持劳动力市场的关键工具。我们构建了一个包含在职人力资本积累的多部门搜寻匹配模型，以研究针对特定部门冲击的劳动力市场政策应对。我们的校准考虑了美国和欧元区劳动力市场的结构性差异，包括后者较低的求职率。我们利用该模型评估不同持续时间衰退中的失业保险和工资补贴政策。在暂时的部门特定冲击之后，失业保险改善了向生产性部门的再配置，但代价是初期失业率上升，从而造成人力资本破坏。相比之下，工资补贴降低了失业率并保留了人力资本，但代价是限制了再配置。在美国，当失业保险不会过久地扭曲就业创造时，它优于工资补贴。在欧元区，鉴于较低的求职率和再配置，工资补贴更受青睐。

records.title_en: Firm behaviour under negative deposit rates
records.title_cn: 负存款利率下的企业行为
records.abstract_en: Using rich microdata from Denmark, the first country in the world to move its key monetary-policy rate below zero, we find that firms which become exposed to negative interest rates on their bank deposits increase their fixed investments and employment to a larger extent than what can be explained by the associated reduction in the level of interest rates. They also tend to rebalance their liquid portfolio, reduce their degree of leverage and become more inclined to change bank connections. Our results also indicate that it is the event of becoming exposed to negative rates (the extensive margin), not the share of deposits exposed to negative interest rates (the intensive margin), that matters for firm behaviour. These findings support the existence of a corporate channel of monetary transmission when bank deposit rates cross zero and become negative.
records.abstract_cn: 利用丹麦（世界上第一个将关键货币政策利率降至负值的国家）的丰富微观数据，我们发现，那些银行定期存款面临负利率的企业，其固定投资和就业的增加幅度超过了利率水平下降所能解释的范围。它们还倾向于重新平衡其流动性资产组合，降低杠杆率，并更倾向于更换银行关系。我们的结果还表明，是企业面临负利率的事件（广延边际），而非面临负利率的存款比例（集约边际），对企业行为产生影响。这些发现支持了当银行存款利率降至零以下时，存在企业渠道的货币传导机制。

records.title_en: Free riding in networks
records.title_cn: 网络中的搭便车行为
records.abstract_en: Players allocate their budgets to links, a local public good, and a private good. A player links in order to free ride on public good provided by others. We derive sufficient conditions for the existence of a Nash equilibrium, in which large contributors link to each other, while others link to them. If linking costs are sufficiently high, poorer players may contribute more and have more central positions in the network than richer ones do. In large societies, free riding reduces inequality only in networks in which it is initially low. Otherwise, richer players free ride more, as they can afford more links. Finally, we derive the policy implications for income redistribution.
records.abstract_cn: 参与者将预算分配给链接（一种地方公共品）和私人品。参与者建立链接是为了搭他人提供的公共品的便车。我们推导出纳什均衡存在的充分条件，在该均衡中，大贡献者相互链接，而其他人则链接到他们。如果链接成本足够高，较贫穷的参与者可能比较富有的参与者贡献更多，并在网络中占据更中心的地位。在大型社会中，搭便车行为仅在初始不平等程度较低的网络中减少不平等。否则，较富有的参与者搭便车更多，因为他们能负担更多的链接。最后，我们推导出收入再分配的政策含义。

records.title_en: Innovation and inequality from stagnation to growth
records.title_cn: 从停滞到增长的创新与不平等
records.abstract_en: This study explores the evolution of income inequality in an economy featuring an endogenous transition from stagnation to growth. We incorporate heterogeneous households in a Schumpeterian model of endogenous takeoff. In the pre-industrial era, the economy is in stagnation, and income inequality is determined by the unequal distribution of land. When the takeoff occurs, the economy experiences innovation and economic growth, and income inequality gradually rises until the economy reaches the steady state. We calibrate the model for a quantitative analysis and compare the simulation results to historical data in the UK. Extending the analysis to allow for endogenous labor supply, we find that endogenous labor supply introduces a channel through which inequality contributes to shaping the transition path of the economy and that households sort themselves into a leisure class that supplies zero labor and the rest of society that supplies labor.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了一个从停滞到增长的内生转型经济体中的收入不平等演变。我们在一个熊彼特式内生起飞模型中纳入了异质性家庭。在前工业化时代，经济处于停滞状态，收入不平等由土地的不平等分配决定。当起飞发生时，经济经历创新和经济增长，收入不平等逐渐上升，直到经济达到稳态。我们校准模型进行定量分析，并将模拟结果与英国的历史数据进行比较。将分析扩展到允许内生劳动供给，我们发现内生劳动供给引入了一个渠道，通过该渠道不平等有助于塑造经济的转型路径，并且家庭将自己分类为提供零劳动的休闲阶层和提供劳动的其余社会群体。

records.title_en: Risk sharing in currency unions: The migration channel
records.title_cn: 货币联盟中的风险分担：移民渠道
records.abstract_en: International risk sharing insulates consumption from country-specific business-cycle fluctuations. This matters for countries in currency unions who lack monetary autonomy. In the spirit of Mundell (1961), we formally integrate migration as a distinct channel into the standard framework used to quantify risk sharing. For the US we find that interstate migration absorbs about 10 percent of the fluctuations in state-level output, for the euro area the corresponding number is 5 percent, consistent with the fact that migration rates are about 15 times higher in the US. The overall amount of risk sharing in the US is approximately three times as high.
records.abstract_cn: 国际风险分担使消费免受特定国家商业周期波动的影响。这对于缺乏货币自主权的货币联盟国家尤为重要。秉承蒙代尔（1961）的思想，我们将移民作为一个独立渠道正式纳入用于量化风险分担的标准框架。对于美国，我们发现州际移民吸收了州级产出波动的约10%；对于欧元区，相应数字为5%，这与美国的移民率约为欧元区的15倍这一事实相符。美国的总体风险分担水平大约是欧元区的三倍。

records.title_en: Private sector debt overhang and government spending multipliers: Not all debts are alike
records.title_cn: 私人部门债务积压与政府支出乘数：并非所有债务都一样
records.abstract_en: This study empirically examines whether government spending multipliers vary depending on the level of debt in the private sector by estimating an interacted panel vector autoregressive model (IPVAR) with unbalanced panel data from 29 OECD countries. Results reveal that (i) government spending multipliers become larger in private debt overhang; (ii) and not all debts are alike: empirical evidence on the larger multipliers in household debt overhang are mixed, while the larger multipliers in firm debt overhang are clear; (iii) in firm debt overhang, positive government spending strongly crowds in both private consumption and investment compared comparing with low firm debt periods, and the multipliers are larger than one; and (iv) in household debt overhang, those crowding-in effects, particularly the effects on private consumption, are not as strong. I investigate various private debt-dependent transmission channels of government spending, including the labor and financial markets. Differences in the behavior of the labor market and investment decision across firm debt overhang and household debt overhang may be important for understanding the empirical results.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究通过估计一个交互面板向量自回归模型（IPVAR），使用来自29个OECD国家的不平衡面板数据，实证检验政府支出乘数是否随私人部门债务水平而变化。结果表明：（i）在私人债务积压情况下，政府支出乘数变大；（ii）并非所有债务都一样：关于家庭债务积压中乘数变大的经验证据不一，而企业债务积压中乘数变大的证据则明确；（iii）在企业债务积压情况下，与低企业债务时期相比，积极的政府支出强烈挤入私人消费和投资，且乘数大于一；（iv）在家庭债务积压情况下，这些挤入效应，尤其是对私人消费的影响，并不那么强烈。我研究了政府支出的各种私人债务依赖的传导渠道，包括劳动力市场和金融市场。劳动力市场行为和企业债务积压与家庭债务积压之间投资决策的差异，可能对理解实证结果很重要。

records.title_en: Taxation, social welfare, and labor market frictions
records.title_cn: 税收、社会福利与劳动力市场摩擦
records.abstract_en: Taking taxation inefficiencies as given, a well-known public finance result is that in partial equilibrium the elasticity of taxable income (ETI) is a sufficient statistic for the deadweight loss (DWL) from labor income taxation. We revisit this result using a general equilibrium macroeconomic framework with labor search frictions. Our theory parses out the extent to which search frictions in and of themselves can distort the DWL-ETI relationship. Numerical analysis suggests that DWL is nearly 10 percent above the ETI given search frictions, only. Accounting for externalities can drive this figure up to about 20 percent, and accounting unemployment benefits can increase this number up to nearly 40 percent. Parsing out these effects both analytically and quantitatively yields novel results that contribute jointly to the public finance and macroeconomic literatures.
records.abstract_cn: 在税收无效率既定的情况下，一个著名的公共财政结果是，在局部均衡中，应税收入弹性（ETI）是劳动所得税无谓损失（DWL）的充分统计量。我们使用具有劳动力搜索摩擦的一般均衡宏观经济框架重新审视这一结果。我们的理论解析了搜索摩擦本身在多大程度上可以扭曲DWL-ETI关系。数值分析表明，仅考虑搜索摩擦时，DWL比ETI高出近10%。考虑外部性可将这一数字推高至约20%，而考虑失业救济金可将这一数字增加至近40%。从分析和数量上解析这些效应，产生了新颖的结果，共同为公共财政和宏观经济文献做出了贡献。

records.title_en: A marriage-market perspective on risk-taking and career choices
records.title_cn: 婚姻市场视角下的风险承担与职业选择
records.abstract_en: We document that women are less likely than men to be in “risky” occupations, i.e., those that exhibit large within-occupation wage dispersion. We first demonstrate that a new theoretical channel—the competitive structure of the marriage market—may incentivize both men and women to choose riskier careers with lower wage returns. We then show that a unifying factor—women’s relative inability to reap the benefits of a risky career due to their shorter reproductive span and consequent career-family trade-off—can help rationalize a set of gender differences in labor-market and marriage-market outcomes. Using data from the United States, we provide empirical evidence that supports the model predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了女性比男性更不可能从事“高风险”职业，即那些职业内工资离散度较大的职业。我们首先证明了一个新的理论渠道——婚姻市场的竞争结构——可能激励男性和女性选择工资回报较低但风险更高的职业。然后我们表明，一个统一的因素——女性由于生育期较短及随之而来的职业与家庭权衡，相对无法从高风险职业中获益——有助于合理化劳动力市场和婚姻市场结果中的一系列性别差异。利用美国的数据，我们提供了支持模型预测的经验证据。

records.title_en: Evidence on monetary transmission and the role of imperfect information: Interest rate versus inflation target shocks
records.title_cn: 货币传导的证据与不完全信息的作用：利率冲击与通胀目标冲击
records.abstract_en: We present new empirical evidence on monetary transmission by incorporating two types of shocks – a standard temporary interest rate shock and a persistent inflation target shock. In an estimated DSGE model under imperfect information, where agents may be unable to distinguish these shocks, we find delayed Neo-Fisherian behavior in response to the persistent shock: interest rate and inflation increase, but with a lag. In an empirical VAR model that accounts for such uncertainty in identifying assumptions, we similarly find evidence for positive co-movement of interest rates and inflation in the short aftermath of the persistent shock, however, not on impact. This suggests that, when pursuing a higher inflation target, the central bank needs to engineer an expansionary monetary policy stance by lowering its real interest rate path and also initially lowering the nominal rate to stimulate inflation and inflation expectations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过纳入两类冲击——标准的临时性利率冲击和持续性通胀目标冲击——提供了关于货币传导的新经验证据。在不完全信息下估计的DSGE模型中，代理人可能无法区分这些冲击，我们发现对持续性冲击的延迟新费雪行为：利率和通胀上升，但存在滞后。在考虑此类识别假设不确定性的经验VAR模型中，我们同样发现持续性冲击后短期内利率和通胀正共同运动的证据，然而，并非在冲击当期。这表明，当追求更高的通胀目标时，中央银行需要通过降低其实际利率路径并最初也降低名义利率来设计扩张性货币政策立场，以刺激通胀和通胀预期。

records.title_en: Expectation dispersion, uncertainty, and the reaction to news
records.title_cn: 预期分散、不确定性与对新闻的反应
records.abstract_en: Key macroeconomic indicator releases are closely monitored by financial markets. We examine the impact of expectation dispersion and economic uncertainty on the stock market’s reaction to these indicators. We find that the strength of the financial market response to news decreases with the preceding dispersion in expectations about the indicator value. Higher uncertainty, in contrast, increases the response. We rationalize our findings in a model of imperfect information. In the model, dispersion results from a perceived weak link between macroeconomic indicators and fundamentals that reduces the informational content of indicators, while fundamental uncertainty makes their informational content more valuable.
records.abstract_cn: 关键宏观经济指标的发布受到金融市场的密切关注。我们研究了预期分散和经济不确定性对股市对这些指标反应的影响。我们发现，金融市场对新闻的反应强度随着先前关于指标值的预期分散程度的增加而减弱。相比之下，更高的不确定性则增强了反应。我们在一个不完全信息模型中合理化我们的发现。在该模型中，分散源于感知到的宏观经济指标与基本面之间的薄弱联系，这降低了指标的信息含量，而基本面不确定性则使其信息含量更有价值。

records.title_en: Average inflation targeting and the interest rate lower bound
records.title_cn: 平均通胀目标制与利率下限
records.abstract_en: Under conventional inflation targeting (IT), the lower bound on nominal interest rates gives rise to a systematic downward bias in inflation that substantially reduces welfare. Using two variants of a New Keynesian model, we investigate whether a monetary policy strategy that aims to stabilize an average inflation rate—rather than a period-by-period inflation rate—leads to better outcomes. With rational expectations, price level targeting (PLT)—the limiting case of average inflation targeting (AIT)—is optimal, yet AIT with sufficient history dependence reaps most of the benefits of PLT. With boundedly rational expectations, PLT is no longer optimal unless the degree of bounded rationality is small. When deviations from rational expectations are sufficiently large, outcomes can be worse under PLT or AIT with strong history dependence than under IT. Finally, for both variants of the model, inflation conservatism improves welfare by eliminating the deflationary bias without invoking history dependence.
records.abstract_cn: 在传统通胀目标制（IT）下，名义利率的下限会导致通胀出现系统性下行偏差，从而大幅降低福利。我们使用两种新凯恩斯主义模型的变体，研究旨在稳定平均通胀率（而非逐期通胀率）的货币政策策略是否能带来更好的结果。在理性预期下，价格水平目标制（PLT）——平均通胀目标制（AIT）的极限情形——是最优的，但具有足够历史依赖性的AIT能获得PLT的大部分好处。在有限理性预期下，除非有限理性程度较小，否则PLT不再是最优的。当偏离理性预期的程度足够大时，PLT或具有强历史依赖性的AIT下的结果可能比IT下更差。最后，对于模型的两种变体，通胀保守主义通过消除通缩偏差而不诉诸历史依赖性来改善福利。

records.title_en: The macroeconomic effects of uncertainty and risk aversion shocks
records.title_cn: 不确定性与风险厌恶冲击的宏观经济效应
records.abstract_en: This paper identifies two types of volatility shocks, namely quantity and price of risk shocks, which can intuitively be interpreted as uncertainty and risk aversion shocks, respectively. Identification is achieved in a shock-restricted SVAR framework using a combination of narrative and external variable restrictions. We find that uncertainty shocks have large negative effects on output, while risk aversion shocks are particularly damaging to asset prices and are deflationary. We also quantify to which extent the endogenous response of risk aversion can exacerbate the effects of uncertainty shocks, thereby providing an estimate of the quantitative relevance of the risk-premium channel of uncertainty shocks. A historical contribution exercise suggests that the GFC is best characterised by a combination of uncertainty and risk aversion shocks, while uncertainty shocks were more important than risk aversion shocks during the COVID pandemic.
records.abstract_cn: 本文识别了两种类型的波动性冲击，即风险的数量和价格冲击，它们可以直观地分别解释为不确定性和风险厌恶冲击。识别是在一个冲击受限的SVAR框架中，结合叙事和外部变量限制实现的。我们发现不确定性冲击对产出有较大的负面影响，而风险厌恶冲击对资产价格尤其有害且具有通缩效应。我们还量化了风险厌恶的内生反应在多大程度上可以加剧不确定性冲击的影响，从而提供了不确定性冲击风险溢价渠道的定量相关性估计。历史贡献分解表明，全球金融危机最好被描述为不确定性和风险厌恶冲击的组合，而在新冠疫情期间，不确定性冲击比风险厌恶冲击更为重要。

records.title_en: Inside the white box: Unpacking the determinants of quality and vertical specialization
records.title_cn: 白盒内部：解开质量与垂直专业化的决定因素
records.abstract_en: This paper explores patterns of quality differentiation and specialization relying on model-level panel data of retail sales and prices of refrigerators across 23 countries in the European Union. Unlike customs data aggregated at the product category, typically used in the trade literature, model-level data allow us to test for the presence of nonhomotheticities by comparing market shares of identical models across different markets. We measure quality at the model level, account for varying willingness-to-pay for quality at different incomes, and link quality measures to objective model attributes. Using originally assembled data on the country of manufacture of each model, we study patterns of quality specialization by brands with plants in multiple countries. We find that firms locate the production of their higher-quality models in richer countries and argue that the home-market effect linked to nonhomothetic preferences is a key driver of such patterns of quality specialization.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用欧盟23个国家冰箱零售销售和价格的模型级面板数据，探讨质量差异化和专业化的模式。与贸易文献中通常使用的按产品类别汇总的海关数据不同，模型级数据使我们能够通过比较相同模型在不同市场的市场份额来检验非齐次性的存在。我们在模型层面衡量质量，考虑不同收入水平下对质量的不同支付意愿，并将质量度量与客观模型属性联系起来。利用原始收集的每个模型制造国的数据，我们研究了在多个国家设有工厂的品牌的质量专业化模式。我们发现，企业将其更高质量模型的生产布局在更富裕的国家，并认为与非齐次偏好相关的本土市场效应是这种质量专业化模式的关键驱动因素。

records.title_en: Will the last be the first? School closures and educational outcomes
records.title_cn: 最后会成为第一吗？学校关闭与教育成果
records.abstract_en: Governments have implemented school closures and online learning as one of the main tools to reduce the spread of Covid-19. Despite the potential benefits in terms of containment of virus diffusion, the educational costs of these policies may be dramatic. This work identifies these costs, expressed as decrease in test scores, for the whole universe of Italian students attending the 5th, 8th and 13th grade of the school cycle during the 2021/22 school year. The analysis is based on a difference-in-difference model in relative time, where the control group is the closest generation before the Covid-19 pandemic. Results suggest a national average loss between 1.8–4.0% in Mathematics and Italian test scores. After collecting the precise number of school closure days for the universe of students in Sicily, this work also estimates that the average days of closure decrease the test score by 2.4%. In this context, parents appear to have a partial compensatory effect, but only when holding higher levels of education and when their children are attending low and middle schools. This is likely explained by the lower relevance of parental inputs and higher reliance on other inputs, such as peers, for the higher grades. Finally, the effects are also heterogeneous across class size, parents’ country of birth and job conditions, pointing towards potential growing inequalities driven by the lack of frontal teaching.
records.abstract_cn: 政府已将学校关闭和在线学习作为减少Covid-19传播的主要工具之一。尽管在遏制病毒传播方面具有潜在益处，但这些政策的教育成本可能是巨大的。本研究针对2021/22学年意大利学校周期中5、8和13年级的所有学生，识别了这些成本，表现为考试成绩的下降。分析基于相对时间的双重差分模型，其中对照组是Covid-19大流行前最近的一代。结果表明，数学和意大利语考试成绩的全国平均损失在1.8-4.0%之间。在收集了西西里岛所有学生学校关闭天数的精确数据后，本研究还估计，平均关闭天数使考试成绩下降2.4%。在此背景下，父母似乎具有部分补偿效应，但仅在父母受教育程度较高且其子女就读于小学和初中时。这很可能是因为在较高年级，父母投入的相关性较低，而更多依赖同伴等其他投入。最后，这些效应在班级规模、父母出生国和工作条件方面也存在异质性，表明缺乏面对面教学可能导致日益加剧的不平等。
