records.abstract_cn: 本文基于加纳北部两轮农户调查和卫星天气数据，运用计量经济模型，考察了韧性能力如何中介或调节天气冲击与农户粮食安全之间的关系。结果表明，韧性能力能够调节或中介热应激和干旱对粮食安全的负面影响。然而，韧性能力在冲击-粮食安全关系中的中介作用比其调节作用更为稳定和强烈。热应激每增加一个标准差（SD），农户粮食消费减少0.71个标准差，但韧性能力能有效调节这一影响，约减少0.61个标准差。对于干旱，农户粮食消费减少0.67个标准差，但韧性能力能有效缓冲这一负面影响，约减少0.60个标准差。另一方面，中介结果表明，热应激对农户卡路里消费的总效应中，有537%是通过韧性能力的间接效应解释的。同样，韧性能力中介了热应激对农户粮食消费总效应的约74%。这些结果表明，有助于提高韧性能力的策略，如采用可持续集约化实践，对于增强加纳北部的粮食安全至关重要。

records.title_en: A behavioural agent-based modelling approach for the ex-ante assessment of policies supporting precision agriculture
records.title_cn: 行为主体建模方法在精准农业支持政策事前评估中的应用
records.abstract_en: Precision agriculture technologies can help reduce nitrogen losses and the associated negative environmental impacts. As the adoption rate of such technologies in small-scale farming systems is still low, additional policy measures are required to support their broader application. We provide an ex-ante assessment of policy measures (payments for reduced nitrogen, subsidy for the technology or area subsidies) to incentivize the adoption of sensing technologies for site-specific nitrogen fertilization with a specific focus on farmers' behavioural characteristics such as reluctance to change and their individual perception of the policy measures. We combine a bio-economic optimization model with data from a choice experiment, survey, and census data in an agent-based modelling framework. We simulate the impact of the policy measures on farmers' adoption decisions in Swiss wheat production. Simulations suggest that for the same level of nitrogen reduction a results-based payment (paying farmers for reduced nitrogen) is 1.5 times more cost-efficient than area-based subsidies and subsidies for technology use. Our results also suggest that considering how farmers perceive costs and benefits decreases the potential to reduce nitrogen input by ∼20%. We conclude that disregarding behavioural factors such as the perception of the instrument may result in a significant overestimation of the policy effect.
records.abstract_cn: 精准农业技术有助于减少氮损失及其相关的负面环境影响。由于此类技术在小规模农业系统中的采用率仍然较低，需要额外的政策措施来支持其更广泛的应用。我们提供了一项事前评估，评估政策措施（减少氮的支付、技术补贴或面积补贴）以激励采用用于特定地点氮肥施用的传感技术，特别关注农民的行为特征，如变革抵触情绪及其对政策措施的个体感知。我们将生物经济优化模型与选择实验、调查和普查数据相结合，构建了一个基于主体的建模框架。我们模拟了这些政策措施对瑞士小麦生产中农民采用决策的影响。模拟结果表明，在相同的氮减排水平下，基于结果的支付（为减少的氮向农民付费）的成本效益是面积补贴和技术使用补贴的1.5倍。我们的结果还表明，考虑农民对成本和收益的感知会降低减少氮投入的潜力约20%。我们得出结论，忽视行为因素（如对工具的感知）可能导致对政策效果的显著高估。

records.title_en: The economic cost of a 130 kph speed limit in Germany
records.title_cn: 德国130公里/小时限速的经济成本
records.abstract_en: Germany remains the only large country in the world without a general speed limit on highways. One of the main arguments for this policy is that lower speeds represent a travel time cost that is not outweighed by benefits, such as a reduction in greenhouse gas emissions. As transport decision making in the European Union is based on cost-benefit analysis (CBA), this paper compares the value of travel time, fuel consumption, infrastructure, crashes, carbon dioxide (CO2), and air pollution. Results suggests that, at the low end of the estimate, a 130 kph speed limit will generate welfare gains in the order of 950 million Euro per year. The ‘no speed limit’ policy consequently represents a subsidy forwarded to fast drivers. The paper also discusses the views of the public vis-à-vis automobile lobbies, and the relevance of Germany's climate change mitigation law, mandating that transport systems be decarbonized. The CBA suggests that a 130 kph speed limit is a policy field where environmental concerns, positive economic effects, and public opinion can be aligned.
records.abstract_cn: 德国仍然是世界上唯一一个没有高速公路普遍限速的大国。支持这一政策的主要论点之一是，较低的速度代表旅行时间成本，而这些成本并未被减少温室气体排放等收益所抵消。由于欧盟的交通决策基于成本效益分析（CBA），本文比较了旅行时间、燃料消耗、基础设施、事故、二氧化碳（CO2）和空气污染的价值。结果表明，在估计的低端，130公里/小时的限速将产生每年约950亿欧元的福利收益。因此，“不限速”政策代表了对快速驾驶者的补贴。本文还讨论了公众相对于汽车游说团体的观点，以及德国气候变化减缓法的相关性，该法要求交通系统脱碳。CBA表明，130公里/小时的限速是一个环境关注、积极经济效应和公众舆论可以一致的政策领域。

records.title_en: Certify or not? The effect of the MSC certification on the ex-vessel prices for Atlantic cod in Norway
records.title_cn: 认证还是不认证？MSC认证对挪威大西洋鳕鱼离船价格的影响
records.abstract_en: There is strong evidence that ecolabeled seafood commands a price premium in the retail market in Northern European countries. At the same time, there is significant uncertainty as to whether these markups are passed on to the fishers. This is important because producer benefits are required for an ecolabel to provide incentives for sustainable fishery management and fishing practices. Therefore, we investigate whether fishers obtained price premiums for certified cod in Norway. A unique setting for this investigation was created when a part of the fishery, the one conducted within the Norwegian territorial waters, lost its certification by the Marine Stewardship Council (MSC), while it was maintained for the offshore part of the fishery. Using a difference-in-difference approach, analyzing a large and detailed dataset, we find that on average, there is no premium for certified cod, and that other factors are more important. When controlling for buyer types, the loss of the MSC certification resulted in a price reduction for cod sold to producers who make fillets for Northern European markets. However, we found no significant price effect for cod sold to the other buyer types. This highlights the difficulty of obtaining a price premium when there are alternative sources of the product.
records.abstract_cn: 有强有力的证据表明，在北欧国家的零售市场中，生态标签海产品享有价格溢价。同时，这些加价是否传递给渔民存在显著的不确定性。这一点很重要，因为生产者利益是生态标签为可持续渔业管理和捕捞实践提供激励所必需的。因此，我们调查了挪威渔民是否因认证鳕鱼而获得价格溢价。当渔业的一部分，即在挪威领海内进行的部分，失去了海洋管理委员会（MSC）的认证，而离岸部分则保持认证时，为这项调查创造了一个独特的环境。采用双重差分方法，分析一个大型且详细的数据集，我们发现平均而言，认证鳕鱼没有溢价，其他因素更为重要。在控制买家类型后，MSC认证的丧失导致销售给为北欧市场制作鱼片的生产商的鳕鱼价格下降。然而，对于销售给其他类型买家的鳕鱼，我们没有发现显著的价格效应。这突显了当产品存在替代来源时获得价格溢价的难度。

records.title_en: Changes in inequality for solar panel uptake by Australian homeowners
records.title_cn: 澳大利亚房主太阳能板采用不平等的变化
records.abstract_en: Evidence is lacking on how inequality in homeowner uptake of solar panels has changed over time. This paper assesses changes in inequality over time using four Australian household surveys from 2012 to 2020. There is evidence of an intuitive transition where average uptake for homeowners with net-wealth just below the median (the fourth and fifth deciles) improved first, with subsequent gains for homeowners in the third net-wealth decile. However, there were still some significant shortfalls by 2020, especially for the first (i.e. lowest) net-wealth decile. In particular, the lowest net-wealth decile had lower uptake by 9.4 percentage points in 2012 and there was a similar gap below the highest decile of 10.6 percentage points in 2019–20. With control variables these corresponding gaps were 8.0 and 8.3 percentage points respectively. Inequality and changes have been less pronounced based on other aspects like education, income, and welfare status. A new policy implication is that Australian support should primarily target the bottom two net-wealth deciles among homeowners. Australia's experience can inform policies for other countries and clean energy technologies. The general implication is that policy approaches should be dynamic and detailed to address inequality changes over time in each context.
records.abstract_cn: 关于房主采用太阳能板的不平等如何随时间变化，目前缺乏证据。本文利用2012年至2020年的四项澳大利亚家庭调查，评估了不平等随时间的变化。有证据表明存在一个直观的转变：净财富略低于中位数（第四和第五十分位）的房主平均采用率首先提高，随后净财富第三十分位的房主也获得收益。然而，到2020年，仍存在一些显著差距，特别是对于净财富最低（即第一）十分位。具体而言，最低净财富十分位的采用率在2012年低9.4个百分点，而在2019-20年，与最高十分位的差距类似，为10.6个百分点。加入控制变量后，这些相应差距分别为8.0和8.3个百分点。基于教育、收入和福利状况等其他方面的不平等及变化则不那么明显。一个新的政策含义是，澳大利亚的支持应主要针对房主中净财富最低的两个十分位。澳大利亚的经验可以为其他国家和清洁能源技术的政策提供参考。总体含义是，政策方法应动态且细致，以应对每个背景下随时间变化的不平等。

records.title_en: Effects of the debate on glyphosate's carcinogenic risk on pesticide producers' share prices
records.title_cn: 关于草甘膦致癌风险辩论对农药生产商股价的影响
records.abstract_en: We analyze the impact of the glyphosate controversy in the European Union in the period 2015–2017 on share prices of pesticides producing companies. Following an event study approach, we use daily stock market data for nine pesticide producers to identify the impact of eight regulatory events on companies' stock returns from 2015 until 2017. More specifically, we examine whether and how i) public announcements of assessments of glyphosate's risk to human health, and ii) decisions by regulatory bodies with respect to glyphosate's approval extension have affected the share prices of publicly traded pesticide producers. We use share prices reflecting the firms' market value and consequently expected future profitability and firm performance. We find that, on average, pesticide producers' share prices have been affected weakly by the glyphosate controversy in the EU. However, the first assessment of glyphosate's risk to human health on 20th of March 2015 has a clear negative effect. Our results show considerable heterogeneity regarding the impact on the firm-level. For example, firms that are more focused on glyphosate sales tend to be affected more strongly. Our analysis provides first insights in pesticide industry implications of discussions on pesticide bans. We draw policy conclusions and derive firm-strategic recommendations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了欧盟在2015-2017年期间关于草甘膦的争议对农药生产公司股价的影响。采用事件研究方法，我们使用九家农药生产商的每日股票市场数据，以识别2015年至2017年期间八个监管事件对公司股票收益的影响。更具体地说，我们考察了i)关于草甘膦对人类健康风险评估的公开公告，以及ii)监管机构关于草甘膦批准延期的决定是否以及如何影响了公开交易的农药生产商的股价。我们使用反映公司市场价值以及由此产生的预期未来盈利能力和公司业绩的股价。我们发现，平均而言，农药生产商的股价受到欧盟草甘膦争议的影响较弱。然而，2015年三月20日对草甘膦对人类健康风险的首次评估具有明显的负面影响。我们的结果显示，在企业层面影响存在相当大的异质性。例如，更专注于草甘膦销售的公司往往受到更强的影响。我们的分析为农药行业对农药禁令讨论的影响提供了初步见解。我们得出了政策结论并提出了企业战略建议。

records.title_en: Consumers' willingness to pay for an animal welfare food label
records.title_cn: 消费者对动物福利食品标签的支付意愿
records.abstract_en: Consumers increasingly rate the ethical dimensions of food production, including animal welfare, as important to them but how these concerns influence their food choices remains unclear. To address this, a Discrete Choice Experiment assesses consumers' willingness to pay for chicken meat. The study aims to understand the effects of food labels (RSPCA Assured and Red Tractor), cause-related marketing campaigns, and price on consumers' willingness to pay. Drawing on a representative sample of 401 British consumers, we estimate a mixed logit model using the hierarchical Bayesian estimation method. The results for the full sample reveal a substantial price premium associated with the animal welfare label (RSPCA Assured); however, this is less pronounced than one of the cause-related marketing campaigns. A latent class analysis identifies two distinct market segments, price sensitive and concerned consumers, which differ on socio-economic and behavioural characteristics. Amongst price sensitive consumers, willingness to pay extra for an animal welfare label is negligible. Complementary, qualitative interviews reveal consumers' difficulties in comparing the varying standards that underpin quality assurance schemes.
records.abstract_cn: 消费者越来越重视食品生产的伦理维度，包括动物福利，但这些关注如何影响他们的食品选择仍不清楚。为了解决这一问题，一项离散选择实验评估了消费者对鸡肉的支付意愿。该研究旨在了解食品标签（RSPCA认证和红拖拉机）、公益营销活动和价格对消费者支付意愿的影响。基于401名英国消费者的代表性样本，我们使用分层贝叶斯估计方法估计了混合logit模型。全样本的结果显示，动物福利标签（RSPCA认证）带来了显著的价格溢价；然而，这一溢价不如其中一个公益营销活动显著。潜在类别分析识别出两个不同的市场细分，即价格敏感型消费者和关注型消费者，他们在社会经济和行为特征上存在差异。在价格敏感型消费者中，为动物福利标签额外支付的意愿可以忽略不计。补充的定性访谈揭示了消费者在比较支撑质量保证计划的不同标准时遇到的困难。

records.title_en: Eco-socio-economic vulnerability assessment of Portuguese fisheries to climate change
records.title_cn: 葡萄牙渔业对气候变化的社会生态脆弱性评估
records.abstract_en: Understanding ecological, and socio-economical vulnerabilities is fundamental towards developing and implementing regional adaptation strategies to climate change. The Portuguese coast is situated in a transition zone between temperate ecosystems to the north, and subtropical with Mediterranean characteristics, to the south, with distinct oceanographic regions (north, centre, and south), fish assemblages and socioeconomic realities of fish communities across these regions. We develop a framework to assess fisheries climate vulnerability in each port. A total of 32 ecological and socio-economic indicators were used to measure exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity of the fishing sector to climate change by combining i) environmental projections ii) information from fishing communities (surveys at ports) and iii) landings and socio-economic data from official statistics offices. The vulnerability to climate change across regions, and its expected impact on fishing fleets and local communities, was low-moderate. Such information will enable fishing communities and decision makers to respond to expected climate change effects and direct/indirect associated activities. This framework comprises background information for developing mandatory EU climate adaptation plans that aim to improve the resilience of fisheries socio-economic systems.
records.abstract_cn: 理解生态和社会经济脆弱性对于制定和实施区域气候变化适应战略至关重要。葡萄牙海岸位于北部温带生态系统与南部具有地中海特征的亚热带生态系统之间的过渡地带，拥有不同的海洋区域（北部、中部和南部）、鱼类群落以及这些区域中鱼类群落的社会经济现实。我们开发了一个框架来评估每个港口渔业的脆弱性。共使用了32项生态和社会经济指标来衡量渔业部门对气候变化的暴露度、敏感性和适应能力，通过结合i）环境预测，ii）来自渔业社区的信息（港口调查），以及iii）来自官方统计机构的登陆和社会经济数据。各地区对气候变化的脆弱性及其对捕捞船队和地方社区的预期影响为低至中等。这些信息将使渔业社区和决策者能够应对预期的气候变化影响及相关直接/间接活动。该框架为制定欧盟强制性气候适应计划提供了背景信息，旨在提高渔业社会经济系统的韧性。

records.title_en: Are German farmers ready for a ‘warm restructuring’ of the pig sector?
records.title_cn: 德国养猪户是否准备好迎接养猪业的“温和重组”？
records.abstract_en: Recent statutory changes have increased the pressure on the German livestock sector to adapt. This paper aims to ascertain the factors affecting German pig farmers' willingness to join a pig farming exit scheme similar to the Dutch ‘warm restructuring’ programme. The analysis is based on a discrete choice experiment with 346 pig farmers. The results indicate great interest of the respondents in a government-run decommissioning scheme. Differences in the perception of scheme attributes (compensation offered, demolition requirements, restrictions on future barn construction and slurry intake) are highlighted by the results of a latent-class estimation.
records.abstract_cn: 最近的法规变化增加了德国畜牧业部门适应压力的紧迫性。本文旨在确定影响德国养猪户参与类似于荷兰“温和重组”计划的养猪退出计划意愿的因素。该分析基于一项包含346名养猪户的离散选择实验。结果表明，受访者对政府运营的退役计划表现出浓厚兴趣。潜在类别估计的结果突出了对计划属性（提供的补偿、拆除要求、未来谷仓建设和泥浆摄入的限制）感知的差异。

records.title_en: Better or different? A reflection on the suitability of indicator methods for a just transition to a circular economy
records.title_cn: 更好还是不同？对指标方法是否适用于向循环经济公正转型的反思
records.abstract_en: Indicator-based methods have long been used as assessment tools in relation to measuring and purportedly enabling sustainable transitions. Common limitations of indicator approaches are well documented in the literature, and include both technical issues related to data availability and the handling of complexity, and epistemological challenges such as the nature of trade-offs and risks associated with reductionism. Nevertheless, such methods remain popular due to their ability to convey complex information related to timely issues in a synthesised way to policy- and decision-makers. In light of this, and the burgeoning literature on indicators for a Circular Economy (CE), we aim to reflect on the extent to which such methods are suitable for engendering a transformative social and ecological transition to a just CE. To do so, we examine the broad literature on the limitations of indicator methods by considering an archetypal three step process of selection, framing, and implementation. As critical CE scholars keen to repoliticise CE by embedding principles of justice, we ask to what extent indicator methods serve our transformative purposes, and whether our stance towards such methods should be to do things better or different? Our answer to this is: both. Yet we emphasise the need to reconceive ‘better’ as moving beyond fixes to technical problems to address more fundamental epistemological challenges and rethink the purpose of an indicator approach as not a technical tool, but a politicised artefact for shaping alternative narratives.
records.abstract_cn: 基于指标的方法长期以来一直被用作评估工具，用于衡量并据称促进可持续转型。指标方法的常见局限性在文献中已有充分记载，包括与数据可用性和复杂性处理相关的技术问题，以及认识论上的挑战，如权衡的性质和与简化主义相关的风险。尽管如此，由于这些方法能够以综合的方式向政策和决策者传达与及时问题相关的复杂信息，它们仍然很受欢迎。有鉴于此，以及关于循环经济（CE）指标的迅速增长的文献，我们旨在反思这些方法在多大程度上适用于引发向公正CE的社会和生态转型。为此，我们通过考虑选择、框架和实施这一典型的三步过程，审视了关于指标方法局限性的广泛文献。作为热衷于通过嵌入公正原则来重新政治化CE的批判性CE学者，我们质疑指标方法在多大程度上服务于我们的转型目的，以及我们对这些方法的态度应该是把事情做得更好还是不同？我们的答案是：两者兼而有之。然而，我们强调需要将“更好”重新构想为超越对技术问题的修复，以解决更根本的认识论挑战，并重新思考指标方法的目的，不是作为一种技术工具，而是作为塑造替代叙事的政治化产物。

records.title_en: Agricultural systems and biodiversity: evidence from European borders and bird populations
records.title_cn: 农业系统与生物多样性：来自欧洲边界和鸟类种群的证据
records.abstract_en: Countries' agricultural systems have an important impact on biodiversity, for example bird populations. Here, we estimate such impacts by exploiting a natural experiment in the middle of Europe, where there is a naturally homogenous area that is divided into three countries: Switzerland, Germany, and France. These countries have markedly different agricultural systems and policies. Using a methodologically unified and unusually rich bird dataset available across these borders, both for the 2010s and 1990s, we analyze (a) whether there is a clear pattern that bird diversity systematically changes when crossing these borders and (b) whether this has changed over time. To assess bird populations, we focus on Shannon diversity, species richness and number of territories, as well as the individual effect on 29 common bird species. We find that Switzerland has systematically smaller and less diverse bird populations compared to Germany and France, driven entirely by agricultural differences. At the same time, we find that the difference between the countries was considerably more pronounced in the 1990s than in the 2010s. Yet, to reach the bird friendliness of Switzerland's neighboring countries, additional policy effort seems required, for example in the form of targeted agri-environmental payments.
records.abstract_cn: 各国的农业系统对生物多样性有重要影响，例如鸟类种群。在此，我们利用欧洲中部的一个自然实验来估计这种影响，该地区是一个自然同质的区域，被划分为三个国家：瑞士、德国和法国。这些国家有着显著不同的农业系统和政策。使用一个方法论统一且异常丰富的鸟类数据集，这些数据跨越这些边界，涵盖2010和1990两个年份，我们分析（a）跨越这些边界时鸟类多样性是否存在系统性变化的清晰模式，以及（b）这种模式是否随时间发生了变化。为了评估鸟类种群，我们关注香农多样性、物种丰富度和领地数量，以及对29种常见鸟类物种的个体影响。我们发现，与德国和法国相比，瑞士的鸟类种群规模系统性更小且多样性更低，这完全由农业差异驱动。同时，我们发现国家之间的差异在1990比在2010更为显著。然而，要达到瑞士邻国的鸟类友好程度，似乎需要额外的政策努力，例如以有针对性的农业环境支付的形式。

records.title_en: Green securities policy and the environmental performance of firms: Assessing the impact of China's pre-IPO environmental inspection policy
records.title_cn: 绿色证券政策与企业环境绩效：评估中国IPO前环境检查政策的影响
records.abstract_en: China has experimented with a wide range of policies to encourage firms to improve their environmental performance, often with mixed results. This paper investigates the effectiveness of combining two different policies at the same time: (1) a more centralised environmental inspection process and (2) new rules on the public disclosure of policy compliance for firms wanting to undertake an initial public offering (IPO). A theoretical framework predicts that a more centralised inspection and public disclosure should improve both a firm's environmental performance and profitability. The results of instrumental variable estimations for 536 listed Chinese firms for the period 2009 to 2019 confirm the theoretical predictions although the positive effect on profitability only lasts for two years after compliance with the IPO requirements. An investigation into possible mechanisms shows that the joint policy promotes investment in green projects while also increasing demand for the firm's products. The findings highlight greater regulatory complexity may be needed if a country wishes to change the behaviour of firms in a manner that is consistent with overcoming environmental challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 中国尝试了多种政策以鼓励企业改善环境绩效，但结果往往好坏参半。本文研究了同时结合两种不同政策的有效性：（1）更集中的环境检查流程和（2）针对希望进行首次公开募股（IPO）的企业关于政策合规性公开披露的新规则。一个理论框架预测，更集中的检查和公开披露应能改善企业的环境绩效和盈利能力。对2009年至2019年间536家中国上市公司的工具变量估计结果证实了理论预测，尽管对盈利能力的积极影响仅在满足IPO要求后持续两年。对可能机制的研究表明，联合政策促进了绿色项目的投资，同时也增加了对企业产品的需求。研究结果强调，如果一个国家希望以符合克服环境挑战的方式改变企业行为，可能需要更大的监管复杂性。

records.title_en: Can a European wealth tax close the green investment gap?
records.title_cn: 欧洲财富税能否弥合绿色投资缺口？
records.abstract_en: This paper analyses the European Commission's assessment of investment needs as implied by the EU's Paris commitment. We find that official estimates of the green investment gap until 2050 are likely to seriously understate actual investment required. Against this backdrop, we assess the potential of a European wealth tax to close this investment gap. In doing so, we first provide a detailed estimate of the wealth distribution across 22 EU member countries and then develop a microsimulation model for recurring wealth taxes in these countries. The model is based on household survey data from the HFCS, but compensates for missing observations at the top of the wealth distribution by means of a Pareto model. Taking different tax designs into account, we generally find a substantial revenue potential that could contribute significantly to closing currently existing green investment gaps. We also find that compensating for the ‘missing rich’ is essential for sensibly evaluating progressive tax designs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了欧盟委员会根据欧盟巴黎承诺所评估的投资需求。我们发现，官方对直至2050年的绿色投资缺口的估计可能严重低估了实际所需的投资。在此背景下，我们评估了欧洲财富税在弥合这一投资缺口方面的潜力。为此，我们首先提供了22个欧盟成员国财富分布的详细估计，然后为这些国家的经常性财富税开发了一个微观模拟模型。该模型基于HFCS的家庭调查数据，但通过帕累托模型补偿了财富分布顶端缺失的观测值。考虑到不同的税收设计，我们普遍发现可观的收入潜力，这可能为弥合当前存在的绿色投资缺口做出重大贡献。我们还发现，补偿“缺失的富人”对于合理评估累进税制设计至关重要。

records.title_en: Who benefits from household energy transition? A cost-benefit analysis based on household survey data in China
records.title_cn: 谁从家庭能源转型中受益？基于中国家庭调查数据的成本效益分析
records.abstract_en: Aiming to alleviate air pollution and carbon emissions from heating, Northern China mandatorily converted household heating energy from coal to electricity (Coal to Electricity), natural gas (Coal to Gas), and clean coal (Clean Coal Replacement). Based on large-scale household survey data in Beijing, this study provides a cost-benefit analysis of the transition program and distinguishes between social and private benefits. The results show that all three programs improve the welfare of society and households. Compared to the Clean Coal Replacement program, Coal to Electricity and Coal to Gas programs provide higher environmental benefits while bringing about larger costs, and thus the benefit-to-cost ratios are lower. We also find that private net benefits are lower than social net benefits, and household satisfaction with the programs is positively determined by private net benefits rather than social net benefits. Furthermore, households with lower income and larger housing areas are more likely to be harmed by the programs by a larger burden from the heating energy transition. These findings call attention to inequity issues during the household energy transition.
records.abstract_cn: 为缓解供暖造成的空气污染和碳排放，中国北方强制将家庭供暖能源从煤炭转换为电力（煤改电）、天然气（煤改气）和清洁煤（清洁煤替代）。基于北京的大规模家庭调查数据，本研究对转型项目进行了成本效益分析，并区分了社会效益和私人效益。结果表明，所有三个项目都改善了社会和家庭的福利。与清洁煤替代项目相比，煤改电和煤改气项目提供了更高的环境效益，但同时也带来了更大的成本，因此效益成本比更低。我们还发现，私人净效益低于社会净效益，家庭对项目的满意度由私人净效益而非社会净效益正向决定。此外，收入较低和住房面积较大的家庭更可能因供暖能源转型带来的更大负担而受到损害。这些发现呼吁关注家庭能源转型过程中的公平问题。

records.title_en: Individuals' and households' climate adaptation and mitigation behaviors: A systematic review
records.title_cn: 个人和家庭的气候适应与减缓行为：一项系统性综述
records.abstract_en: There is increasing recognition that individuals have larger roles to play in reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. As such, we conduct a systematic literature review to consolidate existing evidence, and examine which factors are most important in driving individuals' and households' climate adaptation and mitigation behaviors in developing countries. A comprehensive literature search yields 58 empirical studies, and 158 usable analyses with which we conduct a vote-counting exercise. We first find evidence of climate inequality as adoption of adaptation behaviors are strongly driven by income. Furthermore, this inequality is likely to exacerbate as most adaptation behaviors (e.g., air-conditioners) emit high levels of GHG. A second major observation is that education and environmental knowledge (rather than income) are more important drivers for climate mitigation behaviors. The two findings mean that in order to reduce climate inequality, policymakers should target and assist vulnerable population according to their ability to adapt, and also implement more intensive educational outreach and information campaigns to encourage individuals and households to adopt GHG mitigation activities.
records.abstract_cn: 人们日益认识到，个人在减少温室气体（GHG）排放方面可以发挥更大的作用。因此，我们进行了一项系统性文献综述，以整合现有证据，并考察哪些因素在推动发展中国家的个人和家庭采取气候适应与减缓行为方面最为重要。全面的文献检索得出58项实证研究和158项可用分析，我们据此进行了投票计数分析。我们首先发现了气候不平等的证据，因为适应行为的采用在很大程度上受收入驱动。此外，这种不平等可能会加剧，因为大多数适应行为（如空调）会排放大量温室气体。第二个主要观察结果是，教育和环境知识（而非收入）是气候减缓行为更为重要的驱动因素。这两项发现意味着，为了减少气候不平等，政策制定者应根据人口的适应能力来瞄准并帮助弱势群体，同时还应开展更深入的教育宣传和信息传播活动，以鼓励个人和家庭采取温室气体减排行动。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous industrial agglomeration, technological innovation and haze pollution
records.title_cn: 异质性产业集聚、技术创新与雾霾污染
records.abstract_en: Haze pollution is becoming more and more prominent in recent years with the development of China's economy. This article studies how different types of industrial agglomeration contribute to haze pollution. Based on a panel data of 264 Chinese cities from 2003 to 2016, a spatial econometric model was adopted to analyze the related variety and unrelated variety impact on haze pollution and further investigate the moderating effect of technological innovation. The results show that: (1) There is an inverted U-shaped relationship between related variety and haze pollution, however, the overall variety aggravates haze pollution. (2) Technological innovation can significantly alleviate haze pollution, and the level of technological innovation can strengthen the inverted U-shaped relationship between variety and haze pollution.
records.abstract_cn: 随着中国经济的发展，雾霾污染近年来日益突出。本文研究了不同类型的产业集聚如何影响雾霾污染。基于2003年至2016年中国264个城市的面板数据，采用空间计量模型分析了相关多样性和无关多样性对雾霾污染的影响，并进一步探讨了技术创新的调节效应。结果表明：（1）相关多样性与雾霾污染之间存在倒U型关系，然而，总体多样性加剧了雾霾污染。（2）技术创新能够显著缓解雾霾污染，且技术创新水平能够强化多样性对雾霾污染的倒U型关系。

records.title_en: A screening perspective on experimental zones
records.title_cn: 实验区的筛选视角
records.abstract_en: Experimentation, or, setting experimental zones, is essential to many countries' economic success, especially China. Traditional explanations suggest that setting experimental zones is for loss-control or resistance-minimization. In this paper, we provide an alternative rationale that emphasizes the “screening effect” of experimental zones: when proposals—whose qualities are unknown to the central government (principal)—are proposed by informed local officials (agents), providing support gradually over time rather than all at once reduces the local governments' incentives to propose low-quality projects, resulting in a higher proportion of high-quality projects in equilibrium. The main tradeoff facing the central government is between better screening and delayed implementation of good projects. We show that when the central government is more patient, or good projects exhibit a larger positive externality, the reform speed, measured by initial support level, decreases while the reform scale, measured by the number of approved projects, increases. As the negative consequence of bad projects becomes higher, however, both reform speed and scale decrease, implying a steady but stagnant reform. By contrast, in a benchmark case without information asymmetry between the central and local governments, the optimal initial support is either minimal or full and does not depend on the externality.
records.abstract_cn: 实验，或设立实验区，对许多国家的经济成功至关重要，尤其是中国。传统解释认为设立实验区是为了控制损失或减少阻力。在本文中，我们提供了一个强调实验区“筛选效应”的替代理由：当提案——其质量对中央政府（委托人）未知——由知情的地方官员（代理人）提出时，随时间逐步提供支持而非一次性全部提供，会降低地方政府提出低质量项目的激励，从而在均衡中产生更高比例的高质量项目。中央政府面临的主要权衡是在更好的筛选与延迟实施好项目之间。我们表明，当中央政府更有耐心，或好项目表现出更大的正外部性时，以初始支持水平衡量的改革速度下降，而以批准项目数量衡量的改革规模增加。然而，随着坏项目的负面后果变得更高，改革速度和规模均下降，意味着改革稳定但停滞。相比之下，在中央与地方政府之间不存在信息不对称的基准情形中，最优初始支持要么最小要么全部，且不依赖于外部性。

records.title_en: In the crossfire: Multinational companies and consumer boycotts
records.title_cn: 夹在中间：跨国公司与消费者抵制
records.abstract_en: Multinational firms face challenges as geopolitical tensions are rising when stakeholders may have divergent views on contentious issues. Sharply different attitudes toward the proposed extradition law by the Hong Kong SAR Government in 2019 and related issues were observed among some residents in mainland China and Hong Kong. While firms such as Cathay Pacific Airways expressed support of the government, it was perceived by some of its customers in mainland China that the firm was hostile to them due to
records.abstract_cn: 随着地缘政治紧张局势加剧，利益相关者可能在有争议的问题上持有不同观点，跨国公司面临挑战。2019年，香港特别行政区政府提出的引渡法及相关问题在中国内地和香港部分居民中引发了截然不同的态度。虽然国泰航空等公司表示支持政府，但其在中国内地的一些客户认为该公司对他们怀有敌意，因为

records.title_en: How does people’s liberation army related business closure affect the local economy?
records.title_cn: 军队相关企业关闭如何影响地方经济？
records.abstract_en: People’s Liberation Army (PLA) related business was rampant in China in the 1980s and 1990s, and they significantly disrupted the local economy. However, due to limited data about PLAs, this issue is rarely investigated and thus the negative impact is hardly measured. In this paper we introduce a new proxy for measuring the approximate level of PLA related business in a specific city, PLA hospital score, to identify cities that are more affected by PLA related business closure. We then employ a difference-in-differences (DID) framework and show that PLA related business closure does bring positive effects to China’s local economy, about a 2% increase in GDP growth per year. We also find that this effect is more significant in cities with median economic size and cities that rely more on secondary and tertiary sectors. We finally provide a possible channel of this effect, which mainly works through providing a more efficient and competitive market to local private firms as well as an investment-friendly environment that attracts foreign investments.
records.abstract_cn: 中国人民解放军（PLA）相关企业在1980年代和1990年代在中国泛滥，严重扰乱了地方经济。然而，由于关于PLA的数据有限，这一问题很少被研究，因此其负面影响难以衡量。在本文中，我们引入了一个新的代理指标来衡量特定城市中PLA相关企业的近似水平，即PLA医院评分，以识别受PLA相关企业关闭影响较大的城市。然后，我们采用双重差分（DID）框架，并表明PLA相关企业的关闭确实为中国地方经济带来了积极影响，每年GDP增长约增加2%。我们还发现，这种效应在经济规模中等的城市以及更依赖第二和第三产业的城市中更为显著。最后，我们提供了这种效应的一种可能渠道，主要是通过为当地私营企业提供更高效和竞争性的市场，以及吸引外国投资的投资友好环境来实现的。

records.title_en: Inputs, networks and quality-upgrading: Evidence from China in India
records.title_cn: 投入、网络与质量升级：来自中国在印度的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper exploits China's accession to the WTO to investigate the impact of a supply shock on quality across the Indian production network. After controlling for increased import competition, including in downstream and third-country markets, and for new export opportunities, we find that a fall in input tariffs raises revenue, quality and prices, whilst lowering quality-adjusted prices and the probability of product exit – consistent with a simple model of multi-product manufacturers gaining access to higher-quality components. Upgrading persists for at least ten years; at the peak in 2010, products with a 10% higher pre-accession input tariff, and hence a larger post-accession fall in tariffs, have 5.3% higher quality. This in turn raises quality further down the supply chain, with input-output linkages amplifying the one-step effect by up to 75%. These results highlight a potential beneficial impact of the “China shock” in developing countries, namely supply-driven quality upgrading.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国加入WTO来研究供给冲击对印度生产网络中质量的影响。在控制了进口竞争加剧（包括下游市场和第三国市场）以及新的出口机会之后，我们发现投入品关税的下降提高了收入、质量和价格，同时降低了质量调整后的价格和产品退出的概率——这与多产品制造商获得更高质量零部件的简单模型一致。升级至少持续十年；在2010年达到峰值时，加入前投入品关税高出10%的产品，其质量高出5.3%。这进而提高了供应链下游的质量，投入产出联系将一步效应放大了高达75%。这些结果凸显了“中国冲击”在发展中国家可能产生的有益影响，即供给驱动的质量升级。

records.title_en: China's monetary policy surprises and corporate real investment
records.title_cn: 中国货币政策意外与企业实际投资
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the effect of China's monetary policy shocks on corporate real investment. We propose a new approach to identify China's monetary policy shocks using high-frequency surprises based on treasury futures around monetary policy announcements as external instruments. We then estimate the dynamic effect of monetary policy shocks on corporate real investment using a rich firm-level data of all listed non-financial firms in China. We find that an unexpected monetary policy easing boosts firms' investment expenditures with heterogeneous dynamic responses across firms: small-sized firms have quicker responses than large-sized firms, especially for non-state-owned enterprises (non-SOEs). We show that sales revenue response could be the channel through which monetary policy shock transmits to non-SOEs' investment expenditures in China.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了中国货币政策冲击对企业实际投资的影响。我们提出了一种新方法，利用货币政策公告前后国债期货的高频意外作为外部工具来识别中国的货币政策冲击。然后，我们使用中国所有上市非金融企业的丰富企业层面数据，估计了货币政策冲击对企业实际投资的动态效应。我们发现，意外的货币政策宽松会促进企业投资支出，且不同企业间的动态响应存在异质性：小企业的响应速度快于大企业，尤其是非国有企业。我们表明，销售收入响应可能是货币政策冲击传导至中国非国有企业投资支出的渠道。

records.title_en: Extreme temperatures and out-of-pocket medical expenditure: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 极端温度与自付医疗支出：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the causal effect of extreme temperatures on out-of-pocket medical expenditure. To do so we match data from three waves of China Family Panel Studies, a nationally representative longitudinal survey for China, with daily weather records in the county in which the person lives. We find that both extreme cold and extreme heat increase expenditure and that the effect of hot days on out-of-pocket medical expenditure is collectively larger than that of cold days. Extreme temperatures increase time engaged in sedentary activities and contribute to sleep disruption and energy poverty, which adversely affect physical and mental health. Combining our preferred estimates with daily temperature projections from recent climate models, we find that out-of-pocket medical expenditure would increase by 2.290–6.149% in the medium term (2041–2060), depending on whether measures are taken to curb greenhouse gas emissions. Our study highlights a growing, but previously neglected, burden stemming from climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了极端温度对自付医疗支出的因果效应。为此，我们将中国家庭追踪调查（一项全国代表性的纵向调查）三轮数据与个人所在县的每日天气记录进行匹配。我们发现，极端寒冷和极端炎热都会增加支出，且炎热天数对自付医疗支出的影响总体上大于寒冷天数。极端温度增加了久坐活动的时间，并导致睡眠中断和能源贫困，这些对身心健康产生不利影响。将我们的首选估计与近期气候模型的每日温度预测相结合，我们发现，在中期（2041-2060年），自付医疗支出将增加2.290-6.149%，具体取决于是否采取措施遏制温室气体排放。我们的研究强调了气候变化带来的日益增长但此前被忽视的负担。

records.title_en: Financial reforms and capital accumulation in developing economies: New data and evidence
records.title_cn: 金融改革与发展中经济体的资本积累：新数据与证据
records.abstract_en: This study uses newly constructed data on structural reforms and private and public capital stock to assess the effects of financial reforms on capital formation in developing economies. We find that while both domestic and external financial reforms are important determinants of capital formation, the former is more influential in middle-income countries (MICs) and the latter in low-income countries (LICs). For LICs, external financial reforms work mostly through attracting FDI. For MICs, within domestic financial reforms, what matters most are measures related to strengthening banking supervision and reducing credit controls. These results are driven by capital formation in the private sector. In addition, these effects are nonlinear, and it is important for a country's policy when it comes to the sequence of implementing domestic and external financial reforms. Given the importance of public investment in decarbonization, this study further discusses the potential impacts of financial reforms on climate change and carbon inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用新构建的结构性改革以及私人和公共资本存量数据，评估金融改革对发展中经济体资本形成的影响。我们发现，尽管国内和外部金融改革都是资本形成的重要决定因素，但前者对中等收入国家（MICs）的影响更大，而后者对低收入国家（LICs）的影响更大。对于低收入国家，外部金融改革主要通过吸引外国直接投资发挥作用。对于中等收入国家，在国内金融改革中，最重要的是与加强银行监管和减少信贷控制相关的措施。这些结果主要由私人部门的资本形成驱动。此外，这些影响是非线性的，并且对于一国实施国内和外部金融改革的顺序政策而言，这一点很重要。鉴于公共投资在脱碳中的重要性，本研究进一步讨论了金融改革对气候变化和碳不平等的潜在影响。

records.title_en: The externalities of preschool attendees in middle school classes
records.title_cn: 中学班级中幼儿园就读同伴的外部性
records.abstract_en: Using a nationally representative survey dataset on middle school students in China, this paper examines whether and how exposure to more classmates with a preschool experience affects students' cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes. We make use of the random class assignment rule, required by China's education law, to address the potential selection bias from class sorting. Our results show that exposure to more classmates with a longer preschool duration significantly improves students' cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes, whereas exposure to more classmates with a shorter preschool duration does not have such significantly positive effects, offering evidence of the dosage effects of attending a preschool program from the perspective of externalities. We further demonstrate three possible mechanisms through which the effects operate and quantify the explanatory power of each mechanism in driving the effects.
records.abstract_cn: 利用中国中学生全国代表性调查数据，本文考察了接触更多有幼儿园经历的同伴是否以及如何影响学生的认知和非认知结果。我们利用中国教育法规定的随机分班规则来解决班级分选中潜在的选择偏差。我们的结果表明，接触更多幼儿园就读时间较长的同伴显著提高了学生的认知和非认知结果，而接触更多幼儿园就读时间较短的同伴则没有这种显著的积极影响，这从外部性的角度提供了幼儿园项目剂量效应的证据。我们进一步展示了三种可能的作用机制，并量化了每种机制在驱动这些效应中的解释力。

records.title_en: Assessing the role of economic globalization on energy efficiency: Evidence from a global perspective
records.title_cn: 评估经济全球化对能源效率的作用：来自全球视角的证据
records.abstract_en: There has been concern that economic globalization will increase energy consumption and reduce energy efficiency. A slew of studies investigating this assertion have used trade, foreign investment, or both as indicators of economic globalization, with mixed findings. A number of concerns challenge the empirical literature including measurement issues, infrequent temporal variations in the data, business cycle effects and heterogeneity bias, which affect the causal ability of economic globalization. This study used global data of 141 countries to assess the effects of economic globalization on energy efficiency. Our identification strategies involved using more refined measures of economic globalization and energy efficiency, addressing infrequent temporal variations as well as business cycle effects and concerns of heterogeneity bias. Largely, economic globalization positively drives energy efficiency, but this effect suffers from upward bias without controls. We note that infrequent temporal variations in the data and business cycle effects and heterogeneity bias drive the result. Concerning the latter, the result has shown that economic globalization improves energy efficiency only in upper-middle and lower-middle income countries and not in high and lower-income countries. Our results raise serious caution about the causal abilities of existing studies. And we discuss the policy implications.
records.abstract_cn: 人们一直担心经济全球化会增加能源消耗并降低能源效率。大量研究以贸易、外国投资或两者兼作为经济全球化的指标来检验这一论断，但结果不一。若干问题对实证文献提出了挑战，包括测量问题、数据中不频繁的时间变化、商业周期效应和异质性偏差，这些影响了经济全球化的因果能力。本研究使用了141个国家的全球数据来评估经济全球化对能源效率的影响。我们的识别策略包括使用更精细的经济全球化和能源效率度量，处理不频繁的时间变化以及商业周期效应和异质性偏差的担忧。总体而言，经济全球化正向驱动能源效率，但这一效应在没有控制变量时存在向上偏差。我们注意到，数据中不频繁的时间变化、商业周期效应和异质性偏差驱动了这一结果。关于后者，结果显示经济全球化仅在中高收入和中低收入国家改善了能源效率，而在高收入和低收入国家则不然。我们的结果对现有研究的因果能力提出了严重警示。我们还讨论了政策含义。

records.title_en: Gender peer effects on students’ educational and occupational expectations
records.title_cn: 性别同伴效应对学生教育与职业期望的影响
records.abstract_en: To date, little is known about how gender peers affect students’ educational and occupational expectations. This study investigates the gender peer effects on students’ educational and occupational expectations, using the 2014 China Education Panel Survey. To address students’ self-selection into classes, we choose a sample of schools that randomly assign students to classes. We find that exposure to more female peers increases students’ probability of expecting to attend university and reduces their probability of expecting to complete only middle school. Besides, exposure to more female peers increases boys’ and girls’ probabilities of expecting to pursue a career as a manager, and reduces their probabilities of expecting to become a teacher, doctor, or lawyer. Moreover, exposure to more female peers has significant positive effects on both girls’ and boys’ probability of expecting to pursue prevalently male occupations. In addition, we discuss the mechanisms and check the robustness of the results. This study helps to understand the gender peer effects in education and the variations in individuals’ educational and occupational choices.
records.abstract_cn: 迄今为止，关于性别同伴如何影响学生的教育与职业期望的研究甚少。本研究利用2014年中国教育追踪调查数据，考察性别同伴效应对学生教育与职业期望的影响。为解决学生分班中的自我选择问题，我们选取了随机分配学生到班级的学校样本。研究发现，接触更多女性同伴会提高学生期望上大学的概率，并降低其期望仅完成初中教育的概率。此外，接触更多女性同伴会增加男孩和女孩期望从事管理职业的概率，并降低其期望成为教师、医生或律师的概率。而且，接触更多女性同伴对女孩和男孩期望从事男性主导职业的概率均有显著正向影响。最后，我们讨论了作用机制并检验了结果的稳健性。本研究有助于理解教育中的性别同伴效应以及个体教育与职业选择的差异。

records.title_en: Natural disasters and high-stakes exam performance: Evidence from the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake
records.title_cn: 自然灾害与高风险考试表现：来自2008年汶川地震的证据
records.abstract_en: In this study, the 2008 earthquake in Wenchuan, China serves as a natural experiment for examining the effect of natural disasters on high-stakes exam performance among students who were admitted to four-year colleges between 2005 and 2011. Results of a generalized difference-in-differences model show that, on average, the earthquake reduced a student's National College Entrance Examination (NCEE) standard score by 55% of a standard deviation. The findings have implications for higher education and China's economy, because earthquake exposure lowers a student's probability of being accepted to an elite college, pursuing a major in a high-salary field, and moving to a highly developed urban area for education or employment.
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，2008年中国汶川地震作为一个自然实验，用于考察自然灾害对2005年至2011年间被四年制大学录取的学生高风险考试表现的影响。广义双重差分模型的结果显示，平均而言，地震使学生的全国高考（NCEE）标准分降低了标准差的55%。这些发现对高等教育和中国经济具有启示意义，因为地震暴露降低了学生被精英大学录取、选择高薪领域专业以及迁往高度发达城市地区接受教育或就业的概率。

records.title_en: Does the early bird catch the worm? Evidence and interpretation on the long-term impact of school entry age in China
records.title_cn: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃吗？中国入学年龄长期影响的证据与解释
records.abstract_en: The long-term impact of children's age at primary school entry on educational attainment and labor market outcomes is one of the primary concerns to families, educators, and policymakers. Using a nationally representative survey of families and individuals, this paper is among the first to explore these effects in a causal sense in the Chinese context and understand the underlying mechanisms. We use a regression discontinuity (RD) design that employs the threshold date for primary school entry set by the 1986 Compulsory Education Law of China as a source of exogenous variation in the timing of school entry. We first document a salient and robust compliance rate of school entry requirement. RD estimates indicate that being born right after the cutoff date significantly increases years of schooling and annual earnings for non-agricultural jobs for the full sample. We also observe remarkable heterogeneous effects on labor market performance by gender. Being born right after the cutoff increases the probability of being in the labor force for men, but decreases that for women. We find that the decline in female labor force participation is mainly driven by women who come from economically and socially disadvantaged families. Further evidence suggests that this decline can be explained by supply-side factors including fertility decision and childcare provisions.
records.abstract_cn: 儿童小学入学年龄对教育成就和劳动力市场结果的长期影响是家庭、教育者和政策制定者关注的主要问题之一。利用一项具有全国代表性的家庭和个人调查，本文率先在中国背景下以因果方式探讨这些影响并理解其潜在机制。我们采用断点回归（RD）设计，利用中国1986年《义务教育法》规定的小学入学截止日期作为入学时间外生变异的来源。我们首先记录了入学要求遵守率的显著且稳健的合规率。RD估计表明，对于全样本，出生在截止日期之后立即显著增加了受教育年限和非农业工作的年收入。我们还观察到性别对劳动力市场表现的显著异质性影响。出生在截止日期之后立即增加了男性进入劳动力市场的概率，但降低了女性的这一概率。我们发现女性劳动力参与率的下降主要由来自经济和社会弱势家庭的女性驱动。进一步证据表明，这种下降可以用供给侧因素解释，包括生育决策和儿童保育安排。

records.title_en: Labor price distortion and export product markups: Evidence from China labor market
records.title_cn: 劳动价格扭曲与出口产品加成率：来自中国劳动力市场的证据
records.abstract_en: In the context of expanding the new pattern of opening-up, how to improve export product markups is of great significance to China's high-quality export development. This paper systematically investigates the impact of labor price distortion on the markups of export products by using the combined data of Chinese industrial enterprise database and customs database from 2000 to 2013. The results show that labor price distortion significantly inhibits the increase of export product markups of China's manufacturing enterprises, and the above conclusion is still robust after using various methods for robustness test, but this effect is heterogeneous due to different factor intensity, export destination, trade mode, region and ownership. The mechanism tests demonstrate that labor price distortion inhibits the increase of markups through inhibiting R&D innovation, reducing factor allocation efficiency and causing low efficiency of enterprise scale, among which R&D innovation is the most important channel. In addition, this paper examines the impact of labor price distortion on the change of industry aggregated markups, and finds that intra-enterprise effect and entry effect are the main channels for labor price distortion to inhibit industry aggregated markups, while inter-enterprise effect and exit effect have little impact on industry aggregated markups. Our findings provide a new perspective for reinterpreting the mystery of low markups of Chinese export product, and provides an important decision-making basis for the improvement of China's export product markups.
records.abstract_cn: 在扩大开放新格局的背景下，如何提高出口产品加成率对于中国出口高质量发展具有重要意义。本文利用2000年至2013年中国工业企业数据库与海关数据库的匹配数据，系统考察了劳动价格扭曲对出口产品加成率的影响。研究结果表明，劳动价格扭曲显著抑制了中国制造业企业出口产品加成率的提升，上述结论在经过多种方法的稳健性检验后依然成立，但该效应因要素密集度、出口目的地、贸易方式、地区和所有制不同而存在异质性。机制检验表明，劳动价格扭曲通过抑制研发创新、降低要素配置效率和导致企业规模低效来抑制加成率的提升，其中研发创新是最重要的渠道。此外，本文还考察了劳动价格扭曲对行业加总加成率变动的影响，发现企业内效应和进入效应是劳动价格扭曲抑制行业加总加成率的主要渠道，而企业间效应和退出效应对行业加总加成率的影响较小。本文的研究为重新解读中国出口产品低加成率之谜提供了新视角，也为中国出口产品加成率的提升提供了重要的决策依据。

records.title_en: Working hours and job satisfaction in China: A threshold analysis
records.title_cn: 中国的工作时间与工作满意度：一个门槛分析
records.abstract_en: This study utilizes a threshold model to examine the nonlinear relationship between working hours and job satisfaction, using the open-access data of the 2018 China Family Panel Studies. We address the endogeneity of working hours utilizing an instrumental variable-based two-stage residual inclusion approach. The threshold model shows that the effects are indeed different. Working more than 9 h reduces workers' job satisfaction, and these reductions are even greater among those working more than 12 h. Heterogeneous analysis reveals that working long hours reduces the job satisfaction of female employees more than that of their male counterparts; the job satisfaction of unmarried individuals is unaffected by how long they work, whereas that of married workers declines when they work longer hours. Also, although the job satisfaction of wage-employed workers falls with an increase in the number of hours worked regardless of how long they work, that of self-employed workers falls only when they work more than 12 h. Poor physical health mediates the adverse effects of long working hours on job satisfaction. Finally, working long hours reduces individuals' short-run hedonic well-being but does not affect their perceptions and feelings towards various facets of life in the long run.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究利用门槛模型，基于2018年中国家庭追踪调查的开放数据，考察工作时间与工作满意度之间的非线性关系。我们通过基于工具变量的两阶段残差包含法来处理工作时间的内生性。门槛模型显示，其影响确实存在差异。工作时间超过9小时会降低工人的工作满意度，而工作时间超过12小时的人群中，这种降低更为显著。异质性分析显示，长时间工作对女性员工工作满意度的降低程度大于男性；未婚个体的工作满意度不受工作时间长短的影响，而已婚工人的工作满意度则随着工作时间的延长而下降。此外，尽管受雇工人的工作满意度随着工作时间的增加而下降，无论工作时间长短，但自雇工人的工作满意度仅在每周工作超过12小时时才会下降。身体健康状况不佳是长时间工作对工作满意度产生不利影响的中介因素。最后，长时间工作会降低个体的短期享乐幸福感，但不会影响他们对生活各个方面的长期感知和感受。

records.title_en: Internet use and fertility behavior among reproductive-age women in China
records.title_cn: 互联网使用与中国育龄女性生育行为
records.abstract_en: Using longitudinal data from the 2014–2018 China Family Panel Studies, we investigate the impact of internet use (IU) on fertility among reproductive-age women. We find that IU reduces the number of children born, with more pronounced effects among those with a moderate level of education, those aged 16–19, rural residents, and those who are married. These results are robust to alternative IU measures and a series of estimation approaches that control for endogeneity. IU participation affects the number of children born through decreased marital satisfaction, changed attitudes toward traditional gender roles, a reduction in the importance placed on ancestral lines, deteriorated health and reduced fertility preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 利用2014-2018年中国家庭追踪调查的纵向数据，我们研究了互联网使用（IU）对育龄女性生育的影响。我们发现，互联网使用减少了生育子女的数量，其中对中等教育水平、16-19岁、农村居民以及已婚人群的影响更为显著。这些结果在替代性互联网使用测量和一系列控制内生性的估计方法下依然稳健。互联网使用参与通过降低婚姻满意度、改变对传统性别角色的态度、减少对祖先传承的重视程度、健康状况恶化和降低生育偏好来影响生育子女的数量。

records.title_en: The adoption and use of mobile payment: Determinants and relationship with bank access☆
records.title_cn: 移动支付的采用与使用：决定因素及其与银行服务获取的关系
records.abstract_en: This study aims to answer two questions: What determines the adoption and use of mobile payment? What is the relationship between mobile payment and access to traditional bank services? By using representative survey data in rural China, we apply a hurdle model with 2SLS and find that consumers with better access to bank services are more likely to adopt mobile payment. However, after adoption, the less often the consumers visit banks because of distance or social constraints, the more they use mobile payment to complement bank services. Younger, better educated households with higher income and more smart phones are more likely to adopt and use mobile payment. Among these characteristics, age has the largest marginal effect while income has the least. Households in the agricultural sector are least likely to adopt and use mobile payment. We also find that awareness of neighbors' use of non-cash payment has a substantial positive effect.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在回答两个问题：什么决定了移动支付的采用和使用？移动支付与传统银行服务获取之间的关系是什么？通过使用中国农村具有代表性的调查数据，我们应用带有2SLS的障碍模型，发现银行服务获取更好的消费者更可能采用移动支付。然而，在采用之后，消费者因距离或社会约束而访问银行的频率越低，他们使用移动支付来补充银行服务的频率就越高。更年轻、受教育程度更高、收入更高且拥有更多智能手机的家庭更可能采用和使用移动支付。在这些特征中，年龄的边际效应最大，而收入的边际效应最小。农业部门的家庭最不可能采用和使用移动支付。我们还发现，邻居使用非现金支付的意识具有显著的正面效应。

records.title_en: Do men and women discriminate against women for the same reason? Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 男性和女性是否因相同原因歧视女性？来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: In this study, we examine whether men and women form gender discrimination for the same reason. To do that, we build an experimental Chinese labor market in which employers evaluate the productivity of workers who perform a real-effort task. Before evaluation, the employer observes the worker’s personal and group information. The personal information contains gender identity and a signal of productivity. The group information reveals the productivity distributions of some other male and female workers who do not differ in average productivity. However, it shows more male workers at the very top productivity levels and more female workers at the very bottom productivity levels in one treatment than in the other. According to the belief-based theory, there will be a greater degree of discrimination against female workers in the former. We find that, however, only male employers’ evaluations are well predicted by this approach. Female employers behave oppositely: their degree of gender discrimination is smaller in the treatment emphasizing men’s advantage in the tails of the productivity distributions. To explain female employers’ evaluations, we adopt the preference-based approach. Our findings suggest that employers of different genders can have different motivations for gender discrimination, and thus call attention to the theoretical foundation of gender discrimination and policy measures aimed at reducing gender discrimination.
records.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们考察男性和女性是否因相同原因形成性别歧视。为此，我们构建了一个实验性的中国劳动力市场，其中雇主评估执行实际任务工人的生产率。在评估之前，雇主观察工人的个人和群体信息。个人信息包括性别身份和生产率信号。群体信息揭示了其他一些男性和女性工人的生产率分布，这些工人在平均生产率上没有差异。然而，在一种处理中，与另一种处理相比，生产率最高水平显示更多男性工人，生产率最低水平显示更多女性工人。根据基于信念的理论，前者对女性工人的歧视程度会更大。然而，我们发现，只有男性雇主的评估能很好地被这种方法预测。女性雇主的行为相反：在强调男性在生产率分布尾部优势的处理中，她们的性别歧视程度较小。为了解释女性雇主的评估，我们采用基于偏好的方法。我们的发现表明，不同性别的雇主可能对性别歧视有不同的动机，因此需要关注性别歧视的理论基础以及旨在减少性别歧视的政策措施。

records.title_en: Interdependent investments in attached and movable assets under insecure land rights
records.title_cn: 土地权利不安全下附着资产与可移动资产的相互依赖投资
records.abstract_en: The literature concludes that insecure land rights cause farms to make suboptimal capital investment in attached assets, but not in movable assets, implicitly assuming attached and movable assets to be independent. However, the two asset types can be interdependent because the operational efficiency of movable assets, such as farm machinery, typically depends on field conditions, such as land fragmentation. Thus, investment in attached assets may affect investment in movable assets via farm infrastructure. I develop a conceptual model to explain why tenure insecurity may lead a farm to under-invest in attached assets and over-invest in low-efficiency movable assets relative to the secure-land-right scenario. To quantify the economic significance of investment inefficiency, I collect unique survey data on large-scale farms, for which machinery is of particular importance in production, in Southwest China where land tenure remained insecure in 2016. Simulations based on the large-farm survey data suggest that the suboptimal investment occurs given fairly small probabilities of losing some farmland and results in considerable economic losses. The findings have important policy implications regarding land reforms and farm infrastructure in developing economies.
records.abstract_cn: 文献总结认为，不安全的土地权利导致农场在附着资产上的资本投资次优，但在可移动资产上并非如此，这隐含地假设附着资产和可移动资产是独立的。然而，这两种资产类型可能是相互依赖的，因为可移动资产（如农业机械）的运营效率通常取决于田间条件，如土地碎片化。因此，附着资产的投资可能通过农场基础设施影响可移动资产的投资。我开发了一个概念模型来解释为什么相对于土地权利安全的情景，土地所有权不安全可能导致农场在附着资产上投资不足，而在低效率可移动资产上过度投资。为了量化投资低效率的经济意义，我收集了中国西南地区大规模农场的独特调查数据，这些农场中机械在生产中尤为重要，而该地区在2016年土地所有权仍然不安全。基于大型农场调查数据的模拟表明，在失去部分农田的概率相当小的情况下，次优投资就会发生，并导致相当大的经济损失。这些发现对发展中经济体的土地改革和农场基础设施具有重要的政策意义。

records.title_en: Struggle for survival in credit crunch: The effect of interest rate deregulation in China
records.title_cn: 信贷紧缩中的生存挣扎：中国利率市场化的影响
records.abstract_en: This study investigates how interest rate deregulation affects firms' financing choice between bank debt and public debt. Our analysis exploits China's 2013 bank interest rate floor deregulation as an exogenous shock to the supply of bank credit. Using a difference-in-difference design, we find that firms with higher default risk substitute away from bank loan and switch to public debt after the 2013 deregulation. However, this substitution to public debt is limited, leading to a dramatic decline in debt ratio. Our result also demonstrates that the effect on firms' public debt financing is more pronounced for firms with better information environments, suggesting that good information environment is an important prerequisite for making the switch. This switching, contradicting to traditional financing framework that high-risk firms prefer bank loans, inevitably is costly. Compared with low-risk firms, bonds issued by high-risk firms have significantly higher spreads, a higher likelihood of being secured, and a higher tendency of including an interest-adjusted clause. More importantly, we also document that high-risk firms subsequently improve their information transparency after the interest rate deregulation. Our findings highlight the role of interest rate deregulation in firms' financing choice and illustrate that firms incur high switching costs when their choice deviates from the optimal financing choice.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨利率市场化如何影响企业在银行债务与公共债务之间的融资选择。我们的分析利用中国2013年银行贷款利率下限放开作为银行信贷供给的外生冲击。通过双重差分设计，我们发现，在2013年利率市场化后，违约风险较高的企业会减少银行贷款，转而选择公共债务。然而，这种向公共债务的转换是有限的，导致债务比率大幅下降。我们的结果还表明，对于信息环境较好的企业，利率市场化对企业公共债务融资的影响更为显著，这表明良好的信息环境是进行这种转换的重要前提。这种转换与传统融资框架中高风险企业偏好银行贷款的观点相悖，因此不可避免地代价高昂。与低风险企业相比，高风险企业发行的债券具有显著更高的利差、更高的担保可能性和更高的包含利率调整条款的倾向。更重要的是，我们还发现，在利率市场化后，高风险企业随后提高了其信息透明度。我们的发现强调了利率市场化在企业融资选择中的作用，并说明当企业的选择偏离最优融资选择时，企业会承担高昂的转换成本。

records.title_en: Top incomes and income polarisation in China
records.title_cn: 中国的高收入与收入极化
records.abstract_en: Income polarisation is normally measured using household survey data, but such data often provide insufficient coverage of top incomes. This paper combines data from the Chinese Household Income Project and Top Incomes in China databases for 2002, 2013, and 2018 to study the trends in, reasons for, and heterogeneity of income polarisation in China between 2002 and 2018. Our main findings are as follows. (1) Introducing external top-income data increases the estimated level of polarisation in each of the three surveyed years, but polarisation trends are not affected. (2) Polarisation increases significantly between 2002 and 2013, due to a rise in polarisation among poor residents. Polarisation remains stable between 2013 and 2018, due to the expansion of the middle-income group; the convergence to the middle of the distribution is attributable mainly to the poor, rather than the rich. (3) In 2018, levels of polarisation are higher among male, well educated, and urban residents than among female, less educated, and rural residents, respectively.
records.abstract_cn: 收入极化通常使用住户调查数据进行衡量，但此类数据往往对高收入的覆盖不足。本文结合中国家庭收入项目和中国高收入数据库的数据，涵盖2002年、2013年和2018年，研究2002年至2018年间中国收入极化的趋势、原因及异质性。我们的主要发现如下。（1）引入外部高收入数据提高了三个调查年份中每一年的极化估计水平，但极化趋势未受影响。（2）2002年至2013年间极化显著增加，原因是贫困居民内部的极化上升。2013年至2018年间极化保持稳定，原因是中等收入群体的扩大；向分布中部的收敛主要归因于贫困群体，而非富裕群体。（3）在2018年，男性、高学历和城市居民的极化水平分别高于女性、低学历和农村居民。

records.title_en: The long-term and intergenerational effects of early-life hunger experience on human capital and labor market outcomes
records.title_cn: 早期饥饿经历对人力资本和劳动力市场结果的长期及代际影响
records.abstract_en: Using individual-level retrospective data on early-life hunger experience from China, we investigate the long-term effects of early nutritional deprivation on one's own and adult children's human capital and labor market outcomes. With an instrumental variable approach, we find that hunger experience lowers educational attainment and job quality of the first generation. But this negative impact on human capital does not transmit to the second generation, possibly due to parents' compensatory behavior of human capital investment and extra attention given to children. Our findings imply that the negative impact of non-extreme nutritional adversities on human capital and labor market outcomes are likely to decrease over generations.
records.abstract_cn: 利用中国个体层面关于早期饥饿经历的回顾性数据，我们研究了早期营养剥夺对自身及成年子女的人力资本和劳动力市场结果的长期影响。通过工具变量方法，我们发现饥饿经历降低了第一代人的教育成就和工作质量。但这种对人力资本的负面影响并未传递给第二代，可能是由于父母在人力资本投资上的补偿行为和对子女的额外关注。我们的研究结果表明，非极端营养逆境对人力资本和劳动力市场结果的负面影响可能会随代际递减。

records.title_en: Growing pains for others: Using holidays to identify the pollution spillover between China and South Korea
records.title_cn: 他人的成长之痛：利用假期识别中韩之间的污染溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Transboundary pollution spillovers have emerged as an important global issue in designing optimal regional economic policies. In particular, China and South Korea have been at odds over which country is the “source of evil” and responsible for their air pollution. This study investigates this issue and identifies the burden of the environmental externalities of pollution between China and South Korea. There are two novelties of this study: first, we employ a unique daily pollution indicator, that is, air visibility, to address data limitations. Second, we propose a novel identification strategy to examine the pollution spillovers of economic activities by exploiting the different holiday arrangements between China and South Korea. Evidence indicates significant bilateral environmental externalities between China and South Korea. Therefore, China and South Korea should make joint efforts to deal with their environmental challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 跨界污染溢出已成为制定最优区域经济政策中的一个重要全球性问题。特别是，中国和韩国在谁是“罪恶之源”以及谁应对其空气污染负责的问题上一直存在分歧。本研究探讨了这一问题，并识别了中韩之间污染环境外部性的负担。本研究有两个新颖之处：首先，我们采用了一个独特的每日污染指标，即空气能见度，以解决数据限制问题。其次，我们提出了一种新颖的识别策略，通过利用中韩之间不同的假期安排来考察经济活动的污染溢出效应。证据表明，中韩之间存在显著的双边环境外部性。因此，中国和韩国应共同努力应对其环境挑战。

records.title_en: Effectiveness and risk of initial carbon quota allocation principle under the uncertainty of the Chinese electricity market
records.title_cn: 中国电力市场不确定性下初始碳配额分配原则的有效性与风险
records.abstract_en: The carbon market's effectiveness in deep decarburization and energy transition has been widely proven. However, as other industries join the carbon market in China, the uncertainty and impact of it on the power industry are still under explored. Here, we define the industry-wide scenarios which power industry might confront in the carbon market. Then, we compare its economic output, market activity and environmental impact under initial carbon quota allocation principles based on efficiency and grandfather methods by the comprehensive evaluation model of energy and carbon markets combined with inverse DEA method. Our results show that when the power industry is in an advantageous position, the efficiency method is fairer and more efficient than the grandfather method. The potential economic output rate has more than doubled compared to that of the grandfather method. Market activity and emission reduction potential are 7% and 25% more than that in the grandfather principle, respectively. Nevertheless, when the power industry is in a disadvantageous position, the efficiency method leads to an imbalance between power supply and demand in the market and power shortages in 19 regions. Then the trading activity of the power market drops by 12%, resulting in serious economic loss, especially in China's eastern region (−7.29%). The economic risk caused by the grandfather method has been significantly reduced than that of the efficiency method. And there may be greater potential risks under the efficiency method. This study identifies the potential challenges and obstacles of future carbon market and addresses the urgency of policy to tackle this issue to facilitate a carbon market that operates robustly under uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 碳市场在深度脱碳和能源转型中的有效性已被广泛证实。然而，随着中国其他行业加入碳市场，其对电力行业的不确定性和影响仍待探索。在此，我们定义了电力行业在碳市场中可能面临的行业-wide情景。然后，我们通过能源与碳市场综合评估模型结合逆DEA方法，比较了基于效率法和祖父法的初始碳配额分配原则下的经济产出、市场活动和环境影响。我们的结果表明，当电力行业处于优势地位时，效率法比祖父法更公平且更高效。潜在经济产出率相比祖父法提高了一倍以上。市场活动和减排潜力分别比祖父原则高7%和25%。然而，当电力行业处于劣势地位时，效率法导致市场电力供需失衡，并在19个地区出现电力短缺。电力市场的交易活动下降12%，造成严重的经济损失，尤其是在中国东部地区（−7.29%）。祖父法带来的经济风险显著低于效率法。而效率法下可能存在更大的潜在风险。本研究识别了未来碳市场的潜在挑战和障碍，并强调了政策应对此问题的紧迫性，以促进碳市场在不确定性下稳健运行。

records.title_en: Technological Change and the Consequences of Job Loss
records.title_cn: 技术变革与失业后的后果
records.abstract_en: We examine the role of technological change in explaining the large and persistent decline in earnings following job loss. Using detailed skill requirements from the near universe of online vacancies, we estimate technological change by occupation and find that technological change accounts for 45 percent of the decline in earnings after job loss. Technological change lowers earnings after job loss by requiring workers to have new skills to perform newly created jobs in their prior occupation. When workers lack the required skills, they move to occupations where their skills are still employable but are paid a lower wage.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了技术变革在解释失业后收入大幅且持续下降中的作用。利用近乎全量的在线职位空缺中的详细技能要求，我们估算了各职业的技术变革，并发现技术变革解释了失业后收入下降的45%。技术变革通过要求工人掌握新技能以从事其先前职业中新创造的岗位，从而降低了失业后的收入。当工人缺乏所需技能时，他们会转向其技能仍可就业但工资较低的职业。

records.title_en: Trade with Correlation
records.title_cn: 具有相关性的贸易
records.abstract_en: We develop a trade model with correlation in productivity across countries. The model spans the full class of generalized extreme value import demand systems and implies that countries with relatively dissimilar technology gain more from trade. In the context of a multisector trade model, we provide a tractable and flexible estimation procedure for correlation based on compressing highly disaggregate sectoral data into a few latent factors related to technology classes. We estimate significant heterogeneity in correlation across sectors and countries, which leads to quantitative predictions that are significantly different from estimates of models assuming independent productivity across sectors or countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个国家间生产率具有相关性的贸易模型。该模型涵盖了广义极值进口需求系统的完整类别，并意味着技术相对不相似的国家从贸易中获益更多。在多部门贸易模型的背景下，我们提供了一种基于将高度细分的部门数据压缩为与技术类别相关的少数潜在因子的可操作且灵活的估计程序。我们估计了部门和国别间相关性的显著异质性，这导致了与假设部门或国家间生产率独立的模型估计显著不同的定量预测。

records.title_en: Constrained-Efficient Capital Reallocation
records.title_cn: 约束有效的资本再配置
records.abstract_en: We characterize efficiency in an equilibrium model of investment and capital reallocation with heterogeneous firms facing collateral constraints. The model features two types of pecuniary externalities: collateral externalities, because the resale price of capital affects collateral constraints, and distributive externalities, because buyers of old capital are more financially constrained than sellers, consistent with empirical evidence. We prove that the stationary equilibrium price of old capital is inefficiently high because the distributive externality exceeds the collateral externality, by a factor of two when we calibrate the model. New investment reduces the future price of old capital, providing a rationale for new-investment subsidies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有异质性企业面临抵押品约束的投资和资本再配置均衡模型中刻画了效率。该模型具有两种类型的货币外部性：抵押品外部性，因为资本的转售价格影响抵押品约束；以及分配外部性，因为旧资本的购买者比出售者面临更强的融资约束，这与经验证据一致。我们证明，旧资本的稳态均衡价格是无效地高的，因为分配外部性超过抵押品外部性，在我们校准模型时前者是后者的两倍。新投资降低了旧资本的未来价格，为新投资补贴提供了理由。

records.title_en: Enabling or Limiting Cognitive Flexibility? Evidence of Demand for Moral Commitment
records.title_cn: 启用还是限制认知灵活性？道德承诺需求的证据
records.abstract_en: Moral behavior is more prevalent when individuals cannot easily distort their beliefs self-servingly. Do individuals seek to limit or enable their ability to distort beliefs? How do these choices affect behavior? Experiments with over 9,000 participants show preferences are heterogeneous—30 percent of participants prefer to limit belief distortion, while over 40 percent prefer to enable it, even if costly. A random assignment mechanism reveals that being assigned to the preferred environment is necessary for curbing or enabling self-serving behavior. Third parties can anticipate these effects, suggesting some sophistication about the cognitive constraints to belief distortion.
records.abstract_cn: 当个体难以自利地扭曲信念时，道德行为更为普遍。个体是否寻求限制或启用其扭曲信念的能力？这些选择如何影响行为？对超过9,000名参与者的实验表明，偏好是异质的——30%的参与者倾向于限制信念扭曲，而超过40%的参与者倾向于启用它，即使代价高昂。随机分配机制揭示，被分配到偏好环境对于遏制或启用自利行为是必要的。第三方能够预见这些效应，表明对信念扭曲的认知约束有一定程度的复杂性认识。

records.title_en: Droughts, Deluges, and (River) Diversions: Valuing Market-Based Water Reallocation
records.title_cn: 干旱、洪水与（河流）引水：评估基于市场的水资源再分配
records.abstract_en: This paper develops and applies a method to value water trading on a river network. The framework relies on regulatory variation in diversion caps to identify production functions for irrigated farms, then uses the estimated shadow values to assess the market's reallocation. I apply this framework to the largest water market in human history, located in southeastern Australia. Observed water trading increased output by 4–6 percent from 2007 to 2015, equivalent to avoiding an 8–12 percent uniform decline in water resources. Reallocation and average surplus both increase substantially during drought, implying that water markets can be most valuable when climatic variability is most severe.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发并应用了一种方法，用于评估河流网络上的水交易价值。该框架利用引水上限的监管变化来识别灌溉农场的生产函数，然后使用估计的影子价值来评估市场的再分配。我将此框架应用于人类历史上最大的水市场，位于澳大利亚东南部。观测到的水交易在2007年至2015年间使产出增加了4-6%，相当于避免了水资源8-12%的均匀下降。再分配和平均剩余在干旱期间都大幅增加，这意味着水市场在气候变率最严重时可能最有价值。

records.title_en: Technology Gaps, Trade, and Income
records.title_cn: 技术差距、贸易与收入
records.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the contribution of technology gaps to international income inequality. I develop an endogenous growth model where cross-country differences in R&D efficiency and cross-industry differences in innovation and adoption opportunities together determine equilibrium technology gaps, trade patterns, and income inequality. Countries with higher R&D efficiency are richer and have comparative advantage in more innovation-dependent industries. I calibrate R&D efficiency by country and innovation dependence by industry using R&D, patent, and bilateral trade data. Counterfactual analysis implies technology gaps account for one-quarter to one-third of nominal wage variation within the OECD.
records.abstract_cn: 本文量化了技术差距对国际收入不平等的贡献。我构建了一个内生增长模型，其中各国研发效率的差异以及各行业创新与采用机会的差异共同决定了均衡技术差距、贸易模式和收入不平等。研发效率较高的国家更富裕，并在更依赖创新的行业中具有比较优势。我利用研发、专利和双边贸易数据，按国家校准研发效率，按行业校准创新依赖度。反事实分析表明，技术差距解释了经合组织内部名义工资差异的四分之一到三分之一。

records.title_en: Electronic Food Vouchers: Evidence from an At-Scale Experiment in Indonesia
records.title_cn: 电子食品券：来自印度尼西亚大规模实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We compare how in-kind food assistance and an electronic voucher-based program affect the delivery of aid in practice. The Government of Indonesia randomized across 105 districts the transition from in-kind rice to approximately equivalent electronic vouchers redeemable for rice and eggs at a network of private agents. Targeted households received 46 percent more assistance in voucher areas. For the bottom 15 percent of households at baseline, poverty fell 20 percent. Voucher recipients received higher-quality rice, and increased consumption of eggs. The results suggest moving from a manual in-kind to electronic voucher-based program reduced poverty through increased adherence to program design.
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了实物食品援助和基于电子券的项目在实践中如何影响援助的交付。印度尼西亚政府在105个地区随机分配了从实物大米到约等值电子券的过渡，这些电子券可在私人代理网络中兑换大米和鸡蛋。目标家庭在券地区获得了46%更多的援助。对于基线时最底层的15%家庭，贫困率下降了20%。券领取者获得了更高质量的大米，并增加了鸡蛋的消费。结果表明，从手动实物援助转向基于电子券的项目通过提高对项目设计的遵守程度减少了贫困。

records.title_en: The Voice of Monetary Policy
records.title_cn: 货币政策的声音
records.abstract_en: We develop a deep learning model to detect emotions embedded in press conferences after the Federal Open Market Committee meetings and examine the influence of the detected emotions on financial markets. We find that, after controlling for the Federal Reserve's actions and the sentiment in policy texts, a positive tone in the voices of Federal Reserve chairs leads to significant increases in share prices. Other financial variables also respond to vocal cues from the chairs. Hence, how policy messages are communicated can move the financial market. Our results provide implications for improving the effectiveness of central bank communications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个深度学习模型来检测联邦公开市场委员会会议后新闻发布会中蕴含的情绪，并考察检测到的情绪对金融市场的影响。我们发现，在控制美联储的行动和政策文本中的情绪后，美联储主席声音中的积极语调会导致股价显著上涨。其他金融变量也对主席的声音线索作出反应。因此，政策信息的传达方式可以影响金融市场。我们的结果为提高中央银行沟通的有效性提供了启示。

records.title_en: Housing in Medicaid: Should It Really Change?
records.title_cn: 医疗补助中的住房：是否真的应该改变？
records.abstract_en: Housing is mostly exempted from Medicaid and Supplemental Social Insurance means tests. Reforms of this special treatment have been debated, but little is known about its costs, benefits, and redistributive implications. I estimate a life cycle model of single retirees accounting for this exemption. It shows that the homestead exemption explains important patterns of Medicaid recipiency and that it is highly valued. It also shows that estate recovery could cover most of its costs with possibly limited negative welfare consequences. Finally, the model predicts that removing the homestead exemption or enforcing estate recovery programs would reduce redistribution toward lower-income retirees. (JEL D15, G51, H51, I13, I18, I38, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 住房在医疗补助和补充社会保险的资产审查中大多被豁免。关于这种特殊待遇的改革一直存在争议，但对其成本、收益和再分配影响知之甚少。我估计了一个考虑这一豁免的单身退休人员生命周期模型。该模型表明，宅基地豁免解释了医疗补助领取的重要模式，并且其价值很高。它还表明，遗产追偿可以覆盖其大部分成本，且可能带来有限的负面福利后果。最后，模型预测，取消宅基地豁免或强制执行遗产追偿计划将减少对低收入退休人员的再分配。（JEL D15, G51, H51, I13, I18, I38, J26）

records.title_en: The Effect of Early Childhood Education on Adult Criminality: Evidence from the 1960s through 1990s
records.title_cn: 早期儿童教育对成人犯罪的影响：来自1960年至1990年的证据
records.abstract_en: We compare the effects of early childhood education on adult criminal behavior across time periods, using administrative crime data that provide significant precision advantages over existing work. We find that improvements in early childhood education led to large (20 percent) reductions in later criminal behavior, reductions that far exceed those implied by estimates of test score gains in prior studies. While the benefits generated account for a large portion of the costs of the education provided, we find substantial relative gains from the targeting of funds to high-poverty areas and areas without existing access to subsidized care. (JEL H75, I21, I26, I28, I32, I38, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用行政犯罪数据比较了不同时期早期儿童教育对成人犯罪行为的影响，这些数据相比现有研究具有显著的精度优势。我们发现，早期儿童教育的改善导致了后来犯罪行为的大幅减少（20%），这一减少幅度远超先前研究中基于考试成绩提升的估计所暗示的幅度。虽然所产生的收益占教育提供成本的很大一部分，但我们发现，将资金定向投入到高贫困地区以及没有现有补贴护理获取途径的地区，会带来可观的相对收益。（JEL H75, I21, I26, I28, I32, I38, K42）

records.title_en: Exploring Residual Profit Allocation
records.title_cn: 探索剩余利润分配
records.abstract_en: Residual profit allocation (RPA) schemes have come to prominence in discussions of international tax reform but with almost nothing known about their economic impact. These schemes tax multinationals by allocating their “routine” profits to source countries and sharing their remaining “residual” profit across countries on some formulaic basis. This paper explores the implications, conceptual and empirical, of moving to some form of RPA. Residual profits are estimated to be substantial and concentrated in relatively few multinational enterprises. The impact on tax revenue appears beneficial for developing countries. Aggregate production efficiency is unlikely to increase unless routine profits are lightly taxed. (JEL F23, H25, H87, L25)
records.abstract_cn: 剩余利润分配（RPA）方案在国际税收改革讨论中日益突出，但对其经济影响几乎一无所知。这些方案通过对跨国公司的“常规”利润在来源国征税，并基于某种公式化基础在各国间分享其剩余的“剩余”利润来对其征税。本文探讨了转向某种形式的RPA在概念上和实证上的影响。估计剩余利润规模可观，且集中在相对较少的跨国企业中。对税收收入的影响似乎有利于发展中国家。除非常规利润被轻税，否则总体生产效率不太可能提高。（JEL F23, H25, H87, L25）

records.title_en: Tax Audits as Scarecrows: Evidence from a Large-Scale Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 税收审计作为稻草人：来自大规模实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: The canonical model of Allingham and Sandmo (1972) predicts that firms evade taxes by optimally trading off between the costs and benefits of evasion. However, there is no direct evidence that firms react to audits in this way. We conducted a large-scale field experiment in collaboration with a tax authority to address this question. We sent letters to 20,440 small- and medium-sized firms that collectively paid more than US$200 million in taxes per year. We find that providing information about audits significantly affected tax compliance but in a manner that was inconsistent with Allingham and Sandmo (1972). (JEL C93, D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14)
records.abstract_cn: Allingham和Sandmo（1972）的经典模型预测，企业通过最优权衡逃税的成本与收益来逃税。然而，没有直接证据表明企业以这种方式对审计做出反应。我们与税务机关合作进行了一项大规模实地实验来解决这个问题。我们向20,440家中小企业发送了信件，这些企业每年共同缴纳超过200万美元的税款。我们发现，提供审计信息显著影响了税收合规，但其方式与Allingham和Sandmo（1972）不一致。（JEL C93, D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14）

records.title_en: The Employment Effects of Countercyclical Public Investments
records.title_cn: 逆周期公共投资的就业效应
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal impact of a sizable German public investment program on employment at the county level. The program focused on improving the energy efficiency of school buildings, making it possible to use the number of schools as an instrument for investments. It also enforced tight deadlines, reducing potential implementation lags. The program was cost-effective, creating, on average, one job for one year for an investment of €24,000. The employment gains are detectable after nine months and are accompanied by an unemployment reduction amounting to half of the job creation. Employment grew predominately in the directly affected industries. (JEL E24, E32, E62, H54, J23, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了一项规模可观的德国公共投资计划在县级层面对就业的因果影响。该计划侧重于提高学校建筑的能源效率，从而可以利用学校数量作为投资的工具变量。该计划还规定了严格的截止日期，减少了潜在的落实滞后。该计划具有成本效益，平均每投资24,000欧元即可创造一个持续一年的工作岗位。就业增长在九个月后即可检测到，并伴随着失业减少，其规模相当于新增就业的一半。就业增长主要发生在直接受影响的行业。（JEL E24, E32, E62, H54, J23, R23）

records.title_en: SOEs and Soft Incentive Constraints in State Bank Lending
records.title_cn: 国有企业与国有银行贷款中的软激励约束
records.abstract_en: We study how Chinese state bank managers’ lending incentives impact lending to state-owned enterprises (SOEs). We show lending quantity increases and quality decreases at month’s end, indicating monthly lending targets that decrease lending standards. Increased quantity comes from both SOEs and private lending, whereas decreased quality is from only SOEs, which continue to receive loans even after prior defaults (particularly at month’s end). We suggest that SOE lending may thus be beneficial for state bank managers, who lend to delinquent state enterprises to meet targets, which in turn may exacerbate SOEs’ soft budget constraints. (JEL G21, G28, L32, O16, P34).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究中国国有银行经理的贷款激励如何影响对国有企业的贷款。我们发现在月末，贷款数量增加而质量下降，这表明月度贷款目标降低了贷款标准。数量的增加来自国有企业和私人贷款，而质量的下降仅来自国有企业，这些企业在先前违约后仍继续获得贷款（尤其是在月末）。我们认为，国有企业贷款可能因此对国有银行经理有利，他们向违约的国有企业放贷以达到目标，这反过来可能加剧国有企业的软预算约束。（JEL G21, G28, L32, O16, P34）。

records.title_en: Economic Effects of Environmental Crises: Evidence from Flint, Michigan
records.title_cn: 环境危机的经济影响：来自密歇根州弗林特的证据
records.abstract_en: In April 2014 Flint, Michigan switched its drinking water supply from the Detroit water system to the Flint River as a temporary means to save $5 million. Over 18 months it was revealed that the switch exposed residents to dangerous levels of lead, culminating in an emergency declaration in October 2015. This paper examines the impact of this crisis on the Flint housing market. The value of Flint’s housing stock has fallen by $520 million to $559 million despite over $400 million in remediation spending. Home prices remain depressed through August 2019, 16 months after the water was declared safe for consumption. (JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)
records.abstract_cn: 2014年四月，密歇根州弗林特市将其饮用水供应从底特律供水系统切换到弗林特河，作为节省5万美元的临时手段。18个月后，人们发现这一切换使居民暴露于危险水平的铅中，最终于2015年十月宣布进入紧急状态。本文考察了这一危机对弗林特住房市场的影响。尽管 remediation 支出超过520亿美元，弗林特住房存量的价值仍下降了559亿至400亿美元。在饮用水被宣布安全可饮用2019个月后，即截至16年八月，房价仍处于低迷状态。(JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)

records.title_en: The Extension of Credit with Nonexclusive Contracts and Sequential Banking Externalities
records.title_cn: 非排他性合约与顺序银行外部性下的信贷扩展
records.abstract_en: Nonexclusive sequential borrowing can increase default and impose externalities on prior lenders. We document that sequential banking is pervasive with substantial effects. Using credit card applications from a large bank and data on the applicants’ entire loan portfolios, we find that an additional credit line causes a 5.9 percentage point decline in default for high-score borrowers on previous loans. However, for low-score borrowers, it causes a 19 percentage point increase. The former use the new credit to smooth payments on preexisting loans, while the latter increase their total debt. These results have implications for “ no-universal-default” regulation and financial inclusion. (JEL D62, D82, G21, G51)
