records.abstract_cn: 非排他性的顺序借款可能增加违约并对先前的贷款人施加外部性。我们记录了顺序银行普遍存在且具有实质性影响。利用一家大型银行的信用卡申请数据以及申请人全部贷款组合的数据，我们发现，对于高信用评分借款人，额外的一条信用额度导致先前贷款的违约率下降5.9个百分点。然而，对于低信用评分借款人，它导致违约率上升19个百分点。前者利用新信贷来平滑先前贷款的还款，而后者则增加了其总债务。这些结果对“非普遍违约”监管和金融包容性具有启示意义。(JEL D62, D82, G21, G51)

records.title_en: Expanding Access to Clean Water for the Rural Poor: Experimental Evidence from Malawi
records.title_cn: 扩大农村贫困人口获得清洁用水的途径：来自马拉维的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Data from an 18-month randomized trial show large and sustained impacts on water purification and child health of a program providing monthly coupons for free water treatment solution to households with young children. The program is more effective and much more cost effective than asking Community Health Workers (CHWs) to distribute free chlorine to households during routine monthly visits. This is because only 40 percent of households use free chlorine, targeting through CHWs is worse than self-targeting through coupon redemption, and water treatment promotion by CHWs does not increase chlorine use among beneficiaries of free chlorine. (JEL I12, I18, J13, O12, O13, Q53)
records.abstract_cn: 一项为期18个月的随机试验数据显示，一项为有幼儿家庭提供免费水处理溶液月度优惠券的计划，对水净化和儿童健康产生了显著且持续的影响。该计划比要求社区卫生工作者（CHWs）在常规月度家访期间向家庭分发免费氯更有效，且成本效益更高。这是因为只有40%的家庭使用了免费氯，通过社区卫生工作者进行定向投放不如通过优惠券兑换实现自我定向，且社区卫生工作者进行的水处理推广并未提高免费氯受益者中氯的使用率。（JEL I12, I18, J13, O12, O13, Q53）

records.title_en: Employed in a SNAP? The Impact of Work Requirements on Program Participation and Labor Supply
records.title_cn: 在SNAP中就业？工作要求对项目参与和劳动力供给的影响
records.abstract_en: Work requirements are common in US safety net programs. Evidence remains limited, however, on the extent to which work requirements increase economic self-sufficiency or screen out vulnerable individuals. Using linked administrative data on food stamps (SNAP) and earnings with a regression discontinuity design, we find robust evidence that work requirements increase program exits by 23 percentage points (64 percent) among incumbent participants. Overall program participation among adults who are subject to work requirements is reduced by 53 percent. Homeless adults are disproportionately screened out. We find no effects on employment and suggestive evidence of increased earnings in some specifications. (JEL H75, I18, I32, I38, J22, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 工作要求在美国安全网项目中很常见。然而，关于工作要求在多大程度上提高经济自给自足或筛选出弱势个体的证据仍然有限。利用食品券（SNAP）和收入的关联行政数据以及断点回归设计，我们发现强有力的证据表明，工作要求使现有参与者的项目退出率增加了23个百分点（64%）。在受工作要求约束的成年人中，总体项目参与率降低了53%。无家可归的成年人被不成比例地筛选出去。我们发现对就业没有影响，并且在某些规格中暗示收入增加的证据。（JEL H75, I18, I32, I38, J22, J31）

records.title_en: Implications of Tax Loss Asymmetry for Owners of S Corporations
records.title_cn: 税收损失不对称对S公司所有者的影响
records.abstract_en: We study tax loss asymmetry for S corporate owners. These owners use most losses contemporaneously, reducing the tax asymmetry compared to C corporations. However, these owners face distortions due to the progressive individual tax schedule. The value of this asymmetry is approximately $3.5 billion per year. We find that this asymmetry creates disincentives for risky investment and causes allocative inefficiencies among loss and gains owners. Finally, we simulate the effects of certain provisions of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act; we estimate that these provisions—especially section 199A—reduce the behavioral distortions of the asymmetry for S corporate owners. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, K34)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了S公司所有者的税收损失不对称性。这些所有者当期使用大部分损失，与C公司相比减少了税收不对称性。然而，这些所有者面临累进个人税表造成的扭曲。这种不对称的价值约为每年3.5亿美元。我们发现，这种不对称对风险投资产生了抑制作用，并导致损失和收益所有者之间的配置无效率。最后，我们模拟了《减税与就业法案》某些条款的影响；我们估计这些条款——尤其是第199A条——减少了S公司所有者不对称性的行为扭曲。(JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, K34)

records.title_en: Health Effects of Increasing Income for the Elderly: Evidence from a Chilean Pension Program
records.title_cn: 增加老年人收入对健康的影响：来自智利养老金计划的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of a permanent income increase on the health outcomes of the elderly poor. Our regression discontinuity design exploits an eligibility cutoff in a Chilean basic pension program that grants monthly payments to retirees without a contributory pension. Using administrative data, we find that four years after applying, basic pension recipients are 2.7 percentage points less likely to have died. Survey evidence suggests an increase in food consumption and visits to health centers as relevant drivers of the mortality reduction. (JEL D63, G51, I12, I14, I38, J14, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了永久性收入增加对贫困老年人健康结果的影响。我们的断点回归设计利用了智利基本养老金计划中的资格截止点，该计划向没有缴费型养老金的退休人员提供每月支付。使用行政数据，我们发现申请四年后，基本养老金领取者的死亡可能性降低了2.7个百分点。调查证据表明，食品消费和健康中心就诊的增加是死亡率降低的相关驱动因素。（JEL D63, G51, I12, I14, I38, J14, O15）

records.title_en: The Economic Consequences of Being Denied an Abortion
records.title_cn: 被拒绝堕胎的经济后果
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the financial and economic consequences of being denied an abortion. We link credit report data to the Turnaway Study, which collected high-quality, longitudinal data on women receiving or being denied a wanted abortion in the United States. We compare financial outcomes over a ten-year period for women who had pregnancies just above and below a gestational age limit allowing for a wanted abortion. Outcomes evolved similarly for the two groups prior to the abortion encounter. Following the encounter, women who were denied an abortion experience a large increase in financial distress that remains for several years. (JEL G51, I18, J13, J16)
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了被拒绝堕胎的财务和经济后果。我们将信用报告数据与Turnaway研究相关联，该研究收集了美国接受或拒绝想要堕胎的女性的高质量纵向数据。我们比较了妊娠年龄限制略高于和略低于允许想要堕胎的女性在十年期间的财务结果。在堕胎遭遇之前，两组的结果演变相似。在遭遇之后，被拒绝堕胎的女性经历了财务困境的大幅增加，这种困境持续了数年。（JEL G51, I18, J13, J16）

records.title_en: School Boards and Education Production: Evidence from Randomized Ballot Order
records.title_cn: 学校董事会与教育生产：来自随机选票顺序的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the causal influence of educators elected to the school board on local education production. The key empirical challenge is that school board composition is endogenously determined through the electoral process. To overcome this, we develop a novel research design that leverages California’s randomized assignment of the order that candidate names appear on election ballots. We find that an additional educator elected to the school board reduces charter schooling and increases teacher salaries in the school district relative to other board members. We interpret these findings as consistent with educator board members shifting bargaining in favor of teachers’ unions. (JEL D72, H75, I21, J31, J45, J51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了当选为学校董事会的教育工作者对当地教育生产的因果影响。关键的经验挑战在于，学校董事会的构成是通过选举过程内生决定的。为了克服这一点，我们开发了一种新颖的研究设计，利用加利福尼亚州对候选人姓名在选举选票上出现顺序的随机分配。我们发现，相对于其他董事会成员，每多一位教育工作者当选为学校董事会成员，会减少特许学校教育并增加学区的教师工资。我们将这些发现解释为与教育工作者董事会成员将谈判转向有利于教师工会的方向一致。(JEL D72, H75, I21, J31, J45, J51)

records.title_en: What Does a Provider Network Do? Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid Managed Care
records.title_cn: 提供者网络的作用是什么？来自医疗补助管理护理随机分配的证据
records.abstract_en: Leveraging the random assignment of over 50,000 Medicaid enrollees in New York, I present causal evidence that narrower networks are a blunt instrument for reducing health care spending. While narrower networks constrain spending, they do so by generating hassle costs that reduce quantity, with modest effects on prices paid to providers. Enrollees assigned to narrower networks use fewer of both needed and unneeded services and are less satisfied with their plans. Using my causal estimates to construct counterfactuals, I identify an alternative assignment policy that reduces spending without harming satisfaction by matching consumers with narrower networks that include their providers. (JEL H51, H75, I13, I18, I38)
records.abstract_cn: 利用纽约超过50,000名医疗补助参保者的随机分配，我提供了因果证据表明，较窄的网络是减少医疗保健支出的一个粗略工具。虽然较窄的网络限制了支出，但这是通过产生麻烦成本来减少数量，而对支付给提供者的价格影响不大。被分配到较窄网络的参保者使用的必要和非必要服务都较少，并且对计划的满意度较低。利用我的因果估计构建反事实，我确定了一种替代分配政策，该政策通过将消费者与包含其提供者的较窄网络匹配，在不损害满意度的情况下减少支出。(JEL H51, H75, I13, I18, I38)

records.title_en: Student Performance, Peer Effects, and Friend Networks: Evidence from a Randomized Peer Intervention
records.title_cn: 学生表现、同伴效应与朋友网络：来自随机同伴干预的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of an educational peer intervention in which previously high- and low-achieving students are randomly paired as deskmates in elementary schools in China. Our treatment boosts the mathematics scores of the low-achieving students. Moreover, the treatment enhances the extraversion and agreeableness of high- and low-achieving students, thereby providing evidence that peers can influence personality traits. The positive treatment effects can be attributed to the deskmate-level peer effects. We document friend network structure changes and present additional evidence on how friendship ties help us better understand the mechanisms behind peer effects. (JEL I21, I26, J24, O15, P36, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一项教育同伴干预的效果，在该干预中，中国小学中先前成绩高和成绩低的学生被随机配对为同桌。我们的处理提高了低成就学生的数学成绩。此外，该处理增强了高成就和低成就学生的外向性和宜人性，从而提供了同伴可以影响人格特质的证据。积极处理效应可归因于同桌层面的同伴效应。我们记录了朋友网络结构的变化，并提供了关于友谊联系如何帮助我们更好地理解同伴效应背后机制的额外证据。(JEL I21, I26, J24, O15, P36, Z13)

records.title_en: Price Transparency, Media, and Informative Advertising
records.title_cn: 价格透明度、媒体与信息性广告
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of a price transparency regulation in Israeli supermarkets. Using price data collected before and after the regulation and a difference-in-difference research design, we show that price levels and price dispersion declined significantly after the regulation. Chains also began setting identical prices in all stores. We use Robert and Stahl (1993) to interpret our findings, showing that low-priced chains extensively used price advertising after prices became transparent. These chains referenced price-comparison surveys conducted by the media to induce credibility for ads. Our findings highlight the importance of price transparency and the procompetitive role of informative advertising. (JEL D22, D83, L11, L81, L82, L88, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了以色列超市价格透明度监管的影响。利用监管前后收集的价格数据和双重差分研究设计，我们表明监管后价格水平和价格离散度显著下降。连锁店也开始在所有门店设定相同的价格。我们使用Robert和Stahl（1993）来解释我们的发现，表明低价连锁店在价格变得透明后广泛使用价格广告。这些连锁店引用媒体进行的价格比较调查以增强广告的可信度。我们的发现强调了价格透明度的重要性以及信息性广告的促进竞争作用。（JEL D22, D83, L11, L81, L82, L88, M37）

records.title_en: Compatibility Choices, Switching Costs, and Data Portability
records.title_cn: 兼容性选择、转换成本与数据可携性
records.abstract_en: We study mix-and-match compatibility choices of firms selling complementary products in a dynamic setting. Contrary to what happens in a static setting where symmetric firms choose compatibility (Matutes and Regibeau 1988), when switching costs are high and firms make price discrimination based on past purchases, symmetric firms choose incompatibility to soften future competition if the discount factor is large, which harms consumers. Interoperability increases consumer surplus at least for high switching costs. Data portability, by reducing switching costs, induces the firms to choose compatibility more often but, given a compatibility regime, benefits consumers only if a nonnegative pricing constraint binds. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在动态环境中销售互补产品的企业的混合搭配兼容性选择。与静态环境中对称企业选择兼容性的情况（Matutes和Regibeau 1988）相反，当转换成本较高且企业基于过去的购买行为进行价格歧视时，如果贴现因子较大，对称企业会选择不兼容以缓和未来竞争，这损害了消费者利益。互操作性至少在高转换成本下增加了消费者剩余。数据可携性通过降低转换成本，促使企业更频繁地选择兼容性，但在给定的兼容性制度下，只有在非负定价约束起作用时才对消费者有利。（JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, L86）

records.title_en: Alert the Inert? Switching Costs and Limited Awareness in Retail Electricity Markets
records.title_cn: 唤醒惰性？零售电力市场中的转换成本与有限认知
records.abstract_en: We quantify how switching costs and limited awareness affect consumer inertia in liberalized retail electricity markets by developing and estimating a structural demand model using a novel dataset on electricity contract choices in Belgium. Our data allow us to disentangle different sources of inertia by using a rich combination of macromoments and micromoments. We find that consumers perceive contracts as differentiated and both limited awareness and switching costs hinder efficient choices. Our counterfactuals reveal substantial welfare gains from alleviating both frictions, in particular switching costs, and that a well-regulated monopoly can generate similar consumer surplus as the current deregulated market. (JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过开发并估计一个结构需求模型，利用比利时电力合同选择的新数据集，量化了转换成本和有限认知如何影响自由化零售电力市场中的消费者惰性。我们的数据使我们能够通过宏观时刻和微观时刻的丰富组合来区分惰性的不同来源。我们发现消费者认为合同是有差异的，并且有限认知和转换成本都阻碍了有效选择。我们的反事实分析揭示了缓解这两种摩擦（尤其是转换成本）所带来的巨大福利收益，并且一个监管良好的垄断企业可以产生与当前放松管制市场相似的消费者剩余。（JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98）

records.title_en: Product Quality and Consumer Search
records.title_cn: 产品质量与消费者搜索
records.abstract_en: An increase in quality shifts up the distribution of match utilities offered by firms and makes consumers pickier. The number of products that consumers inspect does not necessarily increase in quality. Higher search costs may lead to less quality investment, and the equilibrium price may decrease. If the equilibrium is inefficient, it is because of the inadequacy of quality investment. The market level of quality investment is excessive (insufficient) and consumers are too (little) picky from the point of view of welfare maximization if and only if a rise in quality results in consumers inspecting a higher (lower) number of products. (JEL D11, D21, D83, G31, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 质量的提高会使企业提供的匹配效用的分布上移，并使消费者变得更加挑剔。消费者检查的产品数量不一定随质量提高而增加。较高的搜索成本可能导致较低的质量投资，均衡价格可能下降。如果均衡是无效率的，那是因为质量投资不足。从福利最大化的角度看，当且仅当质量提高导致消费者检查更多（更少）的产品时，市场质量投资水平是过度（不足）的，消费者过于（不够）挑剔。（JEL D11, D21, D83, G31, L15）

records.title_en: Primary-Market Auctions for Event Tickets: Eliminating the Rents of “Bob the Broker”?
records.title_cn: 活动门票的一级市场拍卖：消除“黄牛鲍勃”的租金？
records.abstract_en: Economists have long been puzzled by event-ticket underpricing: underpricing reduces revenue for the performer and encourages socially wasteful rent-seeking by ticket brokers. What about using an auction? This paper studies the introduction of auctions into this market by Ticketmaster in the mid-2000s. By combining primary-market auction data from Ticketmaster with secondary-market resale value data from eBay, we show that Ticketmaster’s auctions “worked”: they substantially improved price discovery, roughly doubled performer revenues, and, on average, nearly eliminated the potential arbitrage profits associated with underpriced tickets. We conclude by discussing why, nevertheless, the auctions failed to take off. (JEL D44, D47, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家长期以来对活动门票定价偏低感到困惑：定价偏低降低了表演者的收入，并鼓励了票务黄牛进行社会浪费的寻租行为。那么使用拍卖会怎样呢？本文研究了Ticketmaster在2000年代中期将拍卖引入这一市场的情况。通过将Ticketmaster的一级市场拍卖数据与eBay的二级市场转售价值数据相结合，我们表明Ticketmaster的拍卖“奏效了”：它们显著改善了价格发现，大致使表演者收入翻倍，并且平均而言，几乎消除了与定价偏低门票相关的潜在套利利润。最后，我们讨论了为什么尽管如此，拍卖未能普及。（JEL D44, D47, L82）

records.title_en: Misbehavior in Common Value Auctions: Bidding Rings and Shills
records.title_cn: 共同价值拍卖中的不当行为：竞标联盟与托儿
records.abstract_en: We characterize the optimal misbehavior by bidding rings or an auctioneer in the ascending English auction with common values. We also show, in an extended game, that in equilibrium potential members join and truthfully reveal their signals. Under a separability assumption, behavior does not change if nonring bidders are informed about the ring’s existence. In general, misbehavior in dynamic settings is more profitable than in outcome-equivalent static settings. However, under a stronger separability assumption, the ring can do no better in the dynamic English format than in the outcome-equivalent, static Sophi format. (JEL D44, D82)
records.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了在具有共同价值的升序英式拍卖中，竞标联盟或拍卖师的最优不当行为。我们还证明，在扩展博弈中，均衡状态下潜在成员会加入并如实透露其信号。在可分离性假设下，如果非联盟竞标者知晓联盟的存在，行为不会改变。一般而言，动态环境中的不当行为比结果等价的静态环境中更有利可图。然而，在更强的可分离性假设下，联盟在动态英式拍卖中的表现不会优于结果等价的静态Sophi拍卖。（JEL D44, D82）

records.title_en: Contest Design with Stochastic Performance
records.title_cn: 随机绩效下的竞赛设计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal contest design in contests with noisy performance. Here, contest design is a team moral hazard problem that endogenizes the assignment rule that maps performance profiles into winning probabilities. The optimal design features endogenous standards for eligibility, and the number of prizes that are awarded may be stochastic. Generally, one group of agents is identified as “first claimants” of prizes, contingent on performance exceeding a threshold of excellence. However, which group wins prizes more often depends on the designer’s objective function and the performance technologies. Finally, the approach derives endogenous, microfounded, and fully optimal contest success functions. (JEL D44, D82)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在具有噪声绩效的竞赛中的最优竞赛设计。在此，竞赛设计是一个团队道德风险问题，它将绩效概况映射到获胜概率的分配规则内生化。最优设计具有内生性的资格标准，且授予的奖品数量可能是随机的。通常，一组代理人被认定为奖品的“第一索取者”，取决于绩效是否超过卓越阈值。然而，哪一组更频繁地赢得奖品取决于设计者的目标函数和绩效技术。最后，该方法推导出内生的、基于微观基础的、完全最优的竞赛成功函数。（JEL D44, D82）

records.title_en: Two-Stage Contests with Private Information
records.title_cn: 两阶段私人信息竞赛
records.abstract_en: In perfectly discriminating contests with private information, low-ability contestants prefer to appear strong, while high-ability contestants prefer to appear weak. In a two-stage contest, this leads to a unique symmetric equilibrium with partial pooling in the first stage. A higher output in the first contest leads to a weakly higher belief about the contestant’s ability entering the second contest. We characterize this unique equilibrium when cost of effort is linear and show how the prize allocation and type distribution impact contestants’ expected output, payoffs, and the probability of surprise victories. (JEL D44, D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 在具有私人信息的完全歧视性竞赛中，低能力参赛者倾向于表现强大，而高能力参赛者倾向于表现弱小。在两阶段竞赛中，这导致第一阶段存在部分混同的唯一对称均衡。第一次竞赛中的更高产出导致进入第二次竞赛时对参赛者能力的信念弱更高。我们刻画了当努力成本为线性时的这一唯一均衡，并展示了奖金分配和类型分布如何影响参赛者的预期产出、收益以及意外胜利的概率。（JEL D44, D82, D83）

records.title_en: A Theory of Stability in Matching with Incomplete Information
records.title_cn: 不完全信息匹配中的稳定性理论
records.abstract_en: We provide a framework for studying two-sided matching markets with incomplete information. The framework accommodates two-sided incomplete information as well as heterogeneous information among the agents. We propose a notion called stability for a market state, which, based upon agents’ information structure, requires (i) individual rationality, (ii) no blocking, and (iii) information stability. The novelty of our stability notion lies in how the agents evaluate a blocking prospect in the presence of general two-sided incomplete information. We show that a stable state exists; moreover, if a state is stable, then coarsening agents’ information leads to another stable state. (JEL C78, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个研究具有不完全信息的双边匹配市场的框架。该框架既适应双边不完全信息，也适应代理人之间的异质信息。我们提出了一个称为市场状态稳定性的概念，基于代理人的信息结构，要求（i）个体理性，（ii）无阻塞，以及（iii）信息稳定性。我们稳定性概念的新颖之处在于，在存在一般双边不完全信息的情况下，代理人如何评估阻塞前景。我们证明了稳定状态的存在；此外，如果一个状态是稳定的，那么对代理人信息进行粗化会导致另一个稳定状态。（JEL C78, D83）

records.title_en: An Information Theory of Efficient Differential Treatment
records.title_cn: 有效差别待遇的信息理论
records.abstract_en: When are differential treatment policies—such as preferential treatment, affirmative action, and gender equity policies—justified by efficiency concerns? I propose a nonparametric assignment model where a policymaker assigns agents to different treatments or positions to maximize total surplus, based on the agents’ characteristics and noisy information about their types. I provide necessary and sufficient conditions on the agents’ signal structures, which characterize whether surplus maximization requires differential treatment or not, and study how the bias and informativeness of signal structures determine the efficiency implications of differential treatment. I examine implications of this model for inequality, decentralization, and empirical work. (JEL D63, D82, D83, I23, I24, J71)
records.abstract_cn: 差别待遇政策——如优惠待遇、平权行动和性别平等政策——何时因效率考虑而合理？我提出了一个非参数分配模型，其中政策制定者根据代理人的特征及其类型的噪声信息，将代理人分配到不同的待遇或职位以最大化总剩余。我提供了关于代理人信号结构的必要且充分条件，这些条件刻画了剩余最大化是否需要差别待遇，并研究了信号结构的偏差和信息量如何决定差别待遇的效率含义。我考察了该模型对不平等、分权化和实证工作的启示。（JEL D63, D82, D83, I23, I24, J71）

records.title_en: Dynamic Information Design under Constrained Communication Rules
records.title_cn: 受约束沟通规则下的动态信息设计
records.abstract_en: An information designer wishes to persuade agents to invest in a project of unknown quality. To do so, she must induce investment and collect feedback from these investments. Motivated by data regulations and simplicity concerns, our designer faces communication constraints. These constraints hinder her without benefiting the agents: they impose an upper bound on the induced belief spread, limiting persuasion. Nevertheless, two-rating systems (direct recommendations) are the optimal design when experimentation is needed to generate information and approximate the designer’s first-best payoff for specific feedback structures. When the designer has altruistic motives, constrained rules significantly decrease welfare. (JEL D64, D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 一位信息设计者希望说服代理人投资于一个质量未知的项目。为此，她必须诱导投资并从这些投资中收集反馈。出于数据监管和简洁性的考虑，我们的设计者面临沟通约束。这些约束阻碍了她而不利于代理人：它们对诱导信念的扩散施加了上限，限制了说服力。然而，当需要实验来生成信息并为特定反馈结构近似设计者的最优收益时，两级评级系统（直接推荐）是最优设计。当设计者具有利他动机时，受约束的规则会显著降低福利。（JEL D64, D82, D83）

records.title_en: Sequential Learning
records.title_cn: 序贯学习
records.abstract_en: We develop a model in which two players sequentially and publicly examine a project. In our model the player who moves first can fabricate evidence to influence the second mover, which creates a moral hazard problem. We find that early strategic uncertainty can mitigate this problem. In particular, for intermediate prior beliefs about the project’s quality, the Pareto-dominant equilibrium is in mixed strategies and consists of an early stage in which evidence may be fabricated and a later stage in which evidence is always authentic. Our findings shed light on the dynamics of R&D, quality assurance, and drug approval. (JEL D82, D83, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，其中两个参与者序贯且公开地审查一个项目。在我们的模型中，先行动者可以伪造证据以影响后行动者，这产生了道德风险问题。我们发现，早期的战略不确定性可以缓解这一问题。特别是，对于关于项目质量的中等先验信念，帕累托占优均衡是混合策略均衡，包括一个可能伪造证据的早期阶段和一个证据始终真实的后期阶段。我们的发现揭示了研发、质量保证和药物批准的动态。(JEL D82, D83, L15)

records.title_en: When Is a Contrarian Adviser Optimal?
records.title_cn: 何时逆势顾问是最优的？
records.abstract_en: We compare contrarian to conformist advice, a contrarian expert being one whose preference bias is against the decision-maker’s prior optimal decision. Optimality of an expert depends on characteristics of prior information and learning. If either the expert is fully informed or fine information can be acquired cheaply, then for symmetric distributions F of the state, a conformist (contrarian) is superior if F is single peaked (bimodal). If only coarse information can be acquired, then a contrarian acquires more on average and hence is superior. If information is verifiable, a contrarian has less incentive to hide unfavorable evidence and again is superior. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, H71, I12, L94)
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了逆势建议与顺势建议，逆势专家是指其偏好偏差与决策者先验最优决策相反的专家。专家的最优性取决于先验信息和学习的特点。如果专家完全知情或者可以廉价获取精细信息，那么对于状态的对称分布F，如果F是单峰的（双峰的），则顺势（逆势）顾问更优。如果只能获取粗略信息，则逆势顾问平均获取更多信息，因此更优。如果信息是可验证的，则逆势顾问隐藏不利证据的激励较小，同样更优。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, H71, I12, L94）

records.title_en: Debunking Rumors in Networks
records.title_cn: 揭穿网络中的谣言
records.abstract_en: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (the rumor) in a social network. Upon hearing a message, individuals may believe it, disbelieve it, or debunk it through costly verification. Whenever the truth survives in steady state, so does the rumor. Communication intensity in itself is irrelevant for relative rumor prevalence, and the effect of homophily depends on the exact verification process and equilibrium verification rates. Our model highlights that successful policies in the fight against rumors increase individuals’ incentives to verify. (JEL D83, D85, L82, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究真实信息和虚假信息（谣言）在社交网络中的传播。听到信息后，个体可能相信、不相信或通过昂贵的信息核实来揭穿它。只要真相在稳态下存续，谣言也会存续。沟通强度本身与谣言的相对流行度无关，而同质性的影响取决于具体的核实过程和均衡核实率。我们的模型强调，打击谣言的成功政策会增加个体核实的激励。（JEL D83, D85, L82, Z13）

records.title_en: Censorship and Reputation
records.title_cn: 审查与声誉
records.abstract_en: I study how a firm manages its reputation by both investing in the quality of its product and censoring, hiding bad news from consumers. Without censorship, the threat of bad news provides strong incentives for investment. I highlight discontinuities in the firm’s maximum equilibrium payoff that censorship creates. When censorship is inexpensive, the firm never invests and a patient firm’s payoffs approach the lowest possible. In contrast, when censorship is moderately expensive, there exist equilibria where product quality is persistently high and payoffs approach the first-best, which can exceed the maximum equilibrium payoff if it was unable to censor. (JEL D21, D82, D83, G31, G32, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究企业如何通过投资于产品质量和审查（即向消费者隐藏坏消息）来管理其声誉。在没有审查的情况下，坏消息的威胁为投资提供了强有力的激励。我强调了审查给企业最大均衡收益带来的不连续性。当审查成本低廉时，企业从不投资，耐心企业的收益接近最低可能水平。相反，当审查成本适中时，存在产品质量持续高且收益接近最优的均衡，这可能超过无法审查时的最大均衡收益。（JEL D21, D82, D83, G31, G32, L15）

records.title_en: Togetherness in the Household
records.title_cn: 家庭中的共处
records.abstract_en: Spending time with a spouse is a major gain from marriage. We extend the classical collective model of the household to allow for togetherness between spouses. Togetherness takes the form of joint leisure and joint care for children. Using revealed preference conditions and Dutch data over the years 2009–2012, we find that households are willing to pay €1.20 per hour—10 percent of the average wage—to convert private leisure to joint leisure and €2.10 per hour to convert private childcare to joint childcare. Our results suggest togetherness is an important component of household time use despite being overlooked in the economics literature. (JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 与配偶共度时光是婚姻的一大收益。我们将经典的家庭集体模型扩展，允许配偶之间的共处。共处表现为共同休闲和共同照顾孩子。利用显示性偏好条件和荷兰2009-2012年的数据，我们发现家庭愿意为将私人休闲转换为共同休闲支付每小时1.20欧元——占平均工资的10%——以及为将私人育儿转换为共同育儿支付每小时2.10欧元。我们的结果表明，尽管共处在经济学文献中被忽视，但它是家庭时间使用的重要组成部分。(JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)

records.title_en: Ten Isn’t Large! Group Size and Coordination in a Large-Scale Experiment
records.title_cn: 十并不大！大规模实验中的群体规模与协调
records.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence on coordination within large groups that could proxy the atomistic nature of real-world markets. We use a bank run game where the two pure-strategy equilibria can be ranked by payoff and risk dominance and a sequence of public announcements introduces stochastic sunspot equilibria. We find systematic group size effects that theory fails to predict. When the payoff-dominant strategy is risky enough, the behavior of small groups is uninformative of the behavior in large groups: unlike smaller groups of size ten, larger groups exclusively coordinate on the Pareto-inferior strategy and never coordinate on sunspots. (JEL C92, D83, D91, G21)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于大群体内协调的实验证据，这些群体可以代表现实世界市场的原子性质。我们使用一个银行挤兑博弈，其中两个纯策略均衡可以按支付和风险优势排序，一系列公开公告引入了随机太阳黑子均衡。我们发现了理论无法预测的系统性群体规模效应。当支付占优策略足够有风险时，小群体的行为无法反映大群体的行为：与规模为十的较小群体不同，较大群体完全协调于帕累托劣势策略，并且从不协调于太阳黑子。（JEL C92, D83, D91, G21）

records.title_en: The Effects of Time Preferences on Cooperation: Experimental Evidence from Infinitely Repeated Games
records.title_cn: 时间偏好对合作的影响：来自无限重复博弈的实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of time preferences on cooperation in an infinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma game experiment. Subjects play repeated games in the lab, all decisions at once, but stage game payoffs are paid over an extended period of time. Changing the time window of stage game payoffs (weekly or monthly) varies discount factors, and a delay for the first-stage game payoffs eliminates/weakens present bias. First, subjects with weekly payments cooperate more than subjects with monthly payments—higher discount factors promote greater cooperation. Second, the rate of cooperation is higher when there is a delay—present bias reduces cooperation. (JEL C72, C73, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过无限重复囚徒困境博弈实验研究时间偏好对合作的影响。受试者在实验室中进行重复博弈，所有决策一次性做出，但阶段博弈收益在较长时间内分期支付。改变阶段博弈收益的时间窗口（每周或每月）会改变贴现因子，而第一阶段博弈收益的延迟支付则消除或削弱了现时偏误。首先，每周支付的受试者比每月支付的受试者合作更多——更高的贴现因子促进更多合作。其次，存在延迟时合作率更高——现时偏误降低合作。（JEL C72, C73, D91）

records.title_en: Implications of Unequal Discounting in Dynamic Contracting
records.title_cn: 动态契约中不等贴现的含义
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a canonical dynamic screening problem where the agent has Markovian private information and limited commitment and the principal and the agent have different discount factors. Unequal discounting captures unequal access to capital markets. In comparison to standard models of dynamic mechanism design, the principal no longer finds it optimal to maximally back-load the agent’s information rents: a new force of inter-temporal cost of incentive provision pushes toward front-loading agents’ payoffs. The optimal contract settles into a cycle with infinite memory. The introduction of unequal discounting renders the standard relaxed-problem approach invalid for certain parameters. A simple and approximately optimal contract is then provided. (JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个典型的动态筛选问题，其中代理人具有马尔可夫私人信息和有限承诺，且委托人与代理人具有不同的贴现因子。不等贴现反映了进入资本市场的机会不平等。与标准动态机制设计模型相比，委托人不再认为最大化地延迟代理人的信息租金是最优的：一种新的跨期激励提供成本力量推动代理人报酬的前置。最优契约进入一个具有无限记忆的周期。不等贴现的引入使得标准的松弛问题方法在某些参数下失效。随后提供了一个简单且近似最优的契约。（JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14）

records.title_en: Moral Hazard and Efficiency in a Frictional Market
records.title_cn: 摩擦市场中的道德风险与效率
records.abstract_en: Principals seek to trade with homogeneous agents by posting incentive contracts, which direct their search. Search and moral hazard interact in equilibrium. If using transfers to compensate agents failing to contract, the equilibrium allocation is always constrained-welfare-optimal in contrast to the one-to-one principal-agent problem. Search frictions thus correct that inefficiency because search requires internalizing the utility of agents. Incentives are weaker than in bilateral contracting, and agents enjoy more efficient risk sharing. With a constraint on transfers the allocation may become inefficient; principal competition results in overinsurance of the agents, too little effort in equilibrium, and excessive entry by principals. (JEL D82, D83, D86)
records.abstract_cn: 委托人通过发布激励合同来寻求与同质代理人交易，这些合同引导着他们的搜索。搜索与道德风险在均衡中相互作用。如果使用转移支付来补偿未能签约的代理人，均衡配置总是受约束的福利最优，这与一对一的委托-代理问题形成对比。因此，搜索摩擦纠正了这种无效率，因为搜索要求内化代理人的效用。激励比双边缔约时更弱，代理人享受更有效的风险分担。在转移支付受限的情况下，配置可能变得无效率；委托人竞争导致对代理人的过度保险、均衡中的努力不足以及委托人的过度进入。（JEL D82, D83, D86）

records.title_en: The Impact of Restricting Labor Mobility on Corporate Investment and Entrepreneurship
records.title_cn: 限制劳动力流动对企业投资和创业的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how labor mobility restrictions like noncompete agreements affect firms’ investment decisions. Using matched employee-employer data from LinkedIn, I show that increases in the enforceability of noncompete agreements lead to widespread declines in employee departures, specifically in knowledge-intensive occupations. Established firms that rely more on these knowledge-intensive occupations increase their investment rate in physical capital. However, new firm entry in corresponding sectors declines. I provide evidence for different mechanisms to explain these patterns. Together, the findings show that labor frictions play an important role in investment decisions. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了如竞业禁止协议等劳动力流动限制如何影响企业的投资决策。利用来自LinkedIn的匹配员工-雇主数据，我发现竞业禁止协议可执行性的提高导致员工离职率普遍下降，尤其是在知识密集型职业中。更依赖这些知识密集型职业的成熟企业增加了对实物资本的投资率。然而，相应行业的新企业进入有所减少。我提供了不同机制的证据来解释这些模式。总之，研究结果表明劳动力摩擦在投资决策中扮演重要角色。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Who Mismanages Student Loans, and Why?
records.title_cn: 谁在错误管理学生贷款，为什么？
records.abstract_en: Many financially distressed students who qualify for federal assistance plans with interest moratorium and principal forgiveness instead accrue interest over long periods of nonpayment. This loan mismanagement is associated with higher delinquency. Mismanagement varies significantly across student gender and race: it is more prominent among male and non-white students. Mismanagement also varies across loan servicers, depending on proxies for student-adverse servicer policies. We consider explanations based on student selection and servicer treatment for loan mismanagement. Student financial literacy plays an important role but variation in treatment on the part of loan servicers appears more important. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
records.abstract_cn: 许多经济困难的学生符合联邦援助计划的条件，这些计划提供利息暂停和本金减免，但他们却在长期不还款期间累积利息。这种贷款管理不善与更高的违约率相关。管理不善在不同性别和种族的学生中存在显著差异：在男性和非白人学生中更为突出。管理不善也因贷款服务商而异，取决于学生不利服务商政策的代理变量。我们考虑了基于学生选择和贷款服务商处理对贷款管理不善的解释。学生金融素养起着重要作用，但贷款服务商处理上的差异似乎更为重要。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: What Private Equity Does Differently: Evidence from Life Insurance
records.title_cn: 私募股权有何不同：来自人寿保险的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how private equity creates value and its consequences for consumer welfare in the insurance industry, where PE investments grew tenfold following the financial crisis. PE firms add value through regulatory and tax arbitrage that increases profits relative to their non-PE counterparts. Crucially, the impact on consumer welfare is nuanced: in the short run, consumers benefit from more favorably priced products. But the arbitrage strategy also exposes them to more risk, as annual expected losses scaled by capital buffers rise by 50 percentage points. This creates the possibility of consumer harm in the event of a downturn. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了私募股权如何创造价值及其对保险行业消费者福利的影响，其中私募股权投资在金融危机后增长了十倍。私募股权公司通过监管和税收套利增加利润，相对于非私募股权同行。关键在于，对消费者福利的影响是微妙的：在短期内，消费者从更优惠定价的产品中受益。但套利策略也使他们面临更多风险，因为按资本缓冲规模计算的年度预期损失上升了50个百分点。这创造了在经济低迷时期消费者受损的可能性。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: Banks as Liquidity Multipliers
records.title_cn: 银行作为流动性乘数
records.abstract_en: We characterize the interaction between banks’ liquid assets purchases and deposit issuance decisions. Using global games, we derive a liquidity multiplier: the amount of deposits a bank can create when endowed with one additional unit of liquid asset to maintain a given level of liquidity risk. In our central theorem, we prove it is larger than unity. This entails that banks have a special role in enhancing liquidity provision, “multiplying” liquid assets into a larger quantity of deposits. Our theory has implications for banks’ balance sheet choices, the pricing of liquid securities, and the role of public liquidity provision.
records.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了银行流动资产购买与存款发行决策之间的相互作用。利用全局博弈，我们推导出一个流动性乘数：在维持给定流动性风险水平下，银行被赋予一单位额外流动资产所能创造的存款数量。在我们的核心定理中，我们证明该乘数大于一。这意味着银行在增强流动性供给方面具有特殊作用，将流动资产“乘数化”为更大数量的存款。我们的理论对银行的资产负债表选择、流动性证券定价以及公共流动性供给的作用具有启示意义。

records.title_en: The fundamental surplus revisited
records.title_cn: 重新审视基本盈余
records.abstract_en: To generate large responses of unemployment to productivity changes requires a high elasticity of the fundamental surplus with respect to productivity. When all deductions that enter the fundamental surplus are acyclical, and the fundamental surplus does not involve endogenous variables, then the elasticity of the fundamental surplus coincides with the inverse of the fundamental surplus fraction.
records.abstract_cn: 要使失业对生产率变化产生较大反应，需要基本盈余对生产率的弹性较高。当进入基本盈余的所有扣除项都是非周期性的，且基本盈余不涉及内生变量时，基本盈余的弹性与基本盈余比例的倒数一致。

records.title_en: Agency frictions, managerial compensation, and disruptive innovations
records.title_cn: 代理摩擦、管理层薪酬与颠覆性创新
records.abstract_en: Whether a manager leads the innovation efforts of a firm in line with shareholder preferences is key for firm value and growth. This, in turn, influences aggregate productivity growth and welfare. Data on US public firms reveals that (i) firms with better corporate governance tend to adopt highly incentivized contracts rich in stock options and (ii) such contracts are more likely to lead to disruptive innovations – patented inventions that are in the upper tail of the distribution in terms of quality and originality. Motivated by these empirical results, we develop and estimate a new dynamic general equilibrium model of firm-level innovation with agency frictions and endogenous determination of executive contracts. The model is used to study the joint dynamics of corporate governance, managerial compensation, and disruptive innovations, as well as the consequent aggregate implications on growth and welfare. Better corporate governance can reduce the influence of the manager in determining the compensation structure. This leads to more incentivized contracts and boosts innovation, with substantial benefits for the shareholders as well as the broader economy through knowledge spillovers. Removing agency frictions leads to contracts richer in stock options, boosting growth by 0.51pp, and welfare by 7.3% in consumption-equivalent terms. These findings are robust to incorporating short-termism. Short-termism itself is also detrimental, the removal of which increases welfare by 1.5%. Alleviating both frictions at the same time leads to amplified gains in growth and welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 管理者是否按照股东偏好领导企业的创新努力，对企业价值和增长至关重要。这反过来又影响总体生产率增长和福利。美国上市公司数据显示：（i）公司治理较好的企业倾向于采用富含股票期权的高激励合同；（ii）此类合同更有可能带来颠覆性创新——即在质量和原创性方面处于分布上尾部的专利发明。受这些实证结果的启发，我们开发并估计了一个包含代理摩擦和行政合同内生决定的企业层面创新的新动态一般均衡模型。该模型用于研究公司治理、管理层薪酬和颠覆性创新的联合动态，以及由此产生的对增长和福利的总体影响。更好的公司治理可以减少管理者在决定薪酬结构中的影响力。这导致更多激励合同并促进创新，为股东以及通过知识溢出为更广泛的经济带来可观利益。消除代理摩擦会导致合同更富含股票期权，使增长提高0个百分点，福利以消费等价计算提高7.3%。这些发现在纳入短期主义后依然稳健。短期主义本身也是有害的，消除它会使福利提高1.5%。同时缓解两种摩擦会导致增长和福利的收益放大。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous spillovers of housing credit policy
records.title_cn: 住房信贷政策的异质性溢出效应
records.abstract_en: We study the spillovers from government intervention in the mortgage market on households' consumption. Expansionary credit policy increases the consumption of homeowners with mortgage debt significantly, while the consumption response of homeowners without mortgage debt is small and insignificant. Non-homeowners also increase their consumption but less than mortgagors. We also find heterogeneous responses of households of different ages. We explain these facts through a life-cycle model with incomplete markets and endogenous housing choice. Downward pressure on the credit and interest rates creates extra wealth for the mortgagors via the refinancing channel.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了政府对抵押贷款市场的干预对家庭消费的溢出效应。扩张性信贷政策显著增加了有抵押贷款债务的房主的消费，而没有抵押贷款债务的房主的消费反应则较小且不显著。非房主也增加了消费，但增幅低于抵押贷款者。我们还发现不同年龄家庭的反应存在异质性。我们通过一个具有不完全市场和内生住房选择的生命周期模型来解释这些事实。信贷和利率的下行压力通过再融资渠道为抵押贷款者创造了额外财富。

records.title_en: The extent of downward nominal wage rigidity: New evidence from payroll data
records.title_cn: 名义工资向下刚性的程度：来自工资单数据的新证据
records.abstract_en: We use over a decade of representative payroll data from Great Britain to study the nominal wage changes of employees who stayed in the same job for at least one year. We show that basic hourly pay drives the cyclicality of marginal labour costs, making this the most relevant measure of wages for macroeconomic models that incorporate wage rigidity. Basic hourly pay adjusts much less frequently than previously thought in Britain, particularly in small firms. We find that firms compress wage growth when inflation is low, which indicates that downward rigidity constrains firms' wage setting. We demonstrate that the empirical extent of downward nominal wage rigidity (DNWR) can theoretically cause considerable long-run output losses. Combined, our results all point to the importance of including DNWR in macroeconomic and monetary policy models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用英国超过十年的代表性工资单数据，研究了在同一岗位工作至少一年的员工的工资变化。我们表明，基本小时工资驱动了边际劳动力成本的周期性，使其成为包含工资刚性的宏观经济模型中最相关的工资衡量指标。基本小时工资的调整频率远低于此前对英国的认知，尤其是在小企业中。我们发现，当通货膨胀较低时，企业压缩工资增长，这表明向下刚性约束了企业的工资设定。我们证明，名义工资向下刚性（DNWR）的经验程度理论上可能导致相当大的长期产出损失。综合来看，我们的结果都指向了将DNWR纳入宏观经济和货币政策模型的重要性。

records.title_en: Reassessing trade barriers with global production networks
records.title_cn: 重新评估全球生产网络下的贸易壁垒
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a two-country general equilibrium model with forward-looking participation decisions on exporting and multinational production, and examines the effects of final-goods tariffs and intermediate-input tariffs. I show that permanent unilateral tariffs lead to a recession in the policy-imposed country. In the policy-imposing country, investment experiences a short-run boom while consumption falls immediately and persistently, with intermediate-input tariffs resulting in a larger contraction. At the firm level, the least productive exporters exit from the policy-imposing country, while the most productive ones relocate production there. Relative to a model without multinational firms, this production relocation partially offsets the contractionary effects of tariffs. Crucial to the short-run investment expansion and firms' participation in multinational production in the policy-imposing country is the persistence of tariffs. When tariffs are temporary, investment falls immediately, driving an immediate recession there, in contrast to permanent tariffs. Further, temporary tariffs induce hysteresis in firms' participation in exporting and multinational production, which in turn diminishes the expansionary effects of multinational entry.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个包含出口和跨国生产前瞻性参与决策的两国一般均衡模型，并考察了最终品关税和中间投入品关税的影响。研究表明，永久性单边关税会导致政策实施国出现衰退。在政策实施国，投资经历短期繁荣，而消费立即且持续下降，其中中间投入品关税导致更大的收缩。在企业层面，生产率最低的出口商退出政策实施国，而生产率最高的企业则将生产转移到该国。相对于没有跨国企业的模型，这种生产转移部分抵消了关税的收缩效应。对政策实施国短期投资扩张和企业参与跨国生产至关重要的因素是关税的持续性。当关税是暂时性的时，投资立即下降，导致该国立即陷入衰退，这与永久性关税形成对比。此外，暂时性关税会导致企业在出口和跨国生产参与方面产生滞后效应，这反过来又削弱了跨国企业进入的扩张效应。

records.title_en: The risk-premium channel of uncertainty: Implications for unemployment and inflation
records.title_cn: 不确定性的风险溢价渠道：对失业和通胀的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the role of macroeconomic uncertainty in a search-and-matching framework with risk-averse households. Heightened uncertainty about future productivity reduces current economic activity even in the absence of nominal rigidities. A risk-premium mechanism accounts for this result. As future asset prices become more volatile and covary more positively with aggregate consumption, the risk premium rises in the present. The associated downward pressure on current asset values lowers firm entry, making it harder for workers to find jobs and reducing the supply of goods. With nominal rigidities the recession is exacerbated, as a more uncertain future reinforces households' precautionary behavior, which causes demand to contract. Counterfactual analyses using a calibrated model imply that unemployment would rise by less than half as much absent the risk-premium channel. The presence of this mechanism implies that uncertainty shocks are less deflationary than regular demand shocks, nor can they be fully neutralized by monetary policy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在具有风险厌恶家庭部门的搜寻匹配框架中研究了宏观经济不确定性的作用。即使在没有名义刚性的情况下，未来生产率不确定性的加剧也会降低当前经济活动。风险溢价机制解释了这一结果。随着未来资产价格变得更加波动，并与总消费的正协方差增强，当前的风险溢价上升。由此对当前资产价值产生的下行压力降低了企业进入，使工人更难找到工作，并减少了商品供给。在存在名义刚性的情况下，衰退加剧，因为更加不确定的未来强化了家庭的预防性行为，导致需求收缩。使用校准模型进行的反事实分析表明，若无风险溢价渠道，失业率的上升幅度将不到实际的一半。该机制的存在意味着不确定性冲击比常规需求冲击更不具有通缩性，也不能被货币政策完全中和。

records.title_en: Wage dispersion with heterogeneous wage contracts
records.title_cn: 异质性工资合同下的工资离散度
records.abstract_en: I study a labor market in which identical workers search on- and off-the-job and heterogeneous firms employ using either an ex-ante posted wage or flexible wage contracts contingent on outside options. Firm level costs for contingent contracts generate a segmented equilibrium in which less productive firms post wages. The model with heterogeneous contracts can achieve wage dispersion, labor share, employment transitions, and flow value of unemployment that are simultaneously consistent with empirical observations while capturing information frictions and search externalities modeled by ex-ante wage posting. In contrast to well known results regarding pure wage posting models, a good fit to these data can be achieved even when the vast majority of firms post wages. Matching to moments for the U.S. economy in the 2010s implies roughly 58 percent of firms post wages and employ nearly 30 percent of workers under such contracts.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个劳动力市场，其中相同的工人进行在职和离职搜索，而异质性企业要么使用事前公布的工资，要么使用依赖于外部选项的灵活工资合同。企业层面的或有合同成本产生了一个分割均衡，其中生产率较低的企业公布工资。具有异质性合同的模型可以实现工资离散度、劳动份额、就业转换和失业的流动价值，这些同时与经验观察一致，同时捕捉了事前工资发布所建模的信息摩擦和搜索外部性。与关于纯工资发布模型的众所周知的结果相反，即使绝大多数企业公布工资，也能很好地拟合这些数据。对美国经济在2010年的矩匹配意味着大约58%的企业公布工资，并且在这些合同下雇佣了近30%的工人。

records.title_en: Misallocation and markups: Evidence from Indian manufacturing
records.title_cn: 错配与加成率：来自印度制造业的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines the implications of variable markups for resource misallocation and for aggregate productivity. Using manufacturing data from India, I show that variable markups alone account for a small fraction of the dispersion in revenue productivity when allowing for other sources of misallocation. Meanwhile, variable markups are crucial to understanding the aggregate consequences of policies that reduce misallocation. When equalizing marginal products across firms in narrowly defined industries, my model generates a smaller total factor productivity gain than does a model that uses constant markups because more productive firms endogenously choose higher markups. Thus, the indirect costs of markups are higher than one might expect.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了可变加成率对资源错配和总生产率的影响。利用印度的制造业数据，我表明在允许其他错配来源的情况下，仅可变加成率就解释了收入生产率离散度的一小部分。同时，可变加成率对于理解减少错配政策的总体后果至关重要。当在狭义定义的行业内使企业的边际产品相等时，我的模型产生的全要素生产率增益小于使用不变加成率的模型，因为生产率更高的企业内生地选择更高的加成率。因此，加成率的间接成本高于人们可能预期的水平。

records.title_en: Misallocation and intersectoral linkages
records.title_cn: 错配与部门间关联
records.abstract_en: We analytically characterize the aggregate productivity loss from distortions in the presence of sectoral production linkages and show the key role of input substitutability. We analyze the various forces behind the non-monotonic effect of input substitutability on the productivity loss. We then use the second-order approximation to aggregate productivity and find that for moderate distortions, low input substitutability reduces the productivity loss and the role of intermediate-input suppliers. Moreover, when the input elasticity of substitution is low, sectoral linkages do not systematically amplify the productivity loss. Using the model calibrated on industry-level data for 35 countries, we find that the insights obtained from the approximation are relevant in the context of the sectoral distortions caused by market power, even with the large distortions observed in the data. In particular, we find that using Cobb-Douglas production functions (unit elasticities) instead of accounting for low input substitutability (less-than-one elasticities) leads to overestimating the productivity loss by a factor of 1.8.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在存在部门生产关联的情况下，解析性地刻画了扭曲导致的总体生产率损失，并展示了投入替代性的关键作用。我们分析了投入替代性对生产率损失产生非单调影响背后的各种力量。随后，我们利用总体生产率的二阶近似发现，在适度扭曲下，低投入替代性会降低生产率损失以及中间投入供应商的作用。此外，当投入替代弹性较低时，部门关联并不会系统地放大生产率损失。利用基于35个国家行业层面数据校准的模型，我们发现，即使在数据中观察到的大扭曲情况下，从近似中获得的见解在市场力量导致的部门扭曲背景下也是相关的。特别是，我们发现，使用柯布-道格拉斯生产函数（单位弹性）而非考虑低投入替代性（小于一的弹性）会导致生产率损失被高估1.8倍。

records.title_en: Global DSGE models
records.title_cn: 全球DSGE模型
records.abstract_en: We introduce our GDSGE framework and a novel global solution method, called simultaneous transition and policy function iterations (STPFIs), for solving dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models. The framework encompasses many well-known incomplete markets models with highly nonlinear dynamics such as models of financial crises and models with rare disasters including the current COVID-19 pandemic. Using consistency equations, our method is most effective at solving models featuring endogenous state variables with implicit laws of motion such as wealth or consumption shares. Finally, we incorporate this method in an automated and publicly available toolbox that solves many important models in the aforementioned topics, and in many cases, more efficiently and/or accurately than their original algorithms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们介绍了我们的GDSGE框架和一种新颖的全局求解方法，称为同步转换与政策函数迭代（STPFIs），用于求解动态随机一般均衡模型。该框架涵盖了许多著名的具有高度非线性动态的不完全市场模型，如金融危机模型和包含当前COVID-19大流行的罕见灾难模型。利用一致性方程，我们的方法在求解具有隐式运动规律的内生状态变量（如财富或消费份额）的模型时最为有效。最后，我们将此方法整合到一个自动化且公开可用的工具箱中，该工具箱能够求解上述主题中的许多重要模型，并且在许多情况下，比其原始算法更高效和/或更准确。

records.title_en: Retirement timing uncertainty: Empirical evidence and quantitative evaluation
records.title_cn: 退休时间不确定性：实证证据与定量评估
records.abstract_en: People often retire at a different age than expected. We construct a measure of retirement timing uncertainty and find that the standard deviation of the difference between retirement expectations and actual retirement dates ranges from 3 to 6 years. To understand the potential implications of this uncertainty, we develop a simple model of exogenous but risky retirement. In this environment, individuals would give up 1.0%-4.5% of total lifetime consumption to fully insure this risk and 0.8%-3.2% of lifetime consumption simply to know their actual retirement date upon entering the labor force. This is crucial for retirement planning purposes because not saving to hedge this risk would leave individuals with even larger welfare costs.
records.abstract_cn: 人们的实际退休年龄往往与预期不同。我们构建了一个退休时间不确定性的度量指标，发现退休预期与实际退休日期之间差异的标准差范围为3至6年。为了理解这种不确定性的潜在影响，我们开发了一个外生但存在风险的退休简单模型。在这种环境下，个人愿意放弃总终身消费的1.0%-4.5%来完全保险这一风险，并愿意放弃终身消费的0.8%-3.2%仅仅为了在进入劳动力市场时就知道其实际退休日期。这对于退休规划至关重要，因为不为对冲这一风险而储蓄将使个人面临更大的福利损失。

records.title_en: General equilibrium with multiple liquid assets
records.title_cn: 多种流动性资产的一般均衡
records.abstract_en: This paper studies, analytically and numerically, economies with multiple liquid assets: fiat currency; fixed-supply real assets; and reproducible capital. Cases are considered where assets provide direct liquidity, and indirect liquidity via over-the-counter trade. The results shed new light on how monetary policy affects asset markets and investment. We also provide novel results on endogenous fluctuations (self-fulfilling prophecies), including coexistence of multiple equilibria with very different correlation and volatility patterns. Then we investigate if monetary policy can eliminate multiplicity. A calibration exercise assesses the impact on asset markets and on welfare of different policies, including changing inflation, and eliminating currency altogether.
records.abstract_cn: 本文从分析和数值上研究了具有多种流动性资产的经济体：法定货币；固定供给的真实资产；以及可再生产资本。考虑了资产提供直接流动性以及通过场外交易提供间接流动性的情况。结果对货币政策如何影响资产市场和投资提供了新的见解。我们还提供了关于内生波动（自我实现的预言）的新结果，包括具有非常不同的相关性和波动性模式的多个均衡的共存。然后我们研究货币政策是否能消除多重性。校准练习评估了不同政策对资产市场和福利的影响，包括改变通货膨胀和完全取消货币。

records.title_en: When to lock, not whom: Managing epidemics using time-based restrictions
records.title_cn: 何时封锁，而非封锁谁：利用基于时间的限制管理流行病
records.abstract_en: We present novel policy tools to manage epidemics. Rather than using prevalent population restrictions, these policy strategies are based on cyclical time restrictions. Key findings on the outcomes of such policy strategies include: a significant improvement of social welfare, substantially lessening the trade-offs between economic activity and health outcomes; optimally-derived timings of interventions are shown to suppress the disease, while maintaining reasonable economic activity; and outcomes are superior to the actual experience of New York State and Florida over the course of 2020.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了管理流行病的新型政策工具。这些政策策略并非采用普遍的人口限制，而是基于周期性的时间限制。关于此类政策策略结果的关键发现包括：社会福利显著改善，大幅减轻经济活动与健康结果之间的权衡；最优干预时机的确定被证明能够抑制疾病，同时维持合理的经济活动；其结果优于纽约州和佛罗里达州在2020年期间的实际经历。

records.title_en: Financial constraints and economic development: The role of firm productivity investment
records.title_cn: 金融约束与经济发展：企业生产率投资的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates that accounting for firms' endogenous productivity growth over lifecycle plays an important role in understanding the link between financial and economic development. It incorporates firm productivity investment into a span-of-control model, and compares the effects of firm financing constraints arising in this model to the effects of the same constraints in the model in which firm productivity growth is assumed to be exogenous. It finds that, depending on the severity of firm financing constraints, endogenizing firm productivity growth increases the adverse effects of the constraints on steady state output by 1.5-3 times, both due to a large decrease in average productivity and due to a bigger equilibrium effect on capital used in production.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，考虑企业生命周期内内生生产率增长在理解金融发展与经济发展之间的联系中起着重要作用。本文将企业生产率投资纳入控制跨度模型，并比较了该模型中企业融资约束的影响与假设企业生产率增长外生的模型中相同约束的影响。研究发现，根据企业融资约束的严重程度，将企业生产率增长内生化会使约束对稳态产出的不利影响增加1.5-3倍，这既是因为平均生产率大幅下降，也是因为对生产中使用的资本产生了更大的均衡效应。

records.title_en: Credit markets, relationship lending, and the dynamics of firm entry
records.title_cn: 信贷市场、关系型贷款与企业进入的动态
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of credit relationships on firm entry, and the implications for aggregate investment and output. Exploiting Italian data, we find that relationship-oriented local credit markets feature fewer, larger entrants, and relatively more spinoff entrants. Relationship lending discourages de novo entry when banks' knowledge is incumbent-specific but promotes knowledge transfers to spinoffs. We explain these patterns in a dynamic general equilibrium model where banks accumulate information in credit relationships and can reuse information when financing entrants. Relationship lending raises output, as the larger investments and the credit reallocation from de novos to spinoffs outweigh the entry slowdown.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究信贷关系对企业进入的影响，以及对总体投资和产出的含义。利用意大利数据，我们发现关系导向型地方信贷市场具有更少、更大的进入者，以及相对更多的分拆进入者。当银行的知识是针对在位者特定时，关系型贷款阻碍了新进入，但促进了向分拆企业的知识转移。我们在一个动态一般均衡模型中解释这些模式，其中银行在信贷关系中积累信息，并能在为进入者融资时重用信息。关系型贷款提高了产出，因为更大的投资和从新进入者到分拆企业的信贷重新配置超过了进入放缓的影响。

records.title_en: The paradox of price flexibility in an open economy
records.title_cn: 开放经济中价格灵活性的悖论
records.abstract_en: Empirical evidence suggests that the degree of price stickiness is not uniform around the world. Heterogeneous price stickiness introduces a new propagation mechanism of global demand shocks that lead to a liquidity trap for all countries, which we call the open-economy paradox of flexibility. We show that the severity of the paradox increases with the degree of trade and capital market openness, when home and foreign goods are Edgeworth substitutes and when the more affected home country runs a trade deficit. This implies that highly open trade and financial linkages are not desirable in terms of world welfare. We show that the inefficiencies generated by heterogeneous price stickiness can be reduced through two types of international policy coordination: i) an arrangement in which the country with relatively sticky prices raises the interest rates or ii) a monetary union.
records.abstract_cn: 经验证据表明，价格粘性程度在世界各地并不一致。异质性价格粘性引入了一种新的全球需求冲击传导机制，导致所有国家陷入流动性陷阱，我们称之为开放经济中的灵活性悖论。我们表明，当本国和外国商品为埃奇沃思替代品，且受影响更大的本国出现贸易逆差时，悖论的严重程度随着贸易和资本市场开放程度的提高而增加。这意味着高度开放的贸易和金融联系在世界福利方面并不可取。我们表明，通过两种国际政策协调可以减少异质性价格粘性产生的低效率：i) 相对价格粘性较高的国家提高利率的安排，或 ii) 货币联盟。

records.title_en: Does my model predict a forward guidance puzzle?
records.title_cn: 我的模型是否预测了前瞻指引之谜？
records.abstract_en: We show how to characterize the economic forces that generate the forward guidance puzzle in a wide variety of structural macroeconomic models. We accomplish this by showing that studying the predictions of forward guidance announcements is essentially the same as conducting E-stability analysis under adaptive learning. We show that the Iterative E-stability criterion identifies all of the most prominent forward guidance puzzle resolutions proposed in the literature, provides ways to evaluate their robustness, shows how new resolutions may be constructed, and is scalable to quantitatively relevant models. We show some common resolutions are robust while others are not. We also devise a novel solution to the forward guidance puzzle: sunspots.
records.abstract_cn: 我们展示了如何在各种结构性宏观经济模型中刻画产生前瞻指引之谜的经济力量。我们通过表明研究前瞻指引公告的预测本质上等同于在适应性学习下进行E-稳定性分析来实现这一点。我们表明，迭代E-稳定性准则识别了文献中提出的所有最突出的前瞻指引之谜解决方案，提供了评估其稳健性的方法，展示了如何构建新的解决方案，并且可扩展到定量相关的模型。我们表明一些常见的解决方案是稳健的，而另一些则不是。我们还设计了一个新颖的前瞻指引之谜解决方案：太阳黑子。

records.title_en: On the black-white gaps in labor supply and earnings over the lifecycle in the US
records.title_cn: 美国生命周期中劳动力供给与收入的黑白差距
records.abstract_en: In the US economy, Black men, on average, receive lower wages than White men, and the difference increases over the working life. The employment rate and the number of hours worked are also lower for Blacks, but the gap is nearly constant. Together these facts suggest that on-the-job human capital accumulation might explain the diverging wages. However, the wage gap and its evolution over the lifecycle cannot be explained by differences in accumulated experience or educational attainment for the cohort we analyze. Instead, the combination of experience and test scores measured at ages 17-22 accounts for the wage gap and its growth. We propose an on-the-job human capital accumulation model with heterogeneity in the initial human capital endowment and the lifelong ability to accumulate human capital, and endogenous labor supply at the extensive and intensive margins to explain the evolution of the Black-White wage gap over the lifecycle. We discipline the distribution of the ability to accumulate human capital using the power of test scores to predict earnings growth in the data. We find that if the pre-market distributions were the same for Blacks and Whites, the racial gap in hourly earnings would be closed by 84%, with the remaining gap opening throughout life due to higher labor supply amongst White men. That is, the unequal conditions with which men in the two groups enter the labor market are likely to be the key determinant of the differences over the lifecycle.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国经济中，黑人男性的平均工资低于白人男性，且这一差异随工作年限增加而扩大。黑人的就业率和工作时间也较低，但这一差距几乎保持不变。这些事实共同表明，在职人力资本积累可能解释了工资差异的扩大。然而，对于我们分析的队列，工资差距及其随生命周期的演变无法用累积经验或教育程度的差异来解释。相反，年龄在17-22岁之间测量的经验与测试分数的组合解释了工资差距及其增长。我们提出了一个在职人力资本积累模型，该模型考虑了初始人力资本禀赋和终身人力资本积累能力的异质性，以及广泛和集约边际上的内生劳动力供给，以解释黑人与白人工资差距随生命周期的演变。我们利用测试分数预测收入增长的能力来约束人力资本积累能力的分布。我们发现，如果黑人和白人的市场前分布相同，小时收入的种族差距将缩小84%，剩余的差距在整个生命周期中因白人男性更高的劳动力供给而扩大。也就是说，两组男性进入劳动力市场时的不平等条件可能是生命周期差异的关键决定因素。

records.title_en: Market uncertainty and international trade
records.title_cn: 市场不确定性与国际贸易
records.abstract_en: We study the consequences of market uncertainty on international trade. An increase in foreign market uncertainty dampens China's aggregate exports on both the extensive and intensive margins. The adverse effects are more pronounced in industries facing tighter financial constraints than in others. We propose a dynamic trade model to explain the facts. Greater uncertainty depresses a firm's expected value of exporting and borrowing capacity, leading to fewer exporters and smaller average size of exports. Under calibrated parameters, the uncertainty shock accounts for a sizable fraction of China's trade collapse in the 2008 financial crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了市场不确定性对国际贸易的影响。外国市场不确定性的增加抑制了中国在扩展边际和集约边际上的总体出口。与面临较宽松金融约束的行业相比，金融约束更紧的行业受到的不利影响更为显著。我们提出了一个动态贸易模型来解释这些事实。更大的不确定性降低了企业出口的预期价值和借贷能力，导致出口企业数量减少和平均出口规模缩小。在校准参数下，不确定性冲击解释了2008年金融危机期间中国贸易崩溃的相当大一部分。

records.title_en: Revisiting capital-skill complementarity, inequality, and labor share
records.title_cn: 重新审视资本-技能互补性、不平等与劳动份额
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the quantitative contribution of capital-skill complementarity in accounting for rising wage inequality, as in Krusell, Ohanian, Rios-Rull, and Violante (KORV, 2000). We study how well the KORV framework accounts for more recent data, including the large changes in labor's share of income that occurred after the KORV estimation period ended. We also study how using information and communications technology (ICT) capital as the complementary capital stock affects the model's implications for inequality and overall model fit. We find significant evidence for continued capital-skill complementarity across all model permutations we analyze. Despite nearly 30 years of additional data, we find very little change to the original KORV estimates of substitution elasticities when the total stock of capital equipment is used as the complementary capital stock. We find much more capital-skill complementarity when ICT capital is used. The KORV framework continues to closely account for rising wage inequality through 2019, though it misses the three percentage points decline in labor's share of income that has occurred since 2000.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了资本-技能互补性在解释工资不平等上升中的定量贡献，如Krusell、Ohanian、Rios-Rull和Violante（KORV，2000）所述。我们研究了KORV框架在多大程度上解释了更近期的数据，包括在KORV估计期结束后发生的劳动收入份额的大幅变化。我们还研究了使用信息和通信技术（ICT）资本作为互补资本存量如何影响模型对不平等的含义以及整体模型拟合度。我们发现，在我们分析的所有模型变体中，资本-技能互补性持续存在显著证据。尽管增加了近30年的数据，当使用总资本设备存量作为互补资本存量时，我们发现原始KORV对替代弹性的估计几乎没有变化。当使用ICT资本时，我们发现资本-技能互补性更强。KORV框架继续紧密解释截至2019年的工资不平等上升，尽管它未能捕捉到自2000年以来劳动收入份额下降的三个百分点。

records.title_en: Trend inflation and evolving inflation dynamics: A Bayesian GMM analysis
records.title_cn: 趋势通胀与不断演变的通胀动态：一种贝叶斯GMM分析
records.abstract_en: Inflation dynamics are investigated by estimating a generalized version of the New Keynesian Phillips curve (NKPC) of Galí and Gertler (1999) using Bayesian GMM. US macroeconomic data suggests that the generalized NKPC (GNKPC) performs best in terms of quasi-marginal likelihood among those considered both during and after the Great Inflation period. The estimated GNKPC indicates that when trend inflation fell after the Great Inflation period, the probability of price change decreased and the GNKPC flattened, which is in line with findings by previous studies.
records.abstract_cn: 通过使用贝叶斯GMM估计Galí和Gertler（1999）的新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线（NKPC）的广义版本，对通胀动态进行了研究。美国宏观经济数据表明，在大通胀时期及之后，广义NKPC（GNKPC）在准边际似然方面表现最佳。估计的GNKPC表明，当大通胀时期后趋势通胀下降时，价格变动概率降低，GNKPC变得平坦，这与先前研究的发现一致。

records.title_en: Identifying preferences when households are financially constrained
records.title_cn: 识别家庭面临金融约束时的偏好
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that utilizing information on the extensive margin of financially constrained households can narrow down the set of admissible preferences in a large class of macroeconomic models. Estimates based on Spanish aggregate data provide further empirical support for this result and suggest that accounting for this margin can bring estimates closer to microeconometric evidence. Accounting for financial constraints and the extensive margin is shown to matter for empirical asset pricing and quantifying distortions in financial markets.
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，利用金融约束家庭广泛边际的信息，可以在大类宏观经济模型中缩小可接受偏好的集合。基于西班牙总体数据的估计进一步为这一结果提供了实证支持，并表明考虑这一边际可以使估计更接近微观计量证据。考虑金融约束和广泛边际被证明对实证资产定价和量化金融市场扭曲具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Accounting for limited commitment between spouses when estimating labor-supply elasticities
records.title_cn: 在估计劳动供给弹性时考虑配偶间的有限承诺
records.abstract_en: The Frisch elasticity of labor supply can be estimated by regressing hours worked on the hourly wage rate, controlling for consumption of the individual worker. However, most household panel surveys contain consumption information only at the household level. We show that proxying individual consumption by household consumption biases estimated Frisch elasticities downward as limited commitment in the household induces individual consumption to behave differently from household consumption. We develop an improved estimation approach that eliminates this bias by exploiting information on the composition of household consumption to infer its distribution. Using PSID data, we estimate Frisch elasticities of about 0.65 for men and 0.8 for women.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动供给的弗里希弹性可以通过将工作时间对小时工资率进行回归来估计，同时控制个体工人的消费。然而，大多数家庭面板调查仅在家庭层面包含消费信息。我们表明，用家庭消费作为个体消费的代理会使估计的弗里希弹性向下偏误，因为家庭内部的有限承诺导致个体消费行为与家庭消费不同。我们开发了一种改进的估计方法，通过利用家庭消费构成的信息来推断其分配，从而消除这一偏误。使用PSID数据，我们估计男性的弗里希弹性约为0.65，女性约为0.8。

records.title_en: Rescue policies for small businesses in the COVID-19 recession
records.title_cn: COVID-19衰退中的小企业救助政策
records.abstract_en: While the COVID-19 pandemic had a large and asymmetric impact on firms, many countries quickly enacted massive business rescue programs which are specifically targeted to smaller firms. Little is known about the effects of such policies on business entry and exit, investment, factor reallocation, and macroeconomic outcomes. This paper builds a general equilibrium model with heterogeneous and financially constrained firms in order to evaluate the short- and long-term consequences of small firm rescue programs in a pandemic recession. We calibrate the stationary equilibrium and the pandemic shock to the U.S. economy, taking into account the factual Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) as a specific policy. We find that the policy has only a modest impact on aggregate output and employment because (i) jobs are saved predominately in the smallest firms that account for a minor share of employment and (ii) the grant reduces the reallocation of resources towards larger and less impacted firms. Much of the reallocation effects occur in the aftermath of the pandemic episode. By preventing inefficient liquidations, the policy dampens the long-term declines of aggregate consumption and of the real wage, thus delivering small welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管COVID-19疫情对企业产生了巨大且不对称的影响，许多国家迅速实施了大规模的企业救助计划，这些计划特别针对规模较小的企业。关于此类政策对企业进入与退出、投资、要素重新配置以及宏观经济结果的影响，我们知之甚少。本文构建了一个包含异质性和融资约束企业的一般均衡模型，以评估在疫情衰退期间小企业救助计划的短期和长期后果。我们将稳态均衡和疫情冲击校准到美国经济，并将实际的薪资保护计划（PPP）作为具体政策纳入考虑。我们发现，该政策对总产出和就业的影响较为温和，原因在于（i）就业岗位主要保存在最小的企业中，而这些企业仅占就业的较小份额；（ii）补助减少了资源向规模更大且受影响较小的企业的重新配置。大部分重新配置效应发生在疫情结束之后。通过防止低效清算，该政策减缓了总消费和实际工资的长期下降，从而带来了小幅的福利收益。

records.title_en: Money laundering and the privacy design of central bank digital currency
records.title_cn: 洗钱与央行数字货币的隐私设计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the implications of money laundering for the optimal design of central bank digital currency (CBDC). I build a general equilibrium framework to explicitly allow money laundering by agents and income audits by a government. I find that as long as CBDC offers less anonymity than cash, introducing CBDC will decrease money laundering. However, if CBDC still offers a relatively high level of anonymity but a low interest rate, then introducing CBDC will decrease the output from not only agents who launder money but also agents who do not. If CBDC instead offers low anonymity and a high interest rate, then introducing CBDC can increase aggregate welfare without lowering output. Furthermore, introducing CBDC needs not increase the funding costs of banks or decrease bank lending.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究洗钱对央行数字货币（CBDC）最优设计的影响。我构建了一个一般均衡框架，明确允许代理人洗钱和政府进行收入审计。我发现，只要CBDC提供的匿名性低于现金，引入CBDC将减少洗钱活动。然而，如果CBDC仍提供相对较高的匿名性但利率较低，那么引入CBDC将不仅减少洗钱代理人的产出，也减少不洗钱代理人的产出。如果CBDC转而提供低匿名性和高利率，那么引入CBDC可以在不降低产出的情况下增加总体福利。此外，引入CBDC不一定增加银行的融资成本或减少银行贷款。

records.title_en: Low safe interest rates: A case for dynamic inefficiency?
records.title_cn: 低安全利率：动态无效率的一个案例？
records.abstract_en: We reexamine the tests for dynamic inefficiency in productive overlapping-generations economies with stochastic growth. Contrary to certain claims in the recent literature, we argue that the size of real safe interest rates relative to average GDP growth is an inconclusive test for dynamic inefficiency. A more accurate test should take into account the correlation between growth and the marginal utility of wealth. We provide an exhaustive criterion based on the growth-adjusted dominant root of the stochastic discount factor emerging at the competitive equilibrium. Surprisingly, a preliminary rough empirical application of this criterion uncovers dynamic inefficiency of the US economy for any reasonable degree of risk aversion. We also distinguish capital overaccumulation from an inefficient distribution of consumption risk. The refined test for capital overaccumulation is rather stringent: Capital is not overaccumulated if the net dividend remains positive with some probability, as opposed to always, as in the original Abel et al. (1989)'s formulation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了具有随机增长的生产性重叠世代经济中动态无效率的检验。与近期文献中的某些主张相反，我们认为实际安全利率相对于平均GDP增长的规模对于动态无效率而言是一个不确定的检验。更准确的检验应考虑增长与财富边际效用之间的相关性。我们基于竞争均衡中出现的随机贴现因子的增长调整主导根，提供了一个详尽的标准。令人惊讶的是，该标准的初步粗略经验应用揭示了美国经济在任何合理的风险厌恶程度下都存在动态无效率。我们还区分了资本过度积累与消费风险的低效分配。对资本过度积累的精细检验相当严格：如果净股息以某种概率保持为正，则资本未过度积累，而非如原始Abel等人（1989）的表述中那样始终为正。

records.title_en: The preferential treatment of green bonds
records.title_cn: 绿色债券的优惠待遇
records.abstract_en: We study the preferential treatment of green bonds in the central bank collateral framework as a climate policy instrument within a DSGE model with climate and financial frictions. In the model, green and carbon-emitting conventional firms issue defaultable corporate bonds to banks that use them as collateral, subject to haircuts determined by the central bank. A haircut reduction induces firms to increase bond issuance, investment, leverage, and default risk. Collateral policy solves a trade-off between increasing collateral supply, adverse effects on firm risk-taking, and subsidizing green investment. Optimal collateral policy is characterized by a haircut gap of 20 percentage points, which increases the green investment share and reduces emissions. However, welfare gains fall well short of what can be achieved with optimal carbon taxes. Moreover, due to elevated risk-taking of green firms, preferential treatment is a qualitatively imperfect substitute of Pigouvian taxation on emissions: if and only if the optimal emission tax can not be implemented, optimal collateral policy features a preferential treatment of green bonds.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中央银行抵押品框架中绿色债券的优惠待遇，作为气候政策工具，在一个包含气候和金融摩擦的DSGE模型中进行分析。在该模型中，绿色企业和排放碳的传统企业向银行发行可违约公司债券，银行将其用作抵押品，并受中央银行确定的扣减率影响。扣减率的降低促使企业增加债券发行、投资、杠杆和违约风险。抵押品政策解决了增加抵押品供应、对企业风险承担的负面影响以及补贴绿色投资之间的权衡。最优抵押品政策的特点是扣减率差距为20个百分点，这提高了绿色投资份额并减少了排放。然而，福利收益远低于通过最优碳税所能实现的水平。此外，由于绿色企业风险承担上升，优惠待遇在质量上是排放的庇古税的不完美替代品：当且仅当最优排放税无法实施时，最优抵押品政策才具有绿色债券的优惠待遇特征。

records.title_en: Incarceration, employment, and earnings: Dynamics and differences
records.title_cn: 监禁、就业与收入：动态与差异
records.abstract_en: We study the dynamics of incarceration, employment, and earnings. Our hidden Markov model distinguishes between first-time and repeat incarceration, between persistent and transitory nonemployment and earnings risks, and accounts for nonresponse bias. We estimate the model via maximum likelihood using the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979, accounting for the large differences in incarceration rates by race, education level, and gender. First-time incarceration is associated with 33% (50%) lower expected lifetime earnings and 6 (10) fewer years of employment for Black (White) men with a high school degree. Among less-educated men, differences in incarceration and nonemployment can explain around half the Black-White lifetime earnings gap.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了监禁、就业和收入的动态变化。我们的隐马尔可夫模型区分了首次监禁和重复监禁，区分了持续性和暂时性的非就业及收入风险，并考虑了无回答偏差。我们使用1979年全国青年纵向调查数据通过最大似然法估计模型，并考虑了按种族、教育水平和性别划分的监禁率的巨大差异。首次监禁与高中毕业的黑人（白人）男性预期终身收入降低33%（50%）和就业年限减少6（10）年相关。在受教育程度较低的男性中，监禁和非就业的差异可以解释约一半的黑白终身收入差距。

records.title_en: Slow recoveries, endogenous growth and macro-prudential policy
records.title_cn: 缓慢复苏、内生增长与宏观审慎政策
records.abstract_en: Financial crises have severe short and long-term consequences. We develop a general equilibrium model with financial frictions and endogenous growth in which macro-prudential policy supports economic activity and productivity growth by strengthening the resilience of financial intermediaries to adverse shocks. The improved intermediation capacity of a safer financial system leads to a higher steady-state growth rate. The optimal capital ratio increases welfare by 8%, one order of magnitude more than in the case without endogenous growth.
records.abstract_cn: 金融危机具有严重的短期和长期后果。我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦和内生增长的一般均衡模型，在该模型中，宏观审慎政策通过增强金融中介机构对不利冲击的韧性来支持经济活动和生产率增长。更安全的金融体系所改善的金融中介能力导致更高的稳态增长率。最优资本比率使福利增加8%，比没有内生增长的情况高一个数量级。

records.title_en: Fiscal policy and the monetary transmission mechanism
records.title_cn: 财政政策与货币传导机制
records.abstract_en: The economy's response to monetary policy depends on its fiscal backing. We present a novel decomposition of the equilibrium that links the wealth effect, i.e. the revaluation of households' financial and human wealth, to the fiscal response to monetary policy. When monetary policy has fiscal consequences, monetary variables affect the timing of aggregate output while fiscal variables shape its present value and the wealth effect. Consequently, a contractionary monetary policy reduces inflation only if followed by contractionary fiscal policy. The slope of the Phillips curve determines the importance of monetary-fiscal coordination for the effectiveness of monetary policy.
records.abstract_cn: 经济对货币政策的反应取决于其财政支持。我们提出了一种新的均衡分解方法，将财富效应（即家庭金融财富和人力财富的重估）与货币政策引发的财政反应联系起来。当货币政策具有财政后果时，货币变量影响总产出的时间安排，而财政变量则决定其现值和财富效应。因此，紧缩性货币政策只有在随后采取紧缩性财政政策时才能降低通胀。菲利普斯曲线的斜率决定了货币-财政协调对货币政策有效性的重要性。

records.title_en: Optimal GDP-indexed bonds
records.title_cn: 最优GDP指数债券
records.abstract_en: I investigate the introduction of GDP-indexed bonds as an additional source of government borrowing in a quantitative default model. The idea of linking debt payments to developments in GDP resurfaced with the 1980s debt crisis and peaked with the COVID-19 outbreak. I show that the gains from this idea depend on the underlying indexation method and are highest if payments are symmetrically tied to developments in GDP. Optimized indexed debt can eradicate default risk, halve consumption volatility, and increase asset prices while raising the government's debt balances. These changes occur because an optimally chosen indexation method does a better job at completing the markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我在一个量化违约模型中研究了引入GDP指数债券作为政府借款的额外来源。将债务支付与GDP发展挂钩的想法在1980年债务危机时重新出现，并在COVID-19爆发时达到顶峰。我发现，这一想法的收益取决于潜在的指数化方法，并且当支付与GDP发展对称挂钩时收益最高。优化后的指数化债务可以消除违约风险，将消费波动减半，提高资产价格，同时增加政府的债务余额。这些变化之所以发生，是因为最优选择的指数化方法能更好地完善市场。

records.title_en: Climate policy, financial frictions, and transition risk
records.title_cn: 气候政策、金融摩擦与转型风险
records.abstract_en: We study climate and macroprudential policies in an economy with financial frictions. Using a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model featuring both a pollution market failure and a market failure in the financial sector, we explore transition risk – whether ambitious climate policy can lead to macroeconomic instability. It can, but the risk can be alleviated through macroprudential policies – taxes or subsidies on banks' assets. Then, we explore efficient climate and macroprudential policy in the long run and over business cycles. The presence of financial frictions affects the steady-state value and dynamic properties of the efficient carbon tax.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了存在金融摩擦的经济中的气候政策和宏观审慎政策。通过构建一个同时包含污染市场失灵和金融部门市场失灵的动态随机一般均衡模型，我们探讨了转型风险——即雄心勃勃的气候政策是否可能导致宏观经济不稳定。答案是可能，但这种风险可以通过宏观审慎政策——对银行资产征税或补贴——来缓解。然后，我们探讨了长期和商业周期中的有效气候政策和宏观审慎政策。金融摩擦的存在影响了有效碳税的稳态值和动态特性。

records.title_en: Demand, growth, and deleveraging
records.title_cn: 需求、增长与去杠杆
records.abstract_en: We present empirical evidence that weak household demand contributed to a reduction in firm entry in the Great Recession. Motivated by this evidence, we study the general equilibrium response of aggregate economic growth to a severe deleveraging event. To do so, we combine a standard incomplete markets model with a class of endogenous growth models. A large reduction in credit access causes the zero lower bound to bind, inducing a drop in demand via employment rationing. Decreased demand in turn lowers the return to entrepreneurship and innovation, endogenously lowering productivity. We find that a persistent recession induced by deleveraging can significantly influence growth in productivity. Our main result is a powerful feedback effect: households increase savings in response to future slow growth, exacerbate the fall in demand, and further slow the recovery.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了经验证据，表明在“大衰退”期间，家庭需求疲软导致了企业进入的减少。受此证据启发，我们研究了严重去杠杆事件对总体经济增长的一般均衡反应。为此，我们将标准的不完全市场模型与一类内生增长模型相结合。信贷获取的大幅减少导致零下限约束生效，通过就业配给引发需求下降。需求下降反过来降低了创业和创新的回报，内生地降低了生产率。我们发现，由去杠杆引发的持续衰退可以显著影响生产率的增长。我们的主要结果是一个强大的反馈效应：家庭因预期未来增长缓慢而增加储蓄，加剧需求下降，并进一步减缓复苏。

records.title_en: Marginal propensity to consume and unemployment: A meta-analysis
records.title_cn: 边际消费倾向与失业：一项元分析
records.abstract_en: This paper considers 1244 estimates of marginal propensities to consume (MPC) out of stimulus checks and other small transitory or predictable payments. The mean quarterly MPC estimate reported by the literature is .35, but estimates vary widely. I use meta-regressions to study sources of this variation. MPC estimates increase with the unemployment rate: at 4% unemployment MPC out of a $1200 stimulus check is about .22, while for unemployment of 8% it is around .4. MPC estimates decrease with the size of the payments. MPCs are lower for households holding ample liquidity. MPCs out of stimulus checks are higher than those out of some recurring payments. These results highlight the importance of considering state-dependent multipliers, liquidity constraints, two-asset models, near rationality, and mental accounting.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了1244项关于刺激支票及其他小额暂时性或可预测支付边际消费倾向（MPC）的估计。文献报告的季度MPC平均估计值为.35，但估计值差异很大。我使用元回归来研究这种差异的来源。MPC估计值随失业率上升而增加：在4%失业率下，$1200刺激支票的MPC约为.22，而在8%失业率下约为.4。MPC估计值随支付规模增大而下降。持有充足流动性的家庭的MPC较低。刺激支票的MPC高于某些经常性支付的MPC。这些结果凸显了考虑状态依赖乘数、流动性约束、双资产模型、近似理性和心理账户的重要性。

records.title_en: Optimal income taxation: An urban economics perspective
records.title_cn: 最优所得税：一个城市经济学视角
records.abstract_en: We derive an optimal labor income tax rate formula for urban models that nests the Mirrlees model as a limiting case. Optimal tax rates are determined by traditional forces plus a new term arising from urban forces: house price, migration and agglomeration effects. Based on the earnings distribution, housing costs and housing tenure in large and small US cities, we find that in a benchmark model (i) the optimal income tax rate schedule is U-shaped, (ii) urban forces raise the optimal tax rate schedule at all income levels and (iii) adopting an optimal tax system induces agents with low skill levels to leave large, productive cities.
records.abstract_cn: 我们推导了一个城市模型中的最优劳动所得税税率公式，该公式将米尔利斯模型作为极限情况包含在内。最优税率由传统力量加上一个来自城市力量的新项决定：房价、迁移和集聚效应。基于美国大小城市的收入分布、住房成本和住房所有权，我们发现，在基准模型中（i）最优所得税税率表呈U形，（ii）城市力量在所有收入水平上提高了最优税率表，以及（iii）采用最优税收制度会促使低技能水平的个体离开大型、生产力高的城市。

records.title_en: Inflation gap persistence, indeterminacy, and monetary policy
records.title_cn: 通胀缺口持续性、不确定性与货币政策
records.abstract_en: Empirical literature has documented that the persistence of the gap between inflation and its trend declined after the Volcker disinflation. Previous studies into the source of the decline in inflation gap persistence have offered competing views while sidestepping the possibility of equilibrium indeterminacy. We examine the source of the decline by estimating a medium-scale dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model using Bayesian methods that allow for indeterminacy. We show that the Fed's change from a passive to an active policy response to the inflation gap or a decrease in firms' probability of price change can fully account for the decline in inflation gap persistence by ruling out indeterminacy that induces persistent economic dynamics.
