The results are also in line with standard voting models with imperfect information, where interventions that provide credible information on politician quality can help redress preferential targeting of resources that are prevalent in the status quo.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于绩效激励在激励当选政治家改善印度大规模公共项目交付方面有效性的实验证据。该研究随机将泰米尔纳德邦村级政府主席分配到两种激励方案（或对照组）之一：一种财政激励，奖励表现更好的主席更高的公共预算；另一种非财政激励，授予他们证书以展示其成就，并通过信息宣传活动进行传播。研究结果表明，两种激励都改善了多个项目维度的绩效，包括扩大激励主席所在村庄的各种安全网和公共援助计划的覆盖面。非财政激励还减少了主席在其村庄内分配给各小村公共资源的差异，并且与财政激励相比，实施成本显著更低。结果也与标准的不完全信息投票模型一致，在该模型中，提供政治家质量可信信息的干预措施有助于纠正现状中普遍存在的资源偏向性分配。

records.title_en: Place-based consequences of person-based transfers: Evidence from recessions
records.title_cn: 基于个人的转移支付的地方性后果：来自经济衰退的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how government transfers respond to changes in local economic activity that emerge during recessions. Local labor markets that experience greater employment losses during recessions face persistent relative decreases in per capita earnings. However, these areas also experience persistent increases in per capita transfers, which offset 16 percent of the earnings loss on average. The increase in transfers is driven by unemployment insurance in the short run, and medical, retirement, and disability transfers in the long run. Our results show that nominally place-neutral transfer programs redistribute considerable sums of money to places with depressed economic conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了政府转移支付如何应对经济衰退期间出现的当地经济活动变化。在经济衰退期间经历更大就业损失的当地劳动力市场，其人均收入面临持续的相对下降。然而，这些地区的人均转移支付也持续增加，平均抵消了16%的收入损失。转移支付的增加在短期内由失业保险驱动，长期则由医疗、退休和残疾转移支付驱动。我们的结果表明，名义上地方中性的转移支付项目将大量资金重新分配给经济状况低迷的地方。

records.title_en: Minimum wages, retirement timing, and labor supply
records.title_cn: 最低工资、退休时机与劳动力供给
records.abstract_en: We find that minimum wage increases lead to increased employment for low-wage, retirement-age individuals using survey data linked to several decades of individual-level IRS and SSA data. Own-wage elasticity estimates of the employment effect are larger than normal for the minimum wage literature but are consistent with recent evidence on labor supply effects of minimum wages and life-cycle models of labor supply. We also find evidence of delayed permanent employment exit and delayed retirement benefit claiming. The delay in benefit claiming appears to be driven by an interaction between minimum wages and the Social Security earnings test. These results suggest that retirement-age individuals are very responsive to changes in labor market opportunities and that minimum wages may complement Social Security incentives that encourage more work and delayed benefit claiming.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用与数十年个人IRS和SSA数据相关联的调查数据发现，最低工资的提高导致低工资、退休年龄个体的就业增加。就业效应的自身工资弹性估计值高于最低工资文献中的常规水平，但与近期关于最低工资劳动力供给效应和劳动力供给生命周期模型的证据一致。我们还发现了延迟永久性就业退出和延迟退休福利申领的证据。福利申领的延迟似乎是由最低工资与社会保障收入测试之间的相互作用驱动的。这些结果表明，退休年龄个体对劳动力市场机会的变化非常敏感，最低工资可能补充社会保障激励措施，鼓励更多工作和延迟福利申领。

records.title_en: Estimating students’ valuation for college experiences
records.title_cn: 估算学生对大学体验的估值
records.abstract_en: Quantifying the consumption value of college – the utility students derive from in-person instruction and on-campus social activities – has been challenging. We leverage the COVID-19 shock to elicit students’ intended likelihood of enrolling in higher education under different costs and possible states of the world, that vary in terms of class formats (i.e., in-person vs. remote instruction) and restrictions to campus social life. We show how such data can be used to recover students’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for college-related activities in the absence of COVID-19, without parametric assumptions on the underlying heterogeneity in WTP. We find that the average WTP for in-person instruction (relative to a remote format) represents around 6.5% of the average annual net cost of attending university, while the average WTP for on-campus social activities is 10.2% of the average annual net costs. Lower-income and first-generation derive substantially lower value from university social life, partly due to time and resource constraints. Beyond providing an explanation for why college persistence rates may differ by socioeconomic background, our results have implications for how college costs should be structured.
records.abstract_cn: 量化大学的消费价值——学生从面对面教学和校园社交活动中获得的效用——一直具有挑战性。我们利用COVID-19冲击来引出学生在不同成本和可能世界状态下入读高等教育的意向可能性，这些状态在课堂形式（即面对面教学与远程教学）和校园社交生活限制方面有所不同。我们展示了如何利用这些数据来恢复学生在没有COVID-19的情况下对大学相关活动的支付意愿（WTP），而无需对WTP的潜在异质性进行参数假设。我们发现，面对面教学的平均支付意愿（相对于远程形式）约占上大学平均年度净成本的6.5%，而校园社交活动的平均支付意愿占平均年度净成本的10.2%。低收入和第一代大学生从大学社交生活中获得的效用显著较低，部分原因是时间和资源限制。除了为大学持续就读率可能因社会经济背景而异提供解释外，我们的结果还对大学成本应如何构建具有启示意义。

records.title_en: The consequences of job search monitoring for the long-term unemployed: Disability instead of employment?
records.title_cn: 求职监控对长期失业者的影响：残疾而非就业？
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of job search monitoring (JSM) on individual labor market outcomes of the long-term unemployed. Exploiting the implementation of a JSM program targeted at jobseekers under the age of 49, we set up a regression discontinuity design that credibly identifies the program’s causal effect on unemployment, employment, and disability insurance (DI) participation and participation in other social welfare programs within a three-year period. We find that JSM increases exits from unemployment to DI without affecting transitions into employment or other social welfare programs. We further find that the effect of JSM on DI materializes before any sanction can be imposed and monitored individuals are still 10 percentage points more likely to be on DI three years after the start of monitoring. Ultimately, exploring fiscal implications reveals that the decrease in unemployment transfers as a result of JSM is entirely offset by the increase in DI transfers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了求职监控（JSM）对长期失业者个人劳动力市场结果的影响。利用针对年龄在49岁以下的求职者实施的JSM项目，我们建立了一个断点回归设计，该设计可信地识别了该项目在三年期内对失业、就业、残疾保险（DI）参与以及其他社会福利项目参与的因果效应。我们发现，JSM增加了从失业到DI的退出，而不影响向就业或其他社会福利项目的转变。我们进一步发现，JSM对DI的影响在任何制裁实施之前就已显现，并且在监控开始三年后，被监控个体上DI的可能性仍高出10个百分点。最终，探索财政影响揭示，JSM导致的失业转移减少完全被DI转移的增加所抵消。

records.title_en: Trade-offs between access and quality in healthcare: Evidence from retail clinics in Mexico
records.title_cn: 医疗服务的可及性与质量之间的权衡：来自墨西哥零售诊所的证据
records.abstract_en: In settings with inefficient public provision, expansions in low-cost private-market healthcare delivery may be welfare-improving by increasing access, but may be sacrificing on quality. I study the introduction of retail clinics at private pharmacies in Mexico. I find that entry led to large declines in public-sector emergency room visits and a small but significant reduction in public clinic visits for relatively mild respiratory infections. I also find a significant increase in public clinic visits for chronic conditions and a slight decline in emergency room visits, consistent with better disease management. However, I estimate a sizable association between retail clinics and a shift toward stronger antibiotics in private-market sales. Hence, although retail clinics improve access to healthcare, they may be overselling their patients.
records.abstract_cn: 在公共供给效率低下的环境中，低成本私人市场医疗服务的扩张可能通过增加可及性来改善福利，但可能牺牲质量。我研究了墨西哥私人药房引入零售诊所的情况。我发现，零售诊所的进入导致公共部门急诊室就诊量大幅下降，以及相对轻微的呼吸道感染的公共诊所就诊量小幅但显著的减少。我还发现，慢性病的公共诊所就诊量显著增加，急诊室就诊量略有下降，这与更好的疾病管理相一致。然而，我估计零售诊所与私人市场销售中转向更强抗生素之间存在相当大的关联。因此，尽管零售诊所改善了医疗服务的可及性，但它们可能过度销售其患者。

records.title_en: Does wealth reduce support for redistribution? Evidence from an Ethiopian housing lottery
records.title_cn: 财富是否会减少对再分配的支持？来自埃塞俄比亚住房抽签的证据
records.abstract_en: Exploiting the variation in wealth created by an Ethiopian housing lottery, we show that general attitudes towards redistribution and inequality aversion are not affected by a large positive wealth shock. New homeowners are, however, less supportive of taxing homeowners, highlighting a potential conflict between self-interest and preferences for redistribution. We also find evidence of endogenous beliefs: relative to losers, the wealthier winners are less likely to emphasize the role of luck in explaining economic success. We interpret this finding in terms of a self-serving bias.
records.abstract_cn: 利用埃塞俄比亚住房抽签所产生的财富变化，我们表明，对再分配的一般态度和对不平等的厌恶并未受到大规模正向财富冲击的影响。然而，新房主对向房主征税的支持度较低，凸显了自身利益与再分配偏好之间的潜在冲突。我们还发现了内生信念的证据：相对于输家，更富有的赢家不太可能强调运气在解释经济成功中的作用。我们将这一发现解释为一种自利偏差。

records.title_en: Tax competition in the presence of profit shifting
records.title_cn: 存在利润转移时的税收竞争
records.abstract_en: The popular view is that governments should crack down on tax avoidance by multinational corporations, but in practice, lax anti-profit-shifting policies are common. Here, we analyze how controlling profit shifting influences fiscal competition. Equilibrium tax rates are determined by the elasticities of two components: retained profit and capital mobility. Anti-profit-shifting policies decrease the elasticity of the first, but increase the elasticity of the second. The impact of these policies on equilibrium tax rates is then ambiguous. We show that there are cases in which laxer policies increase equilibrium tax rates and countries’ well-being by favoring investments. We use estimates of different elasticities to show that our model can support lax enforcement.
records.abstract_cn: 普遍观点认为政府应严厉打击跨国公司的避税行为，但实践中，宽松的反利润转移政策却很常见。在此，我们分析控制利润转移如何影响财政竞争。均衡税率由两个组成部分的弹性决定：留存利润和资本流动性。反利润转移政策降低了前者的弹性，但增加了后者的弹性。这些政策对均衡税率的影响因此是不明确的。我们表明，在某些情况下，更宽松的政策通过促进投资来提高均衡税率和国家的福祉。我们利用不同弹性的估计值来表明我们的模型可以支持宽松执法。

records.title_en: Economic spillovers and political payoffs in government competition for firms: Evidence from the Kansas City Border War
records.title_cn: 政府竞争企业中的经济溢出与政治回报：来自堪萨斯城边境战争的证据
records.abstract_en: When jurisdictions use business incentives to compete for firms, the political payoffs of winning firms are privately derived by the politicians of the winning jurisdictions, but the economic payoffs, such as new jobs, can spill over to the residents of non-winning jurisdictions. I study how potential political payoffs shape government competition for firms using a simple model of government competition and firm location choice. I use the model to propose an empirical approach of deriving lower bounds on political payoffs with data on accepted incentives. Applying this approach to the recent state competition between Kansas and Missouri for firm relocation within Kansas City, I find that the two states derived sizable political payoffs.
records.abstract_cn: 当辖区使用商业激励措施竞争企业时，获胜企业的政治回报由获胜辖区的政治家私下获得，而经济回报，如新就业机会，可能溢出到非获胜辖区的居民。我使用一个简单的政府竞争和企业选址模型来研究潜在的政治回报如何塑造政府对企业竞争。我利用该模型提出一种实证方法，用已接受的激励数据推导政治回报的下界。将这种方法应用于最近堪萨斯州和密苏里州在堪萨斯城内争夺企业迁址的州际竞争，我发现这两个州获得了可观的政治回报。

records.title_en: Estimating labor supply responses to Danish tax reforms
records.title_cn: 估计丹麦税制改革的劳动供给反应
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the elasticity of labor supply at the intensive margin by applying the latest estimation strategies from the elasticity of taxable income literature to administrative register data on performed hours of work. Performed hours of work are contract hours plus paid overtime, minus paid absence, vacation, and holiday leave. I estimate elasticities of labor supply at the intensive margin (ELS), labor income (ELI), and taxable income (ETI) of 0.08, 0.06, and 0.1. The results show that the high ratio of ELI to ETI can be attributed to changes in labor supply for wage earners, capturing inherent labor responses. As a result, I explicitly connect the labor supply and ETI literatures. The labor supply response is driven by changes in contract hours, paid absence, and individuals switching between main and secondary employment. These results suggest that contextual factors such as labor market fluidity and flexibility are important to facilitate real responses to taxation and that labor supply responses are core underlying drivers of total responses to taxation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过将应税收入弹性文献中的最新估计策略应用于工作小时数的行政登记数据，估计了集约边际上的劳动供给弹性。工作小时数为合同小时数加上带薪加班，减去带薪缺勤、休假和假日。我估计的集约边际劳动供给弹性（ELS）、劳动收入弹性（ELI）和应税收入弹性（ETI）分别为0.08、0.06和0.1。结果表明，ELI与ETI的高比率可归因于工薪阶层劳动供给的变化，这捕捉了内在的劳动反应。因此，我明确地将劳动供给与ETI文献联系起来。劳动供给反应由合同小时数的变化、带薪缺勤以及个体在主要和次要就业之间的转换所驱动。这些结果表明，劳动力市场流动性和灵活性等情境因素对于促进对税收的真实反应至关重要，并且劳动供给反应是对税收总体反应的核心潜在驱动因素。

records.title_en: Barriers to charitable giving
records.title_cn: 慈善捐赠的障碍
records.abstract_en: Donating to charity requires time, effort and attention. If the costs to give are perceived to be large, charities may lose out on donations. We develop a nonparametric test for the presence of these general nuisance costs and conduct a large-scale field experiment to show that costs to give are sizable and impactful. Potential donors were offered a 5:1 fixed match if their donation met or exceeded a minimum amount (e.g. $1, $5 or $10). Absent nuisance costs, the probability of donating should decrease as the minimum amount increases. We find the opposite. We estimate that about half of donors in our sample have nuisance costs of $7 or more. Eliminating these costs would double donations. Charities seeking to expand donations from small donors thus face challenges. Offering a fixed match for donations above a certain threshold may be more effective, by essentially covering nuisance costs, than the standard practice of subsidizing all donations with dollar-for-dollar matches.
records.abstract_cn: 向慈善机构捐款需要时间、精力和注意力。如果捐赠成本被认为很高，慈善机构可能会失去捐款。我们开发了一种非参数检验来检验这些一般性麻烦成本的存在，并进行了一项大规模实地实验，表明捐赠成本是相当大的且具有影响力的。潜在捐赠者被提供5:1的固定配捐，前提是他们的捐款达到或超过最低金额（例如$1、$5或$10）。在没有麻烦成本的情况下，捐赠概率应随着最低金额的增加而降低。我们发现了相反的情况。我们估计，我们样本中约有一半的捐赠者的麻烦成本为$7或更多。消除这些成本将使捐款翻倍。因此，寻求扩大小额捐赠者捐款的慈善机构面临挑战。为超过一定门槛的捐款提供固定配捐，通过实质上覆盖麻烦成本，可能比标准的逐美元配捐补贴所有捐款的做法更有效。

records.title_en: On the existence of private unemployment insurance with advance information on future job losses
records.title_cn: 关于存在预先知晓未来失业信息的私人失业保险的研究
records.abstract_en: We study the existence of a profitable unemployment insurance market in a dynamic economy with adverse selection rooted in workers’ advance information on future job losses. The new feature of the model is that the insurer and workers interact repeatedly. Repeated interactions make it possible to threaten workers with exclusion from future insurance benefits after a default on insurance premia. With exclusion, the insurer can offer not only insurance against unemployment risk itself but also against bad news about a future job loss. We discipline our model with estimates of the willingness to pay for unemployment insurance and the costs of adverse selection in the US. Our quantitative results illustrate that private unemployment insurance could be profitable for an exclusion length of one year. To stimulate the emergence of a private unemployment insurance market, policymakers can facilitate the creation of a registry that archives past defaults on insurance premia.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究在一个动态经济中，基于工人对未来失业的预先信息而产生的逆向选择，是否存在一个有利可图的失业保险市场。该模型的新特点是保险公司与工人进行重复互动。重复互动使得在保险费违约后，可以威胁将工人排除在未来的保险福利之外。通过排除机制，保险公司不仅可以提供针对失业风险本身的保险，还可以提供针对未来失业坏消息的保险。我们用美国对失业保险支付意愿和逆向选择成本的估计来约束我们的模型。我们的定量结果表明，对于一年的排除期，私人失业保险可能是有利可图的。为了促进私人失业保险市场的出现，政策制定者可以促进建立记录过去保险费违约的登记册。

records.title_en: Using schooling decisions to estimate the elasticity of marginal utility of consumption
records.title_cn: 利用教育决策估计消费边际效用弹性
records.abstract_en: This paper uses schooling decisions to estimate curvature in utility of consumption in developing countries. We show that the elasticity of marginal utility of consumption (EMUC) can be recovered from three sufficient statistics: (1) the price effect of schooling; (2) the income effect of schooling; and (3) the consumption cost of sending a child to school. We estimate the consumption cost of schooling using variation from the randomized roll-out of Progresa, a conditional cash transfer program in rural Mexico. Using estimates of income and price effects in the Progresa setting from Bergstrom and Dodds (2021), we estimate the EMUC at 1.6.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用教育决策来估计发展中国家消费效用函数的曲率。我们表明，消费边际效用弹性（EMUC）可以从三个充分统计量中恢复：（1）教育的价格效应；（2）教育的收入效应；（3）送孩子上学的消费成本。我们利用墨西哥农村有条件现金转移项目Progresa的随机推广变化来估计教育的消费成本。利用Bergstrom和Dodds（2021）在Progresa背景下对收入和价格效应的估计，我们估计EMUC为1.6。

records.title_en: Helping struggling students and benefiting all: Peer effects in primary education
records.title_cn: 帮助困难学生并惠及所有人：初等教育中的同伴效应
records.abstract_en: We exploit the randomized evaluation of a remedial education intervention that improved the reading skills of low-performing third grade students in Colombia, to study whether providing educational support to low-achieving students affects the academic performance of their higher-achieving classmates. We find that the test scores of non-treated children in treatment schools increased by 0.108 of a standard deviation compared to similar children in control schools. We interpret the reduced-form effect on higher-achieving students as a spillover effect within treated schools. We then estimate a linear-in-means model of peer effects, finding that a one-standard-deviation increase in peers’ contemporaneous achievement increases individual test scores by 0.679 of a standard deviation. Our findings show that policies aimed at improving the bottom of the achievement distribution have the potential to generate social-multiplier effects that benefit all.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项补救性教育干预的随机评估，该干预提高了哥伦比亚三年级低表现学生的阅读技能，以研究向低成就学生提供教育支持是否会影响其高成就同学的学习成绩。我们发现，与对照学校中相似儿童相比，治疗学校中未接受干预的儿童的测试分数提高了0.108个标准差。我们将对高成就学生的简化形式效应解释为治疗学校内的溢出效应。然后，我们估计了一个线性均值同伴效应模型，发现同伴同期成就每增加一个标准差，个体测试分数增加0.679个标准差。我们的研究结果表明，旨在改善成就分布底端的政策有可能产生惠及所有人的社会乘数效应。

records.title_en: Employer-sponsored health insurance premiums and income in U.S. tax data
records.title_cn: 美国税收数据中的雇主赞助健康保险保费与收入
records.abstract_en: The distribution of employer-sponsored health insurance premiums in the United States is difficult to fully characterize with survey data. Using administrative tax data, we plot the population distribution of premiums and provide new evidence about the relationship between premiums and demographic characteristics, including income. The distribution of premiums measured in the tax data is comparable to survey data. People with higher incomes are more likely to have an employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) policy and, conditional on having a policy, select more expensive plans. Because higher income policyholders and their employers spend more on ESI, they also receive a disproportionate amount of government subsidies for health insurance, even when we account for non-ESI subsidies through Medicare, Medicaid, and Premium Tax Credits. Even though the distribution of health subsidies is skewed toward those with higher incomes, it is less than a quarter as unequal as the distribution of income itself.
records.abstract_cn: 美国雇主赞助健康保险保费的分布难以通过调查数据全面刻画。利用行政税收数据，我们绘制了保费的总体分布，并提供了关于保费与人口特征（包括收入）之间关系的新证据。税收数据中测得的保费分布与调查数据相当。收入较高的人更可能拥有雇主赞助保险（ESI）保单，并且在拥有保单的情况下，会选择更昂贵的计划。由于收入较高的保单持有人及其雇主在ESI上花费更多，他们也获得了不成比例的政府健康保险补贴，即使我们通过Medicare、Medicaid和保费税收抵免考虑了非ESI补贴。尽管健康补贴的分布偏向高收入人群，但其不平等程度不到收入本身分布的四分之一。

records.title_en: Recipes and Economic Growth: A Combinatorial March Down an Exponential Tail
records.title_cn: 配方与经济增长：沿指数尾部的组合行进
records.abstract_en: As Romer and Weitzman emphasized in the 1990s, new ideas are often combinations of existing ideas, an insight absent from recent models. In Kortum's research around the same time, ideas are draws from a probability distribution, and Pareto distributions play a crucial role. Why are combinations missing, and do we really need such strong distributional assumptions to get exponential growth? This paper demonstrates that combinatorially growing draws from standard thin-tailed distributions lead to exponential growth; Pareto is not required. More generally, it presents a theorem linking the max extreme value to the number of draws and the shape of the upper tail for probability distributions.
records.abstract_cn: 正如罗默和韦茨曼在1990年所强调的，新思想往往是现有思想的组合，而这一见解在近期的模型中缺失。在科图姆大约同一时期的研究中，思想是从概率分布中抽取的，帕累托分布起着关键作用。为什么组合缺失了，我们是否真的需要如此强的分布假设才能实现指数增长？本文证明，从标准薄尾分布中组合增长的抽取会导致指数增长；帕累托分布并非必需。更一般地，它提出了一个定理，将最大极值与抽取次数和概率分布上尾的形状联系起来。

records.title_en: Identifying the Effect of Persuasion
records.title_cn: 识别说服效应
records.abstract_en: This paper examines a commonly used measure of persuasion whose precise interpretation has been obscure in the literature. By using the potential outcome framework, we define the causal persuasion rate by a proper conditional probability of taking the action of interest with a persuasive message conditional on not taking the action without the message. We then formally study identification under empirically relevant data scenarios and show that the commonly adopted measure generally does not estimate—but often overstates—the causal rate of persuasion. We discuss several new parameters of interest and provide practical methods for causal inference.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了一种常用的说服度量，其在文献中的精确解释一直模糊不清。通过使用潜在结果框架，我们将因果说服率定义为在无信息时不采取行动的条件下，有说服信息时采取感兴趣行动的适当条件概率。然后，我们在经验相关的数据情景下正式研究识别问题，并表明常用的度量通常不能估计——但往往高估——因果说服率。我们讨论了几个新的感兴趣参数，并为因果推断提供了实用方法。

records.title_en: Determinacy without the Taylor Principle
records.title_cn: 无泰勒原理下的确定性
records.abstract_en: Our understanding of monetary policy is complicated by an indeterminacy problem: the same path for the nominal interest rate is consistent with multiple equilibrium paths for inflation and output. We offer a potential resolution by showing that small frictions in social memory and intertemporal coordination can remove this indeterminacy. Under our perturbations, the unique equilibrium is the same as that selected by the Taylor principle, but it no more relies on it; monetary policy is left to play only a stabilization role; and fiscal policy needs to be Ricardian even when monetary policy is passive.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对货币政策的理解因不确定性问题而复杂化：名义利率的同一路径与通货膨胀和产出的多个均衡路径相一致。我们通过证明社会记忆和跨期协调中的小摩擦可以消除这种不确定性，提供了一个潜在的解决方案。在我们的扰动下，唯一均衡与泰勒原理所选择的均衡相同，但不再依赖于泰勒原理；货币政策仅发挥稳定作用；即使货币政策是被动的，财政政策也必须是李嘉图式的。

records.title_en: Cooperative Property Rights and Development: Evidence from Land Reform in El Salvador: A Comment
records.title_cn: 合作产权与发展：来自萨尔瓦多土地改革的证据：评论
records.abstract_en: Montero (2022) explores a discontinuity in a land reform in El Salvador and reports two main findings. First, relative to outside-owned haciendas operated by contract workers, the productivity of worker-owned cooperatives is higher for staple crops and lower for cash-crop. Second, cooperative property rights increase workers' incomes and compress wage distributions. In this comment, we show that the latter result rests on two mistakes: three-quarters of the observations are duplicates and income inequality is calculated over too few workers to be meaningful. When corrected, the data sources and research design provide no credible evidence regarding the causal effects of ownership structure on income levels and inequality.
records.abstract_cn: Montero（2022）探讨了萨尔瓦多土地改革中的一个断点，并报告了两个主要发现。首先，相对于由合同工人经营的外部所有的庄园，工人所有的合作社在主粮作物上的生产率更高，而在经济作物上的生产率较低。其次，合作产权提高了工人的收入并压缩了工资分布。在本评论中，我们表明后一个结果基于两个错误：四分之三的观测值是重复的，且收入不平等是在过少的工人数量上计算的，因此没有意义。纠正后，数据来源和研究设计无法为所有权结构对收入水平和收入不平等的因果效应提供可信的证据。

records.title_en: Presidential Address: Sustainable Finance and ESG Issues— Value versus Values
records.title_cn: 主席致辞：可持续金融与ESG问题——价值与价值观
records.abstract_en: In this address, I discuss differences across investor and manager motivations for considering sustainable finance— value versus values motivations—and how these differences contribute to misunderstandings about environmental, social, and governance investment approaches. The finance research community has the ability and responsibility to help clear up these misunderstandings through additional research, which I suggest.
records.abstract_cn: 在本次致辞中，我讨论了投资者和管理者在考虑可持续金融时的动机差异——价值动机与价值观动机——以及这些差异如何导致对环境、社会和治理投资方法的误解。金融研究界有能力也有责任通过进一步的研究来帮助澄清这些误解，我对此提出了建议。

records.title_en: Rents and Intangible Capital: A Q+ Framework
records.title_cn: 租金与无形资本：一个Q+框架
records.abstract_en: In recent years, U.S. investment has been lackluster, despite rising valuations. Key explanations include growing rents and growing intangibles. We propose and estimate a framework to quantify their roles. The gap between valuations—reflected in average Q —and investment—reflected in marginal q —can be decomposed into three terms: the value of installed intangibles; rents generated by physical capital; and an interaction term, measuring rents generated by intangibles. The intangible related terms contribute significantly to the gap, particularly in fast‐growing sectors. Our findings suggest care in a pure‐rents interpretation, given the rising role of intangibles.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，尽管估值上升，美国投资却表现疲软。主要解释包括租金增长和无形资产增长。我们提出并估计了一个框架来量化它们的作用。估值（反映在平均Q中）与投资（反映在边际q中）之间的差距可以分解为三个部分：已安装无形资产的价值；实物资本产生的租金；以及一个交互项，衡量无形资产产生的租金。与无形资产相关的部分对差距贡献显著，尤其是在快速增长部门。我们的发现表明，鉴于无形资产作用日益增强，应谨慎对待纯租金解释。

records.title_en: Modeling Corporate Bond Returns
records.title_cn: 公司债券收益建模
records.abstract_en: We propose a conditional factor model for corporate bond returns with five factors and time‐varying factor loadings. We have three main empirical findings. First, our factor model excels in describing the risks and returns of corporate bonds, improving over previously proposed models in the literature by a large margin. Second, our model recommends a systematic bond investment portfolio whose high out‐of‐sample Sharpe ratio suggests that the credit risk premium is notably larger than previously estimated. Third, we find closer integration between debt and equity markets than found in prior literature.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个包含五个因子和时变因子载荷的公司债券收益条件因子模型。我们有三项主要实证发现。首先，我们的因子模型在描述公司债券的风险和收益方面表现出色，大幅优于文献中先前提出的模型。其次，我们的模型推荐了一个系统性债券投资组合，其高样本外夏普比率表明信用风险溢价显著高于先前估计。第三，我们发现债务与股票市场之间的整合程度比先前文献所发现的更为紧密。

records.title_en: Barter Credit: Warehouses as a Contracting Technology
records.title_cn: 易货信贷：仓库作为一种契约技术
records.abstract_en: A large Brazilian agribusiness lender introduces a new contracting technology: grain warehouses. Using runner‐up warehouse locations as a control group, I find that construction of these warehouses permits a new debt contract, namely, barter credit repayable in grain. This contract increases borrowers' debt capacity and reduces borrowing costs. The effects are stronger when grain price risk is higher, for municipalities with weaker courts, and for financially constrained borrowers. These findings are consistent with barter credit reducing financial market imperfections by mitigating borrowers' output price risk.
records.abstract_cn: 一家大型巴西农业企业贷款机构引入了一种新的契约技术：谷物仓库。利用亚军仓库选址作为对照组，我发现这些仓库的建设促成了一种新的债务契约，即以谷物偿还的易货信贷。这种契约增加了借款人的债务能力并降低了借贷成本。当谷物价格风险较高、法院较弱的市镇以及财务受限的借款人中，这种效应更强。这些发现与易货信贷通过减轻借款人的产出价格风险来减少金融市场不完善的观点一致。

records.title_en: Specialization in Bank Lending: Evidence from Exporting Firms
records.title_cn: 银行贷款专业化：来自出口企业的证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a novel approach for measuring bank specialization using granular data on borrower activities and apply it to Peruvian exporters and their banks. We find that borrowers seek credit from banks that specialize in their export destinations, both when expanding exports and when exporting to new countries. Firms experiencing country‐specific export demand shocks adjust borrowing disproportionately from specialized banks. Specialized bank credit supply shocks affect exports disproportionately to countries of specialization. Our results demonstrate that firm credit demand is bank‐ and activity‐specific, which reduces banking competition and affects the transmission and amplification of shocks through the banking sector.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用借款人活动的细粒度数据开发了一种衡量银行专业化的新方法，并将其应用于秘鲁出口商及其银行。我们发现，借款人在扩大出口和向新国家出口时，会寻求在其出口目的地具有专业化的银行的信贷。经历国家特定出口需求冲击的企业，会不成比例地从专业化银行调整借款。专业化的银行信贷供给冲击会不成比例地影响对专业化国家的出口。我们的结果表明，企业信贷需求是银行和活动特定的，这降低了银行业竞争，并影响了冲击通过银行部门的传导和放大。

records.title_en: Employee Costs of Corporate Bankruptcy
records.title_cn: 企业破产的员工成本
records.abstract_en: An employee's annual earnings fall by 13% in the first full calendar year after her firm's bankruptcy, and the present value of lost earnings from bankruptcy to six years following bankruptcy is 87% of pre‐bankruptcy annual earnings. More worker earnings are lost in thin labor markets and among small firms. Ex ante compensating wage differentials for this “bankruptcy risk” are up to 2% of firm value for a firm whose credit rating falls from AA to BBB, comparable in magnitude to debt tax benefits. Thus, wage premia for expected costs of bankruptcy are sufficiently large to be an important consideration in capital structure decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 员工在其公司破产后的第一个完整日历年度内，年收入下降13%，从破产到破产后六年的收入损失现值为破产前年收入的87%。在劳动力市场薄弱和小型企业中，员工收入损失更多。对于信用评级从AA降至BBB的公司，这种“破产风险”的事前补偿性工资差异高达公司价值的2%，与债务税收优惠的规模相当。因此，预期破产成本的工资溢价足够大，是资本结构决策中的重要考虑因素。

records.title_en: Optimal Sequential Selling Mechanism and Deal Protections in Mergers and Acquisitions
records.title_cn: 最优序贯销售机制与并购中的交易保护
records.abstract_en: We study the dynamic profit‐maximizing selling mechanism in a merger and acquisitions (M&A) environment with costly bidder entry and without entry fees. Depending on the parameters, the optimal mechanism is implemented by a standard auction or by a two‐stage procedure with exclusive offers to one bidder followed by an auction potentially favoring that bidder. The optimal mechanism may involve common deal protections like termination fees, asset lockups, or stock option lockups. Our proposed procedures resemble sales of targets filing Chapter 11 bankruptcy or M&A involving public targets, and they shed light on how to use deal protections in practice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在并购（M&A）环境中，投标人进入成本高昂且无入场费情况下的动态利润最大化销售机制。根据参数的不同，最优机制通过标准拍卖或两阶段程序实施，该程序先向一个投标人提供独家报价，随后进行可能偏向该投标人的拍卖。最优机制可能涉及常见的交易保护，如终止费、资产锁定或股票期权锁定。我们提出的程序类似于依据《破产法》第11章申请破产保护的目标公司出售或涉及上市目标的并购，并为实践中如何使用交易保护提供了启示。

records.title_en: Is COVID Revealing a Virus in CMBS 2.0?
records.title_cn: COVID是否揭示了CMBS 2.0中的病毒？
records.abstract_en: Commercial loan valuations crucially depend on accurate loan income, but underwritten income on commercial mortgage‐backed securities (CMBS) loans is commonly overstated relative to actual property income. Consistent with these differences being originator‐specific, income overstatement in CMBS 2.0 deals varies widely and persistently across originators, is priced by originators, is related across property types within an originator, is predictable ex ante, and is accompanied by inflation of past financials. Risk retention and associated regulation had no discernible effect on income overstatement. Originator income overstatement is highly predictive of pre‐ and COVID‐period loan distress. Overall, recent market stresses reveal large systemic differences in underwriting standards across originators.
records.abstract_cn: 商业贷款估值关键依赖于准确的贷款收入，但商业抵押贷款支持证券（CMBS）贷款的承销收入通常相对于实际物业收入被高估。与这些差异源于发起人特定性相一致，CMBS 2.0交易中的收入高估在不同发起人之间广泛且持续地变化，由发起人定价，在发起人内部的不同物业类型之间相关，可事前预测，并伴随过去财务数据的膨胀。风险留存及相关监管对收入高估没有明显影响。发起人收入高估对疫情前和疫情期间的贷款困境具有高度预测性。总体而言，近期的市场压力揭示了不同发起人之间承销标准的巨大系统性差异。

records.title_en: Competition and Misconduct
records.title_cn: 竞争与不当行为
records.abstract_en: Misconduct is widespread. Practices such as misselling, pump and dump, and money laundering cause harm while raising profits. This paper presents a mechanism that can determine what sorts of misconduct can be sustained in competitive equilibrium in concentrated markets, oligopoly settings, and markets with many small competing firms. The model studied allows general demand and distinguishes types of ethical dilemma using current psychological understanding. The paper shows, for example, that markets with many small competing firms are not vulnerable to misconduct if firms respond to entry with niche strategies or if the ethical dilemma draws an emotional response.
records.abstract_cn: 不当行为普遍存在。诸如误导销售、拉高出货和洗钱等行为在提高利润的同时造成危害。本文提出了一种机制，可以确定在集中市场、寡头垄断环境以及众多小型竞争企业并存的市场中，竞争均衡能够维持何种类型的不当行为。所研究的模型允许一般需求，并利用当前心理学理解来区分伦理困境的类型。例如，本文表明，如果企业以利基策略应对进入，或者伦理困境引发情绪反应，那么拥有众多小型竞争企业的市场不易受到不当行为的影响。

records.title_en: Retail Derivatives and Sentiment: A Sentiment Measure Constructed from Issuances of Retail Structured Equity Products
records.title_cn: 零售衍生品与情绪：基于零售结构化股票产品发行构建的情绪度量
records.abstract_en: We use retail structured equity product (SEP) issuances to construct a new sentiment measure for large capitalization stocks. The SEP sentiment measure predicts negative abnormal returns on the SEP reference stocks based on a variety of factor models, and also predicts returns in Fama‐MacBeth regressions that include a wide range of covariates. Consistent with our interpretation that SEP issuances reflect investor sentiment, aggregate SEP issuances are highly correlated with the Baker‐Wurgler sentiment index. Tobit regressions reveal that proxies for attention and sentiment predict SEP issuance volumes, providing additional evidence consistent with the hypothesis that SEP issuances reflect sentiment.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用零售结构化股票产品（SEP）的发行构建了一个针对大市值股票的新情绪度量。SEP情绪度量基于多种因子模型预测SEP参考股票的负异常收益，并且在包含广泛协变量的Fama-MacBeth回归中也能预测收益。与我们关于SEP发行反映投资者情绪的解释一致，SEP总发行量与Baker-Wurgler情绪指数高度相关。Tobit回归显示，注意力和情绪的代表变量能够预测SEP发行量，这为SEP发行反映情绪的假设提供了额外证据。

records.title_en: How Far Goods Travel: Global Transport and Supply Chains from 1965–2020
records.title_cn: 货物运输的距离：1965-2020年的全球运输与供应链
records.abstract_en: This paper considers the evolution of global transportation usage over the past half century and its implications for supply chains. Transportation usage has more than doubled as costs decreased by a third. Participation of emerging economies in world trade and longer-distance trade between countries contribute to this usage increase, thereby encouraging longer supply chains. We discuss technological advances over this period, and their interactions with endogenous responses from transportation costs and supply chain linkages. Supply chains involving more countries and longer distances are reflective of reliable and efficient transportat ion, but are also more exposed to disruptions, highlighting the importance of considering the interconnectedness of transportation and supply chains in policymaking and future work.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了过去半个世纪全球运输使用的演变及其对供应链的影响。运输使用量增加了一倍多，而成本下降了三分之一。新兴经济体参与世界贸易以及国家间更长距离的贸易促进了这一使用量的增加，从而鼓励了更长的供应链。我们讨论了这一时期的技术进步，以及它们与运输成本和供应链联系的内生反应的相互作用。涉及更多国家和更长距离的供应链反映了可靠高效的运输，但也更容易受到干扰，这凸显了在政策制定和未来工作中考虑运输与供应链相互联系的重要性。

records.title_en: The Changing Firm and Country Boundaries of US Manufacturers in Global Value Chains
records.title_cn: 美国制造商在全球价值链中的企业与国家边界变化
records.abstract_en: This paper documents how US firms organize goods production across firm and country boundaries. Most US firms that perform physical transformation tasks in-house using foreign manufacturing plants in 2007 also own US manufacturing plants; moreover, manufacturing comprises their main domestic activity. By contrast, “factoryless goods producers” outsource all physical transformation tasks to arm's-length contractors, focusing their in-house efforts on design and marketing. This dis tinct firm type is missing from standard analyses of manufacturing, growing in importance, and increasingly reliant on foreign suppliers. Physical transformation “within-the-firm” thus coincides with substantial physical transformation “within-the-country ,” whereas its performance “outside-the-firm” often also implies “outside-the-country.” Despite these differences, factoryless goods producers and firms with foreign and domestic manufacturing plants both employ relatively high shares of US knowledge workers. These patterns call for new models and data to capture the potential for foreign production to support domestic innovation, which US firms leverage around the world.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了美国企业如何跨越企业和国家边界组织商品生产。在2007年，大多数在内部使用外国制造工厂执行物理转化任务的美国企业也拥有美国制造工厂；此外，制造业构成了它们主要的国内活动。相比之下，“无工厂商品生产者”将所有物理转化任务外包给独立承包商，将内部努力集中在设计和营销上。这种独特的企业类型在标准制造业分析中缺失，其重要性日益增长，并且越来越依赖外国供应商。因此，企业内部的物理转化与国内的大量物理转化相吻合，而企业外部的执行往往也意味着国家外部的执行。尽管存在这些差异，无工厂商品生产者和拥有国内外制造工厂的企业都雇佣了相对较高比例的美国知识工作者。这些模式要求新的模型和数据来捕捉外国生产支持国内创新的潜力，美国企业正在全球范围内利用这种潜力。

records.title_en: Global Value Chains in Developing Countries: A Relational Perspective from Coffee and Garments
records.title_cn: 发展中国家的全球价值链：来自咖啡和服装的关系视角
records.abstract_en: There is a consensus that global value chains have aided developing countries' growth. This essay highlights the governance complexities arising from participating in such chains, drawing from lessons we have learned conducting research in the coffee and garment supply chains. Market power of international buyers can lead to inefficiently low wages, prices, quality standards, and poor working conditions. At the same time, some degree of market power might be needed to sustain long-term supply relationships that are beneficial in a world with incomplete contracts. We discuss how buyers’ market power and long-term supply relationships interact and how these relationships at the export-gate could be leveraged to enhance sustainability in the domestic part of the chains. We hope that the lessons learned by combining detailed data and contextual knowledge in two specific chains—coffee and garments—have broader applicability to other global value chains.
records.abstract_cn: 人们普遍认为全球价值链促进了发展中国家的增长。本文强调了参与此类链所带来的治理复杂性，借鉴了我们在咖啡和服装供应链中进行研究的经验教训。国际买家的市场力量可能导致低效率的低工资、低价格、低质量标准以及恶劣的工作条件。同时，在合同不完全的世界中，一定程度的市场力量可能是维持有益长期供应关系所必需的。我们讨论了买家的市场力量与长期供应关系如何相互作用，以及这些在出口口岸的关系如何被利用来增强国内部分链的可持续性。我们希望，通过结合两个特定链——咖啡和服装——的详细数据和情境知识所获得的经验教训，能够更广泛地适用于其他全球价值链。

records.title_en: Are Developed Countries Outsourcing Pollution?
records.title_cn: 发达国家是否在向外转移污染？
records.abstract_en: Have rich countries improved their environments by importing polluting goods? No, the mix of goods imported has shifted towards those from cleaner industries, not dirtier. Has pollution worsened in poor countries manufacturing goods for export to rich ones? That depends. Emissions intensities for similar industries are higher in poor countries, which means that even balanced trade causes more pollution there, even for the same goods. And proportional growth in trade has increased that gap. Whether we should consider that to be “outsourcing pollution” is debatable. Have environmental regulations enacted by rich countries caused either of the first two changes? No, the evidence does not show that regulations cause outsourcing.
records.abstract_cn: 富裕国家是否通过进口污染性商品改善了自身环境？没有，进口商品的结构已转向更清洁的行业，而非更肮脏的行业。贫穷国家为向富裕国家出口而生产商品，其污染是否加剧了？这取决于情况。贫穷国家类似行业的排放强度更高，这意味着即使贸易平衡，也会在那里造成更多污染，即使是相同的商品。而且贸易的成比例增长扩大了这一差距。我们是否应将其视为“污染外包”尚有争议。富裕国家实施的环境法规是否导致了上述两种变化中的任何一种？没有，证据并未表明法规导致了外包。

records.title_en: Think Globally, Act Globally: Opportunities to Mitigate Greenhouse Gas Emissions in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
records.title_cn: 全球思考，全球行动：中低收入国家减少温室气体排放的机遇
records.abstract_en: Reductions in greenhouse gas emissions are a global public good, which makes it efficient to act globally when addressing this challenge. We lay out several reasons that high-income countries seeking to mitigate climate change might have greater impact if they invest their resources in opportunities in low- and middle-income countries. Specifically, some of the easiest and cheapest options have already been tapped in high-income countries, land and labor costs are lower in low- and middle-income countries, it is cheaper to build green than to retrofit green, and global targeting matters in integrated economies. We also discuss economic counterarguments such as the challenge of monitoring emissions levels in low- and middle-income countries, ethical considerations, the importance of not double-counting mitigation funding as development aid, and policy steps that might help realize this opportunity.
records.abstract_cn: 温室气体减排是一种全球公共品，这使得在应对这一挑战时采取全球行动是高效的。我们列出了几个理由，说明寻求减缓气候变化的高收入国家如果将资源投资于中低收入国家的机遇，可能会产生更大的影响。具体而言，高收入国家已经利用了一些最简单和最便宜的选择，中低收入国家的土地和劳动力成本较低，新建绿色建筑比改造绿色建筑更便宜，而且在经济一体化的背景下，全球目标定位很重要。我们还讨论了经济上的反对论点，如在中低收入国家监测排放水平的挑战、伦理考量、不将减缓资金重复计算为发展援助的重要性，以及可能有助于实现这一机遇的政策步骤。

records.title_en: Carbon Border Adjustments, Climate Clubs, and Subsidy Races When Climate Policies Vary
records.title_cn: 碳边境调整、气候俱乐部与气候政策差异下的补贴竞赛
records.abstract_en: Jurisdictions adopt climate policies that vary in terms of both ambition and policy approach, with some pricing carbon and others subsidizing clean production. We distinguish two types of policy spillovers from these diverse approaches. First, when countries have different levels of climate ambition, free-riders benefit at the expense of more committed countries. Second, when countries pursue different approaches, carbon-intensive producers within cost-imposing jurisdictions are at a relative competitive disadvantage compared with producers in subsidizing jurisdictions. Carbon border adjustments and climate clubs respond to these spillovers, but when countries have divergent approaches, one policy alone cannot address both spillovers. We also consider the policy dynamics arising from carbon border adjustments and climate clubs; both have the potential to encourage upward harmonization of climate policy, but come with risks. Further, the pressures of international competition may result in subsidy races, with attendant risks and benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 各司法管辖区采取的气候政策在雄心和政策方法上均有所不同，有的对碳定价，有的则补贴清洁生产。我们区分了这些不同方法产生的两类政策溢出效应。首先，当各国气候雄心水平不同时，搭便车者以更坚定承诺的国家为代价获益。其次，当各国采取不同方法时，成本施加管辖区内的碳密集型生产商相对于补贴管辖区内的生产商处于相对竞争劣势。碳边境调整和气候俱乐部应对这些溢出效应，但当各国方法存在分歧时，单一政策无法同时解决两种溢出效应。我们还考虑了碳边境调整和气候俱乐部引发的政策动态；两者都有可能鼓励气候政策的向上协调，但伴随风险。此外，国际竞争的压力可能导致补贴竞赛，并带来相应的风险和收益。

records.title_en: Global Transportation Decarbonization
records.title_cn: 全球交通脱碳
records.abstract_en: Replacing fossil fuels in the name of decarbonization is necessary but will be particularly difficult due to their as-yet unrivaled bundle of attributes: abundance, ubiquity, energy density, transportability and cost. There is a growing commitment to electrification as the dominant decarbonization pathway. While deep electrification is promising for road transportation in wealthy countries, it will face steep obstacles. In other sectors and in the developing world, it’s not even in pole position. Global transportation decarbonization will require decoupling emissions from economic growth, and decoupling emissions from growth will require not only new technologies, but cooperation in governance. The menu of policy options is replete with grim tradeoffs, particularly as the primacy of energy security and reliability (over emissions abatement) has once again been demonstrated in Europe and elsewhere.
records.abstract_cn: 以脱碳为名取代化石燃料是必要的，但由于其迄今无与伦比的属性组合——丰富性、普遍性、能量密度、可运输性和成本——这将特别困难。越来越多的承诺将电气化作为主导的脱碳路径。虽然深度电气化在富裕国家的公路运输中前景广阔，但它将面临严峻的障碍。在其他部门和发展中国家，它甚至不在领先位置。全球交通脱碳将需要将排放与经济增长脱钩，而将排放与增长脱钩不仅需要新技术，还需要治理上的合作。政策选择的菜单充满了严峻的权衡，特别是在能源安全和可靠性（相对于减排）的首要地位再次在欧洲和其他地方得到证明的情况下。

records.title_en: Compensating Wage Differentials in Labor Markets: Empirical Challenges and Applications
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场中的补偿性工资差异：实证挑战与应用
records.abstract_en: The model of compensating wage differentials is among the cornerstone models of equilibrium wage determination in labor economics. However, empirical estimates of compensating differentials have faced persistent credibility challenges. This article summarizes the Rosen model of compensating differentials and chronicles the advances, setbacks, and lessons learned from empirical studies. The progression from cross-sectional to panel models alleviated biases caused by unobserved human capital but yielded new insights into the importance of other biases, including those caused by labor market frictions and endogenous job mobility. I discuss recent approaches that use matched employer-employee data and quasi-random variation in job amenities to address some of these challenges. I then present two examples of applications of compensating differentials: the evaluation public health and safety policies that rely on the value of statistical life, and the measurement and interpretation of earnings inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 补偿性工资差异模型是劳动经济学中均衡工资决定的核心模型之一。然而，补偿性差异的实证估计一直面临可信度挑战。本文总结了罗森补偿性差异模型，并记录了实证研究的进展、挫折和经验教训。从横截面模型到面板模型的演进减轻了由不可观测人力资本引起的偏差，但揭示了其他偏差的重要性，包括由劳动力市场摩擦和内源性工作流动性引起的偏差。我讨论了近期使用匹配雇主-雇员数据和准随机工作环境变化来解决其中一些挑战的方法。然后，我提供了两个补偿性差异应用的例子：依赖统计生命价值评估公共卫生和安全政策，以及收入不平等的测量与解释。

records.title_en: What Can Historically Black Colleges and Universities Teach about Improving Higher Education Outcomes for Black Students?
records.title_cn: 传统黑人学院和大学能为改善黑人学生的高等教育成果提供哪些启示？
records.abstract_en: Historically Black colleges and universities are institutions that were established prior to 1964 with the principal mission of educating Black Americans. In this essay, we focus on two main issues. We start by examining how Black College students perform across HBCUs and non-HBCUs by looking at a relatively broad range of outcomes, including college and graduate school completion, job satisfaction, social mobility, civic engagement, and health. HBCUs punch significantly above their weight, especially considering their significant lack of resources. We then turn to the potential causes of these differences and provide a glimpse into the “secret sauce” of HBCUs. We conclude with potential implications for HBCU and non-HBCU policy.
records.abstract_cn: 传统黑人学院和大学是1964年之前建立的、主要使命是教育美国黑人的机构。在本文中，我们关注两个主要问题。首先，我们通过考察一系列相对广泛的结果，包括大学和研究生院完成情况、工作满意度、社会流动性、公民参与和健康，来审视黑人学院学生在传统黑人学院和非传统黑人学院中的表现。传统黑人学院的表现显著超出其资源水平，尤其是考虑到它们资源的严重匮乏。然后，我们转向这些差异的潜在原因，并一窥传统黑人学院的“秘方”。最后，我们总结了对传统黑人学院和非传统黑人学院政策的潜在启示。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Collective Information Acquisition
records.title_cn: 集体信息获取
records.abstract_en: We consider the problem faced by a group of players who bargain over what public signal to acquire before deciding on a collective action. The players differ in their privately known state-dependent payoffs from taking the action, and therefore differ also in their willingness to pay for the public signal. We take a mechanism design approach to characterizing the efficient frontier of outcomes achievable via bargaining over information. We identify novel distortions in the optimal information structure that arise from the information asymmetry and from the fact that after the signal is realized, the outcome is determined in equilibrium of a subsequent voting game.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一组玩家在决定集体行动之前，就获取何种公共信号进行讨价还价所面临的问题。玩家在采取行动时，其私下已知的状态依赖收益不同，因此他们对公共信号的支付意愿也不同。我们采用机制设计方法来刻画通过信息讨价还价可实现的结果的有效前沿。我们识别了由信息不对称以及信号实现后结果由后续投票博弈的均衡决定这一事实所导致的最优信息结构中的新颖扭曲。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: The Dynamic Impact of Exporting on Firm R&D Investment
records.title_cn: 出口对企业研发投资的动态影响
records.abstract_en: This article estimates a dynamic structural model of firm R&D investment in twelve Swedish manufacturing industries and uses it to measure rates of return to R&D and to simulate the impact of trade restrictions on the investment incentives. Export market profits are a substantial source of the expected return to R&D. R&D spending is found to have a larger impact on firm productivity in the export market than in the domestic market. Counterfactual simulations show that trade restrictions lower both the expected return to R&D and R&D investment level, thus reducing an important source of the dynamic gains from trade. A 10% tariff on Swedish exports reduces the expected benefits of R&D for the median firm by 18.6% and lowers the amount of R&D spending by 7.6% in the high-tech industries. The corresponding reductions in the low-tech industries are 20.6% and 5.5%, respectively. R&D adjustments in response to export tariffs mainly occur on the intensive, rather than the extensive, margin.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了瑞典十二个制造业行业中企业研发投资的动态结构模型，并利用该模型衡量研发回报率以及模拟贸易限制对投资激励的影响。出口市场利润是研发预期回报的重要来源。研究发现，研发支出对出口市场企业生产率的影响大于国内市场。反事实模拟表明，贸易限制降低了研发的预期回报和研发投资水平，从而减少了贸易动态收益的一个重要来源。对瑞典出口征收10%的关税，使中位数企业的研发预期收益降低18.6%，并使高科技行业的研发支出减少7.6%。低科技行业的相应降幅分别为20.6%和5.5%。研发对出口关税的调整主要发生在集约边际，而非扩展边际。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Monetary Policy in a World of Cryptocurrencies
records.title_cn: 加密货币世界中的货币政策
records.abstract_en: Can currency competition affect central banks’ control of interest rates and prices? Yes, it can. In a two-currency world with competing cash (material or digital), the growth rate of the cryptocurrency sets an upper bound on the nominal interest rate and the attainable inflation rate, if the government currency is to retain its role as medium of exchange. In any case, the government has full control of the inflation rate. With an interest-bearing digital currency, equilibria in which government currency loses medium-of-exchange property are ruled out. This benefit comes at the cost of relinquishing control over the inflation rate.
records.abstract_cn: 货币竞争能否影响中央银行对利率和价格的控制？是的，可以。在两种货币并存的世界中，如果政府货币要保持其交换媒介的作用，加密货币的增长率将对名义利率和可实现的通胀率设定一个上限。无论如何，政府对通胀率拥有完全的控制权。对于计息数字货币，政府货币失去交换媒介属性的均衡被排除在外。这一好处是以放弃对通胀率的控制为代价的。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: The Effects of Government Spending in the Eurozone
records.title_cn: 欧元区政府支出的效应
records.abstract_en: Using a newly assembled rich dataset at the regional level, this paper provides novel empirical evidence on the effects of fiscal policy in the Eurozone. Our baseline estimates reveal a government spending relative output multiplier around 2, an employment multiplier of 1.4, and a cost per job created of approximately €30,000. Moreover, we find that a regional fiscal stimulus leads to a significant increase in private investment, productivity, and durable consumption. The labor share also increases, as do total hours worked driven by changes in the extensive margin (total employment), whereas the intensive margin (hours per worker) barely reacts. Contrary to the common policy narrative of strong positive spillover effects, we estimate only small regional fiscal spillovers. Finally, our findings reveal strong heterogeneities across economic sectors, states of the economy, and member states.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个新整理的丰富区域层面数据集，本文提供了欧元区财政政策效应的新颖实证证据。我们的基线估计显示，政府支出的相对产出乘数约为2，就业乘数为1.4，每个新增就业岗位的成本约为€30,000。此外，我们发现区域财政刺激导致私人投资、生产率和耐用品消费显著增加。劳动份额也上升，总工作时间增加是由广泛边际（总就业）的变化驱动的，而集约边际（每工人小时数）几乎没有反应。与常见的强烈正向溢出效应的政策叙事相反，我们估计区域财政溢出效应仅为小幅。最后，我们的研究结果揭示了经济部门、经济状态和成员国之间的强烈异质性。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Using Preference Estimates to Customize Incentives: An Application to Polio Vaccination Drives in Pakistan
records.title_cn: 利用偏好估计定制激励：巴基斯坦脊髓灰质炎疫苗接种运动的应用
records.abstract_en: We use estimates of time preferences to customize incentives for polio vaccinators in Lahore, Pakistan. We measure time preferences using intertemporal allocations of effort, and use these estimates to construct individually tailored incentives. We evaluate the effect of matching contract terms to discounting parameters in a subsequent experiment with the same vaccinators. Our tailored policy is compared with alternatives that either rely on atheoretic reduced-form relationships for policy guidance or apply the same policy to all individuals. We find that contracts tailored to individual discounting outperform this range of policy alternatives.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用时间偏好估计来为巴基斯坦拉合尔的脊髓灰质炎疫苗接种者定制激励措施。我们通过跨期努力分配来测量时间偏好，并利用这些估计构建个性化激励。在随后与同一批接种者进行的实验中，我们评估了将合同条款与贴现参数匹配的效果。我们将定制政策与依赖非理论化简化形式关系指导政策或对所有个体应用相同政策的替代方案进行比较。我们发现，针对个体贴现定制的合同优于这一系列政策替代方案。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Famine, Inequality, and Conflict
records.title_cn: 饥荒、不平等与冲突
records.abstract_en: This paper employs newly collected historical data from Finland to present evidence of historically contingent, long-run consequences of a famine. We document high levels of local inequality in terms of income and land distribution until a violent uprising in 1918. These inequalities partly originated from the famine of 1866–1868, which increased the concentration of land and power to large landowners. We further show that regions with more exposure to the famine had more labor coercion by the early 1900s. These inner tensions led to violent conflict following the Russian Revolution and the Finnish independence from the Russian Empire. Using microdata on all the casualties of the 1918 Finnish Civil War, we demonstrate that the famine plausibly contributed to local insurgency participation through these factors. Although unsuccessful in replacing the government, the insurgency led to significant policy changes, including radical land redistribution and a full extension of the franchise. These national reforms led to a more drastic shift toward equality in locations more affected by the famine with greater pre-conflict inequality. Our findings highlight how historical shocks can have large and long-lasting, but not straightforward impacts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用从芬兰新收集的历史数据，提供了饥荒具有历史偶然性、长期后果的证据。我们记录了直到1918年暴力起义之前，地方在收入和土地分配方面的高度不平等。这些不平等部分源于1866-1868年的饥荒，该饥荒加剧了土地和权力向大地主的集中。我们进一步表明，受饥荒影响更大的地区在1900年代初有更多的劳动强制。这些内部紧张局势在俄国革命和芬兰脱离俄罗斯帝国独立后导致了暴力冲突。利用1918年芬兰内战所有伤亡人员的微观数据，我们证明饥荒可能通过这些因素促进了地方叛乱参与。尽管叛乱未能成功取代政府，但它导致了重大的政策变革，包括激进的土地再分配和选举权的全面扩展。这些国家改革在受饥荒影响更大且冲突前不平等更严重的地区，带来了更剧烈的平等化转变。我们的发现强调了历史冲击如何可能产生巨大而持久但并非直接的后果。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Improving Parenting Practices for Early Child Development: Experimental Evidence from Rwanda
records.title_cn: 改善幼儿发展的育儿实践：来自卢旺达的实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the short- and medium-term impact of a randomized group-based early child development program targeting parents of children aged 6–24 months in a poor, rural district of Rwanda. This low-intensity, short-duration, and low-cost program engaged parents through sessions that included a novel radio show and facilitated discussions during 17 weekly village-level meetings. The intervention included two treatment arms, with different components. Twelve months after baseline, children’s communication, problem-solving, and personal social skills improved in treated groups and persisted almost 3 years later in the full treatment arm. Positive effects on maternal time investments, attitudes, and beliefs, as well as investments in play resources, also persisted over time. A mediation analysis shows that the positive impact observed in child development can be attributed to positive changes in parental and home environment inputs, particularly in the longer term. This study offers important insights for the design and delivery at scale of early child development interventions among some of the most disadvantaged communities in the world.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一项随机分组、以小组为基础的幼儿发展项目对卢旺达贫困农村地区6-24个月大儿童父母的短期和中期影响。该项目强度低、持续时间短、成本低，通过包括新颖广播节目和17次每周村级会议中的引导讨论在内的会议来吸引父母参与。干预包括两个治疗组，具有不同的组成部分。基线后十二个月，治疗组儿童的沟通、解决问题和个人社交技能得到改善，并在完整治疗组中持续了近3年。对母亲时间投入、态度和信念以及游戏资源投资的积极影响也随时间持续。中介分析表明，观察到的儿童发展积极影响可归因于父母和家庭环境投入的积极变化，尤其是在长期内。这项研究为世界上一些最弱势社区中幼儿发展干预措施的设计和大规模实施提供了重要见解。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Technological and Organizational Change and the Careers of Workers
records.title_cn: 技术与组织变革及工人职业生涯
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of technological and organizational change (T&O) on jobs and workers. We show that although T&O reduces firm demand for routine relative to abstract task-based jobs, affected workers do not face higher probability of non-employment or lower earnings growth than unaffected workers. Rather, firms that adopt T&O offer routine workers retraining opportunities to upgrade to more abstract jobs. Older workers form an important exception: T&O increases the risk that they permanently withdraw from the labor market and reduces their earnings, regardless of the tasks they performed in the firm prior to T&O.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了技术与组织变革（T&O）对工作和工人的影响。我们表明，尽管T&O降低了企业对常规相对于抽象任务型工作的需求，但受影响的工人相比未受影响的工人，并不会面临更高的非就业概率或更低的收入增长。相反，采用T&O的企业为常规工人提供再培训机会，以升级到更抽象的工作。老年工人是一个重要的例外：T&O增加了他们永久退出劳动力市场的风险，并降低了他们的收入，无论他们在T&O之前在企业中执行的任务是什么。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Women’s Fertility and Labor Market Responses to a Health Innovation
records.title_cn: 女性生育与劳动力市场对健康创新的反应
records.abstract_en: We investigate women’s fertility, labor, and marriage market responses to a health innovation that led to reductions in mortality from treatable causes, and especially large declines in child mortality. We find delayed childbearing, with lower intensive and extensive margin fertility, a decline in the chances of ever having married, increased labor force participation, and an improvement in occupational status. Our results provide the first evidence that improvements in child survival allow women to start fertility later and invest more in the labor market. We present a new theory of fertility that incorporates dynamic choices and reconciles our findings with existing models of behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了女性对一项健康创新的生育、劳动和婚姻市场反应，该创新导致可治疗原因导致的死亡率下降，尤其是儿童死亡率大幅下降。我们发现生育推迟，密集型和广延型生育率均降低，曾经结婚的概率下降，劳动力参与率提高，职业地位改善。我们的结果首次证明儿童生存率的提高使女性能够推迟生育并更多投资于劳动力市场。我们提出了一种新的生育理论，该理论纳入动态选择，并将我们的发现与现有行为模型相协调。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Childhood Send-Down Experience and Old-Age Support to Parents: The Twins Experiment in China
records.title_cn: 童年下乡经历与对父母的养老支持：来自中国双胞胎实验的证据
records.abstract_en: In the mass movement of sending urban youth to the countryside during China’s Cultural Revolution, many families with multiple age-eligible children were forced to make a send-down choice among the siblings. We exploit this rare social experiment and employ data on urban twins in China to investigate the effect of childhood send-down experience on children’s old-age support to parents. We find that compared with their twin siblings who had stayed in the city, send-downs were less likely to make a monetary transfer to parents and also tended to transfer less. We show that the inferior transfer behavior of send-downs was not due to any income disadvantage or selection of family’s send-down choice in terms of children’s altruism endowment. After ruling out the income and selection channel explanations, we posit that the inferior transfer behavior of send-downs is driven by the adverse effect of childhood send-down experience on children’s willingness to provide old-age support to parents, which could work through both pure altruism and warm glow.
records.abstract_cn: 在中国文化大革命期间的上山下乡运动中，许多有多个适龄子女的家庭被迫在兄弟姐妹之间做出下乡选择。我们利用这一罕见的社会实验，并采用中国城市双胞胎的数据，研究童年下乡经历对子女向父母提供养老支持的影响。我们发现，与留在城市的双胞胎兄弟姐妹相比，下乡者向父母进行货币转移的可能性更低，且转移金额也倾向于更少。我们表明，下乡者较差的转移行为并非由于任何收入劣势或家庭在子女利他禀赋方面的下乡选择。在排除了收入和选择渠道的解释后，我们认为下乡者较差的转移行为是由童年下乡经历对子女向父母提供养老支持意愿的不利影响所驱动的，这种影响可能通过纯粹利他和温暖 glow 两种机制起作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Inattention Matters: An Analysis of Consumers’ Inaction in Choosing a Water Tariff
records.title_cn: 忽视的重要性：消费者在选择水费费率时的不作为分析
records.abstract_en: This paper studies consumers’ choice between two different water tariffs. We document a large inaction in a novel setting where customers face a binary decision and receive simple, detailed, and personalized information about the financial savings they would obtain if they were to switch water tariff. Our empirical framework separates two sources of inertia: inattention and switching costs. The model estimates that half of the customers that would benefit from changing tariff are not aware of the opportunity they are offered. Conditional on paying attention, we estimate median switching costs to be around £100. A model where all customers are assumed to pay attention delivers instead implausibly high switching costs, with a median of £400. This shows the importance of inattention in explaining consumers’ inaction. Looking at the characteristics of the households, our results confirm previous findings that areas where households have higher levels of education or the proportion of minorities is lower display a higher responsiveness to potential savings. The new insight offered by our analysis is that this is entirely driven by attention, whereas switching costs actually increase with education and ethnic homogeneity. Our findings suggest that policies aimed at increasing attention can play a central role in fostering competition among suppliers and reducing inequalities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了消费者在两种不同水费费率之间的选择。我们在一个新颖的背景下记录了大量不作为现象，其中客户面临二元决策，并收到关于如果他们转换水费费率将获得的财务节省的简单、详细和个性化信息。我们的实证框架区分了惯性的两个来源：忽视和转换成本。模型估计，将从更换费率中受益的客户中有一半没有意识到他们被提供的机会。在关注的前提下，我们估计转换成本的中位数约为100英镑。而假设所有客户都关注的模型则给出了难以置信的高转换成本，中位数为400英镑。这表明忽视在解释消费者不作为中的重要性。从家庭特征来看，我们的结果证实了先前的发现，即教育水平较高或少数族裔比例较低的地区对潜在节省的反应更高。我们的分析提供的新见解是，这完全由关注驱动，而转换成本实际上随着教育和种族同质性的增加而增加。我们的研究结果表明，旨在提高关注度的政策可以在促进供应商之间的竞争和减少不平等方面发挥核心作用。

records.title_en: “CONVENTIONAL” MONETARY POLICY IN OLG MODELS: REVISITING THE ASSET‐SUBSTITUTION CHANNEL
records.title_cn: OLG模型中的“常规”货币政策：重新审视资产替代渠道
records.abstract_en: Conventional monetary policy involves actions by the monetary and fiscal authorities: the former sets a nominal interest rate and the latter sets lump‐sum taxes to finance the implied flow of interest payments on government debt. We model such policy within an overlapping generations framework and show that absent any other frictions the magnitude of the nominal interest rate gives rise to asset substitution between government debt and either private debt or capital—substitution that has both real and nominal effects. Such substitution is not in standard New Keynesian models because their dynastic specification implies that government debt is not net wealth.
records.abstract_cn: 常规货币政策涉及货币当局和财政当局的行动：前者设定名义利率，后者设定一次性税收，以融资政府债务利息支付的隐含流量。我们在重叠世代框架内对此类政策进行建模，并表明在不存在其他摩擦的情况下，名义利率的大小会引起政府债务与私人债务或资本之间的资产替代——这种替代既具有实际效应，也具有名义效应。这种替代在标准新凯恩斯模型中并不存在，因为其王朝式设定意味着政府债务并非净财富。

records.title_en: BARGAINING OVER TAXES AND ENTITLEMENTS IN THE ERA OF UNEQUAL GROWTH
records.title_cn: 不平等增长时代关于税收和福利的谈判
records.abstract_en: Entitlements have become an increasing component of total government spending in the United States over the last six decades. Using a political‐economy model where parties bargain over taxes and entitlements, we argue that such dynamics can be explained by two factors: “unequal growth,” where top earners became richer while the income of the bottom 50% stagnated, and budget rules that provide bargaining power to low‐income earners through a “status quo effect.” In a model calibrated to the United States, we show that sustained bargaining power by a party representing the poor results in a rising share of entitlements consistent with the data.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去六十年中，福利已成为美国政府总支出中日益增长的组成部分。通过一个政党就税收和福利进行谈判的政治经济模型，我们认为这种动态可以由两个因素解释：“不平等增长”，即顶层收入者变得更富有，而底层50%的收入停滞不前；以及预算规则，通过“现状效应”为低收入者提供谈判能力。在一个针对美国校准的模型中，我们表明，代表穷人的政党持续拥有谈判能力会导致福利份额上升，这与数据一致。

records.title_en: CREDIT, DEFAULT, AND OPTIMAL HEALTH INSURANCE
records.title_cn: 信贷、违约与最优健康保险
records.abstract_en: I study how credit and default affect optimal health insurance, constructing a life‐cycle model of health investment with a strategic default option on emergency room bills and financial debts. The model is calibrated to the U.S. economy and used to compare the optimal policy for Medicaid by the availability of the default option and credit. I find that strategic default induces the optimal policy to be more redistributive. With (Without) the option, the optimal income threshold for Medicaid eligibility is 44% (25%) of the average income. In these findings, the interaction between strategic default and preventative medical spending is important.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了信贷和违约如何影响最优健康保险，构建了一个包含急诊室账单和金融债务战略违约选项的健康投资生命周期模型。该模型根据美国经济进行校准，并用于比较在违约选项和信贷可用性不同的情况下，医疗补助的最优政策。我发现，战略违约促使最优政策更具再分配性。在有（无）该选项的情况下，医疗补助资格的最优收入门槛为平均收入的44%（25%）。在这些发现中，战略违约与预防性医疗支出之间的相互作用至关重要。

records.title_en: TAIL FORECASTING WITH MULTIVARIATE BAYESIAN ADDITIVE REGRESSION TREES
records.title_cn: 多元贝叶斯加性回归树的尾部预测
records.abstract_en: We develop multivariate time‐series models using Bayesian additive regression trees that posit nonlinearities among macroeconomic variables, their lags, and possibly their lagged errors. The error variances can be stable, feature stochastic volatility, or follow a nonparametric specification. We evaluate density and tail forecast performance for a set of U.S. macroeconomic and financial indicators. Our results suggest that the proposed models improve forecast accuracy both overall and in the tails. Another finding is that when allowing for nonlinearities in the conditional mean, heteroskedasticity becomes less important. A scenario analysis reveals nonlinear relations between predictive distributions and financial conditions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了使用贝叶斯加性回归树的多元时间序列模型，该模型假设宏观经济变量、其滞后项以及可能的滞后误差之间存在非线性关系。误差方差可以是稳定的、具有随机波动性，或遵循非参数设定。我们评估了美国宏观经济和金融指标集合的密度和尾部预测表现。我们的结果表明，所提出的模型在整体和尾部均提高了预测准确性。另一个发现是，当允许条件均值存在非线性时，异方差性的重要性降低。情景分析揭示了预测分布与金融状况之间的非线性关系。

records.title_en: A MULTILAYER VIEW OF SYSTEMIC IMPORTANCE AND AGGREGATE FLUCTUATIONS
records.title_cn: 系统重要性及总体波动的多层视角
records.abstract_en: Economic systems are composed of multiple interrelated groups of agents and with multiple sources of network externalities present. This can give rise to novel systemic risks. We propose a multilayer model to understand this phenomenon. The model features complementary or substitutionary actions of agents active in multiple groups and extends the network concepts of systemic importance and microinduced aggregate fluctuations to their multigroup counterparts. The multilayer allows for the propagation of shocks through both intra‐ and interlayer margins. The interlayer margin can be large enough to induce a reordering of systemic importance indicators as compared to singular group considerations, and produce volatility levels that are larger than economies consisting of a single group of agents.
records.abstract_cn: 经济系统由多个相互关联的代理群体组成，并存在多种网络外部性来源。这可能引发新型系统性风险。我们提出了一个多层模型来理解这一现象。该模型具有活跃于多个群体的代理人的互补性或替代性行动，并将系统重要性和微观引发的总体波动的网络概念扩展到其多群体对应物。多层结构允许冲击通过层内和层间边际传播。与单一群体考虑相比，层间边际可能大到足以引起系统重要性指标的重排序，并产生比由单一代理群体组成的经济体更大的波动水平。

records.title_en: BAYESIAN DYNAMIC VARIABLE SELECTION IN HIGH DIMENSIONS
records.title_cn: 高维贝叶斯动态变量选择
records.abstract_en: This article addresses the issue of inference in time‐varying parameter regression models in the presence of many predictors and develops a novel dynamic variable selection strategy. The proposed variational Bayes dynamic variable selection algorithm allows for assessing at each time period in the sample which predictors are relevant (or not) for forecasting the dependent variable. The algorithm is used to forecast inflation using over 400 macroeconomic, financial, and global predictors, many of which are potentially irrelevant or short‐lived. The new methodology is able to ensure parsimonious solutions to this high‐dimensional estimation problem, which translate into excellent forecast performance.
records.abstract_cn: 本文解决了在存在许多预测变量的情况下时变参数回归模型的推断问题，并提出了一种新颖的动态变量选择策略。所提出的变分贝叶斯动态变量选择算法允许在样本中的每个时间段评估哪些预测变量与预测因变量相关（或不相关）。该算法用于使用超过400个宏观经济、金融和全球预测变量来预测通货膨胀，其中许多变量可能不相关或短期有效。新方法能够确保这一高维估计问题得到简约的解决方案，从而转化为出色的预测性能。

records.title_en: GOODHART'S LAW AND MACHINE LEARNING: A STRUCTURAL PERSPECTIVE
records.title_cn: 古德哈特定律与机器学习：一个结构性视角
records.abstract_en: We develop a simple structural model to illustrate how penalized regressions generate Goodhart bias when training data are clean but covariates are manipulated at known cost by future agents. With quadratic (extremely steep) manipulation costs, bias is proportional to Ridge (Lasso) penalization. If costs depend on absolute or percentage manipulation, the following algorithm yields manipulation‐proof prediction: Within training data, evaluate candidate coefficients at their respective incentive‐compatible manipulation configuration. We derive analytical coefficient adjustments: slopes (intercept) shift downward if costs depend on percentage (absolute) manipulation. Statisticians ignoring manipulation costs select socially suboptimal penalization. Model averaging reduces these manipulation costs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个简单的结构模型，用以说明当训练数据干净但未来代理人以已知成本操纵协变量时，惩罚回归如何产生古德哈特偏差。在二次（极其陡峭）操纵成本下，偏差与岭回归（套索）惩罚成正比。如果成本取决于绝对或百分比操纵，以下算法可产生抗操纵预测：在训练数据内，评估候选系数在其各自的激励相容操纵配置下。我们推导出解析系数调整：如果成本取决于百分比（绝对）操纵，斜率（截距）向下移动。忽视操纵成本的统计学家会选择社会次优的惩罚。模型平均降低了这些操纵成本。

records.title_en: COMPETITIVE MARKET BEHAVIOR: CONVERGENCE AND ASYMMETRY IN THE EXPERIMENTAL DOUBLE AUCTION
records.title_cn: 竞争性市场行为：实验性双向拍卖中的收敛与不对称性
records.abstract_en: We conducted a large number of controlled continuous double auction experiments to reproduce and stress‐test the phenomenon of convergence to competitive equilibrium under private information with decentralized trading feedback. Our main finding is that across a total of 104 markets (involving over 1,700 subjects), convergence occurs after a handful of trading periods. Initially, however, there is an inherent asymmetry that favors buyers, typically resulting in prices below equilibrium levels. Analysis of over 80,000 observations of individual bids and asks helps identify empirical ingredients contributing to the observed phenomena including higher levels of aggressiveness initially among buyers than sellers.
records.abstract_cn: 我们进行了大量受控的连续双向拍卖实验，以再现并压力测试在私有信息和分散交易反馈下收敛至竞争均衡的现象。我们的主要发现是，在总共104个市场（涉及超过1,700名受试者）中，收敛发生在少数几个交易期之后。然而，最初存在一种有利于买方的固有不对称性，通常导致价格低于均衡水平。对超过80,000个个体出价和要价观测值的分析有助于识别促成所观察现象的经验因素，包括最初买方比卖方表现出更高的攻击性水平。

records.title_en: TRADING AMBIGUITY: A TALE OF TWO HETEROGENEITIES
records.title_cn: 交易模糊性：两种异质性的故事
records.abstract_en: We consider markets with heterogeneously ambiguous assets and heterogeneously ambiguity‐averse investors whose preferences are a parsimonious extension of the mean–variance framework. We study portfolio choice and trade upon arrival of public information, and show systematic departures from the predictions of standard theory, that occur in the direction of empirical regularities. In particular, our theory speaks to several phenomena in a unified fashion: the asset allocation puzzle, the observation that earnings announcements are followed by significant trading volume with small price change, and that increases in uncertainty are positively associated with increased trading activity and portfolio rebalancing toward safer assets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有异质性模糊资产和异质性模糊厌恶投资者的市场，其偏好是均值-方差框架的简约扩展。我们研究公共信息到达时的投资组合选择和交易，并展示了与标准理论预测的系统性偏离，这些偏离发生在经验规律的方向上。特别是，我们的理论以统一的方式解释了若干现象：资产配置之谜、盈利公告后伴随显著交易量但价格变动较小的观察，以及不确定性增加与交易活动增加和向更安全资产的投资组合再平衡正相关。

records.title_en: SPOUSES, CHILDREN, AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP
records.title_cn: 配偶、子女与创业
records.abstract_en: We study the relationship between family and entrepreneurship decisions. Family influences entrepreneurship decisions via two channels: (i) Spouses work more in case of business failure and (ii) children increase the cost of failure. We use administrative matched owner–employer–employee–spouse data to estimate the predictions derived from our model. We find evidence that marriage decreases entry into entrepreneurship and increases average firm size, consistent with mechanism (ii) dominating the (i). Using direct information on children, we find that more children decrease entry into entrepreneurship and increase average firm size.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究家庭与创业决策之间的关系。家庭通过两个渠道影响创业决策：（i）配偶在创业失败时增加工作，（ii）子女增加了失败的代价。我们使用行政匹配的所有者-雇主-雇员-配偶数据来估计我们模型得出的预测。我们发现证据表明，婚姻降低了创业进入率并提高了平均企业规模，这与机制（ii）主导（i）相一致。利用关于子女的直接信息，我们发现更多的子女降低了创业进入率并提高了平均企业规模。

records.title_en: REDUCING RECOMMENDATION INEQUALITY VIA TWO‐SIDED MATCHING: A FIELD EXPERIMENT OF ONLINE DATING
records.title_cn: 通过双边匹配减少推荐不平等：在线约会的实地实验
records.abstract_en: Leading dating platforms usually recommend only a small fraction of users based on users' popularity and similarity, leading to recommendation inequality. We use a stylized matching model from economics to modify existing algorithms to reduce inequality. We evaluate the proposed method through a large‐scale field experiment on a dating platform. Experiment results suggest that our recommender reduces inequality, improves predictive accuracy, and leads to substantially more matched couples than other competing algorithms.
records.abstract_cn: 主流约会平台通常仅根据用户的受欢迎程度和相似性推荐一小部分用户，导致推荐不平等。我们使用经济学中的简化匹配模型来修改现有算法以减少不平等。我们通过在约会平台上进行的大规模实地实验来评估所提出的方法。实验结果表明，我们的推荐器减少了不平等，提高了预测准确性，并比其他竞争算法带来了更多的匹配情侣。

records.title_en: ELECTORAL MALDISTRICTING
records.title_cn: 选举不公正划分选区
records.abstract_en: We introduce a framework to theoretically and empirically examine electoral maldistricting—the intentional drawing of electoral districts to advance partisan objectives, compromising voter welfare. We identify the legislatures that maximize voter welfare and those that maximize partisan goals, and incorporate them into a maldistricting index. This index measures the intent to maldistrict by comparing distances from the actual legislature to the nearest partisan and welfare‐maximizing legislatures. Using 2008 presidential election data and 2010 census‐based district maps, we find a Republican‐leaning bias in district maps. Our index tracks court rulings in intuitive ways.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入一个框架，从理论和实证上考察选举不公正划分选区——即为了推进党派目标而故意划分选举区，损害选民福利。我们识别出最大化选民福利的立法机构和最大化党派目标的立法机构，并将其纳入一个不公正划分选区指数。该指数通过比较实际立法机构与最近的党派和福利最大化立法机构之间的距离来衡量不公正划分选区的意图。利用2008年总统选举数据和基于2010年人口普查的选区地图，我们发现选区地图存在偏向共和党的倾向。我们的指数以直观的方式追踪法院裁决。

records.title_en: HETEROGENEITY, FRICTIONAL ASSIGNMENT, AND HOME‐OWNERSHIP
records.title_cn: 异质性、摩擦性配置与住房自有率
records.abstract_en: We study the composition of the housing stock across ownership and rental markets in a dynamic model of frictional assignment. Houses are rented or sold to heterogeneous households that sort over quality. Due to matching frictions and an increasing ownership surplus, wealthy households tend to own and lower value housing tends to be rented, even without financial frictions or rental supply constraints. When calibrated to match key housing market features of the average U.S. city, the model is consistent with observed empirical relationships across cities. We study the model's implications for affordability, ownership, and the impact of progressive property taxation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个摩擦性配置的动态模型中研究住房存量在自有和租赁市场之间的构成。房屋被出租或出售给按质量分类的异质性家庭。由于匹配摩擦和递增的自有剩余，富裕家庭倾向于拥有住房，而低价值住房倾向于被出租，即使没有金融摩擦或租赁供应限制。当校准以匹配美国平均城市的关键住房市场特征时，该模型与观察到的跨城市实证关系一致。我们研究了该模型对可负担性、自有率以及累进财产税影响的意义。

records.title_en: How does the development of digital finance affect small business tax compliance? Empirical evidence from China
records.title_cn: 数字金融发展如何影响小企业税收遵从？来自中国的经验证据
records.abstract_en: How will the development of digital finance affect corporate tax compliance? In the digital economic age, this is a crucial issue. Using the 2011–2015 national tax survey database (NTSD) and the Peking University digital finance index, this paper examines the causal relationship between digital finance and small business tax compliance. Our baseline results show that each standard deviation increase in the digital finance index reduces the level of tax noncompliance by 7.5% for small businesses. We exclude the interference of contemporaneous policies, utilize a specification design based on neighboring cities across provincial borders, and employ instrumental variable estimation methods to jointly alleviate concerns about endogeneity. Furthermore, mechanism analysis shows that digital finance impacts small business tax noncompliance by easing corporate financing constraints and capturing tax-related “digital information”. Finally, we analyze the heterogeneous effects of digital finance development. The effects on tax noncompliance are weaker for large firms (placebo group), small businesses supported by the government's industrial policy, and small businesses located in poor credit environment areas.
records.abstract_cn: 数字金融的发展将如何影响企业税收遵从？在数字经济时代，这是一个至关重要的问题。利用2011-2015年全国税收调查数据库（NTSD）和北京大学数字金融指数，本文考察了数字金融与小企业税收遵从之间的因果关系。我们的基准结果表明，数字金融指数每增加一个标准差，小企业的税收不遵从水平降低7.5%。我们排除了同期政策的干扰，利用基于省界相邻城市的规格设计，并采用工具变量估计方法，共同缓解了内生性问题。此外，机制分析表明，数字金融通过缓解企业融资约束和获取涉税“数字信息”来影响小企业的税收不遵从。最后，我们分析了数字金融发展的异质性效应。对于大企业（安慰剂组）、受政府产业政策支持的小企业以及位于信用环境较差地区的小企业，其对税收不遵从的影响较弱。

records.title_en: Family size, labor supply, and job prestige: Evidence from three decennial censuses in China
records.title_cn: 家庭规模、劳动供给与职业声望：来自中国三次人口普查的证据
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the relationship between family size and parents’ labor market performance, measured by labor supply and occupational prestige scores, based on three census waves in 1990, 2000, and 2010. To address the endogeneity problem of family size, we use the indicator of twins at first birth as an instrumental variable. Our results suggest that in nuclear households, family size affects the labor market performance only of mothers, not of fathers, with the negative effects fading and gradually disappearing over time. More specifically, an increase in family size decreases female labor supply in the 1990 wave, leads to lower prestige scores among working mothers in the 2000 wave, and has no impact on labor supply or occupational prestige scores in the 2010 wave. Our subsample analysis indicates that the negative effects of family size are more severe for parents of households with all children under seven years old and for husbands or wives with lower education level than that of their partners. In addition, we find that the negative effects of family size on parental labor market outcomes are not observed in extended households, especially when no grandparents are aged 65 years or older.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究基于1990年、2000年和2010年的三次人口普查数据，考察了家庭规模与父母劳动力市场表现（以劳动供给和职业声望得分衡量）之间的关系。为解决家庭规模的内生性问题，我们使用头胎双胞胎作为工具变量。结果表明，在核心家庭中，家庭规模仅影响母亲的劳动力市场表现，而不影响父亲，且负面影响随时间逐渐减弱并最终消失。具体而言，家庭规模增加在1990年降低了女性劳动供给，在2000年导致在职母亲的职业声望得分降低，而在2010年对劳动供给或职业声望得分均无影响。我们的子样本分析表明，家庭规模的负面影响对于所有子女均在七岁以下的家庭中的父母，以及教育水平低于配偶的丈夫或妻子更为严重。此外，我们发现家庭规模对父母劳动力市场结果的负面影响在扩展家庭中并未观察到，尤其是在没有祖父母年龄达到65岁或以上的情况下。

records.title_en: Imports of key capital goods and quality upgrading: Evidence from China's import subsidy policy
records.title_cn: 关键资本品进口与质量升级：来自中国进口补贴政策的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of capital goods imports on firms' export quality upgrading with a subsidy policy for advanced capital imports implemented in China since 2008. Using a matched dataset of firms' production and custom data, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy that exploits firms' differential pre-event exposures to the policy. We find that the subsidy policy increases firms' imports of subsidized products, and improves their export quality. Furthermore, export quality improvements due to capital goods imports are larger if (1) firms are more productive; (2) the exporting product is the firm's core product; (3) the product is a differentiated good; and (4) the destination market is larger and richer. Further analysis suggests that capital goods imports can also boost firms' total exports and the number of exporting destinations and products. The mechanism tests reveal that capital-skill complementarity can explain improved export product quality through capital goods imports. Capital goods imports also lead to increased skill management that can improve export quality as well.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国自2008年起实施的先进资本品进口补贴政策，考察了资本品进口对企业出口质量升级的影响。通过匹配的企业生产与海关数据，我们采用双重差分策略，利用企业在政策前不同的暴露程度。我们发现补贴政策增加了企业对补贴产品的进口，并提高了其出口质量。此外，资本品进口带来的出口质量提升在以下情况下更大：（1）企业生产率更高；（2）出口产品是企业核心产品；（3）产品为差异化产品；（4）目的地市场规模更大且更富裕。进一步分析表明，资本品进口还能促进企业总出口以及出口目的地和产品数量的增加。机制检验显示，资本技能互补性可以解释通过资本品进口带来的出口产品质量提升。资本品进口还导致技能管理增加，这同样能提高出口质量。

records.title_en: Multi-generational educational mobility in China in the twentieth century
records.title_cn: 二十世纪中国多代教育流动性
records.abstract_en: Two essential strategies to understand the mechanisms of intergenerational mobility are to compare mobility across countries and across time. However, for multi-generational mobility, estimates for developing countries are mostly missing, and trend studies are rare.
