records.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between credit rating levels and rating agency fees in a public finance market in which rating agencies earn lower fees and face higher disclosure requirements relative to corporate bond and structured finance markets. Controlling for variation in the complexity of credit analysis at the issue level, we find evidence that rating agency conflicts of interest distort credit ratings in the municipal bond market. Unexpectedly expensive ratings are more likely downgraded, and inexpensive ratings are more likely upgraded. The relationship between credit ratings and rating agency fees is driven by issuers who lose access to AAA insurance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在公共财政市场中信用评级水平与评级机构费用之间的关系，在该市场中，相对于公司债券和结构性融资市场，评级机构赚取较低的费用并面临更高的披露要求。在控制发行层面信用分析复杂性的变化后，我们发现有证据表明评级机构的利益冲突扭曲了市政债券市场的信用评级。出乎意料地昂贵的评级更可能被下调，而廉价的评级更可能被上调。信用评级与评级机构费用之间的关系是由失去AAA保险渠道的发行人驱动的。

records.title_en: Macroprudential Policy with Liquidity Panics
records.title_cn: 流动性恐慌下的宏观审慎政策
records.abstract_en: We study the optimality of macroprudential policies in an environment where banks provide liquidity to firms. Informational frictions between banks can cause interbank market freezes, prompting firms to accumulate their own liquid assets. Liquidity hoarding by firms in turn reduces the demand for bank loans and bank profitability, makes interbank market freezes even more likely, and may ultimately trigger a self-fulfilling bad equilibrium. Such “liquidity panics” provide an additional rationale for liquidity requirements on banks, which alleviate frictions in the banking sector and, paradoxically, can increase aggregate investment. Instead, policies encouraging bank lending can have the opposite effect.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在银行向企业提供流动性的环境中宏观审慎政策的最优性。银行之间的信息摩擦可能导致银行间市场冻结，促使企业积累自己的流动资产。企业囤积流动性反过来减少了对银行贷款的需求和银行盈利能力，使银行间市场冻结更可能发生，并最终可能引发自我实现的坏均衡。这种“流动性恐慌”为银行流动性要求提供了额外的理由，这缓解了银行部门的摩擦，并且矛盾的是，可以增加总投资。相反，鼓励银行贷款的政策可能产生相反的效果。

records.title_en: Illiquidity and Higher Cumulants
records.title_cn: 非流动性与高阶矩
records.abstract_en: We characterize the unique equilibrium in an economy populated by strategic CARA investors who trade multiple risky assets with arbitrarily distributed payoffs. We use our explicit solution to study the joint behavior of illiquidity of option contracts. Option bid-ask spreads are proportional to risk aversion and risk-neutral variances of option payoffs. Spreads may decrease in risk aversion, physical variance, open interest, and increase after earnings announcements in a result contrary to conventional wisdom. All these predictions are confirmed empirically using a large panel data set of U.S. stock options. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
records.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了一个由战略性CARA投资者组成的经济体中的唯一均衡，这些投资者交易多种具有任意分布收益的风险资产。我们利用显式解来研究期权合约非流动性的联合行为。期权买卖价差与风险厌恶和期权收益的风险中性方差成比例。价差可能随风险厌恶、物理方差、未平仓合约减少，并在盈利公告后增加，这与传统观点相反。所有这些预测都通过美国股票期权的大面板数据集得到了实证确认。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

records.title_en: r Minus g
records.title_cn: r减g
records.abstract_en: In long-term data, the dynamic efficiency condition, r>g, holds when g is the growth rate of GDP if r is the return on equity, re, but not if r is the risk-free rate, rf. This pattern accords with a disaster-risk model that fits observed equity premia. The equilibrium may feature rf≤g, which does not signal dynamic inefficiency. In contrast, re>g is required for dynamic efficiency, implied by the model, and consistent with data. With complete markets, the representative consumer's transversality condition translates into a no-Ponzi constraint on the public debt that the government can issue asymptotically. Therefore, fiscal changes do not affect the net wealth of the representative consumer, and Ricardian Equivalence holds. This result also holds in an example with incomplete markets where individual ownership of capital stocks cannot be fully diversified.
records.abstract_cn: 在长期数据中，当g为GDP增长率时，动态效率条件r>g在r为股本回报率re时成立，但在r为无风险利率rf时不成立。这一模式与符合观测到的股权溢价的灾难风险模型一致。均衡可能呈现rf≤g，这并不表示动态无效率。相反，re>g是动态效率所必需的，由模型隐含，并与数据一致。在完全市场中，代表性消费者的横截性条件转化为对政府最终可发行的公共债务的无庞氏约束。因此，财政变化不影响代表性消费者的净财富，李嘉图等价成立。这一结果在不完全市场的例子中也成立，其中资本存量的个人所有权无法完全分散化。

records.title_en: Skill-biased entrepreneurial decline
records.title_cn: 技能偏向的企业家精神衰退
records.abstract_en: The U.S. is undergoing a long-term decline in entrepreneurship. We show that this slow-down in entrepreneurship has been more pronounced for skilled individuals – those with a college degree. We document new facts on the skill-biased nature of declining entrepreneurship and propose that it is a response to the rising worker skill premium observed over the same period. In support of this, we find that workers' earnings grew faster than entrepreneurs', particularly for skilled individuals, discouraging the pursuit of entrepreneurship. To quantify the impact of the skill premium on entrepreneurship, we develop a model of occupational choice with worker heterogeneity. In the model, a rising skill premium – driven by skill-biased technological change – contributes little in lowering entrepreneurship. Instead, around 70% of the observed decline in entrepreneurship is driven by skill-neutral technological change and a rising share of college graduates. A rise in the skill premium interacts with these forces to generate the skill-biased decline, and in doing so, shifts the composition of entrepreneurs towards the unskilled, lowering average entrepreneurial productivity. Our findings suggest an integral role for the changing income structure of workers in driving the broader decline in business dynamism in the U.S.
records.abstract_cn: 美国正在经历企业家精神的长期衰退。我们表明，这种企业家精神的放缓对于技能型个体——即拥有大学学位的人——更为显著。我们记录了关于企业家精神衰退的技能偏向性质的新事实，并提出这是对同期观察到的工人技能溢价上升的回应。为支持这一点，我们发现工人的收入增长快于企业家，尤其是对于技能型个体，这抑制了创业的追求。为了量化技能溢价对企业家精神的影响，我们构建了一个具有工人异质性的职业选择模型。在模型中，由技能偏向型技术变革驱动的技能溢价上升，对降低企业家精神的作用甚微。相反，观察到的企业家精神衰退中约有70%是由技能中性技术变革和大学毕业生比例上升所驱动。技能溢价的上升与这些力量相互作用，产生了技能偏向的衰退，并因此将企业家的构成转向非技能型，降低了平均创业生产率。我们的研究结果表明，工人收入结构的变化在推动美国商业活力整体衰退中发挥着不可或缺的作用。

records.title_en: Aggregate implications of financial frictions for unemployment
records.title_cn: 金融摩擦对失业的总体影响
records.abstract_en: The Great Recession has witnessed not only a marked disruption in the credit markets and a sharp increase of capital underutilization, but also a severe deterioration of the matching efficiency in the labor market, as evidenced by the historically high unemployment rate and a significant outward shift of the Beveridge curve. Motivated by these facts, I develop a tractable dynamic general equilibrium model to show that financial frictions can manifest themselves as changes in the endogenous matching efficiency in the labor markets. Furthermore, I come up with sufficient statistics to capture the selection and congestion effects of financial frictions on unemployment. The analytical characterization shows that the competing effects crucially depend on interaction between credit imperfections and labor supply elasticity. I then use a calibrated version of the model to show quantitatively that the credit crunch during the financial crisis was a key driving force behind the outward shift of the Beveridge curve, which can explain up to 40% of the rise in the unemployment rate over the business cycles.
records.abstract_cn: 大衰退不仅见证了信贷市场的显著混乱和资本利用不足的急剧增加，还见证了劳动力市场匹配效率的严重恶化，这从历史高位的失业率和贝弗里奇曲线的显著外移可以看出。受这些事实的启发，我开发了一个易处理的动态一般均衡模型，以表明金融摩擦可以表现为劳动力市场中内生匹配效率的变化。此外，我提出了足够的统计量来捕捉金融摩擦对失业的选择效应和拥挤效应。分析特征表明，这些竞争效应关键取决于信贷不完善与劳动供给弹性之间的相互作用。然后，我使用校准版本的模型进行定量分析，表明金融危机期间的信贷紧缩是贝弗里奇曲线外移的关键驱动因素，这可以解释商业周期中失业率上升的至多40%。

records.title_en: The role of dispersed information in inflation and inflation expectations
records.title_cn: 分散信息在通货膨胀和通胀预期中的作用
records.abstract_en: We solve a rational expectations model of price formation with nominal rigidity and information frictions analytically to study how dispersed information impacts inflation and inflation expectations, without imposing strong structural assumptions on the aggregate marginal cost. We derive a Phillips curve that links inflation, average inflation forecast (i.e., a first-order expectation), and the net effect of higher-order expectations (HOEs). We quantify the essential role of dispersed information in generating inflation inertia and predictable average nowcast and forecast errors. The estimated effect from dispersed information explains a significant inflation variation, and the net effect of HOEs provides a novel micro-foundation for markup shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们解析地求解了一个具有名义刚性和信息摩擦的价格形成理性预期模型，以研究分散信息如何影响通货膨胀和通胀预期，而无需对总边际成本施加强结构假设。我们推导出一条菲利普斯曲线，将通货膨胀、平均通胀预测（即一阶预期）和高阶预期（HOEs）的净效应联系起来。我们量化了分散信息在产生通胀惯性和可预测的平均即时预测及预测误差中的关键作用。分散信息的估计效应解释了显著的通货膨胀变动，而高阶预期的净效应为加价冲击提供了新颖的微观基础。

records.title_en: Long-term sovereign debt: A steady state analysis
records.title_cn: 长期主权债务：稳态分析
records.abstract_en: A model of long-term sovereign debt with a fiscal rule and endogenous default is explored in which debt maturity governs the number of risky steady states. Generally, there is a good steady state with high investment and low indebtedness and default frequencies, and a bad steady state with the reverse. The multiplicity arises when maturity tames an aggressive feedback loop that emerges in the sovereign budget set between debt service and required issuance as expected default frequencies rise. This feedback loop delivers a unique risky steady state at shorter maturities. Local dynamics and policy consequences are explored quantitatively.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了一个包含财政规则和内生产违约的长期主权债务模型，其中债务期限决定了风险稳态的数量。通常，存在一个高投资、低债务和低违约频率的良好稳态，以及一个相反情况的糟糕稳态。当期限抑制了主权预算集中因预期违约频率上升而在债务服务和所需发行之间出现的激进反馈循环时，多重性就会出现。这种反馈循环在较短的期限内产生唯一的风险稳态。本文定量探讨了局部动态和政策后果。

records.title_en: The firm size-leverage relationship and its implications for entry and business concentration
records.title_cn: 企业规模与杠杆率的关系及其对进入和商业集中度的影响
records.abstract_en: Larger firms (by sales or employment) have higher leverage. This pattern is explained using a model in which firms produce multiple varieties, acquire new varieties from their inventors, and borrow against the future cash flow of the firm with the option to default. A variety can die with a constant probability, implying that firms with more varieties (bigger firms) have a lower variance of sales growth and, in equilibrium, higher leverage. In this setup, a drop in the risk-free rate increases the value of an acquisition more for bigger firms because of their higher leverage: they can (and do) borrow a larger fraction of their future cash flow. The drop causes existing firms to buy more of the new varieties arriving into the economy, resulting in a lower startup rate and greater concentration of sales.
records.abstract_cn: 规模较大的企业（按销售额或就业人数衡量）具有较高的杠杆率。这一模式通过一个模型得到解释，在该模型中，企业生产多种产品，从发明者那里获取新产品，并以企业未来现金流为抵押借款，且可以选择违约。一种产品可能以恒定概率消亡，这意味着拥有更多产品（规模更大）的企业销售增长方差较低，在均衡状态下杠杆率较高。在这种设定下，无风险利率的下降对规模较大企业收购价值的影响更大，因为它们的杠杆率更高：它们能够（并且确实）借入其未来现金流的更大比例。利率下降导致现有企业购买更多进入经济的新产品，从而导致创业率降低和销售集中度提高。

records.title_en: Non-traded goods, factor market frictions, and international capital flows
records.title_cn: 非贸易品、要素市场摩擦与国际资本流动
records.abstract_en: The canonical one-sector model over predicts international capital flows by a factor of ten. We show that introducing a non-traded goods sector can reconcile the differences between the theoretical predictions and the observed flows. We analyze the quantitative impact of the non-traded sector using a calibrated model of a small open economy, in which non-traded goods are used in consumption and investment, and need capital and labor to be produced. The model features international frictions directly affecting international borrowing and lending, as well as domestic frictions that limit the scope of inter-sectoral reallocation of capital and labor. We find that: (1) the impact of domestic frictions on the size of international capital flows is similar to the impact of international frictions, and (2) the median elasticity of capital flows with respect to international frictions in the two-sector model with costly inter-sectoral reallocation is about 50-60% lower than that same elasticity in the one-sector model.
records.abstract_cn: 经典的单部门模型对国际资本流动的预测高估了十倍。我们表明，引入非贸易品部门可以调和理论预测与实际流动之间的差异。我们使用一个小型开放经济的校准模型来分析非贸易部门的定量影响，在该模型中，非贸易品用于消费和投资，并且需要资本和劳动力来生产。该模型具有直接影响国际借贷的国际摩擦，以及限制资本和劳动力跨部门重新配置范围的国内摩擦。我们发现：（1）国内摩擦对国际资本流动规模的影响与国际摩擦的影响相似，并且（2）在具有昂贵跨部门重新配置的两部门模型中，资本流动对国际摩擦的中位数弹性比单部门模型中的同一弹性低约50-60%。

records.title_en: Product innovation, diffusion and endogenous growth
records.title_cn: 产品创新、扩散与内生增长
records.abstract_en: We develop a model of Schumpeterian growth featuring a stochastic diffusion process where the rate of commercial success of product innovations is endogenously determined by advertising intensity. We consider both informative advertising, which young technological leaders use to increase the probability of diffusion, and defensive advertising, which incumbents use to prevent the diffusion of competing products. Economic growth depends positively on the arrival rate of product innovations and the diffusion rate of innovations into the mainstream market. We show that R&D subsidies shift relative investment incentives towards innovation and away from diffusion. This creates an inverted U-shaped relationship between R&D subsidies and both economic growth and welfare as innovations arrive more frequently, but fewer commercialize successfully. We find that advertising subsidies increase diffusion, growth, and welfare when advertising is purely informative. In the presence of defensive advertising, advertising subsidies lead to socially wasteful increases in resources devoted to advertising without large increases in diffusion, reducing growth and welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，其中包含一个随机扩散过程，产品创新的商业成功率由广告强度内生决定。我们考虑了信息性广告和防御性广告，前者是年轻的技术领先者用来提高扩散概率的，后者是现有企业用来阻止竞争产品扩散的。经济增长正向依赖于产品创新的到达率和创新向主流市场扩散的速率。我们表明，研发补贴将相对投资激励从扩散转向创新。这导致研发补贴与经济增长和福利之间呈倒U型关系，因为创新出现得更频繁，但成功商业化的较少。我们发现，当广告纯粹是信息性时，广告补贴会增加扩散、增长和福利。在存在防御性广告的情况下，广告补贴会导致资源在社会上浪费地增加用于广告，而扩散没有大幅增加，从而降低增长和福利。

records.title_en: Unemployment risk, consumption dynamics, and the secondary market for durable goods
records.title_cn: 失业风险、消费动态与耐用品二级市场
records.abstract_en: I provide a theoretical framework of optimal purchases of new and used consumer durables in an economy with heterogeneous agents, idiosyncratic income risk and incomplete financial markets. Agents choose optimally between consuming nondurable and durable goods and accumulating a risk-free asset. The price of durable goods in the secondary market is determined endogenously, through market clearing. The model generates pro-cyclical durable expenditures and (resale) prices, which is consistent with the available empirical evidence for the US economy. The mechanism behind this result is that, following increases in unemployment risk during recessions, durable goods become less attractive to households, which rebalance their portfolio towards liquid asset holdings. This decreases the demand for durable goods and exerts a downward pressure on their price. I show that the illiquidity associated to durable accumulation is key in generating the results. The benefits of extending income support to unemployed households during recessions are studied in a policy experiment.
records.abstract_cn: 我提供了一个理论框架，研究在具有异质性主体、特殊收入风险和不完全金融市场的经济中，新旧耐用消费品的最优购买。主体在非耐用品和耐用品消费以及积累无风险资产之间进行最优选择。二级市场中耐用品的价格通过市场出清内生决定。该模型产生了顺周期的耐用品支出和（转售）价格，这与美国经济的现有经验证据一致。这一结果背后的机制是，在经济衰退期间失业风险上升后，耐用品对家庭的吸引力下降，家庭将投资组合转向流动性资产持有。这降低了对耐用品的需求，并对其价格产生下行压力。我表明，与耐用品积累相关的非流动性是产生这些结果的关键。在一项政策实验中，研究了在经济衰退期间向失业家庭提供收入支持的好处。

records.title_en: Global demand for basket-backed stablecoins
records.title_cn: 全球对篮子支持的稳定币的需求
records.abstract_en: We construct a model where a basket-backed stablecoin – a currency backed by and pegged to a combination of sovereign currencies, such as Mark Carney's “synthetic hegemonic currency” or Facebook's proposal for Libra – is demanded for transaction purposes. In the model, demand for the basket derives from trade shocks which affect demand for the underlying sovereign currencies. Despite providing a justification for the basket, our model, in numerical simulations, predicts that overall demand for the basket will be low. This derives from a general-equilibrium effect of the basket currency: Demand for the basket creates pass-through demand for the underlying currencies that back it. This pass-through demand stabilizes the value of the currency for which the basket was meant to substitute, limiting demand for the basket. We calculate that this low demand from buyers would likely limit adoption by sellers. Further, we show that agents in the economy disagree about the optimal basket composition, but its welfare impacts are small.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，其中篮子支持的稳定币——一种由主权货币组合支持并与之挂钩的货币，如马克·卡尼的“合成霸权货币”或Facebook提出的Libra——被用于交易目的。在模型中，对篮子的需求源于影响对基础主权货币需求的贸易冲击。尽管为篮子提供了合理性，但在数值模拟中，我们的模型预测对篮子的总体需求将较低。这源于篮子货币的一般均衡效应：对篮子的需求创造了对支持它的基础货币的传导需求。这种传导需求稳定了篮子旨在替代的货币的价值，限制了对篮子的需求。我们计算出，来自买方的这种低需求可能会限制卖方的采用。此外，我们表明，经济中的主体对最优篮子组成存在分歧，但其福利影响较小。

records.title_en: Rationally inattentive monetary policy
records.title_cn: 理性疏忽的货币政策
records.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal monetary policy under rational inattention: the policy maker optimally chooses her information subject to a processing constraint. Our analytical results emphasize how the policy maker's information choices shape her expectations and the dynamics of the macroeconomy. Paying attention to demand shocks lowers output volatility and causes untracked supply shocks to drive inflation. Because persistent supply shocks have a minor impact on interest rates under full information in the New Keynesian model, the policy maker should bias her limited attention towards demand shocks. Improvements in information can explain a declining slope of the empirical Phillips curve.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了理性疏忽下的最优货币政策：政策制定者在处理约束下最优地选择其信息。我们的分析结果强调了政策制定者的信息选择如何塑造其预期和宏观经济的动态。关注需求冲击会降低产出波动，并导致未被追踪的供给冲击驱动通货膨胀。由于在新凯恩斯模型中，持续性的供给冲击在完全信息下对利率的影响较小，政策制定者应将其有限注意力偏向需求冲击。信息的改善可以解释经验菲利普斯曲线斜率的下降。

records.title_en: Knowledge, germs, and output
records.title_cn: 知识、病菌与产出
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the equilibrium and the social optimum in an economy where knowledge diffusion interacts with disease transmission. Knowledge increases productivity and is diffused through learning. A learner chooses the intensities in normal learning, isolated learning and production. Normal learning is more effective than isolated learning but requires a learner to contact a teacher. A higher intensity in normal learning increases a learner's contact rate with a teacher, thereby speeding up both knowledge diffusion and the transmission of an infectious pathogen. An infection reduces productivity and possibly results in death. Calibrating the pathogen to Covid-19, the model shows that the unexpected arrival of the pathogen induces a susceptible learner to adjust the normal learning intensity in a V-shaped pattern over time. Aggregate output also follows V-shaped adjustments. Switching from the equilibrium to the social optimum reduces infections and deaths substantially and increases social welfare. I also examine temporary lockdowns in the equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个知识扩散与疾病传播相互作用的经济中的均衡与社会最优。知识提高生产率，并通过学习进行扩散。学习者在正常学习、隔离学习和生产之间选择强度。正常学习比隔离学习更有效，但需要学习者接触教师。正常学习强度的提高增加了学习者与教师的接触率，从而加速了知识扩散和传染性病原体的传播。感染会降低生产率，并可能导致死亡。将病原体校准为Covid-19，模型表明，病原体的意外到来会诱导易感学习者随时间以V形模式调整正常学习强度。总产出也遵循V形调整。从均衡转向社会最优可大幅减少感染和死亡，并增加社会福利。我还考察了均衡中的临时封锁措施。

records.title_en: Social Security reform with heterogeneous mortality
records.title_cn: 异质性死亡率下的社会保障改革
records.abstract_en: Using a heterogeneous agent, life-cycle model of Social Security claiming, labor supply and saving, we consider the implications of lifespan inequality for Social Security reform. Quantitative experiments show that welfare is maximized when baseline benefits are independent of lifetime earnings, the payroll tax cap is 50% larger than its current level, and claiming adjustments are reduced. The Social Security system that would maximize welfare in a “2050 demographics” scenario, characterized by longer lifespans and an increased education-mortality gradient, is similar to the one that would maximize welfare today.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个包含社会保障领取、劳动供给和储蓄的异质性代理人生命周期模型，我们考虑了寿命不平等对社会保障改革的含义。定量实验表明，当基准福利与终生收入无关、工资税上限比当前水平高50%、且领取调整减少时，福利达到最大化。在“2050年人口结构”情景下（其特征为寿命延长和教育-死亡率梯度增大），能够使福利最大化的社会保障体系与当前能够使福利最大化的体系相似。

records.title_en: Human capital and the business cycle effects on the postgraduate wage premium
records.title_cn: 人力资本与商业周期对研究生工资溢价的影响
records.abstract_en: Postgraduate degree holders experience lower cyclical variation in real wages than those with undergraduate degrees. Moreover, postgraduate jobs require more specific human capital. Using an equilibrium search model with dynamic incentive contracts, this paper attributes the cyclicality of the postgraduate-undergraduate wage gap to the differences in specific capital. Greater specific capital leads to lower mobility, thereby improving risk-sharing between workers and firms. The estimates of the model reveal that specific capital can explain the differences both in labour turnover and in real wage cyclicality between education groups.
records.abstract_cn: 研究生学位持有者的实际工资周期波动低于本科学位持有者。此外，研究生工作更需要特定人力资本。本文使用带有动态激励合同的均衡搜索模型，将研究生与本科生工资差距的周期性归因于特定资本的差异。更大的特定资本导致流动性降低，从而改善工人与企业之间的风险分担。模型的估计结果显示，特定资本可以解释不同教育群体在劳动力流动和实际工资周期性方面的差异。

records.title_en: Social Networks with Unobserved Links
records.title_cn: 具有未观测链接的社会网络
records.abstract_en: We point-identify and estimate linear social network models without observing any network links. The required data consist of many small networks of individuals, such as classrooms or villages, with individuals who are each observed only once. We apply our estimator to data from Tennessee’s Project STAR (Student-Teacher Achievement Ratio). Without observing the latent network in each classroom, we identify and estimate peer and contextual effects on students’ performance in mathematics. We find that peer effects tend to be larger in bigger classes and that increasing peer effects would significantly improve students’ average test scores in some classes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在不观测任何网络链接的情况下，对线性社会网络模型进行点识别和估计。所需数据由许多小型个体网络组成，如教室或村庄，其中每个个体仅被观测一次。我们将估计器应用于田纳西州“学生教师成就比率”（Project STAR）的数据。在不观测每个教室中潜在网络的情况下，我们识别并估计了同伴效应和情境效应对学生数学成绩的影响。我们发现，在较大的班级中同伴效应往往更大，且增强同伴效应将显著提高某些班级学生的平均考试成绩。

records.title_en: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies, Quasi Nonergodicity, and Wealth Inequality
records.title_cn: 自我实现的预言、准非遍历性与财富不平等
records.abstract_en: We construct a model of an exchange economy in which agents trade assets contingent on an observable signal, the probability of which depends on public opinion. The agents in our model are replaced occasionally, and each person updates beliefs in response to observed outcomes. We show that the distribution of the observed signal is described by a quasi-nonergodic process and that people continue to disagree with each other forever. These disagreements generate large wealth inequalities that arise from the multiplicative nature of wealth dynamics, which makes successful bold bets highly profitable.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个交换经济模型，其中代理人交易依赖于可观察信号的或有资产，该信号的概率取决于公众舆论。模型中的代理人偶尔会被替换，每个人都会根据观察到的结果更新信念。我们表明，可观察信号的分布由准非遍历过程描述，并且人们会永远持续相互分歧。这些分歧产生了巨大的财富不平等，这些不平等源于财富动态的乘数性质，这使得成功的激进赌注变得高度有利可图。

records.title_en: Race, Representation, and Local Governments in the US South: The Effect of the Voting Rights Act
records.title_cn: 种族、代表与美国南部的地方政府：《投票权法案》的影响
records.abstract_en: The Voting Rights Act of 1965 redefined race relations in the United States. Yet evidence on its effect on Black office holding remains scant. Using novel data on Black elected officials between 1962 and 1980, we assess the impact of the Voting Rights Act on the racial makeup of local governments in the Deep South. Exploiting predetermined differential exposure of Southern counties to the mandated federal intervention, we show that the latter fostered local Black office holding, particularly in the powerful county commissions, controlling local public finances. In the presence of election by district, covered counties experienced Black representation gains and faster capital spending growth.
records.abstract_cn: 1965年的《投票权法案》重新定义了美国的种族关系。然而，关于其对黑人担任公职影响的证据仍然稀少。利用1962年至1980年间关于黑人当选官员的新数据，我们评估了《投票权法案》对深南部地方政府种族构成的影响。利用南方各县对强制性联邦干预的预定差异暴露，我们表明后者促进了地方黑人担任公职，特别是在控制地方公共财政的强大县委员会中。在按选区选举的情况下，被覆盖的县经历了黑人代表权的增加和资本支出增长的加快。

records.title_en: The Multidimensional Impact of Teachers on Students
records.title_cn: 教师对学生影响的多维度分析
records.abstract_en: Test score measures of teacher quality may not fully capture teachers’ impact on students. We use test score and non–test score measures of student achievement and behavior to estimate multiple dimensions of teacher quality. We find that these two measures of teacher quality are only weakly correlated and that both affect students’ high school performance. A teacher removal simulation that uses both measures improves most long-term student outcomes by over 50%, compared to a policy that uses test scores alone. Our results also show that for high school outcomes the effects of teachers in later grades are larger than those in earlier grades and that performance in core elementary school subjects matters more than that in other subjects.
records.abstract_cn: 基于考试成绩的教师质量衡量标准可能无法完全反映教师对学生的影响。我们利用学生的考试成绩和非考试成绩指标来衡量学生成就和行为，从而估计教师质量的多维度。我们发现，这两种教师质量衡量标准仅存在弱相关性，且两者均影响学生的高中表现。一项同时使用这两种衡量标准的教师移除模拟，相较于仅使用考试成绩的政策，能改善大多数长期学生成果超过50%。我们的结果还表明，对于高中成果，高年级教师的影响大于低年级教师，且小学核心科目的表现比其他科目更为重要。

records.title_en: Pricing Currency Risks
records.title_cn: 货币风险定价
records.abstract_en: The currency market features a small cross‐section, and conditional expected returns can be characterized by few signals: interest differential, trend, and mean reversion. We exploit these properties to construct the ex ante mean‐variance efficient portfolio of individual currencies. The portfolio is updated in real time and prices all prominent currency trading strategies, conditionally and unconditionally. The fraction of risk in these assets that does not affect their risk premiums is at least 85%. Extant explanations of carry strategies based on intermediary capital or global volatility are related to these unpriced components, while consumption growth is related to the priced component of returns.
records.abstract_cn: 货币市场具有较小的横截面，条件预期收益可以通过少数信号来刻画：利率差异、趋势和均值回归。我们利用这些特性构建了事前均值-方差有效的单一货币投资组合。该组合实时更新，并在条件和非条件下对所有显著的货币交易策略进行定价。这些资产中不影响其风险溢价的风险比例至少为85%。基于中介资本或全球波动性的利差交易策略的现有解释与这些未定价成分相关，而消费增长则与收益的定价成分相关。

records.title_en: Biased Auctioneers
records.title_cn: 有偏见的拍卖师
records.abstract_en: We construct a neural network algorithm that generates price predictions for art at auction, relying on both visual and nonvisual object characteristics. We find that higher automated valuations relative to auction house presale estimates are associated with substantially higher price‐to‐estimate ratios and lower buy‐in rates, pointing to estimates' informational inefficiency. The relative contribution of machine learning is higher for artists with less dispersed and lower average prices. Furthermore, we show that auctioneers' prediction errors are persistent both at the artist and at the auction house level, and hence directly predictable themselves using information on past errors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个神经网络算法，该算法利用视觉和非视觉对象特征生成艺术品在拍卖中的价格预测。我们发现，相对于拍卖行的预售估价，更高的自动化估值与显著更高的价格-估价比率和更低的买断率相关联，这表明估价存在信息效率低下。机器学习对于价格分散度较低且平均价格较低的艺术家而言，其相对贡献更高。此外，我们表明拍卖师的预测误差在艺术家和拍卖行层面都具有持续性，因此可以直接利用过去误差的信息来预测这些误差本身。

records.title_en: Discount‐Rate Risk in Private Equity: Evidence from Secondary Market Transactions
records.title_cn: 私募股权中的折现率风险：来自二级市场交易的证据
records.abstract_en: Measures of private equity (PE) performance based on cash flows do not account for a discount‐rate risk premium that is a component of the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) alpha. We create secondary market PE indices and find that PE discount rates vary considerably. Net asset values are too smooth because they fail to reflect variation in discount rates. Although the CAPM alpha for our index is zero, the generalized public market equivalent based on cash flows is large and positive. We obtain similar results for a set of synthetic funds that invest in small cap stocks. Ignoring variation in PE discount rates can lead to a misallocation of capital.
records.abstract_cn: 基于现金流的私募股权（PE）业绩衡量指标并未考虑作为资本资产定价模型（CAPM）阿尔法组成部分的折现率风险溢价。我们构建了二级市场PE指数，发现PE折现率波动显著。净资产价值过于平滑，因为它们未能反映折现率的变化。尽管我们指数的CAPM阿尔法为零，但基于现金流的广义公开市场等价物却大且为正。我们对于一组投资于小盘股的综合基金获得了类似的结果。忽视PE折现率的变动可能导致资本配置不当。

records.title_en: Do Municipal Bond Dealers Give Their Customers “Fair and Reasonable” Pricing?
records.title_cn: 市政债券交易商是否给予其客户“公平合理”的定价？
records.abstract_en: Municipal bonds exhibit considerable retail pricing variation, even for same‐size trades of the same bond on the same day, and even from the same dealer. Markups vary widely across dealers. Trading strongly clusters on eighth price increments, and clustered trades exhibit higher markups. Yields are often lowered to just above salient numbers. Machine learning estimates exploiting the richness of the data show that dealers that use strategic pricing have systematically higher markups. Recent Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board rules have had only a limited impact on markups. While a subset of dealers focus on best execution, many dealers appear focused on opportunistic pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 市政债券表现出相当大的零售定价差异，即使是同一债券在同一天进行的相同规模交易，甚至来自同一交易商也是如此。加价在不同交易商之间差异很大。交易强烈聚集在八分之一价格增量上，且聚集交易表现出更高的加价。收益率通常被降低至略高于显著数字的水平。利用数据丰富性的机器学习估计表明，采用策略性定价的交易商具有系统性地更高的加价。最近市政证券规则制定委员会的规则对加价的影响有限。虽然一部分交易商专注于最佳执行，但许多交易商似乎专注于机会主义定价。

records.title_en: Information Aggregation via Contracting
records.title_cn: 通过契约实现信息聚合
records.abstract_en: When a group of investors with dispersed private information jointly invest in a risky project, how should they divide the project's profit? We show that a simple contract dividing profits in proportion to investors' risk tolerances may facilitate information aggregation by altering investors' risk‐taking incentives when they decide on how investment strategies respond to private information. Our results provide a contracting‐based approach for information aggregation, which is an alternative to learning from endogenous market variables (e.g., prices) via contingent schedules as seen in well‐known rational expectations equilibrium models.
records.abstract_cn: 当一组拥有分散私人信息的投资者共同投资于一个风险项目时，他们应如何分配项目利润？我们表明，一种按投资者风险容忍度比例分配利润的简单契约，可能通过改变投资者在决定投资策略如何应对私人信息时的风险承担激励，来促进信息聚合。我们的结果为信息聚合提供了一种基于契约的方法，这是对通过或有计划（如价格）从内生市场变量中学习的替代方案，正如著名的理性预期均衡模型中所见。

records.title_en: Equilibrium Bitcoin Pricing
records.title_cn: 比特币的均衡定价
records.abstract_en: We offer a general equilibrium analysis of cryptocurrency pricing. The fundamental value of the cryptocurrency is its stream of net transactional benefits, which depend on its future prices. This implies that, in addition to fundamentals, equilibrium prices reflect sunspots. This in turn implies multiple equilibria and extrinsic volatility, that is, cryptocurrency prices fluctuate even when fundamentals are constant. To match our model to the data, we construct indices measuring the net transactional benefits of Bitcoin. In our calibration, part of the variations in Bitcoin returns reflects changes in net transactional benefits, but a larger share reflects extrinsic volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对加密货币定价进行了一般均衡分析。加密货币的基本价值是其净交易收益流，这取决于其未来价格。这意味着，除了基本面因素外，均衡价格还反映了太阳黑子。这进而意味着多重均衡和外在波动性，即即使基本面保持不变，加密货币价格也会波动。为了使我们的模型与数据相匹配，我们构建了衡量比特币净交易收益的指数。在我们的校准中，比特币收益变动的一部分反映了净交易收益的变化，但更大份额反映了外在波动性。

records.title_en: Local Experiences, Search, and Spillovers in the Housing Market
records.title_cn: 住房市场中的本地经验、搜索与溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Recent local price growth explains differences in search behavior across prospective homebuyers. Those experiencing higher growth in their postcode of residence search more broadly across locations and house characteristics, without changing attention devoted to individual sales listings, and have shorter search duration. Effects are stronger for homeowners, in particular those living in less wealthy areas and looking for a new primary residence. We use reduced‐form analysis and a quantitative equilibrium model to show that the expansion of search breadth translates into widespread spillovers onto house sales prices and inventories of listings across postcodes within a metropolitan area.
records.abstract_cn: 近期本地价格增长解释了潜在购房者搜索行为的差异。那些在其居住邮政编码区经历较高价格增长的人，在位置和房屋特征上的搜索范围更广，但对单个销售列表的关注度并未改变，且搜索持续时间更短。这种效应对于房主更为显著，尤其是那些居住在较不富裕地区并寻找新主要住所的房主。我们使用简化形式分析和定量均衡模型来表明，搜索广度的扩展会转化为对都市区内各邮政编码区房屋销售价格和挂牌库存的广泛溢出效应。

records.title_en: Model Secrecy and Stress Tests
records.title_cn: 模型保密与压力测试
records.abstract_en: Should regulators reveal the models they use to stress‐test banks? In our setting, revealing leads to gaming, but secrecy can induce banks to underinvest in socially desirable assets for fear of failing the test. We show that although the regulator can solve this underinvestment problem by making the test easier, some disclosure may still be optimal (e.g., if banks have high appetite for risk or if capital shortfalls are not very costly). Cutoff rules are optimal within monotone disclosure rules, but more generally optimal disclosure is single‐peaked. We discuss policy implications and offer applications beyond stress tests.
records.abstract_cn: 监管机构是否应披露其用于对银行进行压力测试的模型？在我们的设定中，披露会导致博弈行为，但保密可能促使银行因担心测试失败而对具有社会价值的资产投资不足。我们表明，尽管监管机构可以通过使测试更容易来解决这一投资不足问题，但某些披露仍可能是最优的（例如，如果银行有较高的风险偏好或资本短缺成本不高）。在单调披露规则中，截断规则是最优的，但更一般地，最优披露是单峰的。我们讨论了政策含义，并提供了压力测试之外的应用。

records.title_en: The Gender Gap in Housing Returns
records.title_cn: 住房回报中的性别差距
records.abstract_en: Using detailed transactions data across the United States, we find that single women earn 1.5 percentage points lower annualized returns on housing relative to single men. Forty‐five percent of the gap is explained by transaction timing and location. The remaining gap arises from a 2% gender difference in execution prices at purchase and sale. Consistent with a negotiation channel, women list for less and experience worse negotiated discounts. The gender gap shrinks in tight markets, where negotiation is replaced by quasi‐auctions. Overall, gender differences in housing explain 30% of the gender gap in wealth accumulation for the median household.
records.abstract_cn: 使用美国各地的详细交易数据，我们发现，相对于单身男性，单身女性的住房年化回报率要低 1.5 个百分点。百分之四十五的差距是由交易时间和地点造成的。剩下的差距是由于购买和销售执行价格中的 2% 性别差异造成的。与谈判渠道一致，女性列出的商品价格较低，并且经历的谈判折扣也较差。在紧张的市场中，性别差距缩小，谈判被准拍卖所取代。总体而言，住房方面的性别差异解释了中位家庭财富积累方面的性别差距30%。

records.title_en: Monetary Stimulus amidst the Infrastructure Investment Spree: Evidence from China's Loan‐Level Data
records.title_cn: 基础设施投资热潮中的货币刺激：来自中国贷款层面数据的证据
records.abstract_en: We study how a fiscal expansion via infrastructure investment influences the dynamic impacts of monetary stimulus on credit allocation. We develop a two‐stage approach and apply it to the Chinese economy with a confidential loan‐level data set that covers all sectors. We find that infrastructure investment significantly weakened monetary policy's transmission to credit allocated to private firms, while reinforcing the monetary effects on loans to state‐owned firms. This fiscal‐monetary interaction channel is key to understanding the preferential credit access enjoyed by state‐owned firms during the stimulus period. Consequently, monetary stimulus crowded out private investment and decreased capital allocation efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究通过基础设施投资进行的财政扩张如何影响货币刺激对信贷配置的动态影响。我们开发了一种两阶段方法，并将其应用于覆盖所有部门的机密贷款层面数据集的中国经济。我们发现，基础设施投资显著削弱了货币政策向私营企业信贷的传导，同时增强了货币对国有企业贷款的影响。这种财政-货币互动渠道是理解刺激期间国有企业享有优惠信贷准入的关键。因此，货币刺激挤出了私人投资并降低了资本配置效率。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Endogenous Lemon Markets: Risky Choices and Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 内生柠檬市场：风险选择与逆向选择
records.abstract_en: The severity of adverse selection depends, to a great extent, on the underlying distribution of the asset. This distribution is commonly modeled as exogenous; however, in many real-world applications, it is determined endogenously. A natural question in this context is whether one can predict the severity of the adverse selection problem in such environments. In this paper, we study a bilateral trade model in which the distribution of the asset is affected by pre-trade unobservable actions of the seller. Analyzing general trade mechanisms, we show that the seller’s actions are characterized by a risk-seeking disposition. In addition, we show that (location-independent) riskier underlying distributions of the asset induce lower social welfare. That is, “lemon markets” arise endogenously in these environments.
records.abstract_cn: 逆向选择的严重程度在很大程度上取决于资产的潜在分布。这种分布通常被建模为外生的；然而，在许多现实世界的应用中，它是由内生决定的。在这种背景下，一个自然的问题是，人们能否预测此类环境中逆向选择问题的严重程度。在本文中，我们研究了一个双边贸易模型，其中资产的分布受到卖方交易前不可观察行为的影响。通过分析一般贸易机制，我们表明卖方的行为具有风险寻求倾向的特征。此外，我们表明，（位置无关的）风险更高的资产潜在分布会导致更低的社会福利。也就是说，“柠檬市场”在这些环境中内生地出现。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: European Firm Concentration and Aggregate Productivity
records.title_cn: 欧洲企业集中度与总体生产率
records.abstract_en: This paper derives a European Herfindahl–Hirschman concentration index from 15 micro-aggregated country datasets. In the last decade, European concentration rose due to a reallocation of economic activity toward large and concentrated industries. Over the same period, productivity gains from an increasing allocative efficiency of the European market accounted for 50% of European productivity growth while markups stayed constant. Using country-industry variation, we show that changes in concentration are positively associated with changes in productivity and allocative efficiency. This holds across most sectors and countries and supports the notion that rising concentration in Europe reflects a more efficient market environment rather than weak competition and rising market power.
records.abstract_cn: 本文从15个微观聚合国家数据集中推导出欧洲赫芬达尔-赫希曼集中度指数。在过去十年中，欧洲集中度因经济活动向大型和集中行业重新配置而上升。同期，欧洲市场配置效率提高带来的生产率收益占欧洲生产率增长的50%，而加成率保持不变。利用国家-行业层面的变化，我们表明集中度的变化与生产率和配置效率的变化正相关。这在大多数行业和国家中均成立，并支持了欧洲集中度上升反映的是更有效的市场环境而非竞争疲弱和市场力量增强的观点。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Firms and Collective Reputation: a Study of the Volkswagen Emissions Scandal
records.title_cn: 企业与集体声誉：大众汽车排放丑闻研究
records.abstract_en: This paper uses the 2015 Volkswagen (VW) emissions scandal as a natural experiment to provide evidence that collective reputation externalities are economically significant. Using a combination of difference-in-differences and demand estimation approaches, we document a spillover effect from the scandal to the non-VW German auto manufacturers. The spillover amounts to an average drop of $2,057 in consumer valuations of these manufacturers’ vehicles and a 34.6% reduction in their annual sales. We substantiate our interpretation that the estimates reflect a reputation spillover using data on internet search behavior and direct measures of consumer sentiment from Twitter.
records.abstract_cn: 本文以2015年大众汽车排放丑闻作为自然实验，提供证据表明集体声誉外部性在经济上具有重要意义。通过结合双重差分法和需求估计方法，我们记录了该丑闻对非大众德国汽车制造商的溢出效应。这种溢出效应导致消费者对这些制造商汽车的估值平均下降2,057美元，年销量减少34.6%。我们利用互联网搜索行为数据和来自Twitter的消费者情绪直接测量数据，证实了我们的解释，即这些估计反映了声誉溢出效应。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Housing Insecurity and Homelessness: Evidence from the United Kingdom
records.title_cn: 住房不安全与无家可归：来自英国的证据
records.abstract_en: Homelessness and precarious living conditions are on the rise across much of the Western world. This paper exploits quasi-exogenous variation in the affordability of rents due to a cut in rent subsidies for low-income households in the United Kingdom in April 2011. Using comprehensive district-level administrative data, we show that the affordability shock caused a significant increase in financial distress, evictions, property crimes, insecure temporary housing arrangements, statutory homelessness, and actual rough sleeping. The most notable rise in statutory homelessness is driven by families with children, lone parents, individuals with existing health conditions, and as a result of having been evicted. We estimate that the fiscal savings were low and shifted toward the local administration: Savings by the central government were partially offset by an increase in council spending to meet statutory obligations for homelessness.
records.abstract_cn: 在西方世界的大部分地区，无家可归和不稳定的生活条件正在上升。本文利用英国2011年四月削减低收入家庭租金补贴所导致的租金可负担性的准外生变化。使用全面的区级行政数据，我们表明，可负担性冲击导致了财务困境、驱逐、财产犯罪、不安全的临时住房安排、法定无家可归和实际露宿街头的显著增加。法定无家可归最显著的上升是由有子女的家庭、单亲父母、已有健康问题的个人以及因被驱逐所致。我们估计，财政节省较低，且转向地方行政：中央政府的节省部分被地方议会为履行无家可归法定义务而增加的开支所抵消。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Inattentive Inference
records.title_cn: 疏忽推断
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how people infer a state of the world from information structures that include additional, payoff-irrelevant states. For example, learning from a customer review about a product’s quality requires accounting for the reviewer’s otherwise-irrelevant taste. This creates an attribution problem common to all information structures with multiple causes. We report controlled experimental evidence for pervasive overinference about states that affect utility—a form of “omitted variable bias” in belief updating, providing an explanation for various misattribution patterns. In studying why systematic misattribution arises, we consistently find that errors are not due to deliberate effort avoidance or a lack of cognitive capacity. Instead, people behave as if they form incomplete mental models of the information structure and fail to notice the need to account for alternative causes. These mental models are not stable but context-dependent: Misattribution responds to a variety of attentional manipulations, but not to changes in the costs of inattention.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究人们如何从包含额外、与收益无关的状态的信息结构中推断世界状态。例如，从关于产品质量的客户评论中学习，需要考虑评论者原本无关的品味。这产生了一个归因问题，该问题在所有具有多种原因的信息结构中普遍存在。我们报告了受控实验证据，表明对影响效用的状态存在普遍的过度推断——一种信念更新中的“遗漏变量偏差”，为各种错误归因模式提供了解释。在研究系统性错误归因为何产生时，我们一致发现错误并非源于故意回避努力或缺乏认知能力。相反，人们表现得好像形成了对信息结构的不完整心智模型，并且未能注意到需要考虑替代原因。这些心智模型并非稳定，而是依赖于情境的：错误归因对各种注意力操纵有反应，但对不注意成本的改变没有反应。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Investment Funds, Monetary Policy, and the Global Financial Cycle
records.title_cn: 投资基金、货币政策与全球金融周期
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the role of international investment funds in the transmission of global financial conditions to the euro area using structural Bayesian vector auto regressions. While cross-border banking sector capital flows receded significantly in the aftermath of the global financial crisis, portfolio flows from investors actively searching for yield on financial markets worldwide gained importance during the post-crisis “second phase of global liquidity”. The analysis presented in this paper shows that a loosening of US monetary policy leads to higher investment fund inflows to equities and debt globally. Focussing on the euro area, these inflows not only imply elevated asset prices but also coincide with increased debt and equity issuance. The findings demonstrate the growing importance of non-bank financial intermediation over the past decade and hold important policy implications for monetary and financial stability.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用结构贝叶斯向量自回归模型，考察了国际投资基金在全球金融状况向欧元区传导中的作用。在全球金融危机之后，跨境银行部门资本流动显著回落，而投资者在全球金融市场上积极寻求收益的投资组合流动，在危机后的“全球流动性第二阶段”中变得更为重要。本文的分析表明，美国货币政策的宽松导致全球股票和债务投资基金流入增加。聚焦欧元区，这些流入不仅意味着资产价格上升，还伴随着债务和股票发行的增加。研究结果凸显了过去十年非银行金融中介日益增长的重要性，并对货币和金融稳定具有重要的政策含义。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: The Real Exchange Rate, Innovation, and Productivity
records.title_cn: 实际汇率、创新与生产率
records.abstract_en: We build a dynamic heterogeneous-firm model in which real depreciations raise export demand and the cost of importing intermediates, and also affect borrowing constraints and the profitability of engaging in research and development (R&D). A number of stylized facts on manufacturing firms for a large set of countries discipline our estimation: Firms in emerging East Asia are very export oriented and rely little on imported intermediates, whereas the opposite holds for Latin America and Eastern Europe; firms from industrialized countries export as much as they import. Exporters experience an increase in cash flow, R&D, and productivity growth in response to real exchange rate (RER) depreciations; importers experience the opposite outcomes. In counterfactual simulations of temporary RER movements, the effects on innovation and productivity growth are heterogeneous across regions, sizeable and persistent. In emerging Asia, real depreciations are associated with higher probabilities to engage in R&D, faster growth of average firm-level productivity and cash flow, and higher export entry rates; we find negative average effects on these outcomes for firms in other emerging economies, and no significant average effects for firms in industrialized economies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个动态异质性企业模型，在该模型中，实际贬值提高了出口需求和进口中间品的成本，同时也影响借款约束以及从事研发（R&D）的盈利能力。针对大量国家的制造业企业的一系列典型事实约束了我们的估计：东亚新兴经济体的企业非常倾向于出口，且对进口中间品的依赖较少，而拉丁美洲和东欧的情况则相反；工业化国家的企业出口与进口相当。出口企业面对实际汇率（RER）贬值时，现金流、研发和生产率增长会有所增加；进口企业则面临相反的结果。在临时性实际汇率变动的反事实模拟中，对创新和生产率增长的影响在不同地区间存在异质性，且影响显著且持久。在亚洲新兴经济体，实际贬值与更高的研发参与概率、企业平均生产率和现金流的更快增长以及更高的出口进入率相关；对于其他新兴经济体的企业，我们发现这些结果的平均效应为负，而对于工业化经济体的企业，则没有显著的平均效应。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: City of Dreams
records.title_cn: 梦想之城
records.abstract_en: Bigger cities offer more valuable experiences and opportunities in exchange for higher housing costs. While higher-ability workers benefit more from bigger cities, they are not more likely to move to one. Our model of urban sorting by workers with heterogeneous self-confidence and ability suggests flawed self-assessment is partly to blame. Analysis of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 data shows that, consistent with our model, young workers with high self-confidence are more likely to locate in a big city initially. For more experienced workers, ability plays a stronger role in determining location choices, but the lasting impact of earlier choices dampens their incentives to move.
records.abstract_cn: 更大的城市提供更有价值的体验和机会，但代价是更高的住房成本。虽然能力更强的工人从大城市中获益更多，但他们并不更有可能迁往大城市。我们的模型考虑了具有异质性自信和能力的工作者的城市选择，表明有缺陷的自我评估是部分原因。对1979年全国青年纵向调查数据的分析显示，与我们的模型一致，自信高的年轻工人更有可能最初定居在大城市。对于更有经验的工人，能力在决定地点选择中发挥更强的作用，但早期选择的持久影响削弱了他们搬迁的激励。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Terrorism, Media Coverage, and Education: Evidence from al-Shabaab Attacks in Kenya
records.title_cn: 恐怖主义、媒体报道与教育：来自肯尼亚青年党袭击的证据
records.abstract_en: We relate terrorist attacks to media signal coverage and schooling in Kenya to examine how terrorism alters the demand for education through perceived risks and returns. Exploiting variation in wireless signal coverage and attacks across space and time, we establish that media access reinforces negative effects of terrorism on schooling. Our results are robust to instrumenting both media signal and attacks. We also find that attacks raise self-reported fears for households with media access. Based on these insights, we estimate a simple structural model where heterogeneous households experiencing terrorism form beliefs about risks and returns to education. We allow these beliefs to be affected by media and find that households with media access significantly over-estimate fatality risks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将恐怖袭击与肯尼亚的媒体信号覆盖和学校教育联系起来，以考察恐怖主义如何通过感知风险和回报改变对教育的需求。利用无线信号覆盖和袭击在空间和时间上的变化，我们确定媒体接入强化了恐怖主义对学校教育的负面影响。我们的结果在对媒体信号和袭击进行工具变量处理后依然稳健。我们还发现，袭击提高了有媒体接入家庭的自报恐惧。基于这些见解，我们估计了一个简单的结构模型，其中经历恐怖主义的异质性家庭形成对教育风险和回报的信念。我们允许这些信念受到媒体的影响，并发现有媒体接入的家庭显著高估了死亡风险。

records.journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association
records.title_en: Ballots Instead of Bullets? The Effect of the Voting Rights Act on Political Violence
records.title_cn: 用选票代替子弹？《投票权法案》对政治暴力的影响
records.abstract_en: The extension of voting rights epitomizes the construction of modern democracies. This paper empirically investigates the effect of such an enfranchisement on political violence in the context of the US Voting Rights Act (VRA) of 1965, which forbade discrimination in voting. The formula the VRA used to determine the counties it applied to generated both geographic and temporal local discontinuities in enfranchisement. This paper’s empirical strategy takes advantage of these features by comparing the evolution of political violence in geographically close covered and non-covered counties. Difference-in-differences estimates indicate that VRA coverage halved the incidence and the onset of political violence. Additional empirical evidence implies that voting became the new institutionalized way to state political preferences. Indeed, VRA coverage mostly decreased electoral and small-scale strategic violence. This result is not explained by disaggrievement. Extensions suggest that new strategies of political action may explain a decrease in violence after enfranchisement.
records.abstract_cn: 投票权的扩展是现代民主国家建设的缩影。本文以1965年禁止投票歧视的美国《投票权法案》（VRA）为背景，实证研究了这种赋权对政治暴力的影响。VRA用于确定其适用县的公式在赋权方面产生了地理和时间上的局部不连续性。本文的实证策略利用这些特征，比较了地理位置接近的覆盖县和非覆盖县政治暴力的演变。双重差分估计表明，VRA覆盖使政治暴力的发生率和爆发率减半。额外的实证证据表明，投票成为表达政治偏好的新的制度化方式。事实上，VRA覆盖主要减少了选举性和小规模战略性暴力。这一结果并不能用不满情绪来解释。扩展研究表明，新的政治行动策略可能解释了赋权后暴力的减少。

records.title_en: The Material basis of Cooperation: how Scarcity Reduces Trusting Behaviour
records.title_cn: 合作的物质基础：稀缺如何减少信任行为
records.abstract_en: Trusting behaviour is a cornerstone of cooperation and, hence, economic performance, not least in poorer communities where economic transactions often rely on informal agreements. But trusting behaviour is potentially costly since the counterpart may decide to defect. In this study, we investigate whether food scarcity influences the level of trusting behaviour in rural Tanzania by leveraging quasi-experimental variation in food supply induced by the harvest. Through a lab-in-the-field experiment, we document that farmers display lower levels of trusting behaviour during the lean season compared to the abundant season and show that the difference is explained by variation in food scarcity.
records.abstract_cn: 信任行为是合作乃至经济表现的基石，尤其是在经济交易往往依赖非正式协议的较贫困社区中。但信任行为可能代价高昂，因为对方可能选择背叛。在本研究中，我们利用收获引起的食物供应的准实验性变化，调查食物稀缺是否影响坦桑尼亚农村地区的信任行为水平。通过实地实验，我们记录了农民在淡季相比丰收季节表现出较低的信任行为水平，并表明这种差异是由食物稀缺的变化所解释的。

records.title_en: Shaking Legitimacy: The Impact of Earthquakes on Conflict in Historical China
records.title_cn: 动摇合法性：历史中国地震对冲突的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the causal effect of political legitimacy on stability, using the historical case of Imperial China. Chinese rulers ascribed their legitimacy to a heavenly mandate. Calamities like earthquakes were considered to be a sign of weakened approval, making quakes a proxy for a negative legitimacy shock. I use quake-induced minor shaking (i.e., strong enough to be felt, but too weak to cause material damage) to demonstrate that legitimacy shocks cause more conflicts. I examine whether quakes serve as a coordination device to overcome collective action problems.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中华帝国的历史案例，考察政治合法性对稳定性的因果效应。中国统治者将其合法性归于天命。地震等灾难被视为上天认可减弱的迹象，使地震成为负面合法性冲击的代理变量。我利用地震引起的轻微震动（即，强烈到足以被感觉到，但太弱以至于不会造成物质损害）来证明合法性冲击会导致更多冲突。我考察地震是否作为协调机制以克服集体行动问题。

records.title_en: The Coronavirus Stimulus Package: How Large is the Transfer Multiplier
records.title_cn: 冠状病毒刺激计划：转移乘数有多大
records.abstract_en: In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, large parts of the economy were locked down and, as a result, households’ income risk rose sharply. At the same time, policy makers put forward the largest stimulus package in history. In the United States it amounted to $2 trillion, a quarter of which represented transfer payments to households. To the extent that such transfers were (i) announced in advance and (ii) conditional on recipients being unemployed, they mitigated income risk associated with the lockdown—in contrast to unconditional transfers. We develop a baseline scenario for a COVID-19 recession in a medium-scale heterogeneous agent new Keynesian model and use counterfactuals to quantify the impact of transfers. For the short run, we find large differences in the transfer multiplier: it is negligible for unconditional transfers and about unity for conditional transfers. Overall, we find that the transfers reduced the output loss due to the pandemic by some two percentage points at its trough.
records.abstract_cn: 为了应对新冠肺炎19大流行，大部分经济领域被封锁，家庭收入风险因此急剧上升。与此同时，政策制定者提出了历史上最大规模的刺激计划。在美国，这一数字达到2万亿美元，其中四分之一是对家庭的转移支付。如果此类转移支付（i）提前宣布且（ii）以受助人失业为条件，则可以减轻与封锁相关的收入风险——与无条件转移支付不同。我们在中等规模异构主体新凯恩斯主义模型中制定了 COVID-19 衰退的基准情景，并使用反事实来量化转移的影响。从短期来看，我们发现转移乘数存在很大差异：无条件转移可以忽略不计，而有条件转移则可以忽略不计。总体而言，我们发现转移支付将疫情造成的产出损失减少了约两个百分点。

records.title_en: Long-Run Effects of Aid: Forecasts and Evidence from Sierra Leone
records.title_cn: 援助的长期效应：来自塞拉利昂的预测与证据
records.abstract_en: We evaluate the long-run effects of a decentralised approach to economic development called community-driven development—a prominent strategy for delivering foreign aid—by revisiting a randomised community-driven development program in Sierra Leone 11 years after launch. We estimate large persistent gains in local public goods and market activity, and modest positive effects on institutions. There is suggestive evidence that community-driven development may have slightly improved the communities’ response to the 2014 Ebola epidemic. We compare estimates to the forecasts of experts from Sierra Leone and abroad, working in policy and academia, and find that local policymakers are overly optimistic about the effectiveness of community-driven development.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过重新审视塞拉利昂一个随机化的社区驱动发展项目在启动11年后的情况，评估了这种名为社区驱动发展的分散式经济发展方法——一种提供外国援助的重要策略——的长期效应。我们估计，地方公共物品和市场活动出现了大幅且持续的收益，对制度产生了适度的积极影响。有提示性证据表明，社区驱动发展可能略微改善了社区对2014年埃博拉疫情的应对。我们将估计结果与来自塞拉利昂及国外的政策界和学术界专家的预测进行比较，发现当地政策制定者对社区驱动发展的有效性过于乐观。

records.title_en: Demand- Versus Supply-Side Climate Policies with a Carbon Dioxide Ceiling
records.title_cn: 需求侧与供给侧气候政策：以二氧化碳上限为约束
records.abstract_en: In a Hotelling model with a climate coalition and a free-riding fringe, we compare demand-side and supply-side climate policies aimed at keeping CO$_2$ concentration below a ceiling equivalent to global warming of $2^\circ{\rm C}$. With the demand-side policy, the coalition caps its fuel demand. The corresponding allocation is intra-temporally distorted. With the supply-side policy, the coalition purchases deposits. The corresponding allocation is inter-temporally distorted and the fuel extraction path can be discontinuous. In an empirically calibrated economy, a medium-sized (the grand) coalition is stable with the demand-side (supply-side) policy. If the coalition acts strategically, the stable grand coalition implements first best.
records.abstract_cn: 在一个包含气候联盟和搭便车外围国家的霍特林模型中，我们比较了旨在将二氧化碳浓度控制在相当于全球变暖2°C上限以下的需求侧和供给侧气候政策。在需求侧政策下，联盟限制其燃料需求。相应的配置存在跨期扭曲。在供给侧政策下，联盟购买矿藏。相应的配置存在跨期扭曲，且燃料开采路径可能不连续。在一个经验校准的经济体中，中等规模（大）联盟在需求侧（供给侧）政策下是稳定的。如果联盟采取策略性行为，稳定的大联盟将实现最优结果。

records.title_en: Time of Day and High-Stake Cognitive Assessments
records.title_cn: 一天中的时间与高风险认知评估
records.abstract_en: A variety of external conditions may affect individual performance in high-stake cognitive assessments, with potentially lasting consequences on earnings and career. We provide the first causal evidence that the time of the day is an important condition affecting the performance at the moment of an evaluation. Exploiting a setting in which cognitive assessments are quasi-randomly assigned at a different time of day, we find that peak performance occurs in the early afternoon. The estimated time-of-day effects follow specific patterns consistent with the circadian rhythm, which suggests that biological factors are important determinants of performance even in economically meaningful settings.
records.abstract_cn: 多种外部条件可能影响个体在高风险认知评估中的表现，并可能对收入和职业产生持久影响。我们提供了首个因果证据，表明一天中的时间是影响评估时刻表现的重要条件。利用认知评估在一天中不同时间准随机分配的情境，我们发现表现峰值出现在下午早些时候。估计的时间效应遵循与昼夜节律一致的具体模式，这表明即使在具有经济意义的场景中，生物因素也是表现的重要决定因素。

records.title_en: Steering Fallible Consumers
records.title_cn: 引导易犯错误的消费者
records.abstract_en: Online intermediaries with information about a consumer’s tendencies often ‘steer’ her toward products she is more likely to purchase. We analyse the welfare implications of this practice for ‘fallible’ consumers, who make statistical and strategic mistakes in evaluating offers. The welfare effects depend on the nature and quality of the intermediary’s information and on properties of the consumer’s mistakes. In particular, steering based on high-quality information about the consumer’s mistakes is typically harmful, sometimes extremely so. We argue that much real-life steering is of this type, raising the scope for a broader regulation of steering practices.
records.abstract_cn: 掌握消费者倾向信息的在线中介机构常常会‘引导’她购买更可能购买的产品。我们分析了这种做法对‘易犯错误’消费者的福利影响，这些消费者在评估报价时会犯统计和战略错误。福利效应取决于中介机构信息的性质和质量以及消费者错误的特性。特别是，基于关于消费者错误的高质量信息进行的引导通常是有害的，有时甚至极其有害。我们认为，现实生活中的许多引导都属于这种类型，这为更广泛地监管引导行为提供了空间。

records.title_en: Connecting the Young: High School Graduates’ Matching to First Jobs in Booms and Great Recessions
records.title_cn: 连接年轻人：高中毕业生在经济繁荣和大衰退时期的首份工作匹配
records.abstract_en: Using Swedish economy-wide data, we examine the relationship between business-cycle conditions and the use of social contacts in the process where young workers are matched to their first real jobs. We measure social contacts acquired during paid work during high school, and we rely on interacted class-establishment fixed-effect models to isolate the effects of interest. One-third of post-graduation matches are formed at establishments where youths worked during their studies. Graduates are much more likely to match with sites to which adult co-workers from these jobs have relocated. The importance of these job-finding channels is strongly counter-cyclical for young labour market entrants.
records.abstract_cn: 利用瑞典全国经济数据，我们考察了商业周期条件与年轻工人在匹配其首份实际工作过程中使用社会关系之间的关系。我们衡量了高中期间有偿工作中获得的社会关系，并依赖交互的班级-机构固定效应模型来隔离感兴趣的影响。毕业后三分之一的匹配是在青年学习期间工作的机构形成的。毕业生更有可能与这些工作中的成年同事已迁往的地点匹配。这些求职渠道的重要性对年轻劳动力市场进入者而言具有强烈的逆周期性。

records.title_en: Optimal Fiscal Consolidation Under Frictional Financial Markets
records.title_cn: 摩擦性金融市场下的最优财政整顿
records.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal fiscal policy in a currency union subject to capital flow shocks in an economy with two main ingredients: (i) sticky prices and (ii) financially constrained arbitrageurs. Given capital outflows and high external debt, the fiscal authority faces a trade-off between stimulating the economy or paying off external debt. The planner reduces the value-added tax in the short run, while it raises and front-loads the sum of value-added tax and payroll taxes. It is not optimal to use spending to stimulate the economy. The country engages in a fiscal consolidation, as government debt falls compared with a passive fiscal policy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在货币联盟中，面对资本流动冲击的经济体中的最优财政政策，该经济体具有两个主要特征：（i）价格粘性和（ii）受金融约束的套利者。鉴于资本外流和高外部债务，财政当局面临刺激经济或偿还外部债务之间的权衡。计划者在短期内降低增值税，同时提高并前置增值税和工资税的总和。使用支出刺激经济并非最优选择。与被动财政政策相比，政府债务下降，国家进行财政整顿。

records.title_en: Employment Decline During the Great Recession: the Role of Firm Size Distribution
records.title_cn: 大衰退期间的就业下降：企业规模分布的作用
records.abstract_en: Over 8,000,000 jobs were lost in the Great Recession, creating widespread economic hardship. This paper documents a novel and robust empirical regularity that highly concentrated local labour markets experienced larger employment declines during the Great Recession. Through setting up a model with heterogeneous firms facing idiosyncratic productivity shocks, I show that firm size distribution summarised by the Herfindahl-Hirschman index plays a crucial role in the reallocation of workers, and it magnifies negative idiosyncratic shocks and attenuates positive ones. I undertake a series of empirical tests to rule out alternative explanations, and show that large employment losses in concentrated labour markets are not driven by highly concentrated industry locations being hit harder during the Great Recession, having smaller labour markets or higher firm leverage ratios. The effect of concentration level is larger in sectors with higher labour supply elasticity, or a higher variance of productivity shocks, and rises during the Great Recession compared to other periods, consistent with my model’s predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 大衰退期间损失了超过8,000,000个工作岗位，造成了广泛的经济困难。本文记录了一个新颖且稳健的经验规律：高度集中的地方劳动力市场在大衰退期间经历了更大的就业下降。通过建立一个具有异质性企业并面临特质性生产率冲击的模型，我表明以赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数概括的企业规模分布在工人重新配置中起着关键作用，并且它放大了负面的特质性冲击，削弱了正面的冲击。我进行了一系列实证检验以排除其他解释，并表明集中劳动力市场中的大量就业损失并非由高度集中的行业所在地在大衰退期间受到更严重打击、拥有更小的劳动力市场或更高的企业杠杆率所驱动。集中度的影响在劳动力供给弹性较高或生产率冲击方差较大的部门中更大，并且在大衰退期间相对于其他时期有所上升，这与我的模型预测一致。

records.title_en: Shifting Punishment onto Minorities: Experimental Evidence of Scapegoating
records.title_cn: 将惩罚转嫁给少数群体：替罪羊行为的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Do members of a majority group systematically shift punishment onto innocent members of an ethnic minority? We introduce an experimental paradigm, punishing the scapegoat game, to measure how injustice affecting a member of one's own group shapes punishment of an unrelated bystander. When no harm is done, we find no evidence of discrimination against the ethnic minority (Roma people in Slovakia). In contrast, when a member of one's own group is harmed, the punishment ‘passed’ onto innocent individuals more than doubles when they are from the minority, as compared to when they are from the dominant group.
records.abstract_cn: 多数群体的成员是否会系统性地将惩罚转嫁给无辜的少数族裔成员？我们引入了一种实验范式，即惩罚替罪羊博弈，来衡量影响自己群体成员的不公正如何塑造对无关旁观者的惩罚。当没有伤害发生时，我们没有发现对少数族裔（斯洛伐克的罗姆人）的歧视证据。相反，当自己群体的成员受到伤害时，转嫁给无辜个体的惩罚在对方来自少数群体时比对方来自主导群体时增加了一倍以上。

records.title_en: Dating the Lender of Last Resort
records.title_cn: 为最后贷款人定年
records.abstract_en: We exploit a fixed rule constraining central bank credit provision in a regression discontinuity framework to analyse counterparties’ behavioural responses to the (non-)receipt of liquidity during a crisis. In spring 1847, the Bank of England suddenly started rationing credit to avoid violating its gold reserve requirement. We show that counterparties that suffered rejection from the Bank were more likely to fail. Conditional on survival, rationed counterparties learned from their experience and changed their behaviour during a subsequent panic in fall 1847: they came to the discount window more often, but submitted smaller requests and relied less on central bank liquidity overall.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个固定规则在断点回归框架中约束中央银行信贷提供，以分析交易对手在危机期间对（未）获得流动性的行为反应。在1847年春季，英格兰银行突然开始配给信贷以避免违反其黄金储备要求。我们表明，遭受银行拒绝的交易对手更可能倒闭。在生存条件下，被配给的交易对手从他们的经历中学习，并在1847年秋季的后续恐慌中改变了他们的行为：他们更频繁地来到贴现窗口，但提交的请求更小，并且总体上减少了对中央银行流动性的依赖。

records.title_en: Efficiency vs. equity as China's national carbon market meets provincial electricity markets
records.title_cn: 效率与公平：中国全国碳市场与省级电力市场的交汇
records.abstract_en: Emissions reduction in the electricity sector is critical in achieving China's carbon neutrality target. While a national carbon trading market that covers the electricity sector has been established, its effectiveness depends on how this sector evolves into being a more integrated market. This study evaluated the impact of China's electricity market integration on the cost-effectiveness of carbon pricing. An integrated (regional electricity market) and a segmented (provincial electricity market) market scenario were used to identify possible reform paths going forward. Using high-frequency datasets of the five southern provinces in 2018, we assessed the impact of electricity market integration on the abatement potential and cost-effectiveness of carbon pricing. We found that carbon prices need to be as high as 200 yuan/ton to begin achieving overall carbon reduction. In this context, the regional market is more cost-effective in reducing emissions than the provincial one, as the abatement costs are saved by around 60% compared to the latter under the same emission reduction targets. However, the regional market may also raise potential equity issues. The provincial-level distribution of carbon emission reductions, as well as the withdrawal of coal power, are more concentrated in the regional market than in the provincial one, which indicates an inequitable social-economic-environmental impacts of market integration. Our research findings would help to improve policymakers' understanding of the interaction between carbon pricing and electricity market reforms. This would then assist them in coordinating an effective design of both the carbon and electricity markets, in addition to supporting China's carbon neutrality target.
records.abstract_cn: 电力部门的减排对于实现中国的碳中和目标至关重要。虽然覆盖电力部门的全国碳排放交易市场已经建立，但其有效性取决于该部门如何演变为一个更加一体化的市场。本研究评估了中国电力市场一体化对碳定价成本效益的影响。采用一体化（区域电力市场）和分割（省级电力市场）两种市场情景，以确定未来可能的改革路径。利用2018年南方五省的高频数据集，我们评估了电力市场一体化对碳定价的减排潜力和成本效益的影响。我们发现，碳价格需要高达200元/吨才能开始实现整体碳减排。在此背景下，区域市场在减排方面比省级市场更具成本效益，因为在相同的减排目标下，其减排成本比后者节省约60%。然而，区域市场也可能引发潜在的公平问题。省级层面的碳减排分布以及煤电退出在区域市场中比在省级市场中更为集中，这表明市场一体化带来了不公平的社会-经济-环境影响。我们的研究结果将有助于提高政策制定者对碳定价与电力市场改革之间相互作用的理解。这将有助于他们协调设计碳市场和电力市场的有效方案，同时支持中国的碳中和目标。

records.title_en: Residential responses to service-specific electricity demand: Case of China
records.title_cn: 住宅对特定服务电力需求响应：以中国为例
records.abstract_en: Understanding the diversity of the residential demand for various electrical services is critical for utilities and policymakers in conducting effective demand side management and narrowing urban-rural inequality. Previous research has usually treated the household as a unit of analysis, and thus may have ignored the fact that household electricity consumption is derived demand driven by specific services, which fails to examine the heterogeneous behavioral responses. Therefore, this paper presents a new pattern of residential demand for various electrical services and quantifies the impacts of socioeconomic determinants in China. The conditional demand analysis is performed on the unique dataset of the Chinese Residential Energy Consumption Survey of 2014 to estimate the electricity demand distribution in eight types of services and to investigate the effect of socioeconomic variables on service-specific electricity consumption. The results show that, together, entertainment and food refrigeration account for about half of the total annual electricity consumption, followed by laundry, lighting, space cooling, and hot water. Rural households use about 7.2% of total electricity for cooking purposes, while urban counterparts hardly use electricity to cook at all. Electricity consumption for space heating is negligible for both urban and rural households. Heterogeneity in socioeconomic determinants is found not only among different electrical services but also between urban and rural households.
records.abstract_cn: 理解住宅对各种电力服务需求的多样性对于公用事业和政策制定者进行有效的需求侧管理和缩小城乡不平等至关重要。以往研究通常将家庭作为分析单位，因此可能忽视了家庭电力消费是由特定服务驱动的派生需求这一事实，未能考察异质性的行为响应。因此，本文提出了中国住宅对各种电力服务需求的新模式，并量化了社会经济决定因素的影响。基于中国居民能源消费调查2014的独特数据集，采用条件需求分析，估计了八类服务的电力需求分布，并考察了社会经济变量对特定服务电力消费的影响。结果表明，娱乐和食品冷藏合计约占年总电力消费的一半，其次是洗衣、照明、空间制冷和热水。农村家庭用于烹饪的电力约占总电力的7.2%，而城市家庭几乎不使用电力烹饪。空间供暖的电力消费对城乡家庭而言均可忽略不计。社会经济决定因素的异质性不仅存在于不同电力服务之间，也存在于城乡家庭之间。

records.title_en: Short-term loans and Firms' high-quality innovation: Evidence from the access to patent-backed loans in China
records.title_cn: 短期贷款与企业高质量创新：来自中国专利质押贷款获取的证据
records.abstract_en: When obtaining short-term loans, an innovative firm tends to expand its production scale, thereby reallocating its R&D-related resources away from innovation. By exploiting the unique situation in China that patenting firms for the first time obtained short-term patent-backed loans (PBLs), we find that the PBL access negatively influences firms' propensities of producing high-quality innovation. Consistent with the R&D resource reallocation hypothesis, we find that this negative effect exists only among firms initially having invention patents; it is more pronounced when the PBL covers a larger portion of firm investment and when these firms expand more aggressively. We confirm the scale expansion effect by finding that the PBL access positively influences firms' subsequent size.
records.abstract_cn: 在获得短期贷款时，创新型企业倾向于扩大生产规模，从而将其研发相关资源从创新活动中重新分配。利用中国首次获得短期专利质押贷款（PBL）的专利企业的独特情况，我们发现PBL获取对企业产生高质量创新的倾向产生负面影响。与研发资源重新分配假说一致，我们发现这种负面影响仅存在于最初拥有发明专利的企业中；当PBL覆盖企业投资的较大比例以及这些企业更积极地扩张时，这种影响更为显著。我们通过发现PBL获取对企业后续规模产生正面影响，证实了规模扩张效应。

records.title_en: Is the People's Bank of China consistent in words and deeds?
records.title_cn: 中国人民银行言行一致吗？
records.abstract_en: The People's Bank of China (PBC) now frequently uses communication as a policy tool. Whether its words are consistent with its deeds is important for the public to understand the PBC's complex behavior. In this paper, we employ a supervised learning model to construct monetary policy (MP) and economic outlook (EC) communication indices based on the outlook section of quarterly China Monetary Policy Reports (MPRs). We find that the PBC not only adjusts its interventions according to the corresponding economic situation, but also takes into account the information released in the previous outlook section, which indicates its consistency in words and deeds. Using a time-varying parameter model, we further find that the PBC's consistency of words and deeds has made progress over time. The PBC tends to be more consistent in words and deeds under higher uncertainty, and the improvement of such consistency can significantly decrease disagreement about inflation expectations. An additional analysis shows that the full text of MPRs can help predict future monetary policies on a longer time horizon.
records.abstract_cn: 中国人民银行（PBC）现在经常使用沟通作为政策工具。其言论是否与行动一致，对于公众理解PBC的复杂行为至关重要。在本文中，我们采用监督学习模型，基于季度《中国货币政策执行报告》（MPRs）中的展望部分构建货币政策（MP）和经济展望（EC）沟通指数。我们发现，PBC不仅根据相应的经济形势调整其干预措施，还考虑先前展望部分发布的信息，这表明其言行一致。使用时变参数模型，我们进一步发现PBC的言行一致性随时间取得了进展。在不确定性较高的情况下，PBC倾向于更加言行一致，而这种一致性的提高可以显著降低通胀预期的分歧。额外分析表明，MPRs的全文有助于在更长的时间范围内预测未来的货币政策。

records.title_en: Local guarantees and SOE bond pricing in China
records.title_cn: 地方担保与中国国有企业债券定价
records.abstract_en: We study the changing landscape of credit market guarantees by examining the risk-pricing of the Chinese state-owned enterprise (SOE) bonds, which have experienced rising defaults across provinces from a zero record. Using primary market bond issuance data, we identify a province premium that captures the perceived local government support for local SOEs. We find that on average the perceived local government support is on the decline, while the subnational debt market has become more segmented since 2018. This evidence is found to be closely related to the divergence in local government’s fiscal space and the occurrence of SOE default incidents in the area, highlighting the adverse linkage between public debt and corporate financing costs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察中国国有企业债券的风险定价来研究信贷市场担保格局的变化，这些债券从零违约记录到各省违约事件不断上升。利用一级市场债券发行数据，我们识别出一个省份溢价，该溢价捕捉了市场感知的地方政府对当地国有企业的支持程度。我们发现，平均而言，感知到的地方政府支持正在下降，而自2018年以来，地方债务市场变得更加分割。这一证据被发现与地方政府财政空间的分化以及该地区国有企业违约事件的发生密切相关，凸显了公共债务与企业融资成本之间的不利联系。

records.title_en: The Belt, the Road, and the carbon emissions in China
records.title_cn: 一带一路与中国碳排放
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the effect of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) on China's exports and the domestic carbon emissions induced by the exports. We employ a decomposition framework to assess the driving factors of the change of CO2 emissions induced by China's exports to different destinations and evaluate the main contributions of the gap between the BRI countries and non-BRI (NBRI) countries. The decomposition results show that while the scale effect was the dominant force behind the pre-BRI emission growth, the contribution of the composition effect became more prominent after the inception of the Initiative. Our econometric analysis suggests that the Initiative leads to an increase in the share of carbon-intensive products in China's exports to the BRI countries by nearly 5 percentage points, which is approximately one quarter of the share of carbon-intensive exports to the BRI countries. A further investigation reveals that China's international project contracting is the main channel that has resulted in the increase of the share of carbon-intensive exports in China's exports to the BRI countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了一带一路倡议对中国出口及出口引致的国内碳排放的影响。我们采用分解框架评估中国对不同目的地出口引致碳排放变化的驱动因素，并评估一带一路国家与非一带一路国家之间差距的主要贡献。分解结果表明，虽然规模效应是一带一路倡议前排放增长的主导力量，但倡议启动后，结构效应的贡献变得更加突出。我们的计量经济分析表明，该倡议导致中国对一带一路国家出口中碳密集型产品份额增加了近5个百分点，这大约占对一带一路国家碳密集型出口份额的四分之一。进一步调查显示，中国的国际项目承包是导致中国对一带一路国家出口中碳密集型出口份额增加的主要渠道。

records.title_en: Income inequality and educational expenditures on children: Evidence from the China Family Panel Studies
records.title_cn: 收入不平等与子女教育支出：来自中国家庭追踪调查的证据
records.abstract_en: Using the data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2010 to 2018, we find that rising income inequality causes parents to spend more on children’s education, both in school and out of school. The impact of income inequality on out-of-school expenditures is significant at intensive and extensive margins, especially for study-related tutoring participation. Furthermore, we find some empirical evidence suggesting that in response to rising inequality, mothers spend more time on children’s education and there exists a substitution effect between time and money. Further analysis suggests two potential reasons for the rising education spending: (1) a higher income inequality resulting from rising skill premium strengthens parents’ long-lasting cultural attitude towards education to higher levels, inducing them to spend more on educational investment, and (2) a higher income inequality increases the value of higher education, leading to a stronger demand for better educational opportunities, and then, more intense education competition, forcing parents to invest more in education.
records.abstract_cn: 利用2010年至2018年中国家庭追踪调查的数据，我们发现收入不平等加剧导致父母在子女教育上花费更多，无论是在校内还是校外。收入不平等对校外支出的影响在集约边际和广延边际上均显著，尤其是对与学习相关的补习参与。此外，我们发现一些经验证据表明，面对不平等加剧，母亲在子女教育上花费更多时间，并且时间与金钱之间存在替代效应。进一步分析揭示了教育支出上升的两个潜在原因：（1）技能溢价上升导致的收入不平等加剧，强化了父母对教育的持久文化态度，促使他们增加教育投资；（2）收入不平等加剧提高了高等教育的价值，导致对更好教育机会的需求增强，进而加剧教育竞争，迫使父母增加教育投入。

records.title_en: Using green technology for a better tomorrow: How enterprises and government utilize the carbon trading system and incentive policies
records.title_cn: 利用绿色技术创造更美好的明天：企业与政府如何运用碳交易体系和激励政策
records.abstract_en: This unique study focuses on how the carbon trading system (CTS), stakeholder concerns and innovation incentive policies all combine to effect enterprises' green technology innovation. Using a three-dimension system, this study includes green output level, green output proportion and green total factor productivity. Utilizing a DID model of an unbalanced panel, we investigate how government and enterprise work together better to achieve carbon emission targets. The main findings are as follows: (1) Enterprises are displaying a high level of concern with environmental information disclosure and therefore their CTS will have a more significant impact on green technology output and the proportion of this green output. In contrast, government concerns about decarbonization with CTS have uncertain effects on the three dimensions of green technology innovation. (2) CTS Fiscal subsidies and R&D funding are strong ways to improve enterprises' green technology output. However, the best way to improve green technology output, green output proportion and green total factor productivity is with tax returns. When tax returns increase 1%, the green output level increases 1.5% under the CTS. (3) This study, utilizing data from the impact of different implementation modes of innovations incentive policies, shows that inclusive innovation policies make CTS's combined effects more significant than differentiated policies.
records.abstract_cn: 这项独特的研究聚焦于碳交易体系（CTS）、利益相关者关注和创新激励政策如何共同影响企业的绿色技术创新。通过一个三维体系，本研究包括绿色产出水平、绿色产出比例和绿色全要素生产率。利用非平衡面板的双重差分模型，我们探讨了政府和企业如何更好地合作以实现碳排放目标。主要发现如下：（1）企业对环境信息披露表现出高度关注，因此其碳交易体系对绿色技术产出及绿色产出比例的影响更为显著。相比之下，政府对碳交易体系脱碳化的关注对绿色技术创新的三个维度具有不确定的影响。（2）碳交易体系的财政补贴和研发资金是提高企业绿色技术产出的有力途径。然而，改善绿色技术产出、绿色产出比例和绿色全要素生产率的最佳方式是税收返还。当税收返还增加1%时，在碳交易体系下绿色产出水平增加1.5%。（3）本研究利用不同实施模式的创新激励政策影响数据表明，包容性创新政策使碳交易体系的综合效应比差异化政策更为显著。

records.title_en: Marginal returns on Chinese agricultural technology transfer in Nigeria: Who benefits more?
records.title_cn: 中国农业技术转让在尼日利亚的边际回报：谁受益更多？
records.abstract_en: Agricultural technology transfers are generally considered an effective means of solving persistently low yields in sub-Saharan Africa. This study assesses the impact of the Chinese agricultural training program on farmers' productivity and income using ex-post non-experimental data from Ogun State, Nigeria. Our empirical approach is based on marginal treatment effect models. We find that the returns for individuals who participated in Chinese agricultural technology training indicated a 68.5% increase in yield and a 45.3% increase in agricultural income. Furthermore, we show that the program targets farmers from advantaged backgrounds, who may benefit less from attending the program than disadvantaged farmers, who experience a lower incentive to participate. Finally, we suggest sufficient awareness and incentives to encourage highly resistant farmers to participate in such programmes.
records.abstract_cn: 农业技术转让通常被认为是解决撒哈拉以南非洲持续低产出的有效手段。本研究利用尼日利亚奥贡州的非实验性事后数据，评估了中国农业培训项目对农民生产力和收入的影响。我们的实证方法基于边际处理效应模型。我们发现，参加中国农业技术培训的个体的回报显示产量增加了68.5%，农业收入增加了45.3%。此外，我们表明该项目针对的是来自优势背景的农民，他们从参加该项目中获得的收益可能少于劣势农民，而劣势农民参与的动力较低。最后，我们建议提供充分的意识和激励措施，以鼓励高度抵触的农民参与此类项目。

records.title_en: Women's education and fertility in China
records.title_cn: 中国女性教育与生育
records.abstract_en: Using data from the China Family Panel Studies, this paper exploits the Compulsory Education Law of China implemented in the 1980s to empirically examine the causal impact of women's education on fertility in rural China by difference-in-differences methods. The results show that an additional year of schooling lowered the number of children a woman would have by approximately 0.09 children, postponed the age of first childbirth by 0.7 years, and reduced the probability of having a second child or more children by 0.18 among those mothers whose first child was a girl. In addition to the income effect, these results are also partly explained by more educated women preferring quality to quantity of children, placing a greater value on leisure and no longer perceiving children as the sole focus in their lives.
records.abstract_cn: 利用中国家庭追踪调查数据，本文借助中国于1980年代实施的《义务教育法》，通过双重差分方法实证检验了女性教育对中国农村生育的因果影响。结果表明，额外一年的教育使女性生育子女数减少约0.09个，将首次生育年龄推迟0.7年，并在首胎为女孩的母亲中，使生育二胎及以上子女的概率降低0.18。除收入效应外，这些结果还部分归因于受教育程度较高的女性更注重子女质量而非数量，更重视闲暇，且不再将子女视为生活的唯一重心。

records.title_en: The health impacts of two policies regulating SO2 air pollution: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 两项管制SO2空气污染政策对健康的影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: In developing countries widespread air pollution poses a major threat to public health calling for effective environmental regulation. This paper adds to the limited literature on the health impact of different environmental regulations. Using data from eight waves of the China Health and Nutrition Survey (1993–2015), we employ a difference-in-differences model to investigate the health impact of two policies combatting SO2 air pollution: the command-and-control environmental regulation represented by the Two Control Zones (TCZ) and the market-oriented environmental regulation represented by the SO2 Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS).
